From the developments observed so far it is estimated that the realization of the final objectives of the ESAF programme for 1999 is practically achieved. In all, it is deemed that the economic growth agency will be realized, the three quantitative targets that the Bank of Albania pursues in relation to monetary policy will be achieved, the limits set for the budget deficit and financing with its internal sources will be achieved, the level of annual inflation at the end of the year will be well below the established target and the korean account deficit in relation to GDP is expected to have a level More optimistic than anticipated. I can already say with full conviction that in all the events of the April-June period this year, they did not worsen the economic situation as we predicted at the beginning of the conflict. The immediate and generous assistance of the International Community eased the burden that was created. On the other hand, the turn that events took opened up other prospects for Albania from an economic development point of view. It is more than enough to mention the Stability Pact for the Balkan region as well as the creation of new space for economic activity in the North of the Republic of Albania. The relative macroeconomic and political stability achieved during these two years should serve us as the basis to look more optimistically at 2000. These ideas materialize the targets set for next year. Also, attention in the future should be focused on those issues that have found no solution to date and pose a threat to the country's stability. According to this data, December is characterized by higher rate increases in currency deposits versus deposits in money in the system. Muz and Eduk " Head / Press / Speeches, interviews, articles / Speeches Press releases Notices of # meetings of Council Supervisor Press conference Speeches, interview articles Speeches Interview of articles Calendars # Official holiday calendar for 2022 COVID-19 Europe # BANK OF ALBANIA Presentation of the Bank of Albania's 1999 Annual Report Publication date: 04.05.2000 The Bank of Albania's Annual Report, which is already in your hands, details developments in the Albanian economy, monetary and currency exchange, bank supervision, the payment system and the central bank institution itself. After the crisis that passed the country in the first half of 1997 and the successful implementation of the country's six-month stabilisation programme, Albania signed the ESAF2 agreement with the IMF. The central elements of this agreement were again ensuring a rapid growth of the country's economy, lowering inflation, disciplining fiscal developments to reduce the budget deficit, especially that financed with internal resources, developing institutional reforms to consolidate any achievements in the macroeconomic field, as well as improving the legislative and regulatory framework. In 1998 economic developments were within the defined objectives. In all, the quantitative targets set were achieved. Better discipline of fiscal developments was provided, first expressed in respecting the limits set for the budget deficit. Above all, inflation reduction was achieved from 42 percent at the end of 1997 to 8.7 percent, less than the target set at the end of 1998. In this reduction, there is undoubtedly a significant contribution of monetary policy, tight and prudent, implemented by the Bank of Albania. We can say that 1998 serves as the starting point of the country's economic recovery. N vitin 1998 zhvillimet ekonomike ishin brenda objektivave t prcaktuar. N trsi u realizuan objektivat sasior t vendosur. U sigurua nj disiplinim m i mir i zhvillimeve fiskale, i shprehur s pari n respektimin e kufijve t vendosur pr deficitin buxhetor. N kt reduktim, pa dyshim, ka nj kontribut t rndsishm politika monetare, e shtrnguar dhe e matur, e zbatuar nga Banka e Shqipris. BANK OF ALBANIA Opening word at the First National Conference of Statistical Information in Albania, Tirana, 23 December 2000. Publication date: 02.12.2000 If the world were to shrink as much as a village and the population of the world would be reduced to 100 inhabitants, maintaining all the reports that exist today, then: The village would have 57 Asians, 21 Europeans, 14 inhabitants from the Western Hemisphere, south and north together, 8 Africans. There would be 52 women and 48 males in the village.  1/5 06/08/2022, 09:10 Opening word at the First National Conference of Statistical Information in Albania, Tirana, 23 December 2000. Of the inhabitants of village 70 would be colored and 30 white. Their faith would be for 30 people and for the other 70 non-believers. Only 6 inhabitants of the village would possess 59 per cent of the entire wealth of this world And all six would be from the United States. 80 people would reside at home with substandard conditions. Sadder, 70 residents wouldn't know how to read, 50 people would suffer from it Poor nutrition and 1, only 1, would have higher education. Likewise, only 1 person will He had a computer. In the village there would be 1 person near death, but also 1 near the east. Good morning, I just read you this statistical information in the field of demographics. The pleasant information, although at first glance, resembles a sad picture of today's realities of global demographics, presents the situation in which the world's population is today, reports between racial, religious groups, the situation of ownership, nutrition, educational level and population change. On the basis of this information, decisions can be made for the future to improve these reports. With these sentences, any comment on these demographic statistics presented would begin. But today we have gathered not to discuss or comment on demographic statistics, nor fiscal or monetary and banking statistics. In these two days, the Statistical Information in Albania conference will be held, which I have the honour of opening. Discussions will focus on the state of statistical information in our country. The "Statistical Information in Albania" conference is the first of its kind, organized as a co-operation of the Bank of Albania with the Institute of Statistics. Let me thank you, on behalf of both institutions for your participation and for the interest shown. Let's hope even the organizers of this conference won't let you down. Why was a statistics conference organised at a time when the Albanian economy could have other even more important problems? Why is the Bank of Albania at the centre of an activity on statistics and not a conference on inflation or the exchange rate? What contribution will this conference provide for the development of statistics? I found the answer to these questions by reviewing The Economist magazine in which I read: "Statistics can be worse even than lies themselves. But for central bankers they are the same as the facts for the judges." Having statistics, even good statistics, is a fundamental condition for drafting the right macroeconomic and financial policies. This is a conclusion long reached by others and proven in its accuracy. In Albania, we have an as yet undeveloped data collection, processing and reporting system. The state of statistics, in general, is considered miserable. The statistics problems concern the total absence of one or several statistical categories, the existence of poor statistics, the reporting of unquality data and with a lot of delay that are often also contradictory as well as their minimal publication.  2/5 06/08/2022, 09:10 Opening word at the First National Conference of Statistical Information in Albania, Tirana, 23 December 2000. This state of statistical information prevents the understanding of the country's economy, prevents accurate and complete analysis of it, makes it impossible to carry out predictions, as well as compromises the decision-making process. In this kind of situation Albanian institutions, especially those dealing with the economy, are in difficult positions to fulfill their duties. If I were to express myself figuratively, as Governor of the Bank of Albania, I would say that I am not fully convinced if in monetary policy decisions this institution acted as "a fair and impartial judge who makes a decision on the basis of true and complete facts". The facts that serve the statistical system currently "standing up" in Albania are no guarantee of making right decisions. This situation and the difficulties we face daily as producers and statistics users were concreted in the common idea of the Bank of Albania and INSTAT to organise a conference to address this problem. No one should think that organizing the conference will lead to solving all the problems we are facing. Its aim is to sensitize opinion on the importance of statistics for a state, an institution, a business, a family, even an individual. The conference seeks to attract the attention of all groups that, one way or another, need statistics on their situation and explain how useful it is to invest in their development. For this reason, as presented during the two days of the conference, the referents will broadly address the problems that exist in this area. It is for this reason that even the conference audience is broad and includes governments, state institutions, business representatives or academics. Statistics in Albania in these years have had considerable development and this cannot be denied. Especially important are efforts to approach them with international standards. A lot of projects have been drafted and implemented to achieve this. Others are under way to implement or draft. It is enough to mention the fact that Albania has been chosen by the IMF as a pilot country for the implementation of the Overall Data Distribution System and has received positive assessments for the current performance of the implementation of this system. But let me focus today on some shortcomings that still have the statistical system in our country. Albania lacks the national accounting system. Part of the reported data, including PPB, is estimates and not factual measurements. The methodologies used to measure certain indicators are either inaccurate or outdated. Just mention the ICK measurement. Statistical information is timely and in the areas it covers. For example, the private sector in significant parts of it is not reported and consequently there is no data for it. A large part of the economy remains unseen. This restriction is added to the time series, dating back to the early 1990s Statistical information has still remained "locked in safes". A lot of data or indicators are not published. The rate of exchange of statistical information is low. Calling in help with expressions Mathematical i would say that "This statement is true for public and private subjects, for state institutions and individuals. In other words, this statement is proven throughout community." I don't overthink it when I say there are state institutions, which refuse to give it data even when they are not classified as secret data. On the other hand, there is distrust of the sector private and individuals in the statement of data, which are required by INSTAT or institutions, which the law gives them this right. As well as their co-operation in the surveys Statistically, when confidentiality is guaranteed, is minimal. All these shortcomings listed above limit our vision for the state of the economy the country, after leaving out entire parts of it. But they also offer a relativeview of Distorted for the part that arrives in the morning. Unfortunately, from this situation we are damaged to Everybody. First, the Government and public institutions cannot provide the information necessary for full and accurate evaluation and for making as fair and useful decisions as possible. Second, private business faces decisions that may be harmful to him, but at the same time, he himself does not have the means to help him analyze and develop successful enterprises. Finally, every family, and even every individual, is limited to its activity due to the lack of infotainment, missing many opportunities. We can count a lot of deficiencies and other damage. The references to this conference will create a fuller and clearer vision. They will also list rational and useful proposals to improve this situation. I want to stop at three elements, which I trust as important in improving statistics: Investment in the field of statistics. We have become familiar with the demands for increased foreign investment, increased private or public investment. This time serious investment is required, especially from the Government, in the field of statistics. Their development needs to be included in the priority list. Transparency in reporting statistical information. More data needs to be published and reported. This data should be made available to more users. Education of information-offering subjects. Individuals, businesses, institutions and any other subject need to understand that they are not harmed by the statement of information. Rather, the will to cooperate in exchanging information helps him and others to better decisions. Thanking you for your attention, I invite you to reflect on these issues and discuss offering as rational thoughts and proposals as possible for the development of statistics. Every contribution of yours is welcome and useful. Thank you!  4/5 06/08/2022, 09:10 Opening word at the First National Conference of Statistical Information in Albania, Tirana, 23 December 2000.  5/5

Konferenca "Informacioni statistikor n Shqipri" sht e para e ktij lloji, q organizohet si nj bashkpunim i Banks s Shqipris me Institutin e Statistikave. M lejoni t'ju falenderoj, n emr t t dy institucioneve pr pjesmarrjen tuaj dhe pr interesin e treguar. T shpresojm q edhe organizuesit e ksaj konference nuk do t'ju zhgnjejn. Prse u organizua nj konferenc pr statistikat, n nj koh kur ekonomia shqiptare mund t ket probleme t tjera edhe m t rndsishme? Prse Banka e Shqipris sht n qendr t nj aktiviteti mbi statistikat dhe jo t nj konference mbi inflacionin apo kursin e kmbimit ? far kontributi do t siguroj kjo konferenc pr zhvillimin e statistikave ? Prgjigjen e ktyre pyetjeve e gjeta duke shfletuar revistn "The Economist" n t ciln lexova : "Statistikat mund t jen m t kqija edhe se vet gnjeshtrat. Por, pr bankiert qendror ato jan njsoj si jan faktet pr gjykatsit". T kesh statistika, madje statistika t mira, sht nj kusht themelor pr hartimin e politikave t duhura makroekonomike dhe financiare. Ky sht nj konkluzion i arritur prej kohsh prej t tjerve dhe i provuar n saktsin e tij. N Shqipri, kemi nj sistem grumbullimi, prpunimi dhe raportimi t dhnash ende t pazhvilluar. Gjendja e statistikave, n prgjithsi, vlersohet e mjerueshme. Problemet e statistikave kan t bjn me mungesn totale t nj apo disa kategorive statistikore, ekzistencn e statistikave t varfra, raportimin e t dhnave jocilsore dhe me mjaft vones q shpesh jan edhe kontradiktore si dhe publikimin minimal t tyre. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_hapjes_ne_Konferencen_e_Pare_Kombetare_Informacioni_statis 2/5 06/08/2022, 09:10 Fjala e hapjes n Konferencn e Par Kombtare ''Informacioni statistikor n Shqipri'', Tiran, 2-3 dhjetor 2000. Kjo gjendje e informacionit statistikor pengon t kuptuarin e ekonomis s vendit, pengon analizimin e sakt e t plot t saj, bn t pamundur kryerjen e parashikimeve si dhe kompromenton procesin vendimmarrs. N kt lloj situate institucionet shqiptare, sidomos ato q merren me ekonomin, jan n pozita t vshtira pr t prmbushur detyrat e tyre. Nse do t shprehesha n mnyr figurative, si Guvernator i Banks s Shqipris, do t thoja se nuk jam plotsisht i bindur nse n vendimet pr politikn monetare ky institucion ka vepruar si "nj gjykats i drejt dhe i paanshm q merr vendim mbi bazn e fakteve t vrteta e t plota". Faktet q servir sistemi statistikor q aktualisht "qndron n kmb" n Shqipri nuk jan garanci pr marrje vendimesh t drejta. Kjo gjendje dhe vshtirsit q hasim prdit si prodhues dhe prdorues statistikash u konkretizuan n iden e prbashkt t Banks s Shqipris dhe INSTAT-it pr t organizuar nj konferenc q t trajtoj kt problem. Askush nuk duhet t mendoj se organizimi i konferencs do t oj n zgjidhjen e t gjitha problemeve q po hasim. Qllimi i saj sht t sensibilizoj opinionin mbi rndsin q kan statistikat pr nj shtet, nj institucion, nj biznes, nj familje madje edhe pr nj individ. Konferenca krkon t trheq vmendjen e t gjitha grupeve q, n nj mnyr apo n nj tjetr, kan nevoj pr statistikat mbi gjendjen e tyre dhe t shpjegoj se sa e dobishme sht t investohet pr zhvillimin e tyre. Pr kt arsye, si do t paraqitet gjat dy ditve t konferencs, referuesit do t trajtojn gjersisht problemet q ekzistojn n kt fush. sht po pr kt arsye q edhe auditori i konferencs sht i gjer dhe prfshin qeveritar, institucione shtetrore, prfaqsues biznesi apo akademik. Statistikat n Shqipri n kto vite kan patur zhvillim t konsiderueshm dhe kjo nuk mund t mohohet. Sidomos t rndsishme jan prpjekjet pr prafrimin e tyre me standardet ndrkombtare. Pr t arritur kt jan hartuar dhe zbatuar mjaft projekte. T tjera jan n proces zbatimi apo hartimi. Mjafton t prmend faktin q Shqipria sht zgjedhur prej FMN-s si nj vend pilot pr zbatimin e Sistemit t Shprndarjes s t Dhnave t Pgjithshme dhe ka marr vlersime pozitive pr ecurin e deritanishme t zbatimit t ktij sistemi. Por, m lejoni q sot t prqendrohem n disa mangsi q ende ka sistemi statistikor n vendin ton. Shqipris i mungon sistemi i llogarive kombtare. Nj pjes e t dhnave t raportuara, prfshi PPB, jan vlersime dhe jo matje faktike. Metodologjit e prdorura pr matjen e disa treguesve jan ose t pasakta ose t vjetruara. Mjafton t prmend matjen e IK. Informacioni statistikor sht i cunguar n koh dhe n fushat q ai mbulon. Pr shembull, sektori privat n pjes t konsiderueshme t tij nuk raportohet dhe pr pasoj nuk ka t dhna pr t. Nj pjes e madhe e ekonomis mbetet e paevidentuar. Ktij kufizimi i shtohen serit kohore, q datojn n fillim t viteve '9 Informacioni statistikor ende ka mbetur "i mbyllur n kasaforta". Mjaft t dhna apo tregues nuk publikohen. Edhe ato q publikohen arrijn me vones tek prdoruesit e tyre ose jan privilegj i nj numri t kufizuar prdoruesish. httpsS:/h/wkwwl.lbankofahlbaknia.orbg/iShtiypi/Fjaliimef_intervistai_artiikuj/Fjalimi e/Fikjala_e_hahpjes_ne_KlonfereDncekn_e_Phaire_Kombetared_Iinhformaciohni_statihsj 3/5 06/08/2022, 09:10 Fjala e hapjes n Konferencn e Par Kombtare ''Informacioni statistikor n Shqipri'', Tiran, 2-3 dhjetor 2000. Shkalla e shkmbimit t informacionit statistikor sht e ult. Duke thirrur n ndihm shprehjet matematikore do t thoja se "Ky pohim sht i vrtet pr subjekte publike dhe private, pr institucione shtetrore dhe individ. Me fjal t tjera, ky pohim vrtetohet n t gjith bashksin.". Nuk e teproj kur them se ka institucione shtetrore, t cilat refuzojn t japin t dhna edhe kur ato nuk klasifikohen si t dhna sekret. Nga ana tjetr, ka mosbesim t sektorit privat dhe t individve n deklarimin e t dhnave, q krkohen prej INSTAT-it apo institucioneve, q ligji ua jep kt t drejt. Po ashtu edhe bashkpunimi i tyre n vrojtimet statistikore, kur garantohet ruajtja e konfidencialitetit, sht minimal. T gjitha kto mangsi t renditura m sipr kufizojn vizionin ton pr gjendjen e ekonomis s vendit, pasi ln jasht pjes t tra t saj. Por, ato ofrojn dhe nj pamje relativisht t shtrembruar edhe pr pjesn q arrijn t matin. Pr fat t keq, prej ksaj situate dmtohemi t gjith. S pari, Qeveria dhe institucionet publike nuk sigurojn dot informacionin e nevojshm pr vlersim t plot e t sakt dhe pr marrje vendimesh sa m t drejta e t dobishme. S dyti, biznesi privat ballafaqohet me vendime q mund t jen t dmshme pr t, por, njkohsisht, edhe ai vet nuk ka n dor mjetet q e ndihmojn t analizoj dhe t zhvilloj siprmarrje t suksesshme. S fundi, do familje, e madje do individ, kufizohet n aktivitetin e tij pr shkak t mungess s infomacionit duke humbur mjaft mundsi. Mund t numrojm mjaft mangsi dhe dme t tjera. Referuesit n kt konferenc do t krijojn nj vizion m t plot e m t qart. Ata, gjithashtu, do t rendisin dhe propozime racionale e t dobishme pr t prmirsuar kt situat. Un dua t ndalem n tre elemente, t cilat i besoj si t rndsishme n prmirsimin e statistikave: Investim n fushn e statistikave. Jemi familjarizuar me krkesat pr rritje investimesh t huaja, rritje investimesh private apo publike. Kt her krkohet investim serioz, sidomos i Qeveris, n fushn e statistikave. Zhvillimi i tyre ka nevoj t prfshihet n listn e prioriteteve. Transparenc n raportimin e informacionit statistikor. M tepr t dhna ka nevoj t publikohen dhe t raportohen. Kto t dhna duhet t vihen n dispozicion t m shum prdoruesve. Edukim i subjekteve ofruese t informacionit. Individt, bizneset, institucionet dhe do subjekt tjetr kan nevoj t kuptojn se nuk dmtohen nga deklarimi i informacionit. Prkundrazi, vullneti pr t bashkpunuar n shkmbimin e informacionit ndihmon at dhe t tjert pr vendime m t mira. Duke ju falenderuar pr vmendjen tuaj, ju ftoj t reflektoni pr kto shtje dhe t diskutojm pr t ofruar mendime dhe propozime sa m racionale pr zhvillimin e statistikave. do kontribut i juaji sht i mirpritur dhe i dobishm. Its opening near the Bank of Albania was not random. As in all Central and Eastern European countries, with a similar past to Albania, the state was the main proponent and supporter of the creation of scholarships. But in Albania a different model was followed by the experience of all these countries, as it was decided that the Tirana Stock Exchange would be created under the management of the Central Bank, and this for these reasons: lack of a previous tradition in this direction; limited range of financial instruments; a weaker private sector than in other Central and Eastern European countries, therefore, the lack of shares and titles from the private sector; failure to start privatising strategic enterprises yet; the small chances of securing, within a short-term period, the economic efficiency of this new institution; lack of experts and sufficient experience, outside state institutions of the financial sphere (in our case the Bank of Albania). Aware that the activity of this Stock Exchange, for a medium-term period would not be stock trading, the Government, in co-operation with the Bank of Albania and the Value Letters Commission decided to organise the primary and secondary treasury bond market near the Tirana Stock Exchange. Publication date: 20.03.2001 The performance of the banking system in Albania and the privatisation process of state-owned banks. Under this subject Minister Angelius and I thought we would invite you to a colleagues' discussion on issues of reform of the banking system and especially for an important element of this reform, the privatisation of state-owned banks. The year 2000 is the third consecutive year during which the country's macroeconomic situation is within the frameworks of the medium-term development programme. The implementation of this programme has ensured macroeconomic sustainability by creating premise to support long-term development and to have opportunities to design development strategies for the particular sectors of the country's economy, strengthen institutions and engage in those aspects that constitute priority. Importantly, I would consider developments in the Albanian banking system where among the main ones I can mention: developments in the context of the implementation of monetary policy of the Bank of Albania, the addition of loans to the economy as well as the improvement of the situation of the system of commercial banks. In 2000 the Bank of Albania took all necessary measures to realize the transition from direct instruments to indirect monetary policy implementation instruments. It is well known that to give signals to the market, the central bank is no longer based on the credit limit or the minimum interest rate for term deposits in money. Both of these instruments have been "abolished". The role of reference or base rate already plays the interest rate of the bids for repurchase agreements. In this process the replacement of instruments the Bank of Albania acted prudently and managed to achieve its goals. But success was also helped by the relatively favourable economic environment created in the country, as well as better co-operation with the Ministry of Finance in the direction of managing Page 1 of 2 The 2001 challenge is called savings bank. 29/07/22, 15:08 the internal financing process of the budget deficit. The macroeconomic stability achieved and the need to ensure economic growth created the opportunity for the Bank of Albania to ease monetary policy for the third year continuously reducing interest rates. Overall, interest rates in the economy were lowered. These factors are estimated to have also influenced the increase in credit provided by the banking system for the economy. I am aware that the first reaction of any of us in the hall will be an ironic chuckle every time it is discussed for crediting the economy. But I cannot help but call development the fact that in 2000 the loan situation results three times more than in 1999; that new loans, during 2000, are almost as much surplus at the end of this and that considerable has been the level of loan write-offs. In 2000 the situation in the Albanian banking system was considered relatively safe and sound. Among the most important developments can be the expansion of the banking network, the change in the ownership structure of this system, the capitalization of the system as well as its financial situation. Publication date: 23.04.2001 Honourable gentlemen, deputies, The 2000 Annual Report presents the most important developments occurring during the year at the Bank of Albania and in the environment where it operates. The economic developments of 1998 and 1999 were in full in line with the directives of the country's three-year long-term development programme, defined in the ESAF2 agreement with the IMF, which was replaced in December 1999 with the PRGF agreement. The main goals of this program were to ensure a rapid economic growth, at 7-8 percent per year limits in low-level and stable storage conditions of consumer prices and to carry out institutional reforms to support the development of the economy. The targets for 2000 were determined, considering that this year would affect the deficiencies observed during the previous two years and the effect of the crisis in Kosovo would be extinguished. Also, the main goals were for this year to succeed in overcoming the most typical problems of previous years such as the low level of investment (foreign or domestic), the low level of privatisation of the economy and the development of structural reforms. Based on these considerations, the forecast for the country's real economic growth in 2000 was set at 7 percent; the target for year-over-year inflation was set at 2-4 percent limits; the total budget deficit at 9.4 percent of GDP, of which 4.3 percent of GDP would be financed with internal resources; While the level of currency reserves was predicted sufficient to cope with 4.6 months of imports of goods and services. Thus, the end of 2000 presents a slightly different view than forecasts. Read the governor's full word.  00_ne_Komisionin_e_Ekonomise_te_Financave_dhe_te_Privatizimit.html Page 2 of 2

To be honest, when I received the invitation to refer I thought: why is Albania elected, a small country, with an area of 28,000 km2, with about 3.1 million inhabitants, poor, with problems with order and corruption? Having these in mind I was drawn to a sentence written by Mr Robson: "Albania is a very interesting country". I would add that Albania is also a country of many possibilities. Being Albanian and living in Albania every day, with its many problems, I sometimes become pessimistic about the future of the country and feel difficulties in presenting these opportunities to foreigners. But I often remember the early 1990s and the change in the course of history for Albania and I am convinced that Albania has indeed had visible developments and has what to offer for foreign investors. Exim Bank's own interest is a test of this fact. At the meeting I had with Mrs. Vanessa Weaver a year ago at Exim Bank, it was not thought that this bank would have any rapid concrete activities in Albania. The main issue focusing attention was the discussion of the country's economic programme for 2002, as well as the medium-term strategy for the period 2002-2004. More specifically, the Bank of Albania's discussions with the mission focused on issues such as developments in production, consumer prices, the definition of the monetary programme, the Bank of Albania's policy on interest rates, developments in the banking system and the privatisation of the Savings Bank, as well as preparations for entry into circulation of the physical euro. Discussions were concluded for the final objectives of 2001 as well as the 2002 objectives. In general, it was concluded that even in 2001, the Albanian economy has walked within the programmed framework and is expected to ensure the achievement of the objectives. Publication date: 06.12.2001 The anniversary of membership in the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank more or less coincides with the first political decisions taken by Albanian authorities in the direction of putting under control the main indicators of the economy, which at the time we are referring were disfigured. Just as many of the witnesses in the hall may be witnesses, as a result of centralization  1/2 05/0A8/s2h2,t1u6:5s2ikurs a lot of PoplirticaanMisohnemtariet: nOne vesashltrimmanuanlitidk mtbei tjekna For decades Albania has been cut off from other European countries, even those of Central and Eastern Europe. Consequently, Albania found it completely unprepared to move into the market economy, which led to the destruction of the economy in much of it and a significant drop in living standards. In this situation, Albania was involved in a deep economic and financial crisis. From 1985 to 1992 it was the years of a rapid and pronounced decline in production, major macroeconomic, internal and external imbalances, of a general disorder in direction and infrastructure, of destruction of currency reserves as well as the creation of the country's foreign debt. In 1989 the country's total production had halved, while both industrial and agricultural production suffered sharp declines. Cereal production decreased to a second production in the 1980s. Thus, Albania from an exporting country of agricultural and beekeeping products returned to a country that, on a very high scale, depended on critical and urgent aid from abroad. The effects of this situation were immediately reflected in the unemployment indicators, which suffered significant increases especially in the industry. As a result, it brought the emigration of many Albanians, mainly to neighbouring countries. The country's financial situation deteriorated at rapid pace. This was accompanied by increases in nominal pay as well as payment in the form of assistance for non-functioning companies. Tax revenues fell from 42 percent of PBBs in 1990 to 28 percent of GDP in 1991 and still further, to 16 percent in the first half of 1992. The continued increase in the budget deficit and the lack of an adequate monetary policy led to the failure to control liquidity, inflation, savings and at a deeply negative interest rate level, in real terms. Reflecting all these problems, the shortage in supply of food products as well as measures to liberalize prices, during 1990-1991, inflation rose significantly, to over 100 percent passing about 15-20 percent per month during the beginning of 1992. In the situation when the official exchange rate was far from the exchange rate on the parallel market, currency reserves had fallen significantly and the trade balance had deteriorated considerably. Kshtu, Shqipria nga nj vend eksportues i prodhimeve bujqsore e blegtorale u kthye n nj vend q, n shkall shum t lart, varej nga ndihmat kritike dhe urgjente nga jasht. Efektet e ksaj situate u pasqyruan menjher n treguesit e papunsis, t cilt psuan rritje t ndjeshme veanrisht n industri. Si pasoj kjo solli emigrimin e shum shqiptarve, kryesisht n vendet fqinje. Gjendja financiare e vendit u keqsua me ritme t shpejta. Kjo u shoqrua me rritje t pags nominale si dhe t pagess n formn e asistencs pr ndrmarrjet q nuk funksiononin. T ardhurat nga taksat ran nga 42 pr qind t PBBs n vitin 1990 n 28 pr qind t PBB-s n vitin 1991 dhe ende m tej, n 16 pr qind n gjysmn e par t vitit 1992. Rritja e vazhdueshme e deficitit buxhetor dhe mungesa e nj politike monetare t prshtatshme uan n moskontrollin e likuiditeteve, t inflacionit, t kursimeve dhe n nj nivel thellsisht negativ t prqindjes s interesit, n terma real. Duke reflektuar gjith kto probleme, mungesn n furnizim me produkte ushqimore si dhe masat pr liberalizimin e mimeve, gjat vitit 1990-1991, inflacioni u ngrit ndjeshm, n mbi 100 pr qind duke kaluar rreth 15-20 pr qind n muaj gjat fillimit t vitit 1992. N situatn kur kursi zyrtar i kmbimit ishte shum larg nga kursi i kmbimit n tregun paralel, rezervat valutore kishin rn n mnyr t ndjeshme dhe bilanci tregtar ishte keqsuar s teprmi. Bilanci i pagesave pasqyronte nj deficit t ndjeshm dhe me shum pasoja pr ekonomin. Lexo fjaln e plot t Guvernatorit. Copyright  2018 Banka e Shqipris. Muz and Eduk " Head / Press / Speeches, interviews, articles / Speeches Press releases Notices of # meetings of Council Supervisor Press conference Speeches, interview articles Speeches Interview of articles Calendars # Official holiday calendar for 2022 COVID-19 Europe # BANK OF ALBANIA Bank of Albania and European integration Publication date: 06.12.2001 Honorable Governors and participants at this table, Albania, as well as other countries in the region, shares the same goal, European integration. While this may be considered a strategic, perhaps long-term goal, it is necessary to work out and pursue more medium-term goals during this transitional phase. In the decade we left behind, Albania and the Balkans as a whole, in a way, became part of Europe through immigration. The reform agenda was dominated by problems of economic transition, difficult to solve and very complex in optimizing decision-making. Our integration objectives, which seem to dominate the agenda of actions in the next decade, should be aimed at europeanising society in our region. In these processes, there are spaces for every member of society, every institution or social organization, to have his saying and contribution. I want to stop the following, in the role that the Bank of Albania will play in the country's European integration process. Developing this concept first within itself, the institutional model that the Bank of Albania has chosen to develop is that of the European Central Bank. This commitment is expressed in the document "Bank of Albania's Medium-Term Development Strategy" adopted by the Supervisory Council in 1999. We are aware that achieving a compatibility in the practices and standards of our central bank with European ones will take the necessary time. They will be developed and perfected in parallel with the country's economic development and the degree of democratisation of all Albanian society. In the early stages of the transition, monetary and currency policies were limited by the lack of financial markets, indirect monetary policy instruments, a newly created central bank and without Page 1 of 2 Bank of Albania and European integration 29/07/22, 15:07 Experiences, large budget deficits and the need for a rapid adaptation of relative prices. Although the Bank of Albania's relations with the state budget, for example, are not at their level in the first half of the 1990s, where the deficit was financed mainly with direct loans, they are still far from the practices of the European Central Bank. We still directly fund part of the budget deficit. Such practices, defined in the "Bank of Albania" law, testify that even the legislation itself for the central bank needs to gradually be harmonised with legislation for the European central bank system. On the other hand, the development of institutional independence of the Bank of Albania requires, moreover, the existence of a supportive public and a financial market, which conveys with correctness and speed the signals of monetary policies in the economy. I gladly confirm that the Bank of Albania, through giving its independent opinions, the state of economic development or other important issues of the country's economy, has begun to attract public attention. Addressing these issues, as well as internal structural perfections and developing analytical capacities within our institution, constitute the axis of the Strategy document I just mentioned above. The transformative economic processes of today have contributed to the deepening of convergence towards economic and trade structures with those of the European Union. Economic exchanges, in over 80 per cent of them, today take place with member states of over 80 per cent of them, today take place with the member states of the European Union. Page 2 of 2

Developments in the country's economy for 2001, referring to available data, are generally assessed positive and within the programmed framework. In 2001, the Albanian economy continued to grow at a relatively rapid pace, in conditions of maintaining low levels of consumer prices and falling unemployment levels. On the other hand, fiscal and monetary developments resulted within the specified quantitative targets. The country's currency has been relatively stable against both the U.S. dollar and the euro. The Albanian banking system further expanded its activity, increased the level of lending, took several steps forward towards the privatisation of the Savings Bank, however investor selection could not be achieved, which has pushed this process to at least another year. In 2001, there were and continues to be developments, the impact of which creates difficulties in achieving targets and even their effect may extend into the medium term. It is about the many problems in the electricity supply and its price increase, the conflict in the region, especially the Macedonian crisis, as well as the problems in the world economy highlighted more after the September 11, 2001 attack. As has been warned a long time ago on the part of the Bank of Albania, problems in electricity supply are taking, from an economic point of view, the size of a crisis. Furthermore, the negative effects of such situations, although they may not be distinguished in short-term periods, in long-term periods become more vulnerable. Publication date: 23.01.2002 Good afternoon and welcome. At this press conference I want to address two issues, which concern the functions of the central bank and the devotion. The first is inflation and the second issue I wanted to address is the euro, the introduction of the euro in Albania. In terms of inflation, being the main indicator of each country's central bank, I have to say that in Albania in 2001 an annual inflation of 3.5 percent was proven. The figure is final. It is within the interval declared by the Bank of Albania 2 to 4%. Of course it's a good thing that was proven within the interval. Meanwhile, December inflation was 5.3 percent. Even here, to some extent we can say that the forecast was proven, or that expectation of the Bank of Albania, that we would have an increase in inflation. Of course I'm not happy that price growth is proven, but we are ahead of a fact and we made predictions about this issue. The main influencer in 2001 inflation, almost as for tradition, is the voice "food, drink and tobacco", which as a voice has increased by 6.4% and has given an impact on inflation by 4.4 percent, while the "fruit-vegetable" itself has had an increase of 19.8 percent. It's almost as much as it grew in December in 2000. Of course, this is the voice that gives us the right to draw the conclusion that there is also a speculative increase in prices, so that it is a strong increase in one month and is known to relate to the three holidays that accompanied 2000 and 2001. I said the three holidays they accompanied, why in other years there are two, because the ramadan festival shifts in time. With all three holidays, this gives greater scope for speculation, so that there is an increase in rapid, strong and continuous demand in time. Also in December inflation has also influenced the increase in electricity consumption prices since December 1st by 50 percent for the share over 300 kilowatts per hour. Estimates are that inflation has affected the 1 per cent somewhere. There are other voices that have influenced inflation. Lidhur me inflacionin, duke qn treguesi kryesor i do banke qndrore t do vendi, m duhet t them q n Shqipri n vitin 2001 u vrtetua nj inflacion vjetor 3.5 pr qind. Shifra sht prfundimtare. Although, for most of the year, there were quite difficult situations, caused by the deepening energy crisis, a suitable balance was achieved in the main macroeconomic indicators. Based on the latest estimates by the relevant authorities, year-end production growth reached 6.5 percent. I find it appropriate to repeat once again the concern constantly raised by the Bank of Albania about the quality of statistical information on offer, as well as the low level of transparency and scale of information exchange on the part of state institutions. Authorities should pay proper attention to support the development of statistics and increase their public reporting rate. Returning to estimates for the performance of the economy is observed that the production of the agriculture sector is at lower rates than forecast. Of the 4 percent increase, predicted at the beginning of the year, authorities estimate that production has increased by 1.4 percent. The deepening energy crisis was reflected in the most deteriorating developments especially in the months of November-December; While construction, another important contributor to national production, did not maintain the same growth rates. Last year's quarter-end developments were contrary to the positive cylic developments of past periods. However, the Bank of Albania assesses economic developments overall as positive, especially those in the services sector and more precisely in the field of mobile phone where significant investments have been made during 2001. Ndonse, n pjesn m t madhe t vitit, pati situata mjaft t vshtira, t shkaktuara nga kriza e thelluar energjitike, u arrit q t ruhej nj ekuilibr i prshtatshm n treguesit kryesor makroekonomik. Mbshtetur n vlersimet m t fundit t autoriteteve prkatse, rritja e prodhimit n fund t vitit arriti n 6.5 pr qind. E gjej me vend t prsris edhe nj her shqetsimin e ngritur vazhdimisht nga Banka e Shqipris pr cilsin e informacionit statistikor q ofrohet si dhe nivelin e ult t transparencs dhe shkalls s shkmbimit t informacionit nga ana e institucioneve shtetrore. Autoritetet duhet t'i kushtojn vmendjen e duhur pr t mbshtetur zhvillimin e statistikave dhe pr t rritur shkalln e raportimit n publik t tyre. Duke u kthyer n vlersimet pr ecurin e ekonomis vrehet q prodhimi i sektorit t bujqsis sht n ritme m t ulta se sa parashikimi. Nga 4 pr qind rritje, e parashikuar n fillim t vitit, autoritetet vlersojn q prodhimi sht rritur me 1.4 pr qind. Thellimi i krizs energjitike u reflektua n zhvillimet m t prkeqsuara sidomos n muajt nntor-dhjetor; ndrsa ndrtimi, nj tjetr kontribues i rndsishm n prodhimin kombtar, nuk ruajti t njjtat ritme rritjeje. Zhvillimet e tremujorit t fundit t vitit t kaluar ishin t kundrta me zhvillimet ciklike pozitive t periudhave t kaluara. Sidoqoft, Banka e Shqipris i vlerson zhvillimet ekonomike n trsi si pozitive, sidomos ato n sektorin e shrbimeve dhe m saktsisht n fushn e telefonis celulare ku gjat vitit 2001 jan br investime t rndsishme. Muz and Eduk " Head / Press / Speeches, interviews, articles / Speeches  Ndryshimi_i_struktures_bankare_dhe_i_praktikave_te_mbikeqyrjes.html Page 1 of 3 Changing banking structure and supervision practices 29/07/22, 15:07 Press releases Notices of # meetings of Council Supervisor BANK OF ALBANIA Changing banking structure and supervision practices Publication date: 24.05.2002 Press conference Speeches, interview articles Speeches Interview of articles Calendars # Official holiday calendar for 2022 COVID-19 Europe # Starting on 31 December 1998, the banking system was presented according to the following structure as a result of changes made in favour of private banks: two banks with (entirely) state capital, two banks with common capital and six private banks. The year 2000 marked an increase in economic lending. Albanian banks, by nature universal banking, in addition to traditional activities such as deposit acceptance and lending, also began trading transactions with bonds, shares and derivatives. In general, the Albanian banking system that counts trade bank fears is relatively safe and supported by stable macroeconomic stability. Net foreign banking for the banking system increased by 28.3 percent compared to the end of 2000. Net foreign is rated as relatively good. One of the main issues of the bank reform strategy is the privatisation of state-owned banks, a process that began in 1995, in the implementation of the law "On the transformation of state-owned banks into commercial companies and to allow their privatisation", as well as based on some other laws and regulations. The main part of the privatisation strategy for strategic sectors is the privatisation of the Savings Bank, for the very monopoly position this bank occupies in the market. Changes in banking supervision Approval, in 1992 of the laws "On the Bank of Albania" and "On Banks in the Republic of Albania", recognized the Bank of Albania as the only banking authority, which grants license and oversees all banks in the Republic of Albania. In this framework, the Department of Banking Supervision was established, which was organized by implementing the law and principles of the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision as well as other international acts and practices. The regulatory framework of this department was the subject of continuous improvements during the period 1998-2001. Thus, this department implements the newest and contemporary methods, such as the implementation of quantitative assessments of the bank's conditions based on the CAMEL System of Classification and Evaluation, as well as the implementation of a more developed licensing methodology for nonbank institutions. Currently, this department operates by implementing the latest variant of the Examination Procedures Manual, which is the Early Warning System. This has increased the transparency process through the drafting of the Correctional Measures Action Manual. To make examiners more effective in the process of determining the examination object, the Purpose Definition Module according to the Risk Scale is also designed. N prgjithsi, sistemi bankar shqiptar q numron trembdhjete banka tregtare sht relativisht i sigurt dhe i mbshtetur nga nj stabilitet i qndrueshm makroekonomik. Pjesa m kryesore e strategjis s privatizimit pr sektort strategjik sht privatizimi i Banks s Kursimeve, pr vet pozicionin monopol q kjo bank z n treg. Ndryshimet n mbikqyrjen bankare Miratimi, n vitin 1992 i ligjeve "Mbi Bankn e Shqipris" dhe " Mbi bankat n Republikn e Shqipris", e njohu Bankn e Shqipris si autoritetin e vetm bankar, i cili jep licenc dhe mbikqyr t gjitha bankat n Republikn e Shqipris. Title: Monetary Policy: An Analytical Look at the Past and Its Vision for the Future.
text: The region's economic development prospects. 29/07/22, 15:07 itika ! netare Markets! Stability! Financial Surveillance! Intervention of ! Extraordinary Statistics! Right ! Payments! Muz and Eduk " Head / Press / Speeches, interviews, articles / Speeches Press releases Notices of # meetings of Council Supervisor Press conference Speeches, interview articles Speeches Interview of articles Calendars # Official holiday calendar for 2022 COVID-19 Europe # BANK OF ALBANIA The region's economic development prospects. Publication date: 25.05.2002 Honored colleagues, I wish to begin my presentation at this meeting, with a brief presentation of Albania's overall economic framework and the role the Bank of Albania is playing in reformprocesses. Last year's internal economic developments the Bank of Albania generally deems satisfactory. Domestic production continued to increase, albeit at lower rhythms than those programmed; inflation stayed within the Bank's target; the fiscal deficit was reduced. In all, the parameters set out in our agreements with international bodies remained within the defined limits. However, in dialogue with the government in drafting reform programmes, we have put an emphasis on structural weaknesses that are still pronounced and which are gradually being turned into barriers to development and the preservation of a stabilised macroeconomic framework. One of the serious threats that emerged late last year was the severe energy crisis experienced by the internal economy. In this case, I would like to express my satisfaction that the institutions responsible for this sector also created a common framework in Balkan regional co-operation. The creation of the joint network of regional economic infrastructure already represents an important political orientation, and with benefits for economic agents. On the other hand, free trade agreement initiatives between the countries of the region have already begun. However, the harvesting of the maximum economic benefits stemming from these agreements cannot be realized in the current state of physical and institutional infrastructure. From this point of view, the Bank of Albania has been very active in promoting such regional character projects, making available to Albanian authorities all its qualified expertise for this purpose. In all forums, Page 1 of 3 The region's economic development prospects. 29/07/22, 15:07 As in all cases, the Bank of Albania has clearly reiterated the need for more reforms, particularly structural reforms. As a result, we can say that some of the most key priorities, which lead to a rapid progress of European integration can be summed up as follows: The establishment of an effective institutional framework for promoting foreign direct investment. Key initiatives include the adoption of a law and statute to create an agency to promote investments, as well as an agency for promoting exports, setting a functional target to develop free zones and customs areas, as well as for recognition of ownership and tap on land and property, improving the wealth registration system. Accelerating the privatisation process of strategic sectors. I think the time has come to give up the management of some strategic production capacities according to the old systems. Unfortunately, the Albanian state resulted in being totally unable to manage these strategic capacities, leading them to a miserable end. However, we think there is still time to strongly encourage the authorities to continue the privatisation of the Albanian Energy Corporation (KESH), the Savings Bank, the privatisation of the Insurance Institute, the privatisation of fixed telephony, followed by the successful sale of the GSM license, the formation of the Akaduct company into joint shareholder companies. Improving transparency and reducing corruption in the public sector. Special attention must be paid to the fight against corruption in the customs administration, as well as to give support to the justice system. Key initiatives in this area include continued assessments of progress in implementing the anticorruption action plan, tightening and defining the rules of public procurement, declaration of assets by customs officers and other public administration employees, modeling the experience of the Business Advisory Committee, which has proven to be a very effective insitution in promoting transparency and institutional structuring of the business lobby. Improving physical infrastructure. Started by the severe energy crisis of the year that passed, the government must prepare a strategic plan by discussing the problem of electricity supply with the business community and wider. On the other hand, priority must be given to road infrastructure. Improving the implementation of trade laws, regulations and regulations. In many cases the legal framework of trade relations exists and is in order, but its implementation is poor and the application is not consistent and many times arbitrary. What I would add next is that I would like to go back to those areas in which I think they are more related to the responsibilities of the central bank. A host of issues may be listed in this direction, but it is more important that we start from classical principles, such as independence, transparency, accountability, etc. I believe that by contributing to as powerful a central bank as possible, more opportunities for successful regional integration are implied. However, the ultimate political goal, accession to european union, imposes different conditions as well as challenges for a large part of our region's economies. In the process, I think, our contribution is key. I can say that our long-term policy must Page 2 of 3 The region's economic development prospects. 29/07/22, 15:07 It is oriented by the practices of the European Central Bank and I assume that each of us here, at least once, must have been intrigued by the Euro alternative. The Bank of Albania has decided and agreed with other agencies, both national and international, to adopt a long-term strategy, the inflation targeting regime, but at the same time, the same authorities and some of the most vocal economists are considering the fact of a proper strategic move for the future, which is the euroisation of the economy. So the dilemma of using the euro or lec, I think it's a matter of time and what's certain is that time is working for the Euro. Create more space for our experts to get deeper into this process and, why not, not create a permanent forum, where they can exchange their views, the latest news and the specifics of other countries, so that they are willing that when the time comes, it becomes a gradual and gentle (easy) euroisation of our economies. Finally, after a decade of economic transition, the creation of economic interdependencies has already been outlined in our region for centuries fragmented. We certainly welcome these tendencies and encourage them. But this raises the need for further empowerment of the co-operation of our institutions, in the name of ensuring the stability of the financial system throughout our region. This would also be our most valuable contribution to strengthening the political stability of the region and for increasing the economic prosperity of our citizens. Page 3 of 3

Data e publikimit: 25.05.2002 T nderuar koleg, Dshiroj t filloj prezantimin tim n kt takim, me nj paraqitje t shkurtr t kuadrit t prgjithshm ekonomik t Shqipris dhe rolin q po luan Banka e Shqipris n proceset reformuese. Zhvillimet e brendshme ekonomike t vitit t kaluar Banka e Shqipris i vlerson prgjithsisht t knaqshme. Prodhimi i brendshm vazhdoi t rritej, megjithse me ritme m t ulta se sa ato q ishin programuar; inflacioni qndroi brenda objektivit t Banks; deficiti fiskal u reduktua. N trsi, parametrat e prcaktuara n marrveshjet tona me organizmat ndrkombtar qndruan brenda kufijve t prcaktuar. Sidoqoft, n dialogun me qeverin n hartimin e programeve t reformave, ne kemi vn theksin n dobsit strukturore q jan akoma t theksuara dhe q gradualisht po shndrrohen n barriera t zhvillimit dhe te ruajtjes s nj kuadri makroekonomik t stabilizuar. Nj nga krcnimet serioze q u shfaq q n fundin e vitit t kaluar ishte kriza e rnd energjitike q prjetoi ekonomia e brendshme. Me kt rast, dshiroj t shpreh knaqsin time q institucionet prgjegjse t ktij sektori, krijuan gjithashtu nj kuadr t prbashkt n bashkpunimin rajonal ballkanik. Krijimi i rrjetit t prbashkt t infrastrukturs ekonomike rajonale, prbn tashm nj orientim t rndsishm politik, dhe me prfitime pr agjentt ekonomik. Nga ana tjetr, iniciativat e marrveshjeve t tregtis s lir midis vendeve t rajonit tashm kan filluar. Megjithat, vjelja e prfitimeve maksimale ekonomike q burojn nga kto marrveshje nuk mund t realizohet n gjendjen aktuale t infrastrukturs fizike dhe t asaj institucionale. Nga kjo pikpamje, Banka e Shqipris ka qen mjaft aktive n nxitjen e projekteve t tilla t karakterit rajonal, duke vn n dispozicion t autoriteteve shqiptare gjith ekspertizn e saj t kualifikuar pr kt qllim. N t gjitha forumet, https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Perspektivat_e_zhvillimit_ekonomik_te_rajonit.html Pagina 1 di 3 Perspektivat e zhvillimit ekonomik t rajonit. 29/07/22, 15:07 sikurse edhe n t gjitha rastet, Banka e Shqipris, n mnyr t qart ka prsritur nevojn pr m shum reforma veanrisht reforma strukturore. Si prfundim, ne mund t themi se disa nga prioritetet m kryesore, t cilat t ojn drejt nj progresi t shpejt t integrimit europian mund t prmblidhen si m posht: Vendosja e nj kuadri institucional efektiv pr promovimin e investimeve t huaja direkte. Iniciativat kye prfshijn adoptimin e nj ligji dhe statuti pr t krijuar nj agjenci pr promovimin e investimeve si dhe nj agjenci pr promovimin e eksporteve, vendosjen e nj objektivi funksional pr t zhvilluar zona t lira dhe zona doganore, si dhe pr njohjen e pronsis dhe t tapis mbi tokn dhe pronn, duke prmirsuar sistemin e regjistrimit t pasuris. Prshpejtimi i procesit t privatizimit t sektorve strategjik. Un mendoj se ka ardhur koha q t heqim dor nga menaxhimi i disa kapaciteteve prodhuese strategjike sipas sistemeve t vjetra. Pr fat t keq, shteti shqiptar rezultoi t ishte totalisht i paaft pr t menaxhuar kto kapacitete strategjike duke i uar ato drejt nj fundi t mjerueshm. Megjithat, ne mendojm se ka akoma koh t inkurajojm fuqishm autoritetet pr t vashduar privatizimin e Koorporats Energjitike Shqiptare (KESH), Banks s Kursimeve, privatizimin e Institutit t Sigurimeve, privatizimin e telefonis fikse, e ndjekur kjo nga shitja e suksesshme e licenss s GSM, trasformimit t ndrmarrjes s Ujsjellsit n Kompani t prbashkta aksionere. Prmirsimi i i transparencs dhe reduktimi i korrupsionit n sektorin publik. Nj vmendje e veant i duhet kushtuar lufts kundr korrupsionit n administratn doganore , si dhe t'i jepet mbshtetje sistemit t drejtsis.Iniciativa kye n kt fush prfshijn vlersime t vazhdueshme t progresit n zbatimin e planit t veprimit antikorrupsion, duke shtrnguar dhe prcaktuar rregullat e prokurimit publik, t deklarimit t pasurive nga punonjsit e doganave dhe punonjsit e tjer t administrats publike, duke pasur si model prvojn e Komitetit t Kshillimit t Biznesit, i cili ka provuar t jet nj insitucion shum efektiv n promovimin e transparencs dhe n strukturimin institucional t lobit t biznesit. Prmirsimi i infrastrukturs fizike. Nisur nga kriza e rnd energjitike e vitit q kaloi, qeveria duhet t prgatis nj plan strategjik duke e diskutuar problemin e furnizimit me energji elektrike me komunitetin e biznesit dhe m gjer. Nga ana tjetr, prioritet i duhet dhn edhe infrastrukturs s rrugve. Prmirsimi i zbatimit t ligjeve tregtare, t rregullave dhe t rregulloreve. N shum raste kuadri ligjor i marrdhnieve tregtare ekziston dhe sht n rregull, por zbatimi i tij sht i dobt dhe aplikimi nuk sht konsistent dhe shum her arbitrar. Ajo ka do t shtoja tjetr sht se do t doja t ktheheshim prapa, n ato fusha n t cilat un mendoj q jan t lidhura m shum me prgjegjsit e banks qendrore. Nj mori shtjesh mund t rreshtohen n kt drejtim, por m e rndsishme sht q ta fillojm nga parimet klasike, si pr shembull pavarsia, transparenca, prgjegjshmria etj. Un besoj, se duke kontribuar pr nj bank sa m t fuqishme qendrore, nnkuptohen m shum mundsi pr nj integrim rajonal t suksesshm. Megjithat, qllimi final politik, pranimi n bashkimin europian, t imponon kushte t ndryshme si dhe sfida pr nj pjes t madhe t ekonomive t rajonit ton. N kt proces, mendoj un, kontributi yn sht ky. Un mund t them se politika jon afatgjat duhet t https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Perspektivat_e_zhvillimit_ekonomik_te_rajonit.html Pagina 2 di 3 Perspektivat e zhvillimit ekonomik t rajonit. 29/07/22, 15:07 orientohet nga praktikat e Banks Qendrore Europiane dhe supozoj q secili nga ne ktu, t paktn nj her t vetme, duhet t jet intriguar nga alternativa Euro. Banka e Shqipris ka vendosur dhe ka rn dakord me agjencit e tjera, si kombtare dhe ato ndrkombtare q t adoptojn nj strategji me afat t gjat, regjimin e targetimit t inflacionit, por n t njjtn koh, t njjtat autoritete dhe disa nga ekonomistt m me z po marrin n konsiderat faktin e nj lvizjeje t duhur strategjike pr t ardhmen, q sht euroizimi i ekonomis. Kshtu dilema pr t prdorur euron apo lekun, mendoj se sht nj shtje kohe dhe ajo ka sht e sigurt sht se koha po punon pr Euron. T krijojm m shum hapsir pr ekspertt tan q t'i futen m thell ktij procesi e, pse jo, t mos krijojn nj forum t prhershm, ku mund t shkmbejn pikpamjet e tyre, t rejat m t fundit dhe specifikat e vendeve t tjera, n mnyr q t jen t gatshm q kur t vij koha, t bhet nj euroizim gradual dhe i but ( leht) i ekonomive tona. S fundi, pas nj dekade tranzicioni ekonomik, tashm sht prvijuar krijimi i ndrvarsive ekonomike edhe n rajonin ton, prej shekujsh t fragmentarizuar. Pa dyshim q ne i prshndesim kto tendenca dhe i inkurajojm ato. Por, kjo ngre nevojn e fuqizimit t mtejshm t bashkpunimit t institucioneve tona, n emr t garantimit t stabilitetit t sistemit financiar n gjith rajonin ton. text: Inflation dynamics and monetary policy strategy 29/07/22, 15:07 itika ! netare Markets! Stability! Financial Surveillance! Intervention of ! Extraordinary Statistics! Right ! Payments! Muz and Eduk " Head / Press / Speeches, interviews, articles / Speeches Press releases Notices of # meetings of Council Supervisor Press conference Speeches, interview articles Speeches Interview of articles Calendars # Official holiday calendar for 2022 COVID-19 Europe # BANK OF ALBANIA Inflation dynamics and monetary policy strategy Publication date: 25.05.2002 Discussions about inflation and problems related to the choice of the most appropriate monetary policy regime have consistently generated debate and for many reasons this debate continues to remain open. It seems that in recent years, the fight with inflation is to the advantage of the region's central banks. At least that's what the statistics show. However, the challenge for a long-term stabilisation of it is present not only for most of the economies represented at this meeting, but also wider without excluding and developed economies. In the case of Albania, despite the great commitment we are devoteing to putting inflation under control, we are again failing to establish a full control over consumer prices for relatively long periods of time. More specifically, if we refer to the last 2 to 3 years, the most typical is a kind of Zikzake of inflation, which unfortunately these last 3 to 4 months, has gone notably outside the target interval set by the Bank of Albania. I can mention many factors, subjective and objective, which in one way or another have influenced the performance of inflation times under the target path and times above it. I can also say that in many cases the shock factor has been present. However, my goal is not that. What I want to stress is the fact that in some circumstances, monetary policy decisions by reflecting, the infantility of markets in Albania, fail to be measured and timely in the real economy. Especially, this becomes more evident in those periods when overall economic conditions require a faster response. Indeed, this reinforces once again the need to build more efficient and flexible markets, which are capable of perceiving and conducting monetary policy decisions and signals in the economy in a timely manner. Maybe I need to mention something else about the implications of fiscal policy in the economy. Recent years have marked important steps even in the direction of fiscal consolidation by significantly easing pressure Page 1 of 2 Inflation dynamics and monetary policy strategy 29/07/22, 15:07 fiscal policy on monetary policy. However, there is still no talk of full fiscal consolidation and stability. For this judgment, we start from the budget revenue structure (significant portions still have customs revenues), tax evasion, etc., while the fiscal authority has not adopted the appropriate degree of transparency. This means that the effectiveness of using budgetary income is not fully clear. Finally, low welfare levels in Albania, high unemployment, as well as poor practices in managing budgetary incomeare factors, which will put strong pressure on authorities for budgetary expansion and weakening fiscal position and stability. Well, once again turning to the idea of beginning I would stress that something is clear, that apart from the achievements in short-term inflation stabilization we still have many problems with its long-term control, problems that as listed above reflect a mix of factors both structural and economic and financial policies. In this sense, the question may rightly arise: What will be the monetary policy regime with which inflation will be fought in the future? Let us not forget that the country's strategic objective, EU membership, must also be taken into account. It has been mooted for some time as a possible alternative inflation targeting regime, while in some circles scholars there is also talk of a current replacement or otherwise said Euroisation. In conclusion, I would honestly like this dilemma to become part of the debate of this meeting, seeing it in a broader framework, from a regional perspective. Page 2 of 2

Muz dhe Eduk " Kreu / Shtypi / Fjalime, intervista, artikuj / Fjalime Njoftimet pr shtyp Njoftime t # mbledhjeve t Kshillit Mbikqyrs Konferenca pr shtyp Fjalime, $ intervista, artikuj Fjalime Intervista e artikuj Kalendar # Kalendari i festave zyrtare pr vitin 2022 COVID-19 Evropa # BANKA E SHQIPRIS Dinamikat e inflacionit dhe strategjia e politiks monetare Data e publikimit: 25.05.2002 Diskutimet rreth inflacionit dhe problemet q kan t bjn me zgjedhjen e regjimit m t prshtatshm t politiks monetare, vazhdimisht kan krijuar debat dhe pr shum arsye ky debat vazhdon t mbetet ende i hapur. Duket se kto vitet e fundit, lufta me inflacionin sht n avantazh t bankave qendrore t rajonit. T paktn kt tregojn statistikat. Megjithat, sfida pr nj stabilizim afatgjat t tij sht e pranishme jo vetm pr shumicn e ekonomive t prfaqsuara n kt takim, por edhe m gjer pa prjashtuar dhe ekonomit e zhvilluara. N rastin e Shqipris, megjith angazhimin e madh q po i kushtojm vnies nn kontroll t inflacionit, prsri nuk po arrijm t vendosim nj kontroll t plot mbi mimet e konsumit pr periudha relativisht t gjata kohe. M konkretisht, po t'i referohemi 2 - 3 viteve t fundit, m tipike sht nj lloj zikzakeje e inflacionit, i cili fatkeqsisht kta 3 - 4 muajt e fundit, ka dal dukshm jasht intervalit objektiv t vendosur nga ana e Banks s Shqipris. Mund t prmend shum faktor, subjektiv dhe objektiv, t cilt n nj mnyr ose n nj tjetr kan ndikuar ecurin e inflacionit her nn pathin e targetuar dhe her sipr tij. Mund t them, gjithashtu, se n shum raste faktori shock ka qen i pranishm. Megjithat, qllimi im nuk sht ky. Ajo q dua t theksoj ka t bj me faktin se n disa rrethana, vendimet e politiks monetare duke reflektuar, infantilitetin e tregjeve n Shqipri, nuk arrijn t prohen n masn dhe n kohn e duhur n ekonomin reale. Sidomos, kjo bhet m evidente n ato periudha kur dhe kushtet e prgjithshme ekonomike krkojn nj reagim m t shpejt. N t vrtet, kjo prforcon edhe nj her domosdoshmrin pr t ndrtuar tregje m eficiente dhe m fleksibile, t cilat t jen t afta t perceptojn dhe t projn n kohn e duhur vendimet dhe sinjalet e politiks monetare n ekonomi. Ndoshta m duhet t prmend edhe dika tjetr q ka t bj me implikimet e politiks fiskale n ekonomi. Vitet e fundit kan shnuar hapa t rndsishm edhe n drejtim t konsolidimit fiskal duke zbutur ndjeshm presionin https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Dinamikat_e_inflacionit_dhe_strategjia_e_politikes_monetare.html Pagina 1 di 2 Dinamikat e inflacionit dhe strategjia e politiks monetare 29/07/22, 15:07 e politiks fiskale mbi at monetare. Megjithat, nuk mund t flitet ende pr konsolidim dhe stabilitet t plot fiskal. Pr kt gjykim, nisemi nga struktura e t ardhurave t buxhetit (pjes t konsiderueshme kan ende t ardhurat nga doganat), evazionit fiskal etj., ndrkoh q autoriteti fiskal nuk ka adoptuar shkalln e duhur t transparencs. Kjo do t thot q efektiviteti i prdorimit t t ardhurave buxhetore nuk sht plotsisht i qart. S fundi, niveli i ult i mirqenies n Shqipri, papunsia e lart si dhe praktikat jo t mira n administrimin e t ardhurave buxhetore jan faktor, q do t ushtrojn presion t fort mbi autoritetet pr ekspansion buxhetor dhe pr dobsim t pozicionit dhe t stabilitetit fiskal. E pra, duke ju kthyer edhe nj her ides s fillimit do t theksoja se dika sht e qart, q prve arritjeve n stabilizimin afatshkurtr t inflacionit kemi ende shum probleme me kontrollin afatgjat t tij, probleme kto q si i rendita m sipr pasqyrojn nj przierje faktorsh si strukturor ashtu dhe t politikave ekonomike dhe financiare. N kt kuptim, me t drejt mund t lind pyetja: Cili do t jet regjimi i politiks monetare me t ciln do t luftohet inflacioni n t ardhmen? T mos harrojm se duhet mbajtur parasysh dhe objektivi strategjik i vendit, antarsimi n EU. Ka disa koh q sht hedhur si nj alternativ e mundshme regjimi inflation targeting, ndrkoh q n disa qarqe studiuesish flitet dhe pr nj currency replacement ose e thn ndryshe euroizim. N prfundim, sinqerisht do t doja q kjo dilem t bhej pjes e debatit t ktij takimi, duke e par at n nj kuadr m t gjer, nga kndvshtrimi rajonal. Copyright  2018 Banka e Shqipris.
