Payments! Muz and Eduk " Head / Press / Speeches, interviews, articles / Speeches Press releases Notices of # meetings of Council Supervisor Press conference Speeches, interview articles Speeches Interview of articles Calendars # Official holiday calendar for 2022 COVID-19 Europe # BANK OF ALBANIA Challenges ahead for improving governance statistics in Albania. Publication date: 29.05.2002 I judge it as a great opportunity for me and my small country, to bring you here some of the achievements as well as some of the biggest challenges, currently facing the governance of statistics in Albania. Although during the transition period, Albania has experienced spirals from the most diverse, where I can also mention the total anarchy of 1997, again I would say that the process of drafting statistics has generally performed well, in a continuous progression. This progress culminated in 1998, when Albanian authorities gave their consent to Albania's membership in the Overall System of Dhenale Dissent (GDDS) in the IMF. On 22 May 2000, Albania, along with eight other developing countries, were the first to be included when the GDDSa page was officially introduced. For the sake of truth, it should be said that Albania was previously chosen by the IMF as a pilot country for Eastern Europe in preparing a full group of information on the national statistical system (metadata). Its metadadas were used as a model not only for Europe, but also for many other countries. Briefly to understand what the statistics set consists of in Albania, as well as who responds to their production I would like to clarify that currently, anyone interested can have full series of time, on average from late 1992 to the present day, for money and bank statistics, for statistics for consumer prices as well as for balance of payment statistics. Meanwhile, despite the desire of the authorities and the persistence of international institutions, Albania currently lacks national accounting statistics. Currently, the above-mentioned statistical information is produced by three different institutions: the Bank of Albania, the Ministry of Finance and INSTAT.  rpara_per_permiresimin_e_statistikave_te_qeverisjes_ne_Shqiperi.html Page 1 of 4 Challenges ahead for improving governance statistics in Albania. 29/07/22, 15:07 The Bank of Albania (central bank) is responsible for producing and publishing money and bank statistics (monthly) as well as for preparing and publishing payment balance statistics (every three months). In some cases, the Bank of Albania has financed statistics collection projects, which have been mainly observations with the aim of assessing various sectors of the economy. The Finance Ministry has responsibility for producing and dissecting government financial statistics (every three months). INSTAT (state statistics institution), a national statistical agency, in addition to responsibility for the production and dissection of national and demographic accounting statistics, legally has the right to build and implement statistics design and management policies in Albania. However, it should be stressed that the latter still represents a moment to discuss as the legal status of the institute still has vague spaces and moments to analyze, especially in the direction of consolidating the decision-making process. What I want to highlight as achievements in the field of gathering and drafting Albanian statistics concerns a continued increase in public interest and awareness of statistical products. I think this is a good indicator that speaks to increasing the degree of public confidence by reflecting in this way increasing the scale of professionalism and the ever-lower influence of politics. However, we must aim towards a higher level of professionalism on the part of statisticians despite the low salary they currently receive. On the other hand, we have problems too. For example, data coverage is still incomplete. With the exception of monetary statistics and the consumer price index, (which are released each month) other statistics groups have a relatively high periodicity (usually quarterly). The timing of the publication of the data also poses a major concern. In most cases, the data are released with a delay ranging from 3 to 4 months after the closing of the reporting period. However, what is important concerns the fact that weak points, which currently characterize the collection, processing, drafting and publishing system of statistics in Albania, are known and, at least in principle, there is the right institutional commitment to eliminate them within as short a time as possible. I believe that this elimination also poses the main challenges of the next 2 to 3 years, which Albanian authorities must face to ensure a quality step in perfecting the governance of statistics. More specifically, these priorities I would list as follows: First, I would mention the clear and unequivocal constipation of a political body. Although it is quoted by law that the highest body is the Statistics Council, it should be stressed that de facto it has only a consultative role, while it remains unclear whose competence is the decision-making process towards statistics in Albania. Unfortunately, this problem has long been mentioned and a solution has not yet been found for this legal vacuum.  para_per_permiresimin_e_statistikave_te_qeverisjes_ne_Shqiperi.html Page 2 of 4 Challenges ahead for improving governance statistics in Albania. 29/07/22, 15:07 Secondly, I would point out that despite improvements in the increase in the rate of statistical coverage, unfortunately, the private sector oversight rate is still low. The great importance is the fact that, in addition to increasing coverage, great importance would also be the increase in the veracity of accumulated information, as well as an increase in the degree of trust in private agents, that information collected by state agencies, would not be used for purposes other than statistical ones. The causes that push private companies and societies to ignore or distort information are diverse and depend mainly on the non-understanding of the importance of using information from state structures, distrust of these structures, the level of information confidentiality, competition in the market, etc. Perhaps, more accurate information can be obtained through observations, although I must admit that their quality can be problematic. Third, I would highlight as a priority a particular importance, the creation (establishment) as soon as possible, of the system of collection and publication of National Accounts. Currently, serious efforts have been made by INSTAT to assess national accounts and there is a promise that, within 2002, all data will be published for the period 1995 to 2000. However, the biggest challenge in this direction remains credibility over the accuracy of the figures to be published. To a considerable extent, this will be understood very soon by the fact that internal consumers of this information will react as well as from the grade that international institutions will set. Already, several projects have begun, which I believe will help bring national accounting statistics closer to international standards. Fourth, I would appreciate very important improvement of the process of distributing statistical information from manufacturer to user. Although, currently authorities are engaged in increasing the quality and transparency of statistical data, there is still a need for comprehensive efforts to draft, on the part of these agencies, a calendar of publications, as well as for reducing the period from the calculation of statistical indicators to the publication of this information. Perhaps, the biggest challenge in this direction is the exploitation of the Internet, through the construction of truly functional websites, where anyone interested in having the opportunity to absorb the desired statistical information. Although the Bank of Albania and INSTAT have launched their websites, it must be acknowledged that access to them is difficult and their validity, especially in the direction of statistical information, leaves to be desired and is not resolved on professional grounds. However, increasing the number of users should create an initiative to further increase the quality of distribution of national statistics. Finally, I want to stress that a priority remains even the best exploitation of the priorities that information technology offers today. Admittedly, the rate of internet recognition and exploitation in Albania is still small, while many problems in the respective infrastructure do not allow the large-scale exploitation of the high-tech revolution that the information world is experiencing today. Of course,  para_per_permiresimin_e_statistikave_te_qeverisjes_ne_Shqiperi.html Page 3 of 4 Challenges ahead for improving governance statistics in Albania. 29/07/22, 15:07 We must consider that the wider use of the internet with the aim of collecting statistical data also means the need for increasing measures to preserve confidentiality. In conclusion, I believe that more or less the problems mentioned above constitute that same set of challenges, which lies in the face of every country in transition. I, in fact, hope that concrete proposals will emerge from this conference, which will address the solutions, at least medium-term, of most of the ambiguities that characterize the current statistical framework of transition countries. Thanking you for your understanding, I hope you already know something more about a small country, which, although geographically very close to the waters of the Mediterranean; Although in all the classical divisions of this field it is named as a Mediterranean country; Though the soul, mentality, formation, history, and every other distinctive feature of a country give it the right to feel so; There are still many ways to go, to join the developed present of his natural neighbours. I, I sincerely hope and i'm glad to believe that the trip doesn't last long and we get to where we should and in due course. Thank you.  para_per_permiresimin_e_statistikave_te_qeverisjes_ne_Shqiperi.html Page 4 of 4
text_original: Sfidat prpara pr prmirsimin e statistikave t qeverisjes n Shqipri. 29/07/22, 15:07 itika ! netare Tregjet ! Stabiliteti ! Financiar Mbikqyrja ! Ndrhyrja e ! Jashtzakonshme Statistikat ! Paraja ! Pagesat ! Muz dhe Eduk " Kreu / Shtypi / Fjalime, intervista, artikuj / Fjalime Njoftimet pr shtyp Njoftime t # mbledhjeve t Kshillit Mbikqyrs Konferenca pr shtyp Fjalime, $ intervista, artikuj Fjalime Intervista e artikuj Kalendar # Kalendari i festave zyrtare pr vitin 2022 COVID-19 Evropa # BANKA E SHQIPRIS Sfidat prpara pr prmirsimin e statistikave t qeverisjes n Shqipri. Data e publikimit: 29.05.2002 E gjykoj si nj oportunitet t madh pr mua dhe pr vendin tim t vogl, q t sjell ktu para jush disa nga arritjet si dhe disa prej sfidave m t mdha, me t cilat aktualisht prballet qeverisja e statistikave n Shqipri. Megjithse gjat periudhs s tranzicionit, Shqipria ka njohur spirale nga m t ndryshmet, ku mund t prmend edhe anarkin totale t vitit 1997, prsri do t thosha se procesi i hartimit t statistikave, n prgjithsi ka ecur mir, n nj progres t vazhdueshm. Ky progres kulmoi n vitin 1998, kur autoritetet shqiptare dhan plqimin e tyre pr antarsimin e Shqipris n Sistemin e Pergjithshem te Diseminimit te te Dhenave (GDDS) ne FMN. M 22 maj 2000, Shqipria, s bashku me tet vende t tjera n zhvillim, ishin t parat q u prfshin kur faqja e GDDSs u prezantua zyrtarisht. Pr hir t s vrtets, duhet thn se m par Shqipria ishte zgjedhur prej FMN-s si vend pilot pr Europn Lindore n prgatitjen e nj grupi t plot informacioni mbi sistemin statistikor kombtar (metadata). Metadadat e saj u prdorn si model jo vetm pr Europn, por edhe pr shum vende t tjera. Shkurtimisht pr t kuptuar se n far konsiston seti i statistikave n Shqipri, si dhe kush prgjigjet pr prodhimin e tyre do t doja t sqaroja se aktualisht, kushdo i interesuar mund t disponoj seri t plota kohore, mesatarisht q nga fundi i vitit 1992 e deri n ditt e sotme, pr statistikat e paras dhe t bankave, pr statistikat pr mimet e konsumit si dhe pr statistikat e bilancit t pagesave. Ndrkoh, me gjith dshirn e autoriteteve dhe kmbnguljen e institucioneve ndrkombtare, Shqipris aktualisht i mungojn statistikat e llogarive kombtare. Aktualisht, informacioni i siprprmendur statistikor prodhohet nga tre institucione t ndryshme: Banka e Shqipris, Ministria e Financave dhe INSTAT. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalrpara_per_permiresimin_e_statistikave_te_qeverisjes_ne_Shqiperi.html Pagina 1 di 4 Sfidat prpara pr prmirsimin e statistikave t qeverisjes n Shqipri. 29/07/22, 15:07 Banka e Shqipris (banka qendrore) sht prgjegjse pr prodhimin dhe publikimin e statistikave t parase dhe t bankave (do muaj) si dhe pr prgatitjen dhe publikimin e statistikave t bilancit t pagesave (do tre muaj). N disa raste, Banka e Shqipris ka financuar projekte pr mbledhjen e statistikave, t cilat ka qen kryesisht vrojtime me qllim vlersimin e sektorve t ndryshm t ekonomis. Ministria e Financave ka prgjegjsin pr prodhimin dhe diseminimin e statistikave financiare t qeveris (do tre muaj). INSTAT (institucioni shtetror i statistikave), nje agjenci statistikore kombetare, prve prgjegjsis pr prodhimin dhe diseminimin e statistikave t llogarive kombtare dhe t atyre demografike, ligjrisht ka dhe t drejtn q t ndrtoj dhe t zbatoj politikat e hartimit dhe t menaxhimit t statistikave n Shqipri. Gjithsesi, duhet theksuar se kjo e fundit ende prbn nj moment pr t'u diskutuar pasi statusi ligjor i institutit ka ende hapsira dhe momente t paqarta pr t'u analizuar, sidomos n drejtim t konsolidimit t procesit vendimmarrs. Ajo far dua t theksoj si arritje n fushen e grumbullimit dhe t hartimit t statistikave shqiptare ka t bj me nj rritje t vazhdueshme t interesimit dhe t ndrgjegjesimit nga ana e publikut pr produktet statistikore. Mendoj se ky sht nj tregues i mire q flet pr rritje t shkalls s besimit t publikut duke reflektuar n kt mnyr rritje t shkalls se profesionalizmit dhe ndikimin gjithnj e me t ult t politiks. Megjithat, duhet t synojm drejt nj niveli me t lart profesionalizmi nga ana e statisticienve pavarsisht nga paga e ult q ata marrin aktualisht. Nga ana tjetr, ne kemi probleme gjithashtu. Per shembull, mbulimi i te dhnave sht ende jo i plot. Me prjashtim t statistikave monetare dhe indeksit t mimeve t konsumit, ( t cilat nxirren do muaj) grupet e tjera te statistikave kane nje periodicitet relativisht t larte (zakonisht tremujor). Koha e publikimit t t dhnave prbn, gjithashtu nje shqetsim t madh. N shumicn e rasteve, t dhnat diseminohen me nj vones q varion nga 3 deri n 4 muaj pas mbylljes s periudhs raportuese. Gjithsesi, ajo q sht e rndsishme ka t bj me faktin se pikat e dobta, t cilat karakterizojn aktualisht sistemin e grumbullimit, t prpunimit, t hartimit dhe t publikimit t statistikave n Shqipri, jan t njohura dhe, t paktn n parim, ekziston angazhimi i duhur institucional pr t'i eleminuar ato brenda nj kohe sa m t shkurtr. Besoj, ky eleminim prbn dhe sfidat kryesore t 2 - 3 viteve t ardhshme, me t cilat autoritetet shqiptare duhet t prballen pr t siguruar nj hap cilsor n prsosjen e qeverisjes s statistikave. M konkretisht, kto prioritete do t'i listoja si m posht: S pari, do t prmendja konstituimin e qart dhe pa ekuivoke t nj organizmi politikbrs. Megjithse me ligj sht cituar se organi m i lart sht Kshilli i Statistikave, duhet theksuar se de facto ai ka vetm rol konsultativ, ndrkoh q mbetet ende e paqart se kompetenc e kujt sht procesi vendimmarrs n drejtim t statistikave n Shqipri. Fatkeqsisht, ky problem ka koh q sht konstatuar dhe akoma nuk sht gjetur nj zgjidhje pr kt vakum ligjor. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalpara_per_permiresimin_e_statistikave_te_qeverisjes_ne_Shqiperi.html Pagina 2 di 4 Sfidat prpara pr prmirsimin e statistikave t qeverisjes n Shqipri. 29/07/22, 15:07 S dyti, do t evidentoja se pavarsisht nga prmirsimet n rritjen e shkalls s mbulimit statistikor, fatkeqsisht, shkalla e mbikqyrjes t sektorit privat sht ende e ult. Rndsi t madhe ka fakti, q prve rritjes s mbulimit, nj rndsi t madhe do t kishte dhe rritja e vrtetsis s informacionit t grumbulluar si dhe nj rritje e shkalls s besimit tek agjentt privat, q informacioni i grumbulluar nga agjencit shtetrore, nuk do t prdoret pr qllime t tjera prve atyre statistikore. Shkaqet q shtyjn ndrmarrjet dhe shoqrit private t injorojn ose t deformojn informacionin jan t shumllojshme dhe varen kryesisht nga moskuptimi i rndsis s prdorimit t informacionit prej strukturave shtetrore, nga mosbesimi ndaj ktyre strukturave, nga niveli i konfidencialitetit t informacionit, konkurrenca n treg etj.. Mbase, informacion m i sakt mund t merret nprmjet vrojtimeve, ndonse duhet t pranoj se cilsia e tyre mund t jet problematike. S treti, do t evidentoja si prioritet t nj rndsie t veant, krijimin (ngritjen) sa m shpejt, t sistemit t grumbullimit dhe t publikimit t Llogarive Kombtare. Aktualisht, jan br prpjekje serioze nga INSTAT pr vlersimin e llogarive kombtare dhe ekziston premtimi q, brenda vitit 2002, do t publikohen t gjitha t dhnat pr periudhn 1995 - 2000. Megjithat, sfida m e madhe n kt drejtim mbetet besueshmria mbi saktsin e shifraveq do t publikohen. N nj mas t konsiderueshme, kjo do t kuptohet shum shpejt nga fakti se si do t reagojn konsumatort e brendshm t ktij informacioni ashtu sikurse dhe nga nota q do t'i vn institucionet ndrkombtare. Tashm, kan nisur disa projekte, t cilat besoj se do t ndimojn pr t sjell statistikat e llogarive kombtare m pran standardeve ndrkombtare. S katrti, do t vlersoja shum t rndsishm prmirsimin e procesit t shprndarjes t informacionit statistikor nga prodhuesi tek prdoruesi. Megjithse, aktualisht autoritetet jan t angazhuara n rritjen e cilsis dhe t transparencs s t dhnave statistikore, akoma ka nevoj pr prpjekje t gjithanshme pr hartimin, nga ana e ktyre agjencive, t nj kalendari botimesh si edhe pr zvoglimin e periudhs nga llogaritja e treguesve statistikor n publikimin e ktij informacioni. Ndoshta, sfida m e madhe n kt drejtim ka t bj me shfrytzimin e Internetit, nprmjet ndrtimit t websiteve realisht funksionale, ku kushdo i interesuar t ket mundsin q t thith informacionin e dshiruar statistikor. Edhe pse Banka e Shqiprise dhe INSTAT kan lanuar faqet e tyre n internet, duhet pranuar se aksesi n to sht i vshtir dhe vlefshmria e tyre, sidomos n drejtim t informacionit statistikor, l pr t dshiruar dhe nuk sht zgjidhur mbi baza profesioniste. Megjithat, rritja e numrit t prdoruesve duhet t krijoj nj iniciativ pr t rritur m tej cilsin e shprndarjes s statistikave kombtare. S fundi, dua t theksoj se nj prioritet mbetet edhe shfrytzimi m i mir i prparsive q ofron sot teknologjia e informacionit. Duhet pranuar, se shkalla e njohjes dhe e shfrytzimit t Internetit n Shqipri sht ende e vogl, ndrkoh q shum probleme n infrastrukturn prkatse nuk lejojn shfrytzimin, n shkall t gjer, t revolucionit t teknologjis s lart q po prjeton sot bota e informacionit. I will focus on explaining the position of the Bank of Albania, its role and the banking system as a whole, the rules of the game that must be established between your community and the banking system, etc. The Bank of Albania is a financial institution whose role and importance is vital to the country's economic-financial performance. The opening of these countries towards capital movements and people, efforts to integrate with the rest of the world, in addition to positive aspects, also brought greater exposure to phenomena such as trafficking and money laundering originating illegal activities. The IMF estimates that the amount of dirty money that is cleaned through the financial system is too large: between US500 billion and US1.5 trillion per year or as much as 5 percent of total global production ("The Economist" September 29, 2001). But it is already known that money laundering is carried out in various forms not only through a country's financial system. The various ways that have been found to carry out money laundering require that a group of institutions be involved in the fight against this activity. This issue law no.8610, dated 17.05.2000, "For the prevention of money laundering" has resolved by establishing the creation of a "Responsible Authority" to which they report a set of institutions defined by law and who carry out the verification of the recorded data seeking additional data. This authority is the "War Coordination Agency against Money Laundering" at the Ministry of Finance. The Bank of Albania, like any other subject of this law and in the quality of the supervisory authority of the subjects licensed by it, is tasked with notifying the Responsible Authority if during the conduct of its institutional activity identifies elements of money laundering with the aim of preventing it. text: 06/08/2022, 09:12 The Governor's Greeting Word at the Fourth Bank of Albania Conference BANK OF ALBANIA The Governor's Greeting Word at the Fourth Bank of Albania Conference Publication date: 11.09.2003 Honored Ladies and Gentlemen, I am very happy to welcome the honorable attendees of this hall, my friends and collaborators, those who have constantly contributed to the talkof our annual conferences and those who are for the first time in this year's audience. httpsK://wwwk.beankofalebaniiat.eorg/Shtypi/Ftjealimee_inteervista_aertiktuej/Fjalime/Fjai la_tpersehendetteesek_e_Gfuvernatoerit_n eE_Kkonferencein_e_hKatiertt_te_Bank... 1/3 06/08/2022, 09:12 The Governor's Greeting Word at the Fourth Bank of Albania Conference I have special pleasure, that on behalf of the organizers of the conference "Albanian Economy, achievement and challenges of economic policy", to express thanks and respect for the good friends of Albania and Albanians, present today in this hall, who have made contributions and have They leave a mark on the progress of our economy. I hope that such meetings also serve as public gestures that speak in the language of gratitude for these contributions that have somehow helped the Bank of Albania undertake scientific thought organizations on issues that stress the Albanian economy. Honored colleagues and associates, Albania, in these 13 years, has walked the path of progress. The economy is already, eventually, oriented towards development. We all, as authors and experiencers of our time, are leaning towards the best, towards the future. To live in a society that tries to build a safer future; to have institutions, that attempt advanced models; create a democratic people's middle man oriented by a positive result of the type of ideas; It's a success for the country and the economy. On the other hand, Albanian society, state and land have evolved, generally, simultaneously. This is probably related to our early tradition; perhaps imposed by the difficulty of survival over the years; Perhaps it relates to the great desire to see the country and itself among the most developed. But one thing is certain, that this general step forward supports and relies on an economy that is developing. How much the Albanian economy has grown and how; In which direction has he moved, and whenever he is stuck; These are not the object of this word. What I want to stress is that the economy has ultimately marked tangible growth by all. This increase becomes the support of our future projects and challenges. This growth feeds the belief that all of us are trying to give ourselves and the country what better development today offers and that we actually deserve better. Man must fight hard to gain more and more; He must use what he has gained to use well and then, in the end, have the heart and leave something to others who come after him. This is how the continuity of development is created. We have already laid the foundations for a comprehensive economic development. That this development will be fast or slow; Safe or fragile; Quiet or loaded with surprises is even beyond this conference. It matters that we have projected an ambitious future to the economy. Its realization takes a lot of effort; requires clear economic thinking; Requires bold decision-making; seeks broad vision in addressing problems and real economic development strategies. This is where I hope to express this conference more.  2/3 06/08/2022, 09:12 The Governor's Greeting Word at the Fourth Bank of Albania Conference Dear friends, We're gathered in this hall to talk about an argument that's not unknown to each of us. Shpresoj q takime t tilla t shrbejn edhe si gjeste publike q flasin n gjuhn e mirnjohjes pr kto kontribute q n njfar mnyre kan ndihmuar Bankn e Shqipris t ndrmarr organizime t mendimit shkencor pr shtje q stresojn ekonomin shqiptare. T nderuar koleg dhe bashkpuntor, Shqipria, n kta 13 vjet, ka ecur n rrugn e prparimit. Ekonomia tashm, prfundimisht sht orientuar drejt zhvillimit. Ne t gjith, si autor dhe prjetues t kohs son, jemi t prirur drejt m t mirs, drejt t ardhmes. T jetosh n nj shoqri, q prpiqet t ndrtoj nj t ardhme m t sigurt; t kesh institucione, q tentojn modele t prparuara; t krijosh nj mendsi popullore demokratike t orientuar nga nj rezultante pozitive e llojshmris s ideve; sht nj sukses pr vendin dhe pr ekonomin. N ann tjetr, shoqria, shteti dhe mendsia shqiptare kan evoluar, prgjithsisht, n mnyr t njkohshme. Kjo sht ndoshta e lidhur me traditn ton t hershme; ndoshta e imponuar nga vshtirsia e mbijetess npr vite; ndoshta lidhet me dshirn e madhe pr ta par vendin dhe veten midis m t zhvilluarve. They were present in the many countries in the world, especially in times of confusion, such as wars or economic downturns. Two the past few decades have been characterized by a continued easing of controls on the movements of capital, and many countries have fully opened their capital accounts. However, there are a number of countries, including Albania, in which capital accounts are not liberalized still. While Albania does not apply restrictions or controls on incoming influxes 1/2 05/08/22, 16:52 Capital Account Liberalization: Why, When and How? capital, it applies controls on most of its exit flows. The reasons behind the need for opening of the capital account relates to the benefits arising from this process, such as: increasing the major economic, diversification of investment opportunities, financial development, fulfillment of requirements set out by Albanian authorities in co-operation with the Organisation World Trade and the European Union, reducing the informal economy, achieving a low and stable inflation, etc. Liberalisation of capital account requires meeting certain conditions such as: a sound macroeconomic framework; a powerful institutional and regulatory infrastructure, especially in the financial sector; and an appropriate exchange rate regime. Consequently, we stress the importance of preserving and improving current macroeconomic indicators, such as GDP growth and inflation, the importance of careful monitoring of total debt levels, and especially external debt, and the immediate need for it Developed a strategy for generating currency, which will allow Albania to maintain a healthy balance of payment situation. As for the steps of liberalisation, in accordance with theory and with the practice of the present, we suggest that the opening of capital accounts in Albania should be treated carefully. How should this be understood? So we don't buy at all? Don't we buy everything we want? Don't we buy from some merchants or some certain service providers? These can be solutions of the moment, for once or of a separate person. What we have gathered to discuss is a solution that belongs to the general situation, all of us. Such solutions offer institutions, but must be supported by the public. To be supported, it must be understood, and like everything else that needs to be understood, our argument must first become the object of one or more conversations. It would be absurd for traders, producers, businessmen who offer different services not to think of getting richer and richer. It would also be absurd for a certain layer of people to think that only the state and society should care about solving their economic problems. I think it is right to aim towards a gain based on a sound economic logic, which like any other logic has been worked out and has gone through a lot of experiences of different countries. Nothing that's happening in our country today is a completely unknown phenomenon. The measure of the damage it causes and the traces it leaves in the economy of each and that of the country in general, is completely Albanian.  ritjes_Spekulative_te_Cmimeve_ne_Prag_te_Festave_te_Fundvitit.html Page 1 of 3 , Mr. Brilliance Cani in Ha... among Speculative Price Increases on The Eve of the End Of The Holidays 29/07/22, 14:54 Albanian tradition of celebration The first, which is about our former tradition. With some small exceptions in this hall, we all remember what happened to us and our parents on the eve of the New Year's Holidays. Endless queues to buy at least the fruits of the season, queue to buy drinks counted in species, queues even in baking ovens or for the few services on offer (bespoke sweets in a single pasta workshop that tirana had). And at the end of this training, all houses, in much the same way, had the same reserves of the same products for a few days in a row even after the Feast. The market in general remained only with the season vegetables, which were the only products predicted. Coming from such a situation, rightly all of us, at the first moment, had a desire to consume over measure. This led to the continuation of excess purchases before the holidays, the continuation of the collection of all purchases at the same time and in the continuity of everyone's purchases simultaneously. But we all forgot that in a market economy, which we ourselves talk about relentlessly, every action has its consequence, which in our case translates into: higher demand means higher prices. Thus, everyone can buy as much as they need for the holiday days, that back on the market they will continue to find all they need the next day and the day after, all the other days. On the other hand, there is no need for every item to be purchased at the last moment. Drinks for example, and full of other products, which can stay the same as in the store and at home does not have to be bought a few days ago. Only the busy traffic that is created on the streets of the city, leading to the majority markets or other points of trading food items to remember, and it's enough not to think about holiday shopping! This is what each of us has to do to help ourselves and others in this case. Opportunity to celebrate Second, it's about the opportunities to celebrate. From a recent questionnaire, made by the Bank of Albania, it turns out that the largest increase in prices is noticed in food items and food consumption outside the house. It is not seen, for example, the same price increase in valuables, cosmetics, perfumery, travel tickets, sports articles, cinema tickets, theatre, concerts, etc. Most of these businesses are as private and interested in profit as food merchants, restaurants, hotels, bars, etc. Likewise, the prices of books, albums, which in today's civilized world very often serve as symbolic gifts of the holiday season. Business behavior Another conclusion that has emerged from the questionnaire with the citizens of Tirana turns out that speculation is made by the majority traders. Right now, I want to stop at another point that is about how business itself thinks about this issue. Returning to the reasons for starting our conversation, I would like to stress that even without deliberate price increases in pragmatists, it is again won. I think no one else  ritjes_Spekulative_te_Cmimeve_ne_Prag_te_Festave_te_Fundvitit.html Page 2 of 3 , Mr. Brilliance Cani in Ha... among Speculative Price Increases on The Eve of the End Of The Holidays 29/07/22, 14:54 Present here, it does not go to mind that the managers of other businesses, who do not raise prices and which we just mentioned above, come out lost in this "golden" season for others. Well, here's what's gained even without "speculating" to say with the increase in demand for certain products. And it is gained by having a clearer economic opinion; working not only at the moment but also for the future; working not only for material gains, but also for a good name; thus investing in the future of business or trade. What role does the state play? As a last issue, I have considered addressing the role of the state and perhaps some issues related to our education. We were all used to the state controlling general market regulation to the extent it could. How much this arrangement complied with our request and how much it met, is already an extremely consummate argument for which it is not worth the minutes of this meeting to be spent. As we speak, the state also has a set of obligations which, to be honest, is not that it has always fulfilled them maximum. This is for many reasons, which are also not the purpose of this meeting. No matter how far above, the state realizes its classic role in a market economy, except others it needs to a small extent the co-operation of all of us. For this cooperation to work in all the halls - merchants - business - consumer manufacturers - it must be clear to everyone that living in the community has its own unwritten obligations, which, to a certain extent, cannot impose on any state. Until we all together, we have taken it upon ourselves to live in a market economy and build a society of the advanced economy, we must also together accept our share of the "fault" in the difficulties we have caused each other and to respect the rules of the game fairly.  ritjes_Spekulative_te_Cmimeve_ne_Prag_te_Festave_te_Fundvitit.html Page 3 of 3

Title: Report of the Governor to the Committee on Economy, Finance and Privatization.
text: , Mr. Brilliance Cani, at the meeting of the Interministerial Committee on National Security Policies 29/07/22, 15:04 , Mr. Brilliance Cani, at the meeting of the Interministerial Committee on National Security Policies Publication date: 26.11.2003 The Albanian economy during 2003 appears to have returned to its potential growth rhythms, following the slowdown observed in 2002. Various indicators generally point out that the forecast of economic growth for 2003, about 6 percent, remains a realistic possibility. Developments such as: sustainability in agricultural production, optimistic performance in service, industry and transport branches, increased trade exchange volume verified in the first 6-month of the year, increased tourist numbers, stable and favourable energy situations, sustainability in migrant currency flows and other factors, are credible arguments in achieving the country's economic growth target. 2003 is estimated to mark another year with consumer price stability. As well as over the previous 3 to 4 years, the Bank of Albania's forecasts speak of an annual inflation rate within the target interval, 2 to 4 percent. According to the most recent data, at the end of October 2003, the 12-month change in the consumer price index recorded the 2.9 percent figure, while annual inflation measured as the average of the last twelve months scored only 2.27 percent, reinforcing a clear downward tendency. The Bank of Albania, in its recent analyses, has pointed out that the monetary policy pursued by it has taken life under the terms of a careful fiscal policy, where particular emphasis has been placed on controlling budgetary spending in relation to realized revenues. This has led to this moment the needs for  n_e_Komitetit_Nderministror_te_Politikave_te_Sigurimit_Kombetar.html Page 1 of 4 , Mr. Brilliance Cani, at the meeting of the Interministerial Committee on National Security Policies 29/07/22, 15:04 The Government's liquidity is fully met on the part of the banking system, making it unnecessary to finance the Bank of Albania. Under these circumstances fiscal pressures on monetary policy are pale. By following this course of reasoning, it can be concluded that the movement of both policies (monetary and fiscal) has been harmonized and in line with the country's overall financial economic development programme. Internal financing of the budget deficit by the banking system during 2003 is projected to be approximately the same level as in 2002, being about 2.2 percent of GDP. The government's steady level of domestic borrowing, in the face of rapidly increasing deposits in money, has been another factor that has influenced the rapid decline in treasury bond interest. The monetary policy of 2003 continued to be cautious, with easing tendencies. This has been reflected in lowering interest rates three times this year. Following the continuous performance of inflation and the liquidity indicators of the banking system, the Bank of Albania has decreased by 1.5 percentage points in total the rate of repurchase agreements during 2003, bringing it at the end of October to the same level as last year's liquidity pre-crisis level. The banking system has responded by lowering interest rates on deposit sourcing, treasury bonds and transactions on the interbank market. Low inflationary expectations of banks have led the banking system's response to the interest rate cut to outweigh the lowering of the basic interest rate in the quarterly maturity deadline, for both deposits and treasury bonds. This has affected the reduction of real interest rates in 2003. However, they have remained positive thanks to maintaining the inflation rate within the Bank of Albania's target in the last six months. Real interest rates in positive terms have maintained the interest of individuals and subjects to deposit their savings in the banking system, thus helping to preserve liquidity reports in the system. Monetary developments show that the hemorrhage of deposits in the spring of 2002 has been completely exceeded, which manifests itself in a liquidity surplus of the banking system, which on average has fluctuated to the level of 5.3 billion dollars during 2003. It is worth pointing out that the creation of excess liquidity has influenced the reduction of the cost of brokering the banking system, expressed in lowering the difference in interest rates of treasury bonds and deposits in money. In support of the growth of the economy, it seems that the following year has marked an increase in the support of the economy with loans. Banks' loan portfolio for the private sector of the economy has increased by 9.3 billion dollars during the first 9 months of the year. During this period the economy was given 63.8 billion new loans, or 44 percent more than during the same period last year. Based on verified developments over the nine-month period, current developments in the liquidity of the banking system, etc., it can be concluded that monetary developments during 2003 will be a more contribution to consolidating the country's overall macroeconomic balance. On the other hand, developments in the outside sector of the economy speak of a further increase in foreign trade activity where the most positive developments are expected. Meanwhile, according to preliminary data, the number of tourists in the first 9 months of 2003 has seen an increase, thus recording another optimistic development. Viti 2003 vlersohet se do t shnoj nj vit tjetr me stabilitet t mimeve t konsumit. Ashtu si dhe gjat 3 - 4 vitet t mparshme, parashikimet e Banks s Shqipris flasin pr nj norm vjetore inflacioni brenda intervalit objektiv, 2 - 4 pr qind. Sipas t dhnave m t fundit, n prfundim t muajit tetor 2003, ndryshimi 12mujor i indeksit t mimeve t konsumit rregjistroi shifrn 2.9 pr qind, ndrkoh q inflacioni vjetor i matur si mesatare e dymbdhjet muajve t fundit shnoi vetm 2.27 pr qind, duke prforcuar nj tendenc t qart rnse t tij. Banka e Shqipris, n analizat e saj t kohve t fundit, ka nnvizuar se politika monetare e ndjekur prej saj ka marr jet n kushtet e nj politike fiskale t kujdesshme, ku theks i veant i sht vn kontrollit t shpenzimeve buxhetore n raport me t ardhurat e realizuara. N kto rrethana presionet fiskale mbi politikn monetare jan t zbehta. Duke vijuar kt rrjedh arsyetimi, mund t konkludohet se lvizja e t dy politikave (asaj monetare dhe asaj fiskale) ka qen e harmonizuar dhe n prputhje me programin e prgjithshm t zhvillimit ekonomiko financiar t vendit. Financimi i brendshm i deficitit buxhetor nga sistemi bankar gjat vitit 2003 sht parashikuar t jet afrsisht n t njjtin nivel me at t vitit 2002, duke qen rreth 2.2 pr qind e PBB-s. Niveli i qndrueshm i huamarrjes s brendshme t qeveris, prball rritjes s shpejt t depozitave n lek, ka qen nj tjetr faktor q ka ndikuar n rnien e shpejt t interesave t bonove t thesarit. Politika monetare e vitit 2003 ka vazhduar t jet e kujdesshme, me tendenca zbutjeje. Kjo sht pasqyruar n uljen e normave t interesit tre her gjat ktij viti. Duke ndjekur n vazhdimsi ecurin e inflacionit dhe treguesit e likuiditetit t sistemit bankar, Banka e Shqipris ka ulur me 1.5 pik prqindjeje n total normn e marrveshjeve t riblerjes gjat vitit 2003, duke e uar at n fund t muajit tetor n nivel t njjt me nivelin e parakrizs s likuiditetit t vitit t kaluar. Sistemi bankar ka reaguar duke ulur normat e interesit t pranimit t depozitave, t bonove t thesarit dhe t transaksioneve n tregun ndrbankar. Pritjet e ulta inflacioniste t bankave kan br q reagimi i sistemit bankar n uljen e norms s interesit t tejkaloj uljen e norms baz t interesit n afatin e maturimit tremujor, si pr depozitat ashtu dhe pr bonot e thesarit. Kjo ka ndikuar n uljen e normave reale t interesit gja vitit 2003. Gjithsesi, ato kan mbetur pozitive n saj t ruajtjes s norms s inflacionit brenda objektivit t Banks s Shqipris n gjasht muajt e fundit. Normat reale t interesit n terma pozitiv kan ruajtur interesin e individve dhe subjektet pr t depozituar kursimet e tyre n sistemin bankar, duke ndihmuar kshtu n ruajtjen e raporteve t likuiditetit n sistem. Zhvillimet monetare tregojn se hemoragjia e depozitave n pranvern e vitit 2002, sht tejkaluar plotsisht, gj q manifestohet n nj tepric likuiditeti t sistemit bankar, e cila mesatarisht sht luhatur n nivelin 5.3 miliard lek gjat vitit 2003. Vlen t theksohet se krijimi i likuiditetit t teprt ka ndikuar n uljen e kostos s ndrmjetsimit t sistemit bankar, i shprehur n uljen e diferencs s normave t interesit t bonove t thesarit dhe t depozitave n lek. N mbshtetje t rritjes s ekonomis, duket se viti n vazhdim ka shnuar nj rritje t mbshtetjes s ekonomis me kredi. Portofoli i kredis s bankave pr sektorin privat t ekonomis sht rritur me 9.3 miliard lek gjat 9 muajve t par t vitit. Gjat ksaj periudhe ekonomis i jan dhn 63.8 miliard lek kredi e re, ose 44 pr qind m shum se gjat s njjts periudh t vitit t kaluar. Bazuar n zhvillimet e verifikuara gjat nntmujorit, n zhvillimet aktuale n likuiditetin e sistemit bankar etj., mund t konkludohet se zhvillimet monetare gjat vitit 2003, do t jen nj kontribut m shum n konsolidimin e ekuilibrit t prgjithshm makroekonomik t vendit. Nga ana tjeter, zhvillimet ne sektorin e jashtem te ekonomise flasin per nje rritje te metejshme te aktivitetit te tregtise se jashtme ku zhvillimet me pozitive i p[erkasin https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjal_e_Komitetit_Nderministror_te_Politikave_te_Sigurimit_Kombetar.html Pagina 2 di 4 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, Z.Shklqim Cani, n mbledhjen e Komitetit Ndrministror t Politikave t Sigurimit Kombtar 29/07/22, 15:04 rritjes se eksporteve dhe dergesave nga emigrantet. Nderkohe, sipas te dhenave paraprake numri i turisteve ne 9 muajt e pare te vitit 2003 ka njohur rritje duke regjistruar keshtu nje tjeter zhvillim optimist. Kursi i kembimit, duke pasqyruar zhvillimet ne perqindjet e interesit ne ekonomine amerikane dhe ate evropiane, zhvillimet ne tregjet nderkombetare si dhe ato ne tregun e brendshem, leku ka manifestuar nje lloj mbimimi ndaj dy monedhave kryesore. Ne keto rrethana, banka e Shqiperise here pas here ka nderhyre ne treg per te zbutur presionet e ofertes ne valute. Publication date: 16.12.2003 In line with its framework for drafting and implementing monetary policy, the Bank of Albania builds the monetary programme every year, which is a financial plan aimed at disciplining the circulation of funds in the economy, in line with the country's development goals. The main goal is to meet the economy's needs for monetary means, without affecting the breakdown of the balance of demand and supply for monetary means, producing inflation or contracting the economy. The 2004 monetary programme was also built on the same premises. It is no secret that even for next year, as in previous years, the country's two main institutions in the field of economy and finance, the Government of Albania and the Bank of Albania, have reached consensus on the country's overall development goals, including what is considered to be harmonized coexistence between fiscal and monetary policies. Furthermore, this process has been part of a constructive consultation with institutions such as the IMF and BB, enabling a new financial agreement with these two institutions to be reached for 2004. The Bank of Albania's monetary policy during 2003 was characterized by easing tendencies of monetary conditions, in line with easing inflationary pressures and improving monetary indicators. The Bank of Albania has begun implementing a easing monetary policy since April this year by lowering the basic interest rate by 0.5 percentage points. In July and October this year, two more lows were made, 0.5 percentage points each, lowering the base interest rate to the level it had at the beginning of a year earlier. At the end of the month of 2003, the basic interest rate was 7.0 per cent, the annual inflation rate for this month resulted in 3.4 per cent, while average annual inflation at the end of October is only 2.24 per cent. Data e publikimit: 16.12.2003 N prputhje me kuadrin e saj t hartimit dhe zbatimit t politiks monetare, Banka e Shqipris ndrton cdo vit programin monetar, i cili sht nj plan financiar q synon disiplinimin e qarkullimit t fondeve n ekonomi, n prputhje me objektivat e zhvillimit t vendit. Synimi kryesor sht prmbushja e nevojave t ekonomis pr mjete monetare, pa ndikuar n prishjen e ekuilibrit t krkess dhe oferts pr mjete monetare, duke prodhuar inflacion ose duke kontraktuar ekonomin. Edhe programi monetar i vitit 2004 sht ndrtuar mbi t njjtat premisa. Nuk prbn ndonj sekret fakti q edhe pr vitin e ardhshm, ashtu si n vitet e mparshme, dy institucionet kryesore vendimarrse t vendit n fushn e ekonomis dhe t financave, Qeveria e Shqipris dhe Banka e Shqipris, kan arritur konsensusin pr objektivat e prgjithshm t zhvillimit t vendit, prfshir dhe at q konsiderohet si bashkjetes e harmonizuar midis politikave fiskale dhe monetare. Pr m tepr, ky proces ka qen pjes e nj konsultimi konstruktiv me institucione t tilla si FMN dhe BB, duke br t mundur q edhe pr vitin 2004 t arrihet nj marrveshje e re financiare me kto dy institucione. Politika monetare e Banks s Shqipris gjat vitit 2003 sht karakterizuar nga tendencat lehtsuese t kushteve monetare, n prputhje me zbutjen e presioneve inflacioniste dhe prmirsimin e treguesve monetar. Banka e Shqipris ka filluar zbatimin e nj politike monetare zbutse q prej muajit prill t ktij viti duke ulur normn baz t interesi me 0.5 pik prqind. N muajt korrik dhe tetor t ktij viti u bn dhe dy ulje t tjera, 0.5 pik prqindje secila, duke e cuar normn baz t interesit n nivelin q kishte n fillim t nj viti m par. N fund t muajit nentor t vitit 2003, norma baz e interesit ishte 7.0 prqind, norma vjetore e inflacionit pr kt muaj rezultoi 3.4 prqind, ndrsa inflacioni mesatar vjetor n fund t muajit tetor sht vetm 2.24 prqind. text: On the presentation meeting of the Bank of Albania's draft strategy 29/07/22, 15:03 On the presentation meeting of the Bank of Albania's draft strategy Publication date: 15.01.2004 Today at the Bank of Kumanovo, the presentation of the Bank Of Europe Strategy Presentation was held. In the opening word, the Governor of Bankes se Kumanovo, Mr. Debar Cani, stated that "the Bank of Albania has made its commitments in the process of economic-financial reform within the framework of the Stabilisation and Association Agreement with the European Union being part of the Albanian negotiation team led by the Ministry of European Integration. Also, in co-operation with the Ministry of Finance, the Bank of Albania is committed to implementing financial reforms within the framework of the memorandum of economic policies with the International Monetary Fund". According to Mr. Cani, liberalisation is capital accounting is inevitable and is the task of this table assigning further and concrete steps and preparing an optimal process of liberalisation, such as this, to deliver the desired benefits. Albania has committed to liberalising its capital account and has taken it up to do so within a certain time limit. In the Wto Albania Accession Working Group Report, the removal of capital controls is one of the horizontal commitments. The report stresses that: "The Bank of Albania reserves the right to maintain controls on capital movement, which will be implemented on a national treatment basis. The regime currently in the country will be abolished no later than 2010. At the same time, Albania is preparing to sign the Stabilisation Association Agreement, which represents the first step towards EU integration. In this agreement there will also be points related to capital account liberalisation, as well as time limits, beyond which each of the transactions can be carried out freely.  in_e_prezantimit_te_projektstrategjise_se_Bankes_se_Shqiperise.html Page 1 of 2 On the presentation meeting of the Bank of Albania's draft strategy 29/07/22, 15:03 It is very well known that on the road to European integration free movement of capital is one of the conditions of membership. A long and gradual process of financial integration of all countries has been developed in the European Union, finally achieving that countries are equal in relations with each other. On today's table, specialists from the Bank of Albania presented the current level of capital movement rules and situations, using a standard European Union document on "Applicable Rules for Capital Movements". This document highlights the current situation, while the presenters and discussers also spoke on: - bank of Albania's commitments to capital account liberalisation within the framework of agreements with the World Trade Organisation and the Project for Stabilisation Association with the European Union; - positive and problematic sides of liberalisation; - what is currently done at the Bank of Albania; - tasks that need to be accomplished in the future; - interaction with other institutions; - public awareness of the problems and benefits of liberalizing capital account. The meeting concluded that after this table to be built as soon as possible the fullest matrix of responsible steps, activities and entities that will work in the process of liberalising capital account where the Bank of Albania will play its leading and managing role in this process. text: Mr. Brilliance Cani at the ceremony of the inauguration of the interbank payment system 29/07/22, 15:03 Mr. Brilliance Cani at the ceremony of the inauguration of the interbank payment system Publication date: 08.03.2004 Honorable participants! Thanking you for your participation, I am pleased to officially announce the completion and inauguration of the interbank payment system in real time. I say officially, because the so-called AIPS system actually starting as of January 30, 2004, after successfully passing all the necessary tests is fully operational. I do not judge that I exaggerate, but the Bank of Albania has taken one of the most important steps in the reform process for the banking system towards international standards in recent years for the development and perfection of banking business infrastructure in the country. At the time we launched the project, I did not have the full conviction for the realization at the specific deadline of the project, started by non-positive experiences in the countries that implemented the same project. The process faced difficulties, among which the main ones I think were the coordination of the large number of actors in the project; overall infrastructure in the country, which must be accepted that still remains unfavourable for extensive implementation of information systems; and limited experience in applying important payment systems, which are complex and aim at a high degree of technical and legal issues.  ne_ceremonine_e_perurimit_te_sistemit_te_pagesave_nderbankare.html Page 1 of 3 Mr. Brilliance Cani at the ceremony of the inauguration of the interbank payment system 29/07/22, 15:03 However, the implementation of the system at a total time of 8 months was a very positive result if we compared it to the same experiences of similar countries. This, I think was the fruit of a joint job of the Bank of Albania and the banks that use the system. The interbank payment system - AIPS, can already be considered the main connecting infrastructure of the entire banking system. It creates optimal, equal conditions for both the realization of exchanges between banks and for the safe development of the interbank market. It is installed in the Bank of Albania and through secure communication networks extends to all authorised banks that use it. The system maintains bank accounts and enables the immediate and real-time finalization of all payment instructions, which move through electronic messages. The atonement and finalisation of these instructions is carried out through the immediate movement of funds between the accounts that banks hold in the system. The system, after that, takes care of the immediate announcement of the beneficiary of the funds, as well as for allowing their use. By shifting to some of the benefits this system will bring briefly I will stress that it is expected: 1. Lower the operational risk rate in the banking system; 2. Strengthen the stability of the banking system in general; 3. Increase the eficiency in the management of financial funds and in the exchange of values between the banking system; 4. Further promote developments in the field of payments as well as the development of the sector financial in general; and: 5. Directly affect the increase in reliability and reputation of the Albanian banking system, in the eyes of the local and foreign public. His beneficiaries will also be: Albanian business can make payments or transfers of funds within the day and to any bank branch. The general public will be able to make "rapid payments - AIPS" within the day. Started by the experiences of similar countries, the benefits of the new system, I hope that they will soon be understood and felt by all its users. How's the system working? The current performance of its functioning and behavior is positive. From the first day of operation, the processing of 94 payments worth nearly 40 million was completed. While during the first month of operation the system has finalized an average of 100 payments worth 48 million each day. The maximum recorded charge coincides with a number of about 130 payments per day, with a value of more than 100 million. The full processing time of an instruction on average is less than 2 seconds.  ne_ceremonine_e_perurimit_te_sistemit_te_pagesave_nderbankare.html Page 2 of 3 Mr. Brilliance Cani at the ceremony of the inauguration of the interbank payment system 29/07/22, 15:03 We judge that the system itself will encourage banks on the one hand to be more active in managing their funds and business and the Albanian public on the other, to use the fast payment service more and more. I take the opportunity to welcome the member banks of the system, expressing my confidence and the institution I lead, that this co-operation will increase in the future, and especially in the two major projects of the Bank of Albania: that of the clergy of small-value payments and that of reducing cash money in the economy. After the completion of this project the Bank of Albania has considered further improving the country's financial infrastructure by engaging in another project of national size, that of the intersection of small-value payments. Expressing confidence that even in this case co-operation and inter-insitutional understanding will be at the same level, expresses the assessment that a successful implementation of this new project would mark an important step in the direction of meeting our major objectives. Equally important, I would appreciate the new project even in the function of the latest initiative that we as the Bank of Albania have received before public opinion, that of reducing cash money in the economy. Despite the complexity and interinstitutional dependencies that exist in successfully fulfilling this initiative, I am convinced that the payment intersection system together with the modern system we are inaugurating today will be two delineating steps in ensuring success. Of course, until the project was completed, a series of actors participated for which I want to express special considerations: Sincere thanks belong to the World Bank and its staff engaged in the project, such as the bank of Albania's leading initiator, co-financier and supporter in the project. At the same time, I take the opportunity to express confidence in the success of co-operation even in the project for the creation of automated payment clergy in small value. Special congratulations belong to Montran, Mr. Charls Walch, Vice President, and company employees, who through continued co-operation with the Bank of Albania enabled the timely and quality realization of the project. A special thank you i would address to the International Monetary Fund as well as to the Project Implementation Unit at the Ministry of Finance. In the end, sincere thanks would also be sent to the staff of the Bank of Albania, who professionally enabled the successful completion of this project. Successes to all users of the system and thank you!  ne_ceremonine_e_perurimit_te_sistemit_te_pagesave_nderbankare.html Page 3 of 3

Ky, mendoj se ishte frut i nj pune t prbashkt t Banks s Shqipris dhe bankave prdoruese sistemit. Sistemi i pagesave ndrbankare - AIPS, tashm mund t konsiderohet si infrastruktura kryesore lidhse e t gjith sistemit bankar. Ai krijon kushte optimale, t barabarta si pr realizimin e shkmbimeve midis bankave ashtu pr zhvillimin n mnyr t sigurt t tregut ndrbankar. Ai sht i instaluar n Bankn e Shqipris dhe nprmjet rrjeteve t sigurta t komunikimit shtrihet n t gjitha bankat e autorizuara q e prdorin at. Sistemi mban llogarit e bankave dhe mundson finalizimin e menjhershm dhe n koh reale t t gjith instruksioneve t pagesave, q lvizin nprmjet mesazheve elektronike. Shlyerja dhe finalizimi i ktyre instruksioneve kryhet nprmjet lvizjes s menjhershme t fondeve midis llogarive q bankat mbajn n sistem. Sistemi, pas ksaj, kujdeset pr njoftimin e menjhershm t prfituesit t fondeve, si dhe pr lejimin e prdorimit t tyre. Duke u zhvendosur tek disa nga prfitimet q do t sjell ky sistem shkurtimisht do t theksoj se ai pritet: 1. T ul shkalln e rrezikut operacional n sistemin bankar; 2. T forcoj stabilitetin e sistemit bankar n prgjithsi; 3. T rris eficiencen n administrimin e fondeve financiare dhe n shkmbimin e vlerave midis sistemit bankar; 4. T nxis m tej zhvillimet n fushn e pagesave si dhe zhvillimin e sektorit financiar n prgjithsi; dhe: 5. T ndikoj n mnyr t drejtprdrejt n rritjen e besueshmris dhe reputacionit t sistemit bankar shqiptar, n syt e publikut vendas dhe t huaj. Prfitues t tij, do t jen, gjithashtu: Biznesi shqiptar, mund t realizoj pagesa apo transferime t fondeve brenda dits dhe n do deg banke. Publiku i gjer, do t mundet q n do koh t realizoj, brenda dits "pagesa t shpejta - AIPS". Nisur edhe nga eksperiencat e vendeve t ngjashme, prfitimet e sistemit t ri, shpreoj se shum shpejt do t kuptohen dhe do t ndjehen nga t gjith prdoruesit e tij. Si po funksionon sistemi? Ecuria e deritanishme e funksionimit dhe e sjelljes s tij, sht pozitive. Q n ditn e par t operimit u realizua prpunimi i 94 pagesave me nj vler prej afro 40 milion dollarsh. Ndrkoh q, gjat muajit t par t operimit sistemi ka finalizuar do dit mesatarisht 100 pagesa me vler 48 milion dollar. Ngarkesa maksimale e regjistruar prkon me nj numr prej rreth 130 pagesash n dit, me nj vler e cila ka kaprcyer shifrn 100 milion dollar. Koha e prpunimit t plot t nj instruksioni mesatarisht sht m pak se 2 sekonda. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjne_ceremonine_e_perurimit_te_sistemit_te_pagesave_nderbankare.html Pagina 2 di 3 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris z.Shklqim Cani n ceremonin e prurimit t sistemit t pagesave ndrbankare 29/07/22, 15:03 Gjykojm, se vet sistemi do t inkurajoj bankat nga njra an t tregohen m aktive n administrimin e fondeve t tyre dhe biznesin e publikun shqiptar nga ana tjetr, pr t prdorur gjithnj e m shum shrbimin e pagesave t shpejta. Muz and Eduk " Head / Press / Speeches, interviews, articles / Speeches Press releases Notices of # meetings of Council Supervisor Press conference Speeches, interview articles Speeches Interview of articles Calendars # Official holiday calendar for 2022 COVID-19 Europe # BANK OF ALBANIA 2004 challenge: reducing cash and replacing with banking actions Governor's Lecture, Mr. Brilliance Cani, at the Economicfaculty of Alexander Juvani University of Tirana Publication date: 01.04.2004 Today, The Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Brilliance Cani, held a special lecture with students of the Economic Faculty of the Alexander Juvani University of the city of Tirana, with the themes "Challenge of 2004: reducing cash money and replacement with banking actions". In the presection of the lecture, Mr. Cani mainly stopped at the causes of cash circulation in the Albanian economy and its interdependence with the informal and informal economy. The Bank of Albania considers reducing the use of cash in the economy as a complex problem, not just of the Central Bank institution. The BSH programme for reducing cash and replacing with actions with banks requires the co-operation of all important participants in the country's economic development. The first phase of the Bank of Albania's programme for reducing cash in the economy closed in November 2003, with the implementation of the interinstitutional roundtable. During this phase, meetings and discussions were held between the Ministry of Finance, the Ministry of Economy, the Bank of Albania and the second-rate banks, KESh, Albtelecom, Albaposta. This phase is considered to be the period of awareness, mainly of state institutions regarding the problem of the wide presence of cash use in our economy.  etin_Ekonomik_te_Universitetit_Aleksander_Xhuvani_te_Elbasanit.html Page 1 of 3 Governor's Lecture, Mr. Brilliance Cani, at the Economicfaculty of Alexander Juvani University of Tirana 29/07/22, 15:03 The Albanian government is very interested in reducing this phenomenon, because it directly affects the finding of effective ways for the country's economic growth. This is because money is channelled through official routes and returned to use through the banking system. In this way, parts of the country's economic activity turn from unidentified to identified. This element rightly makes the Albanian government (Ministry of Finance and Ministry of Economy) considered the closest associate of the Bank of Albania in this programme. How can cash be reduced in the Albanian economy? Banks, business and individuals are one side of the relationship that arises to serve the reduction of cash, while the government with the respective administrative structures (the Directorate General of Taxation and that of Customs), has a demarcating role in regulating this relationship in favour of jocash. The state administration can act in some important directions by thus fulfilling the regulatory role that the state has in this broad relationship. Let's list some of the headings: 1. Payments and cashing in favour of the state budget should be carried out maximum through the banking system. This measure is aimed at engaging business in the conduct of bank transfers only. 2. Obligation to open accounts and conduct bank transfers even in relations with fiscal bodies, must have not only big business, but in all Albanian business; 3. stimulation of the wide use of various banking forms of payments such as cheques, etc. The big push must be given to small business in this direction not for the sum, but simply for their large number; 4. It is deemed that the time has come for the write-off of obligations in the form of salaries and other bonuses of the state administration to be carried out through bank accounts. The idea of passing pensions through bank accounts can also be addressed here; 5. Installation and start-up of the work of the clergy system, is a step that helps the relationship: bank - client (business or individual) - taxes and customs - statistical information system. 6. N parashtresn e leksionit, z.Cani u ndal kryesisht n shkaqet e qarkullimit t paras cash n ekonomin shqiptare dhe ndrvarsin e saj me ekonomin informale dhe jozyrtare. Banka e Shqipris e konsideron reduktimin e prdorimit t cash-it n ekonomi, si nj problem kompleks, jo vetm i institucionit t Banks Qendrore. Programi i BSH-s pr reduktimin e cash-it dhe zvendsimit me veprime me bankat, krkon bashkpunimin e t gjith pjesmarrsve t rndsishm t zhvillimit ekonomik t vendit. Faza e par e programit t Banks s Shqipris pr reduktimin e cash n ekonomi u mbyll n nntor t vitit 2003, me realizimin e tryeze t rrumbullakt, ndrinstitucionale. Gjat ksaj faze u zhvilluan takime dhe diskutime ndrmjet Ministris s Financave, Ministris s Ekonomis, Banks s Shqipris dhe bankave t nivelit t dyt, KESh-it, Albtelecom-it, Albaposts. Kjo faz sht konsideruar si periudha e sensibilizimit, kryesisht t institucioneve shtetrore n lidhje me problemin e pranis s gjer t prdorimit t cash -it n ekonomin ton. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjaletin_Ekonomik_te_Universitetit_Aleksander_Xhuvani_te_Elbasanit.html Pagina 1 di 3 Leksion i Guvernatorit, z.Shklqim Cani, n Fakultetin Ekonomik t Universitetit Aleksandr Xhuvani t Elbasanit 29/07/22, 15:03 Qeveria Shqiptare, sht mjaft e interesuar pr t reduktuar kt fenomen, sepse ai ndikon drejtprdrejt n gjetjen e rrugve efikase pr rritjen ekonomike t vendit. Kjo pr faktin se parat kanalizohen nprmjet rrugve zyrtare dhe kthehen n t shfrytzueshme nprmjet sistemit bankar. N kt mnyr, pjes t aktivitetit ekonomik t vendit kthehen nga t paidentifikuara' n t identifikuara'. Ky element, bn q me t drejt qeveria shqiptare (Ministria e Financave dhe Ministria e Ekonomis) t konsiderohet bashkpuntorja m e afrt e Banks s Shqipris n kt program. Si mund t reduktohet cash-i n ekonomin shqiptare? Bankat, biznesi dhe individt jan njra an e marrdhnies q lind pr t'i shrbyer reduktimit t cash-it, ndrsa qeveria me strukturat prkatse administrative (Drejtoria e Prgjithshme e Tatimeve dhe ajo e Doganave), ka nj rol prcaktues n rregullimin e ksaj marrdhnie n favor t jocash-it. Administrata shtetrore, mund t veproj n disa drejtime t rndsishme duke prmbushur kshtu, rolin rregullativ q shteti ka n kt marrdhnie t gjer. Le t listojm disa prej drejtimeve: 1. pagesat dhe arktimet n favor t buxhetit t shtetit duhet t kryhen maksimalisht nprmjet sistemit bankar. Kjo mas synon prfshirjen e biznesit n kryerjen vetm t transfertave bankare. 2. detyrim pr elje llogarish dhe kryerje transfertash bankare edhe n marrdhnie me organet fiskale, duhet t'i ket jo vetm biznesi i madh, por n trsi biznesi shqiptar; 3. stimulimi i prdorimit t gjer t formave te ndryshme bankare te pagesave si si psh ekut etj. Shtytje e madhe i duhet dhn edhe biznesit t vogl n kt drejtim jo pr shumn, por thjesht pr numrin e madh t tyre; 4. gjykohet se ka ardhur koha q shlyerja e detyrimeve n formn e pagave dhe shprblimeve t tjera t administrats shtetrore t kryhet nprmjet llogarive bankare. Ktu mund t trajtohet edhe ideja e kalimit t pensioneve nprmjet llogarive bankare; 5. instalimi dhe fillimi nga puna i sistemit t kleringut, sht nj hap q ndihmon marrdhnien: bank - klient (biznes ose individ) - tatime dhe dogana - sistem informacioni statistikor. 6. rishikimi i kuadrit ligjor dhe rregullativ q ndihmon problemin pr t cilin diskutohet sot; 7. kryerja e likuidimeve t detyrimeve mujore (energji, uj, telefon, rimbursime shndetsore) t punonjsve t administrates publike nprmjet transferts bankare. Bankat e nivelit t dyt, jan aktore q luajn nj rol mjaft t rndsishm n marrdhnien ekonomi - klient - cash. Gjykojme se ka ardhur koha q sistemi bankar t veproj m me agresivitet, sidomos sot, kur pritet q konkurrenca n tregun bankar do t rritet me tej ve te tjerash edhe me ardhjen e Raiffeisen Zentral Bank. The theme of the lecture was the Central Bank and the banking system in Kumanovo. Initially, Mr. Cani made a theoretical treatment of the banking system by focusing on the basic functions of a central bank and a universal commercial bank. The Governor then stopped developments in the banking system for the past 7 years: Macroeconomic stability has recognised improvements during this period, following the pyramid crisis of 1996-1997. Financial sector reforms marked significant progress in the period. They relate to the privatisation of state-owned banks and the entrances of new private banks, which have influenced deepening financial mediation and increasing the quality of banking services. Characteristic of these developments was the increase in the number of banks through new private banks, which currently capture the figure of 16. In 1997, another bank with entirely foreign capital, the International Commercial Bank, was licensed, while in 1998 the American Bank of Albania and the Tirana Branch of Alpha Credit Bank were licensed. In 1999, three other banks, the First Investment Bank, the Commercial Bank of Greece and the ProCredit Bank (Fefad), began activity, while in 2002 the Albanian Credit Bank was licensed. The Credins Bank and the People's Bank were licensed in 2003. Currently, Albania has 5.3 banks for one million inhabitants while Bulgaria has almost the same indicator, Romania has 1.5 banks for one million inhabitants, Hungary 3 banks and Croatia 10 banks.  im_Cani_ne_Fakultetin_Ekonomik_te_Universitetit_Fan_Noli_Korce.html Page 1 of 3 Lecture by Governor of the Bank of Albania Mr. Brilliance Cani at the Faculty of Economics of Fan Noli University, Korca 29/07/22, 15:03 Banking activity has come in expanding along with the expansion of banks in the market, increasing both active and bank deposits. At the end of 2003, the total active system results in 373.6 billion dollars or about 50% of GDP. On the other hand, the level of deposits has marked continuous increases from 178.2 billion dollars in '98 to 323.2 billion in 2003. The level of financial mediation has further deepened, reflecting the positive trend of developments in the banking sector. The ratio of total deposits to PPB, which is one of the main indicators of the level and depth of financial mediation, has come in increasing throughout the transition period and especially after 1998, marking the 43% level in 2003. The same trend also shows the ratio of term deposits to PPB, as the most synificating indicator of mediation, which increased significantly from 12.8% in 1994, to 29.3% in 1998 and 35.3% in 2003. Another characteristic of positive developments in the banking sector is the improvement of the credit market. Two are the most positive trends observed in this market: the first continuous increase in private sector lending and the second the reduction of troubled credit to the total credit. Credit activity of system banks increased by 30.5 percent during 2003. Although this activity accounts for only 13.5 percent of the total active system, the ratio increases to 27.9 percent if we exclude the Savings Bank from estimates. This fact is a good support for further expansion of lending, taking into account the activation of the Savings Bank in the field of lending, following the completion of its privatisation. The banking market underwent significant developments during 2003. The most prominent development, which will have major impacts on the banking system, was the privatisation of the Savings Bank by the renowned raiffeisen bank. During this year, two new banks, with local capital, entered the banking market. The financial situation of the banking system over the past few years has been satisfactory. The Albanian banking system has resulted in continued profitability, guaranteeing its liquidity and increasingly meeting the economy's credit needs. Tema e leksionit ishte Banka qendrore dhe sistemi bankar ne Shqiperi. Fillimisht z.Cani beri nje trajtim teorik te sistemit bankar duke u fokusuar ne funksionet baze te nje banke qendrore dhe te nje banke tregtare universale. Me pas Guvernatori u ndal ne zhvillimet ne sistemin bankar gjate 7 viteve te fundit : Stabiliteti makroekonomik ka njohur prmirsime gjat ksaj periudhe, pas krizs s piramidave t viteve 1996-1997 . Reformat e sektorit financiar shnuan progres t rndsishm n kt periudh. Ato lidhen me privatizimin e bankave shtetrore dhe me hyrjet e bankave t reja private, t cilat kan ndikuar n thellimin e ndrmjetsimit financiar dhe n rritjen e cilsis s shrbimeve bankare. Karakteristik ktyre zhvillimeve ishte rritja e numrit t bankave nprmjet bankave t reja private, t cilat aktualisht kapin shifrn 16. N vitin 1997 u licencua nj bank tjetr me kapital trsisht t huaj, Banka Ndrkombtare Tregtare, ndrkoh q n vitin 1998 u licencua Banka Amerikane e Shqipris dhe Dega e Tirans e Banks Alpha Credit. N vitin 1999 filluan aktivitetin edhe tre banka t tjera, Banka e Par e Investimeve, Banka Tregtare e Greqis dhe Banka ProCredit (Fefad), ndrsa n vitin 2002 u licencua Banka Shqiptare e Kreditit. Banka Credins dhe Banka Popullore u licencuan n vitin 2003. Aktualisht, Shqipria ka 5.3 banka pr nj milion banor ndrkoh q Bullgaria ka thuajse t njjtin tregues, Rumania ka 1.5 banka pr nj milon banor, Hungaria 3 banka dhe Kroacia 10 banka . https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjaim_Cani_ne_Fakultetin_Ekonomik_te_Universitetit_Fan_Noli_Korce.html Pagina 1 di 3 Leksion i Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris z.Shklqim Cani n Fakultetin Ekonomik t Universitetit Fan Noli, Kor 29/07/22, 15:03 Aktiviteti bankar ka ardhur duke u zgjeruar bashk me zgjerimin e bankave n treg, duke u rritur si aktivet ashtu edhe depozitat e bankave. N fundin e vitit 2003, totali i aktiveve t sistemit rezulton 373.6 miliard lek ose rreth 50% e PBB-s. Nga ana tjetr, niveli i depozitave ka shnuar rritje t vazhdueshme nga 178.2 miliard lek n vitin '98 n 323.2 miliard n vitin 2003. Niveli i ndrmjetsimit financiar sht thelluar m tej duke pasqyruar prirjen pozitive t zhvillimeve n sektorin bankar. Raporti i depozitave totale ndaj PPB-s, q sht nj nga treguesit kryesor t nivelit dhe thellsis s ndrmjetsimit financiar, ka ardhur duke u rritur gjat gjith periudhs s tranzicionit dhe veanrisht mbas vitit 1998, duke shnuar nivelin 43% n vitin 2003. T njjtn prirje shfaq edhe raporti i depozitave me afat ndaj PPB-s, si treguesi m sinjifikativ i ndrmjetsimit, i cili sht rritur ndjeshm nga 12.8% n vitin 1994, n 29.3% n vitin 1998 dhe 35.3% n vitin 2003. Nj karakteristik tjerr e zhvillimeve pozitive n sektorin bankar sht prmirsimi i tregut t kreditit. Dy jan prirjet m pozitive q vihen re n kt treg: e para rritja e vazhdueshme e kreditimit t sektorit privat dhe e dyta ulja e kredis me probleme ndaj totalit t kredis. Aktiviteti kreditues i bankave t sistemit u rrit me 30.5 pr qind gjat vitit 2003. Megjithse ky aktivitet prbn vetm 13.5 pr qind t totalit t aktiveve t sistemit, raporti rritet n 27.9 pr qind nse prjashtojm nga llogaritjet Bankn e Kursimeve . Ky fakt, sht nj mbshtetje e mir pr zgjerimin e mtejshm t kreditimit, duke marr parasysh edhe aktivizimin e Banks s Kursimeve n fushn e kredidhnies, pas prfundimit t privatizimit t saj. Tregu bankar psoi zhvillime t rndsishme gjat vitit 2003. Zhvillimi m i spikatur, i cili do t ket ndikime t mdha n sistemin bankar, ishte privatizimi i Banks s Kursimeve nga banka e njohur Raiffeisen. Gjat ktij viti n tregun bankar hyn dy banka t reja, me kapital vendas. Gjendja financiare e sistemit bankar gjat viteve t fundit ka qen e knaqshme. Sistemi bankar shqiptar ka rezultuar n vazhdimsi me fitim, duke garantuar likuiditetin e tij dhe duke plotsuar gjithnj e m shum nevojat e ekonomis pr kredi.
