Arguments by the Governor, Mr. Brilliance Cani, in the lecture with students of the University of Tirana Publication date: 06.04.2004 We all witness that salaries are generally given in cash and not through current accounts that each of the employees in the public or private sector can have. Also, obligations to public companies KESH, Albtelekom, Aquarius, force citizens to waste time and move with sums of money, until the respective sports and health insurance reimbursements have turned into an anxiety for individuals. All this eccesia, has a meaning, the considerable presence of cash actions in Albania, making up one of the proponents of its informality. Even most businesses and individuals continue to conduct the bulk of financial transactions outside banks. One of the costs causing the cash economy is to reduce banks' ability to channel financial tools (deposits) towards investments in the form of loans. Another cost, which relates directly to the Bank of Albania, concerns the fact that the large amount of money in circulation somehow affects the reduction of the effectiveness of monetary policy decisions. For these and other reasons, the Bank of Albania considers reducing the use of cash in the economy, as a complex problem that requires the commitment not only of the banking system but also of actors with significant influence on the country's economic development. The program includes all actors. The first phase is considered the period of awareness, mainly of state institutions regarding the problem of the wide presence of cash use in our economy. It is clear that the Albanian government is very interested in reducing this phenomenon, because it directly affects the finding of effective ways for the country's economic growth. This is because money is channelled through the roads  im_Cani_ne_leksionin_me_studentet_e_Universitetit_te_Elbasanit.html Page 1 of 4 Arguments by the Governor, Mr. Brilliance Cani, in the lecture with students of the University of Tirana 29/07/22, 15:03 official and return to use through the banking system. In this way, parts of the country's economic activity turn from "unidentified" to identified. This element rightly makes the Albanian government, the Ministry of Finance and the Economy considered to be the closest associates of the Bank of Albania in this programme. The further stages of the programme concern the conduct of concrete actions by all actors of this programme. It is understood that the realization of some of them may be in the longer term, while some others need to be carried out faster, as long as it is estimated that the preconditions for applying measures or undertaking concrete actions exist. Banks, business and individuals are one side of the relationship, which arises to serve the reduction of cash, while the government with the respective administrative structures (the Directorate General of Taxation and the General Directorate of Customs), has a demarcating role in regulating this relationship in favour of jocash. Payments and cashing in favour of the state budget should be carried out maximum through the banking system. In this way, the flow of money into unknown channels, which often become the basis of corruption and tax evasion, is reduced. Obligation to open accounts and conduct bank transfers even in relations with fiscal bodies, must have not only big business, but entirely Albanian business, not leaving out of this relationship even medium and small business. It is deemed that the time has come for the write-off of obligations in the form of salaries and other state administration bonuses to be carried out through bank accounts. Although revenues for this category of employees are still low, this is again considered an important step, to make bank customers and public administration employees. It is the banks that through the consolidation of this relationship, can offer these preferential, but also secure, banking services and bonuses, different in exchange for the use of alternative means of payment, in jocash. The idea of passing pensions through bank accounts can also be realized here. Installation and start-up of the work of the clergy system, is a step that helps the relationship: bank - client (business or individual) - taxes and customs - statistical information system. This means that, the path that permeates a banking transaction, is evident in a full system, which ultimately serves everyone: the state, the bank, the central bank, individuals and businesses. The winding-up of monthly obligations (energy, water, telephone, health reimbursements) of public administration employees can be carried out through bank transfer. Wasting time, cases of forgetfulness of carrying out these obligations and moving cash from one sportsman to another, are aspects that are eliminated via this route (bank transfer). For the rest of the population, the use of the bank cheque or even that postal check is a way to achieve the passage of this obligation through the bank account. Second-rate banks, are actresses who play a very important role in the economy - client - cash relationship. A bank, as a financial broker, considers the large conduct of cash transactions, with a lot of difficulties  im_Cani_ne_leksionin_me_studentet_e_Universitetit_te_Elbasanit.html Page 2 of 4 Arguments by the Governor, Mr. Brilliance Cani, in the lecture with students of the University of Tirana 29/07/22, 15:03 And obstacles, because accepting and disbursing cash is a high-cost service for banks. In fact, in most cases, banks offer this service to their customers for free. This sacrifice to offer a cash-in-the-bank payment alternative to a cash payment is an expression of banks' direct interest. Therefore, it is time for the banking system to act more aggressively, especially today, when competition in the banking market is expected to increase with the arrival of Raiffeisen Bank. It is claimed that the latter will provide new banking services, which naturally target the absorption of money within the banking system. By generalising the idea, we would say that the less cash circulates in the economy the more successful its banking system is, the more visible the development. For this it is necessary to realize some important points of the programme in the direction of: the presence of banking agencies near points where periodic obligations and other fiscal obligations are forged; presence of banking agencies near municipalities and small municipalities. In these areas, Albaposta post offices must be active in carrying out bank transfers; building an electronic system that will verify e-card situations on-line, a step that would encourage the mass use of credit and debit cards. The deployment of ATMs and the clergy system are steps, which serve as preconditions for reducing cash money in the economy, towards banks must precede their fulfillment; increasing banking services and lowering commissions that the banking system uses. The time has come for the banking system to increase the number of financial instruments available to individuals, for example, deposit certificates. adding marketing to the banking business. For a large part of the population the bank still identifies with a savings chest, while many other sides of the banking business remain almost unknown. The involvement of business and the public. Business is an important part of the government-business-bank relationship, built on the basis of understanding, order and respect for rules by all and for all the same. There is a group of businesses that have a history of regular relations with banks and the tax and customs administration. This is the elite business group that has actually come to Albania growing up. It quickly absorbs and assimilates new ones into banking technology that, after all, are aimed at using jockeys. Meanwhile, there is a small group of businesses that have not yet become familiar with the bank. Banking marketing should also aim towards this group, to explain the benefits and costs from the services banks offer today. The public, it's a ueverywhere actor in this program. First, it must understand the purpose of the programme, then recognize and use contemporary payment instruments by increasing the volume of transactions it conducts through the banking system. In fact, the Albanian public has shown before that  im_Cani_ne_leksionin_me_studentet_e_Universitetit_te_Elbasanit.html Page 3 of 4 Arguments by the Governor, Mr. Brilliance Cani, in the lecture with students of the University of Tirana 29/07/22, 15:03 There are no difficulties in absorbing new services and products. Here we can mention as examples cases of mass absorption of mobile phone, widespread internet use (the spread and high frequency rate of Internet Cafeenvironments) as well as the widespread use of treasury bond service. Even in the case of the use of jockeys or even new easing products and services provided by banks, the public is expected to be willing to quickly assimilate them. Importantly, the general public and in a particular way, business, which feels daily the risks of cash, its maintenance and transport, the impossibility of good liquidity management and the costs that accompany this phenomenon, feel the presence of the bank as a trust institution. Banks must become present in the economy, to demonstrate to the general public what they offer them, for the latter to feel them present in everyday life. Instead of closing! Living in an economy where money circulates to a large extent in the form of cash, this is not indicative of a modern market economy. Furthermore, such a form is fed and fed by a broad informal sector of the economy. Despite efforts towards development and integration, unfortunately, we state that we live in such a reality, which we must change. The programme, called "Beyond Money", is a step towards reducing the cash economy. The realization of the objectives of this programme is closely related to the aspect of macroeconomic, institutional sustainability and infrastructural developments. While the macroeconomic aspect can be considered up to - somewhere stable, there is still much to do in legal and institutional terms. This is where the emphasis is placed on the application of the law and the provision of order, which affect business activity as a whole and on that bank in particular. A full legal framework, equally applicable to all, affects the country's economic development in the conditions of fair competition by lowering tax evasion and corruption. While infrastructure improvements constitute another precondition that helps achieve the goals of the "Beyond Money" program.  im_Cani_ne_leksionin_me_studentet_e_Universitetit_te_Elbasanit.html Page 4 of 4

Argumente nga Guvernatori, z.Shklqim Cani, n leksionin me studentt e Universitetit t Elbasanit Data e publikimit: 06.04.2004 T gjith jemi dshmitar q prgjithsisht pagat jepen me para n dor dhe jo nprmjet llogarive rrjedhse q secili prej t punsuarve n sektorin publik apo privat mund t ket. Po ashtu, detyrimet ndaj kompanive publike KESH, Albtelekom, Ujsjells, detyrojn qytetart t humbasin kohn dhe t lvizin me shuma parash, deri n sportelet prkatse dhe rimbursimet e sigurimeve shndetsore jan kthyer n nj ankth pr individt. E gjith kjo ecejake, ka nj domethnie, pranin e konsiderushme t veprimeve me para n dor (cash) n Shqipri, duke prbr nj nga mbshtetetsit e informalitetit t saj. Edhe shumica e bizneseve dhe e individve vazhdojn t kryejn pjesn m t madhe t transaksioneve financiare jasht bankave. Nj nga kostot q shkakton ekonomia e cash-it sht zvoglimi i aftsive t bankave pr t kanalizuar mjetet financiare (depozitat) drejt investimeve n formn e kredive. Nj kosto tjetr, e cila lidhet drejtprdrejt me Bankn e Shqipris, ka t bj me faktin se sasia e madhe e paras n qarkullim ndikon n nj far mnyre n uljen e efektivitetit t vendimeve t politiks monetare. Pr kto arsye dhe argumenta t tjer, Banka e Shqipris e konsideron reduktimin e prdorimit t cash-it n ekonomi, si nj problem kompleks q krkon angazhimin jo vetm t sistemit bankar por edhe t aktorve me ndikim t rndsishm n zhvillimin ekonomik t vendit. Programi prfshin t gjith aktort. Faza e par sht konsideruar si periudha e sensibilizimit, kryesisht t institucioneve shtetrore n lidhje me problemin e pranis s gjer t prdorimit t cash -it n ekonomin ton. Duket qart se qeveria shqiptare, sht mjaft e interesuar pr t reduktuar kt fenomen, sepse ai ndikon drejtprdrejt n gjetjen e rrugve efikase pr rritjen ekonomike t vendit. Kjo pr faktin se parat kanalizohen nprmjet rrugve https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalim_Cani_ne_leksionin_me_studentet_e_Universitetit_te_Elbasanit.html Pagina 1 di 4 Argumente nga Guvernatori, z.Shklqim Cani, n leksionin me studentt e Universitetit t Elbasanit 29/07/22, 15:03 zyrtare dhe kthehen n t shfrytzueshme nprmjet sistemit bankar. N kt mnyr, pjes t aktivitetit ekonomik t vendit kthehen nga "t paidentifikuara" n t identifikuara". Ky element, bn q me t drejt qeveria Shqiptare, Ministria e Financave dhe ajo e Ekonomis t konsiderohen si bashkpuntoret m t afrta t Banks s Shqipris n kt program. Fazat e mtejme t programit, kan t bjn me kryerjen e veprimeve konkrete nga t gjith aktort e ktij programi. Kuptohet q realizimi i disa prej tyre mund t jet n nj afat m t gjat kohor, ndrsa disa t tjera, duhen kryer m shpejt, prsa koh q vlersohet se ekzistojn parakushtet e aplikimit t masave apo ndrmarrjes s veprimeve konkrete. Bankat, biznesi dhe individt jan njra an e marrdhnies, q lind pr t'i shrbyer reduktimit t cash-it, ndrsa qeveria me strukturat prkatse administrative (Drejtoria e Prgjithshme e Tatimeve dhe Drejtoria e Prgjithshme e Doganave), ka nj rol prcaktues n rregullimin e ksaj marrdhnie n favor t jocash-it. Pagesat dhe arktimet n favor t buxhetit t shtetit duhet t kryhen maksimalisht nprmjet sistemit bankar. N kt mnyr, reduktohet rrjedhja e paras n kanale t panjohura, q shpesh bhen baz e korrupsionit dhe e evazionit fiskal. Detyrim pr elje llogarish dhe kryerje transfertash bankare edhe n marrdhnie me organet fiskale, duhet t'i ket jo vetm biznesi i madh, por n trsi biznesi shqiptar, duke mos ln jasht ksaj marrdhnieje edhe biznesin e mesm dhe t vogl. Gjykohet se ka ardhur koha q shlyerja e detyrimeve n formn e pagave dhe shprblimeve t tjera t administrats shtetrore t kryhet nprmjet llogarive bankare. Ndonse t ardhurat pr kt kategori t punsuarish jan ende t ulta, prsri gjykohet se ky sht nj hap i rndsishm, pr t br klient t bankave edhe punonjsit e administrats publike. Jan bankat q nprmjet konsolidimit t ksaj marrdhnieje, mund t'u ofrojn ktyre klientve preferencial', por edhe t sigurt, shrbime bankare dhe bonuse, t ndryshme n kmbim t prdorimit t mjeteve alternative t pagess, n jocash. Ktu mund t realizohet edhe ideja e kalimit t pensioneve nprmjet llogarive bankare. Instalimi dhe fillimi nga puna i sistemit t kleringut, sht nj hap q ndihmon marrdhnien: bank - klient (biznes ose individ) - tatime dhe dogana - sistem informacioni statistikor. Kjo do t thot q, rruga q prshkon nj transaksion bankar, evidentohet n nj sistem t plot, q n fund t fundit i shrben t gjithve: shtetit, banks, banks qendrore, individve dhe bizneseve. Likuidimi i detyrimeve mujore (energji, uj, telefon, rimbursime shndetsore) t punonjsve t administrats publike mund t kryhet nprmjet transferts bankare. Humbja e kohs, rastet e harress s kryerjes s ktyre detyrimeve dhe lvizja me cash nga njri sportel n tjetrin, jan aspekte q eliminohen nprmjet ksaj rruge (transfert bankare). Pr pjesn tjetr t popullats, prdorimi i ekut bankar apo edhe i atij postar, sht nj mnyr q realizon kalimin e ktij detyrimi nprmjet llogaris bankare. Bankat e nivelit t dyt, jan aktore q luajn nj rol mjaft t rndsishm n marrdhnien ekonomi - klient - cash. Nj bank, si ndrmjetse financiare, e konsideron kryerjen n mas t madhe t transaksioneve n cash, me mjaft vshtirsi https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalim_Cani_ne_leksionin_me_studentet_e_Universitetit_te_Elbasanit.html Pagina 2 di 4 Argumente nga Guvernatori, z.Shklqim Cani, n leksionin me studentt e Universitetit t Elbasanit 29/07/22, 15:03 dhe pengesa, sepse pranimi dhe disbursimi i cash-it sht nj shrbim me kosto t lart pr bankat. N fakt n shumicn e rasteve, bankat kt shrbim ua ofrojn klientve t tyre falas. Kjo sakrific pr t ofruar nj alternativ pagese cash n bank' ndaj nj pagese cash n dor' sht shprehje e interesit t drejtprdrejt t bankave. Prandaj, ka ardhur koha q sistemi bankar t veproj m me agresivitet, sidomos sot, kur pritet q konkurrenca n tregun bankar do t rritet me ardhjen e Raiffeisen Bank. Pretendohet q kjo e fundit do t ofroj shrbime t reja bankare, q natyrshm, synojn thithjen e paras brenda sistemit bankar. Duke e prgjithsuar iden, do t thonim se sa m pak cash t qarkulloj n ekonomi aq m i suksesshm sht sistemi bankar i saj, aq m i dukshm sht zhvillimi. Pr kt sht e domosdoshme q t realizohen disa pika t rndsishme t programit n drejtim t: pranis s agjencive bankare pran pikave ku arktohen detyrimet periodike si dhe t tjera detyrime me natyr fiskale; pranis s agjencive bankare pran komunave dhe bashkive t vogla. N kto zona, zyrat postare t Albaposts duhet t jen aktive pr kryerjen e transfertave bankare; ndrtimin e nj sistemi elektronik q do t verifikoj on - line gjendjet e kartave elektronike, nj hap ky q do t inkurajonte prdorimin masiv t kartave t kreditit dhe t debitit. Vendosja e ATM-ve dhe sistemi i kleringut, jan hapa, q shrbejn si parakushte pr reduktimin e paras cash n ekonomi, ndaj bankat duhet t'u paraprijn prmbushjes s tyre; rritjen e shrbimeve bankare dhe uljen e komisioneve q sistemi bankar prdor. Ka ardhur koha q sistemi bankar t shtoj numrin e instrumenteve financiare n dispozicion t individve pr shembull, ertifikatat e depozitave. shtimin e marketingut t biznesit bankar. Pr nj pjes t madhe t popullsis banka ende identifikohet me nj ark kursimi, ndrkoh q shum an t tjera t biznesit bankar mbeten pothuaj t panjohura. Prfshirja e biznesit dhe publikut. Biznesi, sht pjes e rndsishme e marrdhnies qeveri - biznes - bank, e ndrtuar mbi baz mirkuptimi, rregulli dhe respektimi t rregullave nga t gjith dhe pr t gjith njsoj. Ekziston nj grup biznesesh q kan nj histori marrdhniesh t rregullt me bankat dhe me administratn tatimore dhe doganore. Ky sht grupi elitar i biznesit i cili n fakt ka ardhur duke u rritur n Shqipri. Ai thith dhe asimilon shum shpejt t rejat n teknologjin bankare q, n fund t fundit, kan pr qllim prdorimin e jocash-it. Ndrkoh, ekziston nj grup jo i vogl biznesesh t cilt akoma nuk jan familjarizuar me bankn. Marketingu bankar duhet t synoj edhe drejt ktij grupi, pr t shpjeguar prfitimet dhe kostot nga shrbimet q ofrojn bankat sot. Publiku, sht nj aktor i kudondodhur i ktij programi. S pari, ai duhet t mirkuptoj qllimin e programit, m pas t njoh dhe t prdor instrumentet bashkkohore t pagesave duke rritur vllimin e transaksioneve q kryen nprmjet sistemit bankar. N fakt, publiku shqiptar ka treguar dhe m par se https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalim_Cani_ne_leksionin_me_studentet_e_Universitetit_te_Elbasanit.html Pagina 3 di 4 Argumente nga Guvernatori, z.Shklqim Cani, n leksionin me studentt e Universitetit t Elbasanit 29/07/22, 15:03 nuk ka vshtirsi n thithjen e shrbimeve dhe t produkteve t reja. Ktu mund t prmendim si shembuj rastet e thithjes n mas t telefonis celulare, t prdorimit t gjer t internetit (prhapja dhe shkalla e lart e frekuentimit t ambienteve t Internet Caf-ve) si edhe t prdorimit t gjer t shrbimit t bonove t thesarit. Edhe n rastin e prdorimit t jocash-it apo edhe t produkteve dhe shrbimeve t reja lehtsuese t ofruara nga bankat, pritet q publiku t jet i gatshm t'i asimiloj shpejt ato. E rndsishme sht q publiku i gjer e n mnyre t veant, biznesi, i cili ndjen n mnyr t prditshme rreziqet cash-it, t mbajtjes dhe transportimit t tij, pamundsin e administrimit t mir t likuiditetit dhe kostot q e shoqrojn kt fenomen, t ndjejn pranin e banks si institucion besimi. Bankat duhet t bhen t pranishme n ekonomi, pr t'i demonstruar publikut t gjer se far ato u ofrojn, q ky i fundit t'i ndjej ato t pranishme n jetn e prditshme. N vend t mbylljes! T jetosh n nj ekonomi ku paraja qarkullon n nj mas t madhe n formn e cash-it, ky nuk sht tregues i nj ekonomie moderne tregu. Pr m tepr nj form e till, ushqen dhe ushqehet nga nj sektor informal i gjer i ekonomis. Me gjith prpjekjet drejt zhvilimit dhe integrimit, fatkeqsisht, konstatojm se jetojm n nj realitet t till, t cilin duhet ta ndryshojm. Programi i cilsuar "Prtej paras", sht nj hap drejt reduktimit t ekonomis cash. Realizimi i synimeve t ktij programi sht i lidhur ngusht me aspektin e qndrueshmris makroekonomike, institucionale dhe zhvillimeve infrastrukturore. Ndrsa aspekti makroekonomik mund t konsiderohet deri - diku i qndrueshm, ka ende shum pr t br n aspektin ligjor dhe institucional. Ktu vihet theksi n zbatueshmrin e ligjit dhe n sigurimin e rendit, t cilat ndikojn mbi veprimtarin e biznesit n trsi dhe mbi at bankar n veanti. Nj kuadr ligjor i plot dhe i zbatueshm njsoj pr t gjith, ndikon n zhvillimin ekonomik t vendit n kushtet e nj konkurrence t ndershme duke ulur evazionin fiskal dhe korrupsionin. Muz and Eduk " Head / Press / Speeches, interviews, articles / Speeches Press releases Notices of # meetings of Council Supervisor Press conference Speeches, interview articles Speeches Interview of articles Calendars # Official holiday calendar for 2022 COVID-19 Europe # BANK OF ALBANIA , Mr. Brilliance Cani, in the Assembly of Albania during the presentation of the 2003 Annual Report Publication date: 06.04.2004 Compliance with the main macroeconomic goals set out in the National Economic and Social Development Strategy has further improved the country's macroeconomic balances during 2003. The Albanian economy during 2003 seems to have returned to satisfactory rhythms of economic growth. Preliminary estimates show that GDP, in real terms, increased by 6 percent during 2003, compared to 4.7 percent in 2002. The increase in economic activity has been verified in all sectors of the economy, despite the more pronounced it is estimated to be in the construction, services and transport sector. In 2003, it should be stressed that there has been a slight improvement in the employment situation. The number of employees continues to increase, while chronic problems of the Albanian transition: emigration and the informality of the labour market and the economy in general affect the reduction of total labour forces and make it difficult to save the effect on employment of the country's economic policies and developments. At the end of the nine-month period of 2003, according to official sources, unemployment stopped at a 15 percent level compared to 15.8 percent at the end of 2002. 2003 was characterized by low inflation, within the Bank of Albania's target. The value of inflation in December was 3.3 percent, respecting the Bank of Albania's target while on average during 2003 consumer prices rose by 2.37 percent. Despite various factors that have influenced, it is estimated that this low inflation has the source for controlling domestic demand, as a result of appropriate fiscal and monetary policies.  uvendin_e_Shqiperise_gjate_prezantimit_te_Raportit_Vjetor_2003.html Page 1 of 2 , Mr. Brilliance Cani, in the Assembly of Albania during the presentation of the 2003 Annual Report 29/07/22, 15:03 Unlike previous years, 2003 was characterized by a more rational distribution of fiscal spending. The government's demand for loans has been more simultaneous during 2003, avoiding the concentration of deficit financing in December. The annual deficit in total was 19 percent lower compared to a year earlier, reaching the 4.4 percent GDP level. However, some problems such as realization of income to the tune of 93 percent and especially the realization of capital expenditures to the tune of 62 percent of the plan should be highlighted. For the first time during the transition period, public savings achieved a positive value as a result of the consolidation of public finances, mainly in the performance of expenditure. Public savings have affected the 0.8 percentage point increase in domestic savings compared to 2002, making domestic savings estimated at the end of 2003 as much as 13.8 percent of GDP. In total, investments are estimated at 22.3 percent of GDP, marking a slight increase compared to 2002. The increase in investment during this year is mostly attributed to the increase in private investment, for the very fact that public investments realized during 2003 were about 11.7 percent lower than the previous year. 2003 was characterized by intensive activity in the country's foreign sector, expressed in the significant increase in revenues and korean spending. The crust account deficit is estimated to have decreased by 2 percentage points compared to a year ago reaching 6.7 percent of GDP. The overall position of the balance of payments is positive, causing the country's currency reserves to rise steadily. For the first time, in December, their total level exceeded the US1 billion figure. text: The Governor's word, Mr. Brilliance Cani, on the occasion of the approval of the new shareholder of the Savings Bank, Raiffeissen Bank. 29/07/22, 15:03 The Governor's word, Mr. Brilliance Cani, on the occasion of the approval of the new shareholder of the Savings Bank, Raiffeissen Bank. Publication date: 15.04.2004 Honourable ladies and gentlemen, representatives of the Savings Bank, Raiffeisen Bank and the media! I am pleased that on behalf of the Bank of Albania to announce today the successful finalisation of the savings bank's privatisation process with the approval of its new shareholder, the well-known bank Raiffeisen Zentralbank. The Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania at yesterday's meeting made the important decision to approve the new shareholder of the Savings Bank, Raiffeisen Bank. Yesterday, the Supervisory Council made yet another important decision regarding the Savings Bank, the permission to resume lending activity, which had been banned from the Savings Bank since 1998. For the very weight the Savings Bank has in our banking system, as well as the traditional role it has played for public savings in Albania, its transition to a reliable investor, financially sound and with the right experience in banking activity, was of maximum importance. Efforts made in this direction by the Albanian Government, the Savings Bank itself, the Bank of Albania and the international financial institutions that assisted in the process resulted in success as Raiifeisen Bank represents a very good choice for the Bank's future performance.  it_te_aksionerit_te_ri_te_Bankes_se_Kursimeve_Raiffeissen_Bank.html Page 1 of 2 The Governor's word, Mr. Brilliance Cani, on the occasion of the approval of the new shareholder of the Savings Bank, Raiffeissen Bank. 29/07/22, 15:03 The new shareholder is expected to bring innovation in competition in the banking system, while positive developments are expected for the Savings Bank itself in the direction of managing, organising, directing and improving information technology. Customer relations, second-rate banks and the Bank of Albania judge that they will improve significantly according to the best standards of Western banking. The approval of the new shareholder, coupled with the lifting of the limit on the bank's commitment to lending activity, will bring its activation to the lending of the economy and specifically loans to private business. Through quality banking services, the bank will come closer to the public and, along with other second-rate banks, will be allied with the Bank of Albania in the process of replacing cash in the economy and other initiatives for the development and consolidation of the banking system. Under the new ownership, the Savings Bank will gain a new dimension from the bank of Albania's monetary policy perspective. The central bank will end up being maximum committed to having decisions in the monetary policy sphere realized on the basis of direct, intensive and transparent communication with the entire banking industry, and especially with its most important actors. We believe that under the new ownership and management, the Savings Bank will bring to this relationship the best co-operation, credibility, reciprocity, principles and market rules. The Bank of Albania notes with pleasure that the Albanian public has positively reacted to this privatisation. This shows that the public has the necessary information for the current state of the bank, recognises the new shareholder and is confident in the future of the bank under its management. In the end, let me wish the Savings Bank and its new shareholder successes in their activity to turn this bank into the "engine" of the Albanian banking system towards conducting an increasingly safe and sound activity, towards quality and quantitative improvement of services for the clientele, towards increasing the developer role of the banking system in the Albanian economy. Thank you for the attention.  it_te_aksionerit_te_ri_te_Bankes_se_Kursimeve_Raiffeissen_Bank.html Page 2 of 2

Muz and Eduk " Head / Press / Speeches, interviews, articles / Speeches Press releases Notices of # meetings of Council Supervisor Press conference Speeches, interview articles Speeches Interview of articles Calendars # Official holiday calendar for 2022 COVID-19 Europe # BANK OF ALBANIA , Mr. Brilliance Cani, at the discussion meeting Publication date: 26.05.2004 Honored ladies and gentlemen, Wishing you a welcome and a pleasant working morning, I want in my name and associates to thank you for your presence in this hall and express all our respect and appreciation for the honor you have done to this table with your participation. The Bank of Albania launched a public campaign on 10 November last year aimed at replacing cash actions with actions through the banking system. The worrying argument not only for the Bank of Albania but also for the Government, for financial institutions, for banks, for business and in general, for the public was that in Albania, cash actions clearly prevail. Put another way, despite the positive developments of the banking system, business maturation, strengthening of governance, etc., Albania again continues to remain a country where cash trails dominate. It is enough to remember that we continue to waste time in sports to pay energy or telephone bills, that we withdraw wages with "payroll", that we pay local taxes, customs tariffs, taxes or social security with cash, that debit/credit cards are missing in our wallets, and that we move outside Albania with large sums of currencies in our pockets, etc., Etc.. To this end, the Bank of Albania and the Albanian Government have ideated a medium-term programme of measures called "Beyond Money", which is essentially the continuation of the campaign launched in November, but certainly enriched with new elements where concrete steps, in which the Government, the Bank of Albania and the Banking System will engage. Page 1 of 4 , Mr. Brilliance Cani, at the discussion meeting 29/07/22, 15:03 Of course, the business community partnership, and the support of the media and civil society, will increase the success of this programme, thus laying the groundwork for modernising the payment system in Albania and approaching the international standards we aspire to. The challenge of reducing cash outweighs central institutions and descends to bank sports, local business, tax-tax and customs branches in districts, public administration officers and private business employees. So a few days ago, together with the staff of the Bank of Albania we held several meetings in Vlora, Saranda, Kumanovo and Korca where I discussed extensively with business, bank branches and the local community the "Beyond Money" programme. Support was absolute from both banks and the business community, civil society and the media, but their "conditions" were clear: open and fair competition, correctness in law enforcement and bilateral transparency of state bodies and private business, in realising commitments made and legal obligations. Let me pause briefly on the steps I think each of the actors of this table should take, and without prejudicing any of the parties, let's turn them into objects of discussion and debate to find the best solutions, with the only goal of how to get close to the banks. Generally, Albanians when there are commitments and tasks to carry out and start with others. Unlike the other early days, we will initially stop at the commitments and tasks of the banking system itself, which we represent along with the second-rate banks, which have their executives/representatives at this meeting. The Bank of Albania is essentially identifying the problem or saying otherwise, what are the main causes of the considerable presence of cash in the economy. Similarly, it will also install the contemporary payment clergy system, as well as collaborating in modernising the legal framework of the payment system in the country, addressing particular attention to the development and improvement of the legal and regulatory part, which supports new payment instruments and actors in the country. Banks are already invested in a broad and competitive process of opening and expanding the network of ATMs, POS (point of sale) making them standards and integrated into networks of large plastic card societies. Their first new clients will be the employees of the Ministry of Finance and the Bank of Albania, which starting in June will attract salaries through the bank, which will provide more priorities and benefits for them. The bank selection process was extremely transparent and after reviewing the offers submitted by the system, in the following two to three days procedures will be completed for Bank of Albania employees to open their bank accounts and in the following months, procedures will also be followed for institutions and other public subjects. Second-rate banks must be prepared to cope with the influx of cash inflows mainly through bank transfers, as a result of the mandatory passage of actions related to payments to the government or with cash in favour of it or state or private institutions and societies. As for actions with business, it is necessary to accelerate the work for the creation of the Credit Information Office as well as to carry out the necessary arrangements for supporting its operation. Any delay in this process will affect Page 2 of 4 , Mr. Brilliance Cani, at the discussion meeting 29/07/22, 15:03 directly in the number and quality of banking products and in the business lending process. On the other hand, the implementation of the project for the intersection of small-value payments (AECH - Automatic Electronic Clearing House), which is thought to be completed during the first half of 2005, we consider that it will bring the addition of banking services, quality improvement of existing services, further approximation of the system with the local population and with large businesses. Business is considered an important party in this effort to reduce the use of cash in the economy. As such, it will be placed at the centre of a relationship: government - business - bank - built on the basis of understanding and implementation of the legal and regulatory framework in force. On the other hand, authorities must guarantee equality, transparency and credibility, conditions these necessary to promote a healthy business environment. Business can and should aim at making the priorities of the banking system obvious, of the usefulness of supporting this system of a sound business, of increasing the reputation of a certain business when it is a trusted customer of a bank, of the security of activity that is added to each business when it has a correct long-term relationship with the commercial bank. On the other hand, the business is already familiar with the legal obligation to carry out transactions over 500 thousand dollars through bank actions, while I believe it will be "seduced" by banks to carry out through bank actions the tax, wage and social security payments of staff and transfers with partners. Ranked in the end but no less important, I sincerely believe that civil society and the media will strongly support the "Beyond Money" programme. The Bank of Albania already has positive experience of supporting the media and civil society during campaigns against speculative price increases in the run-up to the holidays and we think this support will be given to us again. Both the media and civil society would provide the programme with high degree of credibility would increase its measure of success. This is not because the public's trust in the bank passes through the media and civil society, but because the degree of understanding and the public's desire to focus its attention on any new development, which begins to be reflected in the general environment of our society, are highly defined by the attention and positioning of civil society towards it. On the other hand, the media judge that it can perform very well the role of monitor/supervisor of the process to look in time and measure the realization of the commitments we are all expected to make today at this meeting. This monitoring can serve as a positive incentive for this process to move forward and Albanians to approach banks and see them as partners in the process of supporting financially or preserving their savings. Thank you! Page 3 of 4 , Mr. Brilliance Cani, at the discussion meeting 29/07/22, 15:03 Page 4 of 4

Muz dhe Eduk " Kreu / Shtypi / Fjalime, intervista, artikuj / Fjalime Njoftimet pr shtyp Njoftime t # mbledhjeve t Kshillit Mbikqyrs Konferenca pr shtyp Fjalime, $ intervista, artikuj Fjalime Intervista e artikuj Kalendar # Kalendari i festave zyrtare pr vitin 2022 COVID-19 Evropa # BANKA E SHQIPRIS Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z.Shklqim Cani, n takimin e diskutimit Data e publikimit: 26.05.2004 T nderuar zonja dhe zotrinj, Duke ju uruar mirseardhjen dhe nj mngjes pune t kndshm, dua q n emrin tim dhe t bashkpuntorve t'ju falenderoj pr pranin tuaj n kt sall dhe t shpreh gjith respektin dhe vlersimin ton pr nderin q i keni br ksaj tryeze me pjesmarrjen tuaj. Banka e Shqipris filloi m 10 nntor t vitit t kaluar nj fushat publike duke synuar zvendsimin e veprimeve me para n dor (cash) me veprime nprmjet sistemit bankar. Argumenti shqetsues jo vetm pr Bankn e Shqipris por edhe pr Qeverin, pr institucionet financiare, pr bankat, pr biznesin dhe n prgjithsi, pr publikun ishte se n Shqipri mbizotrojn dukshm veprimet me para n dor. Thn ndryshe, me gjith zhvillimet pozitive t sistemit bankar, maturimit t biznesit, forcimit t qeverisjes etj., prsri Shqipria vijon t mbetet nj vend ku mbizotrojn trasaksionet n cash. Mjafton t kujtojm se vazhdojm t humbasim koh npr sportele pr t paguar faturat e energjis apo t telefonis, se trheqim pagat me "bordero", se paguajm taksat lokale, tarifat doganore, tatimet apo sigurimet shoqrore me cash, se n portofolet tona mungojn kartat e debitit/kreditit dhe se lvizim jasht Shqipris me shuma t mdha valutash n xhep etj., etj.. Pr kt qllim, Banka e Shqipris dhe Qeveria Shqiptare kan ideuar nj program afatmesm masash t quajtur "Prtej paras", i cili n thelb sht vazhdim i fushats s nisur n muajin nntor, por sigurisht i pasuruar me elemente t reja ku spikasin hapa konkret, n t cilt do t angazhohet Qeveria, Banka e Shqipris dhe Sistemi Bankar. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fj_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_z_Shkelqim_Cani_ne_takimin_e_diskutimit.html Pagina 1 di 4 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z.Shklqim Cani, n takimin e diskutimit 29/07/22, 15:03 Sigurisht q partneriteti i komunitetit t biznesit dhe mbshtetja e medias dhe e shoqris civile, do ta rrisin suksesin e ktij programi, duke hedhur n kt mnyr bazat pr modernizimin e sistemit t pagesave n Shqipri dhe pr afrimin me standardet ndrkombtare q aspirojm. Sfida pr reduktimin e cash tejkalon institucionet qendrore dhe zbret deri n sportelet e bankave, te biznesi lokal, degt e tatim-taksave dhe t doganave n rrethe, npunsit e administrats publike dhe t punsuarit n biznesin privat. Ndaj dhe para pak ditsh, bashk me stafin e Banks s Shqipris zhvilluam disa takime n Vlor, Sarand, Gjirokastr dhe Kor ku diskutova gjersisht me biznesin, me degt e bankave dhe me komunitetin lokal programin "Prtej paras". Mbshtetja ishte absolute si nga bankat ashtu edhe nga komuniteti i biznesit, nga shoqria civile e media, por "kushtet"e tyre ishin t qarta: konkurrenc e hapur dhe e ndershme, korrektsi n zbatimin e ligjit dhe transparenc e dyanshme e organeve shtetrore dhe biznesit privat, n realizimin e angazhimeve t marra dhe detyrimeve ligjore. M lejoni t ndalem shkurtimisht n hapat q mendoj se duhet t ndrmarr secili nga aktort e ksaj tryeze dhe pa paragjykuar asnj nga palt, le t'i kthejm ata n objekte diskutimi dhe debati pr t gjetur zgjidhjet m t mira, me t vetmin synim si t afrohemi te bankat. Prgjithsisht, shqiptart kur ka angazhime dhe detyra pr t realizuar e fillojn nga t tjert. Ndryshe nga hert e tjera, fillimisht do t ndalemi tek angazhimet dhe detyrat e vet sistemit bankar, t cilin e prfaqsojm s bashku me bankat e nivelit t dyt, q kan drejtuesit/prfaqsuesit e tyre n kt takim. Banka e Shqipris po identifikon n thelb problemin ose thn ndryshe, cilat jan shkaqet kryesore t pranis s konsiderueshme t cashit n ekonomi. Po kshtu, do t instaloj edhe sistemin bashkkohor t kleringut t pagesave si dhe po bashkpunon n modernizimin e kuadrit ligjor t sistemit t pagesave n vend, duke i drejtuar vmendje t veant zhvillimit dhe prmirsimit t pjess ligjore dhe rregullative, q mbshtet instrumentet dhe aktort e rinj t pagesave n vend. Bankat tashm jan investuar n nj proces t gjer dhe konkurrues t hapjes dhe zgjerimi t rrjetit t ATM-ve, POS (point of sale) duke i br ato standarde dhe t integruara n rrjetet e shoqrive t mdha t kartave plastike. Klientt e par t rinj t tyre do t jen npunsit e Ministris s Financave dhe Banks s Shqipris, q duke filluar nga muaji qershor do t trheqin pagat nprmjet banks, q do t ofroj m shum prparsi dhe prfitime pr ta. Procesi i przgjedhjes s bankave ishte tejet transparent dhe pas shqyrtimit t ofertave t paraqitura nga sistemi, n dy-tre ditt n vijim do t prfundojn procedurat q punonjsit e Banks s Shqipris t hapin llogarit e tyre bankare dhe n muaj n vijim, do t vijojn procedurat edhe pr institucionet dhe subjektet e tjera publike. Bankat e nivelit t dyt duhet t jen t prgatitura pr t prballuar fluksin e hyrjeve t paras kryesisht cash nprmjet transfertave bankare, si rezultat i kalimit t detyrueshm t veprimeve q lidhen me pagesa pr qeverin apo me arktime n favor t saj apo t institucioneve dhe shoqrive shtetrore apo private. Sa i prket veprimeve me biznesin, sht i domosdoshm prshpejtimi i puns pr krijimin e Zyrs s Informacionit t Kredive si dhe kryerja e rregullimeve t nevojshme pr mbshtetjen e operimit t saj. do vones n kt proces do t ndikoj https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fj_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_z_Shkelqim_Cani_ne_takimin_e_diskutimit.html Pagina 2 di 4 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z.Shklqim Cani, n takimin e diskutimit 29/07/22, 15:03 drejtprdrejt n numrin dhe n cilsin e produkteve bankare dhe n procesin e kreditimit t biznesit. Nga ana tjetr, zbatimi i projektit pr kryqzimin e pagesave n vler t vogl (AECH - Automatic Electronic Clearing House), i cili mendohet t prfundoj gjat gjysms s par t vitit 2005, gjykojm se do t sjell shtimin e shrbimeve bankare, prmirsimin cilsor t shrbimeve ekzistuese, prafrimin e mtejshm t sistemit me popullatn vendase dhe me bizneset e mdha. Biznesi konsiderohet si pal e rndsishme n kt prpjekje pr t paksuar prdorimin e cash n ekonomi. Si i till do t vendoset n qendr t nj marrdhnieje: qeveri - biznes - bank - t ndrtuar mbi baz mirkuptimi dhe zbatimi t kuadrit ligjor dhe rregullativ n fuqi. Nga ana tjetr autoritetet duhet t garantojn barazi, transparenc dhe besueshmri, kushte kto t domosdoshme pr t promovuar nj ambient t shndetshm biznesi. Biznesi mund dhe duhet t synoj n brjen evidente t prparsive t sistemit bankar, t dobishmris s mbshtetjes nga ky sistem t nj biznesi t shndosh, t rritjes s reputacionit t nj biznesi t caktuar kur sht klient i besuar i nj banke, t siguris s aktivitetit q i shtohet do biznesi kur ka nj marrdhnie korrekte afatgjat me bankn tregtare. Nga ana tjetr, biznesi tashm sht i njohur me detyrimin ligjor t realizimit t transaksioneve mbi 500 mij lek nprmjet veprimeve bankare, ndrkoh q besoj se  do t joshet  nga bankat q t realizoj me an t veprimeve bankare pagesat e taksave, pagave dhe sigurimeve shoqrore t stafit dhe transfertat me partnert. T renditura n fund por jo m pak t rndsishme, me sinqeritet besoj se shoqria civile dhe media do t mbshtesin fuqimisht programin "Prtej paras". Banka e Shqipris ka tashm eksperiencn pozitive t mbshtetjes s medias dhe t shoqris civile gjat fushatave kundr rritjes spekulative t mimeve n prag t festave dhe mendojm se kjo mbshtetje do t na jepet prsri. Si media, ashtu edhe shoqria civile do t'i siguronin programit shkall t lart besueshmrie do t rrisnin masn e suksesit t tij. Kjo, jo sepse besimi i publikut tek banka kalon nprmjet medias dhe shoqris civile, por sepse shkalla e mirkuptimit dhe dshira e publikut pr t prqendruar vmendjen e tij n do zhvillim t ri, q fillon t ravijzohet n ambientin e prgjithshm t shoqris son, jan mjaft t prcaktuara nga vmendja dhe pozicionimi i shoqris civile ndaj tij. Nga ana tjetr, media gjykojm se mund t kryej shum mir rolin e monitoruesit/supervizionit t procesit pr t par n koh dhe pr t matur realizimin e angazhimeve q pritet t marrim t gjith sot n kt takim. Ky monitorim mund t shrbej si nxitje pozitive q ky proces t ec prpara dhe shqiptart t'i afrohen bankave dhe t'i shohin ata si partner n procesin e mbshtetjes financiare apo ruajtjes s kursimeve t tyre. BANK OF ALBANIA Some effects from the implementation of Inflation Targeting By Mr. Brilliance Cani, Governor of the Bank of Albania, Seminar with journalists 'Inflation Targeting and opinions on the kind of inflation that The Bank of Albania must report. Publication date: 20.07.2004 Many countries with developing economies, including Albania, declare but are not  1/5 06/08/2022, 09:09 By Mr. Brilliance Cani, Governor of the Bank of Albania, Seminar with journalists 'Inflation Targeting and opinions on the kind... forced to maintain a target of inflation as the final goal of monetary policy. Meanwhile, the implementation of the monetary policy regime of "Inflation Targeting" is stretching increasingly from industrialized countries to developing economies. The fact that even the monetary policy of the Bank of Albania, in a medium-term period (v.2007) is thought to move towards the inflation targeting regime, requires considerable research, accountability and transparency in front of the public. The Bank of Albania is already working towards the Inflation Targeting Regime, supported technically by IMF experts and the experience of the Central Bank of Turkey. On the other hand, transparency and the transmission mechanism make it necessary to communicate today with the media for the Inflation Targeting (IT) regime. The main conditions in support of the IT strategy can be divided into four main groups: First, and the most important factor is the central bank's right to determine the inflation target and its accountability for maintaining these goals: A central bank must have a "de facto" mandate for determining the level of inflation and independence in choosing the monetary struments it follows; The public should be informed about monetary policy strategy and monetary policy reductions; The second factor is the necessary conditions that the inflation target will not be oriented by other targets: Monetary policy should not be dominated by fiscal priorities, except that the central bank's loan to the government should be strictly limited; The external position of the economy must be strong enough to enable the deployment of inflation targeting as the primary objective; Inflation should be low enough to provide a real degree of monetary control. The third set of conditions requires that the financial system be developed and sufficiently stable for the implementation of the IT strategy. And the latest conditionality relates to the need to have the necessary instruments of implementing monetary policy to mark inflation: The central bank should be in the position of impacting inflation levels with its monetary policy instruments in the logical sense of the link between monetary policy forecasting and inflation.; The exchange rate target should be clearly co-ordinated with the inflation target. Fiscal policy and budget deficit management should be coordinated in ... 2/5 06/08/2022, 09:09 By Mr. Brilliance Cani, Governor of the Bank of Albania, Seminar with journalists 'Inflation Targeting and opinions on the kind... inflation target support. Transparency and accountability Central banks implementing the inflation targeting regime should be responsible in their decision to target inflation. Accountability is essential and protects monetary policy from political pressures. Under the Inflation Targeting Regime, a particular importance is the central bank's accounting. As you may know, currently the Bank of Albania implements the monetary aggregate targeting regime and declares a final inflation target at the end of the year that is not legal. But with the implementation of Inflation Targeting, reporting in the Assembly also changes and in cases of failure to achieve the target, difficult situations could be created for the direction of the central bank. This would require minimal publication of the Inflation Report and the accounting before the Assembly of reasons for not achieving the target. So this whole process establishes increasing the co-operation and relations of the central bank with the government and the Assembly, versus increasing its independence. In order to ensure that the public is receiving sufficient information that the central bank's actions are responsible, monetary policy under the inflation targeting regime must be transparent. The transparency in this case implies: The inflation target must be made explicit and public. the public must have a clear understanding of essential monetary operations. The announcement of changes in monetary policy should be accompanied by clarifying the factors that motivated this change, etc. In the direction of communication with the public, IT adoption means holding regular press conferences after meetings of the Bank Supervisory Council, regular reports on inflation, publication of models and research for inflation forecasting, media publications and information on the website and in some cases/places publishing minutes of meetings of the Supervisor's Council. In this direction we have two different experiences: the Fed publishes the Meeting Minutes while the European Central Bank still does not. A debate on publication was also held in early 2004 at the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania where most members were against publication. However, in my judgment the publication of the minutes of the Meetings of the Supervisory Council would have positive effects in the direction of increasing transparency and accountability of the central bank. In the meantime, I must stress that even the Bank of Albania's relations with the media will be at a more intensive and careful stage as the media plays an important role in the transmission mechanism while a novelty will be its attitude towards (not)achieving the target.  3/5 06/08/2022, 09:09 By Mr. Brilliance Cani, Governor of the Bank of Albania, Seminar with journalists 'Inflation Targeting and opinions on the kind... inflation. The advantages of low and stable inflation. A financial market structure, competitive, deep and straight-integrated, increases the emotion of decision-making and income distribution between consumption and savings. The experience of a decade of research in central banking has brought the already consolidated conclusion of monetary policy theory, what can and cannot accelerate economic growth in the long-term period. According to this conclusion, changes in monetary supply, eventually managed by the central bank, in the long term would have permanent effects on the overall level of prices and not economic growth. However, this does not mean that monetary policy has no impact on long-term economic growth. Rather, by maintaining price stability and predicting long-term expectations for low and stable inflation, the central bank reduces uncertainties in the economy and contributes to the most effective possible way of supporting economic growth and opening new jobs. In order to maintain expectations for low inflation in long-term periods, the central bank needs to be reliable in maintaining its permanent price stability target and must declare to the public in an open and transparent manner, her opinions on the economy and eventually monetary policy actions. Also, price stability allows the economy to express its entire potential offer through other important channels. In a low-inflation and stable environment, inflation uncertainties are minimal and this on the other hand brings the reduction of risk for financial assets and increased investments from a lower cost of firms. This is one of the main benefits currently enjoyed by the euro area that expectations for interest rates in long-term periods are low, which reflects the high level of creditworthiness of the European Central Bank in maintaining price stability in continuity with the best performance followed in Europe before the use of the euro. Does high inflation bring economic growth? The second lesson comes from the experience of the 1970s and '80s, according to which it is not possible to reduce unemployment in medium and long-term periods simply and only by accepting higher inflation rates. So if we ask the question that a 10-12 percent inflation rate is acceptable if economic development is stimulated and unemployment decreases 1.5-2 percent, at first glance political-making authorities seem to be responding yes. But the experience of this period has led to the fact that this is not a possible option. The best investment for medium and long-term economic growth is a low inflation rate. Otherwise, economic agents would eventually cause inflation (psychological effect) to rise from expectations for a high level of inflation and thus in the long-term the result would be higher inflation and not employment growth. Production and employment would return to their potential levels.  4/5 06/08/2022, 09:09 By Mr. Brilliance Cani, Governor of the Bank of Albania, Seminar with journalists 'Inflation Targeting and opinions on the kind... In determining the inflation target, a range of factors are taken into account. First, the "nature" of inflation is taken into account. Inflation, as a concept, represents an increase in the overall level of the prizes. However, in transition countries, there are frequent relative price movements, in search of new balances, in line with market conditions. This puts pressure on inflation. Since relative price movements are in the interest of developing the market economy, it is accepted that transitioncountries have a higher inflation rate than developed countries. However, inflation is harmful to the economy, regardless of its nature. It discourages savings, harms savers and increases uncertainty in making economic decisions. The Bank of Albania's inflation target, expressed in the form of a 2-4 percent interval, represents the balance of these two factors. It is an inflation rate that left the economy breathing, protecting their savings and savings, and minimizing the risk of switching to deflation. Seeing the delicate balance played by the inflation target and its real rate, I see no space and reason for rising inflation in the economy. Furthermore, given the good credit performance of the economy. High inflation levels have proven to be quite fluctuating and unruly. The process of disinflation, needed to fight them, is painful and has high economic costs. On a long-term horizon, it would wipe out any benefit of the moment that rising inflation would bring.  5/5

Data e publikimit: 20.07.2004 Shum vende me ekonomi n zhvillim, prfshir edhe Shqiprin, deklarojn por nuk jan t https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Nga_z_Shkelqim_Cani_Guvernator_i_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_Seminari_ 1/5 06/08/2022, 09:09 Nga z.Shklqim Cani, Guvernator i Banks s Shqipris, Seminari me gazetart 'Inflation Targeting dhe opinionet mbi llojin detyruara t mbajn nj shnjestrim t inflacionit si objektiv final t politiks monetare. Ndrkoh, zbatimi regjimit t politiks monetare t "Targetimit t Inflacionit" po shtrihet gjithmon e m shum nga vendet e industrializuara te ekonomit n zhvillim. Fakti q edhe politika monetare e Banks s Shqipris, n nj periudh afatmesme (v.2007) mendohet se do t lviz drejt regjimit t shnjestrimit t inflacionit, krkon nj pun t konsiderueshme krkimore, prgjegjshmri dhe transparenc para publikut. Banka e Shqipris po punon tashm n drejtim t Regjimit t Shnjestrimit t Inflacionit, mbshtetur nga ana teknike edhe nga ekspert t FMN-s dhe eksperienca e Banks qendrore t Turqis. Nga ana tjetr, transparenca dhe mekanizmit i transmisionit e bjn t domosdoshme komunikimin e sotm me median pr regjimin e Targetimit t Inflacionit (IT). Kushtet kryesore n mbshtetje t strategjis s IT mund t ndahen n katr grupe kryesore: S pari, dhe m i rndsishmi faktor sht e drejta e Banks qendrore mbi prcaktimin e objektivit t inflacionit dhe prgjegjshmria e saj pr n mbajtjen e ktyre objektivave: Nj bank qendrore duhet t ket "de facto" mandatin pr prcaktimin e nivelit t inflacionit dhe pavarsin n zgjedhjen e strumentave monetar q ndjek; Publiku duhet t informohet rreth strategjis s politiks monetare dhe konduktimet e politiks monetare; Faktori i dyt jan kushtet e nevojshme q targeti i inflacionit nuk do t 'orientohet nga objektivat e tjera: Politika monetare nuk duhet t dominohet nga prioritetet fiskale, duke veuar se kredia e banks qendrore pr qeverin duhet t jet e kufizuar n mnyr strikte; Pozicioni i jashtm i ekonomis duhet t jet n mnyr t mjaftueshme i fort pr t mundsuar vendosjen e targetimit t inflacionit si objektiv parsor; Inflacioni duhet t jet mjaftueshm i ult pr t siguruar nj shkall reale t kontrollit monetar. Grupi i tret i kushteve krkon q sistemi financiar t jet i zhvilluar dhe stabl mjaftueshm pr implementimin e strategjis s IT. Dhe kushtzimet e fundit lidhet me nevojn pr t pasur instrumentat e nevojshm t zbatimit t politiks monetare t shenjestrimit t inflacionit: Banka qendrore duhet t jet n pozitn e ndikimit t nivelit t inflacionit me instrumentat e saj t politiks monetare n kuptimin llogjik t lidhjes mes parashikimit t politiks monetare dhe inflacionit.; Objektivi i kursit t kmbimit duhet t jet i bashkkoordinuar n mnyr t qart me objektivin e inflacionit. Politika fiskale dhe menaxhimi i deficitit buxhetor duhet t jen t koordinuara n https://www.banbkofalhbania.jorg/Shtypi/Fjalimie_inteirvisftla_airtikuji/Fjalime/Nga_z_Shkelqim_Cani_Guvernator_i_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_Seminari_ 2/5 06/08/2022, 09:09 Nga z.Shklqim Cani, Guvernator i Banks s Shqipris, Seminari me gazetart 'Inflation Targeting dhe opinionet mbi llojin mbshtetje t targetit t inflacionit. Transparenca dhe prgjegjshmria Bankat qndrore q zbatojn regjimin e targetimit t inflacionit duhet t jen t prgjegjshme n vendimmarjen e tyre pr shnjestrimin e inflacionit. Prgjegjshmria sht thelbesore dhe e mbron politikn monetare nga presionet politike. Nn regjimin e Targetimit t Inflacionit, nj rndsi t veant merr llogaridhnia e Banks qendrore. Si mund ta dini, aktualisht Banka e Shqipris zbaton regjimin e targetimit t agregatve monetar dhe deklaron nj objektiv final t inflacionit n fund t vitit q nuk sht obligim ligjor. Por, me zbatimin e Inflation Targeting ndryshojn edhe raportimi n Kuvend dhe n raste t mos-arritjes s objektivit mund t krijoheshin situate t vshtira pr drejtimin e banks qendrore. Kjo do t krkonte minimalisht publikimin e Raportit t Inflacionit dhe llogaridhnien para Kuvendit t arsyeve t mos-arritjes s objektivit. Pra, i gjith ky proces vendos rritjen e bashkpunimit dhe marrdhnieve t banks qendrore me qeverin dhe Kuvendit, kundrejt rritjes s pavarsis s saj. N mnyr q t sigurohet publiku q po merr informacionin e mjaftueshm se veprimet e banks qendrore jan t prgjegjshme, politika monetare nn regjimin e targetimit t inflacionit duhet t jet transparente. Praktisht transparenca n kt rast nnkupton:  targeti i inflacionit duhet t bhet eksplicit dhe publik.  publiku duhet t ket nj kuptim t qart t operacionoeve thelbsore monetare.  njoftimi i ndryshimeve n politikn monetare duhet t shoqrohet me sqarimin e faktorve q motivuan kt ndryshim etj.. N drejtim t komunikimit me publikut, adoptimi i IT nnkupton mbajtjen e konferencave t rregullta t shtypit pas mbledhjeve t Kshillit Mbikqyrs t Banks, raporte t rregullta mbi inflacionin, publikimin e modeleve dhe krkimeve pr parashikimin e inflacionit, botime pr mediat dhe informacione n faqen e internetit dhe n disa raste/vende publikimin e minutave t mbledhjeve t Kshilit Mbikqyrs. N kt drejtim kemi dy eksperienca t ndryshme: Fed i publikon Minutat e Takimit ndrsa Banka qendrore Evropian ende jo. Nj debat mbi publikimin sht zhvilluar edhe n fillim t vitit 2004 n Kshillin Mbikqyrs t Banks s Shqipris ku shumica e antarve ishte kundr publikimit. Gjithsesi, n gjykimin tim publikimi i minutave t mbledhjeve t Kshillit Mbikqyrs do t kishte efekte positive n drejtim t rritjes s transparencs dhe prgjegjshmris s banks qendrore. Ndrkoh, duhet t theksoj se edhe marrdhniet e Banks s Shqipris me mediat do t jen n nj faz m intensive dhe m t kujdesshme pasi media luan nj rol t rndsishm n mekanizmin e trasmesionit ndrsa nj risi do t jet qndrimi i saj ndaj (mos)arritjes s objektivit https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Nga_z_Shkelqim_Cani_Guvernator_i_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_Seminari_ 3/5 06/08/2022, 09:09 Nga z.Shklqim Cani, Guvernator i Banks s Shqipris, Seminari me gazetart 'Inflation Targeting dhe opinionet mbi llojin t inflacionit. Avantazhet e inflacionit t ult dhe t qendrueshm. Nj struktur e tregut financiar, konkuruese, e thell dhe e integruar drejt, rrit eficensn e vendimmarrjes dhe shprndarjes s t ardhurave mes konsumit dhe kursimeve. Eksperienca e nj dekade krkimesh n bankingun qndror ka sjell konkluzionin tashm t konsoliduar t teoris s politiks monetare, se far mund dhe far nuk mund t prshpejtoj rritjen ekonomike n periudha afatgjat. Sipas ktij konkluzioni, ndryshimet n ofertn monetare, eventualisht t menaxhuara nga banka qendrore, n periudhn afatgjat do t kishin efekte permanente n nivelin e prgjithshm t mimeve dhe jo t rritjes ekonomike. Gjithsesi, kjo nuk do t thot se politika monetare nuk ka ndikim n rritjen ekonomike afatgjat. Prkundrazi, duke mbajtur stabilitetin e mimeve dhe parashikuar pritjet afatgjata pr nj inflacion t ult dhe t qndrueshm, banka qndrore redukton pasigurit n ekonomi dhe kontribon n mnyrn m efektive t mundshme t mbshtetjes s rritjes ekonomike dhe hapjes s vendeve t reja t puns. N mnyr q t mbaj pritjet pr inflacion t ult n periudha afatgjat, banka qendore ka nevoj t jet e besueshme n mbajtjen e objektivit t prhershm t saj t stabilitetit t mimeve dhe duhet t deklaroj pr publikun n nj mnyr t hapur dhe transparente, opinionet e saj mbi ekonomin dhe eventualisht veprimet e politiks monetare. Gjithashtu, stabiliteti i mimeve, lejon ekonomin t shpreh t gjith ofertn e saj potenciale nprmjet kanaleve t tjera t rndsishme. N nj ambjent me inflacion t ult dhe stabl, pasigurit pr inflacionin jan minimale dhe kjo nga ana tjetr sjell reduktimin e riskut pr asetet financiare dhe rritjen e investimeve nga nj kosto m e ult e firmave. Ky sht nj nga prfitimet kryesore q po shijon aktualisht zona e euros q pritshmrit pr normat e interesit n periudha afatgjata jan t ulta, gj q reflekton nivelin e lart t kredibilitetit t Bankes Qendrore Evropiane n ruajtjen e stabilitetit t mimeve n vazhdimsi me performacn m t mir t ndjekur n Europ prpara prdorimit t euros. A sjell rritje ekonomike inflacioni i lart ? Msimi i dyt vjen nga eksperienca e viteve '70 dhe '80, sipas t cilit nuk sht e mundur t reduktosh papunsin n periudha afatmesme dhe afatgjata thjesht dhe vetm duke pranuar norma m t larta inflacioni. Kshtu nse shtrojm pyetjen se nj norm inflacioni 10-12 pr qind sht e pranueshme nse stimulohet zhvillimi ekonomik dhe ulja e papunsis 1.5-2 pr qind, n pamje t par autoritetet politik-brse duket se do t prgjigjen po. Por eksperienca e ksaj periudhe ka trguar se ky nuk sht nj opsion i mundur. Investimi m i mir pr rritjen ekonomike afatmesme dhe afatgjat sht nj norm e ult inflacioni. N rast t kundrt, agjentt ekonomik do t shkaktonin eventualisht rritje t inflacionit(efekti psikologjik) nga pritshmrit pr nj nivel t lart inflacioni dhe n kt mnyr n periudh afatgjat rezultati do t ishte inflacion m i lart dhe jo rritje t punsimit. Prodhimi dhe punsimi do t ktheheshin n nivelet e tyre potenciale. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Nga_z_Shkelqim_Cani_Guvernator_i_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_Seminari_ 4/5 06/08/2022, 09:09 Nga z.Shklqim Cani, Guvernator i Banks s Shqipris, Seminari me gazetart 'Inflation Targeting dhe opinionet mbi llojin N prcaktimin e objektivit t inflacionit, mbahen parasysh nj sr faktorsh. S pari, mbahet parasysh "natyra" e inflacionit. Inflacioni, si koncept, paraqet nj rritje n nivelin e prgjithshm t cmimeve. Megjithat, n vendet n tranzicion, ekzistojn lvizje t shpeshta relative t mimeve, n krkim t ekuilibrave t rinj, n prputhje me kushtet e tregut. Kjo ushtron presion n rritj t inflacionit. Duke qen se lvizjet relative t mimeve jan n interes t zhvillimit t ekonomis s tregut, pranohet q vendet n tranzicion t ken nj norm inflacioni m t lart se vendet e zhvilluara. Megjithat, inflacioni sht i dmshm pr ekonomin, pavarsisht nga natyra e tij. Ai dekurajon kursimet, dmton kursimtart dhe rrit pasigurin n marrjen e vendimeve ekonomike. Objektivi i Banks s Shqipris pr inflacionin, i shprehur n formn e intervalit 2-4 pr qind, prfaqson ekuilibrin e ktyre dy faktorve. Ajo sht nj norm inflacioni q i le frymmarrje ekonomis, q mbron kursimtart dhe kursimet e tyre dhe q minimizon rrezikun e kalimit n deflacion. Duke par ekuilibrin delikat t luajtur nga objektivi i inflacionit dhe norma reale e tij, nuk shikoj hapsir dhe arsye pr rritjen e inflacionit n ekonomi. Pr m tepr, duke patur parasysh edhe ecurine e mir t kreditimit t ekonomis. Nivelet e larta t inflacionit shte provuar se jane mjaft t luhatshme dhe t pakontrollueshme. Procesi i dizinflacionit, i nevojshem pr t luftuar ato, sht i dhimbshm dhe ka kosto t larta ekonomike. text: , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in them... for the construction of the payment intersection system in small value 29/07/22, 15:02 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the meeting of the inauguration of works for the construction of the payment intersection system in small value Publication date: 18.11.2004 Implementation of the Clergy System at the Bank of Albania Good evening to all, I thank you for being here present at an important event of the Bank of Albania and the Albanian banking system. I feel honored to have the privilege of presenting this project to me. Considering the project to build the payment intersection system in small or different value, that of clergy, as one of the challenges in which the Bank of Albania and the banking system have recently been involved, I have every right to believe that this time we will be successful. Building this system is part of the deep reform we are doing to the payment system in the country, which will improve the types and security of payment-related banking services. As we know, payment service is still far from advanced international standards and money is the most usable means of payment. The reason is simple - the lack of a cheaper, faster and safer alternative. We are all witnessing geographical expansion, increasing numbers as well as the cylesia of banking services. This is where the number of bank cards, the number of ATMs and actions carried out through them are particularly noticeable.  ertimin_e_sistemit_te_kryqezimit_te_pagesave_ne_vlere_te_vogel.html Page 1 of 3 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in them... for the construction of the payment intersection system in small value 29/07/22, 15:02 This expansion seems to be just the beginning of the use of new bank card payment instruments. Although the process thus far seems to be rapid, it must be followed by a increase in the number of card admission terminals at points of sale (POS terminals) as well as the use of cards as good payment tools, not limiting their users only to cash withdrawals. Further action must be taken to standardize or unify the technology used, aimed at creating a unified charter. Despite the achievements achieved, the cost of payments still remains high while the time of the long performance. The project, which begins today, is aimed at lowering costs, increasing speed and increasing security in bank payments. To this end, it will be intended that bank payments will be subject to a contemporary process of standardization and automation whose goal will be on the one hand to improve customer bank reports; Bank - Business; As well as Business - Client and on the other hand the creation of basic infrastructure, where banks will rely for further automation in relations with the public or with businesses. More specifically, this system, which is thought to be completed next June, is estimated to: Increase the speed of payment actions, up to the realization of small interbank payments, to not more than 2 days. Significantly reduce the operating costs of the banking system and payment services tariffs. Create (in nails) and use the new form of payment, "direct debit". This payment mode, which is currently in the first steps of use in a number of banks, with the completion of the project will have a fully new format and use. It will be widely used in the realization of utilitarian service payments, and will bring about substantial changes and in line with global trends, Bank-Business, Bank-Client and Business-Client relations. Honorable guests, friends and associates! The intersectional system of payments in small value is essentially a system of banks, but its priorities and benefits are towards the public and businesses in the country. Banks will be conveying the system's priorities to the public. They will follow and accompany this company with further customer rapprochement, automation of actions with businesses, as well as the wider application of modern technologies such as Internet Banking. Implementation of the project is an uneasy process and requires serious commitment from the entire banking system. With the implementation of the AIPS system in January this year, banks and the Bank of Albania created a good co-operation experience and demonstrated that, together, ambitious and difficult projects can be achieved. In implementing the new Bank of Albania project, it is committed to using this positive experience, particularly improving it in the direction of increasing the degree of transparency and all involvement of banks in decision-making.  ertimin_e_sistemit_te_kryqezimit_te_pagesave_ne_vlere_te_vogel.html Page 2 of 3 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in them... for the construction of the payment intersection system in small value 29/07/22, 15:02 In conclusion, I would like to address a deep thank you to the World Bank, our co-funder in this important project. The commitment of expertise and its degree of recognition is one of the guarantees of the success of the project. Already, the Bank of Albania has a long and extremely positive experience of co-operation with the World Bank in carrying out joint projects. Taking advantage of Mr. Bossone's presence at this inauguration ceremony, I wish that in my name and the staff I lead, I would express my high considerations and my deep respect for him, the institution and his associates.  ertimin_e_sistemit_te_kryqezimit_te_pagesave_ne_vlere_te_vogel.html Page 3 of 3

Ndonse procesi i deritanishm duket t jet i shpejt, ai duhet t pasohet nga nj rrije e numrit t terminaleve t pranimit t kartave n pikat e shitjes (terminaleve POS) si dhe prdorimi i kartave si mjete t mirfillta pagese, duke mos i kufizuar prdoruesit e tyre vetm n trheqjet cash. Veprime t mtejshme duhet t ndrmerren pr standardizimin apo pr unifikimin e teknologjis s prdorur, duke synuar krijimin e nj karte t unifikuar. Megjith arritjet e kryera, kostoja e pagesave ende mbetet e lart ndrsa koha e kryerjes e gjat. Projekti, i cili z fill sot, ka pr qllim pikrisht uljen e kostove, rritjen e shpejtsis dhe rritjen e siguris n pagesat bankare. Pr kt qllim, do t synohet q pagesat bankare t'i nnshtrohen nj procesi bashkkohor standardizimi dhe automatizimi synim i t cilave do te jet nga njra an prmirsimi i raporteve Bank Klient; Bank - Biznes; si dhe Biznes - Klient dhe nga ana tjetr krijimi i infrastrukturs baz, ku bankat do t mbshteten pr automatizime t mtejshme n marrdhniet me publikun apo me bizneset. M konkretisht, ky sistem, i cili mendohet t prfundoj n qershorin e ardhshm, vlersohet se do t: Rris shpejtsin e veprimeve t pagesave, deri n realizimin e pagesave t vogla ndrbankare, n jo me shum se 2 dit. Zvogloj dukshm kostot e operimit t sistemit bankar dhe t tarifave t shrbimeve t pagesave. Krijoj (n thonjza) dhe prdor formn e re t pagess, "debitimin direkt". Kjo mnyr pagese, e cila aktualisht sht n hapat e par t prdorimit n nj numr bankash, me prfundimin e projektit do t ket nj format dhe prdorim plotsisht t ri. Ajo do t prdoret gjersisht n realizimin e pagesave t shrbimeve "utilitare", dhe do t sjell ndryshime thelbsore dhe n prputhje me tendencat botrore, t marrdhnieve Bank-Biznes, Bank-Klient dhe Biznes-Klient. T ftuar t nderuar, miq dhe bashkpuntor! Sistemi kryqzimit t pagesave n vler t vogl, n thelb sht nj sistem i bankave, por prparsit dhe prfitimet e tij jan drejt publikut dhe bizneseve n vend. Bankat do t jen prcjellset e prparsive t sistemit tek publiku. Ato do t pasojn dhe shoqrojn kt ndrmarrje me afrimin e mtejshm t klientels, automatizimin e veprimeve me bizneset si dhe aplikimin m t gjer t teknologjive moderne sikurse mund t jet Internet Banking. Zbatimi i projektit, sht nj proces jo i leht dhe krkon angazhim serioz nga i gjith sistemi bankar. Me zbatimin e sistemit AIPS, n janar t po ktij viti, bankat dhe Banka e Shqipris krijuan nj eksperienc t mir bashkpunimi dhe demonstruan se, s bashku, mund t realizojn projekte ambicioze dhe t vshtira. N zbatimin e projektit t ri Banka e Shqipris, sht e vendosur t prdor kt eksperienc pozitive, duke e prmiresuar veanrisht n drejtim t rritjes s shkalls s transparencs dhe t gjithprfshirjes s bankave n vendimmarje. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjaertimin_e_sistemit_te_kryqezimit_te_pagesave_ne_vlere_te_vogel.html Pagina 2 di 3 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, Z.
