Mother and professors of the Faculty of Economics in the city of Korca 29/07/22, 15:02 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the regional meeting with directors of second-level bank branches, with businessmen and teachers of the Faculty of Economics in the city of Korca Publication date: 16.12.2004 Good afternoon to everyone, It is special pleasure whenever I am given the opportunity to visit the city of Korca and this feeling is good to admit that I am feeling it at these moments. The purpose of this meeting today is very simple. It concerns the lancing of the new vision regarding the restructuring of the Bank of Albania, of which its branches are also part of various cities of the country. Our economy has long entered an uninterrupted process of quantitative and qualitative development, including an increasing geographical extent. In this sense, even the southeast geographical region of the country, at the centre of which is the city of Korca, is estimated to make an important contribution and I am glad that a good part of the main protagonists of this development have present in this hall. As I mentioned in the first few days meeting with a representation of business and banks, the two communities need to co-operate more closely with each other and so that this co-operation is effective, we judge that we as the Bank of Albania have our active role, not only through the creation of a safe macroeconomic environment, But also through securing a range of other actions, which on the one hand will promote the lending activity of the banking system and on the other hand, will affect the more accurate business orientation towards safer projects and investments.  e_dhe_me_pedagoge_te_Fakultetit_Ekonomik_ne_qytetin_e_Korces.html Page 1 of 3 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in... Mother and professors of the Faculty of Economics in the city of Korca 29/07/22, 15:02 To this end, in our short and medium-term plans we have thought that our branches in the districts should give it a different role than they have played to this day. We consider it necessary that it is currently time for our branches not to be merely cash warehouses and distributors. It will also be given up on some actions not of the nature of central banking, which will gradually be absorbed naturally by commercial banks. Our goal is to turn these branches into an advanced model of the presence of the Bank of Albania across different regions of the country. They will be good information gathering stations regarding the region's financial economic activity, preceding further analyses and studies. This research work will serve not only the programming of a clearer monetary policy, but also to modernise the elements of the transmission of this policy from the center to the base and vice versa. This initiative of the Bank of Albania to monitor economic activity not only in the metropolis but also in other regions of the country, I think there is a particular interest for all interest groups present in this hall, including the academic representation of the University of Korca. For this reason, I invite you to this process of translation, suggesting that you not only give us the "first subject", the right information but also to use without any limitation our database, the conclusions of our surveys, periodic analyses and other study work. I hope that the usefulness of this analytical work will be great and in this process we will assist and cooperate with the academic staff of the University of Korca, while even students of the Economicfaculty can be utilitarian, especially in various cases of polling. In the following, I would like to add some more comments about the recent developments of the banking system, which I think have created good premise for a real expansion of this business, expansion which will positively affect the performance of your activities. Before, we were here again in Korca, to inaugurate a new bank branch. After this new entry, the number of bank branches in this city reached 6, while for the whole region the number of branches along with the agencies is 13. This interest in banking business to extend to your region, I think reflects the specific developments that this region has, in relation to other areas of the country. I personally believe that this region has great economic potential, and furthermore I stress that this region is of the few that has a multi-sectoral potential, including agricultural potential. Likewise, I judge that cross-border relations are also a good opportunity for the region's intesive development and, by generalising how much I said above, I would encourage the banking system to be more aggressive in this region, with plans and concrete objectives to support your economy. After the completion of the payment system in great value, the Bank of Albania a short time ago inaugurated the beginning of a very important project dealing with the intersection of payments in small value. The operation of this new system will significantly increase the speed of payments among bank users, an element whose lack has kept businesses away from banks. Take the opportunity to  e_dhe_me_pedagoge_te_Fakultetit_Ekonomik_ne_qytetin_e_Korces.html Page 2 of 3 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in... Mother and professors of the Faculty of Economics in the city of Korca 29/07/22, 15:02 Sensitise businesses for the advantages that will accompany the functioning of this system, as among other things the two systems together will help achieve international STANDARDS of ATM and POS (automatic and electronic payment equipment) per number of populations. The challenge for the banking system and businesses, but also for the Bank of Albania remains the public's incentive to use them. To make reality what I said above will encourage the banking system to be more active, meaning banks must go towards the population and businesses with clear and ready products, with fast and efficient services. Assessing recent developments in the banking system in both increasing the number of branches and adding banking services to sports, I think in 2005 the banking system will be more attractive. I judge that the optimistic signs of the year we are leaving will be followed by energetic actions of the banking system in the business of electronic card payments, and in this spirit I would express that the solutions of the banking system are in favour of a unified card. Of course, steps in this direction will be more complex and natural that some of them require interinstitutional interaction. The Bank of Albania is already leading the way towards widespread use of cards in Albania. Credit card service will not only contribute to reducing cash in the economy, but will also give a positive impact on the downgrading of the informal economy. However, what I think is important in the context of this meeting is to do with the incentive and encouragement exercised towards the banking system, that this level of services be present simultaneously throughout the territory of the country where banks exercise their activity. Only in this way, the advantages of electronic payments and all other amenities will be the same throughout the territory of the Republic, both for you and the public in general. Following this logic I think we will create real chances for a geographically harmonized development by making a real contribution to the increase in well-being at the country scale. Honored participants, In the end, I have nothing but once again to express my personal sympathy, for the tradition and culture that has characterized your journey over the years. Furthermore, I take the opportunity to congratulate you also on the holiday season and hoping that today's meeting is only the first step in our long dialogue, let me thank you once again for the presence at this negotiating table. Qllimi i ktij takimi t sotm sht shum i thjesht. Ai ka t bj me lanimin e vizionit t ri n lidhje me ristrukturimin e Banks s Shqipris, pjes e s cils jan dhe degt e saj npr qytete t ndryshme t vendit. Ekonomia jon ka koh q ka hyr n nj proces t pandrprer t zhvillimit sasior dhe cilsor, prfshi dhe nj shtrirje gjeografike gjithnj e m t madhe. N kt kuptim, edhe rajoni gjeografik juglindor i vendit, n qendr t t cilit sht qyteti i Kors, vlersohet se jep nj kontribut t rndsishm dhe mua m vjen mir q nj pjes t mir t protagonistve kryesor t ktij zhvillimi i kemi t pranishm n kt sall. Ashtu si e prmenda edhe n takimin e para pak ditve me nj prfaqsi t biznesit dhe t bankave, t dy komunitetet kan nevoj t bashkpunojn m ngusht me njri - tjetrin dhe n mnyr q ky bashkpunim t jet efikas gjykojm se ne si Bank e Shqipris te kemi rolin ton aktiv, jo vetm nprmjet krijimit t nj ambienti t sigurt makroekonomik, por edhe nprmjet sigurimit t nj sr veprimesh t tjera, t cilat nga njra an do t nxisin aktivitetin kreditues t sistemit bankar dhe nga ana tjetr, do t ndikojn n orientimin m t sakt t biznesit drejt projekteve dhe investimeve m t sigurta. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fje_dhe_me_pedagoge_te_Fakultetit_Ekonomik_ne_qytetin_e_Korces.html Pagina 1 di 3 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, Z. Ardian Fullani, nnesmen dhe me pedagog t Fakultetit Ekonomik n qytetin e Kors 29/07/22, 15:02 Pr kt qllim, n planet tona afatshkurtra dhe afatmesme kemi menduar q degve tona npr rrethe t'i japim nj rol t ndryshm nga ai q ato kan luajtur deri m sot. Ne e gjykojm t domosdoshme se aktualisht ka ardhur koha q degt tona t mos jen thjesht magazina dhe distributor cash-i. Gjithashtu do t hiqet dor edhe nga disa veprime jo t natyrs s bankingut qendror, t cilat gradualisht do t thithen natyrshm nga ana e bankave tregtare. Synimi yn sht q kto deg t shndrrohen n nj model t prparuar t prezencs s Banks s Shqipris npr rajone t ndryshme t vendit. Ato do t jen stacione t mirfillta t grumbullimit t informacionit n lidhje me aktivitetin ekonomiko financiar t rajonit, duke i paraprir analizave dhe studimeve t mtejshme. Kjo pun krkimore do t'i shrbej jo vetm programimit t nj politike monetare m t qart, por edhe modernizimit te elementeve t transmisionit t ksaj politike nga qendra n baz dhe anasjelltas. Kjo nism e Banks s Shqipris pr t monitoruar aktivitetin ekonomik jo vetm n metropol por edhe n rajone t tjera t vendit, mendoj se ka nj interes t veant pr t gjitha grupet e interesit t pranishme n kt sall, prfshi dhe prfaqsin akademike t Universitetit t Kors. Pr kt arsye, ju ftoj n kt proces tranformimi, duke ju sugjeruar q jo vetm t na jepni "lndn e par", informacionin e duhur por edhe q t prdorni pa asnj kufizim bazn ton t t dhnave, konkluzionet e anketimeve tona, analizat periodike dhe punt e tjera studimore. Un shpresoj q dobishmria e ksaj pune analitike t jet e madhe dhe n kt proces t asistohemi dhe t bashkpunojm me stafin akademik t Universitetit t Kors, ndrkoh q edhe studentt e Fakultetit Ekonomik mund t jen utilitar, sidomos n rastet e ndryshme t anketimit. N vijim, dshiroj t shtoj disa komente t tjera n lidhje me zhvillimet e fundit t sistemit bankar, t cilat mendoj se kan krijuar premisa t mira pr nj ekspansion t vrtet t ktij biznesi, ekspansion i cili do t ndikoj pozitivisht edhe n ecurin e aktiviteteve tuaja. M par, ishim prsri ktu n Kor, pr t inaguruar nj deg t re banke. Pas ksaj hyrjeje t re numri i degve t bankave n kt qytet arriti n 6, ndrkoh q pr t gjith rajonin numri i degve s bashku me agjensit sht 13. Ky interes i biznesit bankar pr t'u shtrir n rajonin tuaj, mendoj se pasqyron zhvillimet specifike q ky rajon ka, n raport me zona t tjera t vendit. Un personalisht jam i mendimit se ky rajon ka potencial t madh ekonomik, dhe pr m tepr theksoj se ky rajon sht nga t paktt q ka nj potencial multi sektorial, prfshi dhe at bujqsor. Po kshtu, gjykoj se edhe marrdhniet ndrkufitare jan nj oportunitet i mir pr zhvillimin intesiv t rajonit dhe, duke prgjithsuar sa thash m sipr, do ta inkurajoja sistemin bankar q t jet m agresiv n kt rajon, me plane dhe me objektiva konkret pr t mbshtetur ekonomin tuaj. Pas prfundimit t sistemit t pagesave n vler t mdha, Banka e Shqipris para pak kohsh inaguroi fillimin e nj projekti shum t rndsishm q ka t bj me kryqzimin e pagesave n vler t vogl. Funksionimi i ktij sistemi t ri do t rris ndjeshm shpejtsin e pagesave midis prdoruesve t bankave, nj element mungesa e t cilit i ka mbajtur larg bizneset prej bankave. Sfida pr sistemin bankar dhe bizneset, por dhe pr Bankn e Shqipris mbetet nxitja e publikut n prdorimin e tyre. Pr t br realitet kt q thash m sipr do t inkurajoj sistemin bankar q t jet m aktiv, q do t thot se bankat duhet t shkojn drejt popullsis dhe bizneseve me produkte t qarta dhe t gatshme, me shrbime t shpejta dhe efikase. Duke vlersuar zhvillimet e fundit n sistemin bankar si n rritjen e numrit t degve ashtu dhe n shtimin e shrbimeve bankare n sportel, mendoj se n vitin 2005 sistemi bankar do t jet m atraktiv. Gjykoj se shenjat optimiste t vitit q po lm do t pasohen nga veprime energjike t sistemit bankar n biznesin e pagesave me karta elektronike, e n kt frym do t shprehesha q zgjidhjet e sistemit bankar t jen n favor t nj karte t unifikuar. Sigurisht q hapat n kt drejtim do t jen m kompleks dhe natyrshm q disa prej tyre krkojn dhe bashkveprim ndrinstitucional. Banka e Shqipris tashm po shtron rrugn drejt prdorimit t gjer t kartave n Shqipri. Shrbimi me karta krediti jo vetm q do t kontriboj n reduktimin e cash-it n ekonomi, por do t jap nj ndikim pozitiv edhe n uljen e ekonomis informale. Megjithat, ajo q mendoj se sht e rndsishme n kontekst t ktij takimi ka t bj me nxitjen dhe me inkurajimin e ushtruar ndaj sistemit bankar, q ky nivel shrbimesh t jet i pranishm njtrajtsisht n t gjith territorin e vendit ku bankat ushtrojn veprimtarin e tyre. Vetm n kt mnyr, avantazhet e pagesave elektronike dhe t t gjitha lehtsive t tjera, do t jen t njjta n t gjith territorin e Republiks, si pr ju ashtu edhe pr publikun n prgjithsi. Duke ndjekur kt logjik mendoj se do t krijojm shanse reale pr nj zhvillim t harmonizuar gjeografikisht duke dhn nj kontribut t vrtet n rritjen e mirqenies n shkall vendi. T nderuar pjesmarrs, N prfundim nuk m mbetet gj tjetr vese edhe nj her t shpreh simpatin time personale, pr traditn dhe kulturn q ka karakterizuar trevn tuaj ndr vite. Pr m tepr, prfitoj nga rasti q t'ju uroj edhe pr festat e fundvitit dhe duke shpresuar se takimi i sotm sht vetm hapi i par n dialogun ton t gjat, me lejoni t'ju falenderoj edhe nj her pr pranin n kt tryez bisedimesh. Monetary and Inflation Forecast, Hotel Tirana January 26, 2005 29/07/22, 14:54 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the seminar on Monetary Policy Problems and the Forecast of Inflation, Hotel Tirana January 26, 2005 Publication date: 26.01.2005 Honored colleagues, It is a special pleasure to exchange with you at this working meeting some thoughts on monetary policy and the inflation forecasting process of central banks, and in particular the Bank of Albania. Keeping inflation low is undoubtedly the main objective of central banks in developed countries. They try to maintain price stability through the implementation of monetary policy based on different regimes. Regardless of the chosen regime, the direction of monetary policy is a process that must look ahead in time because monetary policy decisions affect the level of prices in the economy late. For this reason, the inflation forecast has turned into a primary task for central banks in the direction of monetary policy. While theoretical and econometric models have made considerable progress in the last decade, predicting inflation remains a difficult task that requires continuous effort. We live in a fast-changing world, developments that undoubtedly affect our economy. This further makes it even more difficult to predict inflation. On the other hand, the uncertainties and sturktural changes of developing economies such as Albania further complicate this task. Our forecasting methods at the Bank of Albania are currently based on relatively not very complex models. Although they do not take into account all economic ties, this is especially because of serious limitations and data reliability, ... etare_dhe_Parashikimi_i_Inflacionit_Hotel_Tirana_26_ janar_2005.html Page 1 of 3 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in s... Monetary and Inflation Forecast, Hotel Tirana January 26, 2005 29/07/22, 14:54 Their performance has been relatively satisfactory. This has been partly reflected in the good monetary policy results achieved in recent years. Meanwhile, not to leave things to the case, intensive work has begun to build richer structural models for predicting inflation that will better suit current and expected economic developments. To this end, the Bank of Albania is also being assisted by IMF experts, to whom I welcome - Prof. David Mayes and Zj. Marga Peeters - along with our colleagues from Turkey, Montenegro and Kosovo. As I mentioned above, Albania has had satisfactory results in terms of price stability. Albania is generally characterized by low inflation rates compared to other countries in transition, and not far from the inflation level of Eurozone countries. However, there have also been isolated cases when inflation has deviated from our desired target, due to sudden shocks and other factors that have generally been outside the central bank's control. The Bank of Albania will continue to aim to keep inflation at low levels. Achieving this goal requires a lot of effort on our part to overcome obstacles that can be encountered without penalizing economic growth. Among the problems requiring special attention I would mention: the heating of the economy as a result of the progress of structural reforms, the variability of migrants' incomes and their implications in exchange rate fluctuations, developments of the financial system, etc. As far as the latter is concerned, it is worth stressing that our banking system has already transformed all under private management. This is expected to promote banking competition, improve the quality of services and deepen the channelling of bank credit in the economy. All these factors will contribute to a healthier banking system. Meanwhile, the Bank of Albania is carefully tracking and analyzing the implications of these developments in the banking system's response to monetary policy decisions. Particular attention these developments require in relation to further improvement of the supervisory capabilities and regulatory framework of the Bank of Albania. The Bank of Albania is committed to further continuing structural reforms with the aim of expanding banking sector mediation and increasing the use of financial services. From close consultations with second-tier banks, government institutions and the private sector, the Bank of Albania has devised a strategy for increasing the use of the banking system in daily business activity in the context of reducing the cash economy. Returning to the main theme of this seminar, I would like to stress that inflation forecasting is an important condition and for monetary policy transparency, which serves to improve the effectiveness of the transmission mechanism as well as to increase the accountability of the independent central bank. For the special importance that these kinds of activities have, I will continue to promote their organization and in the future. Such roundtables with the participation of experts from the central banks of neighbouring and wider countries are essential for improving our professional skills and leading monetary policy. ... etare_dhe_Parashikimi_i_Inflacionit_Hotel_Tirana_26_ janar_2005.html Page 2 of 3 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in s... Ardian Fullani, n seminarin pr Problemet e Politiks Monetare dhe Parashikimi i Inflacionit, Hotel Tirana 26 janar 2005 Data e publikimit: 26.01.2005 T nderuar koleg, sht nj knaqsi e veant t shkmbej me ju n kt takim pune disa mendime mbi politikn monetare dhe procesin e parashikimt t inflacionit t bankave qendrore, dhe n veanti t Banks s Shqipris. Mbajtja e inflacionit t ult sht padyshim objektivi kryesor i bankave qendrore n vendet e zhvilluara. Ato prpiqen t ruajn stabilitetin e mimeve nprmjet zbatimit t politiks monetare bazuar n regjime t ndryshme. Pavarsisht nga regjimi i zgjedhur, drejtimi i politiks monetare sht nj proces q duhet t shikoj prpara n koh pr shkak se, vendimet e politiks monetare ndikojn mbi nivelin e mimeve n ekonomi me vones. Pr kt arsye, parashikimi i inflacionit sht kthyer n nj detyr parsore pr bankat qendrore n drejtimin e politiks monetare. Ndrkoh q n dekadn e fundit modelet teorike dhe ekonometrike kan br progres t konsiderueshm, parashikimi i inflacionit mbetet nj detyre e vshtir q krkon prpjekje t vazhdueshme. Jetojm n nj bot q ndryshon shpejt, zhvillime t cilat prekin pa dyshim edhe ekonomin ton. Kjo e vshtirson edhe m tepr detyrn e parashikimit t inflacionit. N ann tjetr, pasigurit dhe ndryshimet sturkturore t ekonomive n zhvillim si Shqipria e ndrlikojn akoma m shum kt detyr. Metodat tona t parashikimit n Bankn e Shqipris aktualisht bazohen n modele relativisht jo shum komplekse. Megjithse nuk marrin parasysh t gjitha lidhjet e ekonomis, kjo sidomos prej kufizimeve serioze dhe besueshmris s t dhnave, https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjaletare_dhe_Parashikimi_i_Inflacionit_Hotel_Tirana_26_ janar_2005.html Pagina 1 di 3 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, Z. Ardian Fullani, n ss Monetare dhe Parashikimi i Inflacionit, Hotel Tirana 26 janar 2005 29/07/22, 14:54 performanca e tyre ka qene relativisht e knaqshme. Kjo sht reflektuar pjesrisht edhe n rezultatet e mira t politiks monetare t arritura vitet e fundit. Ndrkoh, pr t mos ja ln gjrat rastit, ka nisur nj pun intensive pr ndrtimin e modeleve m t pasura strukturore pr parashikimin e inflacionit q do t mund t'i prshtaten m mir zhvillimeve aktuale dhe t prithshme t ekonomis. Pr kt qllim, Banka e Shqipris po asistohet dhe nga ekspertt e FMN-s, t cilve ju uroj mirseardhjen - Prof. David Mayes dhe Zj. Marga Peeters - s bashku me kolegt tan nga Turqia, Mali i Zi dhe Kosova. Si e prmenda m sipr, Shqipria ka patur rezultate t knaqshme n lidhje me stabilitetin e mimeve. Shqipria sht karakterizuar n prgjithsi nga norma t ulta inflacioni n krahasim me vende t tjera n tranzicion, dhe jo shum larg nivelit t inflacionit t vendeve t Eurozons. Megjithat, ka patur dhe raste t izoluara kur inflacioni ka devijuar nga objektivi yn i dshiruar, pr shkak t goditjeve t papritura dhe faktorve t tjer q prgjithsisht kan qen jasht kontrollit t banks qendrore. Banka e Shqipris do t vazhdoj t synoj mbajtjen e inflacionit n nivele t ulta. Arritja e ktij objektivi krkon shum prpjekje nga ana jon pr kaprcimin e pengesave q mund t hasen pa penalizuar rritjen ekonomike. Ndr problemet q krkojn vemendje t veant do t prmendja: nxehjen e ekonomis si pasoj e progresit t reformave strukturore, ndryshueshmrin e t ardhurave t emigrantve dhe implikimet e tyre n luhatjet e kursit t kmbimit, zhvillimet e sistemit financiar etj. Prsa i prket ktyre t fundit, vlen pr tu theksuar se tashm sistemi yn bankar sht transformuar i gjithi nn drejtimin privat. Kjo pritet t nxit konkurrencn bankare, t prmirsoj cilsin e shrbimeve dhe t thelloj kanalizimin e kredis bankare n ekonomi. T gjith kta faktor do t kontribuojn n nj sistem m t shendetshm bankar. Ndrkoh, Banka e Shqipris po ndjek dhe po analizon me kujdes implikimet e ktyre zhvillimeve n reagimin e sistemit bankar ndaj vendimeve t politiks monetare. Vmendje t veant kto zhvillime krkojn dhe n lidhje me prmirsimin e mtejshm t aftsive mbikqyrse dhe t kuadrit rregullator t Banks s Shqipris. Banka e Shqipris sht e angazhuar t vazhdoj m tej reformat strukturore me qllim zgjerimin e ndrmjetsimit t sektorit bankar dhe rritjen e prdorimit t shrbimeve financiare. Nga konsultimet e ngushta me bankat e nivelit t dyt, me institucionet qeveritare dhe me sektorin privat, Banka e Shqipris ka hartuar nj strategji pr rritjen e prdorimit t sistemit bankar n aktivitetin e prditshm t biznesit n kuadrin e reduktimit t ekonomis s cash-it. Duke u kthyer tems kryesore t ktij seminari, dshiroj t theksoj q parashikimi i inflacionit sht kusht i rndsishm dhe pr transparencn e politiks monetare e cila i shrben prmirsimit t efektivitetit t mekanizmit t transmisionit si dhe rritjes s prgjegjshmris s banks qendrore t pavarur. Pr rndsin e veant q kan kto lloj aktivitetesh, un do t vazhdoj t nxis organizimin e tyre dhe n t ardhmen. Tryezat t tilla t rrumbullakta me pjesmarrjen e ekspertve nga bankat qendrore t vendeve fqinje dhe m gjer, jan thelbsore pr prmirsimin e aftsive tona profesionale dhe t drejtimit t politiks monetare. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjaletare_dhe_Parashikimi_i_Inflacionit_Hotel_Tirana_26_ janar_2005.html Pagina 2 di 3 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, Z. text: The word greeting of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Ardi... Accountants and Financiers, Congress Palace 10 February 2005 29/07/22, 15:02 The greeting word of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the first Congress of Accountants and Financiers, Congress Palace 10 February 2005 Publication date: 11.02.2005 Hello dear friends, acquaintances and colleagues! I honestly feel good to be invited to participate in a first event of these sizes, albanian accountants. And even more so, I'm glad that among those in this hall, I see a lot of my colleagues and friends, while I see young people among you! During the years we have left behind, we have often had a chance to debate about issues related to the contaminant evidence. The debacle of the planned economy in the late 1980s and in the first two to three years of the following decade, in addition to others, created a kind of parish in the direction of financial accounting. The great economic transformation, the rapid birth of private enterprises, the new conception of the management of public property and enterprises, the state still unconsolidated, the lack of international experiences and many other causes, created a confusion, which despite the years, I think continues to accompany us even nowadays. The word greeting of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the opening of the works of the Fifth Conference International Bank of Albania Central Bank at Time of Integration, Durres, 24 March 2005 Publication date: 24.03.2005 Dear friends, honorable participants, dear ladies and gentlemen,  1/2 06/08/2022, 09:12 The word greeting of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the opening of the works of the Conference of Pe... I have the pleasure of having you my guests at this important bank of Albania event. I believe this conference is one of the highlights of our annual activity and to this end I feel good when I see in the hall many of my acquaintances, honorable professors, prominent economists, governments, bankers, as well as media representatives. We decided to title this conference "Central Bank in Integration Time", for the very vital importance that this difficult process poses to our country, but also to many of the other countries represented in this activity. We have already realized that without financial integration there can be no real integration. I understand that we need more revenue, for more political stability, for more cultural and social integration, but certainly as important as so-called financial integration. And in this context I think that the role of the institution I lead, the role of the banking system, the financial sector in a broader sense is very important and the challenges we have to face in this direction are numerous. Strengthening the country's financial stability, increasing monetary policy efficiency and other economic policies, agitating the financial market, increasing the country's geographical coverage with banking business and increasing financial mediation are necessary conditions for a true integration of the country with the developed part of the old continent. I think what we need is to do with marketing values and truth on Albanian reality. I hope this conference will be a modest contribution in this direction. I would like banks and finance to be avant-garde on the road to integration. I sincerely hope that the works presented at this conference, as well as the discussions made by the participants, will be a concrete step in this direction. To this end I believe that the contribution of all participants will be vulnerable. Let me once again wish him the best of this conference.  2/2

text: 06/08/2022, 09:11 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, held at the Fifth International Conference of the Bank s... , Mr. Ardian Fullani, held at the Fifth International Conference of the Bank of Albania 'The Central Bank at the time of integration. Rising confidence in financial markets' Publication date: 24.03.2005 Ladies and gentlemen,  1/7 06/08/2022, 09:11 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, held at the Fifth International Conference of the Bank s... It is a great pleasure to share with you some opinions and ideas about the current state of the financial market and its prospects in Albania. Dressed in the new Governor's coat, I could stop at more general issues. However, I decided to title my speech "Increasing confidence in financial markets", started by my vision that creating a developed financial market does nothing but better serve our fundamental objectives, especially our ambitions in the field of monetary policy as well as other economic policies. The Bank of Albania is pleased with the monetary policy results it has drafted and implemented over the past 13 years. However, to be honest, inflation has often also had deviations due to periods of decline and slowing economic development. However, his return to acceptable levels has been rapid and, in some case, we have also been surprised by the low rates. We think there are still spaces in increasing accuracy in measuring prices and weights, which occupy the various groups in the basket of goods and consumer services. Some goods are still not included in the basket, while some price movements are difficult to justify. However, the consumer price index has been taken well, uninfluenced by the central bank, serving as an indicator by which the final monetary policy target is measured. Starting from the assumption that inflation rates have been accurate, anyone can think that the Albanian economy is a fairly flexible economy, as long as it manages to bring inflation to normal levels in a short time. That's an argument I want to believe. The lack of flexibility, noted in some other economies, seems to be no case for Albania. I have in mind the long procedures for taking or leaving work or the variety of rules related to the goods and services markets. Above all, the establishment of the flexible exchange rate regime has been and is one of the main contributors, which directly affects this high degree of mobility of the Albanian economy. Returning to the good performance of monetary policy, the Bank of Albania to some extent joins the idea that among other things we have sometimes had some luck. The Albanian economy continues to lack some important traits and therefore monetary policy transmission channels are not yet fully functional. On the other hand, the financial sector is still fragile and needs further reforms and great vigilance. The development and opening of the market itself will bring more exposure and flow, maintaining financial stability becomes more difficult. It is this reason that pushes me to consider increasing financial market confidentiality, as one of my ambitions as Governor of the Bank of Albania. Unlike many other countries, Albania's history is poor in the direction of heritage in financial institutions and financial instruments. Our tradition is not that of developed countries. Although from archival data, the first efforts to establish a national bank date back to  2/7 06/08/2022, 09:11 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, held at the Fifth International Conference of the Bank s... With the beginning of the last century, established institutions have mainly been in the function of facilitating mutual transfers with other countries. Even after the creation of the National Bank, it must again be said that in Albania financial institutions have not had any leading role in the economic-financial life of the country, despite admirable progress in consolidating the economic environment in general. Likewise, even during the long years of the centralized economy, the banking system was typical of eastern European countries. A single bank performed the functions of the central and commercial banks, while population deposits were collected from savings crates and in parallel, a small bank specialized in lending farms and agricultural cooperatives. I am convinced that even during this long period for causes of the most diverse, the financial sector in Albania for the degree of mediation and flexibility cannot be compared to the standard models of the East, including the countries of the region. On the other hand, I do not have to comment on other segments of the financial sector, as we all witness that historical facts are very rare in this context, while the only institutional development belongs to the presence of a state insurance society, which had a limited role in the insurance field with no other role in mediation. Undoubtedly, the real reforms were first introduced in the early 1990s, which culminated in the mid-1990s, with the adoption of the first law for the central bank and the banking system in Albania. Since 1992 and on, the banking system has come to an increase, to come nowadays, when there are 16 active banks, while another bank has received preliminary license. Stopping a little longer in the financial sector, I would like to add that recently there are developments in other segments of it. There is an increase in the number of operators in the insurance field. Similarly, the first operators in the pension field have appeared, as does a modest number of small financial operators in the field of lending, mainly in the form of savings-loans societies and nonbank financial institutions. From a quick glance, it seems that we have a financial sector that is alive from year to year. However, it is notable that quality developments belong to the banking system. Currently, I believe we have a banking system, public confidentiality to which it comes and grows. Especially these recently, much is being done in the direction of geographical coverage of the country with banking services, as well as positive developments there is in payment infrastructure. I gladly agree that business-bank relations are at the most dainty level. Another impetus will be the presentation of the payment intersection system in small value. This system will facilitate small payments between individuals, regardless of geographical distances, while creating the safe bed for more sophisticated developments in the field of electronic payments. httpsG://jwwew.bkaenkofajlbaniai.ordg/hShtypi/Fejablime_hinkteervista_airtikuj/Fdjahlime/FjalaM_e_iGiuverni ateorit_teF_iBankes_se_Shkqiperiise_z_Ardiahn_Fullanki_mbkajt 3/7 06/08/2022, 09:11 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, held at the Fifth International Conference of the Bank s... During this period, in co-operation with the Ministry of Finance, we had concrete steps even in the direction of reducing the cash economy, which is clearly reflected in the performance of reports respective monetary. However, I think the challenges that stand before us are still numerous and great. I believe the rate of financial mediation is still low. On the other hand, still the sector with great economic potential, agriculture, continues not to be covered by banking business, while the rate of penetration of electronic payment cards in everyday life is at modest levels. We as the Bank of Albania have concluded that the banking system needs more flexibility, especially on the regulatory side. To this end, we are thinking of a reassessment of the regulatory framework related to the functioning of the money market, lending policies and the currency market. I would hope the banks had a proactive role. Of course, the arrangements will be part of a broader assessment, not only within the country but also on the part of international specialized institutions and bodies. What about the rest of the financial sector? As Mentioned above, it is noted that there is an increase in operators in the market. However, I agree that their operational activity is still far from the best standards and practices. Furthermore, even their legislative, regulatory and supervisory framework is not complete. To this end I think the challenges are numerous and the corrective measures should be immediate. I judge that it is in the interest of the insurance companies themselves to be more supervised, because only so will they reach standards similar to those of the banking system. Keeping current practices unchanged becomes nothing but difficult their path to the irreversible process of creating an efficient financial market. On the other hand, they will continue to remain peripheral parts of the financial system. The time has come to not just enjoy the numerical addition of operators to the market, but we must aim to build a regulated, valued, flexible and transparent financial sector. Likewise, other financial insituations, including specialized mediators and assistants, judge that they have spaces for more role in mediation, as well as for them, would apply that their activity in advance be covered with legal frameworks and full and contemporary supervision. Confidentiality in a market cannot be decreed by monetary authority, but cannot be imposed. It is a difficult process that requires continuous work. It requires playing rules and accurate recognition of them from all actors. It requires adeptness, transparency, playfulness and careful supervision. Only so will its actors increase mutual trust in each other, as well as market organizers and supervisors. A central bank is as reliable as the banking system itself is. It is difficult to understand that a phlegmatic market with scant inventory of financial instruments with  4/7 06/08/2022, 09:11 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, held at the Fifth International Conference of the Bank s... it is difficult to understand that a phlegmatic market, with low inventory of financial instruments, with still low competition, gain credo, awaken investor interest and give impetus strong formalisation of the economy, these actions, which would ultimately increase the confidence of the public to the financial market. So monetary confidentialness is an axiom that proves every day, only if we are going to have a financial market, open and transparent. Market forces are more efficient, when the number of participants is large and when market principles are recognized and used in the right way by all participants. Meanwhile, market sentiments are like sea waves. They come and go. The more the market develops, the stronger they will become. We can see these waves in economies where developed financial markets are the leading forces in the economy. It is important that we idea and implement monetary, fiscal and other smart economic policies in order to accommodate these waves appropriately. I would not like to stop in detail in my speech in particular segments of the financial market, where we as a banking system are leading organisers and actors. Nor would I want to do analysis for enabling the active involvement of other financial institutions in them. What I would like to stop next is a recent open debate at the Bank of Albania. It has already been acknowledged on a large scale that the treasury bond market has large spaces to expand and deepen more. On the other hand, you're all Witnesses that, for a period of several years, the Bank of Albania has opened its sports to sell treasury bonds directly to individuals. In all the debate of recent days, in no case has the Bank of Albania thought that individuals should be excluded from the primary market and given the opportunity to buy bonds only through the secondary market. Thus, I am convinced that the increase from year to year of population interest in treasury bonds has been a natural process, which above all reflects the increase in public understanding on investment and strengthening public confidence in the country's economy in general. I think it's currently time for this business to head towards the banking system. From recent talks, banks are interested in this business and are willing to get involved in it. Of course I agree with the idea that there is a need for a gradual and well-studied shift, so that the share of individuals in the bond stock is not wrinkled. I understand the banks for the costs they have, as I understand the principle that every service has a price. I judge that in the moments we talk, small investors have realized that you can't win for free. On the other hand, I think the experience of the past years was sufficient in familiarizing individuals with the benefits of investing in treasury bonds. As a result, I think the pace of recent growth will be preserved by making the contribution of the general public to public debt financing sustainable. Anyway, I want to explain to the audience that, what I said above, I don't just e_dGuveernaitorkit_te_Bjanjkesb_se_Skhqiperiese_ez_Aj rdiaen_Fulelani_mbajt... i 5/7 06/08/2022, 09:11 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, held at the Fifth International Conference of the Bank s... Primary treasury bond market. Instead, I would encourage banks to be more aggressive towards the secondary bond market. Make it clear to the public that anyone interested, He can scontify his bonds at any moment, as any individual who has little money aside, at any time it can turn to the banking system not only to deposit, but also to buy Treasure vouchers. I see it reasonable that even the role of financial mediators should be increased in general. The amount of money in circulation is large. This shows that business archaications continue to sleep or convert unintelligently, mainly into unreal assets. Veshur me petkun e Guvernatorit t ri, mund t ndalesha n shtje m t prgjithshme. Megjithat, vendosa q ta titulloj fjalimin tim "Rritja e besimit ndaj tregjeve financiare", nisur nga vizioni im se krijimi i nj tregu financiar t zhvilluar nuk bn gj tjetr vese i shrben m mir objektivave tona themelore, veanrisht ambicieve tona n fushn e politiks monetare si dhe t politikave t tjera ekonomike. Banka e Shqipris sht e knaqur me rezultatet e politiks monetare q ka hartuar dhe zbatuar gjat 13 viteve t fundit. Gjithsesi, pr t qen t sinqert, shpesh inflacioni ka patur edhe devijime pr shkak t periudhave t rnies dhe t ngadalsimit t zhvillimit ekonomik. Megjithat, kthimi i tij n nivele t pranueshme ka qen i shpejt dhe, n ndonj rast, edhe kndshm jemi surprizuar nga normat e ulta. Ne mendojm se ka ende hapsira n rritjen e saktsis n matjen e mimeve dhe t peshave, q zn grupet e ndryshme n shportn e mallrave dhe t shrbimeve t konsumatorit. Disa mallra ende nuk jan t prfshira n shport, ndrkoh q disa lvizje mimesh jan t vshtira t justifikohen. Sidoqoft, indeksi i mimeve t konsumit sht marr i mirqen, i painfluencuar nga banka qendrore, duke shrbyer si tregues me t cilin matet objektivi final i politiks monetare. Nisur nga supozimi q normat e inflacionit kan qen t sakta, dokush mund t mendoj se ekonomia shqiptare sht nj ekonomi mjaft fleksibl, prderisa arrin t sjell inflacionin n nivele normale brenda nj kohe t shkurtr. Ky sht nj argument q dua ta besoj dhe un. Mungesa e fleksibilitetit, e vrejtur n disa ekonomi t tjera, duket nuk prbn rast pr Shqiprin. Kam parasysh procedurat e gjata t marrjes apo t largimit nga puna apo shumllojshmrin e rregullave q lidhen me tregjet e mallrave dhe t shrbimeve. Mbi t gjitha, vendosja e regjimit t kursit fleksibl t kmbimit ka qen dhe sht nj nga kontribuesit kryesor, i cili ndikon drejtprdrejt n kt shkall t lart mobiliteti t ekonomis shqiptare. Duke iu rikthyer performancs s mir t politiks monetare, Banka e Shqipris deri diku bashkohet me iden se ndrmjet t tjerash nganjher kemi pasur edhe pak fat. Ekonomis shqiptare vazhdojn t'i mungojn disa tipare t rndsishme dhe ksisoj kanalet e transmisionit t politiks monetare akoma nuk jan plotsisht funksionale. Nga ana tjetr, sektori financiar sht akoma i brisht dhe ka nevoj pr reforma t mtejshme dhe vigjilenc t madhe. Vet zhvillimi dhe hapja e tregut do t sjell m shum ekspozim e pr rrjedhim, mbajtja e stabilitetit financiar bhet m e vshtir. sht kjo arsyeja q m shtyn t konsideroj rritjen e konfidencs s tregut financiar, si nj nga ambiciet e mia si Guvernator i Banks s Shqipris. Ndryshe nga shum vende t tjera, historia e Shqipris sht e varfr n drejtim t trashgimis n institucione financiare dhe n instrumente financiare. Tradita jon nuk sht ajo e vendeve t zhvilluara. Edhe pas krijimit t Banks Kombtare, prsri duhet thn se n Shqipri institucionet financiare nuk kan pasur ndonj rol parsor n jetn ekonomiko - financiare t vendit, megjith progresin e admirueshm n konsolidimin e ambientit ekonomik n prgjithsi. Po kshtu, edhe gjat viteve t gjata t ekonomis s centralizuar, sistemi bankar ishte tipik si ai i vendeve t Evrops Lindore. Nj bank e vetme kryente funksionet e banks qendrore dhe asaj tregtare, ndrkoh q depozitat e popullats grumbulloheshin nga arkat e kursimeve dhe paralelisht, nj bank e vogl ishte e specializuar n kreditimin e fermave dhe t kooperativave bujqsore. Jam i bindur se edhe gjat ksaj periudhe t gjat pr shkaqe nga m t ndryshmet, sektori financiar n Shqipri pr nga shkalla e ndrmjetsimit dhe e fleksibilitetit nuk mund t krahasohet me modelet standarde t Lindjes, prfshir dhe vendet e rajonit. Nga ana tjetr, nuk m mbetet t bj komente n lidhje me segmentet e tjera t sektorit financiar, pasi t gjith jemi dshmitar se faktet historike jan shum t rralla n kt kontekst, ndrkoh q i vetmi zhvillim institucional i prket pranis s nj shoqrie shtetrore sigurimesh, e cila kishte nj rol t kufizuar n fushn e sigurimeve pa asnj rol tjetr n ndrmjetsim. text: 06/08/2022, 09:12 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the salutary meeting for the beginning of the operation of the system of ... , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the salutary meeting for the beginning of the operation of the intersection system payments in small value, "Implementation of the Clergy System at the Bank of Albania" Publication date: 22.07.2005 Good afternoon to everyone,  1/3 06/08/2022, 09:12 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the salutary meeting for the beginning of the operation of the system of ... I thank you for participating in this simple ceremony on the occasion of the start of operation of the small-value payment intersection system - AECH. As I told you in November last year, when we gathered for the beginning of the implementation of the project, I am pleased to express today that the Bank of Albania kept the promise of achieving this important project in time. The establishment and operation of this system is the second important step taken by the Bank of Albania, with co-financing of the World Bank, in co-financing with second-rate banks, towards increasing the efficiency of the banking sector and that of the payment system. After more than a year of operation of the RTGS system, the expansion of payment infrastructure even with the automated clergy system, AECH, creates the necessary conditions for coping with the growing needs of our economy. The AECH system relies on international best standards and practices. This system, realized with investments in contemporary technology, will enable a significant reduction in the processing time of small-value payments, thus increasing the popularity of bank payments, and providing bank customers with a more quality service. The extent of equipment, software, regulatory base and operating procedures, which are integral to the system, in its entirety have included both the Bank of Albania and the second-tier Banks operating in Albania. Therefore the role and contribution of banks During the implementation process, it has been deemed extremely important. Transparency and all involvement with banks has found reflection on a serious commitment and common decision-making throughout the project. Of course, for this project to be called entirely successful, it must be followed by a campaign to raise awareness of the public and utilities in the direction of the wider use of payment instruments. In this context, in September this year, a broader meeting of leaders of second-level banks and the Albanian Banking Association is expected to take place, with representatives of utilitarian services societies and other interested parties, as well as with the help of the media, with the aim of promoting the wider use of this system. It is a special pleasure for me, as chairman of the Bank of Albania, to confirm that this project was carried out in time by meeting all the objectives set, thanks to fruitful co-operation with You, and media assistance with all the difficulties and complexity that presents a project of such size. I believe that this mechanism is a very important part of the system we are setting up for reducing the cash economy and reducing the informal economy. In this case, I express your congratulations and thank you for your support and contribution to the development of this project. Title: The closing speech of Mr. Ardian Fullani, Governor of the Bank of Albania, at the Open Forum "Preconditions for Inflation Targeting in Albania"
text: , Mr. Ardian Fullani mba... Southeast, organised by Euromoney, Dubrovnik, 25 - 26 October 2005 29/07/22, 15:01 , Mr Ardian Fullani held at the V Regional Conference on Finance and Investment for Southeast Europe, organised by Euromoney, Dubrovnik, October 25 - 26, 2005 Publication date: 27.10.2005 Honored participants, I feel happy to be given the opportunity to give this speech on such an important topic, such as the supervision of financial mediators. I would like to start with some general comments on competition, market infrastructure and responsible management, and the role they play in effectively overseeing these institutions, as well as mentioning the experience we have in Albania on this issue.  glindore_organizuar_nga_Euromoney_Dubrovnik_25-26_tetor_2005.html Page 1 of 5 , Mr. Ardian Fullani mba... Southeast, organised by Euromoney, Dubrovnik, 25 - 26 October 2005 29/07/22, 15:01 Banks are the typical institutions that behave when faced with the concept of "financial mediation". This comes not only as a result of the public appearance and interaction of these institutions, but because it is affected by the weight the banking system has on the financial market as a whole, especially in developing countries. For this reason, public awareness of the function banks play in developing the economy, channelling funds from savers to particular borrowers, is relatively easy to notice and understand. Understanding the role of banks, the relevant public segments find it easier to increase financial knowledge of other financial brokers, which operate in the market. These institutions, which have the ability to mediate those who provide the money and those who can make better use of it, nowadays almost constitute the full mosaic of a developed financial market. This includes nonbank financial institutions, savings-credit societies, different types of funds, etc., whose complex operations sometimes rely on a highly traditional concept of mediation. With the development of the financial market many issues emerge as challenges for market actors, market regulators and authorities in the country. These issues include the ability of market actors to structure themselves internally and the capacity they display in adapting their business towards increased interaction with the most developed markets and institutions. More simple words, this is nothing more than finding a balance for strengthening the competitive environment. Competition is desirable and targeted, because it forces market actors to carry out their operations in such a way, to be as useful and fruitful as possible, with generally very positive impacts on the quality and costs of services and products offered to the public. But we must be aware of some certain risks that accompany the competition, scale and possibility of materialization of which relates to the current state of the market. The positive impacts of competition become entirely real in the medium and long-term periods. This occurs at the very time when the market has identified its stable institutions, which have been able to adapt to the conditions of a new market and when the rate of expansion of new competitive products and services offered to the public increases. In some cases, in short-term periods, the impacts of immediate and fierce competition can have completely different impacts. Financial institutions can close part or all of their business, large public communities can be deprived of financial services in those areas which are considered "distant" in terms of economic development, product prices can rise rather than decrease, as financial institutions will use the priority of asymmetric infotainments in the state of the variable market. For this reason, it is important that competition finds the market and authorities highly prepared and that the process as a whole is fast enough to keep the "competition train" in the right track, known and valued by authorities and regulators. The process of adapting market actors to the changing environment will be affected by the current composition of the market. Under the conditions of an asymmetric composition, the adaptation process can become even more difficult. Changes in market share, scale of product and service expansion offered to the public and performance  glindore_organizuar_nga_Euromoney_Dubrovnik_25-26_tetor_2005.html Page 2 of 5 , Mr. Ardian Fullani mba... Southeast, organised by Euromoney, Dubrovnik, 25 - 26 October 2005 29/07/22, 15:01 financial institutions, more can be made worse than gradually extinguished. In this case, we will be in a vicious self-fulfilling circle, which will increase market deficiencies. The dependence of developments on financial indicators and financial market mediation capacity will be in a single institution or more than one. On the other hand, it would be very favourable for the dominant institution (institutions) to be quite active in persevering competitive behaviour in the market, but even the opposite could be true, too. Large institutions can take advantage of their size to take a passive approach to the needs of the market for development, or at worst, abuse their position. Therefore, it is very important for the regulator to create a regulatory framework, which would support a supervisory practice aimed at identifying stumbling factors a safe competitive environment in the market. The asymmetriccomposition of the market makes it necessary for communication and co-operation with other supervisory entities. At the same time, a sustainable and fruitful dialogue process with all relevant market actors must be developed, so that their views regarding current and expected market developments with an impact on competition conditions can be taken. Everyone's task becomes even easier if there is responsible management of financial mediators. This is important, regardless of the regulatory framework that exists for different segments of the market. In fact, the opposite is true, too. responsible management helps cover deficiencies, which exist in the relevant regulatory frameworks. Ensuring and protecting an open environment for investment, creating requirements related to the management of financial mediators, but also giving proper responsibility in the direction of the institution, searching for control systems in these institutions, establishing rules and procedures for transparency and accountability of the administration of the institution, as well as building a useful communication relationship are the prerequisites, which help the right direction at the level of financial mediators. In Albania, the characteristics of the development of the financial mediatormarket are those of a typical developing country. Over the past few years there have been positive developments in terms of type, quality of services, the state of financial indicators and the competitiveness of financial mediators. We believe that these developments are the fruit of a proper supervisory framework, which has been developed in parallel with the market. The Bank of Albania has the responsibility of overseeing the banking sector, certain types of nonbank financial institutions, savings-credit societies and currency exchange offices. The insurance market and the valuable letters market are overseen by two other different supervisory authorities. The level of interaction between different segments of market actors is increasing at rapid rates and so is co-operation between numerous supervisory authorities. While discussions are being discussed regarding the possibility of integrating the supervisory authorities of the insurance market and that of valuable letters. The reasons for this relate to the need for integration into a market, which does not have sufficient activity to reinforce supervisory work. Then, when the supervisory standard reaches that of the Bank of Albania in the banking sector, more thoughts will be given on the creation of a single supervisory authority for the entire financial market.  glindore_organizuar_nga_Euromoney_Dubrovnik_25-26_tetor_2005.html Page 3 of 5 , Mr. Ardian Fullani mba... Southeast, organised by Euromoney, Dubrovnik, 25 - 26 October 2005 29/07/22, 15:01 Our banking system supervisory framework provides a competitive environment in the market. In the banking sector there are no investment restrictions regarding the nationality of capital, the type of institution (subsidiary or branch), the number of institutions on the market, etc. At the same time, we still treat subsidiaries and branches of foreign banks in the same way, meaning that financial supervisory indicators carry the same meaning for both. As part of our licensing procedures, we seek data on the source of capital, on shareholder activity and sustainability of that activity, etc. We provide and seek co-operation with other supervisory, local or foreign authorities, as part of our licensing and supervision process, being fully compliant with the requirements of the use of confidential information. We also have requirements regarding regulatory capital and capital sufficiency, exposures to particular entities and operations of the bank with related persons, anti-money laundering requirements, on the management of banks (and other licensed institutions) etc.. Our approach to supervisory practice includes on-site inspections and checks through analyses. Also, changes have been made to the technology infrastructure, which is used by the bank in the field of payments. Already, a modern system for high-value payments (RTGS) is in operation, as well as another system for small-value payments. Both of these systems are integrated with each other and with bank working networks. As a result of such an environment, we today have 16 operating banks, which are in good financial conditions and with supportive shareholders. The role and weight of the banking sector in the country's market are increasing and the quality of products and services is having rapid progress. We have a supervisory framework for other licensed institutions as well, which is under the process of change and modernization. Earlier this year, the Albanian financial market underwent an assessment process conducted by the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund, a process otherwise known as FSAP, whose results were realistic and generally positive. In the banking sector, the results were very good, especially those related to the supervisory framework and the financial reinforcement of the market. Also, some certain recommendations were given, which we considered to be right and for which we will work until they are realized. A summary of this report can be found on the website of these institutions. In the end, I would like to express that the efforts we make at an individual country level must be harmonised and combined through a process of regional dialogue and communication. We've tried to be active in this direction, too. At the beginning of April, together with the International Monetary Fund we organised an international seminar on Stress-Testing, whose participants were from almost all Central and Eastern European countries. We will continue on this path, as we think this is important to achieve awareness regarding oversight issues, to achieve harmonisation of supervisory standards throughout the region with those of the EU, to ensure stable market conditions for our entities, and to make our markets and institutions less risk-prone. Thank you!  glindore_organizuar_nga_Euromoney_Dubrovnik_25-26_tetor_2005.html Page 4 of 5 , Mr. Ardian Fullani mba... Do t doja t filloja me disa komente t prgjithshme mbi konkurrencn, infrastrukturn e tregut dhe drejtimin e prgjegjshm, dhe rolin q ata luajn n mbikqyrjen efektive t ktyre institucioneve si edhe do t prmend prvojn q ne kemi n Shqipri lidhur me kt shtje. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjglindore_organizuar_nga_Euromoney_Dubrovnik_25-26_tetor_2005.html Pagina 1 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Ardian Fullani mbaJuglindore, organizuar nga Euromoney, Dubrovnik, 25 - 26 tetor 2005 29/07/22, 15:01 Bankat jan institucionet tipike q sillen ndr mend kur hasemi me konceptin e "ndrmjetsimit financiar". Kjo nuk vjen vetm si pasoj e shfaqjes n publik dhe bashkveprimit t ktyre institucioneve, por sepse ndikohet nga pesha q sistemi bankar ka n tregun financiar n trsi, veanrisht n vendet n zhvillim. Pr kt arsye, ndrgjegjsimi i publikut mbi funksionin q bankat luajn n zhvillimin e ekonomis, duke kanalizuar fondet nga kursimtart deri tek huamarrsit e veant, sht relativisht i leht pr t'u vn re dhe pr t'u kuptuar. Duke kuptuar rolin e bankave, segmentet publike prkatse e kan m t leht q t rrisin njohurit financiare mbi ndrmjetsuesit e tjer financiar, t cilt operojn n treg. Kto institucione, t cilat kan aftsin pr t ndrmjetsuar ata q sigurojn parat dhe ata q mund t'i prdorin m mir ato, n ditt e sotme pothuajse prbjn mozaikun e plot t nj tregu t zhvilluar financiar. Ktu mund t prmenden institucionet financiare jobanka, shoqrit e kursim-kreditit, lloje t ndryshme t fondeve etj., operacionet e ndrlikuara t t cilave ndonjher mbshteten n nj koncept tepr tradicional t ndrmjetsimit. Me zhvillimin e tregut financiar shum shtje dalin si sfida pr aktort e tregut, rregullatort e tregut dhe autoritetet n vend. Kto shtje prfshijn aftsin e aktorve t tregut pr t strukturuar vetveten n brendsi dhe kapacitetin q ata shfaqin n prshtatjen e biznesit t tyre drejt bashkveprimit n rritje me tregjet dhe institucionet m t zhvilluara. M fjal m t thjeshta, kjo nuk sht asgj m tepr sesa gjetja e nj ekuilibri pr forcimin e mjedisit konkurrues. Konkurrenca sht e dshirueshme dhe e synueshme, sepse ajo i detyron aktort e tregut q t'i kryejn operacionet e tyre n nj mnyr t atill, q t jen sa m t dobishme dhe t frytshme, me ndikime prgjithsisht shum pozitive n cilsin dhe kostot e shrbimeve dhe produkteve t cilat i ofrohen publikut. Por, duhet t jemi t vetdijshm pr disa rreziqe t caktuara t cilat shoqrojn konkurrencn, shkalla dhe mundsia e materializimit t s cils lidhet me gjendjen aktuale t tregut. Ndikimet pozitive t konkurrencs bhen trsisht reale n periudhat afatmesme dhe afatgjata. Kjo ndodh pikrisht n kohn kur tregu ka identifikuar institucionet e tij t qndrueshme, t cilat kan mundur t prshtaten me kushtet e nj tregu t ri dhe kur shkalla e zgjerimit t produkteve dhe shrbimeve t reja konkurruese ofruar publikut, rritet. N disa raste, n periudha afatshkurtra, ndikimet e nj konkurrence t menjhershme dhe t ashpr mund t ken ndikime trsisht t ndryshme. Institucionet financiare mund t mbyllin nj pjes apo t gjith biznesin e tyre, komunitetet e mdha publike mund t privohen nga shrbimet financiare n ato zona t cilat konsiderohen si t "largta" n aspektin e zhvillimit ekonomik, mimet e produkteve mund t rriten n vend q t ulen, duke qen se institucionet financiare do t prdorin prparsin e infomacioneve asimetrike n gjendjen e tregut t ndryshueshm. Pr kt arsye, sht e rndsishme q konkurrenca t'i gjej tregun dhe autoritetet mjaft t prgatitura dhe q procesi n trsi, t jet aq i shpejt sa t mbaj "trenin e konkurrencs" n binarin e duhur, i njohur dhe i vlersuar nga autoritetet dhe rregullatort. Procesi i prshtatjes i aktorve t tregut ndaj mjedisit t ndryshueshm do t ndikohet nga prbrja aktuale e tregut. Nn kushtet e nj prbrjeje asimetrike, procesi i prshtatjes mund t bhet edhe m i vshtir. Ardian Fullani mbaJuglindore, organizuar nga Euromoney, Dubrovnik, 25 - 26 tetor 2005 29/07/22, 15:01 financiare t institucioneve, m shum mund t keqsohet sesa t shuhet gradualisht. N kt rast, ne do t jemi n nj rreth vicioz vetprmbushs, i cili do t rris mangsit n treg. Varsia e zhvillimeve n treguesit financiar dhe n kapacitetin e ndrmjetsimit t tregut financiar, do t jet n nj institucion t vetm ose m shum sesa nj. Nga ana tjetr, do t ishte shum e favorshme q institucioni (institucionet) mbizotrues t ishte mjaft aktiv n ngulmimin e nj sjelljeje konkurruese n treg, por edhe e kundrta mund t ishte e vrtet, gjithashtu. Institucionet e mdha mund t prfitojn nga madhsia e tyre pr t mbajtur nj qndrim pasiv ndaj nevojave t tregut pr zhvillim ose n rastin m t keq, t abuzojn me pozicionin e tyre. Prandaj, pr rregullatorin sht shum e rndsishme q t krijoj nj korniz rregullatore, e cila do t mbshteste nj praktik mbikqyrse q synon identifikimin e faktorve pengues nj mjedis konkurrues t sigurt n treg. Prbrja asimetrike e tregut bn t domosdoshme nevojn pr komunikim dhe bashkpunim me entitetet e tjera mbikqyrse. N t njjtn koh, duhet t zhvillohet nj proces dialogu i qndrueshm dhe i frytshm me t gjith aktort e duhur t tregut, n mnyr q t merren edhe pikpamjet e tyre lidhur me zhvillimet aktuale dhe t pritshme t tregut me ndikim n kushtet e konkurrencs. Detyra e gjithsecilit bhet edhe m e leht nse do t ket nj administrim t prgjegjshm t ndrmjetsuesve financiar. Kjo sht e rndsishme, pavarsisht nga korniza rregullatore q ekziston pr segmente t ndryshme t tregut. N fakt, edhe e kundrta sht e vrtet; nj administrim i prgjegjshm ndihmon n mbulimin e mangsive, t cilat ekzistojn n kornizat rregullatore prkatse. Sigurimi dhe mbrojtja e nj mjedisi t hapur pr investime, krijimi i krkesave lidhur me administrimin e ndrmjetsuesve financiar, por edhe dhnia e prgjegjsis s duhur n drejtimin e institucionit, krkimi i sistemeve t kontrollit n kto institucione, vendosja e rregullave dhe e procedurave pr transparenc dhe prgjegjshmri t administrimit t institucionit, si edhe ndrtimi i nj marrdhnieje t dobishme komunikimi jan parakushtet, t cilat ndihmojn drejtimin e duhur n nivelin e ndrmjetsuesve financiar. N Shqipri, karakteristikat e zhvillimit t tregut t ndrmjetsuesve financiar jan ato t nj vendi tipik n zhvillim. Gjat viteve t fundit ka patur zhvillime pozitive lidhur me llojin, me cilsin e shrbimeve, me gjendjen e treguesve financiar dhe konkurrencn e ndrmjetsuesve financiar. Ne besojm q kto zhvillime jan frut i nj kornize t duhur mbikqyrse, e cila sht zhvilluar paralelisht me tregun. Banka e Shqipris ka prgjegjsin e mbikqyrjes s sektorit bankar, t disa llojeve t institucioneve financiare jobanka, shoqrive t kursim-kreditit dhe zyrave t kmbimit valutor. Tregu i sigurimeve dhe tregu i letrave me vler mbikqyren nga dy autoritetete t tjera t ndryshme mbikqyrse. Niveli i bashkveprimit ndrmjet segmenteve t ndryshme t aktorve t tregut sht duke u rritur me ritme t shpejta dhe po kshtu, edhe bashkpunimi ndrmjet autoriteteve t shumta mbikqyrse. Ndrkoh q po diskutohet lidhur me mundsin e integrimit t autoriteteve mbikqyrse t tregut t sigurimeve dhe atij t letrave me vler. Arsyet pr kt lidhen me nevojn e integrimit n nj treg, i cili nuk ka aktivitet t mjaftueshm pr t prforcuar punn mbikqyrse. M pas, kur standardi i mbikqyrjes t arrij at t Banks s Shqipris n sektorin bankar, do t jepen m shum mendime mbi krijimin e nj autoriteti t vetm mbikqyrs pr t gjith tregun financiar. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjglindore_organizuar_nga_Euromoney_Dubrovnik_25-26_tetor_2005.html Pagina 3 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Ardian Fullani mbaJuglindore, organizuar nga Euromoney, Dubrovnik, 25 - 26 tetor 2005 29/07/22, 15:01 Korniza jon mbikqyrse e sistemit bankar siguron nj mjedis konkurrues n treg. N sektorin bankar nuk ka kufizime t investimeve lidhur me kombsin e kapitalit, llojin e institucionit (filial apo deg), numrin e institucioneve n treg etj.. N t njjtn koh, ne ende i trajtojm filialet dhe degt e bankave t huaja n mnyr t njjt, q do t thot se treguesit mbikqyrs financiar bartin t njjtin kuptim pr t dy. Si pjes e procedurave tona t licencimit, ne krkojm t dhna mbi burimin e kapitalit, mbi aktivitetin e aksionerve dhe qndrueshmrin e atij aktiviteti etj.. Ne japim dhe krkojm bashkpunim me autoritetet e tjera mbikqyrse, vendore apo t huaja, si pjes e procesit ton t licencimit dhe mbikqyrjes, duke qen plotsisht n prputhje me krkesat e prdorimit t informacionit konfidencial. Ne gjithashtu kemi krkesa lidhur me kapitalin rregullator dhe mjaftueshmrin e kapitalit, ekspozimet ndaj entiteteve t veanta dhe operacioneve t banks me personat e lidhur me t, krkesa kundr pastrimit t parave, mbi administrimin e bankave (dhe institucioneve t tjera t licencuara) etj.. Prqasja jon e praktiks mbikqyrse prfshin inspektimet n vend dhe kontrollet prmes analizave. Gjithashtu, ndryshime ka patur n infrastrukturn teknologjike e cila prdoret nga banka n fushn e pagesave. Tashm, sht n funksion nj sistem modern pr pagesat me vler t madhe (RTGS), si edhe nj sistem tjetr pr pagesat me vler t vogl. T dyja kto sisteme jan t integruara me njritjetrin dhe me rrjetet e puns s bankave. Si rrjedhoj e nj mjedisi t till, ne sot kemi 16 banka operuese, t cilat jan n kushte t mira financiare dhe me aksioner mbshtets. Roli dhe pesha e sektorit bankar n tregun e vendit po rriten dhe cilsia e produkteve dhe shrbimeve sht duke patur progrese t shpejta. Kemi nj korniz mbikqyrse pr institucionet e tjera t licencuara gjithashtu, e cila sht nn procesin e ndryshimit dhe t modernizimit. N fillim t ktij viti, tregu financiar shqiptar iu nnshtrua nj procesi vlersimi t kryer nga Banka Botrore dhe Fondi Monetar Ndrkombtar, proces i cili njihet ndryshe si FSAP, rezultatet e t cilit ishin realiste dhe prgjithsisht pozitive. N sektorin bankar, prfundimet ishin shum t mira, veanrisht ato q kan t bjn me kornizn mbikqyrse dhe me prforcimin financiar t tregut. Gjithashtu, u dhan disa rekomandime t caktuara, t cilat ne i konsideruam si t drejta dhe pr t cilat ne do t punojm deri n realizimin e tyre. Nj prmbledhje e ktij raporti mund t gjendet n faqen e internetit t ktyre institucioneve. N fund, dshiroj t shpreh se prpjekjet q ne bjm n nj nivel vendi individual duhet t harmonizohen dhe t kombinohen prmes nj procesi t dialogut dhe komunikimit rajonal. Ne jemi prpjekur q t jemi aktiv n kt drejtim, gjithashtu. N fillim t muajit prill, s bashku me Fondin Monetar Ndrkombtar ne organizuam nj seminar ndrkombtar mbi "Stress-Testing", pjesmarrsit e t cilit ishin nga pothuajse t gjitha vendet e Evrops Qendrore dhe Lindore. Ne do t vazhdojm n kt rrug, pasi ne mendojm q kjo sht e rndsishme pr t arritur nj ndrgjegjsim lidhur me shtjet e mbikqyrjes, pr t arritur harmonizimin e standardeve mbikqyrse n gjith rajonin me ato t BE-s, pr t siguruar kushte t qndrueshme tregu pr entitetet tona dhe pr t'i br tregjet dhe institucionet tona m pak t prirura ndaj rrezikut.
