Title: Speech in the meeting with the Prime Minister of the Republic of Albania and the Banking Association - Tirana
text: , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in ... Mediterranean Euro on Microcredit, 5 - 6 December 2005, Rome 29/07/22, 15:01 , Mr Ardian Fullani, at the Mediterranean Euro Conference on Microcredit, 5 - 6 December 2005, Rome Publication date: 14.12.2005 Honorable participants! I feel happy to attend the Mediterranean Euro Conference on Microcredit, an important event, which relates to the 2005 declaration by the United Nations as the "International Year of Microcredit". Usually, a country's authorities aim to achieve sustainable economic growth in a noninflationary environment. Ideally, in a free market, capital will go to those opportunies, which represent the most efficient and profitable investments. But in a developing country, markets have some flaws and problems, and capital can easily be misdistributed. It can go to those investment opportunities, which provide fast, high but dangerous productivity, but also in other low-fruitful enterprises that are almost certain. However, this way of conduct may be problematic for the country's economic future growth. Many sectors with high long-term growth opportunities can be left untapped. This means that some areas of the economy will flourish, while others will lag far behind leading to a highly unbalanced economic development. Also, different population groups, especially those with low incomes, are most likely excluded from financial opportunities by increasing the likelihood of their poverty rising. Consequently, social problems can arise, such as job loss, free movement of the population and illegal businesses, etc., which will force public services to face this situation. Therefore, it is important to find ways to ensure more balanced development opportunities for all sectors of the economy and population groups.  ncen_Mesdhetare_Euro_mbi_Mikrokreditin_5-6_dhjetor_2005_Rome.html Page 1 of 5 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in ... Mediterranean Euro on Microcredit, 5 - 6 December 2005, Rome 29/07/22, 15:01 Generally, the Albanian economy relies on microbusiness. Almost all companies in Albania are part of the small and medium-sized enterprise category. According to INSTAT data, more than 90 per cent of Albanian companies can be classified as small and medium-sized enterprises. Most of these companies are engaged in trade and services, reflecting their nature of micro business, and less in industry. In terms of employment, these companies account for more than 40 percent of total employment in the enterprise sector. In the Tirana-Durres area there is a higher concentration of private enterprises than in other regions, while the industry is mainly concentrated in Tirana. This new private sector, especially small and medium-sized enterprises, needs financial support to grow. So far, the banking sector has not been able to meet these needs. The situation is even more problematic because small private companies do not have much developed financial sectors. Also, these countries have difficulty entering international financial markets. I don't want you to misunderstand me about the role of the financial sector. The financial sector has taken considerable steps in Albania. Today, our financial sector includes many banking and non-bank financial institutions, savings-credit societies and their unions, insurance and reinsurance companies, pension funds. However, it should be noted that the development of financial sector institutions is more visible in the banking sector and in that of insurance. Currently, the banking system includes 16 operating institutions, with total wealth of about 53 percent of the country's GDP. The system is well capitalized and secular. His role of mediation is growing. Lending activity, although small (about 23 percent of total banking and about 12 percent of GDP), is growing rapidly. Other financial institutions are trying to increase and modernize their activity. However, many problems mainly related to legal and property rights, which are outside the financial sector, are making it difficult to expand their credit lines. Microfinance has proven to be a more effective way to solve these problems. With its original formulas, it makes financial resources accessible to small and medium-sized businesses, which make up the bulk of agregated production, during these development phases. These resources are often used to finance small projects in areas such as agriculture, agriculture or services such as crafts, small food, etc. The first microfinancial institutions in Albania were established in 1994, as development projects co-financed by the Albanian Government and the World Bank. 13 donors co-operate with the Albanian Government to support the development of small and medium-sized enterprises in Albania. Since 1992, Albania has benefited from a lot of funds as a donation, but only a fraction of them have been spent. Most of these funds are given as soft loans to the Albanian Government. Aid funds represent about 30 percent and only 5 percent are direct commercial loans for financing private investment. This type of financing, called "Development Projects", is mainly used to finance the credit needs of small and medium-sized enterprises, accompanied by technical assistance. Credit line funds are provided by donors as soft loans and the government places them in banks to be used as loans  ncen_Mesdhetare_Euro_mbi_Mikrokreditin_5-6_dhjetor_2005_Rome.html Page 2 of 5 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in ... Mediterranean Euro on Microcredit, 5 - 6 December 2005, Rome 29/07/22, 15:01 without harming banking practices and the use of the bank's own capital. Consequently, a large part of the financial sources of lending turn into commercial funds. Today, microfinancial institutions operate as independent institutions with an increasing number of clients. In the last 5-7 years some other institutions have focused on microfinancing. Currently, we have 133 individual savings societies organised in 2 unions, which operate in rural areas. The number of their members is about 18,000 and their loan stock is about 12m euros. In addition, we have 7 microfinancial institutions with total assets reaching the sum of 50m euros, and loans of 43m euros. Banks are also becoming more active in microfinance, despite their scarce interest in this direction. This can be explained by the narrowing of competition in the market and the need to explore new investment opportunities. Now, an increasing proportion of loans go to small businesses, which often helps them in the initial stages. Banks are particularly active in microfinancing in urban areas. In fact, one of the banks initially began operating as a microfinancial institution. It still occupies a considerable place in this segment of the market, especially in urban areas. Lending to the microfinancial sector already accounts for more than 10 percent of the banking system's entire lending portfolio. The quality of microfinancial loans has been satisfactory. Based on their reports, portfolio risk averages between 1.5-2 percent. This is not only because of their small sum (usually under 1.5 thousand euros each), but also because of the variety of projects, thus ensuring the diversity of the loan portfolio. It should also be stressed that an important role for this positive performance has also played the experience gained by microfinancial institutions in this area. The legal framework on microfinance ended in 1996, with the adoption of a separate law, which sets out the principles on which such institutions can be created and operated. These principles for specialized institutions included free will, mutual co-operation, capitalization of profit and reinvestment in the community, etc. Subsequent developments necessitated this law to change. For this reason, a new law "On savings-credit societies and their unions" was passed in Parliament in May 2001. This new law was supported by some changes. In addition to the principles which were reemphasized, the law has defined the legal personality of microfinancial institutions, their permitted activities, the rights and obligations of members of society, the managing structures of societies and their functions, other important supervisory financial requirements and reports, the role of unions and the Bank of Albania as regulatory and supervisory authority. Mandated by this role, the Bank of Albania has adopted several regulations, dealing with microfinancial institutions and their development. This regulatory framework includes supervisory requirements to start and operate a savings-credit society, indicators that enable their reporting and financial analyses, and principles on which inspection of such institutions is carried out in the country. Bank of Albania's regulation "On licensing savings-credit societies and their unions", is the first document issued by the Bank of Albania in this regard  ncen_Mesdhetare_Euro_mbi_Mikrokreditin_5-6_dhjetor_2005_Rome.html Page 3 of 5 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in ... Mediterranean Euro on Microcredit, 5 - 6 December 2005, Rome 29/07/22, 15:01 thus representing a major step towards formalizing these institutions. This regulation stipulates the requirements of documentation for the application of the grant of a license, deadlines and the authority that grants this license. These demands are addressed to separate societies, union and union member society. The role of representing the union's proposed member societies in the licensing process has been accepted, which serves as an important instrument to promote independent SHKKs to become members of the union. The number of unions is undoubtedly not limited. Another important regulation is the supervision of savings-credit societies and their unions. In this regulation, the Bank of Albania has defined the supervisory indicators for certain risk typology, which are characteristic of the current phase of development of financial institutions in Albania. The risk of the counterparty is controlled through requirements for a stable loan portfolio analysis process. These include ways of classifying loans, their procurement requirements, their possible individual and group guarantees, supervisory credit quality rates, etc. In addition, the risk of the counterparty is indirectly controlled by requirements on the sufficiency of the institution's capital. Other risks are also mentioned in the regulations, for the protection from which certain requirements are determined. As far as liquidity risk is concerned, different rates have been set for maintaining sufficient liquidity tools and limiting the duration of the loan. While in terms of concentration risk, the requirements of the regulation focus on lending activity and determine rates for net exposure compared to the institution's total tools. This regulatory framework aims to actively orient the activity of microfinancial institutions, and as such, it will be revised as needed by developments. In addition to these two regulations, the inspection manual for these institutions is also prepared. This manual is based on the CAMELS system, which we use for banks and aims to assess the sufficiency of internal policies and procedures, quality of management and identification, assessment and monitoring of risks. Also prepared is the Accounting Manual, which is based on national accounting standards, adapted for microfinancial activity. We think that the current regulatory framework, after some expected changes and its adoption, is properly monitoring microfinancial activity in Albania without simultaneously turning into an obstacle to its development. By accepting the role of microfinance as an important instrument for ensuring development opportunities for small businesses, which otherwise would not have the opportunity to benefit from financial resources, we must stress that microfinance will be healthy if it is provided by healthy institutions. If these institutions fail because of their soft attitude towards their internal rules and procedures, and/or because the supervisory authority has closed one eye because of their social role, then there certainly won't be many benefits from them. This would also make other institutions reluctant to engage in microfinance. The relationship between microfinancial institutions and the banking sector in terms of interaction in financing the economy is a very delicate issue. Their co-existence is undoubtedly "peaceful", in the early phase of the development of at least one of these groups of institutions, but as the economy grows and  ncen_Mesdhetare_Euro_mbi_Mikrokreditin_5-6_dhjetor_2005_Rome.html Page 4 of 5 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in ... Mediterranean Euro on Microcredit, 5 - 6 December 2005, Rome 29/07/22, 15:01 Competition is increased, they tend to be more directed in front of each other. At this stage, it is important to pay particular attention to determining the "clear rules of the game" for their activity and ensuring the right policies, which allow structural reforms in these institutions and on their impact on the market. In conclusion, I would like to stress that microfinance is a very important means of achieving balanced economic growth, providing financial support to small and medium-sized businesses, vital to medium and long-term economic growth. Compared to some other countries in the region, microfinances in Albania have shown higher rates of good quality growth. However, there are enough spaces to develop them further. Maintaining a stable macroeconomic environment, and improving the level for a better law and rules, property rights and free competition, are all very important factors, which will improve business financing in Albania. As supervisory authority, we will work hard towards sustainable growth in microfinance. The credit office project, which our bank will soon undertake, is also expected to increase lending through improved information problems. Thank you for your attention.  ncen_Mesdhetare_Euro_mbi_Mikrokreditin_5-6_dhjetor_2005_Rome.html Page 5 of 5

Ndihem i lumtur q marr pjes n Konferencn Mesdhetare Euro mbi Mikrokreditin, nj ngjarje e rndsishme, e cila lidhet me shpalljen e vitit 2005 nga Kombet e Bashkuara si "Viti ndrkombtar i mikrokreditit". Zakonisht, autoritetet e nj vendi kan pr synim arritjen e nj rritjeje t qndrueshme ekonomike n nj mjedis joinflacionist. Idealisht, n nj treg t lir, kapitali do t shkoj tek ato oportunitete, t cilat prfaqsojn investimet m efikase dhe m fitimprurse. Por, n nj vend n zhvillim, tregjet kan disa t meta dhe probleme dhe kapitali mund t keqshprndahet lehtsisht. Ai mund t shkoj n ato oportunitete investimesh, t cilat sigurojn rendiment t shpejt, t lart por t rrezikshm, por edhe n siprmarrje t tjera me frytshmri t ult e t cilat jan pothuajse t sigurta. Gjithsesi, kjo mnyr sjelljeje mund t jet problematike pr rritjen e ardhme ekonomike t vendit. Shum sektor me mundsi t mdha rritjeje afatgjat mund t lihen t pashfrytzuar. Kjo nnkupton q disa fusha t ekonomis do t lulzojn, ndrkoh q t tjerat do t mbeten mjaft prapa duke uar n nj zhvillim ekonomik tepr t pabalancuar. Gjithashtu, grupe t ndryshme t popullsis, veanrisht ato me t ardhura t ulta, ka shum t ngjar q t prjashtohen nga oportunitetet financiare duke shtuar gjasat e rritjes s varfris s tyre. Pr rrjedhoj, mund t lindin probleme sociale, si pr shembull, humbja e puns, lvizje t lira t popullsis dhe biznese t paligjshme etj., t cilat do t'i detyrojn shrbimet publike q t prballen me kt situat. Prandaj, sht e rndsishme q t gjenden rrug pr t siguruar oportunitete m t balancuara zhvillimi pr t gjith sektort e ekonomis dhe grupet e popullsis. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fncen_Mesdhetare_Euro_mbi_Mikrokreditin_5-6_dhjetor_2005_Rome.html Pagina 1 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Ardian Fullani, n erencn Mesdhetare Euro mbi Mikrokreditin, 5 - 6 dhjetor 2005, Rom 29/07/22, 15:01 Prgjithsisht, ekonomia shqiptare mbshtetet n mikrobiznesin. Pothuajse t gjitha ndrmarrjet n Shqipri bjn pjes n kategorin e ndrmarrjeve t vogla dhe t mesme. Sipas t dhnave t INSTAT-it, m shum se 90 pr qind e ndrmarrjeve shqiptare mund t klasifikohen si ndrmarrje t vogla dhe t mesme. Pjesa m e madhe e ktyre kompanive jan t angazhuara n tregti dhe shrbime, duke reflektuar natyrn e tyre t biznesit mikro, dhe m pak n industri. Prsa i prket punsimit, kto ndrmarrje llogarisin m shum se 40 pr qind t punsimit gjithsej n sektorin e ndrmarrjeve. N zonn Tiran-Durrs ka nj prqendrim m t lart t ndrmarrjeve private sesa n rajonet e tjera, ndrkoh q industria sht kryesisht e prqendruar n Elbasan. Ky sektor i ri privat, veanrisht ndrmarrjet e vogla dhe t mesme, ka nevoj pr mbshtetje financiare pr t'u rritur. Deri tani, sektori bankar nuk ka qen i aft t'i prmbush kto nevoja. Gjendja sht akoma m tepr problematike sepse ndrmarrjet e vogla private nuk kan sektor financiar shum t zhvilluar. Gjithashtu, kto vende kan vshtirsi pr t hyr n tregjet financiare ndrkombtare. Nuk dua t m keqkuptoni pr rolin e sektorit financiar. Sektori financiar ka br hapa t konsiderueshm n Shqipri. Sot, sektori yn financiar prfshin shum institucione financiare bankare dhe jobankare, shoqri t kursim-kreditit dhe unionet e tyre, kompani t sigurimit dhe t risigurimit, fonde pensionesh. Megjithat, duhet t theksohet se zhvillimi i institucioneve t sektorit financiar sht m tepr i dukshm n sektorin bankar dhe n at t sigurimeve. Aktualisht, sistemi bankar prfshin 16 institucione operuese, me asete totale rreth 53 pr qind t PBB-s s vendit. Sistemi sht i mirkapitalizuar dhe likuid. Roli i tij i ndrmjetsimit po rritet. Aktiviteti i kredidhnies, edhe pse i vogl (rreth 23 pr qind t aseteve bankare gjithsej dhe rreth 12 pr qind t PBB-s), po rritet me shpejtsi. Institucionet e tjera financiare po prpiqen t rrisin dhe t modernizojn aktivitetin e tyre. Megjithat, shum probleme t lidhura kryesisht me t drejtat ligjore dhe pronsore, t cilat jan jasht sektorit financiar, po vshtirsojn zgjerimin e linjave t tyre t kreditit. Mikrofinanca ka provuar t jet nj mnyr m efektive pr t'i zgjidhur kto probleme. Me formulat e saj origjinale, ajo bn q burimet financiare t jen t arritshme pr bizneset e vogla dhe t mesme, t cilat prbjn pjesn m t madhe t prodhimit t agreguar, gjat ktyre fazave t zhvillimit. Kto burime shpesh prdoren pr t financuar projekte t vogla n fusha t tilla, si bujqsi, blegtori apo shrbime si artizanat, ushqimore t vogla etj.. Institucionet e para mikrofinanciare n Shqipri u krijuan n vitin 1994, si projekte zhvillimi t bashkfinancuara nga Qeveria Shqiptare dhe Banka Botrore. 13 donator bashkpunojn m Qeverin Shqiptare pr t mbshtetur zhvillimin e ndrmarrjeve t vogla e t mesme n Shqipri. Q nga viti 1992, Shqipria ka prfituar mjaft fonde si donacion, por vetm nj pjes e tyre sht shpenzuar. Pjesa m e madhe e ktyre fondeve jan dhn si kredi t buta pr Qeverin Shqiptare. Fondet ndihma prfaqsojn rreth 30 pr qind dhe vetm 5 pr qind jan kredi direkte tregtare pr financimin e investimit privat. Ky lloj financimi, i quajtur "Projekte pr Zhvillim", prdoret kryesisht pr t financuar nevojat pr kredi t ndrmarrjeve t vogla dhe t mesme, shoqruar kjo me asistenc teknike. Fondet e linjave t kreditit jepen nga donatort si hua t buta dhe qeveria i vendos ato n banka pr t'u prdorur si hua https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fncen_Mesdhetare_Euro_mbi_Mikrokreditin_5-6_dhjetor_2005_Rome.html Pagina 2 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Ardian Fullani, n erencn Mesdhetare Euro mbi Mikrokreditin, 5 - 6 dhjetor 2005, Rom 29/07/22, 15:01 tregtare, pa dmtuar praktikat bankare dhe prdorimin e kapitalit t vet banks. Pr rrjedhoj, nj pjes e madhe e burimeve financiare t kreditimit kthehet n fonde tregtare. Sot, institucionet mikrofinanciare operojn si institucione t pavarura me nj numr klientsh gjithnj e n rritje. N 5-7 vitet e fundit disa institucione t tjera jan prqendruar n mikrofinancimin. Aktualisht, ne kemi 133 shoqri individuale t kursimkreditit t organizuara n 2 unione, t cilat operojn n zonat rurale. Numri i antarve t tyre sht rreth 18 mij dhe stoku i kredis s tyre rreth 12 milion euro. Prve ksaj, kemi 7 institucione mikrofinanciare me asete totale q arrijn shumn e 50 milion eurove, dhe kredi prej 43 milion eurosh. Bankat gjithashtu, po bhen m tepr aktive n mikrofinancim, pavarsisht nga interesi i tyre i pakt n kt drejtim. Kjo mund t shpjegohet nga ngushtimi i konkurrencs n treg dhe nga nevoja pr t eksploruar mundsi t reja investimi. Tani, nj pjes gjithnj e m t madhe e kredive shkon pr bizneset e vogla, gj e cila shpesh i ndihmon ato n fazat fillestare. Bankat jan veanrisht aktive n mikrofinancimin n zonat urbane. N fakt, nj nga bankat fillimisht ka filluar t operoj si nj institucion mikrofinanciar. Ajo ende z nj vend t konsiderueshm n kt segment t tregut, veanrisht n zonat urbane. Kredidhnia ndaj sektorit mikrofinanciar tashm llogaritet n m shum se 10 pr qind t t gjith portofolit t kredidhnies t sistemit bankar. Cilsia e kredive mikrofinanciare ka qen e knaqshme. N baz t raporteve t tyre, rreziku i portofolit sht mesatarisht ndrmjet 1.5-2 pr qind. Kjo nuk sht vetm pr shkak t shums s vogl t tyre (zakonisht nn 1.5 mij euro secila), por gjithashtu pr shkak t shumllojshmris s projekteve, duke siguruar kshtu diversitetin e portofolit t kredive. Duhet theksuar gjithashtu, se nj rol t rndsishm pr kt ecuri pozitive ka luajtur edhe prvoja e fituar nga institucionet mikrofinanciare n kt fush. Korniza ligjore mbi mikrofinancn prfundoi n vitin 1996, me miratimin e nj ligji t veant, i cili prcakton parimet mbi t cilat mund t krijohen dhe t operojn institucione t tilla. Kto parime pr institucionet e specializuara prfshinin vullnetin e lir, bashkpunimin reciprok, kapitalizimin e fitimit e riinvestimin n komunitet etj.. Zhvillimet e mvonshme bn t nevojshme q ky ligj t ndryshonte. Pr kt arsye, nj ligj i ri "Mbi shoqrit e kursim-kreditit dhe unionet e tyre" u miratua n Parlament n maj t vitit 2001. Ky ligj i ri u mbshtet nga disa ndryshime. Krahas parimeve t cilat u ritheksuan, ligji ka prcaktuar personalitetin ligjor t institucioneve mikrofinanciare, aktivitetet e tyre t lejuara, t drejtat dhe detyrimet e antarve t shoqris, strukturat administruese t shoqrive dhe funksionet e tyre, krkesa t tjera t rndsishme financiare mbikqyrse dhe raportet, rolin e unioneve dhe t Banks s Shqipris si autoriteti rregullator dhe mbikqyrs. E mandatuar me kt rol, Banka e Shqipris ka miratuar disa rregullore, q kan t bjn me institucionet mikrofinanciare dhe me zhvillimin e tyre. Kjo korniz rregullatore prfshin krkesat mbikqyrse pr t filluar dhe operuar nj shoqri kursim-krediti, treguesit q mundsojn raportimin dhe analizat e tyre financiare, dhe parimet mbi t cilat kryhet inspektimi n vend i institucioneve t tilla. Rregullorja e Banks s Shqipris "Mbi licencimin e shoqrive t kursim-kreditit dhe unionet e tyre", sht dokumenti i par nxjerr nga Banka e Shqipris lidhur me kt https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fncen_Mesdhetare_Euro_mbi_Mikrokreditin_5-6_dhjetor_2005_Rome.html Pagina 3 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Ardian Fullani, n erencn Mesdhetare Euro mbi Mikrokreditin, 5 - 6 dhjetor 2005, Rom 29/07/22, 15:01 shtje, duke prfaqsuar kshtu nj hap t madh drejt formalizimit t ktyre institucioneve. Kjo rregullore prcakton krkesat e dokumentacionit pr aplikimin e dhnies s licencs, afatet dhe autoritetin q e jep kt licenc. Kto krkesa iu drejtohen shoqrive t veanta, unionit dhe shoqris antare t unionit. sht pranuar roli i prfaqsimit t shoqrive antare t propozuara t unionit n procesin e licencimit, gj e cila shrben si nj instrument i rndsishm pr t nxitur SHKK-t e pavarura q t bhen antare t unionit. Numri i unioneve pa dyshim nuk sht i kufizuar. Nj rregullore tjetr e rndsishme sht edhe ajo mbi "Mbikqyrjen e shoqrive t kursim-kreditit dhe unionet e tyre". N kt rregullore, Banka e Shqipris ka prcaktuar treguesit mbikqyrs pr tipologji t caktuara t rrezikut, t cilat jan karakteristike pr fazn aktuale t zhvillimit t institucioneve financiare n Shqipri. Rreziku i kundrpartis kontrollohet prmes krkesave pr nj proces t qndrueshm t analizs s portofolit t kredis. Kto prfshijn mnyrat e klasifikimit t kredive, krkesat e tyre t provigjonimit, garancit e tyre t mundshme individuale dhe t grupit, normat mbikqyrse t cilsis s kredis etj.. Prve ksaj, rreziku i kundrpartis kontrollohet n mnyr indirekte nga krkesat mbi mjaftueshmrin e kapitalit t institucionit. N rregullore prmenden gjithashtu rreziqe t tjera, pr mbrojtjen nga t cilat prcaktohen krkesa t caktuara. Prsa i prket rrezikut t likuiditetit, jan prcaktuar norma t ndryshme pr mbajtjen e mjeteve t mjaftueshme likuide dhe kufizimin e kohzgjatjes s kredis. Ndrsa lidhur me rrezikun e prqendrimit, krkesat e rregullores fokusohen n aktivitetin e kredidhnies dhe prcaktojn normat pr ekspozimin neto krahasuar me mjetet gjithsej t institucionit. Kjo korniz rregullatore ka pr qllim q t orientoj n mnyr aktive aktivitetin e institucioneve mikrofinanciare, dhe si e till, ajo do t rishikohet sipas nevojs s zhvillimeve. Krahas ktyre dy rregulloreve, sht prgatitur edhe manuali i inspektimit t ktyre institucioneve. Ky manual bazohet n sistemin CAMELS, q ne prdorim pr bankat dhe ka pr qllim vlersimin e mjaftueshmris s politikave dhe procedurave t brendshme, cilsin e administrimit dhe identifikimin, vlersimin dhe monitorimin e rreziqeve. Gjithashtu, sht prgatitur Manuali i Kontabilitetit, i cili sht bazuar n standardet kombtare t kontabilitetit, t prshtatura pr aktivitetin mikrofinanciar. Ne mendojm q korniza aktuale rregullatore, pas disa ndryshimeve t pritshme dhe miratimit t saj, sht duke monitoruar si duhet aktivitetin mikrofinanciar n Shqipri pa u kthyer njkohsisht n nj penges pr zhvillimin e tij. Duke pranuar rolin e mikrofinancs si nj instrument t rndsishm pr sigurimin e oportuniteteve t zhvillimit pr bizneset e vogla, t cilat ndryshe nuk do t kishin mundsi prfitimi nga burimet financiare, duhet t theksojm q mikrofinanca do t jet e shndetshme nse ajo sigurohet nga institucione t shndetshme. Nse kto institucione do t dshtojn pr shkak t qndrimit t but ndaj rregullave dhe procedurave t tyre t brendshme, dhe/ose sepse autoriteti mbikqyrs ka mbyllur njrin sy pr shkak t rolit t tyre social, ather sigurisht q nuk do t ket shum prfitime prej tyre. Kjo gjithashtu, do t'i bnte institucionet e tjera t ngurronin pr t'u angazhuar n mikrofinancim. Marrdhnia ndrmjet institucioneve mikrofinanciare dhe sektorit bankar n aspektin e bashkveprimit n financimin e ekonomis, sht nj shtje tepr delikate. Bashkekzistenca e tyre sht pa dyshim "paqsore", n fazn e hershme t zhvillimit t t paktn nj prej ktyre grupeve t institucioneve, por ndrsa ekonomia rritet dhe https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fncen_Mesdhetare_Euro_mbi_Mikrokreditin_5-6_dhjetor_2005_Rome.html Pagina 4 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Ardian Fullani, n erencn Mesdhetare Euro mbi Mikrokreditin, 5 - 6 dhjetor 2005, Rom 29/07/22, 15:01 konkurrenca shtohet, ato kan tendencn q t drejtohen m shum prball njratjetrs. N kt faz, sht e rndsishme q t'i kushtohet nj vmendje e veant prcaktimit t "rregullave t qart t lojs" pr aktivitetin e tyre dhe sigurimit t politikave t duhura, t cilat lejojn reforma strukturore n kto institucione dhe n ndikimin e tyre n treg. N prfundim, do t doja t theksoja se mikrofinanca sht nj mjet shum i rndsishm pr t arritur nj rritje t balancuar ekonomike, duke u siguruar mbshtetje financiare bizneseve t vogla dhe t mesme, jetsore pr rritjen ekonomike afatmesme dhe afatgjat. Krahasuar me disa vende t tjera n rajon, mikrofinancat n Shqipri kan shfaqur norma m t larta rritjeje me cilsi t mir. Megjithat, ka hapsira t mjaftueshme pr t'i zhvilluar ato m tej. Mbajtja e nj mjedisi t qndrueshm makroekonomik, dhe prmirsimi i nivelit pr nj ligj dhe rregulla m t mir, t drejta pronsore dhe konkurrenc e lir, jan t gjith faktor shum t rndsishm, t cilt do t prmirsojn financimin e biznesit n Shqipri. Si autoritet mbikqyrs, ne do t punojm shum n drejtim t rritjes s qndrueshme t mikrofinancave. Projekti i zyrs s kreditit, q banka jon do t ndrmarr s shpejti, pritet gjithashtu q t rris kreditimin prmes prmirsimit t problemeve t informacionit. Ju faleminderit pr vmendjen tuaj. text: , Mr. Ardian Fullani in k... under the signing of the new agreement with the IMF, 30 January 2006 29/07/22, 15:01 , Mr. Ardian Fullani at the press conference organized within the framework of the signing of the new agreement with the IMF, January 30, 2006 Publication date: 30.01.2006 The Bank of Albania estimates that reaching the new 3-year agreement with the International Monetary Fund represents an important moment in the country's further economic and financial development. The new support the IMF is giving Albania is at the same time a responsibility for responsible institutions that are committed to successfully fulfilling the obligations derived from it, institutions where the Bank of Albania is a part. In this context, on behalf of the institution I lead, I wish to stress that the Bank of Albania will fulfil its obligations with maximum seriousness and commitment. This commitment of ours also stems from the full belief that the agenda of proposed structural reforms and the anticipated trajectory of macroeconomic policies constitute the right answer to the challenges that the Albanian economy has. The importance of the agreement is great as it: First, it clearly contoures the main directions of where the work of our institutions will be concentrated in the next three years, creating a safe bed on the difficult path of further macroeconomic consolidation of the country, economic growth and poverty reduction. Second, it sets clear targets for necessary structural reforms that need to be undertaken in the short and medium-term period, identifying responsible institutions and concrete deadlines for their materialisation. ... er_te_nenshkrimit_te_marreveshjes_se_re_me_FMN_30_ janar_2006.html Page 1 of 2 , Mr. Ardian Fullani in k... under the signing of the new agreement with the IMF, 30 January 2006 29/07/22, 15:01 Third, it creates the premise for more financial discipline and better coordination at all decision-making levels, thus turning into a guarantee factor for local and foreign investors, including important international bodies. To this end, we have taken the appropriate measures to incorporate into the monetary policy strategy and monetary programme of the Bank of Albania, all the basic conditionality and indicators that we have previously agreed to with the IMF Mission, led by Mr Szekely. By closing this brief statement I would add once again that the adoption of this agreement has another particular importance, as at its conclusion if everything goes according to forecast, the movement of the Albanian economy "with its feet" is enabled. To this end, it is important that we start thinking now about the future of the country's basic economic policies after the end of this agreement. Taking advantage of the case, I would like to stress that we are working in this direction and in co-operation and with the assistance of the IMF and other central banks, we have intensified efforts to build appropriate monetary strategies, which will enable control of inflationary pressures and orient the country's sustainable development towards European integration. N kt kontekst, n emr t institucionit q un drejtoj, dshiroj t theksoj se Banka e Shqipris do t prmbush detyrimet e saj me seriozitet dhe angazhim maksimal. Ky angazhim i yni buron edhe nga bindja e plot se axhenda e reformave strukturore t propozuara dhe trajektorja e parashikuar e politikave makroekonomike, prbjn prgjigjen e duhur pr sfidat q ka ekonomia shqiptare. Rndsia e marrveshjes sht e madhe pasi ajo: S pari, konturon qart drejtimet kryesore se ku do t prqendrohet puna e institucioneve tona n tre vitet e ardhshme, duke krijuar nj shtrat t sigurt n rrugn e vshtir t konsolidimit t mtejshm makroekonomik t vendit, t rritjes ekonomike dhe t reduktimit t varfris. S dyti, vendos objektiva t qart pr reformat e nevojshme strukturore q duhen ndrmarr n periudhn afatshkurtr dhe at afatmesme, duke identifikuar institucionet prgjegjse dhe afatet konkrete pr materializimin e tyre. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fer_te_nenshkrimit_te_marreveshjes_se_re_me_FMN_30_ janar_2006.html Pagina 1 di 2 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Pr kt qllim, kemi marr masat e duhura pr t mishruar n strategjin e politiks monetare dhe programin monetar t Banks s Shqipris, t gjitha kushtzimet dhe treguesit baz pr t cilat paraprakisht kemi rn dakord me Misionin e FMN-s, t kryesuar nga zoti Szekely. Duke mbyllur kt prononcim t shkurtr do t shtoja edhe nj her se miratimi i ksaj marrveshjeje ka dhe nj rndsi tjetr t veant, pasi n prfundim t saj n qoft se do gj shkon sipas parashikimit, mundsohet lvizja e ekonomis shqiptare "me kmbt e veta". Pr kt qllim, sht e rndsishme q t fillojm t mendojm q tani pr ardhmrin e politikave baz ekonomike t vendit pas skadimit t ksaj marrveshjeje. Duke prfituar nga rasti, dshiroj t theksoj se ne po punojm n kt drejtim dhe n bashkpunim dhe me asistencn e FMN-s dhe t bankave t tjera qendrore, kemi intensifikuar prpjekjet pr ndrtimin e strategjive t duhura monetare, t cilat do t mundsojn kontrollin e presioneve inflacioniste dhe do t orientojn zhvillimin e qndrueshm t vendit drejt integrimit evropian. Title: Speech in the meeting with the business community, local government, academic circles, etc .., of the Prefecture of Gjirokastra
text: , Mr. Ardian Fullani in them... bank it and academics of the University of Kumanovo, February 17, 2006 29/07/22, 15:01 , Mr. Ardian Fullani at the meeting with the business community, representatives of the local government, banking sector and academics of the University of Kumanovo, February 17, 2006 Publication date: 17.02.2006 The real goal of our arrival here is multiple and first and foremost is in line with our vision for approximating the Bank of Albania with the international standards and best practices of the central bank. This makes sense not only with the needs for increasing our human capacities, but also with the need to increase the bank of Albania's monitoring and presence of expertise in all regions of the country. I believe that this annual meeting of the Governor of the Bank of Albania with its branches and with the most prominent communities of the region, where we exercise our activity has turned into a tradition, aimed not only at highlighting our operational problems, but also identifying and providing advice for as proportionate and harmonized development of the country's various geographical regions. During 2005, we as an important institution in the area of economic policy making and ensuring the country's financial stability multiplied our efforts for better inflation control, believing that this contribution is of vital importance for the performance of economic activity in general, including that of your region. On the other hand, we have tried to further consolidate macro balances in the economy to accompany it with a financially stabilized banking system, so that it is able to finance the country's economic development more and more.  kar_dhe_akademiket_e_Universitetit_te_Shkodres_17_shkurt_2006.html Page 1 of 6 , Mr. Ardian Fullani in them... bank it and academics of the University of Kumanovo, February 17, 2006 29/07/22, 15:01 We see and touch the albanian business, grow and integrate with the banking system, and this fact makes me feel optimistic about the future. This interest in banking business to extend to your region, I think reflects the specific developments that this region has, in relation to other areas of the country. I am personally of the opinion that this region has great economic potential, and furthermore I stress that this region is of the few that has a multisectoral potential, including agricultural potential. Likewise, I consider that cross-border relations are also a good opportunity for its intensive development and by generalising how much I said above, I would encourage the banking system to be more aggressive in this region, with concrete plans and objectives to support your economy. No matter how much I said above, we as the Bank of Albania are aware that the process of growing and consolidating the banking system is a permanent challenge. To this end, in our work programmes for 2006 we have included other concrete steps that will contribute to this direction. More specifically, we are ideating and implementing new measures, which will increase the activity of the banking system not only in the direction of mobilizing free funds in the form of deposits, but will make it more active in allocating funds to the economy, in the most effective management of free funds, in better managing the risks that accompany the investment of funds, in increasing competition to minimise costs and flow, the commissions that banks apply, in creating other amenities to help the system in providing loans, further perfecting the payment system by aiming at further reducing cash money, including appropriate legal and regulatory improvements, related to the day-to-day activity of the banking system. I want to assure you that for us, the sustainability of the banking system is taking on an increasing importance. To this end, we are committed to meticulously implementing all the recommendations left by the IMF's Financial Sector Assessment (FSAP) report during 2005, the imposition of which would significantly increase the efficacy and security of the banking and financial system, in a broader context. I want to stress that the Bank of Albania, as the supervisory authority of commercial banks, feels it is incumbent on it to draw attention that the large increase in the volume of loans during 2005, as well as further growth over the following years, should be accompanied by effective measures for increasing the monitoring, analyzing and controlling capacities of banks themselves to avoid deteriorating the loan portfolio. On the other hand, we will strengthen our supervisory capacities, especially inspection in the country by building measures plans, which will aim for careful control for any member bank of the system. Of course, our idea of inviting the business community to our meetings is not new. In our philosophy we think that business is an important partner, which with its decisions and behaviour affects the success of our policies but also in a sustainable and harmonious development of the banking system. In this context, I want to present some thesis, none of which I have mentioned in other cases, but which, thanks to current developments and perspective, I see instead of re-emphasising them again.  kar_dhe_akademiket_e_Universitetit_te_Shkodres_17_shkurt_2006.html Page 2 of 6 , Mr. Ardian Fullani in them... bank it and academics of the University of Kumanovo, February 17, 2006 29/07/22, 15:01 A first issue, which I would like to share with you, concerns the role of the Bank of Albania branch in the region where it operates. The role of the Bank of Albania branch should be different from what we are used to seeing. We took a first step in this direction during 2005, when after numerous efforts and meetings, we managed to harvest through a specific questionnaire some data on the economy of your region. However, my philosophy for the Bank of Albania branch is a little more advanced why not, much more ambitious. I do not want to hide my point of turning bank of Albania branches into powerful and professional centres for the region's collection, processing and economic-financial analysis. I think the Bank of Albania branch should be open to co-operation with various interest groups, doing its best to make sure that in this "vortex" of analyses and studies to include the intellectual elite of the region, where certainly at the forefront will be local academic circles. However, by passing this way and in my second case, how can our branch play such a role if it does not possess the right information for this purpose? Information on the latest economic markets and developments can be considered the key to success for businesses in modern times of rapid technology and information developments. Although at first glance it may not seem the most acute problem that Albanian businesses are currently facing, not too far away from now will the need for real-time market recognition and analysis - fresh information - arise to face the challenges of globalization. Seen in a broader respect, a country's economy cannot be competitive on the international plain if development policies rely on a weak real information base. For the Bank of Albania, information on the latest economic developments and expectations is irreplaceable for monetary policy decision-making. It has long become clear that the process of preserving price stability - our main objective - is a process that must look at money in time. With the current state of national statistics, which come up with delays sometimes and up to two years, it is understood that our task becomes quite difficult. While reforms in the field of statistics as in many other areas are underway, the results may take time to be realized. On the other hand, our decisions must be based as soundly as possible. In this information gap, one of the solutions used by us is to survey various economic agents. For nearly four years, the Bank of Albania has begun assessing the confidence indexes of businesses and consumers. These surveys, which take place every quarter with the help of INSTAT, include over 600 businesses in the manufacturing, construction and services sectors, and 1,500 consumers. The information collected relates to the performance of prices, consumption, income, production, employment, investments and many other indicators that help us greatly in monetary policy decision-making. The results of our surveys for the year we left behind testify to a good performance of the economy supported by strong demand, reflected in improved production, investment and employment. These results are also confirmed by real data on  kar_dhe_akademiket_e_Universitetit_te_Shkodres_17_shkurt_2006.html Page 3 of 6 , Mr. Ardian Fullani in them... bank it and academics of the University of Kumanovo, February 17, 2006 29/07/22, 15:01 annual sales volume growth, rising number of employees, very rapid growth in economic lending and rising fiscal revenues. This economic growth has developed under the conditions of low inflation around our 3 percent target and budget deficit within scheduled values, not affecting the balances and key macroeconomic reports. Normal inflation performance has led the Bank of Albania to pursue a neutral monetary policy, leaving the basic interest rate unchanged at 5 per cent. Expectations for this year remain positive. We expect inflation to fluctuate within the interval we target 2-4 percent, while economic growth with improved energy situation appears to have returned to its normal trend. Although to date, the results of our questionnaires have been reflected indirectly in our periodic analyses and reports and in various bank studies, the bank soon considers starting regular publication of these results. Initially, we have considered holding several meetings like this today with businesses and academics in co-operation with chambers of commerce and universities, where we will be able to get suggestions on the validity of these questionnaires. Along the same line of improving the sources of economic information, another new initiative, undertaken by us more than a year ago, concerns the activation of bank of Albania branches, gathering and analyzing economic developments in different regions of Albania. So far, two surveys have been carried out which, despite the difficulties of the beginning, have yielded very interesting results, which we have brought to share with you today. The main goal of observing companies in districts is to collect quantitative data on the country's real economy, with quarterly periodicity. The questionnaire aims to receive as complete and continuous information as possible in time on the state of the labour market, price performance, production and business relations with banks. This information will be used to calculate some important indicators such as productivity, cost per unit of work, etc., which are often much needed in the research works of the Bank of Albania. Currently, these indicators are not offered by current official statistics. Another objective is to avoid problems arising from the time delay of official statistical data. Also, the information received is thought to be used to supplement quality information that is made from observing the tendency of business confidence. The periodic development of this observation by bank of Albania branches aims to increase its presence in districts. The direct involvement of branch employees in the interview process aims to exploit and their interpersonal recognitions with executives or company financiers. This will enable answers to some sensitive problems such as the informal labour market, tax evasion, profit, etc. Branch employees have been directly engaged in drafting lists of businesses, in areas where Bank of Albania branches operate, as well as in the process of interviewing them. Despite good efforts, it must be said that the difficulties have not been lacking. The main problems reported by branch employees have been: lack of co-operation on the part of firms to conduct the interview, difficulties in contacting  kar_dhe_akademiket_e_Universitetit_te_Shkodres_17_shkurt_2006.html Page 4 of 6 , Mr. Ardian Fullani in them... bank it and academics of the University of Kumanovo, February 17, 2006 29/07/22, 15:01 competent persons, lack of honesty in the figures stated, etc. I take the opportunity to raise awareness among businesses about the importance of these surveys, not only in macroeconomic terms but also at the company level. In this initiative, businesses will not simply be considered information givers but also users of final analyses, which would help them in better market recognition. Since participating businesses, the final results are distributed they may constitute valuable information for their plans for the future. As for the other difficulties that the branches have faced, especially in relation to the overload of the development of these interviews, since their main object is that operational, I have the opinion that an effective alternative to the costly expansion of branches with new structures, to cope with the burden of these surveys, may be to promote co-operation with local universities like that of Kumanovo. This would greatly facilitate the work of branches for gathering information and create opportunities for students to activate and familiarize with economic analyses. Here I would invite university participants to discuss the possibilities of co-operation in this direction. Moving on to other traditional Initiatives of the Bank of Albania, those on bank-business or consumer-banking-system relations, I would like to draw attention to some other business-bank co-operation opportunities. After the completion of the high-value payment system and that of the intersection of small-value payments, the Bank of Albania considers that the right infrastructure has been provided to channel all periodic payments for utilities through the banking system. On the other hand, the operation of this new system will significantly increase the speed of payments among bank users, an element whose lack has kept businesses away from banks. I take the opportunity to sensitize businesses about the advantages that accompany the functioning of this system, as, among other things, both systems together will help achieve international ATM and POS standards for population numbers. The challenge for the banking system and businesses, but also for the Bank of Albania remains the public's incentive to use them. To make this a reality i said above, I will encourage the banking system to be more active, which means that banks must go towards the population and businesses with clear and ready products, with fast and efficient services. Of course, steps in this direction will be more complex and natural, which some of them require interinstitutional interaction. The Bank of Albania is already leading the way towards widespread use of cards in Albania. Credit card service will not only contribute to reducing cash in the economy, but will also give a positive impact on lowering the informal economy. I think importantly for this meeting, it's the incentive I do to the banking system, to increase the level of services, wherever banks exercise their activity. Ardian Fullani n tait bankar dhe akademikt e Universitetit t Shkodrs, 17 shkurt 2006 29/07/22, 15:01 E shohim dhe e prekim biznesin shkodran, t rritet dhe t integrohet me sistemin bankar dhe ky fakt m bn t ndihem optimist pr t ardhmen. Ky interes i biznesit bankar pr t'u shtrir n rajonin tuaj, mendoj se pasqyron zhvillimet specifike q ky rajon ka, n raport me zona t tjera t vendit. Un personalisht jam i mendimit se ky rajon ka potencial t madh ekonomik, dhe pr m tepr theksoj se ky rajon sht nga t paktt q ka nj potencial shumsektorial, prfshir dhe at bujqsor. Po kshtu, gjykoj se edhe marrdhniet ndrkufitare jan nj oportunitet i mir pr zhvillimin intensiv t tij dhe duke prgjithsuar sa thash m sipr, do ta inkurajoja sistemin bankar q t jet m agresiv n kt rajon, me plane dhe objektiva konkret pr t mbshtetur ekonomin tuaj. Pavarsisht sa thash m sipr, ne si Bank e Shqipris jemi t ndrgjegjshm se procesi i rritjes dhe i konsolidimit t sistemit bankar sht nj sfid e prhershme. Pr kt qllim, n programet tona t puns pr vitin 2006 kemi prfshir hapa t tjer konkret q do t kontribuojn n kt drejtim. M konkretisht, jemi duke ideuar dhe vn n zbatim masa t reja, t cilat do t rrisin aktivitetin e sistemit bankar jo vetm n drejtim t mobilizimit t fondeve t lira n formn e depozitave, por do ta bjn at m aktiv n alokimin e fondeve n ekonomi, n administrimin m efektiv t fondeve t lira, n administrimin m t mir t rreziqeve q shoqrojn investimin e fondeve, n rritjen e konkurrencs pr t minimizuar kostot dhe pr rrjedhim, komisionet q bankat aplikojn, n krijimin e lehtsive t tjera pr t ndihmuar sistemin n dhnien e kredive, n prsosjen e mtejshme t sistemit t pagesave duke synuar paksimin e mtejshm t paras cash, prfshir dhe prmirsimet e duhura ligjore dhe rregullatore, q lidhen me veprimtarin e prditshme t sistemit bankar. Dua t'ju siguroj se pr ne, qndrueshmria e sistemit bankar po merr nj rndsi gjithnj e m t madhe. Pr kt qllim, ne jemi t angazhuar q t zbatojm me prpikmri t gjitha rekomandimet e lna nga raporti i Vlersimit t Sektorit Financiar (FSAP) t FMN-s gjat vitit 2005, vnia n jet e t cilave do t rriste ndjeshm eficiencn dhe sigurin e sistemit bankar dhe t atij financiar, n nj kontekst m t gjer. Dua t theksoj se Banka e Shqipris si autoriteti mbikqyrs i bankave tregtare, e ndien pr detyr t trheq vmendjen se rritja e madhe e vllimit t kredive gjat vitit 2005 si dhe rritja e mtejshme gjat viteve n vazhdim, duhet t shoqrohet me masa efektive pr rritjen e kapaciteteve monitoruese, analizuese dhe kontrolluese t vet bankave pr t shmangur prkeqsimin e portofolit t kredive. Nga ana tjetr, ne do t forcojm kapacitetet tona mbikqyrse, sidomos inspektimin n vend duke ndrtuar plane masash, t cilat do t synojn nj kontroll t kujdesshm pr do bank antare t sistemit. Sigurisht, ideja jon pr t ftuar n takimet tona komunitetin e biznesit nuk sht e re. N filozofin ton ne mendojm se biznesi sht nj partner i rndsishm, q me vendimet dhe sjelljen e tij ndikon n suksesin e politikave tona por gjithashtu, edhe n nj zhvillim t qndrueshm dhe harmonik t sistemit bankar. N kt kontekst, dshiroj t parashtroj disa teza, ndonjrn prej t cilave e kam prmendur edhe n raste t tjera, por t cilat, fal edhe zhvillimeve aktuale dhe t perspektivs, i shoh me vend q t'i ritheksoj prsri. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjakar_dhe_akademiket_e_Universitetit_te_Shkodres_17_shkurt_2006.html Pagina 2 di 6 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Ardian Fullani n tait bankar dhe akademikt e Universitetit t Shkodrs, 17 shkurt 2006 29/07/22, 15:01 Nj shtje e par, t ciln do t doja ta ndaja me ju, ka t bj me rolin e degs s Banks s Shqipris n rajonin ku ajo vepron. Roli i degs s Banks s Shqipris duhet t jet i ndryshm nga ai q ne jemi msuar t shohim. Nj hap t par n kt drejtim e kemi hedhur gjat vitit 2005, kur pas prpjekjesh dhe takimesh t shumta, arritm t vjelim nprmjet nj pyetsori specifik disa t dhna mbi ekonomin e rajonit tuaj. Megjithat, filozofia ime pr degn e Banks s Shqipris sht pak m avangarde pse jo, shum m ambicioze. Nuk dua ta fsheh piksynimin tim pr shndrrimin e degve t Banks s Shqipris n qendra t fuqishme dhe profesionale t grumbullimit, t prpunimit dhe t analizs ekonomiko - financiare t rajonit. Mendoj se dega e Banks s Shqipris duhet t jet e hapur pr bashkpunim me grupe t ndryshme interesi, duke br mos q n kt "vorbull" analizash dhe studimesh t prfshij elitn intelektuale t rajonit, ku sigurisht n pararoj do t jen qarqet akademike vendore. Megjithat, duke kaluar n kt mnyr dhe n shtjen time t dyt, si mund ta luaj nj rol t till dega jon nse ajo nuk zotron informacionin e duhur pr kt qllim? Informacioni mbi tregjet dhe zhvillimet m t fundit ekonomike, mund t konsiderohet si elsi i suksesit pr bizneset n koht moderne t zhvillimeve t vrullshme t teknologjis dhe informacionit. Megjithse n pamje t par mund t mos duket problemi m akut q bizneset shqiptare po hasin aktualisht, jo shum larg prej tani do t lind nevoja e njohjes dhe e analizave t tregut n koh reale- informacion i freskt, pr t'u prballur me sfidat e globalizimit. Par n nj aspekt m t gjer, ekonomia e nj vendi nuk mund t arrij t jet konkurruese n rrafshin ndrkombtar, nse politikat e zhvillimit mbshteten n nj baz t dobt informacioni real. Pr Bankn e Shqipris, informacioni mbi zhvillimet m t fundit ekonomike dhe pritshmrit sht i pazvendsueshm pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare. Prej kohsh sht br e qart, q procesi i ruajtjes s stabilitetit t mimeve - objektivit ton kryesor - sht nj proces q duhet t shikoj ppara n koh. Me gjendjen aktuale t statistikave kombtare, t cilat dalin me vonesa ndonjher dhe deri n dy vjet, kuptohet q detyra jon bhet mjaft e vshtir. Ndrkoh q reformat n fushn e statistikave si n shum fusha t tjera jan n proces, rezultatet mund t duan koh t realizohen. Nga ana tjetr, vendimet tona duhet t mbshteten mbi baza sa m t shndosha. N kt "boshllk" informacioni, nj prej zgjidhjeve t prdorura prej nesh sht anketimi i agjentve t ndryshm ekonomik. Prej gati katr vjetsh, Banka e Shqipris ka filluar vlersimin e indekseve t besimit t bizneseve dhe t konsumatorve. Kto anketime q bhen do tremujor me ndihmn e INSTAT-it, prfshijn mbi 600 biznese t sektorve t prodhimit, t ndrtimit dhe t shrbimeve, dhe 1500 konsumator. Informacioni i mbledhur lidhet me ecurin e mimeve, t konsumit, t t ardhurave, t prodhimit, t punsimit, t investimeve e t shum treguesve t tjer t cilt na ndihmojn mjaft n vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare. Rezultatet e anketimeve tona pr vitin q lam pas, dshmojn pr nj ecuri t mir t ekonomis mbshtetur nga nj krkes e fort, reflektuar n prmirsim t prodhimit, investimeve dhe punsimit. N kt iniciativ, bizneset nuk do t konsiderohen thjesht dhns informacioni por dhe prdorues t analizave finale, q do t'i ndihmonin ata n njohjen m t mir t tregut. Duke qen se bizneseve pjesmarrse, rezultatet finale iu shprndahen ato mund t prbjn nj informacion me vler pr planet e tyre pr t ardhmen. Ktu do t ftoja pjesmarrsit nga universiteti t diskutojm pr mundsit e bashkpunimit n kt drejtim. Duke kaluar n iniciativat e tjera tradicionale t Banks s Shqipris, ato mbi marrdhniet bank-biznes apo konsumator-sistem bankar, do t doja t trhiqja vmendjen n disa oportunitete t tjera t bashkpunimit biznes- bank. Pas prfundimit t sistemit t pagesave n vler t madhe dhe t atij t kryqzimit t pagesave n vler t vogl, Banka e Shqipris gjykon se sht siguruar infrastruktura e duhur pr t kanalizuar t gjitha pagesat periodike pr shrbimet utilitare nprmjet sistemit bankar. Nga ana tjetr, funksionimi i ktij sistemi t ri do t rris ndjeshm shpejtsin e pagesave midis prdoruesve t bankave, nj element mungesa e t cilit i ka mbajtur larg bizneset prej bankave. Prfitoj nga rasti pr t sensibilizuar bizneset pr avantazhet q shoqrojn funksionimin e ktij sistemi, pasi ndrmjet t tjerash, t dyja sistemet s bashku do t ndihmojn arritjen e standardeve ndrkombtare t ATM dhe POS pr numr popullsie. Sfida pr sistemin bankar dhe bizneset, por dhe pr Bankn e Shqipris mbetet nxitja e publikut n prdorimin e tyre. Pr ta br realitet kt q thash m sipr, do t nxis sistemin bankar q t jet m aktiv, q do t thot se bankat duhet t shkojn drejt popullsis dhe bizneseve me produkte t qarta dhe t gatshme, me shrbime t shpejta dhe efikase. Sigurisht q hapat n kt drejtim do t jen m kompleks dhe natyrshm, q disa prej tyre krkojn dhe bashkveprim ndrinstitucional. Banka e Shqipris tashm po shtron rrugn drejt prdorimit t gjer t kartave n Shqipri. Shrbimi me karta krediti, jo vetm q do t kontribuoj n reduktimin e cash-it n ekonomi por do t jap nj ndikim pozitiv edhe n uljen e ekonomis informale. Mendoj q e rndsishme pr kt takim, sht nxitja q i bj sistemit bankar, pr t rritur nivelin e shrbimeve, kudo ku bankat ushtrojn veprimtarin e tyre. text: 05/08/22, 16:51 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in the first lecture of the Bank's Public Lecture Series ... , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in the first lecture of the Public Lecture Series of the Bank of Albania Publication date: 23.03.2006 Honoured ladies and gentlemen, it is a special pleasure that I find before you today, on the occasion of the first lecture of the Bank of  1/3 05/08/22, 16:51 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in the first lecture of the Bank's Public Lecture Series ... Albania, part of a series of public lectures that our institution aims to carry out during this year. I take this opportunity to thank the GTZ Office in Tirana as well as Prof. Michael Bolle and Prof. Helge Berger for their help and support for this series of lectures. The series of public lectures is part of the measures our institution is taking to promote and encourage scientific research in the field of economic, monetary and financial developments in our country, in the region and wider. Today's lecture serves to remind us that the Bank of Albania also has an important research profile, in addition to its operational profile related to meeting the legal tasks charged to it such as preserving price stability, overseeing the financial system, ensuring the operation of payment systems or drafting an important piece of statistical data in the country. We are seriously committed to improving economic research within the Bank of Albania by being aware that despite the achievements, there is still room for further improvement and progress in this area. However, I am convinced that to be as successful as possible in achieving this objective, co-operation with other actors interested in this process remains of essential importance. In this framework, the Bank of Albania is interested in intensifying co-operation with the economic faculties of universities as well as with other centres specializing in economic research in our country. This collaboration will certainly enable the absorption of specialized academic thinking through the participation of university staff in various research projects along with the staff of our institution. At the same time, I would like to express my conviction that closer co-operation would ensure optimal exploitation of human resources on both sides and would also serve the revitalization of scientific research in our universities, which we are all aware of in great need. Another important dimension of co-operation with academic institutions also constitutes the creation of closer relations with distinguished students of economic faculties in the country, aiming to promote the interest of these students to focus their further academic qualification on issues related to central banking. I take advantage of this opportunity to communicate to you the project of the Governor's Award. This project consists of the development of an open competition, where all interested students can compete with their degree topics, which focus on issues related to the field of activity of the Bank of Albania. The best topics of the degree will be selected by a special commission and there will be material rewards for them. I express my confidence that these Bank of Albania initiatives will be welcomed by the academic and student community, and together with the serious commitment of bank of Albania staff, will contribute to achieving the major objective of improving economic research in our country.  2/3 05/08/22, 16:51 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in the first lecture of the Bank's Public Lecture Series ... Thank you!  3/3

text: , Mr. Ardian Fullani in them... academic districts, etc., of the Prefecture of Kumanovo, 31 March 2006 29/07/22, 15:01 , Mr. Ardian Fullani at the meeting with the business community, local government, counties academic, etc., of the Prefecture of Kumanovo, 31 March 2006 Publication date: 31.03.2006 Honored participants, It is a great pleasure to be among you today, representatives of the local government of the District of Kumanovo, the banking sector, the business community and academics of the University of Kumanovo. Today's meeting is ongoing with meetings the Bank of Albania has held in other regions of the country and in line with our goal to increase and improve communication with the public. An independent central bank must communicate with society as a whole in such a way as to create the right trust and prestige, within the framework of transparency, which facilitates the accounting process. In addition to laws and regulations that ensure accountability to bodies chosen by the people as parliament, an important element is direct communication with the public, business and academic circles. I believe that open communication of objectives, ways and means for achieving them improves the effectiveness of our work. Avoiding the uncertainty of expectations that generally causes the implementation of "surprise" policies, the public and businesses turn from agents who try to minimize the costs of "unexpected", to collaborators who support achieving our goals. The main goal of the Bank of Albania is to achieve and preserve price stability. The clear definition of what we understand with price stability represents the first important step in the transparency of our communication. For a long time, the Bank of  qet_akademike_etj_te_Prefektures_se_Gjirokastres_31_mars_2006.html Page 1 of 5 , Mr. Ardian Fullani in them... academic districts, etc., of the Prefecture of Kumanovo, 31 March 2006 29/07/22, 15:01 Albania publishes the inflation rate it targets with its monetary policy, which is currently 2 to 4 percent in annual terms. We are trying to institutionalize this further, considering the possibility of adopting the targeted inflation (IT) regime, which has at its centre the very proclamation and pursuit of a well-defined inflation rate. But this new regime is more than just declaring the inflation rate that the bank, as I mentioned, has already done. It also consists of public recognition of models and analyses where our decision-making is based, as well as on increasing responsibility and transparency for cases where the target is not achieved. This will give a real opportunity to the public and business, to understand how the bank reacts to economic developments and to more accurately judge the policy pursued. To this end, it is being worked on several fronts from improving the statistical base, preparing the models necessary for predicting inflation and functioning the economy, to the necessary legal basis that will enable the successful implementation of this new contemporary and transparent regime. Modern philosophies of central bank governance give great importance to communication. But the Bank of Albania's communication is not limited to monetary policy transparency for achieving price stability. It is equally important to exchange information with various economic agents to provide the necessary signals for preventing possible economic and financial crises. In this respect, regular relations with the banking system and businesses are irreplaceable. Here we can mention business and consumer confidence indexes, indexes that are being processed on the basis of information received at the regional level. Already, we have a positive tradition of periodic meetings with second-rate banks for various problems that may arise or new initiatives undertaken in the banking sector. Recent discussions have focused mainly on the quality of loans with the rapid expansion of lending activity that is characterizing the banking system. 2005 was accompanied by a rapid increase in economic lending. This increase has been the main source of use of funds and monetary expansion, posting for the first time funding the budget deficit from this role. At the end of November, credit to the economy reached nearly 14 percent of GDP. During the July period alone, credit has increased by 2.5 percentage points against GDP, while the pace of annual credit growth has fluctuated around the 70 percent level. The loan has been channelled throughout the sectors of the economy, showing the close connection of businesses to banks. The Bank of Albania estimates that the banking system has so far weathered these rapid developments with a satisfactory degree of security. However, as the supervisory authority of commercial banks, we feel the obligation to stress that increasing the volume of loans must be in line with improving their monitoring capacities, to avoid deteriorating the loan portfolio. For this reason, we are taking steps to initiate the Credit Information Bureau, which will contribute greatly in this direction. The Bank of Albania estimates that monetary and financial stability are inextricably linked. When it is premise to have financial instability, it is followed by monetary instability.  qet_akademike_etj_te_Prefektures_se_Gjirokastres_31_mars_2006.html Page 2 of 5 , Mr. Ardian Fullani in them... academic districts, etc., of the Prefecture of Kumanovo, 31 March 2006 29/07/22, 15:01 The breadth of the informal economy continues to remain a worrying problem for Albania. It significantly increases the risk of investment and lending. Under these conditions, formalisation of the economy remains a primary task in the programme of measures of government authorities, given the very negative impact it has on fair competition and on the intensity of tax evasion. The informal economy in Albania appears in various forms generating crime and corruption; parallel economies, which flourish and function as a result of the lack of efficiency of the formal economy. Increasing the range and quality of banking services, lowering the costs of these services, performing utilities through the banking system, as well as as associating ID cards with bank accounts and a postal address, will affect the formalization of the economy. The formality is equal to a bank account. Co-operation with the banking system has been important in our efforts to reduce the cash economy, as part of the process of formalizing the economy, as well as increasing the mediation role it must have in the economy. The introduction of wages into the public employee banking system is over, while we are also thinking about ways of involving the private sector. The implementation of the electronic system of large payments and that of the intersection of small payments have significantly lowered the costs of financial transactions between banks. In this context, we also think that there are all possibilities for second-rate banks to review spending related to banking services. The Bank of Albania in implementing its policy of gradually exiting from the role of mediator it offers individuals to participate in the primary treasury bond market, has finally decided not to accept cash in its sportel in Tirana. This decision will also extend to other sports of the Bank of Albania, within the first ten days of April. Misunderstandings by some citizens and the media, regarding the Bank of Albania's role in the treasury bond issue process, have made it inevitable to address some problems in this process. I would like to re-clarify once again that the Bank of Albania acts simply as an agent of the Ministry of Finance in issuing treasury bonds. On the one hand, the bank appreciates the importance of direct participation of citizens in these ancillary scans, but we think there are more efficient ways to carry out this process. One alternative would be to sell treasury bonds through the Albanian Mail network. Restructuring the post office would have great benefits not only for the process of treasury bond sales that will always come and grow, but also for many other services that the banking system may not be too flexible to offer, such as transfers of immigrants to deeper areas of the country. Facilitating shipment channels from abroad is another topic of discussion with the banking system. Outside the banks today, significant amounts of money are circulated. More than half of shipments from migrants enter the country through unofficial channels. These revenues account for about 14 percent of Gross Domestic Product (GDP), 70 percent of exports and 33 percent of imports. Italy and Greece are  qet_akademike_etj_te_Prefektures_se_Gjirokastres_31_mars_2006.html Page 3 of 5 , Mr. Ardian Fullani in them... academic districts, etc., of the Prefecture of Kumanovo, 31 March 2006 29/07/22, 15:01 The main destinations where Albanian immigrants live and consequently, they are the main countries of which shipments originate from abroad. Further increasein the volume of shipments and their effectiveness rely on facilitating the service of transfers from the banking system as well as improving the business environment. As I pointed out at a similar meeting in The Struga today, our communication with businesses has been greatly strengthened through surveys that we carry out on the performance of the country's economic activity. However, I accept that so far this communication has been one-sided by businesses in us. It's time for relations to be complete. For this reason, we have thought that businesses would be first in presenting and discussing the results of our surveys. This will be achieved through periodic meetings in co-operation with the Chambers of Commerce. At the same time, these meetings will serve as a window for taking businesses' current concerns more directly, as they were last weekend over energy problems. A significant proportion of businesses were forced to work below production capacities. This reflected in lower production and investment. The restriction of economic activity, due to power cuts, is estimated to have caused lower growth rates of about half a percentage point, compared to forecasts for it. To cope with the difficulties of lack of energy, most businesses turned to the use of alternative resources, which are estimated to have caused no small cost to their activity. Close to 57 percent of the businesses interviewed claim that the cost increase has flucerated from 10 to 30 percent. The manufacturing sector is the one that has felt the most consequences of the energy crisis, because it, above all, has had to face higher additional costs, due to the use of other alternative alternatives to electricity generation. However, businesses believe in a recovery in economic activity within the first quarter of 2006. The Bank of Albania's communication with universities and various academic circles is generally limited to special lectures about monetary policy and financial markets. By assessing the importance of this communication, we have considered raising our relations with universities to a higher stage of partnership, through the direct involvement of students in surveys and analyses that develop branches. Meanwhile, to promote scientific research, we met the public for the first time last week with the "Governor's Prize" project. I believe that increasing and improving communication with all interest groups, with the banking system, business community, local government and academic circles, will positively affect achieving our common goals, for a healthier economy and better social well-being. Thank you.  qet_akademike_etj_te_Prefektures_se_Gjirokastres_31_mars_2006.html Page 4 of 5 , Mr. Ardian Fullani in them... academic districts, etc., of the Prefecture of Kumanovo, 31 March 2006 29/07/22, 15:01  qet_akademike_etj_te_Prefektures_se_Gjirokastres_31_mars_2006.html Page 5 of 5

Ardian Fullani n ta qarqet akademike etj.., t Prefekturs s Gjirokastrs, 31 mars 2006 29/07/22, 15:01 Shqipris publikon normn e inflacionit q ajo synon me politikn e saj monetare, q aktualisht sht 2 deri n 4 pr qind n terma vjetor. Ne po prpiqemi q kt gj ta institucionalizojm m tej, duke shqyrtuar mundsin e adoptimit t regjimit t inflacionit t shnjestruar (IT), i cili ka n qendr t tij pikrisht shpalljen dhe ndjekjen e nj norme t mirprcaktuar inflacioni. Por ky regjim i ri sht m shum se thjesht shpallja e norms s inflacionit q banka, si e prmenda, e ka br tashm. Ai konsiston dhe n njohjen publike t modeleve dhe analizave ku bazohet vendimmarrja jon si dhe n rritjen e prgjegjsis dhe transparencs pr rastet kur objektivi nuk arrihet. Kjo do t'i jap nj mundsi reale publikut dhe biznesit, pr t kuptuar mnyrn se si banka reagon ndaj zhvillimeve ekonomike dhe pr t gjykuar m sakt politikn e ndjekur. Pr kt qllim, po punohet n disa fronte q nga prmirsimi i bazs statistikore, prgatitja e modeleve t nevojshme pr parashikimin e inflacionit dhe funksionimin e ekonomis, e deri te baza ligjore e nevojshme q do t bjn t mundur zbatimin me sukses t ktij regjimi t ri bashkkohor dhe transparent. Filozofit moderne t qeverisjes s bankave qendrore, i japin nj rendsi shum t madhe komunikimit. Por komunikimi i Banks s Shqipris nuk kufizohet thjesht tek transparenca e politiks monetare pr arritjen e stabilitetit t mimeve. Po aq i rndsishm sht dhe shkmbimi i informacionit me agjent t ndryshm ekonomik, pr t siguruar sinjalet e nevojshme pr parandalimin e krizave t mundshme ekonomike dhe financiare. N kt aspekt, marrdhniet e rregullta me sistemin bankar dhe bizneset jan t pazvendsueshme. Ktu mund t prmendim indekset e besimit t biznesit dhe konsumatorit, indekse t cilat po prpunohen n baz t informacionit t marr n nivel rajonal. Tashm, ne kemi nj tradit pozitive t takimeve periodike me bankat e nivelit t dyt pr probleme t ndryshme q mund t dalin apo iniciativa t reja q ndrmerren n sektorin bankar. Diskutimet e fundit jan prqendruar kryesisht tek cilsia e kredive me zgjerimin e vrullshm t aktivitetit kreditues q po karakterizon sistemin bankar. Viti 2005 u shoqrua nga nj rritje e shpejt e kreditimit t ekonomis. Kjo rritje ka qen burimi kryesor i prdorimit t fondeve dhe ekspansionit monetar, duke postuar pr her t par financimin e deficitit buxhetor nga ky rol. N fund t muajit nntor, kredia pr ekonomin arriti n gati 14 pr qind t PBB-s. Vetm gjat periudhs korriknntor kredia sht rritur me 2.5 pik prqindjeje ndaj PBB-s, ndrkoh q ritmet e rritjes vjetore t kredis jan luhatur rreth nivelit 70 pr qind. Kredia sht kanalizuar n t gjith sektort e ekonomis, duke treguar lidhjen e ngusht t bizneseve me bankat. Banka e Shqipris vlerson se sistemi bankar deri m sot i ka prballuar kto zhvillime t vrullshme me nj shkall t knaqshme sigurie. Megjithat, si autoriteti mbikqyrs i bankave tregtare, ndjejm detyrimin t theksojm se rritja e vllimit t kredive duhet t jet n linj me prmirsimin e kapaciteteve monitoruese t tyre, pr t shmangur prkeqsimin e portofolit t kredive. Pr kt arsye, po marrim masa pr t iniciuar Byron e Informacionit t Kredive, q do t kontribuoj shum n kt drejtim. Banka e Shqipris vlerson se stabiliteti monetar dhe ai financiar jan t lidhur n mnyr t pazgjidhshme. Ardian Fullani n ta qarqet akademike etj.., t Prefekturs s Gjirokastrs, 31 mars 2006 29/07/22, 15:01 Gjersia e ekonomis joformale vazhdon t mbetet nj problem shqetsues pr Shqiprin. Ajo rrit ndjeshm rrezikun e investimeve dhe kreditimit. N kto kushte, formalizimi i ekonomis mbetet nj detyr parsore n programin e masave t autoriteteve qeveritare, duke patur parasysh ndikimin shum negativ q ka ajo mbi konkurrencn e ndershme dhe mbi intensitetin e evazionit fiskal. Ekonomia joformale n Shqipri shfaqet n forma t ndryshme q gjeneron krimin dhe korrupsionin; ekonomi paralele, e cila lulzon dhe funksionon si pasoj e mungess s efikasitetit t ekonomis formale. Rritja e gams dhe e cilsis s shrbimeve bankare, ulja e kostove t ktyre shrbimeve, kryerja e shrbimeve utilitare nprmjet sistemit bankar si dhe shoqrimi i kartave t identitetit me llogari bankare dhe me nj adres postare, do t ndikojn n formalizimin e ekonomis. Formaliteti sht baraz me nj llogari bankare. Bashkpunimi me sistemin bankar ka qen i rndsishm n prpjekjet tona pr reduktimin e ekonomis s cash-it, si pjes e procesit t formalizimit t ekonomis si edhe t rritjes s rolit ndrmjetsues q ai duhet t ket n ekonomi. Futja e pagave n sistemin bankar t punonjsve publik ka mbaruar, ndrkoh q po mendojm dhe mnyrat pr prfshirjen e sektorit privat. Zbatimi i sistemit elektronik t pagesave t mdha dhe ai i kryqzimit t pagesave t vogla, kan ulur ndjeshm kostot e transaksioneve financiare ndrmjet bankave. N kt kuadr, ne mendojm gjithashtu se jan t gjitha mundsit q bankat e nivelit t dyt t rishikojn shpenzimet q lidhen me shrbimet bankare. Banka e Shqipris n zbatim t politiks s saj pr daljen graduale nga roli i ndrmjetsuesit q ajo u ofron individve pr t marr pjes n tregun primar t bonove t thesarit, s fundi ka vendosur t mos pranoj cash n sportelin e saj n Tiran. Ky vendim do t shtrihet edhe n sportelet e tjera t Banks s Shqipris, brenda dhjetditorit t par t muajit prill. Keqkuptimet e disa qytetarve dhe mediave, lidhur me rolin e Banks s Shqipris n procesin e emetimit t bonove t thesarit, e kan br t pashmangshm adresimin e disa problemeve n lidhje me kt proces. Do t doja t risqaroja edhe nj her q Banka e Shqipris vepron thjesht si agjente e Ministris s Financave n emetimin e bonove t thesarit. N njrn an, banka vlerson rndsin q ka pjesmarrja e drejtprdrejt e qytetarve n kto ankande por, mendojm se ekzistojn mnyra m eficiente pr t realizuar kt proces. Nj alternativ do t ishte shitja e bonove t thesarit prmes rrjetit t Posts Shqiptare. Ristrukturimi i posts do t kishte prfitime t mdha jo vetm pr procesin e shitjeve t bonove t thesarit q do t vij gjithmon e duke u rritur, por dhe pr shum shrbime t tjera q sistemi bankar mund t mos jet shum fleksibl pr t'i ofruar, si transfertat e emigrantve deri n zonat m t thella t vendit. Lehtsimi i kanaleve t drgesave nga jasht sht nj tem tjetr diskutimi me sistemin bankar. Jasht bankave sot qarkullojn sasi t konsiderueshme t paras. M shum se gjysma e drgesave nga emigrantt hyjn n vend nprmjet kanaleve jozyrtare. Kto t ardhura prbjn rreth 14 pr qind t Prodhimit t Brendshm Bruto (PBB), 70 pr qind t eksporteve dhe 33 pr qind t importeve.
