Si e kam theksuar n nj takim t ngjashm me kt t sotmin n Shkodr, komunikimi yn me bizneset sht forcuar mjaft nprmjet anketimeve q ne realizojm mbi ecurin e aktivitetit ekonomik t vendit. Megjithat, pranoj se deri m tani ky komunikim ka qen i njanshm nga bizneset tek ne. Ka ardhur koha q marrdhniet t bhen t plota. Pr kt arsye, kemi menduar q bizneset t jen t parat n prezantimin dhe diskutimin e rezultateve t anketimeve tona. Kjo do t realizohet prmes takimeve periodike n bashkpunim me dhomat e tregtis. N t njjtn koh, kto takime do t shrbejn si nj dritare pr marrjen m t drejtprdrejt t shqetsimeve aktuale t bizneseve, si ishin ato t fundvitit t kaluar lidhur me problemet e energjis. Nj pjes e konsiderueshme e bizneseve u detyruan t punojn nn kapacitetet prodhuese. Kjo reflektoi n ulje t prodhimit dhe t investimeve. Kufizimi i aktivitetit ekonomik, pr shkak t ndrprerjeve t energjis elektrike, vlersohet t ket shkaktuar ritme m t ulta rritjeje rreth gjysm pik prqindje, n krahasim me parashikimet pr t. Pr t prballuar vshtirsit e mungess s energjis, shumica e bizneseve iu drejtua prdorimit t burimeve alternative, t cilat vlersohet t ken shkaktuar kosto jo t vogl pr aktivitetin e tyre. Afr 57 pr qind e bizneseve t intervistuara, pohojn se rritja e kostos sht luhatur nga 10 deri n 30 pr qind. Sektori i prodhimit sht ai q ka ndjer m shum pasojat e krizs energjitike, sepse atij, mbi t gjitha, i sht dashur t prballet me kosto m t larta shtes, pr shkak t prdorimit t alternativave t tjera zvendsuese t prodhimit t energjis elektrike. Sidoqoft, bizneset besojn n nj rikuperim t aktivitetit ekonomik, brenda tremujorit t par t vitit 2006. Komunikimi i Banks s Shqipris me universitetet e qarqet e ndryshme akademike, prgjithsisht sht kufizuar n leksione speciale rreth politiks monetare dhe tregjeve financiare. Duke vlersuar rndsin e ktij komunikimi, ne kemi menduar t'i ngrem marrdhniet tona me universitetet n nj stad m t lart partneriteti, prmes prfshirjes s drejtprdrejt t studentve n anketimet dhe analizat q zhvillojn degt. Ndrkoh, pr t nxitur krkimet shkencore, ne njohm publikun, pr her t par javn e kaluar me projektin e "mimit t Guvernatorit". Un besoj se rritja dhe prmirsimi i komunikimit me t gjitha grupet e interesit, me sistemin bankar, komunitetin e biznesit, pushtetin lokal dhe qarqet akademike, do t ndikoj pozitivisht n arritjen e objektivave tan t prbashkt, pr nj ekonomi m t shndosh e mirqenie m t mir sociale. Credit Information, Hotel Tirana International, 28 April 2006 29/07/22, 15:01 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the roundtable discussion on the creation of the Office of Credit Information, Hotel Tirana International, 28 April 2006 Publication date: 28.04.2006 Honored participants, Ladies and gentlemen, Initially, I would like to thank the FSVC for their contribution to the organisation of this meeting. I also thank USAID, the American Embassy, the International Monetary Fund, the World Bank, the second-tier banks and all the other participants for the presence at this roundtable. We are all aware of the rhythms of increasing lending activity of the Albanian banking system over the past few years. Thus, in 2005 the loan surplus increased by 57.6 billion dollars (1) or 82 percent, from 19.3 billion dollars or 38 percent for the previous year. The expansion of sound lending is certainly positive for a country's economic development. Sound lending is linked to the possibility that lending institutions (especially banks) have for making a fair decision during the granting of a loan, based on a good and solid analysis of the creditor (seen from a microperspective) and in well-defined and realistic goals related to business development. Increasing competition, rapidly expanding lending through new products and targeting new categories of creditors, the need to maintain at least the same profit and market share, make it difficult to find a fair balance between achieving goals and quality of decision-making in lending activity. That's why  formacionit_te_Kredive_Hotel_Tirana_International_28_prill_2006.html Page 1 of 3 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in try... Credit Information, Hotel Tirana International, 28 April 2006 29/07/22, 15:01 Strengthening credit risk management capacities and careful requirements, especially in the field of lending, are necessary at the time of these rapid developments. In this context, the Bank of Albania appreciates the attention banks have paid to the quality of the loan portfolio. For our part, we have also stepped up our efforts for careful and continuous supervision in the context of credit risk management. As in other areas, the quality of information on which decision-making is also based is essential. In lending activity, information on the creditor's history is critical to reduce the risk of credit activity. The difficulty of obtaining accurate information, caused by the increasing number of creditors and the variety of their categories, has been balanced somewhat by developments in the field of information technology. But there is a need and means to create a centre, collect and distribute information on loans to every creditor in the banking system. Such an institution would help strengthen the stability of the banking system, reducing the risk associated with expanding lending. I think this is the appropriate time to create this information office, given both the high rates of lending growth and the demands of both sides, second-rate banks and the Bank of Albania as supervisory authority, for a decision-making and quality lending performance. Furthermore, the Credit Information Office will reduce the cost of assessment and the time of review of the loan award process; will reduce the probability of extending ingood loans, thus increasing the quality of the loan. So far, considerable and ongoing efforts have been made by the Albanian Banking Association for the creation of a Credit Information Office, but for various reasons this process has not been completed. To overcome the technical and structural difficulties that may be encountered during this process, the Bank of Albania has decided to take a more prominent role in this process and will initially create this office as a unit under its dependence. Under this project, the creation of such an office, data collection in a centralized register, information management and the provision of a service that provides information to banks will be obliged and carried out by the Bank of Albania. But such a project does not rule out other similar projects that could be carried out by the second-tier banks themselves. This centre will serve banks for better management of its loan portfolio and risk, as well as serve the Bank of Albania for conducting more complete analyses of the banking system as a whole and risk-related issues in particular. The establishment of this office at the Bank of Albania also meets the current requirement of banks to manage information on loans by ensuring its accuracy, confidentiality and credibility. I am convinced that banks as the main beneficiaries of this service will co-operate with the Bank of Albania to successfully carry out this project.  formacionit_te_Kredive_Hotel_Tirana_International_28_prill_2006.html Page 2 of 3 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in try... Article IV consultation and PRGF Review - EFF in Albania 29/07/22, 15:01 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the conclusion of the Mission of Consultation of Article IV and Revision PRGF - EFF in Albania Publication date: 11.05.2006 Over the past two weeks we have held very extensive talks with the IMF Mission on the occasion of article IV consultations. At the heart of our discussions were macroeconomic stability and the latest developments in the banking system. During these talks, many issues related to economic developments were discussed in the future and agreed on some necessary measures with the aim of minimising possible risks. The Albanian economy appears to have regenerated after the slowdown caused by the energy crisis last year, promising another positive year with high economic growth. All sectors of the economy, in particular the services sector, have had a successful period, characterized by a great demand. Meanwhile, inflation has been at low levels, which proves that the economy has had enough capacity to cope with this demand, increasing production and trade. For this reason, the Bank of Albania has taken a neutral stance on monetary policy pursued by it. This policy is in line with our inflation forecasts, which show keeping inflationary pressures in check in the coming period. However, the current situation poses some possible risks. High oil prices in world markets, as well as higher energy prices in general, can be included in the cost structure of the economy, thereby causing the so-called second-round effects and rising inflationary expectations. Rising credit levels, at a time when a highly welcome and necessary development of our economy could jeopardize macroeconomic balances, increase inflationary pressures and worsen the crustaccount. At the same time,  onsultimit_te_Artikullit_IV_dhe_Rishikimit_PRGF-EFF_ne_Shqiperi.html Page 1 of 3 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in For... Article IV consultation and PRGF Review - EFF in Albania 29/07/22, 15:01 We cannot rule out the impacts that the global tightening of monetary policy will have on our financial markets and on our monetary policy. We are carefully monitoring and assessing further developments in the situation, with the aim of taking appropriate measures. The Bank of Albania remains committed to maintaining price stability and inflation within the predicted level. High lending growth over the past year and early this year may be a reason for high demand growth. However, we look at the pace of lending growth in relation not only to their impacts on macroeconomic stability, but also on the stability of the banking sector. In general, the increase in private sector lending has been in a line with developments in the economic environment in Albania. Looking at historical performance, credit stock growth has been expected, as the relationship between banks and business has strengthened and consolidated significantly. Also, lowering the government's demand for monetary means has reduced crowding-out effect (the government's weight loss) on public borrowing, pushing banks towards investment in private sector lending. Since banks are more prone to long-term maturity credit, the amount in credit stock circulation increases faster. The so-called "time recovery process" is another reason related to increased lending, where banks due to high competition pressures, greater internal capacities and increased quality of borrowers have begun to use their financial resources more efficiently. Over time, companies' payability has improved significantly, however the banks' initial response, before the privatisation of the Savings Bank, to lending growth has been slightly slow. With further growth in the reputation of companies and the activation of the largest bank in the country, other banks began to be more active in exploiting these opportunities. The initial delay, followed by the "later recovery process", may explain the high lending growth quite well. However, as lending converges towards a more long-term balance, we expect to see lending growth take more normal steps. The Bank of Albania maintains very close contacts with the banking industry and other licensed institutions, with the aim of discussing the latest developments and trends in their activity. Open communication with them also serves to unite our efforts to achieve the development of as sound a banking activity as possible. Based on the characteristic risk developments of loan analyses in each bank and the banking system as a whole, the Bank of Albania aims to take a series of gradual measures, with the aim of improving information flow infrastructure between banks and the Bank of Albania, as well as other necessary measures. Ardian Fullani, n Prfundim t Misionit t Konsultimit t Artikullit IV dhe Rishikimit PRGF - EFF n Shqipri Data e publikimit: 11.05.2006 Gjat dy javve t fundit kemi zhvilluar bisedime mjaft t gjera me Misionin e FMN-s me rastin e konsultimeve t Artikullit IV. N qendr t diskutimeve tona ishin stabiliteti makroekonomik dhe zhvillimet m t fundit n sistemin bankar. Gjat ktyre bisedimeve u diskutuan mjaft shtje q lidhen me zhvillimet ekonomike n t ardhmen dhe u ra dakord mbi disa masa t nevojshme me qllim minimizimin e rreziqeve t mundshme. Ekonomia shqiptare duket t jet rigjeneruar pas ngadalsimit t shkaktuar nga kriza energjitike vitin e kaluar, duke premtuar pr nj vit tjetr pozitiv me rritje t lart ekonomike. T gjith sektort e ekonomis, n veanti sektori i shrbimeve, kan patur nj periudh t suksesshme, e karakterizuar nga nj krkes e madhe. Ndrkoh, inflacioni ka qen n nivele t ulta, gj q dshmon se ekonomia ka patur kapacitete t mjaftueshme pr t prballuar kt krkes, duke rritur prodhimin dhe tregtin. Pr kt arsye, Banka e Shqipris ka mbajtur nj qndrim neutral n politikn monetare t ndjekur prej saj. Kjo politik sht n prputhje me parashikimet tona pr inflacionin, t cilat tregojn mbajtjen nn kontroll t presioneve inflacioniste n nj periudh t ardhshme. Megjithat, situata aktuale paraqet dhe disa rreziqe t mundshme. mimet e larta t nafts n tregjet botrore, si dhe mimet m t larta t energjis n prgjithsi mund t prfshihen n strukturn e kostos s ekonomis, duke shkaktuar n kt mnyr t ashtuquajturat efektet e raundit t dyt dhe rritjen e pritshmrive inflacioniste. Rritja e nivelit t kredis, n kohn kur nj zhvillim tejet i mirpritur dhe i nevojshm i ekonomis son mund t rrezikoj ekuilibrat makroekonomik, rrit presionet inflacioniste dhe mund t prkeqsoj llogarin korente. Ne jemi duke monitoruar dhe vlersuar me kujdes zhvillimet e mtejshme t situats, me qllim marrjen e masave t prshtatshme. Banka e Shqipris mbetet e prkushtuar ndaj mbajtjes s stabilitetit t mimeve dhe inflacionit brenda nivelit t parashikuar. Rritja e lart e kreditimit gjat vitit t kaluar dhe fillimit t ktij viti, mund t jet nj arsye pr rritjen e lart t krkess. Megjithat, ne i shikojm ritmet e rritjes s kreditimit n lidhje jo vetm me ndikimet e tyre mbi stabilitetin makroekonomik, por dhe mbi stabilitetin e sektorit bankar. N prgjithsi, rritja e kreditimit t sektorit privat ka qen n nj linj me zhvillimet n mjedisin ekonomik n Shqipri. Duke par ecurin historike, rritja e stock-ut t kredis ka qen e pritshme, pasi marrdhnia ndrmjet bankave dhe biznesit sht forcuar dhe konsoliduar n mnyr t ndjeshme. Gjithashtu, ulja e krkess s qeveris pr mjete monetare ka paksuar crowding-out effect (rnia e peshs s qeveris) n huamarrjen publike, duke i shtyr bankat drejt investimit n kreditimin e sektorit privat. Duke qen se bankat jan m t prirura ndaj kredis me maturitet afatgjat, shuma n qarkullim e stock-ut t kredis rritet m shpejt. I ashtuquajturi (catch-up process) "procesi i rikuperimit t kohs", sht nj arsye tjetr q lidhet me rritjen e kreditimit, ku bankat pr shkak t presioneve t larta t konkurrencs, kapaciteteve m t mdha t brendshme dhe rritjes s cilsis s huamarrsve, kan filluar t'i prdorin burimet e tyre financiare n mnyr m t efektshme. Me kalimin e kohs, aftsia paguese e kompanive sht prmirsuar ndjeshm, megjithat reagimi fillestar i bankave, prpara privatizimit t Banks s Kursimeve, ndaj rritjes s kredidhnies ka qen paksa i ngadalt. Me rritjen e mtejshme t reputacionit t kompanive dhe me aktivizimin e banks m t madhe n vend, bankat e tjera filluan t ishin m aktive n shfrytzimin e ktyre mundsive. Vonesa fillestare, e ndjekur nga "procesi i mvonshm i rikuperimit", mund t shpjegoj mjaft mir rritjen e lart t kreditimit. Megjithat, ndrsa kreditimi konvergon drejt nj ekuilibri m afatgjat, presim t shohim q rritja e kreditimit t ec n hapa m normal. Banka e Shqipris mban kontakte mjaft t ngushta me industrin bankare dhe me institucionet e tjera t licencuara, me qllim diskutimin e zhvillimeve dhe trendeve m t fundit n aktivitetin e tyre. Komunikimi i hapur me to shrben gjithashtu, pr bashkimin e prpjekjeve tona pr arritjen e zhvillimit t nj aktiviteti bankar sa m t shndosh. Bazuar n zhvillimet karakteristike t rrezikut t analizave t kredive n seciln bank dhe n sistemin bankar n trsi, Banka e Shqipris synon marrjen e nj sr masave graduale, me qllim prmirsimin e infrastrukturs s rrjedhjes s informacionit ndrmjet bankave dhe me Bankn e Shqipris, si dhe masa t tjera t nevojshme. text: , Mr. Ardian Fullani, during... 25 May 2006 29/07/22, 15:01 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, during the presentation of the 2005 Annual Report to the Assembly of Albania, 25 May 2006 Publication date: 25.05.2006 Honorable, Mrs. Speaker, Ladies and gentlemen Deputies! 2005, in general, was characterized by positive developments, which further improved the country's economic-financial environment, contributing to further preservation and consolidation of macroeconomic stability. By making a synthesis of all verified developments in the economy, it is estimated that during 2005 the country's economic activity expanded further, under the conditions of under-control inflation and a further reduction in the budget deficit. Intensive developments have also been recorded in financing the economy with bank loans, which almost doubled compared to 2004. The Bank of Albania has successfully fulfilled its legal mission, effectively managing inflationary pressures in the economy. Although under the conditions of an already private and more dynamic banking market, we have tried to best manage the liquidity situation in the economy, ensuring a constant supply of the money economy, in line with the needs for the country's economic development. Monetary policy implemented by the Bank of Albania has been vigilant, following domestic and international developments step by step. Special care is also dedicated to maintaining the stability of the banking system, at a time when commercial banks make up the most active segment of the financial sector. This constant commitment of the Bank of Albania takes on a particular importance in the conditions of increased lending activity, which means more efficient reporting systems, more careful checks, addition of measures and corrective actions. The focus of our work has also been to further expand and deepen the financial market in the country. In our daily activity the importance is dedicated to reducing the cash economy, considering it as a factor directly related to the reduction of informality in the economy. text: , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in ... piano - organised by the Embassy of the Italian Republic, 5 June 2006 29/07/22, 15:01 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the conference - Economic Governance in the European Union - organised by the Embassy of the Italian Republic, 5 June 2006 Publication date: 05.06.2006 Honored colleagues, It is a pleasure for me to be present today to share some thoughts on governance issues, particularly related to central banking. The environment in which central banks and financial market authorities operate has undergone a lot of changes in recent decades. Globalization and the progress of information and communication technology mean new challenges in achieving their goals. To meet these challenges, central banks need to reconsider their strategies and restructure in the right way, with the aim of achieving their reputation in this ever-changing environment. This process would consist of: changes in the legal framework, -organisational restructuring, which could include changes in the way the bank is run by the council and committees; - improvements in accounting practices, supervisory and human resources standards; - as well as some other changes. In the last decade, Albania has become part of this wind of change and we have come to understand the importance of good governance on the part of central banks and supervisory agencies. For this reason, the Bank of Albania has taken the appropriate steps in order to restructure it. Thus, our goal is to adopt a more formally targeted inflation over the medium term. To achieve this goal we have taken steps to improve our governing structure and strengthen our analytical capabilities. Regarding governance issues, the open forum that was  organizuar_nga_Ambasada_e_Republikes_Italiane_5_qershor_2006.html Page 1 of 2 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in ... piano - organised by the Embassy of the Italian Republic, 5 June 2006 29/07/22, 15:01 organised last year with the best experts discussed many issues related to the implementation of targeted inflation. However, as pointed out by these experts, the proper model of internal governance is far from being an accurate formula. Mrs. Lecier's lecture. Lucia Quaglia today will touch on this issue and help us understand how some institutions are implementing good governance, and try to learn lessons through international comparisons. Also, let me say some words on our bank's second important objective, which is the stability of the financial system. It has become a great job to promote the development and consolidation of a sound banking and financial system. In this regard, I can mention some of the measures that have finally been taken by our bank, such as the establishment of a credit information office, the analytical development of the deposit insurance scheme, the improvement of the legal framework on bankruptcy and collateral, as well as the strengthening of the banking and supervisory regulatory framework, which will also help in the direction of the Government's efforts to combat money laundering. International bodies and the International Monetary Fund in particular are providing valuable technical assistance to the Bank of Albania, supporting the implementation of the institutional development programme for bank supervision that the Bank of Albania has undertaken. With the privatisation of the largest bank, the financial sector in Albania is finally showing long-awaited dynamism and the Bank of Albania is increasing regulatory oversight. In the context of globalization, the Bank of Albania has committed to institutionalizing co-operation between central banks in the region. If we take into account the meetings organised to date with some of the banking authorities in the region, we can say that this initiative is on a good track. However, I am convinced that there is still room for further strengthening of regional co-operation, thanks to which we can exchange our experiences in the field of banking supervision and best governance practices in Southeast Europe, which, I believe, are also part of Mrs. May's future research agenda. Ardian_Fullani_ne_konferencen_per_shtyp_me_misionin_e_FMN-se.html Page 1 of 3 , Mr Ardian Fullani at the press conference with the IMF mission 29/07/22, 15:00 Press releases Notices of # meetings of Council Supervisor Press conference Speeches, interview articles Speeches Interview of articles Calendars # Official holiday calendar for 2022 COVID-19 Europe # BANK OF ALBANIA PRESS CONFERENCE , Mr Ardian Fullani at the press conference with the IMF mission Publication date: 06.11.2006 In meetings held with the IMF's turn mission, over the past two weeks, we have shared the same thoughts on the latest monetary and economic developments and medium-term expectations. The country's economy continues to remain within our early expectations. Inflation has been under control within BSh's target, although it has shown a growing trend from last year. Monetary policy pursued so far by the Bank of Albania has been appropriate for controlling inflationary pressures. The increase in the basic interest rate at the end of July served to control the increase in demand and to signal our readiness for maintaining the stability of the prizes. I would stress that the Bank of Albania is determined to continue pursuing a careful monetary policy by monitoring developments that could negatively affect macroeconomic and financial stability. The extension of the maturity of letters of value issued by the government (today introduced and the 5-year obligation) has increased the need and incentive for the development of their secondary market. In this direction BSh is working intensively to establish the infrastructure needed to facilitate actions in the government's secondary letter market. More specifically, the implementation of the simultaneous system of movement of funds and ownership (DVP) next year represents an important step. In addition, the Bank of Albania is working to inform the register of letters of value held by it, which will simultaneously help further expand and deepen the money market. The stability of the banking system in particular and of the financial system in general constitutes a priority of the Bank of Albania. Our dedication in this direction takes on a particular importance in the context of developments in the credit market, which has continued to mark growth. Last year's positive developments in the banking system have also been evident during this year. BSh has increased the care that these positive developments are as stable as possible. To this end, an intensive dialogue has been launched with the banking system for the implementation of measures aimed at maintaining the quality of banking activity especially that creditor. In conclusion, I would thank the IMF mission for the assistance and constructive ideas given during this important period that the country's economy is going through. ... Ardian Fullani n konferencn pr shtyp me misionin e FMN-s Data e publikimit: 06.11.2006 N takimet e zhvilluara me misionin e radhes t FMN, gjat ktyre dy javve t fundit, kemi ndar mendime t njjta pr zhvillimet m te fundit monetare dhe ekonomike dhe pritshmerive afatmesme. Ekonomia e vendit vazhdon t mbetet brenda pritshmerive tona t fillim vitit. Inflacioni ka qen nen kontroll brenda objektivit te BSh megjithese ka treguar nj prirje rritese nga viti i kaluar. Politika monetare e ndjekur deri tani nga Banka e Shqipris ka qen e prshtatshme pr kontrollin e presioneve inflacioniste. Rritja e norms baz t interesit n fund t muajit korrik shrbeu pr t kontrolluar rritjen e kerkeses dhe pr t sinjalizuar gadishmrin ton pr ruajtjen e stabilitetit t cmimeve. Do t theksoja se Banka e Shqipris sht e vendosur t vazhdoj ndjekjen e nj politike t kujdesshme monetare duke monitoruar zhvillimet t cilat mund t ndikojn negativisht stabilitetin makroekonomik dhe at financiar. Zgjatja e maturimit t letrave me vler t emetuara nga qeveria (sot u prezantua dhe obligacioni 5-vjecar) ka rritur nevojn dhe nxitjen pr zhvillimin e tregut sekondar t tyre. N kt drejtim BSh po punon intensivisht pr ngritjen e infrastruktures s nevojshme pr lehtsimin e veprimeve n tregun sekondar t letrave t qeveris. M konkretisht, zbatimi i sistemit t lvizjes t njkohshme t fondeve dhe t pronsis (DVP) vitin tjetr prbn nj hap t rndsishm. Prvec ksaj, Banka e Shqipris po punon pr informatizimin e regjistrit t letrave me vlere t mbajtura prej saj, gj q do t ndihmoj njkohsisht edhe zgjerimin dhe thellimin e mtejshm t tregut t paras. Stabiliteti i sistemit bankar n veanti dhe i atij financiar n prgjithsi, prbn nj prparsi t Banks s Shqipris. Prkushtimi yn n kt drejtim merr nj rndsi t veant n kontekstin e zhvillimeve n tregun e kredis, e cila ka vazhduar t shnoj rritje. Zhvillimet pozitive t vitit t kaluar n sistemin bankar jan evidentuar dhe gjat ktij viti. BSh ka rritur kujdesin q keto zhvillime pozitive t jen sa me t qendrueshme. Pr kt qllim ka nisur nj dialog intensiv me sistemin bankar pr zbatimin e masave q kan si qllim ruajtjen e cilsis s aktivitetit bankar sidomos atij kreditues. text: 06/08/2022, 09:12 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, during the presentation of the Annual Report of the Bank of Albania ... , Mr. Ardian Fullani, during the presentation of the Annual Report of the Bank of Albania for 2006, to the Commission of Economics and Finance of the Assembly of Albania, April 25, 2007 Publication date: 25.04.2007 Honoured ladies and gentlemen members of the Commission on Economics and Finance, ... 1/20 06/08/2022, 09:12 JThe word of the Governors bank of Albania, Mr. ArdianpFullani, during the presentation of the Vjeto Report, r of the Bank of Albania ... It is a special privilege, in accordance with the legal obligation to present before you the Annual Report of the Bank of Albania, for 2006. The bank of Albania's activity in accordance with constitutional and legal obligations is summed up in this report. In the first part, let me focus on the performance of the national economy to further address the more specific parts, which relate to the institutional responsibilities and direct contributions of the Bank of Albania towards inflation control, maintaining financial stability, improving financial infrastructure, as well as our role in European and regional integration. 1. Economic developments during 2006 The country's economic development during 2006 has generally been in line with the country's medium-term economic development programme. The Albanian economy has had comparatively satisfactory growth rates, thanks to private sector dynamism, macroeconomic stability and the fruits of the current structural reforms. The banking system has provided a powerful stimulus in support of economic activity, increasing credit to the economy by about 70 billion dollars or over US700 million. Based on available economic indicators, the rate of economic growth is estimated to be around 5 percent level. This increase is coupled with price stability, expressed in an average annual inflation of 2.4 percent. Monetary conditions, characterized by historically low interest rates and exchange rate sustainability, have favoured increased investment and consumption in the economy. Specifically, they have also been reflected in the rapid growth of credit, further supporting the growth of the economy. Fiscal developments have resulted within programmed borders, contributing to further consolidation of public finances and control of the budget deficit. However, the realisation of capital expenditure requires greater attention, towards the planned level and in terms of the pace of carrying out these expenditures. Economic growth has also been reflected in the labour market. The number of employees in the country has marked increases, although it still does not fully reflect developments in other sectors of the economy. The expansion of economic activity in the country has been associated with the increase in trade exchanges with abroad. The balance of payments has been closed in positive terms, supporting the sustainability of the exchange rate. Quantitative and quality indicators of economic performance speak of a satisfactory increase, mainly based on services and industrial production activities. Sales by economic companies during the first nine months were about 11 percent higher than in 2005. The fact that the first quarter recorded a high annual sales increase shows that production and utility companies exceeded problems caused by restrictions on electricity supply at the end of 2005. Positive developments have been recorded in the industry sector and particularly in the processing industry Trade activity in ... 2/20 06/08/2022, 09:12 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, during the presentation of the Annual Report of the Bank of Albania ... industry sector and specifically, in the processing industry. Commercial activity in country, continues to provide the bulk of sales, as well as to mark paces of significant annual growth. The construction sector is estimated to have had a performance roughly the same as last year. Direct and indirect indicators of this sector impose the need for greater attention, especially in the better orientation of financial, private or public resources. Developments in the construction branch over recent years, especially the extreme concentration of construction in certain territories, testify to the lack of efficiency of urban development policies, not guaranteeing the long-term sustainability of the branch. Furthermore, the construction branch still continues to be dominated by construction for dwellings, leaving far behind other strategic voices such as investments in road infrastructure, industrial construction, agricultural enhancements and infrastructure included and other investments, directly related to quality of life in small urban and rural communities. Agricultural production during 2006 has partially recovered from the decline in the pace of growth, observed during 2005. The projection for sector growth in 2006 stands at 2.5 percent level, being higher than growth in 2005, but lower than the average growth rate over the last five years. Investments in the agriculture sector and financing on the part of the banking system will increase in line with the potential that this branch has, only if the obstacles created by numerous structural problems are eliminated. Agricultural land is not used to the maximum, as a result of external and internal migration and problems with ownership titles. The relatively undeveloped infrastructure of rural areas makes it difficult to get products on the market. The fragmentation of agricultural land prevents effective production organization, decreases productivity and increases the cost of using agricultural mechanics. As far as energy is concerned, the Bank of Albania estimates that it remains our main challenge in the near and medium-term period. For about a decade and a half we have been facing severe restrictions on electricity supply. Timely handling of current crises with a global environment very sensitive to this problem has caused the costs of importing energy resources to be relatively high, which in long-term terms would be unaffordable. From the Bank of Albania's observations it turns out that the negative consequences this situation creates are numerous and directly related to the economic activity of the manufacturing sector both at the level of the corporation and in that of small or medium business. Occasional repetition increases the risk that periods with significant energy restrictions will no longer be considered as random strokes but are increasingly classified as permanent factors, which must be factored in production and flow costs, price formation policies and expectations for them. To this end, the Bank of Albania estimates that, starting in 2007, all relevant decision-making actors need to implement a new management policy, concrete, different from the 15-year practice. Its integral part should not only be the management of current energy resources, but also concrete steps in the distribution network as short-term measures to move into more long-term actions, which would understand the construction of alternative energy sources The fastest solution to the situation ... 3/20 06/08/2022, 09:12 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, during the presentation of the Annual Report of the Bank of Albania ... building alternative energy sources. The quickest solution to the situation energy, will have positive impacts for Albanian business, for the health of finances public, for the country's sustainable economic development and for stability Macroeconomic. At the end of this first part, I would like to highlight some other issues, which I think should be included in the list of priorities for the country's medium-term economic and financial development. The Albanian economy is moving away from the status of a transitioneconomy approaching that of a developing economy. This qualitative step calls for further deepening of structural reforms, increasing the effectiveness of development policies and expanding the country's absorbing capacities, in the direction of increasing the competitiveness of the Albanian economy in the regional and wider context. As a matter of near and perspective I would point to the continued deepening of the trade deficit. Although currently the country's external position, materialized in indicators such as foreign debt, the level of foreign exchange reserves or the overall position of the balance of payments is not problematic, I appreciate that the increase in exports is not sufficient, especially in the context of the high dependence that the Albanian economy has on migrant shipments. The relatively high corent deficit, around the 7.6 percent LEVEL of GDP, is one more argument in this regard. The latter, in the presence of a fiscal deficit, increases the exposure of our economy and makes it necessary to provide currency flows of a more stable nature. This would translate into a need for more quality foreign direct investment, which in turn would contribute to a steady increase in exports. To this end, taking advantage of a global environment, which is constantly looking for new markets, I would suggest a more quality national marketing strategy. In this strategy, all recent initiatives and the many opportunities Albania offers must be demonstrated professionally and contemporaryly. Also, I think the time has come that in our long-term development plans, we should also integrate joint regional projects. Road infrastructure, energy, communication, tourism and other areas are still undeveloped at the region level. For this reason, I appreciate that regional projects of strategic nature arouse a higher degree of interest in local and foreign investors. The economies of the breakaway region are relatively small, but taken together, I think they form an attractive market with many investment opportunities. In recent years, it has been widely observed that the rate of penetrate foreign investment in our region is relatively small and largely reflects the process of privatising important public assets. The same thing happened to the Albanian economy. More specifically, during the period 2000 to 2006, foreign direct investments taken together, according to payment balance statistics, accounted for about USD 1.45 billion, about 3.5 percent of the PPB realized in the same period. If we were to identify the reasons why FDI flows are so modest, we could mention the complex problems that characterize our region, while even nationally there are various reasons that lower the suction capacity of our economy. ... 4/20 06/08/2022, 09:12 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, during the presentation of the Annual Report of the Bank of Albania ... There are various reasons, which lower the suction capacity of our economy. The Bank of Albania thinks that the current stage of the country's development creates great opportunities in this direction. The experience of newly-member countries has shown that the MSA's signature and the negotiations that follow it have been followed by high FDI flows. However, we cannot claim that this phenomenon will automatically be present in Albania. For this reason, the Bank of Albania considers that further deepening of structural reforms is necessary and that this process should be followed by improving the business climate as well as increasing the scale of law enforcement. As a last problem, but not the most insignificant, I would like to expose the still low rate of coverage of economic activity with statistical data. The monetary policy we are pursuing is a process that is dynamic and visionary. In addition to the existence of efficient markets, it also requires broad support with fresh and methodologically accurate statistical data. Despite our continued efforts and the understanding we have found at INSTAT, we see it necessary to appeal for greater attention of all relevant society and institutions in particular, in the direction of adding statistical information and further consolidating the existing one. The time has come for all monitoring, licensing, decision-making including and numerous nongovernmental organizations to They feel a greater responsibility in this direction. It is time for them to develop models of indirect assessment and measurement, for many of the demographic, economic, social and financial indicators. Let me already present another important issue of my word, which concerns one of the bank of Albania's main legal responsibilities, the stability of consumer prices. 2. Developments in inflation and monetary policy Inflation in consumer goods prices during 2006 has fluctuated in large part between the 2-3 percent interval limits. The year closed at an annual inflation rate of 2.5 percent. This value was close to average annual inflation of 2.4 percent, being the same as in 2005. Inflationary pressures, although moderately, have come to an increase during 2006. The average annual inflation rate climbed to 2.7 percent during the second six months of the year, up from 2.0 percent in the first half of the year. In general, the stability of average annual inflation over the past few years speaks of the sustainability of the inflation rate, regardless of time and size fluctuations, of the factors that have conditioned the performance of consumer prices. Developments on the demand and supply side of the economy have been balanced, creating no premise for inflationary pressures. Fiscal policy has respected annually programmed indicators, stabilizing the impact of the public sector component on aggregate demand. Likewise, monetary policy has controlled liquidity conditions, the development of interest rates and followed the course's performance, monitoring through them the financial incentives of economic activity. This latest factor may have contributed to curbing the effects of the second round, which could cause some of the shocks of the economy offer, faced by the Albanian economy, such as high oil prices and price increases managed. Monetary conditions and monetary policy decisions Monetary policy decisions for the basic interest rate in the economy have been undertaken on the basis of continued analyses of korean and expected developments, demand and supply factors, originating in the internal and external environment. Under conditions when a revival of inflationary pressures was evident and in the presence of a number of factors expected to further favour this situation, the Bank of Albania decided on a change in monetary policy policy at the beginning of the third quarter of 2006. This change came after a period of neutrality, lasting about 1.5 years. The change in monetary policy kahu materialized in two basic interest rate increases during the second six months of 2006. In July and November 2006, the rate of week-long repos increased by 0.25 percentage points respectively. The maturity in monetary policy decision-making found expression in the timely distancing of two austerity movements in interest rates. In the July-November 2006 period, continued assessments have been made on the response measure and sensitivity of the banking market to monetary policy stance on interest rates. The latter's total increase by 0.5 percentage points is estimated to have normalized the pace of annual growth in the money supply, responding more fully to demand for monetary means, on the part of public and private sectors. Monetary policy actions have helped to stabilise inflationary expectations of economic agents over the medium term. Fiscal policy The Bank of Albania estimates that during 2006, fiscal policy has satisfactorily supported developments in inflation. Fiscal indicators were realized within the limits of the budgetary programme, creating no premise for increasing inflationary pressures in the economy. During the fourth quarter of 2006, a high concentration of budgetary spending was established. The realization of the budget deficit at the end of the year, estimated at about 3.2 percent of GDP or 0.7 percentage points lower than a year ago, has affected shrinking inflationary pressures and controlling monetary expansion. Demand factors Domestic demand during 2006 has supported positive economic growth rhythms to a considerable extent. The good performance of domestic demand is reflected by a number of indicators of economic activity. Thus, the sales indicator for the first nine months of ... 6/20 06/08/2022, 09:12 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, during the presentation of the Annual Report of the Bank of Albania ... year, marked an annual increase of 12.4 percent. Specifically, increasing imports of machinery and equipment and increasing loans for real estate are indicative of the expansion of investments in the country. Domestic demand has also increased as a result of the rapid expansion of lending activity, which marked a 57 percent increase in annual terms. In addition to the positive effects of investment expansion, increasing domestic demand puts pressure on overall price level growth. In the absence of any apparent inflationary pressure on the demand side, it can be estimated that the Albanian economy is exploiting free capacities without increasing costs and consequently, the final prices of goods and services. It should also be stressed that part of this internal demand is met through rising imports and the trade deficit, easing pressure on consumer prices. Offer factors Import prices. The Albanian economy is a relatively open economy and, consequently, import prices constitute an important element of inflation in the country. Generally, during this year, the economic conditions of Albania's trading partners have been favourable, easing control of pressures on the supply side and enabling compliance with the inflation target. Oil prices. Consumer prices during 2006 were affected by the tense situation in the international market for the price of oil. The impact of this factor, in terms of the intensity of action on the inflation rate, was not simultaneous, being higher during the first nine months of the year and marking declines during the last quarter. Exchange rate. During 2006, developments in the exchange rate have supported weakening supply kah inflationary pressures. The local currency is overvalued against the US dollar and has maintained its position in relation to the euro unchanged. The lek's derogatory tendencies, although weakened in recent months, have caused the price of imports into the local currency to fall. In this way, the exchange rate has helped curb the effect of high oil prices on world markets and maintain a low inflation rate. Agricultural production. Agricultural production is one of the main internal factors, conditioning developments in consumer prices. The amount of local agricultural products immediately affects the level of prices of food goods. During 2006, the seasonal effect of increasing agricultural production has appeared more late than in previous years, causing the fall in food prices to be recorded only in September and October. Production prices. During 2006, production prices continued to follow the downward trend, noted since April 2005. However, the concentration of the manufacturing price index in the industry's manufacturing sector makes it difficult to compare it with the consumer price index. It is also estimated that the share of domestic production is not yet a degrading component of the supply of goods in the domestic market, thus not influencing consumer prices. Unemployment and wages. The good performance of economic activity during 2006 was also reflected in the ... 7/20 06/08/2022, 09:12 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, during the presentation of the Annual Report of the Bank of Albania ... labour market indicators, and mainly at the unemployment level. New employment opportunities were created, causing the unemployment rate to continue the observed downward trend of more than two years. Improvements have also been observed in the direction of income. Thus, wages in the state sector, minimum wage and pensions have undergone increases under the budget programme. The current performance of inflation shows that the Albanian economy does not suffer from significant discrepancies between wage growth and productivity. Inflationary expectations. Business and public expectations in short-term to medium-term terms have fluctuated around the facted levels of inflation. According to periodic estimates by the Bank of Albania, public expectations have, for the most part, converged on values 1 to 3 percent. Meanwhile, business expectations for price performance show a higher fluctuating. In anchoring the expectations of the general public towards the value of inflation targeted by the Bank of Albania, an important role has played monetary policy and consolidation of macroeconomic stability. 3. Developments in the cash offer During most of 2006, monetary indicators have reflected stabilized demand for monetary means. The average pace of M3 growth resulted in 12 percent. Demand for public sector money increased by only 3.3 percent during 2006. This borrowing, relatively low, has balanced high lending rhythms of the private sector, positively affecting the preservation of monetary stability. In line with the tendency observed over recent years, monetary developments have been characterized by the shift towards more long-term monetary means. Money performance outside banks has followed the general tendency of demand for money. The weight of money outside banks against the M3 at the end of the year, scored 24.2 percent or 1.7 percentage points less than a year ago. In nominal terms, money outside banks suffered increases of 13.6 billion dollars or 9.1 percent. The macroeconomic environment, during 2006, has been favourable for the steady growth of deposits in the money of the banking system. Positive rates of real interest have been associated with further increases in deposits in money. Deposits in money increased by 38 billion during 2006, meeting the needs of 35.9 billion dollars of the economy and government for loans in the national currency. In 2006, deposits in currencies increased by about 29.4 percent. The higher pace of deposit growth in currencies against the pace of monetary supply growth has led to about 29 percent ratio of foreign exchange deposits to M3. The weight of deposits in currencies against total deposits increased to 38.5 percent, compared to 35.5 percent in 2005. 4. Demand for money The expansion of demand for money peaked in December with an annual increase of 16.7 percent. The main contribution to increasing demand for money during the year has given the loan to the economy. This httpsk:// e/Fjala_eh_Guvedrnatkorit_te_dBahnkes_sebe_Sbhqipherjise_zeb_Ardian_jFullaebni_gijajite... i8/20 06/08/2022, 09:12 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, during the presentation of the Annual Report of the Bank of Albania ... The contribution marked its highest in June, coming to a fade in the following months, as well as as a result of increased public borrowing. The foreign currency position has maintained a relatively weight stable in creating monetary tools during the year. Credit to the economy The development of the banking system and the increase in the role of banks as financial mediators have brought significant expansion of lending activity in recent years. The loan portfolio reached 191.2 billion dollars, or 21.3 percent of GDP, at the end of 2006. The loan portfolio for the economy accounted for 31.3 percent of the banking system's total actives and about 37.4 percent of bank system deposits. In absolute terms, the loan to the economy increased by 69.3 billion dollars during 2006, compared to the 52 billion dollar increase during 2005. Over the past two years, commercial banks have better met the growing demand for loans in money. At the end of 2006, the loan in the money accounted for 29 percent of the loan portfolio, marking a moderate expansion in its weight. Credit for businesses makes up the main part of the banks' portfolio, reaching 66.5 percent of the total at the end of 2006. In annual terms, business credit increased by 52 percent. The distribution structure of this loan, according to use, has tried to become more uniform, compared to a year ago. Most of the credit for businesses (34.5 percent), is used to purchase equipment and machinery. While 23.2 percent of the business loan portfolio is used to finance investments to expand activities. Credit for individuals amounted to 7 percent of gross domestic product, in 2006, or 33.5 percent of the total loan portfolio. More than half of individuals' loans (59.3 percent) have been allocated for financing real estate purchases. While growth has also marked the financing of purchases of consumer goods. The ratio of consumer credit, in the total portfolio of individuals is 27.3 percent, up from 20 percent a year ago. In particular, consumer credit has seen noticeable increases in the characteristic months of summer holidays, as well as during the last months of the year, in the holiday period. Stopping at lending to particular sectors should be stressed that the trade sector remains the most credited by the banking system, with 22.4 percent of the loan portfolio. The loan to the construction sector presented curbs on growth rhythms during 2006. This sector presented temporary signs of improvement during the summer months, later returning to the falling pattern. Meanwhile, low lending of the agriculture sector shows ongoing structural problems, which hinder the lending of this sector. In the geographical distribution of the loan, it is noted that 68 per cent of the portfolio is concentrated in Tirana. Behind it are Durres and Vlora, with 8 and 4 percent of the loan portfolio, respectively. This shows the great economic importance of the Tirana area as well as the need for improving economic infrastructure in the rest of the country. ... 9/20 06/08/2022, 09:12 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, during the presentation of the Annual Report of the Bank of Albania ... Net currency tools The currency position of the banking system has improved during 2006. The banking system's net currency tools reached USD 2.4 billion at the end of this year, marking an annual increase of about USD 440 million. Government money demand The government's account showed an uncommon performance during 2006. For most of the year, the government's demand for money has been negative, focusing on planned domestic borrowing in the last two months of the year. The total deficit funding for 2006 resulted in about 22.6 billion dollars. 5. Financial market and interest rates 2006 is characterized by increased activity in the money market and capital market, while interest rate performance is generally oriented by the monetary policy of the Bank of Albania. Under liquidity surplus conditions, interest rates have had a falling tendency during the first half of the year. After signalling tightening monetary conditions in the second six months, interest rates have been on the rise. The interbank market was more active during 2006, providing a more effective way of managing excessive bank funds. The average daily volume of transactions reached 1.6 billion dollars or 0.2 billion dollars more than last year's average. The interbank market is characterized by narrowing interest rate differences according to discretions and positioning them close to the basic interest rate. The average spread between one-day and seven-day interests decreased to 0.7 percentage points in 2006, down from 1.6 percentage points in 2005. In the first half of 2006, there was a steady decrease in yields on treasury bonds and government bonds, as a result of the government's low demand for financing. In the second half of 2006, following the bank of Albania's stringent signals and increased liquidity demand in the system, there was a gradual increase in these yields. Compared to a year ago, the yields are up 0.83 percentage points, 0.45 percentage points and 0.98 percentage points respectively. Ardian Fullani, gjat prezantimit t Raportit Vjetor t Banks s Shqipris  tetor 2006, n Tiran, ku guvernatort e bankave qendrore t Rumanis, Serbis, Malit t Zi, Maqedonis, Bosnje-Hercegovins dhe Kosovs diskutuan n lidhje me stabilitetin financiar t rajonit. N kuadr t objektivit t Banks s Shqipris, pr t prfituar nga prvoja e bankave qendrore t Evrops Qendrore dhe Lindore, t antarsuara vitet e fundit n Sistemin Evropian t Bankave Qendrore (SEBQ), gjat vitit 2006, jan forcuar marrdhniet e bashkpunimit me Bankn Kombtare t Polonis, Bankn Kombtare eke dhe Bankn Kombtare Bullgare. Emisioni i monedhs Shtesa e monedhs n qarkullim, n vitin 2006, prej 14,7 miliard leksh, i sht prgjigjur zhvillimit t balancuar makroekonomik t vendit. Arktimet e parave t bankave t nivelit t dyt nga Banka e Shqipris gjat vitit 2006, u vrtetuan n nivelin e 105 miliard lekve, duke mbetur pothuaj n t njjtin nivel me vitin 2005. Prsa i prket pagesave n cash nga arkat e Banks s Shqipris pr bankat e nivelit t dyt, furnizimi sht realizuar sipas krkesave t paraqitura prej tyre dhe duke synuar n t njjtn koh mbajtjen e strukturs s monedhs n qarkullim n kufijt e projektuar, pr fundvitin 2006. Shpejtsia e qarkullimit t paras n vitin 2006, pr ciklin e shkurtuar t qarkullimit, n total rezultoi pothuaj n t njjtin nivel me vitin 2005. Megjithat, shpejtsia e qarkullimit pati ndryshime pr prerje t veanta t kartmonedhave dhe monedhave metalike. Kshtu, rritje e ndjeshme e shpejtsis s qarkullimit u vrtetua n kartmonedhat e prerjeve 5.000 lek, 1.000 lek dhe 500 lek, prkatsisht me 13,3 pr qind, 38,9 pr qind dhe 8,3 pr qind. Ndryshime n legjislacionin bankar Legjislacioni bankar gjat vitit 2006, n vijim edhe t nnshkrimit t Marrveshjes s Stabilizim Asociimit n dat 12.06.2006, ndryshoi dhe u prmirsua n mnyr thelbsore me hartimin dhe miratimin nga Kuvendi i Republiks s Shqipris t ligjit nr. 9662, dat 18.12.2006 "Pr bankat n Republikn e Shqipris"; ligj, i cili hyn n fuqi n 1 qershor 2007. Ligji "Pr bankat n Republikn e Shqipris" u mundson bankave t shteteve antare t Bashkimit Evropian si dhe t gjitha bankave t tjera t huaja, ofrimin e shrbimeve bankare n Shqipri nprmjet nj dege apo filiali t tyre, pa br asnj dallim ndrmjet kushteve pr licencimin e ktyre degve dhe filialeve, dhe kushteve pr licencimin e bankave shqiptare. Pr m tepr, n zbatim t dispozitave t MSA - s, ligji i miratuar parashikon trajtimin e tyre n ushtrimin e veprimtarive bankare dhe veprimtarive financiare pas licencimit, n t gjitha aspektet, si bank shqiptare. Pr t siguruar dhe forcuar mbrojtjen e depozituesve dhe investitorve, si dhe pr ruajtjen e stabilitetit t sistemit bankar, ligji i ri parashikon rregulla m t qart pr administrimin e rreziqeve, me t cilat mund t prballen bankat, gjat ushtrimit t veprimtaris s tyre. Duke marr n konsiderat kushtet aktuale t rritjes me ritme t shpejta t kredidhnies n sistemin https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_z_Ardian_Fullani_gjat 16/20 06/08/2022, 09:12 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Ardian Fullani, gjat prezantimit t Raportit Vjetor t Banks s Shqipris  bankar, ligji i ri trajton n mnyr m t plot dhe t detajuar, edhe lloje t tjera t rrezikut, t ndryshme nga rreziku i kredis, me t cilat mund t prballen bankat si dhe ekspozimet e lejuara t ktyre t fundit, kur prballen me kto rreziqe. Ndrmjet t tjerash, ligji parashikon pr her t par, krijimin dhe mbajtjen nga Banka e Shqipris t Regjistrit t Kredive. Qllimi i ngritjes s ktij regjistri, n kushtet e nj zhvillimi t vrullshm t aktivitetit t kredidhnies, sht t ndihmoj bankat pr t marr vendime t mirinformuara kur u japin kredi klientve t tyre, si dhe t forcoj mbikqyrjen e Banks s Shqipris mbi sistemin bankar shqiptar. Gjat vitit 2006, Banka e Shqipris ka nisur studimin e parakushteve dhe kushteve t zbatimit n nj periudh afatmesme (viti 2009), t nj regjimi t ri t politiks monetare. N kt kontekst, jan shqyrtuar mundsit e prmirsimit t infrastrukturs ligjore pr krijimin e ktyre kushteve, n prputhje me standardet ndrkombtare n kt fush. Gjithashtu, sht studiuar mundsia e prmirsimit t ligjit organik t Banks s Shqipris, i cili prkon me parashikimin e ndryshimit t tij si prioritet afatmesm n Planin Kombtar pr Zbatimin e MSA - s. Kto ndryshime, parashikohet t prcaktojn kompetenca dhe procedura t qarta n lidhje me procesin e vendimmarrjes s Banks s Shqipris si dhe n lidhje me transparencn e ktij procesi, far prbn dhe nj nga parakushtet thelbsore pr hartimin dhe zbatimin e nj politike monetare efektive. N kuadrin e reforms ligjore, t ndrmarr nga Ministria e Drejtsis pr ndryshimin dhe prmirsimin e Kodit t Procedurs Civile, Banka e Shqipris sht angazhuar plotsisht n bashkpunimin me sektorin bankar, pr plotsimin dhe saktsimin e procedurave t ekzekutimit t detyrueshm, t titujve ekzekutiv. Propozimet e Banks s Shqipris, kan patur pr qllim prmirsimin e bazs ligjore, lidhur me zbatimin e procedurave pr ekzekutimin e akteve, t cilat prbjn tituj ekzekutiv. Qllim kryesor, mbetet shkurtimi i kohs s ekzekutimit t ktyre akteve me qllim rritjen e siguris n zhvillimin e aktivitetit t kredidhnies, duke ulur rrezikun e kredis me t cilin prballen bankat. N fund t vitit 2006, Banka e Shqipris ka bashkpunuar ngushtsisht me Ministrin e Financave, gjat procesit t hartimit t projektligjit "Pr parandalimin e pastrimit t parave dhe financimin e terrorizmit". Banka e Shqipris, si autoriteti mbikqyrs i sistemit bankar, e shikon me prparsi prmirsimin e kuadrit ligjor pr parandalimin e prdorimit t sistemit bankar, pr pastrimin e parave t rrjedhura nga aktivitetet kriminale dhe pasurive prej tij, n prputhje me direktivat e Bashkimit Evropian n kt fush dhe me rekomandimet e tjera ndrkombtare. Kt vit u prfundua me sukses me asistencn e Banks Botrore, hartimi dhe plotsimi i kuadrit rregullativ pr administrimin e rezervs valutore, duke rishikuar politikn e Banks s Shqipris pr administrimin e ksaj rezerve, kriteret dhe kushtet e administrimit si dhe decentralizimin e kompetencave vendimmarrse, gjat ktij procesi. httpsK://www.banllkiofialbbania.odrg/Shhtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_z_Ardian_Fullani_gjat 17/20 06/08/2022, 09:12 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Ardian Fullani, gjat prezantimit t Raportit Vjetor t Banks s Shqipris  Kontrolli i brendshm N vitin 2006 jan realizuar 44 audite dhe 3 procedura verifikimi. Nga auditet e ushtruara, inspektort paraqitn 269 gjetje dhe dhan 197 rekomandime. Auditet u kryen n Bankn e Shqipris, prfshir 5 degt e saj n rrethe si dhe njsin e Shtypshkronjs. 11. Bilanci i Banks s Shqipris Gjat vitit 2006, totali i aktiveve t Banks s Shqipris u rrit m tej, duke regjistruar nivelin 255,5 miliard lek, rreth 14 pr qind m i lart se ai i fundvitit 2005. Rritje pasqyrojn t dyja grupet prbrse, si aktivet e huaja ashtu edhe ato vendase, ndrkoh q grupi i par z rreth 68 pr qind t totalit t aktiveve, nivel ky i njjt me vitin e kaluar. N krahun e pasiveve, detyrimet e huaja kan nj rnie t leht (nga 8 n 7 pr qind t totalit) krahasuar me nj vit m par, ndrsa detyrimet vendase kan psuar rritje n masn 16 pr qind. Paraja n qarkullim sht treguesi q ka peshn kryesore n kt rritje (rreth 45 pr qind t rritjes), i pasuar nga zri i "detyrimeve ndaj qeveris" (rreth 29 pr qind t rritjes) dhe zri "detyrime ndaj bankave" (rreth 26 pr qind t rritjes). N prgjithsi, bilanci kontabl i Banks s Shqipris dhe pasqyra e t ardhurave dhe shpenzimeve, reflektojn disa nga zhvillimet baz q jan regjistruar n ekonomi, ku Banka e Shqipris ka nj rol t rndsishm. T ardhurat e realizuara gjat vitit 2006, tejkalojn nivelin e para nj viti, vetm me rreth 5 pr qind. Ndikimin kryesor n kt rritje e kan t ardhurat nga interesat n valut (rreth 20 pr qind m shum se viti 2005). Kjo reflekton ecurin e normave t interesit n tregjet e huaja valutore. Ky efekt absorbon rnien n zrin "t ardhura nga interesat n lek" (rreth 7 pr qind m pak se viti 2005), q pasqyron nj norm mesatare t interesit posht asaj t vitit 2005, megjith tendencn n rritje gjat fundit t vitit. Nga ana tjetr, shpenzimet pr interesa tejkalojn nivelin e para nj viti me rreth 25 pr qind, duke reflektuar fenomenet pozitive t rritjes s nivelit t depozitave dhe gjendjes s likuiditetit n sistemin bankar. Shpenzimet pr interesat n valut jan tejkaluar n masn rreth 64 pr qind krahasuar nj vit m par, ndrsa pr interesat n lek kemi rritje t shpenzimeve n masn rreth 14 pr qind. Shpenzimet e tjera (operative dhe amortizimi) kapin nj shum pothuajse t njjt me at t vitit t mparshm. N prfundim, kompensimi pothuajse i plot mes rritjes s t ardhurave dhe rritjes s shpenzimeve financiare, bn q fitimi neto i Banks s Shqipris pr vitin 2006, t paraqitet n nivel t njjt me vitin e kaluar, n masn rreth 5,16 miliard lek (ose 99.6 pr qind e fitimit t realizuar gjat vitit 2005). * * * https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_z_Ardian_Fullani_gjat 18/20 06/08/2022, 09:12 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Ardian Fullani, gjat prezantimit t Raportit Vjetor t Banks s Shqipris  T nderuar deputet, N prfundim t fjals time, do t dshiroja t theksoja se Banka e Shqipris gjat vitit 2006 ka prfshir n axhendn e saj t gjitha rekomandimet e lna nga Kuvendi i Shqipris, n rezolutn e miratuar prej tij m dat 25 maj 2006. Po kshtu, dshiroj t'ju siguroj se e njjta filozofi do t karakterizoj punn ton edhe gjat vitit 2007. Duke kuptuar drejt rolin dhe misionin e insitucionit ton, n emr t Kshillit Mbikqyrs t Banks s Shqipris, deklaroj se Banka e Shqipris do t vazhdoj t mbetet nj institucion i prgjegjshm, thellsisht e angazhuar n prmbushjen e detyrimeve q rrjedhin nga Kushtetuta dhe Ligji. Prioritetet tona gjat vitit 2007 jan t shumta por m lejoni t prmend ato m t rndsishmet:  Ruajtja e stabilitetit t mimeve t konsumit mbetet objektivi kryesor ligjor i Banks s Shqipris. Ne jemi t bindur se vendimet e marra n vitin 2006 ishin t prshtatshme dhe ato kan shrbyer pr t orientuar pritjet inflacioniste brenda intervalit t vendosur si objektiv. Ndrkoh q, bazuar n filozofin ton t vshtrimit nga e ardhmja ne do t vlersojm me kujdes t gjith faktort e rrezikut, n mnyr q t veprojm n momentin e prshtatshm dhe n intensitetin e duhur.  Stabiliteti makroekonomik sht i nj rndsie parsore por pa dyshim, q i nj rndsie kaq jetike sht dhe stabiliteti financiar. Pr nga rndsia dhe pr nga momenti n t cilin ndodhet zhvillimi ekonomiko-financiar i vendit, ky prioritet merr nj rndsi t jashtzakonshme. Pr m tepr, shtimi i shpejt i kredis prbn nj argument pr m shum kujdes, veanrisht n drejtim t cilsis s saj. Duke qen plotsisht t ndrgjegjshm pr rolin ton si institucion vendimmarrs dhe rregullues njkohsisht, kemi vendosur q t rrisim vigjilencn n kt drejtim dhe si hap t par, do t krijojm nj njsi t specializuar, Departamentin e Stabilitetit Financiar.  Banka e Shqipris, edhe nj her thekson objektivin e saj pr konsolidimin e mtejshm t sistemit bankar. Ky proces, i cili ishte i pranishm gjat vitit 2006, duhet t vazhdohet m tej gjat vitit n vazhdim. Ne do t synojm q sistemi bankar t jet bashksi e institucioneve t shndosha: q mbshteten nga aksioner t fuqishm dhe me prvoj n industrin bankare; q zbatojn standardet m t mira t prgjegjshmris n drejtim; q realizojn nj veprimtari t ekuilibruar me rreziqe t miradministruara; q jan n gjendje t prballojn dhe t zhvillohen n kushtet e konkurrencs q ofron nj treg i hapur dhe i integruar n tregun financiar ndrkombtar; q mbshtesin zhvillimin e ekonomis s vendit dhe q, n mnyr transparente, i ofrojn publikut shrbime dhe produkte bankare cilsore dhe eficiente. Dshiroj t falenderoj edhe nj her Kuvendin e Shqipris pr shkalln e mirkuptimit dhe mbshtetjen e vazhdueshme, q i ka dhn Banks s Shqipris. The integral analysis of economic indicators suggests recovering the pace of economic growth, close to its potential level. This behaviour has been dictated by private sector development and favoured by adequate macroeconomic conditions and macrofinancial sustainability. In this context, rapid expansion of lending is the main source of support for the economy with funds and as a driver of consumption and investment growth in the country. As an encouraging sign for the future, these developments have not conveyed excessive stresses at the level of inflation or other indicators of economic and financial stability. In particular, the positive role that monetary policy has played was evident through rising interest rates in due time and measure; through adequate liquidity management and through the development of the monetary market expansion. Of course, these talks, as discussions that relate to and directly affect a country's economic policies, were oriented from the future. Their fundamental objective was and remains the company in time for appropriate political responses, to preserve and further strengthen the country's long-term development prospects. ... dian_Fullani_gjate_konferences_per_shtyp_me_Misionin_e_FMN-se.html Page 1 of 3 Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word during press conference with IMF Mission 29/07/22, 14:54 The Bank of Albania's vision for the future is characterized by positive expectations, although recent developments have increased the tone of caution, strengthening our readiness scale, to take the necessary measures to guarantee economic stability and economic growth in the long term. The main development factors remain in place for the future period. The growth of the private sector, especially in the services sector, and macroeconomic stability will be complemented by further structural and infrastructural reforms, and must be accompanied by continued efforts to improve the business climate. In the medium term, these initiatives should raise the profile of the Albanian economy, bearing the scale of dependence on imports, the absorption of long-term sustainable capital and their orientation towards the priority sectors of the economy. The Bank of Albania gladly states that the rhetoric often used in relation to this programme, as a maturity programme for the Albanian economy and institutions, is followed by concrete actions, in a large part of the institutions involved. On its side, the Bank of Albania has taken a series of steps to empower analytical and decision-making capacities in the field of monetary policy, adopting a modern physionominin in this area, as an institutional guarantee for inflation control within the target level. Together with initiatives taken to develop the financial market and empower its supervisory function, these steps have been concreted into measures vulnerable to the financial market and the economy. To expand the tones of care mentioned above, let me cite more clearly some of the main risks identified and to address measures designed by the Bank of Albania. The above economic picture, widely reflected in the bank's periodic contacts with the public, is also complemented by our concerns about potential risks that could affect the stability of the prizes and the monetary one. Without wanting to comment on the details, I would mention: KESH's heavy financial situation, with its implications for budget indicators and production costs; the high level of domestic demand, which directly affects the increase in prizes and the expansion of the trade deficit; high rates of credit growth; the continued tightening of monetary policy in the Eurozone and its impact in Albanian financial markets; As a reason to reconsider the appropriateness of current monetary conditions in the country, with the objective of preserving inflation within the Bank of Albania's target. Also, the Bank of Albania is prioritising the impacts that the above factors have, especially the rapid growth of credit, on the financial stability of the system. In this context, it is considering the possibility of applying a package of regulatory measures, based on the experience of the countries of the region. Finally, I would like to stress that the priority of particular importance was considered the need for further consolidation of the banking system. Ardian Fullani gjat konferencs pr shtyp me Misionin e FMN-s Data e publikimit: 08.05.2007 N mbyllje t bisedimeve intensive t dy javve t shkuara me Misionin e FMN-s dhe Ministrin e Financave, t finalizuara me nj mirkuptim t prgjithshm pr shtjet kryesore t diskutuara, n vijim t deklarats prmbyllse t Misionit t FMN-s dhe t mesazheve t lna nga Ministri i Financave, m lejoni edhe mua t shpreh disa mendime n emr t Banks s Shqipris. Analiza integrale e treguesve ekonomik sugjeron pr rekuperim t ritmit t rritjes ekonomike, afr nivelit t tij potencial. Kjo sjellje sht diktuar nga zhvillimi i sektorit privat dhe sht favorizuar nga kushtet e prshtatshme makroekonomike dhe nga qndrueshmria makrofinanciare. N kt kontekst, zgjerimi i shpejt i kreditimit spikat si burimi kryesor i mbshtetjes s ekonomis me fonde dhe si nxits i rritjes s konsumit dhe t investimeve n vend. Si nj shenj inkurajuese pr t ardhmen, kto zhvillime nuk kan prcjell strese t teprta n nivelin e inflacionit apo t treguesve t tjer t stabilitetit ekonomik dhe financiar. N vecanti, u evidentua roli pozitiv q ka luajtur politika monetare nprmjet rritjes, n kohn dhe n masn e duhur, t normave t interesit; nprmjet administrimit t prshtatshm t likuiditetit dhe nprmjet zhvillimit e zgjerimit t tregut monetar. Natyrisht q kto bisedime, si diskutime q lidhen dhe prekin direkt politikat ekonomike t nje vendi, u orientuan nga e ardhmja. Objektivi i tyre themelor, ishte dhe mbetet ndrmarrja n koh e prgjigjeve t duhura politike, pr t ruajtur e pr t forcuar m tej perspektivat e afatgjata t zhvillimit t vendit. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjdian_Fullani_gjate_konferences_per_shtyp_me_Misionin_e_FMN-se.html Pagina 1 di 3 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris z. Ardian Fullani gjat konferencs pr shtyp me Misionin e FMN-s 29/07/22, 14:54 Vizioni i Banks s Shqipris pr t ardhmen, karakterizohet nga pritshmri pozitive, ndonse zhvillimet e fundit kan rritur tonet e kujdesit, duke prforcuar shkalln ton t gatishmris, pr t marr masat e nevojshme pr t garantuar stabilitetin ekonomik dhe rritjen ekonomike, n nj periudh afatgjat. Faktort kryesor t zhvillimit mbeten n vend edhe pr periudhn e ardhme. Rritja e sektorit privat, veanrisht n sektorin e shrbimeve, dhe stabiliteti makroekonomik do te plotsohen nga reforma t mtejshme strukturore dhe infrastrukturore, dhe duhet t shoqrohen nga prpjekje t vazhdueshme pr prmirsimin e klims s biznesit. N nj periudh afatmesme, kto nisma duhet t ngren profilin e ekonomis shqiptare, duke rulur shkalln e varsis ndaj importeve, thithjes s kapitaleve t qndrueshme afatgjata dhe orientimin e tyre drejt sektorve prioritar t ekonomis. Banka e Shqipris konstaton me knaqsi se retorika e prdorur shpesh n lidhje me kt program, si nj program maturimi pr ekonomin dhe pr institucionet shqiptare, sht pasuar nga aksione konkrete, n nj pjes t madhe t institucioneve t prfshira. N ann e saj, Banka e Shqipris ka ndrmarr nj sr hapash pr fuqizimin e kapaciteteve analizuese dhe vendimmarse n fushn e politiks monetare, duke adoptuar nj fizionomi moderne n kt fush, si nj garanci institucionale pr kontrollin e inflacionit brenda nivelit t synuar. S bashku me nismat e marra pr zhvillimin e tregut financiar dhe fuqizimin e funksionit t saj mbikqyrs, kta hapa jan konkretizuar n masa t prekshme pr tregun financiar dhe ekonomin. Pr t zgjeruar tonet e kujdesit t prmendur m sipr, me lejoni t citoj m qart disa prej rreziqeve kryesore t identifikuara dhe t shtjelloj masat e projektuara nga Banka e Shqipris. Tabloja e msiprme ekonomike, e pasqyruar gjersisht n kontaktet periodike t Banks s Shqris me publikun, sht plotsuar edhe me shqetsimet tona pr rreziqet potenciale q mund t cnojn stabilitetin e cmimeve dhe at monetar. Pa dashur t shtjelloj n detaje, do t prmendja: situatn e rnduar financiare t KESH-it, me implikimet q ka ajo pr treguesit buxhetor dhe pr kostot e prodhimit; nivelin elart t krkess s brendshme, e cila ndikon direkt n rritjen e cmimeve dhe n zgjerimin e deficitit tregtar; ritmet e larta t rritjes s kredis; shtrngimin e vazhdueshm t politiks monetare n Eurozon dhe impaktin e saj n tregjet financiare shqiptare; si arsye t qensishme pr t rikonsideruar prshtatshmrin e kushteve monetare aktuale n vend, me objektivin e ruajtjes s inflacionit brenda objektivit t Banks s Shqipris. Gjithashtu, Banka e Shqipris sht duke vlersuar me prioritet ndikimet q kan faktort e msiprm, vecanrisht rritja e shpejt e kredis, n stabilitetin financiar t sistemit. N kt kontekst, ajo sht duke shqyurtar mundsin e aplikimit t nj pakete masash rregullatore, bazuar edhe n eksperiencn e vendeve t rajonit. S fundi, dshiroj t theksoj se prparsi e rndsis s veant, u konsiderua nevoja pr konsolidimin e mtejshm t sistemit bankar. I'm more than honored for the appreciation I'm getting today. Of course, every man expects to be evaluated one day in his work. Moments of appreciation have not been lacking in my career, but I never thought another nation would honor me with his faith. In my life a few times I've felt so excited and so motivated. However, I will try to express in simple words the deep gratitude and high honor I have, for the President of the Italian Republic, his excellency, Mr. Napolitano. To be one of the elected, for 6 decades honoured with the Star of Italian Solidarity, by the prominent presidents of Italy, the cradle of European civilization, makes me feel proud and completely obliged in my devotion. Despite the emotions of this moment, from the bottom of my heart comes a special thank you to Italy's Foreign Minister, Mr. D'Alema, and for the distinguished diplomat.  monine_e_dekorimit_nga_Presidenti_Italian_z_Giorgio_Napolitano.html Page 1 of 2 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the decoration ceremony by the Italian President, Mr. Giorgio Napolitano 29/07/22, 15:00 And the friend of Albania, Mr. Januci. Of course, I have long share efforts and achievements in the development of the Albanian banking system and economy. On a day like this, I want to thank all those who, with their co-operation, support and presence in my career, have added confidence in me to success. A special place, of course belongs to my family, which with love and patience, has happened to me nearby, on good and difficult days. I think for all my friends, colleagues, relatives, present or not in this lobby, this is a landmark moment. I'm happy to share this great event in my life with you. Ambassador Iannucci, Gratefully accepting this decoration, I want to assure you that my work and efforts, in the direction of deepening co-operation and solidarity with the friendly country Italy, will be continuous. It is not too much to say, to strengthen friendship, mutual respect, gratitude and human understanding among peoples is itself a noble mission. At these moments I remember a wise word: "Friendship for humanity is like the sun for flowers. He keeps feeding them to see how they flourish." In ancient philosophy, accepting honor from a prominent nation nobles you. I accept this appreciation with deep gratitude and respect for the President of the Republic of Italy and the Italian people. Amicitiae nostrae memoriam spero sempiternam fore - I hope that the memory of our friendship will be everlasting.
