BANK OF ALBANIA Presentations by the GOVERNOR , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the Forum organised by the Bank of Albania, in co-operation with the World Bank "Tendencies in currency reserve management" 29 October 2007, hotel "Tirana International" Publication date: 29.10.2007 Honorable gentlemen,  1/5 06/08/2022, 09:13 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the Forum organised by the Bank of Albania, together... It is a great honour for me to welcome you to this forum that the Bank of Albania has organised in co-operation with the World Bank. The aim of this meeting is to create the opportunity to discuss today's trends in the field of currency reserve management on the part of central banks. If we refer to Nugee 2000, a country's currency reserves represent a part of national wealth. As the administrator of this wealth, central banks are accountable to the public. The currency tools held in favour of the third always mean a high obligation of trust. Starting from this, the Bank of Albania built with the World Bank, a bilateral, institutional relationship for modern currency reserve management. What made this initiative more important is the change in the concept of the role of the currency reserve, its holding and management by the central bank after the 1990s. The classic concept of the currency reserve as a buffer to the sudden developments of the exchange rate changed to a security valve to the interruptions of capital inflows and the exchange rate shocks that accompany it. This is even because radical changes in capital account liberalisation developed the flow of capital between different countries, as well as the change in exchange rate regimes from fixed or less fluctuating, to Totally free. In this way, developed countries followed with an increasing trend in currency reserves and developing countries, passed from countries with net foreign debt to countries with net currency tools. In recent years, there has been a significant increase in currency reserves managed by central banks around the world. Starting in 2000, these reserves more than doubled in size, reaching US5.1 trillion at the end of 2006. This galloping increase in the level of foreign exchange reserves has been accompanied by a shift in focus from meeting only liquidity and capital storage targets, in an approach aimed at managing the reserve even deliberately, reducing the opportune cost created by holding reserves. The implementation of this approach is closely related to the preliminary definition of that level of currency reserve, which is assessed as sufficient to meet the central bank's main objective. In today's practice, some indicators are used to assess the sufficiency of reserves, to decide later, which part of them can be dedicated to active management. I would like to take this opportunity to say some words regarding the experience the Bank of Albania has created in the field of currency reserve management. With the creation of the Bank of Albania in 1992, currency reserves under management were about US2m, while today they amount to about US2 billion. 2006 marked the beginning of a new era in currency reserve management. Initially, https:i/whwiwk.ibanikoifalblania.orig/Sbhtypai/Fjalime_intellrvisita_artliikdujh/Speeches/Fjala_ee_Guveernatorit_tde_Bainkies_sie_Sihqipeerise_z_Ardeian_Fulllani_ne_FoN... 2/5 06/08/2022, 09:13 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the Forum organised by the Bank of Albania, together... full revision of the regulatory basis regarding the way currency reserves are administered. In This framework, the Supervisory Council adopted two important regulations, that of the "Policy of investment" and regulation on "Functions of management structures within the framework of the process of reserve management." Compared to the previous regulation, in the new investment policy The objectives that will guide the currency reserve investment process are clearly formulated. This has enabled sufficient level optimization of reserves and the promotion of spaces for active management. More specifically, the liquidity-related target is based on the availability of a sufficient currency reserve fund for purpose: covering the country's import needs; coverage of currency payments for short-term debt write-offs; support of monetary policy and that of the exchange rate; creating confidence in the economy, serving as a means of covering needs in times of crisis. In our practice, the implementation of the liquidity target was carried out through the organization of the currency reserve in some tranches, which will serve to meet liquidity needs, in accordance with their maturity deadline. Taking into consideration this reserve division and the approved criteria, in terms of return from investment and level of risk tolerance, each of the reserve portfolios is selected a landmark portfolio. As a result, the current net reserve structure with circulatory capital, liquidity and investment trance reflects increased aggressiveness, in terms of return and risk, moving from the first transhi to the latter. The regulation on the functions of the management structures was designed with the aim of specifying the role and responsibilities of the Supervisory Council and the Investment Committee, as far as decision-making is concerned within the reserve management process. This regulation defines a decision-making structure organized on two levels, where the Supervisory Council sets the basic criteria under which the investment process is carried out, while the Investment Committee has the responsibility of converting these criteria into landmark portfolios and limits on the degree of risk allowed. The Investment Committee already represents a more active structure in the management process. This committee is responsible for the annual revision of the strategic landmark and must make a decision, based on a careful review and assessment of market expectations scenarios for the performance of the world's most developed economies. This and other investment committee decisions in terms of active management, distribution of permitted risk and restrictions imposed on the company of various risks are determined in a particular document, adopted by this committee. The above decision-making structure is assessed as more effective, as it creates the flexibility required during the investment process to adapt in time to dynamic developments in financial markets. In this way, the opportunities created are achieved to the maximum and any risk is avoided in time, beyond that permitted.  3/5 06/08/2022, 09:13 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the Forum organised by the Bank of Albania, together... The consolidation of this decision-making structure must necessarily be associated with the creation of an investment culture, which is very important, for a full and accurate assessment of risks and for a more effective decision-making in the future. The development of this culture, in addition to a clear division and delegation of responsibilities, presumes and the creation of conditions for a continuous education of staff and the cultivation of the spirit of teamwork. Investment policy is the document that guides and supports the investment process and the selection of the strategic landmark, represents its main part. This is as more than 90 percent of the return on the portfolio from the investment is determined by the relevant landmark, which is the result of the strategic landmark selection process. The rest of the return is determined by the space allowed for the enterprise of risks during active management. Successful active management is indicative of the very good skills, first in assessing the opportunities the market offers for profit and secondly, in the accurate analysis of the risks they carry. Finally, I would like to take a little longer to say some words on the excellent co-operation we have had during this time with the World Bank. It has already been two years since the Bank of Albania engaged in an agreement for management and consultancy with the World Bank, with the aim of receiving technical assistance for establishing a higher degree of functions, which the Bank of Albania carries out within the framework of reserve management activity. During this 2-year period, the Department for Partnership Affairs in Sovereign Investments at the World Bank offered highly valuable assistance and technical expertise in all aspects related to currency reserve management activity at a central bank. This co-operation has been particularly fruitful for the creation and development of professional staff skills working for currency reserve management. Very soon, we will launch an important project dealing with the purchase and implementation of a system, which will be used for the management of the currency reserve. We are all aware of the importance of creating a good information technology infrastructure, in the service of meeting the needs for managing the risks that arise during the investment process. In addition, our plans for the near future include the selection and contracting of external managers, through whom the maximization of insured income for the same level of permissive risk will be targeted. I believe that this seminar will clarify some questions, which flow naturally nowadays: Modern currency reserve management, the transition from passive management to active one, in my personal opinion requires a complete and clear concept on the currency reserve and the way it is administered. He asks: clear and responsible structures; accountability and transparency; organic links between participating entities and interested groups; high information technology and above all PROFESSIONALISM.  4/5 06/08/2022, 09:13 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the Forum organised by the Bank of Albania, together... Thanking once again the World Bank for committed to organising this forum, I would like to see some of the most spicy issues such as: Why do central banks hold currency reserves? How much should the optimal level be and how does it match recent trends? What does active management mean and how do we optimize the risk that accompanies it? How does their level rise and the costs that accompany it? What are the decision-making structures and what does strategic allocation of currency tools mean? I could go on with a range of other questions. However, I consider it reasonable that the turn has now come to the technicians. I invite you to follow the presentations of World Bank experts who will refer to us today. Thank you!  5/5

Ardian Fullani, n Forumin e organizuar nga Banka e Shqipris, n bashk sht nj nder i madh pr mua t'ju uroj mirseardhjen n kt forum q Banka e Shqipris ka organizuar n bashkpunim me Bankn Botrore. Qllimi i ktij takimi sht t krijoj mundsin pr t diskutuar mbi prirjet e sotme n fushn e administrimit t rezervs valutore nga ana e bankave qendrore. Po t'i referohemi Nugee 2000, rezervat valutore t nj vendi prfaqsojn nj pjes t pasuris kombtare. Si administruese t ksaj pasurie, bankat qendrore jan t prgjegjshme ndaj publikut. Mjetet valutore t mbajtura n favor t t tretve gjithmon nnkuptojn nj detyrim t lart besimi. Nisur nga kjo, Banka e Shqipris ndrtoi me Bankn Botrore, nj marrdhnie dypalshe, institucionale pr administrimin modern t rezervs valutore. Ajo q e bri m t rndsishme kt iniciativ sht edhe ndryshimi i konceptit t rolit t rezervs valutore, t mbajtjes dhe administrimit t saj nga banka qendrore, pas viteve 90. Koncepti klasik i rezervs valutore si amortizator ndaj zhvillimeve t papritura t kursit t kmbimit, ndryshoi n nj valvul sigurie ndaj ndrprerjeve t hyrjeve kapitale dhe goditjeve t kursit t kmbimit q e shoqrojn at. Kjo edhe sepse ndryshimet rrnjsore n liberalizimin e llogaris kapitale zhvilluan pa mas rrjedhjen e kapitaleve midis vendeve t ndryshme, si dhe ndryshimin e regjimeve t kursit t kmbimit nga t fiksuara apo m pak t luhatshme, n totalisht t lira. N kt mnyr, vendet e zhvilluara vijuan me nj prirje n rritje t rezervave valutore dhe vendet n zhvillim, kaluan nga vende me borxh t jashtm neto n vende me mjete valutore neto. Kto vitet e fundit sht vrejtur nj rritje e ndjeshme e rezervave valutore q administrohen nga bankat qendrore n t gjith botn. Duke filluar nga viti 2000, kto rezerva jan m shum se dyfishuar n madhsi, duke arritur n 5.1 trilion dollar amerikan, n fund t vitit 2006. Kjo rritje galopante n nivelin e rezervave valutore sht shoqruar me nj zhvendosje t fokusit nga plotsimi vetm i objektivave t lidhur me likuiditetin dhe ruajtjen e kapitalit, n nj prqasje q synon administrimin e rezervs edhe me qllim, zvoglimin e kostos oportune t krijuar nga mbajtja e rezervave. Zbatimi i ksaj prqasjeje sht i lidhur ngusht me prcaktimin paraprak t atij niveli t rezervs valutore, q vlersohet si i mjaftueshm pr plotsimin e objektivit kryesor t banks qendrore. N praktikn e sotme prdoren disa tregues pr t vlersuar mjaftueshmrin e rezervave, pr t vendosur m pas, se cila pjes e tyre mund t'i dedikohet nj administrimi aktiv. Do t dshiroja t prfitoja nga ky rast pr t thn disa fjal lidhur me prvojn q Banka e Shqipris ka krijuar n fushn e administrimit t rezervs valutore. Me krijimin e Banks s Shqipris, n vitin 1992, rezervat valutore nn administrim ishin rreth 2 milion dollar amerikan, ndrsa sot ato arrijn n rreth 2 miliard dollar. Viti 2006 shnoi fillimin e nj ere t re n administrimin e rezervs valutore. Fillimisht, u realizua https:i//whwiwk.ibanikoifalblania.orig/Sbhtypi/Fjalime_intellrvisita_artliikdujh/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_tde_Bainkies_sie_Sihqiperise_z_Ardian_Fulllani_ne_FoN 2/5 06/08/2022, 09:13 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Ardian Fullani, n Forumin e organizuar nga Banka e Shqipris, n bashk rishikimi i plot i bazs rregullative lidhur me mnyrn e administrimit t rezervs valutore. N kt kuadr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs miratoi dy rregullore t rndsishme, at t "Politiks s investimit" dhe rregulloren mbi "Funksionet e strukturave drejtuese n kuadr t procesit t administrimit t rezervs". Krahasuar me rregulloren paraardhse, n politikn e re t investimit formulohen mjaft qart objektivat q do t udhheqin procesin e investimit t rezervs valutore. Kjo ka mundsuar nj optimizim t nivelit t mjaftueshm t rezervave dhe evidentimin e hapsirave pr nj administrim aktiv. M konkretisht, objektivi q lidhet me likuiditetin bazohet n disponueshmrin e nj fondi t mjaftueshm t rezervave valutore me qllim:  mbulimin e nevojave t vendit pr importe;  mbulimin e pagesave n valut pr shlyerjen e borxhit afatshkurtr;  mbshtetjen e politiks monetare dhe asaj t kursit t kmbimit;  krijimin e besimit n ekonomi, duke shrbyer si mjet pr mbulimin e nevojave n periudha krize. N praktikn ton, vnia n zbatim e objektivit t likuiditetit u realizua prmes organizimit t rezervs valutore n disa transhe, t cilat do t'i shrbejn prmbushjes s nevojave pr likuiditete, n prputhje me afatin e tyre t maturimit. Duke marr n konsiderat kt ndarje t rezervs dhe kriteret e miratuara, prsa i takon kthimit nga investimi dhe nivelit t tolerancs ndaj rrezikut, pr secilin nga portofolet e rezervs przgjidhet nj portofol benchmark. Si rezultat, struktura aktuale e rezervs neto me transhet e kapitalit qarkullues, t likuiditetit dhe t investimit, reflekton nj agresivitet n rritje, n terma t kthimit dhe t rrezikut, duke kaluar nga transhi i par tek ai i fundit. Rregullorja mbi funksionet e strukturave drejtuese u hartua me synim specifikimin e rolit dhe t prgjegjsive t Kshillit Mbikqyrs dhe t Komitetit t Investimit, prsa i takon vendimmarrjes n kuadr t procesit t administrimit t rezervs. Kjo rregullore prcakton nj struktur vendimmarrse t organizuar n dy nivele, ku Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendos kriteret baz sipas t cilave realizohet procesi i investimit, ndrsa Komiteti i Investimit ka prgjegjsin e konvertimit ("prkthimit") t ktyre kritereve n portofole benchmark dhe kufizime n shkalln e rrezikut t lejuar. Komiteti i Investimit tashm prfaqson nj struktur m aktive n procesin e administrimit. Ky komitet sht prgjegjs pr rishikimin e prvitshm t benchmark-ut strategjik dhe duhet t marr nj vendim, q bazohet n nj shqyrtim dhe vlersim t kujdesshm t skenarve t pritjeve t tregut pr ecurin e ekonomive m t zhvilluara t bots. Ky dhe vendime t tjera t Komitetit t Investimit prsa i takon administrimit aktiv, shprndarjes s rrezikut t lejuar dhe kufizimeve t vendosura n ndrmarrjen e rreziqeve t ndryshme prcaktohen n nj dokument t veant, t miratuar nga ky komitet. Struktura e msiprme e vendimmarrjes vlersohet si m efektive, pasi ajo krijon fleksibilitetin e krkuar gjat procesit t investimit pr t'iu prshtatur n koh zhvillimeve dinamike n tregjet financiare. N kt mnyr, arrihet t shfrytzohen n maksimum mundsit e krijuara dhe shmanget n koh do rrezik, prtej atij t lejuar. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_z_Ardian_Fullani_ne_Fo 3/5 06/08/2022, 09:13 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Zhvillimi i ksaj kulture, krahas nj ndarjeje t qart dhe delegimit t prgjegjsive, presupozon dhe krijimin e kushteve pr nj edukim t vazhdueshm t personelit dhe kultivimin e fryms s puns n ekip. Politika e investimit sht dokumenti q udhheq dhe mbshtet procesin e investimit dhe przgjedhja e benchmark-ut strategjik, prfaqson pjesn kryesore t tij. Kjo, pasi m shum se 90 pr qind e kthimit t portofolit nga investimi prcaktohet nga benchmark-u prkats, i cili sht rezultat i procesit t przgjedhjes s benchmark-ut strategjik. Pjesa tjetr e kthimit prcaktohet nga hapsira e lejuar pr ndrmarrjen e rreziqeve gjat administrimit aktiv. Nj administrim aktiv i suksesshm sht tregues i aftsive shum t mira, s pari n vlersimin e mundsive q ofron tregu pr fitim dhe s dyti, n analizn e sakt t rreziqeve q ato mbartin. S fundi, do t dshiroja t merrja edhe pak koh pr t thn disa fjal mbi bashkpunimin e shklqyer q kemi pasur gjat ksaj kohe me Bankn Botrore. U bn tashm dy vjet q Banka e Shqipris sht angazhuar n nj marrveshje pr administrim dhe konsulenc me Bankn Botrore, me qllim marrjen e asistencs teknike pr ngritjen n nj shkall m t lart t funksioneve, q Banka e Shqipris kryen n kuadr t aktivitetit t administrimit t rezervs. Departamenti pr shtjet e Partneriteteve n Investimet Sovrane n Bankn Botrore, ka ofruar gjat ksaj periudhe 2-vjeare asistenc dhe ekspertiz teknike mjaft t vlefshme n t gjitha aspektet q lidhen me aktivitetin e administrimit t rezervs valutore n nj bank qendrore. Ky bashkpunim, ka qen veanrisht frytdhns pr krijimin dhe zhvillimin e aftsive profesionale t personelit q punon pr administrimin e rezervs valutore. Shum shpejt, ne do t nisim nj projekt t rndsishm q ka t bj me blerjen dhe vnien n zbatim t nj sistemi, i cili do t prdoret pr administrimin e rezervs valutore. T gjith ne jemi t ndrgjegjshm pr rndsin q ka krijimi i nj infrastrukture t mir t teknologjis s informacionit, n shrbim t plotsimit t nevojave pr administrimin e rreziqeve q lindin gjat procesit t investimit. BANK OF ALBANIA PRESS CONFERENCE Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word at the Finance Ministry's joint press conference with the Bank of Albania and imf after talks for the 4th revision of the agreement with the IMF Publication date: 14.11.2007 Honorable gentlemen,  1/4 06/08/2022, 09:17 Mr Ardian Fullani, at the joint press conference of the Ministry of Finance... Over the past two weeks intensive negotiations have been held with the IMF mission, regarding the latest developments in: economy, inflation, monetary indicators, financial market, bank supervision as well as monetary policy, followed by the Bank of Albania in the second part of 2007. The central part of the discussions were also the Bank of Albania's expectations regarding inflationary developments in the near future and the slightly more distant future, as well as the role monetary policy has in the direction of anchoring these expectations. As we also disclosed in the latest monetary policy report, there is a slight shift in the inflation rate over the upper value of the 4 percent tolerance zone. Given some current developments mostly related to the supply side, it is estimated that the performance of consumer prices for the following 12 months can continue to fluctuate around current values. On the part of the IMF Mission it has been assessed that the Bank of Albania's recent decisions on tightening monetary policy have helped to remove the effects of the second round as well as in maintaining inflationary expectations, anchored around our numerical target, 3 percent. Stopping at the factors that have conditioned inflation performance would briefly mention: Price performance of agricultural products. It is already accepted that local agricultural production, especially in the second and third quarters of the year, was greatly affected by the prolonged drought. Likewise, according to our surveys, the dependence of agricultural production on fuels and electricity, these have recently increased greatly and for the future, the problems that have accompanied the latter have given their direct impact on agriculture. On the other hand, it should be stressed that agricultural products have also suffered growth in international markets, causing even imported inflation to be present in this period. The energy crisis. The energy crisis, which was present almost throughout 2007, appeared at high intensity in its third quarter. Spending on providing alternative energy sources is estimated to be factors that have put pressure on the costs of producing and trading goods and services. Its negative effects are of direct nature, while they may also be of indirect nature, implying a duration of its implications even at a second moment. Demand in the economy. Despite the above factors it must be said that the economy has continued to be characterized by increased demand, which in turn puts pressure on consumer prices. Rising demand for some of the country's basic exports, favourable monetary conditions, as well as rising real estate prices have created an encouraging environment for borrowing and investment. The increase was also evident in the performance of exports, with about 28% for the period January - August 2007. Expanding trade deficit by 4 percentage points in terms of LONG GDP This period reflects not only the increase in consumption, but also the increase in investment. Imports e capital and intermediate goods increased by about 30%, during the six-month period of First. Foreign direct investment has also provided considerable assistance for economic activity. Based on the assumption that the above factors will continue to be present in economic reality, I would like to stress that the accommodation of inflationary pressures in the future has turned into a real challenge, difficult but not impossible to achieve. Assuming that the government in the future will continue to pursue responsible fiscal policies as well as believing in an adequate perception and reaction of the market and the public, in general to the decisions of the Bank of Albania, there is the possibility that the risks of inflation will be kept under control. The Bank of Albania, deeming communication with the public very important, will continuously convey to the public the risks that threaten the stability of consumer prices, with the aim of awareness of the general public for: inflationary developments in the future; balance of risks; keeping inflationary expectations anchored around the 3% target. I would like to stress that the Bank of Albania's monetary policy in the near future will continue to be responsible, the main tool to prevent short-term risks that threaten the stability of consumer prices. The role of interest rates in the economy will be proactive, aimed at keeping inflationary risks under control, the possibility of which to materialize is shifting to the growing direction. An important part of the discussions focused on financial stability, with a particular emphasis on the stability of the banking system. It should be stressed that during 2007 the process of consolidating the banking system, which continues to be well capitalised and operating at a profit, has continued. All indicators speak of a sound situation where I would single out the troubled credit figure which is at very low levels, only 3.4% of the total. However, I never find it too much to bring to the memory of the Albanian public repeatedly, the Commitment of the Bank of Albania towards the financial stability of the system and wider. To this end, we have recently strengthened banking supervision, asking the banking system for greater transparency, better governance and more efficient internal control procedures.  3/4 06/08/2022, 09:17 Mr Ardian Fullani, at the joint press conference of the Ministry of Finance... We shared the same opinion with the IMF Mission that prudence towards the quality of the loan portfolio is a constant priority in the conditions of its unstoppable growth. Credit growth is still high and a potential source of risk for macro and financial stability of the sector. In the end, I take the opportunity to thank Mr. Bell and the other members of the mission for their responsible and dedicated work during the two weeks of Tirana's stay.  4/4

Ardian Fullani, n konferencn e prbashkt pr shtyp t Ministris s Finan Gjat dy javve t fundit jan zhvilluar negociata intensive me misionin e FMN-s, n lidhje me zhvillimet m t fundit n: ekonomi, inflacion, treguesit monetar, tregun financiar, mbikqyrjen bankare si dhe politikn monetare, t ndjekur nga Banka e Shqipris n pjesn e dyt t vitit 2007. Pjes qendrore e diskutimeve ishin edhe pritshmrit e Banks s Shqipris n lidhje me zhvillimet inflacioniste n t ardhmen e afrt dhe at pak m t largt si dhe roli q politika monetare ka n drejtim t ankorimit t ktyre pritshmrive. Si e kemi br t ditur edhe n raportin e fundit t politiks monetare, ka nj zhvendosje t leht t norms s inflacionit mbi vlern e siprme t zons s tolerancs prej 4 pr qind. Bazuar n disa zhvillime aktuale t lidhura m s shumti me ann e oferts, vlersohet se ecuria e mimeve t konsumit pr 12 muajt n vijim mund t vazhdoj t luhatet rreth vlerave aktuale. Nga ana e Misionit t FMN-s sht vlersuar se vendimet e fundit t Banks s Shqipris pr shtrngimin e politiks monetare kan ndihmuar n mnjanimin e efekteve t raundit t dyt si dhe n mbajtjen e pritshmrive inflacioniste, t ankoruara rreth objektivit ton numerik, 3 pr qind. Duke u ndalur n faktort q kan kushtzuar ecurin e inflacionit do t prmendja shkurtimisht: Ecurin e mimeve t produkteve bujqsore. sht fakt i pranuar tashm se prodhimi bujqsor vendas, veanrisht n tremujorin e dyt dhe at t tret t vitit, u prek shum nga thatsira e tejzgjatur. Po kshtu, sipas sondazheve tona rezulton se varsia e prodhimit bujqsor nga karburantet dhe energjia elektrike, kto koht e fundit sht rritur shum dhe pr rrjedhim, problemet q kan shoqruar kto t fundit kan dhn ndikimin e tyre t drejtprdrejt n bujqsi. Nga ana tjetr, duhet theksuar se produktet bujqsore kan psuar rritje edhe n tregjet ndrkombtare, duke br q edhe inflacioni i importuar t jet i pranishm n kt periudh. Krizn energjitike. Kriza energjitike, e cila ka qen e pranishme pothuajse gjat gjith vitit 2007, sht shfaqur me intensitet t lart n tremujorin e tret t tij. Shpenzimet pr sigurimin e burimeve alternative t energjis, vlersohet t jen faktor t cilt kan ushtruar presione mbi kostot e prodhimit dhe t tregtimit t mallrave dhe t shrbimeve. Efektet negative t saj jan t natyrs s drejtprdrejt, ndrkoh q ato mund t jen edhe t natyrs s trthort, duke nnkuptuar nj kohzgjatje t implikimeve t saj edhe n nj moment t dyt. Krkesn n ekonomi. Pavarsisht faktorve t msiprm duhet thn se ekonomia ka vazhduar t karakterizohet nga nj krkes n rritje, e cila nga ana e saj ushtron presion mbi mimet e konsumit. Rritja e krkess pr disa eksporte baz t vendit, kushtet e favorshme monetare si dhe rritja e mimeve t pronave t patundshme kan krijuar nj ambient inkurajues pr huamarrje dhe investime. Ardian Fullani, n konferencn e prbashkt pr shtyp t Ministris s Finan konkretisht, kredia pr ekonomin ka vazhduar t zgjerohet me ritme t larta edhe gjat vitit 2007. Kredia pr bizneset sht rritur me mbi 50% n muajin gusht duke arritur n nj nivel prej 16% t PBB-s, ndrsa kredia pr individt, ka vazhduar t rritet me rreth 70 % n terma vjetor. Rritje e theksuar sht evidentuar edhe n ecurin e eksporteve, me rreth 28% pr periudhn janar - gusht 2007. Zgjerimi i deficitit tregtar me 4 pik prqindjeje n terma t PBB-s gjat ksaj periudhe, reflekton jo vetm rritjen e konsumit, por edhe rritjen e investimeve. Importet e mallrave kapital dhe t atyre t ndrmjetm jan rritur me rreth 30 %, gjat gjashtmujorit t par. Investimet e huaja direkte kan siguruar gjithashtu, nj ndihm t konsiderueshme pr aktivitetin ekonomik. Mbshtetur n supozimin se faktort e msiprm do t vazhdojn t jen t pranishm n realitetin ekonomik, dshiroj t theksoj se akomodimi i presioneve inflacioniste n t ardhmen sht kthyer n nj sfid t vrtet, e vshtir por jo e pamundur pr t'u arritur. Duke supozuar se qeveria n t ardhmen do t vazhdoj t ndjek politika fiskale t prgjegjshme si dhe duke besuar n nj perceptim dhe reagim t prshtatshm t tregut dhe publikut, n prgjithsi ndaj vendimeve t Banks s Shqipris, ekziston mundsia q rreziqet e inflacionit t mbahen nn kontroll. Banka e Shqipris duke e vlersuar shum t rndsishm komunikimin me publikun, do t prcjell n publik n mnyr t vazhdueshme rreziqet q krcnojn stabilitetin e mimeve t konsumit, me qllim ndrgjegjsimin e publikut t gjer pr:  zhvillimet inflacioniste n t ardhmen;  balancn e rreziqeve;  mbajtjen e pritjeve inflacioniste t ankoruara rreth objektivit prej 3%. Dshiroj t theksoj se politika monetare e Banks s Shqipris n t ardhmen e afrt do t vazhdoj t jet e prgjegjshme, mjeti kryesor pr t parandaluar rreziqet afatshkurtra q krcnojn stabilitetin e mimeve t konsumit. Roli i prqindjes s interesit n ekonomi do t jet proaktiv, duke synuar mbajtjen nn kontroll t rreziqeve inflacioniste, mundsia e t cilave pr t'u materializuar sht e zhvendosur n kahun rrits. Nj pjes e rndsishme e diskutimeve u prqendrua n stabilitetin financiar, me nj theks t veant n stabilitetin e sistemit bankar. Duhet theksuar se gjat vitit 2007 ka vazhduar procesi i konsolidimit t sistemit bankar, i cili vazhdon t jet i mirkapitalizuar dhe t operoj me fitim. T gjith treguesit flasin pr nj gjendje t shndosh ku do t veoja shifrn e kredis me probleme e cila sht n nivele shum t ulta, vetm 3.4 % e totalit. Megjithat, asnjher nuk m duket e teprt q t risjell n kujtes t publikut shqiptar n mnyr t prsritur, angazhimin e Banks s Shqipris n drejtim t stabilitetit financiar t sistemit dhe m gjer. Many dear students and others present in this hall! I'm honestly so excited to be here today. For all of us there was a golden time of being a high school student or better high school student! It's time for you now! Try to respect and put it at the service of your future! I don't want to do for you the teacher or the strict parent. I just want to be as close and well-understood as possible. What we're here for today relates to the central bank and its functions. How important is a central bank in the lives of each of us? How useful is a central bank to the well-being of its country and finally, can a country's economy develop without the existence of a central bank? All of these are questions that are answered unequity in today's times. The central bank is useful, necessary, an undivided part of the lives of citizens of the modern world. One might ask: What does this all have to do with me? Personally, I think such a question deserves the classic answer: "You young people are the future of a society". As we are all witnesses, Albanian society is aiming to integrate into United Europe. In simpler words, our society is trying to unite its best values with those of europe's already united peoples. Of course, among the values with which our society can be prided, I have the full conviction that you are. To get closer to our topic, I want to give you a simple presentation of our Central Bank. It is called the Bank of Albania and as you may know it is located in "Skenderbej" Square, in a solid building almost 70 years old. Its main function is to preserve price stability. In this way, it contributes to economic development and well-being in the country. Another important task of the Bank of Albania is to ensure the stability of the banking system in the country. The Bank of Albania is also, the institution that enjoys the exclusive right to extract and circulate the national currency, which as you all know is Leku! Another important mission of the Bank is the responsibility for the breeding of payments in the national currency. These and other functions, equally important, the Bank of Albania performs in service of developing the economy and increasing the well-being of all Albanians. To achieve this goal, the Bank does not act alone, isolated or cut off from a general reality. It is fundamental that the Bank of Albania is independent, far from the influences of any kind. On the other hand, independence means accountability and transparency, which combined together, achieve high credibility. The latter is a necessary condition for achieving the above goals. Within this institutional framework, in co-operation with specialized international institutions, the Bank has drafted and adopted contemporary laws and regulations, which enable it to develop its activity in a safe and sound regulatory environment. Ardian Fullani, n ceremonin e nnshkrimit t Memorandumit t Mirkupti Shum t dashur nxns dhe t tjer t pranishm n kt sall! Jam sinqerisht shum i emocionuar q ndodhem sot ktu. Pr t gjith ne ka patur nj koh "t art" t t qenurit nxns gjimnazi ose m mir gjimnazist! Pr ju koha sht tani! Prpiquni ta respektoni dhe ta vini n shrbim t s ardhmes tuaj! Nuk dua t bj pr ju msuesin dhe as prindin e rrept. Dua vetm t jem sa m i afrt dhe i mirkuptuar. Ajo pr t ciln jemi sot ktu lidhet me bankn qendrore dhe me funksionet e saj. Sa e rndsishme sht nj bank qendrore n jetn e secilit prej nesh? Sa e dobishme sht nj bank qendrore pr mirqenien e vendit t saj dhe m n fund, a mundet t zhvillohet ekonomia e nj vendi pa ekzistencn e nj banke qendrore? T gjitha kto jan pyetje q n koht e sotme marrin prgjigje pa mdyshje. Banka qendrore sht e dobishme, e domosdoshme, pjes e pandar n jetn e qytetarve t bots moderne. Dikush mund t pyes: 'lidhje ka e gjitha kjo me mua? Personalisht, mendoj q nj pyetje e till meriton prgjigjen klasike: "Ju, t rinjt, jeni e ardhmja e nj shoqrie". Si jemi t gjith dshmitar, shoqria shqiptare po synon t integrohet n Evropn e Bashkuar. N fjal m t thjeshta, shoqria jon po prpiqet t bashkoj vlerat e saj m t mira me ato t popujve tashm t bashkuar t Evrops. E pa dyshim, q ndr vlerat me t cilat mund t krenohet shoqria jon, kam bindjen e plot q jeni ju. Pr t ardhur m afr tems ton, dua t'ju bj nj prezantim t thjesht t Banks ton Qendrore. Ajo quhet Banka e Shqipris dhe si mund ta dini sht e vendosur n sheshin "Sknderbej", n nj godin solide e pothuaj 70-vjeare. Funksioni i saj kryesor sht ruajtja e stabilitetit t mimeve. N kt mnyr, ajo kontribuon n zhvillimin ekonomik dhe t mirqenies n vend. Nj detyr tjetr e rndsishme e Banks s Shqipris sht sigurimi i stabilitetit t sistemit bankar n vend. Banka e Shqipris sht gjithashtu, institucioni q gzon t drejtn ekskluzive t nxjerrjes dhe qarkullimit t monedhs kombtare, q si e dini t gjith sht Leku! Nj mision tjetr i rndsishm i Banks sht prgjegjsia pr mbarvajtjen e pagesave n monedhn kombtare. Kto dhe funksione t tjera, po kaq t rndsishme, Banka e Shqipris i kryen n shrbim t zhvillimit t ekonomis dhe rritjes s mirqenies s t gjith shqiptarve. Pr t arritur kt synim, Banka nuk vepron e vetme, e izoluar apo e shkputur nga nj realitet i prgjithshm. sht themelore q Banka e Shqipris t jet e pavarur, larg ndikimeve t do lloj natyre. Nga ana tjetr, pavarsia nnkupton nj llogaridhnie dhe transparenc, q t kombinuara s bashku, arrijn besueshmri t lart. Kjo e fundit sht nj kusht i domosdoshm pr arritjen e objektivave t msiprm. Brenda ksaj kornize institucionale, n bashkpunim me institucione ndrkombtare t specializuara, Banka ka hartuar e miratuar ligje e rregullore bashkkohore, t cilat i japin mundsi t zhvilloj aktivitetin e saj n nj ambient rregullativ t shndosh e t sigurt. Ajo gjithashtu, ka investuar n krijimin e nj baze teknologjike moderne. Programe e sisteme t prparuara jan n shrbim t personelit t Banks s Shqipris. E gjitha kjo, i krijon mundsi t https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_z_Ardian_Fullani_ne_ce 2/4 06/08/2022, 09:17 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Ardian Fullani, n ceremonin e nnshkrimit t Memorandumit t Mirkupti respektoj standardet m t larta t kohs n kt fush e t ndjek ritmet e zhvillimit t prgjithshm, t bankingut t ditve t sotme. Por, investimi m i rndsishm q Banka e Shqipris ka br n vite, sht ai i krijimit t nj personeli t miredukuar, t kualifikuar, t specializuar, q pr nga aftsit sht i krahasueshm me at t mjaft bankave t tjera qendrore, n vende mjaft m t zhvilluara se i yni. Dikush ktu me t drejt mund t pyes: Sa njerz n Shqipri i din t gjitha kto? Un do t sillja si prgjigje nj tjetr pyetje: Sa njerzve do iu shrbente t dinin rreth Banks s Shqipris? Prgjigja n kt rast vjen natyrshm. T gjith sht mir t din! Duke patur dituri mbi nj institucion dhe punn e tij mund t vendossh nj marrdhnie me t. N rastin ton, q marrdhnia t jet e qndrueshme dhe t funksionoj n shrbim t s mirs s prbashkt, do duhej t ishte nj marrdhnie besimi, fryt i komunikimit t vazhdueshm. N prpjekjen e saj pr t fituar dhe ruajtur besimin e publikut, Banka e Shqipris komunikon me t, mbshtetur n parime t transparencs e t respektimit t vlerave reciproke. Un dua t prfitoj nga rasti q m jepet, dhe t jem i sinqert, nuk sht e zakonshme t jem para nj auditori kaq premtues sa ju, t them dy fjal pr nj program edukimi, q kemi ideuar e filluar t zbatojm, t quajtur "Banka qendrore n jetn e prditshme!". Nuk duhet t habiteni kur them q ju jeni nj grup mjaft i synuar nga ne. Pak m lart prmenda ambicien ton t madhe pr t'u integruar n Evrop, por un kam gjithashtu, bindjen q financat sikurse do gj tjetr duhen msuar dhe ju jeni n moshn kur msimi sht parsor. Pr kt arsye programi i msiprm, sht projektuar t zhvillohet n 3 drejtime: 1. Seminare trajnuese pr msuesit e lnds s ekonomis, n fushn e ekonomis, financs dhe bankingut n prgjithsi, e banks qendrore n veanti. 2. Takime n shkollat e mesme me nxns t vitit t tret q zhvillojn lndn e ekonomis, biseda rreth argumenteve q lidhen me ekonomin, administrimin e financave personale dhe rolin e funksionet e banks qendrore veanrisht. Shprndarja e broshurave edukative q ne prgatisim pr publikun e gjer. 3. Zhvillimi i nj konkursi, midis shkollave t mesme t Tirans, t titulluar "Vlera e vrtet e paras". Nprmjet tij, synojm q ju jo vetm t merrni njohuri rreth mnyrs se si banka qendrore vepron n prmbushje t objektivit kryesor t saj: Ruajtjes s stabilitetit t mimeve!, por t zhvilloni edhe aftsin e t punuarit n grup pr t arritur rezultatin e sigurisht, edhe t argtoheni. N fund, sht shum e rndsishme pr mua t'ju kujtoj dhe njkohsisht t'ju siguroj pr kt, q do t mirprisja me knaqsi dhe vlersim maksimal, do koment, krkes, ide apo sugjerim tuajin n kt drejtim. Hotel "Sheraton", January 28, 2008 Publication date: 28.01.2008 Honourable, Prime Minister, Honourable gentlemen ministers, Ladies and gentlemen,  1/5 05/08/22, j16:58 His word to the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the ceremony organized on the occasion of the beginning of the operation of... I am pleased to successfully announce the completion of the Credit Registry project and the beginning of its operation since 3 January this year. The creation and operation of the Register in early 2008 was a pledge taken by the Bank of Albania before the banking sector and international financial institutions, about 17 months ago. In contrast to other similar projects developed on the part of our institution, the Credit Registry is a project in which the Bank of Albania has full authorisation in the direction of financing, drafting technical specifications of the project and implementing it. In general, financial markets cannot function properly, if they do not exploit a developed infrastructure. Through it, the instruments necessary for conducting transactions between participants are offered, loosely and reliably. Regulatory authorities, have a responsibility to create the conditions for developing this infrastructure from the market itself or to play the leading role in its creation, in the function of achieving their objectives, for increasing market efficiency and formalizing the economy. The Credit Registry represents a significant development of financial infrastructure in Albania, which is rapidly developing. Through it, the Bank of Albania aims to improve the loan management process at commercial banks, providing an instrument that enables more complete and effective analysis about the paying ability of creditors. Improving information affects the reduction of the costs of lending financial institutions, which relate to the time of analysis and the consequences of wrong decisions in the field of lending. In a market that displays satisfactory levels of competition in the field of lending, the functioning of the credit register improves access to financing of various creditors, as well as affects the reduction of the interest rate of the loan. For the Bank of Albania, as the regulatory and supervisory authority of the banking sector, the Credit Registry offers an additional and very useful instrument to deepen its analysis, not only in the direction of assessing the overall quality of the loan portfolio, but also in the direction of highlighting credit concentrations according to banks and credit subjects, detailed assessment of the exposure of banks and creditorsubjects to financing according to currencies, detailed assessment of the type of collaterals and collaterals used, of the evidence of the links that exist between different creditor subjects, etc. These are phenomena that accompany lending activity and require careful monitoring by commercial banks and the Bank of Albania, to recognise the risks they contain and to act to mitigate these risks. In fact, the priorities that the banking and financial industry has, as well as their supervisory authorities due to the improvement in the quality of financial information in general and specifically in lending activity through the implementation of the Credit Registry, promote the equity and sustainability of the entire financial system. The process of achieving the Credit Registry at the Bank of Albania passed several phases which I wish  2/5 05/08/22, 16:58 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the ceremony organized on the occasion of the beginning of the operation of... The process of performing the Credit Registry at the Bank of Albania passed several phases, which I wish Briefly mention them. Initially, it was necessary for professional and technical knowledge to be operation of this instrument, focus and expand, to use it afterwards effectively for the implementation of the project. For this reason, the Special Working Group was established, which was I know the operation of credit registers in different countries in our region, as well as to Western Europe, aiming to choose the project, which would be more effective for the conditions of the Our banking market. In parallel, the Working Group consulted and consulted in a manner continued by specialised foreign experts, provided by the International Monetary Fund. The following, this Group began work on determining the technical specifications of the project as well as for the drafting the special regulatory framework for the functioning of the registry. The Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania has followed the project's performance with maximum attention and has offered all necessary support for its quality implementation within the specified time target. Throughout the process, commercial banks have given their opinion by actively engaging in the implementation of the project. Their contribution has been particularly important in the moments of preliminary testing of the selected technical solution, as well as in populating the database with the necessary information. At the same time, the Bank of Albania paid special attention to communication with the public, publishing information brochures throughout the project's implementation, as well as offering the necessary clarifications in the media. Let me mention some of the characteristics of the Credit Registry next. The participation of commercial banks in the Register through the dumping of information under the format defined by the Bank of Albania is mandatory. These institutions provide information about their clients in the Registry database and, in exchange, benefit from access to the database for all system borrowers. Information for creditors is positive and negative. This means that in addition to the creditor's correctness data to pay his financial obligations to creditors, additional information will be found in the Register regarding the creditor's personal data, the main direction of his business, his assets and collateral, his links to other creditors, etc. This type of information, meets the creditor's profile, better addresses the information needs of various lenders by improving decision-making and ultimately improving the creditor's opportunities to benefit from a loan. The Credit Register will include all loans, regardless of their value. In this regard, the experience of other countries offers different solutions. In some countries, part of the database on which the public credit register is established, contains only loans on a certain value by selecting, among a large number of loans, those that matter systemically. In these countries, private registers are those covering the rest of the overall portfolio of loans, realizing a sectoral division of information "de facto". In our case, due to the not very high number of loans in general, as well as due to the lack of a private and alternative register, it was deemed possible and effective, the inclusion in the Register of all loans. In this way, this Register enables the inclusion of data  3/5 05/08/22, 16:58 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the ceremony organized on the occasion of the beginning of the operation of... even for small creditors operating mainly in the small and medium-skilled business sector. Currently, data on about 210,000 active bank sector loans and about 334,000 items or guarantees, which serve as collateral for loans benefited by creditors, have been cast in the Register. Also, in the Register, about 140,000 related creditors have been found. This data will be enriched next. Initially, users of the Credit Registry are only banks. However, our objective is to include as registry users and other non-bank financial institutions, which operate in the area of lending. In this way, the database with new creditors will be expanded, increasing the community of creditors for all creditor institutions. Information included in the database is protected and used in accordance with the requirements of the personal data protection law. Designated employees of commercial banks and the Bank of Albania are the only persons certified by the Bank of Albania, to dump the data and use the information found in the Register. At the same time, to avoid cases of misinterpretation of information found in the Register, creditors are allowed to turn to the Bank of Albania through a defined and clear procedure to verify the information that exists about them in the Register and to request the necessary changes. From the point of view of the technical realization of the project, it is possible to expand the number of users, as well as the interaction of the Registry database with other public registers, according to the interests of the institutions. At the same time, this interaction is possible to be carried out even with similar private registers, if they are to be developed in the future. Of course, in these cases, the regulatory framework must clearly define user subjects as well as their rights and responsibilities. In the event of the successful completion of the project, I would like to thank: - International Monetary Fund, for support with technical consultancy throughout the phases of realisation of project; - Commercial banks for their commitment to the process of adapting internal data systems, with the requirements contained in the Credit Register; - Private society that realizes the technical solution, professionalism and seriousness shown in realization in project time, believing that the same standards will be offered even during the maintenance period of the The Registry's technology platform; - The Bank of Albania Working Group, which compares to daily functional tasks, took over and This important project is performed with dedication and professionalism. In conclusion, I would like to stress that the Bank of Albania is convinced that the Credit Register in  4/5 05/08/22, 16:58 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the ceremony organized on the occasion of the beginning of the operation of... Albania, will be effective and meet the objectives of its creation. Thank you!  5/5

Ardian Fullani, n ceremonin e organizuar me rastin e fillimit t funksionimit t Kam knaqsin t shpall prfundimin me sukses t projektit t Regjistrit t Kredive dhe fillimin e funksionimit t tij q prej dats 3 janar t ktij viti. Krijimi dhe funksionimi i Regjistrit n fillimin e vitit 2008, ishte nj zotim i marr nga Banka e Shqipris prpara sektorit bankar dhe institucioneve financiare ndrkombtare, prpara rreth 17 muajsh. N dallim nga projektet e tjera t ngjashme t zhvilluara nga ana e institucionit ton, Regjistri i Kredive sht nj projekt n t cilin Banka e Shqipris ka autorsin e plot n drejtim t financimit, t hartimit t specifikimeve teknike t projektit dhe t zbatimit t tij. N prgjithsi, tregjet financiare nuk mund t funksionojn si duhet, n rast se nuk shfrytzojn nj infrastruktur t zhvilluar. Nprmjet saj, ofrohen instrumentet e nevojshme pr kryerjen e transaksioneve midis pjesmarrsve, n mnyr t lirshme dhe t besueshme. Autoritetet rregullative, kan prgjegjsin t krijojn kushtet pr zhvillimin e ksaj infrastrukture nga vet tregu ose t luajn rolin parsor n krijimin e saj, n funksion t realizimit t objektivave t tyre, pr rritjen e eficiencs s tregut dhe formalizimin e ekonomis. Regjistri i Kredive prfaqson nj zhvillim t rndsishm t infrastrukturs financiare n Shqipri, infrastruktur e cila po zhvillohet me shpejtsi. Nprmjet tij, Banka e Shqipris synon t prmirsoj procesin e administrimit t kredis n bankat tregtare, duke ofruar nj instrument i cili mundson analiza m t plota dhe efektive rreth aftsis paguese t kredimarrsve. Prmirsimi i informacionit ndikon n reduktimin e kostove t institucioneve financiare kredidhnse, q lidhen me kohn e analizs dhe pasojat e vendimeve t gabuara n fushn e kreditimit. N nj treg i cili shfaq nivele t knaqshme konkurrence n fushn e kreditimit, funksionimi i regjistrit t kredive prmirson aksesin n financim t kredimarrsve t ndryshm, si dhe ndikon n uljen e norms s interesit t kredis. Pr Bankn e Shqipris, si autoriteti rregullativ dhe mbikqyrs i sektorit bankar, Regjistri i Kredive ofron nj instrument shtes dhe mjaft t dobishm pr t thelluar analizn e saj, jo vetm n drejtim t vlersimit t cilsis s prgjithshme t portofolit t kredis, por edhe n drejtim t evidentimit t prqendrimeve t kredis sipas bankave dhe subjekteve kredimarrse, t vlersimit t detajuar t ekspozimit t bankave dhe t subjekteve kredimarrse ndaj financimit sipas monedhave, t vlersimit t detajuar t llojit t kolateraleve dhe t garancive t prdorura, t evidentimit t lidhjeve q ekzistojn midis subjekteve t ndryshme kredimarrse etj.. Kto jan fenomene t cilat shoqrojn veprimtarin e kreditimit dhe q krkojn nj monitorim t kujdesshm nga bankat tregtare dhe Banka e Shqipris, pr t njohur rreziqet q prmbajn dhe pr t vepruar pr zbutjen e ktyre rreziqeve. N fakt, prparsit q ka industria bankare e financiare, si dhe autoritetet mbikqyrse t tyre pr shkak t prmirsimit n cilsin e informacionit financiar n prgjithsi dhe posarisht n veprimtarin e kreditimit nprmjet vendosjes n funksionim t Regjistrit t Kredive, nxitin eficiencn dhe qndrueshmrin e t gjith sistemit financiar. Ardian Fullani, n ceremonin e organizuar me rastin e fillimit t funksionimit t Procesi i realizimit t Regjistrit t Kredive n Bankn e Shqipris, kaloi disa faza, t cilat dshiroj t'i prmend shkurtimisht. Fillimisht, ishte e nevojshme q njohurit profesionale dhe teknike t funksionimit t ktij instrumenti, t prqendroheshin dhe t zgjeroheshin, pr t'i prdorur m pas me efektivitet pr realizimin e projektit. Pr kt arsye, u ngrit Grupi i posam i Puns, i cili u njoh me funksionimin e regjistrave t kredive n vende t ndryshme t rajonit ton, si edhe t Evrops Perndimore, duke synuar t zgjedh projektin i cili do t ishte m efektiv pr kushtet e tregut ton bankar. Paralelisht, Grupi i Puns u konsultua dhe u kshillua n mnyr t vazhdueshme nga ekspert t huaj t specializuar, t ofruar nga Fondi Monetar Ndrkombtar. N vijim, ky Grup filloi punn pr prcaktimin e specifikimeve teknike t projektit si edhe pr hartimin e kuadrit rregullativ t posam pr funksionimin e regjistrit. Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris e ka ndjekur me vmendje maksimale ecurin e projektit dhe ka ofruar t gjith mbshtetjen e nevojshme pr realizimin cilsor t tij brenda objektivit kohor t prcaktuar. Gjat gjith procesit, bankat tregtare kan dhn opinionin e tyre duke u prfshir n mnyr aktive n realizimin e projektit. Kontributi i tyre ka qen veanrisht i rndsishm n momentet e testimeve paraprake t zgjidhjes teknike t przgjedhur, si edhe n popullimin e bazs s t dhnave me informacionin e nevojshm. N t njjtn koh, Banka e Shqipris i kushtoi vmendje t veant komunikimit me publikun, duke publikuar broshura informative gjat gjith realizimit t projektit, si edhe duke ofruar sqarimet e nevojshme n media. M lejoni q n vazhdim t prmend disa nga karakteristikat e Regjistrit t Kredive. Pjesmarrja e bankave tregtare n Regjistr nprmjet hedhjes s informacionit sipas formatit t prcaktuar nga Banka e Shqipris, sht e detyrueshme. Kto institucione ofrojn informacion rreth klientve t tyre n bazn e t dhnave t Regjistrit dhe n kmbim, prfitojn akses n bazn e t dhnave pr t gjith huamarrsit e sistemit. Informacioni pr kredimarrsit sht pozitiv dhe negativ. Kjo do t thot q krahas t dhnave mbi korrektesn e kredimarrsit pr t paguar detyrimet e tij financiare ndaj kredidhnsve, n Regjistr do t gjendet edhe informacioni shtes n lidhje me t dhnat personale t kredimarrsit, drejtimin kryesor t biznesit t tij, pasurit dhe kolateralet e deklaruara prej tij, lidhjet e tij me kredimarrs t tjer etj.. Ky lloj informacioni, plotson profilin e kredimarrsit, adreson m mir nevojat pr informacion t kredidhnsve t ndryshm duke prmirsuar vendimmarrjen dhe n prfundim, prmirson mundsit e kredimarrsit pr t prfituar nj kredi. Regjistri i Kredive do t prfshij t gjitha kredit, pavarsisht nga vlera e tyre. N lidhje me kt element, prvoja e vendeve t tjera ofron zgjidhje t ndryshme. N disa vende, pjes e bazs s t dhnave mbi t ciln sht ngritur regjistri publik i kredive, prmban vetm kredit mbi nj vler t caktuar duke przgjedhur, midis nj numri t madh kredish, ato q kan rndsi sistemike. N kto vende, regjistrat privat jan ata q mbulojn pjesn tjetr t portofolit t prgjithshm t kredive, duke realizuar "de facto" nj ndarje sektoriale t informacionit. N rastin ton, pr shkak t numrit jo shum t lart t kredive n prgjithsi, si edhe pr shkak t mungess s nj regjistri privat dhe alternativ, u gjykua u mundshme dhe efektive, prfshirja n Regjistr e t gjitha kredive. N kt mnyr, ky Regjistr, mundson prfshirjen e t dhnave https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_z_Ardian_Fullani_ne_ce 3/5 05/08/22, 16:58 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Ardian Fullani, n ceremonin e organizuar me rastin e fillimit t funksionimit t edhe pr kredimarrsit e vegjl q veprojn kryesisht n sektorin e biznesit t vogl dhe t mesm. Aktualisht, n Regjistr jan hedhur t dhna pr rreth 210 mij kredi aktive t sektorit bankar dhe rreth 334 mij objekte ose garanci, q shrbejn si kolaterale pr kredit e prfituara nga kredimarrsit. Gjithashtu, n Regjistr, jan evidentuar rreth 140 mij kredimarrs t lidhur. Kto t dhna do t pasurohen n vazhdim. Fillimisht, prdorues t Regjistrit t Kredive jan vetm bankat. Megjithat, objektivi yn sht q n nj afat t arsyeshm kohor, t prfshijm si prdorues t Regjistrit edhe institucionet e tjera financiare jobanka, t cilat veprojn n fushn e kreditimit. N kt mnyr, do t zgjerohet baza e t dhnave me kredimarrs t rinj, duke rritur komunitetin e kredimarrsve pr t gjitha institucionet kredidhnse. Informacioni q prfshihet n bazn e t dhnave, mbrohet dhe shfrytzohet n prputhje me krkesat e ligjit "Pr mbrojtjen e t dhnave personale". Punonjs t caktuar t bankave tregtare dhe t Banks s Shqipris, jan t vetmit persona t ertifikuar nga Banka e Shqipris, pr t hedhur t dhnat dhe pr t prdorur informacionin q gjendet n Regjistr. N t njjtn koh, pr t shmangur rastet e keqinterpretimit t informacionit q gjendet n Regjistr, kredimarrsit lejohen q nprmjet nj procedure t prcaktuar dhe t qart, t'i drejtohen Banks s Shqipris pr t verifikuar informacionin q ekziston rreth tyre n Regjistr dhe pr t krkuar ndryshimet e nevojshme. Nga pikpamja e realizimit teknik t projektit, mundsohet zgjerimi i numrit t prdoruesve si edhe ndrveprimi i bazs s t dhnave t Regjistrit me regjistra t tjer publik, sipas interesave t institucioneve. Njkohsisht, ky ndrveprim sht i mundshm pr t'u realizuar edhe me regjistra t ngjashm privat, nse ato do t zhvillohen n t ardhmen. Sigurisht q n kto raste, kuadri rregullativ duhet t prcaktoj qart subjektet prdoruese si edhe t drejtat e prgjegjsit e tyre. Me rastin e prfundimit me sukses t projektit, dshiroj t falenderoj: - Fondin Monetar Ndrkombtar, pr mbshtetjen me konsulenc teknike gjat gjith fazave t realizimit t projektit; - Bankat tregtare pr angazhimin e tyre n procesin e prshtatjes s sistemeve t brendshme t t dhnave, me krkesat q prmbante Regjistri i Kredive; - Shoqrin private q realizoi zgjidhjen teknike, pr profesionalizmin dhe seriozitetin e treguar n realizimin n koh t projektit, duke besuar q t njjtat standarde do t ofrohen edhe gjat periudhs s mirmbajtjes s platforms teknologjike t Regjistrit; - Grupin e Puns s Banks s Shqipris, i cili krahas detyrave t prditshme funksionale, mori prsipr dhe realizoi me prkushtim e profesionalizm kt projekt t rndsishm. Publication date: 04.02.2008 The Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Ardian Fullani, today held a lecture on the theme "Bank of Albania - step by step towards convergence", in the facilities of the European University of Tirana. About 200 students and teachers attended the university hall, as well as several bank of Albania directors and specialists. The lecture was part of the activities organized at this University, on the occasion of Bank Day. The Bank of Albania, in the context of intensifying its efforts in the field of education, has also ideated organising a special day with conversations, presentations, activities or visits organized at the Bank of Albania by groups of students and students. In his lecture, Mr. Fullani addressed the issue of convergence, the necessity to undertake deep structural reforms, to finally stop in the role of the Bank of Albania in this whole process.  lani_ne_Universitetin_Evropian_te_Tiranes_4_shkurt_2008_Tirane.html Page 1 of 3 Lecture of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the European University of Tirana, February 4, 2008, Tirana. 29/07/22, 14:59 Convergence is a term that expresses the ability of developing economies to achieve the well-being of developed economies. Simply put, convergence means increasing per capita income in an economy towards a predetermined level achieved by developed economies. For a less developed economy to convert towards a developed economy, income per capita or growth rate of the undeveloped economy should be faster than the developed country's economic growth. In other words, convergence requires the establishment of a system of laws, rules, markets, relations, institutions, security and financial support, which would guarantee conditions for adopting new technologies and channelling them into economic activity and materialization in end products faster than other economies. Likewise, Mr. Fullani praised the need for continued structural reforms as vital. The latter remain of particular importance especially in the direction of materializing a real convergence. Structural reforms should aim at protecting public interests and ensuring equality and market freedom. They do not support particular groups and mean accountability. On the other hand, freedom is a responsibility and a consequence, it is precisely structural reforms that guarantee compliance with the rules of the game, contributing to the harmonious and sustainable development of the economy. Next, Mr. Fullani stopped at the role of the Bank of Albania in this process where particular emphasis was placed on the need for financial integration, the role of the financial market, the need to perfect them further and care to ensure the stability of the financial system. As in previous cases, Mr. Fullani highlighted a group of measures that the Bank of Albania has adopted regarding the efficiency of the financial market in Albania, judging that financial integration, first of all, means integration with global markets, ultimately the chances of convergence. Subsequently, the students followed and simultaneously became co-conversational with specialists of the Bank of Albania, on topics about the central bank and its function, the role it plays in the economy and the well-being of a country; today's developments in modern banking and the latest products it offers; personal finances, etc. Also included was the presentation of the bank of Albania's latest educational publication: "Banks in the Internet Age". Around this brochure, a more detailed conversation was held with the interested group of students, who led questions and received information about technological developments that enable modern banking services today. Thus, an important country took the explanation of the role of the Bank of Albania in the functioning of the payment system in our country. For students, questionnaires were distributed, where issues were listed about which they had an interest in discussing, at a second time, with Bank specialists. Thus, a communication bridge more directored by the requirements of this interest group could be created.  lani_ne_Universitetin_Evropian_te_Tiranes_4_shkurt_2008_Tirane.html Page 2 of 3 Lecture of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the European University of Tirana, February 4, 2008, Tirana. 29/07/22, 14:59  lani_ne_Universitetin_Evropian_te_Tiranes_4_shkurt_2008_Tirane.html Page 3 of 3

E thn thjesht, konvergjenca nnkupton rritjen e t ardhurave pr frym n nj ekonomi drejt nj niveli t paracaktuar t arritur nga ekonomit e zhvilluara. Q nj ekonomi m pak e zhvilluar t konvergoj drejt nj ekonomie t zhvilluar duhet q t ardhurat pr frym ose norma e rritjes s ekonomis t pazhvilluar t jet m e shpejt se rritja ekonomike e vendit t zhvilluar. M pas, studentt ndoqn dhe njkohsisht u bn bashkbisedues me specialist t Banks s Shqipris, n tema rreth banks qendrore dhe funksionit t saj, rolit q ajo luan n ekonomin dhe mirqenien e nj vendi; zhvillimeve t sotme n bankingun modern dhe produkteve m t fundit q ky ofron; financave personale etj.. text: 06/08/2022, 09:11 Governor Fullani's discussion at the "Agriculture and Regional Development" meeting, organised by the Institute for Democracy and Reform... Governor Fullani's discussion at the "Agriculture and Regional Development" meeting, organised by the Institute for Democracy and Reform and Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Consumer Protection, Manza Municipality, March 11, 2008 Publication date: 12.03.2008 Honorable, Mr. President, Honored participants  1/5 06/08/2022, 09:11 Governor Fullani's discussion at the "Agriculture and Regional Development" meeting, organised by the Institute for Democracy and Reform... Honored participants, 1: Entrance Today's meeting I think constitutes a serious effort to accurately highlight the weaknesses and priorities of the development of the agricultural sector in Albania. I take the opportunity to welcome the initiative of the organizers of this meeting, to keep this event so significant. I think the high-level debate either in public or institutionally about these problems has been pale and I sincerely want to reemphasize that this meeting today is the right one and with a lot of interest from the perspective of the Bank of Albania. In some of my public appearances, I have cited the impact of this sector on arguments such as consumer goods inflation and the trade deficit, which constitute issues of particular interest to the Bank of Albania. Likewise, I have brought to public attention, the importance and necessity to undertake deep structural reforms, many of which would lead to the development of this sector. Not without cause even at its last meeting the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania re-emphasized (quote from the Supervisory Council)... "The need to undertake structural reforms in agriculture, with the aim of increasing efficiency and production in this sector, so that in the medium term the size and effects of external shocks, which concern agricultural products, may be reduced. Next I'll return to some of the issues I mentioned above. 2: Effect on inflation and trade deficit The fluctuation in agricultural product prices, processed or not, has a rapid and high-intensity impact on inflation. This happens not simply that food prices everywhere are characterized by a pronounced seasonality, but also for the fact that the weight of food goods in the total consumer price index in Albania is higher than all other subgroups, about 40%. Consequently, developments in food prices take on another meaning for the Bank of Albania, in the context of meeting its legal obligation, achieving the main objective of price stability. Another important aspect is the continued deepening of the trade balance of foods, regardless of whether it is processed products or not. Over the last five years 2002-2007, the trade deficit in food has flucifered at the interval of 18% - 20% of the total trade deficit. The third element that makes us very sensitive, I think relates to recent developments in international markets, the effect of which has been reflected in Albania. Recently international markets are recognizing the expensiveness of cereals and products of plant and animal origin  2/5 06/08/2022, 09:11 Animal. Governor Fullani's discussion at the "Agriculture and Regional Development" meeting, organised by the Institute for Democracy and Reform... The reasons are clear, but what is clear is about the duration of this phenomenon and the immunity that different economies have towards it. I think the hardest part is still ahead of us, so it would be a way for today's meeting not to be the end. 3: Structural barriers to agriculture and necessary reforms Agricultural production faces a series of obstacles, among which we can mention: the dysfunction of the agricultural land market and the ambiguities in the titles of ownership, the large fragmentation of agricultural land, the poor collection and distribution system, the undeveloped infrastructure in rural areas, the lack of proper mechanical technology, the lack of adequate irrigation systems, lack of funding, insufficient marketing and plenty of other, similar reasons. The structural obstacles mentioned above are also confirmed by the following data. Agriculture in Albania is mainly driven by meeting the needs of farmers' own families. Only 30% of agricultural production is released. It is also estimated that agricultural production for each farmer is on average 4 times smaller than in new EU members and 20 times smaller than older EU members. Agriculture is dominated by small farms, with an average area of only 1.13 hectares. The current form of agriculture body with very small and fragmented farms makes it impossible to exploit economies of scale, decreases the profitability of the use of agricultural mechanics and consequently results in too high costs and low productivity in agricultural production. Furthermore, the narrow family and informalnature of these farms, as well as low productivity, make it difficult to distribute lending funds towards this sector, thus forming a vicious circle. Precisely, it is necessary to interfere in this vicious circle between low productivity, infrastructure and insufficient mecanization, and lack of funding. To this end, I think structural reform in agriculture is necessary and should be aimed at: increasing productivity, lowering costs, improving infrastructure, collection and distribution systems. --- Increasing productivity in agriculture can only be achieved by improving and optimizing reports between inputs land, labour wing, capital, as well as through the convergence of these reports, at least by the standards of the countries of the region. The demands in question are supported by growth and development theories, but these cannot be achieved alone, if adequate structural reforms are not undertaken. Let me mention here that, as a result of the lack of optimization of these reports and for lack of this convergence, many Albanian farmers have been tempted by higher freedom, to carry out the same work on farms in foreign countries, and have emigrated abroad. Structural reform must lie in the front row towards the functioning of the agricultural land market. No doubt, this requires the clear definition of farmland against them  3/5 06/08/2022, 09:11 Governor Fullani's discussion at the "Agriculture and Regional Development" meeting, organised by the Institute for Democracy and Reform... for other uses, clarifying the titles of ownership of these lands. This would allow the creation of larger farms, optimization of agricultural land reports with a working wing and capital, the movement towards better convergence, the realization of economies of scale and, consequently, increased productivity. This reform alone can guarantee successful and moreover sustainable developments in this sector. --- Infrastructure and collection and distribution system improvements, too, are of particular importance. These improvements would increase the market prospect for agricultural products (compared to that for internal use by rural families themselves). Let me mention here that as a result of the inadequacy of collection and distribution systems, not in a few cases agricultural products remain unsold or sold at low prices, in overfed local markets while their prices in other markets are multiples higher. Even worse, as a result of lack of infrastructure and mecanization, farmland remains unprocessed. Improving the collection and distribution system can formalize initiatives in this sector and turn them into better businesses, making them more transparent, valuable and monitorable. Consequently, it will be able to promote the co-operation of the financial sector with that agricultural sector. While improving road, irrigation and drainage infrastructure is necessary to offer our farmers equal conditions and opportunities, with those of farmers in other countries of the region. --- Agriculture financing and lending is another important pillar. The reasons for the lack of this lending concern the low productivity of the agriculture sector itself, the non-optimization of its inputs, the informalization of agricultural initiatives and their lack of market perspective. Consequently, in the long term it is necessary to guarantee the reforms mentioned above in the direction of increasing productivity and formalisation of agricultural initiatives, so that the agricultural sector can be seen with more interest from banks as well. However, at the same time, all spaces of alternative nature should be examined. Schemes tested in other countries, where agriculture is an important part of economic development, can arise from both public and private initiatives. The important thing is to add alternatives to specialized financing of the agricultural sector. For the past two years, the Bank of Albania has been pursuing the development of agricultural lending institutions with a view to helping them develop in the form of good financial institutions and to behave in accordance with the best standards of transparency, creditand efficiency. In this way, banks will evaluate them as real partners in the process of channeling funds into the agricultural sector. The Bank of Albania's improvement of the institutional, regulatory and reporting aspect of the activity of these institutions will incorporate the latter and their lending network into a  4/5 06/08/2022, 09:11 Governor Fullani's discussion at the "Agriculture and Regional Development" meeting, organised by the Institute for Democracy and Reform... organic parts of the financial system. Specialized agriculture lending agencies need to consolidate and create comparative priorities against banks in general, for the selection of convenient projects, risk assessment, etc. The creation of modern instruments for financing and financial support of agricultural activity, introducing dedicated services and products for particular segments, which currently remain outside financing schemes, would offer the right alternative, as long as universal banks still do not find it convenient and do not have the preavailability and skills, to act on the lending of this sector. These institutions, on the other hand, will also serve to mobilise and distribute the most effective funds temporarily free of various economic agents, giving further impetus to innovations leading to the development of the financial market. Organized in this form, they will generate positive effects in the social and educational context of the agricultural sector. Therefore, it can be said that these institutions represent an essential element of economic and financial infrastructure for employment and economic growth, especially for the agricultural sector and the respective community. 4: Closure In the end, I would like to thank the organizers of the meeting once again for their idea found. I hope that many of the conclusions of this meeting will become part of our short-term and long-term development plans of the country. Thank you.  5/5
