Prfitoj nga rasti pr t prshndetur iniciativn e organizatorve t ktij takimi, pr mbajtjen e ktij evenimenti kaq domethns. Mendoj se debati i nivelit t lart qoft n publik, qoft n nivel institucional rreth ktyre problemeve ka qen i zbeht dhe sinqerisht dshiroj t ritheksoj se ky takim i sotm sht i duhuri dhe me shum interes nga kndvshtrimi i Banks s Shqipris. N disa prej daljeve t mija n publik, kam cituar ndikimin e ktij sektori ndaj argumenteve t tilla si inflacioni i mallrave t konsumit dhe deficiti tregtar, t cilat prbjn shtje t nj interesi t veante pr Bankn e Shqipris. Po kshtu, kam sjell n vmendje t publikut, rndsin dhe domosdoshmrin pr t ndrmarr reforma t thella strukturore, shum prej t cilave do t onin n zhvillimin e ktij sektori. Jo pa shkak edhe n mbledhjen e tij t fundit Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris ritheksoi (citim nga Kshilli Mbikqyrs)... "nevojn e ndrmarrjes s reformave strukturore n bujqsi, me qllim rritjen e eficiencs dhe prodhimit n kt sektor, n mnyr q n nj periudh afatmesme t mund t zvoglohen prmasat dhe efektet e goditjeve nga jasht, q kan t bjn me prodhimet bujqsore". N vazhdim do t'i rikthehem disave prej shtjeve q prmenda shkarazi m sipr. 2: Efekti n inflacion dhe n deficitin tregtar Luhatja e mimeve t produkteve bujqsore, t prpunuara apo jo, ka nj ndikim t shpejt dhe me intensitet t lart n inflacion. Kjo ndodh jo thjesht se mimet e mallrave ushqimor kudo karakterizohen nga nj sezonalitet i theksuar, por edhe pr faktin se pesha e mallrave ushqimor n totalin e indeksit t mimeve t konsumit n Shqipri sht m e lart se e t gjitha nngrupeve t tjera, rreth 40%. Pr rrjedhoj, zhvillimet n mimet e mallrave ushqimor marrin nj kuptim tjetr pr Bankn e Shqipris, n kontekst t prmbushjes s detyrimit t saj ligjor, arritjes s objektivit kryesor t stabilitetit t mimeve. Nj aspekt tjetr i rndsishm sht edhe thellimi i vazhdueshm i bilancit tregtar t ushqimeve, pavarsisht faktit nse bhet fjal pr produkte t prpunuara apo jo. Gjat pes viteve t fundit 2002 - 2007, deficiti tregtar n ushqime sht luhatur n intervalin 18% - 20% t totalit t deficitit tregtar. Elementi i tret q na bn shum t ndjeshm, mendoj se lidhet me zhvillimet e fundit n tregjet ndrkombtare, efekti i t cilave sht pasqyruar n Shqipri. Koht e fundit tregjet ndrkombtare po njohin shtrenjtim t drithrave dhe t produkteve me origjin bimore dhe shtazore https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Diskutimi_i_Guvernatorit_Fullani_ne_takimin_Bujqesia_dhe_Zhvillimi_Raj 2/5 06/08/2022, 09:11 shtazore. Diskutimi i Guvernatorit Fullani n takimin "Bujqsia dhe Zhvillimi Rajonal", organizuar nga Instituti pr Demokraci dhe Refor Arsyet dihen, por ajo q sht e pa qart ka t bj me kohzgjatjen e ktij fenomeni dhe imunitetin q ekonomi t ndryshme kan ndaj tij. Mendoj se pjesa m e vshtir ende na pret prpara, ndaj do t ishte e udhs q takimi i sotm t mos ishte i fundi. 3: Pengesat strukturore n bujqsi dhe reformat e nevojshme Prodhimi bujqsor haset me nj sr pengesash, ndr t cilat mund t prmendim: mosfunksionimi i tregut t toks bujqsore dhe paqartsit n titujt e pronsis, copzimi i madh i toks bujqsore, sistemi i dobt i grumbullimit dhe i shprndarjes, infrastruktura e pazhvilluar n zonat rurale, mungesa e teknologjis s duhur mekanike, mungesa e sistemeve t prshtatshme t vaditjes, mungesa e financimeve, marketingu i pamjaftueshm dhe plot arsye t tjera, t ngjashme. Pengesat strukturore t prmendura m sipr, konfirmohen edhe nga t dhnat e mposhtme. Bujqsia n Shqipri sht e drejtuar kryesisht nga plotsimi i nevojave t vet familjeve fermere. Vetm 30% e prodhimit bujqsor nxirret n treg. Gjithashtu, vlersohet q prodhimi bujqsor pr do fermer sht mesatarisht 4 her m i vogl se n antart e rinj t BE-s dhe 20 her m i vogl se antart e vjetr t BE-s. Bujqsia mbizotrohet nga ferma t vogla, me siprfaqe mesatare vetm 1.13 hektar. Forma aktuale e organizmit t bujqsis me ferma tepr t vogla dhe t copzuara e bn t pamundur shfrytzimin e ekonomive t shkalls, ul rentabilitetin e prdorimit t mekaniks bujqsore dhe pr pasoj, rezulton n kosto tepr t lart dhe produktivitet t ult n prodhimin bujqsor. M tej, natyra e ngusht familjare dhe e paformalizuar e ktyre fermave si dhe produktiviteti i ult, vshtirsojn shprndarjen e fondeve kredituese drejt ktij sektori, duke formuar kshtu nj rreth vicioz. Pikrisht, sht e nevojshme t ndrhyhet n kt rreth vicioz midis produktivitetit t ult, infrastrukturs dhe mekanizimit t pamjaftueshm, dhe mungess s financimeve. Pr kt qllim, mendoj se reforma strukturore n bujqsi sht e domosdoshme dhe duhet t synoj: rritjen e produktivitetit, uljen e kostove, prmirsimin e infrastrukturs, t sistemeve t grumbullimit dhe t shprndarjes. --- Rritja e produktivitetit n bujqsi mund arrihet vetm n saj t prmirsimit dhe optimizimit t raporteve midis inputeve tok, krah pune, kapital si edhe nprmjet konvergimit t ktyre raporteve, t paktn sipas standardeve t vendeve t rajonit. Krkesat n fjal mbshteten nga teorit e rritjes dhe zhvillimit, por kto nuk mund t arrihen vetvetiu, n qoft se nuk ndrmerren reforma t prshtatshme strukturore. M lejoni t prmend ktu se, pr pasoj t mungess s optimizimit t ktyre raporteve dhe pr munges t ksaj konvergjence, shum bujq shqiptar jan tunduar nga nj leverdishmri m e lart, pr t kryer t njjtn pun n ferma n vende t huaja, dhe kan emigruar jasht. Reforma strukturore duhet t shtrihet n rradh t par drejt funksionimit t tregut t toks bujqsore. Pa dyshim, q kjo krkon prcaktimin e qart t tokave bujqsore prkundrejt atyre https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Diskutimi_i_Guvernatorit_Fullani_ne_takimin_Bujqesia_dhe_Zhvillimi_Raj 3/5 06/08/2022, 09:11 Diskutimi i Guvernatorit Fullani n takimin "Bujqsia dhe Zhvillimi Rajonal", organizuar nga Instituti pr Demokraci dhe Refor pr prdorime t tjera, qartsimin e titujve t pronsis s ktyre tokave. Kjo do t lejonte krijimin e fermave m t mdha, optimizimin e raporteve tok bujqsore me krah pune dhe kapital, lvizjen drejt nj konvergjence m t mir, realizimin e ekonomive t shkalls dhe pr pasoj, rritjen e produktivitetit. Vetm kjo reform mund t garantoj zhvillime t suksesshme dhe pr m tepr, t qndrueshme n kt sektor. --- Prmirsimet e infrastrukturs dhe t sistemit t grumbullimit dhe shprndarjes gjithashtu, jan t nj rndsie t veant. Kto prmirsime do t rritnin perspektivn e tregut pr produktet bujqsore (prkundrejt asaj pr prdorim t brendshm nga vet familjet rurale). M lejoni t prmend ktu, se si pasoj e paprshtatshmris t sistemeve t grumbullimit dhe shprndarjes, jo n pak raste prodhimet bujqsore mbeten t pashitura ose shiten me mime t ulta, n tregje lokale t mbingopura ndrsa mimet e tyre n tregje t tjera jan shumfish m t larta. Akoma m keq, si pasoj e mungess s infrastrukturs dhe mekanizimit, tokat bujqsore mbeten t papunuara. Prmirsimi i sistemit t grumbullimit dhe shprndarjes mund t formalizoj iniciativat n ket sektor dhe t'i shndrroj ato n biznese m t mirfillta, duke i br m transparente, t vlersueshme e t monitorueshme. Pr rrjedhoj, do t mund t nxis bashkpunimin e sektorit financiar me at bujqsor. Ndrsa prmirsimi i infrastrukturs rrugore, vaditse dhe asaj kulluese sht i nevojshm pr t'i ofruar bujqve tan kushte dhe mundsi t barabarta, me ato t bujqve n vende t tjera t rajonit. --- Financimi dhe kreditimi i bujqsis prbn nj shtyll tjetr t rndsishme. Arsyet e mungess s ktij kreditimi kan t bjn n rradh t par me vet produktivitetin e ult t sektorit t bujqsis, me mosoptimizimin e inputeve t tij, me mosformalizimin e iniciativave bujqsore dhe mungesn e perspektivs s tyre t tregut. Pr rrjedhoj, n afat t gjat sht e nevojshme t garantohen reformat e prmendura m sipr n drejtim t rritjes s produktivitetit dhe formalizimit t iniciativave bujqsore, n mnyr q sektori bujqsor t shihet me m shum interes edhe nga bankat. Gjithsesi, n t njjtn koh duhet t shqyrtohen t gjitha hapsirat e natyrs alternative. Skema t testuara n vende t tjera, ku bujqsia sht pjes e rndsishme e zhvillimit ekonomik, mund t lindin si nga iniciativa publike ashtu edhe nga ato private. E rndsishme sht q t shtojm alternativat pr financimin e specializuar t sektorit bujqsor. Q prej dy vjetsh, Banka e Shqipris e ndjek me kujdes t veant zhvillimin e institucioneve t kreditimit t bujqsis, me synimin pr t'i ndihmuar ato t zhvillohen n formn e institucioneve t mirfillta financiare dhe t sillen n prputhje me standardet m t mira t transparencs, kredibilitetit dhe eficiencs. N kt mnyr, bankat do t'i vlersojn si partner real n procesin e kanalizimit t fondeve n sektorin bujqsor. Prmirsimi nga Banka e Shqipris i aspektit institucional, rregullativ dhe raportues t aktivitetit t ktyre institucioneve do t'i inkorporoj kto t fundit dhe rrjetin e tyre t kreditimit, n nj https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Diskutimi_i_Guvernatorit_Fullani_ne_takimin_Bujqesia_dhe_Zhvillimi_Raj 4/5 06/08/2022, 09:11 Diskutimi i Guvernatorit Fullani n takimin "Bujqsia dhe Zhvillimi Rajonal", organizuar nga Instituti pr Demokraci dhe Refor pjes organike t sistemit financiar. Agjencit e specializuara t kreditimit t bujqsis, nevojitet t konsolidohen dhe t krijojn prparsi krahasuese kundrejt bankave n prgjithsi, pr przgjedhjen e projekteve t leverdishme, vlersimin e rrezikut etj.. Krijimi i instrumenteve moderne pr financimin dhe mbshtetjen financiare t aktivitetit bujqsor, duke prezantuar shrbime dhe produkte t dedikuara pr segmente t veanta, q aktualisht mbeten jasht skemave t financimit, do t ofronte alternativn e duhur, pr aq koh sa bankat universale ende nuk e gjejn t leverdishme dhe nuk kan predispozicionin dhe aftsit, pr t vepruar n kreditimin e ktij sektori. Kto institucione nga ana tjetr, do t shrbejn dhe pr mobilizimin dhe shprndarjen m efektive t fondeve prkohsisht t lira t agjentve t ndryshm ekonomik, duke i dhn nj shtys t mtejshme risive q ojn n zhvillimin e tregut financiar. T organizuara n kt form, ato do t gjenerojn efekte pozitive n kontekstin social dhe at edukativ t sektorit bujqsor. Title: Speech at the joint press conference of the IMF mission with the Ministry of Finance and the Bank of Albania
text: 06/08/2022, 09:17 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the Forum with the actors of the financial system, with funk thematics... , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the Forum with the actors of the financial system, thematically functioning of the money market and financial, supervision and financial stability, Tirana International Hotel, Tirana, April 3 Publication date: 03.04.2008 Good afternoon to everyone, ... 1/10 06/08/2022, 09:17 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the Forum with the actors of the financial system, with funk thematics... Honored bankers, honorable participants, Today is a big day, marked for all of us. Today's long-announced meeting coincides with an event of particular importance. Invitation to NATO is a privilege that brings with it confidence, certification and security for new investments for Albania. At the same time and above all, it carries responsibility for achieving standards and materializing structural reform. Today's invitation to NATO is a guarantee of further integration into the European family. The Bank of Albania, following recent efforts to increase the financial market's performance as well as guarantee the stability of the banking system, comes before you today with a new initiative, at the centre of which is the installation of a periodic communication channel between it and the banking system. Indeed, our communication with the banking system has been continuous and at all levels, touching on a wide thematic of the momentary problems and perspective that accompany banking activity in Albania. I want to say that what is different about this new initiative is about the necessity of a permanent dialogue well structured by both content and time factor. More specifically, it is a periodic forum at the centre of which will be the analytical treatment of many questions and challenges that we must jointly address in the manner and timely manner. The financial market constitutes an argument that we have mentioned many times recently. In many of my public statements, in the statements of the Supervisory Council, in the reports and research materials of the institution, in many of the formal and informal contacts of the Bank of Albania with separate groups of banks or banks, special attention has been paid to the various elements affecting the deepening and expansion of the financial market. The same can be said for the financial stability of the system. However, I think the new one of this forum stands that inside the bankers' house, we will diagnose and together determine the right therapy, to guarantee one. ... 2/10 06/08/2022, 09:17 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the Forum with the actors of the financial system, with funk thematics... safe future. Similarly, even the period between the two meetings will consist of a dialogue continued at expert levels, to increase the degree of assimilation of tasks and conclusions that will come out of each forum. That's why I publicly invite you to be active, forward-minded, with concrete future-oriented proposals. The Bank of Albania understands directly how every private business, even the business of the banking community aims to maximise profit. Despite this, I wish to reemphasize once again that for us it remains as fundamental as it is: Continued improvement of bank governance; presentation of new products; functioning of the interbank market; increased movement of funds between the system; building full technological capacities; absorbing capable human resources; recognition and protection from numerous risks; adding lending to money; strengthening internal control; As well as publishing the results of your activity. I do not hesitate to repeat once again that for the Bank of Albania the stability of the banking system and the financial market performance are of fundamental importance. In this sense, I also invite you to consider these two priorities of the Bank of Albania as the main priority of your activity. During 2007 the Albanian economy has generally known positive developments. Sustainable economic growth was achieved in harmony with objectives for the stability of consumer prices and the budget deficit. The national currency was stable. 2007 was also good for the banking system. The net result of the banking system for 2007 is reported to be about 42 percent more than in 2006. The active banking system marked increases of 118.6 billion dollars or 19 percent higher than their situation at the end of 2006. The banking system's loan surplus during 2007 marked an increase of 94.5 billion dollars or 47.7 percent higher than the surplus of the end of 2006. Banks have grown electronic products in the service of their customers. Already in the Albanian banking system, 11 banks use electronic transactions. It is worth mentioning the expansion of internet banking service in three other banks of the system. Another evidence of increased banking competition as well as the increase in the volume of financial transactions through banks is the expansion of the banking network with new branches and agencies. During 2007, the number of branches and agencies within the territory of the Republic of Albania increased by 103, of which 43 were opened new, in the District of Tirana. During 2007, modern elements of the consolidation of the banking system were first demonstrated through the merger with the absorption of the two banks. ... 3/10 06/08/2022, 09:17 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the Forum with the actors of the financial system, with funk thematics... Another achievement is the creation of the credit register, which is considered an important element of ensuring the stability of the banking system. However, I want to stress that 2007 and the first months of 2008, correspond to a relatively complex situation in terms of global developments. Currently, we are facing a strong increase in prices of raw materials and food products, which is driven by a high growing demand of developing economies. Financial markets continue to reflect the negative effects of the credit crisis that generated the US economy. Unlike initial estimates, it appears that its spread is greater, infecting a significant number of large financial institutions. Central banks have been injecting liquidity steadily, while the Federal Reserve has aggressively lowered the basic interest rate to avoid a recession of the economy. Due to several factors related to the development characteristics of financial activity within the country, the difficult situation in international markets is not expected to have a real and significant effect on the internal financial market. However, the situation in international financial markets remains unstable, so its impact on the internal financial market may change. For this reason, it is necessary for these developments to be followed and carefully analysed by the country's financial institutions and regulatory authorities. Timely extension and possible worsening of the situation in international financial markets can have a reduced impact on the Albanian financial market through some headings, where we distinguish: The addition of the risk carried by fast lending and especially that in currencies, as a result of increased exchange rate fluctuations and frequent change in interest rates. Increased exposure of the financial system to sectors of the economy that are negatively affected by the slowdown in the regional and global economy. Combining difficulties in international financial markets, with the unfavourable dynamics of energy resource prices and the first substances of food products on a global scale. Honored participants, The problems I mentioned above naturally come to my aid to spend a little more time on financial stability issues, to leave it behind to the financial market efficiency. I guess I don't say any new ones I'm repeating once again, what I've repeatedly quoted as "the bank of Albania's main objective is consumer price stability". However, I consider that monetary policy and financial stability are two things inseparably related to each other. I personally find it difficult to determine where the balance is nowadays. However, I am convinced that any investments we make today to guarantee financial stability will return us to the added efficiency of monetary policy. ... 4/10 06/08/2022, 09:17 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the Forum with the actors of the financial system, with funk thematics... I'll try to make a ranking of the issues I'd like to draw your attention to: Credit to the economy. Currency lending is already a vulnerable reality. It is reached until consumer credit is granted in currency. Financing the consumption of individuals in currency is the same as sellfood products without a deadline. According to the statements made by our experts, it seems that banks are ordering a busy market, often not showing adequate quality care. The data confirmour concern about the addition of troubled loans. The index of troubled loans to the total loan portfolio in gross terms is estimated at 3.6 percent at the end of January 2008. The percentages for the loan in the money continue to be high. Referring to the loan maturing up to a year, according to January 2008 data, there is a 7.3 percentage point difference over percentages of deposits in money with the same maturity deadline. Meanwhile, the same index for currency is 4%. Currently, we are witnessing a very aggressive marketing strategy for foreign currency loan products, while with the exception of one case, it is totally non-existent for loans in money. I can continue to mention other contingencies of this nature. From numerous meetings with representatives of the banking system, I have more or less been familiar with the reasons that you think explain this situation. I would like to stress that there are objective reasons among them that I agree with, but in a good part I have to replicate with them, expressing the controversy of the Bank of Albania. From our perspective, we judge that you are still continuing to underestimate the risk of the exchange rate. Despite this, a perception of the ordinary public for a cheaper price of credit in currency, I think it is dangerous for the same philosophy to find room in you. Moreover, when the prevailing philosophy becomes it for market capture. We judge that you are currently distributing risk to individuals, creating problems of hazard moral nature. Taking advantage of this case, I sincerely want to ask you: how is it possible for consumer credit to be given in foreign currency? How can mortgage loans be granted in foreign currencies? Do you know that most of the individuals employed have the income in money? Which of the banks has made an estimate of exposure to this risk? Which of you has done any action to protect yourself from him? I hope that in your discussions you will address the above questions, as I think the time has come to stop in these problems, avoiding fictitious quotes. Under these conditions, the Bank of Albania has prepared a package of regulatory changes, which intersperses administrative measures with those of supervisory care and inspection. Without stopping at their detailed treatment, I would like to bring to your attention that changes to the "Credit Risk Management" regulation, in cases where the customer is not protected from exchange rate risk, will include these obligations for banks: ... 5/10 06/08/2022, 09:17 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the Forum with the actors of the financial system, with funk thematics... creation of reserve funds for loan losses; increase in capital when a certain limit on foreign currency exposure is violated. Risk management. The factors I decided to discuss today with you are related to each other. Above, I raised a concern about a specific risk, but what constitutes the second issue concerns risk in general, with the extent that your businesses are exposed to different risks. Let me remind you that you manage the savings of Albanians and for the flow, exposure not only endangers your capital but also those of individuals. For this reason, I ask for your maximum commitment to seriously assess this issue. I think the banking system needs to invest more in human resources and adequate infrastructure to recognise and manage towards the risks of activity. I would like to clarify that his life will be rigorously followed, becoming part of the assessments of the activity of each particular bank. Internal management and control. Good governance is the basis for sustainable business development and financial positions. This certainly requires people with high degrees of integrity and professionalism. To this end, we still expect your institutions to be very sensitive in this direction, especially in terms of the quality of human resources involved in decision-making and risk management. To this end, I will ask you to provide the right motivation to select qualified staff, creating the conviction that career and social reward will belong to those who actually deserve it. In some cases, the de facto concentration of decision-making in low hands is constituted, causing the institution's dependence to be concentrated on specific individuals. To this end, I think you should review all the internal procedures on which you develop your daily activity. The Bank of Albania has prepared a new regulation "For some basic criteria for the governance of banks and branches of foreign banks and their managers". This act defines the responsibilities and duties of the management structures of banking institutions. It is these structures that respond and guarantee the safe and sound functioning of the institutions they run. In this regulation, international best practices and standards from the Basel Committee and the European Union are incorporated. From a conceptual point of view, the content of this regulation has been expanded and includes: rules and criteria for effective governance; requirements related to reputation, qualifications and experience; evaluation criteria for the approval of administrators; ... 6/10 06/08/2022, 09:17 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the Forum with the actors of the financial system, with funk thematics... the conditions that bring their dismissal; the responsibilities of the management council and the directorate; criteria for the effectiveness of the work of the steering council; risk management policies and procedures. Governance-related problems will be seen with priority and seriousness by the Bank of Albania, during periodic assessments to be made to your activity. The banking system should prioritise strengthening the structures that control and guarantee the functioning, inform the rules of these procedures. I mean internal control, which needs to have a more active role. Internal control must be active, responsible, cover every cell of the bank in order to turn into a preventer of carrying and developing unwanted phenomena. Recently, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania adopted the regulation "For the internal control system in banks and branches of foreign banks". In this regulatory act, internal control in banks is considered an important part of bank governance. The regulation sets out the criteria for organising internal control, targeting its independent, impartial and responsible functioning. Transparency with the public. Koht e fundit, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris miratoi rregulloren "Pr sistemin e kontrollit t brendshm n banka dhe degt e bankave te huaja". N kt akt rregullativ, kontrolli i brendshm n banka, konsiderohet si pjes e rndsishme e qeverisjes s bankave. Rregullorja prcakton kriteret pr organizimin e kontrollit t brendshm, duke synuar funksionimin e pavarur, t paanshm dhe t prgjegjshm t tij. Transparenca me publikun. Qeverisja e mir kupton transparenc t rritur me klientt dhe tregun. A sht sistemi bankar n Shqipri aq transparent sa do t donim ne t ishte? Transparenca prbn nj shtje q e kam prekur sistematikisht kto koht e fundit. M duhet t pranoj se ka progres por mendoj se hendeku n kt drejtim sht ende i madh. Duke e vn veten n rolin e nj individi q do t konsumoj produkte apo shrbime bankare do t shtroj pyetjen: sa e leht sht pr mua q t orientohem sakt dhe shpejt pr alternativn m t mir? Po kshtu, si depozitues sa t leht e kam pr t msuar rreth gjendjes financiare t banks time? Cila sht banka q ofron komisionet m t leverdisshme? Ku mund ta gjej informacionin q m tregon se sa sht rritur banka ime gjat periudhs? Do t m duhet t pres nj vit pr t msuar dika apo mund t gjej nj informacion me frekuenc m t shpesht? A jeni t sigurt ju se klientt arrijn t kuptojn q shum prej ofertave q ju bni aktualisht jan me prfitime t prkohshme, pasi n nj koh t dyt kushtet e tyre ndryshojn? Duke mos dashur t futem n shum hollsi m duhet t kujtoj se pas krizs s kredive n Amerik, qndron edhe nj arsye shum e thjesht n dukje: edhe pse diku n kontratat q bankat firmosnin me individt e thjesht ishte pjesa specifike pr kushtet e kredis, ata n pjesn drrmuese nuk kishin dijeni pr to. M kt dua t them q nuk ka nevoj pr t br transparenc pr hir t transparencs. Duke i adresuar shtjet e msiprme mendoj se do t jemi m t mbrojtur. N qoft se nj klient i di deri n fund pasojat e kreditimit n valut kur t ardhurat i ka n lek, me siguri q ai do t hezitoj. N qoft se nj klient i kupton shum mir kushtet dhe penalitetet, prsri ai do t hezitoj. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_z_Ardian_Fullani_ne_F 7/10 06/08/2022, 09:17 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Pr t kaluar n nj shtje tjetr do t konkludoja duke theksuar edhe nj her: Transparenc me do mim dhe me do kusht! Duke prmbledhur sa m sipr, m lejoni t prsris edhe nj her se Banka e Shqipris do t krkoj nga strukturat drejtuese t bankave q n prgjithsi, t'i ndjekin me kujdes zhvillimet e tregut, t forcojn sistemet e kontrollit n institucionet e tyre, t marrin masa pr t diversifikuar sa m mir burimet financiare dhe drejtimet e investimit t tyre, t zhvillojn n vazhdimsi nj veprimtari t mirkapitalizuar dhe t monitorojn n mnyr t vazhdueshme rreziqet e saj. Banka e Shqipris do t prforcoj masat pr t pasuruar dhe pr t zbatuar kuadrin rregullativ, n drejtim t prmirsimit t prgjithshm t sistemeve t vlersimit t rrezikut n bankat tregtare, si edhe do t bashkpunoj me Autoritetin e Mbikqyrjes Financiare pr t nxitur zbatimin e plot t ktyre parimeve, n pjesn tjetr t tregut financiar. T nderuar bankier, Angazhimi i Banks s Shqipris n drejtim t zhvillimit t tregjeve t paras do t jet konkret n drejtim t kuadrit operacional, atij rregullativ dhe mbikqyrs. I par nga aspekti i zbatimit operacional t politiks monetare, angazhimi i Banks s Shqipris do t pasqyrohet n orientimin e operacioneve monetare drejt krijimit t nj strukture likuiditeti t prshtatshme, pr t gjallruar aktivitetin n tregun ndrbankar. Teprica strukturore e likuiditetit q ka karakterizuar sistemin bankar, sht shoqruar nga nj sjellje pasive e bankave, ndrkoh q prvoja t shumta tregojn nj lidhje t drejt, midis nj mungese strukturore t likuiditetit me zhvillimin e tregu ndrbankar. Pavarsisht ktij synimi, dua t theksoj se n asnj rast, arritja e tij nuk do t komprometoj objektivin kryesor: zbatimin e politiks monetare. Pr kt qllim, do t krkoja q orientimi i operacioneve drejt nj deficiti strukturor likuiditeti t vlersohet si nj mundsi fitimprurse pr institucionin tuaj. Shfrytzimi i ksaj mundsie nga njerzit q ju duhet t trajnoni dhe motivoni, do t sjell zhvillimin e tregut t paras, e cila n analiz t fundit do t jet fitimprurse pr ju edhe n dobi t nj transmetimi m eficient t politiks monetare. Duke ju siguruar transparenc t plot dhe asistenc teorike dhe praktike n lidhje me kto operacione, dua t sqaroj edhe nj her tre aspekte themelore t puns son: 1. S pari, sinjalizimi i politiks monetare sht dhe do t vazhdoj t bhet vetm nprmjet vendimit t Kshillit Mbikqyrs s Banks s Shqipris pr normn baz t interesit 2. S dyti, instrument kryesor pr zbatimin e politiks monetare sht dhe do t vazhdoj t jet marrveshja e riblerjes me maturim njjavor. 3. S treti, prdorimi i instrumenteve me afat m t gjat maturimi apo forma e ankandit, nuk mbartin asnj lloj sinjali t politiks monetare prve se jan teknika operacionale pr https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_z_Ardian_Fullani_ne_F 8/10 06/08/2022, 09:17 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Pr t'ju krijuar m shum hapsir n drejtim t administrimit t likuiditetit dhe nga ana tjetr, pr t nxitur pozicionimin tuaj aktiv n tregun e paras, po punohet q t zgjerohet hapsira e prdorimit t rezervs s detyruar. Do t jet aftsia juaj profesionale ajo q do t bj transformimin e ksaj lehtsie, nga nj mundsi pr t plotsuar krkesat e papritura pr likuiditet, n nj alternativ konkrete pr t'u pozicionuar n treg n baz t pritjeve t mirbazuara. T gjitha kto masa kan nj emrues t prbashkt: zhvillimin e tregut ndrbankar t paras. Kto masa nuk do t kishin efektivitet pa angazhimin tuaj. Pr t shmangur do justifikim t natyrs subjektive, m lejoni t risjell n vmendjen tuaj projektligjin e hartuar nga Banka e Shqipris, pr marrveshjet e riblerjes ndrmjet bankave t sistemit. Aktualisht, projektligji sht n proces miratimi. Miratimi i ktij ligji do t krkoj nj angazhim m t madh nga ana juaj, pr t shfrytzuar kt instrument t ri. N kt kuadr, krkojm nga ju q t filloni prgatitjet pr t zbatuar n praktik kt ligj, pasi justifikimet nuk do t jen t mirpritura. Tregu i repove n Eurozon sht tregu m i madh ndrbankar, duke zn 35 pr qind t totalit t tregtimit. Bankat, t cilat jan pronare t pjess m t madhe t sistemit bankar n Shqipri jan prbrse t ktij tregu dhe si t tilla, ne besojm q do t jen t gatshme dhe interesuara, t ofrojn asistenc pr tregtimin nprmjet marrveshjeve t riblerjes edhe n tregun vendas. Pjesmarrsit e tregut duhet t kontribuojn n ndrtimin e nj tregu financiar t zhvilluar dhe eficient, pasi n kt mnyr rrisin shanset q t prcaktojn sakt mimin e produkteve t tyre. Shpresoj q forumi n vazhdimin e tij t jet i frytshm dhe debatues. U prpoqa q t hedh n tryezn e debatit disa shtje dhe probleme me t cilat mendoj se duhet t prballemi dhe ku roli i secilit prej nesh sht konkret dhe i prekshm. Un dua t'ju siguroj se Banka e Shqipris do t jet trsisht e angazhuar n marrjen e masave pr nxitjen, rritjen dhe zgjerimin e tregut dhe t instrumenteve t ndrmjetsimit financiar. Ky forum do t konfirmoj rolin e Banks s Shqipris dhe t sistemit bankar si dy nga faktort e rndsishm n zhvillimin e ekonomis n prgjithsi dhe t sistemit financiar, m n veanti. Fatmirsisht, kur do institucion financiar ndjek motivet dhe sht i kujdesshm pr stabilitetin e vet financiar, ather kjo do t garantonte prosperitet afatgjat t t gjith sistemit, efikasitet t lart t primit t politikave ekonomike n prgjithsi, dhe t politiks monetare m n veanti. Prandaj, ju ftoj t'i ndiqni kto stimuj pr t siguruar objektivat tuaj dhe njkohsisht, pr t'i ofruar nj shrbim m cilsor publikut. text: 06/08/2022, 09:17 Mr Ardian Fullani, at the joint press conference of the Ministry of Finance... BANK OF ALBANIA PRESS CONFERENCE Mr Ardian Fullani, at the joint press conference of the Ministry of Finance, BSh- and the IMF at the conclusion of consultations on Article IV and the PRGF-EFF Agreement Review Mission in Albania. Publication date: 14.05.2008 Over the past two weeks the Bank of Albania has been part of negotiations albanian authorities have held with the IMF Mission as part of the review of the agreement's line of action.  1/3 06/08/2022, 09:17 Mr Ardian Fullani, at the joint press conference of the Ministry of Finance... developed with the IMF Mission, as part of the review of the agreement's line of play. Albania with the IMF. Discussions have focused on assessing conditions and some of the problems in our economy recently. I take the opportunity to stress that overall we share the same assessment for the past period, for causes as well as where risks have shifted from in the near future. Regarding the overall macroeconomic situation, the Bank of Albania estimates that the economy continues to enjoy a stable balance. According to initial estimates, overall production is expected to increase to the same level as in 2007. What constitutes interest is related to the reaction of agricultural production, especially in the context of the many incentives that offer increased prices of agricultural products. The disruption of massive and long-term energy supply restrictions has positively influenced the production and consumption process, compared to the second half of last year. However, as in the past, energy continues to remain a delicate problem, one of the main risks to the country's economic activity. During the first 4 months of 2008, external environmental pressure in the local economy continued, manifested mainly in the continued increase in food prices, commodity prices and oil prices. Annual inflation at the end of April 2008 stopped at 4.4 per cent, exceeding by about 0.4 percentage points the upper 3/-1% interval limit, targeted by the Bank of Albania. This figure itself reflects the contribution of the processed food group and the increase in the price of electricity in March 2008. The recent increase in the price of electricity has contributed 0.7 percentage points. Based on short-term forecasts, it turns out that inflation will continue to fluctuate at current levels even during the following months, reaching the end of 2008 slightly below the upper level of the target area, targeted by the Bank of Albania. During the first months of 2008, fiscal developments show a satisfactory performance in the collection of budgetary income. Another development that requires special attention concerns deepening the korean account deficit. Last year's data support this concern. The country's trade activity with the rest of the world, for the first months of 2008, testifies to a steady rate on the part of exports, which is still insufficient to balance the effect of increased imports, on the other hand. Stopping at future developments, the Bank of Albania estimates that supply pressures are still in the growing direction and prevail against those on the demand side. Recent developments in international markets as well as expected developments leave open the possibility for new developments in this direction. Food goods, raw materials but especially oil and its by-products are recognizing unstoppable growth in the international market.  2/3 06/08/2022, 09:17 Mr Ardian Fullani, at the joint press conference of the Ministry of Finance... However, the risks are also determined by the demand arm, and mostly related to the rapid expansion of credit for the economy. Particular importance must also be dedicated to possible measures that authorities can take to soften the effect of rising prices of food goods. In this direction, the Bank of Albania considers it reasonable to adopt measures that enable the direct financing of people in need. This means, schemes or certain public programmes supporting the poorest categories of the population. Any measure of the other subsidising nature or wage growth should be well studied to avoid the side effects of the nature of the second round and the promotion of a new inflationary cycle (where prices raise wages and wages raise prices). A particular importance is also devoted to inflationary expectations, which until now have been best anchored around the level targeted by the Bank of Albania. Further orientation of these expectations is a real challenge, which combines the combination of many measures. But among them I would single out, continued communication about this problem, clarification of the entire inflation process and the role of monetary policy. The Bank of Albania will continue to continuously publicise the balance of risks in the economy, expressing willingness and will to respond proactively, in accordance with the circumstances and conditions of the moment. The Bank of Albania, as the country's monetary authority, is maximum dedicated to making the right decisions. This is in line with the developments made and especially, assessing the possibility of materializing expected developments. The fundamental objective remains the long-term anchoring of inflationary expectations towards the target level as well as the sustainability of the financial stability of the banking system.  3/3

Ardian Fullani, n konferencn e prbashkt pr shtyp t Ministris s Finan kan zhvilluar me Misionin e FMN-s, n kuadr t rishikimit t rradhs s marrveshjes t Shqipris me FMN-n. Diskutimet jan prqendruar n vlersimin e kushteve dhe disa prej problemeve t shfaqura n ekonomin ton kto koht e fundit. Prfitoj nga rasti t theksoj se n trsi ndajm t njjtin vlersim pr periudhn e kaluar, pr shkaqet si dhe pr kahun nga jan zhvendosur rreziqet n t ardhmen e afrt. N lidhje me situatn e prgjithshme makroekonomike, Banka e Shqipris vlerson se ekonomia vazhdon t gzoj nj ekuilibr t qndrueshm. Sipas vlersimeve t para, prodhimi i prgjithshm pritet t rritet n t njjtin nivelin me at t vitit 2007. Ajo q prbn interes lidhet me reagimin e prodhimit bujqsor, veanrisht n kontekst t stimujve t shumt q ofrojn mimet e rritura t produkteve bujqsore. Ndrprerja e kufizimeve masive dhe t gjata t furnizimit t energjis ka influencuar pozitivisht procesin e prodhimit dhe t konsumit, n krahasim me gjysmn e dyt t vitit t kaluar. Megjithat, ashtu si dhe n t kaluarn, energjia vazhdon t mbetet nj problem delikat, nj nga rreziqet kryesore pr aktivitetin ekonomik t vendit. Gjat 4 muajve t par t vitit 2008, ka vazhduar presioni i ambientit t jashtm n ekonomin vendase, i shfaqur kryesisht n rritjen e vazhduar t mimeve t mallrave ushqimor, t mimeve t lndve t para dhe t mimeve t nafts. Inflacioni vjetor n fund t muajit prill 2008 u ndal n nivelin 4.4 pr qind, duke tejkaluar me rreth 0.4 pik prqindjeje kufirin e siprm t intervalit 3+/-1 %, t synuar nga Banka e Shqipris. Kjo shifr n vetvete pasqyron kontributin e grupit t ushqimeve t prpunuara dhe rritjen e mimit t energjis elektrike, n muajin mars 2008. Rritja e fundit e mimit t energjis elektrike ka kontribuar me 0.7 pik prqindjeje. Mbshtetur n parashikimet afatshkurtra, rezulton se inflacioni do t vazhdoj t luhatet n nivelet aktuale edhe gjat muajve n vazhdim, duke arritur n fund t vitit 2008 pak m posht se niveli i siprm i zons objektiv, t synuar prej Banks s Shqipris. Gjat muajve t par t vitit 2008, zhvillimet fiskale dshmojn pr nj ecuri t knaqshme t grumbullimit t t ardhurave buxhetore. Nj zhvillim tjetr q krkon vmendje t veant ka t bj me thellimin e deficitit t llogaris korente. T dhnat e vitit t kaluar e mbshtesin kt shqetsim. Aktiviteti tregtar i vendit me pjesn tjetr t bots, pr muajt e par t vitit 2008, dshmon pr nj ritm t qndrueshm nga ana e eksporteve, i cili gjithsesi sht i pamjaftueshm pr t ekulibruar efektin e importeve t rritura, nga ana tjetr. Duke u ndalur n zhvillimet e s ardhmes, Banka e Shqipris vlerson se presionet nga ana e oferts jan ende n kahun rrits dhe mbizotrojn ndaj atyre nga krahu i krkess. Zhvillimet e fundit n tregjet ndrkombtare si dhe ato t pritshme ln t hapur mundsin pr zhvillime t reja n kt drejtim. Mallrat ushqimor, lndt e para por veanrisht nafta dhe nnproduktet e saj po njohin rritje t pandalshme n tregun ndrkombtar. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_z_Ardian_Fullani_ne_ko 2/3 06/08/2022, 09:17 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris z. Ardian Fullani, n konferencn e prbashkt pr shtyp t Ministris s Finan Megjithat, rreziqet jan t vendosura edhe nga krahu i krkess dhe m s shumti, lidhen me zgjerimin e shpejt t kredis pr ekonomin. Rndsi e veant i duhet kushtuar edhe masave t mundshme q autoritetet mund t ndrmarrin pr t zbutur efektin e rritjes s mimeve t mallrave ushqimor. N kt drejtim Banka e Shqipris gjykon t arsyeshme q t adoptohen masa q mundsojn financimin e drejtprdrejt t njerzve n nevoj. Kjo nnkupton, skema apo programe t caktuara publike t mbshtetjes s kategorive m t varfra t popullats. do mas e natyrs tjetr subvencionuese apo e rritjes s pagave, duhet t jet e studiuar mir pr t shmangur efektet ansore t natyrs s raundit t dyt dhe nxitjen e nj cikli t ri inflacionist ( ku mimet rrisin pagat dhe pagat rrisin mimet). Nj rndsi e veant i kushtohet edhe pritjeve inflacioniste, t cilat deri n kt moment kan qen t ankoruara m s miri rreth nivelit t synuar prej Banks s Shqipris. Orientimi i mtejshm i ktyre pritjeve sht nj sfid e vrtet, e cila ndrthur kombinimin e shum masave. Por midis tyre do t veoja, komunikimin e vazhdueshm pr kt problem, sqarimin e t gjith procesit t inflacionit dhe rolin e politiks monetare. Banka e Shqipris do t vazhdoj t bj publik n mnyr t vazhdueshme bilancin e rreziqeve n ekonomi, duke shprehur gatishmrin dhe vullnetin pr t reaguar n mnyr proaktive, n prputhje me rrethanat dhe kushtet e momentit. Banka e Shqipris, si autoriteti monetar i vendit sht maksimalisht e prkushtuar pr t marr vendimet e duhura. Kjo n prputhje me zhvillimet e faktuara dhe veanrisht, duke vlersuar mundsin e materializimit t zhvillimeve t pritshme. Dr. Fatos Ibrahimi, banking and financial activities in Albania and Southeast Europe Publication date: 16.05.2008 Honored, Mr. Minister, Honorable participants, It is a pleasure to participate in this important promotional forum and present some of the main developments of the banking system in Albania, as one of the fastest developing and positively contributing sectors to the country's sustainable economic growth and macroeconomic stability. Financial activity in Albania, as well as in other Southeast European countries, has experienced significant and significant developments in recent years. One of the main traits observed is that financial activity in Albania is dominated by banking activity, while nonbank activity remains very limited. At the end of 2007, the total active banking system accounted for about 96.8% of the total active people of the entire financial system, while those of the nonbank system accounted for only 3.2%. Consequently, the need to reform the nonbank financial system and enable supervision according to its best practices has been demonstrated. This goal also served the establishment of the Financial Supervision Agency in 2006. The development of non-bank financial mediators and capital markets would provide alternative ways of financing and positively affect the efficiency and competitiveness of the financial system.  tet_bankare_dhe_financiare_ne_Shqiperi_dhe_Evropen_Juglindore.html Page 1 of 5 The word of the Deputy Governor of the Bank of Albania Prof. Assoc. D... banking and financial titillating in Albania and Southeast Europe 29/07/22, 14:59 Another important tendency is that the rate of banking mediation in Albania has seen significant increases in recent years, but is low compared to that of Eurozone countries. The total number of bank system assets against GDP in Albania was 76%, 69% and 60% respectively at the end of 2007, 2006 and 2005 respectively. This indicator for Albania is close to the average for Southeast European countries, but remains far from the average for Eurozone countries where the value reaches about 240%. The increase in banking mediation is also noted in the addition of the type of financial products, greater geographical coverage and rapid credit growth. Rapid credit growth poses a very important and very sensitive issue for the banking system, so I would like to stop a little longer to explain what are the factors that have influenced this rapid growth these last 4-5 years, what impacts does it have on economic growth in general and on the stability of the financial system in particular? In this respect, rapid credit growth, on the one hand, is explained as a necessary convergence process that helps economic growth supported by domestic demand and the fact that it is calculated on a very low initial basis. On the other hand, it is commented on as a dangerous phenomenon for both price stability through the impact on aggregate demand and financial stability through the unfolding of unstable prices for various estates. The rapid increase in loans in many countries has been accompanied by a balloon increase in prices of various assets, such as the prices of real estate, which have subsequently exploded and negatively affected the value of collateral and the quality of loans issued to them. The freshest case of the consequences of this phenomenon is the "sub-prime" market crisis in the United States of America, which has not yet exhausted its negative and contaminant consequences for other countries. This crisis, emerging as a liquidity crisis, with direct impacts on capital markets coupled with the food products crisis, as well as the rapid rise in the price of oil has cast a lot of questions about the development prospects of the world economy. Rritja e ndrmjetsimit bankar vihet re edhe n shtimin e llojshmris s produkteve financiare, n mbulimin m t madh gjeografik dhe n rritjen e shpejt t kredis. Rritja e shpejt e kredis prbn nj shtje tepr t rndsishme dhe mjaft delikate pr sistemin bankar, prandaj do t doja t ndalesha pak m gjat pr t shpjeguar se cilt jan faktort q kan ndikuar n kt rritje kaq t vrullshme kto 4-5 vitet e fundit, far ndikimesh ka ajo n rritjen ekonomike n prgjithsi dhe n stabilitetin e sistemit financiar n veanti? Teprica e kredis n Shqipri ka shfaqur norma t larta rritjeje vjetore: 48%, 55% dhe 82% gjat viteve 2007, 2006 dhe 2005 respektivisht. N kt mnyr Shqipria sht evidentuar si nj nga vendet me rritjen m t lart t kredis gjat ktyre tre viteve t fundit. Gjithsesi, teprica e kredis ndaj PBB-s n Shqipri pr vitin 2007 ishte 30% dhe pr vitin 2006 ishte 22%, duke qen e ult n krahasim me at t Eurozons. Studimi "Bankingu n Evropn Juglindore" nga ekipi krkimor i Deutsche Bank, ndrmjet t tjerave, vlerson se cili duhet t ishte niveli ekuilibr i kredis pr sektorin privat ndaj PBB-s pr disa vende t rajonit, n rast se do t ishte arritur konvergjenca me at t Eurozons. Sipas ktij studimi, ky nivel pr Shqiprin duhet t ishte rreth dy her m i lart se niveli aktual. N kt aspekt, rritja e shpejt e kredis, nga njra an, shpjegohet si nj proces i nevojshm konvergjence q ndihmon rritjen ekonomike t mbshtetur nga krkesa e brendshme dhe nga fakti se llogaritet mbi nj baz fillestare tepr t ult. Nga ana tjetr, komentohet si nj fenomen i rrezikshm si pr stabilitetin e mimeve nprmjet ndikimit n krkesn agregate, ashtu edhe pr stabilitetin financiar nprmjet shpalosjes s mimeve t paqndrueshme pr asete t ndryshme. Rritja e shpejt e kredive n shum vende sht shoqruar me nj rritje tullumbace t mimeve t aseteve t ndryshme, si pr shembull t mimeve t pasurive t paluajtshme, t cilat m pas kan shprthyer dhe kan ndikuar negativisht vlern e kolateralit dhe cilsin e kredive t emetuara ndaj tyre. text: , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in the Monetary Policy Statement for the second six months of 2008 29/07/22, 14:59 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in the Monetary Policy Statement for the second six months of 2008 Publication date: 29.01.2009 1. Governor's Word The world economy and especially the financial system suffered major shocks during the second six months of 2008. The crisis that struck the heart of the global financial system was progressively and unstoppably transmitted into the economic activity of developed countries, leading some of them to recession. The Albanian economy has managed to resist this striking wave during the period in question. According to available official data and judging on a range of indirect indicators, the Bank of Albania states that 2008 economic activity has generally developed in line with early forecasts, both in terms of economic growth and in the direction of preserving macroeconomic balances. In particular, the Bank of Albania has fulfilled its primary mandate, contributing to maintaining price stability. The average inflation rate during 2008 marked the 3.4 percent value, being close to our target. The latest developments in the world rank testify to a further slowdown in economic activity. Despite falling inflationary pressures as a result of falling demand and reduced prices of basic products, tightening lending standards and the resulting slowdown in investment consumption have caused uncertainty about the duration of the problematic situation to still be present. Under these circumstances, coping with shrinking global economic activity still remains an open issue. Eurozone countries are already experiencing economic slowdowns. During the third quarter of the year, eurozone GDP recorded a contraction in the economy while the unemployment rate reached 7.8 percent in November. Similar traits also show the U.S. economy. Further weakening economic activity  eklaraten_e_Politikes_Monetare_per_gjashtemujorin_e_dyte_2008.html Page 1 of 5 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in the Monetary Policy Statement for the second six months of 2008 29/07/22, 14:59 - As a result of the deterioration of U.S. company and household balance sheet financial indicators, reflected in lower spending on consumption and declining aggregate investments has affected the increase in the unemployment rate to 7.2 percent. Monetary and fiscal incentives administered by central banks and finance ministries have served to restore confidence and ease pressure on financial institutions. In the face of these developments, the untouchability of developing countries' economies is showing the first signs of shaking. In contrast to the first six months of the year, the latest data suggest a moderation in the pace of economic growth for most of them. The channels through which slowing developed countries have influenced developing economies are different, depending on their development specifics. Thus, China and India have been negatively hit by slowing exports, Russia has suffered the reduction in the price of raw materials on the world market, while Eastern European countries have been affected by tightening financing conditions at global level. In contrast to many developing countries, the Albanian economy has had as its main feature of its development support in domestic demand, while, although growing, external demand in the form of Albanian exports has had a proportionally lower impact on economic growth. Similarly, economic activity in the country is almost entirely supported by internal sources of financing, while the role of foreign financing, in the form of credit lines or portfolio investments, has been unpriority. Acting within all financial health parameters, the Albanian banking system has been dynamic and effective in channelling economy savings towards financing firmmanufacturing activities or citizens' consumption. This process has also been facilitated by macroeconomic stability, which has enabled the reduction of risk premiums in the economy and has helped to gradually extend the investment horizon. These features have caused economic activity in the country to mark satisfactory growth during the first three quarters of 2008, a period covered by statistical data. Meanwhile, indirect data on economic activity during the last quarter, mainly financial, suggest a slight slowdown in economic activity in this period, but remaining within 2008 forecasts. The main contributor to the increase in the value of afarism in volume was the manufacturing sector, where the construction branch follows to have the main weight. Investments in major road infrastructure projects and the emergence of construction permits from prolonged cramping have driven the high increase in building activity rhythms during this period. Also, the services sector continues to maintain a major contribution to increasing economic activity in the country. Positive developments in domestic production are also supported by the increase in the indicator of economic tendency, assessed on the opinions of businesses and consumers, as well as the increase in the number of registered employees. The unemployment rate records an annual decline of 1.5 percent and is estimated at 12.62 percent. This decline is mainly influenced by the increase in the average number of employees in the private agricultural sector.  eklaraten_e_Politikes_Monetare_per_gjashtemujorin_e_dyte_2008.html Page 2 of 5 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in the Monetary Policy Statement for the second six months of 2008 29/07/22, 14:59 Despite inflationary pressures observed during early 2008, mainly as a result of the shock of supply factors, annual consumer price inflation returned within the Bank of Albania's target during the second half of the year. In the second half of the year, annual inflation marked values near the Bank of Albania's target of 3.0 percent and 2.5 percent, respectively, in each quarter. The performance of the inflation rate during the second six months of 2008 reflected the global effect of falling prices of broad-use goods (mainly food and fuel) goods, as well as a favourable price conjuncture for goods and services in the domestic market, as a result of covering demand for them with an ever-increasing offer. The return of inflation within the bank of Albania's target gang was conditioned not only on calming supply shocks, but also by adequate monetary conditions, which have enabled the balancing of demand and supply factors. During 2008, monetary policy was neutral and the basic interest rate was kept unchanged at 6.25 percent. Together with strengthening some bank oversight measures in the direction of risk management of loans, this policy has influenced a more balanced credit growth and has conveyed the right incentives for consumption and savings. Fair monetary policy and inflation control by the Bank of Albania are also reflected in anchoring expectations for inflation of economic agents near the 3 percent level targeted by the Bank of Albania. In the absence of unexpected blows on financial stability, inflationary expectations or other supply factors, the balance of risks to inflation during the ongoing period appears to be shifting to the fallen direction. In this context, it should not be left without mentioning the contribution of fiscal policy, which, through limiting the budget deficit to acceptable levels, has contributed to the preservation of macroeconomic balances. The realisation of public spending in line with the budgetary programme has helped to control internal demand pressures and strengthen confidence in the country's macroeconomic stability. Budgetary revenues, harvested by the end of November, have met the Finance Ministry's 11-month plan by about 96.4 percent, while spending has met 92 percent of the plan drawn up for this period. Budgetary developments for the period July-November 2008, following the developments of the first six months of the year, record a more rhythmic expenditure. The budget deficit created after the first six months of 2008 is financed mainly with foreign sources. On the other hand, the external sector of the economy has been characterized by the expansion of the crust account deficit. The third quarter of 2008 recorded an increase in the corent deficit by 48 percent in annual terms, reaching about 252m euros. Its ratio to GDP is estimated to have reached about 13.7 percent, being about 5 percentage points higher than in the same period in 2007. The deepening of the Corent deficit during this period contributed not only to the increase in the trade deficit, but also to the narrowing of the positive balance of the income account and the korean transfers. Its sustainability is a necessary condition for the country's financial stability and for sustainable and long-term growth. For this reason, the dynamics of payment balance developments constitute a constant monitoring object of the Bank of Albania, factoring it into our judgments for the suitability of monetary conditions.  eklaraten_e_Politikes_Monetare_per_gjashtemujorin_e_dyte_2008.html Page 3 of 5 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in the Monetary Policy Statement for the second six months of 2008 29/07/22, 14:59 The performance of monetary indicators during the second half of the year results generally stable, although there are signs of slowing growth rhythms during the end of the period. The average annual pace of monetary supply growth during this period fluctuated around 13 percent. The last months of 2008 were accompanied by the withdrawal of a small portion of deposits from the banking system, as a result of the ambiguity that caused global financial situations in specific layers of the population. In relative terms, these withdrawals have made up a small part of the balance sheet of commercial banks and have not affected the health indicators of the banking system or affected its ability to perform the role of financial mediator. Credit to the private sector has continued to play the main role among monetary expansion contributors. Annual loan growth has marked declines during this period, compared to the first six months. Mediation indicators have increased further; The ratio of the loan portfolio to deposits and total actives reached 63 percent and 43 percent respectively at the end of November. After September, the structure of the loan portfolio according to currencies shows a higher rate of annual loan growth in money. The performance of the loan portfolio by clientshows annual rates of higher growth, credit for businesses versus that for individuals. In contrast to the first part of the year, in the second six months there is a tendency to reduce the loan portfolio for construction and trade branches, and a slight increase for the industry branch. The activity of money markets during this period is conditioned by developments of monetary indicators and the real economy. As well as in the experiences of other countries, the increased sensitivity of banks to liquidity has brought down volumes of interbank trading and the increasing tendency of deposit interest rates. Meanwhile, over the last two months of the year, a decline in the report on government borrowing requirements and the expansion of some risk premiums has been noted. These phenomena have brought about rising interest rates of government-valued letters and, in some cases, credit. In response to these developments, the Bank of Albania has intervened in money markets by injecting liquidity with different maturity deadlines, according to system requirements. Also, to better serve the needs of banks, the Bank of Albania changed in November the form of auction of repurchase agreements, at auction without much restriction. * * * In their entirety, economic and financial developments during 2008 have been positive. Economic growth has been in line with early year forecasts while key indicators of macroeconomic and financial stability remain solid. The negative impact of global economy developments has been marginal. However, as with other developing countries, the Albanian economy cannot stay away for long from the direct or indirect impact of the global economic crisis. In the public statements of the Bank of Albania, we have stressed continuously that the impact of the global crisis on the Albanian economy will depend on both its intensity and duration. The timely sustainability and deepening dimensions of the world economy's problems is a signal that the Albanian economy will face a more difficult economic environment during 2009, which could set another set of problems for solution.  eklaraten_e_Politikes_Monetare_per_gjashtemujorin_e_dyte_2008.html Page 4 of 5 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in the Monetary Policy Statement for the second six months of 2008 29/07/22, 14:59 The channels that expose the Albanian economy more to the shocks of the global economic environment are the decline in remittances and the tightening of financing conditions. The expected potential impact of these factors would materialize into slower economic growth during 2009. We judge that the economic and financial plans of all economic agents should reflect this possibility. Lower economic growth does not necessarily translate into crisis for Albania, but is a temporary development dictated by external factors. Incentive policies must be built on this premise. They should not be developed in any case at the expense of long-term macroeconomic stability, which is also one of the most precious capitals the Albanian economy has achieved in these years of transition. Also, maintaining financial stability remains an important aspect for long-term economic development and in constant attention in the Bank of Albania's decision-making process. In this regard, I want to stress that the most rational behaviour for any individual, business or other actor of Albanian society would be faith in the banking system and its balance sheets, entirely transparent. Global practice has shown that the bilateral interaction between the real economy and the banking system, in the direction of saving savings, the use of its payment infrastructure, as well as the exploitation of its expertise in the field of financial advice and support with funds, is an essential feature of economies that have managed to leave behind the level of transitioncountries. In the end, I want to assure the public concerned that the Bank of Albania remains committed to creating premises that offer more breathing for the country's economic activity, but without affecting compliance with its price stability target. At the same time, it will continue to work for further consolidation of the country's financial stability. In this framework, the Bank of Albania's decisions will be a direct contribution to mitigating the negative effects that come from the international crisis, as well as help further sustain the country's economic and financial balances.  eklaraten_e_Politikes_Monetare_per_gjashtemujorin_e_dyte_2008.html Page 5 of 5

Fjala e Guvernatorit Ekonomia botrore dhe veanrisht sistemi financiar psuan tronditje t mdha gjat gjashtmujorit t dyt t vitit 2008. Kriza e cila goditi zemrn e sistemit financiar botror u transmetua n mnyr progresive e t pandalshme n aktivitetin ekonomik t vendeve t zhvilluara, duke i uar disa prej tyre n recesion. Ekonomia shqiptare ka arritur t i rezistoj ksaj vale goditse gjat periudhs n fjal. Sipas t dhnave zyrtare t disponueshme dhe duke gjykuar mbi nj sr treguesish t trthort, Banka e Shqipris konstaton se aktiviteti ekonomik i vitit 2008 sht zhvilluar prgjithsisht n linj me parashikimet e fillimvitit, si pr sa i prket rritjes ekonomike ashtu edhe n drejtim t ruajtjes s balancave makroekonomike. N veanti, Banka e Shqipris e ka prmbushur mandatin e saj parsor, duke kontribuar n ruajtjen e stabilitetit t mimeve. Norma mesatare e inflacionit gjat vitit 2008 shnoi vlern 3.4 pr qind, duke qen afr objektivit ton. Zhvillimet m t fundit n rang botror dshmojn pr nj ngadalsim t mtejshm t aktivitetit ekonomik. Pavarsisht rnies s presioneve inflacioniste si rezultat i rnies s krkess dhe reduktimit t mimeve t produkteve baz, shtrngimi i standardeve t kredidhnies dhe ngadalsimi rezultant i konsumit e investimeve, kan br q pasiguria n lidhje me kohzgjatjen e situats problematike t jet ende e pranishme. N kto rrethana, prballimi i tkurrjes s aktivitetit ekonomik botror mbetet ende nj shtje e hapur. Vendet e Eurozons po prjetojn tashm ngadalsim ekonomik. Gjat tremujorit t tret t vitit, PBB-ja e Eurozons regjistroi nj tkurrje t ekonomis ndrkoh q norma e papunsis arriti n 7.8 pr qind n muajin nntor. Tipare t ngjashme shfaq dhe ekonomia e SHBA-s. Stimujt monetar dhe fiskal t administruar nga bankat qendrore dhe ministrit e financave, kan shrbyer pr rivendosjen e besimit dhe lehtsimit t presionit mbi institucionet financiare. Prball ktyre zhvillimeve, paprekshmria e deritanishme e ekonomive t vendeve n zhvillim, po shfaq shenjat e para t lkundjes. N ndryshim nga gjashtmujori i par i vitit, t dhnat e fundit sugjerojn nj moderim t ritmit t rritjes ekonomike pr shumicn prej tyre. Kanalet nprmjet t cilve ngadalsimi i vendeve t zhvilluara ka ndikuar ekonomit n zhvillim jan t ndryshme, n varsi t specifikave t tyre t zhvillimit. Kshtu, Kina dhe India jan goditur negativisht nga ngadalsimi i eksporteve, Rusia ka vuajtur uljen e mimit t lndve t para n tregun botror, ndrkoh q vendet e Evrops Lindore jan ndikuar nga shtrngimi i kushteve t financimit n rang botror. N ndryshim nga shum vende n zhvillim, ekonomia shqiptare ka patur si tipar kryesor t zhvillimit t saj mbshtetjen n krkesn e brendshme, ndrkoh q, megjithse n rritje, krkesa e jashtme n formn e eksporteve shqiptare ka patur nj ndikim proporcionalisht m t ult n rritjen ekonomike. Po kshtu, aktiviteti ekonomik n vend sht mbshtetur pothuaj trsisht nga burimet e brendshme t financimit, ndrsa roli i financimit t huaj, n formn e linjave t kreditit apo t investimeve t portofolit, ka qen joprioritar. Duke vepruar brenda t gjith parametrave t shndetit financiar, sistemi bankar shqiptar sht treguar dinamik dhe efektiv n kanalizimin e kursimeve t ekonomis drejt financimit t aktiviteteve prodhuese t firmave apo konsumit t qytetarve. Ky proces sht lehtsuar edhe nga stabiliteti makroekonomik, i cili ka mundsuar uljen e primeve t rrezikut n ekonomi dhe ka ndihmuar n zgjatjen graduale t horizontit t investimeve. Kto veori kan br q aktiviteti ekonomik n vend t shnoj rritje t knaqshme gjat tre tremujorve t par t vitit 2008, periudh kjo e cila mbulohet me t dhna statistikore. Ndrkoh, t dhna t trthorta mbi aktivitetin ekonomik gjat tremujorit t fundit, kryesisht financiare, sugjerojn pr nj ngadalsim t leht t aktivitetit ekonomik n kt periudh, por duke mbetur brenda parashikimeve t vitit 2008. Kontribuesi kryesor n rritjen e vlers s afarizmit n vllim ishte sektori i prodhimit, ku dega ndrtim vijon t ket peshn kryesore. Investimet n projekte madhore t infrastrukturs rrugore dhe dalja e lejeve t ndrtimit nga ngri i tejzgjatur, kan nxitur rritjen e lart t ritmeve t aktivitetit ndrtues gjat ksaj periudhe. Gjithashtu, edhe sektori i shrbimeve vijon t ruaj nj kontribut parsor n rritjen e aktivitetit ekonomik n vend. Zhvillimet pozitive n prodhimin vendas mbshteten edhe nga rritja e treguesit t tendencs ekonomike, vlersuar mbi opinionet e bizneseve dhe t konsumatorve, ashtu si edhe rritja e numrit t regjistruar t t punsuarve. Norma e papunsis regjistron nj rnie vjetore prej 1.5 pr qind dhe vlersohet n nivelin 12.62 pr qind. Kjo rnie, sht ndikuar kryesisht nga rritja e numrit mesatar t t punsuarve n sektorin privat bujqsor. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjaeklaraten_e_Politikes_Monetare_per_gjashtemujorin_e_dyte_2008.html Pagina 2 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, Z. Ardian Fullani, n Deklaratn e Politiks Monetare pr gjashtmujorin e dyt 2008 29/07/22, 14:59 Megjith presionet inflacioniste t vna re gjat fillimit t vitit 2008, kryesisht si rezultat i goditjes s faktorve t oferts, inflacioni vjetor i mimeve t konsumit u kthye brenda objektivit t Banks s Shqipris gjat gjysms s dyt t vitit. N gjysmn e dyt t vitit, inflacioni vjetor shnoi vlera pran objektivit t Banks s Shqipris, prkatsisht 3.0 pr qind dhe 2.5 pr qind, n secilin tremujor. Ecuria e norms s inflacionit gjat gjashtmujorit t dyt t vitit 2008, pasqyroi efektin global t rnies t mimeve t mallrave t prdorimit t gjer (kryesisht atyre ushqimor dhe karburanteve), si dhe nj konjuktur t favorshme mimesh pr mallrat dhe shrbimet n tregun vendas, si rezultat i mbulimit t krkess pr to me nj ofert gjithnj n rritje. Rikthimi i inflacionit brenda bands s synuar nga Banka e Shqipris u kushtzua jo vetm nga qetsimi i goditjeve t oferts, por edhe nga kushtet e prshtatshme monetare, q kan mundsuar balancimin e faktorve t krkess dhe oferts. Gjat vitit 2008, politika monetare ka qen neutrale dhe norma baz e interesit sht mbajtur e pandryshuar, n nivelin 6.25 pr qind. S bashku me forcimin e disa masave t mbikqyrjes bankare n drejtim t administrimit t rrezikut t kredive, kjo politik ka ndikuar n nj rritje m t balancuar t kredis dhe ka prcjell stimujt e duhur pr konsum e kursime. Politika e drejt monetare dhe kontrolli i inflacionit nga Banka e Shqipris sht reflektuar edhe n ankorimin e pritjeve pr inflacionin t agjentve ekonomik pran nivelit 3 pr qind t synuar nga Banka e Shqipris. N munges t goditjeve t papritura mbi stabilitetin financiar, mbi pritjet inflacioniste apo mbi faktort e tjer t oferts, balanca e rreziqeve pr inflacionin gjat periudhs n vazhdim duket se po zhvendoset n kahun rns. N kt kontekst nuk duhet ln pa prmendur edhe kontributi i politiks fiskale, e cila, nprmjet kufizimit t deficitit buxhetor n nivele t pranueshme, ka kontribuar n ruajtjen e balancave makroekonomike. Realizimi i shpenzimeve publike n prputhje me programin buxhetor, ka ndihmuar n kontrollin e presioneve t krkess s brendshme dhe forcimin e besimit n stabilitetin makroekonomik t vendit. T ardhurat buxhetore t vjela deri n fund t muajit nntor, kan prmbushur planin 11-mujor t Ministris s Financave me rreth 96.4 pr qind, ndrsa shpenzimet kan prmbushur 92 pr qind t planit t hartuar pr kt periudh. Zhvillimet buxhetore pr periudhn korrik-nntor 2008, n vijimsi t zhvillimeve t gjashtmujorit t par t vitit, regjistrojn nj kryerje m ritmike t shpenzimeve. Deficiti buxhetor i krijuar pas gjashtmujorit t par t vitit 2008, sht financuar kryesisht me burime t huaja. Nga ana tjetr, sektori i jashtm i ekonomis ka vijuar t karakterizohet nga zgjerimi i deficitit t llogaris korente. Tremujori i tret i vitit 2008 regjistroi nj rritje t deficitit korent me 48 pr qind n terma vjetor, duke arritur n rreth 252 milion euro. Raporti i tij ndaj PBB-s vlersohet t ket arritur n rreth 13.7 pr qind, duke qen rreth 5 pik prqindjeje m i lart se n t njjtn periudh t vitit 2007. N thellimin e deficitit korent gjat ksaj periudhe, kontribuoi jo vetm rritja e deficitit tregtar, por edhe ngushtimi i bilancit pozitiv t llogaris s t ardhurave dhe t transfertave korente. Qndrueshmria e tij sht nj kusht i domosdoshm pr stabilitetin financiar t vendit dhe pr nj rritje t qndrueshme e afatgjat. Pr kt arsye, dinamika e zhvillimeve t bilancit t pagesave prbn nj objekt konstant t monitorimit t Banks s Shqipris, duke e faktorizuar at n gjykimet tona pr prshtatshmrin e kushteve monetare. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjaeklaraten_e_Politikes_Monetare_per_gjashtemujorin_e_dyte_2008.html Pagina 3 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, Z. Ardian Fullani, n Deklaratn e Politiks Monetare pr gjashtmujorin e dyt 2008 29/07/22, 14:59 Ecuria e treguesve monetar gjat gjysms s dyt t vitit rezulton prgjithsisht e qndrueshme, ndonse shfaq shenja ngadalsimi t ritmeve t rritjes, gjat fundit t periudhs. Ritmi mesatar vjetor i rritjes s oferts monetare gjat ksaj periudhe u luhat rreth vlers 13 pr qind. Muajt e fundit t vitit 2008 u shoqruan me trheqjen e nj pjese t vogl t depozitave nga sistemi bankar, si pasoj e paqartsis q shkaktoi n shtresa specifike t popullsis situata financiare globale. N terma relativ, kto trheqje kan prbr nj pjes t vogl t bilancit t bankave tregtare dhe nuk kan ndikuar treguesit e shndetit t sistemit bankar apo cnuar aftsin e tij pr t kryer rolin e ndrmjetsit financiar. Kredia pr sektorin privat ka vazhduar t luaj rolin kryesor ndr kontribuesit e zgjerimit monetar. Rritja vjetore e kredis ka shnuar rnie gjat ksaj periudhe, krahasuar me gjashtmujorin e par. Treguesit e ndrmjetsimit jan rritur m tej; raporti i portofolit t kredis ndaj depozitave dhe totalit t aktiveve arriti prkatsisht n 63 pr qind dhe 43 pr qind n fund t muajit nntor. Pas muajit shtator, struktura e portofolit t kredis sipas monedhave shfaq nj norm m t lart t rritjes vjetore t kredis n lek. Ecuria e portofolit t kredis sipas klientels tregon norma vjetore t rritjes m t larta, t kredis pr biznese kundrejt asaj pr individ. N ndryshim nga pjesa e par e vitit, n gjashtmujorin e dyt vihet re nj tendenc pr zvoglimin e portofolit t kredis pr degt ndrtim dhe tregti , dhe nj rritje e leht pr degn industri . Aktiviteti i tregjeve t paras gjat ksaj periudhe sht kushtzuar nga zhvillimet e treguesve monetar dhe t ekonomis reale. Ashtu si dhe n eksperiencat e vendeve t tjera, sensitiviteti i rritur i bankave ndaj likuiditetit ka sjell uljen e vllimeve t tregtimit ndrbankar dhe tendenca rritse t normave t interesit t depozitave. Ndrkoh, gjat dy muajve t fundit t vitit sht vn re nj rnie e raportit t mbulimit t krkesave pr huamarrje t qeveris dhe zgjerim i disa primeve t rrezikut. Kto dukuri kan sjell rritjen e normave t interesit t letrave me vler t qeveris dhe, n disa raste, t kredis. N prgjigje t ktyre zhvillimeve, Banka e Shqipris ka ndrhyr n tregjet e paras duke injektuar likuiditet me afate t ndryshme maturimi, sipas krkesave t sistemit. Gjithashtu, pr t i shrbyer m mir nevojave t bankave, Banka e Shqipris ka ndryshuar n muajin nntor formn e ankandit t marrveshjeve t riblerjes, n ankand pa kufizim shume. * * * N trsin e tyre, zhvillimet ekonomike e financiare gjat vitit 2008 kan qen pozitive. Rritja ekonomike ka qen n linj me parashikimet e fillimit t vitit ndrkoh q treguesit kryesor t stabilitetit makroekonomik e financiar mbeten solid. Impakti negativ i zhvillimeve t ekonomis globale ka qen marzhinal. Megjithat, ashtu si dhe vendet e tjera n zhvillim, ekonomia shqiptare nuk mund t qndroj pr shum koh larg impaktit direkt apo t trthort t krizs ekonomike globale. N deklaratat publike t Banks s Shqipris, kemi theksuar n vazhdimsi se ndikimi i krizs botrore n ekonomin shqiptare do t varet si nga intensiteti, ashtu edhe nga kohzgjatja e saj. Qndrueshmria n koh dhe thellimi i dimensioneve t problemeve t ekonomis botrore sht nj sinjal se ekonomia shqiptare do t prballet me nj ambient m t vshtir ekonomik gjat vitit 2009, i cili mund t shtroj pr zgjidhje nj grup tjetr problemesh. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjaeklaraten_e_Politikes_Monetare_per_gjashtemujorin_e_dyte_2008.html Pagina 4 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, Z. Ardian Fullani, n Deklaratn e Politiks Monetare pr gjashtmujorin e dyt 2008 29/07/22, 14:59 Kanalet t cilat ekspozojn m shum ekonomin shqiptare ndaj goditjeve t ambientit ekonomik botror jan rnia e remitancave dhe shtrngimi i kushteve t financimit. Ndikimi i pritur potencial i ktyre faktorve do t materializohej n nj rritje ekonomike m t ngadalt gjat vitit 2009. Ne gjykojm se planet ekonomike dhe financiare t t gjith agjentve ekonomik duhet t reflektojn kt mundsi. Nj rritje m e ult ekonomike nuk prkthehet domosdoshmrisht n kriz pr Shqiprin, por sht nj zhvillim i prkohshm i diktuar nga faktor t jashtm. Politikat nxitse duhet t ndrtohen mbi kt premis. Ato nuk duhet t zhvillohen n asnj rast n dm t stabilitetit afatgjat makroekonomik, i cili sht edhe nj nga kapitalet m t muara q ka arritur ekonomia shqiptare n kto vite tranzicioni. Gjithashtu, ruajtja e stabilitetit financiar mbetet aspekt i rndsishm pr zhvillimin ekonomik afatgjat dhe n vmendje t vazhdueshme n procesin vendimmarrs t Banks s Shqipris. N kt drejtim, dua t theksoj se sjellja m racionale pr do individ, biznes apo aktor tjetr t shoqris shqiptare, do t ishte besimi n sistemin bankar dhe n bilancet e tij, trsisht transparente. Praktika botrore ka treguar se bashkveprimi i ndrsjell midis ekonomis reale dhe sistemit bankar, n drejtim t ruajtjes s kursimeve, t prdorimit t infrastrukturs s tij t pagesave, si dhe t shfrytzimit t ekspertizs s tij n fushn e kshillimit financiar dhe t mbshtetjes me fonde, sht nj tipar thelbsor i ekonomive q kan arritur t ln prapa nivelin e vendeve n tranzicion. N fund, dshiroj t siguroj publikun e interesuar se Banka e Shqipris mbetet e angazhuar pr t krijuar premisa q ofrojn m shum frymmarrje pr aktivitetin ekonomik t vendit, por pa cnuar respektimin e objektivit t saj t stabilitetit t mimeve. Njkohsisht, ajo do t vazhdoj t punoj pr konsolidimin e mtejshm t stabilitetit financiar t vendit. N kt kuadr, vendimet e Banks s Shqipris, do t jen nj kontribut i drejtprdrejt pr zbutjen e efekteve negative q vijn nga kriza ndrkombtare si dhe do t ndihmojn n qndrueshmrin e mtejshme t ekuilibrave ekonomik dhe financiar t vendit.
