Megjithat, tendencat e fundit t zhvillimit, kryesisht n sektorin e jashtm (rnia e t ardhurave nga emigrantt dhe zgjerimi i prkohshm i deficitit t llogaris korente), kan kontribuar n zhvlersimin e lekut. Deri n fund t muajit prill 2009, kursi nominal efektiv i kmbimit psoi nj rnie prej rreth 6 pr qind. Pavarsisht ksaj, ky zhvlersim mbetet n nivele t moderuara, krahasuar me prvojn e vendeve t tjera t Evrops Qendrore dhe Juglindore. T dhnat mbi bilancin e pagesave dshmojn pr rritjen e besimit n ekonomin shqiptare, e reflektuar kryesisht n shtimin e investimeve t huaja direkte, t cilat n vitin 2008 arritn n 6 pr qind t PBB-s. Kuadri aktual i politiks monetare mund t konsiderohet si nj regjim i nnkuptuar i inflacionit t shnjestruar, i administruar prmes prdorimit t instrumenteve indirekte t politiks monetare. Sinjalet e politiks monetare prohen prmes vendimeve t Kshillit Mbikqyrs s Banks s Shqipris mbi normn baz t marrveshjeve njjavore t riblerjes, si dhe prmes komunikimit t vazhdueshm. Burimet natyrore t vendit ton, si dhe forca e lir por e kualifikuar e puns, vijojn t jen elemente trheqse pr t gjith siprmarrsit evropian, t cilt dshirojn t eksplorojn prparsit q ofron globalizimi. Baza e eksporteve varion nga produktet bujqsore, deri tek ato minerale. Shqipria ofron mjaft mundsi investimi n miniera, bujqsi, energji, infrastruktur dhe turizm. Industria e prpunimit t ushqimit po prjeton nj zhvillim t knaqshm, duke krijuar njkohsisht mjaft hapsira pr rritje t aktivitetit. Ndrkoh q mundsit n sektorin e energjis variojn nga ndrtimi i burimeve t reja, deri tek prmirsimi i rrjetit t shprndarjes. Fokusi strategjik i Shqipris drejt prmirsimit t infrastrukturs s transportit krkon nj pjesmarrje m t madhe t sektorit publik dhe atij privat n ndrtimin e rrugve dhe porteve t reja. Si e prmenda dhe m lart, vendi yn ofron mundsi t jashtzakonshme pr investime n turizmin bregdetar, alpin, historik dhe kulturor, si rezultat i pozicionit t saj t favorshm n Mesdhe, trashgimis s pasur etnografike, si dhe klims s ndryshueshme dhe gjeologjis s saj. Kultura e biznesit gzon aftsi t mdha prshtatse. Gjuha angleze njihet mjaft mir nga brezi i ri. Shqiptart e konsiderojn investimin n arsimimin e tyre si mjaft t rndsishm, ndrkoh q nj numr i konsiderueshm profesionistsh t rinj jan arsimuar n Mbretrin e Bashkuar dhe n universitete t tjera evropiane. Me arsimimin e tyre, ata kan zhvilluar zakone perndimore pune dhe prfaqsojn faktor t vlefshm dhe ndihmues pr zgjerimin e biznesit tuaj n rajonin e Ballkanit. Jo pa qllim e prmenda rajonin pak m lart. Shqipria nuk sht m nj ishull i izoluar dhe i vetmuar i eksperimenteve t uditshme ekonomike. Gjat dy dekadave t fundit, ajo sht transformuar n nj treg t lir, fleksibl, konkurrues dhe t hapur ndaj zhvillimeve moderne t globalizimit. Vendi yn ka msuar t pozicionohet si duhet dhe t prfitoj nga zhvillimet ndrkombtare n rajon. Gjeografikisht, Shqipria gjendet n nj pozicion ky, q lidh lindjen me perndimin. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Gjate_prezantimit_te_zhvillimeve_ekonomike_ne_Shqiperi_dhe_sfidave_t 4/7 06/08/2022, 09:17 Gjat prezantimit t zhvillimeve ekonomike n Shqipri dhe sfidave t ardhshme, organizuar nga Citigroup Londr, IFC - Int Pr sa i prket sistemit financiar, objektivi yn sht q t ruajm nj sistem t shndosh, likuid dhe fitimprurs. N fund t vitit 2008, sistemi bankar shqiptar prbhej nga 16 banka tregtare. Privatizimi i sistemit bankar prfundoi pes vite m par me privatizimin e Banks s Kursimeve nga Banka Raiffeisen. Pas ksaj, n vitin 2004, prqindja e bankave private u rrit n 100 pr qind, ku m shum se 90 pr qind e kapitalit aksioner sht i huaj. Gjat viteve t fundit, kredia pr sektorin privat dhe pr individt sht rritur n mnyr t ndjeshme. Pa dyshim, kreditimi ka qen nj faktor mbshtets pr rritjen ekonomike dhe investimet n vend. Sektori bankar qndron n pararoj t investimeve t huaja direkte dhe t procesit t integrimit t vendit. Ai prfaqson nj nga mundsit m t suksesshme pr investim n Shqipri, duke prfituar mjaft nga prania e disa prej grupeve m t mdha financiare n Evrop. Referenca ime pr integrimin nuk i referohet vetm pranis s kapitalit t huaj, por edhe kapacitetit t sistemit bankar pr t ndrmjetsuar dhe plotsuar iniciativat dhe investimet evropiane n ekonomin shqiptare. Kto banka gzojn reputacionin, aftsin dhe infrastrukturn e nevojshme pr t shrbyer si partnere pr investitort e huaj. Sistemi bankar sht i nevojshm, por jo nj kusht i mjaftueshm pr t nxitur mirqenien ekonomike dhe pr t realizuar shprndarjen e burimeve pr prdoruesit m t mir t mundshm. Shprndarja e tregut financiar n Shqipri anon nga bankat universale tregtare. Lloje t tjera si fonde t prbashkta, kompani investimi me rrezik t lart, fonde pensioni dhe banka investimi nuk ekzistojn. Banka e Shqipris dhe autoritetet e tjera financiare t tregut po inkurajojn krijimin e stimujve t duhur pr promovimin e investimeve n kto segmente. Ne besojm, se sistemi yn financiar nuk i ka shfrytzuar ende t gjitha mundsit e tij. Duke prfituar nga ky takim, do t doja t ftoja t gjitha kompanit britanike q ta prfshijn Shqiprin n hartn e tyre t investimit. T nderuar zonja dhe zotrinj! Zhvillimet globale kan dominuar axhendn e vendimmarrsve n mbar botn. Deri tani, ekonomia shqiptare ka shfaqur rezistenc t admirueshme ndaj ktyre zhvillimeve. Stabiliteti makroekonomik dhe ai financiar jan arritur dhe sistemi bankar mbetet likuid. Megjithat, efektet e krizs financiare ndrkombtare u shfaqn n ekonomin shqiptare duke filluar nga tremujori i fundit i vitit 2008. Pasoja e par ishte trheqja e depozitave, duke reflektuar rnien e besimit t publikut n sistemin bankar. Shkaqet kryesore q nxitn trheqjen e depozitave n mesin e muajit tetor t vitit 2008, mendohen t jen njohja e kufizuar e problemeve reale, e prforcuar prej njoftimeve nga t afrmit emigrant n Itali dhe Greqi, t cilat nxitn panik n publik. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Gjate_prezantimit_te_zhvillimeve_ekonomike_ne_Shqiperi_dhe_sfidave_t 5/7 06/08/2022, 09:17 Gjat prezantimit t zhvillimeve ekonomike n Shqipri dhe sfidave t ardhshme, organizuar nga Citigroup Londr, IFC - Int Nj pasoj tjetr e dukshme lidhet me uljen e flukseve valutore hyrse, n formn e t ardhurave nga emigrantt dhe t eksporteve t mallrave dhe shrbimeve, t cilat shtrnguan gjendjen e prgjithshme financiare n ekonomi, duke ushtruar presion mbi kursin e kmbimit. N kt pik, Banka e Shqipris filloi t bj vlersimin e situats, me qllim prgatitjen pr efektet e raundit t dyt, t cilat do t vinin si pasoj e shtrngimit t gjendjes s likuiditetit dhe t situats botrore, e cila tashm prballej me nj recesion ekonomik. Banka e Shqipris i ka komunikuar shqetsimet e saj lidhur me ndikimin e trthort t krizs financiare, duke renditur efektet e mundshme t raundit t dyt q do t ushtrojn presione m t forta gjat vitit 2009: Ne presim, q shtrngimi i situats s likuiditetit t ngadalsoj rritjen e kreditimit dhe rritjen ekonomike. Ngadalsimi i pritur i eksporteve tona dhe ulja e mimeve t mallrave do t ojn n rritjen e deficitit tregtar. Gjithashtu, reduktimi i mtejshm i t ardhurave nga emigrantt do t kontribuoj n rritjen e deficitit t llogaris korente. Megjithat, ne besojm se regjimi i kursit t lir t kmbimit do t jet nj instrument efektiv pr rregullimin e konsumit dhe pr pasoj, t importeve. Banka e Shqipris nuk do t ndrhyj pr fiksimin e ndonj mimi n treg. Ashtu si prher, ajo do t prpiqet q t shmang do rregullim t theksuar n treg. Deficiti fiskal pritet t rritet, si rezultat i nj ndikimi t pritur negativ t aktivitetit ekonomik mbi t ardhurat buxhetore dhe financimit t tyre, pr shkak t shtrngimit t situats s likuiditetit n tregjet kombtare dhe ndrkombtare. Analizat tona tregojn se aktiviteti ekonomik do t ngadalsohet n mnyr t ndjeshme. Megjithat, ai do t mbetet n nivele pozitive. Analizat stress-test tregojn se cilsia e portofolit t kredis pritet t prkeqsohet m tej, si rezultat i ngadalsimit t aktivitetit ekonomik, zhvlersimit t kursit t kmbimit, si dhe i efektit statistikor t rritjes m t ult t kreditimit. Megjithat, cilsia e ktij portofoli do t mbetet brenda kufijve t pranueshm dhe nuk pritet q t krcnoj ndjeshm stabilitetin financiar t vendit. Gjithashtu, objektivi afatshkurtr i Banks s Shqipris u zhvendos drejt ruajtjes s stabilitetit dhe minimizimit t efekteve t raundit t dyt, duke mbajtur n vmendje t vazhdueshme zhvillimet n inflacion, i cili sht zhvendosur n kahun rns. T nderuar pjesmarrs, Viti me t cilin prballemi do t jet i vshtir. Prpara nesh gjenden mjaft sfida. Kombinimi i krizs financiare me recesionin ekonomik botror sht nj rast i paprecendent. Vendi im, Shqipria, sht gjithashtu pjes e ksaj tabloje globale. Deri tani, ne kemi arritur t ruajm si stabilitetin ekonomik, ashtu dhe at financiar. Ne mbetemi t angazhuar pr ruajtjen e mtejshme t ktyre arritjeve. Duke ju falenderuar pr vmendjen tuaj, mbetem i hapur ndaj do pyetjeje. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Gjate_prezantimit_te_zhvillimeve_ekonomike_ne_Shqiperi_dhe_sfidave_t 6/7 06/08/2022, 09:17 Gjat prezantimit t zhvillimeve ekonomike n Shqipri dhe sfidave t ardhshme, organizuar nga Citigroup Londr, IFC - Int Copyright  2018 Banka e Shqipris. Title: Speech at the Third Open Forum with the banking system in Albania
text: Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word at the press conference for the 2008 Financial Stability Report 29/07/22, 14:58 Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word at the press conference for the 2008 Financial Stability Report Publication date: 09.07.2009 Honored participants, On the occasion of the approval of the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania of the Financial Stability Report for 2008, I came before you today to Summarily presented the assessment of this report on developments in the financial system and the factors determining its sustainability. 2008, it will be remembered at length as the year the world economy experienced the biggest financial crisis of modern times, which culminated in the second part of 2008, with the bankruptcy of some of the financial institutions with global reach. Consequently, a high fluctuating of financial markets, investor departure, liquidity drying up and a significant decline in financial mediation has been observed from that time on. Investor and public confidence in banks and financial institutions was shaken on a global scale, which also led to a general decline in the prices of bank capital titles, greatly narrowing their refinancing opportunities. The size of the financial crisis led to its expansion into the real sector of the world economy. Lack of funds and expensive financing affected declining investment and trade, hitting domestic demand at the global level. The unemployment rate marked increases in all developed countries, under conditions when business enterprises were forced to cut production costs to respond to falling demand. Most developed economies entered a phase of economic decline in the second half of 2008. Slowing the activity of the world economy in demand for raw materials and food products brought down prices for these products.  nferencen_per_shtyp_per_Raportin_e_Stabilitetit_Financiar_2008.html Page 1 of 7 Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word at the press conference for the 2008 Financial Stability Report 29/07/22, 14:58 Deepening and widening the financial crisis in the second six months of the year turned into a need to harmonise actions at the global level, as well as empowering the role of international financial institutions such as the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank. In our country, the impact of the international crisis increased due to its transformation into a crisis of the real economy with global reach. Initially, the international financial crisis did not have a significant direct impact on our financial system. The reasons relate to the lack of exposure of the banking sector and the financial system in general, in products and in financial institutions which were at the centre of the crisis. Another cause is low exposure to borrowing in foreign markets. However, in the last quarter of 2008, due to the psychological effect that caused the severity of the crisis in international markets, the local public reacted by attracting a portion of the banking sector deposits. As a result, liquidity conditions tightened as well as a slowdown in lending on the part of the banking sector was evident. Under these conditions, the Bank of Albania took immediate measures to normalize the situation created and restore public confidence in banks. To this end, the Bank of Albania has injected liquidity into the market in various forms, to enable as easy access as possible on the part of banks. These actions gave a positive effect towards lowering the level and fluctuating interbank interest rates at the end of the year. The timely extent of the crisis, affected the limitation of funding resources and its price increase, shrinking incoming currency flows, increasing depreciating pressures on the lek and worsening economic agents' expectations for financial health in the future. This changing financial environment provides some important challenges for the sustainability of the financial system, and especially the banking sector as its dominant segment. These challenges stem from close financial activity relations with internal and external economic developments and their interaction with the internal state of the financial system itself. More specifically, the Bank of Albania estimates that: 1. The sensitivity of the financial system to internal macroeconomic developments has increased, where the main risks relate to: On the other hand, the most difficult liquidity situation in the internal financial market, as well as in the foreign market, is being accompanied by the increase in the cost of financing the budget deficit, bringing the increase in fiscal burden in the medium term. On the other hand, the realization of public spending must be adapted to the level of factual realisation of income. The Bank of Albania estimates that preserving the target set at the beginning of the year for the budget deficit would better serve the realisation of its financing at a lower cost and the release of funds for use in the internal market and for the private sector; 2. The sensitivity of the financial system to developments in international financial markets has been softened. In this framework, it is estimated that:  nferencen_per_shtyp_per_Raportin_e_Stabilitetit_Financiar_2008.html Page 2 of 7 Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word at the press conference for the 2008 Financial Stability Report 29/07/22, 14:58 a. Slowing down the country's economic activity. Developments in the last quarter of 2008, as well as the first months of 2009, show that economic growth for 2009, although expected to be positive, will be low. The reasons for this slowdown in economic growth relate to declining domestic demand, due to declining revenues of internal economic agents interacting with international markets and significantly lowering financing on the part of the banking sector in the country. For this reason, the possibilities for expanding the activity of the financial system will be more limited and its financial result will be lower during 2009; b. The financial difficulties of the real sector of the economy. Expectations for slowing the economy are making financial resources difficult for business enterprises and families. Internal sources of activity expansion, in the form of revenues provided by the main event, will be negatively affected by the decline in investment and sales. External sources of financing, in the form of borrowing from the banking sector, are still in the fall phase. Various observations of the state of the business sector generally confirm the increase in financial difficulties in the current situation and lack of optimism for short-term developments. The difficulties of business enterprises will negatively affect their ability to provide work steadily, causing the incomes of individuals and families to decline. Again, the financial system, and especially the banking sector, will feel these developments mainly in the form of affecting the quality of the loan portfolio and slowing the pace of public deposit growth; c. Possible fiscal complications. The increase in the budget deficit in 2008 compared to a year ago was realized under the conditions of a more favourable deficit financing situation, both in the internal and external market. The expected slowdown in economic growth and the difficulties facing the real sector of the economy put public revenues under pressure, increasing difficulties in achieving them under the 2009 budget plan. 3. The sensitivity of the financial system has increased to the performance of some indicators of banking activity. In this framework, it is estimated that: For this reason, it is time for the banking sector to prioritise lending in the national currency over currency, exploiting the greatest opportunities that public deposits offer and borrowing from the Bank of Albania. For this, the banking sector must pursue more appropriate credit price-setting policies, to promote the increase in demand for loans in the local currency. Also, forms should be found that support the increase in deposits, and which include increasing the flexibility of their use by the public, faster access  nferencen_per_shtyp_per_Raportin_e_Stabilitetit_Financiar_2008.html Page 3 of 7 Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word at the press conference for the 2008 Financial Stability Report 29/07/22, 14:58 d. High level of the crust account deficit of the balance of payments. Due to the volatility of exports and the decline in shipments from immigrants, the korean account deficit in the trade balance appears to be deteriorating. If this trend strengthens, it can steadily influence the structure of currency flows in the internal market, affecting demand and supply for currencies and bringing increased fluctuation over the exchange rate of the national currency. The free movement of the exchange rate offers an automatic instrument of correcting these imbalances in the demand and supply of currencies in the internal market. In this context, all economic, public and private agents must assess their sensitivity and sustainability to possible adverse exchange rate movements, and take necessary safeguard actions. e. For its part, the banking sector is sensitive to exchange rate movements, especially in the direction of the impact it conveys for the quality of the currency loan portfolio. For this reason, the developments of the first months of 2009 on the exchange rate should promote all necessary actions of the banking sector, for mitigating unintended effects on the financial situation. f. Public policies for the protection of European banking groups have increased security for their legal and financial sustainability and for the access to assistance they can provide for their investments in our country. Financial aid packages, approved in Austria, Greece, Italy, France and other countries, as well as the powerful injection of liquidity on the part of the European Central Bank, have eased the difficulties of major European banks to secure liquidity and refinance their market obligations. The positive performance of these banks' shares in trading stock exchanges, generally during the first months of 2009, shows this improvement in the situation. g. The economic and financial situation in Southeast and Central European countries presents improved, as a result of financial aid from the International Monetary Fund and the European Commission, affecting the softening of negative expectations. Actions that ease investor uncertainty for economic developments in these countries, they improve perception of our country, in the conditions of the relative similarity that exists, at least to the countries of the region; via the internet or other elements of modern communication, etc. The banking sector is sensitive to exchange rate behaviour, especially for the impact this has on the quality of the loan portfolio. Currency credit prevails  nferencen_per_shtyp_per_Raportin_e_Stabilitetit_Financiar_2008.html Page 4 of 7 Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word at the press conference for the 2008 Financial Stability Report 29/07/22, 14:58 h. Signs of an improvement in the global economic situation have been added. From the economies of developed countries and the largest economies of developing countries, some relatively more optimistic signals come. The perception of an improvement in the global economic climate would positively affect economic agents in the internal market, not only economically but also through creating more optimistic expectations, supporting a return to normal behaviour in their relations with the banking sector. i. Careful management of the liquidity requirements of the banking sector is needed. In fact, to cope with the decline in deposits in the last quarter of 2008, commercial banks reduced their portfolio of cash tools, increased borrowing from banking groups owned and that of the Bank of Albania. The weight of public deposits in financing banking activity, although it remains dominant and at high levels, suffered declines. This process must be carefully monitored, to see how stable it will be in time, as well as to avoid significant shifts towards wholesale borrowing, especially in currencies. Under the conditions when, sources of foreign currency financing depend on the foreign market, the banking sector is nevertheless more protected for the fact that currency financing lines are taken up by foreign banking groups. Bank of Albania's borrowing of the banking sector provides a stable source of financing in a particular situation, and helps improve the monetary policy transmission mechanism. This development is particularly important for banks that are not part of foreign banking groups. At the same time, it allows commercial banks to draft policies that more support financial activity in the national currency. In this view, managing the portfolio of valuable letters, which serve as collateral for wholesale borrowing, also takes importance. For such transactions in money, commercial banks are supported by possessions of letters worth of government debt, such as treasury bonds and bonds. Banks must create and manage a special portfolio of these valuable letters, to use in the case of sudden liquidity needs. Taking action for further development of the secondary value letter market would also be a supporting factor in this direction. j. In general, to ensure that banks follow more conservative policies towards liquidity risk management, the Bank of Albania is preparing a special regulation, which will require banks to improve their capacities in the direction of predicting liquidity needs, as well as establishing fairer and closer reports between banks' sources of financing and investments, towards the type of currency, changing the maturity deadline, creating special collateral portfolios, etc.;  nferencen_per_shtyp_per_Raportin_e_Stabilitetit_Financiar_2008.html Page 5 of 7 Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word at the press conference for the 2008 Financial Stability Report 29/07/22, 14:58 k. The likes of the loan portfolio have entered a trend of whether. The difficulties of the real sector of the economy, the slowing of economic growth and the very sharp shrinking of lending due to the volatile liquidity situation in recent months, has brought the increase in the volume of troubled loans, regardless of the type of currency, the way or the sector of use. The increase in troubled loans has prompted a process of tightening procedures in lending, bringing down the volume of lending and cutting the lending deadline. It has also been associated with increasing reserve funds of banks to cope with possible losses from loans, which has influenced the decline in the financial result of the banking sector. The banking sector must cope with this situation, aiming to keep its financial mediation activity as stable as possible, a very important function for the development of the economy and the state of the sector itself. in the total loan portfolio of the banking sector. The causes of its growth in years are related to the balance sheet structure of the banking sector, lower interest rates compared to the loan in money, as well as the perception that the past sustainability of the lek exchange rate would continue in the future. It is understandable that the underpayment of the lec in large values and for a short time, for those creditors who have no income in currency, increases the value in money of the credit instalments that are paid in currency, can be accompanied by delays in the write-off of the loan and causes its return to troubled loans. From this point of view, both the public and banks need to be more careful about better risk management that comes from exchange rate fluctuations. l. The financial result of the banking sector, even during 2009, will continue the decline that began in 2008. In fact, this is a consequence of declining activity revenues, due to the decrease in the volume of high-profit activity and rising activity costs, especially from the increase in reserve funds to cope with possible losses from loans. The decline in the net financial result means that the banking sector will have less internal resources to support activity and increase capital. In the case of banks that can experience financial losses, this would translate into a reduction in its funds. Although the decline in the financial result is not expected to have a significant impact on capital values, banks must carefully monitor activity capitalization indicators, and increase capital in case of need. For 2009, capitalization has increased through non-distribution of profit and capital flows by motherbanks. As a conclusion, we stress that the efforts of public authorities should aim to maintain the sustainability of macroeconomic and financial indicators. Within the framework of fiscal policy, maintaining the budget deficit limit serves to lower the cost of financing, freeing up financing spaces for the private sector and easing pressures on the Korean account deficit. At the same time, this action increases the credibility of fiscal policy in international investors, ensuring that  nferencen_per_shtyp_per_Raportin_e_Stabilitetit_Financiar_2008.html Page 6 of 7 Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word at the press conference for the 2008 Financial Stability Report 29/07/22, 14:58 stability of future financing opportunities. Care for keeping macrofiscal indicators under control automatically translates into the country's stability and creditto the country's financial markets. It constitutes the fundamental condition for a sustainable long-term growth of the country. Within the framework of monetary policy, we will serve to preserve low inflationary expectations and manage the liquidity situation in the interbank market to avoid interest rate fluctuations. As the regulatory authority and supervisor of the banking sector, we will urge banks to take all necessary actions to maintain good indicators of capitalization and liquidity of activity. By showing the necessary care for the quality of borrowing and the sustainability of financing resources, the banking sector will be encouraged to find ways to increase the financing of the economy in the national currency. Based on the financial indicators of the banking sector, as well as the size of their fluctuating according to stress-test analyses, the banking sector remains stable and its resistance to the risks mentioned above is rated high. The latest data speak of a return to public confidence, reflected in the increase in deposits in the banking system. Increasingly, the economy's lending is reflected, while even the currency money structure on bank balances has seen improvement. The impact the system suffered in autumn 2008 may already be considered past. In conclusion, I would like to stress that the Bank of Albania will continue to carefully pursue any financial economic development with possible impacts on the country's macroeconomic and financial balances. We remain fully committed to taking the necessary actions at the right time and intensity, while conveying them with full transparency to the public. Thank you!  nferencen_per_shtyp_per_Raportin_e_Stabilitetit_Financiar_2008.html Page 7 of 7

Ardian Fullani, n konferencn pr shtyp pr Raportin e Stabilitetit Financiar 2008 Data e publikimit: 09.07.2009 T nderuar pjesmarrs, Me rastin e miratimit nga ana e Kshillit Mbikqyrs t Banks s Shqipris t Raportit t Stabilitetit Financiar pr vitin 2008 , kam dal sot para jush pr t paraqitur n mnyr t prmbledhur vlersimin e ktij raporti mbi zhvillimet n sistemin financiar dhe n faktort q prcaktojn qndrueshmrin e tij. Viti 2008, do t kujtohet gjat si viti kur ekonomia botrore provoi krizn m t madhe financiare t kohve moderne, e cila kulmoi n pjesn e dyt t vitit 2008, me falimentimin e disa prej institucioneve financiare me shtrirje globale. Pr pasoj, q nga ajo koh e n vazhdim vihet re nj luhatshmri e lart e tregjeve financiare, largim i investitorve, tharje e likuiditetit dhe rnie e ndjeshme e ndrmjetsimit financiar. Besimi i investitorve dhe i publikut tek bankat dhe institucionet financiare u trondit n shkall botrore, gj q solli dhe nj rnie t prgjithshme t mimeve t titujve t kapitalit t bankave, duke ngushtuar s teprmi mundsit e tyre t rifinancimit. Madhsia e krizs financiare, oi n shtrirjen e saj n sektorin real t ekonomis botrore. Mungesa e fondeve dhe shtrenjtimi i financimeve, ndikuan n rnien e investimeve dhe t tregtis, duke goditur krkesn e brendshme n nivel botror. Norma e papunsis shnoi rritje n t gjitha vendet e zhvilluara, n kushtet kur siprmarrjet e biznesit u detyruan t shkurtojn kostot e prodhimit pr t iu prgjigjur rnies s krkess. Shumica e ekonomive t zhvilluara hyn n nj faz rnieje ekonomike n gjysmn e dyt t vitit 2008. Ngadalsimi i aktivitetit t ekonomis botrore n krkesn pr lnd t para t prodhimit dhe pr produktet ushqimore, solli rnien e mimeve pr kto produkte. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalnferencen_per_shtyp_per_Raportin_e_Stabilitetit_Financiar_2008.html Pagina 1 di 7 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris z. Ardian Fullani, n konferencn pr shtyp pr Raportin e Stabilitetit Financiar 2008 29/07/22, 14:58 Thellimi dhe zgjerimi i krizs financiare n gjashtmujorin e dyt t vitit, ktheu n domosdoshmri harmonizimin e veprimeve n nivel global, si edhe fuqizimin e rolit t institucioneve financiare ndrkombtare si Fondi Monetar Ndrkombtar dhe Banka Botrore. N vendin ton, ndikimi i krizs ndrkombtare u rrit pr shkak t transformimit t saj n nj kriz t ekonomis reale me shtrirje globale. Fillimisht, kriza financiare ndrkombtare nuk pati nj ndikim t drejtprdrejt t rndsishm mbi sistemin ton financiar. Arsyet lidhen me mungesn e ekspozimit t sektorit bankar dhe sistemit financiar n prgjithsi, n produkte dhe n institucione financiare t cilat ishin n qendr t krizs. Nj shkak tjetr sht dhe ekspozimi i ult ndaj huamarrjes n tregjet e huaja. Megjithat, n tremujorin e fundit t vitit 2008, pr shkak t efektit psikologjik q shkaktoi ashprsimi i krizs n tregjet ndrkombtare, publiku vendas reagoi duke trhequr nj pjes t depozitave t sektorit bankar. Pr pasoj, kushtet e likuiditetit u shtrnguan si dhe u evidentua nj ngadalsim i kreditimit nga ana e sektorit bankar. N kto kushte, Banka e Shqipris mori masa t menjhershme pr t normalizuar situatn e krijuar dhe pr t rikthyer besimin e publikut tek bankat. Pr kt qllim, Banka e Shqipris ka injektuar likuiditet n treg n forma t ndryshme, pr t mundsuar nj akses sa m t leht nga ana e bankave. Kto veprime dhan efekt pozitiv drejt uljes s nivelit dhe luhatshmris s normave t interesit ndrbankar n fund t vitit. Shtrirja n koh e krizs, ndikoi n kufizimin e burimeve t financimit dhe n rritjen e mimit t tij, n tkurrjen e flukseve hyrse n valut, n rritjen e presioneve zhvlersuese mbi lekun dhe n prkeqsimin e pritshmrive t agjentve ekonomik pr shndetin financiar n t ardhmen. Ky mjedis i ndryshuar financiar, ofron disa sfida t rndsishme pr qndrueshmrin e sistemit financiar, dhe posarisht t sektorit bankar si segment mbizotrues i tij. Kto sfida burojn prej marrdhnieve t ngushta t veprimtaris financiare me zhvillimet ekonomike t brendshme dhe t jashtme dhe ndrveprimin e tyre me gjendjen e brendshme t vet sistemit financiar. M konkretisht, Banka e Shqipris vlerson q: 1. sht rritur ndjeshmria e sistemit financiar ndaj zhvillimeve t brendshme makroekonomike, ku rreziqet kryesore lidhen me: Nga ana tjetr, situata m e vshtir e likuiditetit n tregun e brendshm financiar si edhe n tregun e huaj, po shoqrohet me rritjen e kostos s financimit t deficitit buxhetor, duke sjell rritjen e ngarkess fiskale n nj periudh afatmesme. Nga ana tjetr, realizimi i shpenzimeve publike duhet t prshtatet me nivelin e realizimit faktik t t ardhurave. Answer: I think the Albanian economy already has a long history with elections and electoral campaigns. In line with world developments and experiences, the Albanian economy has reached its maturity and has all the skills for good absorption of these situations. Question: Mr. Governor, there is a debate or conviction in public that the dynamics of the election campaign have hindered to some extent or temporarily curbed the effects of the crisis. What is your opinion, has the Albanian economy passed the worst or the worst should come, as a result of this crisis? Even a second question, you were among the first to articulate in public the need for financial support from international bodies. With the latest developments you see you think this need still exists or has it become more necessary? Answer: As far as your first question is concerned, it is in line with my statement, which means that Albania and its banking and financial system has all the capacities to absorb such situations. We must bear in mind that the political decision-making of the Bank of Albania has been very careful, taking into account all the political, economic, financial elements of the country and not only the period of electoral campaigning, i.e. a period of 1 to 3 years. I think there are all possibilities from the Bank of Albania to carefully monitor the situation by the end of the year. As for your second question I always stick consistent to my early public statements, that the highly complex global situation, the very delicate situation Albania is going through as a NATO member and as an applicant for the European Union, require that all channels of formal communication be open, that policies be smart and forward-looking, and that communication and co-operation relations with such important institutions be open, that policies be smart and forward-looking, and that communication and co-operation relations with such important institutions be open. such as the International Monetary Fund, the World Bank, the European Central Bank, the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development and other institutions to be open and effective. Q: Mr. Governor, do you think we've passed the peak of the crisis? Answer: As I said, the blow suffered by the banking system in autumn 2008 may already be considered past. To summarize it more simply to the public, the return of deposits to the system, both the deposits of businesses and those of individuals, the return of lending, the return of liquidity, the overall return of trust in the banking and financial system and at the same time the very realistic approach of the fluctuating exchange rate in Albania, show that the possibility of a financial crisis of the banking system is already called the past. Of course, in our first communication to the public, in the early days of the crisis, we have said that the crisis will have its effects on the real economy as well. What we are doing today is a very important step: we are making available to decision-makers, the market, the media, the public in general a professional, forward-looking, consistent and transparent analysis to better understand the risks and potential they have to materialize in the future. To this end, I would suggest to the media that in the conclusions and messages they convey to the public have as a strong reference point the documentation of the Bank of Albania. The reference in these professional analyses shows not only culture and education, but simultaneously shows confidence in the constitutional institutions of the country and the market in general. To this end, I would once again say that the Bank of Albania is assessing every day, step by step, developments in the real economy and the effects of the crisis on the real economy, which are clearly expressed in material. What I want to make clear to the public is that the economy is the approach of each individual's economic behaviors and in this framework, every individual's behavior has its impact on the overall development of the economy. Thus, the general care for preserving macroeconomic parameters, increasing public confidence in the economy and developing the Albanian banking system, returning deposits to the system, restoring liquidity to the system and trusting the Albanian banking system would automatically translate into increasing lending, increasing macro-financial stability and sustainable development of the country. Prgjigje: Un mendoj q tashm ekonomia shqiptare ka nj histori t gjat me zgjedhjet dhe fushatat elektorale. N prputhje me zhvillimet dhe eksperiencat botrore, ekonomia shqiptare ka arritur maturimin e saj dhe ka t gjitha aftsit pr absorbimin e mir t ktyre situatave. Cili sht mendimi juaj, a e ka kaluar ekonomia shqiptare m t keqen apo m e keqja duhet t vij, si pasoj e ksaj krize? Edhe nj pyetje e dyt, ju keni qen ndr t part q keni artikuluar n publik nevojn e mbshtetjes financiare nga organizmat ndrkombtar. Mendoj se jan t gjitha mundsit nga Banka e Shqipris, pr t monitoruar me kujdes situatn deri n fund t vitit. Prsa i prket pyetjes tuaj t dyt un i qndroj gjithmon me konsistenc deklaratave t mia publike t hershme, q situata mjaft komplekse globale, situata mjaft delikate q Shqipria po kalon si antare e NATO-s dhe si aplikuese pr n Bashkimin Evropian, krkojn q t gjitha kanalet e komunikimit formal t jen t hapura, q politikat t jen t zgjuara dhe largpamse dhe q komunikimi dhe marrdhniet e bashkpunimit me institucione t tilla t rndsishme si Fondi Monetar Ndrkombtar, Banka Botrore, Banka Qendrore Evropiane, Banka Evropiane pr Rindrtim dhe Zhvillim dhe institucione t tjera t jen t hapura dhe efektive. Pyetje: Zoti Guvernator, a mendoni se e kemi kaluar kulmin e krizs? Prgjigje: Si thash, goditja q psoi sistemi bankar n vjeshtn e vitit 2008 mund t konsiderohet tashm e kaluar. Pr ta prmbledhur m thjesht pr publikun, rikthimi i depozitave n sistem, si depozitat e bizneseve ashtu dhe ato t individve, rikthimi i kredidhnies, rikthimi i likuiditetit, rikthimi n prgjithsi i besimit n sistemin bankar dhe financiar dhe njkohsisht prqasja mjaft realiste e kursit t luhatshm t kmbimit n Shqipri, tregojn q mundsia pr nj kriz financiare t sistemit bankar tashm quhet e shkuar. Natyrisht, n komunikimin ton t par n publik, n ditt e para t shfaqjes s krizs, kemi thn se kriza do t ket efektet e saj edhe n ekonomin reale. Ajo q ne po bjm sot sht nj hap mjaft i rndsishm: po i vm n dispozicion vendimmarrsve, tregut, medias, publikut n prgjithsi nj analiz profesionale, largpamse, konsistente dhe transparente pr t kuptuar m mir rreziqet dhe potencialin q ato kan pr t u materializuar n t ardhmen. Pr kt qllim, do t i sugjeroja medias q n konkluzionet dhe mesazhet q ata i prcjellin publikut t ken si pik t fort referimi dokumentacionin e Banks s Shqipris. Referimi n kto analiza profesionale tregon jo vetm kultur dhe edukat, por njkohsisht tregon besim n institucionet kushtetuese t vendit dhe t tregut n prgjithsi. Pr kt qllim, edhe nj her do t thoja se Banka e Shqipris po vlerson do dit, hap pas hapi, zhvillimet n ekonomin reale dhe efektet e krizs n ekonomin reale, t cilat shprehen qart n material. Ajo q un dua t bj t qart pr publikun sht q ekonomia, sht prqasje e sjelljeve ekonomike t do individi dhe n kt kuadr, do sjellje e do individi ka ndikimin e saj n zhvillimin e prgjithshm t ekonomis. Kshtu q kujdesi i gjithanshm pr ruajtjen e parametrave makroekonomik, rritja e besimit t publikut n ekonomin dhe zhvillimin e sistemit bankar shqiptar, rikthimi i depozitave n sistem, rikthimi i likuiditetit n sistem dhe i besimit n sistemin bankar shqiptar do t prkthehej automatikisht n rritje t kreditimit, n rritje t stabilitetit makro-financiar dhe n zhvillim t qndrueshm t vendit. This next IMF visit, under the Article IV consultations, coincides with a still difficult period in terms of the pressures the major crisis has generated, which has engulfed the world economy since last year. We have gladly stated that the Bank of Albania shares the same estimates for many of the developments that the Albanian economy passed in the first six months of 2009. I take the opportunity to once again emphasize the long-articulated conclusion: (1) that the Albanian economy and its financial system showed a satisfactory degree of resistance, and (2) that the policies undertaken by both authorities, both by the Bank of Albania and on the part of the Ministry of Finance, have resulted in useful in creating and conveying appropriate incentives in the direction of the country's financial stability and economic activity. By stopping more specifically in the monetary policy of the Bank of Albania, I want to assess that it has been prudent throughout this period, reflecting carefully on recent macroeconomic developments, developments in the banking system and agent expectations. Part of this care has also been the tactics used by the Bank of Albania in the money market with the aim of adding liquidity into the system. Page 1 of 2 Mr. Ardian Fullani, in k... IMF's session with the Ministry of Finance and the Bank of Albania 29/07/22, 14:58 However, turning a look at the short-term and long-term horizon, I would like to briefly stop on two three issues, which the Bank of Albania has decided to have on its priority agenda for the coming months. First, I would like to stress once again a my idea launched at the Third Bank of Albania Forum with the banking system, regarding the shift of the economy towards a new balance different from that of pre-crisis. This is an argument that is dominating the debate of the day and I personally think we should factor this conclusion into our macro projections of the country's development for years to come. Second, the Bank of Albania deems increased financial care and vigilance necessary for the following period. This would mean a further strengthening of macrofinancial stability, especially in better harmonisation of the two basic policies in the economy, to continue the necessary stimulation of the country's economic activity. Third, I would appreciate as very important the continuation of the credit of the economy, the absorption of foreign investment, as well as the deepening of structural reforms. The Bank of Albania is committed to ensuring long-term price stability and to this end, its decision will continue to be anchored with this legal objective of its own. In the conditions of a new reality, post-crisis, we will not take attention away from the structural processes of the economy to further adapt the Albanian economy to the face of post-crisis effects and turn it into a vibrant economy, not only in the region, but even wider. Title: Speech at the conference "Responsible Finance"
text: Mr Ardian Fullani kept... by the Albanian Banking Association, on the occasion of the 2009 closure 29/07/22, 14:58 Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word held at the reception organised by the Albanian Banking Association, on the occasion of the 2009 closure Publication date: 18.12.2009 On the occasion of the 2009 closure, the Albanian Banking Association organised a reception with bankers and representatives of banks operating in Albania. At the invitation of the Albanian Banking Association, the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Ardian Fullani, gave a speech to the devotees. Below is the full word of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Ardian Fullani, held at this event. Honorable bank directors, Honored colleagues and friends, It's nice to be with you today to celebrate the anniversary of the Albanian Banking Association. This event coincides with the end of 2009, giving us one more reason to analyse the performance of the Albanian banking system this year and the contribution the Association has made in this direction. In general, this period has had its own lows and ups, but it is nevertheless a period that has marked the noticeable progress of the Albanian banking sector, turning it into the main engine of economic growth of our country. Let me initially underline some of the main elements that show the progress of the Albanian banking sector during these years. The banking sector, which dominates the financial sector in Albania, has gone from a sector with 3 banks, all of which were property  hoqata_Shqiptare_e_Bankave_me_rastin_e_mbylljes_se_vitit_2009.html Page 1 of 4 Mr Ardian Fullani kept... by the Albanian Banking Association, on the occasion of the 2009 closure 29/07/22, 14:58 state and had various shortcomings, in a sector that today counts 16 banks, all privately owned, where foreign capital prevails. During this time, the banking sector has expanded its activity, taking 77% of the country's Gdp, increasing the number of branches, offering more products to the public and improving their quality, as well as increasing the financial mediation role, making an important contribution to the country's economic development. At the same time, the entry of well-known European banking groups from Greece, Austria, Italy and France has been accompanied by episodes of consolidation in the banking industry. High standards for better bank governance and more transparent relations with the public have been adopted. During these years, the banking sector has been highly profitable and has operated in accordance with the regulatory and supervisory frameworks in relation to capital and liquidity. The Board of Directors and shareholders have immediately presented the necessary measures for maintaining the sound financial situation and in support of the expansion of their banks with additional capital. The supervisory work of the Bank of Albania has followed and monitored the development of the banking sector during this time, in an effort to adopt the best international standards in this area. But of course, nothing is absolute. The banking industry has faced a number of issues, many of which are part of the development phase of our financial sector in the direction of its consolidation and the development of the economy and society. We have discussed these issues in many other cases, but i would not leave without mentioning the importance of the appropriate mechanisms for risk management, balanced activity expansion, clear and transparent procedures, and many other issues. But I would like to reemphasize the importance of a single element that includes all this: good governance. For a bank's management team, this means: Professionalism, or ability to make fair business decisions, as risks and benefits are weighed; Dedication, or ability to root in an institution a workenvironment; Responsibility, or ability to meet objectives qualityly; Vision, or ability to be forward-sighted in planning the performance of your institutions; and accounting, or the ability to create an efficient control and balance system for processes and structures in your institutions. These elements, which are a necessity for management philosophy, must be rooted in the minds of every employee of the institutions you lead, as a normal culture at work. I am sure that we all agree that these issues must be further improved in our banking sector. Honorable friends,  hoqata_Shqiptare_e_Bankave_me_rastin_e_mbylljes_se_vitit_2009.html Page 2 of 4 Mr Ardian Fullani kept... by the Albanian Banking Association, on the occasion of the 2009 closure 29/07/22, 14:58 During 2009, our banking sector faced a unique and challenging situation. The international economic and financial crisis clearly affected the public's confidence in our banking sector. It showed how sensitive our social environment is to financial shocks and how important it is to be prepared for the worst. Financial crises are the hardest to manage and their consequences take a long time to absorb. Indeed, thanks to the liquidity of the banking sector, shareholder support and measures taken by the Bank of Albania, the banking sector weathered the situation caused by the withdrawal of deposits earlier this year. Of course, the short-term blow we've already left behind, but the horizon is not clear yet. To manage the liquidity situation, you were forced to reduce credit. This has defined more pronounced difficulties in the real sector of the economy, which has influenced credit demand. We are already facing a deterioration in the quality of the loan portfolio, which will weigh on your financial outcome over the medium term. The Bank of Albania recognises and supports the efforts of the banking sector to identify as early as possible and cover troubled loans with reserve funds as soon as possible. We encourage you to continue to show proper prudence when assessing credit quality. On the other hand, you need to support your customers and continue lending to reliable borrowers, as this is useful for your customers, for you and for the entire economy. I will continue to stress this to you, as I am convinced that you have real opportunities to do so under competitive conditions, especially for loans in the national currency. For our part, the Bank of Albania will continue to provide the necessary support, maintaining the flow of liquidity to meet your needs. Lending requires more work and analysis not only from offices, but also on the ground. It requires deep customer recognition and its pursuit of the market. But it is vital for bank balances and the country's economic activity. The impact of the international financial crisis on our banking sector should serve as a lesson for the future. As we have mentioned in recent publications, it is necessary to carry out a process of reassessing your objectives and development models for the future, in order to ensure a continuous, sustainable and profitable activity. You also need to develop policies and structures that improve your ability to act under unusual circumstances and preserve "business as usual" for the most important areas. The Bank of Albania is already working, with the aim that within a certain period of time and after consultation with you, to support this process through the introduction of changes in the regulatory and supervisory framework. With deeper judgments and changes in supervisory standards at European level, we must work together to ensure a more balanced, risk-free and sustainable financial market, as well as such institution activity in the future. I want to express my belief that the banking industry in Albania will be an active actor in meeting these goals.  hoqata_Shqiptare_e_Bankave_me_rastin_e_mbylljes_se_vitit_2009.html Page 3 of 4 Mr Ardian Fullani kept... by the Albanian Banking Association, on the occasion of the 2009 closure 29/07/22, 14:58 Let me now end with a sincere congratulations on a happy and successful New Year for you, your families and the institutions you lead! For the Banks Association, I wish the New Year a period of meaningful progress and further achievement! Thank you!  hoqata_Shqiptare_e_Bankave_me_rastin_e_mbylljes_se_vitit_2009.html Page 4 of 4

Gjat ksaj kohe, sektori bankar e ka zgjeruar aktivitetin e tij, duke zn 77% t PBBs s vendit, ka rritur numrin e degve, ka ofruar m shum produkte ndaj publikut dhe ka prmirsuar cilsin e tyre, si dhe ka rritur rolin ndrmjetsues financiar, duke dhn nj kontribut t rndsishm n zhvillimin ekonomik t vendit. Njkohsisht, hyrja e grupeve t njohura bankare evropiane nga Greqia, Austria, Italia dhe Franca, sht shoqruar me episode t konsolidimit n industrin bankare. Jan miratuar standarde t larta pr nj qeverisje m t mir t bankave dhe marrdhnie m transparente me publikun. Gjat ktyre viteve, sektori bankar ka qen mjaft fitimprurs dhe ka operuar n prputhje me kuadrin rregullator dhe mbikqyrs n lidhje me kapitalin dhe likuiditetin. Bordi i Drejtorve dhe aksionert kan prezantuar menjher masat e nevojshme pr ruajtjen e gjendjes s shndosh financiare dhe n mbshtetje t zgjerimit t bankave t tyre me kapital shtes. Puna mbikqyrse e Banks s Shqipris ka ndjekur dhe monitoruar zhvillimin e sektorit bankar gjat ksaj kohe, n prpjekje pr t adoptuar standardet m t mira ndrkombtare n kt fush. Por sigurisht, asgj nuk sht absolute. Industria bankare sht prballur me nj numr shtjesh, shum prej t cilave jan pjes e fazs s zhvillimit t sektorit ton financiar n drejtim t konsolidimit t tij dhe zhvillimit t ekonomis dhe shoqris. Ne kemi diskutuar n lidhje me kto shtje n shum raste t tjera, por kurrsesi nuk do t lija pa prmendur rndsin e mekanizmave t duhura pr menaxhimin e rrezikut, zgjerimin e balancuar t aktivitetit, procedura t qarta e transparente, e shum shtje t tjera. Por, do t doja t ritheksoja rndsin e nj elementi t vetm q i prfshin t gjitha kto: qeverisja e mir. Pr ekipin e menaxhimit t nj banke, kjo do t thot: Profesionalizm, apo aftsi pr t marr vendime t drejta biznesi, pasi t peshohen rreziqet dhe prfitimet; Prkushtim, ose aftsi pr t rrnjosur n nj institucion nj mjedis pundashs; Prgjegjsi, ose aftsi pr t prmbushur objektivat n mnyr cilsore; Vizion, apo aftsi pr t qen largpams n planifikimin e ecuris s institucioneve tuaja; dhe Llogaridhnie, apo aftsi pr t krijuar nj sistem efikas kontrolli dhe balancimi pr proceset dhe strukturat n institucionet tuaja. Kto elemente, t cilat jan nj domosdoshmri pr filozofin e administrimit, duhet t rrnjosen n mendjen e do punonjsi t institucioneve q ju drejtoni, si nj kultur normale n pun. Jam i sigurt se t gjith ne jemi dakord q kto shtje duhet t prmirsohen m tej n sektorin ton bankar. Ardian Fullani mbajt nga Shoqata Shqiptare e Bankave, me rastin e mbylljes s vitit 2009 29/07/22, 14:58 Gjat vitit 2009, sektori yn bankar u prball me nj situat unike dhe sfiduese. Kriza ndrkombtare ekonomike dhe financiare, ndikoi dukshm n besimin e publikut ndaj sektorit ton bankar. Ajo tregoi se sa i ndjeshm sht mjedisi yn social ndaj goditjeve financiare dhe se sa e rndsishme sht q t jemi t prgatitur pr m t keqen. Krizat financiare jan m t vshtirat pr t u administruar dhe pasojat e tyre krkojn nj koh t gjat pr t u absorbuar. N t vrtet, fal likuiditetit t sektorit bankar, mbshtetjes s aksionerve dhe masave t marra nga Banka e Shqipris, sektori bankar e prballoi gjendjen e shkaktuar nga trheqja e depozitave n fillim t ktij viti. Me siguri, goditjen afatshkurtr tashm e kemi ln pas, por horizonti nuk sht ende i qart. Pr t menaxhuar situatn e likuiditetit, ju u detyruat t paksonit kreditimin. Kjo ka prkuar me vshtirsi m t theksuara n sektorin real t ekonomis, i cili ka ndikuar n krkesn pr kredi. Tashm po prballemi me nj prkeqsim t cilsis s portofolit t kredis, i cili do t rndoj n rezultatin tuaj financiar pr nj periudh afatmesme. Banka e Shqipris i njeh dhe i mbshtet prpjekjet e sektorit bankar pr t identifikuar sa m hert dhe pr t mbuluar me fonde rezerv sa m shpejt kredit me probleme. Ne ju inkurajojm q t vazhdoni t tregoni maturin e duhur, kur vlersoni cilsin e kredis. Nga ana tjetr, ju duhet t mbshtesni klientt tuaj dhe t vazhdoni kreditimin e huamarrsve t besueshm, pasi kjo sht e dobishme pr klientt tuaj, pr ju dhe pr gjith ekonomin. Un do t vazhdoj t jua theksoj kt gj, pasi jam i bindur se keni mundsi reale pr ta br kt n kushte konkurruese, veanrisht pr kredit n monedhn kombtare. Nga ana jon, Banka e Shqipris do t vazhdoj t jap mbshtetjen e nevojshme, duke ruajtur rrjedhjen e likuiditetit n prmbushje t nevojave tuaja. Kreditimi krkon m shum pun dhe analiz jo vetm nga zyrat, por edhe n terren. Krkon njohje t thell t klientit dhe ndjekje t tij dhe t tregut. Por ai sht vital pr bilancet e bankave dhe aktivitetin ekonomik t vendit. Ndikimi i krizs financiare ndrkombtare n sektorin ton bankar duhet t shrbej si nj msim pr t ardhmen. Si e kemi prmendur n botimet e fundit, sht e nevojshme q t kryeni nj proces rivlersimi t objektivave dhe t modeleve tuaja t zhvillimit pr t ardhmen, n mnyr q t siguroni nj aktivitet t vazhdueshm, t qndrueshm dhe fitimprurs. Gjithashtu, ju duhet t zhvilloni politika dhe struktura q prmirsojn aftsin tuaj pr veprim n rrethana t pazakonta dhe pr t ruajtur "biznesin si zakonisht" pr fushat m t rndsishme. Banka e Shqipris tashm sht duke punuar, me synimin q brenda nj periudhe t caktuar kohore dhe pas konsultimit me ju, t mbshtes kt proces nprmjet futjes s ndryshimeve n kuadrin rregullator dhe mbikqyrs. Me gjykime m t thella dhe pas ndryshimeve n standardet mbikqyrse n nivel evropian, ne duhet t punojm s bashku pr t siguruar nj treg financiar m t balancuar, pa rrezik dhe t qndrueshm, si dhe nj veprimtari t till t institucioneve n t ardhmen. Title: Speech in the presentation of the Annual Report of the Bank of Albania for 2009 before the Committee on Economy and Finance
text: Lecture by Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani at POLIS University 29/07/22, 14:52 Lecture by Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani at POLIS University Publication date: 30.01.2010 The Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Ardian Fullani, on 13 January 2010, held a lecture at POLIS University. In his lecture, before the students, the Governor stopped at the project of the new Bank of Albania complex in Tirana. This project is perceived as a intertwining of the architecture of the existing building and the modern architecture of the new building. This complex besides architectural features also has a very functional solution. During his lecture the Governor made a general description of the main developments in the Albanian economy, as well as the role given by the Bank of Albania for the sustainable and sound security and development of macroeconomic and financial stability. The global real estate crisis, its effects and the role of the Bank of Albania was another theme contained in the Governor's lecture. In the end, Mr. Fullani conveyed the idea that the Albanian banking system presents itself healthy and capable of carrying out its mission. Over 120 students and pedagogical staff of this University participated in this lecture.  e_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_z_Ardian_Fullani_ne_Universitetin_POLIS.html Page 1 of 2 Lecture by Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani at POLIS University 29/07/22, 14:52 Page 2 of 2

text: , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the inauguration ceremony of the Research Centre in the city of Kumanovo 29/07/22, 14:52 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the inauguration ceremony of the Research Centre in the city of Kumanovo Publication date: 10.02.2010 Honored friends, guests, colleagues and associates, I have the special pleasure that today in the old city of Kumanovo, to wait for the inauguration strip of one of the newest buildings of this city, that of the Research Centre of the Bank of Albania. Through the construction of this research centre, the Bank of Albania wanted to join beratcitizens in telling a story worth confessing. This was the reason we remained faithful to the architectural values of the Mangalam museum district, because we believe that architectural quality and originality are unrepeatable values that make the city of Kumanovo an important part of the country's cultural heritage. For this reason, I am convinced that we have contributed to the grace of the city, bringing it a new building of age, but in perfect harmony with the picturesque ensemble of one on a window. There is an admirable understanding in our institution when it comes to Albania's cultural heritage. This is why we have taken concrete steps in the last two years towards documenting, preserving and propagandising it. Let me bring to your memory, that at the end of each year the Bank of Albania has been very careful in propagandising cultural values through the calendar for the following year. I would distinguish the last calendar where through a work full of dedication, we managed to produce a very special publication, in reflection of the 12 ancient ruins of the country, where ancient coins of the period before Christ were found.  onine_e_inaugurimit_te_Qendres_Kerkimore_ne_qytetin_e_Beratit.html Page 1 of 4 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the inauguration ceremony of the Research Centre in the city of Kumanovo 29/07/22, 14:52 At first glance cultural heritage and the central bank institution may seem disconnected, unconnected to each other. Personally, I believe otherwise. Central banks carry the culture of a people. They hold within them the treasures of a nation, defeat and sweat generations, and put them in the function of the future. Central banks, as descendants of commercial banks, are that in origin linked to the art and culture of a country, show the scale of civilization and its long path to prosperity. The discovery of numbers, letters, figures created the foundation of a people's culture and art, reflecting widely in coins, icons, codecs, monuments. The connection between art, culture, money has always made me believe, that they have lived together and are destined to resist time, because they have preserved their identity. Like the shape, purpose, idea, content of an icon resembles that of a coin, as well, its particular elements can stay in harmony with a monument, partition, characteristic clothing or an old song. In the above sense, they are treasures. It's spare money. It's investment. Over the course of centuries, they have expressed the soul, faith, strength, wealth, culture of a nation. They have been traded, they have passed hand in hand, spreading knowledge and civilization, gaining new values, bringing us prosperity. These values have passed from one mind to another, writing history and therefore caring for this historical heritage is the best investment, is the added value for the next generation. The culture and coins we have inherited over the centuries belong to us all and with these values we will enter Europe. Faith in language, customs, art, coins, culture has furthered our society, keeping Albanian identity alive. The Bank of Albania, as the country's only monetary authority, takes care of the country's money and financial health. In its communication with other central banks and important international institutions, it is fundamental that in addition to achievements in the professional field to advance the country's national identity, underlining the most prominent values of national cultural heritage. This image makes the central bank a more worthy and reliable partner. The very currency of a country with its history constitutes a unique value in the cultural heritage of each nation. It is the currency, therefore another element that creates a bridge between the central bank and the cultural heritage of the country. Another factor is the buildings where the central bank exercises its activity. In most cases, central banks possess as assets, complex entire buildings, which, for historical and architectural values, reflect the newest parts of the heritage in this field. It is not random that the buildings of central banks have been chosen such. They must convey to the public messages of independence, sustainability, prosperity, foresight and faith. I believe that such a building is also our building in Skenderbej Square, as well as this building we are persuading today. Our legal mandate for price stability or financial stability, among others, implies a general political, social and cultural environment that interprets towards the role of money in the economy: How it is created and how its value should be preserved;  onine_e_inaugurimit_te_Qendres_Kerkimore_ne_qytetin_e_Beratit.html Page 2 of 4 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the inauguration ceremony of the Research Centre in the city of Kumanovo 29/07/22, 14:52 How does it finance our needs, including our assets, which we want to leave to our children; How does it finance the maintenance of our physical assets or even those of intellectual nature; How it funds us the absorption of foreign experiences and how foreigners through money manage to visit our heritage. Honorable friends, Today's inauguration marks a return to lost values. Despite the important function it has performed for our city and country in general, the former object, a typical work of socialist realism, was placed in ugly contrast to the ensemble of historical dwellings, bringing about the ugliness of this area. Today, the Bank of Albania is proud to offer the city and every visitor, an architectural symbol, which embodies prominent hospitality values and features, massively accepted by residents, local authorities and anyone who has seen it. My personal ambition for the future remains the exploitation of this building for the benefit of the living of the city of Kumanovo. If we had offered only a numismatic museum, I believe our success would be incomplete. Targeting from the beginning, the economic-social vitality of the city, the Bank of Albania is offering a literal research and training centre, where the stories of modern visitors will be intertwined with the stories, places and dates of human drama, which has been developed in this 2400-year-old city. Our aspirations are so dreamy and feasible. I will do my best to turn this centre into a regional centre whose regular frequenters are our colleagues from the region and at large. I am convinced that with the creation of this Research Centre, the Bank of Albania will give a new boost to its scientific work, in better definition of causal links, which characterize the interaction of economic-financial indicators in Albania. I am also convinced that our experience, through this investment, will gain a new dimension in confronting international experiences, further completing with an excellent infrastructure tool. In conclusion, I am convinced of another thing, that we have already created functional logistical support to transmit certain and contemporary knowledge to the new generation of professionals and wider, in the field of bank, money and finance. In our nearby plans there are also programmes to develop regional themes on Balkan civilization or various categories of it, such as art, literature, culture, architecture and why not, the banking industry in the respective stages of this civilization. Such co-operation, we believe will not only increase the promotion of our entire region with common and different traditions, but we can efficiently use existing resources and generate additional ideas, projects and resources from our regional partners.  onine_e_inaugurimit_te_Qendres_Kerkimore_ne_qytetin_e_Beratit.html Page 3 of 4 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the inauguration ceremony of the Research Centre in the city of Kumanovo 29/07/22, 14:52 Honorable friends, I believe I don't say anything new when I repeat that every nation's pride is rooted in its culture and that no nation can be achieved without a past of its culture and tradition. Each nation is the legacy of faiths, customs and knowledge accumulated, systematized and gradually processed over the course of centuries. Believing in the meaningful significance of this designation, I hope that our contribution to the city of Kumanovo serves the entire community of this city, preserved and enriched further, so that we leave inheritance to the generations of this city. Only in this way will the ancient and medieval heritage of this city be enriched with the new values of tomorrow. Kasam Aga, the sultan's architect, wrote of the cesma he donated to the city: ... I did this charity work to arouse the envy of the viewer... whereas today, on behalf of the Bank of Albania, we bring you this work to the good of this city. Thanking you heartily, I invite you to visit the inner environments of the Centre together.  onine_e_inaugurimit_te_Qendres_Kerkimore_ne_qytetin_e_Beratit.html Page 4 of 4

Personalisht, besoj t kundrtn. Bankat qendrore jan mbartse t kulturs s nj populli. Ato mbajn brenda tyre thesaret e nj kombi, mundin dhe djersn e brezave dhe i vn ato n funksion t s ardhmes. Bankat qendrore, si pasardhse t bankave tregtare, jan q n origjin t lidhura me artin dhe kulturn e nj vendi, tregojn shkalln e qytetrimit dhe rrugn e tij t gjat drejt prosperitetit. Zbulimi i numrave, shkronjave, figurave krijoi themelin e kulturs dhe t artit t nj populli, duke u pasqyruar gjersisht n monedhat, ikonat, kodikt, monumentet. Lidhja midis artit, kulturs, paras, gjithmon m ka br t besoj, se ato kan jetuar s bashku dhe jan t destinuara t i rezistojn kohs, sepse kan ruajtur identitetin e tyre. Ashtu si forma, qllimi, ideja, prmbajtja e nj ikone ngjan me at t nj monedhe, po aq, elemente t veanta t saj mund t qndrojn n harmoni me nj monument, partitur, veshje karakteristike apo nj kng t vjetr. N kuptimin e msiprm, ato jan thesare. Jan para rezerv. Jan investim. N rrjedhn e shekujve, ato kan shprehur shpirtin, besimin, forcn, pasurin, kulturn e nj kombi. Ato jan tregtuar, kan kaluar dor m dor, duke prhapur dije dhe qytetrim, duke fituar vlera t reja, duke na sjell prosperitet. Kto vlera kan kaluar nga nj mendje te tjetra, duke shkruar historin dhe prandaj kujdesi pr kt trashgimi historike sht investimi m i mir, sht vlera e shtuar pr brezin e ardhshm. Kultura dhe monedhat q kemi trashguar ndr shekuj na prkasin ne t gjithve dhe me kto vlera do t hyjm n Evrop. Besimi n gjuhn, zakonet, artin, monedhat, kulturn, ka uar prpara shoqrin ton, duke mbajtur gjall identitetin shqiptar. Banka e Shqipris, si autoriteti i vetm monetar i vendit, kujdeset pr paran dhe shndetin financiar t vendit. N komunikimin e saj me bankat e tjera qendrore dhe institucionet e rndsishme ndrkombtare, sht themelore q prve arritjeve n fushn profesionale t proj identitetin kombtar t vendit, duke nnvizuar vlerat m t spikatura t trashgimis kombtare kulturore. Ky imazh e bn bankn qendrore nj partner m t denj dhe m t besueshme. Vet monedha e nj vendi me historin e saj prbn nj vler unikale n trashgimin kulturore t do kombi. sht monedha, pra nj element tjetr q krijon nj ur t qensishme midis banks qendrore dhe trashgimis kulturore t vendit. Nj faktor tjetr, lidhet me godinat ku banka qendrore ushtron aktivitetin e saj. N shumicn e rasteve bankat qendrore zotrojn si pasuri, komplekse t tra godinash, t cilat pr nga vlerat historike dhe arkitektonike pasqyrojn pjest m t arrira t trashgimis n kt fush. Nuk sht e rastsishme, q godinat e bankave qendrore jan zgjedhur t tilla. Ato duhet t projn n publik mesazhe t pavarsis, t qndrueshmris, t prosperitetit, t largpamsis dhe t besimit. Besoj se nj godin e till sht dhe ndrtesa jon n sheshin Sknderbej , si dhe kjo godin q po prurojm sot. Mandati yn ligjor pr stabilitet mimesh apo stabilitet financiar, midis t tjerash, nnkupton nj ambient t prgjithshm politik, shoqror dhe kulturor q interpreton drejt rolin e paras n ekonomi: si sht krijuar ajo dhe si duhet ruajtur vlera e saj; https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjaonine_e_inaugurimit_te_Qendres_Kerkimore_ne_qytetin_e_Beratit.html Pagina 2 di 4 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z.Ardian Fullani, n ceremonin e inaugurimit t Qendrs Krkimore n qytetin e Beratit 29/07/22, 14:52 si na financon ajo nevojat tona prfshir dhe pasurit tona q duam t ia lm trashgim fmijve tan; si na financon ajo mirmbajtjen e pasurive tona fizike apo edhe ato t natyrs intelektuale; si na financon ajo thithjen e eksperiencave t huaja dhe si t huajt nprmjet paras arrijn t vizitojn trashgimin ton. T nderuar miq, Prurimi i sotm shnon nj kthim t vlerave t humbura. Pavarsisht nga funksioni i rndsishm q ka kryer pr qytetin dhe vendin ton n prgjithsi, objekti i mparshm, nj vepr tipike e realizmit socialist, ishte vendosur n kontrast t shmtuar me ansamblin e banesave historike, duke sjell edhe shmtimin e ksaj zone. Sot, Banka e Shqipris sht krenare t i ofroj qytetit dhe do vizitori, nj simbol arkitekturor, q mishron vlera dhe veori t spikatura mikpritjeje, i pranuar masivisht nga banort, autoritetet lokale dhe kushdo q e ka par. Ambicia ime personale pr t ardhmen mbetet shfrytzimi i ksaj godine n dobi t gjallrimit t qytetit t Beratit. Nse, do t kishim ofruar vetm nj muze numizmatik, besoj se suksesi yn do t ishte jo i plot. Duke synuar q nga fillimi, gjallrimin ekonomiko-shoqror t qytetit, Banka e Shqipris po ofron nj qendr t mirfillt krkimore dhe trainimi, ku historit e vizitorve modern do t ndrthuren me historit, vendet dhe datat e drams njerzore, q sht zhvilluar n kt qytet 2400 vjear. Aspiratat tona jan sa ndrrimtare aq dhe t realizueshme. Do t bj t pamundurn, q kjo qendr t kthehet n nj qendr rajonale, frekuentues t rregullt t s cils, t jen kolegt tan nga rajoni dhe me gjer. Jam i bindur se me krijimin e ksaj Qendre Krkimore, Banka e Shqipris do t i jap nj hov t ri puns s saj shkencore, n prcaktimin m t mir t lidhjeve shkak pasoj, q karakterizojn ndrveprimin e treguesve ekonomiko-financiar n Shqipri. Jam gjithashtu i bindur se prvoja jon, nprmjet ktij investimi do t fitoj nj dimension t ri n prballjen e saj me eksperiencat ndrkombtare, duke u kompletuar m tej me nj mjet t shklqyer infrastrukturor. N prfundim, jam i bindur edhe pr nj gj tjetr, se tashm kemi krijuar nj mbshtetje logjistike funksionale pr t transmetuar dije t caktuara dhe bashkkohore tek brezi i ri i profesionistve dhe m gjer, n fushn e banks, t paras dhe t financave. N planet tona t afrta bjn pjes edhe programe pr t zhvilluar tema rajonale mbi qytetrimin ballkanik apo kategori t ndryshme t tij, si arti, letrsia, kultura, arkitektura dhe pse jo, industria bankare n fazat respektive t ktij qytetrimi.
