Title: Speech In the presentation of the Annual Report for 2009
text: Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word in PR... n 2009 before the Economy and Finance Commission, 07 April 2010 29/07/22, 14:57 Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word at the presentation of the Bank of Albania's 2009 Annual Report before the Economy and Finance Commission, 07 April 2010 Publication date: 07.04.2010 Honourable, Mr. Chairman of the Commission, Honorable ladies and gentlemen members, I am pleased to be before you today to present the Bank of Albania's Annual Report. This report, whose main conclusions I will try to summarize following my word, is a full and transparent analysis of economic and financial developments in the country, as well as a mirror of the Bank of Albania's work on meeting its legal obligations and realising our institutional commitments. Honourable, Mr. Chairman of the Commission, Honorable ladies and gentlemen members, Let me start this presentation by making a brief overview of the main topics and messages of the Annual Report. 2009 was a challenging year for the Albanian economy, in all its dimensions. In response to the global economic and financial crisis, during this year, they were tested: the country's macroeconomic balances; sustainability of our financial system; business models and financial sustainability of the private sector; as well as  9_perpara_Komisionit_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_07_Prill_2010.html Page 1 of 14 Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word in PR... n 2009 before the Economy and Finance Commission, 07 April 2010 29/07/22, 14:57 analytical and responsive capacities of macroeconomic policies. In a broader plan, the blow our economy took during 2009 tested the flexibility of the country's economic development model and its ability to respond to a radically transformed global environment. The global crisis gave a rapid impact on economic activity in the country. It was accompanied by a reduction in currency inflows into the crust and capital account, an immediate decrease in external demand and a slowdown in domestic demand for goods and services. In response to these developments, the pace of economic growth marked a progressive slowdown over the past year, but remaining in positive territory anyway. The performance of the country's balance of payments was characterized by a imbalance in incoming and foreign exchange flows. This imbalance was reflected in the swing in demand reports and currency supply, resulting in the underlying exchange rate in response to the new balances that prevailed in the currency market. Fiscal policy strengthened its expansionist character during 2009, supporting economic activity in the country but simultaneously increasing pressure in financial markets. The shock suffered by the financial system created a difficult environment for full and timely transmission of monetary policy. Under these challenging conditions, the Bank of Albania managed to successfully meet its legal mandate for maintaining price stability in the economy: annual consumer price inflation resulted within our target of 3 /- 1% during 2009. The Bank of Albania's monetary policy managed to create the right monetary conditions for maintaining price stability. Also, the supply of the economy with necessary liquidity and declining costs stabilized financial markets and created the right conditions for supporting economic activity during 2009. The performance of the financial system in the country was influenced by the shake-up of confidence in our financial system during the first half of the year and the withdrawal of part of the deposit from it. This development, combined with another group of factors, resulted in a smaller and higher-cost support of the Albanian economy with bank loans. Among the other factors we would distinguish: increasing economic agent uncertainty and expensive liquidity premiums; correction of the business model of certain segments of the financial market; increasing exchange rate volatiles; and the reduction of loan demand in the second half of the year. The wavering of public confidence underlined the primary importance of financial stability in the country's economic life. In its area of responsibility, the Bank of Albania undertook a broad and coordinated plan of measures aimed at maintaining financial stability at the systemic level and institution. These measures, among other things, consisted of: Page 2 of 14 Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word in PR... n 2009 before the Economy and Finance Commission, 07 April 2010 29/07/22, 14:57 - revision of the regulatory basis in the direction of adding supervisory care; - strengthening inspections in the country; - the addition of balance sheet analyses at the individual level of banks and the system; as well as - increasing co-operation with local and foreign counterpart institutions. Our efforts to maintain financial stability were also coordinated with other public, executive and legislative authorities. It is worth mentioning the improvement of the public deposit insurance scheme and increasing the scale of their guarantee by the Deposit Security Agency. These measures resulted in the limitation of negative consequences and the complete restoration of trust in the banking system. As a result, the Albanian banking system managed to preserve healthy balance sheets and be able to exercise its function as financial mediator and that of the supplier of the economy with payment instruments. Following my word, I wish to more detailedly touch and analyze the issues mentioned above. 1. Bank of Albania monetary policy and price stability (Performance of economic activity, key monetary developments, monetary policy and meeting the inflation target) In accordance with its legal mandate, the bank of Albania's monetary policy is drafted and implemented as a function of achieving and preserving price stability. During 2009, the main risks to price stability have come from slowing economic activity, shifting the confidence of economic agents, unbalancing the external position of the Albanian economy and undermining the exchange rate. Despite these challenges, the Bank of Albania managed to keep consumer price inflation within the target. Let's see in more detail the elements affected above. 1.1 World Economy The international context, which accompanied economic and financial developments in the country over the past year, was not favourable at all. 2009 was characterized by shrinking global economic activity, as a consequence of economic decline in developed countries and significant economic slowdown in developing countries. The growth of the world economy marked the first negative value over the past 50 years. Following the problems first appeared during 2008, the global financial system also experienced a difficult period. The attention of regulators and financial institutions themselves focused on regulating damaged balances of the financial system. Shrinking economic activity and rising uncertainty in financial markets were accompanied by lower trade and reduced movement of financial flows at the global level. The economic recession also caused rising unemployment and lowering the capacity exploitation rate, thus creating an environment of low inflationary pressures. This environment enabled the pursuit of strong fiscal and monetary stimulus policies, in support of rising demand and production in the economy. Page 3 of 14 Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word in PR... n 2009 before the Economy and Finance Commission, 07 April 2010 29/07/22, 14:57 Stimulus policies resulted in success for most countries. Economic activity, whose growth was largely negative in the first half of the year, marked a slight improvement in the second six months. The recovery in demand at the global level influenced the revitalization of the economy and the growth of trade, improved confidence indicators, and in creating more optimistic expectations for the future. Also, the authorities' determined intervention in support of the financial system helped to ease tensions created by the crisis. This normalization was reflected in reducing risk premiums, falling interest rate performance and more moderate fluctuating. However, recovering economic activity in the world remains fragile. In particular, significantly increased public debt as a consequence of high fiscal deficits has turned to the attention of financial markets and policymakers. The ability of governments to refinance and serve this debt in the future will condition risk premiums on the financial markets and macroeconomic stability of particular countries. 1.2 Economic growth and factors that have influenced it The increasing integration of the Albanian economy, and especially its financial system, caused the global crisis to reflect early on in our country. The main channels that exposed the Albanian economy were: decrease in exports; the decline of remittances and other currency inflows; increased uncertainty in financial institutions; and in response, the revision of the business plans of almost all economic agents. This impact took the form of lowering growth rates and shaking some macroeconomic balances during 2009. Gross Domestic Product during the first nine months of 2009 increased by 4.9% in annual terms. Its annual growth rhythms are characterized by a progressive decline, from 5.4% in the first quarter, to 4.1% in the third quarter. Indirect data and other quality information suggest that the economy slowed further in the fourth quarter of 2009. Remaining awaiting official INSTAT statistics, preliminary estimates show that economic growth for 2009 has fluctuated around the 3% level. The slowdown in GDP growth has reflected the contracting of activity in the industry and construction sectors, while the value added by the services sector remained the main contributor to economic growth. Starting from the difficult circumstances in which economic activity developed and compared to the experiences of the countries of the region, preserving in positive terms the pace of economic growth is an encouraging development. However, its slowdown and new macroeconomic balances require proper attention from all economic agents in their projections for the future. The country's economic development outlook also requires more support Page 4 of 14 Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word in PR... n 2009 before the Economy and Finance Commission, 07 April 2010 29/07/22, 14:57 large in the private sector, while the public sector's impact on economic growth is expected to come down. Aggregate demand data show that slowing private consumption and falling investments have been the determinants in slowing demand growth in the country. Net exports were intended to make a negative contribution to aggregate demand during 2009, but to a lesser extent compared to 2008. In addition to easing monetary conditions, fiscal stimulus supported the economy in generating positive growth rates during 2009. Private consumption is the main component of aggregate demand, weighing about 80% of GDP. Slowing wage growth rhythms, falling remittances and shrinking consumer credit influenced slowing consumption during 2009. Private investment is estimated to have been more influenced than other components of aggregate demand by the global financial and economic crisis. Slowing domestic and external demand, uncertainties related to the economic situation at home and abroad, as well as tight lending conditions, dictated private investment contracting during 2009. Fiscal policy and fiscal indicators The slowdown in the local economy affected the performance of fiscal policy and fiscal indicators. Fiscal policy had an expansionary nature, which was reflected in the expansion of the budget deficit, especially during the first half of the year. The budget deficit for 2009 is estimated to be around 7% of GDP levels. The main sources of deficit financing were privatisation income and union credit, reducing the need for borrowing in the internal market. Budgetary revenues marked annual increases of 2.7%, mainly as a result of slow growth in tax revenues. On the other hand, public spending increased by about 8%, led by the high pace of Korean spending. Expansionary fiscal policy gave the necessary impetus to economic activity during the year, but it was also associated with rising public debt and growing pressures on government-valued letter yields. The expansion of the budget deficit resulted in a significant increase in public debt, which at the end of 2009 is estimated at about 59.5% of GDP. The Bank of Albania considers that the expansionist character of fiscal policy is unaffordable on the medium-term horizon and potentially with negative consequences on the long-term horizon. In this regard, we encourage action to reduce the budget deficit and public debt. A budget deficit and lower public debt on the long-term horizon will create more spaces in private sector access to funds and increase confidence in the country's macroeconomic stability. Also, these measures will complement the creation of a climate suitable for attracting foreign capital in the form of private loans or foreign direct investment. Monetary developments and financial markets Page 5 of 14 Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word in PR... n 2009 before the Economy and Finance Commission, 07 April 2010 29/07/22, 14:57 Financial mediation activity in the economy is conditional on shrinking financial resources, fluctuating confidence in financial institutions and falling demand for bank loans during 2009. At the end of March, deposits fell to 55% of GDP, compared to the 63% level marked in September 2008. The withdrawal of deposits during the first quarter of the year brought a slowdown in the expansion of monetary measure in the economy. Banking activity recognized a slow recovery over the following three quarters. Monetary supply increased by an average of 6% during this year, or about 2 times less than a year ago. The increase in monetary measure is mainly due to the increase in the component in its money, while credit and currency deposits have marked contractions during 2009. The creation of money in money is based on internal borrowing of the fiscal sector and the preservation of lending rhythms in private sector money. In addition to increasing banks' sensitivity to their liquidity indicators, private sector borrowing during 2009 developed under the conditions of a more conservative behaviour of banks in lending. As I mentioned at the beginning of my word, this conservative behavior also owes banks added care to some banking products, such as: currency loans for segments of the economy exposed to exchange rate fluctuations, as well as consumer credit. In the second half of the year, the decline in loan demand was also noted, conditional on tight lending standards and slowing economic activity. Despite the Bank of Albania's easing monetary policy, credit to the private sector had a simultaneous slowdown trend throughout 2009. The annual growth rate at the end of the year marked 12%, versus the 33% level marked a year ago. The increase in credit is supported by the demand of businesses to finance liquidity needs, while the loan portfolio for individuals has shrunk during this year. 1.3 Balance of Payments and Exchange Rate In the presence of slowing domestic demand and reflecting the difficult situation of the global economy, the crustaccount deficit narrowed by about 3% during 2009, staying at the 15.3% GDP level. Despite easy correction during the year, the corent deficit remains at comparatively high levels and represents one of the weaknesses of the Albanian economy. As we have stressed in a continuous manner, the Bank of Albania considers that its priority treatment will require the drafting of support policies for long-term increases in the savings rate in the country, as well as taking measures to promote production in those branches or industries which result competitively in international markets. The narrowing of the trade balance was influenced by the simultaneous annual decline of our exports and imports, by 18% and 9%, respectively. The difficult situation in neighbouring countries has also been reflected in the decline in remittances, which shrunk by 6.5% in annual terms, while their ratio to GDP marked the 9% level. Suficiti's capital and financial account decreased significantly during 2009, falling by 35.6% in Page 6 of 14 Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word in PR... n 2009 before the Economy and Finance Commission, 07 April 2010 29/07/22, 14:57 compared to last year. This performance was dictated to a large extent by the comparatively low growth of foreign direct investment and by the reduction of foreign private borrowing. Unlike the previous two years, where the capital and financial account covered over 100% of the Corent deficit, in 2009 it financed only 77% of it. Although declining, total currency inflows were almost enough to cover this deficit during 2009. The country's currency reserve remained at the same relative levels as last year, being enough to cover 4.2 months of imports of goods and services. The shrinking of currency inflows exerted derogatory pressure on the exchange rate, especially in the first half of 2009. In the internal currency market, the average annual domestic currency subprice against the euro and dollar was 7.6% and 13.2%, respectively. The underlying tendency of the lek exchange rate has appeared more moderate in the second six months of the year, as a result of the restoration of a more stable balance between demand and currency supply. The rebalancing of demand and supply owes to a considerable extent the correction of the trade balance and the softening of psychological effects. 1.4 Inflation and Monetary Policy of the Bank of Albania Consumer price inflation performance Consumer prices rose by 2.2% on average during 2009; this increase is within the Bank of Albania's inflation target. As a result of reducing global inflationary pressures, annual inflation scored low values of 1.8% on average during the first quarter of the year. In the following two quarters, inflation values stabilized near the lower limit of the Bank of Albania's 2.0% target. Annual inflation showed increasing trends in the fourth quarter, scoring 2.9% in average terms and converging towards the inflation target. The highest inflation rate of 3.5% was recorded in December. The rise in inflation in the latter part of the year was mainly caused by the fuller focus of the subprice of the exchange rate on consumer prices, in the presence of the increasing trend of commodity prices in world markets. Slowing economic activity in the country and low inflationary pressures from the world economy created an environment of relatively weak inflationary pressures. Basic inflation and that of unmarketable goods scored average rates of 1.3 and 1.6% respectively during the year, witnessing the low inflationary pressures of the internal economy. These factors balanced the effect of underpricing the local currency, which influenced the increase in the prices of imported goods and a portion of products that are still indexed with the exchange rate. Inflation of marketable goods, some of which are of import origin, and the rest are directly under the influence of world prices - has risen significantly compared to the previous two years. Its contribution to the value of total inflation was fluctuated around the 73% level during 2009. Bank of Albania monetary policy Page 7 of 14 Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word in PR... n 2009 before the Economy and Finance Commission, 07 April 2010 29/07/22, 14:57 Weakening economic activity and domestic inflationary pressures, our forecasts for future controlled inflation and anchored expectations of economic agents created spaces for pursuing a easing monetary policy during 2009. This policy materialized at two lows by 0.5 percentage points of the basic interest rate in January and October 2009, which brought the base interest rate to 5.25% level, as well as in the continued injection of liquidity required by the market and the economy. Through this careful monetary policy, the Bank of Albania aimed to create monetary conditions suitable for a balanced and long-term development of the country. The base rate cuts immediately shifted to short-term interest rates in the interbank market, which consequently marked declines and a lower fluctuating from last year. On the other hand, these movements were not complete in quantities and rapid in time in interest rates of loans and bank deposits. As in all other countries, increased liquidity, increased uncertainty in general and deteriorating financial results of the banking system were depreciating factors of monetary authority easing measures. However, our monetary policy and our operations in the interbank market successfully managed to avoid a harmful contracting of banks' balance sheets, a bitter experience this of many developing countries. The 1.00 percentage point reduction in the cost of refinancing during 2009 has enabled the easing of the financial burden of the system's mediation activity. The Bank of Albania has consistently supported the banking system with the necessary liquidity. In addition to lowering the basic interest rate, the Bank of Albania has helped the activity of the banking system through: changing the form of the refinancing auction, from multi-fixed auction to auction with very unlimited; extension of the injected liquidity maturity deadline by up to three months; increasing the range of collateral accepted in our refinancing operations; increase in the use of the forced reserve; and the reduction of the one-day loan interest rate. We have used almost the entire range of our instruments to implement monetary policy. The amount of liquidity injected by the Bank of Albania reached the highest point of about 40 billion dollars in the summer months, while influenced by deposit inflows into the banking system, this amount gradually decreased to about 28 billion dollars at the end of 2009. 2. Banking supervision and financial stability The development of the banking system is markedly conditioned by slowing the economy and shaking confidence, aspects of which I dealt with extensively above. As a result, there was an increase in uncertainty, a higher sensitivity of banks to liquidity, a more careful behaviour in the provision of loans, as well as an increase in troubled loans. These are also the most prominent developments of the banking system during 2009. Although its profitability came down, capitalization indicators remain at satisfactory levels. The banking system remains healthy, thanks to this Page 8 of 14 Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word in PR... n 2009 before the Economy and Finance Commission, 07 April 2010 29/07/22, 14:57 and the effective fulfilment of the regulatory and supervisory function of the Bank of Albania. By following this section, I want to unravel the above issues in more detail. 2.1 Performance of the banking system During 2009, the Albanian banking system marked increases in the total active, but at a rate about twice as low compared to a year earlier. This decrease fully reflects the lower expansion of lending activity. Our banking system follows to be financed mainly by public deposits and to be focused on lending activity to businesses. System deposits and loans increased, but at a lower rate than in previous years. The loan-to-total ratio of deposits increased by nearly 3 percentage points during the year, ranging from 62% to 65%. On the other hand, the increase in deposits as a result of the return of public confidence has improved the liquidity situation of the banking system. Meanwhile, troubled loans suffered growth during 2009, as a result of slowing the economy and underperforming the exchange rate. The credit portfolio quality indicator, expressed as troubled loans to the total loan surplus, rose to 10.48% at the end of the year, from 6.64% at the end of 2008. The Bank of Albania has closely monitored this situation by being aware of the procyclic effects, which could cause these developments in the loan portfolio. From our assessments and proactive stance we have stated that although the deteriorating loan portfolio has been at previously untested levels, the quality and sufficiency of capital not only to fully track banking operations, but in particular to support the extent and expansion in lending have remained almost intact. In this context, we can mention the fact that although the loan portfolio has not increased at the pace of years past, perhaps also for reasons of large accounting base, but also as a result of a kind of step by banks for prudence reasons, growth has again been satisfactory and at higher levels than the countries of the region. The Bank of Albania, based on periodic stress tests carried out continuously, has managed to assess capital needs on the part of banks in advance, thus enabling a rapid increase in capital on their part in cases where necessary. Thus, the growth of troubled loans has been associated with the increase in the capital of the banking system. The total regulatory capital of the banking system has increased 37.7% dominated by basic capital, which indicates a regulatory capital that is extremely good and stable. Despite the difficult economic and financial environment, the appropriateness of the level of regulatory capital to the scale of risks, mainly credit risk, has remained generally satisfactory and the degree of capitalisation of the banking system is clearly above the regulatory minimum required by our regulations and international practices. Page 9 of 14 Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word in PR... n 2009 before the Economy and Finance Commission, 07 April 2010 29/07/22, 14:57 The efficiency indicator shows almost the same level as the end of 2008, showing a careful and steady increase in banking activity as a whole. On the other hand, the system's shareholder capital is estimated to have increased 18.7% against 2008. The ratio of actives on this indicator, or as the financial lever is otherwise known, was gradually reduced during 2009. The drop in lever from 11.7 to 10.4% over the course of a year implies that the system has relied less on debt for active financing. Compared to European Union countries, the levies of the banking system in Albania continue to remain low, indicating a low degree of borrowing practice of the system. The expansion of the network of branches and banking agencies in the territory of Albania continued in 2009, but at lower paces compared to previous years. At the end of the past year, the total number of branches and agencies reached 530 out of 517 in late 2008. Thus, 17 new bank branches were opened, while 4 existing branches/agencies were closed. This highlights the fact that banks and branches of foreign banks operating in Albania even during 2009 continued with the expansion of their activity, while being more cautious in more efficient investments in the latter. 2.2 Supervision of the banking system With the aim of ensuring the stability of the banking system, the Bank of Albania in implementing its supervisory function has continuously carried out a more careful process of thorough analysis and oversight of the application and compliance of the legal and regulatory framework for licensed subjects. This has been carried out through inspections in the country, which during 2009 have been more frequent and rigorous, especially in the direction of the system's liquidity needs. In addition to respecting the supervisory cycle, banks have been constantly contacted for phenomena that have constituted concern during the year, taking relevant measures to address potential problems in time. In general, the banking system has acted carefully in carrying out operational processes of their activity and in accordance with the regulatory framework of the Bank of Albania. On the other hand, the Bank of Albania has co-operated closely with other supervisory institutions in the country, which monitor specific financial market activities, such as the Financial Supervision Authority, the Directorate for The Prevention of Money Laundering, the Deposit Security Agency, the Competition Authority. Co-operation in the direction of supervision has also been extended with international institutions, counterparts of the Bank of Albania. With the initiative of the European Central Bank, supervisory colleges were established for the coordination of work, information exchange and joint supervision of major European banking and financial institutions with several supervisory authorities of the countries where these institutions originated. In this context we have become part of the group in some of these colleges, being closer to monitoring the activity of foreign-capital banks in the country. 2.3 Strengthening the regulatory framework of supervisory Page 10 of 14 Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word in PR... n 2009 before the Economy and Finance Commission, 07 April 2010 29/07/22, 14:57 Strengthening the regulatory framework for banking supervision has been one of the Bank of Albania's priorities during 2009. Drafting strong and appropriate rules and rigorously monitoring them constitute a guarantee of maintaining financial stability. The Bank of Albania Banking Act and the continuous implementation of the Bank of Albania's medium and long-term objectives consolidated work to revise the regulatory framework overseeing compliance with the provisions of the law, intertwining with the implementation of the revised principles of the Basel Committee for effective oversight and new concepts of the New Capital Accord, directives of the European Council and best practices in the area of regulation and supervision of financial institutions licensed by the Bank of Albania. The Bank of Albania, during 2009 finalized the drafting of some new regulations and recognised changes to several other banking supervision regulations. This process has aimed to precede the prevention of negative phenomena of the system and has often received impetus from developments in global financial markets, in particular from the recent financial crisis. The main objective remains the adaptation of best practices: in the field of internal control; for a responsible and effective direction; in strengthening risk management capacities and increasing banks' level of transparency with clientele and the public. For the latter, increased opening and communication of the banking system to the clientele is required at the moment of offering products and services, in the presentation of promotional campaigns for new products and informing the real financial situation and their risk profile. 3. Other activities of the Bank of Albania I stopped in detail in describing and analysing two aspects of the bank of Albania's work, that of drafting and implementing monetary policy and banking supervision, as they are key functions of the institution I lead and have a more vulnerable nature to the public. However, let me mention some other aspects of the Bank of Albania's work that help develop the financial system and market economy in Albania. In this framework I want to order: the development of the payment system; supporting the European integration process; improving the bank's communication with the public; development of monetary and balance of payment statistics; as well as increasing research and research capacities. 3.1 Payment System During 2009, payment systems reflected safety and efficiency. On average, about 225 transactions with an average daily circulation of 19 billion dollars have been processed and atoned daily in the AIPS system. This is the system of high-value payments in real time, which is managed by the Bank of Albania and whose participants are all licensed banks in the country. The total value of liquidity atonement in the AIPS system during 2009 turns out to be about 4.3 times the value of gross domestic product. In addition to this system, the AECH system, which processes and regulates payments of small-value customers, operates near the Bank of Albania. On average, about 413 payments have been processed in this system every day, with an average daily value of 62.3 million dollars. Page 11 of 14 Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word in PR... n 2009 before the Economy and Finance Commission, 07 April 2010 29/07/22, 14:57 2009 also marked an expansion of payment instruments used by the public reflecting the addition of the use of the banking network by individuals and increasing confidence in the banking system. Debit or credit cards are one of those instruments that are finding increasing use in Albania. In 2009, an 11% increase in the number of cards in circulation was noted, compared to the end of 2008. On the other hand, the number of ATM and POS card use devices has increased, by 15 and 48%, respectively, compared to their number at the end of 2008. However, it is noted that of the total transactions, about 96% constitute cash withdrawals from the ATM, an indicator of a high-use cash economy. Building and maintaining an efficient and secure payment system is one of the priorities of the bank of Albania's work. An effective and developed payment system supports the functioning of financial markets and serves to strengthen financial stability in the country. The main directions where work focused during 2009 are: strengthening the legal framework in the function of the supervisory role for payment systems; and the improvement and promotion of changes in the national payment system in the function of the reformer role for payment systems. Regarding the first objective, the Bank of Albania is close to finalising the Bill for Payment Systems in the Republic of Albania, which aims to regulate, to oversee and protect payment systems. In relation to the second objective, the Bank of Albania has been co-realising projects aimed at providing technical infrastructure and regulatory for the establishment of payment platforms, as well as in projects aimed at reducing the use of cash in the economy. 3.2 Supporting integration processes The Bank of Albania, as the country's central bank, has an important role in the European integration process. In accordance with the MSA implementation process, the Bank of Albania has contributed to the revision of the National Plan for the Implementation of the MSA (PKZMSA) for 2009 2014, identifying and updating the priorities and measures taken in the areas of macroeconomic stability, free movement of capital, freedom of deployment, and freedom to provide services and also anticipating legal initiatives, implementation activities, necessary technical assistance, as well as expected costs during the process of approximating local legislation with acquis communautaire. It has maintained regular contact with the Ministry of European Integration, forwarding monthly progress reports, which reflect achievements in the direction of the implementation of legal measures and implementing activities and a description of the degree of compliance of legal acts adopted by the Bank of Albania with acquis communautaire. 3.3 Communication with the public and institutional transparency The Bank of Albania, over the years, has paid increasing attention to communication with the public. This is not only done within the framework of increasing transparency, as an important institutional pillar of the bank of Albania's activity, but also in the function of increasing the efficiency of its actions. In this way, the Bank of Page 12 of 14 Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word in PR... n 2009 before the Economy and Finance Commission, 07 April 2010 29/07/22, 14:57 Albania recognises and addresses the importance that a well-informed and well-educated public has in transmitting monetary policy to the economy, through timely making of fair and rational decisions. In this context, during 2009, activity in the field of public financial education has deepened further, through quality growth and greater geographical reach. At the center of training and educational activities were students, teachers and high school students. Also, in the focus of our educational work have continued to be journalists and the media, as important actors in mediating dialogue between the Bank of Albania and the general public. At the same time, our educational publications have been increased in number and variety, better addressing different interest groups. Finally, the redesign of the Bank of Albania's website in early 2009 already offers a more efficient information delivery portal, reorganized and adapted for various groupusers. 3.4 Improving statistics at the Bank of Albania The drafting of economic and monetary policies cannot be understood without support in reliable and timely figures and statistics. The Bank of Albania has an important role in the national statistical system, as the institution responsible for the production and distribution of monetary statistics and external sector statistics. In carrying out its statistical functions, the Bank of Albania is guided by the basic principles of official statistics in the Republic of Albania, which are: impartiality, credibility, professional independence, affiliation, cost-effectiveness, statistical confidentiality and transparency. During 2009, the Bank of Albania was able to draw up and distribute monetary statistics and external sector statistics, taking care to improve statistical service in all its sizes. This commitment has aimed to achieve the approximation of methodology with international best recommendations and practices, increase data quality through improving and informatics of control processes, as well as increasing the number of published indicators and detailing composite indicators. 3.5 Strengthening the research and research capacities of the Bank of Albania The Bank of Albania has been paying particular attention and energy for several years to increasing research capacities in the field of economics and finance, through strengthening human resource capacities, modernizing demanding technical infrastructure and creating bridges for exchanging experience and knowledge with institutions and authorities in the research field. Some of the main aspects of research during 2009 are: predictions and development of iconometric models; analysis of monetary policy transmission channels; aspects of the external sector; financial stability; economic growth, etc. Already, the study of various economic phenomena relies on complete or partial iconometric models, which enable the extraction of reliable conclusions and predictions. Our internal challenge in the future will be to further improve these models and their increasing use in the decision-making of the Bank of Albania. Ardian Fullani n prn 2009 prpara Komisionit t Ekonomis dhe Financave, 07 Prill 2010 29/07/22, 14:57 kapacitetet analizuese dhe reaguese t politikave makroekonomike. N nj plan m t gjer, goditja q mori ekonomia jon gjat vitit 2009 vuri n prov fleksibilitetin e modelit t zhvillimit ekonomik t vendit dhe aftsin e tij pr t iu prgjigjur nj ambienti botror rrnjsisht t transformuar. Kriza botrore dha nj ndikim t shpejt n aktivitetin ekonomik n vend. Ajo u shoqrua me nj reduktim t hyrjeve valutore n llogarin korente dhe kapitale, me nj ulje t menjhershme t krkess s jashtme dhe me nj ngadalsim t krkess s brendshme pr mallra e shrbime. N prgjigje t ktyre zhvillimeve, ritmi i rritjes ekonomike shnoi nj ngadalsim progresiv gjat vitit t shkuar, por duke mbetur gjithsesi n territor pozitiv. Ecuria e bilancit t pagesave t vendit u karakterizua nga nj zhbalancim i flukseve hyrse dhe dalse valutore. Ky zhbalancim u reflektua n lkundjen e raporteve t krkess dhe t oferts pr valut, duke rezultuar n nnmimin e kursit t kmbimit n prgjigje t ekuilibrave t rinj q mbizotruan n tregun valutor. Politika fiskale e forcoi karakterin e saj ekspansionist gjat vitit 2009, duke mbshtetur aktivitetin ekonomik n vend por duke rritur njkohsisht presionin n tregjet financiare. Tronditja q psoi sistemi financiar krijoi nj mjedis t vshtir pr transmetimin e plot dhe n koh t politiks monetare. N kto kushte sfiduese, Banka e Shqipris arriti t prmbush me sukses mandatin e saj ligjor pr ruajtjen e stabilitetit t mimeve n ekonomi: inflacioni vjetor i mimeve t konsumit rezultoi brenda objektivit ton prej 3 +/- 1% gjat vitit 2009. Politika monetare lehtsuese e Banks s Shqipris arriti t krijoj kushtet e duhura monetare pr ruajtjen e stabilitetit t mimeve. Gjithashtu, furnizimi i ekonomis me likuiditetin e nevojshm dhe me kosto n rnie, stabilizoi tregjet financiare dhe krijoi kushtet e duhura pr mbshtetjen e aktivitetit ekonomik gjat vitit 2009. Ecuria e sistemit financiar n vend u ndikua nga lkundja e besimit n sistemin ton financiar gjat gjysms s par t vitit dhe nga trheqja e nj pjese t depozitave prej tij. Ky zhvillim i kombinuar me nj grup tjetr faktorsh, rezultoi n nj mbshtetje m t vogl dhe me kosto m t lart t ekonomis shqiptare me kredi bankare. Ndr faktort e tjer do t veonim: rritjen e pasiguris s agjentve ekonomik dhe shtrenjtimin e primeve t likuiditetit; korrektimin e modelit t biznesit t disa segmenteve t tregut financiar; rritjen e volatilitetit t kursit t kmbimit; dhe reduktimin e krkess pr kredi n gjysmn e dyt t vitit. Lkundja e besimit t publikut nnvizoi rndsin parsore t stabilitetit financiar n jetn ekonomike t vendit. N fushn e saj t prgjegjsis, Banka e Shqipris ndrmori nj plan t gjer dhe t koordinuar masash t cilat synonin ruajtjen e stabilitetit financiar n nivel sistemik dhe institucioni. Prpjekjet tona pr ruajtjen e stabilitetit financiar u koordinuan edhe me autoritetet e tjera publike, ekzekutive dhe legjislative. Vlen t prmendet prmirsimi i skems s sigurimit t depozitave t publikut dhe rritja e shkalls s garantimit t tyre nga Agjencia e Sigurimit t Depozitave. Kto masa rezultuan t suksesshme n kufizimin e pasojave negative dhe n rivendosjen e plot t besimit n sistemin bankar. Si rrjedhoj e tyre, sistemi bankar shqiptar arriti t ruaj bilance t shndetshme dhe t jet n gjendje t ushtroj funksionin e tij t ndrmjetsuesit financiar dhe at t furnizuesit t ekonomis me instrumente pagese. N vijim t fjals sime, dshiroj t prek dhe t analizoj n mnyr m t detajuar, shtjet e prmendura m sipr. 1. Politika monetare e Banks s Shqipris dhe stabiliteti i mimeve (Ecuria e aktivitetit ekonomik, zhvillimet kryesore monetare, politika monetare dhe prmbushja e objektivit t inflacionit) N prputhje me mandatin e saj ligjor, politika monetare e Banks s Shqipris sht hartuar dhe zbatuar n funksion t arritjes dhe t ruajtjes s stabilitetit t mimeve. Gjat vitit 2009, rreziqet kryesore ndaj stabilitetit t mimeve kan ardhur nga ngadalsimi i aktivitetit ekonomik, luhatja e besimit t agjentve ekonomik, zhbalancimi i pozicionit t jashtm t ekonomis shqiptare dhe nnmimi i kursit t kmbimit. Pavarsisht ktyre sfidave, Banka e Shqipris arriti t ruaj inflacionin e mimeve t konsumit brenda objektivit. Le t shohim m n detaje elementet e prekura m sipr. 1.1 Ekonomia botrore Konteksti ndrkombtar, i cili shoqroi zhvillimet ekonomike dhe financiare n vend gjat vitit t shkuar, nuk ishte aspak i favorshm. Viti 2009 u karakterizua nga tkurrja e aktivitetit ekonomik botror, si rrjedhoj e rnies ekonomike n vendet e zhvilluara dhe e ngadalsimit t ndjeshm ekonomik n vendet n zhvillim. Rritja e ekonomis botrore shnoi vlern e par negative gjat 50 viteve t fundit. N vijim t problemeve t shfaqura s pari gjat vitit 2008, edhe sistemi financiar botror prjetoi nj periudh t vshtir. Vmendja e rregullatorve dhe e vet institucioneve financiare u prqendrua n rregullimin e bilanceve t dmtuara t sistemit financiar. Tkurrja e aktivitetit ekonomik dhe rritja e pasiguris n tregjet financiare u shoqruan me uljen e tregtis dhe paksimin e lvizjes s flukseve financiare n nivel botror. Recesioni ekonomik shkaktoi gjithashtu rritjen e papunsis dhe uljen e shkalls s shfrytzimit t kapaciteteve, duke krijuar kshtu nj ambient me presione t ulta inflacioniste. Ky ambient mundsoi ndjekjen e politikave t forta stimuluese fiskale dhe monetare, n mbshtetje t rritjes s krkess dhe t prodhimit n ekonomi. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fj_perpara_Komisionit_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_07_Prill_2010.html Pagina 3 di 14 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris z. Aktiviteti ekonomik, rritja e t cilit ishte kryesisht negative n gjysmn e par t vitit, shnoi nj prmirsim t leht n gjashtmujorin e dyt. Rimkmbja e krkess n nivel botror ndikoi n rigjallrimin e ekonomis dhe n rritjen e tregtis, n prmirsimin e treguesve t besimit, dhe n krijimin e pritjeve m optimiste pr t ardhmen. Gjithashtu, ndrhyrja e vendosur e autoriteteve n mbshtetje t sistemit financiar ndihmoi n sheshimin e tensioneve t krijuara nga kriza. Ky normalizim u reflektua n reduktimin e primeve t rrezikut, n ecurin rnse t normave t interesit dhe n luhatshmrin m t moderuar t tyre. Megjithat, rikuperimi i aktivitetit ekonomik n bot mbetet i brisht. N veanti, borxhi publik i rritur ndjeshm si rrjedhoj e deficiteve fiskale t larta, sht kthyer n vmendjen e tregjeve financiare dhe t politikbrsve. Aftsia e qeverive pr t rifinancuar dhe shrbyer n t ardhmen kt borxh, do t kushtzoj primet e rrezikut n tregjet financiare dhe stabilitetin makroekonomik t vendeve t veanta. 1.2 Rritja ekonomike dhe faktort q kan ndikuar n t Integrimi n rritje i ekonomis shqiptare dhe veanrisht i sistemit t saj financiar, bri q kriza botrore t reflektohej q hert n vendin ton. Kanalet kryesore t cilat ekspozuan ekonomin shqiptare ishin: ulja e eksporteve; rnia e remitancave dhe e hyrjeve t tjera valutore; rritja e pasiguris n institucionet financiare; dhe n prgjigje t tyre, rishikimi i planeve t biznesit t pothuajse t gjith agjentve ekonomik. Ky ndikim mori formn e uljes s normave t rritjes dhe t lkundjes s disa ekuilibrave makroekonomik gjat vitit 2009. Prodhimi i Brendshm Bruto gjat nntmujorit t par t vitit 2009 u rrit me 4.9% n terma vjetor. Ritmet e rritjes vjetore t tij jan karakterizuar nga nj rnie progresive, nga 5.4% n tremujorin e par, n 4.1% n tremujorin e tret. T dhna t trthorta dhe informacione t tjera me natyr cilsore sugjerojn se ekonomia ka vijuar t ngadalsohet m tej edhe n tremujorin e katrt t vitit 2009. Duke mbetur n pritje t statistikave zyrtare t INSTAT-it, vlersimet paraprake tregojn se rritja ekonomike pr vitin 2009 sht luhatur rreth nivelit 3%. Ngadalsimi i rritjes s PBB-s ka reflektuar kontraktimin e aktivitetit n sektort e industris dhe t ndrtimit, ndrkoh q vlera e shtuar nga sektori i shrbimeve mbeti kontribuesi kryesor n rritjen ekonomike. Duke u nisur nga rrethanat e vshtira n t cilat u zhvillua aktiviteti ekonomik dhe n krahasim me prvojat e vendeve t rajonit, ruajtja n terma pozitiv e ritmit t rritjes ekonomike sht nj zhvillim inkurajues. Megjithat, ngadalsimi i saj dhe ekuilibrat e rinj makroekonomik krkojn vmendjen e duhur nga t gjith agjentt ekonomik n projeksionet e tyre pr t ardhmen. T dhnat pr krkesn agregate tregojn se ngadalsimi i konsumit privat dhe rnia e investimeve kan qen faktort prcaktues n ngadalsimin e rritjes s krkess n vend. Krahas kushteve t lehtsuara monetare, stimuli fiskal mbshteti ekonomin n gjenerimin e normave pozitive t rritjes gjat vitit 2009. Ritmet e ngadalsuara t rritjes s pagave, rnia e remitancave dhe tkurrja e kredis konsumatore, ndikuan n ngadalsimin e konsumit gjat vitit 2009. Investimet private vlersohen t jen ndikuar m shum sesa prbrsit e tjer t krkess agregate nga kriza financiare dhe ekonomike botrore. Ngadalsimi i krkess s brendshme e t jashtme, pasigurit lidhur me situatn ekonomike n vend dhe jasht, si dhe kushtet e shtrnguara t kreditimit kan diktuar kontraktim t investimeve private gjat vitit 2009. Politika fiskale dhe treguesit fiskal Ngadalsimi i ekonomis vendase ndikoi ecurin e politiks fiskale dhe t treguesve fiskal. Politika fiskale pati nj natyr ekspansioniste, e cila u reflektua n zgjerimin e deficitit buxhetor, veanrisht gjat gjysms s par t vitit. Deficiti buxhetor pr vitin 2009 vlersohet t jet rreth nivelit 7% t PBB-s. Burimet kryesore t financimit t deficitit ishin t ardhurat e privatizimeve dhe kredia sindikale, duke reduktuar nevojn pr huamarrje n tregun e brendshm. T ardhurat buxhetore shnuan rritje vjetore prej 2.7%, kryesisht si pasoj e rritjes s ngadalt t t ardhurave tatimore. Nga ana tjetr, shpenzimet publike u rritn me rreth 8%, t udhhequra nga ritmi i lart i shpenzimeve korente. Politika fiskale ekspansioniste i dha impulsin e nevojshm aktivitetit ekonomik gjat vitit, por ajo u shoqrua gjithashtu me rritjen e borxhit publik dhe presione n rritje mbi yield-et e letrave me vler t qeveris. Zgjerimi i deficitit buxhetor rezultoi n rritjen e ndjeshme t borxhit publik, i cili n fund t vitit 2009 vlersohet n rreth 59.5% t PBB-s. Banka e Shqipris gjykon se karakteri ekspansionist i politiks fiskale sht i paprballueshm n horizontin afatmesm dhe potencialisht me pasoja negative n horizontin afatgjat. N kt drejtim, ne inkurajojm marrjen e masave pr reduktimin e deficitit buxhetor dhe t borxhit publik. Nj deficit buxhetor dhe nj borxh publik m i ult n horizontin afatgjat, do t krijojn m shum hapsira n aksesin e fondeve nga sektori privat dhe do t rrisin besimin n stabilitetin makroekonomik t vendit. Gjithashtu, kto masa do t plotsojn krijimin e nj klime t prshtatshme pr trheqjen e kapitaleve t huaja n formn e kredive private apo t investimeve t huaja direkte. Banka e Shqipris e ka monitoruar nga afr kt situat duke qen e ndrgjegjshme pr efektet prociklike, q mund t shkaktonin kto zhvillime n portofolin e kredis. N vitin 2009, vihet re nj rritje prej 11% e numrit t kartave n qarkullim, krahasuar me fundin e vitit 2008. Nga ana tjetr, numri i pajisjeve ATM dhe POS pr prdorimin e kartave sht rritur, prkatsisht me 15 dhe 48%, krahasuar me numrin e tyre n fund t vitit 2008. Megjithat, evidentohet se nga totali i transaksioneve, rreth 96% e prbjn trheqjet cash nga ATM, tregues ky i nj ekonomie me prdorim t lart t cash-it. Ndrtimi dhe mirmbajtja e nj sistemi pagesash eficient dhe t sigurt sht nj nga prparsit e puns s Banks s Shqipris. Nj sistem efektiv dhe i zhvilluar pagesash mbshtet mirfunksionimin e tregjeve financiare dhe i shrben forcimit t stabilitetit financiar n vend. Drejtimet kryesore ku sht fokusuar puna gjat vitit 2009, jan: forcimi i kuadrit ligjor n funksion t rolit mbikqyrs pr sistemet e pagesave; dhe prmirsimi dhe nxitja e ndryshimeve n sistemin kombtar t pagesave n funksion t rolit reformator pr sistemet e pagesave. N lidhje me objektivin e par, Banka e Shqipris sht pran finalizimit t projektligjit Pr sistemet e pagesave n Republikn e Shqipris i cili synon t rregulloj, t mbikqyr dhe t mbroj sistemet e pagesave. N lidhje me objektivin e dyt, Banka e Shqipris ka qen bashkrealizuese e projekteve q synojn ofrimin e infrastrukturs teknike dhe rregullative pr ngritjen e platformave t pagesave si dhe n projekte t cilat synojn reduktimin e prdorimit t cash-it n ekonomi. 3.2 Mbshtetja e proceseve integruese Banka e Shqipris, si banka qendrore e vendit, ka nj rol t rndsishm n procesin e integrimit evropian. N prputhje me procesin e zbatimit t MSA-s, Banka e Shqipris ka kontribuar n rishikimin e Planit Kombtar pr Zbatimin e MSA-s (PKZMSA) pr vitet 2009 2014, duke identifikuar dhe prditsuar prparsit dhe masat e marra n fushat e stabilitetit makroekonomik, lvizjes s lir t kapitalit, liris s vendosjes si dhe liris pr t ofruar shrbime dhe gjithashtu duke parashikuar nismat ligjore, aktivitetet zbatuese, asistencn e nevojshme teknike si dhe kostot e pritshme gjat procesit t prafrimit t legjislacionit vendas me acquis communautaire. Ajo ka mbajtur kontakte t rregullta me Ministrin e Integrimit Evropian, duke i prcjell raporte mujore t progresit, t cilat pasqyrojn arritjet n drejtim t realizimit t masave ligjore dhe aktiviteteve zbatuese dhe nj prshkrim t shkalls s prputhshmris t akteve juridike t miratuara nga Banka e Shqipris me acquis communautaire. 3.3 Komunikimi me publikun dhe transparenca institucionale Banka e Shqipris, ndr vite, i ka kushtuar nj vmendje n rritje komunikimit me publikun. Kjo nuk sht br vetm n kuadr t rritjes s transparencs, si nj shtyll institucionale e rndsishme e veprimtaris s Banks s Shqipris, por edhe n funksion t rritjes s eficiencs s veprimeve t saj. N kt kuadr, gjat vitit 2009, veprimtaria n fushn e edukimit financiar t publikut sht thelluar m tej, nprmjet rritjes cilsore dhe shtrirjes m t madhe gjeografike. N qendr t trajnimeve dhe aktiviteteve edukuese kan qen studentt, msuesit dhe nxnsit e shkollave t mesme. Gjithashtu, n fokus t puns son edukative kan vazhduar t jen edhe gazetart dhe mediat, si aktor t rndsishm n ndrmjetsimin e dialogut mes Banks s Shqipris dhe publikut t gjer. N t njjtn koh, botimet tona edukative jan shtuar n numr dhe larmishmri, duke adresuar m mir grupe t ndryshme t interesit. S fundi, ridizenjimi i faqes s internetit t Banks s Shqipris n fillim t vitit 2009 ofron tashm nj portal m eficient t dhnies t informacionit, t riorganizuar dhe prshtatur pr grupprdorues t ndryshm. 3.4 Prmirsimi i statistikave n Bankn e Shqipris Hartimi i politikave ekonomike e monetare nuk mund t kuptohet pa mbshtetjen n shifra dhe statistika t besueshme dhe n koh. Banka e Shqipris ka nj rol t rndsishm n sistemin statistikor kombtar, si institucioni prgjegjs pr prodhimin dhe shprndarjen e statistikave monetare dhe statistikave t sektorit t jashtm. N kryerjen e funksioneve t saj statistikore, Banka e Shqipris udhhiqet nga parimet baz t statistikave zyrtare n Republikn e Shqipris, q jan: paanshmria, besueshmria, pavarsia profesionale, prkatsia, kosto-efektiviteti, konfidencialiteti statistikor dhe transparenca. Gjat vitit 2009, Banka e Shqipris ka vijuar t hartoj dhe t shprndaj statistika monetare dhe statistika t sektorit t jashtm, duke u kujdesur t prmirsoj shrbimin statistikor n t gjitha prmasat e tij. Ky angazhim ka synuar t arrij prafrimin e metodologjis me rekomandimet dhe praktikat m t mira ndrkombtare, rritjen e cilsis s t dhnave nprmjet prmirsimit dhe informatizimit t proceseve t kontrollit, si dhe rritjen e numrit t treguesve t publikuar dhe detajimin e treguesve t prbr. 3.5 Forcimi i kapaciteteve studimore dhe krkimore t Banks s Shqipris Banka e Shqipris, prej disa vitesh i ka kushtuar vmendje dhe energji t veant rritjes s kapaciteteve krkimore n fushn e ekonomis dhe t financs, nprmjet forcimit t kapaciteteve t burimeve njerzore, modernizimit t infrastrukturs teknike krkuese dhe krijimit t urave pr shkmbimin e prvojs dhe njohurive me institucione e autoritete n fushn krkimore. Disa nga aspektet kryesore ku sht prqendruar krkimi gjat vitit 2009 jan: parashikimet dhe zhvillimi i modeleve ekonometrike; analizimi i kanaleve t transmetimit t politiks monetare; aspekte t sektorit t jashtm; t stabilitetit financiar; t rritjes ekonomike etj. Tashm, studimi i fenomeneve t ndryshme ekonomike mbshtetet n modele t plota apo t pjesshme ekonometrike, t cilat mundsojn nxjerrjen e konkluzioneve dhe parashikimeve t besueshme. text: 06/08/2022, 09:18 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the Regional High Level Dialogue Table, themed "... , Mr Ardian Fullani, at the Regional High Level Dialogue Table, with the theme "Strengthening internal anchors in aid of exit strategies", Washington, D.C., April 23, 2010 Publication date: 23.04.2010 Honored participants,  1/7 06/08/2022, 09:18 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the Regional High Level Dialogue Table, themed "... It's great fun to go back to Washington and continue our dialogue. The pre-meeting confirmed and clarified the value of building stronger fiscal internal anchors. I hope that in my discussion I will show the extent to which internal and external anchovy are connected, and that capacity building must also be taken into account for external anchovy. It is even more interesting that the issues that will be discussed remain at the core of the problem, not only in the economies of the region, but also throughout the world. I think that's the best way to serve the complainant policies. The points we discuss today do not differ from what Blanchard and other co-authors (2010) address recently in relation to developed economies. Capacity building in the field of policy coordination is becoming increasingly important, as the consequences of fiscal policy are imposing threats to other policies, particularly monetary policy. One of the lectures we have learned is that: in any case fiscal policy matters. Not only in the context of creating the problem, but also in the context of solving the problem. Recent developments have indeed shown that under certain circumstances, monetary policy may have limited room for manoeuvre; so fiscal policy must take charge of the direction of the situation. Still, as this enterprise occurs, the situation can become very unstable as the budget and debt grow more. Unlike monetary policy, which uses correction mechanisms to eliminate collateral damage to the final objective fiscal policy leaves the economy with a high debt at the end of the crisis. Consequently, today, the most urgent macro task is to reregulate the fiscal sector. Which anchors can be used for this purpose? Fiscal regulation may be a solution. A fiscal rule that provides long-term macro fiscal stability is ultimately a very good internal complainant. A fiscal rule does not simply mean a quantitative restriction. It is a dynamic and complex issue, which intertwines all other economic and social policies. It is designed and implemented in full compliance with the objectives of other key social and economic policies of a given country. This ensures compliance with EU directives, under the Stability and Economic Growth Pact, or any other political agreement, according to the circumstances of specific countries. I would like to discuss later compliance with EU directives and various related issues, as part of the discussion of external anchors, while focusing on another important issue: that of independent fiscal agencies, as a fiscal council. This discussion logically follows arguments for fiscal rule. The essential problem of the rule is to decide, agree or build a consensus on what is considered sustainable in the long term. The overall goal here, in the form of capacity building for policy coordination, is to create an independent agency, which will in fact play the role of arbitrator between the fiscal agent and other parties involved, who httpsk://wwew.ibankofalbania.eorg/Shtypi/Fjalime_liinitkerevistaf_iarktikulj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_z_Ardian_Fullani_ne_Tr... 2/7 06/08/2022, 09:18 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the Regional High Level Dialogue Table, themed "... they have interests in or with fiscal policy. Now before we answer the question of whether we need these agencies, let's look at the following issues: Announcing the creation of a new agency is exactly how to accept that there is a problem. What kind of problem? Is this a problem of bringing the political system or the problem of the institution and capacity building? It's not easy to answer that question. It carries important consequences because of the nature of therapy. Assuming this is a problem of political behaviour, then the creation of a new institution from the same (democratic) political system is unlikely to be the solution. This is because the new institution will manifest the same problem of political behaviour as existing constitutional authorities. It is difficult to believe that such an institution can solve problems of reverse selection or moral risk in fiscal policy. We all know that fiscal problems do not lie within specific institutions. They are always the product of internal political systems. Under such circumstances, new state agencies will have the capacity to reduce the central bank's independence. Consequently, if the solution to such behavioural problems is a new independent constitutional agency, then the solution is very likely to become more serious than the problem itself. It is appropriate to mention the last right-wing victory in Hungary. If a clear party is confirmed then what will happen to the Fiscal Council and its Policy? The council would see itself under possible major threats. The council chairman can leave office, their financial situation may change or their salaries can be affected and so on. It is not possible to equip the council with the same style of central bank independence as financial independence, objective independence and what comes from tradition. Need for capacity building If the problem lies with institutions, then there is a need for capacity building, and perhaps institution construction. Our experience highlights two important shortcomings in terms of fiscal regulation, which indicate the direction for reforms and capacity building. This applies in the area of determining fiscal targets. The evidence points not only to technical deficiencies, for example income resilience, but also deficiencies to some extent of care and realization in assessing risks and exchanges. The rule is a report, which measures the government's behaviour towards the PBB. So if someone doesn't have an accurate, reliable and recent GDP figure, then it's almost impossible to have a useful fiscal rule. As can be seen, the fiscal rule requires an extraordinary delay in building policies and capacities in statistics. Without a satisfactory level of transparency, integrity and dedication, regulation becomes an exercise  3/7 06/08/2022, 09:18 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the Regional High Level Dialogue Table, themed "... meaningless mathematical. Let's take the case of Greece; Can there be another better example to illustrate this issue? Another key element is the need for coordination between key policymakers. At this point I remember one of my answers to journalists: Isolation is loneliness. This leads me to another issue: Independence versus isolation. The way the Bank of Albania has dealt with the docking issue, especially after the IMF Agreement ended is precisely independent but do not isolate itself. We have invited the Minister of Finance with his staff to participate in joint meetings, where we exchange and discuss our views on economic developments, and the arguments behind them. These meetings have in fact been a learning process for both sides, and I confirm with full confidence that this has ultimately been a process of capacity building in the field of policy coordination. Among other things, another lesson we realized was that sometimes differences in thought result not only from policy objectives, but predominantly from different opinions regarding current and expected economic developments, statistics that should in fact have already been valid for policy analyses. It's hard to discuss separate the issue of capacity building and that of internal anchors, while they are so interconnected with each other. In my judgment, I believe that the best inner anchovy is a professional, who is an independent intellectual, proud of what he does, and who understands the consequences of his actions and results. The real problem is how to build such a complainant? First you must educate her, then make her independent politically and financially, and then further educate her in those areas where her actions and results play an important role, with immediate consequences. On the other hand, capacity building is not a matter of persons; It's a matter of institutions. It's actually a timeless process by human beings. This is why capacities must be built in processes and not in people, in order to live long. From this point of view, everyone can understand that institutions are part of the government's pay even under political influence. In fact, much has been said about the independence of the central bank, but not so much has been said about independent agencies, for example the statistics office. The right anchors are not thought to be used only by institutions that link their politics to these anchors. They must become a powerful argument in the hands of the public, to pressure government agencies to draft and implement sustainable policies. This leads me to the thought that the public itself should be able to understand and use the anchovy. Thus, there is a need for capacity building in our societies beyond institutions. Let me illustrate this point with a story as fun but at the same time so sad by my personal experience. After a word to the public on TV, a friend called me to congratulate me. He told me that every single word had been in the right place. Even my wife, who's a doctor  4/7 06/08/2022, 09:18 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the Regional High Level Dialogue Table, themed "... He understood everything my friend told me. However, in the end she asked my friend to explain what pBB meant? And his answer was: mathematics has never been one of my strongest abilities. Capacity building and the role of external anchors In developed Europe there are common places, where researchers naturally gather to discuss such issues from a critical point of view. These forums are held by non-profit research bodies (institutes) or universities, whose respected thoughts play an important role in public perception, in the context of the credibility of public institutions. The question in which case lies in why such institutions are not as powerful in our economies as they are in the EU? In this regard I have the full conviction that European values can play a crucial role, strengthening and supporting the creation of reputable institutions, where criticism can be made independently of political processes and objectives. From a general point of view, supporting EU policies has been aimed at political process and consolidation of governing institutions. Meanwhile our societies are developing faster, in many other important ways and dimensions, which so far are not part of European approximation initiatives. Just to give some examples, I would like to mention the rapid addition of universities, programmes and academic institutions. These examples are in fact natural poles that are thought to create, shape and strengthen internal anchovy, as well as discussed above. Ignoring the capacity building process is the same as ignoring the creation of important internal anchors. In other words, all those institutions capable of joining groups of individuals and intellectuals, who, regardless of their professions, ideas, interests or political or social affiliations, will be able to make criticism of volatile fiscal policies. As for other issues such as the Fiscal Economic Programme (PEF) and the Economic ProcessEs Programme (EPP), I have expressed my views regarding the significant contribution of both programmes. However, I believe that the EU can play a greater role as external complainers. The EU guide refers to the budget or debt situation in any time period. So if it is a constitutional criterion that, current policies under normal circumstances should leave space for urgent fiscal intervention, then this does not violate the border. The latest crisis showed that PEF and PPE are somewhat rigid and may not function properly in economic stress conditions. Some of the main goals may be to develop the most reliable basic risk scenarios for the economy and public finances; and the creation of the right fiscal space to deal with inconvenient blows. Thus it would be advisable for the EU to require all aspiring countries in the region to have a functional agreement with the IMF throughout the EU membership process.  5/7 06/08/2022, 09:18 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the Regional High Level Dialogue Table, themed "... the region to have a functional agreement with the IMF throughout the eu membership process. This is not only to control, but also to guarantee immediate intervention in case of crises; and better structural integration reforms including the adoption of acquis communitarians. It will be quite optimistic to expect the economies of the region's aspiring countries to last as long as Greece resisted, while the EU analyses the options. Above all, under recent legal agreements, the EU has or does not take any responsibility for resolving possible crises in our countries. In this respect, the EU alone, with difficulty is labelled a foreign policy and supervisory institution along with other legal and institutional political roles. While this more or less generally sums up my opinion (expressed the year that went), I would like to add some points regarding this discussion. The most important aspect of these two agreements is that they are the same for all countries and therefore do not matter for particular needs or situations of the country. The fiscal rules we are addressing today can and need to be different for different countries, designed according to the country's specific needs, based on individual economic needs and priorities in structural reforms. In fact, all these specific needs have been paid detailed attention according to IMF programmes. The structural standards of these programmes have played a similar role as fiscal rules, although they have been different in different countries and periods. In this context they have allowed temporary adjustments, not including the long-term sustainability of macro-fiscal balances. Our countries have also gained considerable experience in negotiating and implementing such agreements. In the absence of these agreements, countries cannot use this collected experience, simply because the other side in the new agreement does not pursue the same agreement as the IMF. So it can be a responsible and smart solution for all aspirational countries, including new members during the EU integration process, until full economic approximation is achieved, that the macrofiscal framework must be drawn up and implemented under a three-sided agreement respectively between the Country, the European Commission and the IMF. I think it serves you both together both the country and the EU. They both gain experience from the IMF in the field of policy harmonisation, capacity building and implementation of economic policies. Although now most countries in the region are referred to as emerging market economies, we must bear in mind that, according to economic wisdom, the border between the transition market and the developing market is very thin. Progress towards the emerging market economy carries greater and highly vulnerable responsibilities. Exiting the transition does not mean the end of economic problems, or automatically provides confidence in markets. As such, I think these countries are still not capable of fully pursuing aggressive policies themselves.  6/7 06/08/2022, 09:18 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the Regional High Level Dialogue Table, themed "... economic and financial without relying on international expertise. Such expertise could provide additional guarantees for markets. This would bring greater confidence, higher IHD, a rapid approximation process and no doubt stable economic growth. Honoured participants, this initiative resulted in useful and benefited from this opportunity to thank the Centre for Exelence in Finance for the contribution given. I am convinced that the Centre for Exelence in Finance has helped greatly to unfold and prioritize capacity building efforts in the region. It is necessary for methods and other ways of capacity building to be explored in the future; And I see CEF as an active management agency. In the end I would like to end up evaluating experience exchange, education systems and strengthening human resource skills as complementary and not as alternatives. Thank you for the attention!  7/7

Tani para se ti prgjigjemi pyetjes nse kemi nevoj pr kto agjenci le t shqyrtojm shtjet e mposhtme: T njoftosh krijimin e nj agjencie t re sht pikrisht si t pranosh se ka nj problem. far lloj problemi? A sht ky nj problem i sjelljes s sistemit politik apo problem i institucionit dhe i ndrtimit t kapaciteteve? Nuk sht e leht ti japsh prgjigje ksaj pyetjeje. Ajo mbart pasoja t rndsishme pr shkak t natyrs s terapis. Duke supozuar se ky sht nj problem i sjelljes politike, ather krijimi i nj institucioni t ri nga i njjti sistem politik (demokratik) nuk ka t ngjar t jet zgjidhja. Kjo pr arsye sepse institucioni i ri do t manifestoj t njjtin problem t sjelljes politike ashtu si autoritetet ekzistues konstitucionale. sht e vshtir t besohet se nj institucion i tille mund t zgjidh problemet e przgjedhjes s kundrt ose t rrezikut moral n politikn fiskale. T gjith e dim se problemet fiskale nuk qndrojn brenda institucioneve specifik. Ato jan gjithmon produkt i sistemeve t brendshm politik. N rrethana t tilla, agjenci t reja shtetrore do t ken kapacitetin t zvoglojn pavarsin e banks qendrore. Kryetari i kshillit mund t largohet nga detyra, gjendja e tyre financiare mund t ndryshoj ose rrogat e tyre mund t preken e kshtu me radhe. Nuk sht mundur t pajissh kshillin me t njjtin stil t pavarsis s banks qendrore  si pavarsi financiare, pavarsia objektive dhe ajo qe vjen nga tradita. Nevoja pr ndrtimin e kapaciteteve N qoft se problemi qndron tek institucionet, ather ka nevoj pr ndrtim t kapaciteteve, dhe ndoshta pr ndrtim t institucioneve. Prvoja jon evidenton dy mangsi t rndsishme lidhur me rregullin fiskal, t cilat tregojn drejtimin pr reformat dhe ndrtimin e kapaciteteve. Kjo zbatohet n fushn e prcaktimit t objektivave fiskal. Rregulli sht nj raport, i cili mat sjelljen e qeveris ndaj PBB. Kshtu nse dikush nuk ka nj shifr t sakt, t besueshme dhe t fundit t PBB-s, ather sht pothuajse e pamundur t kihet nj rregull fiskal i dobishm. Si mund t shihet, rregulli fiskal krkon nj shtyrje t jashtzakonshme n ndrtimin e politikave dhe kapaciteteve n statistika. Ardian Fullani, n Tryezn e Dialogut t Nivelit t Lart Rajonal, me tem  matematikor pa kuptim. T marrim rastin e Greqis; a mund t ket shembull tjetr m t mir q t ilustroj kt shtje? Nj element tjetr ky lidhet me nevojn pr koordinim ndrmjet politikve-brsve kryesor. N kt pik kujtoj nj nga prgjigjet e mia pr gazetart:  Izolimi sht vetmi. Kjo m on n nj shtje tjetr: Pavarsia kundrejt izolimit. Mnyra si Banka e Shqipris ka trajtuar shtjen e ankorimit, veanrisht pasi prfundoi Marrveshja m FMN sht pikrisht e pavarur por mos e izolo veten. Ne e kemi ftuar Ministrin e Financave bashk me stafin e tij t marrin pjes n takime t prbashkta, ku shkmbejm dhe diskutojm pikpamjet tona pr zhvillimet ekonomike, dhe argumentet q qndrojn pas tyre. Kto takime n fakt kan qen nj proces msimi pr t dy palt, dhe un konfirmoj me besim t plot se ky ka qene prfundimisht nj proces ndrtim i kapaciteteve n fushn e koordinimit t politikave. Midis t tjerash, nj msim tjetr q n kuptuam ishte se, ndonjher diferencat n mendime rezultojn jo vetm nga objektivat e politiks, por n mnyr mbizotruese nga opinionet t ndryshme lidhur me zhvillimet aktuale dhe t pritshme ekonomike, statistika q n fakt tashm duhet t ken qen t vlefshme pr analizat e politikave . sht e vshtir ti diskutosh t ndara shtjen e ndrtimit t kapaciteteve dhe at t ankorave t brendshme, prderisa ato jan kaq t ndrlidhura me njra tjetrn. Sipas gjykimit tim, un besoj se ankoreta m e mir e brendshme sht nj profesionist, i cili sht intelektual i pavarur, krenar pr at q bn, dhe q kupton pasojat e veprimeve dhe rezultateve t veta. Problemi real sht si t ndrtosh nj ankor t till? S pari duhet ta arsimosh, m pas ta bsh t pavarur politikisht dhe financiarisht, e m pas ta arsimosh m tej n ato fusha ku veprimet dhe rezultatet e saj luajn nj rol t rndsishm, me pasoja t menjhershme. Nga ana tjetr, ndrtimi i kapaciteteve nuk sht shtje e personave; sht shtje e institucioneve. N fakt sht proces i pandryshueshm nga qenia njerzore. Kjo sht arsyeja prse kapacitetet duhet t ndrtohen n procese dhe jo n njerz, me qllim q t jetojn gjat. Nga ky kndvshtrim, secili mund t kuptoj se institucionet jan pjes e pags s qeveris madje dhe nn ndikimin politik. N fakt sht thn shum n lidhje me pavarsin e banks qendrore, por nuk sht thn aq shum n lidhje me agjencit e pavarura, pr shembull zyra e statistikave. Ankorat e duhura nuk mendohen t prdoren vetm nga institucionet t cilt lidhin politikn e tyre m kto ankora. Ato duhet t bhen nj argument i fuqishm n duart e publikut, pr ti br presion agjencive qeveritare t hartojn dhe zbatojn politika t qndrueshme. Kjo m on mua n mendimin q vet publiku duhet t jet i aft t kuptoj dhe t prdor ankorn. Kshtu, ka nj nevoj pr ndrtimin e kapaciteteve n shoqrit tona prtej institucioneve. M lejoni t ilustroj kt pike m nj histori sa argtuese por njkohsisht aq e trishtuar nga prvoja ime personale. Pas nj fjale pr publikun n TV, nj mik m mori n telefon pr t m uruar. Ai m tha se do fjale e vetme kish qen n vendin e duhur.
