Dhe prgjigja e tij kish qen: matematika asnjher nuk ka qen nj nga aftsit e mia m t forta. Ndrtimi i kapaciteteve dhe roli i ankorave t jashtme N Evropn e zhvilluar ka vende t zakonshme, ku studiuesit mblidhen n mnyr t natyrshme pr t diskutuar shtje t tilla nga kndvshtrimi kritik. Kto forume zhvillohen nga organizma (institute) krkimore jo-fitimprurse apo universitetet, mendimet e respektuara t t cilve luajn rol t rndsishm n perceptimin publik, n kontekstin e besueshmris s institucioneve publike. Pyetja n k rast qndron n at se prse institucione t tilla nuk jan po kaq t fuqishm n ekonomit tona, si jan n BE? Lidhur me kt kam bindjen e plot se vlerat evropiane mund t luajn rol vendimtar, duke forcuar dhe mbshtetur krijimin e institucioneve me reputacion, ku kritika mund t bhet n mnyr t pavarur nga proceset dhe objektivat politike. Nga nj kndvshtrim i prgjithshm, mbshtetja e politikave t BE ka pasur si qllim procesin politik dhe konsolidimin e institucioneve drejtuese. Ndrkoh shoqrit tona po zhvillohen m shpejtsi, n shum mnyra dhe dimensione t tjera t rndsishme, t cilat deri m tani nuk jan pjes e iniciativave evropiane t prafrimit. Vetm sa pr t dhn disa shembuj, do t doja t prmendja shtimin e shpejt t universiteteve, programeve dhe institucioneve akademike. Kto shembuj n fakt jan polet natyral q mendohen t krijojn, ti japin form e t forcojn ankorat e brendshme, si dhe u diskutua m sipr. Injorimi i procesit t ndrtimit t kapaciteteve sht i njjt si t injorosh krijimin e ankorave t brendshme t rndsishme. Me fjal t tjera, t gjith ato institucione t aft t bashkojn grupe individsh dhe intelektualsh, t cilt, pavarsisht profesioneve, ideve, interesave apo prkatsive politike apo shoqror t tyre, do t jen t aft t bjn kritik pr politikat e paqndrueshme fiskale. Pr sa i prket shtjeve t tjera si: Programi Ekonomik Fiskal (PEF) dhe Programit i Proceseve Ekonomike (PPE), kam shprehur pikpamjet e mia lidhur me kontributin domethns t t dy programeve. Megjithat, un besoj se BE mund t luaj rol m t madh si ankor e jashtme. Udhzuesi i BE-s i referohet buxhetit ose gjendjes s borxhit n do periudh kohore. Kshtu q, nse sht kriter kushtetues q, politikat aktuale n rrethana normale duhet t ln hapsir pr ndrhyrje urgjente fiskale, ather kjo nuk e shkel kufirin. Kriza e fundit tregoi se PEF dhe PPE jan disi t ngurta dhe mund t mos funksionojn si duhet n kushtet e stresit ekonomik. Disa prej qllimeve kryesore mund t jen zhvillimi i skenarve m t besueshm baz t rrezikut pr ekonomin dhe financat publike; dhe krijimi i hapsirs s duhur fiskale pr t trajtuar goditjet e pavolitshme. Kshtu do t ishte e kshillueshme q BE ti krkonte t gjith vendeve aspirues t rajonit t kishin nj marrveshje funksionale me FMN gjat gjith procesit pr antarsim n BE https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_z_Ardian_Fullani_ne_Tr 5/7 06/08/2022, 09:18 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Ardian Fullani, n Tryezn e Dialogut t Nivelit t Lart Rajonal, me tem  rajonit t kishin nj marrveshje funksionale me FMN gjat gjith procesit pr antarsim n BE. Kjo jo vetm pr t kontrolluar, por dhe pr t garantuar ndrhyrje t menjhershme n rast krizash; dhe reforma m t mira strukturore integruese duke prfshir miratimin e acquis communitares. Do t jet mjaft optimiste t pritej q ekonomit e vendeve aspiruese t rajonit t mund rezistojn aq gjat sa rezistoi dhe Greqia, ndrsa BE analizon opsionet. Mbi t gjitha, sipas marrveshjeve t fundit ligjore, BE nuk ka ose nuk merr asnj prgjegjsi pr zgjidhjen e krizave t mundshme n vendet tona. N kt kndvshtrim, BE e vetme, me vshtirsi etiketohet si nj ankore e politiks s jashtme dhe institucion mbikqyrs bashk me rolet e tjera politike ligjore dhe institucionale. Ndrsa kjo prmbledh pak a shum n prgjithsi mendimin tim (t shprehur vitin q shkoi), do t dshiroja t shtoja disa pika lidhur me kt diskutim. Aspekti m i rndsishm i ktyre dy marrveshjeve sht se ato jan njjta pr t gjith vendet dhe pr rrjedhoj nuk kan rndsi pr nevoja apo situate t veanta t vendit. Rregullat fiskale q po trajtojm sot mund dhe kan nevoj t jen t ndryshme pr vende t ndryshme, t hartuara sipas nevojave specifike t vendit, bazuar ne nevojat ekonomike individuale dhe prparsit n reformat strukturore. N fakt t gjith ktyre nevojave specifike i sht kushtuar vmendje e detajuar sipas programeve t FMN. Standardet strukturore t ktyre programeve kan luajtur rol t ngjashm si rregulla fiskale, megjithse ato kan qen t ndryshm n vende t ndryshme dhe periudha t ndryshme. N kt kuadr ato kan lejuar rregullime t prkohshme, pa prfshir qndrueshmrin afatgjat t balancave makro-fiskale. Vendet tona gjithashtu kan fituar prvoj t konsiderueshme n negocimin dhe zbatimin e marrveshjeve t tilla. N munges t ktyre marrveshjeve, vendet nuk mund t prdorin kt prvoj t mbledhur, thjesht sepse pala tjetr n marrveshjen e re nuk ndjek t njjtin marrveshje si FMN. Kshtu q mund t jet nj zgjidhje e prgjegjshme dhe e zgjuar pr t gjitha vendet aspirate, prfshir antart e rinj gjat procesit t integrimit n BE, derisa t arrihet prafrimi i plot ekonomik, se kuadri makrofiskal duhet t hartohet dhe zbatohet sipas nj marrveshjeje tre paleshe prkatsisht midis:Vendit, Komisionit Evropian dhe FMN. Mendoj se kjo t ti shrbej t dyve bashk si vendit ashtu dhe BE. Ata t dy fitojn prvoj nga FMN n fushn e harmonizimit t politikave, ndrtimit t kapaciteteve dhe zbatimit t politikave ekonomike. Megjithse tani pjesa m e madhe e vendeve t rajonit cilsohen si ekonomi tregu n zhvillim, ne duhet t mbajm parasysh se, sipas urtsis ekonomike, kufiri midis tregut n tranzicion dhe atij n zhvillim sht shum i holl. Progresi drejt ekonomi tregu n zhvillim mbart prgjegjsi m t mdha dhe me shum prekshmri. Dalja nga tranzicioni nuk nnkupton fundin e problemeve ekonomike, ose nuk siguron automatikisht besim n tregje. Title: Speech held at the reception organized by the Albanian Banking Association on the occasion of the closing of 2010
text: Word of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Ardian Fullani, at the regional meeting in the city of Kumanovo, 30 September 2010 29/07/22, 14:57 Word of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Ardian Fullani, at the regional meeting in the city of Kumanovo, 30 September 2010 Publication date: 05.10.2010 Honored participants, It is a special privilege to be in the city of Kumanovo again. Through this communication today with representatives of your county's business community, I would like to return to some of the arguments pertaining to the growth model. Initially, I want to stress that this discussion will not stop at philosophical considerations of the political economy. More simply, the discussion is not intended to address the theoretical thesis of nature: market economy or centralized economy. This is a choice already made and we have no hesitation or doubt that the market economy is the right alternative. Likewise, it is not about discussing the role of the state in the economy, about its size, about the structure of the tax system or government spending. Of course, the debate about the role of the state is an extremely important argument, especially if we look at it from the perspective of business cycle theory, when analyzing the philosophy, role and measure of government intervention, to correct short-term fluctuations in the economy or the redistribution of the income it generates. In my statements on this argument, I have always started and wanted to discuss the role of the state in the economy from the perspective of long-term economic growth theory. In practice, these models are known as: the Asian model, through the rapid growth of exports or the Irish model through the rapid promotion and growth of technology.  ani_ne_takim_rajonal_ne_qytetin_e_Gjirokastres_30_shtator_2010.html Page 1 of 6 Word of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Ardian Fullani, at the regional meeting in the city of Kumanovo, 30 September 2010 29/07/22, 14:57 In this case, the entire state superstructure is built to support the transformation of the economy (legal, economic, manufacturing, academic and pedagogical structure, even the nature of foreign policy) in accordance with the major strategic development plan. To illustrate the concept of the above more simply, let everyone ask themselves for a moment: What is my picture of the scale of the country's economic and financial development in the next 30 years? What will be the distinctive characteristics of our economy during this period? What model will we stick to in this long process of successive changes and adaptations? How will the legal basis be adopted? What about the structure of the economy in whose favor will it change? Will there be a special role for academic life, scientific thought? This is the debate we want to promote. Recognising expected structural developments and reforms for the economy is a necessity for us and for our policies, so that they support the development tendencies of the economy, with the aim of ensuring the country's macroeconomic and financial stability. It is difficult for a single institution, in a single word, to draw up this whole strategy. Furthermore, it is wrong, because as I said above this debate is the property of society, which must have a proactive role in both its design and implementation. I think that in addition to the general discussion, these are the topics where I see it appropriately to focus discussion on the new growth model. The country's economic activity in the past 20 years has defined a relatively long period of co-operation agreements with the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank, ranging from support with payment balance deficit funds, continuing with stabilisation and poverty reduction programmes, to reach even the most liberal agreements in trade terms in recent years. The low per capita income, the large imbalances we inherited, caused large currency funds to enter the form of aid or soft loans. This was also accompanied by the uninterrupted increase in currency flows from immigration and the privatisation process. As a result, with the stabilization of basic parameters, conditions were gradually created for a rapid increase in trade activity with the world, especially as far as imports are concerned. A major impetus was also the consolidation of the banking system, which significantly increased the lending of the economy in recent years. Domestic consumption recognized uninterrupted growth. The lack of sufficient internal production capacities led to the continued deepening of the crust account from one year to the next. This was more or less the model that dominated the country's economic development over the past 20 years, a model that spread throughout the formerly communist European countries and was known by its name process of fast approximation (catching-up process). The latest crisis interrupted this mechanism of debt-indebted consumer financing. It is a fact that this crisis ended the financial abundance and the desire of investors to accept risk. In other words, the thrusters of developed countries and developing economies have no desire to  ani_ne_takim_rajonal_ne_qytetin_e_Gjirokastres_30_shtator_2010.html Page 2 of 6 Word of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Ardian Fullani, at the regional meeting in the city of Kumanovo, 30 September 2010 29/07/22, 14:57 make their funds available to consumers, for the latter to increase production, buying apartments, machinery, making holidays abroad or buying other consumer goods. Today, the transition of these countries from transitional economies to the developing economy requires further deepening structural reforms and implementing new models of economic growth. We must all understand that economic growth, based on credit-driven consumption, has left negative consequences for the economy. The current level of debt, which we have accumulated with this model, is relatively high. It is visible in the high trade deficits and crusts that we have accumulated during these 20 years. In recent years, our deficits to the world are at a record high of about 14% of the country's total gross production. Put simply, every year we consume about 14% of the production we will achieve in the future. Various empirical studies argue that to maintain external economic balance, Albania must keep the corent deficit no higher than 5% of gross domestic product. Consequently, efforts to reduce the corent deficit to sustainable long-term levels would affect the growth of domestic production potentials and consequently the structure or model of economic growth in the country. A country's crust account is, according to economic identity, equal to savings minus investments within the country. So, to reduce the corent deficit, Albania must increase savings (or lower consumption) or reduce national investment. Maintaining high rates in making investments is necessary, as they are the basis of economic growth. To this end, it is necessary to orient ourselves towards a new model, which maintains the level of savings in optimal balances. This brings us to another important argument. The financial market infrastructure and instruments offered by it still need both savings promotion and investment financing. Current instruments, in the form of deposits and investments in government value letters, are short-term, with maturity deadlines of up to five years. Consequently, they do not encourage the individual to equalise, to weigh the value of consumption today, versus consumption in the future. Unlike our economy, the savings structure in developed economies is markedly in favour of long-term investments, mainly in the form of retirement funds, instruments that provide the right incentives to increase long-term savings, which supports the new model of economic growth. For this reason, I have sometimes highlighted the need for a pension reform. Such topics on the role of capital and other production factors have been widely addressed by economic growth theories, so we can say the same about the large role that the earth has as the main and most limited manufacturing factor. What prevents this important factor from giving the same production as in developed economies or at least as in the region's economies? At this point I do not want to stop and repeat myself, given that land use will also depend on the specific objectives we will set for our economy for the next 30 years. I want to continue discussing the new theory of economic growth further. This theory determines that  ani_ne_takim_rajonal_ne_qytetin_e_Gjirokastres_30_shtator_2010.html Page 3 of 6 Word of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Ardian Fullani, at the regional meeting in the city of Kumanovo, 30 September 2010 29/07/22, 14:57 The ability of an economy to grow is determined much by its ability to be competitive and produce, or to adapt quickly and effectively to new manufacturing technologies. These theories value the competitiveness of the economy by its ability to generate scientific innovation and the ability to increase productivity in production, through free manpower. Thus, competitiveness is not the attribute of the monetary values that a country possesses, but of the ability of the workforce to increase the productivity of the work, faster than its cost. These theories highlight the great importance that human capital and technology have for economic growth. Without wanting to determine the nature and direction education and education must take to have a competitive workforce in the 21st century (this should be part of the debate I mentioned at the beginning), I want to attract attention and promote discussion in two main aspects: the nature of current education and market instruments for intellectual property. First, our education strategies from a demand perspective are generally based on appropriate expectations or as they are known in literature in adaptive expectations and not on the rational expectations of individuals. Simply put, the selection of a high or high school is carried out by looking to the past and not from the future. It is enough to remember that over the last 10 years the labour market has generated jobs in the banking system, the construction sector, or provided high incomes in the jurisprudence sector. We have many lawyers, economists, construction engineers and architects. Based on the latest INSTAT figures, even during 2008, the most preferred branches for university studies remained economic (17%), law (6.4%), pharmacy, construction engineering, as well as political science, which make up approximately 42% of graduate students. Branches that for years have been highly sought after, causing a market overflow with such specialists. While in terms of branches of the economy, such as engineering in the branches of the mechanical industry, metallurgy, mining engineering, industrial chemistry, mathematics and physics, the number of graduate students has decreased greatly compared to the past 10 years, making up only 5% of graduate students during 2008. One of the problems that the current economic growth model has is that this contingency will face an economic structure that will not be able to include these specialists in the future. Despite successful education reforms (reflected in the number of individuals participating in basic and secondary education), participation in higher education is still low, only 28%. This figure is still far from that of the countries where we should converge, on average over 50%, (Italy 67%, Greece 95%, Czechia 50%). I think that even the denomination of higher education should better adapt to the needs and ambitions of the country's economic and social development in the future. A similar situation can be observed in secondary education. In the early 1990s, about 50% of high school students attended vocational schools, While during 2009 only 16% of students specialize in a given profession. Creating such a gap between market needs and the creation of human capital, generally specializing as technicin, does not constitute a choice  ani_ne_takim_rajonal_ne_qytetin_e_Gjirokastres_30_shtator_2010.html Page 4 of 6 Word of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Ardian Fullani, at the regional meeting in the city of Kumanovo, 30 September 2010 29/07/22, 14:57 optimal for long-term development. As long as we do not have a discussion on the priorities and branches that should be favoured in the development of the country, it is impossible to adapt a rational trend of demand for education. The labour market, with its data, provides the necessary food for a sound decision-making of monetary policy and economic policies in general. It must play an important role in determining the curricula of study in our education system, not only from the perspective of participation reports (capacities) of current programmes and texts, but also from the perspective of the academic framework and material basis for the exercise of academic knowledge. How do these programmes and participation in them match, in relation to the long-term or short-term objectives of developing Albanian businesses? How much role do Albanian businesses play in financing these programmes? These are very important topics to discuss under the economic growth model. Generally on the Albanian market it is difficult to identify whether those financial and social instruments exist, which would enable this co-operation between education and business. As a conclusion, it can be said that the development of human capacities in our case is a random phenomenon, with a look at the past, which is not necessarily worth its future and model. Relevant forums and institutions should be an important part of discussions about the growth model. An important element in the design of the new economic model, to which our academic, business and state systems need to direct attention, is intellectual property and its support mechanisms. Intellectual property, as an important component of technology development, takes a dual role in a country's economic development. It turns not only into a powerful supporter of economic growth, but by promoting technology, even in the object of economic development. Finally, I want to stop in terms of the global growth model. In today's global economy the definition of competitive standards and products is part of the world game. If you look at the development plans of the economies of the region around us, they look more like competition among countries than regional co-operation, which will enable the creation of a common market, because of the similar nature of the region's economies. The country's new economic model should also redefine Albania's role in the region. The Albanian economy must be restructured, to find its place in the worldwide economy. This restructuring also includes its resizing in the region, in order for the balkan countries' economic development policies to be colinear. All these issues lead to a question: What prevents the Albanian economy from creating the institutions that should debate these important issues? What steps should we take to make them controversial? How can we promote the creation of these institutions and their credibility?  ani_ne_takim_rajonal_ne_qytetin_e_Gjirokastres_30_shtator_2010.html Page 5 of 6 Word of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Ardian Fullani, at the regional meeting in the city of Kumanovo, 30 September 2010 29/07/22, 14:57 These are generally the issues where I wanted to direct the future of the debate on economic growth. IT of the Bank of Albania twinning project, March 23, 2011 29/07/22, 14:57 Mr Ardian Fullani at the ceremony of the launch of the twinning project of the Bank of Albania Albania, March 23, 2011 Publication date: 23.03.2011 Ladies and gentlemen, honourable friends, it is a pleasure to be here with you today at the ceremony of the launch of this important project. This event is exciting for me and many colleagues among us, because today we see a proposal coming to life, an excellent idea which I am convinced that within the following months it will turn into a useful and very successful product. In my first speech to the public, about 7 years ago, I stressed that: the Bank of Albania sees in the European Central Bank the institution which represents not only the model of organisation and action towards which we intend to approach rapidly, but also the possibility of concrete co-operation in particular directions of the functioning of the Bank of Albania as well as the strategic objectives of the country's economy. From this point of view I gladly state that this simple ceremony we are holding today is a testimony of: fulfilling this ambition at the beginning of my term; maturity of our institution; rapid approximation with the standards of the European central bank system; increasing public confidence in it and improving image on the international stage;  projektit_te_binjakezimit_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_23_mars_2011.html Page 1 of 3 Mr Ardian Fullani in the cer... IT of the Bank of Albania twinning project, March 23, 2011 29/07/22, 14:57 I am convinced that the twinning project we have gathered for here today will further strengthen co-operation and communication not only in the professional sphere but also in the personal one among our institutions, an element in which I believe greatly. We live in a global society in which developments in the banking and financial world walk with alarming steps and therefore central banks must have internal, strong and reliable mechanisms of coordination and communication that can prepare our institutions to face these situations. In this context, even the twinning project is a major element that will assist our Bank in this process, but not only. Carefully analyzing the overall objective of this project we note that it focuses on assisting the Bank of Albania in meeting the economic criteria within our country's EU integration, thus contributing to improved labour practices in the areas of banking supervision, statistics, payment systems, interbank market, co-ordination of the EU integration process and financial education. I also stress that this twinning project aims, among other things, at approximating our institution's standards with those of the European Central Banks System (SEBQ) as well as ensuring an approximation of our Bank's legal and regulatory framework with acquis communautaire affecting the banking and financial field. A proverb says: When you plan for a year, you plant corn. When you plan for a decade, you plant wood. When you plan for a lifetime, train and educate people. This is a philosophy that is still being embodied today through this twinning project which, in addition to helping to develop the aforementioned fields, will also help raise awareness of the need to obtain information and further training of our institution's staff in the respective fields. Harmonizing the tasks and standards of our work with those of the European Union is one of the priorities of the Association Stabilisation Agreement, and also our institution as an essential part of this process of national importance. In this case I want to express my gratitude for the excellent co-operation we have had with Banca d'Italia and banque de France during the preparation phases as well as the implementation of the first phase of the twinning project. I also express my thanks to the European Union Delegation for the continued assistance and care shown throughout the performance of the twinning project, and express my deep conviction that these are only the first steps of closer co-operation between our institutions. I welcome your efforts and hope that the successful implementation of this project will serve as an example for all of us to be more involved in initiatives of this kind. I am closing the word by being convinced that this project and this co-operation are the cornerstones for a better future, and an important step towards the European integration of our institution. Let us build on our hopes and above all accept our responsibilities. Let this be our European future.  rojektit_te_binjakezimit_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_23_mars_2011.html Page 2 of 3 Mr Ardian Fullani in the cer... Me kt rast dua t shpreh mirnjohjen time pr bashkpunimin e shklqyer q kemi pasur me Banca d'Italia dhe Banque de France gjat fazave t prgatitjes si dhe implementimit t fazs s par projektit t binjakzimit. Po e mbyll fjaln duke qen i bindur se ky projekt e ky bashkpunim jan gurt e themelit pr nj t ardhme m t mir, e nj hap i rndsishm drejt integrimit evropian t institucionit ton. Muz and Eduk " Head / Press / Speeches, interviews, articles / Speeches Press releases Notices of # meetings of Council Supervisor Press conference Speeches, interview articles Speeches Interview of articles Calendars # Official holiday calendar for 2022 COVID-19 Europe # BANK OF ALBANIA ANNOUNCEMENT Bank of Albania projects within the framework of infrastructural expansion with new environments Publication date: 28.03.2011 This heavy lady who has been sitting in Skenderbej Square for years has maintained her values, embodying the strength of the state and the market. It conveys to the public, the important message, that the bank protects and manages our national wealth. Its mission naturally materializes even in the new project, whose soul is continuity, the path to the standards of time and the model of European central banks. Ardian Fullani Governor of the Bank of Albania The Bank of Albania is the central bank of the Albanian State. After a long history of economic-political-social developments starting in 1913, it comes today as a modern, solid and reliable central bank with added, expanded and consolidated functions. Its main objective is to preserve price stability, thus contributing to our economic development and well-being. In addition to this objective, the Bank of Albania also has many other objectives and functions, all of which together can be translated into one: preserving the country's macroeconomic stability.  ise_ne_kuader_te_zgjerimit_infrastrukturor_me_ambiente_te_reja.html Page 1 of 6 Bank of Albania projects within the framework of infrastructural expansion with new environments 29/07/22, 14:57 Its central building is located in the centre of Skenderbej Square, dinitely representing one of our country's most important administrative institutions, the central bank, in the quality of single monetary authority as well as supervisor. Built about 70 years ago, this building stands as a Artwork, and is protected by the state as part of the centre of the capital, declared the Monument Kulture Ensemble. Work on the construction of the National Bank of Albania building, the name by which it was known in those years, began in February 1937, while its inauguration ceremony took place on 30 October 1938. It was designed by Prof. Vittorio Morpurgo Ballio, one of the most famous Italian architects of the time. This building constitutes one of his masterpieces. Its architectural style belongs to the current of rationalism, a current that flourished in the first half of the 19th century in Europe. From an urban point of view, the composition of the Building of Morpurgo is oriented towards three main streets of the city, the Street of Kumanovo (the axis of the road matches the main axis of the building), the Street of The Struga and the boulevard of the city. Placing it in this position makes it possible for its elegant forms to be conceived from far distances of the Way of Kumanovo. The architectural values of this building are of particular importance in cultural terms, as a prominent representative of the current of rationalism, which in addition has other representatives in Albania. Solid and heavy at first glance, the building is surrounded by an original warmth, which comes from the reddish color of the facade and the softened shape of the semicircle. Its main entrance with extremely high giant columns finds a complete harmony with the ceramics with which it is decorated. The perfect fusion of the material and color that has been used there wear this building with a monumental character. Its grandeur, artistic elements, terracotta-clad facade, basorelieves on the main facade and in particular the mosaic in the main hall of the building give extraordinary importance to this work. In the low reliefs of the main entrance of the bank building are carved precious figures, works by the famous Italian sculptor Alfredo Biagini, which symbolize the sources of the life and wealth of the nation. They break the height of the walls and the figures engraved there adapt to those of the interior hall of the public, which are the work of the Italian painter Giulio Roso. The architectural elements of the facades and the interiers, as elements of the windows, doors and decorations in themselves simple, but that in the general line of the building, remain in full unity. The Bank of Albania building was completed in 1938 and met the requirements of the time. While, in the forties, architect Morpurgo drafted another project, which envisioned the construction of other buildings that suited the architectural line of the current building. Their construction would complement the Bank of Albania complex. But this project remained on paper without being able to be realized. For more than 70 years this building has housed many of the country's most important financial institutions, such as the State Bank, the Ministry of Finance or  ise_ne_kuader_te_zgjerimit_infrastrukturor_me_ambiente_te_reja.html Page 2 of 6 Bank of Albania projects within the framework of infrastructural expansion with new environments 29/07/22, 14:57 and as a B.K.T. subsidiary for the city of Tirana. During these years until the current project, no initiative has been undertaken for this building for simple or complete reconstructions to restore it to its original state. There have been attempts at reconstruction projects, but it has not been possible to carry out. Meanwhile, there have been simple maintenance, which are seen as necessary not to let the building degrade, until the realization of the full reconstruction intervention project began. Thus, after more than 70 years the building remained the same, while the Bank of Albania developed as time grew, the building where it exercised activity unfortunately continued to be that of 70 years ago. A building with unique architecture, with perfect location but from the perspective of working spaces and functionalities was left behind with the time. As part of its development strategy, the Bank of Albania's activity expands day-to-day and constantly qualifies. As a result, the building could not meet even the most minimal requirements: accommodation in the working environments of its employees, not to say that for other activities of primary, representative and auxiliary nature, such as meeting halls, conferences, library, museum, as well as other environments of social nature, it could not even be said. Therefore, the necessity of building reconstruction and restoration was born as the realization of the main requirement for increasing the functionality of the environments in aid of the activities of the Bank of Albania, which also relied on another principle, that of returning to the originality of the existing building. For this reason, Morpurgo's idea was used: to build an addition to the southern and western wings of the courtyard, of a new building or complex, whose height should be the size of the existing building. This request from the Bank of Albania, found support and in the regulatory plan of the city centre of Tirana. In this context, the Bank of Albania decided by special procedure to organize an international competition for the selection of the best draft idea. Given the importance this project presented, as well as to guarantee the competition and participation of the most prestigious subjects in this area, the Bank of Albania published the announcement of the development of the international competition for the selection of the best draft idea in the prestigious newspaper "Financial Times" and in the local press. The announcement was also communicated to foreign embassies, professional associations, as well as published on the official website of the Bank of Albania. After these publications, they showed interest in participating in the competition 27 foreign design studios and designers, of which 17 of them presented the respective documentation. The competition took place in three phases, where in the first phase the legal qualification of mandatory documentation for submission by the competitors was verified. In the second phase, through an international jury of renowned, foreign and local experts, the technical assessment was carried out, maintaining until this stage the secrecy of the identity of 8 (eight)  ise_ne_kuader_te_zgjerimit_infrastrukturor_me_ambiente_te_reja.html Page 3 of 6 Bank of Albania projects within the framework of infrastructural expansion with new environments 29/07/22, 14:57 competitors who passed the legal qualification phase. At the conclusion of the assessment, the jury listed draft ideas on a summary list according to the number of points won by each competitor and decided on qualification in the third phase of 3 (three) draft ideas, which earned the highest number of points. The winning project, which has already begun implementation in practice, was carried out by Italian architect Marco Petreschi. Architect Petreschi holds the title of professor and is Chief of the Architecture Cathedral at La Sapienza University in Rome. Architect Petreschi, in addition to his architectural creativity, is also a deep connoisseur of the culture and tradition of Italian architecture of the era of rationalism, when the Morpurgo project was carried out. The primary goal of this project is to return to the original state (original project) of the building. Any changes, additions or interventions made from 1938 to the present will be eliminated. During the process of building reconstruction, the various architectural elements (doors, windows, various refinements) will be updated, with restorations or even replacements, which will belong to the same material, shape, technology, etc.. Respecting the architectural values this building presents has been the Bank of Albania's main demand for the winning project. Consequently, artistic elements, such as basorelieves and mosaics, will be restored under the supervision of specialists of the Institute of Cultural Monuments in Tirana and Italian specialists. The methods, restoration ways and technologies to be used are envisaged in the respective project, for each element in particular. In the new project, it is envisaged that in accordance with the philosophy of the Bank of Albania, in addition to meeting administrative requirements, the requirement for fuller and transparent relations with the public will also be met. In this context, it is envisaged that in this building, the Bank of Albania will have the museum of numismatics and history of financial and banking activity of Albania. In this way, the rich collection of coins and banknotes issued from antiquity until now will be open to the public. The rapid quantitative and qualitative developments that have accompanied the bank of Albania's activity have caused the requirements for construction spaces to exercise its day-to-day activity to increase continuously. The exercise of many of the unique functions of representation, increasing functional requirements, numerous commitments of the Bank of Albania in international activities, necessary requirements in technollogical information, and a number of other reasons dictated the need for other additional environments. Under these conditions, the purchase of the building of the former Dajti Hotel constitutes one of the strategic movements of the Bank of Albania, for a long-term and dainty solution, in securing new environments, which will further complement the infrastructure that the central building offers. This is a move that will affect the Approximation of the Bank of Albania with the European Central Bank. After this purchase it can be said that the Bank of Albania already owns two of the buildings with the prominent centre of the Albanian Capital, Tirana. It is her task already that within a time the sooner she returns both buildings to the former brilliance by making them precious parts of Tirana's cultural and architectural heritage.  ise_ne_kuader_te_zgjerimit_infrastrukturor_me_ambiente_te_reja.html Page 4 of 6 Bank of Albania projects within the framework of infrastructural expansion with new environments 29/07/22, 14:57 Built around the 1930s, by Gherardo Bosio, a Fiorentina architect of the 20th century school of rationalism, and designed in detail by Gio Ponti, considered As the father of modern European design, he splits over a very short distance with the central building of the Bank of Albania. With its large surface area and physical location, the building meets the Bank of Albania's requirements for the expansion of the structure, as well as will best help its commitment to be transparent, open and as close to the public as possible. From a historical point of view, the Dajti Hotel for the citizens of Tirana has been one of the most prominent and simultaneously coveted works. The hotel's elegance, equipment and furniture were of a particular level, in line with its rank. While, regionally, this building has long been praised as the most modern Balkan hotel. The Bank of Albania, in the context of the restoration of the building, has drawn up plans for the operation of the building in the service of its activity. Despite the destruction it has suffered during these years, these projects envision the return of the building in all its aspects to its original state, the resurrection of this object and the return of the former brightness. It is worth pointing out that the restoration will be carried out in accordance with the initial ideas of architect Bosio, but of course in the conditions of the new century, without forgetting the green environment around it. This building with its very rich library will be a window of direct contact with the public especially the most demanding, academic, student and media. Instead of closure The Bank of Albania is a modern central bank, with a series of functions that are fulfilled on time and quality affect the well-being of all Albanians. Like any inidivid, she carries within herself the aspiration to be up to her friends, which can only be met with a high standard of infrastructure and technology. Functional convenience is not only a desire to serve its employees, but a necessity of time, which over the years will translate into further increases in the professionalism and credibility of the Bank of Albania. With the completion of investments in these two objects, the Bank of Albania expresses the belief that its institutional model will be even closer to that of Europe's central bank system. On the other hand, it will be an extraordinary contribution to preserving and highlighting the cultural heritage of the city of Tirana as well as in the quality promotion of the country's educational-scientific activity in the field of central banking and finance.  ise_ne_kuader_te_zgjerimit_infrastrukturor_me_ambiente_te_reja.html Page 5 of 6 Bank of Albania projects within the framework of infrastructural expansion with new environments 29/07/22, 14:57  ise_ne_kuader_te_zgjerimit_infrastrukturor_me_ambiente_te_reja.html Page 6 of 6

Vlerat arkitektonike t ksaj ndrtese jan t nj rndsie t veant n aspektin kulturor, si nj prfaqsuese e spikatur e rryms s racionalizmit , e cila prve ksaj ndrtese ka edhe prfaqsuese t tjera n Shqipri. Solide dhe e rnd n pamjen e par, godina rrethohet nga nj ngrohtsi origjinale, e cila buron nga ngjyra e kuqrremt e fasads dhe forma e zbutur e gjysmrrethit. Hyrja e saj kryesore me kolonat gjigande tepr t larta gjen nj harmoni t plot me qeramikn me t ciln sht dekoruar. Shkrirja perfekte e materialit dhe ngjyrs q sht prdorur aty, e veshin kt godin me nj karakter monumental. Madhshtia, elementet artistike t saj, fasada e veshur me terrakot, basorelievet n fasadn kryesore dhe n veanti mozaiku n hollin kryesor t ndrtess i japin nj rndsi t jashtzakonshme ksaj vepre. N relievet e ulta t hyrjes kryesore t godins s banks jan gdhendur figura t muara, vepra t skulptorit t famshm italian Alfredo Biagini, t cilat simbolizojn burimet e jets e t pasuris s kombit. Ato thyejn lartsin e mureve dhe figurat e gdhendura aty prshtaten me ato t salls s brendshme t publikut, t cilat jan vepr e piktorit italian Giulio Roso. Elementet arkitektonik t fasadave dhe t interierve, si element t dritareve, dyerve dhe dekoracioneve n vetvete t thjeshta, por q n linjn e prgjithshme t ndrtess, qndrojn n unitet t plot. Godina e Banks s Shqipris prfundoi s ndrtuari n vitin 1938 dhe plotsonte krkesat e kohs. Ndrsa, n vitet dyzet, arkitekti Morpurgo hartoi nj tjetr projekt, i cili parashikonte ndrtimin e godinave t tjera q i prshtateshin linjs arkitektonike t ndrtess aktuale. Ndrtimi i tyre do t plotsonte kompleksin e Banks s Shqipris. Por, ky projekt mbeti n letr pa mundur t realizohet. Ka patur tentativa pr projekte rikonstruksioni, por nuk sht mundur t realizohen. Kshtu, pas m shum se 70 vjetsh godina mbeti po ajo, Ndrkoh q Banka e Shqipris zhvillohej me rritmin e kohs, godina ku ajo ushtron aktivitetin pr fat t keq vazhdonte t ishte ajo e 70 viteve m par. N kuadr t strategjis s saj s zhvillimit, aktiviteti i Banks s Shqipris zgjerohet dita-dits dhe kualifikohet vazhdimisht. Si rrjedhim, ndrtesa nuk mund t plotsonte edhe krkesat m minimale: akomodimin n ambiente pune t punonjsve t saj, pr t mos thn q pr aktivitete t tjera t natyrs parsore, prfaqsuese dhe ndihmse, si salla mbledhjejesh, konferencash, bibliotek, muze si dhe ambiente t tjera t natyrs sociale as nuk mund t bhej fjal. Pr kt arsye, u shfrytzua ideja e Morpurgos: t ndrtohej nj shtes n kraht jugor dhe perndimor t oborrit, t nj ndrtese ose t nj kompleksi t ri, lartsia e t cilit duhet t ishte sa ajo e ndrtess ekzistuese. Kjo krkes e Banks s Shqipris, gjeti mbshtetje dhe n planin rregullues t qendrs s qytetit t Tirans. N kt kuadr, Banka e Shqipris vendosi me procedur t veant organizimin e nj konkursi ndrkombtar pr przgjedhjen e projekt-ides m t mir. Projekti fitues, i cili tashm ka filluar zbatimin edhe n praktik, sht realizuar nga arkitekti italian Marco Petreschi. Arkitekt Petreschi, mban titullin profesor dhe sht Shef i Katedrs s Arkitekturs n Universitetin La Sapienza t Roms. Arkitekt Petreschi, prve krijimtaris s tij arkitekturore, sht edhe nj njohs i thell i kulturs dhe tradits s arkitekturs italiane t epoks s racionalizmit, kur sht realizuar projekti i Morpurgos. Respektimi i vlerave arkitektonike q paraqet kjo ndrtes ka qen krkesa kryesore e Banks s Shqipris ndaj projektit fitues. Pr rrjedhoj, elementt artistik, si basorelievet dhe mozaikt, do t restaurohen nn mbikqyrjen e specialistve t Institutit t Monumenteve t Kulturs n Tiran dhe t specialistve italian. N projektin e ri, parashikohet q n prputhje me filozofin e Banks s Shqipris, prve plotsimit t krkesave administrative t plotsohet edhe krkesa pr marrdhnie m t plota dhe transparente me publikun. N kt kuadr, sht parashikuar q n kt ndrtes, Banka e Shqipris do t ket muzeun e numizmatiks dhe t historis s aktivitetit financiar dhe bankar t Shqipris. N kt mnyr, koleksioni i pasur i monedhave dhe kartmonedhave t emetuara q nga antikiteti e deri m tani do t jet i hapur pr publikun. Zhvillimet e vrullshme sasiore dhe cilsore q kan shoqruar aktivitetin e Banks s Shqipris kan br q krkesat pr hapsira ndrtimore pr t ushtruar aktivitetin e saj ditor t rriten n vazhdimsi. Ushtrimi i shum prej funksioneve unike t prfaqsimit, krkesat funksionale gjithnj e n rritje, angazhimet e shumta t Banks s Shqipris n aktivitetet ndrkombtare, krkesat e domosdoshme ne teknollogjike e informacionit, dhe nj sr arsyesh t tjera diktonin nevojn pr ambiente t tjera shtes. N kto kushte, blerja e godins s ish - Hotel Dajtit, prbn nj nga lvizjet strategjike t Banks s Shqipris, pr nj zgjidhje afat gjat t dhe dinjitoze, n sigurimin e ambienteve t reja, t cilat do plotsojn m tej infrastrukturn q ofron godina qendrore. Kjo sht nj lvizje q do t ndikoj n prafrimin e Banks s Shqipris me Bankn Qendrore Evropiane. Nga kndvshtrimi historik, hotel Dajti pr qytetart e Tirans ka qen nj nga veprat m t spikatura dhe njkohesisht m t lakmuara. Eleganca, pajimet dhe mobilimet e hotelit ishin t nj niveli t veant, n prputhje me rangun e tij. Ndrsa, n planin rajonal, kjo ndrtes sht vlersuar pr shum koh si hoteli m modern i Ballkanit. Pavarsisht shkatrrimit q ka psuar gjat ktyre viteve, kto projekte parashikojn rikthimin e ndrtess n t gjith aspektet e saj n gjendjen fillestare, ringjalljen e ktij objekti dhe kthimin e shklqimit t dikurshm. Kjo godin me bibliotekn shum t pasur t saj do t jet nj dritare e kontaktit t drejtprdrejt me publikun veanrisht m krkuesit, akademikt, studentt dhe median. Ashtu si do inidivid, edhe ajo mbart brenda vetes aspiratn pr t qen n lartsin e shoqeve t saj, e cila mund t prmbushet vetm me nj standard t lart infrastrukture dhe teknologjie. Komoditeti funksional nuk sht vetm nj dshir pr tju ardhur n shrbim punonjsve t saj, por nj domosdoshmri e kohs, e cila me kalimin e viteve do t prkthet n rritje t mtejshme t profesionalizmit dhe besueshmris s Banks s Shqipris. text: On the development of the 24th conference of the group of banking supervisors of central and eastern European countries 29/07/22, 14:56 On the development of the 24th conference of the group of banking supervisors of central and eastern European countries Publication date: 19.04.2011 On 12-13 April 2011, the 24th International Conference of the Group of Banking Supervisors of Central and Eastern European Countries (BSCEE) took place in Tirana. The Central and Eastern European Banking Supervisors Group was established in 1991 and today it recognises as members the banking supervisory authorities of 21 countries in this region. On general lines, this group serves: as a platform of co-operation between the banking supervision authorities of member states; as an opportunity to exchange experiences in the field of supervision; as a high-level discussion forum on current and technical issues. The group's leadership - which changes every year - for the first time in many years was entrusted to Albania, thus charging our country with responsibility for the administrative and technical organisation of its 24th annual conference. Albania has been a member of this group since 1996 and is represented through the Bank of Albania, as the country's only banking supervisory authority. In addition to participants from member states, special guests at the conference were also personalities such as: Deputy Secretary General of the Basel Committee for Banking Supervision, Director of Financial Institutions for the Western Balkans BERZH, as well as Director of the Department of Supervision of Banking Groups at the Bank of Italy. The conference, in the role of a high-level technical forum, addressed two topics: The role of the banking system and supervisors in maintaining financial stability, and ... esve_bankare_te_vendeve_te_Evropes_Qendrore_dhe_asaj_Lindore.html Page 1 of 3 On the development of the 24th conference of the group of banking supervisors of central and eastern European countries 29/07/22, 14:56 Basel III: international regulatory standards on the capital sufficiency of financial institutions and liquidity, defined by the Basel Committee for Banking Supervision. The opening word was kept by the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Ardian Fullani, who conducted a summary analysis of economic and financial developments in Albania over the past two years, stopping at issues that require greater attention on the part of the banking industry and supervisory authority in the future. Governor Fullani stressed the importance of the central bank's preventive role, the need for improving macroprudence policies, improving the supervisor's work, increasing accountability in the direction of banking institutions and the importance of the quality of their management structures, as well as careful assessment of any new banking innovation or product. The above positions were in full coherence with the issues that were later raised across the conference as well as with the conclusions reached by the participants. Furthermore, participants with their presentations predicted the developments and positions of representative institutions and at the same time contributed to discussions by giving their opinions and assessments. Discussions noted that despite changes stemming from the variety of banking systems, conditions and individual development, as well as the approach of banking supervision, the findings converged. The recent financial crisis further reinvigorate the role of supervision and the need for improvement in different directions with particular focus banks of systemic importance, stabilisation of bank financing conditions, improved risk management practices, increased confidence in the banking sector, etc. In this line, it was stressed that beyond the role that the supervisory authority carries in maintaining financial stability, it must be taken into account that the supervisor is not only a regulator; As important as an accurate and clear regulatory framework, it is also its implementation. Therefore, primary importance takes on the development of usable and transparent standards and putting them into practice. Despite the particular importance of international supervisory standards as a step in the right direction, they should not be considered a medicine against any problem, especially in Central and Eastern European countries. Periodically conducting the banking sector's resistance (stress test) tests to alleged adverse economic and financial developments was another common point that was brought to attention, as a micro and macroprudence supervisory tool. At the same time, the need for sufficient capital reserves was widely discussed by participants, who also introduced developments of their countries during the crisis and measures taken to cope with the situation. It is worth mentioning that despite improving the liquidity situation in the markets, it remains one of the moments that requires constant attention, both on the part of supervisors and by the main actors of the banking system. Basel III's philosophy is to make banks more resilient to mitigate the kinds of economic shocks encountered recently, which has also been the impetus to introduce reforms as micro, ... esve_bankare_te_vendeve_te_Evropes_Qendrore_dhe_asaj_Lindore.html Page 2 of 3 On the development of the 24th conference of the group of banking supervisors of central and eastern European countries 29/07/22, 14:56 So is macroprudence. However, no matter how high, it was concluded that liquidity and capital management should remain at national levels and furthermore, liquidity supervisory requirements should be considered as minimum requirements and not as recommended liquidity management tools at the bank. In conclusion, the conclusions of this conference are summed up as follows: Following the process of revitalizing lending, as a development that supports not only customers and banks, but also the economy of participating countries itself, within the framework of sound and safe banking activity; The intended improvement of the quality of the loan, where the conduct of determined and timely actions for the execution of collateral guarantees and other forms of collateral for maximum value recovery, as well as co-operation with customers facing temporary difficulties, is considered essential, under conditions where lending activity is expected to continue to face a challenging environment; The banking system's embrace of a culture based on the best values of ethics, service and integrity, as the primary objective of management structures, which would lead to increased accountability in the direction of banking institutions; Avoiding large concentrations as well as dependence on short-term financial funds with priority adopting careful risk management practices; Increasing the role of the central bank, within the framework of macroprudence surveillance policies, especially as far as its preventive role is concerned. Nga diskutimet u vu re se pavarsisht ndryshimeve q rrjedhin nga larmia e sistemeve bankare, kushteve dhe zhvillimit individual si dhe prqasjes s mbikqyrjes bankare, prfundimet konvergonin. Kriza e fundit financiare ravijzoi m tej rolin e mbikqyrjes dhe nevojn pr prmirsim n drejtime t ndryshme me fokus t veant bankat me rndsi sistemike, stabilizimin e kushteve t financimit t bankave, prmirsimin e praktikave t administrimit t rrezikut, rritjen e besimit n sektorin bankar, etj. N kt linj, u theksua se prtej rolit q autoriteti mbikqyrs mbart n ruajtjen e stabilitetit financiar, duhet t kihet parasysh q mbikqyrsi nuk sht vetm rregullator; pasi po aq i rndsishm sa nj kuadr rregullator i sakt dhe i qart, sht edhe zbatimi i tij. Ndaj, rndsi primare merr zhvillimi i standardeve t prdorshme e transparente dhe vnia n praktik e tyre. Pavarsisht rndsis s veant t standardeve ndrkombtare mbikqyrse si nj hap n drejtimin e duhur, ato nuk duhen konsideruar si nj ila kundr do problemi, sidomos n vendet e Evrops Qendrore dhe Lindore. Kryerja n mnyr periodike e testeve t rezistencs (stress test) t sektorit bankar ndaj zhvillimeve ekonomike dhe financiare t pafavorshme t supozuara ishte nj tjetr pik e prbashkt q u soll n vmendje, si nj mjet mbikqyrs mikro dhe makroprudencial. Njkohsisht, nevoja pr rezerva t mjaftueshme kapitali u diskutua gjersisht nga pjesmarrsit, t cilt prezantuan edhe zhvillimet e vendeve t tyre gjat krizs dhe masat e ndrmarra pr prballimin e situats. Vlen t prmendet fakti se pavarsisht prmirsimit t situats s likuiditetit n tregje, ai gjithsesi mbetet nj nga momentet q krkon vmendje t vazhdueshme, si nga ana e mbikqyrsve, ashtu edhe nga aktort kryesor t sistemit bankar. Filozofia e Bazel III sht t bj bankat m elastike pr t zbutur llojet e tronditjeve ekonomike t hasura koht e fundit, ka ka qen edhe shtysa pr t prezantuar reforma si mikro, https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjesve_bankare_te_vendeve_te_Evropes_Qendrore_dhe_asaj_Lindore.html Pagina 2 di 3 Mbi zhvillimin e konferencs s 24t t grupit t mbikqyrsve bankar t vendeve t Evrops Qendrore dhe asaj Lindore 29/07/22, 14:56 ashtu dhe makroprudenciale. Megjithat, pavarsisht sa m lart, u arrit n prfundimin se administrimi i likuiditetit dhe kapitalit duhet t mbeten n nivele kombtare dhe pr m tepr, krkesat mbikqyrse pr likuiditetin duhet t konsiderohen si krkesa minimale dhe jo si mjete t rekomanduara pr administrimin e likuiditetit n bank. N prfundim, konkluzionet e ksaj konference prmblidhen si m posht: Vijimi i procesit t rigjallrimit t kreditimit, si nj zhvillim q mbshtet jo vetm klientt dhe bankat, por edhe vet ekonomin e vendeve pjesmarrse, n kuadr t nj veprimtarie t shndosh e t sigurt bankare; Prmirsimi i synuar i cilsis s kredis, ku kryerja e veprimeve t vendosura dhe n koh pr ekzekutimin e garancive dhe formave t tjera t kolateralit pr rikuperimin maksimal t vlerave, si dhe bashkpunimi me klientt q ndeshin vshtirsi t prkohshme, konsiderohet si thelbsore, n kushtet kur veprimtaria e kreditimit pritet t vazhdoj t ndeshet me nj mjedis sfidues; Prqafimi nga sistemi bankar i nj kulture t mbshtetur n vlerat m t mira t etiks, t shrbimit dhe t integritetit, si objektiv parsor i strukturave drejtuese, ka do t onte n rritjen e prgjegjshmris n drejtimin e institucioneve bankare; Shmangia e prqendrimeve t mdha si dhe e varsis nga fondet financiare afatshkurtra me prioritet adoptimin e praktikave t kujdesshme t administrimit t rrezikut; Rritja e rolit t banks qendrore, n kuadr t politikave makroprudenciale t mbikqyrjes, veanrisht pr sa i takon rolit parandalues t saj. Kjo nnkupton identifikimin dhe ndrtimin e nj grupi treguesish t matshm, t cilt s bashku formojn sistemet paralajmruese t problemeve makroprudenciale, ku pjes e domosdoshme jan dhe testet e rezistencs, t cilat duhet t jen m t shpeshta, reale, transparente dhe t ndahen mes autoriteteve mbikqyrse t vendeve antare t konferencs.
