Title: Speech during the presentation of the Annual Report of the Bank of Albania for 2010 in the Assembly of the Republic of Albania
text: Governor's Word at the Economy and Finance Commission for the Presentation of the Bank of Albania's 2010 Annual Report 29/07/22, 14:52 Governor's word at the Economy and Finance Commission for the Presentation of the Bank of Albania's Annual Report for 2010 Publication date: 24.05.2011 Honourable, Mr. Chairman of the Commission, Honorable ladies and gentlemen members, It is a pleasure for me to be before you today to present the main conclusions of the Bank of Albania's Annual Report. In support of legal requirements, as well as our institutional commitments to strengthen the independence, transparency and accountability of the central bank, the annual report contains a full analysis of economic and financial developments in the country as well as faithfully reflects the activity of the Bank of Albania during 2010. This activity, throughout its spectrum, is oriented by the fulfillment of our mission and legal duties, reflecting at the same time the recommendations left by the Assembly of the Republic of Albania in 2010.  imin_e_Raportit_Vjetor_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_per_vitin_2010.html Page 1 of 13 Governor's Word at the Economy and Finance Commission for the Presentation of the Bank of Albania's 2010 Annual Report 29/07/22, 14:52 Let me first make a brief summary of the main issues addressed in the report. The Albanian economy had generally positive development during 2010. On the other hand, this year's developments simultaneously highlighted the need for the continuation and deepening of structural reforms, as a prerequisite for sustainable and long-term economic growth. Economic activity in the country marked growth over the past year. This growth reflected the sound foundations of the Albanian economy; private sector dynamism; as well as maintaining and consolidating macroeconomic stability. Reflecting developments in the real and financial sector of the economy, as well as the monetary policy of the Bank of Albania, consumer price inflation stayed in line with our target during 2010. During this year: inflation was within the Bank of Albania's target; budget deficit and public debt marked declines in relative terms; financial stability consolidated; financial mediation expanded further. Also, the economy's external position improved and interest rates and risk premiums in financial markets marked declines. According to INSTAT data, the Albanian economy is estimated to have grown by 3.9% during this year. Compared to 2009, economic growth is more balanced in its sectoral distribution and demand components. During the year we left behind, economic growth has mostly relied on foreign demand, which has been reflected in the rapid growth of Albanian exports and the reduction of the trade deficit. It has also found growing support in domestic demand. The significant reduction in fiscal stimulus, especially in the second half of the year, has been offset by the positive tendencies displayed by consumption and private investment during this period. Although growing, the Albanian economy has been markedly characterized by the existence of free capacities, both in the labour market and in capital.  imin_e_Raportit_Vjetor_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_per_vitin_2010.html Page 2 of 13 Governor's Word at the Economy and Finance Commission for the Presentation of the Bank of Albania's 2010 Annual Report 29/07/22, 14:52 Free capacities in the economy, inflationary-anchored expectations of economic agents, as well as controlled monetary expansion in response to the Bank of Albania's careful policy, have exerted a falling influence on inflation. These factors have offset inflationary effects from rising managed prices, undervalued exchange rate and price performance in world markets. Consequently, consumer price inflation scored an average value of 3.6% during 2010, being entirely in line with the Bank of Albania's definition of price stability. The developments mentioned above are supported by the careful combination of monetary, macroprudential and fiscal policies. In the presence of current and expected inflationary controlled pressures, sub-potential production of the Albanian economy, but also of restoring public confidence in the financial system, macroeconomic policies during 2010 maintained towards stimulus. The welcome shift in fiscal policy attention towards maintaining the long-term sustainability of debt indicators was associated with reducing the budget deficit and fiscal stimulus. This development enabled the pursuit of a more stimulus monetary policy by the Bank of Albania and gave way to a 0.25 percentage point reduction in the basic interest rate in July 2010. In response to the continued liquidity injections by the monetary authority, the easing of monetary policy was reflected in the reduction of interest rates of deposits in money, the yields of letters worth the government, and, to a lesser extent, the interest rates of loans in money. Financial markets have had a quieter year, with liquidity rising and interest rates falling. Also, liquidity and capitalization indicators of the banking system have improved. Lending conditions implemented by the banking system marked gradual relief during 2010. This relief reflected not only the bank of Albania's monetary policy, but also improved liquidity indicators, falling risk premiums, and reducing public borrowing in internal monetary markets. Easing lending conditions and rising demand for loans were accompanied by faster credit growth during 2010. In the regional context, the increase in financial mediation over the past year represents a significant development, in contrast to the experience of many other countries characterized by the decline of this indicator. This loan has mainly supported increased investment in the services and industry sectors, while growth in consumer credit has been low. By closing the conclusions of the Annual Report, I want to draw your attention to one of its main topics. The economic developments of 2010 illustrated the economic challenges facing the Albanian economy. First, the economic development model followed so far has room for improvement. The new structural reform agenda should aim at creating conditions for a more balanced and sustainable growth in the long term.  imin_e_Raportit_Vjetor_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_per_vitin_2010.html Page 3 of 13 Governor's Word at the Economy and Finance Commission for the Presentation of the Bank of Albania's 2010 Annual Report 29/07/22, 14:52 The albanian economy's greater orientation towards export, as well as the overall increase in the competitiveness of our products in foreign and domestic markets, dictate the need for further structural reforms, at macro and microeconomic levels. Second, consolidating macroeconomic stability requires greater work in the future. Preserving the country's internal and external balances requires further development of macroeconomic decision-making and coordination architecture, as well as the supervisory and regulatory mechanisms of the economy and markets. The analytical, predictive and decision-making skills of public and private agents must also be further improved. The lessons of the last global crisis must be analysed and implemented decisively by all of us. Third, ensuring the country's financial stability requires coordinating the actions of all supervisory and regulatory institutions, as well as private market agents. Financial stability serves to channel savings into the most competitive sectors of the economy over the long term. *** Following my word I will make a more detailed treatment of the above issues, focusing on the main directions of the work of the Bank of Albania. 1. Economic and financial developments during 2010 The performance of the Albanian economy during 2010 is characterized by gradual improvement in aggregate demand and further consolidation of macroeconomic stability. Economic development has been accompanied by price stability, while public debt, budget deficit and korean account deficit have been reduced. Economic growth is mainly supported by foreign demand and increased Albanian exports, while domestic demand has had slower performance. The latter has been curbed by the consolidation of public finances and the reduction of the budget deficit during 2010, while consumer spending and private investment are influenced by uncertainty for the future and the presence of untapped capacities. Private consumption has had slow performance during 2010, as a result of uncertainty over the economic and financial situation as a whole, and expectations for future employment. This performance is reflected in increasing consumers' preference for savings, while aggregate data speak of increased disposable income. As in many other economies, promoting private consumption will be one of the main determinants of economic growth and one of the challenges we will face over the following period. Private investment has also had a low impact on 2010 economic growth. Albanian businesses have been reluctant to make new investments, influenced by low levels of exploitation of production capacities, but also by the greater care of banks in the lending process.  imin_e_Raportit_Vjetor_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_per_vitin_2010.html Page 4 of 13 Governor's Word at the Economy and Finance Commission for the Presentation of the Bank of Albania's 2010 Annual Report 29/07/22, 14:52 Fiscal policy was oriented towards fiscal consolidation during 2010, following the countercyclic nature shown in 2009. Fiscal consolidation accelerated, especially in the second six months of the year, with the adoption of the revised budget. This consolidation was present in both income and expenditure. Budgetary revenues increased by 8.4% in annual terms, reflecting economic growth, expanding the base of tax users, and revenues from privatizations. On the other hand, budgetary spending shrunk by 4.5%, following the government's shrinking capital expenditure. The budget deficit for 2010 decreased around the 3.0% GDP level, reducing by 52% compared to a year earlier. This deficit was financed mainly through the issue of common internal debt instruments. However, deficit financing brought a novelty in 2010, through the emission of the first Albanian Eurobond. This issue, at 300m euros, met some of the public sector's currency needs and was accompanied by reducing domestic borrowing. It overturned pressures on the local currency, increased private sector borrowing spaces and influenced improving its financing conditions. The crust account deficit narrowed by about 21.5% during 2010, staying at the 11.9% GDP level. This reduction reflected the increase in private and public sector savings. It was also helped by the increase in exports as a result of the revitalization of foreign demand, the undervalued exchange rate and the improvement of trade terms in this period. Despite the marked improvement during 2010, the korean account deficit remains high. As we have stressed continuously, the Bank of Albania considers that drafting structural policies for easing foreign economy imbalances should be addressed with priority. The significant shrinking of the trade deficit in goods and services came as a result of the accelerated increase in exports of goods and services, by about 16.4% at the annual level. On the other hand, imports of goods and services reflected a moderate growth rate of 2.6% in average terms, but with growing trends in the last months of the year. The difficult economic situation in neighbouring countries has been reflected in the annual decline in net shipments by immigrants by 11.7%, while their ratio to GDP was estimated at 7.8%. Net capital and financial account flows recorded a decline of about 11.2% during 2010, enabling the financing of the crust account deficit to the tune of 87.5%. Excluding privatisations, foreign direct investment was estimated at 9.3% of GDP and were the main source of foreign financing of the Albanian economy. The country's currency reserve rose by about 178.8m euros and its stock of 1.9 billion euros is enough to cover 4.8 months of imports of goods and services. Positive developments in the foreign sector of the economy, mainly as a consequence of the expansion of exports, as well as currency inflows from Eurobond, have helped generate the pressures contained in the currency exchange market this year. In the macroeconomic perspective, the relative sustainability of the exchange rate during the year has reflected a new balance achieved in foreign currency demand and supply. In sectoral terms, the development of the Albanian economy is mainly supported by  imin_e_Raportit_Vjetor_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_per_vitin_2010.html Page 5 of 13 Governor's Word at the Economy and Finance Commission for the Presentation of the Bank of Albania's 2010 Annual Report 29/07/22, 14:52 the growth of the industry sector and that of services. These sectors have benefited greatly respectively from foreign demand and the structural shift in domestic demand towards short-term consumer goods. On the short and medium-term horizon, the industry and services sectors are expected to remain the main supporters of the Albanian economy. The construction sector came to contract during 2010, reflecting shrinking public investment, tighter credit conditions, more cautious consumer behaviour towards investment in real estate, and problems caused by the relatively high stock of inherited inventories. The overcoming of these problems, as well as price correction tendencies in some segments of residential markets, will pave the way for the more sustainable development of this sector. On the other hand, the agricultural sector is estimated to have marked growth, as a result of better climatic conditions and favourable price conjuncture that characterizes, and will characterize this sector. Monetary developments and financial markets Broad money increased by an average of 10.6% during 2010. Its growth reflects the performance of economic activity and the return of economic agents' confidence in the banking system. The expansion of the monetary measure has been in line with the economy's demand for money, not promoting inflationary tendencies in the economy. The deposit to GDP ratio scored 64.2% at the end of the year, staying higher than the level recorded before the withdrawal of deposits. The deposit time structure profile has also reflected the increased preference for savings, characterizing the shift of deposits to longer-term maturity. Easing lending conditions during the second half of the year, stimulus measures taken by the Bank of Albania, the growing interest of the banking system to support consumption and investment in the country, as well as lower uncertainty and risk premiums, were accompanied by a gradual increase in credit during the year. The private sector loan portfolio expanded by 10% during 2010, mainly influenced by increased currency lending. However, lending activity continues to suffer from lack of demand and realistic, quality and valuable business plans for lending. The return of confidence in the financial system, the stabilized macroeconomic situation and regulatory and supervisory measures undertaken by the Bank of Albania influenced the stabilisation and improvement of capitalization, liquidity and the profitability of the banking system. 2 Inflation performance and monetary policy Annual consumer price inflation resulted in an average of 3.6% during 2010, staying within the Bank of Albania's target for it. Inflationary pressures were more concentrated in the first half of the year, mainly caused by the rise in some managed prices. Average annual inflation in the first six months of the year resulted in 3.9%. In the following two quarters, relative stabilisation of the exchange rate and low inflationary pressures from domestic demand helped to  imin_e_Raportit_Vjetor_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_per_vitin_2010.html Page 6 of 13 Governor's Word at the Economy and Finance Commission for the Presentation of the Bank of Albania's 2010 Annual Report 29/07/22, 14:52 convergence of the average inflation rate around the Bank of Albania's target. The negative yield gap has produced contained inflationary pressures throughout 2010, balancing the effect of underpricing the local currency and rising prices in international markets. During 2010, the Bank of Albania's monetary policy was developed in a macroeconomic environment characterized by positive economic growth rates, anchored inflationary expectations and contained inflationary pressures. As I pointed out before, this environment enabled the preservation of the expansionist nature of monetary policy, which has been on display since 2009. This policy has driven the falling trend of interest rates, and further complemented the stimulating effects of the exchange rate subprice. Low interest rates have favoured increased consumption and investment in the country, while the undervalued exchange rate has supported the increase in Albanian exports during the year. Reducing fiscal stimulus further expanded the spaces for pursuing a monetary stimulus policy. In July 2010, the Bank of Albania lowered the basic interest rate by 0.25 percentage points, bringing it down to a historic low of 5.0%. Improved liquidity conditions in the banking system and weak state sector demand for monetary means have supported the monitoring of easing policy in all segments of financial markets in the last months of 2010. In parallel with this movement, the Bank of Albania has supplied the financial market with the liquidity needed to support financial mediation. Always aiming at adopting more advanced central banking models, and in particular convergence with Eurosystem practices, the Bank of Albania also changed the form of its operational target. Starting in June 2010, our liquidity management operations are oriented by targeting short-term interest rates in the interbank market and minimizing their fluctuations. This re-modelling of our interventions in the money market increases the effectiveness of monetary policy and promotes the development of the interbank market. In parallel, it marks another step in completing our technical preparations for adopting the targeted inflation regime. *** Another important aspect of the central bank's duties is the supervisory function of the banking system. 3. Banking supervision and financial stability Improving economic activity in the country is also reflected in the performance of banking activity. 2010 was characterized by the increase in bank actives, improved health and bank profitability indicators, as well as by the good capitalization of the system. On the other hand, the banking system was characterized by the growth of the portfolio of troubled loans, reflecting also the bank of Albania's active policy towards increasing bank balance sheet transparency. Organisational change of  imin_e_Raportit_Vjetor_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_per_vitin_2010.html Page 7 of 13 Governor's Word at the Economy and Finance Commission for the Presentation of the Bank of Albania's 2010 Annual Report 29/07/22, 14:52 banking supervision, in line with the challenges facing time, has provided assistance in further improving the regulatory and supervisory framework and, consequently, strengthening financial stability in the country. Performance of the banking system The banking sector continues to remain the main actor in financial mediation in Albania. Currently this sector consists of 16 banks, two of which are branches of foreign banks. At the end of 2010, the active banking system grew at rates twice as high as a year earlier, representing about 81% of GDP. Overall, this ratio expanded by about 3.5 percentage points compared to a year ago. The active structure of the banking system follows to be financed mainly by public deposits and to be focused on lending activity, which is mainly oriented towards private sector financing. Investments in the banking system, in lending activity, increased during 2010, but growth rates continue to be at moderate levels. This performance reflects the banks' careful policies on the quality of the loan portfolio as well as the moderate demand for loans that economic agents have displayed in the country. Slow growth in lending activity and below-potential performance of the economy have affected the growth of the troubled credit index to 14%. However, the pace of its growth has come to a decline throughout 2010. The capital sufficiency ratio remains at satisfactory levels. The system's shareholder capital increased by 10% in 2010. The Albanian banking sector is rated well-capitalised, which is confirmed by the high capital sufficiency rate at 15.4%, significantly higher than the 12% level defined under the regulatory framework. The financial lever index in 2010 resulted in 10.6%, remaining at almost the same level as in 2009. This performance testifies to a steady support of the banking system's mediation activity, at the same debt levels for the two years mentioned. Credit risk remains the main risk to our banking sector. In response to this risk, the banking sector has created its own reserve funds for coping with possible losses. At the end of 2010, reserve funds for dealing with credit risk (providies) from lending to residents are about 33% more than their level at the end of 2009. Our test stress tests, or resistance tests, confirm that capital in the Albanian banking system is enough to cope with major shocks, which cause creditors to reduce their payability or disrupt market balances. The Bank of Albania has significantly improved its analysis through stress-test analyses supported by increased co-operation with the IMF, the World Bank, the European Central Bank and co-operation with foreign central banks. As part of strengthening the supervision process of banking subjects, the Bank of Albania has signed a series of co-operation agreements with the region's central and European banks where parent banks have headquarters. The process of exchanging information both during the licensing process of banking institutions and in relation to possible risks to the financial stability of the banking institutions they oversee and co-operation in carrying out checks  imin_e_Raportit_Vjetor_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_per_vitin_2010.html Page 8 of 13 Governor's Word at the Economy and Finance Commission for the Presentation of the Bank of Albania's 2010 Annual Report 29/07/22, 14:52 financial subjects operating both domestically and abroad will help the Bank of Albania in exercising its role in ensuring the stability of the banking system in the country. In addition to the banking sector, 2010 has also been positive for non-bank financial institutions, testifying to increased diversity and fulfillment of financial infrastructure in the country. At the end of the year, the number of nonbank institutions in the financial system reached 17 out of 12 institutions that were the year before. Overall, their financial activity and creditor activity have reflected good performance and mainly in line with the regulatory framework set by the Bank of Albania. Supervision of the banking system As I mentioned a little earlier, in early 2010, the Bank of Albania changed the organisational framework of banking supervision, directing and directly linking it to the risks that accompany financial activity. In parallel, the Bank of Albania also made a reconception of the focus and strategy of working for supervisory purposes, according to the risks facing the banking and financial system in the country. In focus of the supervisory process throughout 2010 have also been transparency and publication of information, for banking and financial products and services. First, the Bank of Albania through the publication of detailed financial health analyses at system level since 2010, every six months, provides an orientated framework for building plans for businesses for both the public and financial agents. On the other hand, the push for increased transparency of private financial agents has also been reflected in changes in the regulatory framework during the year. A sensitive issue pursued over the past year and which will take precedence over the following periods is also the high level of commissions applied to banking products and services. The Bank of Albania, through its analyses, has been an important part of discussions on this phenomenon, targeting timely and effective addressing the problem. An important part of the supervisory process throughout 2010 have also been issues related to preventing money laundering, transparency and monitoring norms. For these purposes, full inspections were carried out in the country of two banks and four nonbank financial subjects as well as two targeted inspections. In response to these inspections, these subjects have drafted internal regulations and further developed payment systems, which every day can identify all transactions in physical money. Strengthening the regulatory framework of the supervisor During 2010, the Bank of Albania finalized the drafting of some new regulations and made changes to several other banking supervision regulations. This process has aimed to continually adapt to basel committee standards and European Union directives, considering best practices in the area of regulation and developments in the Albanian banking system. New regulatory acts and significant changes to the acts in force for banking supervision adopted during this year are:  imin_e_Raportit_Vjetor_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_per_vitin_2010.html Page 9 of 13 Governor's Word at the Economy and Finance Commission for the Presentation of the Bank of Albania's 2010 Annual Report 29/07/22, 14:52 The Risk Management Regulation from open currency positions, which specifies rules and criteria for calculating, reporting and overseeing banks' open currency positions, with the aim of managing exchange rate risk. The Risk Management Regulation in the activity of nonbank financial subjects, the object of which is the definition of risk management rules in the activity of nonbank financial subjects, distinguishing in particular the rules for risk management in the activity of microcredit financial institutions and those developing financial rental activity in the country. The Manual for the Custody and Dilution of Banks , which defines procedures and actions for the realization of the custody and liquefying process, complementing the authority's action framework in cases of placement in custody/laundering of the foreign bank or branch of the foreign bank. **** In addition to the main job headings of the Bank of Albania, such as monetary policy and supervision and regulation of the banking sector, in my word I would like to stop in some other aspects of our work. These activities meet our legal obligations, and serve the development of the financial system and market economy in Albania. 4. Other activities of the Bank of Albania In this framework, I will summarily present you with the role of the Bank of Albania in developing the payment system; in supporting the European integration process; in education and communication with the public; in statistics developments in the country; As well as in conclusion I would like to mention and increase the research and research capacities of the staff I lead. Payment systems During 2010, the infrastructure of payment systems has improved further, their security and performance has increased, at the same time processing a greater number and volume of payments. The payment system for large real-time values (AIPS) has shown transaction volume growth by 44% compared to 2009. This year marked further expansion of the use of payment instruments, reflecting among other things the increase in public confidence in the banking system. The functioning of financial markets and strengthening financial stability in the country cannot be achieved without an effective and developed payment system. In this context, the Bank of Albania is working to adopt the best practices of other central banks. The twinning project with the Bank of Italy and the Bank of France carried out this year constitutes one of these activities, where in addition to others, capacity building and approximation of the regulatory and operational framework for the operation of Payment Systems in Albania with those of European Union countries is aimed. Work during 2010 has focused on two main aspects: strengthening the legal framework in the function of the supervisory role for payment systems; And, the improvement and promotion of  imin_e_Raportit_Vjetor_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_per_vitin_2010.html Page 10 of 13 Governor's Word at the Economy and Finance Commission for the Presentation of the Bank of Albania's 2010 Annual Report 29/07/22, 14:52 changes to the national payment system in the function of the bank of Albania's reformer role. In the direction of improving the legal framework, in the year we just closed, the drafting of the Payment Systems Bill was finalized. This bill represents a further, very important step in the process of continuously approximating Albanian legislation with that of the EU in the banking and financial field, also envisaged in articles 70 and 89 of the Stabilisation and Association Agreement (MSA). In fulfilling the reformist role, the Bank of Albania in March 2010 carried out live communication through the electronic interface of the Treasury System at the Ministry of Finance and Payment Systems near the Bank of Albania. This new scheme enables the Ministry of Finance to monitor real-time activity in its accounts near the Bank of Albania, thus serving as efficient a management of funds as possible. Also, this year work has focused on improving and expanding the infrastructure needed to atone for electronic payment instruments in money for various international cards (MasterCard, Visa) as well as projects aimed at reducing the use of cash in the economy. Supporting integration processes In accordance with the MSA implementation process, the Bank of Albania has contributed to the revision of the National Plan for the Implementation of the MSA (PKZMSA) for 2010 2014, identifying and updating the priorities and measures taken in the areas of macroeconomic stability, free movement of capital, freedom of deployment, as well as freedom to provide services. The Bank of Albania engaged in the process of filling in questions of the questionnaire sent by the European Commission, also having a coordinating role for its particular chapters, as well as actively participating in further fact-gathering meetings organised by this body. The Bank of Albania during 2010 continued to maintain continuous and fruitful contacts with key international financial institutions such as the IMF, the World Bank, the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) bank for International Regulation (BIS) as well as boosted bilateral relations with other central banks. During 2010, the Bank of Albania set out work to revise the legal and regulatory framework in line with EU legislation and in line with the latest dynamics of developments in the country, drafting important legal, sublegal and regulatory acts in the banking field. Communication with the public and institutional transparency Communication with the general public and with separate institutions is considered one of the most important elements of the bank of Albania's work, to which a significant portion of its resources are also dedicated. During 2010, the Bank of Albania's work in this framework focused mainly on restructuring existing tools and building new modes of communication, which help  imin_e_Raportit_Vjetor_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_per_vitin_2010.html Page 11 of 13 Governor's Word at the Economy and Finance Commission for the Presentation of the Bank of Albania's 2010 Annual Report 29/07/22, 14:52 in creating an environment with well-informed actors and able to understand the central bank's decision-making, and to make rational decisions on economic and financial issues. From this perspective, contacts with different layers of the public have been added over the past year, particularly those that have an impact on its educational processes. Activities have consisted of direct communications, periodic and non-periodic publications, presentations and meetings that have made information available to the public about the Bank's work and its decision-making process. At the same time, the official website offers in real and simple time any information on activity and decisions made by the institution, as well as on statistics produced by it. Improving statistics at the Bank of Albania In carrying out the function of producing statistics, the Bank of Albania has aimed to not only successfully design and publish statistical indicators, but also to continuously improve service to the public, expanding the range of indicators, approaching methodology with international best standards and practices and providing information as appropriately as possible. Paralelisht me kt lvizje, Banka e Shqipris ka furnizuar tregun financiar me likuiditetin e nevojshm pr mbshtetjen e ndrmjetsimit financiar. Duke synuar gjithnj adoptimin e modeleve m t prparuara t bankingut qendror, dhe n veanti konvergjencn me praktikat e Eurosistemit, Banka e Shqipris ndryshoi edhe formn e objektivit t saj operacional. Duke filluar nga muaji qershor 2010, operacionet tona t administrimit t likuiditetit orientohen nga shnjestrimi i normave afatshkurtra t interesit n tregun ndrbankar dhe nga minimizimi i luhatjeve t tyre. Ky ri-modelim i ndrhyrjeve tona n tregun e paras rrit efektivitetin e politiks monetare dhe nxit zhvillimin e tregut ndrbankar. Paralelisht me t, ai shnon edhe nj hap tjetr n prfundimin e prgatitjeve tona teknike pr adoptimin e regjimit t inflacionit t shnjestruar. *** Nj tjetr aspekt i rndsishm i detyrave t banks qendrore sht edhe funksioni mbikqyrs i sistemit bankar. 3. Mbikqyrja bankare dhe stabiliteti financiar Prmirsimi i aktivitetit ekonomik n vend sht pasqyruar edhe n ecurin e aktivitetit bankar. Viti 2010 u karakterizua nga rritja e aktiveve t bankave, prmirsimi i treguesve t shndetit dhe t prfitueshmris bankare, si dhe nga - kapitalizimi i mir i sistemit. Nga ana tjetr, sistemi bankar u karakterizua nga rritja e portofolit t kredive me probleme, duke reflektuar edhe politikn aktive t Banks s Shqipris n drejtim t rritjes s transparencs s bilanceve t bankave. Ndryshimi organizativ i https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjaimin_e_Raportit_Vjetor_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_per_vitin_2010.html Pagina 7 di 13 Fjala e Guvernatorit n Komisionin e Ekonomis dhe Financave pr Prezantimin e Raportit Vjetor t Banks s Shqipris pr vitin 2010 29/07/22, 14:52 mbikqyrjes bankare, n prshtatje me sfidat q parashtron koha, ka dhn nj ndihmes n prmirsimin e mtejshm t kuadrit rregullativ dhe mbikqyrs dhe, pr rrjedhoj, n forcimin e stabilitetit financiar n vend. Ecuria e sistemit bankar Sektori bankar vijon t mbetet aktori kryesor i ndrmjetsimit financiar n Shqipri. Aktualisht ky sektor prbehet nga 16 banka, ku dy prej tyre jan deg t bankave t huaja. N fund t vitit 2010, aktivet e sistemit bankar jan rritur me ritme dy her m t larta se nj vit m par, duke prfaqsuar rreth 81% t PBB-s. N trsi ky raport sht zgjeruar me rreth 3.5 pik prqindjeje krahasuar me nj vit m par. Struktura e aktivit t sistemit bankar vijon t financohet kryesisht nga depozitat e publikut dhe t jet e prqendruar n aktivitetin e kredidhnies, i cili sht i orientuar kryesisht drejt financimit t sektorit privat. Investimet e sistemit bankar, n aktivitetin kreditues jan rritur gjat vitit 2010, por ritmet e rritjes vazhdojn t jen n nivele t moderuara. Kjo ecuri reflekton politikat e kujdesshme t bankave pr cilsin e portofolit t kredis si dhe t krkess s moderuar pr kredi q kan shfaqur agjentt ekonomik n vend. Rritja e ngadalt e aktivitetit kreditues dhe ecuria nn potencial e ekonomis kan ndikuar n rritjen e treguesit t kredis me probleme, n nivelin 14%. Megjithat, ritmet e rritjes tij kan ardhur n rnie prgjat vitit 2010. Raporti i mjaftueshmris s kapitalit mbetet n nivele t knaqshme. Kapitali aksioner i sistemit sht rritur me 10% n vitin 2010. Sektori bankar shqiptar vlersohet i mirkapitalizuar, gj q konfirmohet nga norma e lart e mjaftueshmris s kapitalit n nivelin 15.4%, dukshm m e lart se niveli prej 12% i prcaktuar n kuadrin rregullator. Treguesi i levs financiare n vitin 2010, rezultoi 10.6%, duke mbetur n nivel pothuaj t njjt me at t vitit 2009. Kjo ecuri dshmon pr nj mbshtetje t qndrueshme t aktivitetit ndrmjetsues t sistemit bankar, n nivele t njjta borxhi pr dy vitet e lartprmendur. Rreziku i kreditit, mbetet rreziku kryesor pr sektorin ton bankar. N prgjigje t ktij rreziku, sektori bankar ka krijuar fondet e veta rezerv pr prballimin e humbjeve t mundshme. N fund t vitit 2010, fondet rezerv pr prballimin e rrezikut t kreditit (provigjonet) nga huadhnia pr rezidentt, jan rreth 33% m shum se niveli i tyre n fund t vitit 2009. Analizat tona t stress test-it, ose provs s rezistencs, konfirmojn se kapitali n sistemin bankar shqiptar sht i mjaftueshm pr t prballuar goditje t mdha, t cilat shkaktojn uljen e aftsis paguese t kredimarrsve apo prishjen e ekuilibrave t tregut. Banka e Shqipris ka prmirsuar dukshm analizn e saj nprmjet analizave stres-test mbshtetur edhe nga nj bashkpunim n rritje me FMN-n, Bankn Botrore, Bankn Qendrore Evropiane dhe bashkpunimit me bankat qendrore t huaja. N kuadr t forcimit t procesit t mbikqyrjes s subjekteve bankare, Banka e Shqipris ka nnshkruar nj sr marrveshjesh bashkpunimi me bankat qendrore t rajonit dhe ato evropiane ku bankat mma kan selit qendrore. Procesi i shkmbimit t informacionit si gjat procesit t licencimit t institucioneve bankare, ashtu edhe n lidhje me rreziqe t mundshme ndaj stabilitetit financiar t institucioneve bankare q ato mbikqyrin dhe bashkpunimi n kryerjen e kontrolleve https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjaimin_e_Raportit_Vjetor_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_per_vitin_2010.html Pagina 8 di 13 Fjala e Guvernatorit n Komisionin e Ekonomis dhe Financave pr Prezantimin e Raportit Vjetor t Banks s Shqipris pr vitin 2010 29/07/22, 14:52 t subjekteve financiare q operojn si brenda dhe jasht vendit do t ndihmoj Bankn e Shqipris n ushtrimin e rolit t saj n garantimin e stabilitetit t sistemit bankar n vend. Krahas sektorit bankar, viti 2010 ka qen pozitiv edhe pr institucionet financiare jobanka, duke dshmuar pr rritje t shumllojshmris dhe plotsimit t infrastrukturs financiare n vend. N fund t vitit, numri i institucioneve jobanka n sistemin financiar arriti n 17 nga 12 institucione q ishin nj vit m par. N trsi aktiviteti i tyre financiar dhe ai kredidhns kan pasqyruar ecuri t mir dhe kryesisht n prputhje me kuadrin rregullativ t vendosur nga Banka e Shqipris. Mbikqyrja e sistemit bankar Sikurse e prmenda pak m par, n fillim t vitit 2010, Banka e Shqipris ndryshoi kuadrin organizativ t mbikqyrjes bankare, duke e orientuar dhe e lidhur drejtprdrejt at me rreziqet q shoqrojn aktivitetin financiar. Paralelisht me kt, Banka e Shqipris bri edhe nj rikonceptim t fokusit dhe strategjis s puns pr qllime mbikqyrse, sipas rreziqeve me t cilat prballet sistemi bankar dhe financiar n vend. N fokus t procesit mbikqyrs prgjat vitit 2010 kan qen dhe transparenca dhe publikimi i informacionit, pr produktet dhe shrbimet bankare dhe financiare. S pari, Banka e Shqipris nprmjet publikimit t analizave t detajuara t shndetit financiar n nivel sistemi q prej vitit 2010, n do gjasht muaj, ofron nj kuadr orientues pr ndrtimin e plan-bizneseve si pr publikun ashtu dhe pr agjentt financiar. Nga ana tjetr nxitja pr rritjen e transparencs s agjentve financiar privat sht pasqyruar dhe n ndryshimet e kuadrit rregullativ gjat vitit. Nj shtje sensitive e ndjekur gjat vitit t kaluar dhe q do t ket prparsi n periudhat n vijim sht dhe niveli i lart i komisioneve t aplikuara pr produktet dhe shrbimet bankare. Banka e Shqipris, nprmjet analizave t saj ka qen pjes e rndsishme e diskutimeve mbi kt fenomen, duke synuar adresimin n koh dhe me eficenc t problematiks. Pjes e rndsishme e procesit mbikqyrs prgjat vitit 2010, kan qen edhe shtjet q lidhen me parandalimin e pastrimit t parave, me transparencn si dhe me ndjekjen e normave mbikqyrse. Pr kto qllime jan kryer inspektime t plota n vend n dy banka dhe katr subjekte financiare jobanka si dhe dy inspektime t targetuara. N prgjigje t ktyre inspektimeve, kto subjekte kan hartuar rregullore t brendshme dhe kan zhvilluar m tej sistemet e pagesave, t cilat do dit mundsojn identifikimin e t gjitha transaksioneve n para fizike. Forcimi i kuadrit rregullator e mbikqyrs Gjat vitit 2010, Banka e Shqipris finalizoi hartimin e disa rregulloreve t reja dhe bri ndryshime n disa rregullore t tjera t mbikqyrjes bankare. Ky proces ka synuar q n vazhdimsi t prshtat me standardet e Komitetit t Bazelit dhe direktivat e Bashkimit Evropian, duke konsideruar praktikat m t mira n fushn e rregullimit dhe zhvillimet n sistemin bankar shqiptar. Rregullorja Pr administrimin e rrezikut n veprimtarin e subjekteve financiare jobanka , objekti i s cils sht prcaktimi i rregullave pr administrimin e rrezikut n veprimtarin e subjekteve financiare jobanka duke dalluar n veanti rregullat pr administrimin e rrezikut n veprimtarin e institucioneve financiare t mikrokredis dhe t atyre q zhvillojn veprimtarin e qiras financiare n vend. Manuali Pr kujdestarin dhe likuidimin e bankave , i cili prcakton procedurat dhe veprimet pr realizimin e procesit t kujdestaris dhe likuidimit, duke plotsuar kuadrin e veprimit t autoritetit n rastet e vendosjes n kujdestari/likuidim t banks ose degs s banks s huaj. **** Krahas drejtimeve kryesore t puns s Banks s Shqipris, sikurse jan politika monetare dhe mbikqyrja e rregullimi i sektorit bankar, n fjaln time do t doja t ndalesha edhe n disa aspekte t tjera t puns son. Kto aktivitete prmbushin detyrimet tona ligjore, dhe i shrbejn zhvillimit t sistemit financiar dhe t ekonomis s tregut n Shqipri. 4. Aktivitete t tjera t Banks s Shqipris N kt kuadr, n mnyr t prmbledhur do t ju paraqes rolin e Banks s Shqipris n zhvillimin e sistemit t pagesave; n mbshtetjen e procesit t integrimit evropian; n edukimin dhe komunikimin me publikun; n zhvillimet e statistikave n vend; si dhe n prfundim do t doja t prmendja dhe rritjen e kapaciteteve studimore e krkimore t stafit q un drejtoj. Sistemet e pagesave Gjat vitit 2010, infrastruktura e sistemeve t pagesave sht prmirsuar m tej, siguria dhe eficienca e tyre sht rritur, duke procesuar n t njjtn koh nj numr dhe vllim m t madh pagesash. Sistemi i pagesave pr vlerat e mdha n koh reale (AIPS) ka shfaqur rritje t volumit t transaksioneve me 44 % krahasuar me vitin 2009. Ky vit ka shnuar zgjerim t mtejshm t prdorimit t instrumenteve t pagesave, duke reflektuar ndr t tjera edhe rritjen e besimit t publikut n sistemin bankar. Mirfunksionimi i tregjeve financiare dhe forcimi i stabilitetit financiar n vend nuk mund t realizohen pa nj sistem efektiv dhe t zhvilluar pagesash. N kt kuadr, Banka e Shqipris po punon pr t adoptuar praktikat m t mira t bankave t tjera qendrore. Projekti i binjakzimit me Bankn e Italis dhe me Bankn e Francs i realizuar kt vit prbn nj nga kto aktivitete, ku prve t tjerave synohet ngritja e kapaciteteve dhe prafrimi i kuadrit rregullativ dhe operacional t funksionimit t Sistemeve t Pagesave n Shqipri me ato t vendeve t Bashkimit Evropian. Puna gjat vitit 2010 sht fokusuar n dy aspekte kryesore: forcimi i kuadrit ligjor n funksion t rolit mbikqyrs pr sistemet e pagesave; dhe, prmirsimi e nxitja e https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjimin_e_Raportit_Vjetor_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_per_vitin_2010.html Pagina 10 di 13 Fjala e Guvernatorit n Komisionin e Ekonomis dhe Financave pr Prezantimin e Raportit Vjetor t Banks s Shqipris pr vitin 2010 29/07/22, 14:52 ndryshimeve n sistemin kombtar t pagesave n funksion t rolit reformator t Banks s Shqipris. N drejtim t prmirsimit t kuadrit ligjor, n vitin q sapo mbyllm u finalizua draftimi i projektligjit Pr sistemet e pagesave . Ky projektligj prbn nj hap t mtejshm, tepr t rndsishm n procesin pr prafrimin e vazhdueshm t legjislacionit shqiptar me at t BE-s n fushn bankare dhe financiare, parashikuar gjithashtu edhe n nenet 70 dhe 89 t Marrveshjes pr Stabilizim dhe Asocim (MSA). N prmbushje t rolit reformator, Banka e Shqipris n muajin Mars 2010 realizoi komunikimin live nprmjet ndrfaqes elektronike t Sistemit t Thesarit pran Ministris s Financave dhe sistemeve t pagesave pran Banks s Shqipris. Kjo skem e re i mundson Ministris s Financave monitorimin n koh reale t aktivitetit n llogarit e saj pran Banks s Shqipris, duke i shrbyer kshtu nj administrimi sa m efient t fondeve nga ana e saj. Gjithashtu, gjat ktij viti puna sht fokusuar edhe n prmirsimin dhe zgjerimin e infrastrukturave t nevojshme pr shlyerjen e instrumenteve elektronike t pagesave n lek pr kartat e ndryshme ndrkombtare (MasterCard, Visa) si dhe n projekte t cilat synojn reduktimin e prdorimit t cash-it n ekonomi. Mbshtetja e proceseve integruese N prputhje me procesin e zbatimit t MSA-s, Banka e Shqipris ka kontribuar n rishikimin e Planit Kombtar pr Zbatimin e MSA-s (PKZMSA) pr vitet 2010 2014, duke identifikuar dhe prditsuar prparsit dhe masat e marra n fushat e stabilitetit makroekonomik, t lvizjes s lir t kapitalit, liris s vendosjes, si dhe liris pr t ofruar shrbime. Banka e Shqipris u angazhua n procesin e plotsimit t prgjigjeve t pyetjeve t pyetsorit drguar nga Komisioni Evropian, duke patur edhe rol koordinues pr kapituj t veant t tij, si edhe ka marr pjes aktive n takimet e mtejshme faktmbledhse t organizuara nga ky organ. Banka e Shqipris gjat vitit 2010 vazhdoi t mbaj kontakte t vazhdueshme dhe t frytshme me institucionet kryesore financiare ndrkombtare si FMN, Banka Botrore, Bankn Evropiane pr Rindrtim dhe Zhvillim (EBRD) Bankn pr Rregullime Ndrkombtare (BIS) si dhe ka rritur marrdhniet dypalshe me bankat e tjera qendrore. Gjat vitit 2010, Banka e Shqipris vijoi punn pr rishikimin e kuadrit ligjor dhe rregullativ n prputhje me legjislacionin e BE-s dhe n prshtatje me dinamikn m t fundit t zhvillimeve n vend, duke hartuar akte t rndsishme ligjore, nnligjore dhe rregullative n fushn bankare. Komunikimi me publikun dhe transparenca institucionale Komunikimi me publikun e gjer dhe me institucione t veanta konsiderohet si nj ndr elementet m t rndsishm t puns s Banks s Shqipris, t cils i dedikon edhe nj pjes t konsiderueshme t burimeve t saj. Gjat vitit 2010, puna e Banks s Shqipris n kt kuadr sht fokusuar kryesisht n ristrukturimin e mjeteve ekzistuese dhe ndrtimin e mnyrave t reja t komunikimit, t cilat ndihmojn https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjimin_e_Raportit_Vjetor_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_per_vitin_2010.html Pagina 11 di 13 Fjala e Guvernatorit n Komisionin e Ekonomis dhe Financave pr Prezantimin e Raportit Vjetor t Banks s Shqipris pr vitin 2010 29/07/22, 14:52 n krijimin e nj mjedisi me aktor t mirinformuar dhe t aft pr t kuptuar vendimmarrjen e banks qendrore, dhe pr t marr vendime racionale mbi shtjet ekonomike e financiare. Nn kt kndvshtrim, gjat vitit t kaluar jan shtuar kontaktet me shtresat e ndryshme t publikut, duke u drejtuar veanrisht tek ato q kan ndikim n proceset edukative t tij. Aktivitetet e kryera kan konsistuar n komunikime t drejtprdrejta, botime periodike dhe joperiodike, prezantime dhe takime t cilat kan vn n dispozicion t publikut informacione mbi punn e Banks dhe procesin vendimmarrs t saj. N t njjtn koh, faqja zyrtare e internetit ofron n koh reale dhe t thjesht do informacion mbi aktivitetin dhe vendimet e marra nga institucioni, si dhe mbi statistikat e prodhuara prej tij. Prmirsimi i statistikave n Bankn e Shqipris N kryerjen e funksionit t prodhimit t statistikave, Banka e Shqipris ka synuar q, jo vetm t realizoj me sukses hartimin dhe publikimin e treguesve statistikor, por edhe t prmirsoj n vazhdimsi shrbimin ndaj publikut, duke zgjeruar gamn e treguesve, duke prafruar metodologjin me standardet dhe praktikat m t mira ndrkombtare dhe duke ofruar informacion n mnyr sa m t prshtatshme. Zhvillimi kryesor gjat vitit 2010 n drejtim t prodhimit statistikor ishte publikimi pr her t par i statistikave t borxhit t jashtm bruto, statistikave t pozicionit t investimeve ndrkombtare dhe statistikave t detajuara t kredis pr ekonomin, duke plotsuar kshtu kategorin e statistikave t sektorit t jashtm. N fushn e statistikave monetare e financiare, sht punuar n drejtim t prmirsimit metodologjik, t informatizimit t proceseve t kontrollit, si dhe t rritjes s numrit t treguesve t publikuar. Forcimi i kapaciteteve studimore e krkimore Banka e Shqipris prej kohsh e ka konsideruar krkimin shkencor n fushat ekonomike, financiare dhe sociale si nj element t rndsishm n vlersimin dhe analizn e kryer prej saj, n funksion t mbshtetjes s procesit t vendimmarrjes. Rritja e kapaciteteve krkimore sht zhvilluar nprmjet trajnimit t vazhdueshm t burimeve njerzore, modernizimit t infrastrukturs krkimore dhe krijimit t urave pr shkmbimin e prvojs dhe njohurive me institucione n fushn krkimore. Disa nga aspektet kryesore ku sht prqendruar krkimi gjat vitit 2010 kan qen: politika monetare dhe ajo fiskale, shtje t stabilitetit financiar, modeli i ri i rritjes ekonomike, si dhe sektori i jashtm i ekonomis. Mbshtetja dhe aplikimi i modeleve ekonometrike n studimin e fenomeneve t ndryshme ekonomike ka mundsuar nxjerrjen e konkluzioneve dhe parashikimeve t besueshme. Title: Speech at the 9th International Conference on "Building the future through financial culture"

Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word at the roundtable: "Collateral, credit, market and law" July 12 2011 Publication date: 12.07.2011 Honored bank managers, Honored participants, ... 1/7 05/08/22, 16:59 Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word at the roundtable: "Collateral, credit, market and law" 12 ... It is special pleasure to open the work of the next forum, which we have titled Collateral, Credit, Market and Law. Today's table will carefully analyze all factors affecting quality and secure economic lending. For this reason we have an added presence of state institutions, who take advantage of the opportunity to welcome you and welcome you to this discussion table. In the last three years we have witnessed several events that have exceeded normal expectations limits, imposing a whole range of changes. As a result, markets, structures, institutions, even economic concepts are affected. However, while the Albanian economy has been influenced by international financial developments, we gladly state that it has demonstrated a high degree of resistance and sustainability. As I have stated other times, Albania is one of the countries that: did not experience bank bankruptcy or capital injections on the part of the state; He faced with great courage the crisis of trust in the banking system and where financial mediation did not stop for any moment; continued to record positive growth terms, despite a slower pace; continued to maintain well-anchored inflationary expectations throughout; The additional costs that followed the blows generated by the international crisis were negligent and fully absorbable. This performance, and this immunity, is not a product of casual circumstances. The increased economic activity and stability of the financial sector reflect: successful coordination of economic policies undertaken before and during the crisis; carrying out structural reforms since before the crisis period and continuing them even during it; the particular care of the Bank of Albania, especially in the period before the crisis, in the direction of strengthening financial stability through a series of regulatory and administrative actions of bank supervision; ... 2/7 05/08/22, 16:59 Bank of Albania Governor Ardian Fullani's word at the roundtable: "Collateral, credit, market and law" 12 ... consolidation and expansion of the market through involvement in the banking supervision scheme of all nonbank financial operators, as well as through the licensing of new factoring operators. The current positive stage of economic development gives us the opportunity to deepen structural reforms on a long-term horizon, to cement the comparative advantages that the country has, seen in a context not only national and regional but even wider. Returning to previous growth rates, from a global perspective, is a difficult challenge which requires a combination of high soil, capital and labour productivity. In concrete terms, economic growth for 2010 has been at a 3.9% level. This economic growth is mainly supported by foreign demand and the growth of domestic exports, while domestic demand has seen slowdown. The Albanian economy is expected to reach a growth level of 5% for the next two years, thus reflecting optimistic expectations. The Bank of Albania, even in previous statements, has disclosed that the inflation rate is under control and, by the end of the year, this rate will remain within its target. The developments of the banking system show that its activity continues, albeit at lower rates compared to the period before the emergence of the international financial crisis. During the following 2010, the activity of the banking system has increased significantly, based on non-growth only deposits but also of the economic lending process, with about 18 and 10% respectively in annual terms, for the month of May 2011. The banking system follows with a satisfactory and well-capitalized liquidity. The capital sufficiency ratio reaches about 15%; significantly higher than the regulatory limit of 12%, which testifies to a satisfactory ability of the banking system to meet future development challenges. The Bank of Albania has been conducting periodic resistance tests. Pr kt qllim nevojitet q grupet e interesit t cilt kan shtje gjyqsore n proces, nprmjet prfaqsuesve t tyre ligjor, t nxisin paraqitjen e shtjeve n Gjykatn e Lart, ku do t ndiqet procedura pr krkimin e nj vendimi t unifikuar; t shikohet mundsia e rishikimit t kuadrit ligjor e rregullativ prkats pr t eliminuar t gjitha vshtirsit e identifikuara; aktor t ndryshm t tregut me interes n problematikn e ngritur, t ndihmojn pr zhvillimin e nj fushate sensibilizuese pr kt qllim; nprmjet asistencs s Euralius-it, t hartohet nj manual pr shtjet praktike q lidhen me ekzekutimin e kolateralit. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_z_Ardian_Fullani_ne_try 6/7 05/08/22, 16:59 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris z. Ardian Fullani n tryezn e rrumbullakt: Kolaterali, kredia, tregu dhe ligji 12  Kto masa do t jen objekt i diskutimeve n vijim. E rndsishme sht q, mbasi t biem dakord, ti prkthejm ato sa m shpejt n nj plan veprimi, me qllim zgjidhjen n koh t problemeve q lidhen me ekzekutimi e kolateralit. T nderuar zotrinj, Banka e Shqipris ka luajtur nj rol t madh duke qndruar si ruajts jo vetm pr stabilitetin makroekonomik, por edhe pr stabilitetin financiar t vendit. Makroprudenca ka qen fjala q ka mbizotruar komunikimin ton me tregun, autoritetet dhe me publikun e gjer. At e kemi prkthyer si nj domosdoshmri pr m shum kapital, m shum likuiditet, m shum aftsi paguese t sistemit bankar. Pr rrjedhoj, sektori bankar shqiptar, pr asnj ast, nuk ka prjetuar ngr. Banka e Shqipris i dha, dhe vazhdon ti jap, likuiditetin e nevojshm sistemit bankar, duke i sjell frymmarrjen e nevojshme jo vetm tregut, por gjith ekonomis. Politikat e kujdesshme dhe rregullimet ligjore t kryera n koh, nga njra an garantuan nj mbikqyrje bankare efektive dhe nga ana tjetr mundsuan nj shkall t knaqshme aksesi t biznesit ne kredin bankare. Sigurisht q bankat jan krijuar pr t dhn kredi, por, para s gjithash, duhet t mbajm parasysh se rndsi m t madhe se kreditimi i nj biznesi t veant apo se portofoli i nj banke t veant, prbn stabiliteti i depozitave t popullats; t individve t thjesht. Pr m tepr biznesi duhet t rikalibroj pozicionin e tij n raport me zhvillimet e fundit, si n ekonomin e brendshme ashtu edhe n at t jashtme. Ai duhet t synoj produktivitet m t lart, kryesisht nprmjet evidentimit t t gjith avantazheve krahasuese, n raport me spektrin e ndryshimeve globale. Banka e Shqipris ka qen dhe do t jet vokale n rolin dhe mbshtetjen e ekonomis me kredi. Vizioni i saj s ardhmes sht: m shum stabilitet, m shum investime t huaja, m shum kredi, pr t siguruar nj zhvillim t qndrueshm dhe nj integrim t natyrshm me familjen evropiane. Ju faleminderit! Title: Speech on the occasion of the closing ceremony of the Twinning Project
text: 06/08/2022, 09:18 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the discussion table: "For a healthy banking system... , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the discussion table: "For a healthy and efficient banking system in Albania. Activities and results achieved under the framework Twinning Project" Publication date: 04.07.2012 Honored participants, ... 1/10 06/08/2022, 09:18 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the discussion table: "For a healthy banking system... The Bank of Albania's development strategy includes rapidly approximating the institutional, legal and operational framework with the best standards of the EU Central Banks model, within the framework of Albania's major eu membership priority. To meet this challenge, the Bank of Albania became a party to the European Union-funded twinning project, which aimed to strengthen our institutional capacities, especially in the areas of banking supervision, statistics, payment systems and monetary policy implementation, benefiting from the experience and professionalism of the Bank of Italy and the Bank of France. This was a difficult project that contained challenging objectives that had to be achieved within a relatively short period of time. Its success would depend on the commitment and professionalization of the staff of participating institutions, as well as their ability to achieve real co-operation. After about 18 months of intensive joint work, today I have a special pleasure to participate and salute in this important activity that crowns the successful completion of the twinning project. In this case, I would like to express a special thanks to all the experts and structures involved in this project at the Bank of Italy and the Bank of France, for the commitment and professionalism shown. I also want to thank representatives of the European Union office in Tirana for the support and care they showed in terms of monitoring the project. The project was based on 6 main modules that are: ... 2/10 06/08/2022, 09:18 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the discussion table: "For a healthy banking system... Coordination of the European Integration Process Financial Education Supervision and Financial Stability Payment Systems Interbank Market Statistics The objective of the European Integration Process Coordination Module was implemented entirely by the Bank of France and consisted of the development and possession of the necessary coordinating instruments of the European integration process with the aim of preparing meetings at European level, as well as coordinating Albania's EU membership process. The Bank of France offered its experience in organising meetings at European level and managing the process of approximating banking legislation with communitarian acquis. The objective of the Financial Education module consisted of the development of research work activities in this area, relying on international best practices and European experience. In implementing this objective, surveys were conducted with the aim of measuring the overall financial culture in Albania as well as measuring the effectiveness of the Bank of Albania's educational activities for secondary education. Taking on the growing importance of financial education worldwide, part of this module was the organization of a high-level conference, to bring to Albania the best international experiences and various initiatives in this direction. Statistics and the payment system are two other areas in which the Bank of Albania benefited from this project. The implementation of this project enabled the creation of a modern infrastructure for compiling various macroeconomic statistics at the Bank of Albania, especially in the field of balance of payments. As far as the payment system is concerned, the project has carried out the revision of the regulatory framework, with the aim of developing and improving it in full adaptation to The BE's current directives and practices in this area. Further development of the interbank market represented one of the other components of project development, considering its remit in improving the transmission mechanism of monetary policy in the economy. The project had a considerable mock-up in the field of banking supervision and financial stability. The change in supervisory philosophy began in January 2010, with the creation of a new dynamic structure oriented towards identification and risk management. To this end, in addition to building human capacities that would enable its application in practice, the need for recognition and absorption at the immediacy of the best European standards arose. The Bank of Italy's valuable experience as one of the most prestigious institutions in Europe, within the framework of the Twinning Project, made it possible to adapt the Albanian supervisory process to the best European models ... 3/10 06/08/2022, 09:18 European. , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the discussion table: "For a healthy banking system... Without wanting to explain the projects in question, what the following presenters will do, I would like to stop at some of the key moments: First, migration from the current CAMELS assessment system has been realized towards an assessment model based on a broader spectrum of particular risks, as predicted by basel ii and III standards. This was the most intensive process of this project, which also required maximum staff engagement of the Bank of Albania during these 18 months. In the end, a new supervisory manual with European principles and methodology has been carried out, divided according to risks and with separate assessment systems. An important part of this supervisory framework is to improve the valuation of banks, beyond the figures, even with quality criteria. Second, the revision of the capital sufficiency regulation, whose project is drafted in accordance with BASEL II and the Capital Sufficiency Directive, was carried out. The review is accompanied by the presentation of the standard approach to credit risk and market risks and the simple and standard method for operational risk. For the very importance of this regulation, its project is currently being discussed with the banking industry. That third, to increase care for the stability of the financial system, several new techniques were adopted that enabled the fullest assessment of systemic risk, the exercise of resistance test with the bottom up approach was enriched, as well as worked to improve the models of indirect credit risk assessment. Honored participants, The twinning project focused the important part of its resources towards supervision and financial stability. Establishing this priority in addition to constant motivation with the perfection of the regulatory framework, supervisory activity and risk management, currently becomes more necessary from the added challenges associated with specific developments of recent years. Let me share with you the Bank of Albania's position on facing and overcoming these challenges. For the fourth year in a row, the Albanian economy is under the influence of the global economic and financial crisis. Its last phase, the sovereign debt crisis and its liaison with the balance sheets of the financial system, has put us on the front line. Our two largest trading and financial partners, Greece and Italy, are among the states most affected by it. Even in this unfavourable context, the Albanian economy has marked growth and maintained its financial and economic health. ... 4/10 06/08/2022, 09:18 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the discussion table: "For a healthy banking system... Private agents generally enjoy a healthy financial position, maintaining a relatively low debt level and positive savings rates during this period. The financial system has continued to credit the economy, unlike the countries of the region, albeit at slower rates and with somewhat tighter conditions. This response, supported by an appropriate and flexible regulatory framework, has been defining in promoting the restructuring of the economy towards the most profitable sectors. Looking to the future, the Bank of Albania estimates that the main risks threatening the country's economic stability relate to economic growth. A series of signals, coming from both the real and financial sectors, show that shrinking consumer balance sheets and slowing investments, so far used by private economic agents as crisis safeguards, could turn to the detriment of the medium-term prospect of economic growth. The tendency to save and delay investmentrisks affecting the economy's competitive advantages and its growth potential. On the other hand, the deleveraging process, driven mostly by regulatory requirements not related to the state of the local economy, could damage installed financing channels for the economy, which have so far been an important component of growth. The Bank of Albania considers that the current situation requires greater attention and courage from all economic agents, in the direction of making appropriate development decisions and in response to challenges arising from the external environment. At a more general level, the Bank of Albania believes that implementing appropriate macroeconomic policies, harmonizing monetary and fiscal policies, is a prerequisite for the country's sustainable and long-term development. They must have two main components: the first to support the growth and sustainable development of the country's economy, and the second, to orient long-term development through the promotion of structural reforms. The Bank of Albania estimates that the Albanian economy is a flexible economy, with an infrastructure of basic services, financial services and the growing regulatory environment and continuous improvement, as well as with a competitive workforce in terms of cost and with increased qualification. However, a series of indicators of the degree of competitiveness of the Albanian economy show that we still have much work to do in this direction, to cope with competition at the regional and global level. For its part, the Bank of Albania has committed to maintaining the monetary and financial stability of the economy. We intend to carry out this objective in a continuous way through: a) a careful monetary policy, achieving to ensure the Albanian economy a level of ... 5/10 06/08/2022, 09:18 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the discussion table: "For a healthy banking system... stable prices, respecting our inflation target and anchoring long-term expectations of the economy. This has made it possible to increase space to better harmonise short-term stimulation of economic activity with its long-term sustainability. In response to the blows we suffered, we have pursued a progressively easing monetary policy starting in 2009. This monetary policy has brought basic interest rates to their historic lowest level, in boosting consumption and investment in the country. Also, undermining the nominal and real exchange rate has offered another stimulus channel for the Albanian economy, boosting exports and discouraging imports. We have continuously adapted to the framework of our monetary operations, guaranteeing an increasing supply of the economy with liquidity versus an expanded collateral base and increasing maturity deadlines. Following the current state of the Albanian economy, we believe that the kahu of macroeconomic policies should be stimulating even in the future. The need for economic stimulus policies is conditioned in the first place by the fact that the Albanian economy is operating below its potential, as a result of the inability of demand to guarantee full exploitation of capacities. In the second place, it is enabled by short-term and medium-term controlled risks to economic stability. Within the framework of harmonisation between fiscal and monetary policy, the Bank of Albania has supported increasing fiscal policy orientation towards budgetary consolidation. In response to progress in this direction, we remain ready to respond in a short time to any public sector consolidation initiatives. Our easing measures will remain within the legal framework of the Bank of Albania's instruments and will be in line with the consolidated philosophy of central banks' action. Monetary policy can succeed, unless the mechanism of its transmission to the economy is functional. In this context, the banking system has a very important role, as the first area of the transmission mechanism. b) a careful supervisory and regulatory policy, enabling the preservation of sound balances of the financial system and the private sector of the economy. Thanks to taking timely measures to control credit, capital and liquidity risks, the Albanian economy has successfully resisted the shock coming from global financial markets and is already presented with consolidated financial stability and a banking system capable of doing its job of supporting the Albanian economy with loans. Maintaining the sustainability of the banking sector is one of the two basic priorities of the Bank of Albania's activity. For this reason, I take advantage of the case to attract the leading attention of the banking industry, to engage maximumly, to act in full compliance with the supervisory legal and regulatory framework, while simultaneously respecting the standards of sound direction of banking activity. Our main objective continues to remain unchanged and is preserved unaffected by further strengthening public confidence in the banking sector For this purpose the banking system must: ... 6/10 06/08/2022, 09:18 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the discussion table: "For a healthy banking system... further public confidence in the banking sector. To this end, the banking system must: Continuously verify the suitability and aim to strengthen internal control systems; To continuously empower risk assessment and management capacities; Keep capital and liquidity indicators at appropriate levels at all costs. To this end, the system must monitor on a daily basis the performance of the bank's obligations, with the aim of creating and maintaining the necessary size of the secular acetate for their atonement; Factor in capital requirements, expected developments in the future. Injecting additional capital from shareholders should consider creating a security zone in the value of capital, towards unexpected developments in the future. Therefore, banks must carefully interpret the profit distribution requirements in the form of a dividend. The performance of credit quality represents the main problem currently facing the banking sector. The increase in troubled loans increases the level of stress in banking activity and lowers the sector's contribution to financial mediation and support for economic growth in the country. The Bank of Albania has followed this situation with concern by focusing on the following directions: The most accurate evidence of the problem, through the conduct of inspections and verification of procedures by which banks assess quality and categorize credit; Creation of the respective reserve funds in the size and time needed; The incentive for banks to address the problem through the most established initiatives for executing collateral of lost loans. Our assessment has been and remains that only in this way are conditions created for faster recognition and treatment of the problem, avoiding its scope in time and reducing uncertainties for the future. The banking industry has added reactions to a review of the supervisory regulatory framework, with the aim of mitigating it in dealing with troubled loans. The Bank of Albania is open to considering any valid and realistic banking industry proposals in this direction, as long as they do not bring weakening of the banking sector's adhesion in a situation with unclear developments. By stopping more concretely in some recent opinions, we deem inappropriate the demand made for lower-value procurement as we are dealing with an unrealistic improvement in the position of event capitalization. I take the opportunity to explain public opinion that in this direction, the rates applied by us are fully consistent with the experiences of other countries and in some cases they are lower. This assistance can come in various forms, including those of restructuring in the most appropriate way for the parties. On this issue, the Bank of Albania wants assess the possibilities and forms for this process to become more stimulating for the bank as well. As for considering the value of collateral for lowering the value of banks' risky assets, the Bank of Albania remains of the opinion that the concentration of collateral in the form of real estate, as well as the difficulties still facing in its execution and the recovery of the value of the lost loan, devalue from the start such an initiative. It is necessary that some improvements to the legal and regulatory framework, as already identified by joint working groups with the banking industry, be implemented and implemented correctly, so that collateral gains its optimal value. In conclusion, the banking industry must testify that it is active in dealing with troubled loans and releasing resources into the balance sheet for further supporting activity. This is also the best form to test the real possibilities that exist, which can then be supported by careful changes in the supervisory regulatory framework. Our common goal is to ensure that the value of troubled loans interrupts its growth, as well as gradually improve. In the banking sector there are banks that thanks to careful work at 2-3 In recent years in the relationship with their customers have managed to significantly lower the ratio of troubled loans, resulting in satisfactory lending rhythms. The way their work is organised and directed should be an example for other banks in the banking sector. Honored participants, The legal and regulatory framework we have built so far is complete and in line with the best international standards. Of course, as in any other area he is subject to the need for continuous improvement. However, our consolidated opinion is that all OF US and the factors involved must fully exasperate all the spaces that exist before us, and of course the hand will take further steps to further reform the institutional and legal framework. More specifically, the banking industry and the business community must work more closely with each other. I believe there is a lot of scope for more fruitful understanding and cooperation. Business and the banking sector emerge from the trunk and co-operate on the challenges of the future. Currently the banking system is willing to increase the support of the economy with loans. This fact was confirmed to me in the first two days with the executives of the five largest banks. I personally pushed the banking system for a more active approach to lending. Believe me it's a real challenge, where many institutions and interest groups are involved. To this end, I would invite all other actors to be open-minded and very cooperative in this direction with the aim of re-crediting the economy. ... 8/10 06/08/2022, 09:18 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, at the discussion table: "For a healthy banking system... First, I would suggest that the business community be more creative, transparent and more formal in its activity. He must carefully respect all contractual obligations arising from the relationship with the banking system. This is necessary to be understood and widely accepted. A correction process in the economy is necessary, which would first of all mean a rebalancing of prices. There can be no reduction of troubled loans, increased credit for the economy, healthy balance sheets of businesses and banks, as long as we do not have collateral execution and consequently correction of fixed assets prices. This process would free up very large financial resources that would be a vital fresh money serum to inject back into the economy. With fresh money we must promote the creation of new, effective and rapidly returning initiatives on investment. One of the lessons learned from the crisis is for any healthy new money to go to a healthy business initiative. Currently, we must promote high-productive manufacturing sectors. Only in this way will we ensure the revitalization of the economy to make it worthy European partners. Second, I would ask the banking system to be more dynamic and in constant search of the opportunities that deserve to be supported with financing. Offer reliable financing packages by prioritising the country's economic soundness, which in return would also guarantee the long-term success of your business. Do your best to increase your authority and lobbying ability with Albanian executive with parliament and justice system. Take a public stand for every case so that the scale of speculation and abuse with the truth decreases to the maximum. Co-operation between state bodies and the banking system can also be fruitful in a direction of more specific presentation of developer programmes and support with financial and concessional assistance for sectors, branches, important operators including foreign investors. Fourth, I would vitally appreciate a broad understanding and consensus of the entire political spectrum in support of the Bank of Albania's efforts and movements towards preserving the country's macrofinancial stability. We remain open to continually explaining our past institutional decision-making and what will follow in the future. We remain unchanged in our position that a central bank is successful and enjoys the public's confidence when its decision is independent, forward-minded and fully transparent. S fundmi, por jo m pak e rndsishme, do t doja q publiku i gjer shqiptar t vazhdoj t tregohet i matur dhe besim plot ndaj arkitekturs financiare q kemi ndrtuar. sht pr tu prshndetur kujdesi i shtuar i tij i cili pasqyrohet n prirjen e tij pr t rritur kursimet. Prfitoj nga rasti t prsris edhe njher q me qndrimin ton optimist ti japim form t tashmes dhe t ardhmes son. Ne vlersojm se ka ardhur momenti q sentimenti konsumator i popullats t filloj rritjen. Kjo do t krijonte at reaksion zinxhir aq t dshiruar t prshpejtimit t qarkullimit t paras dhe mallrave n ekonomi duke mundsuar kshtu gjallrimin e aktivitetit ekonomik t vendit n parametrat e parakrizs. M lejoni q edhe nj her t shpreh vlersimin tim personal dhe t Banks se Shqipris, pr Bankn e Italis dhe Bankn e Francs, pr ndihmn dhe partneritetin q treguan gjat projektit t binjakzimit.
