Title: Speech at the joint press conference of the IMF mission with the Ministry of Finance and the Bank of Albania
text: , Mr. Ardian Fullani in the conf... animated by the Joint Vienna Institute on the occasion of the 20th anniversary of creation 29/07/22, 14:55 , Mr Ardian Fullani at the high-level conference organised by the Join Vienna Institute on the occasion of the 20th anniversary of the creation Publication date: 12.07.2012 Honorable ladies and gentlemen, It is an honor and privilege for me to welcome this conference marking the 20th anniversary of the Ent Vienna Institute. It is also great pleasure for me to be given the opportunity to share with you my thoughts regarding current global developments and their implications for our economies. Despite several certain episodes of disorders and imbalances, much of the last two decades has been characterized by a general political commitment towards the free market and reforms throughout the Southeast European region. As a result, all economies scored extraordinary achievements, which led to rapid and stable convergence. These developments were supported by a similar commitment on the part of the EU's public and private sectors, particularly the financial sector, towards the economies of Central, Eastern and Southeast Europe. Albania, so far, is one of these success stories. For 20 years, our country has undertaken considerable reforms, with the sole aim of bringing the united European family closer together. From painful reforms of broad price liberalisation, followed by the beginning of the implementation of a free exchange rate regime and complete liberalisation of current account and capital, to the most sophisticated current reforms, Albania has ... r_nga_Joint_Vienna_Institute_me_rastin_e_20_vjetorit_te_krijimit.html Page 1 of 5 , Mr. Ardian Fullani in the conf... animated by the Joint Vienna Institute on the occasion of the 20th anniversary of creation 29/07/22, 14:55 made considerable progress towards establishing democracy and free market principles. In most of this period, economic activity has been stable and key indicators, such as inflation, budget deficit, exchange rate and unemployment rate, have had a positive performance, ensuring a sound and stable macroeconomic environment. The financial system has become an important factor in supporting economic activity. The banking industry, the dominant segment of the financial sector, has contributed significantly to overall developments, significantly increasing financial mediation. The process has reflected and is dominated by the involvement of important European banking groups operating in Albania, as well as in other Balkan countries. After this short picture, let me make some comments on the recent challenges and difficulties facing our economies. Last year and the first half of this year showed that the crisis that began in 2008 has reached its most acute stage, characterized by a bilateral link between sovereign debt and the banking system crisis. For analogy, I would like to use the title of the memorable film Enemy at the Gate, to describe the situation weighed down in our region, especially in Albania, as a result of the difficult economic situation of our southern neighbour Greece, as well as the situation in Italy and the rest of Europe. About 80% of our trade and financial exchanges are conducted with these countries. After several years of economic and financial crisis, our economies have shown an extraordinary ability to confront it. This is not a coincidence. Rather, it is the testament of the careful work done before and during the crisis. Coordinating monetary and fiscal policy actions throughout the region and Albania has been successful in mitigating the negative impacts of the crisis. In particular, central banks have taken unprecedented steps through their monetary, liquidity and macroprudential policy instruments. Much has been done and achieved in the direction of providing amenities to financial markets, ensuring the transfer of sovereign debt and maintaining macroeconomic stability. However, in the long term, macrofinancial stability is exposed to certain potential risks. The Southeast European region is struggling to preserve the relatively sound economic and financial progress achieved in the last 20 years of the post-communist era. Currently, the region is characterized by weak economic activity, accompanied by high unemployment, low inflationary pressures and rising levels of troubled loans. All economies are operating below their potential, mainly due to anemic credit growth, loss of confidence in the internal economy and weak economic activity in the EU. And last, but not least, ... r_nga_Joint_Vienna_Institute_me_rastin_e_20_vjetorit_te_krijimit.html Page 2 of 5 , Mr. Ardian Fullani in the conf... animated by the Joint Vienna Institute on the occasion of the 20th anniversary of creation 29/07/22, 14:55 The loss of competitiveness and slowing structural reforms are acting as barriers to economic growth in the long term. Since the end of 2011, in addition to these pressures, we have been facing a new problem. More specifically, I refer to the rapid and significant reduction in exposure of foreign banking groups to private and public debt, as part of their objectives of rapidwithdrawal from debt exposure to the private and public sectors, or as deleveraging is otherwise known. This process was not reasoned on the situation in Albania, but was suddenly imposed from abroad, creating significant difficulties in financing public debt, as well as for private consumption and investment activities. All these negative implications can further censor financial and fiscal stability. I believe that the totality of recent measures to strengthen financial stability in Eurozone countries has taken the form of a closed economy approach. These measures have not sufficiently considered the major implications in developing European countries. In general, meeting the EBA's recommendations regarding the implementation of policies, which have resulted in the rapid withdrawal of debt exposure to the private and public sector, at group level in the Eurozone, has created major problems at subsidiary level in emerging market economies. Thus, it has influenced the prospects for economic growth and confidence at both the group level and at the level of local economies. What I mean is that the financial burden of these rules is not shared proportionally between countries of origin and host countries, and between Eurozone countries and developing European countries. This non-proportionality is greater in those countries with transitional economies where financial mediation is based almost exclusively on internal sources. For example, at the end of 2008, the total loan stock for the economy in Albania covered only 62% of the total deposit. The currency loan stock was financed almost entirely by total deposits in currencies, while lines of credit from the mother banks for their subsidiaries and branches have been at negliging levels. In principle, financial mediation is always financed in internal markets. He has not imposed financial restrictions on the balance sheet of the mother bank, but nevertheless, we had to bear a burden that seems unfair. In fact, as a result of the interpretation of the EBA regulation, one of the foreign banks operating in Albania reduced exposure to Albanian government debt by 3 percentage points of GDP within about a quarterly period. These actions caused liquidity-level imbalances in the interbank market, which could not be resolved in a quick time due to structural problems. These imbalances were accompanied by interest rate increases for government debt value letters, limiting the mechanism of monetary policy transmission. Reducing exposure to letters worth of government debt does not coincide with an increase in ... r_nga_Joint_Vienna_Institute_me_rastin_e_20_vjetorit_te_krijimit.html Page 3 of 5 , Mr. Ardian Fullani in the conf... animated by the Joint Vienna Institute on the occasion of the 20th anniversary of creation 29/07/22, 14:55 similar exposure to credit for the private sector, contributing to lower credit growth. All this comes at a time when possible absorbing mechanisms (towards fiscal space) and public confidence in the economy have decreased, leaving no additional space for added economic incentives. On the other hand, certain creative measures to stimulate credit and economic growth through the implementation of a nontraditional monetary policy and more relaxed supervisory requirements are potentially dangerous. In an extremely uncertain economic environment, they can stimulate further deterioration of banks' balance sheets, without having a major impact on economic activity. This is also the sequence of current economic problems facing our entire region. In general, while many of the measures taken by European authorities in the last three years have been necessary and important, they have given the impression that they have been undertaken late, without much enthusiasm and with hesitation towards a more Europe approach, as well as not properly considering the impact on neighbouring countries. And most importantly, these measures have not curbed the negative medium-term impact of the financial crisis on economic activity, thus promoting the need for a better and timely balance between austerity and pro-growth measures. Honored ladies and gentlemen, In our vision, integration represents a journey between friends and partners towards a common goal or destination. Because our economies are getting closer and closer to each other and because our financial systems need to be seen as a whole, we believe we need to be prepared and willing to share both the benefits and costs of this process. We are fully aware of the benefits and already, we have enjoyed their fruits. At the same time, we are becoming aware of the possible costs of this process, which come mainly from asymmetric shocks and uncoordinated political actions. For these reasons, I take this opportunity to appeal to all relevant EU decision-makers to consider, with the same attention, the impact of their decisions on the economies found in the convergence process. We're in the same boat and I think we should drive in the same direction. Looking towards European countries with developing economies, we note that there is a great need to link previous policies that facilitated incoming capital flows into the region's economies with measures that would ensure the continuity of liquidity needed, at the moment these flows stop or change direction. Our countries must benefit from swap or similar agreements in order to enable us to benefit from short-term liquidity in currencies. Because of the interconnections of our financial systems, I think this issue deserves ... r_nga_Joint_Vienna_Institute_me_rastin_e_20_vjetorit_te_krijimit.html Page 4 of 5 , Mr. Ardian Fullani in the conf... animated by the Joint Vienna Institute on the occasion of the 20th anniversary of creation 29/07/22, 14:55 greater attention in the future. Specifically, our partners, international development institutions and financial funds should encourage and facilitate the complex agenda of reforms and economic growth that supports the convergence process. We must create the right incentives for decision-makers and economic agents in countries with developing economies. Convergence, in itself, is a structural process. For this reason, all development institutions must preserve and increase support for economic growth and stability in the region. We must learn the right lessons from the crisis: identified weaknesses must turn them into development priorities and integrate them into our growth agenda for the future. The questions that naturally arise are: What is the best economic model? What resources will fund the improvement of these economies? How will the convergence of these economies be achieved and how will employment be secured? Our economies are small, taken apart. However, we must look at the big picture and understand that our region, taken as a whole, represents a large and vital market. N pjesn m t madhe t ksaj periudhe, aktiviteti ekonomik ka qen i qndrueshm dhe treguesit kryesor, si inflacioni, deficiti buxhetor, kursi i kmbimit dhe norma e papunsis, kan pasur nj ecuri pozitive, duke siguruar nj mjedis makroekonomik t shndosh dhe t qndrueshm. Sistemi financiar sht br faktor i rndsishm n mbshtetjen e aktivitetit ekonomik. Industria bankare, segmenti mbizotrues i sektorit financiar, ka kontribuar n mnyr t konsiderueshme n zhvillimet e prgjithshme, duke rritur ndjeshm ndrmjetsimin financiar. Procesi ka reflektuar dhe sht dominuar nga prfshirja e grupeve t rndsishme bankare evropiane q veprojn n Shqipri, si dhe n vende t tjera t Ballkanit. Pas ksaj tabloje t shkurtr, m lejoni t bj disa komente mbi sfidat e fundit dhe vshtirsit, me t cilat po prballen ekonomit tona. Viti i kaluar dhe gjysma e par e ktij viti treguan se kriza q filloi n vitin 2008 ka arritur n fazn e saj m akute, e karakterizuar nga nj lidhje e ndrsjell midis borxhit sovran dhe krizs s sistemit bankar. Pr analogji, do t doja pr prdorja titullin e filmit t paharrueshm Armiku tek Porta , pr t prshkruar situatn e rnduar n rajonin ton, e veanrisht n Shqipri, si rezultat i gjendjes s vshtir ekonomike t fqinjit ton jugor, Greqis, si dhe t situats n Itali dhe n pjesn tjetr t Evrops. Rreth 80% e shkmbimeve tona tregtare dhe financiare kryhen me kto vende. Pas disa vitesh t krizs ekonomike dhe financiare, ekonomit tona kan treguar nj aftsi t jashtzakonshme n prballjen me t. Kjo nuk sht nj rastsi. Prkundrazi, sht testamenti i puns s kujdesshme t kryer para dhe gjat krizs. Koordinimi i veprimeve t politiks monetare dhe asaj fiskale n mbar rajonin dhe n Shqipri ka qen i suksesshm n zbutjen e ndikimeve negative t krizs. N veanti, bankat qendrore kan ndrmarr hapa t paprecedent prmes instrumenteve t tyre monetar, t likuiditetit dhe t politiks makroprudente. Shum sht br dhe arritur n drejtim t ofrimit t lehtsirave pr tregjet financiare, duke siguruar transferimin e borxhit sovran dhe ruajtjen e stabilitetit makroekonomik. Megjithat, n periudhn afatgjat, stabiliteti makrofinanciar sht i ekspozuar ndaj disa rreziqeve t caktuara t mundshme. Rajoni i Evrops Juglindore po lufton q ta ruaj progresin relativisht t shndosh ekonomik dhe financiar t arritur n 20 vitet e fundit t epoks post-komuniste. Aktualisht, rajoni karakterizohet nga nj aktivitet i dobt ekonomik, i shoqruar nga papunsi e lart, presione t ulta inflacioniste dhe rritje t nivelit t kredive me probleme. T gjitha ekonomit po operojn nn potencialin e tyre, kryesisht pr shkak t rritjes anemike t kredis, humbjes s besimit n ekonomin e brendshme dhe aktivitetit t dobt ekonomik n BE. Q prej fundit t vitit 2011, krahas ktyre presioneve, po prballemi me nj problem t ri. M konkretisht, i referohem uljes s shpejt dhe t konsiderueshme t ekspozimit t grupeve t huaja bankare ndaj borxhit privat dhe atij publik, si pjes e objektivave t tyre t trheqjes s shpejt nga ekspozimi i borxhit prkundrejt sektorit privat dhe atij publik, apo si njihet ndryshe deleveraging. Ky proces nuk u arsyetua mbi gjendjen n Shqipri, por u imponua n mnyr t papritur nga jasht, duke krijuar vshtirsi t konsiderueshme pr financimin e borxhit publik, si dhe pr konsumin privat dhe veprimtarit e investimit. T gjitha kto implikime negative mund t cenojn m tej stabilitetin financiar dhe at fiskal. Besoj se trsia e masave t fundit pr forcimin e stabilitetit financiar n vendet e Eurozons ka marr formn e nj prqasjeje t nj ekonomie t mbyllur. Kto masa nuk kan konsideruar n mnyr t mjaftueshme implikimet e mdha n vendet evropiane n zhvillim. N prgjithsi, prmbushja e rekomandimeve t EBA-s lidhur me zbatimin e politikave, q kan rezultuar n trheqjen e shpejt ndaj ekspozimit t borxhit prkundrejt sektorit privat dhe atij publik, n nivel grupi n Eurozon, ka krijuar probleme t mdha n nivel filialesh n ekonomit me treg n zhvillim. Kshtu, ajo ka ndikuar n perspektivat pr rritjen ekonomike dhe n besimin si n nivel grupi, ashtu dhe n nivel t ekonomive lokale. Ajo far dua t them sht se barra financiare e ktyre rregullave nuk ndahet proporcionalisht midis vendeve t origjins dhe atyre pritse, dhe midis vendeve t Eurozons dhe atyre evropiane n zhvillim. Ky jo-proporcionalitet sht m i madh n ato vende me ekonomi n tranzicion ku ndrmjetsimi financiar sht mbshtetur pothuajse ekskluzivisht n burime t brendshme. Pr shembull, n fund t vitit 2008, stoku i prgjithshm i kredis pr ekonomin n Shqipri mbulonte vetm 62% t totalit t depozitave. Stoku i kredis n valut u financua pothuajse trsisht nga totali i depozitave n valut, ndrkoh q linjat e kredis nga bankat mma pr filialet dhe degt e tyre kan qen n nivele t paprfillshme. N parim, ndrmjetsimi financiar sht financuar gjithmon n tregjet e brendshme. Ai nuk ka imponuar kufizime financiare n bilancin e banks mm, por megjithat, ne na u desh t mbanim nj barr q duket e padrejt. N fakt, si rezultat i interpretimit t rregullores s EBA-s, nj nga bankat e huaja q operon n Shqipri e uli ekspozimin ndaj borxhit t qeveris shqiptare me 3 pik prqindjeje t PBB-s brenda rreth nj periudhe tremujore. Kto veprime shkaktuan zhbalancime n nivelin e likuiditetit n tregun ndrbankar, t cilat nuk mund t zgjidheshin n nj koh t shpejt pr shkak t problemeve strukturore. Kto zhbalancime u shoqruan me rritje t norms s interesit pr letrat me vler t borxhit t qeveris, duke kufizuar mekanizmin e transmetimit t politiks monetare. E gjith kjo vjen n nj koh kur mekanizmat e mundshm absorbues (n drejtim t hapsirs fiskale) dhe besimi i publikut n ekonomi jan ulur, duke mos ln hapsira shtes pr stimuj t shtuar ekonomik. Nga ana tjetr, masa t caktuara kreative pr stimulimin e kredis dhe t rritjes ekonomike prmes zbatimit t nj politike monetare jotradicionale dhe krkesave mbikqyrse m t lehtsuara jan potencialisht t rrezikshme. N nj mjedis tejet t pasigurt ekonomik, ato mund t stimulojn prkeqsimin e mtejshm t bilancit t bankave, pa pasur ndikim t madh mbi aktivitetin ekonomik. Kjo sht dhe sekuenca e problemeve aktuale ekonomike, me t cilat po prballet mbar rajoni yn. N prgjithsi, ndrsa shum prej masave t ndrmarra nga autoritetet evropiane n tre vitet e fundit kan qen t nevojshme dhe t rndsishme, ato kan dhn prshtypjen sikur jan ndrmarr von, pa shum entuziazm dhe me hezitim ndaj nj prqasjeje m shum Evrop , si dhe duke mos konsideruar si duhet ndikimin mbi vendet fqinje. Dhe m e rndsishmja, kto masa nuk kan frenuar ndikimin negativ afatmesm t krizs financiare n aktivitetin ekonomik, duke nxitur kshtu nevojn pr nj balanc m t mir dhe n koh midis masave shtrnguese dhe atyre t pro-rritjes . T nderuar zonja dhe zotrinj, N vizionin ton, integrimi prfaqson nj udhtim n mes miqsh dhe partnersh drejt nj objektivi ose destinacioni t prbashkt. Duke qen se ekonomit tona po afrohen gjithnj e m tepr me njra-tjetrn dhe pr shkak se sistemet tona financiare duhen par si nj i tr, ne besojm se duhet t jemi t prgatitur dhe t gatshm pr t ndar si prfitimet, ashtu dhe kostot e ktij procesi. Ne jemi trsisht t vetdijshm pr prfitimet dhe tashm, i kemi shijuar frytet e tyre. N t njjtn koh, po bhemi t vetdijshm pr kostot e mundshme t ktij procesi, t cilat vijn kryesisht nga goditjet asimetrike dhe veprimet e pakoordinuara politike. Pr kto arsye, prfitoj nga kjo mundsi pr t u br nj apel t gjith vendimmarrsve prkats t BE-s, q t konsiderojn, me po t njjtn vmendje, ndikimin e vendimeve t tyre n ekonomit q gjenden n procesin e konvergjencs. Ne gjendemi n t njjtn vark dhe besoj se duhet t vozisim n t njjtin drejtim. Duke hedhur vshtrimin drejt vendeve evropiane me ekonomi n zhvillim, vrejm se ekziston nj nevoj e madhe pr t lidhur politikat e mparshme q lehtsuan flukset hyrse t kapitalit n ekonomit e rajonit me masa q do t siguronin vazhdimsin e likuiditetit t nevojshm, n momentin q kto flukse ndalojn ose ndryshojn drejtim. Vendet tona duhet t prfitojn marrveshje swap ose t ngjashme, me qllim q t na mundsohet prfitimi i likuiditetit afatshkurtr n valut. N mnyr t veant, partnert tan, institucionet ndrkombtare t zhvillimit dhe fondet financiare duhet t inkurajojn dhe lehtsojn axhendn komplekse t reformave dhe t rritjes ekonomike q mbshtet procesin e konvergjencs. Ne duhet t krijojm stimujt e duhur pr vendimmarrsit dhe agjentt ekonomik n vendet me ekonomi n zhvillim. Konvergjenca, n vetvete, sht nj proces strukturor. Pr kt arsye, t gjitha institucionet e zhvillimit duhet t ruajn dhe t rrisin mbshtetjen pr rritje ekonomike dhe stabilitet n rajon. Ne duhet t nxjerrim msimet e duhura nga kriza: dobsit e identifikuara duhet t i shndrrojm n prioritete t zhvillimit dhe t i integrojm n agjendn ton t rritjes pr t ardhmen. Pyetjet q lindin natyrshm jan: Cili sht modeli m i mir ekonomik? Cilat burime do t financojn prmirsimin e ktyre ekonomive? Si do t arrihet konvergjenca e ktyre ekonomive dhe si do t sigurohet punsimi? Ekonomit tona jan t vogla, marr ve e ve. Megjithat, ne duhet t shikojm tablon e madhe dhe t kuptojm se rajoni yn, i marr si nj i tr, prfaqson nj treg t madh dhe vital. Besoj se duke punuar s bashku si partner, ne mund t korrim suksese. text: , Mr. Ardian Fullani, UK... national currency, National History Museum, October 25, 2012 29/07/22, 14:55 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, held at the opening of the Bank of Albania themed exhibition "100 Years of Independence: Reflection of History in the National Currency", National Historical Museum, October 25, 2012 Publication date: 25.10.2012 Twenty years ago, in February 1992, the governments of 12 European Union countries signed a treaty in the Dutch city of Maastiricht, whereby they committed to adopting a common currency. On New Year's Eve 2002, ten years ago, the lights on the highest floors of European central banks always stayed on. Governors and their closest associates slept a little. Preparations for the Euro presentation were punctuated, but this was an experiment not tried before. There were no similar actions where they could be based and variables in the game were numerous. While 20 years ago, we Albanians relived the experience of very important historical changes, full of concerns and enthusiasm no less powerful than that experienced by our ancestors who founded the Albanian State 100 years ago. It was this year, which was marked for the European monetary system, that substantial economic changes occurred in our country, among other things. We are transforming this that would give life to the two-tier banking system and pave the way for the creation of a central bank with contemporary features and functions. The last 20 years showed the unprecedented value of an independent central bank, as one of the cornerstones of the Albanian State and its efforts in years to preserve the value of the national currency LEKUT. ... ne_monedhen_kombetare_Muzeu_Historik_Kombetar_25_tetor_2012.html Page 1 of 3 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, UK... national currency, National History Museum, October 25, 2012 29/07/22, 14:55 These 20 years for the Albanian economy have certainly not been the same as those of our European neighbours, but the developments show without question that it is already oriented towards a developed market economy and final integration into the European Union. This period has shown how important structural reforms the Albanian economy undertook are, making it more competitive and protected from the crisis. Through this exhibition organised on the occasion of the celebration of the 100th anniversary of Albania's declaration of independence, the Bank of Albania is proud to recall one of the most key aspects of the country's state-building process, which is not usually paid the same attention as political events, military events and real economy developments themselves. This aspect is the story of our national currency. But at the same time we want to bring to attention that, as is also highlighted by that part of the exhibition dedicated to monetary circulation during the period of antiquity, in historical Albanian traditions since the 19th century. IV bc, when the first local currency was cut on the rock market, Europe's main currencies were circulated. Another not-less important message that seeks to broadcast this exhibition is that Albania's history is closely related to that of the rest of the old continent to which it irreversibly belongs, and that despite historical deviations, its future is predetermined to be European. Although our national currency could not be established as the currency of the Albanian State immediately after the declaration of Independence, the events and peripections of its history contribute best to the confession of the history of our country, amid the difficulties and hopes of the time. As one of the most important symbols of a sovereign state, the issue of the Albanian national currency and consequently the creation of a national central bank was one of the main projects and aspirations of Albania's fathers and ideologues. Thanks to it, Albania aspired to enjoy not only political independence but also economic independence - it would serve not only the development of the country's economy but also to consolidate its independence. In his speech, delivered a few days after the signing of the agreement on the creation of the National Bank of Albania, Ismail Iikesaid: Like every man, who as rich as he is needs loans, even according to the loans he has It is understood how much his honor is. Thus, states need loans and are praised for the loan they have in the bay of general scholarships. This expression of Ismail Iiis is as old and old as the time, because what was proven today is that the sovereignty of the countries depends on the price of government obligations on the market. Dear participants, The history of the coin is as ancient as the world itself. To whom would it go to mind that axes would be the main means of exchange in our region that replaced money in ancient times. To the greatest surprise this would be the first stateless currency and instead of the figures of kings, princes or scholars in it, bridges, maps, arches, buildings, stars would take place, and so on. And more surprising would be that this currency, out of a specific responsibility of a state, would turn into a common responsibility. But so surprising is the prediction Victor Hygo made in 1855 when he said: A continental currency based on trust and precious metals, which constitutes the basis of capital of all Europe, and supported by the activity of a 200 million population: this single currency will replace and extract from circulation all other absurd types of money circulating today, along with princely images and their swelling. But this coin still has a long way to go in the blacksmith's doll. So our road with the lek is still long. The features, quality and technical characteristics of the money are part of its creditworthiness. But certainly what characterizes the true value of money is its purchasing power. In these 20 years the Bank of Albania has managed to provide a healthy, reliable and beloved currency for all Albanians. Finally, I would like to stress that this year has been a marked year for numismatics with the release of a series dedicated to the 100th anniversary of independence, a series which we are presenting to you at the exhibition we are inaugurating today. I wish that through this exhibition we have created an idea on the travel of our national currency and consequently, also the current monetary system. I hope that all visitors want to visit such exhibitions again, as the time when the Bank of Albania will open its museum is near. To carry out this project we are addressed to historians, economists, librarians, archivists, artists, communication experts and national and international architects. The final result will stem from detailed co-operation between the academic world, institutions, cultural industry and the Bank of Albania. Ardian Fullani, mbis n monedhn kombtare", Muzeu Historik Kombtar, 25 tetor 2012 29/07/22, 14:55 Kta 20 vjet pr ekonomin shqiptare sigurisht q nuk kan qen t njjt me ata t fqinjve tan evropian por zhvillimet tregojn pa diskutim se ajo sht tashm e orientuar drejt nj ekonomie tregu t zhvilluar dhe integrimit prfundimtar n Bashkimin Evropian. Kjo periudh ka treguar sesa t rndsishme jan reformat strukturore q ndrmori ekonomia shqiptare, duke e br at m konkurruese dhe m t mbrojtur nga kriza. Me an t ksaj ekspozite t organizuar me rastin e kremtimit t 100-vjetorit t shpalljes s Pavarsis s Shqipris, Banka e Shqipris sht krenare t rikujtoj nj prej aspekteve m kryesore t procesit shtetformues t vendit, t cilit zakonisht nuk i kushtohet e njjta vmendje si ngjarjeve politike, atyre ushtarake dhe vet zhvillimeve t ekonomis reale. Ky aspekt sht historia e monedhs son kombtare. Por, njkohsit duam t sjellim n vmendje se, ashtu si del n pah edhe nga ajo pjes e ekspozits kushtuar qarkullimit monetar gjat periudhs s lashtsis, n trevat historike shqiptare q n shek. IV para e.s, kur u pre monedha e par vendase n tregun e shkmbit, kan qarkulluar monedhat m kryesore t Evrops. Nj mesazh tjetr jo m pak i rndsishm q krkon t transmetoj kjo ekspozit sht se historia e Shqipris sht e lidhur ngusht me at t pjess tjetr t kontinentit t vjetr t cilit i prket n mnyr t pakthyeshme, e se pavarsisht devijimeve historike, e ardhmja e saj sht paracaktuar t jet evropiane. Megjithse monedha jon kombtare nuk mundi t instituohej si valuta e Shtetit Shqiptar menjher pas shpalljes s Pavarsis, ngjarjet dhe peripecit e historis s saj, kontribuojn m s miri n rrfimin e historis s vendit ton, mes vshtirsive dhe shpresave t kohs. Si nj prej simboleve m t rndsishme t nj shteti sovran, emetimi i monedhs kombtare shqiptare dhe rrjedhimisht krijimi i nj banke qendrore kombtare ishte nj ndr projektet dhe aspiratat kryesore t baballarve dhe ideologve t Shqipris. Fal saj aspirohej q Shqipria t gzonte jo vetm nj pavarsi politike por edhe nj pavarsi ekonomike - ajo do t i shrbente jo vetm zhvillimit t ekonomis s vendit por edhe konsolidimit t pavarsis s tij. N fjalimin e tij, t mbajtur disa dit pas firmosjes s marrveshjes mbi krijimin e Banks Kombtare t Shqipris, Ismail Qemali u shpreh: Ashtu si do njeri, i cili sado i pasur t jet ka nevoj pr kredi, madje sipas kredive q ka kuptohet se sa sht nderi i tij. Dhe m e habitshme do t ishte q kjo monedh, nga nj prgjegjsi e prveme e nj shteti, do t kthehej n nj prgjegjsi t prbashkt. Por aq i habitshm sht dhe parashikimi q Viktor Hygo ka br n vitin 1855 kur thoshte: Nj monedh kontinentale e bazuar te besimi dhe te metalet e muara, q prbn bazn e kapitalit t t gjith Evrops, dhe e mbshtetur nga aktiviteti i nj popullsie 200 milionshe: kjo monedh e vetme do t zvendsoj dhe nxjerr nga qarkullimi t gjith llojet e tjera absurde t paras q qarkullojn sot, s bashku me imazhet princrore dhe mizrin e tyre. Por kjo monedh ka akoma rrug t gjat pr t br n kudhrn e farktarit. Kshtu q rruga jon me lekun sht akoma e gjat. Tiparet, cilsia dhe karakteristikat teknike t paras jan pjes e kredibilitetit t saj. Por sigurisht ajo q karakterizon vlern e vrtet t paras sht fuqia e saj blerse. N kto 20 vjet Banka e Shqipris ka arritur t siguroj nj monedh t shndetshme, t besueshme dhe t dashur pr t gjith shqiptart. Uroj q me an t ksaj ekspozite t kemi krijuar nj ide mbi udhtimin e monedhs son kombtare dhe rrjedhimisht, edhe sistemit monetar aktual. Shpresoj q t gjith vizitort t ken dshir t vizitojn prsri ekspozita t tilla, pasi koha kur Banka e Shqipris do t el muzeun e saj sht afr. Pr t realizuar kt projekt i jemi drejtuar historianve, ekonomistve, bibliotekarve, arkivistve, artistve, ekspertve t komunikimit dhe arkitektve kombtar dhe ndrkombtar. Rezultati prfundimtar do t rrjedh nga bashkpunimi i hollsishm mes bots akademike, institucioneve, industris kulturore dhe Banks s Shqipris. (CNNMoney) As the Federal Reserve prepares to gradually reduce its stimulus program, many fear that this change in policy direction could lead to the successive collapse of emerging-market economies. But the question is: Should the Fed be concerned about this? That was the focus of the debate at the table that gathered bankers and economists in Jackson Hole, Wyo., on Saturday. As the Fed tried to save the U.S. economy over the past four years through lowering interests to historic minimum levels and large investments in bonds, the value of the U.S. dollar suffered declines, pushing investors toward higher-risk and higher-return markets. During these years, emerging market economies such as India, Brazil, Indonesia and Southeast European countries have benefited from large inflows of dollar loans. China, Korea and Thailand experienced rising prices of real estate, ... ncim_te_Guvernatorit_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_z_Ardian_Fullani.html Page 1 of 3 Article in CNNMoney with a report by the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Ardian Fullani 29/07/22, 14:53 While China, Mexico and Russia were characterized by rising stock prices. Likewise, in states such as Brazil, China, Korea and Turkey, borrowers were granted more loans. But now, as the Fed prepares to slow down and then complete stimulus policies, the U.S. dollar is gaining ground against other currencies, such as the Brazilian real and the Indian rupee. Meanwhile, investors are withdrawing their money from these countries, causing panic. "From the Fed's perspective, communication regarding reducing stimulus policies is important not only to the American people, but also to foreign audiences," said Glenn Hubbard, dean of Columbia University's Graduate School of Business and former adviser to President George W. Bush. "Many of the reactions in emerging-market economies relate to what the Fed implies." Here's how a crisis could evolve: With the value of emerging-market economies' currencies falling, fears emerge that borrowers in these countries may not be able to repay their loans in US dollars. If this happens massively, local banks may face difficulties, even go bankrupt. Meanwhile, the fact that the value of their currencies is falling does not mean that prices will fall. In countries that import food and oil from abroad often with prices expressed in US dollars the basic needs for the average population level will be expensive. This is the recipe for geopolitical turmoil, says Philippa Malmgren, President of Principals Advantage Management and former economic adviser to President George W. Bush. "Ironically, they are characterized by higher inflation and this is a serious problem," she said. "In emerging-market economies, people spend 40% to 70% of their income on food and energy alone. An American may complain about rising food prices, but for most of them this remains unconsiderable, while for emerging market economies, this is a matter for life or death." The two discussion materials presented at Jackson Hole called on central bankers to think about the consequences of their domestic policies internationally. Christine Lagarde, Executive Director of the International Monetary Fund, also gave a speech, calling for more international co-operation. "No country is an island," she said. "In today's interconnected world, the mutual effects from domestic policies ... They can take you back to where they started. It is in your interest to consider the effects from a broader point of view. It's in everyone's interest." Monetary policy coordination is not unusual for smaller and emerging-market economies. Some of the member states of this club are Turkey, Russia, the Czech Republic, Romania, Albania, Kazakhstan, etc. "We have coordinated policies, both before and during the crisis, and I think the time has come to coordinate policies even after Quantitative Easing 3," said Ardian Fullani, Governor of the Bank of Albania. But for the United States, such coordination is difficult to be politically acceptable. After the financial crisis, the Federal Reserve offered 14 countries swap deals in US dollars. Co-operation between global central banks was "overall, extremely successful" in reducing tensions, but at the same time it found disapproval of Congress and the general public, Jean-Pierre Landau, former Executive Director of the IMF and world bank, said in his discussion material presented at Jackson Hole. The discussion remains debatable, as it directly contradicts American law. Congress has mandated the Federal Reserve for drafting policies that maximize Americans' employment and keep prices at stable levels. American law does not express anything about, let's say, food prices or wages in India. "By law, the Fed focuses on domestic issues and this clash has always existed," said Alan Blinder, an economist at Princeton University and former Vice Chairman of the Federal Reserve Board. "Anything that pushes us towards international co-operation can fall against the Federal Reserve Act." If there is a key message that deI from this year's Jackson Hole symposium, it is the new call for bringing monetary policies in line with the global economy. In fact, the title of the discussions is "Global Dimensions of Nontraditional Monetary Policy." "Most central bankers believe that monetary policy is simply an internal phenomenon and that they should only consider data from within the country," Malmgren said. Bush. "Mjaft prej reagimeve n ekonomit me treg n zhvillim lidhen me at q nnkupton Fed-i." Ja se si mund t evoluoj nj kriz: Me rnien e vlers s monedhave t ekonomive me treg n zhvillim, shfaqet frika se huamarrsit n kto vende mund t mos jen n gjendje t shlyejn kredit e tyre n dollar amerikan. Nse kjo ndodh n mnyr masive, bankat vendase mund t hasin vshtirsi, madje edhe mund t falimentojn. Ndrkoh, fakti se vlera e monedhave t tyre po pson rnie nuk nnkupton q dhe mimet do t bien. N vendet q importojn ushqime dhe naft nga jasht shpesh me mime t shprehura n dollar amerikan nevojat baz pr nivelin mesatar t popullsis do t shtrenjtohen. Kjo sht receta pr trazira gjeopolitike, shprehet Philippa Malmgren, Presidente e Principals Asset Management dhe ish-kshilltare ekonomike e Presidentit George W. Bush. "Pr ironi, ata karakterizohen nga nj inflacion m i lart dhe ky sht nj problem serioz," u shpreh ajo. Nj amerikan mund t ankohet pr rritjen e mimeve t ushqimeve, por pr shumicn e tyre kjo mbetet e pakonsiderueshme, ndrkoh q pr ekonomit me treg n zhvillim, kjo sht nj shtje pr jet a vdekje." Dy materialet e diskutimit t prezantuara n Jackson Hole iu bn thirrje bankierve qendror q t mendojn pr pasojat e politikave t tyre t brendshme n nivel ndrkombtar. Christine Lagarde, Drejtore Ekzekutive e Fondit Monetar Ndrkombtar, gjithashtu mbajti nj fjalim, ku bri thirrje pr m shum bashkpunim ndrkombtar. "Asnj vend nuk sht ishull," u shpreh ajo. Koordinimi i politikave monetare nuk sht i pazakont pr ekonomit m t vogla dhe me treg n zhvillim. Muz and Eduk " Head / Press / Speeches, interviews, articles / Speeches Press releases Notices of # meetings of Council Supervisor Press conference Speeches, interview articles Speeches Interview of articles Calendars # Official holiday calendar for 2022 COVID-19 Europe # BANK OF ALBANIA PRESS CONFERENCE , Mr Ardian Fullani, at the joint press conference with the Ministry of Finance and the International Monetary Fund Mission Publication date: 18.12.2013 Honored media representatives, In recent days, intensive negotiations have been held with the International Monetary Fund Mission for the future direction of economic and financial policies, which will undertake Albanian authorities in the 2014 2016 mid-term. I would like to say that, on the whole, these discussions have resulted in success and, in their conclusion, we have reached an agreement with the IMF to draft a package of measures that will enable the country to cope with immediate problems as well as support a sustainable economic growth. From the central bank's perspective, we judge that the agreement addresses our main concerns, which we have shared with you in our previous communications. I believe that during the following period you will be familiar with fuller details of the agreement. However, at this press conference, I would like to present to you the Bank of Albania's views on the situation of the Albanian economy and financial system, as well as to highlight the main points that will guide our policies for the next three years. The Albanian economy is characterized by slow growth and below potential. This situation creates a series of problems in the economy, such as: difficulties in the financial situation of businesses; slowing employment and wage growth; worsening financial indicators particularly of credit; Page 1 of 3 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in ... Ministry of Finance and International Monetary Fund Mission 29/07/22, 14:53 increase in the degree of conservatism of financial agents; And, increase pressures on deficit and debt indicators. All the problems listed above are present in the Albanian economy. For this reason, the Bank of Albania has continuously stressed that low growth is the priority concern facing the Albanian economy. For this reason, the fair understanding of growth problems also provides the key to undertaking the right development policies. We think that, as in other countries in the region, economic growth problems have a dual, cynical and structural nature, and that putting the Albanian economy on the path of sustainable growth requires their simultaneous address. In the situation we are in, I consider that the agreement with the IMF offers an optimal solution. -- Cyclically, aggregate demand appears low and fails to put the country's production capacities into full use. The reasons are clear: Foreign demand for Albanian goods and services appears problematic, partly also as a result of the problems our trading partners have; the public sector has limited opportunities for fiscal stimulus as a result of the high level of public debt, while the private sector appears reluctant and faces tight financing conditions from the financial system. -- In this context, the Bank of Albania considers that the agreement with the IMF serves positively the solution to this. First, signing this agreement serves as a guarantee for the consistency of our economic policies and provides low-cost financial guarantees to the country. As such, it strengthens the confidence of internal and foreign investors in the Albanian economy and has positive effects on investment and consumption. Second, the agreement paves the way for a softer fiscal correction than the one we might be forced to do in its absence. In other words, the projected financial assistance avoids a stronger fiscal contraction that financial markets could impose on us. Third, imf and World Bank financial support means reducing government borrowing in the internal market by creating more liquidity space for private sector lending. -- In structural terms, the Albanian economy must adopt a new growth model, to create a more competitive, adhesive and immune profile to the fluctuating global conjuncture. This goal requires the relocation of financial, entrepreneurial and human resources into the economy, from internal market-oriented industries to those industries that have a regional and global perspective. Also, this objective will require the continuation of structural reform through improvements to the legal and regulatory framework, through investments in infrastructure and through increased qualifications. Page 2 of 3 , Mr. Ardian Fullani, in ... Ministry of Finance and International Monetary Fund Mission 29/07/22, 14:53 manpower. All these stocks require time, financial resources and technical expertise. The agreement with the IMF I believe addresses them structurally and satisfactorily. In our judgment, these policies pave the way for progressive economic growth over the coming years. They will naturally require constant attention, clarity and flexibility to match the dynamics of economic and financial reality, with our objectives and policies. Another important aspect of economic and financial policies will be to further maintain and strengthen the country's macroeconomic stability. The Bank of Albania will continue to remain focused on respecting its price stability target. At the last two meetings of the Supervisory Council we have undertaken two consecutive interest rate cuts, bringing it down to 3%. These movements are carried out exclusively in compliance with our 3% inflation target. They aim to facilitate economic lending and promote consumption and investment in the country, serving the return of the currently low inflation rate to target. We have been and will always remain attentive to this indicator, willing to take the relevant measures to ensure price stability in the economy. Finally, the banking system has been and continues to remain healthy and profitable. The financial system assessment programme, FSAP, estimates that the Albanian banking system is healthy, able to cope with blows, supervised and regulated according to sound principles. The Bank of Albania is committed to further improving supervisory and regulatory infrastructure under FSAP recommendations to provide the economy with a healthy banking system. Also, the Bank of Albania will aim to increase the attention of financial institutions, public or private, under multilateral initiatives such as Vienna 2 or bilateral co-operation with counterparty institutions. These initiatives and projects, but also other commitments that are part of the central bank's normal work, will serve to improve the country's lending conditions and economic growth. Thank you for the attention! Page 3 of 3

Me knaqsi konstatoj se, n trsi, kto diskutime kan rezultuar t suksesshme dhe, n prfundim t tyre, kemi arritur nj marrveshje me FMN-n pr hartimin e nj pakete masash t cilat do t i mundsojn vendit prballimin e problemeve t menjhershme si dhe mbshtetjen e nj rritjeje t qndrueshme ekonomike. Nga kndvshtrimi i banks qendrore, gjykojm se marrveshja adreson shqetsimet tona kryesore, t cilat i kemi ndar me ju n komunikimet tona t mparshme. Besoj se gjat periudhs n vijim do t njiheni me detaje m t plota t marrveshjes. Megjithat, n kt konferenc pr shtyp, dshiroj t ju paraqes prmbledhtazi pikpamjet e Banks s Shqipris mbi situatn e ekonomis dhe t sistemit financiar shqiptar, si dhe t evidentoj pikat kryesore t cilat do t orientojn politikat tona pr tre vitet e ardhshme. T gjitha problemet e renditura m sipr jan t pranishme n ekonomin shqiptare. Pr kt arsye, Banka e Shqipris ka theksuar n vazhdimsi se rritja e ult sht shqetsimi prioritar me t cilin prballet ekonomia shqiptare. Pr kt arsye, kuptimi i drejt i problemeve t rritjes ofron edhe elsin pr ndrmarrjen e politikave t duhura t zhvillimit. Ne mendojm se, ashtu si dhe n vende t tjera t rajonit, problemet e rritjes ekonomike kan nj natyr t dyfisht, ciklike dhe strukturore, dhe se vendosja e ekonomis shqiptare n rrugn e rritjes s qndrueshme krkon adresimin e tyre t njkohshm. N situatn q ndodhemi, gjykoj se marrveshja me FMN-n ofron nj zgjidhje optimale. --N aspektin ciklik, krkesa agregate shfaqet e ult dhe nuk arrin t vr n shfrytzim t plot kapacitetet prodhuese t vendit. Arsyet jan t qarta: krkesa e huaj pr mallra e shrbime shqiptare shfaqet problematike, pjesrisht edhe si pasoj e problemeve q kan partnert tan tregtar; sektori publik ka mundsi t kufizuara pr stimul fiskal si pasoj e nivelit t lart t borxhit publik, ndrsa sektori privat shfaqet hezitues dhe prballet me kushte t shtrnguara financimi nga sistemi financiar. --N kt kontekst, Banka e Shqipris gjykon se marrveshja me FMN-n i shrben pozitivisht zgjidhjes s ktij ngri. S pari, nnshkrimi i ksaj marrveshjeje shrben si garanci pr konsistencn e politikave tona ekonomike dhe ofron garanci financiare me kosto t ult pr vendin. Si e till, ajo forcon besimin e investitorve t brendshm e t huaj n ekonomin shqiptare dhe ka efekte pozitive n investime dhe n konsum. S dyti, marrveshja i hap rrug nj korrektimi m t but fiskal se ai t cilin mund t ishim t detyruar t bnim n munges t saj. Me fjal t tjera, asistenca financiare e parashikuar shmang nj tkurrje m t fort fiskale t ciln mund t na e impononin tregjet financiare. S treti, mbshtetja financiare e FMN-s dhe e Banks Botrore nnkupton reduktim t huamarrjes s qeveris n tregun e brendshm duke krijuar m shum hapsir likuiditeti pr kreditimin e sektorit privat. --N aspektin strukturor, ekonomia shqiptare duhet t adoptoj nj model t ri rritjeje, pr t krijuar nj profil m konkurrues, m t zhdrvjellt dhe m imun ndaj luhatjes s konjukturave globale. Gjithashtu, ky objektiv do t krkoj vazhdimin e reforms strukturore nprmjet prmirsimeve t kuadrit ligjor e rregullativ, nprmjet investimeve n infrastruktur dhe nprmjet rritjes s kualifikimit https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/F_e_Financave_dhe_Misionin_e_Fondit_Monetar_Nderkombetar_2212.html Pagina 2 di 3 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Ardian Fullani, n e Ministrin e Financave dhe Misionin e Fondit Monetar Ndrkombtar 29/07/22, 14:53 t fuqis puntore. T gjitha kto aksione krkojn koh, burime financiare dhe ekspertiz teknike. Marrveshja me FMN-n besoj se i adreson ato n mnyr t strukturuar dhe t knaqshme. N gjykimin ton, kto politika i hapin rrug nj rritjeje ekonomike progresive gjat viteve t ardhshme. Ato do t krkojn natyrisht vmendje, qartsi dhe fleksibilitet t vazhdueshm pr t prputhur dinamikat e realitetit ekonomik e financiar, me objektivat dhe politikat tona. Nj aspekt tjetr i rndsishm i politikave ekonomike dhe financiare do t jet mbajtja dhe forcimi i mtejshm i stabilitetit makroekonomik t vendit. Banka e Shqipris do t vazhdoj t mbetet e fokusuar n respektimin e objektivit t saj t stabilitetit t mimeve. N dy mbledhjet e fundit t Kshillit Mbikqyrs ne kemi ndrmarr dy ulje t njpasnjshme t norms baz t interesit, duke e zbritur at n 3%. Kto lvizje jan kryer ekskluzivisht n funksion t respektimit t objektivit ton prej 3% t inflacionit. Ato synojn t lehtsojn kreditimin e ekonomis dhe t nxisin konsumin e investimet n vend, duke i shrbyer kthimit t norms aktualisht t ult t inflacionit n objektiv. Ne kemi qen dhe do t mbetemi gjithnj t vmendshm ndaj ktij treguesi, t gatshm t ndrmarrim masat prkatse pr garantimin e stabilitetit t mimeve n ekonomi. S fundi, sistemi bankar ka qen dhe vazhdon t mbetet i shndetshm dhe fitimprurs. Programi i vlersimit t sistemit financiar, FSAP, vlerson se sistemi bankar shqiptar sht i shndetshm, i aft t prballoj goditje, i mbikqyrur dhe i rregulluar sipas parimeve t shndosha. Banka e Shqipris sht e angazhuar q, edhe n kuadrin e rekomandimeve t FSAP-it, t prmirsoj m tej infrastrukturn mbikqyrse dhe rregullatore, pr t i siguruar ekonomis nj sistem bankar t shndetshm. Po ashtu, Banka e Shqipris do t synoj q, n kuadrin e nismave shumpalshe si ajo e Vjena 2 apo t bashkpunimit dypalsh me institucione homologe, t rris vmendjen e institucioneve financiare, publike apo private, ndaj investimit n ekonomin shqiptare. Kto nisma e projekte, por edhe angazhime t tjera q jan pjes e puns normale t banks qendrore, do t i shrbejn prmirsimit t kushteve t kreditimit dhe rritjes ekonomike t vendit. text: Word of Mr Ardian Fullani, Governor of the Bank of Albania at the 10th Vienna Economic Forum 29/07/22, 14:55 Word of Mr Ardian Fullani, Governor of the Bank of Albania at the 10th Vienna Economic Forum Publication date: 07.05.2014 Imagine the future: For better economic co-operation. The responsibilities of the Chambers of Commerce and Banks Honorable Ladies and Gentlemen! Honored colleagues and participants in the Vienna Economic Forum! I have the special honour and pleasure to speak before such a constructive and important economic forum to discuss economic development issues affecting the present and future of our economies. The theme of this forum is very important for the economies of Southeast Europe. It creates the right environment for examining the problems facing our economies during crises. Undoubtedly, we can learn some lessons from what we have experienced over the past few years, which followed the financial and economic crisis. These discussions and harmonisation of policies will help us design a strong and co-ordinated structure for the long-term future of our economies. It is particularly important that we converge together here in Vienna and discuss the issue of co-operation, as one of the obvious results (lessons) of developments in recent years is that economic developments, especially for the small and open economies of the Southeast European region, are no longer of local and regional nature. Like flu, they make no differences and are extremely communicable from one economy to another, from one sector of the economy to another.  i_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_ne_Forumin_e_10-te_Ekonomik_te_Vjenes.html Page 1 of 4 Word of Mr Ardian Fullani, Governor of the Bank of Albania at the 10th Vienna Economic Forum 29/07/22, 14:55 Most importantly, European economies and their financial systems, among which the Austrian financial system enjoys a significant share in the market, define globalisation for the region and are largely important delineators for the success or failure of these economies. Given the great weight european financial groups have, they play and will play an important role in conveying global shocks in the region. What is more important is that they have a significant role in transmitting blows from legislative and regulatory measures undertaken by European monetary and supervisory authorities. The size is such that even a simple change in the future business plans of a single financial institution in Europe could turn into real blows to the region's economies. During the crisis, but even later, it became apparent that rising risk and uncertainties added to the incentive for attracting banks from developing European economies. Although this was mostly prevented due to increased co-operation through institutions such as the Vienna Initiative, concerns, from our perspective, have not been fully withered. In this regard, the business plan of groups established in the EU could potentially play an important role in terms of the nature and results of this co-operation. The crisis noted some weaknesses in the growth model adopted by southeast Europe's developing economy. On the other hand, it is equally true that, to some extent, this behaviour was also encouraged by the development strategies of financial groups in the region, as it is true that there have also been some weaknesses in co-ordination and co-operation between various institutions of the European Union, such as monetary policies (ECB), fiscal policies (of member states) and the non-existence of a specific mechanism (such as the crisis relief fund) for it. protected the European Union during difficult economic times. This conference appreciates these lessons, while acknowledging and acknowledging the importance of co-ordination through bilateral co-operation at the multidimensional institutional level between the countries of the region as well as with joint partner countries. We, in the region, hope that our foreign partners share the same views. Albania's economy and its financial market have common characteristics with other economies in the region. Our main partners for trade and financial exchanges are part of eu economies. For this reason, developments in the EU are directly or indirectly conveyed and play an important role in economic developments in Albania. Our support for the EU has not only influenced our economic developments, but has also limited the effects of policy measures. Several European banking groups operate in the Albanian financial sector. These groups have brought extensive and valuable expertise and experience to the Albanian market, thus playing a key role in the financial integration of the Albanian economy into the European Union. However, EU supervisory rules and requirements for European financial groups regarding risk, along with the approach in which they are implemented, are putting significant constraints on our economies and monetary policy performance to respond to economic developments. Faced with new and tight capital and risk demands, banks are trying to meet the obligation by adapting their future plans for business as well as  i_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_ne_Forumin_e_10-te_Ekonomik_te_Vjenes.html Page 2 of 4 Word of Mr Ardian Fullani, Governor of the Bank of Albania at the 10th Vienna Economic Forum 29/07/22, 14:55 the size and composition of their balance sheets in the economies of our region. These tighter arrangements, which were adopted by the European Supervisory and Banking Authority and which were implemented, consequently, by the parent banks have already been accompanied by lower lending levels in the economy. From our research, it is shown that further tightening of lending, due to legal reforms being undertaken, can bring a significant effect not only on economic activity, but also on the quality of commercial banks' equities, in particular in the situation of troubled loans. Deteriorating economic activity would largely follow in the same way, leading to the deterioration of the ratio of troubled loans, lower bank profits and greater capital restrictions, along with slower growth. This second channel is seen, albeit debatablely, as more dangerous, where empirical research shows that elasticity is almost twice as large for a strike of such a size. These arrangements are putting significant difficulties on our economies. More directly, we have observed a decrease in financial mediation, which comes due to tight lending procedures even for economies or sectors that have performed well during the crisis. Consequently, this was reflected in curbing investment and lowering the dynamics of the Albanian economy, both in the public and private sectors. Furthermore, current business practices and policy orientation are setting significant obstacles to the eficiency of the monetary policy transmission mechanism, and the ability of authorities to give the economy much-needed stimulus. It is understandable that banks will have to be careful, prudent and responsible in view of the current situation of troubled loans. However, they should also consider the fact that lending and financial mediation are important for growth, which can improve the ability of economic agents to write off loans. This is especially true for particular sectors such as agriculture and agribusiness, which have so far not benefited from the expansion of lending, but have great and untapped potential for growth. The timing of a pattern of economic growth driven mainly by domestic consumption is already gone. Banks, their central headquarters and supervisory authorities in European countries of origin must work together with the authorities of host countries to develop a long-term and sustainable model of economic growth. This new model is needed to rely on investments in productive sectors of the economy. Our products and services must not only be competitive in the domestic market, but also provide comparative advantages in both the region's and the European Union's markets. It is clear that co-operation is the only choice for the future. For more than 15 years, the Process of European Integration, in its entire political, economic and financial dimension, has been the driving force for the economic and social prosperity of the Southeast European region. The EU represents our main trading partner, a large part of iHD, and the largest investor in the banking system. Our countries have made structural reforms and adapted the regulatory, legislative and institutional framework to adapt to these partnerships.  i_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_ne_Forumin_e_10-te_Ekonomik_te_Vjenes.html Page 3 of 4 Word of Mr Ardian Fullani, Governor of the Bank of Albania at the 10th Vienna Economic Forum 29/07/22, 14:55 Led by the European integration process, the region's countries have also signed bilateral agreements for free trade between them. Our studies at the Bank of Albania show that these free trade agreements have had a positive impact on trade flows between western Balkan countries. However, these studies suggest that trade flows between western Balkan countries are below potential. The goal of bilateral free trade agreements is to create a regional free trade area between western Balkan countries. Authorities in Southeast European countries have shown signs of continued regional co-operation; However, they must make additional efforts to unify and harmonise their legal, regulatory and infrastructural frameworks. These efforts must be supported by a clear commitment of financial groups from the EU to the region's small and open economies. Developments in regional markets for products and factors, investments in education and improving human capital, exploitation of economies of scale and comparative advantages will depend on credit availability and investments and financial support of the banking system. In this respect, eu-based financial groups will be extremely important factors for building bridges of co-operation between the region's economies and turning it into a larger, more integrated, more competitive, profitable and prosperous economy, leading to a prosperous economic future through economic co-operation. In this direction, I would encourage foreign groups to see the region from this point of view, not according to countries individually, when considering their future in the region. There is no need to say that any policy limiting the engagement and exposure of financial groups from the EU to the region does not support economic co-operation between our countries. Furthermore, it creates an unfavourable economic environment and a less prosperous future for all economies in the region. The Western Balkan region offers great opportunities and profit prospects for corporations and financial groups coming from the EU. Harmonising the above mentioned reforms will create an even more attractive environment for various private subjects interested in investing in our region. I invite financial groups from the EU to see the region in this regard. European institutions and financial groups must support and become a positive force for facilitating, mitigating and supporting regional economic co-operation, which will lead to a more prosperous future and faster process of the region's European integration. Thank you for the attention!  i_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_ne_Forumin_e_10-te_Ekonomik_te_Vjenes.html Page 4 of 4

Ashtu sikurse gripi, ato nuk bjn dallime dhe jan tejet t transmetueshme nga nj ekonomi n tjetrn, nga nj sektor i ekonomis n nj tjetr. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fji_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_ne_Forumin_e_10-te_Ekonomik_te_Vjenes.html Pagina 1 di 4 Fjala e z. Ardian Fullani, Guvernator i Banks s Shqipris n Forumin e 10-t Ekonomik t Vjens 29/07/22, 14:55 M e rndsishmja, ekonomit evropiane dhe sistemet e tyre financiare, ndr t cilat sistemi financiar austriak gzon nj pjes domethnse n treg, prkufizojn globalizimin pr rajonin dhe jan, n mas t madhe, prcaktues t rndsishm pr suksesin apo dshtimin e ktyre ekonomive. Duke patur parasysh peshn e madhe q kan grupet financiare evropiane, ato luajn dhe do t luajn nj rol t rndsishm n prcjelljen e goditjeve globale n rajon. Ajo q sht m e rndsishme sht se ato kan nj rol domethns n transmetimin e goditjeve nga masat legjislative dhe rregullatore t ndrmarra nga autoritetet monetare dhe mbikqyrse evropiane. Prmasa sht e till q edhe nj ndryshim i thjesht n planet e ardhshme t biznesit t nj institucioni t vetm financiar n Evrop mund t shndrrohet n goditje t vrteta pr ekonomit e rajonit. Gjat krizs, por edhe m pas, u b e dukshme se rritja e rrezikut dhe pasigurive i shtoi nxitsit pr trheqjen e bankave nga ekonomit evropiane n zhvillim. Ndonse kjo u parandalua m s shumti pr shkak t rritjes s bashkpunimit nprmjet institucioneve t tilla si Nisma e Vjens, shqetsimet, nga kndvshtrimi yn, nuk jan shuar plotsisht. N kt drejtim, plani i biznesit i grupeve t vendosura n BE mund t luaj potencialisht nj rol t rndsishm n lidhje me natyrn dhe rezultatet e ktij bashkpunimi. Kriza vuri n dukje disa dobsi n modelin e rritjes t adoptuar nga ekonomi n zhvillim t Evrops Juglindore. Nga ana tjetr, sht po aq e vrtet q, deri diku, kjo sjellje u inkurajua edhe nga strategjit e zhvillimit t grupeve financiare n rajon, pasi sht e vrtet q ka patur edhe disa dobsi n bashkrendimin dhe bashkpunimin midis institucioneve t ndryshme t Bashkimit Evropian, t tilla si politikat monetare (BQE), politikat fiskale (t vendeve antare) dhe mosekzistenca e nj mekanizmi specifik (t till si fondi i ndihms pr dalje nga kriza) pr t mbrojtur Bashkimin Evropian gjat kohve t vshtira ekonomike. Kjo konferenc i vlerson kto msime, ndrkoh q njeh dhe pranon rndsin e bashkrendimit nprmjet bashkpunimit t ndrsjell n nivel institucional shumdimensional midis vendeve t rajonit si dhe me vendet partnere t prbashkta. Ne, n rajon, shpresojm q partnert tan t huaj t ndajn t njjtat pikpamje. Ekonomia e Shqipris dhe tregu i saj financiar kan karakteristika t prbashkta me ekonomit e tjera n rajon. Partnert tan kryesore pr shkmbime tregtare dhe financiare jan pjes e ekonomive t BE-s. Pr kt arsye, zhvillimet n BE prcillen drejtprdrejt apo trthorazi dhe luajn nj rol t rndsishm n zhvillimet ekonomike n Shqipri. Mbshtetja jon te BE jo vetm q ka ndikuar mbi zhvillimet tona ekonomike por edhe ka kufizuar efektet e masave t politikave. N sektorin financiar shqiptar veprojn disa grupe bankare evropiane. Kto grupe kan sjell n tregun shqiptar ekspertiz dhe prvoj t gjer dhe t vlefshme, duke luajtur, kshtu, nj rol ky n integrimin financiar t ekonomis shqiptare n Bashkimin Evropian. Megjithat, rregullat mbikqyrse t BE-s dhe krkesat pr grupet financiare evropiane n lidhje me rrezikun, s bashku me qasjen n t ciln ato zbatohen, po vendosin shtrngesa domethnse mbi ekonomit tona dhe eficiencn e politiks monetare pr t reaguar ndaj zhvillimeve ekonomike. T prballur me krkesa t reja dhe t shtrnguara pr kapital dhe pr rrezikun, bankat po prpiqen t prmbushin detyrimin duke prshtatur planet e tyre t ardhme pr biznesin si dhe https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fji_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_ne_Forumin_e_10-te_Ekonomik_te_Vjenes.html Pagina 2 di 4 Fjala e z. Ardian Fullani, Guvernator i Banks s Shqipris n Forumin e 10-t Ekonomik t Vjens 29/07/22, 14:55 prmasn dhe prbrjen e bilanceve t tyre n ekonomit e rajonit ton. Kto rregullime m t shtrnguara q u miratuan nga Autoriteti Evropian i Mbikqyrjes dhe ai Bankar dhe q u zbatuan, pr rrjedhoj, nga bankat mma jan shoqruar tashm me ulje t nivelit t kreditimit n ekonomi. Nga krkimet tona, tregohet se shtrngimi i mtejshm i kreditimit, pr shkak t reformave ligjore q po ndrmerren, mund t sjell nj efekt t rndsishm jo vetm mbi aktivitetin ekonomik, por edhe mbi cilsin e aseteve t bankave tregtare, n veanti n situatn e kredive me probleme. Prkeqsimi i aktivitetit ekonomik do t vijonte kryesisht n t njjtn mnyr, duke uar n prkeqsimin e raportit t kredive me probleme, n fitime m t ulta t bankave dhe kufizime m t mdha t kapitalit, s bashku me rritje m t ngadalt. Ky kanal i dyt shihet, ndonse n mnyr t debatueshme, si m i rrezikshm, ku krkimi empirik tregon se elasticitetet jan pothuajse dy her m t mdha pr nj goditje t nj prmase t till. Kto rregullime po vendosin vshtirsi domethnse mbi ekonomit tona. N mnyr m t drejtprdrejt, kemi vrejtur nj ulje t ndrmjetsimit financiar, q vjen pr shkak t procedurave t shtrnguara t huadhnies madje edhe pr ekonomi apo sektor q kan patur ecuri t mir gjat krizs. Si rrjedhoj, kjo u reflektua n frenim t investimeve dhe ulje t dinamiks s ekonomis shqiptare, si n sektorin publik ashtu edhe n at privat. Pr m tepr, praktikat aktuale t biznesit dhe orientimi i politikave po vendosin pengesa domethnse n eficiencn e mekanizmit t transmetimit t politiks monetare, dhe aftsin e autoriteteve pr t'i dhn ekonomis stimulin aq t nevojshm. sht e kuptueshme q bankat do t duhet t jen t kujdesshme, prudente dhe t prgjegjshme duke patur parasysh gjendjen aktuale t kredive me probleme. Megjithat, ato duhet t konsiderojn edhe faktin q kreditimi dhe ndrmjetsimi financiar jan t rndsishm pr rritjen, e cila mund t prmirsoj aftsin e agjentve ekonomik pr t shlyer kredit. Kjo sht e vrtet sidomos pr sektor t veant si bujqsia dhe agrobiznesi, t cilt deri tani nuk kan prfituar nga zgjerimi i kreditimit, po q kan potencial t madh e t pashfrytzuar pr rritje. Koha e nj modeli t rritjes ekonomike t nxitur kryesisht nga konsumi vendas tashm ka ikur. Bankat, selit e tyre qendrore dhe autoritetet mbikqyrse n vendet evropiane t origjins duhet t punojn s bashku me autoritetet e vendeve pritse pr t zhvilluar nj model afatgjat dhe t qndrueshm t rritjes ekonomike. Ky model i ri nevojitet t mbshtetet te investimet n sektor produktiv t ekonomis. Produktet dhe shrbimet tona duhet q t jen jo vetm konkurruese n tregun vendas, por edhe t ofrojn avantazhe krahasuese edhe n tregjet e rajonit dhe ato t Bashkimit Evropian. sht e qart se bashkpunimi sht e vetmja zgjedhje pr t ardhmen. Pr m shum se 15 vjet, procesi i integrimit evropian, n tr dimensionin e tij politik, ekonomik dhe financiar ka qen forca shtytse pr prosperitetin ekonomik dhe social t rajonit t Evrops Juglindore. BE-ja prfaqson partnerin ton tregtar kryesor, nj pjes t madhe t IHD-ve, dhe investitorin m t madh n sistemin bankar. Vendet tona kan br reforma strukturore dhe kan prshtatur kuadrin rregullator, legjislativ dhe institucional pr t'iu prshtatur ktyre partneriteteve. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fji_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_ne_Forumin_e_10-te_Ekonomik_te_Vjenes.html Pagina 3 di 4 Fjala e z. Ardian Fullani, Guvernator i Banks s Shqipris n Forumin e 10-t Ekonomik t Vjens 29/07/22, 14:55 Udhhequr nga procesi i integrimit evropian, vendet e rajonit kan nnshkruar, gjithashtu, marrveshje dypalshe pr tregtin e lir midis tyre. Studimet tona n Bankn e Shqipris tregojn se kto marrveshje t tregtis s lir kan patur ndikim pozitiv mbi flukset tregtare midis vendeve t Ballkanit Perndimor. Megjithat, kto studime sugjerojn se flukset tregtare midis vendeve t Ballkanit Perndimor jan nn potencial. Qllimi i marrveshjeve dypalshe pr tregtin e lir sht t krijoj nj zon rajonale t tregtis s lir midis vendeve t Ballkanit Perndimor. Autoritetet n vendet e Evrops Juglindore kan treguar shenja t bashkpunimit t vazhdueshm rajonal; megjithat, ato duhet t bjn prpjekje shtes pr t unifikuar dhe harmonizuar kuadrin ligjor, rregullator dhe infrastrukturor t tyre. Kto prpjekje duhet t mbshteten nga nj angazhim i qart i grupeve financiare nga BE-ja n ekonomit e vogla e t hapura t rajonit. Zhvillimet n tregjet rajonale pr produkte dhe faktor, investimet n arsimim dhe prmirsimi i kapitalit njerzor, shfrytzimi i ekonomive t shkalls dhe avantazhet krahasuese do t varen nga disponueshmria e kredis dhe investimet dhe mbshtetja financiare e sistemit bankar. N kt aspekt, grupet financiare t vendosura n BE do t jen faktor tejet t rndsishm pr ndrtimin e urave t bashkpunimit midis ekonomive t rajonit dhe shndrrimin e saj n nj ekonomi m t madhe, m t integruar, m konkurruese, m fitimprurse dhe t begat, duke uar n nj t ardhme ekonomike t begat nprmjet bashkpunimit ekonomik. N kt drejtim, do t inkurajoja grupet e huaja q ta shohin rajonin nga ky kndvshtrim dhe jo sipas vendeve individualisht, kur marrin n konsiderat t ardhmen e tyre n rajon. Nuk ka nevoj t themi q do politik q kufizon angazhimin dhe ekspozimin e grupeve financiare nga BE-ja n rajon nuk e mbshtet bashkpunimin ekonomik midis vendeve tona. Pr m tepr, krijon nj mjedis ekonomik t pafavorshm dhe nj t ardhme m pak t begat pr t gjitha ekonomit e rajonit. Rajoni i Ballkanit Perndimor ofron mundsi t mdha dhe perspektiv pr fitim pr korporatat dhe grupet financiare q vijn nga BE-ja. Harmonizimi i reformave t prmendura m lart do t krijoj nj mjedis edhe m trheqs pr subjekte t ndryshme private t interesuara pr t investuar n rajonin ton. I ftoj grupet financiare nga BE-ja ta shohin rajonin n kt kndvshtrim. Institucionet dhe grupet financiare evropiane duhet t mbshtesin dhe t bhen nj forc pozitive pr lehtsimin, zbutjen dhe mbshtetjen e bashkpunimit ekonomik rajonal, q do t oj n nj t ardhme m t begat dhe proces m t shpejt t integrimit evropian t rajonit. Monetary policy in the most developed economies, which are currently going through a period of extended at interest rate practically 0 and abundant amounts of liquidity, not to Deliberately has caused consequences in international currency exchange markets. Unprecedented movements over previous years have begun a significant shift in terms of exchange rate fluctuations among the currencies of key players in the global economy. For example, when the Federal Reserve reduced its interest rate to near zero in 2009 and then came up with quantitative easing programs, numerous voices considered it a secret currency war. The same can be said for the European Central Bank and many other central banks. However, due to trade and financial ties with the euro currency, historical preferences against the US dollar and low interest rates of the Swiss franc, exchange rate developments of these currencies carry more important effects within  2/4 05/08/22, 16:59 Governor Seyko's word at the Summit of Finance Ministers and Governors on the theme "Financial Future of the Region", ... economies of Eastern and Southeast Central European countries. In the case of Albania, we are mainly linked to the euro and the US dollar only because of the fact that Albania was the last economy to easily embrace the Swiss fringe. By the time it entered the market, the central bank was already concerned by the larger weight of foreign currency loans and stopped further expansion through macroprudence regulation (higher and collateral mandatory providions). On the other hand, euro currency developments are particularly important in terms of real economy activity, export competition and financial developments, while a significant amount of active trade and bank obligations (almost half of savings and more than 50% of loans) are held in the euro currency. Meanwhile, the U.S. dollar is also important as a means of trade and as a currency for keeping savings. The outbreak of the crisis caused many concerns in Albania, especially regarding issues of financial stability (since 75% of the loan surplus portfolio was in foreign currency, mainly in the euro currency). However, Albanian lek has been one of the most stable currencies among free exchange-rate currencies in Eastern Central European countries and Southeast or developing countries in Europe. Perhaps surprisingly, the lek appeared to be the least fluctuating currency of all other currencies. In the past five years, the coefficient of its variation was less than one, while that of other currencies ranges from three to thirteen times more than the coefficient of Albania's currency. This performance has greatly helped financial stability and price stability (the inflation rate in Albania is also significantly less fluctuating), but on the other hand has prevented/postponed a much-needed adjustment in trade flows related to consumption and investment. In general, our analysis shows that the fluctuations in the exchange rate of the lec against the US dollar and the Swiss franc have mainly reflected their position towards the euro currency, which is the main and most important currency of trade and financial transactions. Currently, the economy is more and largely more susceptible to blows in the Eurozone, while the response to the economic policies of the United States or other countries follows that of the Eurozone. In our view, the performance of the lek currency against strong/main currencies, despite the high foreign deficit, declining migrant shipments and easing monetary policy are reflected in narrowing the monetary policy rate gap between Albania and the Eurozone (the difference was 4% four years ago and today is less than 2%), Shows two important facts: Firstly unlike other Eastern Central and Southeast European countries Albania as  3/4 05/08/22, 16:59 Governor Seyko's word at the Summit of Finance Ministers and Governors on the theme "Financial Future of the Region", ... First, unlike other Eastern Central and Southeast European countries, Albania as partner countries in the region have not integrated its production and industrial structure with Eurozone. In addition, financial mediation has almost been fully supported by domestic deposits, which have consistently covered more than 100% of the loan surplus. So, at the time of the crisis, we didn't experience major leaks and important capital. Second, the relatively slow transmission mechanism (due to balance sheet problems and pessimistic expectations about the situation in neighbouring Greece) has not responded proportionally to reducing the interest rate. Under these conditions, the European Central Bank's quantitative easing programme has further supported the sustainability of the lek currency against the euro currency. In conclusion, I mean that this preserved stability of the lek currency against the euro currency is precious asset. However, long-term stability will depend on future economic growth, inflation as well as trade models and conditions. The currency will continue the regime of the free currency exchange rate to reflect market forces and the respective monetary policy stance.  4/4
