Lvizjet e paprecedente gjat viteve t mparshme kan nisur nj zhvendosje t rndsishme n terma t luhatjeve t kursit t kmbimit ndr monedhat e aktorve kryesor t ekonomis globale. Pr shembull, kur Rezerva Federale reduktoi normn e saj t interesit pran zeros n vitin 2009 dhe m pas vijoi me programet e lehtsimit sasior, zra t shumt e konsideruan si nj luft t fsheht t monedhs. E njjta gj mund t thuhet pr Bankn Qendrore Evropiane dhe pr shum banka t tjera qendrore. Megjithat, pr shkak t lidhjeve tregtare dhe financiare me monedhn euro, preferencave historike prkundrejt dollarit amerikan dhe normave t ulta t interesit t frangs zvicerane, zhvillimet e kursit t kmbimit t ktyre monedhave, mbartin efekte m t rndsishme brenda https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_Sejko_ne_samitin_e_Ministrave_te_Financave_dhe 2/4 05/08/22, 16:59 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n samitin e Ministrave t Financave dhe Guvernatorve me tem E ardhmja financiare e rajonit,  ekonomive t vendeve t Evrops Qendrore Lindore dhe Juglindore. N rastin e Shqipris, jemi t lidhur kryesisht me monedhn euro dhe dollarin amerikan vetm pr shkak t faktit se, Shqipria ishte ekonomia e fundit q prqafoi leht frangn zvicerane. N kohn q ajo u fut n treg, banka qendrore ishte tashm e shqetsuar nga pesha m e madhe e huave n monedh t huaj dhe ndaloi zgjerimin e mtejshm nprmjet rregullores makroprudenciale (provigjione m t larta dhe kolateral i detyrueshm). Nga ana tjetr, zhvillimet e monedhs euro jan veanrisht t rndsishme n lidhje me veprimtarin e ekonomis reale, konkurrencs s eksporteve dhe zhvillimeve financiare, prderisa nj sasi e konsiderueshme e tregtis s aktiveve dhe detyrimeve t bankave (pothuajse gjysma e kursimeve dhe m shum se 50% e huave) mbahen n monedhn euro. Ndrkoh, dollari amerikan sht gjithashtu i rndsishm si mjet i tregtis dhe si monedh pr mbajtjen e kursimeve. Shprthimi i krizs shkaktoi shum shqetsime n Shqipri, veanrisht n lidhje me shtje t stabilitetit financiar (meqense 75% e portofolit t teprics s huave ishte n monedh t huaj, kryesisht n monedhn euro). Gjithsesi, leku shqiptar ka qen nj nga monedhat m t qndrueshme ndr monedhat me kurs t lir kmbimi n vendet e Evrops Qendrore Lindore dhe Juglindore ose n vendet n zhvillim n Evrop. Ndoshta n mnyr surprizuese, leku u shfaq si monedha m pak e luhatshme nga t gjitha monedhat e tjera. N pes vitet e kaluara, koeficienti i variacionit t tij ishte m pak se nj, ndrsa ai i monedhave t tjera varion nga tre deri n trembdhjet her m shum se sa koeficienti i monedhs s Shqipris. Kjo ecuri ka ndihmuar shum stabilitetin financiar dhe at t mimeve (norma e inflacionit n Shqipri gjithashtu sht dukshm m pak e luhatshme), por nga ana tjetr ka parandaluar/shtyr nj rregullim tepr t nevojshm n flukset tregtare t lidhura me konsumin dhe investimet. N prgjithsi, analiza jon tregon se luhatjet e kursit t kmbimit t lekut ndaj dollarit amerikan dhe frangs zvicerane kan pasqyruar kryesisht pozicionin e tyre ndaj monedhs euro, e cila sht monedha kryesore dhe m e rndsishme e transaksioneve tregtare dhe financiare. Aktualisht, ekonomia sht m shum dhe kryesisht m e ndjeshme ndaj goditjeve n Eurozon, ndrsa prgjigjja ndaj politikave ekonomike t ShBA-ve ose t vendeve t tjera ndjek at t Eurozons. Sipas kndvshtrimit ton, ecuria e monedhs lek ndaj monedhave t forta/kryesore, pavarsisht deficitit t huaj t lart, drgesat e emigrantve n rnie dhe politika monetare lehtsuese jan pasqyruar n ngushtimin e hendekut t normave t politiks monetare midis Shqipris dhe Eurozons (diferenca ishte 4% katr vjet m par dhe sot sht m pak se 2%), tregon dy fakte t rndsishme: S pari ndryshe nga vendet e tjera t Evrops Lindore Qendrore dhe Juglindore Shqipria si https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_Sejko_ne_samitin_e_Ministrave_te_Financave_dhe 3/4 05/08/22, 16:59 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n samitin e Ministrave t Financave dhe Guvernatorve me tem E ardhmja financiare e rajonit,  S pari, ndryshe nga vendet e tjera t Evrops Lindore Qendrore dhe Juglindore, Shqipria si vendet partnere n rajon nuk ka integruar prodhimin dhe strukturn e saj industriale me Eurozonn. Prve ksaj, ndrmjetsimi financiar pothuajse sht mbshtetur plotsisht nga depozitat vendase, t cilat kan mbuluar vazhdimisht m shum se 100% t teprics s kredis. Kshtu q, n kohn e shprthimit t krizs, ne nuk prjetuam rrjedhje t mdha dhe t rndsishme t kapitalit. S dyti, mekanizmi relativisht i ngadalt i transmisionit (pr shkak t problemeve t bilancit dhe pritshmrive pesimiste n lidhje me situatn n Greqin fqinje) nuk i sht prgjigjur proporcionalisht reduktimit t norms s interesit. N kto kushte, programi sasior lehtsues i Banks Qendrore Evropiane ka mbshtetur m tej qndrueshmrin e monedhs lek ndaj monedhs euro. N prfundim, dua t them se ky stabilitet i ruajtur i monedhs lek ndaj monedhs euro sht aset i muar. Megjithat, stabiliteti afatgjat do t varet nga rritja e ardhshme ekonomike, inflacioni si dhe nga modelet dhe kushtet e tregtis. text: 05/08/22, 16:52 Governor Seyko's word at the Inauguration Ceremony of the Reconstructed Building and the Bank of Albania Museum Governor Seyko's word at the Inauguration Ceremony of the Reconstructed Building and the Bank of Albania Museum Publication date: 30.10.2015 Honorable, Mr. Prime Minister, Honourable gentlemen ministers, ... 1/3 05/08/22, 16:52 Governor Seyko's word at the Inauguration Ceremony of the Reconstructed Building and the Bank of Albania Museum Honorable ambassadors, Honored friends and colleagues, Welcome! I feel particularly privileged to welcome you to the ceremony of the inauguration of the Bank of Albania building and its Museum. Your presence in this lobby highlights the great appreciation of this institution's particular role and importance in maintaining the country's macroeconomic balances and financial stability. The building we inaugurate today is undoubtedly one of the most prominent architectural achievements in Albania. As you can see today we have a building of contemporary standards, which simultaneously preserves intact the main elements of the current to which it belongs: rationalism. The large volumes, symmetry and strong lines on the facade are in harmony with the modern building that has already been attached to the traditional one. Architect Morpurgo's passionate work, finalized in 1938, has been further enriched by the interesting project of Professor Petreschi, whose implementation has brought the building we see today. In structural, mechanical, technical aspects, the building has been updated with the most the end of the respective areas, fully guaranteeing the implementation of contemporary standards in relation to the conditions of staff work. From a functional point of view, it enables the performance of activities of primary, representative and auxiliary nature. It is equipped with meeting halls, conference halls, as well as other environments of social and educational nature. I take the opportunity to thank Professor Petreschi for the idea and realization of this natural coexistence between the new and old building. The inauguration of the building was the best opportunity to inaugurate yet another modest jubilee of our work in these years. As is tradition everywhere in the world, the Bank of Albania will finally have its own museum, which we are officially steeling tonight. At the core of the museum is money, in all its dimensions. There are reflected not only physical transactions and its role in various periods of economic development of the country, but also the form of how this precious asset has evolved physically, from the strange form it had in antiquity, to its sophistication over the centuries, to today's visible form and that invisible through digital transactions. However, this is not just a currency museum, so we have called it the Bank of Albania Museum. The Bank of Albania is the country's central bank and it has an important mission to meet. I believe that any age group or interest group will find in it, facts and interesting information about the past and present of the Albanian currency. Furthermore, you will find other interesting information related to you in a stylized way.  2/3 05/08/22, 16:52 Governor Seyko's word at the Inauguration Ceremony of the Reconstructed Building and the Bank of Albania Museum Furthermore, you will find other interesting information that is related in a stylized way. with the banking system, with the functions of the Bank of Albania, with the instruments it uses and certainly with the country's European future, including its monetary integration. Honored participants, The inauguration of the building and museum coincides with a challenging situation for the internal and external economy. The Bank of Albania, being fully responsible for its mission, will continue to be a reliable voice in the country's important economic-financial analysis and decision-making. For us, the economic and financial stability of the country remains very important. As widely addressed at today's Conference, our short- and long-term objectives are geared towards revitalizing the country's economic activity, price stability and the financial health of the banking system. The creation of contemporary work and scientific thought premises constitute more assistance in successfully fulfilling the constitutional mission of the Bank of Albania. Before I close this short word of welcome, I find it reasonable to make some thanks: I want to start with the European Central Bank and the Bank of Italy for the assistance they have provided at certain stages of consultation and selection of the winning project. I take the opportunity to thank all external collaborators as well as the public institutions of the field, which with their assistance enabled the completion in time and with quality of the museum. Special gratitude will be directed to all bank of Albania employees who worked with dedication and made their contribution to the implementation of these projects. I am convinced that this building will be a source of motivation and prosperity for both us and for generations to come. I thank you for your participation.  3/3

Kryeministr, T nderuar zotrinj ministra, httpsT://wwwd.bankofalbanhiak.orgl/Shtypii/Fjalimbe_intedrvista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_Sejko_ne_Ceremonine_e_Inaugurimit_te_Ndertese 1/3 05/08/22, 16:52 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n Ceremonin e Inaugurimit t Ndrtess s Rikonstruktuar dhe Muzeut t Banks s Shqipris T nderuar shklqesi ambasador, T nderuar miq dhe koleg, Mir se keni ardhur! Ndjehem veanrisht i privilegjuar tju uroj mirseardhjen n ceremonin e prurimit t ndrtess s Banks s Shqipris dhe t Muzeut t saj. Prania juaj n kt holl nxjerr n pah vlersimin e madh mbi rolin dhe rndsin e veant t ktij institucioni n ruajtjen e ekuilibrave makroekonomik dhe t stabilitetit financiar t vendit. Godina q inaugurojm sot, prbn padyshim nj nga arritjet m t spikatura arkitektonike n Shqipri. Si mund ta shikoni edhe vet sot kemi nj godin t standardeve bashkkohore, e cila njkohsisht ruan t paprekur elementet kryesore t rryms s cils i prket: racionalizmit. Volumet e mdha, simetria dhe linjat e forta n fasada jan n harmoni me godinn moderne q i sht bashkangjitur tashm asaj tradicionale. Puna plot pasion e arkitektit Morpurgo, e finalizuar n vitin 1938, sht pasuruar m tej nga projekti interesant i profesor Petreschit, zbatimi i t cilit ka sjell godinn q shohim sot. N aspektet strukturore, mekanike, teknike, ndrtesa sht prditsuar me teknologjit m t fundit t fushave prkatse, duke garantuar plotsisht zbatimin e standardeve bashkkohore n lidhje me kushtet e puns s personelit. Nga pikpamja funksionale, ajo mundson kryerjen e aktiviteteve t natyrs parsore, prfaqsuese dhe ndihmse. Ajo sht e pajisur me salla mbledhjesh, sall konference, si dhe me ambiente t tjera t natyrs sociale dhe edukative. Prfitoj nga rasti t falnderoj Profesor Petreschin pr iden dhe realizimin e ksaj bashkjetese t natyrshme mes godins s re dhe asaj t vjetr. Prurimi i ndrtess ishte rasti m i mir pr t pruruar edhe nj tjetr jubile modest t puns ton n kto vite. Ashtu si sht tradit kudo n bot, m n fund edhe Banka e Shqipris do t ket muzeun e saj, t cilin zyrtarisht po e elim sonte. N thelb t muzeut qndron paraja, n t gjitha dimensionet e saj. Aty jan pasqyruar jo vetm transaksionet fizike dhe roli i saj n periudha t ndryshme t zhvillimit ekonomik t vendit, por edhe forma se si ky aset i muar ka evoluar fizikisht, nga forma e uditshme q ajo kishte n lashtsi, tek sofistikimi i saj prgjat shekujve, deri n formn e sotme t dukshme dhe at t padukshme prmes transaksioneve dixhitale. Megjithat, ky nuk sht vetm nj muze monedhe, prandaj dhe ne e kemi quajtur Muzeu i Banks s Shqipris. Banka e Shqipris sht banka qendrore e vendit dhe ajo ka nj mision t rndsishm pr t prmbushur. Besoj se do grup-mosh apo grup interesi do t gjej n t, fakte dhe informacion interesant n lidhje me t shkuarn dhe t tashmen e monedhs shqiptare. Pr m tepr n mnyr t stilizuar do t gjeni edhe informacione t tjera interesante q lidhen https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_Sejko_ne_Ceremonine_e_Inaugurimit_te_Ndertese 2/3 05/08/22, 16:52 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n Ceremonin e Inaugurimit t Ndrtess s Rikonstruktuar dhe Muzeut t Banks s Shqipris Pr m tepr, n mnyr t stilizuar do t gjeni edhe informacione t tjera interesante q lidhen me sistemin bankar, me funksionet e Banks s Shqipris, me instrumentet q ajo prdor dhe sigurisht edhe me t ardhmen evropiane t vendit, prfshir dhe integrimin monetar t tij. T nderuar pjesmarrs, Inaugurimi i ndrtess dhe muzeut prkon me nj situat sfiduese pr ekonomin e brendshme dhe at t jashtme. Banka e Shqipris, duke qen plotsisht e prgjegjshme pr misionin e saj, do t vazhdoj t jet nj z i besueshm n analizn dhe vendimmarrjen e rndsishme ekonomiko-financiare t vendit. Pr ne mbetet shum i rndsishm stabiliteti ekonomik dhe financiar i vendit. Si u trajtuan gjersisht edhe n Konferencn e sotme, objektivat tona afatshkurtra dhe afatgjata jan t orientuara drejt gjallrimit t aktivitetit ekonomik t vendit, stabilitetit t mimeve dhe shndetit financiar t sistemit bankar. Krijimi i premisave bashkkohore t puns dhe t mendimit shkencor prbjn nj ndihm m shum n prmbushjen me sukses t misionit kushtetues t Banks s Shqipris. Prpara se ta mbyll kt fjal t shkurtr mirseardhjeje, e shoh t arsyeshme t bj disa falnderime: Dshiroj ta nis me Bankn Qendrore Evropiane dhe Bankn e Italis pr ndihmesn q kan dhn n faza t caktuara t konsultimit dhe przgjedhjes s projektit fitues. Prfitoj nga rasti t falenderoj t gjith bashkpuntort e jashtm si dhe institucionet publike t fushs, t cilat me ndihmesn e tyre mundsuan prfundimin n koh dhe me cilsi t muzeut. Mirnjohje t veant do ti drejtoj t gjith punonjsve t Banks s Shqipris q punuan me prkushtim dhe dhan kontributin e tyre pr realizimin e ktyre projekteve. text: Governor Seyko's word at joint press conference with IMF mission, MF and MZHETTS 29/07/22, 14:54 Governor Seyko's word at joint press conference with IMF mission, MF and MZHETTS Publication date: 10.11.2015 On the completion of the Fifth and Sixth Revisions of the Agreement with the IMF Honored media representatives, As you are aware, over the past two weeks we have been engaged in intensive talks with representatives of the IMF Mission. As always, discussions have been focused on exchanging opinions on economic and financial developments, naturally trying to identify the right policies and instruments to move forward, on the country's path to sustainable development.  t_per_shtyp_me_misionin_e_FMN-se_MF-ne_dhe_MZHETTS-ne_2385.html Page 1 of 3 Governor Seyko's word at joint press conference with IMF mission, MF and MZHETTS 29/07/22, 14:54 In general, I state that we share with the Mission the convergent view about the problems we face, the policies and reforms we must undertake, as well as the coordination and proper sequence of them. Let me briefly summarize the opinion of the Bank of Albania. The Albanian economy has scored positive growth rates during the first half of the year. Preliminary data suggest that these rhythms will also be preserved during the second half. The country's banking system remains solid, characterized by good liquidity and capital levels. Developments in Greece left no consequences in financial health indicators, reflecting the public's confidence in this system and the measures taken by the Bank of Albania. However, the Albanian economy continues to remain below potential and inflation continues to stay below the 3% target targeted by us. The pace of growth is still insufficient to ensure full employment and its resources are not yet consolidated. In particular, the external environment remains challenging, high uncertainty continues to curb consumption and investment, while credit growth is below the desired level. In response to this situation, at the last meeting of the Supervisory Council, the Bank of Albania decided to further increase monetary stimulus, lowering the basic interest rate to 1.75%. This movement aims to lower the cost of financing as well as promoting consumption and investment. Taking into account the expected praise of Eurobond, the Albanian financial system is expected to operate under abundant and low-cost liquidity conditions during 2016 and beyond. Meanwhile, economic activity is expected to return to potential and inflation on target within the medium-term horizon. However, the realization of this scenario requires taking action in the following directions: - Preserving the current kah of macroeconomic policies. The Bank of Albania considers that the current composition of macroeconomic policies, based on monetary policy stimulus and fiscal policy consolidation, is the right one for the Albanian economy. At the same time, this composition will ensure the growth of the economy and reduce the risk emanating from public debt levels. For its part, the Bank of Albania will continue to maintain a monetary policy stimulus course, as long as inflation has not returned steadily to its intended target. - Reducing uncertainty and improving the business climate in all segments of the Albanian economy. In our analyses, uncertainty results as one of the reasons that continues to curb consumption and investment in the country. Softening it, through increasing transparency and strengthening political consensus, would help create a more favourable environment for economic growth. - Credit incentive, through credit risk reduction. As we have said before, the smooth implementation of the national platform for addressing issues surrounding troubled loans is a necessary step towards returning  t_per_shtyp_me_misionin_e_FMN-se_MF-ne_dhe_MZHETTS-ne_2385.html Page 2 of 3 Governor Seyko's word at joint press conference with IMF mission, MF and MZHETTS 29/07/22, 14:54 credit at a stable and efficient source of financing for the Albanian economy. - The country's development outlook remains positive, but sustainable growth requires combining short-term economic stimulus with long-term structural reforms. In the direction of structural reforms, I want to underline some of the concrete commitments that we, as monetary authorities, have made under the agreement with the IMF: The Bank of Albania will continue to exchange information and co-operate with the European Banking Authority and other counterparty institutions, in the direction of co-ordinating supervisory measures and regulatory practices; The Bank of Albania will review several regulatory requirements, with the aim of promoting restructuring, cleaning or selling troubled loans from banks' balance sheets; The Bank of Albania will take further measures to improve the functioning of the Credit Register. In closing, I would like to thank the IMF Mission for the honest discussions and collaborative approach they have displayed. Thank you!  t_per_shtyp_me_misionin_e_FMN-se_MF-ne_dhe_MZHETTS-ne_2385.html Page 3 of 3

Si gjithnj, diskutimet kan qen t prqendruara n shkmbimin e opinioneve mbi zhvillimet ekonomike dhe financiare, duke u prpjekur natyrisht t identifikojm politikat dhe instrumentet e duhura pr t ecur prpara, n rrugn e zhvillimit t qndrueshm t vendit. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikujt_per_shtyp_me_misionin_e_FMN-se_MF-ne_dhe_MZHETTS-ne_2385.html Pagina 1 di 3 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn e prbashkt pr shtyp me misionin e FMN-s, MF-n dhe MZHETTS-n 29/07/22, 14:54 N prgjithsi, konstatoj se ndajm me Misionin pikpamje konvergjente n lidhje me problemet me t cilat prballemi, me politikat dhe reformat t cilat duhet t ndrmarrim, si dhe me koordinimin e sekuencimin e duhur t tyre. M lejoni t prmbledh shkurtimisht opinionin e Banks s Shqipris. Ekonomia shqiptare ka shnuar norma pozitive rritjeje gjat gjysms s par t vitit. T dhnat paraprake sugjerojn se kto ritme do t ruhen edhe gjat gjysms s dyt. Sistemi bankar i vendit mbetet solid, i karakterizuar nga nivele t mira likuiditeti dhe kapitali. Zhvillimet n Greqi nuk lan pasoj n treguesit e shndetit financiar, duke reflektuar besimin e publikut n kt sistem dhe masat e marra nga Banka e Shqipris. Megjithat, ekonomia shqiptare vazhdon t mbetet nn potencial dhe inflacioni vazhdon t qndroj posht objektivit prej 3% t synuar prej nesh. Ritmi i rritjes sht ende i pamjaftueshm pr t siguruar punznie t plot dhe burimet e saj nuk jan ende t konsoliduara. N veanti, ambienti i jashtm mbetet sfidues, pasiguria e lart vazhdon t frenoj konsumin dhe investimet, ndrsa rritja e kredis sht posht nivelit t dshiruar. N prgjigje t ksaj situate, n mbledhjen e fundit t Kshillit Mbikqyrs, Banka e Shqipris vendosi t rrit m tej stimulin monetar, duke ulur normn baz t interesit n nivelin 1.75%. Kjo lvizje synon t ul koston e financimit si dhe nxitjen e konsumit dhe investimeve. Duke marr parasysh edhe lvrimin e pritur t Eurobondit, sistemi financiar shqiptar pritet t operoj n kushtet e likuiditetit t bollshm dhe me kosto t ult, gjat vitit 2016 e m tej. Ndrkoh, edhe aktiviteti ekonomik pritet t kthehet n potencial dhe inflacioni n objektiv, brenda horizontit afatmesm. Megjithat, realizimi i ktij skenari krkon marrjen e masave n drejtimet e mposhtme: - Ruajtjen e kahut aktual t politikave makroekonomike. Banka e Shqipris gjykon se kompozimi aktual i politikave makroekonomike, i bazuar n kahun stimulues t politiks monetare dhe at konsolidues t politiks fiskale, sht ai i duhuri pr ekonomin shqiptare. Njkohsisht, ky kompozim do t siguroj rritjen e ekonomis dhe reduktimin e rrezikut q buron nga nivelet e borxhit publik. Nga ana e saj, Banka e Shqipris do t vazhdoj t ruaj nj kurs stimulues t politiks monetare, pr sa koh q inflacioni nuk sht kthyer n mnyr t qndrueshme n objektivin e synuar. - Reduktimin e pasiguris dhe prmirsimin e klims s biznesit, n t gjitha segmentet e ekonomis shqiptare. N analizat tona, pasiguria rezulton si nj nga arsyet q vazhdon t frenoj konsumin dhe investimet n vend. Zbutja e saj, nprmjet rritjes s transparencs dhe forcimit t konsensusit politik, do t ndihmonte n krijimin e nj ambienti m favorizues pr rritjen ekonomike. - Nxitjen e kreditimit, nprmjet reduktimit t rrezikut t kredis. Title: Speech in the presentation of the EBRD Transition Report 2015-2016
text: , Mr. Gent Sejko, in the see... IT Parliamentary Economics and Finance on draft budget 2016 29/07/22, 14:46 , Mr Gent Seyko, at the hearing of the Parliamentary Economic Commission and Finance on the 2016 draft budget Publication date: 09.12.2015 Honourable, Mr. Chairman of the Commission, Honourable ladies and gentlemen, Drafting and adopting the budget and accompanying fiscal package is a very important moment for contouring economic policies for next year. As a financial plan for public sector activity, the budget details the main features of fiscal policy and envisions support with policy funds and development priorities. In parallel with it, fiscal packages and tax legislation influence the structure of private sector development incentives. For this reason, I appreciate that careful examination, extensive consultation and constructive debates on them serve to finalize a document as quality and realistic as possible. In response to your invitation, I will present the bank of Albania's opinion on the main draft points for 2016. Wanting to be correct and loyal to the central bank's legal mandate, the ongoing opinion will focus on the main areas of our action and expertise: (i) the economic framework and economic policies; (ii) fiscal projections and the sustainability of public finances; and, (iii) the expected impact of public borrowing on the internal financial market. In closing, (iv) I want to share with you some suggestions for increasing the effectiveness and sustainability of public finances, during 2016 and onwards. 1. The expected economic framework for 2016 and its supporting policies Budget indicators and the performance of economic activity have a mutual and causal connection, both in the forecast and realisation phase. Accuracy of  lamentar_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_mbi_projektbuxhetin_2016.html Page 1 of 5 , Mr. Gent Sejko, in the see... IT Parliamentary Economics and Finance on draft budget 2016 29/07/22, 14:46 Budgetary projections depend to a large extent on the quality of macroeconomic forecasts, while the economy's own performance is a function of economic policies and structural reforms designed to be followed during the year. For this reason, formatting a reliable and consistent framework of expected economic developments is of paramount importance. Fiscal forecasts of the draft budget are based on the assumption of a real GDP increase of 3.4% during 2016, while inflation is expected to reach 2.3% and interest rates are projected to stay at levels approximate to those of 2015. These forecasts are based on expectations for domestic demand recovery and expectations for a more positive situation in our trading partners. Also, these forecasts factor the continuation of fiscal consolidation even over the next year, as shown by the reduction of the budget deficit from 4.1% of GDP in 2015, to 2.2% of GDP in 2016. The Bank of Albania estimates that these forecasts offer an acceptable starting point for drafting next year's fiscal projections. In our judgment, economic growth will come to progressive improvement over the next two years, while inflationary pressures will continue to remain weak. Also, interest rates will continue to stay at low levels, in response to our monetary stimulus policy and the reduction of public borrowing in internal financial markets. Also, in line with the country's development needs and agreement commitments with the IMF, the Bank of Albania has sought and supported pursuing a consolidating fiscal policy aimed at reducing the deficit and public debt. The consolidating fiscal policy kahu is consistent with monetary stimulus policy pursued by the Bank of Albania and is reflected in the high intensity of this monetary stimulus. In this way, the two main economic and fiscal policies - simultaneously support economic growth and serve to reduce public debt, which also constitutes one of the biggest structural weaknesses of the Albanian economy. 2. Fiscal projections and the sustainability of public finances In the bank of Albania's view, the budget must respect two important and interdependent objectives with priority. First, it must be a realistic budget and based on careful predictions. Second, it should help the long-term sustainability of public finances. According to the draft budget projections: - budgetary revenues are expected to reach 417.7 billion dollars during 2016 or about 27.3% of GDP. This value represents an annual increase of 4.9% compared to the level planned for 2015; - The public spending of 2016 will be about 452.1 billion dollars or 29.5% of GDP. In annual terms, spending is expected to shrink by about 0.9% compared to a year ago; - The 2016 budget deficit is projected to the tune of 34.4 billion dollars or about 41% lower than a year earlier. In GDP terms, the budget deficit is estimated at about 2.2% of GDP, which represents a reduction of 1.8 percentage points against  lamentar_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_mbi_projektbuxhetin_2016.html Page 2 of 5 , Mr. Gent Sejko, in the see... IT Parliamentary Economics and Finance on draft budget 2016 29/07/22, 14:46 2015 level. The reduction follows the completion of the payment of outstanding liabilities (with an impact of 1.3 percentage points) and discrete fiscal policy (with an impact of 0.5 percentage points); - The primary balance for 2016 results in positive results, about 0.3% of GDP, showing an improvement of about 1.5 percentage points over the previous year. The current balance is forecast to reach a suffice of about 34 billion dollars or about 2.2% of GDP, showing a slight improvement against last year. The Bank of Albania estimates that the forecast of budgetary revenues is cautious. Our forecast for tax revenues is approximate, with projectbudget forecasts. Also, the Bank of Albania considers that the draft budget presents some structural improvements, especially in the direction of improving the primary balance, which measures the budget's impact on public debt and towards preserving the positive current balance, which advances the eficiency of the use of public income. These improvements should be included and further explained in the budgets of the following years. As for the level of public debt, the Bank of Albania estimates that meeting draft projections will provide a turning point in the trajectory of public debt. The projected debt level is forecast to drop from 72.6% of GDP in 2015 to about 71% of GDP in 2016. However, the Bank of Albania draws attention to the fact that this level of debt remains high and continues to pose an obstacle to the country's development. Its steady reduction will require consistent preservation of the consolidating fiscal policy kah for many years to come. First of all, this will require bipartisan will and political consensus, a philosophy that I invite you all to adopt. 3 . Draft budget and internal financial market The government's financial activity has unquestionable impact on internal financial markets. This becomes more vulnerable in countries like Albania, where the financial system is relatively undiversified and where the public sector has a major impact on liquidity and interest rate indicators. The 2016 draft budget envisions a new public borrowing in internal financial markets around the 21 billion dollar level. Starting from the liquidity situation and the structure of interest rates in these markets, the Bank of Albania estimates that this target is feasible and low-impact on the liquidity situation, at the level and the slope of the interest rate curve. These developments create more space in banks' balance sheets for increasing private sector lending. *** At the close of this opinion, let me express some suggestions from the Bank of Albania for the 2016 budget and for further structural improvements in the management of public finances. 4. Some suggestions from the Bank of Albania  lamentar_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_mbi_projektbuxhetin_2016.html Page 3 of 5 , Mr. Gent Sejko, in the see... IT Parliamentary Economics and Finance on draft budget 2016 29/07/22, 14:46 4.1 Revenue Forecasting and Budgetary Risk Management To increase fiscal transparency and protect the budget from major deviations, the Bank of Albania suggests meeting it with alternative fiscal plans, the implementation of which would be conditional on possible revenue deviations from the projected level. Having been in line with our previous communications, the Bank of Albania considers that the sources of economic growth do not yet appear consolidated and the balance of risks continues to remain at the bottom. In other words, the probability of avoiding the lower direction from predicting the performance of public income is greater than the probability of avoidance in the upper direction. Fiscal authorities must continue to exercise due care, so that the budget deficit and public debt remain at planned levels. If the realisation of budgetary income is lower than forecast, the Bank of Albania suggests preliminary identification and ranking of expenditure according to the level of importance or profitability, so that fiscal correction based on reducing spending is transparent and effective. In the same way, in the event of better revenue performance against the forecast, we suggest determining in advance whether additional revenues will go towards improving fiscal position by reducing the deficit and debt, or will be spent to preserve the budget deficit and fiscal policy course unchanged. The Bank of Albania suggests that: (i) if budgetary revenues result in higher than the plan as a result of faster economic growth than forecast, additional revenues should be used to reduce debt. This response increases fiscal spaces for dealing with possible future shocks, without negatively impacting economic growth; (ii) if budgetary revenues are higher than the planned level, as a result of a more positive effect of fighting informality or improving fiscal management, additional revenues can be used to carry out capital expenditure. Let this reaction untouch the fiscal stimulus in the economy. 4.2 The spending structure needs attention in the future The ratio of current spending to capital expenditure has shown a falling tendency for several years. Capital spending has a more efficient and long-term economic impact on indicators of economic activity. Furthermore, at the stage where the country is located, capital expenditure is important for improving infrastructure and unlocking growth factors. The Bank of Albania suggests increasing efforts that, even within the limits posed by the commitment to fiscal consolidation, this tendency to be corrected over the coming years.  lamentar_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_mbi_projektbuxhetin_2016.html Page 4 of 5 , Mr. Gent Sejko, in the see... IT Parliamentary Economics and Finance on draft budget 2016 4.3 Deficit and Public Debt Financing Facility 29/07/22, 14:46 The Bank of Albania estimates that foreign exchange borrowing increases risks from possible exchange rate fluctuations. Internal financial markets have the opportunity to cover the level of domestic borrowing planned in the budget over the next year, without putting pressure on liquidity and interest rate indicators. In this context, the Bank of Albania suggests that foreign financing in trade terms be seen as a contingent plan, conditional on the emergence of strong tensions in internal financial markets or their inability to cover the level of domestic borrowing. 4.4 Long-term sustainability of public finances Finally, the Bank of Albania follows the need to present a fiscal rule, which will discipline fiscal policy and ensure the long-term sustainability of public finances. The accompanying draft report envisions that this law will be introduced under the comprehensive revision of the organic budget law. The Bank of Albania suggests that the adoption of a fiscal rule be seen as a separate, priority and breakaway initiative from other objectives of revising organic budget law. Among other things, this rule should present a reliable and transparent government commitment to reducing public debt, as well as sanction the preservation of spaces needed for capital expenditure. Thank you for the attention!  lamentar_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_mbi_projektbuxhetin_2016.html Page 5 of 5

N prgjigje t ftess suaj, do t paraqes n vijim opinionin e Banks s Shqipris mbi pikat kryesore t projektbuxhetit pr vitin 2016. Duke dashur t jem korrekt dhe besnik i mandatit ligjor t banks qendrore, opinioni n vazhdim do t prqendrohet n fushat kryesore t veprimit dhe ekspertizs son: (i) kuadri ekonomik dhe politikat ekonomike; (ii) projeksionet fiskale dhe qndrueshmria e financave publike; dhe, (iii) ndikimi i pritur i huamarrjes publike n tregun e brendshm financiar. N mbyllje, (iv) dshiroj t ndaj me ju disa sugjerime pr rritjen e efektivitetit dhe t qndrueshmris s financave publike, gjat vitit 2016 dhe n vazhdim. 1. Kuadri i pritur ekonomik pr vitin 2016 dhe politikat mbshtetse t tij Treguesit buxhetor dhe ecuria e aktivitetit ekonomik kan nj lidhje t ndrsjell dhe shkaksore, si n fazn e parashikimit ashtu edhe n at t realizimit. Gent Sejko, n seait Parlamentar t Ekonomis dhe Financave mbi projektbuxhetin 2016 29/07/22, 14:46 projeksioneve buxhetore varet n nj mas t madhe nga cilsia e parashikimeve makroekonomike, ndrkoh q vet ecuria e ekonomis sht funksion i politikave ekonomike dhe i reformave strukturore t parashikuara pr t u ndjekur gjat vitit. Pr kt arsye, formatimi i nj kuadri t besueshm dhe konsistent t zhvillimeve t pritura ekonomike ka rndsi parsore. Parashikimet fiskale t projektbuxhetit jan bazuar n supozimin e nj rritjeje reale t PBB-s me 3.4% gjat vitit 2016, ndrkoh q inflacioni pritet t arrij n 2.3% dhe normat e interesit jan parashikuar t qndrojn n nivele t prafrta me ato t vitit 2015. Kto parashikime bazohen n pritjet pr rikuperimin e krkess s brendshme dhe pritjet pr nj situat m pozitive n partnert tan tregtar. Gjithashtu, kto parashikime faktorizojn vazhdimin e konsolidimit fiskal edhe gjat vitit t ardhshm, sikurse tregohet nga reduktimi i deficitit buxhetor nga 4.1% t PBB-s n vitin 2015, n 2.2% t PBB-s n vitin 2016. Banka e Shqipris vlerson se kto parashikime ofrojn nj piknisje t pranueshme pr hartimin e projeksioneve fiskale t vitit t ardhshm. N gjykimin ton, rritja ekonomike do t vij n prmirsim progresiv gjat dy viteve t ardhshme, ndrsa presionet inflacioniste do t vazhdojn t mbeten t dobta. Gjithashtu, normat e interesit do t vazhdojn t qndrojn n nivele t ulta, n prgjigje t politiks son monetare stimuluese dhe t reduktimit t huamarrjes publike n tregjet e brendshme financiare. Gjithashtu, n prputhje me nevojat e zhvillimit t vendit dhe angazhimet e marrveshjes me FMN-n, Banka e Shqipris ka krkuar dhe ka mbshtetur ndjekjen e nj politike fiskale konsoliduese, e cila synon reduktimin e deficitit dhe t borxhit publik. Kahu konsolidues i politiks fiskale sht konsistent me politikn monetare stimuluese t ndjekur nga Banka e Shqipris dhe pasqyrohet n intensitetin e lart t ktij stimuli monetar. N kt mnyr, dy politikat kryesore ekonomike ajo monetare dhe ajo fiskale - njkohsisht mbshtesin rritjen ekonomike dhe i shrbejn reduktimit t borxhit publik, i cili prbn dhe nj nga dobsit m t mdha strukturore t ekonomis shqiptare. 2. Projeksionet fiskale dhe qndrueshmria e financave publike N kndvshtrimin e Banks s Shqipris, buxheti duhet t respektoj me prparsi dy objektiva t rndsishm dhe t ndrvarur. S pari, ai duhet t jet nj buxhet realist dhe i mbshtetur n parashikime t kujdesshme. S dyti, ai duhet t ndihmoj qndrueshmrin afatgjat t financave publike. Sipas projeksioneve t projektbuxhetit: - t ardhurat buxhetore pritet t arrijn n 417.7 miliard lek gjat vitit 2016 ose n rreth 27.3% t PBB-s. Kjo vler prfaqson nj rritje vjetore prej 4.9% krahasuar me nivelin e planifikuar pr vitin 2015; - shpenzimet publike t vitit 2016 do t jen rreth 452.1 miliard lek ose 29.5% e PBB-s. N terma vjetor, shpenzimet pritet t tkurren me rreth 0.9% krahasuar me nj vit m par; - deficiti buxhetor i vitit 2016 sht parashikuar n masn 34.4 miliard lek ose rreth 41% m i ult se nj vit m par. Reduktimi vjen si pasoj e prfundimit t pagess s detyrimeve t prapambetura (me nj ndikim prej 1.3 piksh prqindjeje) dhe politiks fiskale diskrecionare (me nj ndikim prej 0.5 piksh prqindjeje); - balanca primare pr vitin 2016 rezulton pozitive, rreth 0.3% e PBB-s, duke shfaqur nj prmirsim prej rreth 1.5 piksh prqindjeje ndaj vitit paraardhs. Balanca korrente parashikohet t arrij nj suficit prej rreth 34 miliard leksh ose rreth 2.2% e PBB-s, duke shfaqur nj prmirsim t leht kundrejt vitit t shkuar. Banka e Shqipris vlerson se parashikimi i t ardhurave buxhetore sht i kujdesshm. Parashikimi jon pr t ardhurat tatimore sht i prafrt, me parashikimet e projektbuxhetit. Gjithashtu, Banka e Shqipris gjykon se projektbuxheti paraqet disa prmirsime strukturore, veanrisht n drejtim t prmirsimit t balancs primare, e cila mat ndikimin e buxhetit n borxhin publik dhe n drejtim t ruajtjes s balancs pozitive korrente, e cila prafron eficiencn e prdorimit t t ardhurave publike. Kto prmirsime duhet t prfshihen e t shtjellohen m tej n buxhetet e viteve n vazhdim. Prsa i takon nivelit t borxhit publik, Banka e Shqipris vlerson se prmbushja e projeksioneve t projektbuxhetit do t ofroj nj pik kthese n trajektoren e borxhit publik. Niveli i parashikuar i borxhit parashikohet t zbres nga 72.6% e PBB-s n vitin 2015 n rreth 71% t PBB-s n vitin 2016. Megjithat, Banka e Shqipris trheq vmendjen n faktin se ky nivel borxhi mbetet i lart dhe vazhdon t prbj penges pr zhvillimin e vendit. Reduktimi i qndrueshm i tij do t krkoj ruajtjen n mnyr konsekuente t kahut konsolidues t politiks fiskale edhe pr shum vite n vazhdim. Para s gjithash, kjo do t krkoj vullnet dhe konsensus politik bipartisan, nj filozofi t ciln ju ftoj t gjithve ta adoptojm. 3 . Projektbuxheti dhe tregu i brendshm financiar Aktiviteti financiar i qeveris ka ndikim t padiskutueshm n tregjet e brendshme financiare. Kjo bhet m e prekshme n vende si Shqipria, ku sistemi financiar sht relativisht i pa-diversifikuar dhe ku sektori publik ka nj ndikim t madh n treguesit e likuiditetit dhe t normave t interesit. Projektbuxheti i vitit 2016 parashikon nj huamarrje t re publike n tregjet e brendshme financiare rreth nivelit 21 miliard lek. Duke u nisur nga situata e likuiditetit dhe struktura e normave t interesit n kto tregje, Banka e Shqipris vlerson se ky objektiv sht i realizueshm dhe me ndikim t ult n gjendjen e likuiditetit, n nivelin dhe n pjerrsin e kurbs s normave t interesit. Kto zhvillime krijojn m shum hapsir n bilancet e bankave pr rritjen e kreditimit t sektorit privat. *** N mbyllje t ktij opinioni, m lejoni t shpreh disa sugjerime t Banks s Shqipris pr buxhetin e vitit 2016 dhe pr prmirsime t mtejshme strukturore n administrimin e financave publike. 4. Gent Sejko, n seait Parlamentar t Ekonomis dhe Financave mbi projektbuxhetin 2016 29/07/22, 14:46 4.1 Parashikimi i t ardhurave dhe administrimi i rrezikut buxhetor Pr t rritur transparencn fiskale dhe pr t mbrojtur buxhetin nga shmangie t mdha, Banka e Shqipris sugjeron plotsimin e tij me plane alternative fiskale, zbatimi i t cilave do t ishte i kushtzuar nga devijime t mundshme t t ardhurave nga niveli i parashikuar. Duke qen n linj me komunikimet tona t mparshme, Banka e Shqipris gjykon se burimet e rritjes ekonomike nuk shfaqen ende t konsoliduara dhe balanca e rreziqeve vazhdon t qndroj n kahun e poshtm. Me fjal t tjera, probabiliteti pr shmangie n kahun e poshtm nga parashikimi i ecuris s t ardhurave publike sht m i madh se probabiliteti pr shmangie n kahun e siprm. Autoritetet fiskale duhet t vazhdojn t ushtrojn kujdesin e duhur, n mnyr q deficiti buxhetor dhe borxhi publik t mbeten n nivelet e planifikuara. N rast se realizimi i t ardhurave buxhetore sht m i ult se parashikimi, Banka e Shqipris sugjeron identifikimin paraprak dhe renditjen e shpenzimeve sipas nivelit t rndsis apo t rentabilitetit, n mnyr q korrektimi fiskal i bazuar n reduktimin e shpenzimeve t ishte transparent dhe efektiv. N t njjtn mnyr, n rast performance m t mir t t ardhurave ndaj parashikimit, sugjerojm t prcaktohet paraprakisht nse t ardhurat shtes do t shkojn pr prmirsimin e pozicionit fiskal duke zvogluar deficitin dhe borxhin, apo do t shpenzohen pr t ruajtur t pandryshuar deficitin buxhetor dhe kursin e politiks fiskale. Banka e Shqipris sugjeron q: (i) n rast se t ardhurat buxhetore rezultojn m t larta se plani si pasoj e nj rritjeje ekonomike m t shpejt se parashikimi, t ardhurat shtes duhet t prdoren pr reduktimin e borxhit. Ky reagim rrit hapsirat fiskale pr prballimin e goditjeve t mundshme n t ardhmen, pa ndikuar negativisht mbi rritjen ekonomike; (ii) n rast se t ardhurat buxhetore jan m t larta se niveli i planifikuar, si pasoj e nj efekti m pozitiv t lufts ndaj informalitetit apo prmirsimit t administrimit fiskal, t ardhurat shtes mund t prdoren pr kryerjen e shpenzimeve kapitale. Ky reagim le t paprekur stimulin fiskal n ekonomi. 4.2 Struktura e shpenzimeve ka nevoj pr vmendje n t ardhmen Raporti i shpenzimeve korrente ndaj shpenzimeve kapitale ka shfaqur nj tendenc rnse disavjeare. Shpenzimet kapitale kan nj ndikim ekonomik m t qensishm dhe m afatgjat n treguesit e aktivitetit ekonomik. Pr m tepr, n stadin ku ndodhet vendi, shpenzimet kapitale jan t rndsishme pr prmirsimin e infrastrukturs dhe pr zhbllokimin e faktorve t rritjes. Banka e Shqipris sugjeron rritjen e prpjekjeve q, edhe brenda kufizimeve q paraqet angazhimi pr konsolidim fiskal, kjo tendenc t korrektohet gjat viteve t ardhshme. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjlamentar_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_mbi_projektbuxhetin_2016.html Pagina 4 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Title: Speech held during the Annual Analysis of KLSH for 2015
text: , Mr Gent Seyko at the presentation of the BERZH Transition Report 2015-2016 29/07/22, 14:45 , Mr Gent Seyko at the presentation of the BERZH Transition Report 2015-2016 Publication date: 17.12.2015 Honorable representatives of the BERZH, Dear friends and colleagues, I want to start this word of greeting, welcoming you to the premises of the Bank of Albania! The event we are meeting for today is the presentation of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (BERZH) Transition Report for 2015-2016. I am convinced that open discussion of this report will provide a new perspective on the country's current development problems and on possible ways to resolve them. Page 1 of 5 , Mr Gent Seyko at the presentation of the BERZH Transition Report 2015-2016 29/07/22, 14:45 At this short entrance I want to stop at three main moments. First, as host of this activity, I want to say two words about the importance of the Transition Report and its main messages. Second, as Governor of the Bank of Albania, I find it appropriate to offer a preliminary assessment of the validity of these messages for our country. Third, I feel it necessary to make a very short summary of the important contribution the BERZh has had in the transition process. 1. Transition report and its main messages for the current year The Transition Report occupies a primary place on the list of professional analyses that are done to the economies of the region and wider. This annual report is much more than a summary mirror of the current economic and financial situation. It provides a coherent guide to formatting the development agenda of transitioncountries, underlining the structural growth problems and macro and microeconomic weaknesses of these countries. To illustrate what I said above, I am bringing to your attention that the Transition Report over the past few years has focused on topics such as: the impact on the region of the global financial crisis (in 2011); challenges arising from the growing integration of the world economy (in 2012); the reasons for the prolonged transition (in 2013); And, the problems that technological and financial innovation brings to developing countries (in 2014). All these topics have fully defined the challenges albania has faced and continues to face. The main theme of this year's Report concerns the need for the creation of a new financing model for transitioncountries. This conclusion naturally stems from the context of economic and financial developments in them. Although seven years have passed since the beginning of the crisis, transitioneconomies continue to be characterized by fading growth rhythms. As in past experiences, economic recovery is partly curbed by cyclic weaknesses and partly from the structural problems of the real sector. But, unlike past experiences, economic recovery after the last financial crisis has been hampered and continues to be hampered by poor bank credit performance and lack of financing options. Page 2 of 5 , Mr Gent Seyko at the presentation of the BERZH Transition Report 2015-2016 29/07/22, 14:45 In summary, the Report notes that the level of development and diversification of our financial systems does not respond enough and properly to the needs we have for investment. For a number of reasons, this discrepancy has come to be strengthened in the post-crisis period and, if not addressed with priority, it could pose a serious obstacle to our development path. The report further continues with concrete proposals for resolving this scare. These proposals aim not only at further expansion of the financial system, but also quality improvements in the way it operates. The Bank of Albania has paid constant attention to lending problems. At our last annual conference, we had a wide-ranging discussion of the shortcomings that the model for financing the Albanian economy shows. I cannot and do not wish to claim that the Bank of Albania has all the answers and that it has all the instruments for their solution. But what I can say is that the Bank of Albania has a good diagnosis of the situation and is making maximum efforts to promote lending and for the sustainable development of the financial system. Let me continue to make a brief summary of Albania's position in the face of the main challenges addressed in this year's Transition Report. 2. Challenges of developing the financial system in Albania The report suggests that transition countries have had a noticeable slowdown in the pace of investment. This slowdown is not justified by cyclic or fundamental factors, and is harmful to the long-term growth of these economies. The Bank of Albania has continuously stressed that the global economic and financial crisis left a mark on the country's development. One of its intended effects has been to slow the pace of investment, from an average of about 36% of GDP in the decade before the crisis to an average of about 28% of GDP in subsequent years. Part of this slowdown is dedicated to reducing investment in residential buildings, which constitutes a natural correction of the rapid growth shown in this segment in the pre-crisis period. But, in parallel with it, the rest of this slowdown is dedicated to reducing investments in machinery, equipment and infrastructure, which negatively affects the country's development potential. According to some estimates, the level of capital stock per resident in Albania is about 40% of the average level of this indicator for the Eurozone. This level of capital is of course insufficient to support the convergence of the standard of living with the countries in question. For this reason, promoting investment and expanding potential growth rhythms should be constant priorities of our work. According to the Report, increased investment in transition countries continues to be curbed by lack of funding resources. In particular, the offer for bank loans appears reduced, as a result of structural changes in the European banking sector, but also as a result of problems inherited in the financial systems of transitioncountries. Page 3 of 5 , Mr Gent Seyko at the presentation of the BERZH Transition Report 2015-2016 29/07/22, 14:45 In general, the region's economies have financial systems dominated by the banking sector. This financial structure helped channel foreign savings into local loans, but this process was accompanied by a high degree of euroisation in the pre-crisis period and rapidly increasing troubled loans in the period after it. The loan offer shrunk significantly in the post-crisis period. European banking groups had financial difficulties and withdrew funds from a large part of transition countries. At the same time, the new regulatory environment in the European Union, the high level of euroisation and the rapid growth of troubled loans, damaged the balance sheets of the real and financial sector of the economy. The performance of the financial system in Albania has a series of parallels with the performance of the financial system in countries in the region. The banking sector is the main actor in the financial system, which owns over 90% of total financial assets. Bank credit had a rapid increase in the 2004-2008 time arc, moving from 8% to 35% gdp level. The subsequent period showed a marked slowdown in the pace of credit growth and its ratio to GDP currently stands around the 36% level. Similarly, lending in Albania had strong euroisation tendencies in the pre-crisis period, where nearly three out of four loans were in currencies, while this tendency showed a marked improvement in the following period where the loan ratio to the total reached around 40% level. Finally, the trajectory of troubled loans has had a similar performance to the countries of the region. The post-crisis period was accompanied by a rapid increase in these loans; Their ratio to total credit peaked at around 25% in 2014 and subsequently followed a clear downward trend. On the other hand, the financial system in Albania has its own specifics. A positive feature that is worth mentioning is the fact that banking sector activity in Albania is based on internal sources of financing. Currently, the ratio of loans to deposits fluctuates around 50% level and the banking sector is characterized by a high liquidity situation, especially in currencies. This feature has protected Albania from fluctuations in global financial flows. Unlike many countries in the region, the withdrawal of bank funds from Albania was sporadic and relatively limited. Similarly, the high level of investment in the country has been supported to a considerable extent by foreign direct investment. In the post-crisis period, these investments have fluctuated around the 8% LEVEL of GDP and have constituted a significant depreciation of slowing bank credit. Finally, the Transition Report presents some concrete suggestions for further restructuring and development of the financial system. Among other things, this system must further diversify in terms of its segments and products, as well as should be based more on internal savings. Also, the banking sector and businesses need to be more rational in their financial strategies. Of course, these suggestions also make up the most important contribution of this Report. Not wanting to precede this discussion, I would like to stress that Albania has taken some important steps for increasing internal savings such as reform of the pension system; energy sector reform coupled with lowering its fiscal subsidies, and returning to a falling public debt trajectory. Likewise, as a monetary authority and supervisory and regulatory institution of the banking system, the Bank of Albania has taken concrete steps to boost demand and supply. Page 4 of 5 , Mr Gent Seyko at the presentation of the BERZH Transition Report 2015-2016 29/07/22, 14:45 For credit. These measures have aimed at lowering the cost of financing, dealing with troubled loans, introducing more careful supervisory rates on currency lending and promoting loan restructuring. We have also attracted the attention of banks and businesses that their business strategies should be more rational and forward-paced. On the other hand, the capital markets segment continues to remain unexplored. The development of this segment, at the local but also regional level, continues to be curbed by lack of expertise and financial culture, by insufficient standards of transparency and goodgovernance of businesses. Capital markets can provide an alternative platform for financing business projects, much more so if these markets were to succeed in attracting the interest of major players in the global financial market. Dear friends, I want to close it, saying two more words about the irreplaceable role berzh has had in the Albanian transition process. 3. BERZH and Albanian transition Beyond the consultative function I foresaw above, the BERZH has made an important contribution to concrete support with financial investments in key areas of the economy. According to the latest data, BERZH has invested about 940m euros in the Albanian economy through 70 projects, in areas such as infrastructure (with about 34% of the total); energy (by about 28%); development of financial infrastructure (by about 23%); as well as various projects in the field of industry, trade and agribusiness (with about 15%). The beneficiaries of these projects have been both public and private sectors. In particular, I would like to underline that the guarantee line this bank has offered to the Deposit Security Agency in Albania constitutes an additional safety net for our entire financial system and has greatly helped to its normal functioning. Thank you for your attention and invite you to attend the Report presentation! Page 5 of 5

S pari, si mikprits i ktij aktiviteti, dshiroj t them dy fjal mbi rndsin e Raportit t Tranzicionit dhe mesazhet kryesore t tij. S dyti, si Guvernator i Banks s Shqipris, e gjej me vend t ofroj nj vlersim paraprak t vlefshmris s ktyre mesazheve pr vendin ton. S treti, e ndjej t nevojshme t bj nj prmbledhje fare t shkurtr t kontributit t rndsishm q ka pasur BERZH-i n procesin e tranzicionit. 1. Raporti i Tranzicionit dhe mesazhet kryesore t tij pr vitin aktual Raporti i Tranzicionit z nj vend primar n listn e analizave profesionale q iu bhen ekonomive t rajonit dhe m gjer. Ky raport vjetor sht shum m tepr se nj pasqyr prmbledhse e situats ekonomike dhe financiare aktuale. Ai ofron nj udhrrfyes koherent pr formatimin e axhends s zhvillimit t vendeve n tranzicion, duke nnvizuar problemet strukturore t rritjes dhe dobsit makro e mikroekonomike t ktyre vendeve. Pr t ilustruar sa thash m sipr, po risjell n vmendjen tuaj se Raporti i Tranzicionit gjat viteve t fundit sht fokusuar n tema t tilla si: ndikimi n rajon i krizs financiare globale (n vitin 2011); sfidat q vijn nga integrimi n rritje i ekonomis botrore (n vitin 2012); arsyet e tranzicionit t zgjatur (n vitin 2013); dhe, problemet q sjell inovacioni teknologjik e financiar pr vendet n zhvillim (n vitin 2014). T gjitha kto tema kan prkuar plotsisht me sfidat me t cilat sht prballur dhe vazhdon t prballet Shqipria. Tema kryesore e Raportit t sivjetshm ka t bj me nevojn pr krijimin e nj modeli t ri financimi pr vendet n tranzicion. Ky konkluzion buron natyrshm nga konteksti i zhvillimeve ekonomike dhe financiare n to. Edhe pse kan kaluar shtat vjet nga fillimi i krizs, ekonomit n tranzicion vazhdojn t karakterizohen nga ritme t zbehta rritjeje. Ashtu si dhe n eksperiencat e kaluara, rikuperimi ekonomik frenohet pjesrisht nga dobsit ciklike dhe pjesrisht nga problemet strukturore t sektorit real. Por, n ndryshim nga eksperiencat e kaluara, rikuperimi ekonomik pas krizs s fundit financiare sht penguar e vazhdon t pengohet dhe nga ecuria e dobt e kreditit bankar dhe mungesa e alternativave t financimit. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fj_ne_prezantimin_e_Raportit_te_Tranzicionit_te_BERZH_2015-2016.html Pagina 2 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko n prezantimin e Raportit t Tranzicionit t BERZH 2015-2016 29/07/22, 14:45 N mnyr t prmbledhur, Raporti v n dukje se niveli i zhvillimit dhe diversifikimit t sistemeve tona financiare nuk i prgjigjet sa dhe si duhet nevojave q kemi pr investim. Pr nj sr arsyesh, kjo mosprputhje ka ardhur duke u forcuar n periudhn pas krizs dhe, nse nuk trajtohet me prparsi, ajo mund t prbj nj penges serioze n rrugn ton t zhvillimit. Raporti vazhdon m tej me propozime konkrete pr zgjidhjen e ktij ngri. Kto propozime synojn jo vetm zgjerimin e mtejshm t sistemit financiar, por edhe prmirsime cilsore n mnyrn e funksionimit t tij. Banka e Shqipris i ka kushtuar vmendje t vazhdueshme problemeve t kreditimit. N konferencn ton t fundit vjetore, ne patm nj diskutim t gjer t mangsive q shfaq modeli i financimit t ekonomis shqiptare. Nuk mund dhe nuk dshiroj t pretendoj se Banka e Shqipris i ka t gjitha prgjigjet dhe se ajo disponon t gjitha instrumentet pr zgjidhjen e tyre. Por, ajo q mund t them sht se, Banka e Shqipris ka nj diagnostikim t mir t situats dhe sht duke br prpjekjet maksimale pr nxitjen e kreditimit dhe pr zhvillimin e qndrueshm t sistemit financiar. M lejoni n vazhdim t bj nj prmbledhje t shkurtr t pozicionit t Shqipris prball sfidave kryesore t trajtuara n Raportin e sivjetshm t Tranzicionit. 2. Sfidat e zhvillimit t sistemit financiar n Shqipri Raporti sugjeron se vendet n tranzicion kan pasur nj ngadalsim t dukshm t ritmit t investimeve. Ky ngadalsim nuk justifikohet nga faktort ciklik apo fondamental, dhe sht i dmshm pr rritjen afatgjat t ktyre ekonomive. Banka e Shqipris ka theksuar n vazhdimsi se kriza ekonomike dhe financiare botrore la gjurm n zhvillimin e vendit. Nj ndr efektet e spikatura t saj, ka qen dhe ngadalsimi i ritmit t investimeve, nga nj mesatare prej rreth 36% t PBB-s n dekadn para krizs n nj mesatare prej rreth 28% t PBB-s n vitet pasuese. Nj pjes e ktij ngadalsimi i dedikohet reduktimit t investimit n ndrtesa rezidenciale, ka prbn nj korrektim t natyrshm t rritjes s shpejt t shfaqur n kt segment n periudhn para krizs. Por, paralelisht me t, pjesa tjetr e ktij ngadalsimi i dedikohet reduktimit t investimeve n makineri, pajisje dhe infrastruktur, ka ndikon negativisht potencialin e zhvillimit t vendit. Sipas disa vlersimeve, niveli i stokut t kapitalit pr banor n Shqipri sht sa rreth 40% e nivelit mesatar t ktij treguesi pr Eurozonn. Ky nivel kapitali sht natyrisht i pamjaftueshm pr t mbshtetur konvergjencn e standardit t jetess me vendet n fjal. Pr kt arsye, nxitja e investimeve dhe zgjerimi i ritmeve t rritjes potenciale duhet t jen prioritete konstante t puns son. Sipas Raportit, rritja e investimeve n vendet n tranzicion vazhdon t frenohet nga mungesa e burimeve t financimit. N veanti, oferta pr kredi bankare shfaqet e reduktuar, si pasoj e ndryshimeve strukturore t sektorit bankar evropian, por edhe si pasoj e problemeve t trashguara n sistemet financiare t vendeve n tranzicion. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fj_ne_prezantimin_e_Raportit_te_Tranzicionit_te_BERZH_2015-2016.html Pagina 3 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko n prezantimin e Raportit t Tranzicionit t BERZH 2015-2016 29/07/22, 14:45 N prgjithsi, ekonomit e rajonit kan sisteme financiare t dominuara nga sektori bankar. Kjo struktur financiare ndihmoi kanalizimin e kursimeve t huaja n kredi lokale, por ky proces u shoqrua me nj shkall t lart euroizimi n periudhn para krizs dhe me rritje t shpejt t kredive me probleme n periudhn pas saj. Oferta e kredis u tkurr ndjeshm n periudhn pas krizs. Grupet bankare evropiane patn vshtirsi financiare dhe trhoqn fondet nga nj pjes e madhe e vendeve n tranzicion. N t njjtn koh, ambienti i ri rregullator n Bashkimin Evropian, niveli i lart i euroizimit dhe rritja e shpejt e kredive me probleme, dmtuan bilancet e sektorit real dhe financiar t ekonomis. Ecuria e sistemit financiar n Shqipri ka nj sr paralelesh me ecurin e sistemit financiar n vendet e rajonit. Sektori bankar sht aktori kryesor i sistemit financiar i cili ka n pronsi t tij mbi 90% t aktiveve financiare totale. Kredia bankare pati nj rritje t shpejt n harkun kohor 2004-2008, duke kaluar nga niveli 8% n nivelin 35% t PBB-s. Periudha pasuese shfaqi nj ngadalsim t dukshm t ritmit t rritjes s kredis dhe raporti i saj ndaj PBB-s qndron aktualisht rreth nivelit 36%. Po kshtu, kreditimi n Shqipri pati tendenca t forta euroizimi n periudhn para krizs, ku afrisht tre nga katr kredi ishin n valut, ndrkoh q kjo tendenc ka shfaqur nj prmirsim t dukshm n periudhn vijuese ku raporti i kredis n lek ndaj totalit arriti rreth nivelit 40%. S fundi, trajektorja e kredive me probleme ka pasur nj ecuri t ngjashme me vendet e rajonit. Periudha pas krizs u shoqrua me nj rritje t shpejt t ktyre kredive; raporti i tyre ndaj kredis totale kulmoi rreth nivelit 25% n vitin 2014 dhe ka ndjekur m pas nj tendenc t qart rnse. Nga ana tjetr, sistemi financiar n Shqipri ka dhe specifikat e veta. Nj tipar pozitiv q vlen t prmendet sht fakti se aktiviteti i sektorit bankar n Shqipri bazohet n burimet e brendshme t financimit. Aktualisht, raporti i kredive ndaj depozitave luhatet rreth nivelit 50% dhe sektori bankar karakterizohet nga nj situat e lart likuiditeti, sidomos n valut. Ky tipar ka mbrojtur Shqiprin nga luhatjet e flukseve financiare botrore. N ndryshim nga shum vende t rajonit, trheqja e fondeve bankare nga Shqipria ishte sporadike dhe relativisht e kufizuar. Po kshtu, niveli i lart i investimeve n vend sht mbshtetur n nj mas t konsiderueshme nga investimet e huaja direkte. N periudhn pas krizs, kto investime jan luhatur rreth nivelit 8% t PBB-s dhe kan prbr nj amortizues t ndjeshm t ngadalsimit t kredis bankare. S fundi, Raporti i Tranzicionit paraqet disa sugjerime konkrete pr ristrukturimin dhe zhvillimin e mtejshm t sistemit financiar. Ndr t tjera, ky sistem duhet t diversifikohet m tej n terma t segmenteve dhe produkteve t tij, si dhe duhet t bazohet m shum n kursimet e brendshme. Gjithashtu, sektori bankar dhe bizneset duhet t tregohen m racional n strategjit e tyre financiare. Natyrisht q kto sugjerime prbjn edhe kontributin m t rndsishm t ktij Raporti. text: Governor presents bank of Albania's 2015 Annual Report to the Economy and Finance Commission 29/07/22, 14:45 Governor presents bank of Albania's 2015 Annual Report to the Economy and Finance Commission Publication date: 29.03.2016 Today, on 29 March 2016, the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Sejko, presented before the Deputies of the Economy and Finance Commission (KEF), the Bank of Albania's Annual Report for 2015. During the year, the decision of the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania was reflected in full, with particular emphasis on measures taken in the direction of strengthening institutional governance and organisational, structural, technological and financial improvement of the Bank of Albania. Furthermore, the Governor stopped at the contribution the Bank of Albania has made to maintaining the country's macroeconomic and financial stability, as well as for further development and consolidation of financial markets. The easing monetary policy pursued in 2015 has been an important factor in supporting the country's economic activity. Through it is guaranteed an economic and financial environment with low interest rates under the conditions of abundant liquidity. Careful supervision of banks, regulatory improvements, along with intensive information exchange with European and international analogue institutions, contributed to strengthening the financial stability of the banking system. An important part of the Governor's exposure was also devoted to the bank of Albania's activity in terms of improving and increasing the security of payment systems, managing and physical security of the currency and banknote, managing the currency reserve, increasing quality research activity, methodological improvements in the Bank's statistical product, public education, its contribution to the financial integration process, to perfect communication with the public, to the development of information technology, to improve accounting standards, to motivate human resources, and certainly the last, but not least, in the direction of strengthening internal control. In the report, the main objectives of the work on which the Bank of Albania's short- and medium-term activity will be oriented during 2016 and beyond were also presented. Title: Speech at the press conference of the monetary policy decision-making of the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania
text: Questions - answers of the Governor's press conference dated April 6, 2016 29/07/22, 14:45 Questions - answers of the Governor's press conference dated April 6, 2016 Publication date: 06.04.2016 Q: You said that the Bank of Albania is willing to do everything in case other disinflationary pressures materialize. Do you mean only traditional measures, so for further relief by lowering the basic interest rate or other measures, beyond traditional ones? Are you considering such measures? Governor: As we have pointed out before, the Bank of Albania has so far pursued a traditional monetary policy through lowering the basic interest rate. Also, today we have also narrowed the corridor for deposit and one-day credit in order to reflect the transmission of monetary policy easing. This issue has finally been discussed in the Economics and Finance Commission. We have stressed that, starting from certain criteria and from some economic and macroeconomic parameters, and despite the basic rate reaching historical minimum levels, there is further scope to continue with traditional monetary policy. If we see interest rates cut by the central banks of the countries of the region and the Eurozone, we note that their minimum levels are below our rate. We expect easing monetary policy to affect the revitalization of lending and economic activity in general. We believe that the effect has not been lacking, as the loan in money has increased and continues to increase in relation to currency credit. Also, the effect has been conveyed in increasing consumption and investment. Page 1 of 3 Questions - answers of the Governor's press conference dated April 6, 2016 29/07/22, 14:45 There are some parameters and indicators that we monitor and measure every month and every three months. If our monetary policy with its conventional measures fails to positively affect economic growth, lending and other macroeconomic parameters, certainly like any central bank and we are given the right to think about adopting non-conventional methods. This is a known practice in recent years, which we have seen implemented in the region and wider. The European Central Bank has lowered the basic interest rate to negative levels. Practically, we're not under these conditions. Generally, non-conventional methods apply at moments near recession, when economic growth is zero or below zero, when there is a deflationary situation, when there is a lack of liquidity and some other elements, which we do not encounter in Albania. The Albanian banking system has a sufficient liquidity situation, so the loan ratio continues to remain high, while economic growth this year is estimated to be 2.7%. Furthermore, our expectations for economic growth are positive for its further growth. Figures, facts, and indicators argue that the current easing framework of monetary policy continues. Q: I wanted to bring to attention a problem that has recently exploded in the media, along with a list of celebrities with secret accounts in Panama. No further than yesterday it was discovered that Albanian concession companies do not present financial mirrors in Albania; They carry out transactions without leaving any trace in Albania, and the Albanian state is unable to track them. Is the Bank of Albania a role and do you have information about these companies that are not known where these transactions lead, where the money circuit of these companies closes? Governor: Your question is broader. The phenomenon is international. Today the Panama Slippers is one of the most newsworthy international news in terms of the flow of much information about the financial accounts of companies or various personalities. We have seen that many names of personalities in the world rank have been spoken, making this an international problem, many times greater than the problem in Albania. In Albania, I'm not sure if concrete names have come up. Despite this, I will stress that any fact, whether related to tax evasion or with income concealment, must be addressed in accordance with the legal framework. If there is factually information, which has been violated by law, then this would constitute a matter belonging to the prosecution and the prosecution would have to exercise the role in respect of the law without question. More specifically, regarding your question, the Bank of Albania has always expressed its stance against informality. We have exercised the regulatory role in relation to banks and other institutions licensed by us, so that they do not use two standards for financial mirrors. As we have pointed out before, banks licensed by the Bank of Albania have financial mirrors certified and supervised by both the accounting experts and the central bank in the role of the regulator. This phenomenon is not reflected in the balance sheets of banks and does not result in the banking sector being involved in transactions or income concealment or double mirror reporting.  e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_Guvernatorit_te_dates_6_prill_2016.html Page 2 of 3 Questions - answers of the Governor's press conference dated April 6, 2016 29/07/22, 14:45 On the other hand, banks have exercised all their powers and legal power in respect of the law in relation to their clients. Banks have carried out periodic reporting under the law to the relevant authority that is the Directorate of Money Laundering Prevention. From this point of view, banks are subject to periodic checks and examinations, both by the Bank of Albania and the aforementioned authority itself. In conclusion, I once again clarify that we do not have extensive information to say further details, other than what has been made public by the press. As I mentioned at first, this is a major international information, which does not belong only to Albania. Of course, beyond the great noise it has caused in the international press, we remain vigilant to look and exercise all our legal functions and authority so that this event can help us in the direction of deepening the fight against informality. , Mr. Gent Sejko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making of the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania, April 6, 2016  e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_Guvernatorit_te_dates_6_prill_2016.html Page 3 of 3

Kjo sht nj praktik e njohur n kto vitet e fundit, q e kemi par t zbatohet n rajon dhe m gjer. Banka Qendrore Evropiane e ka ulur normn baz t interesit deri n nivele negative. Praktikisht, ne nuk jemi n kto kushte. Prgjithsisht, metodat jo-konvencionale zbatohen n momente afr recesionit, kur rritja ekonomike sht zero ose nn zero, kur ka situat deflacioniste, kur ka munges likuiditeti dhe disa element t tjer, t cilat ne nuk i hasim n Shqipri. Pr m tepr, pritshmrit tona pr rritjen ekonomike jan pozitive pr rritjen e mtejshme t saj. Shifrat, faktet, dhe treguesit e argumentojn vazhdimin e kuadrit aktual lehtsues t politiks monetare. Pyetje: Doja t sillja n vmendje nj problem q ka shprthyer s fundmi n media, s bashku m nj list personash t famshm me llogari t fshehta n Panama. Jo m larg se dje u zbulua q kompanit koncesionare shqiptare nuk i paraqesin pasqyrat financiare n Shqipri; i kryejn transaksionet pa ln asnj gjurm n Shqipri dhe shteti shqiptar qenka i paaft t'i gjurmoj. A ka nj rol Banka e Shqipris dhe a keni informacion pr kto kompani q nuk dihet ku i ojn kto transaksione, ku mbyllet qarku i parave i ktyre kompanive? Guvernatori: Pyetja juaj sht m e gjer. Fenomeni sht ndrkombtar. Sot "Panama Papers" sht nj nga lajmet ndrkombtare m t bujshme lidhur me rrjedhjen e shum informacioneve pr llogarit financiare t kompanive apo t personaliteteve t ndryshme. Kemi par q jan prfolur shum emra personalitetesh n rang botror, duke e br kt nj problem ndrkombtar, shum her m t madh sesa problemi n Shqipri. N Shqipri, nuk jam i sigurt nse kan dal emra konkret. Pavarsisht ksaj, do t theksoj se do fakt, qoft i lidhur me evazion fiskal apo me fshehje t ardhurash, duhet trajtuar n prputhje me kuadrin ligjor. N rast se ka informacion t faktuar, q sht shkelur ligji, ather kjo do t prbnte nj shtje q i takon prokuroris dhe prokuroria do t duhej pa diskutim t ushtronte rolin n respekt t ligjit. Ne kemi ushtruar rolin rregullator n raport me bankat dhe institucionet e tjera t licencuara nga ne, n mnyr q ato t mos prdorin dy standarde pr pasqyrat financiare. Sikurse e kemi theksuar dhe m par, bankat e licencuara nga Banka e Shqipris kan pasqyra financiare t certifikuara dhe t mbikqyrura si nga ekspertt kontabl, ashtu edhe nga banka qendrore n rolin e rregullatorit.
