Bank of Albania Supervisory Council, April 6, 2016 29/07/22, 14:45 , Mr. Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making of Bank of Albania Supervisory Council, April 6, 2016 Publication date: 06.04.2016 At today's meeting, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed the intermediate monetary policy report. Particular attention was paid to the analysis of current and expected inflation performance during discussions, as well as its impacts on monetary policy. These analyses once again confirmed the Bank of Albania's previous findings that the rapid fall in inflation during the first two months of the year reflects the effect of low oil and food prices. New information on real economy sector activity is generally in line with our expectations and does not  e_te_Keshillit_Mbikeqyres_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_6_prill_2016.html Page 1 of 4 , Mr. Gent Seyko at the conference... Bank of Albania Supervisory Council, April 6, 2016 29/07/22, 14:45 signals declining aggregate demand. Consequently, the supply shocks are expected to be fleeting and not affect the return of inflation to the target, within the time frames previously communicated by the Bank of Albania. However, disinflationary supply pressures will continue to keep inflation at low levels, even for several months to come. For this reason, the Bank of Albania revised down its forecast for inflation performance during 2016. Under these circumstances, the Bank of Albania deemed it necessary to increase monetary stimulus in the economy. Reflecting on these developments, the Supervisory Council decided to lower the base interest rate by 0.25 percentage points. This movement aims to ensure that inflation is returned to target within the medium-term time horizon. Next I'm going to make a fuller focus on the issues I outlined above. *** Inflation marked a rapid decline during the first two months of the year. Its annual rate decreased to 0.2% in February, compared to the 2% level recorded in December 2015. Our analyses show that this decline reflects the combined action of three factors: (i) low inflation of food products, especially fresh seasonal foods; (ii) the direct and indirect effect of low oil prices; as well as, (iii) the high price comparison base during the same period a year ago. All three of these factors explain about 3/4 of the decline in inflation in this period. The effect of the high comparative base is expected to be extinguished within April. On the other hand, low food and oil prices have hit inflation performance in all countries in the region and in our trading partners. These factors will continue to exert their impact on inflation over the next few months. Consequently, the updated forecasts suggest that inflation will fluctuate around the 1.9% level at the end of 2016, compared to 2.3% in our previous forecast. As for factors with a lasting and long-term impact on inflation, aggregate demand and the scale of capacity exploitation in the economy, our judgment on them has not changed. Domestic inflationary pressures still appear pale, reflecting below-potential economic activity and still scant pressures for wage and production costs growth. However, the Albanian economy is on a positive development trajectory and these pressures are expected to gradually strengthen on the medium-term horizon. Inflation is expected to return to target in the second quarter of 2018, in line with the expected progressive improvement of the Albanian economy. New data on economic activity are in line with our expectations. Information directly on consumer and private investment performance is lacking, but indirect data obtained from fiscal and foreign trade indicators suggest a positive performance of them.  e_te_Keshillit_Mbikeqyres_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_6_prill_2016.html Page 2 of 4 , Mr. Gent Seyko at the conference... Bank of Albania Supervisory Council, April 6, 2016 29/07/22, 14:45 On the other hand, fiscal policy has had a consolidating profile in the first two months of the year. Budgetary revenues have marked double-digit increases during this period, while public spending has been reduced and the budgetbalance resulted positively for about 9.9 billion dollars. In line with the budget adopted, fiscal policy will remain consolidating throughout 2016, but the intensity of consolidation is expected to come down over the remainder of the year. Low oil prices in international markets have hurt the performance of our exports. The trade deficit widened by about 11.8% during the January-February period, in response to falling exports and increased imports. In line with our previous estimates, the external environment is expected to be unfavourable for increasing exports of Albanian goods during 2016. As a result of the Bank of Albania's easing monetary policy, financial markets are characterized by abundant liquidity and falling interest rate trends. Recently, these tendencies have been reinforced more by the shift in public borrowing towards the foreign market. Public and private sector financing costs are close to historic minimum levels. Likewise, liquidity premiums appear declining and interbank market activity improved. However, lending activity remains slow. Cleared of the effect of taking troubled loans off balance sheets, the private sector bank loan portfolio marked an annual increase of 2.6% in january. As we have said before, the poor performance of the loan reflects the low demand for loans and its tight offer from banks. Demand for loans is expected to come in increasing over the medium-term horizon, in line with the expected improvement in economic activity. On the other hand, the Bank of Albania considers that resolving issues related to troubled loans and collateral execution will have a primary impact on improving the loan offer. *** At the end of the discussions, the Supervisory Council decided to lower the basic interest rate by 0.25 percentage points. After this reduction, the basic interest rate drops to the 1.5% level. Further monetary policy easing aims to give additional impetus to economic activity, boosting domestic demand growth and improving its support with bank loans. Empowering economic activity is expected to increase domestic inflationary pressures, offsetting disinflationary tendencies coming from the foreign environment. Also, this move signals the Bank of Albania's will to guarantee price stability, in line with its medium-term inflation target. The Bank of Albania stresses and once that it has the will and instruments necessary to achieve this objective. In support of this commitment, the Bank of Albania will remain in constant monitoring of the situation, and ready to undertake further monetary policy easing should the disinflationary supply shocks undermine the medium-term prospect of price stability.  e_te_Keshillit_Mbikeqyres_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_6_prill_2016.html Page 3 of 4 , Mr. Gent Seyko at the conference... Bank of Albania Supervisory Council, April 6, 2016 29/07/22, 14:45 In any case, starting from the information available as well as based on our estimates and forecasts, the Supervisory Council estimates that monetary stimulus will not weaken throughout 2016. *** In support of the monetary policy decision, as well as aiming for a better functioning of the interbank market, at today's meeting the Supervisory Council decided to narrow the interest rate corridor in the interbank market from 3.5 percentage points to 2.5 percentage points. This corridor is limited by deposit and one-day loan interest rates. After the reduction of the basic interest rate and after the narrowing of the corridor, the new deposit and one-day loan interest rates will be 0.25% and 2.75%, respectively. These changes target the conditions under which the Bank of Albania trades liquidity with commercial banks. This movement aims to reduce interest rate fluctuations in the interbank market and help transmit the Bank of Albania's easing monetary policy. Kto analiza konfirmuan edhe nj her prfundimet e mparshme t Banks s Shqipris se rnia e shpejt e inflacionit, gjat dy muajve t par t vitit, pasqyron efektin e mimeve t ulta t nafts dhe t ushqimeve. Pr rrjedhoj, goditjet e oferts pritet t jen kalimtare dhe t mos cnojn kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv, brenda afateve kohore t komunikuara m par nga Banka e Shqipris. Megjithat, presionet dizinflacioniste t oferts do t vazhdojn ta mbajn inflacionin n nivele t ulta, edhe pr disa muaj n vazhdim. Pr kt arsye, Banka e Shqipris ka rishikuar pr posht parashikimin e saj pr ecurin e inflacionit gjat vitit 2016. N kto rrethana, Banka e Shqipris e gjykoi t nevojshme rritjen e stimulit monetar n ekonomi. Duke reflektuar mbi kto zhvillime, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi ta ul normn baz t interesit me 0.25 pik prqindjeje. Kjo lvizje synon t garantoj kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv, brenda horizontit kohor afatmesm. N vazhdim do t bj nj shtjellim m t plot t shtjeve q parashtrova m sipr. *** Inflacioni shnoi rnie t shpejt gjat dy muajve t par t vitit. Norma vjetore e tij zbriti n 0.2% n muajin shkurt, kundrejt nivelit 2% t regjistruar n dhjetor 2015. Analizat tona tregojn se kjo rnie pasqyron veprimin e kombinuar t tre faktorve: (i) inflacionin e ult t produkteve ushqimore, veanrisht t ushqimeve t freskta t stins; (ii) efektin e drejtprdrejt dhe t trthort t mimeve t ulta t nafts; si dhe, (iii) bazn e lart krahasuese t mimeve gjat s njjts periudh t nj viti m par. T tre kta faktor shpjegojn rreth  e rnies s inflacionit n kt periudh. Efekti i bazs s lart krahasuese pritet t shuhet brenda muajit prill. Nga ana tjetr, mimet e ulta t ushqimeve dhe t nafts kan goditur ecurin e inflacionit n t gjitha vendet e rajonit dhe n partnert tan tregtar. Kta faktor do t vazhdojn t ushtrojn ndikimin e tyre n inflacion edhe prgjat disa muajve n vazhdim. Pr rrjedhoj, parashikimet e prditsuara sugjerojn se inflacioni do t luhatet rreth nivelit 1.9% n fund t vitit 2016, krahasuar me 2.3% n parashikimin ton paraardhs. Sa u prket faktorve me ndikim t qndrueshm dhe afatgjat n inflacion, krkess agregate dhe shkalls s shfrytzimit t kapaciteteve n ekonomi, gjykimi yn mbi to nuk ka ndryshuar. Presionet e brendshme inflacioniste shfaqen ende t zbehta, duke reflektuar aktivitetin ekonomik nn potencial dhe presionet ende t pakta pr rritje t pagave dhe t kostove t prodhimit. Megjithat, ekonomia shqiptare sht n nj trajektore pozitive zhvillimi dhe kto presione pritet t forcohen gradualisht n horizontin afatmesm. Inflacioni pritet t kthehet n objektiv n tremujorin e dyt t vitit 2018, n prputhje me prmirsimin e pritshm progresiv t ekonomis shqiptare. T dhnat e reja mbi aktivitetin ekonomik jan n linj me pritjet tona. Informacioni direkt mbi ecurin e konsumit dhe t investimeve private mungon, por t dhnat e trthorta t prftuara nga treguesit fiskal dhe ata t tregtis s jashtme sugjerojn nj ecuri pozitive t tyre. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjale_te_Keshillit_Mbikeqyres_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_6_prill_2016.html Pagina 2 di 4 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. T ardhurat buxhetore kan shnuar rritje dyshifrore gjat ksaj periudhe, ndrkoh q shpenzimet publike jan reduktuar dhe balanca buxhetore rezultoi pozitive pr rreth 9.9 miliard lek. N prputhje me buxhetin e miratuar, politika fiskale do t mbetet konsoliduese gjat gjith vitit 2016, por intensiteti i konsolidimit pritet t vij n rnie gjat pjess s mbetur t vitit. mimet e ulta t nafts n tregjet ndrkombtar kan dmtuar ecurin e eksporteve tona. Deficiti tregtar sht zgjeruar me rreth 11.8% gjat periudhs janar-shkurt, n prgjigje t rnies s eksporteve dhe t rritjes s importeve. N linj edhe me vlersimet tona t mparshme, ambienti i jashtm pritet t jet i pafavorshm pr rritjen e eksporteve t mallrave shqiptare gjat vitit 2016. Si rezultat i politiks monetare lehtsuese t Banks s Shqipris, tregjet financiare karakterizohen nga likuiditet i bollshm dhe nga tendenca rnse t normave t interesit. S fundmi, kto tendenca jan prforcuar m shum nga zhvendosja e huamarrjes publike drejt tregut t huaj. Kostot e financimit t sektorit publik e privat jan afr niveleve minimale historike. Po ashtu, primet e likuiditetit shfaqen n rnie dhe aktiviteti i tregut ndrbankar i prmirsuar. Megjithat, aktiviteti kreditues mbetet i ngadalt. I pastruar nga efekti i nxjerrjes jasht bilancit t kredive me probleme, portofoli i kredis bankare pr sektorin privat shnoi nj rritje vjetore prej 2.6% n muajin janar. Sikurse e kemi thn dhe m par, ecuria e dobt e kredis reflekton krkesn e ult pr kredi dhe ofertn e shtrnguar t saj nga bankat. Krkesa pr kredi pritet t vij n rritje gjat horizontit afatmesm, n prputhje me prmirsimin e pritur t aktivitetit ekonomik. Nga ana tjetr, Banka e Shqipris gjykon se zgjidhja e shtjeve q lidhen me kredit me probleme dhe ekzekutimin e kolateralit, do t ket nj ndikim parsor n prmirsimin e oferts pr kredi. *** N prfundim t diskutimeve, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi t ul normn baz t interesit me 0.25 pik prqindjeje. Pas ksaj uljeje, norma baz e interesit zbret n nivelin 1.5%. Lehtsimi i mtejshm i politiks monetare synon t?i jap nj impuls shtes aktivitetit ekonomik, duke nxitur rritjen e krkess s brendshme dhe duke prmirsuar mbshtetjen e saj me kredi bankare. Fuqizimi i aktivitetit ekonomik pritet t rris presionet e brendshme inflacioniste, duke kompensuar tendencat dizinflacioniste q vijn nga ambienti i huaj. Gjithashtu, kjo lvizje sinjalizon vullnetin e Banks s Shqipris pr t garantuar stabilitetin e mimeve, n prputhje me objektivin e saj afatmesm t inflacionit. Banka e Shqipris thekson dhe nj her se ajo ka vullnetin dhe instrumentet e nevojshm pr ta arritur kt objektiv. N mbshtetje t ktij angazhimi, Banka e Shqipris do t mbetet n monitorim t vazhdueshm t situats, dhe e gatshme t ndrmarr lehtsime t mtejshme t politiks monetare n rast se goditjet dizinflacioniste t oferts do t dmtojn perspektivn afatmesme t stabilitetit t mimeve. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjae_te_Keshillit_Mbikeqyres_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_6_prill_2016.html Pagina 3 di 4 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko n konfernetare t Kshillit Mbikqyrs t Banks s Shqipris, 6 prill 2016 29/07/22, 14:45 N do rast, duke u nisur nga informacioni i disponuar si dhe n baz t vlersimeve e parashikimeve tona, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlerson se stimuli monetar nuk do t dobsohet prgjat gjith vitit 2016. *** N mbshtetje t vendimit t politiks monetare, si dhe duke synuar nj funksionim sa m t mir t tregut ndrbankar, n mbledhjen e sotme Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi t ngushtoj korridorin e normave t interesit n tregun ndrbankar, nga 3.5 pik prqindjeje n 2.5 pik prqindjeje. Ky korridor kufizohet nga normat e interesit t depozits dhe t kredis njditore. Pas reduktimit t norms baz t interesit dhe pas ngushtimit t korridorit, normat e reja t interesit t depozits dhe t kredis njditore do t jen 0.25% dhe 2.75%, respektivisht. Kto ndryshime targetojn kushtet me t cilat Banka e Shqipris tregton likuiditetin me bankat tregtare. Kjo lvizje synon t reduktoj luhatjet e normave t interesit n tregun ndrbankar dhe t ndihmoj transmetimin e politiks monetare lehtsuese t Banks s Shqipris. Museum and Education " Head / Press / Speeches, interviews, articles / Speeches Press releases Notices of # meetings of Council Supervisor Press conference Speeches, interviews, articles Speeches Interview of articles Calendars # Official holiday calendar for 2022 COVID-19 Europe # On the activity of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko, during the development of the Spring Meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank Publication date: 24.04.2017 On 21-23 April 2017, Bank of Albania Governor Gent Sejko participated in the Spring Meetings of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the World Bank Group (BB) in Washington. Albania participated in these meetings with a joint delegation consisting of the Bank of Albania, with representative Governor of the Bank of Albania Mr Gent Sejko, First Deputy Governor, Mr. Elisabeta John and its senior representatives, and the Ministry of Finance, with representatives Deputy Finance Minister Erjon Luci and other representatives of this ministry.  eres_te_Fondit_Monetar_Nderkombetar_dhe_Bankes_Boterore_2537.html Page 1 of 4 On the event of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent S... International Monetary Fund and World Bank Spring 29/07/22, 14:10 Spring Meetings include central bank governors and finance ministers of member states, as well as senior executives of international financial institutions. As expected, the main issue that dominated the discussions at these meetings was the further revitalization of the world economy. In the IMF Financial Monetary Committee's press release, it notes that "the global recovery is taking on a new impetus, commodity prices are rising and deflation risks are decreasing. While forecasts are improving, economic growth remains modest and subject to heightened uncertainties about political developments and followed policies. The committee remains deeply committed to achieving strong, stable, balanced, comprehensive and employment-based economic growth. For this, he recommends continuing monetary easing policies, implementing fiscal policies oriented towards economic growth, continuing structural reforms prepared according to needs and priorities, ensuring financial stability, as well as more comprehensive economic growth. During the participation in the IMF and BB Spring Meetings, Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Seyko held several important meetings with well-known international financial field personalities, among which we distinguish: from the IMF with: Mr. Taho Zhang, Deputy Director General of the IMF, Mr. Carlo Cottarelli, Executive Director for Albania, Mr. Poul Thomsen, Director of the European Department, zj. Anita Tuladhar, IMF Mission Chief for Albania, Mr Dong He, Deputy Director of the Department of Monetary and Capital Markets, and from the BB group with: Mr Cyril Myller, Vice President of the World Bank for the Region of Europe and Central Asia, Mr Patrizio Pagano, Executive Director for Albania; Zj. Ellen Goldstein, Local Director and Regional Coordinator for Southeast Europe, Mr Marcelo Guigale, Councillor near BB, etc.  res_te_Fondit_Monetar_Nderkombetar_dhe_Bankes_Boterore_2537.html Page 2 of 4 On the event of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent S... International Monetary Fund and World Bank Spring 29/07/22, 14:10 The Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Sejko, at all the above meetings, recognised the participants with the latest developments in the Albanian economy, stopping at the prospect of economic growth as well as in the developments of the banking sector. Governor Seyko stressed that the country's economic growth is on a positive development trajectory. Economic growth is expected to improve and key economic balances will strengthen over the coming years. Regarding recent developments in consumer price performance, Mr. Seyko stressed that inflation performance in current values is gradually returning to the target level. Regarding the banking system in the country, Governor Sejko underlined that addressing the issue of troubled loans has been one of the commitments of the Bank of Albania, coupled with a well-thought-out action plan for reducing them. Implementation of this plan helped reduce the level of troubled loans to about 18%. The meeting talks also stopped in measures taken by the Bank of Albania, supported by monetary stimulus policy, with the aim of boosting lending in the country. The governor stressed that these measures have given their effects by influencing the decrease in the price of credit in all segments of the financial market in the country. Another important issue discussed was the Bank of Albania's commitment to co-operation with other institutions in the country, for increasing the use of local currency in the Albanian economy. Governor Sejko recognized senior international officials regarding the Co-operation Memorandum signed by the Bank of Albania, the Ministry of Finance and the Financial Supervision Authority, which aims mainly to improve monetary policy effectiveness and reduce risks to financial stability and fiscal policy. During these meetings, the IMF and BB's senior representatives praised the work done by the Bank of Albania in maintaining the country's macroeconomic and financial stability. In their view, the Bank of Albania is a serious and professional partner in fulfilling its duties. They expressed a willingness to further continue co-operation and technical assistance for our institution. Furthermore, senior international officials stressed that the banking system in Albania is consolidated. However, foreign investment must remain in focus of policies so that we can have a safe and healthy financial system in the long term. Also, one element of particular importance to the economy, highlighted during discussions on their part, was the continuation of the country's reforms and political stability. During the stay in Washington, the Bank of Albania delegation had the opportunity to hold meetings with representatives of various central banks, among which it is worth mentioning the meeting with senior leaders of the Bank of the Netherlands and the National Bank of Moldova. During these meetings, the current relations between the central banks were assessed, as well as discussed for increasing bilateral co-operation in the future.  res_te_Fondit_Monetar_Nderkombetar_dhe_Bankes_Boterore_2537.html Page 3 of 4 On the event of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent S... International Monetary Fund and World Bank Spring 29/07/22, 14:10 During these meetings, Governor Seyko also participated in the plenary session of the IMF International Monetary and Financial Committee, as well as the Executive Forum organised by the World Bank for policymakers and senior officials. Another activity organized within these meetings was also the participation in the series of presentations "The Postcard Series" by IMF member states, where the First Deputy Governor of the Bank of Albania, Zj. N deklaratn pr shtyp t Komitetit Monetar Financiar t FMN-s vihet n dukje se "rimkmbja globale po merr nj shtys t re, mimet e mallrave po ngrihen dhe rreziqet e deflacionit po ulen. Komiteti mbetet thellsisht i angazhuar pr t arritur nj rritje ekonomike t fort, t qndrueshme, t ekuilibruar, gjithprfshirse dhe t mbshtetur mbi punsimin. Pr kt, ai rekomandon vazhdimin e politikave monetare lehtsuese, zbatimin e politikave fiskale t orientuara drejt rritjes ekonomike, vazhdimin e reformave strukturore t prgatitura sipas nevojave dhe prioriteteve, garantimin e stabilitetit financiar, si dhe rritje ekonomike m gjithprfshirse. Gent Sejko, n t gjitha takimet e siprprmendura, i njohu t pranishmit me zhvillimet m t fundit n ekonomin shqiptare, duke u ndalur n perspektivn e rritjes ekonomike si dhe n zhvillimet e sektorit bankar. Guvernatori Sejko theksoi se rritja ekonomike e vendit sht n nj trajektore pozitive zhvillimi. Rritja ekonomike pritet t vij n prmirsim dhe balancat kryesore ekonomike do t forcohen gjat viteve t ardhshme. N lidhje me zhvillimet e fundit n ecurin e mimeve t konsumit, z. Sejko theksoi se ecuria e inflacionit n vlerat aktuale po kthehet gradualisht n nivelin e synuar. Lidhur me sistemin bankar n vend, Guvernatori Sejko nnvizoi se trajtimi i shtjes s kredive me probleme ka qen nj ndr angazhimet e Banks s Shqipris, i shoqruar me nj plan veprimi t mirmenduar pr reduktimin e tyre. Zbatimi i ktij plani ndihmoi n zbritjen e nivelit t kredive me probleme n rreth 18%. Bisedimet e takimeve u ndaln, gjithashtu, n masat e marra nga Banka e Shqipris, t mbshtetura nga politika monetare stimuluese, me qllim nxitjen e kreditimit n vend. Guvernatori theksoi se kto masa i kan dhn efektet e tyre duke ndikuar n uljen e mimit t kredis n t gjitha segmentet e tregut financiar n vend. Nj tjetr shtje me rndsi e diskutuar ishte angazhimi i Banks s Shqipris n bashkpunim me institucionet e tjera n vend, pr rritjen e prdorimit t monedhs vendase n ekonomin shqiptare. Guvernatori Sejko i njohu zyrtart e lart ndrkombtar lidhur me Memorandumin e Bashkpunimit t nnshkruar nga Banka e Shqipris, Ministria e Financave dhe Autoriteti i Mbikqyrjes Financiare, i cili ka si qllim kryesor prmirsimin e efektivitetit t politiks monetare dhe uljen e rreziqeve pr stabilitetin financiar dhe politikn fiskale. Gjat ktyre takimeve, prfaqsuesit e lart t FMN-s dhe BB-s, vlersuan punn e br nga Banka e Shqipris n drejtim t ruajtjes s stabilitetit makroekonomik dhe financiar t vendit. N kndvshtrimin e tyre, Banka e Shqipris sht nj partner serioz dhe profesional n prmbushjen e detyrave t saj. Ata shprehn gatishmrin pr t vazhduar m tej bashkpunimin dhe asistencn teknike pr institucionin ton. M tej, zyrtart e lart ndrkombtar theksuan se sistemi bankar n Shqipri sht i konsoliduar. Megjithat, investimet e huaja duhet t qndrojn n fokus t politikave n mnyr q t kemi nj sistem financiar t sigurt dhe t shndetshm n afat t gjat. Gjithashtu, nj element i nj rndsie t veant pr ekonomin, i nnvizuar gjat diskutimeve nga ana e tyre, ishte vazhdimi i reformave dhe stabiliteti politik i vendit. Gjat qndrimit n Uashington, delegacioni i Banks s Shqipris pati rastin t kryej takime me prfaqsues t bankave t ndryshme qendrore, mes t cilave vlen t prmendet takimi me drejtues t lart t Banks s Holands dhe Banks Kombtare t Moldavis. Title: Speech at the press conference of the monetary policy decision-making of the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania
text: Questions - answers of the Governor's press conference dated May 4, 2016 29/07/22, 14:45 Questions - answers of the Governor's press conference dated May 4, 2016 Publication date: 04.05.2016 Q: The Bank of Albania has been active in terms of easing policies to promote lending, but in the meantime we do not have a credit increase. What are the reasons, in fact, that we do not have a credit increase and what remains to be done? Governor: As we pointed out, we have a moderate increase in lending during the first two months of 2016, stripping it of the effect of wiping out lost loans. So has the loan increased in 2015. More specifically, the increase in the loan surplus was at the level of 2.4%, (without the effect of deleting loans) at the end of the first two months of the year, compared to about 1.8% at the end of 2015. So I wanted to underline the fact that we have lending growth, certainly easy, not the level we want and that we aim for through our monetary stimulus policy. To speak in absolute terms, during 2015 the banking and financial system (remember that the banking system accounts for over 95% of the financial system), has credited the Albanian economy with over 1 billion euros. Despite this, to better support the economy on its way to capturing its potential, we aim for more loans to the economy, in line with our forecasts and targets for sustainable economic growth. We intend to have an increase in lending, which is not in pre-crisis size. So we don't intend to have a credit increase at 20-30% levels. This high lending activity would create problems in the quality of the loan portfolio. For this reason, without referring to the absolute figure, I would stress that an annual increase in the 5% to 10% limit would be pleasant and very healthy for economic revitalization.  t_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_Guvernatorit_te_dates_4_maj_2016.html Page 1 of 3 Questions - answers of the Governor's press conference dated May 4, 2016 29/07/22, 14:45 I want to stop at another important fact. The Bank of Albania's easing monetary policy has been transmitted and has given its effects to lending. The central bank's basic interest rate reductions have influenced and this has been reflected prominently in the growth of the loan portfolio in the money. The loan in the money has increased above the 43% level and the pace of growth of the loan portfolio in money continues. So this shows that in terms of lending, monetary policy has worked and been transmitted. Meanwhile, the currency component, as a result of monetary policy followed by the European Central Bank, is offered at very low rates of a relatively long period of time. So, in the direction of the offer, the Bank of Albania has fulfilled its role through the adoption of a monetary stimulus policy, satisfactory transmission of this policy and the quantitative increase of the credit component for the economy in the national currency. What is worth pointing out is related to problems of another nature, which will be resolved and corrected in time as a result of the positive effects that structural reforms will yield. Without being enlivened and without improving the business climate at higher rates, of course we will face reluctance from private agents and investors for lending. Regarding 2016, as we pointed out in our Monetary Policy report, we expect improved financing conditions. Banks have eased lending conditions and this will bring higher lending growth rates, which will also affect economic growth forecast for this year. On the other hand, in addition to lending, we expect there will also be an increase in foreign investment during 2016. Today, we did the analysis and reporting for the first quarter of 2016. Of course we are in constant monitoring of the performance of not only lending, but all other macroeconomic and monetary parameters. Q: The interest rate cut at today's meeting of the Bank of Albania Supervisory Council was a surprise decision. Mr. Governor, you said that economic growth is not at predicted levels, but is lower. Can you tell us how much lower than you had predicted? And when you declare that monetary policies should be accompanied by structural reforms, what reform is it about, specifically a specification? Governor: We have stressed before that we have corrected the forecast for the level of economic growth for 2016. If you remember, we had forecast economic growth for 2015 at the 3% level and then corrected it in our subsequent estimates. Likewise, and for this year, economic growth was projected at a 3.5% level and is later corrected. The International Monetary Fund's forecast along with the Albanian government was for economic growth around the 3.4% level. Meanwhile, we as the Central Bank, always being conservative in our analysis of economic growth, have revised our forecast for economic growth to 3%, for 2016. Of course, the forecast remains forecast and we continue to constantly analyze indicators, month after month, and quarter after quarter. I would like to stress that despite the correction of economic growth, it is important that the trend or pace of economic growth is steadily increasing, from 2% to 2.6%,  t_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_Guvernatorit_te_dates_4_maj_2016.html Page 2 of 3 Questions - answers of the Governor's press conference dated May 4, 2016 29/07/22, 14:45 3% and so on. As I stressed, and in the monetary policy statement, we expect the economy to return to balance during 2017 and inflation will reach the target around the end of 2018. If we were to keep up with these forecasts, despite the current fluctuations in economic growth percentages, I would appreciate that the economy is on a positive development trajectory. So whether the figure will be 2.8% or 3%, it is very important that we have a positive trend of economic growth. However, we must be aware that there are autonomous, external and internal elements and factors that affect the main economic indicators. For example, low inflation in february and March is estimated to have come mainly from supply shocks, as a result of falling oil and agricultural and food products in international markets. , Mr. Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making of the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania, May 4, 2016  t_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_Guvernatorit_te_dates_4_maj_2016.html Page 3 of 3

Cilat jan arsyet, n fakt, q nuk kemi nj rritje t kredis dhe far mbetet akoma pr t'u br? Guvernatori: Sikurse e theksuam, kemi nj rritje t moderuar t kreditimit gjat dy muajve t par t vitit 2016, duke e zhveshur at nga efekti i fshirjes s kredive t humbura. Po kshtu edhe n vitin 2015 kredia sht rritur. M konkretisht, rritja e teprics s kredis ka qen n nivelin prej 2.4%, (pa efektin e fshirjes s kredive) n fund t dy muajve t par t vitit, krahasuar me rreth 1.8% n fund t vitit 2015. Pra doja t nnvizoja faktin q ne kemi rritje t kreditimit, sigurisht t leht, jo nivelin q dshirojm dhe q synojm nprmjet politiks ton monetare stimuluese. Pr t folur n terma absolut, gjat vitit 2015 sistemi bankar dhe financiar (mos harroni se sistemi bankar prbn mbi 95% t sistemit financiar), ka kredituar ekonomin shqiptare me mbi 1 miliard euro. Pavarsisht ksaj, pr t mbshtetur m mir ekonomin n rrugn e saj pr t kapur potencialin e vet, ne synojm pr m shum kredi pr ekonomin, n prputhje me parashikimet dhe objektivat tona pr nj rritje t qndrueshme ekonomike. Ne synojm t kemi nj rritje t kreditimit, e cila t mos t jet n prmasat e parakrizs. Pra nuk synojm t kemi nj rritje t kredis n nivelet 20-30%. Ky aktivitet i lart kreditimi do t krijonte problematika n cilsin e portofolit t kredive. Pr kt arsye pa referuar shifra absolute, do t theksoja se nj rritje vjetore n kufirin 5% deri n 10% do t ishte e plqyeshme dhe shum e shndetshme pr rigjallrimin ekonomik. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjt_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_Guvernatorit_te_dates_4_maj_2016.html Pagina 1 di 3 Pyetje - prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp t Guvernatorit t dats 4 maj 2016 29/07/22, 14:45 Dua t ndalem edhe n nj fakt tjetr t rndsishm. Politika monetare lehtsuese e Banks s Shqipris sht transmetuar dhe i ka dhn efektet e saj n kreditim. Uljet e norms baz t interesit nga ana e Banks Qendrore kan ndikuar dhe kjo sht reflektuar dukshm n rritjen e portofolit t kredis n lek. Kredia n lek sht rritur mbi nivelin 43% dhe trendi i ritmit t rritjes s portofolit t kredis n lek vazhdon. Pra kjo tregon q n kahun e kreditimit, politika monetare ka funksionuar dhe sht transmetuar. Ndrkoh edhe komponenti n valut, si rezultat i politiks monetare t ndjekur nga Banka Qendrore Evropiane, ofrohet me norma shum t ulta prej nj periudhe relativisht t gjat kohe. Pra, n kahun e oferts, Banka e Shqipris ka prmbushur rolin e saj nprmjet adoptimit t nj politike monetare stimuluese, transmetimit t knaqshm t ksaj politike dhe rritjes sasiore t komponentit t kredis pr ekonomin n monedhn kombtare. Ajo q vlen t theksohet, lidhet me problemet e nj natyre tjetr, t cilat do t zgjidhen dhe do t korrigjohen n koh si pasoj e efekteve pozitive q do t japin reformat strukturore. Pa u gjallruar dhe pa u prmirsuar klima e biznesit n ritme m t larta, natyrisht q ne do t hasim hezitim t agjentve privat dhe investitorve pr kreditim. N lidhje me vitin 2016, sikurse theksuam n raportin ton t Politiks Monetare, ne presim prmirsim t kushteve t financimit. Bankat i kan lehtsuar kushtet e kreditimit dhe kjo do t sjell norma m t larta rritjeje t kreditimit, i cili do t ndikoj dhe n rritjen ekonomike t parashikuar pr kt vit. Nga ana tjetr, prve kreditimit, ne presim q t ket edhe nj rritje t investimeve t huaja gjat vitit 2016. Sot, bm analizn dhe raportimin pr tremujorin e par t vitit 2016. Sigurisht q jemi n monitorim t vazhdueshm t ecuris jo vetm t kreditimit, por t gjith parametrave t tjer makroekonomik dhe monetar. Pyetje: Ulja e norms s interesit n mbledhjen e sotme t Kshillit Mbikqyrs t Banks s Shqipris, ishte nj vendim surpriz. Zoti Guvernator, ju that se rritja ekonomike nuk sht n nivelet e parashikuara, por sht m e ult. A mund t na thoni se sa sht m e ult nga ajo q kishit parashikuar? Dhe kur deklaroni q politikat monetare duhet t shoqrohen me reforma strukturore, pr cilat reforma bhet fjal, konkretisht nj specifikim? Guvernatori: E kemi theksuar edhe m par, se ne kemi korrektuar parashikimin pr nivelin e rritjes ekonomike pr vitin 2016. N qoft se ju kujtohet, ne kishim parashikuar pr vitin 2015 nj rritje ekonomike n nivelin 3% dhe pastaj e korrektuam n vlersimet tona pasardhse. Po kshtu dhe pr kt vit, rritja ekonomike ishte parashikuar n nivelin 3.5% dhe sht korrektuar m von. Parashikimi i Fondit Monetar Ndrkombtar s bashku me qeverin shqiptare ishte pr nj rritje ekonomike rreth nivelit 3.4%. Ndrkoh, ne si Bank Qendrore, duke qen gjithmon konservator n analizat tona n drejtim t rritjes ekonomike, kemi rishikuar parashikimin ton pr rritjen ekonomike n nivelin 3%, pr vitin 2016. Sigurisht q parashikimi mbetet parashikim dhe ne vazhdojm n mnyr konstante t analizojm treguesit, muaj pas muaji, dhe tremujor pas tremujori. Un do t doja t theksoja q pavarsisht korrektimit t rritjes ekonomike, e rndsishme sht q trendi apo hapi i ritmit t rritjes ekonomike sht n rritje t vazhdueshme, nga 2% n 2.6%, https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjt_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_Guvernatorit_te_dates_4_maj_2016.html Pagina 2 di 3 Pyetje - prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp t Guvernatorit t dats 4 maj 2016 29/07/22, 14:45 n 3% dhe kshtu n vazhdim. Sikurse theksova dhe n deklaratn e politiks monetare presim q ekonomia t kthehet n ekuilibr gjat vitit 2017 dhe inflacioni t arrij objektivin rreth fundit t vitit 2018. N rast se ne do t ecim me kto parashikime, pavarsisht luhatjeve t momentit n prqindjet e rritjes ekonomike, un do t vlersoja se ekonomia sht n nj trajektore pozitive zhvillimi. Pra, pavarsisht nse shifra do t jet 2.8% apo 3%, sht shum e rndsishme q kemi nj trend pozitiv t rritjes ekonomike. Gjithsesi duhet t jemi t ndrgjegjshm q ka element dhe faktor autonom, t jashtm dhe t brendshm, q ndikojn treguesit kryesor ekonomik. Pr shembull, inflacioni i ult i muajve shkurt dhe mars, vlersohet t ket ardhur kryesisht nga goditjet e oferts, si pasoj e rnies s mimit t nafts dhe produkteve bujqsore dhe ushqimore n tregjet ndrkombtare. Bank of Albania Supervisory Council, May 4, 2016 29/07/22, 14:45 , Mr. Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making of Bank of Albania Supervisory Council, May 4, 2016 Publication date: 04.05.2016 The new economic and monetary information of recent months has generally been at the lower end of our expectations. Fourth quarter 2015 economic growth resulted somewhat lower than expected, while first-quarter 2016 inflation marked a strong and unexpected decline as a result of supply shocks. Despite these developments, the Bank of Albania considers that the Albanian economy continues to remain on a positive development trajectory. On a medium-term horizon, we expect improved economic growth and a gradual return of inflation to target. However, the new information illustrates the risk and uncertainties that the materialization of this scenario has. In particular, the external environment appears to be deteriorating as in the direction of  re_te_Keshillit_Mbikeqyres_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_4_maj_2016.html Page 1 of 4 , Mr Gent Seyko in confection... Bank of Albania Supervisory Council, May 4, 2016 29/07/22, 14:45 the growth of our exports and in the direction of the disinflationary pressures arising from it as confidence and business climate in the Albanian economy continue to fluctuate. These developments try to slow the speed of the economy's return to balance and inflation on target. In response, following analysis and forecasts of the Quarterly Monetary Policy Report, adopted today by the Supervisory Council, as well as in line with the previous monetary policy stance, the Supervisory Council decided to lower the basic interest rate by 0.25 percentage points. This basic interest rate cut is aimed at increasing monetary stimulus in the economy. Through reducing interest rates in the financial market, our monetary policy aims to support further growth in credit, consumption and private investment. This move also signals the Bank of Albania's will to take all necessary measures to maintain price stability in line with its inflation target. Let me offer the following a more detailed mirror of our analyses and conclusions. Average first-quarter inflation resulted in a 0.7% level. Within this quarter, inflation marked a strong decline during the first two months and stabilized at low levels of 0.3%? In March. The fall in inflation has come from supply shocks, in the form of low levels of food item inflation and falling oil prices, as well as technical factors of the high comparative high base of the same period last year. These shocks originate to the greatest extent in the international market and have been reflected in rapidly falling inflation in all countries of the region. Their impact on inflation is expected to be fleeting. However, this impact will also be noticeable during the second quarter of the year, but will gradually move towards the end in the third and fourth quarters. In response to economic growth as well, inflation at the end of 2016 is expected to fluctuate around 1.9%, a decrease against the 2.3% forecast of our Previous Quarterly Report. Although falling inflation in the first quarter was influenced by supply shocks, overall inflationary pressures in the country continue to remain low. Aggregate demand, monetary expansion and inflationary expectations do not signal rapid recovery of inflation towards the target. Although growing, aggregate demand is still not capable of generating a full exploitation of production capacities, both in the labour market and in that of capital. Consequently, pressures for rising wages and production costs remain weak, reflecting on low base inflation values. According to INSTAT data, the Albanian economy grew by 2.2% during the fourth quarter of 2015. The balance of information available suggests that it has scored similar growth rates even during the first quarter of this year. From a sectoral perspective, economic growth has been led by the expansion of activity in the construction and services sector, while industrial activity shows weakness as a result of adverse conuncture in world markets and our trading partners. From the perspective of aggregate demand, economic growth is mainly led by the expansion of family consumption and private investment.  re_te_Keshillit_Mbikeqyres_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_4_maj_2016.html Page 2 of 4 , Mr Gent Seyko in confection... This year's economic growth is expected to be somewhat higher than the 2.6% rate recorded in 2015, but somewhat lower compared to our previous estimates. The expansion of economic activity will be helped by continued positive consumer and private investment. Their growth is expected to be financed to the greatest extent by private sector savings and foreign direct investment projects, but it will also benefit from the most favourable financial conditions expected to exist during 2016. In response to monetary stimulus policy and the reduction of public borrowing in internal markets, the financial environment is characterized by abundant liquidity and low interest rates. Similarly, the exchange rate is stable, the financial balances of businesses, households and the banking sector appear to be improving, while lending standards have been eased. However, these stimulus financial conditions have not yet translated into stable credit growth, as a result of the reluctance present in the behaviour of economic and financial agents. Excluding the effect of de-registering loans from banks' balance sheets, the private sector loan portfolio marked an average annual increase of 2.4% during the first two months of the year. The Bank of Albania considers that the banking system should be more realistic and bold in its lending decisions. The full transmission of the effects of monetary policy on financial markets will be accompanied by increased banks' interest in lending. Also, the success of the plan of measures to reduce troubled loans will help reduce the perceived credit risk. Both of these factors create premise for better future credit performance. In medium-term terms, economic growth is expected to improve during 2017 and 2018. On this time horizon, it is expected to better reflect the effects of monetary stimulus policy and find greater support from improving the global environment. The Albanian economy is forecast to gradually return to balance during 2017, helping to return inflation to the target around the end of 2018. Both of these projections show a slight deviation from the previous forecast, while the balance of risks continues to remain at the lower end. Aiming to create more appropriate monetary conditions for compliance with the inflation target, the Supervisory Council decided to lower the basic interest rate to 1.25% level. Also, the Supervisory Council decided to keep the one-day deposit interest rate at 0.25% and lower the one-day loan interest rate to 2.25%. Judging on the information available, the Supervisory Council estimates that monetary stimulus could increase further during 2016, while the increasing interest rate cycle will not begin before 2017. Zgjerimi i aktivitetit ekonomik do t ndihmohet nga vazhdimi i trendit pozitiv t konsumit dhe t investimeve private. Rritja e tyre pritet t financohet n masn m t madhe nga kursimet e sektorit privat dhe nga projektet e investimeve t huaja direkte, por ajo do t prfitoj edhe nga kushtet m t favorshme financiare q priten t ekzistojn gjat vitit 2016. N prgjigje t politiks monetare stimuluese dhe t reduktimit t huamarrjes publike n tregjet e brendshme, ambienti financiar karakterizohet nga likuiditet i bollshm dhe nga norma t ulta interesi. Po kshtu, kursi i kmbimit sht i qndrueshm, bilancet financiare t bizneseve, t familjeve dhe t sektorit bankar shfaqen n prmirsim, ndrsa standardet e kreditimit jan lehtsuar. Megjithat, kto kushte financiare stimuluese nuk jan prkthyer ende n rritje t qndrueshme t kredis, si pasoj e hezitimit t pranishm n sjelljen e agjentve ekonomik dhe financiar. Duke prjashtuar efektin e regjistrimit t kredive nga bilancet e bankave, portofoli i kredis pr sektorin privat shnoi nj rritje mesatare vjetore prej 2.4% gjat dy muajve t par t vitit. Banka e Shqipris gjykon se sistemi bankar duhet t tregohet m realist dhe i guximshm n vendimet e tij t kreditimit. Transmetimi i plot i efekteve t politiks monetare n tregjet financiare do t shoqrohet me rritjen e interesimit t bankave ndaj kreditimit. Gjithashtu, suksesi i planit t masave pr reduktimin e kredive me probleme do t ndihmoj n uljen e rrezikut t perceptuar t kreditit. N kt horizont kohor, ajo pritet t reflektoj m mir efektet e politiks monetare stimuluese dhe t gjej nj mbshtetje m t madhe nga prmirsimi i mjedisit botror. Ekonomia shqiptare parashikohet t kthehet gradualisht n ekuilibr gjat vitit 2017, duke ndihmuar n kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv rreth fundit t vitit 2018. Cetkovic, Director of the Department of Banking and Financial Operations.  re_te_Malit_te_Zi_z_Milojica_Dakic_viziton_Banken_e_Shqiperise.html Page 1 of 3 Montenegro Central Bank Governor Milojica Dakic Visits Bank of Albania 29/07/22, 14:45 The meeting between the two governors focused on bilateral relations between the two institutions, the performance of the respective banking systems, as well as the latest developments in the region. Initially, Governor Sejko recognized his counterpart with the latest financial developments in the country, where he stressed that the Albanian banking system is secular and well-capitalized. He said that the Bank of Albania remains committed to ensuring and maintaining financial stability in the country. Stopping at the country's economic performance, Governor Seyko said in particular that, despite the challenges of the external economic environment, again the Albanian economy remains on a positive development trajectory. In this direction, the Governor guaranteed that the institution he leads through monetary easing policy will continue to make all the necessary contribution to support efforts for sustainable economic growth. During the presentation of the main developments in the Albanian banking sector, Governor Sejko stressed that increasing lending and reducing troubled loans are in the focus of the work of the Bank of Albania. He also recognized his counterpart with the performance of the interinstitutional plan of measures by the Bank of Albania and Albanian authorities, for lowering troubled loans. International financial developments as well as the European integration process was another issue discussed by the two central bank executives. They stressed that it is very important that Albania and Montenegro, as well as the countries of the region, have a common position in European and international forums, as they are characterized by similar specifics. Discussions also stopped in the work done by the two central banks to approximate the legal framework with European directives, where Governor Seyko recognized his counterpart with the work done by the Bank of Albania in this direction. The governor of the Central Bank of Montenegro, Mr. Milojica Daki, thanked Governor Seyko for the invitation made and the so far co-operation between the two central banks. During this meeting, Governor Daki took a picture of Montenegro's macroeconomic developments, noting the challenges and problems of the Montenegrin banking system. He singled out the role and contribution of the Central Bank of Montenegro to the country's European integration process and the adoption of European standards.  re_te_Malit_te_Zi_z_Milojica_Dakic_viziton_Banken_e_Shqiperise.html Page 2 of 3 Montenegro Central Bank Governor Milojica Dakic Visits Bank of Albania 29/07/22, 14:45 The co-workers shared the same view on the prospects for further growth in economic co-operation between the two countries and mainly in the area of the financial system. At the close of the meeting, Governor Sejko invited Governor Daki to attend the annual conference of the Bank of Albania, which will hold the works in September 2016. During his visit to the Bank of Albania, Governor Daki also met with the Deputy Governors and executives of some of the Bank's main departments, where the policies pursued in the area of banking supervision and financial stability of the two countries were at the centre of the discussions. This meeting is part of the BSH's commitment to develop productive and consultative communication with various interest groups, which can play a positive role in the good of the financial system in particular of the Albanian economy as a whole. In addition to ambassadors of accredited foreign countries in Albania, resident representatives of international financial institutions attended the meeting. During the meeting, initially the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Sejko, gave a presentation of the country's macroeconomic situation, predicting that, despite adverse international developments, Albania has marked a positive trend in improving economic growth. The country's macroeconomic stability is supported by harmonisation of monetary policy easing with consolidating fiscal policy. Taking advantage of the case, the Governor once confirmed the Commitment of the Bank of Albania to support the country's financial sustainability and growth. Page 1 of 3 On the meeting of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko with ambassadors of accredited foreign countries in Albania 29/07/22, 14:43 its economic policy through monetary stimulus policy. In this framework, he stressed as very important the continuation of structural reforms, which would affect further improving the business climate and accelerating the country's economic development. In his presentation, Governor Sejko stopped in particular on financial sector developments in Albania and reforms undertaken to increase financial mediation in the economy. The governor said: ... Albania is a country with financial stability, where one of the promoters of this development has also been the banking sector, which has supported the economy and business on the road to economic development. This sector is cash, well capitalized and able to cope with market demand for funds. These optimal parameters create the necessary conditions for this sector to support all domestic and foreign investor initiatives. . One issue of particular importance, discussed during the meeting, was also the promotion of interest in increasing economic co-operation and assessing opportunities for promoting foreign direct investment in our country. In this context, Governor Seyko invited representatives of the accredited diplomatic body instead of this picture of the Albanian economy to convey to investors to convince them that Albania offers great potential for investment. Albania is moving towards a new development model oriented towards manufacturing sectors, which need support. ... The financial environment in Albania is characterized by abundant liquidity, low interest rates, stable exchange rates, facilitated lending standards; this environment increases the potential economic prospect of our country... The Governor said. Therefore, it is important that foreign ambassadors use their influence to promote Albania and promote foreign investment in the Albanian financial system and wider. In conclusion, Governor Seyko thanked ambassadors for supporting their countries' institutions, European Union institutions, international financial institutions and they have personally given the Bank of Albania in strengthening institutional capacities, improving internal governance and approximating international central banking standards. Page 2 of 3 On the meeting of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko with ambassadors of accredited foreign countries in Albania 29/07/22, 14:43 Ambassadors praised the Bank of Albania's initiative for holding such a meeting, as fruitful enough, to exchange ideas and opinions on Albania's economic development. In response to ambassadors' interest, the Governor shared with them his views on issues raised such as the country's development prospects, central bank independence, perception of economic reality, the impact of justice reform and strengthening law enforcement, and the integrity of the banking sector. For their part, the Ambassadors stressed that it is important for Albanian institutions to be more vocal in promoting Albania, which has known noticeable changes over the years. At the end of the meeting, representatives of the foreign diplomatic body also held a visit to the Bank of Albania Museum, where they expressed the best assessments for this initiative, as a vulnerable contribution to the education of citizens and the expansion of financial culture in Albania. International organised high-level co-ordination review seminar between monetary policy and fiscal policy in which the Governor of the Bank participated Albania, Mr. Gent Seyko. A high number of governors attended the seminar. various European central banks, within and outside the Eurozone, representatives of the international institutions and well-known figures of the academic and financial world. This seminar served as a platform of discussion to exchange ideas on monetary and fiscal policy coordination, an issue that represents a particular interest from the perspective of the challenges central banks are facing today. Bank of Albania Governor Gent Sejko held a statement on the monetary policy implementation panel when fiscal space is limited, presented by Mr Hans-Helmut Kotz, Professor at the Centre for Financial Studies at Goethe University and led by Mr Dubravko Mihaljek, Director of Macroeconomic Analysis at the International Bank of Adjustments. In his address, Governor Sejko discussed the contribution and role of monetary policy in the terms of a consolidating fiscal policy referred to albanian experience. In conclusion, the Governor responded to the interest of the participants, sharing with them his views on the issues raised. During this seminar, Governor Sejko had the opportunity to hold meetings with the Governor of the Bank of Slovenia, Mr. Bostjan Jazbec, and other participating governors, whose focus was developing co-operation and discussing issues of common interest.  2/3 06/08/2022, 09:18 Bank of Albania Governor Mr Gent Seyko at the high-level seminar on "Review of midi co-ordination...  3/3

text: Second Meeting of the National Payment System Committee 29/07/22, 14:42 Second Meeting of the National Payment System Committee Publication date: 25.05.2016 On 24 May 2016, the second meeting of the National Payment System Committee was held at the Bank of Albania facilities. The meeting was led by the First Deputy Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Elisabeth John, chairman of this Committee. In the meeting, in addition to members of the National Payment System Committee, as representatives of the Ministry of Finance, the Ministry for Innovation and Public Administration, the Ministry of Economic Development, Tourism, Trade and Entrepreneurship, the Financial Supervision Authority, the Ministry of Internal Affairs, as well as the Albanian Association of Banks, were also present and zj. Maria Teresa Chiminenti and Mr. Nenad Bosiljcic from the Payment Systems Development Group near the World Bank. Representatives of non-bank financial institutions were also invited to the meeting, vista_ar tikuj/Fj /Mbledhja_e_dyte_e_Komitetit_Kombetar_te_Sistemit_te_Pagesave.html Page 1 of 3 Second Meeting of the National Payment System Committee 29/07/22, 14:42 representatives of operators of national card payment schemes and representatives of utilitarian societies. In the opening address, Deputy Governor John stressed the role that payment systems and instruments play in economic activity and the importance of operating the National Payment System Committee in coordinating interinstitutional policies in this area. Besides, Mr. John stopped in particular on projects the Bank of Albania plans to undertake in co-operation with the World Bank within the framework of promoting security and efficiency of payment systems and instruments. In her discussion, Minister of Innovation and Public Administration, Mr. Milena Harito presented the latest developments related to projects undertaken in the field of digitization of government services on the part of the Ministry and praised with particular importance the creation of communication bridges between utilitarian societies and commercial banks for their realization. In this context, Minister Harito stressed that promoting innovative ways of payment, such as mobile, is estimated to be the future of payments. In the end, Mr. Harito singled out the importance of using the electronic firm in banking services. Mr. Elona Gjebrea, Deputy Minister of Home Affairs, discussed developments related to the project of creating the electronic Register of Civil Situation and Address on the part of the Ministry, mainly describing the main functionality and benefits, where one of the main interested parties is the banking system. On the other hand, The Deputy Minister of the Ministry of Economic Development, Trade, Tourism and Entrepreneurship, Mr. Ervin Mete, presented the competences of the Ministry representing, within the framework of protecting consumers from the point of view of banking services and the importance of creating structures and procedures similar to those of the European Union. In this context, the Deputy Minister underlined the need for co-operation between the Bank and MZHETTS for transposition of several important field directives and regulations. vista_ar tikuj/Fj /Mbledhja_e_dyte_e_Komitetit_Kombetar_te_Sistemit_te_Pagesave.html Page 2 of 3 Second Meeting of the National Payment System Committee 29/07/22, 14:42 Furthermore, during the meeting, the achievements of three projects raised by the recommendations of the first meeting were presented by the Bank of Albania. More specifically, within the framework of standardization of the payment was introduced the agreed format among banks, which is based on SEPA standards. In relation to direct interbank debit, the achievements of the present day were presented, as well as the necessary steps for the completion of this project. Finally, the Albanian Banking Association presented the findings from measuring euro payment costs domestically, where it was pointed out that the use of corresponding banks not only carries significant costs, but promotes the use of physical money, thus generating high costs for the banking system within the framework of cash management. Also, the meeting highlighted once again the fact that the legal and regulatory framework of the Bank of Albania does not create barriers to the implementation of electronic signatures and it was stressed that the Bank of Albania will take all necessary measures in this direction. Finally, World Bank representatives presented preliminary results of the study of the costs of payment instruments from the demand kahu. The findings of this study highlighted that cash constitutes the costliest means of payment and moving from cash payments to electronic ones can significantly help increase effective productivity. The meeting ended with the intervention of guests from nonbank financial institutions, who, after pandering to the initiative undertaken, identified several areas of possible co-operation for the future. Participants also held a visit to the Bank of Albania Museum, where they expressed the best assessments for this Bank of Albania initiative. text: Digital Banking in Albania conference takes place 29/07/22, 14:42 Digital Banking in Albania conference takes place Publication date: 26.05.2016 On 25 May 2016, the Digital Banking-themed conference was held in Albania at the Tirana International hotel facilities, organised by the Albanian Banking Association in co-operation with the Bank of Albania and the National Payment System Committee. The aim of organising this conference is to promote new technologies that the banking sector uses in providing services and banking products to Albanian citizens. This sector devotes particular importance to innovation in the field of technology, so it remains a vanguard in adopting and implementing innovations in this area, as an more opportunity for increasing the quality of service to the customer. In his opening address, Albanian Banking Association Chairman Christian Canacaris stressed that technology and consumers have contributed to the vision of banks, forcing the latter to rethink the way in which they operate. Digitalisation in banks and the banking industry is not a choice, nor an option: this is the way of banking business today and in the future. Mr. Canacaris noted that the banking industry in Albania is well oriented towards digital banking and that the figures so far are very optimistic, 12 of the 16 banks that operate in the country offer internet banking, 7 out of 16 offer mobile banking and 3 banks offer e-commerce. Over the past five years (2011-2015), the banking industry has invested 65m euros in infrastructure and information technology services. This year, 16m euros are scheduled to be invested. Page 1 of 3 Digital Banking in Albania conference takes place 29/07/22, 14:42 This conference was organized in three main panels. The first panel was led by the First Deputy Governor of the Bank of Albania, Zj. Elisabeth John, chairman of the National Payment System Committee and participants in this panel were: Minister of Innovation and Public Administration, zj. Milena Harito, Mr. Francisco Tur Hartmann, representative of the European Central Bank, ZJ. Pascale Marie Brien, representative of the European Banking Federation, Mr Frederic Blanc, member of the Albanian Banking Association and Director General of societe general equip Albania, and Mr Periklis Drougkas, Director General of Alpha Bank Albania. Deputy Governor John during the panel's moderation stressed that, as part of the market's push towards innovative payment services, the Bank of Albania in the role of regulator and catalyst has undertaken a series of regulatory measures recently aimed at removing barriers and increasing competition. These measures are based on European practices, not only within albania's accession towards the European common market, but also as one of the most optimal solutions in terms of security and efficiency at the international level. Also, Mr. John underlined that many challenges remain for the future and therefore close interinstitutional co-operation is extremely important. As an important step in this direction, the Deputy Governor cited the activity of the National Payment System Committee, which aims to create a vision for the development of payment systems on the Albanian market. Minister of Innovation and Public Administration, Mr. Milena Harito, during her speech, presented the latest developments related to projects undertaken in the field of digitization of government services on the part of the Albanian government. Minister Harito stressed that promoting innovative ways of payment, such as mobile, are valued as the future of payments not only for the fact that they enable the fight against informality, but also because they facilitate the daily lives of citizens. In the end, Mr. Harito singled out the importance of promoting new projects to ensure data integrity. The second panel presented the latest developments regarding digital transformation and its role in the banking industry. This panel, moderated by Zj. Maria Teresa Chimeti, representative of the Payment Systems Development Group near the World Bank, was Page 2 of 3 Digital Banking in Albania conference takes place 29/07/22, 14:42 focused on the latest developments in the prospect of innovation by market actors. Particular emphasis was devoted to real-time payments and banking services, both from the perspective of service providers and on the development of support infrastructure. Added value was also the presentation of Mr. Wim Mijs, Executive Director of the European Banking Federation, who spoke on the regulatory framework in the European Union and the impact on Albania. In this section, referrals from Turkey (Guarantee Bank) and Poland brought the experience of the countries and respectively the latest trend in digital banking and the model followed by Poland in payment systems. The third Digital Bank-themed panel in Albania where we are positioned and what we need to know was led by the Chairman of the Albanian Banking Association, Mr Christian Canacaris and participants in it were Mr Enkelejd Zotaj from Raiffeisen Bank, Mr Fatih Karli, BKT, Mr Gideon Van Der Broek and Mr Paul Wide from International Commercial Bank. The referrers introduced the products and services offered to the Albanian consumer by the banks they represent. During the last two presentations by Mr. Romano Stasi, Director of the Italian Banking Association, and Mr. Raja Said, representative of ProgressSoft Corporation, topics were addressed on information security within the framework of new developments in technology and possible solutions were introduced in the payments sector, which could apply in the future to the banking sector. At the conference were guests, journalists, representatives of international organisations, telecommunications societies, providers of innovative products and services in the banking sector, as well as groups of interest in technology. text: Bank of Albania Governor Mr Gent Seyko meets with Bank of France Governor Francois Villeroy de Galhau 29/07/22, 14:42 Bank of Albania Governor Mr Gent Seyko meets with Bank of France Governor Francois Villeroy de Galhau Publication date: 29.05.2016 On 26-27 May 2016, The Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Sejko, held a two-day working visit to the Bank of France. This visit is considered very important within the framework of the bilateral co-operation relations that exist between the two central banks. During his stay in France, the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Seyko held meetings with the Governor of the Bank of France, Mr. Francois Villeroy de Galhau, as well as with other senior leaders of this institution. The conversations focused mainly on bilateral economic relations, the performance of the Albanian banking system, the promotion of Albania's potentials, as well as the latest developments in the Eurozone.  uvernatorin_e_Bankes_se_Frances_z_Francois_Villeroy_de_Galhau.html Page 1 of 4 Bank of Albania Governor Mr Gent Seyko meets with Bank of France Governor Francois Villeroy de Galhau 29/07/22, 14:42 Governor Sejko recognized his counterpart with the latest economic and financial developments in Albania, stressing that despite the unfavourable international situation, Albania has marked a positive performance in the direction of the country's economic growth. The Bank of Albania has made the necessary contribution through easing monetary policy in support of a sustainable economic growth and ensuring the country's macroeconomic stability.  uvernatorin_e_Bankes_se_Frances_z_Francois_Villeroy_de_Galhau.html Page 2 of 4 Bank of Albania Governor Mr Gent Seyko meets with Bank of France Governor Francois Villeroy de Galhau 29/07/22, 14:42 During the meeting, the two governors discussed the role and challenges facing monetary policy today, in a situation of uncertainty and low inflation anywhere in the world and in Europe, and shared the same view that harmonisation of macroeconomic policies affects the acceleration of the economic development of the two countries. Stopping in particular in banking sector developments, Governor Sejko praised the achievements and potentials this sector offers in Albania, with optimal parameters of financial indicators. The Bank of Albania, in the role of supervisory and regulatory authority, is in constant effort to approximate banking legislation with the European one, as a prerequisite for creating the appropriate environment for further development of this sector. Governor Seyko thanked Governor Villeroy de Galhau for the successful co-operation between the two institutions, especially for the assistance provided by the Bank of France in joint projects developed so far in some areas of activity of the Bank of Albania. For his part, Governor Villeroy de Galhau praised the bank of Albania's important contribution and role in ensuring the country's macroeconomic and financial stability. He stressed that the policies followed and measures taken by the Bank of Albania have influenced strengthening its institutional capacities and integrity. Governor Villeroy de Galhau stressed that the ties between the two institutions have been and tend to be quite stable and fruitful. In the quality of the Member of the European Central Bank's Steering Council, he assured Governor Sejko that the Bank of France and the member banks of the European Central Bank System will continue to provide support to the Bank of Albania, strengthen institutional capacities and adopt international central banking standards,  uvernatorin_e_Bankes_se_Frances_z_Francois_Villeroy_de_Galhau.html Page 3 of 4 Bank of Albania Governor Mr Gent Seyko meets with Bank of France Governor Francois Villeroy de Galhau 29/07/22, 14:42 until Albania becomes part of the European family. This co-operation can be reflected in areas such as: convergence of legislation with European standards, resolving issues of troubled loans, governing the central bank, etc. At the end of the meeting, Governor Seyko, thanking him for the warm hospitality, invited counterpart Villeroy de Galhau to hold a visit to Albania at a time suitable for his agenda. Title: Speech, at the joint press conference with the IMF Mission and the Minister of Finance
text: Financial Forum IV 29/07/22, 14:42 Financial Forum IV Publication date: 23.06.2016 On 23 June 2016, the Financial Forum IV, organised by the Bank of Albania and the International Monetary Fund, was carried out under the special care of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Sejko. This year, discussions of this forum focused on the issue of credit revitalization, in support of a sustainable economic growth. The forum was attended by the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Minister and Deputy Minister of Finance, Minister and Deputy Minister of Economy, senior director of the Bank of Albania and the Financial Supervision Authority, executive leaders of the main banks operating in Albania and representatives from the parent banks, mission managers and local representatives of the IMF and the World Bank, representatives of the European Central Bank (ECB), the European Banking Authority (EBA), the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD), the International Financial Corporation (IFC), etc. Page 1 of 4 Financial Forum IV 29/07/22, 14:42 This forum, already back in tradition, serves as a platform to exchange ideas and present positions on the various problems associated with the banking and financial sector in the country. The wide participation reflected the organizers' objective to promote active discussions between the parties present and to help in a humane and detailed approach to the forum's theme. In his presentation, the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Sejko, initially stopped at Albania's economic perspective, where he pointed out the fact that the country's economic recovery continues according to forecasts made and that expectations for 2016 and 2017 are for higher growth rates. More specifically, he stressed that: .... In the short and medium term, the economic recovery is expected to be strengthened by the increase in private demand to be followed in the long term by a further stimulus generated by the increase in exports. However, for growth to be stable, it must find the necessary support from sufficient lending to the banking sector, otherwise the economic recovery cannot enjoy long-term sustainability. In his address, the Governor highlighted the Commitment of the Bank of Albania to create an environment as soon as possible Page 2 of 4 Financial Forum IV 29/07/22, 14:42 favourable for boosting the economy's lending. To support lending growth, he underlined, we as the central bank have tried to influence both directions: both the demand and the supply of loans. On the demand side, the Bank of Albania has continuously undertaken an easing monetary policy, which according to its analyses has been continuously transmitted to the economy. As a result, lending in the local currency, as a result of the marked reduction in interest rates, has marked marked increases over the years. Meanwhile, on the offer side, the Bank of Albania has taken a series of regulatory actions aimed at restructuring the loan, taking bad loans off the balance sheet, extending the ownership deadline on real estate on bank balance sheets, etc. Also, anti-cyclic measures have been undertaken in terms of promoting lending, requiring additional capital for banks boosting funds investments abroad and easing capital requirements for banks with higher lending growth. As for the above, the Governor called for the banking system to be more forward-looking and flexible in lending policies. You must strengthen co-operation and improve partnerships with local businesses, actively seek possible healthy lending cases, adapt lending products to the specific business/sector/sector/country risk profile, promote early restructuring for productive businesses, based on clear and transparent guidelines. The Governor said. At the end of his speech, the Governor called on participants to actively promote Albania, as perception is more negative compared to reality in Albania. Albania's promotion and reality reflection positively affect the country's perceived risk reduction, facilitating banks' work in lending activity. During the forum's work, all participants discussed extensively on the problems and other issues that are assessed as obstacles to the revitalization of healthy lending to the economy, while the relevant conclusions were drawn up in its conclusions. Page 3 of 4 Financial Forum IV 29/07/22, 14:42 More specifically, the first conclusion relates to the necessity of the country's economic and financial stability. Strengthening macro-financial balances is a guarantor for sustainable growth, and for the future creates the necessary premise for an increase in bank credit in the near future. Of particular importance, the country's authorities must devote themselves to meeting all the points set out in the interinstitutional plan for reducing troubled loans. After successfully fulfilling all measures related to regulatory acts, it is important to progress rapidly in the final adoption of the legal package part of this plan. Further improving the business climate is assessed as another important direction where efforts should be concentrated in the future. Despite the progress achieved, in the following period, authorities are committed to taking further action in this direction. The high level of troubled loans was accepted as one of the important factors negatively affecting the banking system's offer of loans. For this reason, a particular emphasis was placed on the detailed study of contemporary international practices, which in many countries have resulted in success in promoting bank credit. Another important conclusion relates to the need for further improvement of the communication strategy on the part of all actors involved in this process, with the aim of promoting the initiatives undertaken and the potentials that the country offers. At the end of the forum, on behalf of the Bank of Albania and the International Monetary Fund, Governor Seyko thanked the participants for their contribution and underlined once again the vital role credit plays in the country's economic development.
