Bank of Albania Supervisory Council, July 6, 2016 29/07/22, 14:42 , Mr. Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making of Bank of Albania Supervisory Council, July 6, 2016 Publication date: 06.07.2016 At today's meeting, the Bank of Albania's Supervisory Council reviewed the intermediate monetary policy report. At the conclusion of the analysis of the information and forecasts presented, the Supervisory Council decided to keep the basic interest rate unchanged at the 1.25% level. *** New data available show that the Albanian economy and its monetary indicators have generally performed in line with our expectations. In line with these forecasts, economic activity and inflation appear to be on the rise. The balance of information available suggests that the Albanian economy has marked growth in the first half of 2016. This increase appears to have been supported by the expansion of consumption and private investment, while the deteriorating foreign trade balance and budgetary sufficiency created during the first six months of the year have acted in the opposite direction. The expansion of private consumption reflects the increase in employment and disposable income, as well as has been helped by monetary stimulus policy, adequate financing conditions and increased consumer credit. The positive investment contribution reflects the expansion of private, domestic and foreign investment, while public investment has marked declines. The expansion of private investment has also benefited from abundant liquidity and low interest rates in financial markets. Bank of Albania expects increased internal private demand Page 1 of 4 , Mr. Gent Seyko at the conference... Bank of Albania Supervisory Council, July 6, 2016 29/07/22, 14:42 Even during the second half of the year. However, business confidence and consumer confidence remain fluctuating, illustrating the still unconsolidated position of private domestic demand as the engine of economic growth. In parallel with it, the poor economic performance of our trading partners, the fall in the price of some of our traditional export products, as well as the high import bill that some of the foreign direct investments have in Albania, have brought about an expansion with 26.3% of the trade deficit during the first five months of the year. In the Bank of Albania's judgment, this picture will also be preserved in the second six months, and foreign trade exchanges will not support economic growth during 2016. Public sector financial activity resulted in a suffice of 18.2 billion dollars by May, compared to a deficit of 10.6 billion dollars in the same period a year ago. This strong fiscal consolidation reflected both revenue growth and shrinking budgetary spending. In particular, the latter reflected the reduction in capital expenditure, remaining below the level planned for them. In line with budgetary projections, we expect the pace of public spending to increase and slow the pace of fiscal consolidation during the second half of the year. However, the Bank of Albania finds it appropriate to reemphasize that a more simultaneous distribution of budgetary spending would help reduce fluctuations in economic activity and financial markets. In response to monetary stimulus policy, financial markets continue to be characterized by a satisfactory level of liquidity and falling interest rate trends. The latest monetary stimulus has also been transmitted in financial markets, where interest rates on loans in money have fallen by about 1.0 percentage points while the government's value letter interest rate curve has shifted downwards, averaging 1.20 percentage points. The performance of deposits and the balance sheet of the banking system is stable. However, lending activity still remains pale. Cleared of the effect of clearing loans from balance sheets, the loan to the private sector recorded an annual increase of 2.5% in the month of April. Consequently, the revival of bank credit remains the prerequisite for a sustainable and long-term increase, and will be one of the medium-term objectives of the work of the Bank of Albania and other public authorities. ... te_Keshillit_Mbikeqyres_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_6_korrik_2016.html Page 2 of 4 , Mr. Gent Seyko at the conference... Bank of Albania Supervisory Council, July 6, 2016 29/07/22, 14:42 Annual inflation marked 0.7% in May, moving to the direction and intensity expected by the Bank of Albania. Improved economic activity brought rising base inflation, while the fading effects of supply shocks were accompanied by the fading of disinflationary tendencies imported from foreign markets. New information and updating forecasts have not changed our expectations for the future. Our projection of economic growth for 2016 remains the same, while short-term inflation projections have easily shifted upwards and medium-term projections have not changed. In line with these forecasts, the Bank of Albania expects progressive improvement in economic activity on the medium-term horizon. This improvement will help gradually increase inflation and return it to target at the end of 2018. The effects of easing monetary policy are continuing to be transmitted in financial markets and the current monetary policy stance is assessed appropriate to meet our objectives. In accordance with these conclusions, the Supervisory Council decided to keep the basic interest rate unchanged at the 1.25% level. The Supervisory Council considers that, in the absence of unforeseen shocks, monetary stimulus will not fade throughout 2016. Similarly, the Supervisory Council decided not to change the interest rate corridor in the interbank market, defined by the one-day deposit interest rate at 0.25% level and the one-day loan interest rate, at the 2.25% level. At the close of the analysis, the Bank of Albania states that the balance of risks around expected medium-term developments continues to remain at the fallen point. In particular, the Bank of Albania is closely following the Brexit phenomenon and the consequences it could have on the Albanian economy. Our analysis suggests that the Albanian economy and financial system result immune to direct blows that could come from the UNITED Kingdom's expected exit from the European Union. Our trade exposure with the United Kingdom, in the form of exports and imports, is almost insignificant. Likewise, direct or financial investments originating in the United Kingdom in Albania are low, while remittances from it account for something more than 10% of total remittances. In parallel with them, the Albanian banking system has low exposure to even the most extreme forms of pound fluctuations and the British financial system. On the other hand, Albania has greater exposure to the indirect blows That Brexit could have on the European economy and financial system. The latter countries are our main economic and trading partners, and any negative reaction to Brexit would try to be broadcast in Albania as well. Regarding these indirect effects, the Bank of Albania wants to stress that: First, the probability of materializing extreme shocks is relatively low. We are confident that the actors involved in the discussions will know how to avoid undesirable situations for everyone. However, we remain in monitoring the ... te_Keshillit_Mbikeqyres_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_6_korrik_2016.html Page 3 of 4 , Mr. Gent Seyko at the conference... Bank of Albania Supervisory Council, July 6, 2016 29/07/22, 14:42 The situation continued. Second, the Albanian economy and financial system appear better prepared to cope with possible shocks compared to similar previous situations. We will continue to work to increase their readiness and immunity. Third, even in the event of further worsening of the situation, the Bank of Albania has the right will and instruments to ensure that its price stability target is met, as well as to support the activity and health of the financial system. In particular, monetary policy would take on a stronger stimulus nature, initially exploiting the remaining spaces of use of traditional instruments and further addressing, if necessary, nontraditional monetary policy instruments. *** At the close of this announcement, the Supervisory Council once again reconfirms the message that, in the absence of negative shocks, the country's medium-term development outlook remains positive. ... te_Keshillit_Mbikeqyres_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_6_korrik_2016.html Page 4 of 4

Gent Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp t vendimmarrjes s politiks monetare t Kshillit Mbikqyrs t Banks s Shqipris, 6 korrik 2016 Data e publikimit: 06.07.2016 N mbledhjen e sotme, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris mori n shqyrtim raportin e ndrmjetm t politiks monetare. N prfundim t analizs s informacionit dhe parashikimeve t paraqitura, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi t mbaj t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 1.25%. *** T dhnat e reja t disponuara tregojn se ekonomia shqiptare dhe treguesit e saj monetar kan ecur prgjithsisht n prputhje me pritjet tona. N linj me kto parashikime, aktiviteti ekonomik dhe inflacioni shfaqen n rritje. Balanca e informacionit t disponuar sugjeron se ekonomia shqiptare ka shnuar rritje n gjysmn e par t vitit 2016. Kjo rritje duket t jet mbshtetur nga zgjerimi i konsumit dhe i investimeve private, ndrkoh q prkeqsimi i bilancit tregtar me jasht dhe suficiti buxhetor i krijuar gjat gjashtmujorit t par t vitit, kan vepruar n kahun e kundrt. Zgjerimi i konsumit privat reflekton rritjen e punsimit dhe t t ardhurave t disponueshme, si dhe sht ndihmuar nga politika monetare stimuluese, kushtet e prshtatshme t financimit dhe rritja e kredis pr konsum. Kontributi pozitiv i investimeve reflekton zgjerimin e investimeve private, t brendshme dhe t huaja, ndrkoh q investimet publike kan shnuar rnie. Zgjerimi i investimeve private ka prfituar gjithashtu nga likuiditeti i bollshm dhe nga normat e ulta t interesit n tregjet financiare. Gent Sejko n konferetare t Kshillit Mbikqyrs t Banks s Shqipris, 6 korrik 2016 29/07/22, 14:42 edhe gjat gjysms s dyt t vitit. Megjithat, besimi i biznesit dhe ai konsumator mbeten t luhatshm, ka ilustron pozitn ende t pakonsoliduar t krkess s brendshme private si motor i rritjes ekonomike. Paralelisht me t, ecuria e dobt ekonomike e partnerve tan tregtar, rnia e mimit t disa prej produkteve tona tradicionale t eksportit, si dhe fatura e lart e importit q kan disa prej investimeve t huaja direkte n Shqipri, kan sjell nj zgjerim me 26.3% t deficitit tregtar gjat pes muajve t par t vitit. N gjykimin e Banks s Shqipris, kjo tablo do t ruhet edhe n gjashtmujorin e dyt, dhe shkmbimet tregtare me jasht nuk do t mbshtesin rritjen ekonomike gjat vitit 2016. Aktiviteti financiar i sektorit publik rezultoi me nj suficit prej 18.2 miliard leksh deri n muajin maj, kundrejt nj deficiti prej 10.6 miliard leksh n t njjtn periudh t nj viti m par. Ky konsolidim i fort fiskal reflektoi si rritjen e t ardhurave, ashtu edhe tkurrjen e shpenzimeve buxhetore. N veanti, kto t fundit pasqyruan reduktimin e shpenzimeve kapitale, duke mbetur posht nivelit t planifikuar pr to. N prputhje me projeksionet buxhetore, ne presim rritjen e tempit t shpenzimeve publike dhe ngadalsimin e tempit t konsolidimit fiskal gjat gjysms s dyt t vitit. Megjithat, Banka e Shqipris gjen me vend t ritheksoj se nj shprndarje m e njtrajtshme e shpenzimeve buxhetore do t ndihmonte n uljen e luhatjeve t aktivitetit ekonomik dhe t tregjeve financiare. N prgjigje t politiks monetare stimuluese, tregjet financiare vazhdojn t karakterizohen nga nj nivel i knaqshm likuiditeti dhe nga tendenca rnse t normave t interesit. Stimuli i fundit monetar sht transmetuar edhe n tregjet financiare, ku normat e interesit t kredive ne lek kan rn me rreth 1.0 pik prqindjeje ndrsa kurba e normave t interesit t letrave me vler t qeveris sht zhvendosur pr posht, mesatarisht me 1.20 pik prqindjeje. Ecuria e depozitave dhe e pasivit t bilancit t sistemit bankar sht e qndrueshme. Megjithat, aktiviteti kreditues mbetet ende i zbeht. E pastruar nga efekti i pastrimit t kredive nga bilancet, kredia pr sektorin privat regjistroi nj rritje vjetore prej 2.5% n muajin prill. Si rrjedhoj, rigjallrimi i kredis bankare mbetet parakusht pr nj rritje t qndrueshme dhe afatgjat, dhe do t jet nj nga objektivat afatmesm t puns s Banks s Shqipris dhe t autoriteteve t tjera publike. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjate_Keshillit_Mbikeqyres_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_6_korrik_2016.html Pagina 2 di 4 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Prmirsimi i aktivitetit ekonomik solli rritjen e inflacionit baz, ndrsa zbehja e efekteve t goditjeve t oferts u shoqrua me zbehjen e tendencave dezinflacioniste t importuara nga tregjet e huaja. Informacioni i ri dhe prditsimi i parashikimeve nuk kan ndryshuar pritjet tona pr t ardhmen. Projeksioni yn i rritjes ekonomike pr vitin 2016 mbetet i njjt, ndrkoh q projeksionet afatshkurtra t inflacionit jan zhvendosur lehtsisht pr lart dhe ato afatmesme nuk kan ndryshuar. N prputhje me kto parashikime, Banka e Shqipris pret prmirsim progresiv t aktivitetit ekonomik n horizontin afatmesm. Ky prmirsim do t ndihmoj n rritjen graduale t inflacionit dhe n kthimin e tij n objektiv n fund t vitit 2018. Efektet e politiks monetare lehtsuese po vazhdojn t transmetohen n tregjet financiare dhe qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare vlersohet i prshtatshm pr t prmbushur objektivat tona. N prputhje me kto konkluzione, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi t mbaj t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 1.25%. Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjykon se, n munges t goditjeve t paparashikuara, stimuli monetar nuk do t zbehet prgjat gjith vitit 2016. Po kshtu, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi t mos ndryshoj korridorin e normave t interesit n tregun ndrbankar, t prcaktuar nga norma e interesit t depozits njditore n nivelin 0.25% dhe norma e interesit t kredis njditore, n nivelin 2.25%. N mbyllje t analizs, Banka e Shqipris konstaton se balanca e rreziqeve rreth zhvillimeve t pritura afatmesme vazhdon t qndroj n kahun rns. N veanti, Banka e Shqipris sht duke ndjekur me vmendje fenomenin Brexit dhe pasojat q ai mund t ket n ekonomin shqiptare. Analiza jon sugjeron se ekonomia dhe sistemi financiar shqiptar rezultojn imun ndaj goditjeve direkte q mund t vijn nga dalja e pritur e Mbretris s Bashkuar nga Bashkimi Evropian. Ekspozimi jon tregtar me Mbretrin e Bashkuar, n formn e eksporteve dhe importeve, sht pothuaj i paprfillshm. Po kshtu, investimet direkte apo financiare t origjinuara nga Mbretria e Bashkuar n Shqipri jan t ulta, ndrsa remitancat prej saj prbjn dika m shum se 10% t remitancave totale. Paralelisht me to, sistemi bankar shqiptar ka nj ekspozim t ult edhe ndaj formave m ekstreme t luhatjeve t paundit dhe t sistemit financiar britanik. Nga ana tjetr, Shqipria ka nj ekspozim m t madh ndaj goditjeve indirekte q Brexit mund t ket n ekonomin dhe n sistemin financiar evropian. Vendet e ktij t fundit jan partnert tan kryesor ekonomik dhe tregtar, dhe do reagim negativ i tyre ndaj Brexit do t tentonte t transmetohej edhe n Shqipri. N lidhje me kto efekte indirekte, Banka e Shqipris dshiron t theksoj se: S pari, probabiliteti i materializimit t goditjeve ekstreme sht relativisht i ult. Ne kemi besim se aktort e prfshir n diskutime do t din t shmangin situata t padshirueshme pr gjithknd. During the visit, Sir Suma Chakrabarti held a series of high-level meetings with the country's main authorities. The meeting with the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Sejko, took place in the premises of the Bank of Albania. Sir Suma Chakrabarti and berzh's highest representatives attended the meeting. Initially, Governor Seyko praised the excellent co-operation relations with the BERZH, which have served as a coherent guide to the drafting of the country's development agenda.  kes_Europiane_per_Rindertim_dhe_Zhvillim_Sir_Suma_Chakrabarti.html Page 1 of 3 On the meeting of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko m... European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, Sir Suma Chakrabarti 29/07/22, 14:41 Furthermore, the Governor recognized the President of the BERZH with the latest economic and financial developments in the country. In particular, the Governor stopped at addressing the main challenges facing the Albanian economy, the framework of macroeconomic policies and structural reforms needed to boost economic growth, improve the business climate and absorb as much foreign investment in Albania as possible. The governor stressed that the country's economic growth is on a positive development trajectory. Economic growth is expected to improve and key economic balances will strengthen over the coming years. As far as the banking system is concerned, the Governor stressed that today the system appears with quite good financial indicators. Governor Sejko underlined that addressing the issue of troubled loans has been one of the Bank of Albania's main commitments, coupled with a well-thought-out action plan for reducing them, including a range of legal, fiscal and regulatory improvements. Implementation of this plan helped reduce the level of troubled loans to 18.2%, at the end of 2015. Another important issue discussed during the talks was also the promotion of lending and measures taken supported by monetary stimulus policy, which has given its effects affecting the lowering of the price of credit, in all segments of the financial market in the country. For his part, the President of the BERZH praised the Bank of Albania for its policies, which have contributed to maintaining the country's macroeconomic stability and the continued consolidation of the financial system in Albania. Furthermore, he stated that the BERZH will continue to make its contribution to Albania in terms of projects of particular importance, in areas such as agribusiness, infrastructure, energy, etc. with the aim of developing the public and private sector. In conclusion, he expressed commitment to continue co-operation with the Bank of Albania on strengthening the financial sector through supporting the banking system through lending lines and other amenities. In conclusion, Governor Sejko once thanked berzh for his important contribution and concrete support with financial investments in key areas of our country's economy and invited him to continue to assess the potentials Albania offers.  kes_Europiane_per_Rindertim_dhe_Zhvillim_Sir_Suma_Chakrabarti.html Page 2 of 3 On the meeting of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko m... text: Questions - answers of the press conference dated August 3, 2016 29/07/22, 14:41 Questions - answers of the press conference dated August 3, 2016 Publication date: 03.08.2016 Q: Today in the media there has been a report, according to which the High State Control has revealed that triple the amount that has so far been publicly said has been stolen from the Bank of Albania treasure. The questions I have are: do you confirm the veracity of this figure? And second, if there's any chance what are those second-rate banks that are being talked about in that report? Governor: Thank you for the question, which gives me the opportunity to make a clarification after I also read the newspaper before the meeting of the Supervisory Council. Normally we have informed the public and confirmed continuously, even in the period of the beginning of my term as Governor, that the stolen sum has been what has been inventoryed and declared. This has come not only as a result of inventories carried out at the behest of administrators at the time of identification of the theft, but also as a result of subsequent inventories carried out by inventory groups that have reconfirmed this figure. Also, the figure of 713 million stolen money has been reconfirmed by both other external auditors, financial mirrors and the International Monetary Fund mission of the FSVC, which is a consultancy institution for the Bank of Albania. So this is a figure confirmed by several next audits and various inventories. I as Governor have no information regarding the figure read today. Every report, even the State High Control report itself, even the High State Control itself, has confirmed the figure I mentioned above. So, once again, in the reports I have from KLSH I have confirmed exactly this figure. Of course I'm not the inventor. I'm the one who organizes the work and awaits information from the groups. Any other media speculation, which may seek to make news, would ruin the image of the Bank of Albania and misinform the public about the figure stolen from the Bank of Albania. Q: Mr. Governor, you mentioned and welcomed justice reform. But political developments, especially over the last month, have been very dynamic and it looks like there is an increase in political risk. Does the Bank of Albania perceive the same thing and what the impacts would be? Does this pose an added risk to the economy? Governor: Basically, any political destabilisation in theory would have its impact on the level of economic growth. In the concrete case, we have seen that justice reform had a consensus approval, as ever, by 140 votes. This was a very positive signal for Albania in general, for albania's integration, but also for the Albanian economy. From our perspective as the Central Bank, this gives us an extremely optimistic signal for lending performance, but also for implementing the plan of measures for troubled loans. Implementing justice reform would bring a better execution of collateral and better implementation of contracts in the long-term and medium-term relationship between banks and creditors. So, after the adoption of justice reform, our current perception as the Bank of Albania is positive. Normally this creates positive premise and for the Albanian economy. Let's look step by step at the performance of reform implementation, as this will have its steps. Let us hope that the implementation will also be consensual and will take positive steps as the adoption of the constitutional package. Pyetje: Zoti Guvernator, ju prmendt dhe prshndett edhe reformn n drejtsi. Por zhvillimet politike, veanrisht gjat muajit t fundit, kan qen shum dinamike dhe duket sikur ka nj rritje t rrezikut politik. A percepton dhe Banka e Shqipris t njjtn gj dhe cilat do t ishin impaktet? A prbn kjo nj rrezik t shtuar pr ekonomin? Guvernatori: Parimisht, do destabilizim politik n teori, do t kishte ndikimin e tij n nivelin e rritjes ekonomike. N rastin konkret, ne kemi par q reforma n drejtsi pati nj miratim me konsensus, si asnjher, me 140 vota. Ky ishte nj sinjal shum pozitiv pr Shqiprin n prgjithsi, pr integrimin e Shqipris, por dhe pr ekonomin shqiptare. Nga kndvshtrimi yn si Bank Qendrore, kjo na jep nj sinjal jashtzakonisht optimist pr ecurin e kreditimit, por dhe pr zbatimin e planit t masave pr kredit me probleme. Zbatimi i reforms n drejtsi do t sillte nj ekzekutim m t mir t kolateralit dhe nj zbatim m t mir t kontratave n planin afatgjat dhe afatmesm n raport midis bankave dhe kredimarrsve. Pra, pas miratimit t reforms n drejtsi, perceptimi yn aktual si Bank e Shqipris sht pozitiv. Normalisht kjo krijon premisa pozitive dhe pr ekonomin shqiptare. Le t shohim hap pas hapi ecurin e implementimit t reforms, pasi dhe kjo do t ket hapat e saj. T shpresojm se dhe implementimi do t jet konsensual dhe do t ec me hapa pozitiv njsoj si miratimi i pakets kushtetuese. Bank of Albania Supervisory Council, August 3, 2016 29/07/22, 14:41 , Mr. Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making of Bank of Albania Supervisory Council, August 3, 2016 Publication date: 03.08.2016 At the meeting dated 3 August 2016, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed the Monetary Policy Report for the second quarter. At the end of discussions on the analysis and forecasts presented in it, the Supervisory Council decided to keep the basic interest rate unchanged at the 1.25% level. Also, the Supervisory Council left deposit and one-day loan interest rates unchanged, at 0.25% and 2.25% respectively. Page 1 of 3 , Mr Gent Seyko in confection... Bank of Albania Supervisory Council, August 3, 2016 29/07/22, 14:41 The performance of the Albanian economy and financial markets has generally been in line with our expectations. Thus, economic activity resulted in expansion during the first half of the year, inflation had growth tendencies during the second quarter, while the stimulus of our monetary policy has enabled the creation of a secular financial environment and with low interest rates. Under these circumstances, our medium-term forecasts have not changed and the current monetary policy position is estimated to be appropriate for meeting the price stability target in the medium term. Inflation marked progressive growth during the second quarter. At the end of June, annual inflation reached a level of 1.2%. Its increase came mainly as a result of rising food and rent prices. In macroeconomic terms, the return of inflation to an increasing trajectory was influenced by easing foreign disinflationary pressures and strengthening domestic pressures. This tendency confirms our estimates of the transient nature of the supply shocks that brought down this indicator during the first quarter. It also reflects improving economic activity in the country. The economic growth of the first quarter resulted in the upper direction of our expectations. According to Instat data, the Albanian economy scored annual growth of 2.96% during the first quarter of the year. This increase reflects improved activity in the services and construction sectors, while the industrial and agriculture sectors continued to mark declines. Available indirect indicators suggest rough growth rhythms even in the second quarter. The economic growth of the first half of the year reflected the combined effects of monetary stimulus policy and consolidated fiscal policy pursued in Albania. Thus, the expansion of economic activity resulted from increased consumption and private internal investment. Their growth reflects improving business and household financial balances, positive developments in the labour market, easing uncertainty and unlocking the construction market. It has also been helped by monetary stimulus and improved activity financing conditions. On the other hand, foreign trade exchanges and public sector activity have not favoured economic growth. Our exports continue to suffer unfavourable price conjunctude in international commodity markets, but this factor is somewhat offset by improved tourism. On the other hand, fiscal policy continues to maintain a consolidating nature, even with a stronger intensity than the planned level. The tendencies made during the first half of the year and the financial conditions of the economy have brought a slight revision in the upper direction of economic growth and inflation expected during 2016. Financial markets appear calm, with interest rates at low levels and abundant liquidity. The transmission of our monetary stimulus in these markets has been reflected in lowering financing costs for the Albanian economy. Interest rates have marked new historical minimum levels, throughout the arc of financial instruments, during the second quarter. Monetary stimulus policy has lowered consumer and investment financing costs, as well as eased service costs Page 2 of 3 , Mr Gent Seyko in confection... Bank of Albania Supervisory Council, August 3, 2016 29/07/22, 14:41 credit and debt, without generating negative consequences on the health indicators of the financial system. In particular, liquidity and capitalisation indicators of the banking sector remain at satisfactory levels. Credit performance showed improvement trends in the second quarter. Cleared of the effect of deleting lost loans from the balance sheet, the bank loan portfolio marked average annual growth around the 3% level. This performance is owed to the overwhelming extent of the annual expansion with 6.4% of the loan in money, while the currency loan portfolio is almost unchanged from a year ago. However, the pace of its annual growth still remains dim. Slow credit growth continues to reflect both low demand and tight supply for this product. The Bank of Albania considers that boosting demand and further improving credit supply remains one of the necessary prerequisites for the country's sustainable medium-term and long-term growth. For this reason, full implementation of the plan of measures to deal with troubled loans is of paramount importance. For this reason, we welcome justice reform, as we judge that among other things it will pave the way for a more transparent and reliable legal environment for the commitment of parties to long-term contracts. The new information available and the update of the analyses have not produced significant changes in our medium-term forecasts. On this time horizon, we expect economic activity to come to progressive improvement, reflecting even favourable financing conditions. The Albanian economy is expected to return to balance during the second half of 2017, which will further create the premise for returning inflation to the target in the second half of 2018. These forecasts are conditional on the preservation of monetary policy stimulus kah during this period. Monetary stimulus is forecast to remain unchanged during 2016. The balance of risks continues to remain in the lower direction. It is further strengthened by the possible consequences of Brexit, directly or indirectly, in the Albanian economy and financial system. However, the Bank of Albania considers that the positive trajectory of economic and financial developments will also be preserved in the future. In any case, our monetary policy position will be in line with our inflation target and the need for further consolidation of economic growth resources. Page 3 of 3

Kshtu, aktiviteti ekonomik rezultoi n zgjerim gjat gjysms s par t vitit, inflacioni pati tendenca rritjeje gjat tremujorit t dyt, ndrsa kahu stimulues i politiks son monetare ka mundsuar krijimin e nj ambienti financiar likuid dhe me norma t ulta interesi. N kto rrethana, parashikimet tona afatmesme nuk kan ndryshuar dhe qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare vlersohet t jet i prshtatshm pr prmbushjen e objektivit t stabilitetit t mimeve n nj periudh afatmesme. Inflacioni shnoi rritje progresive gjat tremujorit t dyt. N fund t muajit qershor, inflacioni vjetor arriti n nivelin 1.2%. Rritja e tij erdhi kryesisht si pasoj e rritjes s mimeve t ushqimeve dhe t qirave. N terma makroekonomik, rikthimi i inflacionit n nj trajektore rritse u ndikua nga zbutja e presioneve t huaja dizinflacioniste dhe nga forcimi i presioneve t brendshme. Kjo tendenc konfirmon vlersimet tona pr natyrn kalimtare t goditjeve t oferts q solln rnien e ktij treguesi gjat tremujorit t par. Ajo reflekton gjithashtu prmirsimin e aktivitetit ekonomik n vend. Rritja ekonomike e tremujorit t par rezultoi n kahun e siprm t pritjeve tona. Sipas t dhnave t Instat-it, ekonomia shqiptare shnoi rritje vjetore prej 2.96% gjat tremujorit t par t vitit.. Kjo rritje pasqyron prmirsimin e aktivitetit n sektort e shrbimeve dhe t ndrtimit, ndrkoh q sektori industrial dhe ai i bujqsis vazhduan t shnojn rnie. Treguesit e trthort t disponuar sugjerojn pr ritme t prafrta rritjeje edhe n tremujorin e dyt. Rritja ekonomike e gjysms s par t vitit pasqyroi efektet e kombinuara t politiks monetare stimuluese dhe t politiks fiskale konsoliduese t ndjekur n Shqipri. Kshtu, zgjerimi i aktivitetit ekonomik erdhi si pasoj e rritjes s konsumit dhe investimeve t brendshme private. Rritja e tyre pasqyron prmirsimin e bilanceve financiare t biznesit dhe familjeve, zhvillimet pozitive n tregun e puns, zbutjen e pasiguris dhe zhbllokimin e tregut t ndrtimit. Ajo sht ndihmuar gjithashtu nga stimuli monetar dhe nga prmirsimi i kushteve t financimit t aktivitetit. Nga ana tjetr, shkmbimet tregtare me jasht dhe aktiviteti i sektorit publik nuk kan favorizuar rritjen ekonomike. Eksportet tona vazhdojn t vuajn koniunkturn e pafavorshme t mimeve n tregjet ndrkombtare t mallrave, por ky faktor sht kompensuar disi nga prmirsimi i turizmit. Nga ana tjetr, politika fiskale vazhdon t ruaj nj natyr konsoliduese, madje me nj intensitet m t fort se niveli i planifikuar. Tendencat e faktuara gjat gjysms s par t vitit dhe kushtet financiare t ekonomis kan sjell nj rishikim t leht n kahun e siprm t rritjes ekonomike dhe t inflacionit t pritur gjat vitit 2016. Tregjet financiare shfaqen t qeta, me norma interesi n nivele t ulta dhe likuiditet t bollshm. Transmetimi i stimulit ton monetar n kto tregje sht reflektuar n uljen e kostove t financimit pr ekonomin shqiptare. Normat e interesit kan shnuar nivele t reja minimale historike, n t gjith harkun e instrumenteve financiare, gjat tremujorit t dyt. E pastruar nga efekti i fshirjes s kredive t humbura nga bilanci, portofoli i kredis bankare shnoi rritje mesatare vjetore rreth nivelit 3%. Kjo ecuri i detyrohet n masn drrmuese zgjerimit vjetor me 6.4% t kredis n lek, ndrkoh q portofoli i kredis n valut sht pothuaj i pandryshuar nga nj vit m par. Megjithat, ritmet e rritjes vjetore t saj mbeten ende t zbehta. Rritja e ngadalt e kredis vazhdon t reflektoj si krkesn e ult, ashtu dhe ofertn e shtrnguar pr kt produkt. Banka e Shqipris gjykon se nxitja e krkess dhe prmirsimi i mtejshm i oferts s kredis mbetet nj nga parakushtet e nevojshme pr rritjen e qndrueshme afatmesme dhe afatgjat t vendit. Pr kt arsye, zbatimi i plot i planit t masave pr trajtimin e kredive me probleme ka rndsi parsore. Po pr kt arsye, ne prshndesim reformn n drejtsi, pasi gjykojm se ndr t tjera ajo do t i hap rrug nj ambienti juridik m transparent e t besueshm pr angazhimin e palve n kontrata afatgjata. Informacioni i ri i disponuar dhe prditsimi i analizave, nuk kan prodhuar ndryshime t ndjeshme n parashikimet tona afatmesme. N kt horizont kohor, ne presim q aktiviteti ekonomik t vij n prmirsim progresiv, n reflektim edhe t kushteve t favorshme t financimit. Ekonomia shqiptare pritet t kthehet n ekuilibr gjat gjysms s dyt t vitit 2017, ka do t krijoj m tej premisa pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv n gjysmn e dyt t vitit 2018. Kto parashikime jan t kushtzuara nga ruajtja e kahut stimulues t politiks monetare gjat ksaj periudhe. Stimuli monetar parashikohet t mbetet i pandryshuar gjat vitit 2016. Balanca e rreziqeve vazhdon t mbetet n kahun e poshtm. Ajo forcohet m tej nga pasojat e mundshme t Brexit, direkte apo indirekte, n ekonomin dhe sistemin financiar shqiptar. Megjithat, Banka e Shqipris gjykon se trajektorja pozitive e zhvillimeve ekonomike e financiare do t ruhet edhe n t ardhmen. text: PRESS RELEASE 29/07/22, 14:41 PRESS RELEASE Publication date: 11.08.2016 In recent days, some media have broadcast the news that some second-rate banks have unfairly benefited from the process of dealing with damaged banknotes unsuitable for circulation. Regarding this issue, the Bank of Albania clarifies to the public that the news is untrue. The Bank of Albania administers banknotes unsuitable for circulation under fully well-defined rules and recently approached by European Central Bank standards. Rules that rate the exchange of damaged banknotes are broadly on the same line as those applied to EURO banknotes, according to the European Central Bank's (ECB/2013/10) decision of 19 April 2013. European experts have given their assessment that the processes and regimes followed by the Bank of Albania for cuts, specifications, reproduction, exchange, treatment of damaged and unsuitable coins for circulation as well as their withdrawal are the same as European ones. The practice of dealing with inappropriate banknotes for circulation, verified even during inspections conducted at commercial banks, proves that there has been no fact or case supporting what has been commented on recently in these media. The writing in the media, - that second-rate banks have compensated their customers only 80% of the value of damaged banknotes brought in for annihilation near the Bank of Albania, and on the other hand, these banks have been compensated with 100% of the value by the Bank of Albania, - is untrue. The Bank of Albania has done all necessary verifications envisaged by the "Transparency for Banking and Financial Products and Services" regulation, inspecting commercial banks. From the review, no commission held by the banks resulted in reflecting that a penalty was upheld in the value of 20% for Page 1 of 2 PRESS RELEASE 29/07/22, 14:41 Damaged banknotes. It also does not result in any complaints filed by bank customers inspected by the Bank of Albania for this matter. The processing process is fully documented. In support of the analysis as above, the Bank of Albania is convinced that no damage has been caused to the state budget or even the bank's own customers who have exchanged damaged banknotes with second-rate banks. KlSH's mentioned report has been treated institutionally with official communications between the two institutions. The Bank of Albania is committed to ensuring the quality functioning of the emission and circulation of the national banknote, in full compliance with the country's laws and international standards. text: Bank of Albania Governor Gent Seyko hosted a t... new UK in Tirana, US Duncan Norman MBE 29/07/22, 14:41 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Sejko hosted the new UK Ambassador at a welcome meeting today in Tirana, US Duncan Norman MBE Publication date: 08.09.2016 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Sejko held an official meeting with the new UK Ambassador to Tirana, US Duncan Norman MBE, at the Bank of Albania facilities. Page 1 of 2 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Seyko hosted a t... new UK in Tirana, US Duncan Norman MBE 29/07/22, 14:41 In his exhibition, Governor Sejko introduced financial developments in the country, where he underlined that the Albanian banking system is capitalized, secular and financially healthy. Governor Seyko said the institution he heads will continue to be committed to fulfilling its mission, for sustaining consumer prices and the financial stability of the country. During the meeting, Governor Seyko also stopped at the latest developments in the Eurozone and the United Kingdom's departure from the European Union, and analysed the impacts they have on the Albanian economy. In this direction, Governor Sejko guaranteed that despite these developments, the Bank of Albania is willing to make all the necessary contribution to support sustainable economic growth. Bank of Albania Governor Gent Seyko expressed his gratitude to the Bank of England for helping to exchange experiences and technical assistance provided in various areas of central banking. Particular attention was paid to the close relations that exist between the two countries and further strengthening co-operation in the field of education, in the area of justice for improving the legal framework, as well as potential prospects in the future. U.K. Ambassador Mr Duncan Norman MBE thanked Governor Sejko for the meeting and expressed his assessments of the important contribution the Bank of Albania makes in maintaining the country's macroeconomic stability. At the end of the meeting, the co-workers shared the same view of further increased economic co-operation between the two countries mainly in the field of the financial system, as well as in the growth of foreign investment in Albania. N kt drejtim, Guvernatori Sejko garantoi se pavarsisht ktyre zhvillimeve, Banka e Shqipris sht e gatshme t jap t gjith kontributin e nevojshm pr t mbshtetur nj rritje ekonomike t qndrueshme. Guvernatori i Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko shprehu mirnjohjen e tij ndaj Banks s Anglis pr ndihmn n shkmbimin e prvojave dhe asistencn teknike t dhn n fusha t ndryshme t bankingut qendror. Nj vmendje e veant iu kushtua marrdhnieve t ngushta q ekzistojn midis dy vendeve dhe forcimit t mtejshm t bashkpunimit n fushn e edukimit, n fushn e drejtsis pr prmirsimin e kuadrit ligjor, si dhe perspektivat potenciale n t ardhmen. Ambasadori i Mbretris s Bashkuar SH.T.Z. Duncan Norman MBE, falnderoi Guvernatorin Sejko pr kt takim dhe shprehu vlersimet e tij pr kontributin e rndsishm q Banka e Shqipris jep n ruajtjen e stabilitetit makroekonomik t vendit. N prfundim t takimit, bashkbiseduesit ndan t njjtin mendim pr rritjen e mtejshme t bashkpunimit ekonomik midis dy vendeve kryesisht n fushn e sistemit financiar, si dhe n rritjen e investimeve t huaja n Shqipri. Title: Speech at the press conference of the monetary policy decision-making of the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania
text: Questions - answers of the press conference dated October 5, 2016 29/07/22, 14:41 Questions - answers of the press conference dated October 5, 2016 Publication date: 05.10.2016 Q: The government has announced that there will be wage and pension increases. How will this affect monetary policy, will there be an increase in inflation and interest rates? More accurately, is there a coordinated plan between the Bank of Albania and the government for this increase? Governor: Raising wages and pensions is the exclusive right of the Albanian government. In advance we have been notified that the government will make a pay and pension increase. At first glance, this increase would affect consumption growth. We have stressed that the monetary easing policy pursued by the Bank of Albania with the aim of increasing lending, consumption and investment is not sufficient without undertaking and structural reforms. In this respect, we see rising wages and pensions as a stimulating factor in the direction of consumption growth. But, on the other hand, we as the Bank of Albania are interested in maintaining macroeconomic balances, reducing the budget deficit and continuing fiscal consolidation. We haven't seen the government's plan for raising wages and pensions, so we still don't have a final budget draft. We will have to look at this draft so that we can give a more accurate opinion and at that moment we will judge whether the increase in the figure would be acceptable, always in relation to these parameters and these objectives of the Bank of Albania, i.e. maintaining fiscal consolidation, maintaining the reduction of the level of the budget deficit and the reduction of debt. As long as these parameters are preserved, of course the increase in wages and pensions is an exclusive right and attribute of the Albanian government. Q: How does the Governor of the Bank of Albania predict lending performance by the end of 2016?  yetje-pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_5_tetor_2016.html Page 1 of 2 Questions - answers of the press conference dated October 5, 2016 29/07/22, 14:41 Governor: According to the data we have for the end of August, removing the effect of deleting loans from the balance sheet, the loan increased to the 2.7% level - the total loan including credit in the lek and currency credit. Last year, credit rose to the 3% level. This year, we expect credit growth to the level above 3%, i.e. a higher lending increase than last year's level, always removing the effect of deleting loans from the balance sheet as this is taken as surplus. We are pleased to highlight the increase in credit in the lek, in the local currency, in relation to the increase in currency credit. I also pointed out during my word that lending in the lek for the period until August was at 6.9%, versus a 2.3% increase in currencies. This proves the good transmission of monetary policy followed by the Bank of Albania. Title: On the meetings during the Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank
text: , Mr. Gent Seyko at the conference... Bank of Albania Supervisory Council, October 5, 2016 29/07/22, 14:41 , Mr. Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making of Bank of Albania Supervisory Council, October 5, 2016 Publication date: 05.10.2016 The new information, taken into analysis in the next monetary policy report, has generally resulted in line with our expectations. Economic activity continues to expand, inflation has come in rising, while financing costs remain around historically lower levels. The new information has also left our predictions unchanged. These forecasts suggest that the return of the economy to balance and the stable convergence of inflation on target will only materialize within a medium-term time horizon. Under these circumstances, the Supervisory Council considers that the current monetary policy position is appropriate. The secular and low-interest-rate financial environment, dictated by monetary stimulus policy, is necessary to promote further growth in economic activity and guarantee the return of inflation to the target. Page 1 of 4 , Mr. Gent Seyko at the conference... Bank of Albania Supervisory Council, October 5, 2016 29/07/22, 14:41 Consumer price inflation reached a 2% level in August, continuing to follow a growing trajectory following low values scored during the first quarter. The rise in inflation came as a result of rising food prices and the price of oil. In macroeconomic terms, the rise in inflation reflects the effect of increasing aggregate demand and reducing supply shocks from low food and raw materials prices in world markets. Available data suggest that the Albanian economy continued to grow during the second and third quarters, at rates comparable to those scored in the first quarter. This increase is supported by the expansion of internal private sector demand, while trade exchanges with abroad and consolidating fiscal policies have influenced the opposite direction. The favourable financial environment, increasing employment, improving the confidence of economic agents and continuing high inflows of foreign direct investment have helped boost consumption and private investment. The Bank of Albania estimates that these components of aggregate demand will continue to guide economic growth even in the following quarters. On the other hand, deepening the deficit in foreign trade exchanges has not helped the country's economic growth. This performance is mainly influenced by the increase in imports, in response to the positive cycle of investment in the economy. In parallel with it, low foreign demand for some typical Albanian export products such as oil and mineral raw materials has curbed our exports. The external economic environment is expected to remain unfavourable even in the short term, but the foreign trade balance is expected to mark a gradual improvement in the medium-term horizon. The consolidating fiscal policy translated into a budget sufficiency of about 13.7 billion dollars during the first eight months of the year. Respecting scheduled budget deficit levels for 2016 implies that fiscal policy will take on a stimulating nature for the remainder of the year. This respect also requires accelerating the pace of spending in the remainder of the year. Bank of Page 2 of 4 , Mr. Gent Seyko at the conference... Bank of Albania Supervisory Council, October 5, 2016 29/07/22, 14:41 Albania considers that a more simultaneous distribution of budgetary spending during the year would improve their effectiveness and reduce fluctuations in economic and financial indicators. The monetary stimulus, conveyed through the reduction of the basic interest rate, has already been transmitted to financial markets. These markets have generally resulted in calm, although certain segments have had added volatiles. Interest rates on loans and deposits have continued to hover near historic minimum levels even during August. On the other hand, the government's valuable letter yields have marked increases during recent polls. This increase reflects a correctional tendency of their rapid decline during the first half of the year, but also temporary imbalances in demand and supply for these instruments. Crediting the economy continues to mark growth, but this performance still remains fragile. Cleaned up by the effects of deleting loans from bank system balances and exchange rate fluctuations, credit to the economy marked an annual increase of 4.2% in august. The loan portfolio in the money marked an annual increase of 6.9% while the currency loan portfolio increased by 2.3%. In sectoral terms, consumer credit has a better relative performance than business credit. The slowdown in the monthly pace of credit growth in July and August is expected to be a passing phenomenon. However, this development illustrates the instability of lending in the country and reemphasizes the need for further structural reforms, which would enable credit risk reduction and increased demand for it. Based on available information, the Bank of Albania considers that the expected picture of economic and financial developments, presented in the previous quarterly report, still remains valid. We anticipate a progressive improvement in economic activity over the next two years. This improvement will help to return the economy to balance during the second half of 2017 and inflation on target during the second half of 2018. At the same time, available information suggests that the balance of risks on the medium-term horizon continues to remain at the fallen point. By also factoring in expected fiscal consolidation, the Supervisory Council estimates that meeting our inflation target will require pursuing a monetary stimulus policy during this period. In accordance with these judgments, the Supervisory Council decided: - keep the basic interest rate unchanged at 1.25%. - keep deposit and one-day loan interest rates unchanged, at 0.25% and 2.25% respectively. Also, the Supervisory Council estimates that the intensity of monetary stimulus will not decrease throughout 2016. In closing, the Supervisory Council finds it appropriate to stress that monetary and fiscal policies serve and are sufficient only for the return of the economy to balance and to preserve the country's economic and financial stability. On the other hand, accelerating Page 3 of 4 , Mr. Gent Seyko at the conference... Bank of Albania Supervisory Council, October 5, 2016 29/07/22, 14:41 economic growth potential depends on the breadth and ambition of the structural reform programme. Rritja e inflacionit erdhi si pasoj e rritjes s mimeve t ushqimeve dhe e mimit t nafts. N terma makroekonomik, rritja e inflacionit pasqyron efektin e rritjes s krkess agregate dhe reduktimin e goditjeve t oferts t ardhura nga mimet e ulta t ushqimeve dhe t lndve t para n tregjet botrore. T dhnat e disponuara sugjerojn se ekonomia shqiptare ka vazhduar t rritet gjat tremujorit t dyt e t tret, me ritme t krahasueshme me ato t shnuara n tremujorin e par. Kjo rritje sht mbshtetur nga zgjerimi i krkess s brendshme t sektorit privat, ndrkoh q shkmbimet tregtare me jasht dhe politika fiskale konsoliduese kan ndikuar n kahun e kundrt. Ambienti i favorshm financiar, rritja e punsimit, prmirsimi i besimit t agjentve ekonomik dhe vazhdimi i flukseve t larta hyrse t investimeve t huaja direkte, kan ndihmuar n rritjen e konsumit dhe t investimeve private. Banka e Shqipris vlerson se kta komponent t krkess agregate do t vazhdojn t udhheqin rritjen ekonomike edhe n tremujort n vazhdim. Nga ana tjetr, thellimi i deficitit t shkmbimeve tregtare me jasht nuk ka ndihmuar rritjen ekonomike t vendit. Kjo ecuri sht ndikuar kryesisht nga rritja e importeve, n prgjigje t ciklit pozitiv t investimit n ekonomi. Paralelisht me t, krkesa e ult e huaj pr disa produkte tipike t eksportit shqiptar si nafta dhe lndt e para minerale ka frenuar eksportet tona. Ambienti i jashtm ekonomik pritet t mbetet i pafavorshm edhe n afatin e shkurtr, por bilanci tregtar me jasht pritet t shnoj nj prmirsim gradual n horizontin afatmesm. Politika fiskale konsoliduese u prkthye n nj suficit buxhetor prej rreth 13.7 miliard leksh gjat tet muajve t par t vitit. Respektimi i niveleve t programuara t deficitit buxhetor pr vitin 2016 nnkupton se politika fiskale do t marr nj natyr stimuluese pr pjesn e mbetur t vitit. Ky respektim krkon gjithashtu prshpejtimin e ritmit t shpenzimeve n pjesn e mbetur t vitit. Stimuli monetar, i prcjell nprmjet reduktimit t norms baz t interesit, sht transmetuar tashm n tregjet financiare. Kto tregje kan rezultuar prgjithsisht t qeta, ndonse segmente t caktuara kan pasur volatilitet t shtuar. Normat e interesit t kredive dhe t depozitave kan vazhduar t qndrojn pran niveleve minimale historike edhe gjat muajit gusht. Nga ana tjetr, yield-et e letrave me vler t qeveris kan shnuar rritje gjat ankandeve t fundit. Kjo rritje pasqyron nj tendenc korrektuese t rnies s shpejt t tyre gjat gjysms s par t vitit, por edhe zhbalancime t prkohshme t krkess dhe oferts pr kto instrumente. Kreditimi i ekonomis vazhdon t shnoj rritje, por kjo ecuri mbetet ende e brisht. E pastruar nga efektet e fshirjes s kredive nga bilancet e sistemit bankar dhe t luhatjes s kursit t kmbimit, kredia pr ekonomin shnoi nj rritje vjetore prej 4.2% n muajin gusht. Portofoli i kredis n lek shnoi nj rritje vjetore prej 6.9% ndrkoh q portofoli i kredis n valut u rrit me 2.3%. N terma sektoriale, kredia konsumatore ka nj ecuri relative m t mir se kredia pr biznese. Ngadalsimi i ritmit mujor t rritjes s kredis n muajt korrik e gusht pritet t jet nj fenomen kalimtar. Megjithat, ky zhvillim ilustron paqndrueshmrin e kreditimit n vend dhe rithekson nevojn pr vazhdimin e reformave strukturore, t cilat do t mundsonin reduktimin e rrezikut t kredis dhe rritjen e krkess pr t. N baz t informacionit t disponuar, Banka e Shqipris gjykon se tabloja e pritur e zhvillimeve ekonomike e financiare, e paraqitur n raportin tremujor paraardhs, mbetet ende e vlefshme. Ne parashikojm nj prmirsim progresiv t aktivitetit ekonomik gjat dy viteve t ardhshme. Ky prmirsim do t ndihmoj n kthimin e ekonomis n ekuilibr gjat gjysms s dyt t vitit 2017 dhe t inflacionit n objektiv gjat gjysms s dyt t vitit 2018. Njkohsisht, informacioni i disponuar sugjeron se balanca e rreziqeve n horizontin afatmesm vazhdon t qndroj n kahun rns. Duke faktorizuar edhe konsolidimin e pritur fiskal, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlerson se prmbushja e objektivit ton t inflacionit do t krkoj ndjekjen e nj politike monetare stimuluese gjat ksaj periudhe. N prputhje me kto gjykime, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi: - t mbaj t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 1.25%. - t mbaj t pandryshuar normat e interesit t depozits dhe t kredis njditore, respektivisht n nivelin 0.25% dhe 2.25%. Gjithashtu, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlerson se intensiteti i stimulit monetar nuk do t ulet prgjat 2016. N mbyllje, Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjen me vend t theksoj se politikat monetare e fiskale shrbejn dhe jan t mjaftueshme vetm pr kthimin e ekonomis n ekuilibr dhe pr ruajtjen e stabilitetit ekonomik e financiar t vendit. text: 05/08/22, 17:04 On Governor Seyko's meetings during the development of the Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank On Governor Seyko's meetings during the development of the Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank Publication date: 10.10.2016 On 6 - 9 October 2016, the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Sejko, participated in the Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the World Bank Group (BB), which took place in the United States of America. These meetings represent a high-level forum where they come together to discuss  1/5 05/08/22, 17:04 On Governor Seyko's meetings during the development of the Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank These meetings represent a high-level forum where they come together to discuss the latest developments of the world economy, the IMF and BB's top decision-makers, along with governors and finance ministers of member states of these institutions international financial. The main issue that dominated the discussions at these meetings was the further revitalization of the world economy. The Bank of Albania's annual conference on the theme: "Harmonisation of monetary policy with financial stability - objectives, responses and interaction between them in periods of uncertainty" Publication date: 27.10.2016 On October 27, 2016, the Bank of Albania in co-operation with the University of Oxford's Centre for Southeast European Studies held its annual themed conference: ... 1/3 05/08/22, 17:05 The Bank of Albania's annual conference on the theme: "Harmonizing monetary policy with financial stability ... Oxford University's Southeast Europe held its annual themed conference: Harmonisation of monetary policy with financial stability objectives, responses and interaction among them in periods of uncertainty. This conference was organized within the framework of the agreement of the co-operation that the Bank of Albania has with the University of Oxford. During the forum's work, participants were able to discuss extensively the harmonisation of monetary policy followed by central banks and measures taken in the direction of preserving financial stability, as well as the implications and effects of the United Kingdom's exit from the European Union, for the countries of the region. At the end of the forum, The Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Seyko presented to the participants the conclusions of the forum's developments. The future of the European Union remains the main concern for European countries and for our region, for which European integration constitutes a priority. A strong Europe is what is needed, however, fulfilling the banking union and capital market are also needed. Central banks should pay attention to monetary policy, exchange rate policy and financial stability. Particular importance must be devoted to fiscal consolidation and structural reforms. Central banks have continuously made their contribution through new instruments and coordination of macroeconomic policies. Revitalization and economic growth are what everyone expects, but this cannot come without a stable credit. Furthermore, on behalf of the Bank of Albania and the University of Oxford's Southeast European Studies Centre, Governor Seyko thanked the conference participants for their contribution. Kjo konferenc u organizua n kuadr t marrveshjes s bashkpunimit q Banka e Shqipris ka me Universitetin e Oksfordit. Gjat punimeve t forumit, pjesmarrsit patn mundsi t diskutojn gjersisht pr harmonizimin e politiks monetare t ndjekur nga bankat qendrore dhe masat e marra n drejtim t ruajtjes s stabilitetit financiar si dhe implikimet dhe efektet e daljes s Mbretris s Bashkuar nga Bashkimi Evropian, pr vendet e rajonit. N prfundim t forumit, Guvernatori i Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko prezantoi pr pjesmarrsit konkluzionet e zhvillimeve t forumit. E ardhmja e Bashkimit Evropian mbetet shqetsimi kryesor pr vendet evropiane dhe pr rajonin ton, pr t cilin integrimi evropian prbn nj prioritet. Nj Evrop e fort sht ajo q nevojitet, megjithat plotsimi i bashkimit (unionit) bankar dhe tregut t kapitalit jan gjithashtu t nevojshm. Bankat qendrore duhet ti kushtojn vmendje politiks monetare, politiks s kursit t kmbimit dhe stabilitetit financiar. Nj rndsi e veant duhet ti kushtohet konsolidimit fiskal dhe reformave strukturore. Bankat qendrore kan dhn n vazhdimsi kontributin e tyre t nprmjet instrumenteve t reja dhe koordinimit t politikave makroekonomike. Rigjallrimi dhe rritja ekonomike jan ato q gjithkush pret, por kjo nuk mund t vij pa nj kreditim t qndrueshm. M tej, n emr t Banks s Shqipris dhe Qendrs s Studimeve t Evrops Juglindore t Universitetit t Oksfordit, Guvernatori Sejko falnderoi pjesmarrsit e konferencs pr kontributin e tyre. Boaz Rodkin, today on October 28, 2016. Bilateral discussions initially stopped in the very good relations that exist between the two countries. Governor Sejko, in his exhibition, introduced financial developments in the country, where he underlined that the Albanian banking system is capitalized, secular and financially healthy. He said the institution he heads will continue to be committed to fulfilling its mission, sustaining consumer prices and the country's financial stability.  jko_me_Ambasadorin_e_Izraelit_ne_Shqiperi_SH_T_Z_Boaz_Rodkin.html Page 1 of 2 On the meeting of governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko with Israel's Ambassador to Albania, US Mr Boaz Rodkin 29/07/22, 14:41 Halting the country's economic performance, Governor Seyko stressed that recent developments show that the external macroeconomic environment remains challenging, but monetary authority will make all the right contribution to support efforts for sustainable economic growth. The Bank of Albania has followed and will continue to pursue a easing monetary policy in the following period, under conditions when fiscal policy is following a consolidating trajectory. During the meeting, structural reforms recently undertaken by the government were discussed in the direction of formalizing the economy. Israel's ambassador praised the work done by the Bank of Albania, in the direction of preserving and ensuring the country's financial system and macroeconomic stability, and called Albania a safe place for Israeli investors. Furthermore, U.S. Ambassador Boaz Rodkin introduced Israel's economic panorama and development models. Particular attention was paid to the potential prospects within the framework of economic co-operation, mainly in the area of the financial system between the two countries. text: Questions - answers of the press conference dated November 9, 2016 29/07/22, 14:40 Questions - answers of the press conference dated November 9, 2016 Publication date: 09.11.2016 Question - At the end of February, the agreement with the IMF is revised. It is thought that this agreement will be passed at advisory levels, do you think it is the right time to move on to these levels and is this in support of the Bank's policies, and for inflation? Governor - The three-year agreement with the International Monetary Fund ends in February next year. This agreement has given its positive effects. In this framework, a series of structural reforms have been undertaken in both the economy and the financial sector, which have resulted in success. As a result of this agreement, as well as the measures taken and structural reforms we have moved towards fiscal consolidation. Practically, the agreement is the prerogative right of the Albanian government. It is to be seen after next year's elections how it will coincide with the continuation of the agreement. So we'll have a fuller judgment on the type of deal after next year's election. Normally, before the agreement is complete, there is also a next discussion, which will be in January, where the International Monetary Fund will make the pwrditwsue assessment of the Albanian economy's data and we will have fuller judgment. We judge and believe, based on the figures, that this was a successful agreement. How the agreement will continue will be seen after the elections, as it is the right of the Albanian government. We have proven that we are capable of carrying out reforms to the economy and financial system, both on the part of the Albanian government and on the part of the Bank of Albania. These reforms have been successful and successful, and if we continue with it ... thirst-pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_9_nentor_2016.html Page 1 of 2 Questions - answers of the press conference dated November 9, 2016 29/07/22, 14:40 the same trend of carrying out reforms, the premises will be positive for the development of the Albanian economy. Question - Today at the conference of assembly speakers passed next year's draft budget, has the Bank of Albania been recognized with the draft and are budget parameters met to increase investments and increase consumption? The Governor - Bank of Albania has been part of discussions with the Ministry of Finance and the International Monetary Fund during the preparations of the 2017 draft budget, but we do not have a final variant of it in fact. You have already been familiar with some of the main elements of this draft budget both in terms of wage growth and pensions, stated at the press conference of the Minister of Finance and representatives of the International Monetary Fund. This draft budget is generally a draft budget that continues to aim for fiscal consolidation. This is also what we as the Bank of Albania have had in mind: the draft budget must continue to ensure a fiscal consolidation, i.e. a reduction in the level of public debt. And as far as we've seen so far, the budget achieves this goal. Of course, as we have pointed out at the previous press conference, raising wages and pensions would be a positive element that would affect consumption and investment growth, so it would have a positive impact on the country's economy. Combining these two elements, i.e. maintaining lower public debt levels through fiscal consolidation and increasing consumption and investment, we would judge it as positive. If the 2017 draft budget is to preserve these balances and achieve these objectives, then it would certainly be an acceptable draft budget for the Bank of Albania. Mendohet q kjo marrveshje t kalohet n nivele kshilluese, a mendoni se sht momenti i duhur pr t kaluar n kto nivele dhe a sht kjo n mbshtetje t politikave t Banks, dhe pr inflacionin? Guvernatori - Marrveshja trevjeare me Fondin Monetar Ndrkombtar prfundon n shkurt t vitit t ardhshm. Kjo marrveshje i ka dhn efektet e saj pozitive. N kt kuadr, jan ndrmarr nj sr reformash strukturore si n ekonomi po ashtu edhe n sektorin financiar, t cilat kan rezultuar t suksesshme. Si rezultat i ksaj marrveshjeje, si dhe i masave t marra dhe reformave strukturore ne kemi ecur drejt nj konsolidimi fiskal. Praktikisht, marrveshja sht e drejta prerogative e qeveris shqiptare. sht pr tu par konkretisht pas zgjedhjeve t vitit t ardhshm sesi do t konkludohet me vazhdimin e marrveshjes. Pra, ne do t kemi nj gjykim m t plot pr tipin e marrveshjes pas zgjedhjeve t vitit t ardhshm. Normalisht, prpara prfundimit t marrveshjes ka dhe nj diskutim t radhs, i cili do t jet n muajin janar,ku Fondi Monetar Ndrkombtar do t bj vlersimin e pwrditwsuar t t dhnave t ekonomis shqiptare dhe ne do t kemi gjykim m t plot. Ne gjykojm dhe besojm, bazuar dhe n shifrat, se kjo ishte nj marrveshje e suksesshme. Sesi do t jet vazhdimi i marrveshjes kjo do t shihet pas zgjedhjeve, pasi sht e drejt e qeveris shqiptare. Ne kemi provuar se jemi t aft pr t kryer reforma n ekonomi dhe sistemin financiar, si nga ana e qeveris shqiptare ashtu edhe nga ana e Banks s Shqipris. Pyetje - Sot n konferencn e kryetarve t kuvendit kaloi projektbuxheti i vitit t ardhshm, a sht njohur Banka e Shqipris me draftin dhe a plotsohen parametrat e buxhetit a shtohen investimet a rritet konsumi? Guvernatori - Banka e Shqipris ka qen pjes e diskutimeve me Ministrin e Financave dhe Fondin Monetar Ndrkombtar gjat prgatitjeve t projektbuxhetit 2017, por ne nuk kemi nj variant final t tij n fakt. Ju tashm jeni njohur me disa nga elementt kryesor t ktij projektbuxheti si lidhur me rritjen e pagave ashtu edhe me pensionet, deklaruar edhe n konferencn pr shtyp t Ministrit t Financave dhe prfaqsuesve t Fondit Monetar Ndrkombtar. Ky projektbuxhet sht n prgjithsi nj projektbuxhet i cili vazhdon t synoj konsolidimin fiskal. Kjo sht edhe ajo q ne si Bank e Shqipris kemi pasur n vmendje: projektbuxheti duhet t vazhdoj t siguroj nj konsolidim fiskal, pra nj ulje t nivelit t borxhit publik. Dhe pr sa kemi par deri tani projektbuxheti e arrin kt objektiv. Sigurisht, si e kemi theksuar edhe n konferencn e mparshme pr shtyp rritja e pagave dhe pensioneve do t ishte nj element pozitiv q do t ndikonte n rritjen e konsumit dhe t investimeve, pra do t kishte nj ndikim pozitiv n ekonomin e vendit. Kombinimin e ktyre dy elementve, pra ruajtjen e uljes s nivelit t borxhit publik nprmjet konsolidimit fiskal dhe rritjen e konsumit dhe t investimeve, ne do ta gjykonim si pozitiv. N rast se projektbuxheti i vitit 2017 do t ruaj kto ekuilibra dhe do t arrij kto objektiva, ather sigurisht q do t ishte nj projektbuxhet i pranueshm edhe pr Bankn e Shqipris. Title: Speech, at the hearing of the Parliamentary Committee on Economy and Finance on the draft budget 2017
text: , Mr Gent Seyko in confection... bank of Albania Supervisory Council, November 9, 2016 29/07/22, 14:40 , Mr. Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making of Bank of Albania Supervisory Council, November 9, 2016 Publication date: 09.11.2016 The Albanian economy has continued to show signs of improvement over the past two quarters. Economic activity has marked progressive growth, inflation is gradually moving towards the target, while financial markets remain calm and financing costs in them are near historic minimums. These tendencies reflect the effects of monetary stimulus policy followed by the Bank of Albania, improving confidence in the economy and calming blows from the foreign environment. The new information received in the analysis in this report has generally been in line with our expectations. Also, updating medium-term forecasts has not changed the expected trajectories of economic growth and inflation. Under these circumstances, the Supervisory Council assesses that the current monetary policy position is appropriate for meeting our objective.  te_Keshillit_Mbikeqyres_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_9_nentor_2016.html Page 1 of 4 , Mr Gent Seyko in confection... bank of Albania Supervisory Council, November 9, 2016 29/07/22, 14:40 Average third-quarter inflation resulted in a 1.9% level, marking increases versus low values recorded in the two previous quarters. Inflation dropped to a 1.5% level in October. Rising inflation during the third quarter and its fall in October were influenced by fluctuations in food and oil inflation. Rising inflation during the second half of the year reflects strengthening inflationary pressures from domestic demand and easing foreign disinflationary pressures. Expanding economic activity in the country has brought employment growth and lower unemployment. The gradual movement of the economy towards balance creates premise for wage and production costs increases on the medium-term horizon. These tendencies are reflected in the increase in basic inflation. As expected, the effect of foreign shocks on inflation and disinflationary pressures imported from abroad have eased. These factors have influenced and are expected to continue to support the rising inflation trend on the medium-term horizon. According to INSTAT data, economic activity marked annual growth of 3.2% in the second quarter of the year. Available data suggest third and fourth quarter economic growth will remain at comparable levels. Seen from a sectoral perspective, economic growth reflected the expansion of service sector activity, mainly as a result of a good tourist season. Meanwhile, the manufacturing sector, which summarizes the activities of industry, construction and agriculture branches, was at almost the same levels as a year ago. Seen from an aggregate demand perspective, economic growth was supported by strengthening domestic demand, in response to improving family consumption, while foreign trade activity made an increased negative contribution. Consumption and private investment have carried the main weight in economic growth. Their expansion is supported by improved confidence, increased employment and higher exploitation of production capacities, as well as through flows  te_Keshillit_Mbikeqyres_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_9_nentor_2016.html Page 2 of 4 , Mr Gent Seyko in confection... bank of Albania Supervisory Council, November 9, 2016 29/07/22, 14:40 foreign direct investment intrusions. In parallel with them, easing monetary policy has created favourable conditions for consumer stimulation and investment financing. On the other hand, the expansion of domestic demand has been associated with the rapid increase in imports. As a result of unfavourable conunctures for our products in international markets, this increase has not been offset by the simultaneous expansion of exports, although revenues from tourism activity have resulted in growth. Under these circumstances, foreign trade activity has contributed negatively to second-quarter economic growth. Finally, fiscal policy continues to have a consolidating course, which has also generated a budget sufficiency of about 10.6 billion dollars by the month of September. The realisation of public spending according to the spaces allowed by the 2016 budget deficit plan suggests that the restraining impact of fiscal consolidation on economic growth will be lower in the last quarter. However, the Bank of Albania considers that a more simultaneous distribution of borrowing and deficit in the future would help to increase the effectiveness of public finances and to mitigate the economic and financial fluctuations generated by them. The update to medium-term forecasts has confirmed our previous expectations. According to the Bank of Albania's forecast, the country's economic activity will come to an increase during this period and the Albanian economy will return to balance during 2017. Economic growth will be driven by consumption and private investment, while foreign trade activity is forecast to play an increasing secondary role and fiscal policy is expected to remain in the consolidating direction. The return of the economy to balance and stabilise the external environment will create conditions for a progressive rise in inflation in the medium term. Annual inflation is expected to mark value 2.3% after four quarters and return to target during 2018. By factoring and the expected consolidating direction of fiscal policy, these forecasts are conditional and consistent with pursuing a easing monetary policy over this time horizon. Our monetary incentives, transmitted through lowering the basic interest rate, continued liquidity injections and market orientation on the future of monetary policy, have been conveyed in significantly lowering financing costs in financial markets. Loan interest rates in money are at historical minimum levels, favouring the steady growth of the loan portfolio in money. Excluding the effect of extracting lost loans from banks' balance sheets, annual loan growth in money at the end of September was around 8.2% level, bearing the main weight in the growth of the total loan portfolio. The total loan to the private sector recorded annual growth of 3.3% at the end of September. In parallel with it, low interest rate levels ease existing debt service costs, help improve real sector balances and favour further growth in consumption and investment.  te_Keshillit_Mbikeqyres_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_9_nentor_2016.html Page 3 of 4 , Mr Gent Seyko in confection... bank of Albania Supervisory Council, November 9, 2016 29/07/22, 14:40 Low interest rate levels, as well as a secular and well-capitalized banking system, are positive premise for credit growth and financing the country's economic growth. However, banks' lending policies still remain conservative, as a result of tightening supervisory and regulatory rates at European level, but also as a result of the still high perception of credit risk in the country. For this reason, the Bank of Albania assesses the measures taken so far and considers that the full and timely implementation of the interinstitutional plan for reducing troubled loans will be a major help to improve the financial environment in the country. Together with implementing other dimensions of structural reform, these measures will help meet our medium-term goals and further expand the country's potential. *** Judging on the above analysis and forecasts, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current monetary policy position is appropriate for meeting our inflation target. Under these circumstances, the Supervisory Council decided: Keep the basic interest rate unchanged at 1.25%; Keep deposit and one-day loan interest rates unchanged, at 0.25% and 2.25% respectively. Also, judging on the information available, on the expected developments and risks around them, the Supervisory Council estimates that the intensity of monetary stimulus will not decrease before the second six months of 2017.  te_Keshillit_Mbikeqyres_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_9_nentor_2016.html Page 4 of 4
