Gent Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp t vendimmarrjes s politiks monetare t Kshillit Mbikqyrs t Banks s Shqipris, 9 nntor 2016 Data e publikimit: 09.11.2016 Ekonomia shqiptare ka vazhduar t shfaq shenja prmirsimi gjat dy tremujorve t fundit. Aktiviteti ekonomik ka shnuar rritje progresive, inflacioni po lviz gradualisht drejt objektivit, ndrsa tregjet financiare mbeten t qeta dhe kostot e financimit n to jan pran minimumeve historike. Kto tendenca reflektojn efektet e politiks monetare stimuluese t ndjekur nga Banka e Shqipris, prmirsimin e besimit n ekonomi dhe qetsimin e goditjeve nga ambienti i huaj. Informacioni i ri i marr n analiz n kt raport ka qen prgjithsisht n prputhje me pritjet tona. Gjithashtu, prditsimi i parashikimeve afatmesme nuk ka ndryshuar trajektoret e pritura t rritjes ekonomike dhe t inflacionit. N kto rrethana, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlerson se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare sht i prshtatshm pr prmbushjen e objektivit ton. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjate_Keshillit_Mbikeqyres_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_9_nentor_2016.html Pagina 1 di 4 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko n konfetare t Kshillit Mbikqyrs t Banks s Shqipris, 9 nntor 2016 29/07/22, 14:40 Inflacioni mesatar i tremujorit t tret rezultoi n nivelin 1.9%, duke shnuar rritje kundrejt vlerave t ulta t regjistruara n dy tremujort paraardhs. Inflacioni zbriti n nivelin 1.5% n muajin tetor. Rritja e inflacionit gjat tremujorit t tret dhe rnia e tij n muajin tetor u ndikuan nga luhatjet e inflacionit t ushqimeve dhe t nafts. Rritja e inflacionit gjat gjysms s dyt t vitit pasqyron forcimin e presioneve inflacioniste nga krkesa e brendshme dhe zbutjen e presioneve t huaja dezinflacioniste. Zgjerimi i aktivitetit ekonomik n vend ka sjell rritje t punsimit e ulje t papunsis. Lvizja graduale e ekonomis drejt ekuilibrit krijon premisa pr rritje t pagave dhe t kostove t prodhimit n horizontin afatmesm. Kto tendenca jan reflektuar n rritjen e inflacionit baz. Ashtu dhe sikundr pritej, efekti i goditjeve t huaja n inflacion dhe presionet dezinflacioniste t importuara nga jasht jan zbutur. Kta faktor kan ndikuar dhe pritet t vazhdojn t mbshtesin trendin rrits t inflacionit n horizontin afatmesm. Sipas t dhnave t INSTAT-it, aktiviteti ekonomik shnoi rritje vjetore prej 3.2% n tremujorin e dyt t vitit. T dhnat e disponuara sugjerojn se rritja ekonomike e tremujorit t tret e t katrt do t mbetet n nivele t krahasueshme. E par nga kndvshtrimi sektorial, rritja ekonomike pasqyroi zgjerimin e aktivitetit t sektorit t shrbimeve, i ardhur kryesisht si pasoj e nj sezoni t mir turistik. Ndrkoh, sektori prodhues i cili prmbledh aktivitetet e degve t industris, t ndrtimit dhe t bujqsis ishte pothuaj n nivele t njjta me nj vit m par. E par nga kndvshtrimi i krkess agregate, rritja ekonomike u mbshtet nga forcimi i krkess s brendshme, n prgjigje edhe t prmirsimit t konsumit familjar, ndrkoh q aktiviteti tregtar me jasht dha nj kontribut negativ n rritje. Konsumi dhe investimet private kan mbajtur peshn kryesore n rritjen ekonomike. Zgjerimi i tyre sht mbshtetur nga prmirsimi i besimit, nga rritja e punsimit dhe shfrytzimi m i lart i kapaciteteve prodhuese, si dhe nga flukset https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjate_Keshillit_Mbikeqyres_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_9_nentor_2016.html Pagina 2 di 4 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko n konfetare t Kshillit Mbikqyrs t Banks s Shqipris, 9 nntor 2016 29/07/22, 14:40 hyrse t investimeve t huaja direkte. Paralelisht me to, politika monetare lehtsuese ka krijuar kushte favorizuese pr stimulimin e konsumit dhe pr financimin e investimeve. Nga ana tjetr, zgjerimi i krkess s brendshme sht shoqruar me rritjen e shpejt t importeve. Si pasoj e koniunkturave t pafavorshme pr produktet tona n tregjet ndrkombtare, kjo rritje nuk sht kompensuar nga zgjerimi i njkohshm i eksporteve, ndonse t ardhurat nga aktiviteti i turizmit kan rezultuar n rritje. N kto rrethana, aktiviteti tregtar me jasht ka kontribuar negativisht n rritjen ekonomike t tremujorit t dyt. S fundi, politika fiskale vazhdon t ket nj kurs konsolidues, ka ka prodhuar dhe nj suficit buxhetor prej rreth 10.6 miliard leksh deri n muajin shtator. Realizimi i shpenzimeve publike sipas hapsirave t lejuara nga plani i deficitit buxhetor pr vitin 2016 sugjeron se ndikimi frenues i konsolidimit fiskal n rritjen ekonomike do t jet m i ult n tremujorin e fundit. Megjithat, Banka e Shqipris gjykon se nj shprndarje m e njtrajtshme e huamarrjes dhe deficitit n t ardhmen do t ndihmonin n rritjen e efektivitetit t financave publike dhe n zbutjen e luhatjeve ekonomike e financiare t gjeneruara prej tyre. Prditsimi i parashikimeve afatmesme ka konfirmuar pritjet tona t mparshme. Sipas parashikimit t Banks s Shqipris, aktiviteti ekonomik i vendit do t vij n rritje gjat ksaj periudhe dhe ekonomia shqiptare do t rikthehet n ekuilibr gjat vitit 2017. Rritja ekonomike do t udhhiqet nga konsumi dhe investimet private, ndrkoh q aktiviteti tregtar me jasht parashikohet t luaj nj rol dytsor n rritje dhe politika fiskale pritet t mbetet n kahun konsolidues. Kthimi i ekonomis n ekuilibr dhe stabilizimi i ambientit t jashtm do t krijojn kushte pr nj rritje progresive t inflacionit n afatin e mesm. Inflacioni vjetor pritet t shnoj vlern 2.3% pas katr tremujorsh dhe t kthehet n objektiv gjat vitit 2018. Duke faktorizuar dhe kahun e pritur konsolidues t politiks fiskale, kto parashikime jan t kushtzuara dhe konsistente me ndjekjen e nj politike monetare lehtsuese gjat ktij horizonti kohor. Stimujt tan monetar, t transmetuar nprmjet uljes s norms baz t interesit, injektimeve t vazhdueshme t likuiditetit dhe orientimit t tregut mbi t ardhmen e politiks monetare, jan prcjell n uljen e ndjeshme t kostove t financimit n tregjet financiare. Normat e interesit t kredis n lek jan n nivele minimale historike, duke favorizuar rritjen e qndrueshme t portofolit t kredis n lek. Duke prjashtuar efektin e nxjerrjes s kredive t humbura nga bilancet e bankave, rritja vjetore e kredis n lek n fund t muajit shtator ishte rreth nivelit 8.2%, duke mbajtur peshn kryesore n rritjen e portofolit total t kredis. Kredia totale pr sektorin privat regjistroi rritje vjetore prej 3.3% n fund t muajit shtator. Paralelisht me t, nivelet e ulta t normave t interesit lehtsojn kostot e shrbimit t borxhit ekzistues, ndihmojn n prmirsimin e bilanceve t sektorit real dhe favorizojn rritjen e mtejshme t konsumit e investimeve. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjate_Keshillit_Mbikeqyres_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_9_nentor_2016.html Pagina 3 di 4 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko n konfetare t Kshillit Mbikqyrs t Banks s Shqipris, 9 nntor 2016 29/07/22, 14:40 Nivelet e ulta t normave t interesit, si dhe nj sistem bankar likuid dhe i mirkapitalizuar, jan premisa pozitive pr rritjen e kredis dhe pr financimin e rritjes ekonomike t vendit. Megjithat, politikat kredituese t bankave mbeten ende konservatore, si pasoj e shtrngimit t normave mbikqyrse e rregullatore n nivel evropian, por edhe si pasoj e perceptimit ende t lart t rrezikut t kredis n vend. Pr kt arsye, Banka e Shqipris vlerson masat e deritanishme t marra dhe gjykon se zbatimi i plot dhe n koh i planit ndrinstitucional pr reduktimin e kredive me probleme do t jet nj ndihm e madhe pr prmirsimin e ambientit financiar n vend. S bashku me zbatimin e dimensioneve t tjera t reforms strukturore, kto masa do t ndihmojn n plotsimin e objektivave tan afatmesm dhe n zgjerimin e mtejshm t potencialit t vendit. *** Duke gjykuar mbi analizn dhe parashikimet e msiprme, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare sht i prshtatshm pr prmbushjen e objektivit ton t inflacionit. N kto rrethana, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi: T mbaj t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 1.25%; T mbaj t pandryshuar normat e interesit t depozits dhe kredis njditore, respektivisht n nivelin 0.25% dhe 2.25%. Gjithashtu, duke gjykuar mbi informacionin e disponuar, mbi zhvillimet e pritura dhe rreziqet rreth tyre, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlerson se intensiteti i stimulit monetar nuk do t ulet prpara gjashtmujorit t dyt t vitit 2017. Title: On the 10th Economic Research Workshop in Southeast Europe, on "Involving shocks in monetary policy and financial stability decision-making"
text: Bank of Albania Governor Gent Seyko meets Romania's Ambassador to Albania, Sh.T.Z. Mircea Perpelea 29/07/22, 14:40 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Seyko meets Romania's Ambassador to Albania, Sh.T.Z. Mircea Perpelea Publication date: 25.11.2016 Governor Gent Sejko hosted today at an official meeting at the Bank of Albania, Romania's Ambassador to our country, U.T.Z. Mircea Perpelea. During the meeting, Governor Seyko introduced the developments of the banking system in the country, where he underlined that this system appears with quite good financial indicators. The governor said that the institution he heads has pursued a easing monetary policy, supporting fiscal consolidation policy, within the framework of the country's stable and long-term growth. Also, Governor Gent Sejko recognized Ambassador Perpelea with the latest developments in the economy and contribution from the Bank of Albania to stimulate economic activity in the country, where he stressed that the country's economic growth is on a positive development trajectory. Economic growth is expected to improve and key economic balances will strengthen over the coming years.  n_Ambasadorin_e_Rumanise_ne_Shqiperi_Sh_T_Z_Mircea_Perpelea.html Page 1 of 2 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Seyko meets Romania's Ambassador to Albania, Sh.T.Z. Mircea Perpelea 29/07/22, 14:40 Ambassador Perpelea, after thanking Governor Sejko for the hospitality, stressed his country's commitment as a member state of the European Union to provide all necessary assistance within the framework of Albania's European integration process. Also, Romania's Ambassador expressed the importance of co-operation between the two countries' central banks and offered the expertise of the National Bank of Romania in various areas of central banking. Furthermore, Sh.T.Z. Perpelea, even as a former employee of the National Bank of Romania, praised the work done by the Bank of Albania in the direction of preserving and ensuring the financial system in the country, price stability and currency sustainability. In this context, Ambassador Perpelea stressed the similarity of the sustainability of Romania's currency, as did the local lek currency to the fluctuations of international financial markets. Romania's ambassador stressed the importance in implementing economic, structural and sectoral reforms, and praised albania's progress in recent years. These reforms will positively influence the creation of an attitudinal environment for foreign investors. In the end, the co-workers shared the same view on the prospects for further growth in economic co-operation between the two countries and mainly in the field of the financial system, as well as in the growth of foreign investment in Albania.  n_Ambasadorin_e_Rumanise_ne_Shqiperi_Sh_T_Z_Mircea_Perpelea.html Page 2 of 2

Guvernatori u shpreh se institucioni q ai drejton, ka ndjekur nj politik monetare lehtsuese, duke mbshtetur politikn e konsolidimit fiskal, n kuadr t rritjes s qndrueshme dhe afatgjat t vendit. N kt kuadr, Ambasadori Perpelea theksoi ngjashmrin e qndrueshmris s monedhs s Rumanis leu ashtu si monedha vendase lek ndaj luhatjeve t tregjeve financiare ndrkombtare. Ambasadori i Rumanis theksoi rndsin n drejtim t zbatimit t reformave ekonomike, strukturore e sektoriale, dhe vlersoi progresin e br nga Shqipria vitet e fundit. Kto reforma do t ndikojn pozitivisht n krijimin e nj ambienti atraktiv pr investitort e huaj. N prfundim, bashkbiseduesit ndan t njjtin mendim mbi perspektivat pr rritjen e mtejshme t bashkpunimit ekonomik midis dy vendeve dhe kryesisht n fushn e sistemit financiar, si dhe n rritjen e investimeve t huaja n Shqipri. Bank of Albania Governor Mr Gent Seyko attends the official ceremony organised on the occasion of the 100th anniversary of the Proclamation Autonomous Province of Korca Publication date: 10.12.2016 Within the framework of the organisations on the occasion of the 100th anniversary of the proclamation of the Autonomous Province of Korca by the District of Korca, the Bank of Albania organized a special exhibition at the National Museum of Education in Korca.  1/3 05/08/22, 17:05 Bank of Albania Guvchernatori Mr Gent Seyko attends the official ceremony organised on the occasion of the 100th anniversary of ... 2016 coincides with a historic date, that of the proclamation of the Autonomous Province of Korca on 10 December 1916, which, although short in time, was a positive factor for keeping alive the formal relevance of the Albanian state and its re-establishment. Albanian, the national flag and self-rule by the albanians remain the three main pillars of this region's activity. This event is also reflected in the collection of banknotes of the Province of Korca, which the Bank of Albania Museum presented to the National Museum of Education in Korca through an exhibition, in which the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Sejko, participated. Through this organization, the Bank of Albania aims to unfold the historical and cultural values of the Albanian banknote issued over the years. In this exhibition, the full collection of local banknotes issued by the Autonomous Province of Korca in 1917 and 1918 was presented, accompanied by photographic and graphic illustrations, which reflect the historical, economic and numismatic context of the time. In addition to banknotes, visitors were also able to be recognized with various educational materials of the Bank of Albania, such as brochures, information panels, etc.  2/3 05/08/22, 17:05 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Seyko attends the official ceremony organised on the occasion of the 100th anniversary of ... Guests in this exhibition were also three collectors of numismatics and philately, members of the Association of Collectors of Albania, who enriched the Exhibition of the Bank of Albania with their collections, such as Autonomous Province stamps, banknotes and original postcards of from 1916 to 1920. At the invitation of the organizers, the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Sejko participated in the official ceremony held in homage to the devotee Themistokli Germenji and placed a bouquet of flowers in his monument. Furthermore, The Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Sejko accompanied Mr. Niko Peleshi during the visit to the exhibition of the Bank of Albania, deputy prime minister of the Republic of Albania, Mr. Niko Peleshi; Zj County Mayor. Anna Verushi and The Mayor of Korca, Mr. Sotiraq Filo. During this visit, the presence was presented with the historical context of the formation of the Autonomous Province of Korca, the general economic situation according to the data of the time and Frangu of the Autonomous Province. Governor Seyko donated the series of commemorative coins of the Monastery Congress to the organizers of the activity dedicated to this important event. The Governor of the Bank of Albania was also present at the solemn ceremony organized on the occasion of this anniversary, where he had the pleasure of handing over the commemorative medal "Honor of the District" to mr. Qani Dishnica's descendants. The Bank of Albania thanks the National Museum of Education Korca, collectors of numismatics and philately, as well as all other collaborators for the assistance given in organising this exhibition.  3/3

During his greeting speech, The Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Sejko briefly introduced developments in the world economy, those of our economy, as well as the performance of the banking system along with the challenges it faced during 2016. ... bylles_te_vitit_te_organizuar_nga_Shoqata_Shqiptare_e_Bankave.html Page 1 of 3 The governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Seyko, participates in them... closing year organised by the Albanian Banking Association 29/07/22, 14:40 Governor Sejko said that during 2016, the banking sector has been able to expand its activity, characterized by a satisfactory level of capitalization, healthy financial situations and positive results. ... Low interest rate levels, as well as a secular and well-capitalized banking system, are positive premise for credit growth and financing the country's economic growth. The Bank of Albania considers that the full and timely implementation of the interinstitutional programme for facilitating troubled loans will be a major help to improve the financial environment in the country. - the Governor said. Bank of Albania Governor Gent Sejko noted that the year we are entering will again be challenging as with all the achievements of 2016, the global situation continues to be complex. From this point of view, he singled out the important role of the country's banking system executives as brokers and suppliers of the money economy. Governor Sejko conveyed the message that even during 2017, the Bank of Albania will maintain regular communication with commercial banks, as an essential element that helps identify problems and improves the application of the legal framework for overcoming them. In the end, Governor Gent Sejko congratulated and wished successes to the newly elected Chairman of the Albanian Banking Association, Mr. Periklis Drougkas, Director General of Alpha Bank. At least, according to the government's public statements there will no longer be an agreement under the current format, but there will be a more relaxed agreement. Is the Bank of Albania commenting on this? Governor - As you said, the current agreement with the International Monetary Fund ends in February of the coming year. First, it should be stressed that the agreement has achieved its objectives, and in general economic developments in the country are oriented according to this agreement. Monetary stimulus policy and consolidating fiscal policy have had those results that have been mentioned constantly and have been in line with the agreement. Of course, agreements with the Fund have a definite deadline. I have stressed at other times, even in the Economy and Finance Commission during respective questions, that the future agreement with the International Monetary Fund will be very clear after next year's elections. So, the new government, which will take over after next year's elections, will also have a strategy and project of its own for continuing relations with the International Monetary Fund. This would happen in any other country. Since next year we have the elections, of course the two sides would not look at the connection of an agreement before the elections, i.e. with a quarterly deadline. Despite the agreements we may have with the International Monetary Fund, the authorities in the country and the Bank of Albania are sufficiently strengthened to continue with both agreement and without agreement achieving their objectives. ... Kjo do t ndodhte n do vend tjetr. Duke qen se vitin tjetr ne kemi zgjedhjet, sigurisht q t dy palt nuk do t shikonin me vend lidhjen e nj marrveshjeje para zgjedhjeve, pra me nj afat tremujor. The information analysed in the Quarterly Report confirms our previous assessments of the current situation and the expected developments of the Albanian economy. More specifically: - Available data suggest that economic activity in the country continues to mark growth. The expansion of economic activity has brought improvements in labour market indicators and is reflected in a gradual rise in inflation towards the target. - Our easing monetary policy, reflected in reducing financing costs and lowering risk premiums, remains a crucial factor in this development picture. - Our predictions for the future remain positive. The Bank of Albania expects a strengthening of economic growth over the next two years and the return of inflation to the target within 2018. Based on these estimates, the Supervisory Council confirmed that the current monetary policy position is appropriate and decided to keep the basic interest rate unchanged at 1.25% level. Also, the Council decided to keep deposit and one-day loan interest rates unchanged, at levels 0.25 and 2.25%, respectively. Let me explain in more detail the reasons for this decision-making and its expected effects. Inflation has come in rising over the past few months, marking an annual rate of 2.2% in the month of December. In terms of composition, the increase in inflation during the fourth quarter came as a result of rising food and oil prices. In macroeconomic terms, the increasing trend of inflation during this period reflects the increase in inflationary pressures from the internal environment and the reduction of disinflationary pressures from the foreign environment. According to INSTAT data, the Albanian economy grew by 3.3% during the first nine months of the year and by 3.1% in its third quarter. Economic growth reflected the expansion of consumption and private investment, as well as the increase in tourism revenues. Domestic demand found support from monetary conditions stimulus from improved confidence from employment growth  2/4 05/08/22, 17:05 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... support from monetary stimulus conditions, improved confidence, employment growth, and by expanding foreign direct investment. On the other hand, foreign demand contributed positively on increasing the export of services, but exports of goods continue to show a poor performance, as a result of still low prices of raw materials in international markets. In our judgment, fourth-quarter economic growth will be higher than that of the previous quarter. The economic growth of all of 2016 will be roughly that of the first nine months, and higher than that of 2015. The expansion of aggregate demand has brought increased employment and reduced unemployment. Third-quarter data show an annual increase of 8.5% in employment and a 14.7% drop in the unemployment rate. Economic and financial developments have reflected the combined effect of consolidating fiscal policy and easing monetary policy pursued over the year. The fiscal balance of the first eleven months resulted in a sufficite of 7.1 billion dollars. This result influenced annual growth with 7.3% of revenues and annual declines by 2% in spending. This fiscal policy course has kept the direct contribution of public spending low to aggregate demand, but has created more spaces for the transmission of our monetary policy in financial markets. Our monetary stimulus has created favourable financial conditions, although the exchange rate is overpriced compared to a year ago. The low level of the basic interest rate has contributed to the reduction of interest rates in all financial market products destined for the private sector. In particular, the average loan interest on money in November was 0.6 percentage points lower than a year earlier. On the other hand, the government's valuable letter yields in the primary market have shown growth over the past few months. This performance has partly reflected a correction of their rapid decline in the first part of the year and partly the effects of the fluctuations of the demand-supply ratio. The growing trend is expected to come fading, as long as monetary and fiscal policies remain unchanged. Also, available data suggest that this tendency has not been reflected in the tightening of the credit price for the private sector, failing to distort the way we convey our monetary policy. In response to this policy, as well as in reflection of the revitalization of economic activity, credit for the economy has come to an increase. Excluding the effect of extracting lost loans from the balance sheet, the loan portfolio for the private sector in November was 3.4% higher than a year earlier. In more detail, the 10.4% increase in the domestic currency loan portfolio has offset the 1.4% contraction of the foreign currency loan portfolio. The Bank of Albania expects a further improvement in lending during 2017. These expectations rely on signals for a gradual revival of loan demand, as well as on the positive effects on offer that will bring about the implementation of the plan of measures to reduce troubled loans. Stopping at the latter, data shows that the ratio of troubled loans decreased to 18.2% in the month of December. This reduction reflects the combined effects of improving the economic situation, restructuring loans and extracting lost loans from the balance sheet.  3/4 05/08/22, 17:05 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... The analysis above suggests that economic and financial conditions are appropriate for turning inflation into targets. Economic growth is forecast to strengthen further over the next two years, creating the right premise for returning the economy to balance and inflation on target within 2018. For 2017, the Bank of Albania expects average inflation at 2.3%, versus the 1.3% level scored in 2016. Meeting this scenario requires preserving monetary policy stimulus kah, even during the medium-term period. However, the intensity of monetary stimulus during this period will follow the trend of improving the economy, always being adapted to the needs of preserving macroeconomic balances. Starting from the information available, as well as judging on the balance of risks, which continues to stay in the lower direction, the Supervisory Council considers that the intensity of monetary stimulus will not decrease before the fourth quarter of 2017. Following this monetary policy course is in line with meeting our price stability target. In parallel with it, monetary stimulus policy creates suitable conditions for the implementation of structural reforms. These reforms are needed - among other things - for further expanding the country's productive potential and increasing the economy's resistance to potential shocks.  4/4

Gent Sejko n koj nfejrencn pjr shtyp tj vendimmarrjjes s politiks monetare  t begat, juve dhe t gjith atyre q na ndjekin nprmjet ekranit. Informacioni i analizuar n Raportin Tremujor konfirmon vlersimet tona t mparshme mbi gjendjen aktuale dhe zhvillimet e pritura t ekonomis shqiptare. M konkretisht: - T dhnat e disponuara sugjerojn se aktiviteti ekonomik n vend vazhdon t shnoj rritje. Zgjerimi i aktivitetit ekonomik ka sjell prmirsime n treguesit e tregut t puns dhe sht pasqyruar n nj rritje graduale t inflacionit drejt objektivit. - Politika jon monetare lehtsuese, e pasqyruar n reduktimin e kostove t financimit dhe n uljen e primeve t rrezikut, mbetet nj faktor vendimtar n kt tablo zhvillimi. - Parashikimet tona pr t ardhmen mbeten pozitive. Banka e Shqipris pret nj forcim t rritjes ekonomike gjat dy viteve t ardhshme dhe kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv brenda vitit 2018. Bazuar n kto vlersime, Kshilli Mbikqyrs konstatoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare sht i prshtatshm dhe vendosi t mbaj t pandryshuar normn baz n interesit, n nivelin 1.25%. Gjithashtu, Kshilli vendosi t mbaj t pandryshuar edhe normat e interesit t depozits dhe t kredis njditore, respektivisht n nivelet 0.25 dhe 2.25%. M lejoni t shpjegoj m n detaje arsyet e ksaj vendimmarrjeje dhe efektet e pritura t saj. Inflacioni ka ardhur n rritje gjat muajve t fundit, duke shnuar nj norm vjetore prej 2.2% n muajin dhjetor. N aspektin e kompozimit, rritja e inflacionit gjat tremujorit t katrt erdhi si pasoj e rritjes s mimeve t ushqimeve dhe t nafts. N aspektin makroekonomik, trendi rrits i inflacionit gjat ksaj periudhe reflekton shtimin e presioneve inflacioniste nga mjedisi i brendshm dhe reduktimin e presioneve dezinflacioniste nga mjedisi i huaj. Sipas t dhnave t INSTAT-it, ekonomia shqiptare u rrit me 3.3% gjat nnt muajve t par t vitit dhe me 3.1% n tremujorin e tret t tij. Rritja ekonomike pasqyroi zgjerimin e konsumit dhe t investimeve private, si dhe rritjen e t ardhurave nga turizmi. Krkesa e brendshme gjeti mbshtetje nga kushtet monetare stimuluese nga prmirsimi i besimit nga rritja e punsimit https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_z_Gent_Sejko_ne_konf 2/4 05/08/22, 17:05 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp t vendimmarrjes s politiks monetare  mbshtetje nga kushtet monetare stimuluese, nga prmirsimi i besimit, nga rritja e punsimit, dhe nga zgjerimi i investimeve t huaja direkte. Nga ana tjetr, krkesa e huaj kontribuoi pozitivisht n rritjen e eksportit t shrbimeve, por eksportet e mallrave vazhdojn t shfaqin nj ecuri t dobt, si pasoj e mimeve ende t ulta t lndve t para n tregjet ndrkombtare. N gjykimin ton, rritja ekonomike e tremujorit t katrt do t jet m e lart se ajo e tremujorit paraardhs. Rritja ekonomike e gjith vitit 2016 do t jet e prafrt me at t nntmujorit t par, dhe m e lart se ajo e vitit 2015. Zgjerimi i krkess agregate ka sjell rritjen e punsimit dhe reduktimin e papunsis. T dhnat e tremujorit t tret tregojn nj rritje vjetore me 8.5% t punsimit dhe nj rnie t norms s papunsis n nivelin 14.7%. Zhvillimet ekonomike e financiare kan pasqyruar efektin e kombinuar t politiks fiskale konsoliduese dhe t politiks monetare lehtsuese t ndjekur prgjat vitit. Balanca fiskale e njmbdhjet muajve t par rezultoi me nj suficit prej 7.1 miliard leksh. N kt rezultat ndikuan rritja vjetore me 7.3% e t ardhurave dhe rnia vjetore me 2% e shpenzimeve. Ky kurs i politiks fiskale ka mbajtur t ult kontributin direkt t shpenzimeve publike n krkesn agregate, por ka krijuar m shum hapsira pr transmetimin e politiks son monetare n tregjet financiare. Stimuli yn monetar ka krijuar kushte t favorshme financiare, ndonse kursi i kmbimit paraqitet i mbimuar n raport me nj vit m par. Niveli i ult i norms baz t interesit ka kontribuar n reduktimin e normave t interesit n t gjitha produktet e tregut financiar t destinuara pr sektorin privat. N veanti, interesi mesatar i kredis n lek n muajin nntor ishte 0.6 pik prqindjeje m i ult nga nj vit m par. Nga ana tjetr, yield-et e letrave me vler t qeveris n tregun primar kan shfaqur rritje gjat muajve t fundit. Kjo ecuri ka pasqyruar pjesrisht nj korrektim t rnies s tyre t shpejt n pjesn e par t vitit dhe pjesrisht efektet e luhatjeve t raportit krkes - ofert. Tendenca rritse pritet t vij duke u zbehur, pr sa koh politikat monetare dhe fiskale mbeten t pandryshuara. Gjithashtu, t dhnat e disponuara sugjerojn se kjo tendenc nuk sht pasqyruar n shtrngimin e mimit t kredis pr sektorin privat, duke mos deformuar prcjelljen e politiks son monetare. N prgjigje t ksaj politike, si dhe n reflektim t gjallrimit t aktivitetit ekonomik, kredia pr ekonomin ka ardhur n rritje. Duke prjashtuar efektin e nxjerrjes s kredive t humbura nga bilanci, portofoli i kredis pr sektorin privat n muajin nntor ishte 3.4% m i lart se nj vit m par. M n detaje, rritja me 10.4% e portofolit t kredis n monedhn vendase ka kompensuar tkurrjen me 1.4% t portofolit t kredis n monedh t huaj. Banka e Shqipris pret nj prmirsim t mtejshm t kreditimit gjat vitit 2017. Kto pritje mbshteten n sinjalet pr nj gjallrim gradual t krkess pr kredi, si dhe n efektet pozitive n ofert q do t sjell realizimi i planit t masave pr reduktimin e kredive me probleme. Duke u ndalur te kto t fundit, t dhnat tregojn se raporti i kredive me probleme zbriti n 18.2% n muajin dhjetor. Ky reduktim pasqyron efektet e kombinuara t prmirsimit t situats ekonomike, t ristrukturimit t kredive dhe t nxjerrjes s kredive t humbura nga bilanci. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_z_Gent_Sejko_ne_konf 3/4 05/08/22, 17:05 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Rritja ekonomike parashikohet t forcohet m tej gjat dy viteve t ardhshme, duke krijuar premisat e duhura pr kthimin e ekonomis n ekuilibr dhe t inflacionit n objektiv brenda vitit 2018. Pr vitin 2017, Banka e Shqipris pret nj inflacion mesatar n nivelin 2.3%, kundrejt nivelit 1.3% t shnuar n vitin 2016. Prmbushja e ktij skenari krkon ruajtjen e kahut stimulues t politiks monetare, edhe gjat periudhs afatmesme. Megjithat, intensiteti i stimulit monetar gjat ksaj periudhe do t ndjek trendin e prmirsimit t ekonomis, duke qen gjithnj i prshtatur me nevojat e ruajtjes s ekuilibrave makroekonomik. Duke u nisur nga informacioni i disponuar, si dhe duke gjykuar mbi balancn e rreziqeve, e cila vazhdon t qndroj n kahun e poshtm, Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjykon se intensiteti i stimulit monetar nuk do t ulet prpara tremujorit t katrt t vitit 2017. Ndjekja e ktij kursi t politiks monetare sht n prputhje me prmbushjen e objektivit ton t stabilitetit t mimeve. Paralelisht me t, politika monetare stimuluese krijon kushte t prshtatshme edhe pr zbatimin e reformave strukturore. Kto reforma jan t nevojshme - ndr t tjera - pr zgjerimin e mtejshm t potencialit prodhues t vendit dhe pr rritjen e rezistencs s ekonomis ndaj goditjeve t mundshme. Copyright  2018 Banka e Shqipris. Title: Speech at the press conference of the monetary policy decision-making of the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania.
text: , Mr. Gent Seyko in conferences... Albania's 2016 and its priorities for 2017, 29/07/22, 14:40 , Mr. Gent Sejko at the press conference for analysis of the work of the Bank of Albania for 2016 and its priorities for 2017, Publication date: 21.12.2016 Honored media representatives, Since this press conference is also the last for 2016, I would like to briefly meet you and the entire Albanian public, with some of the main moments of the bank of Albania's work during the year we are closing. Decision-making activity The activities of the Supervisory Council for 2016 are exercised in accordance with the powers stipulated in the Law for the Bank of Albania and in sublegal acts. During 2016, the Supervisory Council held 15 regular meetings. Eight of these meetings are dedicated to monetary policy decision-making, divided into four quarterly meetings and four monthly intermediate meetings. Four other meetings have focused on issues of banking supervision and financial stability, while the rest is dedicated to decision-making on specific issues, important for the institution's work. Page 1 of 5 , Mr. Gent Seyko in conferences... Albania's 2016 and its priorities for 2017, 29/07/22, 14:40 The Supervisory Council has adopted 130 decisions, regulations and guidelines with general implementation, of which 78 acts adopted for the first time and 52 changes or supplements of existing acts. Among the decisions made we would single out: a) Adoption, for the first time, of the Policy for Operational Risk Management at the institution level and the creation of the Unit for Operational Risk Management. b) The establishment and functioning of specialised committees and entities, which enable the improvement of management and control of the Bank's financial values and physical assets. Also, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania has fulfilled on time and transparency the legal obligation to account in the Assembly of Albania, while its Chairman, Governor of the Bank of Albania, has participated in hearings on specific issues required by the Parliamentary Commissions. A particular importance in his work has been devoted to the reports of the External Auditor, the Inspector General, as well as the High State Control. In all cases, these reports have been reviewed by the Audit Committee, which has made the Supervisory Council aware of the recommendations left and the status of their realization. Monetary policy during 2016 Briefly, I would like to underline once again that the Albanian economy, despite the challenging situation in key partners, has shown clear signs of improvement throughout 2016. Undoubtedly, our monetary stimulus policy has played a major role in this direction. Our interventions through the reduction of the basic interest rate, the supply of the financial market with liquidity, or the orientation of expectations for the future have been at the right time and intensity. They served to calm pressures in markets Page 2 of 5 , Mr. Gent Seyko in conferences... Albania's 2016 and its priorities for 2017, 29/07/22, 14:40 financial, enabled the reduction of financing costs to historical minimum levels, contributed to the acceleration of the revitalization of economic activity, as well as influenced the return of the inflation trajectory to the intended direction. In this way, the Bank of Albania estimates that monetary policy, ideated and implemented by it, has made a substantial contribution to supporting the country's sustainable and long-term development. The banking sector and its stability During 2016, the banking sector has continued to expand its activity, while its liquidity and capitalisation indicators remain at high levels and the financial result presents positive. Here I would like to stress that, thanks to the consistent implementation of the plan of measures to reduce troubled loans, the level of troubled loans presents itself controlled and the coverage of credit risk through procurement is considered satisfactory. To a large extent, this performance reflects our careful work towards bank supervision. In parallel with it, the Bank of Albania has further improved the legal and regulatory framework. Let me identify some of the main directions of our work in this area during 2016. Interinstitutional plan to reduce troubled loans The interinstitutional plan, ideated since 2015, took full shape in the year we are closing. First, through the Supervisory Council's approval of regulatory changes, there is already greater clarity on the criteria and procedures for extracting lost loans from banks' balance sheets, as well as the treatment of real estate taken into ownership. Also, these regulatory changes facilitate the creation of a functional market for troubled loans, as well as faster evidence of information in the Credit Register. Second, the adoption on the part of the Assembly of Albania of the legal package, which was linked, among other things, to bankruptcy and the final processes, also fulfilled the second and most important column of this plan. The Bank of Albania estimates that the effects of legal changes, experience gained by banks, the extraction of lost loans off bank balance sheets, as well as further revitalization of the economy, will create incentives for a gradual and stable reduction in the level of troubled loans during 2017. Bill for recovery and extraordinary intervention in banks in the Republic of Albania This bill aims to protect the public's interest in the case of a stressed financial sector situation, avoiding the use of taxpayers' money. This is achieved through structural, mandatory and preliminary changes, as well as Page 3 of 5 , Mr. Gent Seyko in conferences... Albania's 2016 and its priorities for 2017, 29/07/22, 14:40 the creation of a fund with contributions from financial institutions themselves, with the only purpose: to cover financing needs in the event of a crisis. I would like to stress that this is a preventive measure, which further strengthens security networks in Albania. The Law on Savings-Credit Societies and Their Unions In an attempt to more properly regulate savings-credit societies, during 2016 it became possible to adopt the new Law Assembly for their savings societies and unions. The new law brings a complete adjustment of the activity of a savings-credit society, ranging from the moment of establishment and licensing, to the moment of distribution of its electricity. In accordance with the law, the Bank of Albania reviewed in its entirety the sublegal acts that regulated the functioning of the savings-credit societies and their Unions. Other activities We have also devoted special importance to the financial and material management of the institution. For the first time, in March 2016, we enabled the preparation and adoption of financial mirrors of the Bank of Albania in accordance with International Financial Reporting Standards. Over the past year, we have been moving to support and promote the use of electronic payment instruments. Within the framework of the functioning of the National Payment System Committee and co-operation with the World Bank, projects have been undertaken in the field of payments, which aim to promote the use of modern instruments and increase the financial involvement of the population, with the aim of reducing the use of cash money in the economy. Likewise, the Bank of Albania has intensified work on the methodological approximation of financial statistics with international standards and harmonizing them with those of the European Union. During 2016 the regulatory framework for the mission of money and the management of monetary values was further enriched, through the adoption of six new regulations, five guidelines and four manuals of normative character. Beyond the most effective management of work processes in cash activity, the ultimate goal has been to minimise operational risks. Scientific research during 2016 has provided its assistance in the Bank of Albania's decision-making process. Our research work has been widely discussed in scientific activities, which have sparked interest not only in decision-makers but also in the public. In the field of information technology, 2016 will be mentioned for process automation, where it is worth highlighting in particular the full integration of bank of Albania branches into the institution's central systems. Another aspect of our work is the financial education of the public. For 2016, Page 4 of 5 , Mr. Gent Seyko in conferences... Albania's 2016 and its priorities for 2017, 29/07/22, 14:40 Activities in the field of economic and financial education have included about 21 institutions and 13,000 children, young people and teachers of the country, while the Bank of Albania Museum has hosted about 1900 visitors. In conclusion I would like to underline the fact that the Bank of Albania is prepared to enter another challenging year. With pleasure, I appreciate that the Bank of Albania possesses the right potential to contribute to meeting fundamental objectives, for further revitalization of the economy, price control and ensuring financial stability. The Bank of Albania will continue to be a serious, transparent and fully responsible partner in meeting all legal obligations. At the close of this statement, I would like to make a special thanks to all of you, the media representatives, for the time, attention and importance you have given to all our press communications. The space you have dedicated to our statements has served the distribution of Bank of Albania messages to economic agents and the general public. So, on behalf of the Supervisory Council, I thank you for this precious role. Thank you! Page 5 of 5

Gjithashtu, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris ka prmbushur n koh dhe me transparenc detyrimin ligjor pr llogaridhnie n Kuvendin e Shqipris, ndrkoh q Kryetari i tij, Guvernatori i Banks s Shqipris, ka marr pjes n dgjesa pr shtje specifike t krkuara nga Komisionet Parlamentare. Nj rndsi t veant n punn e tij Kshilli Mbikqyrs i ka kushtuar raporteve t Auditorit t Jashtm, t Inspektorit t Prgjithshm, si dhe t Kontrollit t Lart t Shtetit. N t gjitha rastet, kto raporte jan shqyrtuar nga Komiteti i Auditimit i cili ka br me dije Kshillin Mbikqyrs n lidhje me rekomandimet e lna dhe statusin e realizimit t tyre. Politika monetare gjat vitit 2016 Shkurtimisht do t doja t nnvizoja edhe njher se ekonomia shqiptare, pavarsisht situats sfiduese n partnert kryesor, ka shfaqur shenja t qarta prmirsimi gjat gjith vitit 2016. Pa dyshim, politika jon monetare stimuluese ka luajtur rol parsor n kt drejtim. Ndrhyrjet tona nprmjet reduktimit t norms baz t interesit, furnizimit t tregut financiar me likuiditet, apo orientimit t pritjeve pr t ardhmen kan qen n kohn dhe me intensitetin e duhur. Gent Sejko n konferes s Shqipris pr vitin 2016 dhe prioritetet e saj pr vitin 2017, 29/07/22, 14:40 financiare, mundsuan uljen e kostove t financimit n nivele minimale historike, kontribuan n prshpejtimin e gjallrimit t aktivitetit ekonomik, si dhe ndikuan n kthimin e trajektores s inflacionit n drejtimin e synuar. N kt mnyr, Banka e Shqipris vlerson se politika monetare, e ideuar dhe e zbatuar prej saj, ka dhn nj kontribut t qensishm n mbshtetjen e zhvillimit t qndrueshm dhe afatgjat t vendit. Sektori bankar dhe stabiliteti i tij Gjat vitit 2016, sektori bankar ka vijuar t zgjeroj aktivitetin e tij, ndrkoh q treguesit e tij t likuiditetit dhe kapitalizimit mbeten n nivele t larta dhe rezultati financiar paraqitet pozitiv. Ktu dshiroj t theksoj se, n saj t zbatimit konseguent t planit t masave pr reduktimin e kredive me probleme, niveli i kredive me probleme paraqitet i kontrolluar dhe mbulimi i rrezikut t kredis prmes provigjionimit vlersohet i knaqshm. N nj mas t madhe, kjo ecuri pasqyron punn ton t kujdesshme n drejtim t mbikqyrjes bankare. Paralelisht me t, Banka e Shqipris ka prmirsuar m tej kuadrin ligjor dhe rregullativ. M lejoni t identifikoj disa nga drejtimet kryesore t puns son n kt fush gjat vitit 2016. Plani ndrinstitucional pr reduktimin e kredive me probleme Plani ndrinstitucional, i ideuar q n vitin 2015, mori form t plot n vitin q po mbyllim. S pari, nprmjet miratimit nga Kshilli Mbikqyrs i t ndryshimeve rregullatore, tashm ekziston nj qartsi m e madhe n kriteret dhe procedurat e nxjerrjes s kredive t humbura jasht bilancit t bankave, si dhe t trajtimit t pronave t patundshme t marra n pronsi. Gjithashtu, kto ndryshime rregullative lehtsojn krijimin e nj tregu funksional t kredive me probleme, si dhe evidentimin m t shpejt t informacionit n Regjistrin e Kredive. S dyti, miratimi nga ana e Kuvendit t Shqipris i pakets ligjore, q lidhej, ndrmjet t tjerash, me falimentimin dhe proceset prmbaruese, plotsoi dhe kolonn e dyt dhe m t rndsishme t ktij plani. Banka e Shqipris vlerson se efektet e ndryshimeve ligjore, prvoja e fituar nga bankat, nxjerrja e kredive t humbura jasht bilanceve t bankave si edhe gjallrimi i mtejshm i ekonomis, do t krijojn stimuj pr nj ulje graduale dhe t qndrueshme t nivelit t kredive me probleme gjat vitit 2017. Dshiroj t theksoj se kjo sht nj mas parandaluese, e cila forcon m tej rrjetet e siguris n Shqipri. Ligji Pr shoqrit e kursim-kreditit dhe Unionet e tyre N prpjekje pr nj rregullim m adekuat t shoqrive t kursim-kreditit, gjat vitit 2016 u b e mundur miratimi nga ana e Kuvendit i Ligjit t ri Pr shoqrit e kursimkreditit dhe Unionet e tyre . Ligji i ri sjell nj rregullim t plot t veprimtaris s nj shoqrie t kursim-kreditit, duke filluar nga momenti i themelimit dhe i licencimit, e deri n momentin e shprndarjes e likuidimit t saj. N zbatim t ligjit, Banka e Shqipris rishikoi n trsi aktet nnligjore t cilat rregullonin funksionimin e shoqrive t kursim-kreditit dhe Unioneve t tyre. Aktivitete t tjera Rndsi t veant i kemi kushtuar edhe administrimit financiar dhe material t institucionit. Pr her t par, n muajin mars t vitit 2016, mundsuam prgatitjen dhe miratimin e pasqyrave financiare t Banks s Shqipris n prputhje me Standardet Ndrkombtare t Raportimit Financiar. Prgjat gjith vitit t kaluar, kemi vijuar t mbshtesim dhe t promovojm prdorimin e instrumenteve elektronike t pagesave. N kuadr t funksionimit t Komitetit Kombtar t Sistemit t Pagesave dhe bashkpunimit me Bankn Botrore, n fushn e pagesave jan ndrmarr projekte, t cilat synojn nxitjen e prdorimit t instrumenteve moderne dhe rritjen e prfshirjes financiare t popullats, me qllim reduktimin e prdorimit t paras cash n ekonomi. Po kshtu, Banka e Shqipris ka intensifikuar punn pr prafrimin metodologjik t statistikave financiare me standardet ndrkombtare dhe harmonizimin e tyre me ato t Bashkimit Evropian. Gjat vitit 2016 kuadri rregullator i emisionit t paras dhe administrimit t vlerave monetare sht pasuruar m tej, nprmjet miratimit t gjasht rregulloreve t reja, pes udhzimeve dhe katr manualeve me karakter normativ. Prtej administrimit m efektiv t proceseve t puns n aktivitetin e cash-it, qllimi final ka qen minimizimi i rreziqeve operacionale. Krkimi shkencor gjat vitit 2016 ka dhn ndihmesn e tij n procesin vendimmarrs t Banks s Shqipris. Puna jon krkimore sht diskutuar gjersisht n aktivitete shkencore, t cilat kan ngjallur interes jo vetm te vendimmarrsit por edhe te publiku. N fushn e teknologjis s informacionit, viti 2016 do t prmendet pr automatizimin e proceseve, ku vlen t theksojm n veanti integrimin e plot t degve t Banks s Shqipris, n sistemet qendrore t institucionit. Nj aspekt tjetr i puns son sht edhe edukimi financiar i publikut. Banka e Shqipris do t vazhdoj t jet nj partner serioz, transparent dhe plotsisht i prgjegjshm n prmbushjen e t gjitha detyrimeve ligjore. Susanne Schfctz Publication date: 22.12.2016 On 22 December 2016, the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Sejko, held an official meeting in the premises of the Bank of Albania, with the new Ambassador of the Federal Republic of Germany to Albania, USA Zj. Susanne Schfctz. During this meeting, Governor Seyko expressed thanks to the Ambassador of the Federal Republic of Germany to Albania, US ZJ. Susanne Schfctz, for the close relations between the two countries, stressing the importance and positive impact of Germany's support in Albania's integration process into the European Union. Particular attention was paid to further strengthening this co-operation in the economic field, in the area of justice for improving the legal framework, as well as potential prospects in the future. ... s_Federale_te_Gjermanise_ne_Shqiperi_SH_S_Zj_Susanne_Schuetz.html Page 1 of 3 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Seyko meets Ambassador... Bilateral discussions also stopped at the important contribution the Bank of Albania is making to the country's European integration process, through approximation of the regulatory framework and labour practices, with european Union directives and standards. The Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko, expressed his gratitude to the Bank of Germany for helping to exchange experiences and technical assistance provided in various areas of central banking. Title: On the meeting, with journalists, analysts and media executives
text: Bank of Albania Governor Gent Seyko's word during meeting with journalists, analysts and media executives 29/07/22, 14:39 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Seyko's word during meeting with journalists, analysts and media executives Publication date: 23.12.2016 Honored participants, It is special pleasure to welcome to the historic lobby of the Bank of Albania representatives of economic journalism as well as talented students in the field of economic thought, so let me, in my name and the Bank of Albania, welcome you to this last meeting for 2016. Today's activity, already turned into a tradition of the Bank of Albania, aims to support and promote student work in the field of economics and finance. Through this award, the Bank of Albania aims to encourage students and young professionals to deepen further in the universe of knowledge and their materialization in academic and professional activity. Over the years, this competition has aroused the interest of the best students inside and outside the country, so many students have brought their jobs to participate in it this year. I would like to congratulate and thank all those who have applied to become part of this activity for the high quality of their works, where the topics presented touch on a wide circle of economic and social issues, which are today the subject of discussions between policymakers and academics. I have to admit that the commission found it difficult to select three winning degrees as all the work was very good. As in past years, the Governor's Award aims to select the best winning diplomats from a methodological perspective and the originality of research work. This time, what distinguished the winning works is the fact that they have dared more than others in these directions. ... ejko_gjate_takimit_me_gazetare_analiste_dhe_drejtues_te_medias.html Page 1 of 3 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Seyko's word during meeting with journalists, analysts and media executives 29/07/22, 14:39 Before announcing the names of the winners, I wish to pause briefly to discuss the main characteristics and features identified in the community of works presented. First, I note that there is an increase in the originality of the works of diploma themes that have applied to the competition. In the works, thethematics reflect the concerns and challenges of the time take place, a development which I personally consider very important. Students have become more courageous in the selection not only of thematics, but also of research methodologies. Consequently, the subjects of diplomas have become more original and simultaneously more informative and valuable, not only for the university environment, but also to attract the attention of state institutions and corporations. However, I appreciate that universities and students would benefit more from closer co-operation with industry, the financial sector and institutions for discussing the problems facing the economy and business today. Second, we have highlighted an increase in the scientific quality of student works. Materials are moving away from descriptive analyses, increasingly based on contemporary scientific research methodologies. In some cases, we have rapidly increasing the number and type of models applied to student works. Furthermore, there is an increase in the attention and seriousness of creating databases, on which scientific research relies. This has brought increased quality of works and the validity of conclusions, which gives meaning to the efforts and work carried out by the authors. I also note that there are efforts to create qualitative databases of microeconomic character, to increase the size of statistical choice and thus give more real meaning to the application of empirical research analysis. However, I think greater care needs to be done in creating representative databases and expresses the willingness of the Bank of Albania to provide co-operation and assistance in this direction. Third, we gladly contain a desire and courage of students to implement sophisticated and contemporary methods of scientific research in their works. The use of micro databases is a methodology of the moment that applies not only to finance and business, but also to decision-making. The application of these methods is shifting the memes from comparative table analysis for market study, towards research of phenomena and economic legalities. I hope that these tendencies will arouse greater interest from industry and the financial sector for scientific research and by seeing the quality of the works in all their dimensions, I believe that graduates will constitute a human wealth of value to their employers. Once again I want to stress that your jobs are valued as a valuable contribution to analyze economic phenomena in today and the future. I wish you to continue to expand your professional work and culture in the institutions where you will be hired or further educated! Let me congratulate you on these qualities and congratulate you for ... ejko_gjate_takimit_me_gazetare_analiste_dhe_drejtues_te_medias.html Page 2 of 3 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Seyko's word during meeting with journalists, analysts and media executives 29/07/22, 14:39 Good work and academic seriousness displayed in your work. I hope that the assessment you will receive today will encourage you to further expand your knowledge and support you in starting a successful career. At the end of this word, I want to make a special thanks to all of you, the media representatives, for the time, attention and importance you have devoted to all our press communications. The space you dedicated to our statements during the year we close has been enough to distribute to the public the messages and conclusions of the Bank of Albania. I express the belief that the degree of co-operation and mutual understanding will be the dominant feature of our relations. Economic agents and the general public have the right to be informed on time and quality, and we are convinced that you will best perform this role even in 2017. N punime zn vend tematika q reflektojn shqetsimet dhe sfidat e kohs, nj zhvillim t cilin personalisht e konsideroj shum t rndsishm. Studentt jan br m guximtar n przgjedhjen jo vetm t tematikave, por dhe t metodologjive t krkimit. Rrjedhimisht temat e diplomave jan br m origjinale dhe njkohsisht m informative e m t vlefshme, jo vetm pr mjedisin universitar, por gjithashtu dhe pr t trhequr vmendjen e institucioneve shtetrore dhe korporatave. Gjithsesi vlersoj se universitetet dhe studentt do t prfitonin m shum nga nj bashkpunim m i ngusht me industrin, sektorin financiar dhe institucionet pr diskutimin e problemeve me t cilat prballet sot ekonomia dhe biznesi. S dyti, kemi evidentuar nj rritje t cilsis shkencore t punimeve t studentve. Materialet po largohen nga analizat prshkruese, duke u bazuar gjithnj e m shum n metodologji bashkkohore t krkimit shkencor. N disa raste, kemi rritje t shpejt t numrit dhe t llojshmris s modeleve t aplikuara n punimet e studentve. Pr m tepr ka nj rritje t vmendjes dhe seriozitetit t krijimit t bazave t t dhnave, n t cilat mbshtetet krkimi shkencor. Kjo ka sjell rritje t cilsis s punimeve dhe t vlefshmris s konkluzioneve, gj q i jep kuptim prpjekjeve dhe puns s kryer nga autort. Gjithashtu, vrej se ka prpjekje pr krijimin e bazave t t dhnave cilsore me karakter mikroekonomik, pr t rritur madhsin e zgjedhjes statistikore dhe pr t i dhn kshtu m shum kuptim real aplikimit e analizs empirike t krkimit. Megjithat, mendoj se kujdes m i madh duhet br n krijimin e bazave t t dhnave prfaqsuese dhe shpreh gatishmrin e Banks s Shqipris pr t ofruar bashkpunim dhe asistenc n kt drejtim. S treti, me knaqsi konstatojm nj dshir dhe kuraj t studentve pr t zbatuar n punimet e tyre metoda t sofistikuara e bashkkohore t krkimit shkencor. Prdorimi i bazave t t dhnave mikro, sht nj metodologji e momentit q aplikohet jo vetm n financ dhe biznes, por njkohsisht edhe n vendimmarrje. Aplikimi i ktyre metodave po i zhvendos temat nga analiza tabelore krahasuese pr studimin e tregut, drejt hulumtimit t fenomeneve dhe ligjshmrive ekonomike. Shpresoj se kto tendenca do t ngjallin interesim m t madh nga industria dhe nga sektori financiar pr krkimin shkencor dhe duke par cilsin e punimeve n gjith dimensionet e tyre, besoj se diplomantt do t prbjn nj pasuri humane me vler pr pundhnsit e tyre. Edhe njher dua t theksoj se punt tuaja i vlersojm si nj kontribut t vlefshm pr t analizuar fenomenet ekonomike n t sotmen dhe t ardhmen. text: On the meeting of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko, with journalists, analysts and media executives 29/07/22, 14:39 On the meeting of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko, with journalists, analysts and media executives Publication date: 23.12.2016 On 23 December 2016, on the occasion of the end of the year, the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko, held a meeting with written and electronic media journalists, economic analysts, executives and other media representatives in Albania. The meeting was opened with the word carried by Governor Seyko, who thanked media representatives for the time, attention and importance they have devoted to all press communications of the institution, distributing to the public the messages and conclusions of the Bank of Albania. Page 1 of 4 On the meeting of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko, with journalists, analysts and media executives 29/07/22, 14:39 Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Sejko added that the role of the media is considered of particular importance to the Bank of Albania, in conveying information to both economic agents and the general public, timely and quality. At the close of his word, Governor Seyko expressed confidence in further increased co-operation and understanding during 2017, as well as conveyed his best and heartfelt congratulations for a new year as successful as possible. During this activity, the three awards of the open competition were divided, the Governor's Award for Best Diploma for 2016. This competition is organised annually by the Bank of Albania and is dedicated to Albanian students who graduate during the year, domestically and abroad, for research and scientific work on issues related to monetary and international economics, price stability and financial, economic integration, etc. 1. At the first price it was rated zj. Danjela Guja student at the University of Freiburg, Germany on the subject of master's optimization of the portfolio through assessment of expected losses in the context of the general hyperbolic multidimensional method , which was handed over by the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko. This study brings a contribution to the field of finance by proposed, applied and evaluated a new model, alternative to modelling risk factors of an investment portfolio. The material discusses optimization of investment portfolios based on the general hyperbolic method of returning financial assets to Germany. In fact, the study proposes general hyperbolic distribution as a better adjudicator of risk factors than normal distribution, testing this hypothesis in financial market conditions in Germany. This study constitutes a contemporary and interesting theme related to finance and which finds application in the field of currency reserve management, banking supervision and financial stability. Page 2 of 4 On the meeting of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko, with journalists, analysts and media executives 29/07/22, 14:39 2. At the second price it was rated zj. Pamela Student Centre at the University of Bonn in Germany on the subject of master's transition from school banks to the labour market and youth unemployment in Europe, which was handed over by the First Deputy Governor of the Bank of Albania, Zj. Elizabeth John. The material addresses a very interesting topic about the labour market and youth unemployment in Europe and mainly in southern and eastern European countries, which were affected by higher unemployment rates after the last global financial crisis. The theme focuses mainly on the new graduate labour market. Some of the material's results show that the financial crisis has mostly affected youth unemployment in Southeast European countries, where the right level of education and work experience are factors affecting a shorter period of staying out of work after completing studies. 3. At the third price it was rated zj. Anisa Plepi from the University of Tirana on the subject of master the role of monetary policy in influencing the decisions of economic agents: An assessment of the Case of Albania based on the theory of the structure of the term interest rates, which was handed over by the Second Deputy Governor of the Bank of Albania, Zj. Natasha Ahmetaj. The material has focused on the bank of Albania's monetary policy role in economic and financial decision-making of economic agents. A topic that undoubtedly has our maximum interest and attention not only for what we have done, but also making us understand the students' perception of economics for raising hypotheses on the policies and challenges we have and that await us in the future. More specifically, the results show the role of monetary policy in the short and medium term, the evidence of the element of uncertainty affecting the decision of economic agents, as well as highlighting the important role that economic agents' expectations have in transmitting the effects of monetary policy. Growth resources are estimated to have been strengthened: in addition to the sustainable contribution of domestic demand, an added positive contribution in this period is estimated to have made and foreign demand. Domestic demand has benefited from rising employment, stimulus monetary conditions, increased confidence of economic agents, as well as foreign direct investment. On the other hand, rising prices and the revitalization of demand in foreign markets has brought an increase in exports of Albanian goods during this period. Accelerating growth during 2016 has brought the Albanian economy closer to its potential and activated a greater share of production capacities. The unemployment rate dropped to 14.2% at the end of the year, while the rate of capacity exploitation has come to an increase. Under these conditions, domestic inflationary pressures have increased. In parallel with them, two- and three-year medium-term inflationary expectations have strengthened, marking levels of 2.6% and 2.7%, respectively. The co-ordination of macroeconomic policies has created an appropriate environment to stimulate the economy and support strengthening the country's macroeconomic stability. Fiscal policy has followed a consolidating course, reflected in reducing the public debt deficit. However, this consolidation course had a lower intensity at the end of last year and in the first two months of this year. In January, the fiscal sufficiency resulted in 7.9 billion dollars, influenced by revenue growth by 0.2% and spending by 5.1%. Although it has injected low fiscal stimulus into the economy, consolidating fiscal policy has facilitated monetary policy. Easing monetary policy has contributed to reducing the financing costs of economic agents and recovering lending in the local currency. The current monitoring of monetary stimulus in the financial market can be considered complete. In particular, the government's valuable letter yields in the primary market have reversed the growing trend displayed late last year. In line with our expectations, this behavior has reflected the improvement of the demand-to-offer ratio for these instruments, as well as unchanged monetary and fiscal policy. The fluctuations of treasury bond yields have not been conveyed in the products of other segments of the financial market. Luhatjet e inflacionit nuk kan zbehur trendin e tij rrits, t nisur gjat gjashtmujorit t dyt t vitit t kaluar. Ky trend sht mbshtetur nga forcimi i presioneve t brendshme inflacioniste, nga rritjet e mimeve n tregjet e huaja dhe nga konvergimi gradual i pritjeve inflacioniste afatmesme drejt objektivit. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_z_Gent_Sejko_ne_konf 2/5 05/08/22, 17:06 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp t vendimmarrjes s politiks monetare  Prditsimi i analizs ekonomike me statistikat e reja tregon vazhdimin e rritjes ekonomike, si gjat tremujorit t fundit t vitit 2016 ashtu edhe n dy muajt e par t ktij viti. Burimet e rritjes vlersohet t jen forcuar: krahas kontributit t qndrueshm t krkess s brendshme, nj kontribut t shtuar pozitiv n kt periudh vlersohet t ket dhn dhe krkesa e huaj. Krkesa e brendshme ka prfituar nga rritja e punsimit, nga kushtet monetare stimuluese, nga rritja e besimit t agjentve ekonomik, si dhe nga investimet e huaja direkte. Nga ana tjetr, rritja e mimeve dhe gjallrimi i krkess n tregjet e huaja ka sjell nj rritje t eksporteve t mallrave shqiptare gjat ksaj periudhe. Prshpejtimi i rritjes gjat vitit 2016 e ka afruar ekonomin shqiptare me potencialin e saj dhe ka aktivizuar nj pjes m t madhe t kapaciteteve prodhuese. Norma e papunsis zbriti n nivelin 14.2% n fund t vitit, ndrsa norma e shfrytzimit t kapaciteteve ka ardhur n rritje. N kto kushte, presionet e brendshme inflacioniste jan shtuar. Paralelisht me to, pritjet inflacioniste afatmesme dy dhe trevjeare jan forcuar, duke shnuar prkatsisht nivelet 2.6% dhe 2.7%. Bashkrendimi i politikave makroekonomike ka krijuar krijuar nj mjedis t prshtatshm pr t stimuluar ekonomin dhe pr t mbshtetur forcimin e stabilitetit makroekonomik t vendit . Politika fiskale ka ndjekur nj kurs konsolidues, t pasqyruar n reduktimin e deficitit e t borxhit publik. Megjithat, ky kurs konsolidues ka pasur nj intensitet m t ult n fundin e vitit t kaluar dhe n dy muajt e par t ktij viti. N muajin janar, suficiti fiskal rezultoi 7.9 miliard lek, i ndikuar nga rritja e t ardhurave me 0.2% dhe e shpenzimeve me 5.1%. Megjithse ka injektuar nj stimul t ult fiskal n ekonomi, politika fiskale konsoliduese ka lehtsuar prcjelljen e politiks monetare. Politika monetare lehtsuese ka kontribuar n reduktimin e kostove t financimit t agjentve ekonomik dhe rikuperimin e kreditimit n monedhn vendase. Prcjellja e deritanishme e stimulit monetar n tregun financiar mund t konsiderohet e plot. N veanti, yield-et e letrave me vler t qeveris n tregun primar kan kthyer prirjen rritse t shfaqur n fundin e vitit t kaluar. N linj me pritjet tona, kjo sjellje ka reflektuar prmirsimin e raportit krkes-ofert pr kto instrumente, si dhe politikn e pandryshuar monetare e fiskale. Luhatjet e yield-eve t bonove t thesarit nuk jan prcjell n produktet e segmenteve t tjera t tregut financiar. Kostot e financimit t sektorit privat ruajn nivelet e ulta historike dhe kushtet "jomim" vijojn t lehtsohen pr individt, por mbeten t shtrnguara pr bizneset, kryesisht pr korporatat. Kushtet monetare lehtsuese kan kontribuar n rritjen e vazhdueshme t portofolit t kredis n lek. Vllimi i kredis n lek u rrit me 11% n terma vjetor, duke kompensuar tkurrjen e kredis n valut n muajin janar. Trendi rrits i kredis n lek sht nj zhvillim inkurajues, por shprndarja e ksaj rritjeje tregon prqendrimin e saj n segmentin e individve, ndrkoh q kredia pr biznese vijon e ngadalt. Kjo ecuri ndikohet nga sjellja hezituese e bankave ndaj ktij segmenti, nga krkesa e pakt cilsore, por edhe nga gjendja e bollshme e httpsli:/k/wwidw.ibankiofalbaniaf.org/Shtypi/Fjalidme_interviista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjjala_e_bGiuvernatorit_tRe_Bi ajnkes_ske_Shqiperisie_zd_hGent_Seijko_ne_kionf 3/5 05/08/22, 17:06 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp t vendimmarrjes s politiks monetare  likuiditetit, n formn e depozitave, q gzojn bizneset. Rritja e konsumit dhe e investimeve pritet t shoqrohet me absorbimin e likuiditetit t biznesit dhe me rritjen e krkess s tij pr kredi. Gjithashtu, oferta pr kredi pritet t lehtsohet, e ndihmuar nga masat e marra pr reduktimin e kredive me probleme dhe pr nxitjen e kredis s shndetshme. Reduktimi i mtejshm i raportit t kredive me probleme n muajin shkurt, tashm i zbritur n nivelin 18%, sht nj shenj inkurajuese n kt drejtim. E kushtzuar dhe nga fashitja e shpejt e pasigurive aktuale, Banka e Shqipris vlerson se aktiviteti kreditues i ka t gjitha premisat pr t shnuar rritje gjat vitit 2017. Prditsimi i parashikimeve makroekonomike ka konfirmuar pritjet tona t mparshme pr zhvillimet ekonomike e monetare n t ardhmen. Sipas skenarit baz, kthimi i ekonomis n potencial dhe absorbimi gradual i kapaciteteve t pashfrytzuara priten t shoqrohen me forcimin e presioneve inflacioniste. Inflacioni vjetor pritet t luhatet rreth nivelit 2.4% pr vitin 2017 dhe t kthehet n objektivin ton brenda vitit 2018. Nga ana tjetr, balanca e rreziqeve rreth ktyre parashikimeve vlersohet t jet e shmangur pr posht, si n afatin e shkurtr dhe n at t mesm, e ndikuar nga pasigurit n ambientin e brendshm dhe t jashtm. Ecuria e deritanishme e ekonomis dhe materializimi i pritjeve tona rikonfirmon prshtatshmrin e qndrimit aktual t politiks monetare. *** Bazuar n kto gjykime, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi t mbaj t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 1.25%. Gjithashtu, Kshilli vendosi t mbaj t pandryshuar edhe normat e interesit t depozits dhe t kredis njditore, respektivisht n nivelet 0.25 dhe 2.25%. Duke gjykuar mbi informacionin e disponuar, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlerson se intensiteti i stimulit monetar nuk do t ulet prpara tremujorit t katrt t vitit vitit 2017. M tej, intensiteti i stimulit monetar do t rikalibrohet pr t'iu prgjigjur trendit t prmirsimit t pritur t ekonomis. S fundi, Kshilli Mbikqyrs rithekson se ky qndrim i politiks monetare i shrben ruajtjes s ekuilibrave makroekonomik n prgjithsi dhe arritjes e ruajtjes s stabilitetit t mimeve n veanti. Nga ana tjetr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs rithekson se ruajtja dhe forcimi i mtejshm i tempit t reformave strukturore, si n drejtim t rritjes s potencialit t ekonomis ashtu edhe n drejtim t reduktimit t dobsive t saj, sht nj parakusht pr garantimin e rritjes s qndrueshme dhe afatgjat t vendit. Title: Speech at the press conference of the monetary policy decision-making of the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania
text: Questions - answers of the press conference dated February 1, 2017 29/07/22, 14:39 Questions - answers of the press conference dated February 1, 2017 Publication date: 01.02.2017 Q: Mr Governor, yesterday the government launched the "1 billion euro investment" initiative with the Private Public Partnership. Do you think the government with this initiative will use citizens' savings in banks and is the rest of the business at risk, d.m.th. Is business lending at risk that will not be part of this project? Governor: Of course, population savings would not be censored. Savings are in the form of deposits in second-rate banks, intended to be invested by these banks, as they themselves are business centres. Lending is based on the liquidity banks have from savings, but we don't see any problems here for their use in a certain direction. Important to stress is that lending will continue to increase through successful and healthy projects, major projects. We have noticed that the increase in lending in the local currency has resulted from the transmission of our easing monetary policy and banks' policies for diversifying credit risk in certain segments, mainly for individuals and for small and medium-sized businesses. Of course, the lack of projects as a result of internal and external factors, the crisis in the eurozone and the region, has influenced lending. We judge that this government project will be based on major projects and these projects will also attract investments from second-rate banks and financial institutions. So they pose a potential not only for economic development, but also investment potential on the part of banks. Of course, these projects will be studied for their physibilities on the basis of risk criteria ... thirst-pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_1_shkurt_2017.html Page 1 of 3 Questions - answers of the press conference dated February 1, 2017 29/07/22, 14:39 who will have the banks themselves. In general, this is a positive signal that indicates the further prospect of development and lending through the presentation of projects against second-rate banks. Q: What are the tangible effects on the economics of the easing monetary policy that the Bank of Albania has undertaken so far? Governor: We are very pleased that the decision of the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania in relation to monetary policy has been transmitted to financial markets. The very increase in credit in the local currency of 10.4% indicates a transmission of this policy. Our goal of easing monetary policy through lowering the basic interest rate is to stimulate investment, consumption and lending. We have an increase in lending in the local currency in relation to that in foreign currency. At the same time, economic growth has resulted from increased domestic consumption and development in the tourism sector. So, in these terms, we can say that so far it has been proven that the transmission of monetary policy and its effects on the financial system and broader are positive. It remains to be seen in the following, but our predictions are what I emphasized during my word. We anticipate inflation reaching our target of 3% in 2018, while the economy's return to balance is forecast to occur during this year. Q: You just mentioned that the level of bad loans has fallen to 18.2%, it is a substantial decline, but I think it would be of interest to know as we have had previous declines, but which have been attributed to the deletion of bad loans from banks' balance sheets. Are we in the same situation or do we have other factors that affect this decline? Governor: The decline is a combination of several factors: First, as a result of the increase in the loan portfolio, in total to the level of 3.4% at the end of November, as we do not have the final figures for 2016; Secondly, as a result of the restructuring of some loans on the part of the banks carried out earlier, as the effects of restructuring are reflected in the financial balances of banks with a period of six months delay; Third, as a result of the deletion of loans lost in the respective period. The combination of these three factors has brought the decline in the level of troubled loans to the figure of 18.2%. This is a significant decline compared to previous reports. We managed to lower the troubled loan rate from the 25% level it was two years ago, later to the level of 21% and already have the ratio of 18.2% which is a positive ratio, to the falling trend. Of course this is a very difficult challenge, we have seen fluctuations in the ratio of troubled loans. At the end of last year, we had a rough decline at this level and then again it increased by 2 percentage points, to the 21% level. The Bank of Albania, in coordination with the Albanian government and other actors, has prepared and followed a plan of measures, which will continue to be implemented during 2017. The elements I mentioned above are points of this plan. We will coordinate work with banks, to be more proactive in restructuring loan portfolios and supporting businesses, which have difficulties, but present positive projections for the future, as well as to have efficiency in loan execution processes, which have no future. Therefore, the management of these portfolios with clarity and with an accelerated decision-making on the part of banks, with our coordination as regulatory authority, will make the plan of measures to reduce troubled loans more efficient during 2017.
