Guvernator, dje qeveria lanoi nismn "1 miliard euro investime" me Partneritet Publik Privat. A ju duket se qeveria me kt nism do t prdor kursimet e qytetarve n banka dhe a sht e rrezikuar pjesa tjetr e biznesit, d.m.th. a sht i rrezikuar kreditimi i biznesit q nuk do t jet pjes e ktij projekti? Guvernatori: Natyrisht q kursimet e popullats nuk do t cenoheshin. Kursimet jan n formn e depozitave n bankat e nivelit t dyt, t destinuara pr tu investuar nga kto banka, pasi dhe ato vet jan qendra biznesi. Kreditimi bazohet mbi likuiditetin q bankat kan nga kursimet, por ne nuk shikojm ktu ndonj problem pr prdorimin e tyre n nj drejtim t caktuar. E rndsishme pr t theksuar sht q kreditimi do t vazhdoj t rritet nprmjet projekteve t suksesshme dhe t shndetshme, projekteve t mdha. Kemi vn re q rritja e kreditimit n monedhn vendase ka ardhur si pasoj e transmetimit t politiks ton monetare lehtsuese dhe e politikave t bankave pr diversifikimin e rrezikut t kredis n disa segmente t caktuara, kryesisht pr individt dhe pr bizneset e vogla dhe t mesme. Natyrisht q mungesa e projekteve si pasoj e faktorve t brendshm dhe t jashtm, t krizs n eurozon dhe n rajon, ka ndikuar kreditimin. Ne gjykojm q ky projekt i qeveris do t jet i bazuar n projekte madhore dhe kto projekte do t trheqin edhe investimet nga ana e bankave t nivelit t dyt dhe institucioneve financiare. Pra, ato prbjn nj potencial jo vetm pr zhvillimin ekonomik, por njkohsisht edhe nj potencial investimi nga ana e bankave. Sigurisht q kto projekte do t studiohen pr fizibilitetin e tyre n baz t kritereve t rrezikut https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjaletje-pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_1_shkurt_2017.html Pagina 1 di 3 Pyetje - prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp t dats 1 shkurt 2017 29/07/22, 14:39 q do t ken vet bankat. N prgjithsi, ky sht nj sinjal pozitiv i cili tregon pr perspektivn e mtejshme t zhvillimit dhe kreditimit nprmjet prezantimit t projekteve kundrejt bankave t nivelit t dyt. Pyetje: Cilat jan efektet e prekshme n ekonomi t politiks monetare lehtsuese q ka ndrmarr deri m tani Banka e Shqipris? Guvernatori: Ne jemi shum t knaqur q vendimmarrja e Kshillit Mbikqyrs t Banks s Shqipris n raport me politikn monetare sht transmetuar n tregjet financiare. Vet rritja e kredis n monedhn vendase prej 10.4 % tregon pr nj transmetim t ksaj politike. Synimi yn i politiks monetare lehtsuese nprmjet uljes s norms baz t interesit sht stimulimi i investimeve, konsumit dhe kreditimit. Ne kemi nj rritje t kreditimit n monedhn vendase n raport me at n monedh t huaj. Njkohsisht, rritja ekonomike ka ardhur si pasoj e rritjes s konsumit t brendshm dhe e zhvillimit n sektorin e turizmit. Pra, n kto terma, ne mund t themi q deri tani sht provuar q transmetimi i politiks monetare dhe efektet e saj n sistemin financiar dhe m gjer jan pozitive. Mbetet pr tu par n vijim, por parashikimet tona jan ato q theksova gjat fjals time. Parashikojm q inflacioni t arrij n objektivin ton prej 3% n vitin 2018, ndrsa kthimi i ekonomis n ekuilibr parashikohet t ndodh gjat ktij viti. Pyetje: Sapo prmendt q niveli i kredive t kqija ka rn n vlern 18.2%, sht nj rnie thelbsore, por mendoj se do t ishte me interes t dinim pasi kemi pasur edhe rnie t mparshme, por q i jan atribuar fshirjes s kredive t kqija nga bilancet e bankave. Jemi n t njjtn situat apo kemi dhe faktor t tjer q ndikojn n kt rnie? Guvernatori: Rnia sht kombinim i disa faktorve: S pari, si pasoj e rritjes s portofolit t kredis, n total n nivelin e 3.4% n fund t muajit nntor, pasi nuk i kemi shifrat prfundimtare t vitit 2016; S dyti si pasoj e ristrukturimeve t disa kredive nga ana e bankave t kryera m hert, pasi efektet e ristrukturimit pasqyrohen n bilancet financiare t bankave me nj periudh prej gjasht muaj vones; S treti, si pasoj e fshirjes s kredive t humbura n periudhn prkatse. Kombinimi i ktyre tre faktorve ka sjell rnien e nivelit t kredive me probleme n shifrn prej 18.2%. Kjo sht nj rnie e konsiderueshme krahasuar me raportet e mparshme. Ne arritm ta ulnim normn e kredive me probleme nga niveli 25% q ishte dy vjet m par, m pas n nivelin e 21% dhe tashm kemi raportin prej 18.2% q sht nj raport pozitiv, n trendin rns. Natyrisht kjo sht nj sfid shum e vshtir, kemi par luhatje n raportin e kredive me probleme. N fund t vitit t kaluar, kemi pasur nj rnie t prafrt n kt nivel dhe m pas, prsri u rrit me 2 pik prqindjeje, n nivelin 21%. Banka e Shqipris, n koordinim me qeverin shqiptare dhe me aktort e tjer ka prgatitur dhe ndjekur nj plan masash, i cili do t vazhdoj t zbatohet edhe gjat vitit 2017. text: 06/08/2022, 09:11 The Bank of Albania in co-operation with the World Bank organised the workshop themed "Financial System in Albania  ... The Bank of Albania in co-operation with the World Bank organised the workshop themed "Financial System in Albania  By Scenarios of 2025, the action nowadays" Publication date: 03.02.2017 On 2 February 2017, the Bank of Albania, in co-operation with the World Bank, organised the "Financial System in Albania - From the 2025 scenarios to the current action", under the direction of the Second Deputy Governor of the Bank of Albania,  1/3 06/08/2p022, 09:11 The Bank of Albania in bashing with the Bank of the World organized the workshop with the theme "Financial system if Sphqiperi  ... Zj. Natasha Ahmetaj. Representatives of the World Bank, ministries, attended the workshop, financial institutions of the country, the academic world as well as the staff of the Bank of Albania. This forum was aimed at discussing different scenarios for the future of the Albanian economy. Located on a long-term time horizon, alternative combinations of factors influencing an open economy found answers in the financial and macroeconomic policies proposed by workshop participants. Workshop was conceived as a platform dynamic discussion to exchange thoughts regarding challenges, identification and risk management, testing different strategies, bringing the future to everyday thought. In her address, Deputy Governor Ahmetaj stressed that the Albanian banking system is capitalized, secular and financially healthy. But today's healthy must keep awake interest in discovering new opportunities that the future can bring, so that we can be prepared to benefit the best from them. This means that institutions must spend the right time analyzing different scenarios of the future and considering these analyses during decision-making.  2/3 06/08/2022, 09:11 The Bank of Albania in co-operation with the World Bank organised the workshop themed "Financial System in Albania  ... Furthermore, the Deputy Governor thanked the World Bank for the assistance and technical expertise offered in this area, as well as praised this experience as very useful for preparing long-term strategies, but simultaneously to reflect on today's decision-making. Organizing such workshops is part of the World Bank's practices in various countries, as well as part of the Bank of Albania's work plans for an Albanian financial sector with vision beyond the decade.  3/3

This meeting came together to discuss the latest developments of the world economy and the respective economies, governors and finance ministers of the member states of this constitucy. Senior representatives of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the World Bank (BB) presented perspectives regarding the revision of countries' quotas and capital, the adequacy of current instruments related to lending, fiscal spaces that exist in a limited budget environment, as well as the interconnections that exist between country poverty and social inequality.  onetar_Nderkombetar_FMN_dhe_te_Grupit_te_Bankes_Boterore_BB.html Page 1 of 3 Bank of Albania Governor Mr Gent Seyko attends UK... During the meeting, Bank of Albania Governor Gent Sejko introduced the country's economic panorama where he stressed that economic growth is on a positive development trajectory, supported by the combination of monetary stimulus and fiscal consolidation. Furthermore, Governor Seyko said economic growth is expected to continue sustainable growth and key macroeconomic balances will strengthen in the future. In terms of perspective, the Governor stressed that the Bank of Albania expects improved economic activity over the medium-term time horizon, which will enable the economy to return to balance, further improve labour market indicators, as well as return inflation to target. Structural reforms and improving the business climate will help sustain the country's economic growth. text: Bank of Albania discussion meeting with Albanian Banking Association (SHSHB) 29/07/22, 14:39 Bank of Albania discussion meeting with Albanian Banking Association (SHSHB) Publication date: 15.02.2017 On 15 February 2017, a discussion meeting was held between the Bank of Albania and the Steering Board of the Albanian Bank Association. The meeting was organised with the initiative and direction of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Sejko. Also present were the Second Deputy Governor of the Bank of Albania Zj. Natasha Ahmetaj and other bank of Albania directors, Chairman of the US Steering Board and Director General of Alpha Bank Albania, Mr Periklis Drougkas, the other members of this Board, as well as Mr Spiro Brumbulli, Secretary General of the USB.  Bankes_se_Shqiperise_me_Shoqaten_Shqiptare_te_Bankave_SHSHB.html Page 1 of 2 Bank of Albania discussion meeting with Albanian Banking Association (SHSHB) 29/07/22, 14:39 The main purpose of this meeting was to intensify dialogue and co-operation between the Bank of Albania, the Albanian Association of Banks and commercial banks operating in Albania, on issues particularly related to the security of the development of banking activity, started even by events that occurred recently during the transport of monetary values, as well as to discuss financial activity, creditor and operational of the banking system. At the beginning of the meeting, the whitewash of the authors of the robbery of the monetary values of banks and the intensive work carried out by the State Police in this direction were pleased. Furthermore, it was discussed for further strengthening co-operation between banks and relevant institutions for revising security measures in banking activity and transporting monetary values with the aim of meeting and improving them, to avoid repeating such events in the future. Participants also discussed increasing coordinated efforts and institutional interaction within the framework of promoting economic lending, through identifying potential healthy investments, with the aim of accelerating the country's economic activity and increasing banks' contribution to it. During the meeting, Governor Seyko also stopped short on the issue of dealing with troubled loans, estimating that the effects of legal changes, the experience gained by banks, the extraction of lost loans off banks' balance sheets and the restructuring of troubled loans would promote a gradual and stable reduction in their level during 2017. Also, particular importance was given to financial education for public awareness, as well as preserving the image of the banking system, stressing the impact of banks on both the financial system and the country's economy. In conclusion, the Albanian Banking Association thanked the Bank of Albania for this very positive and fruitful meeting. The association assured that it would continue to have maximum co-operation with the Bank of Albania and with central and local authorities for a banking sector as healthy and supportive of the country's economic development. / Bankes_se_Shqiperise_me_Shoqaten_Shqiptare_te_Bankave_SHSHB.html Page 2 of 2

Title: Speech at the opening ceremony of Money Week
text: Key Money Week 29/07/22, 14:38 PeRISE. SANKOFALBANIE Key Money Week Publication date: 27.03.2017 On 27 March 2017, in the premises of the Bank of Albania, The Week of Money was opened for 2017, during which various activities will be organised on 27-31 March 2017. This Week is a worldwide money festival, aimed at raising awareness among children and young people to be financially responsible citizens in the future. Numerous partners around the globe will organize diverse activities to include children, learning how to take care of money, how to save, how to understand changes in the economic systems they live in, how to earn income through entrepreneurship and set the stage for their future. During this week, the Bank of Albania, in co-operation with the Albanian Banking Association, and with the support of the Ministry of Education and Sport, and other partners will organise educational and awareness activities for children and young people such as: Page 1 of 2 Key Money Week 29/07/22, 14:38 Lectures, school and television competitions, visits to the Bank of Albania Museum and commercial banks, open teaching hours, theatrical performances and exhibitions with children's paintings. The key activity of The Week of Money 2017 greeted the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko, Minister of Education and Sport, zj. Lindita Nikola, and Chairman of the Albanian Banking Association, Mr. Periklis Drougkas. In his welcoming address, Governor Sejko stressed the Bank of Albania's serious commitment to financial education, through the implementation of educational programmes and the drafting of teaching texts dedicated to primary and secondary education. He also underlined the motto of "Learn, and win" activity, which is devoted entirely to young people's awareness of the importance of money and their wider involvement in the country's economic and financial system even wider. Furthermore, Governor Seyko added that the fullest consumer information and financial involvement of the public constitute two key issues that have a direct impact on the economic well-being of individuals and businesses. Furthermore, the activity came with the award-sharing ceremony for the winners of the first three competitions organised by the Bank of Albania and the Albanian Banking Association on the occasion of The Week of Money. The first competition was "My Money" in which elementary school students, grades I-III, participated, with simple drawings on their concept of money and savings. Over 500 students from about 35 9-year-old schools participated in the competition, of which 10 winners were selected. The second contest organized is that of the best video with the theme "While for difficult days! And for better days!" The competition invited high school students to convey their messages on the subject through a video no longer than 2 minutes. A total of 14 videos were presented in the competition by high school students in the country, of which 3 winners were declared. The third organised competition is that of the best essay with the theme "Should financial education be mandatory in academic curricular?". In this competition, 19 essay were presented by students of the finance-bank branch of the third year, from various universities in the country, of which they were selected to win awards 3 best essay. Full information about the winners of these awards, as well as other activities of the Week you will find on the official Facebook page of the Bank of Albania. Page 2 of 2

text: 05/08/22, 17:06 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... , Mr. Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making of Bank of Albania Supervisory Council Publication date: 03.05.2017 The new information analyzed in the next Quarterly Report has generally resulted in line with our expectations. New economic and financial data show an acceleration of economic growth and an improvement in key macroeconomic balances during the end of the year  1/5 05/08/22d, 17:06 , Mr. Gent Sejkonoja press conference of the decision-making of monetary policy ... 2016 and early 2017. In particular, inflation and inflation expectations have come to an increase During this period. The analysis of available information highlights the positive role our monetary policy has had. Monetary stimulus conditions have favoured increasing lending and lowering the cost of debt service; In this way, they have supported the vitality of consumption and private investment, as well as creating the necessary prerequisites for turning inflation into targets. Updating our medium-term forecasts suggests that the Albanian economy will continue to grow and that inflation will return to target within 2018. These predictions have not undergone significant changes from the previous round, although the risks of the lower kah are estimated to have increased. Under these circumstances, the Supervisory Council estimated that the current monetary policy position remains appropriate and decided to keep the basic interest rate unchanged at the 1.25% level. Also, the Council decided to keep deposit and one-day loan interest rates unchanged, at levels 0.25 and 2.25%, respectively.  2/5 05/08/22, 17:06 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... Next, I will stop in more detail in the analyses and conclusions that motivated this decision-making. *** Inflation came up in the first quarter of 2017, marking an average value of 2.4%. Inflation performance was determined by rising food and oil prices. Prices of other basket items did not undergo significant changes, continuing to make low positive contributions. In the macroeconomic perspective, the increasing trend of inflation is supported by improved economic activity and fuller exploitation of production capacities, rising price trends in world markets, as well as better anchoring of inflationary expectations. The effect of these factors is expected to extend to the following periods. Inflation is forecast to hover around the average level of 2.3% for 2017 and rise further towards the target over the next year. According to INSTAT data, the pace of economic growth improved in the last quarter of last year. Gross domestic product grew by 4.0% in the quarter, bringing 2016 economic growth to a 3.5% level. Greatest contribution to activity expansion the service and construction sector gave it, while the industry and agriculture sector had positive but lower growth. In terms of aggregate demand, economic growth reflected the expansion of domestic and foreign demand for goods and services. Consumption and private investment have increased, supported by low interest rates, employment expansion and improved confidence, as well as high incoming flows of foreign direct investment. In parallel, fourth-quarter economic growth benefited from increased tourist activity and the recovery of increasing rates of goods exports. The indirect data available suggests that these trends continued even during the first quarter of 2017. Fiscal first quarter data show a reduction in the speed of fiscal consolidation, materialized to a budget suffice 33.2% lower than the same period last year. This quarter's budgetary spending recognized a 10.3% increase in annual terms, compared to the 4.3% increase that marked revenues. The 2017 budget plan suggests an added fiscal policy contribution to the increase in aggregate demand, but the Bank of Albania continues to draw attention to the need for a more simultaneous distribution of spending and budget deficit over the year. Financial markets have continued to reflect the impulses of our easing monetary policy. The increase in government value letter yields at the end of the year resulted in temporary and was not transmitted to other segments of the financial market. Financial markets continue to be characterized by low levels of deposit and interest rates  3/5 05/08/22, 17:06 loans. , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... Monetary policy has supported lowering financing costs and increasing credit in the local currency, although total credit growth still remains pale. At the end of March, the loan to the private sector was 3.3% higher than a year earlier. Over the past twelve months, the loan in money marked an increase of 10.3%, while the currency loan a reduction of 1.6%. In sectoral terms, credit expansion is concentrated in the individual segment, while business lending appears slow, influenced by both weak business demand and the tight supply of the banking sector. Judging on current economic and financial tendencies, as well as on their supporting factors, the Bank of Albania estimates that the cyclical improvement of the economy will continue even in the medium term. According to the basic scenario, on this time horizon we expect a further increase in economic activity, supported by the revitalization of domestic demand and by the improvement of the foreign environment. The increase in economic activity is expected to be associated with the absorption of free production capacities, both in labour markets, and in capital ones. Returning the economy to balance will create the right premise for the sustainable return of inflation to the target within 2018. The Supervisory Council estimates that meeting these projections requires preserving the current mix of macroeconomic policies and continuing structural reforms. Fiscal policy is expected and should continue to maintain a consolidating nature in the medium term. This policy lowers risk premiums, increases spaces for private sector lending and strengthens the country's capacity for coping with future shocks. Starting from the information available, the Supervisory Council considers that monetary policy will continue to remain in the easing direction during the medium term and that the intensity of monetary stimulus will not decrease before the first quarter of 2018. This policy provides  4/5 05/08/22, 17:06 The word of the Governor of the Bank of Sqpiperia, Mr. Gent Sjejko in the press conference of the decision-making of monetary policy ... stimulus needed to boost economic activity and return inflation to target. In parallel, the Supervisory Council reemphasizes the need for further structural reforms towards improving the business climate, increasing efficiency and expanding the country's productive potential. In particular, on the medium-term horizon, the Bank of Albania expects a progressive improvement in loan demand. This added demand must find an increased loan offer. In this regard, the 17.4% reduction in the ratio of troubled loans in March is an encouraging development, but it should be accompanied by the continuation of the implementation of initiatives initiated to further improve the credit environment, as well as by the banks' more active policy towards lending. *** Finally, the Supervisory Council stresses that the balance of risks around expected developments continues to remain shifted to the lower corner. In the short term, the tense political situation in the country could affect rising uncertainty and timely delays in investment and consumption. In the medium term, risks are mainly linked to uncertainties in the foreign environment and the speed of credit recovery. In any case, the Bank of Albania remains ready to react? In due time and measure? to ensure compliance with its objectives.  5/5

Title: Speech at the press conference of the monetary policy decision-making of the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania
text: Questions - answers of the press conference dated March 29, 2017 29/07/22, 14:38 Questions - answers of the press conference dated March 29, 2017 Publication date: 29.03.2017 Q: Some last year's observations by the Bank of Albania have highlighted an added presence of the euro in the market, while you earlier this year have announced some deeuroisation policies, in order to promote the use of the local currency. Where do these policies consist, so how will you actually do it? Governor: yes, it's true. The Bank of Albania is focusing on this year's work, a plan of measures to deeuroize and increase the influence of the local currency on the Albanian economy. This would affect the bank of Albania's increasing monetary policy efficiency, as it is known that the Bank of Albania, through the basic interest rate instrument, affects the local currency, lek. Euroisation, d.m.th. The large exposure to euros on the part of the financial and banking system has an effect on the stability of the financial system, as a large part of the loan is still in the euro. A large number of customers have income in the local currency, while having loans in euros, and this exposes them, affecting the performance of their loan. Euroisation also has broader macroeconomic effects, and affects the cost of servating the government's debt. In this respect, to reduce the euroisation of the banking system we have taken measures, by honouring the active assets in euros and liability at a higher rate. Also, we will take some measures to recount the mandatory reserve at the Bank of Albania, defavouring the euro and favouring the local currency. There are other measures that will be taken for public awareness, regarding the risks associated with Euroisation. ... thirst-pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_29_mars_2017.html Page 1 of 4 Questions - answers of the press conference dated March 29, 2017 29/07/22, 14:38 Of course this is a broader phenomenon, which concerns not only the role and functions of the central bank, but also of other institutions. We have also discussed this phenomenon at the meeting of the Financial Stability Advisory Group and are preparing a memorandum of understanding with the Ministry of Finance and the Financial Oversight Authority to expand measures in the fight against Euroisation. Summarily, I would say that this would increase monetary policy eficiency for a fuller transmission of it and strengthen more positive impacts in the direction of maintaining financial stability in the country. Q: Mr. Governor, a question about the political situation in the country. Have you factored political risk into your expectations for the economy, and does the current political situation pose a threat to economic developments? Governor: In this report, we have referred to the reporting period data, taking into analysis the official figures, results and data we have. Of course, our model has always taken into account electoral periods and electoral years. Our model has been developed, referring to historical data, i.e. looking at certain policy and economic behaviors in previous periods. Practically speaking, the Bank of Albania's model for macroeconomic forecasting has a correction, taking into account the political situation. We judge and hope that processes will proceed and continue within normal democratic deadlines, as has been proven other times in previous years, but of course we have taken into account the situation in our model. For us as the Bank of Albania, despite the transitional periods of electoral years that occur in each country, it is very important that we have a continuation of the structural reforms initiated, which will have their impact on returning the economy to balance, closing the negative production gap and continuing a sustainable economic growth. Q: By not turning away from the political situation, you said you would do a correction. This consists of correcting economic growth? And are there signals from foreign investors of any departure because of this situation? Governor: We have no formal signals for foreign investors to leave because of this situation. We receive information from the media and have no concrete information on departures from foreign investors. Of course, if the situation is prolonged, there may also be negative consequences. Principledly and theoretically, we have emphasized other times that political worsening has their effect on the economy. Any kind of destabilisation, not only political, affects the direction of increasing uncertainty, but currently we are in an electoral year and this is an expected period. In terms of investor departure or other elements, at the moment, it is not that we have factual data based. The Bank of Albania is in constant monitoring and monitoring of the situation. In a month's time, we will have the full report of the monetary policy quarter, which will be accompanied by statement from the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania, where we will have the updated data, including ... thirst-pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_29_mars_2017.html Page 2 of 4 Questions - answers of the press conference dated March 29, 2017 29/07/22, 14:38 and the overall results and effects of the situation we have. At the moment, we are making comments regarding the Intermediate Monetary Policy Report for the first two months of 2017. Q: The Competition Authority has made a decision on the general investigation into banks after a distortion of competition. A stronger oversight by the Bank of Albania has also been sought, and the rewording of the Bank of Albania's regulation has been sought. Is there a plan for measures by the Bank of Albania? Governor: It is important that in the Competition Authority report it is not stressed that we have a monopoly situation. So in the banking system there is no monopoly situation, we have no bank, which constitutes dominance. We have 16 banks, not all of the same size, but the specific weight of each bank ensures that there is sufficient competition in the banking and financial system. Some elements mentioned not only by the Competition Authority, but also by various media and analysts, concern the revenues of the banking system. I would stress that it is a very positive element for the banking system to be profitable. Banks manage deposits, population savings, so it's good that they're profitable. But, under the influence of macroeconomic factors and risks in The Eurozone, region and Albania, banks have had a drop in profit levels compared to previous periods. This has also come as a result of the procurement of some reserve funds for the coverage of losses from loans. Also, return on capital and not net profit could be a more accurate indicator to judge on the profitability of banks, in normal terms, in the region or wider. To be more objective and clearer, the return on bank capital is at levels 14-15%, while in Albania it is at levels 6-7%. So the profitability of banks is normal. On the other hand, we are cooperating with the Competition Authority to have a clear memorandum of understanding as well as a concrete plan of measures to increase the level of transparency at the banking level. Transparency is very important. It is one of the Bank of Albania's objectives to make banks transparent, but also their customers very clear about the products and prices offered to it. Question: A clarification, so we don't interpret you. When you say you have corrected your scenarios due to political developments, do you mean that you have lowered the forecast for economic growth as a result of political developments? Governor: No, we have not revised the forecast in this report, as our initial forecast has taken into account from the beginning that this will be an election year. As I pointed out, in our model we have taken into account the historical behavior of previous electoral years, in which the influence of the electoral factor is included. We haven't made a changed forecast on economic growth yet. Muz dhe Eduk " Kreu / Shtypi / Fjalime, intervista, artikuj / Fjalime Njoftimet pr shtyp Njoftime t # mbledhjeve t Kshillit Mbikqyrs Konferenca pr shtyp Fjalime, $ intervista, artikuj Fjalime Intervista e artikuj Kalendar # Kalendari i festave zyrtare pr vitin 2022 COVID-19 Evropa # BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PER SHTYP Pyetje - prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp t dats 29 mars 2017 Data e publikimit: 29.03.2017 Pyetje: Disa vrojtime t vitit t kaluar nga Banka e Shqipris kan nxjerr n pah nj prani t shtuar t euros n treg, ndrkoh q ju n fillim t ktij viti keni shpallur disa politika deeuroizimi, pr nxitje t prdorimit t monedhs vendase. Ku konsistojn konkretisht kto politika, pra si do t veproni realisht? Guvernatori: Po, sht e vrtet. Banka e Shqipris ka n fokus t puns s ktij viti, nj plan masash pr deeuroizimin dhe rritjen e ndikimit t monedhs vendase n ekonomin shqiptare. Kjo do t ndikonte n rritjen e eficiencs s politiks monetare t Banks s Shqipris, pasi dihet q Banka e Shqipris, nprmjet instrumentit t norms baz t interesit ndikon monedhn vendase, lek. Euroizimi, d.m.th. ekspozimi i madh n euro nga ana e sistemit financiar dhe bankar, ka efekt n stabilitetin e sistemit financiar, duke qen se nj pjes e madhe e kredis sht akoma n euro. Nj numr i madh klientsh kan t ardhura n monedhn vendase, ndrkoh q kan kredi n euro, dhe kjo i ekspozon ata, duke ndikuar n performancn e kredis s tyre. Gjithashtu, euroizimi ka edhe efekte m t gjera makroekonomike, ndikon edhe n koston e shrbimit t borxhit t qeveris. N kt aspekt, pr t ulur euroizimin e sistemit bankar ne kemi marr masa, duke ponderuar aktivet likuide n euro dhe pasivet me nj norm m t lart. Gjithashtu, ne do t marrim disa masa pr rinumerimin e rezervs s detyrueshme n Bankn e Shqipris, duke defavorizuar euron dhe favorizuar monedhn vendase. Ka dhe masa t tjera q do t merren pr ndrgjegjsimin e publikut, lidhur me rreziqet q vijn nga euroizimi. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjaetje-pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_29_mars_2017.html Pagina 1 di 4 Pyetje - prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp t dats 29 mars 2017 29/07/22, 14:38 Sigurisht q ky sht nj fenomen m i gjer, i cili ka t bj jo vetm me rolin dhe funksionet e banks qendrore, por edhe t institucioneve t tjera. Ne e kemi diskutuar kt fenomen edhe n mbledhjen e Grupit t Kshillimor t Stabilitetit Financiar dhe jemi duke prgatitur nj memorandum mirkuptimi me Ministrin e Financave dhe Autoritetin e Mbikqyrjes Financiare pr t zgjeruar masat n luftn kundr euroizimit. N mnyr t prmbledhur, do t thoja q kjo do t rriste eficiencn e politiks monetare pr nj transmetim m t plot t saj dhe do t forconte m shum ndikimet pozitive n drejtim t ruajtjes s stabilitetit financiar n vend. Pyetje: Z. Guvernator, nj pyetje n lidhje me situatn politike n vend. A e keni faktorizuar ju rrezikun politik n pritshmrit tuaja pr ekonomin, dhe a prbn situata aktuale politike nj krcnim pr zhvillimet ekonomike? Guvernatori: N kt raport, ne i jemi referuar t dhnave t periudhs raportuese, duke marr n analiz shifrat, rezultatet dhe t dhnat zyrtare q kemi. Natyrisht q modeli yn gjithmon ka marr dhe merr parasysh edhe periudhat elektorale dhe vitet zgjedhore. Modeli yn sht elaboruar, duke iu referuar t dhnave historike, pra duke par sjelljet e caktuara t politiks dhe t ekonomis n periudhat e mparshme. Praktikisht, modeli i Banks s Shqipris pr parashikimin makroekonomik ka nj korrektim, duke marr parasysh situatn politike. Ne gjykojm dhe shpresojm q proceset do t ecin dhe do t vazhdojn brenda afateve normal demokratik, sikurse sht provuar dhe her t tjera n vitet e mparshme, por sigurisht q ne kemi marr parasysh situatn n modelin ton. Pr ne si Bank e Shqipris, pavarsisht nga periudhat kalimtare t viteve zgjedhore q ndodhin n do vend, sht shum e rndsishme q t kemi nj vazhdim t reformave strukturore t nisura, t cilat do t ken ndikimin e tyre n kthimin e ekonomis n ekuilibr, n mbylljen e hendekut negativ t prodhimit dhe n vazhdimin e nj rritjeje t qndrueshme ekonomike. Pyetje: Duke mos ju larguar situats politike, ju that q do t bni nj korrektim. Kjo konsiston n korrektim t rritjes ekonomike? Dhe a ka sinjale nga investitort e huaj pr ndonj largim pr shkak t ksaj situate? Guvernatori: Nuk kemi sinjale formale pr largim t investitorve t huaj pr shkak t ksaj situate. Ne marrim informacion nga media dhe nuk kemi informacion konkret pr largime t investitorve t huaj. Natyrisht q n rast se situata do t jet e tejzgjatur, mund t ket dhe pasoja negative. Parimisht dhe teorikisht, e kemi theksuar dhe her t tjera q prkeqsimet politike kan efektin e tyre n ekonomi. do lloj destabilizimi, jo vetm politik, ndikon n drejtim t rritjes s pasiguris, por aktualisht ne jemi n nj vit elektoral dhe kjo sht nj periudh e pritshme. Lidhur me largim investitorsh ose me element t tjer, pr momentin, nuk sht se kemi t dhna faktike t bazuara. Banka e Shqipris sht n monitorim dhe mbikqyrje t vazhdueshme t situats. Pas nj muaji, ne do t kemi raportin e plot t tremujorit t politiks monetare, i cili do t shoqrohet me deklarat t Kshillit Mbikqyrs t Banks s Shqipris, ku do t kemi t dhnat e prditsuara, prfshi https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjaetje-pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_29_mars_2017.html Pagina 2 di 4 Pyetje - prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp t dats 29 mars 2017 29/07/22, 14:38 dhe rezultatet dhe efektet e prgjithshme t situats q kemi. Pr momentin, po bjm komente lidhur me Raportin e Ndrmjetm t Politiks Monetare pr periudhn e dy mujorit t par t vitit 2017. Pyetje: Autoriteti i Konkurrencs ka marr nj vendim pr hetimin e prgjithshm ndaj bankave pasi ka konstatuar nj shtrembrim t konkurrencs. Po ashtu sht krkuar nj mbikqyrje m e fort nga Banka e Shqipris, sht krkuar dhe riformulimi i rregullores s Banks s Shqipris.A ka nj plan masash nga Banka e Shqipris? Guvernatori: E rndsishme sht q n raportin e Autoritetit t Konkurrencs nuk sht theksuar q kemi nj situat monopol. Pra, n sistemin bankar nuk ekziston nj situat monopol, nuk kemi asnj bank, e cila t prbj dominancn. Kemi 16 banka, jo t gjitha t s njjts prmas, por pesha specifike e secils bank siguron q t ket nj konkurrenc t mjaftueshme n sistemin bankar dhe financiar. Disa elemente t prmendur jo vetm nga Autoriteti i Konkurrencs, por edhe nga mediat dhe analist t ndryshm, kan t bjn me t ardhurat e sistemit bankar. Do t theksoja q sht nj element shum pozitiv q sistemi bankar t jet me prfitueshmri. Bankat menaxhojn depozitat, kursimet e popullats, prandaj sht mir q ato jan me fitim. Por, nn ndikimin e faktorve makroekonomik dhe t rreziqeve n Eurozon, rajon dhe Shqipri, bankat kan patur nj rnie t nivelit t fitimit krahasuar me periudhat e mparshme. Kjo ka ardhur edhe si pasoj e provigjonimit nga llogaritja e disa fondeve rezerv pr mbulimin e humbjeve nga kredit. Gjithashtu, kthimi nga kapitali dhe jo fitimi neto mund t ishte nj tregues m i sakt pr t gjykuar mbi prfitueshmrin e bankave, n terma normal, n rajon ose m gjer. Pr t qen m objektiv dhe m t qart, kthimi nga kapitali i bankave sht n nivelet 14-15%, ndrkoh q n Shqipri sht n nivelet 6-7%. Pra, prfitueshmria e bankave sht normale. Nga ana tjetr, ne jemi duke bashkpunuar me Autoritetin e Konkurrencs pr t pasur nj memorandum t qart mirkuptimi si dhe nj plan konkret masash, pr t rritur nivelin e transparencs n nivelin bankar. Transparenca sht shum e rndsishme. Ajo sht nj nga objektivat e Banks s Shqipris, pr ti br bankat t jen transparente, por dhe klientt e tyre shum t qart pr produktet dhe mimet q i ofrohen. Pyetja: Nj sqarim, q edhe ne mos t interpretojm. Kur thoni q keni korrektuar skenart tuaj pr shkak t zhvillimeve politike, nnkuptoni q keni ulur parashikimin pr rritjen ekonomike si pasoj e zhvillimeve politike? Guvernatori: Jo, nuk kemi rishikuar parashikimin n kt raport, pasi parashikimi yn fillestar ka marr parasysh q n fillim q ky do t jet nj vit zgjedhor. Sikurse e theksova, n modelin ton ne kemi marr parasysh sjelljen historike t viteve t mparshme elektorale, n t cilin sht prfshir edhe ndikimi i faktorit elektoral. Nuk kemi br akoma nj parashikim t ndryshuar mbi rritjen ekonomike. N raportet e mtejshme tremujore ose gjashtmujore t politiks monetare do t reflektohet, n varsi t ecuris s ekonomis dhe t faktorve t tjer. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjaetje-pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_29_mars_2017.html Pagina 3 di 4 Pyetje - prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp t dats 29 mars 2017 29/07/22, 14:38 Copyright  2018 Banka e Shqipris. text: On Governor Seyko's meeting with representatives of the Board of Directors of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development 29/07/22, 14:38 On Governor Seyko's meeting with representatives of the Board of Directors of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development Publication date: 31.03.2017 As part of the visit to Albania, representatives of the Board of Directors of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (BERZH) held a meeting today with the Governor, Mr Gent Sejko in the premises of the Bank of Albania. The first deputy governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Zj, also attended the meeting. Elizabeth John, Second Deputy Governor, Mr. Natasha Ahmetaj, Director General of the Deposit Security Agency, Mr. Genci Mamani and other representatives of the Bank of Albania. Initially, Governor Seyko recognized representatives of the BERZHitme Board of Directors the latest economic and financial developments in the country. The governor stressed that the country's economic growth is on a positive development trajectory and key economic balances will strengthen over the coming years. Page 1 of 3 On Governor Seyko's meeting with representatives of the Board of Directors of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development 29/07/22, 14:38 As far as the banking system is concerned, the Governor said that today the system appears with quite good financial indicators. Some of the most important issues discussed were promoting lending, reducing troubled loans, as well as the latest initiative towards deeuroisation of the economy. Governor Sejko underlined that addressing these issues has been one of the main commitments of the Bank of Albania, which has taken continuous measures, including a series of legal and regulatory improvements. These measures have given their gradual and lasting effects, which are expected to continue in the near future. The development of capital markets with the aim of further expanding the financial system, compliance with international directives in aspects such as money laundering, as well as focusing on wider financial education of the public and other actors, were some other issues that were met with great interest. For their part, representatives of the BERZH Board of Directors praised the Bank of Albania for its policies and role, which have contributed to maintaining macroeconomic stability and stimulated the country's economic growth. Furthermore, representatives of the Board of Directors expressed that the BERZH will continue to make its contribution to Albania in terms of projects of particular importance, in areas Page 2 of 3 On Governor Seyko's meeting with representatives of the Board of Directors of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development 29/07/22, 14:38 such as: financial stability, agribusiness, energy, etc. It was also discussed regarding some of the BERZH's priorities in Albania, including increasing private sector competitiveness, support in a strong entrepreneurial spirit in the economy, strengthening regional infrastructure ties, promoting sustainable energy and sound investments for the environment. During the discussions, participants noted that addressing the main challenges facing the Albanian economy, such as preserving political stability and further deepening structural reforms, remain of particular importance to improve the business climate and absorb as much foreign investment in Albania as possible. In conclusion, the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko praised our country's excellent relations with the BERK. He thanked BERZH for the important contribution it has made to Albania and stressed that expanding co-operation with it remains very important, not only for concrete support with financial investments, but also for the security and seriousness of the projects it funds. text: Bank of Albania Governor Gent Seyko attends taki... countries of Central Asia, the Black Sea Region and the Balkans 29/07/22, 14:10 The Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Seyko, attends the meeting of the Club of Governors of Central Asian countries, Black Sea and Balkan region Publication date: 03.04.2017 On 2 - 4 April 2017, The Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko attended the 37th meeting of the Governors Club of Central Asian countries, the Black Sea Region and the Balkans. The meeting, which took place in Turkey's Antalya and attended by the leaders of the central banks of the Club member states, was opened by the welcoming words of the Governor of the Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey, Mr Murat Cetinkaya and Turkey's Deputy Prime Minister Mr Mehmet Simsek.  vendeve_te_Azise_Qendrore_Rajonit_te_Detit_te_Zi_dhe_Ballkanit.html Page 1 of 3 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Seyko attends taki... countries of Central Asia, the Black Sea Region and the Balkans 29/07/22, 14:10 The Club's works were based on the various challenges facing central banks today in meeting their goal of maintaining price sustainability and financial stability, as well as highlighting the mechanisms of macroeconomic, financial policies and economic structures better suited to increase resistance to various shocks. The meeting served as an excellent discussion platform where central banks were able to exchange ideas and experiences regarding these issues. The Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Sejko, during this meeting held a presentation for participants on the theme "Optimal Mix Policies in the Current Environment: Lessons Learned from Measures Implemented during the Crisis". Governor Sejko brought to the attention of participants that western Balkan countries, despite feeling its effects on the sidelines of the global crisis, in forms such as curbing economic activity, often accompanied by a series of structural problems. Furthermore, the Governor stated that although there were debates on the suitability and efficiency of instruments used by central banks to cope with the crisis, these instruments managed to avoid further consequences and gradually create premise for the return of the growth curve. The governor stressed that as a typical Western Balkan country, Albania is at a similar stage of development with other countries in the region and that the Albanian economy is already in a positive trend where economic growth is expected to come to progressive improvement. Further during the presentation, Governor Seyko noted that from each crisis the necessary lessons must be learned in order to avoid repeating possible mistakes: "How important it is to overcome a crisis, so important is learning from it". In conclusion, Governor Sejko underlined that the Bank of Albania through exercising its role in the economy, at the same time as a promoter and regulator, has made the necessary contribution in support of a sustainable economic growth and ensuring the country's macroeconomic stability. Information on the Club The Governors' Club was established in 1998, on the initiative of the Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey. The member countries of this Club are 25: Albania (since 1998), Greece, Turkey, Romania, Bulgaria, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Macedonia, Serbia, Montenegro, the Russian Federation, Ukraine, Israel, Azerbaijan, Armenia, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Moldova, Tajikistan, China, Czech Republic, Poland, Croatia, Slovenia and Belarus. Its goal is to strengthen ties between the region's central banks and promote regional co-operation through the exchange of better experiences and treatment at roundtables at the level of governors or problem experts of the moment.  vendeve_te_Azise_Qendrore_Rajonit_te_Detit_te_Zi_dhe_Ballkanit.html Page 2 of 3 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Seyko attends taki... countries of Central Asia, the Black Sea Region and the Balkans 29/07/22, 14:10  vendeve_te_Azise_Qendrore_Rajonit_te_Detit_te_Zi_dhe_Ballkanit.html Page 3 of 3

Publication date: 18.04.2016 On 15-17 April 2016, Bank of Albania Governor Gent Sejko participated in the Spring Meetings of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the World Bank Group (BB) in Washington. Spring meetings bring together the governors and finance ministers of member states as well as senior leaders of international financial institutions. As expected, the main issue that dominated the discussions at these meetings was the further revitalization of the world economy. In the IMF Financial Monetary Committee press release, it is noted that the global economy continues to  res_te_Fondit_Monetar_Nderkombetar_dhe_Bankes_Boterore_2438.html Page 1 of 3 On the event of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent S... Spring of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank. 29/07/22, 14:45 It expands modestly. In relation to october 2015 estimates, the Fund states that the risks to the fallen direction in the prospect of the world economy have increased. To this end, the Committee recommends that stimulating growth and ensuring the financial stability of countries dictates the need for the implementation of economic growth-oriented fiscal policies, continuing accommodative monetary policies, deepening structural and financial reforms, as well as expanding and deepening global co-operation. Albania was represented by a joint delegation with the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko, and Deputy Finance Minister Erjon Luci. During the participation in the IMF and BB Spring Meetings, Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Seyko held several important meetings with the most well-known personalities of the international financial field and other senior representatives of these institutions. Among them, v from the IMF: with Mr Carlo Cottarelli, Executive Director for Albania, and Mr Poul Thomsen, Director of the European Department; from the BB group: with Mr Cyril Muller, Vice President of the World Bank for the Region of Europe and Central Asia, and Zj. Ellen Goldstein, Regional Director for the Region of Europe and Central Asia. An important meeting was also with the finance ministers and governors of the central banks of the constitution, which albania is participating in, under the direction of Italy's Minister of Economy and Finance, Pierre Carlo Padoan. In addition to Italy and Albania, Greece, Malta, Portugal and San Marino are also part of this constitution. In all the meetings above, the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Seyko recognized the participants with the latest developments in the Albanian economy, stopping at the problem and the prospect of economic growth, as well as in the developments of the banking sector. The governor stressed that the country's economic growth is on a positive development trajectory. Economic growth is expected to improve and key economic balances will strengthen over the coming years. Regarding recent developments in consumer price performance, Mr. Seyko once again stressed the strong influence that the international price conjuncture has exerted. He expressed the Bank of Albania's opinion that inflation performance in current values is temporary and soon it will return to the target level.  res_te_Fondit_Monetar_Nderkombetar_dhe_Bankes_Boterore_2438.html Page 2 of 3 On the event of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent S... Spring of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank. 29/07/22, 14:45 Regarding the banking system in the country, Governor Seyko underlined that addressing the issue of troubled loans has been one of the bank of Albania's main commitments, coupled with a well-thought-out action plan for reducing them, including a range of legal, fiscal and regulatory improvements. Implementation of this plan helped reduce the level of troubled loans to 18.2%, at the end of 2015. Another important issue discussed during the talks was also the stimulus of lending and measures taken supported by monetary stimulus policy, which has given its effects affecting the lowering of the price of credit in all segments of the financial market in the country. For their part, senior international officials praised the work done by the Bank of Albania in maintaining the country's macroeconomic and financial stability. In their view, the Bank of Albania is a serious and professional partner in fulfilling its duties. They expressed a willingness to further continue co-operation with our institution. Also, the Bank of Albania delegation had the opportunity to conduct meetings with high representatives of various central banks, among which it is worth mentioning the meeting with Mr. Jens Weidmann, President of the Central Bank of Germany. During this meeting, the so-far co-operation with Germany's central bank was praised as one of the main providers of technical assistance and expertise for the Bank of Albania. Part of the discussions was the increase in bilateral co-operation with this bank in the form of a potential twinning project, for which President Weidmann confirmed his commitment. During these meetings, Governor Seyko participated in the plenary session of the IMF International Monetary and Financial Committee as well as the Executive Forum organised by the World Bank for policymakers and senior officials. Title: Questions - answers of journalists addressed to the Governor after the session for the presentation of the Annual Report of the Bank of Albania in the Committee on Economy and Finance
text: Governor presents at economy and finance commission, Bank of Albania's 2016 Annual Report 29/07/22, 14:10 Governor presents at economy and finance commission, Bank of Albania's 2016 Annual Report Publication date: 02.05.2017 Today, on 2 May 2017, the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko, presented before the Deputies of the Economy and Finance Commission (KEF), the Bank of Albania's Annual Report for 2016. Reporting to the Assembly of Albania is the legal obligation by which the institution's accounting process for last year's exercise activity is met, as well as to recognize lawmakers with some of the main objectives that will guide the institution's work in the following periods.  ancave_Raportin_Vjetor_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_per_vitin_2016.html Page 1 of 3 Governor presents at economy and finance commission, Bank of Albania's 2016 Annual Report 29/07/22, 14:10 As Governor Sejko stressed at the beginning of his word, the Bank of Albania's 2016 activity has aimed at successfully meeting targets stemming from the "Bank of Albania" law, as well as meeting all obligations stemming from sublegal acts and relations with international partners. 2016 was very important in the direction of institutional perfection. During the year, the decision of the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania was reflected in full, with particular emphasis on measures taken in the direction of strengthening institutional governance and organisational, structural, technological and financial improvement of the Bank of Albania. During his address, the Governor stopped at the contribution the Bank of Albania has made to maintaining the country's macroeconomic and financial stability, as well as for further development and consolidation of financial markets. "... The policies, measures and legal and regulatory changes initiated by us have made a substantial contribution to addressing macroeconomic imbalances, promoting economic activity, strengthening financial stability, as well as promoting the country's European integration process." - the Governor said. The governor underlined that the easing monetary policy pursued in 2016 has contributed to strengthening economic growth and creating the conditions needed to maintain price stability. The governor said that despite positive trends, the economic and financial environment during 2016 has been challenging monetary policy, however it reacted decisively and guaranteed an economic and financial environment with low interest rates under the conditions of abundant liquidity. Furthermore, Governor Sejko introduced that thanks to the research work of the Bank of Albania during 2016, the functioning of the monetary policy transmission mechanism and the factors that help or hinder it have been analysed. In this context, he stressed that the Bank of Albania has identified two main obstacles in the monetary policy transmission mechanism, the solution of which requires broader co-operation. The first relates to the high level of troubled loans, for which the national action plan for reducing troubled loans is being built and implemented. The second relates to the high level of use of the euro currency in the economy, for which drafting a plan to reduce euroisation is the common commitment of some authorities, and the Bank of Albania is in the process of identifying measures that can be taken by it in this direction. Also, Governor Seyko stopped at one of the institutional duties of the Bank of Albania, such as preserving the country's financial stability and addressing the possible risks affecting it. The governor stressed that the main financial indicators of the health of the banking sector - those of capitalisation, liquidity and profitability - demonstrate its full capacity to meet the risks of activity under normal conditions, as well as to show good resistance to shocks. Meanwhile, the Governor stated that the main risk to which the banking sector is exposed continues to remain that of credit and therefore, the reduction of troubled loans and the creation of incentives for promoting healthy lending has been and remains one of the priorities of the work of the Bank of Albania. In the report, the main objectives of the work on which it will be oriented were also presented.  ancave_Raportin_Vjetor_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_per_vitin_2016.html Page 2 of 3 Governor presents at economy and finance commission, Bank of Albania's 2016 Annual Report 29/07/22, 14:10 the bank of Albania's short- and medium-term activity during 2017 and beyond. Price stability, The solidity of the banking system, the revitalization of credit, the supply of the market with liquidity, the promotion of the use of the national currency, the reduction of troubled loans, the implementation of contemporary supervisory standards, strengthening governance, increasing transparency, as well as the addition of communication with the Assembly, with state institutions and strategic partners of the Bank will constitute the axis of the institution's activity in the following periods. On behalf of the Economy and Finance Commission, MP Anastas Angjeli recalled the bank of Albania's activity during 2016, generally praising its work for maintaining the country's macroeconomic and financial stability, as well as improving internal governance and meeting institutional objectives under last year's Assembly resolution. In the end, Mr. The angel stressed and the challenges facing the Bank of Albania, noting also the recommendations of the Economy and Finance Commission for improving the activity of the Bank of Albania and increasing its further contribution in support of the country's economy. Title: Speech during the presentation of the Annual Report of the Bank of Albania for 2016 in the Committee on Economy and Finance
text: Questions  journalists' answers to the Governor after the hearing ... Bank of Albania's Board of Economy and Finance 29/07/22, 14:10 Questions  journalists' answers to the Governor after the presentation of the Bank of Albania's Annual Report to the Economics and Finance Commission Publication date: 02.05.2017 Q: The current political situation is continuing to have some kind of tension. Perhaps a message for the current political situation and the impact it is expected to give on the economy that businesses have appealed all along for growing uncertainty of this entire atmosphere? Governor: We have highlighted at the last press conference, which the Bank of Albania has made its estimates of macroeconomic forecasts given it is an election year. We will monitor further developments, but in principle if there is an extension of political tension, of course this would not help and affect the level of investments and initiatives and mainly consumer confidence and confidence in investments made. We're not at a moment to say an accurate figure. We are monitoring the situation and looking at the impact the political situation can have. We currently have no changes or deviations in the macroeconomic parameters we are monitoring, therefore: at the level of lending, at the level of economic growth, etc. Always referring to the first quarter figures, the Bank of Albania states that there is no substantial deviation. I reemphasize that if there is to be an extension of political tension, of course this will also be reflected in the economic climate. We will monitor the situation and publish the assessment in our reports. Q: Do you have signals from businesses that may show interest, but show an doubt, a skepticism, about the current situation?  Bankes_se_Shqiperise_ne_Komisionin_e_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave.html Page 1 of 2 Questions  journalists' answers to the Governor after the hearing ... Bank of Albania's Board of Economy and Finance 29/07/22, 14:10 Governor: We as the Central Bank make an observation on consumer and business confidence, the indicator of economic sensation. This indicator has been very positive in reference to the first quarter period. This may not match the current situation, but will be reflected when we have the data of this situation. For the first quarter, the economic sense index has been positive. Q: Do you have an appeal for the political class? Governor: I wish there was stability. Q: When you talk about reviewing economic growth, is a downward revision predicted? Governor: If there is to be an extension of political tension, of course there will be a downward economic review. Q: Excuse me for insisting, but two months have become... How much longer can this be than you think will happen, as another 2-3 months will be the electoral effects, it falls to be 5 months in total minimally? Governor: Let's see how the political situation evolves. I'm confident things will turn in the right direction. Q: The decline in the use of the euro. You have a signed memorandum signed with the Ministry of Finance and the AMF, in a few simple words, how will it be acted because it is very technical? Governor: It's technical. In simple terms, we want there to be greater use of lek in the Albanian economy. The euroisation or level of use of the euro on the territory of the Republic of Albania is real, so we still have euro quota prices and in the financial system we have a high level of exposure to euros. First, the Bank of Albania aims to increase the use of lek for increasing the efficiency of our monetary policy, i.e. to have a better transmission of monetary policy as the bank of Albania's main instrument for maintaining price stability. The second goal relates to financial stability. We want to have greater lending in the local currency, to avoid the exchange rate risk in the return of credit, i.e. to create financial stability in the financial system. For these two reasons, the Bank of Albania aims to make let's say "a war against euroisation", i.e. a gradual reduction in the use of the euro and an increase in the use of lek in the economy. This is also our legal role.  Bankes_se_Shqiperise_ne_Komisionin_e_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave.html Page 2 of 2

Me fjal t thjeshta, ne duam q t ket nj prdorim m t madh t lekut n ekonomin shqiptare. Euroizimi ose niveli i prdorimit t euros n territorin e Republiks s Shqipris sht real, pra ne kemi akoma mime t kuotuara n euro dhe n sistemin financiar kemi nj nivel t lart ekspozimi n euro. N radh t par, Banka e Shqipris synon t rris prdorimin e lekut pr rritjen efikasitetit t politiks ton monetare, pra t kemi nj transmetim m t mir t politiks monetare si instrumenti kryesor i Banks s Shqipris pr ruajtjen e stabilitetit t mimeve. Synimi i dyt lidhet me stabilitetin financiar. Ne duam t kemi kredidhnie m t madhe n monedhn vendase, pr t shmangur riskun e kursit t kmbimit n kthimin e kredis, pra t krijojm stabilitet financiar n sistemin financiar. Pr kto dy arsye, Banka e Shqipris synon t bj le t themi "nj luft kundr euroizimit", pra nj ulje graduale t prdorimit t euros dhe nj rritje t prdorimit t lekut n ekonomi. Ky sht dhe roli yn ligjor. text: 05/08/22, 17:14 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... , Mr. Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making of Bank of Albania Supervisory Council Publication date: 02.08.2017 New information obtained during the second quarter of the year shows that the Albanian economy continues to move on a growing trajectory. This performance has been helped by improving the external environment, increasing confidence in the economy, as well as by an internal stimulus financial environment, and  1/5 05/08/g22, 17:14d , Mr. gGent Sjejko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... characterized by low interest rates and reduced risk premiums. Meanwhile, Second quarter average inflation has marked declines in the value recorded in the quarter First. Growth in economic activity has been somewhat higher than our expectations, while the value of inflation has been somewhat lower. Analysis of available information suggests that both these developments are dictated by temporary factors and do not affect the direction and intensity of expected developments in the medium term. The updated, short and medium-term forecasts are in line with our previous expectations and confirm the appropriateness of monetary policy stance. This policy will continue to stay at the accommodative direction throughout the medium-term horizon. Let me explain in more detail the conclusions of the Quarterly Monetary Policy Report. The Albanian economy has marked growth in the first six months. According to INSTAT data, gross domestic product grew by 3.9% in the first quarter, reflecting the positive contribution of almost all of its constituent sectors and branches. The indirect data available suggests a positive growth, albeit in slight moderation, even in the second quarter. In terms of aggregate demand, the expansion of economic activity has reflected both the increase in domestic demand and the improvement of the balance sheet of external exchanges. More in detail:  2/5 05/08/22, 17:14 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... Consumption and private investment have increased in the first half of the year, as a result of favourable financing conditions, improved confidence in the economy, employment growth, and the continuation of high flows of foreign direct investment. Fiscal policy has also produced a positive stimulus. Although this policy has maintained its consolidating direction even in the first six months of the year, which is reflected in positive budgetary balance values, the intensity of fiscal consolidation appears lower compared to a year ago. On the other hand, improving the balance sheet of trade exchanges has reflected favourable international conyuktura, increased attention to Albania as a tourism destination, as well as structural improvements in the country's oil extraction, processing and trading chain. Overall, the performance of economic activity has been in the expected direction, but the growth rate was higher than our projections. Our analyses show that the pace of improvement in the balance sheet of trade exchanges during the first six months, as well as the size of its positive contribution to THE BBP, have been dictated by factors that are not representative of medium-term trends. Consequently, our projections for 2017 economic growth have undergone only a slight upward revision. Second-quarter inflation marked an average value of 2.0%, coming in decline versus the average value of 2.4% of the previous quarter. The fall in inflation in this quarter has been influenced, in part, by the high inflation values marked in the first quarter as a result of supply shocks and, in part, by the falling effect stemmed from the overpriced exchange rate. The exchange rate effect was most present in the fall in the inflation of import items, and - especially - of food items. Starting from the second quarter performance, our projection for 2017 average inflation has undergone a slight downward revision, down from 2.3% to 2.2% level. On the other hand, macroeconomic factors with medium and long-term impact on inflation are in line with further growth and its return to target in the medium term. So: The Albanian economy seems to be gradually approaching the potential level, reflected in both the fall in the unemployment rate and the medium-term trend of increasing the rate of capacity exploitation. This cyclical improvement will enable a gradual increase in wages and a convergence of business profit margins towards historical averages. In parallel with it, the negative effect of the exchange rate is expected to gradually be extinguished. The Bank of Albania estimates that the current intensity of the exchange rate overprice - derived to the greatest extent from the rapid improvement of the balance sheet of trade and services exchanges and high flows of foreign direct investment - will come towards fading. Under these circumstances, the restraining effect this overprice conveys on inflation is expected to come progressively towards reduction in the medium-term horizon. The picture of current and expected GDP developments and inflation is consistent with the performance of financial markets and the position of our monetary policy  3/5 05/08/22, 17:14 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... the performance of financial markets and the position of our monetary policy. The accommodative monetary policy we have pursued - through the low level of the basic interest rate, through continued liquidity injection, as well as through market information on the future direction of monetary policy - has been fully conveyed to financial markets. This policy has brought interest rates to historic lows, helped to progressively reduce risk premiums, and enabled annual growth with 9.3% of the loan portfolio in money. However, second-quarter data of the year suggest that credit performance still remains moderate. Cleaned up by the effect of extracting lost loans off the balance sheet, the loan to the private sector marked an average increase of 2% during the second quarter, influenced by the 3.2% annual decline in the currency loan portfolio. In sectoral terms, lending activity shows a faster and more stable growth in the credit segment for individuals, especially in the direction of consumer credit, while business credit growth appears slower. The still moderate pace of credit growth reflects both weak credit demand and banks' cautious lending policies. The growing cycle of investment has been financed, to date and to the greatest extent, by the use of its own business funds. However, looking to the future, the growing need for financing businesses is expected to be accompanied by increased demand for loans. Likewise, further improving the business climate, reducing the risk of credit and further improving the balance sheets of the banking system are expected to facilitate the loan offer. In this regard, the further reduction in the ratio of troubled loans in June reduced this indicator to 15.58%, illustrating the success of our measures but also giving encouraging signals for future improvements in lending activity. *** Judging on the current performance trends of the economy, as well as on the defining factors in the internal and external environment, the Bank of Albania estimates that economic growth will continue even in the medium term. In our basic scenario, this growth will be enough to put the economy in balance and will be the determining factor for returning inflation to the target within 2018. Meeting these objectives requires pursuing an accommodative monetary policy throughout the medium-term horizon, to compensate for the short-term restraining effect of the exchange rate. Under these circumstances, the Supervisory Council decided: Keep the basic interest rate unchanged at 1.25%; Keep the deposit and one-day loan interest rate unchanged, at levels 0.25% and 2.25%, respectively. Also, judging on the information available, the Supervisory Council estimates that monetary stimulus intensity will not ease before the second quarter of 2018. In any case, monetary policy normalization will be prudent, aiming at ensuring the stability of the  4/5 05/08/22, 17:14 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... the normalization of monetary policy will be prudent, aiming at ensuring the stability of the prices in the medium term and taking care not to undermine the sustainability of growth economic. Finally, the Bank of Albania stresses that it remains willing to react at any moment to various blows, which negatively affect inflation expectations or undermine the prospect of meeting its target in the medium term.  5/5

Rritja e aktivitetit ekonomik ka qen disi m e lart se pritjet tona, ndrsa vlera e inflacionit ka qen disi m e ult. Analiza e informacionit t disponuar sugjeron se t dyja kto zhvillime jan diktuar nga faktor t prkohshm dhe nuk prekin kahun dhe intensitetin e zhvillimeve t pritura n afatin e mesm. Parashikimet e prditsuara, afatshkurtra dhe afatmesme, jan n linj me pritjet tona t mparshme dhe konfirmojn prshtatshmrin e qndrimit t politiks monetare. Kjo politik do t vazhdoj t qndroj n kahun akomodues gjat gjith horizontit afatmesm. M lejoni t shpjegoj m n detaje konkluzionet e Raportit Tremujor t Politiks Monetare. Ekonomia shqiptare ka shnuar rritje n gjashtmujorin e par. Sipas t dhnave t INSTAT-it, prodhimi i brendshm bruto u rrit me 3.9% n tremujorin e par, duke pasqyruar kontributin pozitiv t pothuajse t gjith sektorve dhe degve prbrse t tij. T dhnat e trthorta t disponuara sugjerojn nj rritje pozitive, ndonse n moderim t leht, edhe n tremujorin e dyt. N kndvshtrimin e krkess agregate, zgjerimi i aktivitetit ekonomik ka reflektuar si rritjen e krkess s brendshme, ashtu dhe prmirsimin e bilancit t shkmbimeve me jasht.
