Gent Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp t vendimmarrjes s politiks monetare  Konsumi dhe investimet private kan vijuar t rriten n gjysmn e par t vitit, si rrjedhoj e kushteve t favorshme t financimit, e prmirsimit t besimit n ekonomi, e rritjes s punsimit, si dhe e vijimit t flukseve t larta t investimeve t huaja direkte. Po ashtu, politika fiskale ka prodhuar nj stimul pozitiv. Ndonse kjo politik ka ruajtur kahun e saj konsolidues edhe n gjashtmujorin e par t vitit, ka sht reflektuar n vlera pozitive t balancs buxhetore, intensiteti i konsolidimit fiskal shfaqet m i ult krahasuar me nj vit m par. Nga ana tjetr, prmirsimi i bilancit t shkmbimeve tregtare ka reflektuar koniukturn e favorshme ndrkombtare, rritjen e vmendjes ndaj Shqipris si destinacion turizmi, si dhe prmirsime strukturore n zinxhirin e nxjerrjes, t prpunimit dhe t tregtimit t nafts n vend. N trsi, ecuria e aktivitetit ekonomik ka qen n kahun e pritur, por norma e rritjes ishte m e lart se projeksionet tona. Analizat tona tregojn se ritmi i prmirsimit t bilancit t shkmbimeve tregtare gjat gjashtmujorit t par, si dhe madhsia e kontributit t tij pozitiv n PBB, jan diktuar nga faktor q nuk jan prfaqsuese t trendeve afatmesme. Pr rrjedhoj, projeksionet tona pr rritjen ekonomike t vitit 2017 kan psuar vetm nj rishikim t leht pr lart. Inflacioni i tremujorit t dyt shnoi nj vler mesatare prej 2.0%, duke ardhur n rnie kundrejt vlers mesatare prej 2.4% t tremujorit paraardhs. Rnia e inflacionit n kt tremujor sht ndikuar, pjesrisht, nga vlerat e larta t inflacionit t shnuara n tremujorin e par si pasoj e goditjeve t oferts dhe, pjesrisht, nga efekti rns i ardhur nga mbimimi i kursit t kmbimit. Efekti i kursit t kmbimit ishte m i pranishm n rnien e inflacionit t artikujve t importit, dhe - veanrisht - t atyre ushqimor. Nisur nga ecuria e tremujorit t dyt, projeksioni yn pr inflacionin mesatar t vitit 2017 ka psuar nj rishikim t leht pr posht, nga niveli 2.3% n nivelin 2.2%. Nga ana tjetr, faktort makroekonomik me ndikim afatmesm dhe afatgjat n inflacion, jan n linj me rritjen e mtejshme dhe kthimin e tij n objektiv n afatin e mesm. Kshtu: Ekonomia shqiptare duket se po i afrohet gradualisht nivelit potencial, e reflektuar kjo si n rnien e norms s papunsis ashtu edhe n trendin afatmesm t rritjes s norms s shfrytzimit t kapaciteteve. Ky prmirsim ciklik do t mundsoj nj rritje graduale t pagave dhe nj konvergjenc t marzheve t fitimit t biznesit drejt mesatareve historike. Paralelisht me t, efekti negativ i kursit t kmbimit pritet t shuhet gradualisht. Banka e Shqipris vlerson se intensiteti aktual i mbimimit t kursit t kmbimit - i derivuar n masn m t madhe nga prmirsimi i shpejt i bilancit t shkmbimeve tregtare e t shrbimeve dhe nga flukset e larta t investimeve t huaja direkte - do t vij drejt zbehjes. N kto rrethana, efekti frenues q ky mbimim prcjell n inflacion pritet t vij progresivisht drejt reduktimit n horizontin afatmesm. Tabloja e zhvillimeve aktuale dhe t pritura t PBB-s dhe t inflacionit sht konsistente me ecurin e tregjeve financiare dhe qndrimin e politiks son monetare https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_z_Gent_Sejko_ne_konf 3/5 05/08/22, 17:14 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp t vendimmarrjes s politiks monetare  ecurin e tregjeve financiare dhe qndrimin e politiks son monetare. Politika monetare akomoduese q kemi ndjekur - nprmjet nivelit t ult t norms baz t interesit, nprmjet injektimit t vazhduar t likuiditetit, si dhe nprmjet informimit t tregut mbi kahun e ardhshm t politiks monetare - sht prcjell plotsisht n tregjet financiare. Kjo politik i ka sjell normat e interesit n nivelet m t ulta historike, ka ndihmuar n reduktimin progresiv t primeve t rrezikut, dhe ka mundsuar rritjen vjetore me 9.3% t portofolit t kredis n lek. Megjithat, t dhnat e tremujorit t dyt t vitit sugjerojn se ecuria e kredis mbetet ende e moderuar. E pastruar nga efekti i nxjerrjes s kredive t humbura jasht bilancit, kredia pr sektorin privat shnoi nj rritje mesatare prej 2% gjat tremujorit t dyt, e ndikuar nga rnia vjetore prej 3.2% e portofolit t kredis n valut. N terma sektorial, aktiviteti kreditues shfaq nj rritje m t shpejt dhe m t qndrueshme n segmentin e kredis pr individ, sidomos n drejtim t kredis konsumatore, ndrkoh q rritja e kredis pr biznese shfaqet m e ngadalt. Ritmi ende i moderuar i rritjes s kredis pasqyron si krkesn e dobt pr kredi, ashtu edhe politikat e kujdesshme t bankave n kredidhnie. Cikli rrits i investimeve sht financuar, deri tani dhe n masn m t madhe, nga prdorimi i fondeve t veta t biznesit. Megjithat, duke par nga e ardhmja, nevoja n rritje pr financim e bizneseve pritet t shoqrohet me rritje t krkess pr kredi. Po kshtu, prmirsimi i mtejshm i klims s biznesit, reduktimi i rrezikut t kreditit dhe prmirsimi i mtejshm i bilanceve t sistemit bankar, pritet t lehtsojn ofertn e kredis. N kt drejtim, reduktimi i mtejshm i raportit t kredive me probleme n muajin qershor e zbriti kt tregues n nivelin 15.58%, duke ilustruar suksesin e masave tona por edhe duke dhn sinjale inkurajuese pr prmirsimin e ardhshm t aktivitetit kreditues. *** Duke gjykuar mbi trendet aktuale t ecuris s ekonomis, si dhe mbi faktort prcaktues n mjedisin e brendshm e at t jashtm, Banka e Shqipris vlerson se rritja ekonomike do t vazhdoj edhe n afatin e mesm. N skenarin ton baz, kjo rritje do t jet e mjaftueshme pr t vendosur ekonomin n ekuilibr dhe do t jet faktori prcaktues pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv brenda vitit 2018. Prmbushja e ktyre objektivave krkon ndjekjen e nj politike monetare akomoduese gjat gjith horizontit afatmesm, pr t kompensuar edhe efektin afatshkurtr frenues t kursit t kmbimit. N kto rrethana, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi: T mbaj t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 1.25%; T mbaj t pandryshuar normn e interesit t depozits dhe t kredis njditore, respektivisht n nivelet 0.25% dhe 2.25%. Gjithashtu, duke gjykuar mbi informacionin e disponuar, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlerson se intensiteti i stimulit monetar nuk do t zbutet prpara tremujorit t dyt t vitit 2018. From the other side, we have a tightening on the part of the banks, while reports speak of an amount of money or loans that are being passed abroad. How is this kind of situation explained? Governor: I stressed that lending has had a pale increase, but that has marked growth anyway. Lending growth at the end of the first quarter of 2017 was around the 3.2% level. This comes mainly from increased lending in money, which has been over 10%. This is a positive sign as it testifies to the full transmission of our monetary policy. On the other hand, the increase in lending is more pronounced in the individual segment than in the business segment. There is a sluggish, low demand on the part of businesses for loans, while there is an increase in demand on the part of individuals. This is about the overall economic environment and the business environment. We have stressed that the need for projects, stimulated and by structural reforms, is one of the current challenges. In terms of your question, we can say that lending to non-residents is related to only two banks and has been mainly in Kosovo. The decline in demand for loans from businesses has not stimulated and has led banks towards lending nonresidents, so this is not a direct factor. If there is a healthy demand for loans from non-residents, banks have seen it as an investment opportunity. The Bank of Albania has regulatory limits for banks regarding lending to non-residents. On the other hand, banks have sufficient liquidity and this has not censored the parameters and supervisory rates of second-rate banks. So there is no direct correlative link, low demand for loans of local businesses with lending versus non-residents.  Pyetje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_3_maj_2017.html Page 2 of 2

Nga krahu tjetr, kemi nj shtrngim nga ana e bankave, ndrsa raportet flasin pr nj sasi t parave apo kredive q po kalojn jasht vendit. Si shpjegohet kjo lloj situate? Kjo vjen kryesisht nga rritja e kreditimit n lek, e cila ka qen mbi 10%. Kjo sht nj shenj pozitive pasi dshmon pr transmetimin e plot t politiks ton monetare. Nga ana tjetr, rritja e kreditimit sht m e theksuar n segmentin e individve sesa n segmentin e bizneseve. Ka nj plogshti, nj krkes t ult nga ana e bizneseve pr kredi, ndrkoh q ka nj rritje t krkess nga ana e individve. Kjo ka t bj me mjedisin e prgjithshm ekonomik dhe me mjedisin e biznesit. Ne kemi theksuar q nevoja pr projekte, e stimuluar dhe nga reformat strukturore, sht nj nga sfidat aktuale. Lidhur me pyetjen tuaj, mund t themi q kreditimi pr jorezidentt ka lidhje vetm me dy banka dhe ka qen kryesisht n Kosov. Rnia e krkess pr kredi nga e bizneseve nuk ka stimuluar dhe ka uar bankat drejt kreditimit t jorezidentve, pra nuk sht ky nj faktor i drejtprdrejt. Nse ka nj krkes t shndetshme pr kredi nga jorezidentt, bankat e kan par si nj mundsi investimi. Banka e Shqipris ka limite rregullator pr bankat lidhur me kreditimin pr jorezidentt. Nga ana tjetr, bankat kan likuiditetet e mjaftueshme dhe kjo nuk ka cenuar parametrat dhe normat mbikqyrse t bankave t nivelit t dyt. Governor Seyko's word at the conference "Negative interest rates in the Eurozone and their impact on policies and in instruments of central banks in western Balkan countries" Publication date: 04.05.2017 Honored Ambassador Graf, Honorable Mr. Savastano,  1/5 05/08/22, 17:07 Governor Seyko's word at the conference "Negative interest rates in the Eurozone and their influence on policies and instr... Honored participants in the conference, I feel privileged to have the honour of opening the front of this conference, co-organised by the Bank of Albania and the International Monetary Fund, and with the precious financial support of the Government of Switzerland. This conference focuses on investigating the economic and financial consequences for Western Balkan countries, which have stemmed from negative interest rates in the Eurozone. These negative interest rates have reflected the easing monetary policy aggressively pursued by the European Central Bank, both through standard monetary policy instruments and through non-standard instruments. The agenda of this conference is extremely ambitious. It aims to discuss and analyze the implications of monetary policy recently pursued by the ECB for countries in the region from three different perspectives. These views include: financial stability, currency reserve management, and monetary policy. In recent analysis, this conference aims to create a high-level forum for policymakers in the region and more broadly, where challenges can be discussed in building specific policies, optimal reaction forms, as well as their effects. The term "Western Balkans" refers to six countries in the region which are potential candidates and candidates to enter the EU. They are Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Kosovo, Macedonia, Montenegro and Serbia. Looking at a regional perspective is useful as long as the economic structures of the countries in question have many similarities. For the most part, these similarities reflect a common background of our direction towards a market economy and the strategic objective of joining the European Union, and further into the Eurozone. These common goals represent the fundamental anchovy of policies drawn up in the countries of the region.  2/5 05/08/22, 17:07 Governor Seyko's word at the conference "Negative interest rates in the Eurozone and their influence on policies and instr... The region's economies are closely intertwined with the Eurozone, through several important channels: First, through the trade channel: Eurozone countries make up our main trading partners. In albania's case, for example, export to Eurozone countries accounts for about 3/4 of our total exports. Second, through capital flows from foreign direct investment, portfolio investments, or bank financing. Foreign direct investment from Eurozone makes up about 64 per cent of total foreign direct investment in Albania. Likewise, Eurozone bank subsidiaries have a significant market weight, in a large number of countries in the region. In Albania, their weight has resulted in decline, but these subsidiaries still represent over 55 percent of the banking industry. Finally, remittances from EU countries are an important source of disposable income and currency inflows into the region. In Albania, remittances represent about 6 percent to GDP, and most of them come from Eurozone countries. Starting from how much I predicted above, it is natural to state that the countries of the region are significantly exposed to recent economic and financial developments in the Eurozone. Let me mention some of these important developments. Low inflation rates in the Eurozone have also been transmitted to our economies, thus making it difficult to achieve our target for price stability. Since September 2012, the performance of basic inflation in Eurozone countries and those in the region has been avoided by the overall average inflation performance in the rest of the world. The synchronised dysinflationist tendency throughout Europe suggests a reflection of low inflation rates from Eurozone countries towards western Balkan countries. The degree of sensitivity of the countries of the region to disinflationary tendencies originating in the Eurozone is determined by the scale of their trade with Eurozone countries and by the form of the exchange rate regime. In the case of Albania, import goods meet about 40% of domestic demand and the performance of their prices of course affects the overall price level in the economy. However, this report is lower than that of other Eastern and Central European countries, which are even more exposed to the spread of disinflationary effects by Eurozone countries from the trade channel. On the other hand, the implementation of a modern inflation targeting regime in Albania, the application of a fluctuating exchange rate, as well as the rapid and determined monetary policy response in Albania helped to cope with disinflationary pressures of foreign origin. Beyond the impact on inflation, negative interest rates in the Eurozone income as a response to low inflation rates also had some consequences in the countries of the region. The first effect is undoubtedly positive, for countries like Albania which witness a cyclic convergence with the Eurozone and which face similar negative blows on prices and economic activity. As long as negative interest rates have resulted in the prevention of deflation and further deepening of the eurozone crisis, they have https:/d/wiwhw.bankofalbjainiha.orgh/Press/Fdjahlime_bintervkista_artikujd/Speeches/Fjaela_e_jGuvei rnatoerit_Seejko_ene_kobnferehncen_Normatd_negative_te_intere... 3/5 05/08/22, 17:07 Governor Seyko's word at the conference "Negative interest rates in the Eurozone and their influence on policies and instr... also helped the region's central banks meet their mandates for price stability. Furthermore, countries in the region have also benefited from capital and capital inflows. portfolio of Eurozone countries, boosted by negative interest rates in the Eurozone and from major financial means acquisition programmes by the European Central Bank. However, negative interest rates in the Eurozone have also brought specific monetary policy challenges to countries in the region: First, they have made it difficult to assess the lower interest rate limit in our economies, or the point of division between the use of standard and non-standard monetary policy instruments. Second, they have changed the relative returns between denominated financial instruments in local and foreign currency, thus creating both opportunities and challenges in trying to limit the level of "euroisation" in our financial systems. Third, they have lowered the investment gain of our currency reserve tools, even producing, in some cases, negative return rates. This result becomes even more important when, unlike other countries, the space to diversify the reserve into more foreign currencies is smaller. This aspect confronted us with deformities and concrete challenges to our forced reserve system, especially as it belongs to the modalities of remuneration of the forced reserve. In addition, our financial systems have been influenced by the presence of Eurozone bank subsidiaries, which were exposed to the tightening of the regulatory framework in the European banking sector. This tightening came as a result of system weaknesses that stemmed from the financial crisis. In the long run, we must all benefit from a stronger, better-capitalized and more stable European banking system. However, in the short term, adaptation to this new regulatory environment poses a challenge in itself for the countries of the region, due to several specific factors: First, it has brought tendencies to shrink exposure to countries in the region, from many European banks. Second, it has encouraged the adoption of new and tighter lending standards at the group level, which often do not reflect the particularities of each country, or market, in which these banks operate. Third, the criteria for the equivalent of the supervisory and regulatory framework have not yet been determined, which means that exposure to countries in the region is treated by European regulators and European banking groups with a high risk coefficient. All these factors affect different behaviors in business between subsidiaries of Eurozone banks and other banks originating outside Eurozone or local banks, divergent behaviour that is highly evident in Albania. *** Honored participants,  4/5 05/08/22, 17:07 Governor Seyko's word at the conference "Negative interest rates in the Eurozone and their influence on policies and instr... The conference we are starting has important references, who I am convinced will discuss these topics in immediacy during these two days. I am sure that all of you will share your precious knowledge of these challenges and I hope that all of us will benefit from mutual experiences. At the same time we have also compiled an extremely interesting social programme with a visit to the Bank of Albania Museum and a guided walk through the city of Tirana. I hope the conference is valid and the social program interesting. *** In closing my incoming word, let me take this opportunity to direct some thanks to our long-term partners and fellow conference organizers. The Swiss government, through the State Secretariat for Economic Affairs - SEco - has supported the Bank of Albania over the years through a large number of initiatives and funding for vital technical co-operation projects. In the context of this intensive and successful co-operation, they are sponsoring the organization of this important conference. I would also like to underline the extremely valuable technical assistance provided by the IMF, which has contributed to the increase in human capacities at the Bank of Albania over the years. This fruitful co-operation continues, as is witnessed by the organization of this conference or by the compiling of some of our presentations. So let me express my sincere gratitude to Ambassador Graf and to Mr. Miguel Savastanon, Deputy Director of the Department of Monetary and Capital Markets at the IMF. *** Honored participants, It is an honor for me to welcome you all to Tirana. Thank you!  5/5

Kjo konferenc prqendrohet n investigimin e pasojave ekonomike dhe financiare pr vendet e Ballkanit Perndimor, q kan buruar prej normave negative t interesit n Eurozon. Kto norma negative interesi kan pasqyruar politikn monetare lehtsuese t ndjekur agresivisht nga Banka Qendrore Evropiane, si nprmjet instrumenteve standarde t politiks monetare ashtu edhe nprmjet instrumenteve jo-standarde. Axhenda e ksaj konference sht tejet ambicioze. Ajo synon q, nga tre kndvshtrime t ndryshme, t diskutoj dhe t analizoj implikimet e politiks monetare t ndjekur s fundmi nga BQE-s pr vendet e rajonit. Kto kndvshtrime prfshijn: stabilitetin financiar, administrimin e rezervs valutore, dhe politikn monetare. N analiz t fundit, kjo konferenc ka pr qllim krijimin e nj forumi t nivelit t lart pr politik-brsit n rajon e m gjer, ku mund t diskutohen sfidat n ndrtimin e politikave specifike, format optimale t reagimit, si dhe efektet e tyre. Termi "Ballkan Perndimor" i referohet gjasht vendeve t rajonit t cilat jan kandidate dhe kandidate potenciale pr t aderuar n BE. Ato jan Shqipria, Bosnje-Hercegovina, Kosova, Maqedonia, Mali i Zi dhe Serbia. Vshtrimi n nj perspektiv rajonale sht i dobishm pr sa koh strukturat ekonomike t vendeve n fjal kan shum ngjashmri. N pjesn m t madhe, kto ngjashmri reflektojn nj sfond t prbashkt t rrugtimit ton drejt nj ekonomie tregu dhe objektivin strategjik t aderimit n Bashkimin Evropian, dhe m tej n zonn Euro. Kto synime t prbashkta prfaqsojn ankorat themelore t politikave t hartuara n vendet e rajonit. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_Sejko_ne_konferencen_Normat_negative_te_intere 2/5 05/08/22, 17:07 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn "Normat negative t interesit n Eurozon dhe ndikimi i tyre n politikat dhe n instr Ekonomit e rajonit jan t ndrthurura ngusht me zonn Euro, nprmjet disa kanaleve t rndsishme: S pari, nprmjet kanalit t tregtis: vendet e Eurozons prbjn partnert tan kryesor tregtar. N rastin e Shqipris, pr shembull, eksporti drejt vendeve t Eurozons prbn rreth  e eksporteve tona totale. S dyti, nprmjet flukseve t kapitalit nga investimet e huaja direkte, nga investimet e portofolit, apo nga financimet e bankave. Investimet e huaja direkte nga Eurozona prbjn rreth 64 pr qind t totalit t investimeve t huaja direkte n Shqipri. Po ashtu, filialet e bankave t Eurozons kan nj pesh t konsiderueshme t tregut, n nj numr t madh t vendeve t rajonit. N Shqipri, pesha e tyre ka rezultuar n rnie, por kto filiale prfaqsojn ende mbi 55 pr qind e industris bankare. S fundi, remitancat nga vendet e BE-s jan nj burim i rndsishm t ardhurash t disponueshme dhe hyrjesh valute n rajon. N Shqipri, remitancat prfaqsojn rreth 6 pr qind ndaj PBB-s, dhe pjesa m e madhe e tyre vjen nga vendet e Eurozons. Duke u nisur nga sa parashtrova m sipr, sht e natyrshme t konstatosh se vendet e rajonit jan t ekspozuar ndjeshm ndaj zhvillimeve t fundit ekonomike dhe financiare n Eurozon. M lini t prmend disa prej ktyre zhvillimeve t rndsishme. Normat e ulta t inflacionit n Eurozon jan transmetuar edhe n ekonomit tona, duke vshtirsuar kshtu arritjen e objektivit ton pr stabilitetin e mimeve. Q prej muajit shtator 2012, ecuria e inflacionit baz n vendet e Eurozons dhe n ato t rajonit sht shmangur nga ecuria mesatare e prgjithshme e inflacionit n pjesn tjetr t bots. Tendenca e sinkronizuar dizinflacioniste n t gjith Evropn sugjeron pr nj prcjellje t normave t ulta t inflacionit, nga vendet e Eurozons drejt vendeve t Ballkanit Perndimor. Shkalla e ndjeshmris s vendeve t rajonit ndaj tendencave dizinflacioniste t origjinuara n Eurozon, prcaktohet nga shkalla e tregtis s tyre me vendet e Eurozons dhe nga forma e regjimit t kursit t kmbimit. N rastin e Shqipris, mallrat e importit plotsojn rreth 40% t krkess s brendshme dhe ecuria e mimeve t tyre natyrisht q ndikon nivelin e prgjithshm t mimeve n ekonomi. Megjithat, ky raport sht m i ult se ai i vendeve t tjera Evrops Lindore e Qendrore, t cilat jan edhe m t ekspozuara ndaj prhapjes s efekteve dizinflacioniste prej vendeve t Eurozons nga kanali i tregtis. Nga ana tjetr, zbatimi i nj regjimi modern t shnjestrimit t inflacionit n Shqipri, aplikimi i nj kursi t luhatshm t kmbimit, si dhe reagimi i shpejt dhe i vendosur i politiks monetare n Shqipri ndihmuan n prballimin e presioneve dizinflacioniste me origjin t huaj. Prtej ndikimit n inflacion, normat negative t interesit n Eurozon t ardhura si prgjigje ndaj normave t ulta t inflacionit, patn gjithashtu disa pasoja n vendet e rajonit. Efekti i par sht padyshim pozitiv, pr vendet si Shqipria t cilat dshmojn nj konvergjenc ciklike me Eurozonn dhe t cilat u prballen me goditje t ngjashme negative mbi mimet dhe mbi aktivitetin ekonomik. Pr aq koh sa normat negative t interesit kan rezultuar t suksesshme n parandalimin e deflacionit dhe n thellimin e mtejshm t krizs n Eurozon, ato kan https:/d/wiwhw.bankofalbjainiha.orgh/Shtypi/Fdjahlime_bintervkista_artikujd/Fjalime/Fjala_e_jGuvei rnatorit_Sejko_ne_kobnferehncen_Normatd_negative_te_intere 3/5 05/08/22, 17:07 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn "Normat negative t interesit n Eurozon dhe ndikimi i tyre n politikat dhe n instr ndihmuar gjithashtu edhe bankat qendrore t rajonit pr t prmbushur mandatet e tyre pr stabilitetin e mimeve. M tej, vendet e rajonit kan prfituar edhe prej hyrjeve t kapitalit e t portofolit prej vendeve t Eurozons, t nxitura nga normat negative t interesit n zonn Euro dhe nga programet e mdha t blerjes s mjeteve financiare prej Banks Qendrore Evropiane. Megjithat, normat negative t interesit n Eurozon kan sjell edhe sfida specifike pr politikn monetare n vendet e rajonit: S pari, ato kan vshtirsuar vlersimin mbi kufirin e poshtm t norms baz t interesit n ekonomit tona, apo pikn e ndarjes midis prdorimit t instrumenteve standarde dhe jo-standarde t politiks monetare. S dyti, ato kan ndryshuar kthimet relative midis instrumenteve financiare t denominuara n monedh vendase e t huaj, duke krijuar kshtu si mundsi ashtu edhe sfida n prpjekjen pr t kufizuar nivelin e "euroizimit" n sistemet tona financiare. S treti, ato kan ulur fitimin prej investimit t mjeteve tona t rezervs valutore, duke prodhuar madje, n disa raste, edhe norma negative kthimi. Ky rezultat bhet edhe m i rndsishm kur, n ndryshim nga vende t tjera, hapsira pr t diversifikuar rezervn n m shum monedha t huaja sht m e vogl. Ky aspekt na prballi me deformime dhe sfida konkrete pr sistemin ton t rezervs s detyruar, sidomos sa i takon modaliteteve t remunerimit t rezervs e detyruar. Ve ksaj, sistemet tona financiare jan ndikuar nga prezenca e filialeve t bankave t Eurozons, t cilat u ekspozuan ndaj shtrngimit t kuadrit rregullator n sektorin bankar evropian. Ky shtrngim erdhi si rezultat i dobsive t sistemit q buruan prej krizs financiare. N afat t gjat, t gjith duhet t prfitojm nga nj sistem bankar evropian m i fort, m i mir-kapitalizuar, dhe m i qndrueshm. Megjithat, n afat t shkurtr, prshtatja me kt ambient t ri rregullator prbn nj sfid n vetvete pr vendet e rajonit, pr shkak t disa faktorve specifik: S pari, ai ka sjell tendenca t tkurrjes s ekspozimit ndaj vendeve t rajonit, prej shum bankave evropiane. S dyti, ai ka inkurajuar adoptimin e standardeve t reja dhe m t shtrnguara t kreditimit n nivel grupi, t cilat shpesh nuk reflektojn veantit e secilit vend, apo treg, n t cilin operojn kto banka. S treti, kriteret e ekuivalentimit t kuadrit mbikqyrs dhe rregullator nuk jan prcaktuar akoma, ka nnkupton se ekspozimi ndaj vendeve t rajonit trajtohet nga rregullatort evropian dhe grupet bankare evropiane me nj koeficient t lart rreziku. T gjith kto faktor ndikojn n sjellje t ndryshme n biznes midis filialeve t bankave t Eurozons dhe bankave t tjera me origjin jasht Eurozons apo bankave vendase, sjellje divergjente kto q jan tepr evidente n Shqipri. *** T nderuar pjesmarrs, https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_Sejko_ne_konferencen_Normat_negative_te_intere 4/5 05/08/22, 17:07 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn "Normat negative t interesit n Eurozon dhe ndikimi i tyre n politikat dhe n instr Konferenca q po fillojm ka referues t rndsishm, t cilt jam i bindur se do t'i diskutojn kto tema n imtsi gjat ktyre dy ditve. Jam i sigurt q t gjith ju do t ndani njohurit tuaja t muara mbi kto sfida dhe shpresoj se t gjith ne do t prfitojm nga eksperiencat e ndrsjella. The works of the conference on the theme "Negative interest rates in the Eurozone and their influence on the policies and instruments of banks central western Balkan countries" Publication date: 04.05.2017 On 4-5 May 2017, in the facilities of hotel Tirana International, Bank of Albania in co-operation with the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and with the financial assistance of the Swiss Government through the Swiss Secretariat of State for Economic Affairs, works and  1/4 06/08/2022, 09:11 p Celijworks conference on the theme "Negative rates of inpteresitE Eiroston and their influence on policies dphe instruments ... Conference on "Negative interest rates in the Eurozone and their impact on the policies and instruments of the central banks of the Western Balkan countries". Conceived in three sessions, the conference works were opened with the words of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko, Switzerland's Ambassador to Albania, Sh.T.Z. Christoph Graf, and Deputy Director of the Department of Monetary and Capital Markets near the IMF, Mr. Miguel Savastano. The Governor of the Bank of Albania in the opening address, held in this case stressed that our country's financial systems have been influenced by the presence of subsidiaries of Eurozone banks, which were exposed to tightening regulatory frameworks in the European banking sector. This tightening came to a large extent as a result of the weaknesses of the European system, which stemmed from the financial crisis. Furthermore, the Governor stated that in the long run, we will all benefit from a stronger, more well-capitalised and stable European banking system. However, in the short term, adapting to this new regulatory environment poses a challenge in itself for the countries of the region. Recently, Governor Seyko recognized those present with the aim of this conference, which is to identify the economic and financial consequences for Western Balkan countries, which have stemmed from negative interest rates in the Eurozone as well as the challenges of central banks to identify mechanisms that can be considered more effective than the rest under certain circumstances.  2/4 06/08/2022, 09:11 The works of conferences on the theme "Negative interest rates in the Eurozone and their influence on policies and instruments ... Governor Ambassador to Albania, Sh.T.Z. Christoph Graf during his greeting speech, expressed conviction that based on the experience of the Swiss state, macroeconomic stability and a healthy financial sector are crucial to the country's economic growth. Furthermore, Switzerland's Ambassador to Albania added that the country he represents helps countries in the region and around the globe in strengthening monetary policies and this conference is part of this effort. He stressed that a sound monetary policy supports macroeconomic stability and economic growth by fostering a favourable environment for initiatives in the private sector. During his speech, the Deputy Director of the Department of Monetary and Capital Markets at the IMF, Mr Miguel Savastano, stressed that this conference will provide an excellent opportunity for participants to discuss challenges in building monetary policies, as well as exchange their experiences and perspectives regarding financial stability, currency reserve management and monetary policy. The first session of the conference will be dedicated to the challenges facing central banks today in managing the currency reserve, in the context of negative interest rates in the Eurozone. During the second session, discussions will be based on financial stability issues that come as a consequence of fluctuating capital flows and exchange rates. The third session of the conference will address monetary policy developments under conditions of a low interest rate and the challenges facing monetary policy due to the euroisation of the financial system.  3/4 06/08/2022, 09:11 The works of conferences on the theme "Negative interest rates in the Eurozone and their influence on policies and instruments ... Participants in this conference are high-level representatives from the central banks of the Western Balkan countries, including the Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina, the Central Bank of Kosovo, the National Bank of the Republic of Macedonia, the National Bank of Serbia; The European Central Bank, the central banks of countries near the Eurozone, including the National Bank of Bulgaria, the National Bank of Croatia, the Central Bank of the Republic of Hungary, the National Bank of Romania, the Swiss National Bank, the Bank for International Adjustments (BIS); As well as academy representatives.  4/4

text: Third Meeting of the National Payment System Committee 29/07/22, 14:09 Third Meeting of the National Payment System Committee Publication date: 11.05.2017 On 9 May 2017, the third meeting of the National Payment System Committee took place. The meeting was led by The Chair of this Committee. Elisabeth John, First Deputy Governor of the Bank of Albania. In meetings, in addition to members of the National Payment System Committee as Chairman of the Albanian Bank Association and Chairman of the Payments Committee near this association, Executive Director General of the Financial Supervision Authority, representatives of the Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Innovation and Public Administration, Ministry of Economic Development, Tourism, Trade and Entrepreneurship, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Mr Mario Guadamillas, Manager at the World Bank for Europe and the Region, was also present. Maria Teresa Chimantti and Mr. Jose Antonio Garcia, from the Payment Systems Development Group near the World Bank and Zj. Johanna Jaeger, Financial Sector Expert at the World Bank.  Mbledhja_e_trete_e_Komitetit_Kombetar_te_Sistemit_te_Pagesave.html Page 1 of 4 Third Meeting of the National Payment System Committee 29/07/22, 14:09 Representatives of non-bank financial institutions, representatives of operators of national card payment schemes and representatives of utilities were also invited to the meeting. In the opening word, Mr. John, it was stated that the National Payment System Committee represents an opportunity to promote developments of various actors regarding payment instruments and to discuss projects in the future. In this direction, Mr. John stressed that the strategy adopted by the National Payment System Committee at its first meeting served to create a guide in general lines for the work of this Committee, but currently the Bank of Albania in co-operation with the World Bank are working on drafting a strategy with concrete steps for reforming and developing the payment system market. During her word, Mr. John also presented the three main objectives regarding future projects of the National Payment System Committee, among which stressed the importance of creating necessary legal or regulatory amenities and spaces with the aim of promoting the use of innovative and secure payment instruments. Further, Mr. John added that further increased security of internet payments remains of particular importance, in line with the Best Practices of the European Union. Recently, Mr. John pointed out that further increases in public education, with the aim of increasing the financial involvement of the population, is also in the focus of the National Payment System Committee.  Mbledhja_e_trete_e_Komitetit_Kombetar_te_Sistemit_te_Pagesave.html Page 2 of 4 Third Meeting of the National Payment System Committee 29/07/22, 14:09 The representative of the Ministry of Innovation and Public Administration presented the latest developments related to projects undertaken in the field of innovation related to internet and digital technology. In this context, the Ministry representative stressed that promoting the use of the electronic firm in banking services and innovative ways of payment remain of particular importance. The representative of the Ministry of Economic Development, Trade, Tourism and Entrepreneurship focused on the work done by the institution she represents in relation to consumer protection. In this regard, she stressed that the Ministry in fulfilling its mandate has taken care of drafting policies for consumer protection, while recently taking concrete steps within the framework of dealing with their complaints, creating the relevant structures. Despite these structures being found in their first steps, territorial reform and co-operation with local government have made their contribution to the sensitisation campaign the Ministry has undertaken. Recently, it stressed the importance of developing the electronic paymentmarket, a service that affects tourism development in the country. The Representative of the Ministry of Home Affairs discussed addressing cybercrime in banking services, presenting concrete cases and subtracted the importance and necessity of co-operation of actors with the aim of increasing security in the electronic field and possible measures to prevent them. Furthermore, during the meeting of the Chairman of the Committee, Mr. Elisabeth John invited Mr. Mario Guadamillas, Manager to the World Bank for Europe and the Region, who presented to the participants a general panorama of measures and projects that the World Bank has undertaken internationally. Representatives of the World Bank presented to the Committee the main results of the two payment projects in Albania and the continuation of co-operation in the future.  Mbledhja_e_trete_e_Komitetit_Kombetar_te_Sistemit_te_Pagesave.html Page 3 of 4 Third Meeting of the National Payment System Committee 29/07/22, 14:09 In the following, World Bank representatives presented a summary of the results and recommendations of projects undertaken by them in the field of financial inclusion from a payment perspective as well as in relation to the international remittances project. The chairman of the Albanian Banking Association, Mr Periklis Drougkas, presented the latest developments of the banking system within the framework of electronic payments. More specifically, he developed platforms for electronic banking by some banks. He also highlighted the novelty of second-rate banks in the customer identity verification process. For more, Mr. Drougkas also introduced innovative services offered by banks in terms of bank cards. Finally, he made a review of KKSP projects finalized by the Albanian Banking Association. Further, Mr. Anjeza Beja, Director of the Department of Payment, Accounting and Finance Systems at the Bank of Albania held a presentation on the transposition of the Payment Services Directive on the internal market as well as on the European Banking Authority's (EBA) recommendation document on the security of internet payments. The meeting ended with the intervention of guests from non-bank financial institutions, who, after pandering to the initiatives undertaken, identified several areas of possible co-operation for the future. The National Payment System Committee at the conclusion discussed draft recommendations for further developments in the future. S Annual BERZH, held in Cyprus, on 9 - 11 May 2017 29/07/22, 14:09 On the meetings of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko, during the Annual Meeting of the BERK, held in Cyprus, 9 - 11 May 2017 Publication date: 12.05.2017 On 9-11 May 2017, the annual meeting of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (BERZH) was held in Cyprus with the theme "Aiming for a green and comprehensive growth "Recognition with regional and global challenges", in which the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko, was present. As part of the participation in this meeting, the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Sejko, held several important meetings with the most well-known personalities of the international financial field. Among these are the meeting with Mr Holger Muent, Director for Western Balkan Countries, Mr Peter Sanfey, Deputy Director of the Sector for Economic Affairs of countries in berzh, as well as with other senior representatives of the BERZH.  jetore_te_BERZH-it_te_mbajtur_ne_Qipro_ne_datat_9-11_maj_2017.html Page 1 of 3 On the meetings of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Seyko, g... S Annual BERZH, held in Cyprus, on 9 - 11 May 2017 29/07/22, 14:09 During the meetings, Governor Sejko recognized the participants with the latest developments in the Albanian economy, stopping at the prospect of economic growth, as well as in the developments of the banking sector. The governor stressed that the country's economic growth is on a positive development trajectory and key economic balances will strengthen over the coming years. As far as the banking system is concerned, the Governor said that today the system appears with quite good financial indicators. Some of the most important issues discussed were the promotion of lending, as well as the reduction of troubled loans. Governor Sejko underlined that addressing the issue of troubled loans has been one of the commitments of the Bank of Albania, coupled with a well-thought-out action plan for reducing them. Implementation of this plan helped reduce the level of troubled loans to about 17.4%. Taking advantage of the case, Governor Seyko thanked berzh representatives for the important contribution regarding engagement through various projects and concrete support with financial investments in key areas of our country's economy and invited them to continue to assess the potentials Albania offers.  jetore_te_BERZH-it_te_mbajtur_ne_Qipro_ne_datat_9-11_maj_2017.html Page 2 of 3 On the meetings of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Seyko, g... S Annual BERZH, held in Cyprus, on 9 - 11 May 2017 29/07/22, 14:09 Assessing the role and contribution of the Bank of Albania in maintaining the country's macroeconomic stability, BERZH representatives thanked the Governor for his continued institutional co-operation, as well as discussed future projects in the field of the financial system and wider. BERZH representatives praised the country's potentials and expressed commitment to increasing co-operation in areas of particular interest to Albania such as tourism, agroindustry, etc. Also, during the meeting, berzh representatives discussed together with Governor Seyko, regarding the advantages of creating a joint regional market with the aim of further developing economic co-operation between the countries of the region. Both sides stressed that a broader market is valued as a pretty good opportunity to attract investors and greater financing. During his tenure, Bank of Albania Governor Gent Sejko also held meetings with representatives from internationally known institutions such as Euromoney and Finance in Motion.  jetore_te_BERZH-it_te_mbajtur_ne_Qipro_ne_datat_9-11_maj_2017.html Page 3 of 3

Ndrsa, nj muze bashkon epokat, t shkuarat dhe t tashmen. Kt e bn veanrisht nj muze i kartmonedhave t nj vendi. E bn kt modestisht edhe muzeu yn, i themeluar vetm nj vit m par e q besojm se do t vazhdoj t zhvillohet e plotsohet si nj pasuri e kujtess ton kombtare. N mesin e viteve 1800, duke shpallur konkursin e dizenjimit pr kartmonedhn amerikane, ministri i thesarit t SHBA-ve t asaj kohe prcaktonte dy krkesa t detyrueshme pr pjesmarrsit: dizenjimi t ishte pun origjinale, e papublikuar m par, t kishte karakter kombtar. Sepse q n gjenez, kartmonedha sht konceptuar jo vetm si mjet kmbimi. Por si nj mjet edukues pr publikun e si i till, duhet t mbart mbi vete nj sken t rndsishme t historis s vendit. Ama, kt duhet ta bnte me nj teknik t till t komplikuar linjash t imta, sa t ishte tepr e vshtir t riprodhohej. Kjo e fundit i atribuohej elementve t siguris si barts vlere. Ne i kalojm shpesh npr duar kto letra me vler, por shum rrall i japim vetes knaqsin e prqendrimit pr pak minuta mbi artin e trupzuar n to. Natasha Ahmetaj n hapjen e aktivitetit "Kuriozitete nga th t talentuar, duke e kthyer at cop letre n nj shprehje elegante t artit kreativ. Imazhi na duket familjar, por ama nuk do ta besojm kur t dgjojm se vetm 14% e t intervistuarve n vendet e zhvilluara jan n gjendje t kujtojn se far figure sht dizenjuar mbi seciln kartmonedh. Akoma m pak mund t prgjigjen se cili portret gjendet mbi 2-mij lekshin shqiptar apo kujt i prket portreti mbi 1- mij leksh. Pikrisht pr t ndryshuar kt kumtim t dobt t mesazhit e pr t edukuar publikun prmes veprave t artit q dshmojn pjes t identitetit ton kombtar, shrbejn muzet, shrbejn aktivitete si ky, shrben misioni i forcimit t ndrgjegjes kombtare prmes artit t kartmonedhs shqiptare. Jo m kot numizmatt i shijojn imazhet dhe ngjyrat e kartmonedhave. Sepse mbi ato copza letre ata jan n gjendje t dallojn edhe epokat, edhe shkalln e liris sociale. Sepse, shpesh, sidomos n diktatura, imazhet mbi kartmonedha manifestojn ndikimet e qeverive mbi tregjet. Mungesa e ktyre ndikimeve sht nj dimension i liris sociale. Por mbi kartmonedh lexohet edhe shqetsimi i nj shoqrie. Natyrisht, kur artisti ka mundur ta lexoj mir kt shqetsim. Kshtu, jeshilja e dollarit amerikan u zgjodh si nevoj e simboliks s stabilitetit n epokn e lufts civile. Seria e vitit 2017 e paras norvegjeze dshmon shqetsimin e asaj shoqrie pr rikthim n vlerat baz humane q digjitalizimi po i zbeh. Dhe n reflektim t ktij shqetsimi kemi zvendsimin e portreteve t figurave t shquara t artit e shkencs me simbolikat e burimeve natyrore t lidhura fort me identitetin e popullit norvegjez, t tilla si anija vikinge, peshku apo fari. T gjitha kto tregojn se asgj nuk e ka cnuar misionin edukues e kombtar t kartmonedhs. Ajo vazhdon ta mbart at duke i rezistuar edhe pr kt arsye formave virtuale t paras. Madje, si thot nj studiues i Harvardit, m par do t zhduket karta nga ekzistenca sesa kartmonedha. T dashur pjesmarrs, 18 Maji sht caktuar si Dita Ndrkombtare e Muzeve n vitin 1977 nga Kshilli Ndrkombtar i Muzeve, i themeluar n vitin 1946. Por, sht prej 1992 q po ky Kshill vendosi q do vit n kt dit t celebrohet nj tematik e caktuar. Pr kt vit, tematika e przgjedhur sht "Muzet dhe historit e diskutueshme: t shprehsh t pathnat n muze". Duke dashur t jemi pjes e ksaj fryme mbarbotrore, por n truallin e muzeut ton, ne kemi e formuluar n "Kuriozitete nga thesari: Arti i kartmonedhs shqiptare". Dhe pr t shprehur t pathnat tona, na vjen sot n ndihm z. Mark Bundy, mjeshtr dizenjimi prej mbi 40 vjetsh pran kompanis De La Rue, pioniert e printimit t kartmonedhs n bot. Me prfundimin e procedurave pr marrjen e lejes dhe njoftimin zyrtar nga autoritetet prkatse, n fund t korrikut 2016, pas njohjes me httpsd://www.ibanikofalbania.ohrgl /Shtyjpi/Fjalime_kintervista_artikduji/kFjialimie/Sqarimi _fper_publikkun_Mbi_rBikonsktruksionSinh_e_iish-hoitel_Dkajtit.html ji h 2/4 05/08/22, 17:07 Sqarim pr publikun: Mbi rikonstruksionin e ish-hotel Dajtit detyrimin pr shlyerjen e takss s ndikimit n infrastruktur, Banka e Shqipris kreu t gjitha pagesat prkatse pr Bashkin e Tirans. Procedurat pr przgjedhjen e kompanis zbatuese N periudhn gusht - shtator 2016, Banka e Shqipris hartoi specifikimet teknike pr procedurn e prokurimit t rikonstruksionit t godins s ish-Hotel Dajtit sipas projektit t pranuar prej saj q n vitin 2013 dhe t miratuar nga KKT. Pr t garantuar nj proces sa m cilsor dhe eficient, Banka e Shqipris, gjat muajit tetor 2016 publikoi n gazetn ndrkombtare "Financial Times" njoftimin pr shprehje interesi, pr procedurn e rikonstruksionit t godins s ish-hotel "Dajtit". Afati i pritjes s shprehjes s interesit ishte 30 dit nga publikimi. N prgjigje t ktij njoftimi, pran Banks s Shqipris shprehn interesin pr pjesmarrje n tender 10 kompani. Nisur nga rndsia q paraqet ky objekt, si dhe veorit teknike dhe arkitekturore t tij, Banka e Shqipris hulumtoi kompanit q shprehn interes me qllim vlersimin e besueshmris s tyre n treg, kapaciteteve teknike dhe punimeve t ngjashme t realizuara m par. N prfundim, u vendos t vijohej me procedurn "Tender i kufizuar ndrkombtar", n prputhje t plot me rregulloren "Pr procedurat e prokurimit t Banks s Shqipris" miratuar me vendim t Kshillit Mbikqyrs nr.81, dat 15.11.2006, e ndryshuar. Banka e Shqipris prokuron shrbime dhe mallra mbshtetur n prcaktimet e ksaj rregulloreje, dhe jo mbshtetur n ligjin "Pr prokurimin Publik". Kjo bazuar n nenin 76 t ligjit nr. 8269, dat 23.12.1997 "Pr Bankn e Shqipris", i ndryshuar. Pr t siguruar cilsin e procesit dhe t nj rezultati sa m eficient pr Bankn e Shqipris, u vlersuan pr t'u ftuar pr t marr pjes n tender 7 kompani t huaja. Procedura "Tender i kufizuar ndrkombtar" sht aplikuar nga Banka e Shqipris edhe pr rikonstruksionin e ndrtess qendrore t saj. Fondi i kontraktuar pr kontratn baz dhe shtesat e saj pr rikonstruksionin e ndrtess qendrore t Banks s Shqipris ishte n vlern 15.8 milion euro. Ndrsa, konkursi ndrkombtar sht aplikuar nga Banka e Shqipris vetm pr przgjedhjen e projektit pr rikonstruksionin dhe jo pr punimet e rikonstruksionit. Me krkes t administratorve t Banks s Shqipris, gjat vitit 2015-2016, u b nj rishqyrtim i t gjitha kostove, prfshir edhe t atyre t zbatimit t projektit t miratuar pr rikonstruksionin e ish-hotel Dajtit, me qllim minimizimin e tyre. N prfundim, fondi me t cilin u el procedura e prokurimit u ul n 16 milion euro nga 18 milion euro (ekuivalenti n lek) q ishte parashikuar sipas vendimeve prkatse t Kshillit Mbikqyrs. Memes of Southeast Europe at the University of Oxford, London 29/07/22, 14:09 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Sejko holds a lecture at the Southeast European Studies Centre in Oxford University, London Publication date: 13.06.2017 On 12 June 2017, the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko at the invitation of the University of Oxford in London, gave a lecture to a large audience, themed "The Role of the Central Bank as a preserver of the country's price sustainability and financial stability". This lecture was organised within the framework of the co-operation that the Bank of Albania has over the years with the University of Oxford's Centre for Southeast European Studies. Present at this lecture were university academic bodies, international experts in the field of economics, as well as master's and Phd university students. At the opening of his lecture, The Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Sejko made an exhibition of macroeconomic developments in the country, where he particularly stopped at the latest developments in the Eurozone and the region, as well as analysed the impacts they had on the Albanian economy. Page 1 of 2 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Sejko holds a lecture on... Memes of Southeast Europe at the University of Oxford, London 29/07/22, 14:09 In this direction, the Governor presented a summary of the challenges facing such situations, the two main policies of central banks: monetary and macroprudential ones. Furthermore, Governor Sejko gave his lecture, stressing that despite these developments, the Bank of Albania has been willing to make all the necessary contribution to support sustainable economic growth. Governor Sejko said that in an unfavourable international situation, the Bank of Albania has pursued a easing monetary policy and, in addition, it has paid great attention to reform in the financial sector and banking supervision. Governor Sejko also added that monetary easing policy pursued by the Bank of Albania, improved financing conditions and strengthening the confidence of private agents are assessed as the main elements behind this revival and gradual return of the economy to balance. Recently, the Governor stressed that policies pursued by central banks require maximum internal and external coordination to achieve optimal effects. At the conclusion of the lecture, Governor Seyko answered questions from interested parties regarding economic and financial developments in Albania and the region. During his visit, Governor Seyko also held a meeting with Albanian students and professors at Oxford University. Page 2 of 2

N kt proces, krahas mbikqyrjes nga afr, Banka e Shqipris do t ushtroj kompetencat q i njeh ligji dhe kuadri rregullativ pr rastin e ndryshimit t aksionerit t nj banke. Title: Governor Sejko participates in the high-level conference "Accelerating Convergence in Central, Eastern and Southeastern Europe - The Role of Governance and Institutions"
text: 05/08/22, 17:16 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... , Mr. Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making of Bank of Albania Supervisory Council Publication date: 20.12.2017 Honored media representatives, First, let me start this meeting a little differently, the last one for 2017,  1/5 05/08/22, 17:16 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... thanking you, not just for carefully conveying the Bank's work and messages. Albania in public, but also for the continued attention you have paid to the results of our monetary, supervisory and regulatory measures and policies, in improving the the country's economic and financial environment. This conference coincides with the last meeting of the Supervisory Council for 2017. At this meeting, we took the Intermediate Monetary Policy Report into analysis, once again reassessing our judgments on the current state of the economy, on expected developments and on the appropriateness of monetary policy stance. With the report's conclusions, I will meet you in more detail. The new information, taken into analysis in the December Intermediate Report, has generally resulted in line with expectations. Likewise, updating our forecasts on the future performance of economic and monetary developments has not brought about any change from previous forecasts. Based on these considerations, the Supervisory Council estimated that the current monetary policy position would remain appropriate. Our easing monetary policy has lowered private sector financing costs, boosted lending in money and helped improve the financial situation of borrowers. In this way, it has supported the expansion of economic activity and has created the preconditions for turning inflation to target  2/5 05/08/22, 17:16 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... economic and has created the preconditions for returning inflation to the target. Financial markets have been characterized by a relatively quiet performance over the past two months, with low interest rates, controlled risk premiums and a tendency to stabilize the exchange rate. However, credit growth for the economy continues to remain pale, marking value 3.5% in the month of October. The expansion of the loan portfolio continues to rely on the expansion of the loan into money, whose portfolio marked an annual increase of 9.3%. The country's economic activity has seen growth in the third and fourth quarters, although some indirect indicators suggest a slight slowdown in the second half of the year. Economic growth has reflected the favourable financial environment, improved confidence, impulses generated by employment growth and high levels of foreign direct investment, as well as the positive moment of trading partner economies. In terms of aggregate demand, growth is supported by expanding consumption and private investment, as well as improving the balance sheet of foreign trade exchanges, especially in the third quarter of the year. In response to the reduction by about 10.5% of the trade deficit in goods and services, the current account deficit decreased to 4.6% of GDP during the third quarter, one of the the lowest levels of the last decade. On the other hand, fiscal stimulus is estimated to have come down during the third and fourth quarters, although revenues and budgetary spending have been seen as marking high growth rates. The continued expansion of aggregate demand has brought an increasingly full use of production capacities. The unemployment rate dropped to 13.6% during the third quarter, down 1.1 percentage points compared to the same quarter of the previous year. However, the gradual convergence of the economy towards balance has not yet been associated with increasing inflationary pressures, enough to turn inflation into a target. Inflation marked values of 1.9% and 1.7%, respectively in October and November, recording only a slight improvement over the level of the month of September and resulting in the lower direction of our expectations. The dynamics of total inflation were largely dictated by the performance of food prices. In macroeconomic terms, slow inflation growth continues to reflect the combined effect of several factors: the negative production gap follows to curb rising labour costs and basic inflation; inflation in trading partner countries remains low; And, the overpriced exchange rate further lowers the import prices of basic goods and consumer goods. In our judgment, the restraining effects that come from these three factors will gradually fade in the future. Our projections for the future speak of a further improvement in economic activity on the medium-term horizon. Expanding economic activity will enable further growth ... 3/5 05/08/22, 17:16 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... employment and is expected to bring faster wage and production costs growth. These developments will be supported, among other things, by current favourable financing conditions and by a better expected credit performance. Further decline in the ratio of troubled loans, report, which marked the 14.3% level in November, shows that the balance sheets of the banking system are coming towards improvement and that credit risk is coming towards decline. In parallel with strengthening domestic pressures, inflationary pressures in the global environment are expected to increase on the medium-term horizon, while the strong restraining effect of the overpriced exchange rate is expected to come towards fading. Based on these factors, the Bank of Albania expects inflation to return to target within the first half of 2019. Judging on the analyses and forecasts of the basic scenario, outlined above, the Supervisory Council estimated that the current monetary policy position would remain appropriate. Under these circumstances, he decided: Keep the basic interest rate unchanged at 1.25%; Keep deposit and one-day loan interest rates unchanged, at levels 0.25% and 2.25%, respectively. Also, based on available information, the Supervisory Council stated that: The intensity of monetary stimulus will not ease before the fourth quarter of 2018. Monetary stimulus policy pursued by the Bank of Albania has had positive effects on boosting aggregate demand, increasing economic activity and gradually turning inflation towards the target; The balance of risks over our forecasts remains shifting to the lower direction. Compared to the forecasts of the base scenario, a slower rise in inflation in partner countries, a further oversupply of the exchange rate, a slower lending performance or a lower wage sensitivity to employment growth could result in lower inflation levels compared to our expectations. In these circumstances, the Supervisory Council finds it appropriate to stress that, in the event of materialization of these shocks or their potential negative impact on inflation expectations, meeting the inflation target could require an even more accommodative monetary policy position. In response, the Supervisory Council would be willing to consider further easing of this policy.  4/5 05/08/22, 17:16 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ...  5/5

Gent Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp t vendimmarrjes s politiks monetare  duke ju falnderuar, jo vetm pr prcjelljen e kujdesshme t puns dhe t mesazheve t Banks s Shqipris n publik, por edhe pr vmendjen e vazhdueshme q i keni kushtuar rezultateve t masave dhe politikave tona monetare, mbikqyrse dhe rregullatore, n prmirsimin e ambientit ekonomik dhe financiar t vendit. Kjo konferenc prkon me mbledhjen e fundit t Kshillit Mbikqyrs pr vitin 2017. N kt mbledhje, ne morm n analiz Raportin e Ndrmjetm t Politiks Monetare, duke rivlersuar dhe nj her gjykimet tona mbi gjendjen aktuale t ekonomis, mbi zhvillimet e pritura dhe mbi prshtatshmrin e qndrimit t politiks monetare. Me konkluzionet e raportit do tju njoh m n detaje n vijim. Informacioni i ri, i marr n analiz n Raportin e Ndrmjetm t muajit dhjetor, ka rezultuar prgjithsisht n prputhje me pritjet. Po kshtu, prditsimi i parashikimeve tona mbi ecurin e ardhshme t zhvillimeve ekonomike dhe monetare, nuk ka sjell ndryshime t qensishme nga parashikimet e mparshme. Duke u bazuar n kto konsiderata, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare vijon t mbetet i prshtatshm. Politika jon monetare lehtsuese ka ulur kostot e financimit t sektorit privat, ka nxitur rritjen e kreditimit n lek dhe ka ndihmuar n prmirsimin e gjendjes financiare t huamarrsve. N kt mnyr, ajo ka mbshtetur zgjerimin e aktivitetit ekonomik dhe ka krijuar parakushtet pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_z_Gent_Sejko_ne_konf 2/5 05/08/22, 17:16 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp t vendimmarrjes s politiks monetare  ekonomik dhe ka krijuar parakushtet pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv. Tregjet financiare jan karakterizuar nga nj ecuri relativisht e qet gjat dy muajve t fundit, me norma t ulta interesi, me prime t kontrolluara rreziku dhe me nj tendenc stabilizimi t kursit t kmbimit. Megjithat, rritja e kredis pr ekonomin vazhdon t mbetet e zbeht, duke shnuar vlern 3.5% n muajin tetor. Zgjerimi i portofolit t kredis vazhdon t mbshtetet n zgjerimin e kredis n lek, portofoli i s cils shnoi nj rritje vjetore prej 9.3%. Aktiviteti ekonomik i vendit ka vijuar t shnoj rritje n tremujorin e tret dhe t katrt, ndonse disa tregues indirekt sugjerojn nj ngadalsim t leht n gjysmn e dyt t vitit. Rritja ekonomike ka pasqyruar ambientin e favorshm financiar, prmirsimin e besimit, impulset e gjeneruara nga rritja e punsimit dhe nga nivelet e larta t investimeve t huaja direkte, si dhe momentin pozitiv t ekonomive partnere tregtare. N terma t krkess agregate, rritja sht mbshtetur nga zgjerimi i konsumit dhe i investimeve private, si dhe nga prmirsimi i bilancit t shkmbimeve tregtare me jasht, sidomos n tremujorin e tret t vitit. N prgjigje t reduktimit me rreth 10.5% t deficitit tregtar n mallra e shrbime, deficiti i llogaris korrente zbriti n 4.6% t PBB-s gjat tremujorit t tret, nj nga nivelet m t ulta t dekads s fundit. Nga ana tjetr, stimuli fiskal vlersohet t ket ardhur n rnie gjat tremujorit t tret e t katrt, ndonse t ardhurat dhe shpenzimet buxhetore kan vijuar t shnojn norma t larta rritjeje. Zgjerimi i vazhdueshm i krkess agregate ka sjell nj prdorim gjithnj e m t plot t kapaciteteve prodhuese. Norma e papunsis zbriti n nivelin 13.6% gjat tremujorit t tret, n rnie me 1.1 pik prqindje krahasuar me t njjtin tremujor t vitit paraardhs. Megjithat, konvergjenca graduale e ekonomis drejt ekuilibrit nuk sht shoqruar ende me rritjen e presioneve inflacioniste, n mnyr t mjaftueshme pr t kthyer inflacionin n objektiv. Inflacioni shnoi vlerat 1.9% dhe 1.7%, respektivisht n muajt tetor dhe nntor, duke regjistruar vetm nj prmirsim t leht ndaj nivelit t muajit shtator dhe duke rezultuar n kahun e poshtm t pritjeve tona. Dinamika e inflacionit total u diktua kryesisht nga ecuria e mimeve t mallrave ushqimore. N terma makroekonomik, rritja e ngadalt e inflacionit vazhdon t pasqyroj efektin e kombinuar t disa faktorve: hendeku negativ i prodhimit vijon t frenoj rritjen e kostove t puns dhe t inflacionit baz; inflacioni n vendet partnere tregtare mbetet i ult; dhe, kursi i mbimuar i kmbimit ul m tej mimet e importit t mallrave baz dhe t mallrave t konsumit. N gjykimin ton, efektet frenuese q vijn nga kta tre faktor do t zbehen gradualisht n t ardhmen. Projeksionet tona pr t ardhmen flasin pr nj prmirsim t mtejshm t aktivitetit ekonomik n horizontin afatmesm. Gent Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp t vendimmarrjes s politiks monetare  t punsimit dhe pritet t sjell rritje m t shpejt t pagave dhe t kostove t prodhimit. Kto zhvillime do t mbshteten, ndr t tjera, nga kushtet aktuale t favorshme t financimit dhe nga nj ecuri e pritur m e mir e kreditimit. Rnia e mtejshme e raportit t kredive me probleme, raport i cili shnoi nivelin 14.3% n muajin nntor, tregon se bilancet e sistemit bankar po vijn drejt prmirsimit dhe se rreziku i kredis po vjen drejt rnies. Paralelisht me forcimin e presioneve t brendshme, edhe presionet inflacioniste n ambientin botror pritet t vijn n rritje n horizontin afatmesm, ndrsa efekti i fort frenues i kursit t mbimuar t kmbimit pritet t vij drejt zbehjes. Bazuar n kta faktor, Banka e Shqipris pret kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv brenda gjysms s par t vitit 2019. Duke gjykuar mbi analizat dhe parashikimet e skenarit baz, t shtjelluara m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare vijon t mbetet i prshtatshm. N kto rrethana, ai vendosi: T mbaj t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 1.25%; T mbaj t pandryshuar normat e interesit t depozits dhe t kredis njditore, respektivisht n nivelet 0.25% dhe 2.25%. Gjithashtu, n baz t informacionit t disponuar, Kshilli Mbikqyrs konstatoi se: Intensiteti i stimulit monetar nuk do t zbutet para tremujorit t katrt t vitit 2018. Politika monetare stimuluese e ndjekur nga Banka e Shqipris ka pasur efekte pozitive n nxitjen e krkess agregate, n rritjen e aktivitetit ekonomik dhe n kthimin gradual t inflacionit drejt objektivit; Balanca e rreziqeve mbi parashikimet tona mbetet e zhvendosur n kahun e poshtm. Krahasuar me parashikimet e skenarit baz, nj rritje m e ngadalt e inflacionit n vendet partnere, nj mbimim i mtejshm i kursit t kmbimit, nj ecuri m e ngadalt e kreditimit apo nj ndjeshmri m e ult e pagave ndaj rritjes s punsimit, mund t rezultonin n nivele m t ulta inflacioni krahasuar me pritjet tona. N kto rrethana, Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjen me vend t theksoj se, n rast t materializimit t ktyre goditjeve apo t ndikimit t mundshm negativ t tyre mbi pritjet pr inflacionin, prmbushja e objektivit t inflacionit mund t krkonte nj qndrim edhe m akomodues t politiks monetare. text: Question-and-answer of the Governor's press conference dated 05.07.2017 29/07/22, 14:07 Question-and-answer of the Governor's press conference dated 05.07.2017 Publication date: 05.07.2017 Q: The industry in a press release has held the Bank of Albania responsible for not interfering with the monetary market from the major depreciation of the euro and an artificial assessment of the lec, and this has happened according to them due to the informality of political party spending during the election campaign. Were there any problems according to you? Governor: The Bank of Albania follows a free exchange rate regime. It interferes with the market in those cases when indicators require this. Currently, the Bank of Albania has not judged and has not assessed that market interference has been necessary to influence the exchange rate. We have had a lectern assessment in relation to the euro during this period. We've given some explanation, but anyway since you're asking, I'd like to explain it again. Based on the data, we have had increased euro bids; We always talk based on the official data we have as the Bank of Albania. We've had a positive activity of trade exchanges abroad. The balance of trade and financial exchanges with partner countries has come to an improvement and this has created an increase in the euro offer. We have also had an increase in the flow of foreign investment, especially for the first quarter, but also for the five-month period of 2017. Net inflows from foreign direct investment have been 174m euros for the first quarter, about 26m euros more than a year ago. Exports of goods and services were 772m euros or 163m euros more than a year ago. text: Bank of Albania Governor Mr Gent Sejko attends the cere... the occasion of the 100th anniversary of the Proclamation of the Autonomous Province of Korca 29/07/22, 14:40 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Seyko attends the official ceremony organised on the occasion of the 100th anniversary of the Proclamation of the Autonomous Province of Korca Publication date: 10.12.2016 Within the framework of the organisations on the occasion of the 100th anniversary of the proclamation of the Autonomous Province of Korca by the District of Korca, the Bank of Albania organized a special exhibition at the National Museum of Education in Korca. 2016 coincides with a historic date, that of the proclamation of the Autonomous Province of Korca on 10 December 1916, which, although short in time, was a positive factor for keeping alive the formal relevance of the Albanian state and its re-establishment. Albanian, the national flag and self-rule by the albanians remain the three main pillars of this region's activity. This event is also reflected in the collection of banknotes of the Province of Korca, which the Bank of Albania Museum presented to the National Museum of Education in Korca through an exhibition, in which the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Sejko, participated.  tin_e_100-vjetorit_te_Shpalljes_se_Krahines_Autonome_te_Korces.html Page 1 of 3 Bank of Albania Governor Mr Gent Sejko attends the cere... the occasion of the 100th anniversary of the Proclamation of the Autonomous Province of Korca 29/07/22, 14:40 Through this organization, the Bank of Albania aims to unfold the historical and cultural values of the Albanian banknote issued over the years. In this exhibition, the full collection of local banknotes issued by the Autonomous Province of Korca in 1917 and 1918 was presented, accompanied by photographic and graphic illustrations, which reflect the historical, economic and numismatic context of the time. In addition to banknotes, visitors were also able to be recognized with various educational materials of the Bank of Albania, such as brochures, information panels, etc. Invited to this exhibition were also three collectors of numismatics and philately, members of the Association of Collectors of Albania, who enriched the Exhibition of the Bank of Albania with their collections, such as stamps of the Autonomous Province, banknotes and original postcards from 1916 to 1920. At the invitation of the organizers, the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Sejko participated in the official ceremony held in homage to the devotee Themistokli Germenji and placed a bouquet of flowers in his monument. Furthermore, The Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Sejko accompanied Mr. Niko Peleshi during the visit to the exhibition of the Bank of Albania, deputy prime minister of the Republic of Albania, Mr. Niko Peleshi; Zj County Mayor. Anna Verushi and The Mayor of Korca, Mr. Sotiraq Filo. During this visit, the presence was presented with the historical context of the formation of the Autonomous Province of Korca, the general economic situation according to the data of the time and Frangu of the Autonomous Province.  tin_e_100-vjetorit_te_Shpalljes_se_Krahines_Autonome_te_Korces.html Page 2 of 3 Bank of Albania Governor Mr Gent Sejko attends the cere... the occasion of the 100th anniversary of the Proclamation of the Autonomous Province of Korca 29/07/22, 14:40 Governor Seyko donated the series of commemorative coins of the Monastery Congress to the organizers of the activity dedicated to this important event. The Governor of the Bank of Albania was also present at the solemn ceremony organized on the occasion of this anniversary, where he had the pleasure of handing over the commemorative medal "Honor of the District" to mr. Qani Dishnica's descendants. The Bank of Albania thanks the National Museum of Education Korca, collectors of numismatics and philately, as well as all other collaborators for the assistance given in organising this exhibition.  tin_e_100-vjetorit_te_Shpalljes_se_Krahines_Autonome_te_Korces.html Page 3 of 3

text: 06/08/2022, 09:11 PRESS RELEASE: On risks related to the use of virtual money PRESS RELEASE: On risks related to the use of virtual money Publication date: 13.07.2017 Taking precedence over the interest of the general public in particular, regarding the purchase, possession or possible trading of virtual money, such as BITCOIN, the Bank of Albania finds it appropriately brought to the attention of public opinion that the legal framework in force and that regulatory framework of the Bank of Albania does not envision carrying out such an activity in Albania. ... 1/3 06/08/2022, 09:11 PRESS RELEASE: On risks related to the use of virtual money The Bank of Albania has not licensed any financial subjects in whose activity to include the use of virtual currencies. Consequently, any society involved in this activity in the Republic of Albania is not licensed, and consequently its activity is not subject to the regulatory framework and that supervisor on the part of the Bank of Albania. Consequently, under the conditions of the lack of rules that would discipline financial activity and their supervision, the activity of these subjects is characterized by a considerable degree of risk and uncertainty, without full guarantees for protecting customers from loss in investment. Starting from this point of view, the involvement of everyone in this kind of activity remains an action in the individual responsibility of every person who undertakes it. All relevant, national and international factors, including the European Banking Authority and the European Central Bank, are working intensively to assess all the problems related to virtual money, with the aim of regulating and overseeing it. The European Banking Authority, as the competent and independent authority to ensure careful regulation and oversight of the European banking sector with the aim of maintaining financial stability, at the end of 2013 publishedthe risks consumers will face when buying, holding or trading virtual currencies. Likewise, and the European Central Bank has stopped at this problem and has stressed in its publicationsb2 that there should never be a sign of equality between virtual money and electronic money. While the latter is legally regulated and supervised activity as in Albania, virtual money is an activity entirely out of the eye and control of authorities. The Bank of Albania brings to the attention of the Albanian public the need for as complete awareness as possible of the latter on the risks that accompany this kind of activity. To this end, below we are listing a list of the most main ones, which accompany it: First, the value of virtual currencies traded or invested in the respective exchange platforms is not guaranteed and is quite unstable. The value of coins can be manipulated by causing the investor to face a significant loss outside its control. Also, there is a great possibility that as a result of the lack of liquidity against the side, the conversion of virtual currency back into conventional currency (fiat) will never be possible. Second, virtual money exchangers are unknown, unregulated or registered societies in a given jurisdiction. Consequently, anyone who invests his money in virtual currency exchanged by these societies will face the risk of loss as a consequence of the problems of different natures that they may exhibit. Third, as long as platforms are only virtual and without encryption opportunities, they are highly exposed to cyberattacks. Under these conditions, investment becomes uncertain and it can be attacked at any time by hackers and lost forever, without the possibility of recovery. This, as long as there is no possibility of coverage or protection, such as the fund of ... 2/3 06/08/2022, 09:11 PRESS RELEASE: On risks related to the use of virtual money deposit insurance in banks. Fourth, as long as the investment in these currencies has anonymity, it can be used by specific individuals to enable illegal activities such as money laundering, terrorism financing or smuggling of illegal goods. Fifth, at the request of the virtual currency scheme, persons need to make their identification on electronic platforms, such as through passport, retina or fingerprint scans. The application of these methods of identification on the part of the program (IT software) are not subject to laws and regulations for the protection of personal data or security standards. Consequently, there is no guarantee that these credentials will be managed safely to avoid stealing or misusing them. For all the above, we appeal to the Albanian public to be prudent and responsible in managing the free savings or liquidity they possess. It should orient investments towards financial products and instruments provided by institutions licensed and supervised by the Bank of Albania and the Financial Supervision Authority.
