text_original: 06/08/2022, 09:11 DEKLARAT PR SHTYP: Mbi rreziqet n lidhje me prdorimin e paras virtuale  Kreu / Shtypi / Fjalime, intervista, artikuj / Fjalime Njoftimet pr shtyp Njoftime t mbledhjeve t Kshillit Mbikqyrs Konferenca pr shtyp Fjalime, intervista, artikuj Fjalime Intervista e artikuj Kalendar Kalendari i festave zyrtare pr vitin 2022 COVID-19 Evropa      BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PER SHTYP DEKLARAT PR SHTYP: Mbi rreziqet n lidhje me prdorimin e paras virtuale Data e publikimit: 13.07.2017 Duke marr shkas nga interesimi mediatik dhe nga ai i publikut t gjer m n veanti, n lidhje me blerjen, zotrimin apo tregtimin e mundshm t parave virtuale, t tilla si BITCOIN, Banka e Shqipris e gjen me vend t sjell n vmendjen e opinionit publik se kuadri ligjor n fuqi dhe ai rregullator i Banks s Shqipris nuk e parashikon kryerjen e nj veprimtarie t till n Shqipri. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/DEKLARAT_P_R_SHTYP_Mbi_rreziqet_ne_lidhje_me_perdorimin_e_par 1/3 06/08/2022, 09:11 DEKLARAT PR SHTYP: Mbi rreziqet n lidhje me prdorimin e paras virtuale Banka e Shqipris nuk ka licencuar asnj subjekt financiar n veprimtarin e t cilit t prfshihet prdorimi i monedhave virtuale. Pr rrjedhoj, do shoqri e cila prfshihet n kt aktivitet n Republikn e Shqipris nuk sht e licencuar, e pr rrjedhim aktiviteti i saj nuk i nnshtrohet kuadrit rregullues dhe atij mbikqyrs nga ana e Banks s Shqipris. Si pasoj, n kushtet e mungess s rregullave q do t disiplinonin aktivitetin financiar dhe mbikqyrjen e tyre, veprimtaria e ktyre subjekteve karakterizohet nga nj shkall e konsiderueshme rreziku dhe pasigurie, pa garanci t plota pr mbrojtjen e klientve nga humbja n investim. Nisur nga ky kndvshtrim, prfshirja e dokujt n kt lloj veprimtarie mbetet nj veprim n prgjegjsin individuale t do personi q e ndrmerr at. T gjith faktort relevant, kombtar dhe ndrkombtar, prfshir Autoritetin Bankar Evropian dhe Bankn Qendrore Evropiane, jan duke punuar intensivisht pr t vlersuar t gjith problematikn q lidhet me paran virtuale, me qllim rregullimin dhe mbikqyrjen adekuate t saj. Autoriteti Bankar Evropian, si autoriteti kompetent dhe i pavarur pr t garantuar rregullim dhe mbikqyrje t kujdesshme t sektorit bankar evropian me qllim ruajtjen e stabilitetit financiar, n fund t vitit 2013 publikoi rreziqet me t cilat do t prballen konsumatort kur blejn, mbajn ose tregtojn monedhat virtuale. Po kshtu, dhe Banka Qendrore Evropiane sht ndalur n kt problem dhe ka theksuar n publikimet e saj se asnjher nuk duhet vn shenja e barazis midis paras virtuale dhe paras elektronike. Ndrsa kjo e fundit sht aktivitet i rregulluar ligjrisht dhe i mbikqyrur sikurse dhe ne Shqipri, paraja virtuale sht nj aktivitet trsisht jasht syrit dhe kontrollit t autoriteteve. Banka e Shqipris sjell n vmendjen e publikut shqiptar nevojn pr nj ndrgjegjsim sa m t plot t ktij t fundit mbi rreziqet q shoqrojn kt lloj veprimtarie. Pr kt qllim, m posht po rendisim nj list me ato m kryesoret, q e shoqrojn: S pari, vlera e monedhave virtuale t tregtuara apo investuara n platformat prkatse t kmbimit nuk sht e garantuar dhe sht mjaft e paqndrueshme. Vlera e monedhave mund t manipulohet duke br q investuesi t prballet me nj humbje t konsiderueshme jasht kontrollit t tij. Gjithashtu, ka nj mundsi t madhe q si pasoj e mungess s likuiditetit t kundr pals, t mos mundsohet asnjher konvertimi i monedhs virtuale srish n monedh konvencionale (fiat). S dyti, kmbyesit e paras virtuale jan shoqri t panjohura, t parregulluara apo regjistruara n nj juridiksion t caktuar. Pr rrjedhoj, kushdo q investon parat e tij n monedh virtuale t kmbyera nga kto shoqri, do t prballet me rrezikun e humbjes si rrjedhoj e problemeve t natyrave t ndryshme q ato mund t shfaqin. S treti, pr sa koh platformat jan vetm virtuale dhe pa mundsi enkriptimi, ato jan mjaft t ekspozuara ndaj sulmeve kibernetike. N kto kushte, investimi bhet i pasigurt dhe ai mund t sulmohet n do koh nga hackers dhe t humbas prgjithmon, pa pasur mundsi rikuperimi. Kjo, prsa koh nuk ka asnj mundsi mbulimi apo mbrojtjeje, si sht pr shembull fondi i https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/DEKLARAT_P_R_SHTYP_Mbi_rreziqet_ne_lidhje_me_perdorimin_e_par 2/3 06/08/2022, 09:11 DEKLARAT PR SHTYP: Mbi rreziqet n lidhje me prdorimin e paras virtuale sigurimit t depozitave n banka. S katrti, pr sa koh investimi n kto monedha ka anonimat, ai mund t prdoret nga individ t caktuar edhe pr t mundsuar aktivitete t jashtligjshme si pastrim parash, financim terrorizmi apo kontraband mallrash t paligjshme. S pesti, me krkes t skems s monedhs virtuale, nevojitet q personat t bjn identifikimin e tyre n platformat elektronike, si pr shembull nprmjet skanimit t pasaports, t retins apo t gjurmve t gishtrinjve. Aplikimi i ktyre mnyrave t identifikimit nga ana e programit (IT software) nuk jan subjekt i ligjeve dhe rregullave pr mbrojtjen e t dhnave personale apo t standardeve t siguris. Pr rrjedhoj, nuk ka asnj garanci q kto kredenciale do t administrohen n mnyr t sigurt pr t shmangur vjedhjen apo keqprdorimin e tyre. Pr gjith sa m sipr, i bjm apel publikut shqiptar q t tregohet i matur dhe i prgjegjshm n administrimin e kursimeve apo likuiditeteve t lira q zotron. Ai duhet t'i orientoj investimet drejt produkteve dhe instrumenteve financiare t ofruara nga institucione t licencuara dhe t mbikqyrura nga Banka e Shqipris dhe Autoriteti i Mbikqyrjes Financiare. Banka e Shqipris, duke mirkuptuar transformimin e madh q vjen nga teknologjia e informacionit, shpreh angazhimin e saj pr t informuar n vazhdimsi publikun shqiptar n lidhje me risit e paras virtuale, si dhe rregullimin dhe administrimin e rreziqeve q shoqrojn kt produkt. https://www.eba.europa.eu/documents/10180/598344/EBA Warning on Virtual Currencies.pdf http://www.ecb.europa.eu/pub/pdf/other/virtualcurrencyschemes201210en.pdf Copyright  2018 Banka e Shqipris. Muz and Eduk " Head / Press / Speeches, interviews, articles / Speeches  hqiperise_te_Rezolutes_per_nje_Zhvillim_Global_te_Qendrueshem.html Page 1 of 2 On the Bank of Albania's signing of the Resolution for A Sustainable Global Development 29/07/22, 14:06 Press releases Notices of # meetings of Council Supervisor Press conference Speeches, interview articles Speeches Interview of articles Calendars # Official holiday calendar for 2022 COVID-19 Europe # On the Bank of Albania's signing of the Resolution for A Sustainable Global Development Publication date: 20.07.2017 On 13-14 July 2017 in the city of Karlsruhe, Germany, the 7th Conference for Sustainable Financial Development was held in support of United Nations resolutions regarding the "Goals of a Sustainable Development" and the Paris Climate Agreement, in which the Bank of Albania was also represented. At the conference, 200 delegates from 30 different countries participated, including personalities and representatives of international financial institutions as well as banks, microfinance institutions, among them the Executive Director of the European Organisation for Sustainable Development, Secretary-General of the Organization for the Development of Financial Institutions in Asia and the Pacific, Secretary of the African Organization for the Development of Financial Institutions, as well as the representative of the Federal Ministry for Economic Development and Co-operation of Germany, Mayor of the city of Karlsruhe, etc. Conference delegates signed an official ceremony organized at the Karlsruhe Municipality on 13 July 2017, a Resolution regarding sustainable development goals called the Karlsruhe Resolution. The resolution highlights the important role of the financial services industry for achieving agenda 2030 aspirations such as, among other things, financing and investing projects within the framework of the implementation of the United Nations-backed Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Climate Agreement (COP21); appeal for the creation of policy frameworks that promote investments in innovation, which would contribute to the creation of a green, inclusive and sustainable economy; and appeal for joint action at global level to ensure equal playing conditions for all players in the financial sector.  hqiperise_te_Rezolutes_per_nje_Zhvillim_Global_te_Qendrueshem.html Page 2 of 2

N konferenc morn pjes 200 delegat nga 30 vende t ndryshme, prfshir personalitete dhe prfaqsues t institucioneve financiare ndrkombtare si dhe t bankave, institucioneve t mikrofinancs, ndr to Drejtori Ekzekutiv i Organizats Evropiane pr nj Zhvillim t Qndrueshm, Sekretari i Prgjithshm i Organizats pr Zhvillimin e Institucioneve Financiare n Azi dhe Paqsor, Sekretari i Organizats Afrikane t Zhvillimit t Institucioneve Financiare, si dhe prfaqsuesi i Ministris Federale pr Zhvillimin dhe Bashkpunimin Ekonomik t Gjermanis, Kryetari i Bashkis s qytetit Karlsruhe, etj. Rezoluta thekson rolin e rndsishm t industris s shrbimeve financiare pr arritjen e aspiratave t Axhends 2030 t tilla si, ndr t tjera, financimin dhe investimin e projekteve n kuadr t zbatimit t Objektivave pr Zhvillim t Qndrueshm, mbshtetur nga Kombet e Bashkuara, dhe t Marrveshjes s Parisit pr Klimn (COP21); apeli pr krijimin e kuadrit t politikave q nxisin investimet n inovacion, t cilat do t kontribuonin n krijimin e nj ekonomie t gjelbr, prfshirse dhe t qndrueshme; dhe apeli pr veprim t prbashkt n nivel global pr t siguruar kushte t barabarta loje pr t gjith lojtart n sektorin financiar. text: Tomorrow, Governor Seyko's press conference on monetary policy decision-making 29/07/22, 14:06 Tomorrow, Governor Seyko's press conference on monetary policy decision-making Publication date: 01.08.2017 Tomorrow, dated 02.08.2017, the next meeting of the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania on monetary policy decision-making will take place, according to the calendar published on our website. Title: Speech at the press conference of the monetary policy decision-making of the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania
text: 05/08/22, 17:15 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... , Mr. Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making of Bank of Albania Supervisory Council Publication date: 03.10.2017 Analysis of available data shows that economic activity in the country has seen improvement, while inflation has marked declines in the months of July and August. The divergence between the performance of economic activity and inflation performance seems to reflect the effect of the shocks of  1/4 05/08/22, 17:15 , Mr Gent Sejko at the conference of the decision-making of the pgolithic monetary ... supply, which is expected to have only a short-term impact on inflation. On the other hand, conditions monetary and financial remain stimulating, supporting growth in demand, improving further scale of capacity exploitation and return of inflation to target within medium-term period. In a more detailed analysis, annual inflation marked declines in the first two months of the third quarter, marking value 1.6% in the month of August. The fall in inflation in this period reflected the reduction in food inflation, and especially raw food, while other groups showed no visible fluctuations. Taking into account new developments in inflation, our projection for 2017 average inflation has undergone a slight downward revision, down from 2.2% to 2.1% level. The concentration of falling inflation in particular segments of the basket, as well as the correlation of this decline with food inflation dynamics in the region, with the overpriced exchange rate and increasing domestic supply for these products, leads us to think that slowing inflation reflects the action of short-term supply shocks. In contrast to these shocks, the overall balance of factors with more long-term impact on inflation does not present itself as changed: (i) the rate of capacity exploitation has come to an increase; (ii) inflation expectations remain relatively stable; and, (iii) inflation in partner countries is forecast to mark its rise in the future.  2/4 05/08/22, 17:15 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... Economic activity in the country has continued to increase during the second and third quarters of the year. Based on INSTAT data, economic growth scored 4.06% in the second quarter. It has found support in both domestic demand and foreign demand. - Rising employment and incomes, improving financing conditions and improving confidence in the manufacturing sectors have supported the expansion of consumption and private investment. - Fiscal policy has been able to pursue a consolidating course, expressed in positive values of the budgetary balance. At the end of August, the budgetbalance resulted in a suffice of 0.1 billion dollars, reflecting the annual increase with 6.7% of public income and 12.4% of budgetary spending. However, softening the speed of fiscal consolidation compared to last year has generated positive momentum in the increase in aggregate demand, especially in the first six months of the year. - Finally, improving foreign economies and increased attention to Albania as a tourism destination has increased demand for Albanian exports of goods and services during the first eight months of 2017. The increase in aggregate demand has brought a fuller exploitation of production capacities in the country. According to INSTAT data, employment continues to mark increases, while the unemployment rate dropped to 13.9% in the second quarter. Likewise, data obtained from the survey of businesses and consumers suggest that the rate of exploitation of businesses' productive capacities has come to an increase, although this indicator still remains below historically high levels. In all, the Bank of Albania states that the Albanian economy continues to operate below potential, but this gap has come to a narrowing. Financial markets operate calmly, and interest rates and financing conditions support meeting our target. The easing monetary policy pursued by the Bank of Albania has played a crucial role in this direction. The conveyance of monetary stimulus in the financial market is reflected in low interest rate levels and reduced risk premiums. These developments have eased the costs of serving existing loans and boosted credit growth in money. In annual terms, the loan to the private sector increased by 3.1% in the month of August, supported almost entirely by the 9.6% annual increase in the loan portfolio in money. Indicators of the health of the banking system have improved. They show satisfactory levels of capitalization and liquidity, as well as declining levels of troubled loans. Measures taken to reduce troubled loans have caused their ratio to total credit to drop to 15.14% in August, the lowest level since 2011. The index of troubled loans is declining for almost all banks in the system and reflects not only the regulatory obligation to wipe them out, but also the write-off of loans from the private sector. Improved bank system balances, perceived reduction in credit risk, as well as further business climate improvements are expected to affect a better bank loan offer in the medium term. Along with the expected growth in loan demand, these developments are expected to be reflected in a faster increase in lending in the future. ***  3/4 05/08/22, 17:15 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... The update of short-term analysis and forecasts is in line with our previous expectations for economic and monetary developments in the medium term. Slowing inflation in the past two months does not create significant deviations in its expected trajectory in the future. The return of the economy to potential and gradual absorption of untapped capacities is expected to be accompanied by gradual inflation growth. The latter is expected to return to target within 2018. *** Expected economic and monetary developments suggest that the current monetary policy position is appropriate. Meeting the inflation target requires pursuing an accommodative monetary policy over the medium-term horizon, to compensate for the short-term restraining effect of the exchange rate and to support economic growth. Under these circumstances, the Supervisory Council decided: Keep the basic interest rate unchanged at 1.25%; Keep the deposit and one-day loan interest rate unchanged, at levels 0.25% and 2.25%, respectively. Judging on the information available, the Supervisory Council estimates that the intensity of monetary stimulus will not ease before the second quarter of 2018. In any case, the normalization of monetary policy will be prudent, aiming at ensuring price stability in the medium term and taking care to support the sustainability of economic growth. Also, in response to continued supply-to-inflation shocks as well as reflecting on the shift down the balance of risks, the Supervisory Council stresses that it remains willing to take all necessary measures to ensure the sustainable return of inflation to the target within a reasonable time horizon. Depending on the intensity of the blows or materialization of various risks, these measures may range from a slower normalization of possible increasing monetary policy of monetary stimulus intensity.  4/4

Nga ana tjetr, kushtet monetare dhe financiare mbeten stimuluese, duke mbshtetur rritjen e krkess, prmirsimin e mtejshm t shkalls s shfrytzimit t kapaciteteve dhe kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv brenda periudhs afatmesme. Rnia e inflacionit n kt periudh pasqyroi reduktimin e inflacionit t ushqimeve, dhe veanrisht t ushqimeve t paprpunuara, ndrkoh q grupet e tjera nuk shfaqn luhatje t dukshme. Duke marr parasysh zhvillimet e reja n inflacion, projeksioni yn pr inflacionin mesatar t vitit 2017 ka psuar nj rishikim t leht pr posht, nga niveli 2.2% n nivelin 2.1%. Prqendrimi i rnies s inflacionit n segmente t veanta t shports, si dhe korrelacioni i ksaj rnieje me dinamikat e inflacionit t ushqimeve n rajon, me kursin e mbimuar t kmbimit dhe me rritjen e oferts vendase pr kto produkte, na shtyn t mendojm se ngadalsimi i inflacionit pasqyron veprimin e goditjeve afatshkurtra t oferts. Prkundrejt ktyre goditjeve, balanca e prgjithshme e faktorve me ndikim m afatgjat n inflacion nuk paraqitet e ndryshuar: (i) shkalla e shfrytzimit t kapaciteteve ka ardhur n rritje; (ii) pritjet pr inflacionin mbeten relativisht t qndrueshme; dhe, (iii) inflacioni n vendet partnere parashikohet t shnoj rritje t tij n t ardhmen. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_z_Gent_Sejko_ne_konf 2/4 05/08/22, 17:15 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp t vendimmarrjes s politiks monetare  Aktiviteti ekonomik n vend ka vazhduar t rritet gjat tremujorit t dyt dhe t tret t vitit. Bazuar tek t dhnat e INSTAT-it, rritja ekonomike shnoi vlern 4.06% n tremujorin e dyt. Ajo ka gjetur mbshtetje si n krkesn e brendshme ashtu dhe n krkesn e huaj. - Rritja e punsimit dhe e t ardhurave, prmirsimi i kushteve t financimit dhe prmirsimi i besimit n sektort prodhues, kan mbshtetur zgjerimin e konsumit dhe t investimeve private. - Politika fiskale ka vijuar t ndjek nj kurs konsolidues, t shprehur n vlera pozitive t balancs buxhetore. N fund t muajit gusht, balanca buxhetore rezultoi me nj suficit prej 0.1 miliard leksh, duke pasqyruar rritjen vjetore me 6.7% t t ardhurave publike dhe me 12.4% t shpenzimeve buxhetore. Megjithat, zbutja e shpejtsis s konsolidimit fiskal krahasuar me vitin e kaluar, ka gjeneruar impuls pozitiv n rritjen e krkess agregate, veanrisht n gjashtmujorin e par t vitit. - S fundi, prmirsimi i ekonomive t huaja dhe vmendja e rritur ndaj Shqipris si destinacion turizmi, ka rritur krkesn pr eksportet shqiptare t mallrave dhe shrbimeve prgjat tet muajve t par t vitit 2017. Rritja e krkess agregate ka sjell nj shfrytzim m t plot t kapaciteteve prodhuese n vend. Sipas t dhnave t INSTAT-it, punsimi vazhdon t shnoj rritje, ndrsa norma e papunsis zbriti n nivelin 13.9% n tremujorin e dyt. Po kshtu, t dhnat e prftuara nga vrojtimi i bizneseve dhe i konsumatorve sugjerojn se shkalla e shfrytzimit t kapaciteteve prodhuese t bizneseve ka ardhur n rritje, ndonse ky tregues mbetet ende posht niveleve t larta historike. N trsi, Banka e Shqipris konstaton se ekonomia shqiptare vazhdon t operoj posht potencialit, por ky hendek ka ardhur duke u ngushtuar. Tregjet financiare operojn t qeta dhe normat e interesit e kushtet e financimit mbshtesin prmbushjen e objektivit ton. Politika monetare lehtsuese e ndjekur nga Banka e Shqipris ka luajtur nj rol vendimtar n kt drejtim. Prcjellja e stimulit monetar n tregun financiar sht reflektuar n nivele t ulta t normave t interesit dhe n prime t reduktuara rreziku. Kto zhvillime kan lehtsuar kostot e shrbimit t kredive ekzistuese dhe kan nxitur rritjen e kredis n lek. N terma vjetor, kredia pr sektorin privat u rrit me 3.1% n muajin gusht, e mbshtetur pothuaj trsisht nga rritja vjetore prej 9.6% e portofolit t kredis n lek. Treguesit e shndetit t sistemit bankar jan prmirsuar. Ato evidentojn nivele t knaqshme kapitalizimi dhe likuiditeti, si dhe rnie t nivelit t kredive me probleme. Masat e marra pr reduktimin e kredive me probleme kan br q raporti i tyre ndaj kredis totale t zbres n 15.14% n muajin gusht, niveli m i ult ky i shnuar q prej vitit 2011. Treguesi i kredive me probleme sht n rnie pr pothuajse t gjitha bankat e sistemit dhe reflekton jo vetm detyrimin rregullator pr fshirjen e tyre, por edhe shlyerjen e kredive nga sektori privat. Prmirsimi i bilanceve t sistemit bankar, reduktimi i perceptuar i rrezikut t kreditit si dhe prmirsimet e mtejshme t klims s biznesit, pritet t ndikojn n nj ofert m t mir t kredis bankare n afatin e mesm. S bashku me gjallrimin e pritur t krkess pr kredi, kto zhvillime pritet t pasqyrohen n nj rritje m t shpejt t kreditimit n t ardhmen. *** https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_z_Gent_Sejko_ne_konf 3/4 05/08/22, 17:15 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp t vendimmarrjes s politiks monetare  Prditsimi i analizs dhe i parashikimeve afatshkurtra sht n linj me pritjet tona t mparshme pr zhvillimet ekonomike dhe monetare n afatin e mesm. Ngadalsimi i inflacionit n dy muajt e fundit nuk krijon shmangie t rndsishme n trajektoren e pritur t tij n t ardhmen. Kthimi i ekonomis n potencial dhe absorbimi gradual i kapaciteteve t pashfrytzuara, pritet t shoqrohet me rritjen graduale t inflacionit. Ky i fundit pritet t kthehet n objektiv brenda vitit 2018. *** Zhvillimet e pritura ekonomike dhe monetare sugjerojn se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare sht i prshtatshm. Prmbushja e objektivit t inflacionit krkon ndjekjen e nj politike monetare akomoduese gjat horizontit afatmesm, pr t kompensuar efektin afatshkurtr frenues t kursit t kmbimit dhe pr t mbshtetur rritjen ekonomike. N kto rrethana, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi: T mbaj t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 1.25%; T mbaj t pandryshuar normn e interesit t depozits dhe t kredis njditore, respektivisht n nivelet 0.25% dhe 2.25%. Duke gjykuar mbi informacionin e disponuar, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlerson se intensiteti i stimulit monetar nuk do t zbutet prpara tremujorit t dyt t vitit 2018. N do rast, normalizimi i politiks monetare do t jet i matur, duke synuar garantimin e stabilitetit t mimeve n afatin e mesm dhe duke u kujdesur t mbshtes qndrueshmrin e rritjes ekonomike. Gjithashtu, n prgjigje t goditjeve t vazhduara t oferts n inflacion si dhe duke reflektuar mbi zhvendosjen pr posht t balancs s rreziqeve, Kshilli Mbikqyrs thekson se ai mbetet i gatshm t marr t gjitha masat e nevojshme pr t garantuar kthimin e qndrueshm t inflacionit n objektiv, brenda nj horizonti kohor t arsyeshm. N varsi t intensitetit t goditjeve apo materializimit t rreziqeve t ndryshme, kto masa mund t shkojn nga nj normalizim m i ngadalt i politiks monetare n rritje t mundshme t intensitetit t stimulit monetar. text: 05/08/22, 17:15 Workshop "Factoring in Albania" Workshop "Factoring in Albania" Publication date: 05.09.2017 On 5 September 2017, the Bank of Albania organised the "Factoringu in Albania" workshop, in co-operation with the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (BERK). Representatives of the Bank of Albania, BERK, commercial banks, non-bank financial institutions, etc. attended the workshop. The purpose of this workshop was to help banks and financial institutions to be aware 1/3 05/08/22, 17:15 Workshop "Factoring in Albania" for the advantages of expanding factoring service in Albania, as an opportunity to finance business, especially small and medium-sized enterprises. The factoring service is part of the Albanian financial system. The Bank of Albania's regulatory framework allows the licensing of banks or nonbank financial institutions for this type of service, where there are currently 8 nonbank financial institutions and 9 banks licensed by the Bank of Albania. The workshop opened its work with the greeting word of the Second Deputy Governor of the Bank of Albania, Zj. Natasha Ahmetaj and BERZH representative in Albania, Mr. Matteo Colangeli. In her address, Deputy Governor Ahmetaj stressed that factoring can be a service of important in the Albanian financial system, with development potential. For this reason, the Bank of Albania, interest groups to work together to identify real obstacles to further development of this service, as from bank of Albania observations turns out that the market in Albania needs this kind of service. This service can offer more much financing than traditional lending institutions and at the same time reduces risks 2/3 05/08/22, 17:15 Workshop "Factoring in Albania" much financing than traditional lending institutions and at the same time reduces risks lending. In his address, berzh's representative Mr. Colangeli underlined that factoring is not a very well-known service in Albania and needs to be expanded. In addition to the benefits in business financing, this service also increases the competitiveness of the economy, a target widely supported by the BERZH. 3/3

Title: The Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Sejko, meets the Ambassador of Japan in Tirana
text: Bank of Albania Governor Gent Seyko meets Japan Ambassador to Tirana 29/07/22, 14:06 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Seyko meets Japan Ambassador to Tirana Publication date: 13.09.2017 On 13 September 2017, the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Sejko, held the first official meeting in the premises of the Bank of Albania, with the Ambassador of Japan to Tirana, USA Makoto Ito. During this meeting, Governor Seyko expressed his assessments to Japan's Ambassador to Tirana, US Makoto Ito, of the very good relations between the two countries, as well as talked about the potential prospects of economic co-operation for the future in areas such as trade exchanges, information technology development, infrastructure, etc. ... qiperise_z_Gent_Sejko_takon_Ambasadorin_e_Japonise_ne_Tirane.html Page 1 of 2 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Seyko meets Japan Ambassador to Tirana 29/07/22, 14:06 Furthermore, the meeting came with talks regarding the country's economic panorama, where Governor Seyko stopped at the positive performance of economic growth so far, which is expected to follow such in the future. "In this context, he said - even the easing monetary policy undertaken by the Bank of Albania has made its contribution, influencing economic development, the sustainability of consumer prices and the financial stability of the country". Bilateral discussions stopped at structural reform developments in the country, where Governor Seyko stressed that continuing and further deepening them remains of particular importance to improve the business climate and absorb foreign investment in Albania. In this regard, it was noted that the broad and efficient labour market in the country could be used as another important factor for their attractiveness. Japan's Ambassador to Tirana, US Mr Makoto Ito, thanked Governor Gent Seyko for the meeting and expressed his assessments of the important contribution the Bank of Albania makes in maintaining the country's macroeconomic stability. Japan's ambassador to Tirana added that Albania as a factor of stability in the region contributes to preserving and strengthening its political and economic stability. At the end of the meeting, the co-workers expressed that Albania is already on track for the European integration process, where an important role has also played through its contribution to approximating the regulatory framework, with european Union directives and standards. ... qiperise_z_Gent_Sejko_takon_Ambasadorin_e_Japonise_ne_Tirane.html Page 2 of 2

Title: Governor Sejko meets with the Director of Economic Cooperation and Development at the Swiss State Secretariat for Economic Affairs
text: Governor Seyko holds meeting with Director of Econo Co-operation... imitation at the Swiss State Secretariat for Economic Affairs 29/07/22, 14:06 Governor Seyko holds meeting with Director of Economic Co-operation and Development at swiss State Secretariat on Economic Issues Publication date: 14.09.2017 On 14 September 2017, the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Sejko, held a meeting in the premises of the Bank of Albania, with the Director of Economic Co-operation and Development at the Swiss State Secretariat for Economic Affairs* (SECO), Ambassador Raymund Furrer. Switzerland's Ambassador to Albania, U.T.Z. Christoph Graf, and other senior representatives from the relevant institutions were present at the meeting. During this meeting, the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Sejko, thanked the Swiss Government for its fruitful support and co-operation so far, as well as expressing its very positive assessments of organised projects and activities as part of this co-operation.  prane_Sekretariatit_te_Shtetit_Zviceran_per_Ceshtjet_Ekonomike.html Page 1 of 3 Governor Seyko holds meeting with Director of Econo Co-operation... imitation at the Swiss State Secretariat for Economic Affairs 29/07/22, 14:06 In this regard, Governor Sejko stressed that this co-operation has provided assistance to the Bank of Albania in both the research process and the decision-making process, developing analysis and forecasting models, through the implementation of new models and improving policymaking. More specifically, since 2013, over 20 training activities have been organised, of which about 290 Bank of Albania employees have benefited. During the meeting, Governor Sejko stressed that increasing the technical and professional capacities of the Bank of Albania strengthens credibility and supports further strengthening the activity of the Bank of Albania. Also, during the meeting Governor Sejko gave an exhibition of the situation of the Albanian economy and finances, as well as the work and results of the Bank of Albania. During this exhibition, he stressed the sustainability that the Albanian economy and financial system displayed in confronting the crisis and contribution of the Bank of Albania to it, through its monetary stimulus policy and through careful supervision and regulation of the banking system. Governor Seyko underlined the positive trend of the country's development, as well as stressed the importance of further reforms to improve the country's development model, improve the business environment and lending climate, as well as move forward in the integration process and attract foreign investment. In particular, the Governor stressed that the time has come for the Albanian diaspora to no longer be seen only as a source of remittances, but also as a source of financial capital and energy source and managerial expertise. In the following, SECO representatives thanked the Bank of Albania for its support through active participation and organisation of joint activities, as well as praised their programme with the Bank of Albania as one of their best and successful programmes. Furthermore, Ambassador Raymund Furrer, SECO's Director of Economic Co-operation and Development, told attendees that the Swiss parliament has approved the fund for continuing the central bank support programme and that Albania will continue to be part of the SECO programme. Through this programme, support will be made for the Bank of Albania over the next few years, through a large number of initiatives and activities for vital technical co-operation projects.  prane_Sekretariatit_te_Shtetit_Zviceran_per_Ceshtjet_Ekonomike.html Page 2 of 3 Governor Seyko holds meeting with Director of Econo Co-operation... imitation at the Swiss State Secretariat for Economic Affairs 29/07/22, 14:06 Ambassador Furrer stated that the continuation of joint development projects was based and encouraged by the positive results achieved by the current programme and the high absorption capabilities displayed by the Bank of Albania. Bilateral discussions followed regarding future co-operation and development opportunities for new projects in areas of particular importance to the Bank of Albania. _________ * The State Secretariat for Economic Affairs is the centre of expertise of Switzerland's federal government, which examines all the main problems related to economic policies. Its goal is to ensure sustainable economic growth, enabling the necessary conditions for regulatory and economic policies. Since 1992, SECO, based on growing demands for technical assistance in the field of central banking, has supported the central banks of partner countries, through a strategic co-operation with the Institute of Studies for International Development (Graduate Institute of International and Development Studies). Co-operation with several central banks consists, generally, of general advisory services and specific activities adapted according to the country, in the form of Technical Assistance and Training Programs (TATPs).  prane_Sekretariatit_te_Shtetit_Zviceran_per_Ceshtjet_Ekonomike.html Page 3 of 3

Title: The Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Sejko participates in the conference organized by the Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina
text: Bank of Albania Governor Gent Seyko attends conference organised by Bosnia's Central Bank of Herzegovina 29/07/22, 14:06 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Seyko attends conference organised by Bosnia's Central Bank of Herzegovina Publication date: 22.09.2017 On 22 September 2017, Bank of Albania Governor Gent Sejko attended the international conference organised by Bosnia and Herzegovina's Central Bank on the theme "20 Years of Stability" in Sarajevo. The conference was organised on the occasion of the 20th anniversary of the founding of Bosnia and Herzegovina's central bank. Participants in the conference were senior local and international officials, governors and other central bank representatives from Europe and the region, as well as policymakers and experts from the European Union and international financial institutions.  rencen_e_organizuar_nga_Banka_Qendrore_e_Bosnje_Hercegovines.html Page 1 of 3 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Seyko attends conference organised by Bosnia's Central Bank of Herzegovina 29/07/22, 14:06 The conference works were opened with the greeting word of bosnia and herzegovina's Central Bank Governor Senad Softiae, who after thanking those present presented the conference programme, stressing that the purpose of this activity was to exchange thoughts and experiences with colleagues from different countries. Bank of Albania Governor Gent Sejko was invited to one of the main panels on "Challenges of Central Banks during the integration process of countries into the European Union", along with governors and other representatives of the region's central banks. The panel's discussions focused on the new challenges of central banks in the European Union membership process, as well as the impacts of current developments in the Eurozone and region for these countries. During his speech, Governor Sejko introduced Albania's progress in the Process of European Integration by highlighting some key moments of convergence, as well as addressing the challenges facing our country in the future. Governor Seyko stressed that the political and economic future of the countries of the Southeast European region is directly related to the process of integrating these countries into the European Union. He also underlined that a healthy and efficient financial market is a necessary prerequisite for long-term growth, as well as an important factor in the convergence process. He estimated that central banks have a very important role in advancing the process, through preserving macroeconomic parameters and strengthening financial stability, singling out that, as policymakers, we must continue to contribute in the direction of further strengthening regional co-operation. Title: Speech, at the conference organized by the Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina
text: , Mr Gent Seyko, at the conference organised by the Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina 29/07/22, 14:06 , Mr Gent Seyko, at the conference organised by the Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina Publication date: 22.09.2017 New challenges of central banks during the European Union integration process Honorable, Mr. Speaker, Honorable Colleagues, Honored participants, It is a pleasure for me to participate in this Conference and, at the same time, it seems appropriate to me that one of the topics it addresses concerns the challenges facing the region's central banks in the convergence process. As always, exchanging thoughts among colleagues is of interest. I organized my presentation based on three main pillars. At first, I will present a summary of our current position in the convergence process with BEna. Then I'll stop at some of the lessons we've learned so far. In the end, I will try to address some of the challenges that I think are important for the future. 1. EJL region and convergence process with EU The political and economic future of the EJL region is closely linked to the ongoing process of European integration. The region's proximity to the EU, a larger and more prosperous market, as well as the fundamental values of the EU itself, make the process of ... rencen_e_organizuar_nga_Banka_Qendrore_e_Bosnje_Hercegovines.html Page 1 of 5 , Mr Gent Seyko, at the conference organised by the Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina 29/07/22, 14:06 convergence and integration a long-term commitment that must surely be undertaken. On the other hand, EU integration affects the form of policy models and serves as an annoyance for our major political and economic reforms. The convergence process in the EJL region can be divided into two periods. Before the economic and financial crisis of 2008, convergence maintained a healthy growing trajectory and the countries of the region were progressing progressively towards the EU. After 2008, growth rates in the region moderated and the EJL region failed to maintain a stable convergence rate. Currently, the average per capita income in the region is 35 per cent of the EU average, which leads to the conclusion that it will take a relatively long time for the EJL to fully convert to the EU average. At this point, it's clear that something needs to be done. If we go back, the economic and financial crisis of 2008, while on the one hand shook the foundations of some of the world's largest and developed economies, on the other hand played a key role in exposing weaknesses and the need for a review of the economic structures system of EJL countries. The foundations, on which growth had been established in the pre-crisis region, resulted in unstable. Fortunately, in determining the course of our policy in the future, we can look back and refer to some of the lessons we have learned from the past. 2. General look at the lessons learned so far The convergence process has been as difficult as it is challenging and I would like to stop at some of the lessons we have learned. First, moving towards membership goes through a long and difficult path that requires institution building, economic restructuring and policy discipline. This route must prepare our economies structurally, so that they are able to withstand competition pressures within the EU market as well as bring a degree of synchrony to avoid asymmetric shocks. Progress in each of these areas is difficult in itself. However, one thing that often goes unpaid is that only a co-ordinated plan, which would address all three areas, would bring success. Second, economic reforms often have short-term costs. Stability-oriented policies usually create conditions for short-sighted populist calls, because building modern institutions means fighting routines and, sometimes, facing certain interests. All of these create discontent and dissent. However, as long as our societies remain committed to EU integration, this is a long way to go. However, as policymakers, we should not take good care of the EU's patience. We must be not only determined in our actions, but also honest and transparent about their results. In the end, we must be careful to explain the losses and benefits of policies and have realistic expectations about a reliable time frame for membership. That takes us to the third point. The EU remains - for the moment - a mobile target, as far as internal policy dynamics and structural reforms are concerned in ... rencen_e_organizuar_nga_Banka_Qendrore_e_Bosnje_Hercegovines.html Page 2 of 5 , Mr Gent Seyko, at the conference organised by the Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina 29/07/22, 14:06 the following, which have been further strengthened after the crisis. As such, some of yesterday's political models appear to have been reversed, while new goals and commitments tend to gradually emerge. We must be as attentive to these new and flexible trends in their treatment. Finally, and speaking a little more technically, the crisis dynamics in the region and the impacts that followed should signal to us the need for a closer analytical look at economic stability. It is clear that the objectives for price or exchange rate stability must be met by the financial stability mandate. Furthermore, we must be attentive to any external or internal imbalance, and constantly test the sustainability of our economies against possible adverse scenarios. In summary of this point, I would like to point out that while we - as policymakers - have learned a lot from the past, the future remains quite difficult and uncertain. That said, let me move on to the next issue: what are the challenges central banks perceive as important to the future? 3. New challenges of central banks during the European Union integration process In line with the germ and spirit of EU legislation, as monetary authorities, central banks have a duty to make a major contribution to the convergence process. Three of the EU's convergence criteria are under the direct or indirect authority of central banks. As far as the nominal values defined by the Maastricht Criteria are concerned, Albania meets 3 out of 5 of them, in this case: Price stability, where the inflation rate is lower than 1.5 percentage points above the average of three economies with the best performance in the EU; The stability of the exchange rate, where the local currency is relatively stable, even in a valuation trend against the euro in the last two years. Low budget deficits, where the budget deficit has been below 3% of the GDP ceiling for two consecutive years. The two criteria we have not met - yet - are the sustainability of convergence, or the long-term interest rate for government titles, and the sustainability of public finances, or the relatively high level of public debt. Based on current trends, I am convinced that we will be able to achieve them within a reasonable time frame. I think our monetary policy framework, based on the fluctuating exchange rate and targeted inflation regime, is solid and sufficiently developed to allow the Albanian economy to achieve convergence targets within the next decade. From an institutional point of view, I believe Albania has chosen the right policy regime. In addition to our positive experiences in the past, it seems that they are also in line with EU guidelines. According to the European Commission, although there is not a single policy mix framework to be adapted in any context, their preferred path to EU membership would be what intersects a course regime. ... rencen_e_organizuar_nga_Banka_Qendrore_e_Bosnje_Hercegovines.html Page 3 of 5 , Mr Gent Seyko, at the conference organised by the Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina 29/07/22, 14:06 exchange with an independent monetary policy, aimed at price stability. Furthermore, the recently introduced fiscal rule should strengthen fiscal sustainability and help lower risk premiums in financial markets. However, limiting the role of central banks in the convergence process should not be a recommended approach. As regulators and supervisors of the banking system throughout the region, they have a major role in implementing the agenda for structural reforms. For this reason, I believe that the central bank should clearly engage in the following three areas: Development of the financial sector. A healthy and efficient financial market is a necessary prerequisite for high and sustainable long-term growth. Central banks in the region have engaged in promoting lending growth, through easing policies and reducing legal and institutional barriers, aimed at improving troubled loans. However, they can and should initiate growth, efficiency and sustainability, strengthening structural reforms for financial markets: - In terms of deepening financial markets, more needs to be done for the development of capital markets. This is an untapped source, which would provide an alternative and efficient source for financing investments. At the moment, EJL countries lag far behind EU standards in this respect. - In terms of increasing their sustainability, we must try to harmonise all local regulatory standards - financial - with those implemented by central banks; (ii) further develop and improve security nets, such as mechanisms for extraordinary intervention in banks, recently introduced to the Bank of Albania; and (iii) try to implement healthy management practices in all financial institutions. Fulfilling all these tasks is not exclusively in the hands of central banks, but they can become catalysts for change. Accelerating convergence efforts. I believe that central banks must take full responsibility to advance the convergence process in the following areas: - Regulatory convergence. Central banks in the region may be more ambitious in their efforts to harmonise the regulation of the banking system and their supervisory practices with those of the EU. Although full harmonisation may be unrealistic, even counterproductive, we must try to minimize our distance from EU standards. - Institutional convergence. Central banks need to adapt to EU requirements. For this, we must constantly try to increase professionalism, improve analytical and policymaking capacities, as well as strengthen our policy implementation skills. In short, we must always position ourselves in line with EU standards. Strengthening regional co-operation. The European Commission has determined ... rencen_e_organizuar_nga_Banka_Qendrore_e_Bosnje_Hercegovines.html Page 4 of 5 , Mr Gent Seyko, at the conference organised by the Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina 29/07/22, 14:06 regional co-operation as a prerequisite for Western Balkan countries for EU membership. The Free Trade Agreement already exists, somehow helping our local economies prepare for the pressures of the European single market. In the medium term, businesses will benefit from foreign competition, prompting them to reform and increase performance. However, regional markets could benefit from further integration. Access to larger markets brings even greater risks, as well as creating greater opportunities, building a positive investment climate for local and global actors. The Berlin process (and the Trieste Summit part of it), already in operation, has shown that countries can work together to create a better business climate. I am confident that this process will follow, and the region will enjoy the progress made in many directions, bringing common market membership closer to the region, as a whole. Nga ana tjetr, integrimi n BE ndikon mbi formn e modeleve t politikave dhe shrben si ankor pr reformat tona madhore politike dhe ekonomike. Procesi i konvergjencs n rajonin e EJL-s mund t ndahet n dy periudha. Para krizs ekonomike dhe financiare t vitit 2008, konvergjenca ruante nj trajektore t shndetshme rritse dhe vendet e rajonit po prparonin n mnyr progresive drejt BE-s. N kt pik, sht e qart se duhet br dika. Nse kthehemi pas, kriza ekonomike dhe financiare e vitit 2008, ndrsa nga njra an tronditi themelet e disa prej ekonomive m t mdha e t zhvilluara t globit, nga ana tjetr luajti nj rol ky n ekspozimin e dobsive dhe nevojs pr nj rishikim sistemit t strukturave ekonomike t vendeve t EJL-s. Themelet, mbi t cilat ishte ngritur rritja n rajon para krizs, rezultuan t jen t paqndrueshme. Progresi n seciln prej ktyre fushave sht i vshtir n vetvete. Megjithat, nj gj q shpesh kalon pa i kushtuar vmendje sht se vetm nj plan i bashkrenduar, q do t'i trajtonte t tria fushat, do t sillte sukses. S dyti, reformat ekonomike shpesh kan kosto afatshkurtra. Politika t orientuara drejt stabilitetit zakonisht krijojn kushte pr thirrje populiste dritshkurtra, sepse t ndrtosh institucione moderne do t thot t luftosh rutinn dhe, disa her, t prballesh me disa interesa. T gjitha kto krijojn paknaqsi dhe mosdakordsi. Megjithat, pr sa koh q shoqrit tona mbeten t angazhuara pr integrimin n BE, kjo sht nj rrug e gjat npr t ciln duhet t ecim. Megjithat, si politikbrs, ne nuk duhet ta marrim t mirqen durimin e BE-s. Ne duhet t jemi jo vetm t vendosur n veprimet tona, por edhe t ndershm dhe transparent pr rezultatet e tyre. Megjithat, kufizimi i rolit t bankave qendrore n procesin e konvergjencs nuk duhet t jet nj qasje q t rekomandohet. Si rregullator dhe mbikqyrs t sistemit bankar n t gjith rajonin, ato kan nj rol madhor n zbatimin e agjends pr reforma strukturore. Pr kt arsye, besoj se banka qendrore duhet t angazhohet n mnyr t qart n tri fushat e mposhtme: Zhvillimi i sektorit financiar. Nj treg i shndetshm dhe eficient financiar sht nj parakusht i domosdoshm pr rritje t lart dhe t qndrueshme afatgjat. Bankat qendrore n rajon jan angazhuar n nxitjen e rritjes s kreditimit, nprmjet politikave lehtsuese dhe reduktimit t pengesave ligjore dhe institucionale, duke synuar prmirsimin e kredive me probleme. Megjithat, ato mundet dhe duhet t iniciojn rritje, eficienc dhe qndrueshmri, duke forcuar reformat strukturore pr tregjet financiare: - N lidhje me thellimin e tregjeve financiare, duhet br ende m shum pr zhvillimin e tregjeve t kapitalit. Ky sht nj burim i pashfrytzuar, q do t siguronte nj burim alternativ dhe eficient pr investime financimi. Pr momentin, vendet e EJL-s mbeten shum prapa standardeve t BE-s n kt aspekt. - N lidhje me rritjen e qndrueshmris s tyre, duhet: (i) t prpiqemi pr harmonizimin e t gjitha standardeve rregullatore vendase - financiare - me ato t zbatuara nga bankat qendrore; (ii) t zhvillojm m tej dhe t prmirsojm rrjetat e siguris, t tilla si mekanizmat pr ndrhyrjen e jashtzakonshme n banka, t prezantuara s fundmi n Bankn e Shqipris; dhe (iii) t prpiqemi t zbatojm praktika t shndetshme administrimi n t gjitha institucionet financiare. Prmbushja e t gjitha ktyre detyrave nuk sht ekskluzivisht n duart e bankave qendrore, por ato mund t bhen katalizatore t ndryshimit. Prshpejtim i prpjekjeve pr konvergjenc. Besoj se bankat qendrore duhet t marrin prgjegjsi t plot pr t uar prpara procesin e konvergjencs n fushat e mposhtme: - Konvergjenc rregullator. Bankat qendrore n rajon mund t jen m ambicioze n prpjekjet e tyre pr t harmonizuar rregullimin e sistemit bankar dhe praktikat e tyre mbikqyrse me ato t BE-s. Ndonse nj harmonizim i plot mund t jet jorealist, madje kundrproduktiv, ne duhet t prpiqemi t minimizojm distancn ton nga standardet e BE-s. - Konvergjenc institucionale. Bankat qendrore nevojitet t prshtaten me krkesat e BE-s. Pr kt, ne duhet t prpiqemi vazhdimisht t rrisim profesionalizmin, t prmirsojm kapacitetet analitike dhe politikbrse, si dhe t forcojm aftsit tona pr zbatimin e politikave. Russian Federation, Mr. Elvira Nabiullina and 24th central bank executives participated member states of the Club. Discussions of this meeting had focused on two main directions: financial technologies, global trends and the regulatory framework; As well as the normalization of monetary policy of the European Central Bank and the Bank of England and possible complications for the economies of the Club member states. In the focus of these issues, the leaders of monetary institutions shared with each other their experiences and the challenges facing central banks, especially from the perspective of preserving financial sustainability, as an important element of the activity of central banks today. Governor Sejko said monetary normalization in Europe is not expected to have negative effects in Albania. Even these effects can be positive, given the synchronisation enjoyed by the Bank of Albania's monetary policy with that of the European Central Bank, as well as albania's current integration into European markets. In conclusion, the Governor stressed that the Bank of Albania remains ready to take all necessary measures by making its contribution in support of a sustainable economic growth and ensuring the country's macroeconomic stability. As far as technological development is concerned, Governor Sejko outlined measures taken by Albania in the direction of innovation and digitization. Despite the late start, the steps followed in recent years have been accelerated, based on a strategy pursued by the Albanian government for digitizing services and creating e-governance. On the other hand, the Governor stressed that the banking system today is introduced with innovative products, following recent developments in the field of services of this kind. Therefore, in the role of the regulator, the Bank of Albania shows particular attention to the relevant framework, to create the right legal framework and infrastructure in support of this process. Title: Questions - answers to the press conference of October 3, 2017
text: Question  answers of the press conference dated October 3, 2017 29/07/22, 14:05 Question  answers of the press conference dated October 3, 2017 Publication date: 03.10.2017 Q: Mr. Governor I wanted to ask you a question regarding yesterday's statement that the IMF mission distributed. I wanted to know what your opinion is about what the IMF emphasizes about the fiscal risks that projects have with concession, in terms of the Government's programme that 1 billion euros of investment and the recommendation it makes to the government to have a sustainable fiscal policy, focusing on raising taxes, despite it being a question that belongs more to the Ministry of Finance, I would like to know your opinion and as far as the concession projects the government has in the programme to undertake, do these lending increase the economy, what is their impact on the economy? Governor: The recommendation made by the IMF has been a normal, standard and professional recommendation. What I would say is that Albania is a country with great needs for capital investment and limited financial resources, especially of the public sector. In this context, the application of concessions or the PPP programme, if studied, if we had projects with high profitability and clearly defined priorities, which would result in success, would certainly affect the country's economic growth as well as the acceleration of the country's European integration. Even the IMF itself has expressed that there is nothing against concessions or private public partnership projects. The idea is that these projects should be studied, profitability and successful. If successful, even their fiscal impact would be within budgetary parameters. The Bank of Albania of course remains of the opinion that reflection of these projects should be done transparently and within international standards. He has not disputed and has not discussed this. We remain open to watching  yetje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_3_tetor_2017.html Page 1 of 3 Question  answers of the press conference dated October 3, 2017 29/07/22, 14:05 the performance of these projects. It is a major project planned for the next four years and should normally be processed and detailed in each year's budgets. Of course, project after project and budget after budget we will look, judge and assess their performance, but once again I stress that Albania needs capital investment and these projects would affect albania's development and acceleration of integration into the European Union as well as on the country's economic growth and increased welfare of Albanian citizens. Regarding the second question, in the same context, I also judge that these projects would affect positively. I have emphasized other times the mobilization of the liquidity surplus of the Albanian financial system. The Albanian financial system is well capitalized and with excess liquidity. Private public partnership projects would be an opportunity to share risk and divide it between private, foreign or domestic investors, and the financial system. But this must always be according to project financing criteria, i.e. risk criteria that banks respect according to international standards. So, in general, I would say that these projects, which present a great positive potential for capital investment, should be done in a studied way, respecting international standards and the risk criteria that the financial industry applies. Q: Mr Governor are structural changes taking place in the financial system a source of concern for the Bank of Albania? What is your comment regarding IMF recommendations requiring added vigilance? Governor: The International Monetary Fund has made a recommendation that has been agreed, agreed and welcomed by us. We cooperate continuously with the International Monetary Fund. They provide us with consultancy and normally not only monetary policy but also the work of the Bank of Albania in the direction of preserving financial stability is coordinated and harmonised with the international monetary fund and world bank consultancy. Albania has a very stable macroeconomic situation, a very stable financial stability so far, and is expected to be such and the following. Therefore, this is a very normal recommendation, very welcome, coordinated and agreed with the International Monetary Fund. We don't see any concerns. Of course we need to increase our supervisory capacities, as the market, products and technologies evolve. The Bank of Albania, like all other central banks, needs to be perfected, advanced, trained and consulted. In this context, we see a lot of positive growth in the supervisory capacities of the Bank of Albania. Oversight in its supervisory and regulatory role is a crucial element in the entire process of preserving financial stability, but also in terms of the structural changes you say. Regarding your first question about structural changes in the banking system we have no requirement. Apart from the Greek National Bank, we have no official information on other structural changes. Of course, if we had a request, we would implement all legal requirements and regulations of the Bank of Albania which are well-built and provide in detail for all possible structural changes.  yetje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_3_tetor_2017.html Page 2 of 3 Question  answers of the press conference dated October 3, 2017 29/07/22, 14:05 What I would say and assure the public is that the banking system is very stable, well capitalized and liquidity. We will be very careful as regulator, in co-operation and with the International Monetary Fund, to strictly implement the criteria of the law in any change of any potential shareholder for the banking system.  yetje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_3_tetor_2017.html Page 3 of 3

Lidhur me pyetjen e dyt, n t njjtin kontekst, gjithashtu gjykoj q kto projekte do t ndikonin pozitivisht. E kam theksuar edhe her t tjera mobilizimin e teprics s likuiditetit t sistemit financiar shqiptar. Sistemi financiar shqiptar sht i mirkapitalizuar dhe me tepric likuiditeti. Projektet e partneritetit publik privat do t ishin nj mundsi pr t ndar rrezikun dhe pr ta pjestuar at midis investitorve privat, t huaj apo vendas, dhe sistemit financiar. Por, kjo gjithmon duhet t jet sipas kritereve t financimit t projekteve, domethn kritereve t rrezikut q bankat i respektojn sipas standardeve ndrkombtare. Pra, n prgjithsi do t thoja q kto projekte q parashtrojn nj potencial t madh pozitiv pr investime kapitale, duhen br n mnyr t studiuar, duke respektuar standardet ndrkombtare dhe kriteret e rrezikut q industria financiare aplikon. Pyetje: Z. Guvernator a jan ndryshimet strukturore q po ndodhin n sistemin financiar nj burim shqetsimi pr Bankn e Shqipris? Cili sht komenti juaj lidhur me rekomandimet e FMN q krkojn vigjilenc t shtuar? Guvernatori: Fondi Monetar Ndrkombtar ka br nj rekomandim i cili ka qen i rakorduar, i dakordsuar dhe i mirpritur nga ne. Ne bashkpunojm n mnyr t vazhdueshme me Fondin Monetar Ndrkombtar. Ata na sigurojn konsulenc dhe normalisht jo vetm politika monetare por edhe puna e Banks s Shqipris n drejtim t ruajtjes s stabilitetit financiar sht e koordinuar dhe e harmonizuar me konsulencn e Fondit Monetar Ndrkombtar dhe t Banks Botrore. Shqipria ka nj situat shum stabl makroekonomike, nj stabilitet financiar mjaft t qndrueshm deri tani, dhe parashikohet t jet i till dhe n vijim. Prandaj, ky sht nj rekomandim krejt normal, shum i mirpritur, i koordinuar dhe i dakortsuar me Fondin Monetar Ndrkombtar. Nuk shikojm asnj shqetsim. Natyrisht q ne duhet t rrisim kapacitetet tona mbikqyrse, pasi tregu, produktet dhe teknologjit evoluojn. Banka e Shqipris si t gjitha bankat e tjera qendrore ka nevoj t prsoset, t avancoj, t trajnohet dhe t konsultohet. N kt kontekst, ne e shikojm mjaft pozitive rritjen e kapaciteteve mbikqyrse t Banks s Shqipris. Mbikqyrja n rolin e saj mbikqyrs dhe rregullator sht nj element vendimtar n t gjith procesin e ruajtjes s stabilitetit financiar, por edhe n aspektin e ndryshimeve strukturore q ju thoni. Title: Speech at the press conference of the monetary policy decision-making of the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania
text: 05/08/22, 17:05 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... , Mr. Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making of Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania. Publication date: 21.12.2016 The new information received in the analysis in this report has been - in its entirety - in line with our expectations and forecasts.  1/4 05/08/22, 17:05 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... Real and financial sector data show an improving economic activity, one gradually rising inflation towards the target, and a financial environment conducive to Meeting our goals. The update of analysis and forecasts suggests that the Albanian economy will continue to mark improvement in the medium-term horizon. In line with these forecasts, economic activity is expected to return to balance within 2017 and inflation is expected to return to target within 2018. Inflation scored 1.9% in November, rising 0.4 percentage points against the level of the previous month. The increase in total inflation this month came as a result of rising food and oil item inflation, while inflation of other basket items has remained relatively unchanged. The increasing trend of inflation during 2016 has been dictated, to the greatest extent, by strengthening domestic inflationary pressures, in response to increasing aggregate demand and improving the scale of capacity exploitation. Better exploitation of capacities in the labour and capital markets has created conditions for increasing employment and wages as well as helping to improve the operating margins of businesses These tendencies  2/4 05/08/22, 17:05 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... wages, as well as helping to improve business operating margins. These tendencies are reflected in the continued rise in basic inflation. In parallel with them, rising inflation is also supported by weakening foreign disinflationary pressures as well as the increasing tendency of inflation expectations. New information on economic activity is positive. The economy's growth is estimated to have strengthened somewhat in the second half of 2016, following growth of 3.1% in the first half. This increase is fuelled by the revitalization of consumption and private investment, supported by rising wages and employment, improved confidence, as well as favourable financing conditions. Economic activity in the second half of the year has also been helped by accelerating the pace of budgetary spending and increasing foreign demand in the tourism sector. The Bank of Albania expects further improvement in economic growth over the next two years. The main engine of growth will continue to be the revitalization of private demand, while fiscal policy will continue to remain in the consolidating direction and the external environment will continue to be characterized by weakness and uncertainty. In line with recovering economic activity, as well as supported by the expected reduction in foreign disinflationary pressures, inflation is forecast to mark progressive growth and return to target within 2018. This picture of developments will be helped by the combination of a monetary stimulus policy with a consolidating fiscal policy. This combination optimally addresses our objectives and the challenges we face. Through supporting aggregate demand, our monetary policy creates the right conditions for returning inflation to target. On the other hand, through reducing public debt, fiscal policy consolidator kahu helps reduce risk premiums in financial markets and increases spaces for private sector lending. Monetary stimulus is conveyed through low levels of the basic interest rate, through liquidity injection operations, as well as through the orientation of financial markets for the future course of monetary policy. Financial markets have fully reflected this stimulus. Financing costs in the economy have stabilized at historically low levels, creating premise for promoting consumption and investment. The recent fluctuations in interest rates of certain segments of financial markets are estimated to reflect specific developments in these markets and have not affected the tightening of monetary conditions in the economy. The loan recovery was also made in October. Excluding the effect of extracting lost loans off banks' balance sheets, the total loan portfolio marked an annual increase of 2.9% in the month of October. This increase has fully reflected the dynamic performance of credit in money, whose portfolio recorded an annual growth rate of 9.2% in October, while lending activity in currencies remains pale. The Bank of Albania expects a better credit performance over the coming years, although banks' lending policies continue to remain conservative. In this direction, the Bank  3/4 05/08/22, 17:05 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... Albania estimates that improving the lending environment even in response to the joint plan of measures to reduce troubled loans will enable a further reduction in risk premiums and pave the way for a better performance of lending and economic activity in the country itself. *** Judging on the above analysis and forecasts, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current monetary policy position is appropriate for meeting our inflation target. Under these circumstances, the Supervisory Council decided: Keep the basic interest rate unchanged at 1.25%; Keep deposit and one-day loan interest rates unchanged, at 0.25% and 2.25%, respectively. Also, judging on the information available, on the expected developments and risks around them, the Supervisory Council estimates that the intensity of monetary stimulus will not decrease before the second six months of 2017. Thank you!  4/4

Gent Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp t vendimmarrjes s politiks monetare  T dhnat e sektorit real dhe financiar tregojn nj aktivitet ekonomik n prmirsim, nj inflacion n rritje graduale drejt objektivit, dhe nj ambient financiar t favorshm pr prmbushjen e objektivave tan. Prditsimi i analizs dhe parashikimeve sugjeron se ekonomia shqiptare do t vazhdoj t shnoj prmirsim n horizontin afatmesm. N prputhje me kto parashikime, aktiviteti ekonomik pritet t kthehet n ekuilibr brenda vitit 2017 dhe inflacioni pritet t kthehet n objektiv brenda vitit 2018. Inflacioni shnoi vlern 1.9% n muajin nntor, duke u rritur me 0.4 pik prqindjeje kundrejt nivelit t muajit paraardhs. Rritja e inflacionit total n kt muaj erdhi si pasoj e rritjes s inflacionit t artikujve ushqimor dhe t nafts, ndrkoh q inflacioni i artikujve t tjer t shports ka mbetur relativisht i pandryshuar. Tendenca rritse e inflacionit gjat vitit 2016 sht diktuar, n masn m t madhe, nga forcimi i presioneve t brendshme inflacioniste, n prgjigje t rritjes s krkess agregate dhe prmirsimit t shkalls s shfrytzimit t kapaciteteve. Shfrytzimi m i mir i kapaciteteve n tregjet e puns dhe t kapitalit ka krijuar kushte pr rritjen e punsimit dhe t pagave si dhe ka ndihmuar n prmirsimin e marzheve t operimit t bizneseve Kto tendenca https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_z_Gent_Sejko_ne_konf 2/4 05/08/22, 17:05 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp t vendimmarrjes s politiks monetare  pagave, si dhe ka ndihmuar n prmirsimin e marzheve t operimit t bizneseve. Kto tendenca jan reflektuar n rritjen e vazhdueshme t inflacionit baz. Paralelisht me to, rritja e inflacionit sht mbshtetur edhe nga dobsimi i presioneve t huaja dezinflacioniste si dhe nga tendenca rritse e pritjeve pr inflacionin. Informacioni i ri mbi aktivitetin ekonomik sht pozitiv. Rritja e ekonomis vlersohet t jet forcuar disi n gjysmn e dyt t vitit 2016, pas rritjes me 3.1% n gjysmn e par. Kjo rritje sht ushqyer nga gjallrimi i konsumit dhe i investimeve private, t mbshtetur nga rritja e pagave dhe e punsimit, nga prmirsimi i besimit, si dhe nga kushtet e favorshme t financimit. Aktiviteti ekonomik n gjysmn e dyt t vitit sht ndihmuar edhe nga prshpejtimi i ritmit t realizimit t shpenzimeve buxhetore dhe nga rritja e krkess s huaj n sektorin e turizmit. Banka e Shqipris pret nj prmirsim t mtejshm t rritjes ekonomike gjat dy viteve n vazhdim. Motori kryesor i rritjes do t vazhdoj t jet gjallrimi i krkess private, ndrkoh q politika fiskale do t vazhdoj t mbetet n kahun konsolidues dhe ambienti i jashtm do t vazhdoj t karakterizohet nga dobsi dhe pasiguri. N linj me rikuperimin e aktivitetit ekonomik, si dhe i mbshtetur nga reduktimi i pritur presioneve t huaja dezinflacioniste, inflacioni parashikohet t shnoj rritje progresive dhe t kthehet n objektiv brenda vitit 2018. Kjo tablo zhvillimesh do t ndihmohet nga kombinimi i nj politike monetare stimuluese me nj politik fiskale konsoliduese. Ky kombinim adreson n mnyr optimale objektivat tan dhe sfidat me t cilat prballemi. Nprmjet mbshtetjes s krkess agregate, politika jon monetare krijon kushtet e duhura pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv. Nga ana tjetr, nprmjet reduktimit t borxhit publik, kahu konsolidues i politiks fiskale ndihmon n reduktimin e primeve t rrezikut n tregjet financiare dhe rrit hapsirat pr kreditimin e sektorit privat. Stimuli monetar sht prcjell nprmjet niveleve t ulta t norms baz t interesit, nprmjet operacioneve injektuese t likuiditetit, si dhe nprmjet orientimit t tregjeve financiare pr kursin e ardhshm t politiks monetare. Tregjet financiare e kan reflektuar t plot kt stimul. Kostot e financimit n ekonomi jan stabilizuar n nivele t ulta historike, duke krijuar premisa pr nxitjen e konsumit dhe t investimeve. Luhatjet e vrejtura s fundi n normat e interesit t segmenteve t caktuara t tregjeve financiare vlersohet se pasqyrojn zhvillime specifike t ktyre tregjeve dhe nuk kan ndikuar n shtrngimin e kushteve monetare n ekonomi. Rikuperimi i kredis ka vijuar edhe n muajin tetor. Duke prjashtuar efektin e nxjerrjes s kredive t humbura jasht bilanceve t bankave, portofoli total i kredis shnoi nj rritje vjetore prej 2.9% n muajin tetor. Kjo rritje ka reflektuar trsisht ecurin dinamike t kredis n lek, portofoli i s cils regjistroi nj norm vjetore rritjeje prej 9.2% n muajin tetor, ndrkoh q aktiviteti kreditues n valut mbetet i zbeht. Banka e Shqipris pret nj ecuri m t mir t kredis gjat viteve t ardhshme, ndonse politikat e kreditimit t bankave vazhdojn t mbeten konservatore. European hours for Eastern and Southeast Central European countries 29/07/22, 14:05 The works of this conference were conceived in two main sessions, with high representative participants of the ECB, governors of the central banks of the EQLJL countries, as well as renowned experts of the banking and financial sector. The conference discussions focused specifically on the role central banks have today in the process of economic convergence in the European Union, based on each country's experience, in building institutions. Governor Seyko was part of the panel of the session on the theme "Challenges and Policies to achieve a stable economic convergence in The EQLJL countries", under the direction of Mr Benoeet Coeure9, Member of the ECB's Steering Board. At this table, the Governor made a mirror of the challenges facing the EJL convergence process, from the perspective of the Bank of Albania, as well as the positioning of our country in the face of these dimensions. During his address, Governor Seyko noted that through structural reforms undertaken in the country, the institutional framework has been contributing to the convergence process. He also added that macroeconomic policymaking has recently improved, helping to achieve long-term, comprehensive and sustainable economic growth. Furthermore, Governor Seyko stated that the long-term political future and economic prosperity are closely linked to the process of convergence and THAT of EU integration, as well as, although the countries of the EJL region have differences between them, the economic and political benefits from the process constitute a common specificity. In conclusion, Governor Seyko stressed that the contribution of European Union institutions to this process remains of particular importance, thanks to the provision of transparent and objective EU integration guidelines, as well as monitoring and reporting the progress of each country. "On the one hand, this will strengthen the positive impact of the EU integration process for the development of our countries and societies. While on the other hand, it will promote positive competitiveness among the countries of the region, in the direction of compliance." - Governor Seyko said. During this conference, the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Seyko answered questions from the attendees, as well as was able to discuss with senior representatives from the ECB and governors of the central banks of the EQLJL countries. Benot Coeur, Antar i Bordit Drejtues t BQE-s. N kt tryez, Guvernatori bri nj pasqyr t sfidave me t cilat po prballet procesi i konvergjencs i EJL, nga kndvshtrimi i Banks s Shqipris, si dhe pozicionimin e vendit ton prball ktyre dimensioneve. "Nga njra an, kjo do t forcoj ndikimin pozitiv t procesit t integrimit n BE pr zhvillimin e vendeve dhe shoqrive tona. Ndrsa nga ana tjetr, do t nxis konkurrueshmrin pozitive mes vendeve t rajonit, n drejtim t prputhshmris." - u shpreh Guvernatori Sejko. Gjat ksaj konference Guvernatori i Bank s Shqipris, z.
