Title: The Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Sejko, meets the new Ambassador of the French Republic, in Tirana
text: The Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko, meets the new Ambassador of the French Republic, in Tirana 29/07/22, 14:04 The Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko, meets the new Ambassador of the French Republic, in Tirana Publication date: 09.10.2017 On 9 October 2017, the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Sejko, held the first official meeting in the premises of the Bank of Albania, with the new Ambassador of the French Republic, in Tirana, USA Zj. Christina Vasak. During this meeting, Governor Sejko expressed his assessments to the Ambassador of the French Republic to Albania, S. Zj. Christina Vasak, for the close co-operation relations between the two countries. Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Seyko presented economic developments in the country for the Ambassador, where it was stated that the monetary easing policy pursued by the Bank of Albania has helped by positively influencing the trajectory of economic development, in the sustainability of consumer prices, as well as in the financial stability of the country.  ejko_takon_Ambasadoren_e_re_te_Republikes_Franceze_ne_Tirane.html Page 1 of 3 The Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko, meets the new Ambassador of the French Republic, in Tirana 29/07/22, 14:04 Furthermore, Governor Seyko recognized Ambassador Vasak with financial developments in the country, with particular focus on the banking sector. Governor Seyko stressed that the financial system is characterized by satisfactory levels of capitalization and liquidity. In the banking sector panorama, Governor Seyko singled out improving the index of troubled loans, saying that the interinstitutional plan undertaken has given its effects, causing their ratio to total credit to drop to the lowest level since 2011. The following conversations focused on bilateral economic relations as well as the importance of promoting our country's potentials. In this regard, the importance of French foreign investment in Albania, opportunities for further growth in trade exchanges, as well as strengthening relations in strategic sectors of the country's development, such as industry, agriculture, tourism, etc. were highlighted. Governor Sejko took the opportunity to thank Ambassador Vasak for the Bank of Albania's successful co-operation with the Bank of France, especially for her assistance in joint projects developed in several areas of Activity of the Bank of Albania. For her part, US Ambassador Zj. Christina Vasak praised the important role the Bank of Albania has in the process of European integration through the contribution made in approximating the regulatory framework with EU standards. The co-workers shared the same view on the importance of continuing structural reforms, and in particular that in justice, which would affect further improving the business climate and accelerating the country's economic development. In conclusion, the Ambassador of the French Republic to Tirana, US ZJ. Christina Vasak, thanked Governor Sejko for the meeting and expressed her assessments of the essential contribution the Bank of Albania makes in maintaining the country's macroeconomic stability.  ejko_takon_Ambasadoren_e_re_te_Republikes_Franceze_ne_Tirane.html Page 2 of 3 The Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko, meets the new Ambassador of the French Republic, in Tirana 29/07/22, 14:04  ejko_takon_Ambasadoren_e_re_te_Republikes_Franceze_ne_Tirane.html Page 3 of 3

Title: On the meetings during the Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank
text: 05/08/22, 17:15 On Governor Seyko's meetings during the development of the Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank On Governor Seyko's meetings during the development of the Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank Publication date: 16.10.2017 On 13-15 October 2017, the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Seyko, in the quality of Governor of the Republic of Albania at the IMF, participated in the Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the World Bank Group (BB), which took place in the United States of America.  1/4 05/08/22, 17:15 On Governor Seyko's meetings during the development of the Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank These meetings represent a high-level forum where the IMF and BB's top decision-makers, together with governors and finance ministers of member states of these international financial institutions, come together to discuss the latest developments of the world economy. The IMF Monetary and Financial Committee press release states that the growing trend in global economic activity follows, while trying to achieve higher, stable and broad-based growth. Forecasts are strengthening, with a marked improvement in investment, trade, industrial production, along with increased confidence. However, the recovery is not yet complete, while inflation remains below target in most of the most developed economies and potential growth remains weak in many countries. The committee remains deeply committed to achieving strong, stable, balanced, comprehensive and employment-generating economic growth. For this, he recommends support for recovery and revitalization of growth prospects, preserving financial stability, promoting inclusion and building trust in institutions, as well as co-operation to meet common challenges. At these meetings, Albania was represented through a joint delegation with senior representatives of the Bank of Albania and the Ministry of Finance. During the participation in these meetings, the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Seyko, developed some  2/4 05/08/22, 17:15 On Governor Seyko's meetings during the development of the Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank Important meetings with well-known international financial field personalities, among whom we distinguish: from the IMF with Mr. Neo Zhang, Deputy Director General of the IMF, with Mr. Carlo Cottarelli, Executive Director for Albania, Mr. Poul Thomsen, Director of the European Department, Zj. Anita Tuladhar, International Monetary Fund Mission Chief for Albania; from the BB group with: Mr Cyril Muller, Vice President of the World Bank for the Region of Europe and Central Asia, Mr Patrizio Pagano, Executive Director for Albania; Zj. Linda Van Gelder, Regional Director for the Vienna-based Western Balkans, ZJ. Johanna Jaeger, senior expert in the financial sector, Mr Mario Guadamillas, Manager of Finance and Markets Practices. During these meetings, Governor Sejko gave an exhibition of the Albanian economic and financial situation. The governor stressed that economic activity in the country has been aimed at improving and expressed the Commitment of the Bank of Albania to provide all appropriate support within the framework of the steps to be taken to accelerate the country's future economic activity. For their part, imf and BB representatives positively praised the role and policy pursued by the Bank of Albania, which has contributed to the country's macroeconomic development and stability. As far as the banking system is concerned, the Governor stated that the system appears with quite good financial indicators as well as a satisfactory level of capitalization and liquidity. Some of the most important issues discussed were promoting lending, reducing troubled loans, initiatives in direction of deeuroisation of the economy, development of the capital market in the country as well as that of the payment system. Regarding the high levels of euroisation, Governor Sejko presented the Memorandum of Co-operation signed by the Bank of Albania along with the Ministry of Finance and the Financial Supervision Authority, with which a long-term strategic approach to deeuroisation of the economy is being pursued, which through reducing the use of the euro in the Albanian economy will enable increased monetary policy effectiveness and strengthening financial stability in the country.  3/4 05/08/22, 17:15 On Governor Seyko's meetings during the development of the Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank During the discussions, participants noted that addressing the main challenges facing the Albanian economy, such as preserving stability and further deepening structural reforms, remain of particular importance to improve the business climate and absorb as much foreign investment in Albania as possible. During the meetings held, Governor Sejko expressed thanks to IMF representatives for their continuous assistance to the Bank of Albania and other institutions in the country. For their part, IMF representatives singled out and rated as very positive the increase in professional capacities at the Bank of Albania, as well as their participation and contribution to IMF-organised activities. Another very important meeting was that of the Vienna Initiative Steering Committee. During it, the Governor recognised those present regarding the interinstitutional action plan and various measures of the Bank of Albania towards the reduction of troubled loans, as well as underlined that their treatment has been one of the main commitments of the Bank of Albania. Governor Seyko added that the measures undertaken have delivered their gradual and lasting effects, causing the ratio of troubled loans to total credit to fall to the lowest level since 2011, and is expected to continue in this direction even in the near future. Also, the delegation had the opportunity to hold meetings and counterparts from different countries. In these meetings, further development of bilateral relations was discussed with the aim of absorbing technical assistance for specific issues on the part of the Bank of Albania. During these meetings, Governor Seyko participated in the meeting of the IMF International Monetary and Financial Committee, as well as the works of the G30 seminar. He was also a participant in the joint meetings of ministers and governors of member states of several IMF consistencies. Photo gallery during meetings  4/4

Pr kt, ai rekomandon mbshtetje pr rimkmbjen dhe rigjallrim t perspektivave t rritjes, ruajtje t stabilitetit financiar, nxitje t prfshirjes dhe ndrtimin e besimit te institucionet si dhe bashkpunim pr prballimin e sfidave t prbashkta. Tao Zhang, Zvendsdrejtor i prgjithshm i FMN-s, me z. Carlo Cottarelli, Drejtor Ekzekutiv pr Shqiprin, z. Poul Thomsen, Drejtor i Departamentit Evropian, zj. Anita Tuladhar, Shefe e Misionit t Fondit Monetar Ndrkombtar pr Shqiprin; nga grupi i BBs me: z. Cyril Muller, Zvendspresident i Banks Botrore pr Rajonin e Evrops dhe Azis Qendrore, z. Patrizio Pagano, Drejtor Ekzekutiv pr Shqiprin; zj. Linda Van Gelder, Drejtore Rajonale pr Ballkanin Perndimor me qendr n Vjen, zj. Johanna Jaeger, eksperte e lart n sektorin financiar, z. Mario Guadamillas, Menaxher i Praktikave t Financave dhe Tregjeve. Gjat ktyre takimeve, Guvernatori Sejko bri nj ekspoze t situats ekonomike dhe financiare shqiptare. Guvernatori theksoi se aktiviteti ekonomik n vend ka vijuar t shnoj prmirsim dhe shprehu angazhimin e Banks s Shqipris pr t dhn t gjith mbshtetjen e duhur n kuadr t hapave q duhen ndrmarr pr t prshpejtuar aktivitetin e ardhshm ekonomik t vendit. Nga ana e tyre, prfaqsuesit e FMN-s dhe BB-s vlersuan pozitivisht rolin dhe politikn e ndjekur nga Banka e Shqipris, e cila ka kontribuar n zhvillimin dhe stabilitetin makroekonomik t vendit. Pr sa i prket sistemit bankar, Guvernatori u shpreh se sistemi shfaqet me tregues mjaft t mir financiar si dhe me nj nivel t knaqshm kapitalizimi dhe likuiditeti. Disa nga shtjet m t rndsishme q u diskutuan ishin nxitja e kreditimit, reduktimi i kredive me probleme, nisma n drejtim t deeuroizimit t ekonomis, zhvillimi i tregut t kapitalit n vend si dhe ai i sistemit t pagesave. Lidhur me nivelet e larta t euroizimit, Guvernatori Sejko prezantoi Memorandumin e Bashkpunimit t nnshkruar nga Banka e Shqipris s bashku me Ministrin e Financave dhe Autoritetin e Mbikqyrjes Financiare, me t ciln po ndiqet nj prqasje strategjike afatgjat pr deeuroizimin e ekonomis, q nprmjet reduktimit t prdorimit t euros n ekonomin shqiptare do t mundsoj rritjen e efektivitetit t politiks monetare dhe forcimin e stabilitetit financiar n vend. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Mbi_takimet_e_Guvernatorit_Sejko_gjate_zhvillimit_te_Mbledhjeve_Vjetor 3/4 05/08/22, 17:15 Mbi takimet e Guvernatorit Sejko gjat zhvillimit t Mbledhjeve Vjetore t Fondit Monetar Ndrkombtar dhe Banks Botrore Gjat diskutimeve, pjesmarrsit nnvizuan se trajtimi i sfidave kryesore me t cilat prballet ekonomia shqiptare, si ruajtja e stabilitetit dhe vazhdimi e thellimi i mtejshm i reformave strukturore, mbeten t nj rndsie t veant pr t prmirsuar klimn e biznesit dhe pr t thithur sa m shum investime t huaja n Shqipri. Gjat takimeve t zhvilluara, Guvernatori Sejko shprehu falnderimet ndaj prfaqsuesve t FMNs pr asistencn e dhn n vazhdimsi prej tyre ndaj Banks s Shqipris dhe institucioneve t tjera n vend. Nga ana e tyre, prfaqsuesit e FMN-s veuan dhe vlersuan si mjaft pozitive rritjen e kapaciteteve profesionale n Bankn e Shqipris, si dhe pjesmarrjen dhe kontributin e tyre n aktivitetet e organizuara nga FMN-ja. Nj tjetr takim mjaft i rndsishm ishte edhe ai i Komitetit Drejtues t Nisms s Vjens. Gjat tij, Guvernatori njohu t pranishmit lidhur me planin e veprimit ndrinstitucional dhe masave t ndryshme t Banks s Shqipris n drejtim t uljes s kredive me probleme, si dhe nnvizoi se trajtimi i tyre ka qen nj ndr angazhimet kryesore t Banks s Shqipris. Guvernatori Sejko shtoi se masat e ndrmarra, kan dhn efektet e tyre graduale dhe t qndrueshme, duke br q raporti i kredive me probleme ndaj kredis totale t zbres n nivelin m t ult q prej vitit 2011, dhe pritet t vazhdoj n kt drejtim edhe n t ardhmen e afrt. Gjithashtu, delegacioni pati rastin t zhvilloj takime dhe me homolog nga vende t ndryshme. N kto takime u diskutua mbi zhvillimin e mtejshm t marrdhnieve dypalshe me qllim thithjen e asistencs teknike pr shtje specifike nga ana e Banks s Shqipris. N kuadr t ktyre mbledhjeve, Guvernatori Sejko mori pjes n takimin e Komitetit Ndrkombtar Monetar e Financiar t FMN-s, si dhe n punimet e seminarit t G30. He opened the cycle with "Museum Nights" lectures. The aim of "Museum Nights" is to co-ordinate and integrating knowledge of the currency into the exhibition of the Bank of Albania Museum with information found in archives, libraries, private collections or even that displayed through architecture, sculpture, visual arts and photos of other museums in the country. In her word of welcome, Mr. John, First Deputy Governor of the Bank of Albania, stressed that the Museum makes the Bank of Albania an institution more open and closer to the public. Although a new museum, it has hosted numerous visitors, mainly students and students, but also professionals and other age groups. Mr. John stated that in order to encourage and support closer relations with other disciplines, during 2017 and 2018, the Bank of Albania Museum has committed that through the "Museum Nights" lectures bring different perspectives from personalities distinguished in the fields of numismatics, banking history, economics, financial education, But other disciplines such as philately, art and architecture, giving visitors the opportunity to hear interesting lectures, visit  2/4 05/08/22, 17:16 The Bank of Albania Museum opens the cycle with lectures "Museum Nights" with Mr. Artan Lame's lecture "Monetimation in Albanian Lands... The museum after the Bank's official work schedule, but also to benefit from knowledge and expertise Guest lecturers. "We aim for the Bank of Albania Museum not to be just a place where It is put to enjoy an exhibition, but also a place where thoughts and ideas can be exchanged." The First Deputy Governor stressed. The first lecture was held by Mr. Artan Lame, as one of the prominent collectors and connoisseurs of Albanian and Ottoman numismatics and medallistism, also a scholar of Albanian history, as well as a civil society activist for the protection of cultural heritage. Mr. Artan Lame, held a lecture on monetation in present-day Albania and its historical lands during the Ottoman Period. The lecture addressed the issues of ottoman currency, from its birth in the 19th century. 14th to the Tanzimat Reforms in the 19th century. 19th century, characteristics and types of coins circulated in Albanian lands. The lecture was also stopped in the circulation of European coins, used in Albanian lands before and during the use of ottoman currency. At the end of the activity, a question-and-answer session was held with listeners and visits to the Museum were conducted. The first lecture of "Museum Nights" was met with interest from the public. Through an open invitation on social media, about 160 listeners, mainly university students, participated. The "Museum Nights" cycle will follow during the remaining months of 2017, but also over the next year. Title: Speech at the press conference of the monetary policy decision-making of the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania
text: 05/08/22, 16:52 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... , Mr. Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making of Bank of Albania Supervisory Council Publication date: 01.11.2017 At today's meeting, the Bank of Albania's Supervisory Council reviewed the Quarterly Monetary Policy Report. ... 1/5 05/08/22, 16:52 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... The analysis presented in it suggests that economic activity in the country has been improving during the second and third quarters, influenced by a favourable external environment, by improved trust of economic agents, as well as better financing conditions in the country. On the other hand, overall inflationary pressures are still pale and inflation marked declines in Third quarter. This divergent tendency, also reported in the two previous monetary policy communications, shows that the Albanian economy continues to operate below potential and that inflation continues to remain the object of continued supply shocks. The new information and the update of forecasts have not changed the expected direction of economic and financial developments, but have pushed in time our assessment of the return of the economy to balance and inflation on target. This performance has confirmed the appropriateness of the current monetary policy position, as well as highlighted the need for a more accommodative monetary policy over the medium-term horizon. At the conclusion of discussions on the analysis and forecasts presented, the Supervisory Council decided to keep the basic interest rate unchanged. Let me explain in more detail the report's conclusions and the reasons for this decision. Inflation recorded an average annual rate of 1.7% in the third quarter of the year, marking declines from the values of the two previous quarters. This slowdown has mainly reflected falling food inflation, as a result of increased domestic supply, overpriced exchange rates and slowing inflation of these products in foreign markets. In macroeconomic terms, the Bank of Albania estimates that slowing inflation has resulted from supply shocks, the effect of which is expected to be limited in intensity and short in time. However, low base inflation values suggest that, while rising, medium-term pressures on inflation still remain weak. However, Albanian economy continues to operate below potential, which follows to curb pressures for increases in wages and production costs. According to INSTAT data, the Albanian economy grew by 4.1% during the second quarter of the year, a rate that is roughly that of the first quarter. This increase was supported by expanding internal private demand, improving the balance of foreign trade exchanges, as well as increased public spending and high levels of foreign direct investment during this period. The indirect data available suggest that economic activity has been increasing at approximate rates even during the third quarter. The positive performance of economic activity in the country continues to benefit from our monetary stimulus policy, which maintains a financial environment with low interest rates and abundant liquidity. It has also been helped by consolidating fiscal policy, which lowers risk premiums and increases spaces for private sector financing. The Bank of Albania estimates that these factors will continue to help economic growth, return the economy to balance and inflation on target. Financial markets continue to be characterized by low interest rates. The growing trend of treasury bond yields has not affected private sector lending costs, which - even during the third quarter - have remained at their historic lowest levels. In response, the loan to the private sector increased by an average of 3.1% during the third quarter, almost entirely as a result of the expansion with 9.7% of the loan portfolio in money. One positive aspect of the third quarter was the increase in demand for loans, especially in the corporate segment. Likewise, private sector lending standards have been relaxed, although these standards continue to remain relatively conservative. Judging on current development trends and the balance of supporting factors, the Bank of Albania estimates that the country's medium-term economic development outlook remains positive. Improving the economic environment is expected to bring inflation back to target within the first six months of 2019. In relation to last round, the Bank of Albania has easily revised upwards the forecast for economic growth throughout the three-year forecast horizon, while the forecast of the economy's return to balance and the return of inflation to target have been pushed back somewhat on time. The projection of higher economic growth has been influenced by the upward revision of the assessment for the potential pace of growth, in response to structural improvements in the Albanian economy. At the same time, the upward revision of the potential pushes in time our forecast for the economy to return to balance and inflation on target. It implies that, compared to our previous estimates, the production capacities of the economy are greater and their full exploitation will take a longer time. The timely delay in meeting the target also reflects the need for full absorption of supply shocks and to quell the restraining effects that come from the course's overriding performance exchange. The above projections factor the strengthening of monetary policy stimulus kah throughout the medium-term horizon. They also remain conditional on materializing expectations for a more favourable external environment and a faster recovery of lending activity in the country. The fall in the 14.78% ratio of troubled loans in September shows that the bank sector's balance sheets are improving and that credit risk is coming towards reduction. In this context, the Bank of Albania considers that increasing demand for loans should be followed by more favourable and forward-looking lending policies by the banking sector. On the other hand, further unbalancing demand and supply for loans would curb the pace of economic growth and be a missed opportunity for the banking sector. *** Judging on the analyses and forecasts of the basic scenario, outlined above, the Supervisory Council estimated that the current monetary policy position would remain appropriate. Under these circumstances, he decided: Keep the basic interest rate unchanged at 1.25%; Keep deposit and one-day loan interest rates unchanged, at levels 0.25% and 2.25%, respectively. Also, based on available information, the Supervisory Council states that: The intensity of monetary stimulus will not ease before the fourth quarter of 2018. Monetary stimulus policy pursued by the Bank of Albania has had positive effects on boosting aggregate demand, increasing economic activity and gradually increasing inflation towards the target; The balance of risks to our forecasts is moving to the lower direction, both in the short and middle term. In these circumstances, the Supervisory Council finds it appropriate to stress that, in the event of further shocks materialization or their potential negative impact on inflation expectations, meeting the inflation target could require an even more accommodative monetary policy position. Banka e Shqipris vlerson se kta faktor do t vazhdojn t ndihmojn rritjen ekonomike, kthimin e ekonomis n ekuilibr dhe t inflacionit n objektiv. Nj aspekt pozitiv i tremujorit t tret ishte rritja e krkess pr kredi, veanrisht n segmentin e korporatave. Po ashtu, standardet e kreditimit t sektorit privat jan lehtsuar, megjithse kto standarde vazhdojn t mbeten relativisht konservatore. N t kundrt, zhbalancimi i mtejshm i krkess dhe oferts pr kredi do t frenonte ritmin e rritjes ekonomike dhe do t ishte nj mundsi e humbur pr sektorin bankar. *** Duke gjykuar mbi analizat dhe parashikimet e skenarit baz, t shtjelluara m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare vijon t mbetet i prshtatshm. Title: Bank of Albania signs a Memorandum of Cooperation with the Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey
text: Bank of Albania signs Co-operation Memorandum with Central Bank of Republic of Turkey 29/07/22, 13:29 Bank of Albania signs Co-operation Memorandum with Central Bank of Republic of Turkey Publication date: 06.11.2017 Today, November 6, 2017, the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Seyko, hosted mr. Murat Cetinkaya on an official visit to the premises of the Bank of Albania, the Governor of the Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey. During this one-day visit, the signing ceremony of a Co-operation Memorandum was held, aimed at increasing co-operation between the two central banks. The ceremony was opened with the greeting words of Bank of Albania Governor Mr Gent Seyko and The Governor of the Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey Mr Murat Cetinkaya and came with the signing of the Co-operation Memorandum. Ambassador of the Republic of Turkey to Albania, U.T.Z. Hidayet Bayraktar, as well as senior representatives from the Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey and the Bank of Albania, were present in this activity. During his address, Governor Sejko stated that the two countries have many common elements to build and consolidate the bridges of co-operation and this memorandum is an expression of the common will and desire to continue and intensify the mutual co-operation that the two institutions have had in years.  um_Bashkepunimi_me_Banken_Qendrore_te_Republikes_se_Turqise.html Page 1 of 3 Bank of Albania signs Co-operation Memorandum with Central Bank of Republic of Turkey 29/07/22, 13:29 Furthermore, Governor Seyko stressed that economic and financial co-operation with Turkey is of particular importance to Albania, as the neighbouring country represents a key partner for our country's economy. In the following, the Governor underlined that for as fruitful co-operation, it is necessary to intensify the exchange of information, opinions and expertise in various areas of central banking, such as: supervision, financial stability, research work, financial education, etc. "The Bank of Albania is an active supporter of financial and economic integration, considering it one of the most important pillars to unleash the potential of the economy." - Governor Seyko added. At the end of his speech, Governor Seyko thanked on behalf of the Bank of Albania, once again the Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey for its continued and very fruitful co-operation, as well as expressed special thanks for the unwelcome support of Governor Cetinkaya, as well as for his presence in this ceremony. For his part, the Governor of the Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey, Mr Murat Cetinkaya, stressed that Turkey and Albania are two countries with close relations based on friendship and mutual trust; Especially recently, bilateral relations have grown to a higher level and solidarity has been added among them in the international arena. "In this context, even as the central bank of the two friend countries, we have had close co-operation relations for years. But today with this memorandum, we give a new dimension to these relations, starting a more powerful experiential exchange process and concrete training programs." - Governor Chetinkaya said. As part of this visit, the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Seyko, and the Governor of the Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey, Mr Murat Cetinkaya, were hosted at a cortese meeting by The Prime Minister of the Republic of Albania Mr Edi Rama.  um_Bashkepunimi_me_Banken_Qendrore_te_Republikes_se_Turqise.html Page 2 of 3 Bank of Albania signs Co-operation Memorandum with Central Bank of Republic of Turkey 29/07/22, 13:29 Governor Sejko Photo Gallery Memorandum (English version)  um_Bashkepunimi_me_Banken_Qendrore_te_Republikes_se_Turqise.html Page 3 of 3

Title: The annual conference of the Bank of Albania: Conclusions closed
text: 05/08/22, 17:16 Bank of Albania annual conference closed: Conclusions Bank of Albania annual conference closed: Conclusions Publication date: 09.11.2017 On 9 November 2017, the Bank of Albania, in co-operation with the University of Oxford's Centre for Southeast European Studies, held its annual conference on "Developments in the banking market and financial markets infrastructure. The role of the structure, size and infrastructure of markets in mitigating risks and the performance of the financial broker".  1/3 05/08/22, 17:16 Bank of Albania annual conference closed: Conclusions During the conference work, participants were able to discuss extensively the development of financial markets and their role in conducting the effects of monetary policy, mitigating financial shocks and macroeconomic uncertainties. From the discussions of the participants in the conference it was concluded that monetary policy finds support in other financial instruments. In this way, it can benefit from further development of financial institutions, as this development along with the use of financial instruments has a direct impact on the conduct of the effects of monetary policy. This implies that monetary policy and the development of financial markets are very important for the performance and further promotion of the economy, as well as for the continuation of reforms and policies undertaken. Participants also noted that membership of the European Union is and remains an important survey for all countries in the region. However, further development of reforms, internal policies and local institutions must be constant priorities for them. On the other hand, these countries must work intensively to reduce macroeconomic and financial uncertainties, deepen the banking sector, develop capital markets, as well as diversify investment portfolios. Further deepening and expanding the financial market in other segments, as well as increasing financial education, were some of the important conclusions highlighted during the conference's work. Undertaking these measures would improve the performance of central banks' policies, protect investors, contribute to lower risks, as well as provide greater macroeconomic and financial sustainability. During the conference it was pointed out that after the last financial crisis it was noted that financial shocks have major effects not only for the banking system, but also for the real sector and the well-being of the country as a whole. At this point, participants discussed that price stability is a necessary condition, but not sufficient to ensure financial stability. On the other hand, macroprudence policies cannot alone ensure the financial stability of the country. Consequently, identifying financial shocks and coordinating between monetary and financial policy is important, considering that there is a mutual effect between them. At the conclusion of the conference it was stressed that although developing countries have shown that they have successfully solved some problems, they will face other challenges in the future, which are not only related to the banking system. Some of them are directly related to the development of new capital markets. In this context, regional co-operation between countries and their institutions should be a priority for Southeast European countries. This will serve to strengthen institutionally, create the necessary infrastructure, as well as for a fuller and more efficient implementation of macroeconomic policies. Also, participants stressed the need for further increases in inclusion levels  2/3 05/08/22, 17:16 Bank of Albania annual conference closed: Conclusions financial education, the financial education of the general public, as well as the need for the implementation of the latest technological developments. This would enable Southeast European countries to have much more developed financial systems. The development of this conference also represents a testimony to the validity of co-operation between institutions and academia in the field of scientific research. This co-operation helps deepen the knowledge of political institutions as well as support their development. Photo Gallery  3/3

Nga diskutimet e pjesmarrsve n konferenc u arrit n prfundimin se politika monetare gjen mbshtetje n instrumentet e tjera financiare. N kt mnyr, ajo mund t prfitoj nga zhvillimi i mtejshm i institucioneve financiare, pasi ky zhvillim s bashku me prdorimin e instrumenteve financiare ka nj ndikim t drejtprdrejt n primin e efekteve t politiks monetare. Kjo nnkupton se politika monetare dhe zhvillimi i tregjeve financiare jan mjaft t rndsishme pr ecurin dhe nxitjen e mtejshme t ekonomis, si dhe pr vazhdimin e reformave dhe politikave t ndrmarra. Pjesmarrsit gjithashtu vun n dukje se antarsimi n Bashkimin Evropian sht dhe mbetet nj ankor e rndsishme pr t gjitha vendet e rajonit. Megjithat, zhvillimi i mtejshm i reformave, politikave t brendshme dhe institucioneve vendase duhet t jen prioritete t vazhdueshme pr to. Nga ana tjetr, kto vende duhet t punojn intensivisht pr uljen e pasigurive makroekonomike dhe financiare, thellimin e sektorit bankar, zhvillimin e tregjeve t kapitalit, si dhe diversifikimin e portofoleve t investimit. Thellimi dhe zgjerimi i mtejshm i tregut financiar edhe n segmente t tjera, si dhe rritja e edukimit financiar, ishin disa prej konkluzioneve t rndsishme q u theksuan gjat punimeve t konferencs. Ndrmarrja e ktyre masave do t prmirsonte eficiencn e politikave t bankave qendrore, do t mbronte investitort, do t kontribuonte n uljen e rreziqeve, si dhe do t siguronte qndrueshmri m t madhe makroekonomike dhe financiare. Gjat konferencs u theksua se mbas krizs s fundit financiare u vu re se goditjet financiare kan efekte madhore jo vetm pr sistemin bankar, por edhe pr sektorin real dhe mirqenien e vendit n trsi. N kt pik, pjesmarrsit diskutuan se stabiliteti i mimeve sht nj kusht i domosdoshm, por jo i mjaftueshm pr t siguruar stabilitetin financiar. Nga ana tjetr, politikat makroprudenciale nuk mund sigurojn t vetme stabilitetin financiar t vendit. Si rrjedhoj, identifikimi i goditjeve financiare dhe koordinimi midis politiks monetare dhe asaj financiare sht i rndsishm, duke marr parasysh se ekziston nj efekt i ndrsjell midis tyre. N prfundim t konferencs u theksua se megjithse, vendet n zhvillim kan treguar q kan zgjidhur me sukses disa probleme, ato do t prballen me sfida t tjera n t ardhmen, t cilat nuk lidhen vetm me sistemin bankar. Disa prej tyre lidhen drejtprdrejt me zhvillimin e tregjeve t reja t kapitalit. N kt kontekst, bashkpunimi rajonal midis vendeve dhe institucioneve t tyre, duhet t jet prioritet pr vendet e Evrops Juglindore. Kjo do t shrbej pr forcimin institucional, pr krijimin e infrastrukturs s nevojshme, si dhe pr nj zbatim m t plot dhe m t efektshm t politikave makroekonomike. Title: Speech, at the hearing session of the Parliamentary Committee on Economy and Finance on the draft budget 2018
text: , Mr. Gent Sejko, in the see... IT Parliamentary Economy and Finance on draft budget 2018 29/07/22, 13:38 , Mr Gent Seyko, at the hearing of the Parliamentary Economic Commission and Finance on the 2018 draft budget Publication date: 15.11.2017 Honourable, Mr. Chairman of the Commission, Honourable ladies and gentlemen, Deputies, First, let me thank you for the invitation and opportunity for, on behalf of the Bank of Albania, to present before this Commission our opinion on the 2018 Draft Budget. The budget is the main instrument of fiscal policy exercise. On the one hand, it schedules and performs direct state intervention in the economy. On the other hand, the tax legislation accompanying the Budget sets out fiscal incentives that influence private sector decisions for consumption and investment. Both of these aspects affect domestic demand, economic growth, employment expansion and improved well-being. ... rlamentar_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_mbi_projektbuxhetin_2018.html Page 1 of 7 , Mr. Gent Sejko, in the see... IT Parliamentary Economy and Finance on draft budget 2018 29/07/22, 13:38 Starting from this point of view, it is natural that the design of such an important project requires as broad a consultation as possible, with field experts and interest groups. This consultation should aim to produce a as quality action plan as possible, which determines the optimal way of using limited financial resources according to the country's long-term development goals. Without further ado, let me submit the Bank of Albania's opinion on this Draft Budget. As always, in respect of the legal mandate, I will focus on those issues which are within the scope of the objectives and activity of the Bank of Albania. More specifically, my comments will be summed up in the following areas: Kahu and the effect of fiscal policy on the economy; ii Long-term sustainability of public finances; iii Public borrowing and its impact on internal financial markets; And, finally, iv Increasing the effectiveness and sustainability of public finances. Let me, at first, summarize our vision on the country's development prospects and the contribution we as policymakers must make to it. ... lamentar_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_mbi_projektbuxhetin_2018.html Page 2 of 7 , Mr. Gent Sejko, in the see... IT Parliamentary Economy and Finance on draft budget 2018 29/07/22, 13:38 1. Fiscal policy and 2018 draft budget In contrast, we have emphasized before in our public statements, the Bank of Albania states that the Albanian economy is in a positive development trend. The country's economic activity is coming to an increase, public and private sector financial balances are towards improvement, internal and external balances are coming towards soundness, while private agent confidence is towards consolidation. This performance is favoured by improving the external environment, but it reflects in the first place the right mix of internal economic policies: - Monetary stimulus policy has targeted and managed to provide a financial lyrical environment, with low interest rates and improved financing conditions; - Fiscal consolidation has reduced risk premiums in financial markets, enabled the conveyance of our monetary policy in these markets, as well as increased spaces for private sector lending; - Careful macroprudence policy has maintained the financial stability of the country, while regulation and supervision of the banking sector have helped the normal functioning of this sector, as the main instrument of preserving the public's savings and financing the economy. Our analyses suggest that the country's development premises remain positive, but they should continue to be supported by careful economic policies. Starting from above, the Bank of Albania states that, through targeting a positive primary balance and aiming for further reduction of public debt, the 2018 Draft Budget continues the path of fiscal consolidation. The Bank of Albania estimates that this Draft Budget keeps unchanged the combination of economic policies that have supported the development of the country, which helps further strengthen macroeconomic balances, increases investor confidence in the Albanian economy, as well as sends the right signals to financial markets and public debt ranking agencies. More in detail: ... lamentar_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_mbi_projektbuxhetin_2018.html Page 3 of 7 , Mr. Gent Sejko, in the see... IT Parliamentary Economy and Finance on draft budget 2018 29/07/22, 13:38 - The 2018 primary balance is projected to be positive, at the 0.6% GDP level, while the ratio of public debt to GDP is expected to decrease by 2.5 percentage points. The Bank of Albania estimates that the 2018 Draft Budget strengthens the consolidating fiscal policy direction and enables the continuation of the continuation of monetary stimulus in the economy. - Projections of fiscal revenue seem cautious, although the predicted levels seem to be easily optimistic. These projections are based on an acceptable macroeconomic framework, while public spending policy and tax policies appear consistent with expected economic developments. - The composition of public spending is more supportive of the country's development. Capital expenditure is projected to grow at faster rates than current spending during 2018, reaching the 5.2% GDP level. Our studies suggest that the total effect of capital expenditure on economic growth is relatively greater and more stable in time than that of current spending. - The 2018 budget envisions increasing tax revenues, mainly in line with improving economic activity, but partly as a consequence of increasing the formalization of the economy. The Bank of Albania welcomes the continuation of this initiative, judging that the long-term benefits of increasing competition and transparency in the economy outweigh the short-term costs of reform. In support of this initiative, the Bank of Albania has already instructed commercial banks that, starting in 2018, financial analyses of creditors rely entirely on certified fiscal balances, providing another stimulus for formalization and increasing the costs of informal activity. - Finally, the estimated fiscal effect of changes in tax and customs legislation seems to be small. Based on these estimates, the expected impact of fiscal measures on inflation is expected to be relatively low and transitory. Let me stop on issues related to the long-term health of public finances. 2. Sustainability of public finances The long-term sustainability of public finances is a prerequisite for the country's overall economic and financial stability. As above, the Bank of Albania states that the 2018 Draft Budget meets the requirements arise from the Organic Budget Law (LOB). The implementation of the criteria of this law, helps discipline the drafting and implementation of fiscal policies, increases their consistency over years, and serves to strengthen public finances in the long term. It also reduces risk premiums and improves the investment climate in the country. In the spirit of strengthening public finances, the 2018 Draft Budget introduces the establishment of a limit on the total value of projects contracted under the public-private partnership programme (PPP), at the 40.1% gdp level. The Bank of Albania positively assesses the imposition of this restriction, as it helps prevent the unplanned expansion of public obligations. ... lamentar_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_mbi_projektbuxhetin_2018.html Page 4 of 7 , Mr. Gent Sejko, in the see... IT Parliamentary Economy and Finance on draft budget 2018 29/07/22, 13:38 At the close of my word, I will present some suggestions on further strengthening of public finances. I now want to share with you our assessment of the expected impact of the Budget on financial markets. 3. Public borrowing and its impact on internal financial markets The level of public debt and its financing structure have a direct and mutual connection with the development and health of the internal financial system. In our judgment, preserving the confidence of financial markets should be one of the primary objectives of our fiscal policy, as - in the long run - it determines not only the cost of public debt, but also the cost of financing and access to private sector loans. The Bank of Albania states that budget deficit financing for 2018 is programmed to be covered entirely through internal borrowing. Regarding the impact this request can give on internal financial markets, the Bank of Albania notes that: - Our financial market is characterized by a good liquidity situation and low interest rates. These trends are expected to follow during 2018, creating suitable conditions for the accommodation of planned borrowing. In principle, starting with the risk that exchange rate fluctuations and fluctuations in foreign investor appetite towards the sovereign debt of developing countries bring, the Bank of Albania suggests continuous treatment of foreign borrowing in trade terms, as the last option in line for financing the budget deficit. - The financial market remains sensitive to fluctuations in budget deficit financing during the year. As above, the Bank of Albania suggests: - Continuous monitoring of the financial market, as well as increasing efforts to reduce liquidity fluctuations resulting from public sector activity. - Accelerating efforts to develop the secondary value letter market, which would reduce risks to the accommodation of internal borrowing. The good functioning of this market would help to expand the investor base, increase the liquidity of government debt instruments and reduce the cost of debt. Finally, the Draft Budget includes - for the first time - legal provisions for the transfer of funds created from foreign borrowing, from one fiscal year to the next. This innovation allows for a better distribution of the use of funds provided by foreign lending, as well as enables pre-financing of payment of contractor obligations in the form of foreign debt. In all, this provision helps to mitigate fiscal weaknesses, if foreign borrowing and transfers are made in accordance with the foreign debt repayment tab. It also enables lowering the risk of refinancing and, potentially, lowering the cost of financing from foreign markets. However, the Bank of Albania suggests: (i) its preliminary consultation on foreign borrowing plans; and, (ii) care and quantitative limitation of the size of this transfer over years. *** Honourable Deputies, ... lamentar_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_mbi_projektbuxhetin_2018.html Page 5 of 7 , Mr. Gent Sejko, in the see... IT Parliamentary Economy and Finance on draft budget 2018 29/07/22, 13:38 Let me present some suggestions and recommendations of the Bank of Albania in the closing function of increasing the effectiveness and sustainability of public finances. 4. Some suggestions on increasing the effectiveness and sustainability of public finances On social and health insurance scheme deficits Pension scheme and social security deficits continue to remain a heavy burden on the budget. The deficit of these schemes is about 2.5 times higher than the total value of the budget deficit. This phenomenon must remain in constant monitoring, its medium and long-term implications must be assessed with seriousness, and - if necessary - correctional measures must be taken. In particular, the Bank of Albania thinks that more encouragement should be given to the creation of private pension schemes, which ease the burden on public finances and give further breathing to the development of financial markets. On Public - Private Partnership programmes The 2018 draft budget takes into account the risks stemming from the expansion of public-private partnership projects, setting limits on the total value of these projects and detailing the list of new PPPs during the year. However, the Bank of Albania suggests assessing the possibility of including a general upper limit on the total value of PpPs in the Organic Budget Law. This option would discipline in long-term terms, the total contracted volume of these projects and would be in line with the provisions of this law on the maximum limit that the service of these schemes occupies in the budgetary expenditure of the year. Also, the other concern regarding these projects lies in the potential obligations that could come into the budget. In this respect, we emphasize the need to: (i) continuously improve the professional capacities of entities that manage the evaluation, contracting and monitoring of these projects, especially as it belongs to their legal and financial side; as well as, (ii) the implementation of the best standards in the field of accounting for their impact on debt indicators. On the debt financing structure One of the strengths of the Albanian public debt financing structure has been its focus on the internal market and the focus on the local currency. This feature has kept the risk of refinancing relatively low and reduced fluctuations in the size and cost of debt service, resulting from exchange rate fluctuations. The Bank of Albania considers that this feature of the structure should be preserved even in the future. Finally, at the close of this opinion, let me share with you two permanent concerns of the Bank of Albania. On respecting the projected level of budget deficit during 2018 ... lamentar_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_mbi_projektbuxhetin_2018.html Page 6 of 7 , Mr. Gent Sejko, in the see... IT Parliamentary Economy and Finance on draft budget 2018 29/07/22, 13:38 While the macro framework and fiscal forecasts of the 2018 budget seem generally cautious, the Bank of Albania draws attention to the fact that the preservation of the budget deficit must be fixed as its non-negotiable target. In the name of fiscal care, this means that the budget must include, implicitly or explicitly, contingencies plans for coping with possible situations when the deficit risks being exceeded. On the effectiveness of public finances I also find instead of repeating once again the call for as simultaneous a distribution of budgetary spending as possible during the year, which would soften unnecessary fluctuations in financial markets and increase the effectiveness of fiscal policy. Gent Sejko, n seait Parlamentar t Ekonomis dhe Financave mbi projektbuxhetin 2018 29/07/22, 13:38 1. Politika fiskale dhe projektbuxheti i vitit 2018 Sikundr kemi theksuar edhe m par n prononcimet tona publike, Banka e Shqipris konstaton se ekonomia shqiptare sht n nj trend pozitiv zhvillimi. Aktiviteti ekonomik i vendit po vjen n rritje, bilancet financiare t sektorit publik dhe privat jan drejt prmirsimit, ekuilibrat e brendshm dhe t jashtm po vijn drejt shndoshjes, ndrsa besimi i agjentve privat sht drejt konsolidimit. Kjo ecuri sht favorizuar nga prmirsimi i ambientit t jashtm, por ajo pasqyron n radh t par miksin e duhur t politikave t brendshme ekonomike: - Politika monetare stimuluese ka synuar dhe ka arritur t siguroj nj ambient financiar likuid, me norma t ulta interesi dhe me kushte financimi t prmirsuara; - Konsolidimi fiskal ka reduktuar primet e rrezikut n tregjet financiare, ka mundsuar prcjelljen e politiks son monetare n kto tregje, si dhe ka rritur hapsirat pr kreditimin e sektorit privat; - Politika e kujdesshme makroprudenciale ka ruajtur stabilitetin financiar t vendit, ndrsa rregullimi dhe mbikqyrja e sektorit bankar kan ndihmuar funksionimin normal t ktij sektori, si instrumenti kryesor i ruajtjes s kursimeve t publikut dhe i financimit t ekonomis. Analizat tona sugjerojn se premisat e zhvillimit t vendit mbeten pozitive, por ato duhet t vazhdojn t mbshteten nga politika t kujdesshme ekonomike. Nisur nga sa m sipr, Banka e Shqipris konstaton se, nprmjet shnjestrimit t nj balance primare pozitive dhe synimit pr reduktimin e mtejshm t borxhit publik, Projektbuxheti i vitit 2018 vazhdon rrugn e konsolidimit fiskal. Banka e Shqipris vlerson se ky Projektbuxhet ruan t pandryshuar kombinimin e politikave ekonomike q kan mbshtetur zhvillimin e vendit, ka ndihmon n forcimin e mtejshm t ekuilibrave makroekonomik, rrit besimin e investitorve n ekonomin shqiptare, si dhe drgon sinjalet e duhura n tregjet financiare dhe n agjencit e renditjes s borxhit publik. M n detaje: https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjlamentar_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_mbi_projektbuxhetin_2018.html Pagina 3 di 7 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko, n seait Parlamentar t Ekonomis dhe Financave mbi projektbuxhetin 2018 29/07/22, 13:38 - Balanca primare e vitit 2018 projektohet t jet pozitive, n nivelin 0.6% t PBB-s, ndrsa raporti i borxhit publik ndaj PBB-s pritet t ulet me 2.5 pik prqindje. Banka e Shqipris vlerson se Projektbuxheti i vitit 2018 forcon kahun konsolidues t politiks fiskale dhe mundson vazhdimin e prcjelljes s stimulit monetar n ekonomi. - Projeksionet e t ardhurave fiskale duken t kujdesshme, ndonse nivelet e parashikuara duket t jen lehtsisht optimiste. Kto projeksione bazohen n nj kuadr makroekonomik t pranueshm, ndrsa politika e shpenzimeve publike dhe politika tatimore duken konsistente me zhvillimet e pritura ekonomike. - Kompozimi i shpenzimeve publike paraqitet m mbshtets pr zhvillimin e vendit. Shpenzimet kapitale parashikohet t rriten me ritme m t shpejta se shpenzimet korrente gjat vitit 2018, duke arritur n nivelin 5.2% t PBB-s. Studimet tona sugjerojn se efekti total i shpenzimeve kapitale n rritjen ekonomike sht relativisht m i madh dhe m i qndrueshm n koh, se ai i shpenzimeve korrente. - Buxheti i vitit 2018 parashikon rritjen e t ardhurave tatimore, kryesisht n linj me prmirsimin e aktivitetit ekonomik, por pjesrisht edhe si rrjedhoj e rritjes s formalizimit t ekonomis. Banka e Shqipris e prshndet vazhdimin e ksaj nisme, duke gjykuar se prfitimet afatgjata q vijn nga rritja e konkurrencs dhe transparencs n ekonomi, i tejkalojn kostot afatshkurtra t reforms. N mbshtetje t ksaj nisme, Banka e Shqipris ka udhzuar tashm bankat tregtare q, duke filluar nga viti 2018, analizat financiare t kredimarrsve t'i bazojn trsisht n bilance fiskale t certifikuara, duke ofruar nj stimul tjetr pr formalizimin dhe duke rritur kostot e aktivitetit informal. - S fundi, efekti fiskal i vlersuar i ndryshimeve n legjislacionin tatimor e doganor duket t jet i vogl. Duke u bazuar n kto vlersime, ndikimi i pritur i masave fiskale n inflacion pritet t jet relativisht i ult dhe kalimtar. M lejoni t ndalem n vazhdim n shtjet q kan t bjn me shndetin afatgjat t financave publike. 2. Qndrueshmria e financave publike Qndrueshmria afatgjat e financave publike sht nj parakusht pr stabilitetin e prgjithshm ekonomik e financiar t vendit. Sa m sipr, Banka e Shqipris konstaton se Projektbuxheti i vitit 2018 plotson krkesat q burojn nga Ligji Organik i Buxhetit (LOB). Zbatimi n vijimsi i kritereve t ktij ligji, ndihmon disiplinimin e hartimit dhe zbatimit t politikave fiskale, rrit konsistencn e tyre n vite, dhe i shrben forcimit t financave publike n afatin e gjat. Gjithashtu, ai redukton primet e rrezikut dhe prmirson klimn e investimeve n vend. Po n frymn e forcimit t financave publike, Projektbuxheti i vitit 2018 prezanton vendosjen e nj kufiri mbi vlern totale t projekteve t kontraktuara n kuadrin e programit t partneritetit publik - privat (PPP), n nivelin 40.1% t PBB-s. Banka e Shqipris vlerson pozitivisht vendosjen e ktij kufizimi, pasi ai ndihmon n parandalimin e zgjerimit t paplanifikuar t detyrimeve publike. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjlamentar_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_mbi_projektbuxhetin_2018.html Pagina 4 di 7 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko, n seait Parlamentar t Ekonomis dhe Financave mbi projektbuxhetin 2018 29/07/22, 13:38 N mbyllje t fjals sime, do t paraqes disa sugjerime mbi forcimin e mtejshm t financave publike. Tani dshiroj t ndaj me ju vlersimin ton mbi ndikimin e pritur t Projektbuxhetit n tregjet financiare. 3. Huamarrja publike dhe ndikimi i saj n tregjet e brendshme financiare Niveli i borxhit publik dhe struktura e financimit t tij kan nj lidhje direkte dhe t ndrsjell me zhvillimin dhe shndetin e sistemit t brendshm financiar. N gjykimin ton, ruajtja e besimit t tregjeve financiare duhet t jet nj nga objektivat primar t politiks son fiskale, pasi - n afat t gjat - ai prcakton jo vetm koston e borxhit publik, por edhe koston e financimit dhe aksesin n kredi t sektorit privat. Banka e Shqipris konstaton se financimi i deficitit buxhetor pr vitin 2018 sht programuar t mbulohet trsisht nprmjet huamarrjes s brendshme. Lidhur me ndikimin q kjo krkes mund t jap n tregjet e brendshme financiare, Banka e Shqipris vren se: - Tregu yn financiar karakterizohet nga nj gjendje e mir likuiditeti dhe nga norma t ulta interesi. Kto tendenca pritet t vijojn edhe gjat vitit 2018, duke krijuar kushte t prshtatshme pr akomodimin e huamarrjes s planifikuar. N parim, duke u nisur nga rreziku q sjellin luhatjet e kursit t kmbimit dhe luhatjet e oreksit t investitorve t huaj ndaj borxhit sovran t vendeve n zhvillim, Banka e Shqipris sugjeron trajtimin n vazhdimsi t huamarrjes s huaj me terma tregtar, si opsionin e fundit n radh pr financimin e deficitit buxhetor. - Tregu financiar mbetet i ndjeshm ndaj luhatjeve n financimin e deficitit buxhetor gjat vitit. Sa m sipr, Banka e Shqipris sugjeron: - Monitorimin e vazhdueshm t tregut financiar, si dhe rritjen e prpjekjeve pr reduktimin e luhatjeve t likuiditetit q vijn nga aktiviteti i sektorit publik. - Prshpejtimin e prpjekjeve pr zhvillimin e tregut dytsor t letrave me vler, ka do t reduktonte rreziqet pr akomodimin e huamarrjes s brendshme. Funksionimi i mir i ktij tregu do t ndihmonte n zgjerimin e bazs s investitorve, n rritjen e likuiditetit t instrumenteve t borxhit t qeveris dhe n uljen e kostos s borxhit. S fundi, Projektbuxheti prfshin - pr her t par - dispozita ligjore pr transferimin e fondeve t krijuara nga huamarrja e huaj, nga nj vit fiskal n tjetrin. Kjo risi lejon nj shprndarje m t mir t prdorimit t fondeve t siguruara nga huadhnia e huaj, si dhe mundson para-financimin e pagimit t detyrimeve kontraktore n formn e borxhit t huaj. N trsi, kjo dispozit ndihmon n zbutjen e dobsive fiskale, n rast se huamarrja e huaj dhe transferimet bhen n prputhje me skedulin e ripagimit t borxhit t huaj. Gjithashtu, ajo mundson uljen e rrezikut t rifinancimit dhe, potencialisht, uljen e kostos s financimit nga tregjet e huaja. Gjithsesi, Banka e Shqipris sugjeron: (i) konsultimin e saj paraprak mbi planet e huamarrjes s huaj; dhe, (ii) kujdesin dhe kufizimin sasior t madhsis s ktij transferimi ndr vite. *** T nderuar Deputet, https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjlamentar_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_mbi_projektbuxhetin_2018.html Pagina 5 di 7 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Disa sugjerime mbi rritjen e efektivitetit dhe t qndrueshmris s financave publike Mbi deficitet e skemave t sigurimeve shoqrore e shndetsore Deficitet e skems s pensioneve dhe asaj t sigurimit shoqror, vazhdojn t mbeten nj barr e rnd pr buxhetin. Deficiti i ktyre skemave sht rreth 2.5 her m i lart se vlera totale e deficitit buxhetor. Ky fenomen duhet t mbetet n monitorim t vazhdueshm, implikimet afatmesme dhe afatgjata t tij duhen vlersuar me seriozitet, dhe - n rast se sht e nevojshme - duhen marr masa korrektuese. N veanti, Banka e Shqipris mendon se duhet inkurajuar m shum krijimi i skemave private t pensioneve, t cilat lehtsojn barrn mbi financat publike dhe i japin nj frymmarrje t mtejshme zhvillimit t tregjeve financiare. Mbi programet e Partneritetit Publik - Privat Projektbuxheti i vitit 2018 merr parasysh rreziqet q burojn nga zgjerimi i projekteve t partneritetit publik-privat, duke vendosur kufi mbi vlern totale t ktyre projekteve dhe duke detajuar paraprakisht listn e PPP-ve t reja gjat vitit. Megjithat, Banka e Shqipris sugjeron vlersimin e mundsis s prfshirjes s nj kufiri t siprm t prgjithshm mbi vlern totale t PPP-ve n Ligjin Organik t Buxhetit. Ky opsion do t disiplinonte n terma afatgjat, vllimin total t kontraktuar t ktyre projekteve dhe do t ishte n linj me dispozitat e ktij ligji mbi kufirin maksimal q shrbimi i ktyre skemave z n shpenzimet buxhetore t vitit. Gjithashtu, shqetsimi tjetr lidhur me kto projekte qndron n detyrimet potenciale q mund t vijn n buxhet. N kt aspekt, theksojm nevojn pr: (i) prmirsimin e vazhdueshm t kapaciteteve profesionale t njsive q administrojn vlersimin, kontraktimin dhe monitorimin e ktyre projekteve, sidomos sa i takon ans ligjore dhe financiare t tyre; si dhe, (ii) zbatimin e standardeve m t mira n fushn e kontabilizimit t ndikimit t tyre n treguesit e borxhit. Mbi strukturn e financimit t borxhit Nj nga pikat e forta t strukturs s financimit t borxhit publik shqiptar ka qen prqendrimi i tij n tregun e brendshm dhe fokusi n monedhn lokale. Ky tipar ka mbajtur relativisht t ult rrezikun e rifinancimit dhe ka reduktuar luhatjet e madhsis dhe kostos s shrbimit t borxhit, q vijn nga luhatjet e kursit t kmbimit. Banka e Shqipris gjykon se ky tipar i strukturs duhet t ruhet edhe n t ardhmen. S fundi, n mbyllje t ktij opinioni, m lejoni t ndaj me ju edhe dy shqetsime t prhershme t Banks s Shqipris. Title: Speech of the First Deputy Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mrs. Elisabeta Gjoni, at the international conference organized by the Department of Economics, Faculty of Economics, University of Tirana, December 1, 2017
text: The word of the First Deputy Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Elise... Mix, Faculty of Economics, University of Tirana, December 1, 2017 29/07/22, 13:37 The word of the First Deputy Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Elisabeth John, at the international conference organized by Department of Economics, Faculty of Economics, University of Tirana, December 1, 2017 Publication date: 01.12.2017 Honorable professors, Honored colleagues, Dear students, It is an honour for me to welcome on behalf of the Bank of Albania, the works of the first international conference organized by the Department of Economics, the Economic Faculty themed "Socio  Economic Perspectives in the Age of XXI Century Globalization". And at the same time, it's a special pleasure to be among the colleagues in my faculty. Through my word today, I want to meet you precisely with the role and appreciation that the Bank of Albania has given to scientific analysis and research in its activity. The Bank of Albania is engaged in the field of scientific research, making serious investments in human, financial and technological capacities for supporting scientific research and analysis. The aim of this investment is to harness extensive statistical information in the field of economy, finance, demographics, etc., to ensure as complete recognition of conceptual and empirical foundations as possible that influence price stability and financial stability in the economy. Conclusions and results of macro and microeconomic research are generally focused on the effects that economic and financial developments in the country have on policy  ksit_Fakulteti_i_Ekonomise_Universiteti_i_Tiranes_1_dhjetor_2017.html Page 1 of 5 The word of the First Deputy Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Elise... Mix, Faculty of Economics, University of Tirana, December 1, 2017 29/07/22, 13:38 and monetary operations, financial stability policies or bank supervision. The objective of research activity remains to support decision-making in function of meeting the mandate of the Bank of Albania. At the same time, research activity aims to promote and support public and academic discussions on economic developments at home and wider, also serving as a school for bank staff in its daily work. The focus of scientific research, methodologies and sources of statistical information used have evolved in line with the problems of the time. They have generally followed the issues that have concerned the Bank of Albania. Although 10 years are filled by the outbreak of the global financial crisis and its effects have evolved, they continue to be present in the economy. Our research and analysis have reflected this evolution at best. Topics that have dominated bank of Albania's research and scientific conferences have touched on issues related to the reconception and reorientation of macroeconomic policy; analysis and discussion of financial stability issues and effects from crisis broadcasting channels; reconception of monetary policy in the conditions of financial crises and its interaction with financial stability policy; the role and impact that financial developments and the structure of the financial market have on financial stability and the effectiveness of central bank policies, etc. Various studies discussed in these activities and published in scientific publications of the Bank of Albania have pointed out that it was moderate economic fluctuations and price stability, factors that may have caused everyone's "blindness" to understand the coming storm. Central banks, especially those under the inflation targeting regime, believed that the use of an instrument (i.e. the basic interest rate) for a single purpose (inflation control) was sufficient for achieving and preserving their goals as monetary authority. But financial innovations, expanded and complicated during time, led to the increase in traditional financial lever, which caused a disstability of the entire system, albeit with a diversified risk alloy. Of course, the Balkans and Albania could not be immune to the "contaminant" effects of the crisis. The effects were felt on declining exports, declining economic growth, rapidcurbing of lending and halving shipments of migrants in the form of investment or assistance to their families in the country. The Bank of Albania, faced with these challenges, initially pursued a easing monetary policy, steadily lowering the interest rate since 2009. However, under the conditions of a prolonged global financial crisis, price stability is a necessary but not sufficient condition, causing the Bank of Albania like many other central banks to address the issue of financial stability as well, through macroprudence policies to strengthen the country's banking and financial system, as well as addressing the issue of bad loans. All these developments, as well as the general economic and financial mechanism that binds them, constitute a particular interest in study work. Research analyses, year after year, have tried to respond to many challenges and dilemmas facing our economy, and therefore in the last decade we have reassessed the focus and  sit_Fakulteti_i_Ekonomise_Universiteti_i_Tiranes_1_dhjetor_2017.html Page 2 of 5 The word of the First Deputy Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Elise... Mix, Faculty of Economics, University of Tirana, December 1, 2017 29/07/22, 13:38 research models. Unlike pre-crisis research thematics, which were mainly in support of monetary policy and inflation targeting, using aggregate data and macroeconomic models (such as VAR, VECM, ARDL, etc.), the need has already arisen to study the economy more closely as well as heterogeneity among economic agents including families, businesses and banks. For this reason, research at the Bank of Albania has been reoriented towards analyses of microeconomic character using panel and intersectoral data in support of the function of the Bank of Albania, as supervisor of financial stability and as regulator of banking system activity. During this period, we have had the opportunity, together with field experts and academics, local and foreign, to analyze the latest trends in the development of the financial sector, throughout the region, with particular emphasis on potential complications on macroeconomic balance and financial stability of each economy. From a general point of view, studies undertaken by the Bank of Albania present, in a rigorously scientific form and methodology, the Bank's empirical work for analysis of the development of the banking system, financial efficiency and stability, competitiveness, sovereign risk and the risks facing the Albanian economy in the future. Let me illustrate with some examples, some of our most recent studies: A scientific study on the assessment of the "lower monetary policy base rate limit" in early 2016- a period in which we faced very low levels of inflation, a challenging external environment and the risk of unanchored inflation. Under these conditions when it was still unclear how long this situation could last, one of the most essential questions of monetary policy required answers: to what level can the base rate be lowered? What factors should be considered to assess this lower border? Is there room for unconventional measures and what ratio do these stand with financial stability? What measures are most effective? The study tries to assess how far the basic rate of monetary policy could be lowered under Albania's concrete conditions to ensure price stability, but without censoring financial stability. The study clearly gave the message that as a result of the sustainability of the exchange rate - as a key factor in our economy - the lower base rate limit had not been reached and that there was still space to use the traditional instrument. In an economy and financial system with a pronounced presence of the Euro, these results and other dedicated research are considered in the BSH's policies for deeuroisation. The monetary policy transmission mechanism has been an integral part of the BSH's analytical and empirical studies, with the aim of identifying and assessing the impact of monetary policy transmission channels and exchange rate in production and post-crisis inflation, based on new empirical facts. Studies on the credit gap, the penetration and inclusion of finances, the structure of the financial system, with the aim of supporting a sustainable economic growth, are under way and must be completed. They aim  sit_Fakulteti_i_Ekonomise_Universiteti_i_Tiranes_1_dhjetor_2017.html Page 3 of 5 The word of the First Deputy Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Elise... Mix, Faculty of Economics, University of Tirana, December 1, 2017 29/07/22, 13:38 assess with acceptable credibility the optimal levels of growth indicators in the real economy and financial sector. Studies on the interaction of macroprudence with microprudence are underway, coupled with modelling of the relevant instruments to mimic the effects of the financial cycle on the economy. The empirical work of the Bank of Albania has been done together in the form of several econometric models, which focus monetary policy, the real economy and the financial system. These models detailed the link between the banking sector and the economy in general. They provide a quantified analytical picture, through which the effects of potential risks, at an individual or macroeconomic level, can be analyzed and assessed, that could hit the financial sector. These models offer a community of instruments to analyze and predict the behaviour of the banking system towards macroeconomic financial developments and the effectiveness of policies undertaken by the Bank of Albania. The models bring an added value to the analysis of developments in the banking system compared to alternative tools based on single equations, as they define and generate assessments for the main economic and financial indicators in an endogenous and simultaneous manner. The bank of Albania's research conclusions identify the need to deepen further empirical research and their discussion among field experts. The current problems and gaps identified in the empirical framework of analysis and forecasting for the financial and banking market determine the need to expand scientific research, in relation to issues of financial stability and banking supervision. More studies are needed in the field of data and statistics to provide reliable and systematic information. Currently, technological developments and their spread are rapidly increasing the amount of information generated and accumulated in all areas of life. This information contains and conveys public behavior and its perception of political, social and economic developments, and as such, contains valuable signals for policymaking. "Wise" use of this information can help assess public expectations and perceptions and improve decision-making predictions and analysis. In this framework, the Bank of Albania aims to invest in the research and application of "Big Data" technologies, for filtering valuable information from the community of numerical and matchinformation (structured or not) generated by the entire public economy. We also encourage other researchers to get involved in this project - a separate challenge that would greatly enrich our analyses. We appreciate and hope that scientific research at the Bank of Albania in the areas mentioned above will promote the interest of academia and field scholars to further fill the missing link, making this part of their work  sit_Fakulteti_i_Ekonomise_Universiteti_i_Tiranes_1_dhjetor_2017.html Page 4 of 5 The word of the First Deputy Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Elise... Mix, Faculty of Economics, University of Tirana, December 1, 2017 29/07/22, 13:38 so that the academy can precede further developments and support policy design as much as possible. Therefore, find the opportunity to invite all interested parties to engage in the discussion of academic and scientific works. In addition to possessing consolidated theoretical knowledge, the academy has the potential to guide policy development, both in terms of research inputs, as well as in terms of participation in decision-making processes. The Bank of Albania notes that institutions have made an important contribution to the creation and accumulation of human capital in the field of scientific research. Currently, through the creation of doctoral studies, a scientific research network has been established that summarizes professors, current students and academic institutions. This network has great potential for developing scientific research in the economy and discussing research generated by the Bank of Albania or other institutions operating in this area. Their participation in activities organised by the Bank of Albania, with the aim of discussing empirical analyses and studies, may be greater. Consequently, in closing, I call on scholars and potential users of studies to be involved in discussing academic and scientific works of economic character. This is also because empirical models remain in a continuous process of improvement and fulfillment. As a result, their participation and discussion constitute a necessary essential process and decision-making. At the same time, I encourage readers to discuss these hypotheses with researchers and employees of the Bank of Albania to hold the debate on the above themes and to promote the research of these hypotheses from new perspectives. Hoping that the works of this ongoing conference will be characterized by a fruitful exchange of ideas and views among those present in this hall, I wish you good work!  sit_Fakulteti_i_Ekonomise_Universiteti_i_Tiranes_1_dhjetor_2017.html Page 5 of 5
