Dhe njkohsisht, sht nj knaqsi e veant t jem midis kolegve n fakultetin tim. Prmes fjals time sot, dshiroj tju njoh pikrisht me rolin dhe vlersimin q Banka e Shqipris i ka dhn analizs dhe krkimit shkencor n veprimtarin e saj. Banka e Shqipris sht e angazhuar n fushn e krkimit shkencor, duke br investime serioze n kapacitete njerzore, financiare e teknologjike pr mbshtetjen e krkimit dhe analizs shkencore. Qllimi i ktij investimi sht t shfrytzoj informacionin e gjer statistikor n fushn e ekonomis, financs, demografis etj., pr t siguruar nj njohje sa m t plot t fondamenteve konceptuale dhe empirike q ndikojn stabilitetin e mimeve dhe at financiar n ekonomi. Konkluzionet dhe rezultatet e krkimit shkencor n nivel makro dhe mikroekonomik jan prgjithsisht t fokusuara tek efektet q zhvillimet ekonomike e financiare n vend kan mbi politikn https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjaliksit_Fakulteti_i_Ekonomise_Universiteti_i_Tiranes_1_dhjetor_2017.html Pagina 1 di 5 Fjala e Zvendsguvernatores s Par t Banks s Shqipris, zj. Elismiksit, Fakulteti i Ekonomis, Universiteti i Tirans, 1 dhjetor 2017 29/07/22, 13:38 dhe operacionet monetare, politikat e stabilitetit financiar apo mbikqyrjen bankare. Objektivi i aktivitetit krkimor mbetet mbshtetja e vendimmarrjes n funksion t prmbushjes s mandatit t Banks s Shqipris. Njkohsisht, aktiviteti i krkimit synon t nxis dhe t mbshtes diskutimet publike dhe akademike mbi zhvillimet ekonomike n vend dhe m gjer, duke shrbyer edhe si nj shkoll pr stafin e banks n punn e tij t prditshme. Fokusi i krkimit shkencor, metodologjit dhe burimet e informacionit statistikor t prdorura kan evoluar n prputhje me problematikat e kohs. Ato kan ndjekur prgjithsisht shtjet q kan shqetsuar Bankn e Shqipris. Megjithse mbushen 10 vjet nga shprthimi i krizs financiare globale dhe efektet e saj kan evoluar, ato vazhdojn t jen t pranishme n ekonomi. Krkimi dhe analiza jon e kan reflektuar kt evoluim m s miri. Temat q kan dominuar krkimin dhe konferencat shkencore t Banks s Shqipris kan prekur shtje q lidhen me rikonceptimin dhe riorientimin e politiks makroekonomike; analizn dhe diskutimin e shtjeve t stabilitetit financiar dhe efekteve nga kanalet e transmetimit t krizave; rikonceptimin e politiks monetare n kushtet e krizave financiare dhe ndrveprimin e saj me politikn e stabilitetit financiar; rolin dhe ndikimin q zhvillimet financiare dhe struktura e tregut financiar ka mbi stabilitetin financiar dhe efektshmrin e politikave t banks qendrore etj. Studime t ndryshme t diskutuara n kto aktivitete dhe t publikuara n botimet me karakter shkencor t Banks s Shqipris, kan nxjerr n pah se ishin luhatjet e moderuara ekonomike dhe stabiliteti i mimeve, faktort q mund t ken shkaktuar verbrin e t gjithve pr t kuptuar stuhin q po vinte. Bankat qendrore, sidomos ato nn regjimin e shnjestrimit t inflacionit, besonin se prdorimi i nj instrumenti (pra, i norms baz t interesit) pr nj qllim t vetm (kontrollin e inflacionit) ishte i mjaftueshm pr arritjen dhe ruajtjen e objektivave t tyre si autoritet monetar. Por inovacionet financiare, t zgjeruara e t ndrlikuara shum gjat kohs, uan n rritjen e levs financiare tradicionale, e cila shkaktoi nj destabilitet t gjith sistemit edhe pse me nj alokim t diversifikuar t rrezikut. Sigurisht, Ballkani dhe Shqipria nuk mund t ishin imune ndaj efekteve kontaminuese t krizs. Efektet u ndjen n rnien e eksporteve, rnien e rritjes ekonomike, frenimin e shpejt t kreditimit dhe prgjysmimin e drgesave t emigrantve n form investimi apo ndihme pr familjart e tyre n vendlindje. Banka e Shqipris, e gjendur prball ktyre sfidave, ndoqi fillimisht nj politik monetare lehtsuese, duke ulur n mnyr t vazhdueshme normn e interesit q prej vitit 2009. Megjithat, n kushtet e nj krize financiare globale t strzgjatur, stabiliteti i mimeve sht nj kusht i nevojshm por jo i mjaftueshm, duke br q Banka e Shqipris si shum banka t tjera qendrore t adresojn edhe shtjen e stabilitetit financiar, nprmjet politikave makroprudenciale pr t forcuar sistemin bankar dhe financiar t vendit, si dhe duke adresuar shtjen e kredive t kqija. T gjitha kto zhvillime si dhe mekanizmi i prgjithshm ekonomik e financiar q i lidh ato, prbjn nj interes t veant pr punn studimore. Analizat krkimore, vit pas viti, kan tentuar tiu japin prgjigje shum sfidave dhe dilemave me t cilat prballet ekonomia jon dhe pr kt arsye n dekadn e fundit kemi rivlersuar fokusin dhe https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalisit_Fakulteti_i_Ekonomise_Universiteti_i_Tiranes_1_dhjetor_2017.html Pagina 2 di 5 Fjala e Zvendsguvernatores s Par t Banks s Shqipris, zj. Elismiksit, Fakulteti i Ekonomis, Universiteti i Tirans, 1 dhjetor 2017 29/07/22, 13:38 modelet krkimore. Ndryshe nga tematikat krkimore prpara krizs, t cilat ishin kryesisht n mbshtetje t politiks monetare dhe t shnjestrimit t inflacionit, duke prdorur t dhna agregate dhe modele makroekonomike (si VAR, VECM, ARDL etj.), tashm ka lindur nevoja pr t studiuar ekonomin m n imtsi si dhe heterogjenitetin midis agjentve ekonomik ku prfshihen familjet, bizneset dhe bankat. Pr kt arsye, krkimi n Bankn e Shqipris sht riorientuar drejt analizave me karakter mikroekonomik duke prdorur t dhna panel dhe ndrsektoriale n mbshtetje t funksionit t Banks s Shqipris, si mbikqyrse e stabilitetit financiar dhe si rregullatore e aktivitetit t sistemit bankar. Gjat ksaj periudhe, ne kemi pasur mundsi, s bashku me ekspert t fushs dhe akademik, vendas e t huaj, t analizojm tendencat m t fundit n zhvillimin e sektorit financiar, n gjith rajonin, me theks t veant n ndrlikimet potenciale mbi ekuilibrin makroekonomik dhe stabilitetin financiar t do ekonomie. Nga nj kndvshtrim i prgjithshm, studimet e ndrmarra nga Banka e Shqipris paraqesin, n nj form dhe metodologji rigorozisht shkencore, punn empirike t Banks pr analizn e zhvillimit t sistemit bankar, efikasitetit dhe stabilitetit financiar, konkurrueshmris, rrezikut sovran dhe rreziqet me t cilat prballet ekonomia shqiptare n t ardhmen. M lejoni t ilustroj me disa shembuj, disa nga studimet tona m t fundit: Nj studim shkencor mbi vlersimin e kufirit t poshtm t norms baz t politiks monetare n fillim t vitit 2016- periudh n t ciln u prballm me nivele shum t ulta t inflacionit, me nj ambient t jashtm sfidues dhe me rrezikun e nj inflacioni t paankoruar. N kto kushte kur akoma ishte e paqart sa mund t zgjaste kjo situat, nj nga pikpyetjet m thelbsore t politiks monetare krkonte prgjigje: deri n far niveli mund t ulet norma baz? far faktorsh duhen konsideruar pr t vlersuar kt kufi t poshtm? A ka vend pr masa jokonvecionale dhe n raport qndrojn kto me stabilitetin financiar? Cilat masa jan m efektive? Studimi prpiqet t vlersoj se deri n far niveli mund t ulej norma baz e politiks monetare n kushtet konkrete t Shqipris pr t siguruar stabilitetin e mimeve, por pa cenuar stabilitetin financiar. Studimi jepte qart mesazhin se si rezultat i qndrueshmris s kursit t kmbimit - si nj faktor ky n ekonomin ton - kufiri i poshtm i norms baz nuk ishte arritur dhe se kishte akoma hapsir pr t prdorur instrumentin tradicional. N nj ekonomi dhe sistem financiar me nj prani t theksuar t Euros, kto rezultate dhe krkime t tjera t dedikuara jan konsideruar n politikat e BSH-s pr deeuroizimin. Mekanizmi i transmetimit t politiks monetare ka qen pjes integrale e studimeve analitike dhe empirike t BSH-s, me synim identifikimin dhe vlersimin e impaktit t kanaleve t transmetimit t politiks monetare dhe t kursit t kmbimit n prodhim dhe n inflacion pas krizs, bazuar n fakte empirike t reja. Studime mbi hendekun e kredis, deprtimin dhe prfshirjen e financave, strukturn e sistemit financiar, me qllim mbshtetjen e nj rritjeje t qndrueshme ekonomike, jan n proces dhe duhet t plotsohen. Elismiksit, Fakulteti i Ekonomis, Universiteti i Tirans, 1 dhjetor 2017 29/07/22, 13:38 t vlersojn me besueshmri t pranueshme nivelet optimale t treguesve t rritjes n ekonomin reale dhe sektorin financiar. Studime mbi ndrveprimin e makroprudencs me mikroprudencn jan n proces, shoqruar me modelime t instrumenteve prkatse pr t mitiguar efektet e ciklit financiar n ekonomi. Puna empirike e Banks s Shqipris sht br bashk n formn e disa modeleve ekonometrike, t cilat kan n fokus politikn monetare, ekonomin reale dhe sistemin financiar. Kto modele prshkruajn n mnyr t detajuar lidhjen ndrmjet sektorit bankar dhe ekonomis n prgjithsi. Ato japin nj tablo analitike t kuantifikuar, prmes s cils mund t analizohen dhe vlersohen efektet e rreziqeve potenciale, n nivel individual apo makroekonomik, q mund t godasin sektorin financiar. Kto modele ofrojn nj bashksi instrumentesh pr t analizuar dhe parashikuar sjelljen e sistemit bankar ndaj zhvillimeve financiare makroekonomike dhe efektshmrin e politikave t ndrmarra nga Banka e Shqipris. Modelet sjellin nj vler t shtuar n analizn e zhvillimeve n sistemin bankar prkundrejt mjeteve alternative t bazuara n ekuacione t vetme, pasi ato i prcaktojn dhe i gjenerojn vlersimet pr treguesit kryesor ekonomik e financiar n mnyr endogjene e t njkohshme. Konkluzionet e krkimeve t Banks s Shqipris identifikojn nevojn pr tu thelluar n hulumtime t mtejshme empirike dhe pr diskutimin e tyre midis ekspertve t fushs. Problematikat aktuale dhe boshllqet e identifikuara n kuadrin empirik t analizs dhe t parashikimit pr tregun financiar e at bankar, prcaktojn nevojn e zgjerimit t krkimit shkencor, n lidhje me shtjet e stabilitetit financiar dhe mbikqyrjes bankare. M shum studime nevojiten n fushn e t dhnave dhe statistikave, pr t siguruar nj informacion t besueshm dhe sistematik. Aktualisht, zhvillimet teknologjike dhe prhapja e tyre po e rrisin me shpejtsi sasin e informacionit t gjeneruar dhe akumuluar n t gjitha fushat e jets. Ky informacion prmban dhe prcjell sjelljen e publikut dhe perceptimin e tij n lidhje me zhvillimet politike, sociale e ekonomike, dhe si i till, prmban sinjale t vlefshme pr politikbrjen. Shfrytzimi i menur i ktij informacioni mund t ndihmoj n vlersimin e pritshmrive dhe perceptimeve t publikut dhe n prmirsimin e parashikimeve dhe analizs s vendimmarrjes. N kt kuadr, Banka e Shqipris synon t investoj n hulumtimin dhe aplikimin e teknologjive t Big Data, pr filtrimin e informacioneve t vlefshme nga bashksia e informacioneve numerike e shkresore (t strukturuara ose jo) q gjenerohen nga e gjith ekonomia e publiku. Ne gjithashtu inkurajojm dhe studiues t tjer t prfshihen n kt projekt - nj sfid m vete kjo, q do ti pasuronte shum analizat tona. Vlersojm dhe shpresojm se krkimi shkencor n Bankn e Shqipris n fushat e prmendura me lart, do t nxis interesin e akademis dhe studiuesve t fushs pr t plotsuar m tej hallkat q mungojn, duke e br kt pjes t puns s tyre https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalisit_Fakulteti_i_Ekonomise_Universiteti_i_Tiranes_1_dhjetor_2017.html Pagina 4 di 5 Fjala e Zvendsguvernatores s Par t Banks s Shqipris, zj. Prandaj, gjej rastin t ftoj t gjith t interesuarit t prfshihen n diskutimin e punimeve akademike dhe atyre shkencore. Prve zotrimit t njohurive teorike t konsoliduara, akademia ka potencialin t udhzoj n drejtim t zhvillimit t politikave, si n aspektin e inputeve krkimore, po ashtu dhe n aspektin e pjesmarrjes n proceset vendimmarrse. Banka e Shqipris v re se institucionet kan dhn nj kontribut t rndsishm n krijimin dhe akumulimin e kapitalit njerzor n fushn e krkimit shkencor. Aktualisht, prmes krijimit t studimeve t doktoraturs, sht krijuar nj rrjet krkimi shkencor q prmbledh n vetvete profesort, studentt aktual dhe institucionet akademike. Ky rrjet ka potencial t madh pr zhvillimin e krkimit shkencor n ekonomi dhe diskutimin e krkimit t gjeneruar nga Banka e Shqipris apo institucionet e tjera q veprojn n kt fush. Pjesmarrja e tyre n aktivitetet e organizuara nga Banka e Shqipris, me qllim diskutimin e analizave dhe studimeve empirike, mund t jet m e madhe. Rrjedhimisht, n mbyllje, i bj thirrje studiuesve dhe prdoruesve potencial t studimeve t prfshihen n diskutimin e punimeve akademike dhe atyre shkencore me karakter ekonomik. Title: Speech at the press conference of the monetary policy decision-making of the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania
text: 05/08/22, 17:14 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... , Mr. Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making of Bank of Albania Supervisory Council Publication date: 05.07.2017 The new economic and financial information, analysed in the Intermediate Monetary Policy Report, suggests that the Albanian economy has been able to maintain a positive development. Economic activity has come to an increase, medium-term inflationary pressures are estimated to be in  1/4 05/08/22, 17:14 The word of the Governor of the Bank of Sjhqippria, Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy making ... Line with target, financial markets appear calm, and interest rates and conditions funding is consistent with meeting our goal. First-quarter economic growth has resulted in higher than our expectations, while inflation in April and May has been somewhat lower. Updating our forecasts has not brought about significant changes in expected developments, such as short and medium-term developments. In the absence of shocks, the positive trend of the economy, favourable financing conditions, as well as gradual improvement of foreign confidence and environment, are expected to enable the economy to return to balance and inflation on target within 2018. Annual inflation marked values of 1.9% and 2.0%, respectively in April and May, coming down from the first quarter. The inflation fluctuations reflected the lower contribution of food inflation, in response to the increase in agricultural production, as well as the lower contribution of imported inflation, in response to the overpriced exchange rate. The effect of these supply factors is estimated to be fleeting. The performance of the economic and financial environment is consistent with rising inflation towards our target in the medium term. Inflationary pressures are on the rise and are supported by the expansion of economic activity and increased exploitation of production capacities, price increases in foreign markets and the gradual convergence of medium-term inflationary expectations towards  2/4 05/08/22, 17:14 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... prices in foreign markets and the gradual convergence of medium-term inflationary expectations towards target. The update of economic analysis with the new statistics shows that the Albanian economy has continued to grow in the first half of the year. Economic growth scored 3.94% in the first quarter, while available data suggests a slowdown in its second quarter. One of the factors relates to the uncertainty that accompanies pre-election situations. Furthermore, in the last month, an added uncertainty stems from adverse climatic conditions, the effects of which may appear in specific manufacturing sectors. The effects stemming from these uncertainties are expected to be temporary. Economic growth is supported by favourable financing conditions in the country and improved foreign economic environment. The expansion of consumption and investment has also benefited from the continued improvement of the labour market, strengthening confidence, and increasing foreign direct investment. In parallel with the increase in private demand, the positive effect on the revival of economic activity is estimated to have also given the public sector and improved the balance of foreign trade exchanges. The latter is reflected in the rapid narrowing of the current deficit, by 20% in annual terms, while also supporting the strengthening of the exchange rate. Fiscal policy has followed a consolidating course, reflected in a positive budgetary balance. However, fiscal consolidation had a lower intensity than a year ago, producing positive stimulus in the economy in the first half of the year. At the end of the first five months of the year, the budgetary balance results in a suffix of 6.3 billion dollars, reflecting the annual increase with 7.3% of public income and 16.4% of budgetary spending. Easing monetary policy has contributed to reducing the financing costs of economic agents. The conveyance of monetary stimulus to the financial market is reflected in low interest rate levels for deposits and loans. On the other hand, the government's valuable letter yields in the primary market have shown slight increases, mainly generated by temporary demand and supply imbalances for them. However, the fluctuations in treasury bond yields have not been conveyed in other segments of the financial market. Easing monetary conditions have contributed to the increase in the loan portfolio in the money. The volume of credit in money increased by 9% in annual terms, offsetting the contraction of credit in currencies. The increasing trend of credit in money remains a welcome development, but the distribution of this increase shows its concentration in the individual segment, while the loan for businesses follows slow. Also, cleared of the effects of credit deregistration from the balance sheet, the annual growth of the total loan portfolio in April remains modest, at the 3% level. The Bank of Albania expects a gradual improvement in lending activity in the following quarters, reflecting the expected expansion of demand and improved supply. The terms of the bank offer for loans are expected to be eased, helped by measures taken to reduce troubled loans and promote healthy credit. The ratio of troubled loans has dropped to a level of 15.9% in May, down from 18.2% in December last year.  3/4 05/08/22, 17:14 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference of monetary policy decision-making ... The update of macroeconomic forecasts has confirmed our previous expectations for economic and monetary developments in the medium term. The fact-based slowdown in inflation in the second quarter does not create significant deviations in the expected inflation trajectory. The return of the economy to potential and gradual absorption of untapped capacities are expected to be accompanied by strengthening inflationary pressures. Inflation is expected to return to our target within 2018. On the other hand, the balance of risks around these forecasts is estimated to be avoided for below, influenced by uncertainties in the internal and external environment. *** In accordance with these conclusions, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania considers that the current monetary policy position is appropriate. Starting from above, the Supervisory Council decided to keep the basic interest rate unchanged at 1.25% level. Also, the Council decided to keep deposit and one-day loan interest rates unchanged, at levels 0.25 and 2.25%, respectively. Judging on the information available, the Supervisory Council estimates that monetary policy will continue to remain in the easing direction and the intensity of monetary stimulus will not decrease before the first quarter of 2018.  4/4

Prditsimi i analizs ekonomike me statistikat e reja tregon se ekonomia shqiptare ka vazhduar t rritet n gjysmn e par t vitit. Rritja ekonomike shnoi vlern 3.94% n tremujorin e par, ndrkoh q t dhnat e disponuara sugjerojn nj ngadalsim t saj n tremujorin e dyt. Nj nga faktort lidhet me pasigurin q shoqron situatat para-zgjedhore. M tej, n muajin e fundit, nj pasiguri e shtuar buron nga kushtet e pafavorshme klimaterike, efektet e t cilave mund t shfaqen n sektor t caktuar t prodhimit. Efektet q rrjedhin nga kto pasiguri pritet t jen t prkohshme. Rritja ekonomike sht mbshtetur nga kushtet e favorshme t financimit n vend dhe nga prmirsimi i ambientit t huaj ekonomik. Zgjerimi i konsumit dhe i investimeve ka prfituar gjithashtu nga prmirsimi i vazhdueshm i tregut t puns, nga forcimi i besimit, dhe nga rritja e investimeve t huaja direkte. Paralelisht me rritjen e krkess private, efekt pozitiv n gjallrimin e aktivitetit ekonomik vlersohet t ken dhn edhe sektori publik dhe prmirsimi i bilancit t shkmbimeve tregtare me jasht. Ky i fundit sht reflektuar n ngushtimin e shpejt t deficitit korrent, me 20% n terma vjetor, duke mbshtetur edhe forcimin e kursit t kmbimit. Politika fiskale ka ndjekur nj kurs konsolidues, t pasqyruar n nj balanc buxhetore pozitive. Megjithat, konsolidimi fiskal ka pasur nj intensitet m t ult se nj vit m par, duke prodhuar stimul pozitiv n ekonomi n gjysmn e par t vitit. N fund t pesmujorit t par t vitit, balanca buxhetore rezulton me nj suficit prej 6.3 miliard leksh, duke pasqyruar rritjen vjetore me 7.3% t t ardhurave publike dhe me 16.4% t shpenzimeve buxhetore. Politika monetare lehtsuese ka kontribuar n reduktimin e kostove t financimit t agjentve ekonomik. Prcjellja e stimulit monetar n tregun financiar sht reflektuar n nivele t ulta t normave t interesit pr depozita dhe kredi. Nga ana tjetr, yield-et e letrave me vler t qeveris n tregun primar kan treguar rritje t lehta, kryesisht t gjeneruara nga zhbalancimet e prkohshme t krkess dhe oferts pr to. Megjithat, luhatjet e yield-eve t bonove t thesarit nuk jan prcjell n segmente t tjera t tregut financiar. Kushtet monetare lehtsuese kan kontribuar n rritjen e portofolit t kredis n lek. Vllimi i kredis n lek u rrit me 9% n terma vjetor, duke kompensuar tkurrjen e kredis n valut. Trendi rrits i kredis n lek mbetet nj zhvillim i mirpritur, por shprndarja e ksaj rritjeje tregon prqendrimin e saj n segmentin e individve, ndrkoh q kredia pr biznese vijon e ngadalt. Gjithashtu, e pastruar nga efektet e regjistrimit t kredive nga bilanci, rritja vjetore e portofolit total t kredis n muajin prill mbetet modeste, n nivelin 3%. Banka e Shqipris pret nj prmirsim gradual t aktivitetit kreditues n tremujort n vazhdim, n reflektim t zgjerimit t pritur t krkess dhe prmirsimit t oferts. Title: Speech at the press conference on the activity of the Bank of Albania during 2017
text: , Mr Gent Seyko in confection... n press on the Bank of Albania's activity during 2017 29/07/22, 13:37 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Sejko's word at press conference on Bank of Albania event during 2017 Publication date: 20.12.2017 At this conference at the end of the year I want to make a review of the main moments of work of the Bank of Albania during 2017, of course focused this on our main priorities. *** I will initially stop at the Bank of Albania Supervisory Council event. Supervisory Council activity As you have been recognized through the pre-announced calendar, the Council held 15 meetings during 2017, in which 69 decisions were made, of which 53 acts were adopted for the first time and 16 changes or completions of existing acts. ... shtyp_mbi_veprimtarine_e_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_gjate_vitit_2017.html Page 1 of 6 , Mr Gent Seyko in confection... n press on the Bank of Albania's activity during 2017 29/07/22, 13:37 In eight meetings, economic-financial developments in the country have been taken into analysis, followed by the adoption of the relevant monetary policy reports, as well as decisions on the position of monetary policy as a whole and the basic interest rate in particular. In all cases, the decision-making is explained through press reports, while periodic monetary policy reports have been sent to the Assembly of Albania as well as to all other interested, local and foreign actors. For broad opinion, they are published on the Bank of Albania page. Another important product of the bank of Albania's Supervisory Council activity has been decision-making dedicated to further strengthening bank supervision, as well as ensuring the country's financial stability. In this view, I find it appropriate to mention the creation of the Department of Extraordinary Intervention, the adoption of the Macroprudence Policy Strategy, as well as the adoption of two 6-month reports of financial stability. At its event, the Supervisory Council has paid special attention to monitoring the administrative and financial activity of the institution itself. In addition to the adoption of the annual report and financial mirrors, which, within the framework of the accountability, have been sent to the Assembly of Albania and made public, the Council has devoted special care to the reports of the External Audit, the Inspector General, the High State Control, as well as the duties left in the resolution of the Assembly of Albania. On the other hand, throughout the year, the Audit Committee has continuously analyzed the findings and conclusions of internal and external audit. Finally, I find it appropriate to stress that the Supervisory Council has paid particular attention to strengthening the Bank's institutional capacities, through further improving the functioning procedures of the institution, as well as through the support of increasing professional capacities and further motivating staff. Monetary policy and operations ... htyp_mbi_veprimtarine_e_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_gjate_vitit_2017.html Page 2 of 6 , Mr Gent Seyko in confection... n press on the Bank of Albania's activity during 2017 29/07/22, 13:37 Regarding monetary policy, we have known you in detail with our analyses as well as the decisions that have followed them. Without falling into repetition, I see it with interest to reemphasize once again that the monetary stimulus policy of the Bank of Albania has played an important role in supporting and enlivening the country's economic activity. Our decisions have been at the right time and intensity, contributing to lower financing costs and the normal functioning of financial markets. Nprmjet 120 fjalimeve, njoftimeve dhe intervistave, 40 raportesh, analizash e buletinesh, nj shumllojshmrie t lart statistikash e t dhnash, organizimit t 3 konferencave shkencore dhe nj sr aktivitetesh t tjera me karakter t veant kemi prmbushur procesin ton t transparencs dhe llogaridhnies ndaj publikut. Pr t rritur ndrveprimin me publikun, gjat vitit 2017 kemi shtuar edhe komunikimin dixhital nprmjet rrjeteve sociale, duke transmetuar aktivitetin e prgjithshm t Banks s Shqipris tek opinioni publik, n nj koh sa m t shpejt dhe t plot. Banka e Shqipris i ka kushtuar vmendje edhe forcimit t bashkpunimit me agjenci dhe institucione homologe. N kt kuadr, gjat vitit 2017, kemi shkmbyer vazhdimisht opinione me institucione si FMN-ja, Banka Botrore, Banka Qendrore Evropiane dhe Komisioni Evropian, me t cilat kemi kryer nj sr aktivitetesh t prbashkta si dhe kemi prezantuar nisma me ndikim potencial pozitiv n ekonomin dhe financat e vendit. Po ashtu, gjat vitit 2017, Banka e Shqipris nnshkroi nj Memorandum Bashkpunimi me Bankn Qendrore t Republiks s Turqis. Ky memorandum synon forcimin e bashkpunimit ndrmjet dy institucioneve prmes shkmbimit t ndrsjell t informacionit, ekspertizs, puns krkimore, si dhe nprmjet dialogut t rregullt n nivel teknik e politikbrs. N prfundim, dua t theksoj se gjat vitit q po lm pas, institucioni yn hodhi hapa t mtejshm n prmbushjen e objektivit strategjik pr prafrimin me modelin e banks qendrore t Sistemit Evropian t Bankave Qendrore. Progresi ka qen i shtrir n t gjitha hallkat dhe n mnyr proporcionale, fakt ky q na rrit besimin se institucioni sht plotsisht i prgatitur pr tu prballur me nj tjetr vit sfidues. Title: Speech at the graduation ceremony of students of the Faculty of Economics, University of Tirana
text: , Mr Gent Seyko in ceremo... student lomation of the Faculty of Economics, University of Tirana 29/07/22, 13:37 , Mr. Gent Seyko at the graduation ceremony of students of the Economicfaculty, University of Tirana Publication date: 12.01.2018 Honourable Minister Nicholas, Honorable Chairman of the High Control of the State Mr. Leskaj, Honored Dean of the Faculty Prof. Kule, Honored teachers, Dear students and students, I feel honored and satisfied at the same time that I am in a student environment today, especially on such a special day for you, but which is really also for me, as I too was a student of the University of Tirana. Today you successfully crown your multi-year efforts, partially closing an important chapter of your life, that of education. I used the term partly not without purpose, as education is a permanent challenge, which accompanies us for the rest of our lives. Despite the form and time we spend, all without exception, we are in an uninterrupted process of updating and adding knowledge.  mit_te_studenteve_te_Fakultetit_Ekonomik_Universiteti_i_Tiranes.html Page 1 of 3 , Mr Gent Seyko in ceremo... student lomation of the Faculty of Economics, University of Tirana 29/07/22, 13:37 I say with conviction that you have reason to feel proud, as you have placed an important milestone in your life. From today onwards, the doors of another world open to you, different from student life. The doors of the real world open, with many challenges and unknowns. If you asked me today what my advice is to each of you, although it may sound a little like cliche, I wouldn't hesitate for a moment to say: you'll only be successful if you learn to give beyond yourself. From this point of view, for all of you who already have an idea of what you will do with your life, I have nothing left but to say congratulations and successes. For all of you who have not yet decided, I urge you to seek believing in your instinct, with will and dedication. Never give up your ambitions and goals. Never stop fighting for what you believe in and always support the people who care for you. Behave with dignity, pride and honesty, without forgetting that in any case you are neither less nor more just yourself. The world beyond audiences is more challenging. Prepare that in life you will face even difficult moments. In many cases disappointment is an undivided part of life. For this reason, I advise you to build stability in yourself. As one phrase says: "We are more fragile than we think, but stronger than we imagine." You'll have good days and bad days. Be good and take heart to pass them with courage and optimism. Remember to learn lessons on a case-by-case occasion and share them with your friends and colleagues. Embrace every innovative idea, build constant faith, transmit positive energy and embrace every shared dream that inspires love, prosperity, integrity and human understanding. This is the right way to build a better society than this today, capable of facing the challenges of time, and guaranteeing the future of the nation in the course of time. I wish students who graduate today, successes in their lives. The Bank of Albania has always opened its doors to students of the University of Tirana. Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making and approval of the de-euroization package
text: , Mr Gent Seyko in confection... monetary policy arrival and adoption of deeuroisation package 29/07/22, 13:37 , Mr Gent Seyko at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making and adoption of the deeuroisation package Publication date: 07.02.2018 At today's meeting, the Supervisory Council reviewed and approved the Quarterly Monetary Policy Report. Based on the analyses and forecasts presented in it, we once again reassessed the suitability of monetary policy stance. The following press release will introduce you to the main conclusions of the Supervisory Council. Page 1 of 5 , Mr Gent Seyko in confection... monetary policy arrival and adoption of deeuroisation package 29/07/22, 13:37 The new information received in the analysis has generally resulted in line with our expectations. Likewise, forecasts on economic and monetary developments in the future have remained generally unchanged. The Supervisory Council confirmed that progressive recovery of economic activity has been helped and will come to be helped, among other things, by the accommodative course of our monetary policy. Starting from above, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current monetary policy position is appropriate. Inflation marked a slight increase in the fourth quarter of 2017, illustrating the short-term nature of the supply shocks that brought its decline during the previous quarter. The increase in total inflation came mainly as a result of rising inflation of housing-related categories. Although rising, inflation in the country continues to remain low and below the Bank of Albania's 3% target. In macroeconomic terms, this performance reflects the stage of cyclical development of our economy and low levels of imported inflation. Although increasing, aggregate demand still remains insufficient to fully exploit production capacities, as illustrated by the fact that the unemployment rate remains above its natural level and that businesses report a still incomplete exploitation of capacities. This phenomenon hinders the growth of wages, production costs and profit margins, in line with our inflation target. In parallel with it, the main trading partner countries are to be characterized by low inflation levels. The oversupply of the exchange rate over the past quarters has further curbed their influence on the local economy. Analysis of macroeconomic indicators suggests that the Albanian economy has been growing in the second half of 2017, albeit at slower pace than in the first six months. According to INSTAT data, gross domestic product grew 3.55% in the third quarter, marking a slowdown against the average growth rate of 3.9% in the first six months. In the sectoral perspective, economic growth is supported by the expansion of service sector activity, while its slowdown reflects slowing activity in the construction sector and for certain branches in that industry. From an aggregate demand perspective, economic growth was supported to the greatest extent by the expansion of private consumption, while its slowdown reflected slowing investment and negative foreign trade contribution. The indirect data available suggests a similar economic performance even during the fourth quarter. The Bank of Albania's monetary policy has played an important supporting role in the growing trend of the economy and in strengthening domestic inflationary pressures. The low level of the basic interest rate, the orientation of markets on future monetary policy performance, as well as the continued injection of liquidity into the interbank market, have lowered private sector financing costs, driving up consumption and investment growth. In parallel with it, low interest rates have Page 2 of 5 , Mr Gent Seyko in confection... monetary policy arrival and adoption of deeuroisation package 29/07/22, 13:37 easing debt service costs, improving the health of private sector financial balances, as well as trying to curb derogatory pressures on the exchange rate. Financial markets have generally appeared calm during the second half of the year. Deposit and loan interest rates in money remain near historic low levels, while the government's letter yield fluctuations are not transmitted to other segments of the financial market. On the other hand, the exchange rate resulted in relatively stable during the fourth quarter, but its overprice came down compared to the high levels recorded in the third quarter. In contrast to this positive picture, lending performance continues to remain pale. Cleared for the exchange rate effect, the private sector loan portfolio recorded an average annual increase of 5% in the fourth quarter. In contrast, we have done so before, the expansion of the total loan follows to the greater extent of the expansion of the loan into the money. The latter's portfolio marked an average annual increase of 7.9% in the fourth quarter, while currency lending increased by 2.4%. Our analyses suggest that the slow performance of the loan reflects the simultaneous effect of low demand and tight supply conditions. Sustainable lending growth will require improved demand and supply. In this context, while our projections suggest an increase in demand on the medium-term horizon, the Bank of Albania draws attention to the fact that the banking sector should be more proactive in its lending policies. The financial health of banks is constantly improving. This performance is witnessed by the stable liquidity situation, the positive performance of profitability indicators, as well as the progressive reduction of troubled loans. The latter's ratio to total loans decreased to a level of 13.2% in December, reflecting improved economic activity, the effect of measures taken to reduce them, as well as the continued efforts of banks and businesses to clean up and restructure their balance sheets. In this context, the Bank of Albania considers that there is further scope for factoring credit risk reduction in easing lending policies by banks. Our projections for the future suggest a continuation of positive development trends. The Albanian economy will come to grow over the medium-term horizon, helped by improved foreign environment and favourable financing conditions in the country. These factors will cushion some of the effect of specific shocks in specific sectors as well as the reduction of fiscal stimulus during 2018. Further increase in aggregate demand and fuller exploitation of production capacities are expected to create the necessary prerequisites for returning inflation to the target around mid-2019. *** Judging on the analyses and forecasts of the basic scenario, outlined above, the Supervisory Council estimated that the current monetary policy position would remain appropriate. Under these circumstances, he decided: Page 3 of 5 , Mr Gent Seyko in confection... monetary policy arrival and adoption of deeuroisation package 29/07/22, 13:37 Keep the base interest rate unchanged at 1.25%; and, keep deposit and one-day loan interest rates unchanged, at levels 0.25 and 2.25%, respectively. Also, based on available information, the Supervisory Council: First, it reconfirms that the intensity of monetary stimulus will not ease before the fourth quarter of 2018. Even further, monetary policy is expected to continue to remain in the stimulus direction throughout the medium-term horizon, to ensure stable inflation convergence on target. Second, it states that the balance of risks above our forecasts follows to remain shifted to the lower direction. Third, it resonates that "beyond the cyclical dimension" further accelerating the pace of economic growth requires the rigorous continuation of structural reforms. These reforms should contribute to increasing efficiency, expanding the country's manufacturing potential, and increasing the economy's resistance to potential shocks. Honored media representatives, Taking advantage of the possibility of this public communication, let me introduce you to an important decision, taken at today's meeting by the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania, and which concerns our initiative to promote the use of the national currency in economic and financial transactions in the country. This initiative, also known as the deeuorization package, has already been defined as a nationwide goal, through the signing of the Memorandum of Co-operation in April last year. This memorandum formalizes the agreement for joint and coordinated efforts, nationally, between three institutions: the Bank of Albania, the Ministry of Finance and Economy, and the Financial Oversight Authority. Before I come up with detailing concrete measures, let me say two words on the motive of this initiative. The Bank of Albania estimates that the deeuroisation process is necessary and beneficial in the long term, both for improving the effectiveness of economic and financial policies and reducing financial stability risks. Our studies and analyses show that the use of foreign currencies in the sphere of internal financial economic activity is on a relatively high scale. This phenomenon relates to both the high use of currencies in trade transactions and their high use as a savings tool, in the form of bank deposits, or even as a financing tool, in the currency lending route. From the beginning, I want to clarify to the public that the Bank of Albania is not aiming to reduce the use of currencies to zero in financial activity, but to reduce euroisation to acceptable levels for economies of similar structure and size. What we want to reduce, soften or minimize is the presence of positions of Page 4 of 5 , Mr Gent Seyko in confection... monetary policy arrival and adoption of deeuroisation package 29/07/22, 13:37 currency openings and the risk-taking of the exchange rate, directly or indirectly, unstudiedly or unprotectedly, by the consumer, business and financial market agents. Started from above, as well as aiming to concrete our institutional commitment, the Supervisory Council considered and adopted a package of decisions in support of promoting the use of the national currency. In this framework, they were approved: 1) First, the Policy document "On expanding the use of the national currency in the activity of the banking sector and non-bank financial institutions that are regulated and supervised by the Bank of Albania". The document sets out how the Bank of Albania will contribute to this process (otherwise known as deeuroisation) and how it will assess the impact of this contribution. 2) Second, some regulatory changes, which finalise work held over the past year for the identification, evaluation and consultation with the banking industry, of several measures supporting the expansion of the use of the national currency in banking sector activity. These regulatory changes aim to make it more costly (i.e. less preferred) to activity in the currency of the banking sector and to strengthen the awareness mechanisms of borrowers (especially those individuals and vulnerable to the risk of exchange rate) for the risks that accompany borrowing in currencies. These changes come into force within the first six months of this year. In closing, let me stress that this process requires a long-term commitment, to these measures can be fulfilled with others in the future. In any case, the Bank of Albania will act gradually and in consultation with the banking industry. To be effective, the process must be comprehensive, towards the Bank of Albania will maximum harmonize its actions with other authorities overseeing the system and financial markets in the country, as well as constantly consulting with relevant European institutions. Po ashtu, parashikimet mbi zhvillimet ekonomike dhe monetare n t ardhmen kan mbetur prgjithsisht t pandryshuara. Kshilli Mbikqyrs konstatoi se rikuperimi progresiv i aktivitetit ekonomik sht ndihmuar dhe do t vijoj t ndihmohet, ndr t tjera, nga kursi akomodues i politiks son monetare. Nisur nga sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare sht i prshtatshm. Inflacioni shnoi nj rritje t leht n tremujorin e katrt t vitit 2017, duke ilustruar natyrn afatshkurtr t goditjeve t oferts t cilat solln rnien e tij gjat tremujorit paraardhs. Rritja e inflacionit total erdhi kryesisht si pasoj e rritjes s inflacionit t kategorive t lidhura me strehimin. Megjithse n rritje, inflacioni n vend vijon t mbetet i ult dhe nn objektivin 3% t Banks s Shqipris. N aspektin makroekonomik, kjo ecuri pasqyron stadin e zhvillimit ciklik t ekonomis son dhe nivelet e ulta t inflacionit t importuar. Ndonse n rritje, krkesa agregate mbetet ende e pamjaftueshme pr t shfrytzuar n mnyr t plot kapacitetet prodhuese, sikundr ilustrohet nga fakti se norma e papunsis mbetet mbi nivelin e saj natyral dhe se bizneset raportojn nj shfrytzim ende jo t plot t kapaciteteve. Ky fenomen pengon rritjen e pagave, t kostove t prodhimit dhe t marzheve t fitimit, n linj me objektivin ton pr inflacionin. Paralelisht me t, vendet partnere tregtare kryesore vijojn t karakterizohen nga nivele t ulta inflacioni. Mbimimi i kursit t kmbimit gjat tremujorve t fundit ka frenuar m tej prcjelljen e tyre n ekonomin vendase. Analiza e treguesve makroekonomik sugjeron se ekonomia shqiptare ka vijuar t rritet n gjysmn e dyt t vitit 2017, ndonse me ritme m t ngadalta se n gjashtmujorin e par. Sipas t dhnave t INSTAT-it, prodhimi i brendshm bruto u rrit me 3.55% n tremujorin e tret, duke shnuar ngadalsim kundrejt norms mesatare t rritjes prej 3.9% t gjashtmujorit t par. N kndvshtrimin sektorial, rritja ekonomike vijon t mbshtetet nga zgjerimi i aktivitetit t sektorit t shrbimeve, ndrkoh q ngadalsimi i saj pasqyron ngadalsimin e aktivitetit n sektorin e ndrtimit dhe pr deg t caktuara n at industris. Nga kndvshtrimi i krkess agregate, rritja ekonomike u mbshtet n masn m t madhe nga zgjerimi i konsumit privat, ndrkoh q ngadalsimi i saj pasqyroi ngadalsimin e investimeve dhe kontributin negativ t tregtis me jasht. T dhnat e trthorta t disponuara sugjerojn nj ecuri t ngjashme ekonomike edhe gjat tremujorit t katrt. Politika monetare e Banks s Shqipris ka luajtur nj rol t rndsishm mbshtets n trendin rrits t ekonomis dhe n forcimin e presioneve t brendshme inflacioniste. Niveli i ult i norms baz t interesit, orientimi i tregjeve mbi ecurin e ardhshme t politiks monetare, si dhe injektimi i vazhdueshm i likuiditetit n tregun ndrbankar, kan ulur kostot e financimit t sektorit privat, duke nxitur rritjen e konsumit dhe t investimeve. Gent Sejko n konfearrjen e politiks monetare dhe miratimin e pakets s deeuroizimit 29/07/22, 13:37 lehtsuar kostot e shrbimit t borxhit, duke prmirsuar shndetin e bilanceve financiare t sektorit privat, si dhe kan tentuar t frenojn presionet mbimuese mbi kursin e kmbimit. Tregjet financiare jan shfaqur prgjithsisht t qeta gjat gjysms s dyt t vitit. Normat e interesit t depozitave dhe t kredive n lek mbeten pran niveleve t ulta historike, ndrkoh q luhatjet e yield-eve t letrave me vler t qeveris nuk jan transmetuar n segmente t tjera t tregut financiar. Nga ana tjetr, kursi i kmbimit rezultoi relativisht i qndrueshm gjat tremujorit t katrt, por mbimimi i tij erdhi n rnie krahasuar me nivelet e larta t regjistruara n tremujorin e tret. Prkundrejt ksaj tabloje pozitive, ecuria e kreditimit vazhdon t mbetet e zbeht. I pastruar pr efektin e kursit t kmbimit, portofoli i kredis pr sektorin privat regjistroi nj rritje mesatare vjetore prej 5% n tremujorin e katrt. Sikundr e kemi br prezent dhe m par, zgjerimi i kredis totale vijon t mbshtetet n masn m t madhe nga zgjerimi i kredis n lek. Portofoli i ksaj t fundit shnoi nj rritje mesatare vjetore prej 7.9% n tremujorin e katrt, ndrkoh q kreditimi n valut u rrit me 2.4%. Analizat tona sugjerojn se ecuria e ngadalt e kredis pasqyron efektin e njkohshm t krkess s ult dhe t kushteve t shtrnguara t oferts. Rritja e qndrueshme e kreditimit do t krkoj prmirsimin e krkess dhe oferts. N kt kontekst, ndrkoh q projeksionet tona sugjerojn nj rritje t krkess n horizontin afatmesm, Banka e Shqipris trheq vmendjen n faktin se sektori bankar duhet t jet m proaktiv n politikat e veta t kreditimit. Shndeti financiar i bankave sht n prmirsim t vazhdueshm. Kjo ecuri dshmohet nga gjendja e qndrueshme e likuiditetit, nga ecuria pozitive e treguesve t prfitueshmris, si dhe nga reduktimi progresiv i kredive me probleme. Raporti i ktyre t fundit ndaj kredive totale zbriti n nivelin 13.2% n muajin dhjetor, n pasqyrim t prmirsimit t aktivitetit ekonomik, t efektit t masave t marra pr reduktimin e tyre, si dhe t prpjekjeve t vazhdueshme t bankave e bizneseve pr pastrimin dhe ristrukturimin e bilanceve t tyre. N kt kontekst, Banka e Shqipris gjykon se ka hapsir t mtejshme pr faktorizimin e reduktimit t rrezikut t kredis n lehtsimin e politikave t kreditimit nga bankat. Projeksionet tona pr t ardhmen sugjerojn nj vazhdimsi t trendeve pozitive t zhvillimit. Ekonomia shqiptare do t vijoj t rritet gjat horizontit afatmesm, e ndihmuar nga prmirsimi i ambientit t huaj dhe nga kushtet e favorshme t financimit n vend. Kta faktor do t amortizojn nj pjes t efektit t goditjeve specifike n sektor t caktuar si dhe t reduktimit t stimulit fiskal gjat vitit 2018. Rritja e mtejshme e krkess agregate dhe shfrytzimi m i plot i kapaciteteve prodhuese pritet t krijojn parakushtet e nevojshme pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv rreth mesit t vitit 2019. *** Duke gjykuar mbi analizat dhe parashikimet e skenarit baz, t shtjelluara m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare vijon t mbetet i prshtatshm. N kto rrethana, ai vendosi: https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fja_e_politikes_monetare_dhe_miratimin_e_paketes_se_deeuroizimit.html Pagina 3 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko n konfearrjen e politiks monetare dhe miratimin e pakets s deeuroizimit 29/07/22, 13:37 T mbaj t pandryshuar normn baz n interesit, n nivelin 1.25%; dhe, T mbaj t pandryshuar normat e interesit t depozits dhe t kredis njditore, respektivisht n nivelet 0.25 dhe 2.25%. Gjithashtu, n baz t informacionit t disponuar, Kshilli Mbikqyrs: S pari, rikonfirmon se intensiteti i stimulit monetar nuk do t zbutet para tremujorit t katrt t vitit 2018. Edhe m tej, politika monetare pritet t vazhdoj t mbetet n kahun stimulues gjat gjith horizontit afatmesm, pr t siguruar konvergimin e qndrueshm t inflacionit n objektiv. S dyti, konstaton se balanca e rreziqeve mbi parashikimet tona vijon t mbetet n e zhvendosur n kahun e poshtm. S treti, rithekson se "prtej dimensionit ciklik" prshpejtimi i mtejshm i ritmit t rritjes ekonomike krkon vazhdimin rigoroz t reformave strukturore. Kto reforma duhet t kontribuojn n rritjen e eficiencs, n zgjerimin e potencialit prodhues t vendit, dhe n rritjen e rezistencs s ekonomis ndaj goditjeve t mundshme. T nderuar prfaqsues t medias, Duke prfituar nga mundsia e ktij komunikimi publik, m lejoni tju prezantoj dhe nj vendim t rndsishm, t marr n mbledhjen e sotme nga Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris, dhe q ka t bj me nismn ton pr promovimin e prdorimit t monedhs kombtare n transaksionet ekonomike dhe financiare n vend. Kjo nism, e njohur edhe si paketa e deeuorizimit, sht prcaktuar tashm si nj synim mbarkombtar, prmes nnshkrimit t Memorandumit t Bashkpunimit n prill t vitit t kaluar. Ky memorandum formalizon dakordsin pr prpjekje t prbashkta dhe t koordinuara, n nivel kombtar, midis tre institucioneve: Banks s Shqipris, Ministris s Financave dhe Ekonomis, dhe Autoritetit t Mbikqyrjes Financiare. Prpara se t vijoj me detajimin e masave konkrete, m lejoni t them dy fjal mbi motivin e ksaj nisme. Banka e Shqipris vlerson se procesi i deeuroizimit sht i nevojshm dhe dobiprurs n afatin e gjat, si pr prmirsimin e efektivitetit t politikave ekonomike dhe financiare ashtu edhe pr uljen e rreziqeve t stabilitetit financiar. Studimet dhe analizat tona evidentojn se prdorimi i valutave t huaja n sfern e aktivitetit t brendshm ekonomik financiar sht n nj shkall relativisht t lart. Ky fenomen lidhet si me prdorimin e lart t valutave n transaksionet tregtare, ashtu edhe me prdorimin e lart t tyre si mjet kursimi, n formn e depozitave bankare, apo edhe si mjet financimi, n trajtn e kredimarrjes n valut. Q n fillim, dshiroj ta qartsoj publikun se Banka e Shqipris nuk synon uljen n zero t prdorimit t valutave n veprimtarin financiare, por uljen e euroizimit n nivele t pranueshme pr ekonomi me struktur dhe madhsi t ngjashme. Ajo q ne duam t reduktojm, t zbutim apo t minimizojm, sht prania e pozicioneve t https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fja_e_politikes_monetare_dhe_miratimin_e_paketes_se_deeuroizimit.html Pagina 4 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko n konfearrjen e politiks monetare dhe miratimin e pakets s deeuroizimit 29/07/22, 13:37 hapura valutore dhe marrja prsipr e rrezikut t kursit t kmbimit, direkt apo indirekt, n mnyr t pastudiuar apo t pambrojtur, nga konsumatori, nga biznesi dhe nga agjentt e tregut financiar. Nisur nga sa m sipr, si dhe duke synuar t konkretizojm angazhimin ton institucional, Kshilli Mbikqyrs mori n shqyrtim dhe miratoi nj paket vendimesh n mbshtetje t nxitjes s prdorimit t monedhs kombtare. N kt kuadr, u miratuan: 1) S pari, dokumenti i Politiks "Mbi zgjerimin e prdorimit t monedhs kombtare n veprimtarin e sektorit bankar dhe t institucioneve financiare jobankare q rregullohen e mbikqyren nga Banka e Shqipris". Dokumenti prcakton mnyrn se si Banka e Shqipris do t kontribuoj n kt proces (i njohur ndryshe si deeuroizim) dhe si do t vlersoj ndikimin e ktij kontributi. 2) S dyti, disa ndryshime rregullative, t cilat finalizojn punn e zhvilluar gjat vitit t kaluar pr identifikimin, vlersimin dhe konsultimin me industrin bankare, t disa masave q mbshtesin zgjerimin e prdorimit t monedhs kombtare n veprimtarin e sektorit bankar. Kto ndryshime rregullative synojn ta bjn m t kushtueshme (pra, m pak t preferuar) veprimtarin n valut t sektorit bankar dhe t forcojn mekanizmat e ndrgjegjsimit t huamarrsve (veanrisht t atyre individ dhe t pambrojtur nga rreziku i kursit t kmbimit) pr rreziqet q shoqrojn huamarrjen n valut. Kto ndryshime, hyjn n fuqi brenda gjashtmujorit t par t ktij viti. N mbyllje, m lejoni t theksoj se ky proces krkon nj angazhim afatgjat, ndaj kto masa mund t plotsohen me t tjera n t ardhmen. N do rast, Banka e Shqipris do t veproj gradualisht dhe n konsultim me industrin bankare. Q t jet efektiv, procesi duhet t jet gjithprfshirs, ndaj Banka e Shqipris do t harmonizoj maksimalisht veprimet e saj me autoritetet e tjera q mbikqyrin sistemin dhe tregjet financiare n vend, si edhe do t konsultohet vazhdimisht me institucionet relevante evropiane. Honorable, Mr. Ambassador, Honored guests, I welcomed the invitation to attend this meeting, for the very fact that issues of economic growth, sustainable development, as well as the country's European integration, should be seen as integrated and interdependent topics. I am convinced that this roundtable will serve to identify these addictions and build integrated development strategies. Today's economic, financial and geopolitical realities dictate the expansion of the field of analysis and broaden the perspective of our economic policies. The globalisation process, the expansion of markets and the integration of production chains are a challenge we are facing and will increasingly face in the future. Like any challenge, it can bring benefits, if properly managed, but also cost and loss, if not understood and addressed in time. On the positive side, integration and globalization offers developing countries financial capital and enables access to larger markets. On the negative side, integration and globalization strengthen competition between products, between companies, but also between countries. In this welcoming word, I want to share with you my personal perspective on the role and importance of economic diplomacy. But before I present this view, let me say two words on the current stage and the prospects of developing the Albanian economy. Last week, the Bank of Albania's Supervisory Council conducted periodic quarterly analysis of the Albanian economy and financial markets. Based on the information available, we concluded that the Albanian economy follows to be characterized by a positive development moment. The economic growth of 2017 is expected to fluctuate at the interval 3.5% - 4%. Demand growth has enabled production growth and, in a virtuoso chain of consequences, is associated with expansion ... 2/5 05/08/22, 17:17 Gupvernator Sejko's sentence, in T, you are round with the theme: p"Energjjia dh, and The Development of The Important Ekonomgikj - The Role of Dipl... employment, improving the financial situation of families and businesses, as well as reducing the Economic and financial imbalances. Despite weaknesses, which are still present, economic growth is gaining an increasingly broad base. In sectoral terms, the expansion of production has reflected the positive contribution of almost all sectors: industry, service, construction and agriculture. In terms of the source of spending, economic growth has reflected the empowerment of family consumption, the positive trend of domestic and foreign investment, as well as the increase in Albanian exports, and in particular the export of tourism services. Finally, in terms of development policies, economic growth has reflected monetary stimulus and fiscal consolidation, which have enabled low interest rates and abundant liquidity in markets, as well as the careful supervisory and regulatory policies we have pursued, policies that have enabled a healthy, profitable and credit-capable financial system. The country's economic and financial stability, empowering growth sources, but also improving the global economic environment, make us optimistic about the future. Of course, as policymakers, we have a lot of work to do so that these positive premises turn them into reality. We are aware of this and I think our positive record in the past is evidence of our seriousness, dedication and results. However, from my point of view as Governor, I am convinced that we can and must do more. Let me identify three main directions, in which economic diplomacy can be oriented. First, economic diplomacy should aim to increase interest in foreign capital investment in Albania. Over the past five years, foreign direct investment has been around the average level of 8.7% of GDP, or about 870m euros a year, ranking us second in the region, behind Montenegro. However, Albania continues to remain penultimate in the region as it belongs to the stock ... 3/5 05/08/2j2, 17, :1p7 The word of The Sejko Governance, n, of the Rumjbullac stake with the theme: "Energy and Economic Centreable Development - Role of Dipl... foreign investment and remains a country hungry for capital investment, throughout economic sectors. Second, we need to do more to have a better sectoral distribution of these investments. According to the information we have, about 23% of foreign investment has focused on the energy sector and this is undoubtedly encouraging in terms of the prospect of developing this sector. But, on the other hand, sectors with high development potential, such as the processing industry, have remained relatively behind in attracting foreign investment. Third, economic diplomacy can become more part of efforts to promote the brand of Albanian products, i.e. for expanding markets and increasing the penetration of our products in these markets. *** Honored participants, In the end, I would like to add something regarding the energy sector and its lending from the banking sector. The banking sector has always been interested in supporting the energy sector with investment. A few years ago, some legal changes were made to the law for concessions, which They have paved the legal path of investment in the field of energy. The financial sector, which consists mainly of banks - they occupy over 90% of the financial sector - has shown a considerable interest in supporting renewable energy projects, mainly hydropower projects. These loans take a considerable weight on loans granted by commercial banks. Of course, the 2008 crisis and the subsequent blow to the financial sector and the economy tightened the lending criteria of commercial banks. This tightening occurred in all sectors, including the energy sector, however lending has continued. Banks have continued to support those projects that meet the criteria and in continuity we see an interest in this sector. Of course, the energy sector has matured over time, so it has understood what the risks are and what it needs to meet in order to become more credit-supported by commercial banks. It is in the common interest of both investors in the field of energy and commercial banks. This is one of the most profitable sectors, 23% of foreign investment in Albania is precisely in this sector. We expect further investment. The support of the energy sector by banks would be a positive element in absorbing foreign investment, as investors often and investors seek to share risk with the Albanian financial system. We as a regulator have overseen and supported the banking sector to stimulate the energy sector more, as one of the main sectors of the industry. Jam i bindur se kjo tryez e rrumbullakt do ti shrbej identifikimit t ktyre varsive dhe ndrtimit t strategjive t integruara t zhvillimit. Realitetet e sotme ekonomike, financiare dhe gjeopolitike, diktojn zgjerimin e fushs s analizs dhe zgjerimin e perspektivs s politikave tona ekonomike. Procesi i globalizimit, zgjerimi i tregjeve dhe integrimi i zinxhirve t prodhimit, jan nj sfid me t ciln po prballemi e do t prballemi gjithnj e m shum n t ardhmen. Si do sfid, ajo mund t sjell prfitime, nse administrohet si duhet, por edhe kosto e humbje, nse nuk kuptohet dhe nuk trajtohet n koh. N ann pozitive, integrimi dhe globalizimi iu ofron vendeve n zhvillim, kapitale financiare dhe iu mundson akses n tregje m t mdha. N ann negative, integrimi dhe globalizimi forcon konkurrencn midis produkteve, midis kompanive, por edhe midis vendeve. N kt fjal prshndetse, dshiroj t ndaj me ju kndvshtrimin tim personal mbi rolin dhe rndsin e diplomacis ekonomike. Por, prpara se t parashtroj kt kndvshtrim, m lejoni t them dy fjal mbi stadin aktual dhe perspektivat e zhvillimit t ekonomis shqiptare. Javn e shkuar, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris kreu analizn periodike tremujore t ekonomis dhe t tregjeve financiare shqiptare. N baz t informacionit t disponuar, ne konkluduam se ekonomia shqiptare vijon t karakterizohet nga nj moment pozitiv zhvillimi. Rritja ekonomike e vitit 2017 pritet t luhatet n intervalin 3.5% - 4%. Rritja e krkess ka mundsuar rritjen e prodhimit dhe, n nj zinxhir virtuoz pasojash, sht shoqruar me zgjerimin https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_Sejko_ne_Tryezen_e_Rrumbullaket_me_teme_Ene 2/5 05/08/22, 17:17 Fjjala e Gupvernatorit Sejko, n T, ryezn je Rrumbullakt me tem:p"Energjjia dh,e Zhvillimi i Qnqdrueshm Ekonomgikj - Roli i Dipl e punsimit, prmirsimin e gjendjes financiare t familjeve dhe t bizneseve, si dhe reduktimin e zhbalancimeve ekonomike e financiare. Pavarsisht dobsive, t cilat vijojn t jen ende t pranishme, rritja ekonomike po merr nj baz gjithnj e m t gjer. N aspektin sektorial, zgjerimi i prodhimit ka pasqyruar kontributin pozitiv t pothuajse t gjith sektorve: industris, shrbimit, ndrtimit dhe bujqsis. N aspektin e burimit t shpenzimeve, rritja ekonomike ka pasqyruar fuqizimin e konsumit familjar, trendin pozitiv t investimeve t brendshme dhe t huaja, si dhe rritjen e eksporteve shqiptare, e n veanti t eksportit t shrbimeve t turizmit. S fundi, n aspektin e politikave t zhvillimit, rritja ekonomike ka pasqyruar stimulin monetar dhe konsolidimin fiskal, t cilt kan mundsuar norma t ulta interesi dhe likuiditet t bollshm n tregje, si dhe politikat e kujdesshme mbikqyrse e rregullatore q kemi ndjekur, politika t cilat kan mundsuar nj sistem financiar t shndetshm, fitimprurs dhe t aft pr kreditim. Stabiliteti ekonomik dhe financiar i vendit, fuqizimi i burimeve t rritjes, por edhe prmirsimi i ambientit ekonomik botror, na bjn optimist pr t ardhmen. Natyrisht, neve si politikbrs, na mbetet shum pun pr t br, n mnyr q kto premisa pozitive ti shndrrojm n realitet. Ne jemi t ndrgjegjshm pr kt dhe mendoj se rekordi yn pozitiv n t shkuarn sht dshmi e seriozitetit, prkushtimit dhe e rezultateve tona. Megjithat, nga kndvshtrimi im si Guvernator, jam i bindur se ne mund dhe duhet t bjm m shum. M lejoni t identifikoj tre drejtime kryesore, n t cilat mund t orientohet diplomacia ekonomike. S pari, diplomacia ekonomike duhet t synoj rritjen e interesit pr investimin e kapitaleve t huaja n Shqipri. Gjat pes viteve t fundit, investimet e huaja direkte kan qen rreth nivelit mesatar 8.7% t PBB-s, ose rreth 870 milion euro n vit, duke na renditur n vendin e dyt n rajon, pas Malit t Zi. Megjithat, Shqipria vijon t mbetet e parafundit n rajon sa i takon stokut https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_Sejko_ne_Tryezen_e_Rrumbullaket_me_teme_Ene 3/5 05/08/2j2, 17, :1p7 Fjala e Guvernatgorjit Sejko, n,  Tryqezpn e Rrumjbullakt me tem: "Enerpgjia dhe Zhvillimi i Qndjrueshm Ekonomik - Roli i Dipl t investimeve t huaja dhe vijon t mbetet nj vend q ka uri pr investime kapitale, n t gjith sektort ekonomik. S dyti, ne duhet t bjm m shum pr t pasur nj shprndarje m t mir sektoriale t ktyre investimeve. Sipas informacionit q disponojm, rreth 23% e investimeve t huaja jan prqendruar n sektorin e energjetiks dhe kjo sht padyshim dika inkurajuese sa i takon perspektivs s zhvillimit t ktij sektori. Por, nga ana tjetr, sektor me potencial t lart zhvillimi, si industria prpunuese, kan mbetur relativisht mbrapa n trheqjen e investimeve t huaja. S treti, diplomacia ekonomike mund t bhet m shum pjes e prpjekjeve pr promovimin e brand-it t produkteve shqiptare, pra pr zgjerimin e tregjeve dhe pr rritjen e penetrimit t produkteve tona n kto tregje. *** T nderuar pjesmarrs, N prfundim, do t doja t shtoja dika lidhur me sektorin e energjis dhe kreditimin e tij nga sektori bankar. Sektori bankar ka qen gjithmon i interesuar t mbshtes me investime sektorin e energjis. Para disa vitesh, jan br disa ndryshime ligjore t ligjit pr koncesionet, t cilat kan hapur rrugn ligjore t investimit n fushn e energjis. Sektori financiar i cili prbhet kryesisht nga bankat - ato zn mbi 90% t sektorit financiar - ka shfaqur nj interes t konsiderueshm pr t mbshtetur me kreditim projektet e energjis s rinovueshme, kryesisht hidrocentralet. Kto kredi zn nj pesh t konsiderueshme n kredit e dhna nga bankat tregtare. Sigurisht q kriza e vitit 2008 dhe goditja q pasoi n sektorin financiar dhe ekonomin shtrngoi kriteret e kreditimit t bankave tregtare. Ky shtrngim ndodhi n t gjith sektort, prfshi dhe sektorin e energjis, megjithat kreditimi ka vazhduar. Bankat kan vazhduar t mbshtesin ato projekte q plotsojn kriteret dhe n vazhdimsi ne shohim nj interes pr kt sektor. Natyrisht q dhe sektori i energjis sht maturuar gjat kohs, pra ka kuptuar se cilat jan rreziqet dhe se far duhet t plotsoj n mnyr q t bhet m i mbshtetur me kreditim nga bankat tregtare. sht n interes t prbashkt si t investitorve n fushn e energjis ashtu dhe t bankave tregtare. Ky sht nj nga sektort m fitimprurs, 23% e investimeve t huaja n Shqipri jan pikrisht n kt sektor. Ne presim investime t mtejshme. Mbshtetja e sektorit t energjis nga bankat do t ishte nj element pozitiv n thithjen e investimeve t huaja, pasi shpeshher dhe investitort krkojn t ndajn rrezikun bashk me sistemin financiar shqiptar. Ne si rregullator, e kemi mbikqyrur dhe e kemi mbshtetur sektorin bankar q t stimuloj m shum sektorin e energjis, si nj nga sektort kryesor t industris. This project is a further step in the Bank of Albania's extremely fruitful co-operation with the World Bank in the field of payments, enabled by Swiss government funds. A World Bank initiative in support of migrant shipments, GreenBack aims to increase the efficiency of remittance markets, mainly through awareness and financial education. So far, the project in question has been implemented in a range of remittance countries, while now it is also implemented in a host country of remittances, such as our country. I find it appropriate to stress that their remittances and importance to the Albanian economy have always been in the focus of the Bank of Albania. Greenback 2.0 project for Albania as host country for remittances 29/07/22, 13:37 More specifically, in Albania more than 1/3 of families (about 32%) are remittance hosts, which are estimated to directly affect their well-being, funding consumption mainly for necessary good, education and health, as well as to some extent investments. Remittances have significantly affected poverty reduction and increased well-being of these families. Globally, it is estimated that a 10% increase in remittances affects poverty reduction by 3.5%. For the implementation of the GreenBack project, Berat has been selected as one of the cities with high shipment flows from immigrants, within the framework of supporting remittances and using them by families. In the event of a positive impasse from the implementation of this pilot project, this experience may well extend to other host cities or regions, expanding the effect nationally. The GreenBack project, as explained by World Bank colleagues, makes a complex address of remittances, in the perspective of payments, technical infrastructure, financial inclusion, market structure, consumer protection, poverty reduction - i.e. in the social, economic and technological framework. For this reason, it is worth pointing out that effectiveimplementation of this project requires close engagement and co-operation between different actors. As far as possible, take the opportunity to thank the readiness of a range of institutions for their involvement, both regionally and centrally, as well as to encourage the continuation of co-operation until the completion of the project. A key role has banks and other institutions operating in the field of payments, which I invite to be as active and creative as possible about the services offered on the market. From international experience it is estimated that remittances can serve as an important tool for expanding the financial involvement of the population, and as a result in promoting mediating activity, creating new potentials for your activity. I would single out here and the importance that costs have in sending remittances. The impact of these costs has been highlighted by a range of international organisations, which are taking concrete steps, with the aim of reducing them. More specifically, in 2009 the G8 and later the G20, with the aim of promoting migrant shipments, set a target of reducing the costs of sending remittances globally to 5%, while in 2016, the United Nations, within the framework of sustainable development, has undertaken an extremely ambitious target, which aims to reduce these costs to 3% in 2030, and the elimination of remittance corridors at a cost of over 5%. Reducing costs for migrant shipments should be a priority for us as well. N nivel global, vlersohet se nj rritje e remitancave me 10% ndikon n zbutjen e varfris me 3.5%. Ndikimi i ktyre kostove sht evidentuar nga nj sr organizatash ndrkombtare, t cilat po ndrmarrin hapa konkret, me qllim reduktimin e tyre. M konkretisht, n vitin 2009 G8 dhe m von G20, me qllim nxitjen e drgesave t emigrantve, vendosn si objektiv reduktimin e kostove t drgimit t remitancave n nivel global n 5%, ndrkoh q n vitin 2016, Kombet e Bashkuara, n kuadr t zhvillimit t qndrueshm, kan ndrmarr nj objektiv tejet ambicioz, i cili synon reduktimin e ktyre kostove n 3% n 2030, dhe eliminimin e korridoreve t remitancave me kosto mbi 5%. Has the Bank of Albania taken any measures to strengthen the euro and what other effects is expected to have on the market? Governor: The Bank of Albania follows a free exchange rate regime. In this framework, the course is determined by demand and supply. The Bank of Albania's policies are not intended to achieve a certain level of exchange rate, as it is a free regime. In case there are major exchange rate fluctuations, and if the criteria set by it are met, the Bank of Albania is interfering with the market. In the concrete case, we have not deemed that the criteria set to intervene have been met. The course is determined by demand and supply factors. Last week we had an overprice of our lek currency, which lasted for two days and then the course has returned to its previous tendencies. Operations and quotas of commercial banks and other agents operating with the exchange rate have stabilized. Bank of Albania analyses for a longer period of time show that the exchange rate, mainly euro-lek, but also for other currencies, is determined by fundamental factors. We, as the Bank of Albania, pride ourselves on the sustainability of our currency against other currencies, if we refer to exchange rate fluctuations. Our currency has considerable stability, compared to the currencies of the countries of the region, but even wider. At the moment, it must be said that the course has been restabilized after last week's market fluctuations. We do not anticipate further fluctuations, but I stress once again that the course is determined by market demand and supply. We have no objective of interfering with the exchange rate. N kt kuadr, kursi prcaktohet nga krkesa dhe oferta. Politikat e Banks s Shqipris nuk kan si objektiv arritjen e nj niveli t caktuar t kursit t kmbimit, duke qen se sht regjim i lir. Analizat e Banks s Shqipris pr nj periudh m t gjat kohore, tregojn se kursi i kmbimit, kryesisht euro-lek, por edhe pr monedhat e tjera, sht prcaktuar nga faktor fondamental. Ne si Banka e Shqipris, krenohemi me qndrueshmrin e monedhs ton kundrejt monedhave t tjera, nse i referohemi luhatjeve t kursit t kmbimit. Monedha jon ka nj stabilitet t konsiderueshm, krahasuar me monedhat e vendeve t rajonit, por edhe m gjer. Pr momentin, duhet thn se kursi sht ristabilizuar pas luhatjeve t tregut t javs s kaluar. Nuk parashikojm q t ket luhatje t tjera, por e theksoj dhe njher se kursi prcaktohet nga krkesa dhe oferta t tregut. Ne nuk kemi objektiv t ndrhyjm n kursin e kmbimit. text: 05/08/22, 17:17 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Sejko's word at press conference on monetary policy decision-making Bank of Albania Governor Gent Sejko's word at press conference on monetary policy decision-making Publication date: 06.06.2018 Honored media representatives, At today's meeting, the Bank of Albania's Supervisory Council was recognised with the latest developments in financial markets in the country. In particular, he stopped short of analysing the rapid overpriceof the exchange rate on its expected impact on inflation performance over the medium-term horizon as ... 1/3 05/08/22, 17:17 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Sejko's word at press conference on monetary policy decision-making exchange rate, its expected impact on inflation performance over the medium-term horizon, such as and in assessing the appropriateness of monetary policy stance. In the press release dated May 2, based on analysis of supporting factors, the Supervisory Council estimated that course strengthening rhythms by April would have a limited and transitional effect on inflation. However, the exchange rate performance during May showed a further and faster strengthening of it. This overpricehas gone beyond the strengthening curve of the two previous years and seems to reflect the creation of unilateral expectations - in the strengthening exchange rate direction - by currency market operators. These expectations are caused by information for increased currency supply, mainly in response to the expected conversion of capital by some banks of the system, the disbursement of a currency loan in favour of a public company, as well as expectations for a good tourist season. Consequently, expectations have simultaneously brought increased supply and reduced demand for currencies. The action of these factors - although estimated to be temporary - has resulted in strong course overlap. This overreach - which was identified as a risk factor in the meeting of the Supervisory Council in May - has strengthened pressures on the falling inflation. Our judgment on the country's economic and financial situation and prospects has not changed. The development trend is expected to be positive, characterized by further economic growth, by the gradual movement of the economy towards balance, as well as the progressive strengthening of internal inflationary pressures. However, the Supervisory Council estimates that the strengthening of the exchange rate in consumer prices curbs the speed of returning inflation to target. Also, although in the absence of a change in fundamental factors, short-term one-sided expectations on the strengthening exchange rate path risk turning into stable and long-term expectations. Consolidating these expectations and creating their self-fulfilling dimension can create a vicious circle with harmful impact on inflation and other economic indicators. Judging above, the Supervisory Council assessed further easing of monetary policy stance as necessary. This assessment is in full consistency with our previous assessments and communications. Under these circumstances, the Supervisory Council decided: Lower the base interest rate by 0.25 percentage points, lowering it to 1.00%; Lower the one-day deposit interest rate by 0.15 percentage points, bringing it down to 0.10%; Lower the one-day loan interest rate by 0.35 percentage points, bringing it down to 1.90%. The increase in monetary stimulus is expected to be accompanied by further reductions in credit interest rates and increased circulation of monetary tools in money. In this way, he is expected to ... 2/3 05/08/22, 17:17 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Sejko's word at press conference on monetary policy decision-making gives an additional boost to aggregate demand, both through lowering the cost of consumer financing and investments even through rebalancing demand and currency supply in the financial market. Also, starting from the need to create the right monetary conditions for maintaining price stability as well as reflecting on reducing the scope of use of the traditional monetary policy instrument, the basic interest rate, the Supervisory Council placed the company of currency purchase operations on the internal currency market. These operations will be undertaken in accordance with the legal and regulatory framework. Currency purchase operations will aim at eliminating the temporary currency surplus in the market and curbing further strengthening of the exchange rate, a strengthening that would harm meeting our target for price stability. In this way, operations will serve to meet and strengthen monetary stimulus, transmitted through lowering the basic interest rate. They will also help the market find the fair price of the exchange of lek versus currencies, in line with the stable and long-term reports of demand and supply for it. Currency purchase operations will preserve the necessary and sufficient duration for meeting our objectives. Finally, the Supervisory Council finds it appropriate to stress that the exchange rate in Albania has been, is and will be a free course, which is determined by reports of demand and supply in the currency market. For this reason, we once again invite all operators of the economy and financial markets to avoid unstudied, unprotected and unwanted exposures to currencies. The use of currency operations is and will remain a separate case, undertaken under the specific circumstances of the need for monetary policy reaction and the narrowing of the space of action of its traditional instruments.
