Gent Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare kursit t kmbimit, n ndikimin e pritur t tij n ecurin e inflacionit gjat horizontit afatmesm, si dhe n vlersimin e prshtatshmris s qndrimit t politiks monetare. N deklaratn pr shtyp t dats 2 maj, bazuar n analizn e faktorve mbshtets, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se ritmet e forcimi t kursit deri n muajin prill do t kishin nj efekt t kufizuar dhe kalimtar n inflacion. Megjithat, ecuria e kursit t kmbimit gjat muajit maj tregoi nj forcim t mtejshm dhe m t shpejt t tij. Ky mbimim ka shkuar prtej trendit forcues t dy viteve paraardhse dhe duket se pasqyron krijimin e pritjeve t njanshme  n kahun forcues t kursit t kmbimit  nga operatort e tregut valutor. Kto pritje jan shkaktuar nga informacioni pr rritje t oferts valutore, kryesisht n prgjigje t konvertimit t pritur t kapitalit nga disa banka t sistemit, t disbursimit t nj kredie n valut n favor t nj kompanie publike, si dhe t pritjeve pr nj sezon t mir turistik. Si rrjedhoj, pritjet kan sjell njkohsisht rritje t oferts dhe reduktim t krkess pr valut. Veprimi i ktyre faktorve  ndonse vlersohet t jet i prkohshm  ka rezultuar n mbimim t fort t kursit. Ky mbimim  i cili u identifikua si nj faktor rreziku n mbledhjen e Kshillit Mbikqyrs n muajin maj  ka forcuar presionet n kahun rns t inflacionit. Gjykimi yn mbi situatn dhe perspektivat ekonomike dhe financiare t vendit nuk ka ndryshuar. Trendi i zhvillimit pritet t jet pozitiv, i karakterizuar nga rritja e mtejshme ekonomike, nga lvizja graduale e ekonomis drejt ekuilibrit, si dhe forcimi progresiv i presioneve t brendshme inflacioniste. Megjithat, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlerson se prcjellja e forcimit t kursit t kmbimit n mimet e konsumit e frenon shpejtsin e kthimit t inflacionit n objektiv. Gjithashtu, edhe pse n munges t ndryshimit t faktorve fondamental, pritjet e njanshme afatshkurtra mbi kahun forcues t kursit t kmbimit rrezikojn t shndrrohen n pritje t qndrueshme dhe afatgjata. Konsolidimi i ktyre pritjeve dhe krijimi i dimensionit vet-prmbushs t tyre, mund t krijojn nj rreth vicioz me ndikim t dmshm n inflacion dhe n treguesit e tjer ekonomik. Duke gjykuar mbi sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi si t nevojshm lehtsimin e mtejshm t qndrimit t politiks monetare. Ky vlersim sht n konsistenc t plot me vlersimet dhe komunikimet tona paraardhse. N kto rrethana, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi: T ul me 0.25 pik prqindjeje normn baz t interesit, duke e zbritur at n nivelin 1.00%; T ul me 0.15 pik prqindjeje normn e interesit t depozits njditore, duke e zbritur at n nivelin 0.10%; T ul me 0.35 pik prqindjeje normn e interesit t kredis njditore, duke e zbritur at n nivelin 1.90%. Rritja e stimulit monetar pritet t shoqrohet me reduktim t mtejshm t normave t interesit t kredis dhe me rritje t qarkullimit t mjeteve monetare n lek. Gent Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare jap nj impuls shtes krkess agregate, si nprmjet uljes s kostos s financimit t konsumit dhe t investimeve edhe nprmjet riekuilibrimit t krkess dhe oferts pr valut n tregun financiar. Gjithashtu, duke u nisur nga nevoja e krijimit t kushteve t duhura monetare pr ruajtjen e stabilitetit t mimeve si dhe duke reflektuar mbi reduktimin e hapsirs s prdorimit t instrumentit tradicional t politiks monetare, norms baz t interesit, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi ndrmarrjen e operacioneve t blerjeve t valuts n tregun e brendshm valutor. Kto operacione do t ndrmerren n prputhje me kuadrin ligjor dhe rregullativ. Operacionet e blerjes s valuts do t synojn eliminimin e teprics s prkohshme t valuts n treg dhe frenimin e forcimit t mtejshm t kursit t kmbimit, forcim i cili do t dmtonte prmbushjen e objektivit ton pr stabilitetin e mimeve. N kt mnyr, operacionet do ti shrbejn plotsimit dhe prforcimit t stimulit monetar, t transmetuar nprmjet uljes s norms baz t interesit. Gjithashtu, ato do t ndihmojn tregun pr t gjetur mimin e drejt t kmbimit t lekut kundrejt valutave, n linj me raportet e qndrueshme dhe afatgjata t krkess dhe oferts pr t. Operacionet e blerjes s valuts do t ruajn kohzgjatjen e nevojshme dhe t mjaftueshme pr prmbushjen e objektivave tan. S fundi, Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjen me vend t theksoj se kursi i kmbimit n Shqipri ka qen, sht dhe do t jet nj kurs i lir, i cili prcaktohet nga raportet e krkess dhe oferts n tregun valutor. Pr kt arsye, ftojm dhe nj her t gjith operatort e ekonomis dhe t tregjeve financiare t shmangin ekspozimet e pastudiuara, t pambrojtura dhe t padshiruara n valut. Prdorimi i operacioneve valutore sht dhe do t mbetet nj rast i veant, i ndrmarr n rrethanat specifike t nevojs pr reagim t politiks monetare dhe t ngushtimit t hapsirs s veprimit t instrumenteve t saj tradicional. Title: Questions - answers to the press conference
text: Question  answers of the press conference dated May 2, 2018 Publication date: 02.05.2018 Q: Yesterday there was an open public letter from the Exporters Association calling for the intervention of the Bank of Albania in terms of deeuroisation of the economy. What is your position, since they expressed that there will be money missing from circulation? Governor: I invite exporters to come and talk to the Bank of Albania to clarify more clearly on the effects our strategy has and the role of the Bank of Albania. We have received the letter and join the concern of exporters. But, I want to make it clear that the Bank of Albania, as an institution that aims to maintain price stability, looks at the macro phenomenon and the impact of the exchange rate on the economy level. It has been mentioned many times in the media that one of the factors that has influenced the oversupply of the exchange rate has been the psychological effect of the measures taken by the strategy of stimulating the use of the national currency that we have launched. In fact, this strategy has measures related to mandatory reserve and apply only to the banking market. From the data we have so far, the level of deposits in currencies, and mainly in euros, has not changed, but rather has increased. If there is a decline in these deposits, this comes precisely from the overprice of the exchange rate, as expressed in the money show decline, but de facto in absolute value expressed in the original currency have shown growth. So we have neither a drop in foreign exchange deposits nor falling interest rates. We have envisaged that the strategy of deeuroisation and stimulation of the use of the national currency has a neutral effect on the banking system and the financial system. This is as measures applying on mandatory currency reserves they are compensated for in money and vice versa. We expect a decrease in foreign currency positions in relation to the national currency in a 3-5 year term. Except that the measures have not yet come into force. If we have a psychological effect, which is not impossible, this one comes from the market. It comes from a noise, overreaction, misunderstanding or perhaps misreaction from market perception. But we also have many other factors related to the real market, we have high inflows, fundamental factors. I mentioned and during the statement, the exchange rate overprice has been beginning since the second six months of 2015. In case we have an overpriced exchange rate from fundamental factors, this shows that the course is moving towards a new balance and that there is no problem for the economy, as it shows increased purchasing power of the economy. But if we have a higher overprice than the impact of fundamental factors, as a result of various factors, then this negatively affects the level of inflation. With the main objective of price stability, we carefully monitor the market and would respond in such a case, in accordance with our monetary policy regime. And that's exactly what we're doing, monitoring the exchange rate daily, based on parameters and criteria, also determining our response strategy according to conventional monetary policy instruments. I call on all economic agents not to take hasty pre-trial actions on the course level, i.e. not to make conversions driven by exchange rate fluctuations, as they may suffer losses in the future. Any psychological impact or various factors on the exchange rate, which is outside of fundamental factors, is always temporary. And if it is temporary it means that those economic agents would do hasty actions and have losses. This is the postulate and it happened. But of course, no one can predict how he will go. That otherwise we would be prophets if we predicted the level of exchange rate and thus the reactions would be correct, even for economic agents. One thing is certain that we have high inflows of the euro into the economy. But also strengthening or overpriced the exchange rate beyond parameters may be also as a result of speculative factors in the market. Therefore, and once, I call on economic agents to react intelligently and to take measures continuously, not just in a situation of overprice or undermining, to lower the risk of the exchange rate in their contracts, as happens all over the world. To return and once to what you mentioned, I invite exporters and we will keep in touch with them to explain in detail our strategy for promoting the use of the national currency and to clarify that this strategy does not target the impact of the exchange rate. We have as our objective price stability and a excessive overpriceof the course would affect our objective. We will develop all elements of our strategy so that we are clear and coordinated not only with exporters, but also with all other interest groups that are sensitive to this issue. Q: You talked about the incoming flows, what are the sources of these incoming flows? Governor: We have constantly mentioned the sources of incoming flows. They are foreign investments, remittances, and especially the summer period brings in visitors and tourism. We also have improved balance sheets of trade exchanges with abroad. It has been noted that the level of exports has increased significantly over the last period, which also shows increased competitiveness. One of the factors that has influenced the exchange rate is precisely the high level of exports. Albanian exports have had a very positive increase, but on the other hand we have current account deficit, the balance of exports-imports is negative, so we have more imports than exports. In the concrete case, for every lek of overpriced exchange rate there are more beneficiaries than losers. But that is not the strategy and purpose of the Bank of Albania. At the macro level, I said that the overprice of the exchange rate shows increased purchasing power, as long as it is determined by fundamental factors. Our objective is to have a price stability and reach the 3% inflation target. We will co-operate with all interest groups to be as transparent and coordinated as possible for explaining the Bank of Albania's strategy in line with its legal objectives so that we do not have misunderstandings or misperceptions, as is often the case, as they are specific and difficult to understand macroeconomic phenomena. We will continue to have as transparent and elaborate communication as possible to understand, clarify and orient markets in the right direction. But of course the course is a consequence of demand  supply, since we have a free currency exchange rate regime.

Por, n rast se kemi nj mbimim m t lart sesa ndikimi i faktorve fondamental, si pasoj e faktorve t ndryshm, ather kjo ndikon negativisht dhe n nivelin e inflacionit. Duke pasur objektiv kryesor stabilitetin e mimeve, ne monitorojm me kujdes tregun dhe do t reagonim n rast t till, n prputhje me regjimin ton t politiks monetare. Dhe pikrisht kt po bjm, po monitorojm kursin e kmbimit n mnyr ditore, n baz t parametrave dhe kritereve, duke prcaktuar dhe strategjin ton t reagimit sipas instrumenteve konvencional t politiks monetare. Un i bj thirrje gjith agjentve ekonomik q t mos bjn veprime t nxituara paragjykuese mbi nivelin e kursit, pra t mos bjn konvertime t nxitura nga luhatjet e kursit t kmbimit, pasi mund t psojn humbje n t ardhmen. do ndikim psikologjik ose nga faktor t ndryshm n kursin e kmbimit, i cili sht jasht faktorve fondamental, sht gjithmon i prkohshm. Dhe n rast se sht i prkohshm kjo do t thot q ata agjent ekonomik do t bnin veprime t nxituara dhe do t kishin humbje. Ky sht postulat dhe ka ndodhur. Por sigurisht, askush nuk e parashikon dot sesi do t shkoj; se ndryshe do t ishim profet po t parashikonim nivelin e kursit t kmbimit dhe kshtu reagimet do t ishin t sakta, edhe pr agjentt ekonomik. Nj gj sht e sigurt q ne kemi flukse t larta hyrse t euros n ekonomi. Por dhe forcimi ose mbimimi i kursit t kmbimit prtej parametrave mund t jet dhe si pasoj e faktorve spekulativ n treg. Prandaj dhe njher, i bj thirrje agjentve ekonomik pr t reaguar me zgjuarsi dhe pr t marr masa n vazhdimsi, jo vetm n nj situat mbimimi ose nnmimi, pr t ulur rrezikun e kursit t kmbimit n kontratat e tyre, sikurse ndodh n t gjith botn. Guvernatori: Ne i kemi prmendur vazhdimisht burimet e flukseve hyrse. Ato jan investimet e huaja, remitancat, dhe sidomos periudha e vers sjell t hyra nga vizitort dhe turizmi. Nj nga faktort q ka ndikuar kursin e kmbimit sht pikrisht niveli i lart i eksporteve. Eksportet shqiptare kan pasur nj rritje shum pozitive, por nga ana tjetr kemi deficit t llogaris korrente, bilanci i eksport-importeve sht negativ, pra kemi m shum importe sesa eksporte. N rastin konkret, pr do nj lek t mbimimit t kursit t kmbimit ka m shum prfitues sesa humbs. Por, nuk sht kjo strategjia dhe qllimi i Banks s Shqipris. N nivel makro, e thash q mbimimi i kursit t kmbimit tregon rritje t fuqis blerse, pr sa koh q prcaktohet nga faktor fondamental. Objektivi yn sht t kemi nj stabilitet mimesh dhe t arrijm objektivin prej 3% t inflacionit. Do t bashkpunojm me gjith grupet e interesit pr t qen sa m transparent dhe t koordinuar pr shpjegimin e strategjis t Banks s Shqipris n prputhje me objektivat e saj ligjor q mos t kemi keqkuptime apo keqperceptime, si ndodh shpeshher, pasi jan fenomene makroekonomike specifike dhe t vshtira pr tu kuptuar. Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making 29/07/22, 13:36 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making Publication date: 01.08.2018 The Albanian economy came to follow a positive development trend in the first six months of 2018. Economic activity has come to an increase, enabling employment expansion, wage growth, improving the financial situation of businesses and gradually strengthening inflationary pressures. These developments are supported by improved foreign environment, improved confidence in the economy, favourable financial conditions, dictated by our easing monetary policy, as well as positive supply shocks. ... encen_per_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_21258.html Page 1 of 3 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making 29/07/22, 13:36 Our expectations for the future remain positive. However, their materialization requires the preservation of monetary policy easing kah, while the balance of risks remains shifting to the lower direction. Average second-quarter inflation recorded 2.2% value, coming in growth from the average rate of 1.9% of the first quarter. In particular, inflation scored 2.4% in the month of June. The balance of inflationary pressures continues to be formed by a gradual trend strengthening internal pressures and short-term price fluctuations of specific consumer basket items. The rise in inflation in the second quarter reflected the resulting effect of two reverse kah shocks. On the one hand, rising oil prices in international markets brought rising production costs and exerted a growing impact on inflation. On the other hand, strengthening the exchange rate curbed the conveyance of foreign inflationary pressures in the domestic market. The first factor had a stronger intensity of action in the second quarter, but its effect is estimated to be shorter in time. Our projections suggest that inflation will return to target within 2020. This forecast factors positive economic growth dynamics and our expectations for the economy to return to balance in the first six months of next year. It also relies on the assessment that disinflationary pressures from the exchange rate overprice will remain fleeting. These judgments find support from the economic and monetary data of the first six months. The Albanian economy marked a 4.45% increase in the first quarter, and indirect data speak of positive growth rates even in the second quarter. The acceleration of the pace of economic growth in the first quarter of the year reflected the rapid increase in electricity production, in response to good hydraulic conditions. In more long-term terms, the expansion of economic activity was based on increased consumption and private investment, while the deficit in foreign trade exchanges increased and fiscal policy remained in the consolidating direction. Indirect data suggest that these development trends were carried even in the second quarter. The expansion of economic activity has been associated with increased employment and a 12.5% drop in the unemployment rate. This rate represents the lowest historical level of unemployment recorded in Albania and suggests an increasingly full use of production capacities in the country. In response, Instat reports that average real wages increased by 2.3% in the first quarter, which represents a positive premise for gradually strengthening domestic inflationary pressures. The internal financial market continues to appear calm and secular, but the derogatory pressures of the lek continue to be present in its currency segment. Kto zhvillime jan mbshtetur nga prmirsimi i ambientit t huaj, nga prmirsimi i besimit n ekonomi, nga kushtet e favorshme financiare, t diktuara nga politika jon monetare lehtsuese, si dhe nga goditje pozitive t oferts. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjencen_per_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_21258.html Pagina 1 di 3 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare 29/07/22, 13:36 Pritjet tona pr t ardhmen mbeten pozitive. Megjithat, materializimi i tyre krkon ruajtjen e kahut lehtsues t politiks monetare, ndrsa balanca e rreziqeve mbetet e zhvendosur n kahun e poshtm. Inflacioni mesatar i tremujorit t dyt regjistroi vlern 2.2%, duke ardhur n rritje nga norma mesatare prej 1.9% e tremujorit t par. N veanti, inflacioni shnoi vlern 2.4% n muajin qershor. Balanca e presioneve inflacioniste vazhdon t formohet nga nj trend gradual forcimi t presioneve t brendshme dhe nga luhatje afatshkurtra t mimeve t artikujve specifik t shports s konsumit. Rritja e inflacionit n tremujorin e dyt pasqyroi efektin rezultant t dy goditjeve t kahut t kundrt. Nga njra an, rritja e mimit t nafts n tregjet ndrkombtare solli rritjen e kostove t prodhimit dhe ushtroi nj ndikim rrits n inflacion. Nga ana tjetr, forcimi i kursit t kmbimit frenoi prcjelljen e presioneve t huaja inflacioniste n tregun vendas. Faktori i par ka pasur nj intensitet m t fort veprimi n tremujorin e dyt, por efekti i tij vlersohet t jet m i shkurtr n koh. Projeksionet tona sugjerojn se inflacioni do t kthehet n objektiv brenda vitit 2020. Ky parashikim faktorizon dinamikn pozitive t rritjes ekonomike dhe pritjet tona pr kthimin e ekonomis n ekuilibr n gjashtmujorin e par t vitit t ardhshm. Gjithashtu, ai mbshtetet n vlersimin se presionet dezinflacioniste t ardhura nga mbimimi i kursit t kmbimit do t mbeten kalimtare. Kto gjykime gjejn mbshtetje nga t dhnat ekonomike e monetare t gjashtmujorit t par. Ekonomia shqiptare shnoi nj rritje prej 4.45% n tremujorin e par, dhe t dhnat e trthorta flasin pr ritme pozitive rritjeje edhe n tremujorin e dyt. Prshpejtimi i ritmit t rritjes ekonomike n tremujorin e par t vitit pasqyroi rritjen e shpejt t prodhimit t energjis elektrike, n prgjigje t kushteve t mira hidrike. N terma m afatgjat, zgjerimi i aktivitetit ekonomik u bazua te rritja e konsumit dhe e investimeve private, ndrkoh q deficiti i shkmbimeve tregtare me jasht u rrit dhe politika fiskale vijoi t mbetet n kahun konsolidues. T dhnat e trthorta sugjerojn se kto tendenca zhvillimi jan mbartur edhe n tremujorin e dyt. Zgjerimi i aktivitetit ekonomik sht shoqruar me rritjen e punsimit dhe rnien n 12.5% t norms s papunsis. Kjo norm prbn nivelin m t ult historik t papunsis t regjistruar n Shqipri dhe sugjeron nj prdorim gjithnj e m t plot t kapaciteteve prodhuese n vend. N prgjigje t saj, Instat-i raporton se paga mesatare reale u rrit me 2.3% n tremujorin e par, ka prbn nj premis pozitive pr forcimin gradual t presioneve t brendshme inflacioniste. Tregu i brendshm financiar vazhdon t shfaqet i qet dhe likuid, por presionet mbimuese t lekut vijojn t jen t pranishme n segmentin e tij valutor. Masat e fundit t politiks monetare  ulja n nivelin 1.0% e norms baz t interesit dhe ndrhyrja n tregun e brendshm valutor, me objektiv frenimin e mbimimit t shpejt t kursit t kmbimit  kan rezultuar efektive. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjencen_per_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_21258.html Pagina 2 di 3 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare 29/07/22, 13:36 Normat e interesit t lekut kan ardhur n rnie n tremujorin e dyt. Normat e interesit t kredive, depozitave dhe letrave me vler n lek shfaqen n nivele minimale. Kredia pr sektorin privat regjistroi nj rritje mesatare me 5% n tremujorin e dyt t vitit, me nj kontribut m t balancuar n rritje midis kredis n lek dhe kredis n valut. N prgjithsi, rritja e kredis sht n linj me prmirsimin e moderuar t krkess pr t. Megjithat, vrojtimi i aktivitetit kreditues sugjeron se standardet dhe kushtet e kreditimit t aplikuara nga sektori bankar vijojn t mbeten konservatore. Banka e Shqipris konstaton se rnia e rrezikut t kredis dhe prmirsimi i vazhdueshm i bilanceve, sikundr ilustrohet nga rnia n nivelin 13.27% e raportit t kredive me probleme, duhet t gjejn nj pasqyrim m t mir n politikat e kreditimit t sektorit bankar. Pas mbimimit t shpejt t regjistruar n muajt prill-maj, ndrhyrja e Banks s Shqipris arriti t qetsoj funksionimin e tregut t brendshm valutor dhe t frenoj mbimimin e kursit t kmbimit. Megjithat, analizat tona sugjerojn se raporti i krkess dhe oferts n tregun valutor mbetet i zhbalancuar, pjesrisht dhe si pasoj e prurjeve t larta sezonale, dhe se mbimimi i shpejt dhe i mtejshm i kursit t kmbimit do t dmtonte kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv n afatin e mesm. Duke gjykuar mbi sa m sipr, Banka e Shqipris vlerson se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare mbetet i prshtatshm. N kto rrethana, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi: t mbaj t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 1.0%; t mbaj t pandryshuara normat e interesit t depozits dhe t kredis njditore, respektivisht n nivelin 0.1% dhe 1.9%; t vijoj programin e blerjeve n tregun valutor, me synim frenimin e mbimimit t shpejt t kursit t kmbimit. Ruajtja e kahut stimulues t politiks monetare n afatin e mesm do ti shrbej nxitjes s krkess agregate, duke ndihmuar rritjen e punsimit, t pagave dhe t presioneve t brendshme inflacioniste. Stimuli monetar sht konsistent me kahun konsolidues t politiks fiskale dhe mbetet nj parakusht i nevojshm pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv brenda vitit 2020. N prputhje me parashikimet e skenarit baz, si dhe n baz t informacionit t disponuar, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se normalizimi i normave t interesit n tregun e brendshm financiar nuk do t filloj prpara tremujorit t dyt t vitit 2019. Governor Seyko's word at the 39th Meeting of the Central Asian Country Governors' Club of Governors, Black Sea and Balkan region Publication date: 15.05.2018 Honorable, Mr. Mayor! Honorable ladies and gentlemen!  1/5 05/08/22, 17:17 Governor Seyko's word at the 39th Meeting of the Central Asian Country Governors' Club of Governors, R... I am pleased to be among colleagues at this 39th Governors Club Meeting, and discuss common economic challenges and predictions for future developments. I am honoured for the opportunity to share our views and experiences with the participants, to present an assessment of the progress achieved and a reflection of the priorities of our policies and our policy options. The theme of this panel, the sustainability of global economic recovery, is becoming an increasingly important topic among policymakers. Since the financial crisis began, our focus has focused on addressing the subsequent crisis shocks and promoting a rapid recovery. After a long and arduous journey, the growth rates of the world economy are reviving. Global growth rates are accelerating and jobs lost during crises have almost fully recovered. Also, the economic feel is high, globalization and integration are easing inflation pressures, while moderate growth in investment for business provides additional certainty for growth. The latest forecasts confirm this picture of developments. They show that recovery is continuous, synchronized and broad-based. The basic scenario is positive, for at least the short to medium-term horizon. However, as policymakers, we must try to look beyond the relevant horizon. The moment we turn our attention to this aspect, we can identify several risk factors that have the potential to influence global growth. Without wanting to be depleted at this point, the risks I would like to share with you are as follows: 1. Divergences regarding free and global trade 2. Insufficient structural reforms 3. Fluctuations in financial markets 4. Political uncertainties. Let me further intrude on each of them. Global trade Global trade, financial integration and the free movement of goods, capital and people are key elements to economic success in the post-war period, a success that had not been experienced before. From a global perspective, open markets allow for a more efficient distribution of resources and offer better employment opportunities. This takes on immense importance for Albania and our region, the EJL region, which represents a range of small and open economies, in the process of convergence with the EU. Therefore, recent potential protectionist tensions and policies are not so encouraging. Although it is generally believed that the trade war will be avoided, uncertainties still remain high. I believe it is our duty to work on preservation - and possibly strengthening the spirit of free trade. Structural reforms  2/5 05/08/22, 17:17 Governor Seyko's word at the 39th Meeting of the Central Asian Country Governors' Club of Governors, R... Past crises have highlighted a wide range of structural problems and provided the necessary political stimulus for established structural reforms. In advanced economies, attention has focused more on overhauling the financial system and sustainability of public finances. From the perspective of a developing country, such as Albania and many countries in the EJL region, the challenge has been threefold: The need to revise our economic growth models, improving external competitiveness and increasing internal flexibility; The need to rebuild space for fiscal reserves, through fiscal consolidation; and, the need to increase domestic savings and attract more IHD, especially given a more reluctant attitude towards risk-taking on the part of private and institutional investors in the world. These challenges require firm action and strong political commitment. With memories of the crisis fading, I fear that the political will for structural reforms may fade. The aim of EU integration may be a impetus in this direction, but it cannot replace national authorship for reforms. Fluctuations in financial markets After several years of a low-interest environment and in search of high return rates, financial agents have accumulated large exposures to the global financial system. The risk here stems from the fact that the expected normalization of monetary policy in - at least - some of the major economies could shake global financial markets. A short time ago, this was evident in the capital markets, with the so-called 'taper tantrum' phenomenon. The high rise in U.S. bond return rates in mid-2013 caused an almost same increase in interest rates in many foreign economies, driving down risky oil prices globally, and giving only a limited preliminary mirror of possible risks that could arise from a policy move in appropriate or insufficiently clear times. Therefore, communicating key elements regarding a timely and comprehensive change of strategy would further strengthen the possibility of a smooth normalization process in developing economies. This would, consequently, mitigate any risk to unwanted and possible chain effects in other countries and promote a stronger and more stable global economy. Geopolitical risks This is a topic that we - for from the profession we have - are perhaps less qualified to discuss. For this reason, I would limit my comments only by noting that reviving political tensions would only bring about a high price increase, and hinder the normal flow of goods and capital. The link between geopolitical risks and growth opportunities could be even stronger for developing countries' economies and could make them even more exposed to risks in remote geographical territories.  3/5 05/08/22, 17:17 Governor Seyko's word at the 39th Meeting of the Central Asian Country Governors' Club of Governors, R... It can make them even more exposed to dangers in remote geographical territories. Developing countries are vulnerable to obstacles in trade flows with which progress Their economics are closely related. Also, the risks added due to tensions policy could bring consequences on the progress made so far in relation to financial integration and technologically, factors of vital importance for each country's progress towards an economy with it High incomes. *** Honored colleagues, As central bankers, we are either direct responsible, or actors important for mitigating these risks. However, what would be some effective guides to informing our policy response? Let me close my word with some views on these issues. I'll start from the latter, i.e. softening the fluctuations in the financial market. From a global perspective, I believe that proper communication and information exchange will be essential. In a financially integrated world, no country is a lonely island. Normalising monetary policy in developed countries can cause unintended consequences in developing economies, but can in turn restore them to developed economies themselves. From the perspective of developing countries, such as Albania, we must work further on lowering the level of troubled loans, improving the supervision of nonbank segments in our financial system, as well as for increasing the sustainability of financial institutions and financial markets in the country. Regarding the need to update economic growth models in our countries, I believe that this task will require a greater focus on competitive industries for exports, and a general impetus for increasing productivity and flexibility. As the expression says, every long journey begins with a first step. In our case, I think increasing investment in human capital and promoting market reforms should be the first key step in the right direction. Regarding the need for strengthening fiscal mechanisms, I believe we must insist on anchoring fiscal consolidation into clear and transparent fiscal rules. Fiscal rules must be as flexible - to allow a certain measure of countercyclical stimulus  as well as solid to avoid repeated fiscal deviations. In terms of attracting IHD and maintaining incoming financial flows, we must further improve the business environment in the country and expand regional integration. These objectives are not easy to achieve; Therefore, it is necessary to move beyond the positions of short-term policies and discrete decision-making. With the aim of achieving economic and political sustainability as well as an economic structure that supports foreign and domestic investment, public policies must be carefully and intelligently drafted, taking into account long-term objectives. Expanding human capital, increasing the quality of infrastructure and the legal framework, as well as a more efficient bureaucracy could bring a  4/5 05/08/22, 17:17 Governor Seyko's word at the 39th Meeting of the Central Asian Country Governors' Club of Governors, R... infrastructure and legal frameworks, as well as a more efficient bureaucracy, could bring a significant improvement for the business environment and attractive market capacity, in order to offer investors excellent opportunities. In the end, in terms of the need for maintaining global trade, we need to better explain and interact more to influence in favour of well-defined historical trends for trade opening and global integration. The latter have shown that they are of extremely great importance for global interconnection, the rapprochement of distant territories and the facilitation of technological development, where the benefits are equally conveyed as developed and less developed countries. We must not allow developments to happen in the opposite direction and we must be prepared to clearly and firmly express the achievements that the world has witnessed throughout this era of intensified trade and global integration. *** Honorable ladies and gentlemen! Correcting the problems of the past and putting the global economy on the path to sustainable growth is a common responsibility. We all share the benefits of global growth together and together we must share the responsibility to ensure its sustainability.  5/5

Jam i nderuar pr mundsin q t ndaj me pjesmarrsit pikpamjet dhe prvojat tona, t paraqes nj vlersim pr progresin e arritur dhe nj reflektim t prparsive t politikave tona dhe opsioneve t politikave tona. Tema e ktij paneli, qndrueshmria e rimkmbjes ekonomike globale, po bhet nj tem gjithmon e m e rndsishme ndr politikbrsit. Q kur nisi kriza financiare, fokusi yn sht prqendruar te trajtimi i goditjeve pasuese t krizs dhe te nxitja e nj rimkmbjeje t shpejt. Pas nj rrugtimi t gjat e t mundimshm, ritmet e rritjes s ekonomis botrore po gjallrohen. Normat globale t rritjes po prshpejtohen dhe vendet e puns t humbura gjat krizave jan rikuperuar pothuajse plotsisht. Gjithashtu, ndjesia ekonomike sht e lart, globalizimi dhe integrimi po i zbusin presionet inflacionit, ndrsa rritja e moderuar n investime pr biznesin jep nj siguri shtes pr rritjen. Parashikimet m t fundit e konfirmojn kt tablo zhvillimesh. Ato tregojn se rimkmbja sht e vazhdueshme, e sinkronizuar dhe me baz t gjer. Skenari baz sht pozitiv, pr t paktn n horizontin afatshkurtr deri n afatmesm. Megjithat, si politikbrs, ne duhet t prpiqemi t shohim prtej horizontit prkats. N momentin q ne e kthejm vmendjen n kt aspekt, mund t identifikojm disa faktor rreziku q kan potencialin t ndikojn mbi rritjen globale. Pa dashur t jem shterues n kt pik, rreziqet q do t doja t ndaja me ju, jan si m posht: 1. Divergjencat lidhur me tregtin e lir dhe globale 2. Reforma t pamjaftueshme strukturore 3. Luhatjet n tregjet financiare 4. Pasigurit politike. M lejoni q t shtjelloj m tej seciln prej tyre. Tregtia globale Tregtia globale, integrimi financiar dhe lvizja e lir e mallrave, e kapitalit dhe e njerzve jan elemente kye pr suksesin ekonomik n periudhn e paslufts, sukses q nuk ishte prjetuar m par. Nga kndvshtrimi global, tregjet e hapura lejojn nj shprndarje m eficiente t burimeve dhe ofrojn mundsi m t mira punsimi. Kjo merr rndsi tejet t madhe pr Shqiprin dhe rajonin ton, rajonin e EJL-s, ka prfaqson nj sr ekonomish t vogla e t hapura, n proces konvergjimi me BE-n. Prandaj, tensionet dhe politikat e mundshme proteksioniste t kohve t fundit nuk jan aq inkurajuese. Ndonse prgjithsisht besohet se lufta tregtare do t shmanget, pasigurit mbeten ende t larta. Un besoj se sht detyra jon t punojm pr ruajtjen - dhe mundsisht forcimin e fryms s tregtis s lir. N ekonomit e prparuara, vmendja sht prqendruar m shum te rregullimi i sistemit financiar dhe te qndrueshmria e financave publike. Nga kndvshtrimi i nj vendi n zhvillim, si Shqipria dhe shum vende t rajonit t EJL-s, sfida ka qen e trefisht: Nevoja pr t rishikuar modelet tona t rritjes ekonomike, duke prmirsuar konkurrueshmrin me jasht dhe duke rritur fleksibilitetin e brendshm; Nevoja pr t rindrtuar hapsira pr rezerva fiskale, nprmjet konsolidimit fiskal; dhe, Nevoja pr t rritur kursimet vendase dhe pr t trhequr m shum IHD, veanrisht duke pasur parasysh nj qndrim m ngurrues ndaj marrjes s rrezikut nga ana e investitorve privat dhe institucional n bot. Kto sfida krkojn veprim t vendosur dhe angazhim t fort politik. Me venitjen e kujtimeve t krizs, druaj se vullneti politik pr reforma strukturore mund t zbehet. Qllimi i integrimit n BE mund t jet nj shtys n kt drejtim, por nuk mund t zvendsoj autorsin kombtare pr reforma. Luhatjet n tregjet financiare Pas disa vitesh t nj mjedisi me interesa t ulta dhe n krkim pr norma t larta kthimi, agjentt financiar kan akumuluar ekspozime t mdha n sistemin financiar global. Rreziku ktu rrjedh nga fakti se normalizimi i pritur i politiks monetare n - t paktn - disa prej ekonomive t mdha mund t trondit tregjet financiare globale. Pak koh m par, kjo u evidentua n tregjet e kapitalit, me dukurin e ashtuquajtur taper tantrum. Rritja e lart n normat e kthimit t obligacioneve t SHBA-s n mesin e vitit 2013 shkaktoi nj rritje pothuajse t njjt n normat e interesit n shum ekonomi t huaja, duke i ulur mimet e aseteve me rrezik n nivel global, dhe duke dhn vetm nj pasqyr paraprake t kufizuar t rreziqeve t mundshme q mund t lindin nga nj veprim i politiks n koh t paprshtatshme ose n mnyr jo mjaft t qart. Prandaj, komunikimi i elementeve kye n lidhje me nj ndryshim t strategjis n kohn e duhur dhe n mnyr gjithprfshirse, do ta forconte m shum mundsin pr nj proces t but normalizimi n ekonomit n zhvillim. Kjo do t zbuste, pr rrjedhoj, do rrezik pr efekte zinxhir t padshiruara e t mundshme n vende t tjera dhe do nxiste nj ekonomi globale m t fort dhe m t qndrueshme. Title: Questions and answers to the press conference
text: Question answers of the press conference June 06, 2018 Publication date: 06.06.2018 Q: You just declared that you would buy currency on the currency market. What can we call this Mr. Governor, a direct intervention on the part of the Bank of Albania on the exchange rate? Governor: This is an intervention for the purchase of currency surpluses in the currency market, in order to curb further acceleration of exchange rate overprice, which has been reported to have had rapid rates during the month of May. This overprice has gone beyond the parameters and criteria we have as the Bank of Albania, when we monitor the free exchange rate market. So, in this situation, it is understood that all the legal and regulatory criteria of the Bank of Albania have been met, which have forced the Supervisory Council to make such a decision to limit a further oversupply of the exchange rate. Q: Why is this lek overpriced, there are more amounts of euros on the market or is there more money? Governor: The market has had an increase in the amount of the euro, without question. This increase in the amount of the euro has been constant, starting in 2015. Of course, the exchange rate overprice has not only come as an increase in the amount of the euro in the market, but has come more as an increase in the expectation of currency market agents for an overpriced exchange rate. This expectation, defined by specific factors I mentioned during my word, has pushed the exchange rate to overprice perhaps even psychologically. So the expectation of economic agents has been towards an overprice and has oriented all agents: banks and currency exchange agencies to have an overpriced exchange rate. This has gone outside the normal parameters of a free exchange rate regime and has forced us as a central bank to undertake currency market intervention operations in this situation to ensure a normal currency market. Page 1 of 2 Question answers of the press conference June 06, 2018 29/07/22, 13:36 Q: At the last conference you assured us that there is no need for interference in the currency exchange market. What changed in so little time that the Bank of Albania intervened with operation and currency purchases? Governor: At the last conference we have clearly said that we have a free exchange rate regime and the Bank of Albania has criteria for market intervention. We have not intervened for exchange rate effect, but we have intervened to stop the acceleration of exchange rate overprice, which hits key macroeconomic parameters and especially our main inflation target. Our main goal for undertaking these operations is to stop accelerating the overpriced exchange rate which is abnormal for the reasons I explained and has a very negative impact on our inflation target in the long term. Monetary policy analyses led by our main objective have defined exactly this element. Nor have we intended to intervene, as it is a free exchange rate regime. In Albania, the free exchange rate regime will continue, but as long as there is a market expectation driven by specific factors i mentioned earlier, the Bank of Albania, in its legal mandate, in accordance with laws and regulations, has its right to regulate market parameters. text: 05/08/22, 17:17 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Sejko's word at press conference on monetary policy decision-making BANK OF ALBANIA Bank of Albania Governor Gent Sejko's word at press conference on monetary policy decision-making Publication date: 28.03.2018 The new economic and financial information, taken into analysis in the Intermediate Monetary Policy Report, resulted in line with our expectations. The volume of economic activity and inflation were expected to increase in the first quarter of 2018, while financial markets were characterized by low interest rates and controlled risk premiums. Likewise, updating forecasts did not change our expectations for the future. Economy  1/5 05/08/22, 17:17 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Sejko's word at press conference on monetary policy decision-making Albanian is expected to grow further on the medium-term horizon. Improved cyclical position, i reflected in an increasingly complete exploitation of production capacities, is expected to add to the internal inflationary pressures and enable inflation to return to target during the year 2019. Judging on the above, the Supervisory Council estimated that the monetary policy position remains appropriate, for boosting economic growth and for the steady return of inflation to the 3% level. Next I'll explain our assessment in more detail. Inflation marked a slight increase during the first quarter of the year, recording values of 1.7% and 2.1%, respectively in the months of January and February 2018. This increase mainly reflected higher food, water and rent prices. However, inflation continues to remain below target. In macroeconomic terms, this performance reflects the combined effect of three factors: First, the still incomplete exploitation of production capacities causes the increase in wages and production costs to not yet be in line with our inflation target. Second, foreign price growth pressures appear weak, influenced by the level of  2/5 05/08/22, 17:17 y, the word of the Governor of The Bapnka of Sjhqiperisca, Mr. Gent Seykpo in the press code, the decision of low monetary poglicity of inflation in trading partner countries and by overpriced the exchange rate of the lec. Third, economic agents' expectations for inflation are still below our target. In our judgment, the restraining effect of these factors will gradually be reduced on the medium-term horizon. New information taken in the analysis suggests that first-quarter economic growth is supported by the expansion of private consumption, continued investment growth, as well as by speeding up the pace of budgetary spending. On the other hand, the deficit in trade in goods appeared fluctuating: it expanded in January and narrowed in February. The expansion of aggregate demand continues to be accompanied by employment growth and falling unemployment, as evidenced by labour market data for the fourth quarter. However, wage growth still remains pale. The positive performance of the economy is supported by our monetary stimulus policy, by improving confidence in the economy, and by expanding foreign demand for Albanian goods and services. It is also favoured by reducing public borrowing, which has lowered risk premiums and facilitated monetary policy in financial markets. Low interest rates have supported increased consumption and private investment, through lending incentives and through lowering the cost of servatising existing debt. Cleared for the exchange rate effect, the total loan portfolio recorded an average annual increase of 5.8% in the months of January and February. This expansion follows to the greater extent of the increase in credit in money, whose portfolio marked an average annual increase of 7.2% during the period in question, while the currency loan portfolio increased by 4.7%. In parallel with it, easing monetary policy has also helped reduce troubled loans, through demand promotion and through encouraging credit restructuring. This index stayed at levels similar to the end of 2017.  3/5 05/08/22, 17:17 Bank of Albania Governor Gent Sejko's word at press conference on monetary policy decision-making The Bank of Albania estimates that the gradual return of the economy to potential and fuller exploitation of production capacities will be accompanied by a faster increase in wages and production costs, strengthening domestic inflationary pressures. Also, inflation in foreign markets is expected to rise as exchange rate oversupply is expected to fade, enabling a fuller transmission of foreign pressures in domestic markets. Finally, inflation expectations are forecast to rise, following the factual performance of this indicator. In line with these estimates, annual inflation is expected to fluctuate around the 2.2% level for 2018 and return to our target within 2019. Based on these judgments, the Supervisory Council decided to keep the basic interest rate unchanged at the 1.25% level. Also, the Council decided to keep deposit and one-day loan interest rates unchanged, respectively at levels 0.25 and 2.25%. However, the Supervisory Council considers that the balance of risks continues to remain shifted to the lower direction. In particular, the recovery of the European economy remains subject to risks and uncertainties, while the offer for bank loans continues to remain tight. How much it belongs to this. Last, the Supervisory Council states that the progressive reduction in credit risk should be accompanied by more realistic lending policies by the banking sector, which would create premise for meeting the financing needs of the economy, which are expected to come in growth in the future. Reflecting on the information available, forecasts according to the basic scenario and the risks that accompany it, the Supervisory Council reconfirms that: the intensity of monetary stimulus will not ease before the fourth quarter of 2018; Even further, monetary policy will continue to remain in the stimulus direction throughout the medium-term horizon, to ensure the stable return of inflation to the target. *** In closing, the Supervisory Council considers that the positive moment of the economic cycle should be used with the aim of intensifying structural reforms, which should further stimulate the pace of economic growth and improve its resistance to shocks. In particular, these reforms should aim at improving the business climate, increasing efficiency and competitiveness, as well as expanding the country's manufacturing potential. Informacioni i ri i marr n analiz sugjeron se rritja ekonomike e tremujorit t par sht mbshtetur nga zgjerimi i konsumit privat, nga vazhdimi i trendit rrits t investimeve, si dhe nga shpejtimi i ritmit t realizimit t shpenzimeve buxhetore. Nga ana tjetr, deficiti i shkmbimeve tregtare n mallra u shfaq i luhatshm: ai u zgjerua n muajin janar dhe u ngushtua n muajin shkurt. Zgjerimi i krkess agregate vazhdon t shoqrohet me rritje t punsimit dhe rnie t papunsis, sikundr dshmohet nga t dhnat e tregut t puns pr tremujorin e katrt. Megjithat, rritja e pagave mbetet ende e zbeht. Ecuria pozitive e ekonomis sht mbshtetur nga politika jon monetare stimuluese, nga prmirsimi i besimit n ekonomi, dhe nga zgjerimi i krkess s huaj pr mallra e shrbime shqiptare. Gjithashtu, ajo sht favorizuar nga reduktimi i huamarrjes publike, ka ka ulur primet e rrezikut dhe ka lehtsuar prcjelljen e politiks monetare n tregjet financiare. Normat e ulta t interesit kan mbshtetur rritjen e konsumit dhe t investimeve private, nprmjet nxitjes s kreditimit dhe nprmjet uljes s kostos s shrbimit t borxhit ekzistues. I pastruar pr efektin e kursit t kmbimit, portofoli i kredis totale regjistroi nj rritje mesatare vjetore prej 5.8% n muajt janar e shkurt. Ky zgjerim vijon t mbshtetet n masn m t madhe nga rritja e kredis n lek, portofoli i s cils shnoi nj rritje mesatare vjetore prej 7.2% gjat periudhs n fjal, ndrkoh q portofoli i kredis n valut u rrit me 4.7%. Paralelisht me t, politika monetare lehtsuese ka ndihmuar gjithashtu reduktimin e kredive me probleme, nprmjet nxitjes s krkess dhe nprmjet inkurajimit t ristrukturimit t kredive. Ky tregues vijoi t qndroj n nivele t ngjashme me fundin e vitit 2017. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_te_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_z_Gent_Sejko_ne_konf 3/5 05/08/22, 17:17 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris z. Gent Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare Banka e Shqipris vlerson se kthimi gradual i ekonomis n potencial dhe shfrytzimi m i plot i kapaciteteve prodhuese, do t shoqrohen me nj rritje m t shpejt t pagave dhe t kostove t prodhimit, duke forcuar presionet e brendshme inflacioniste. Po ashtu, inflacioni n tregjet e huaja pritet t rritet ndrsa mbimimi i kursit t kmbimit pritet t zbehet, duke mundsuar nj transmetim m t plot t presioneve t huaja n tregjet e brendshme. S fundi, pritjet pr inflacionin parashikohet t rriten, duke ndjekur ecurin faktike t ktij treguesi. N prputhje me kto vlersime, inflacioni vjetor pritet t luhatet rreth nivelit 2.2% pr vitin 2018 dhe t kthehet n objektivin ton brenda vitit 2019. Bazuar n kto gjykime, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi t mbaj t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 1.25%. Gjithashtu, Kshilli vendosi t mbaj t pandryshuar edhe normat e interesit t depozits dhe t kredis njditore, prkatsisht n nivelet 0.25 dhe 2.25%. Megjithat, Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjykon se balanca e rreziqeve vazhdon t mbetet e zhvendosur n kahun e poshtm. N veanti, rikuperimi i ekonomis evropiane mbetet subjekt rreziqesh e pasigurish, ndrsa oferta pr kredi bankare vijon t mbetet e shtrnguar. Sa i takon ksaj t fundit, Kshilli Mbikqyrs konstaton se reduktimi progresiv i rrezikut t kredis duhet t shoqrohet me politika m realiste kreditimi nga sektori bankar, ka do t krijonte premisa pr plotsimin e nevojave pr financim t ekonomis, t cilat pritet t vijn n rritje n t ardhmen. Duke reflektuar mbi informacionin e disponuar, parashikimet sipas skenarit baz dhe rreziqet q i shoqrojn ato, Kshilli Mbikqyrs rikonfirmon se: intensiteti i stimulit monetar nuk do t zbutet para tremujorit t katrt t vitit 2018; edhe m tej, politika monetare do t vazhdoj t mbetet n kahun stimulues gjat gjith horizontit afatmesm, pr t siguruar kthimin e qndrueshm t inflacionit n objektiv. *** N mbyllje, Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjykon se momenti pozitiv i ciklit ekonomik duhet t prdoret me qllim intensifikimin e reformave strukturore, t cilat duhet t nxitin m tej ritmin e rritjes ekonomike dhe t prmirsojn rezistencn e saj ndaj goditjeve. N veanti, kto reforma duhet t synojn prmirsimin e klims s biznesit, rritjen e eficiencs dhe t konkurrueshmris, si dhe zgjerimin e potencialit prodhues t vendit. Title: Speech by Deputy Governor Ahmetaj at the forum "Empowering financial inclusion through financial education", organized by the Albanian Banking Association and the Bank of Albania
text: Deputy Governor Ahmetaj's word at the empowering fina forum... rganised by the Albanian Banking Association and the Bank of Albania 29/07/22, 13:36 Deputy Governor Ahmetaj's word at the empowering financial integration through financial education forum, organised by Albanian Banking Association and Bank of Albania Publication date: 29.06.2018 As a representative of the Bank of Albania, It feels good to be part of this conference, because the Bank of Albania is among the pioneering central banks in the region for concrete involvement in the financial education of the public. There is a binding reason for this commitment: for anyone living in a market economy, making the right financial decisions is an essential skill for well-being not only individual, but social. Because, the same skills, simultaneously guide the decisions individuals make as citizens, thus helping to shape a good economy. In recent years there has been a shift in emphasis, from a traditional education on the economy, to knowledge of finances. This is because the sophistication of financial products and services, as well as the increasing involvement of fintech in this industry, makes this need more urgent.  izuar_nga_Shoqata_Shqiptare_e_Bankave_dhe_Banka_e_Shqiperise.html Page 1 of 5 Deputy Governor Ahmetaj's word at the empowering fina forum... rganised by the Albanian Banking Association and the Bank of Albania 29/07/22, 13:36 And, out of the need for more knowledge, no one is excluded, not even us who work in this industry. For example, even for us, there may be a need for clarifications on a mortgage contract. Likewise, expanding the financial market with new products, such as pension funds, health and assets insurance, are increasingly shifting the need for long-term financial protection, from businesses to individuals, making financial knowledge more necessary for them. Alfred Marshall's simple concept of economics remains quite appropriate, as a study of humanity in the business of life. This means that if we want to have a strong economy, we must help people use the knowledge of the economy according to their daily lives, of what he calls "life business". The Bank of Albania's activity for public financial education begins with the aim of stripping the bank of the mystery that has historically surrounded the real activity of a central bank. In this way, it aims to build and strengthen the public's trust in its decisions and actions. This has started with the opening of the bank doors to the public in various activities as well as, especially, in the creation of a museum with facts and artifacts, on the roots of the creation and present day of the Albanian monetary system. That museum has become part of our pride in the eyes of visitors. From the countries involved earlier and actively in responsibility for the financial education of the public come some valuable experiences for us, which are still in the first steps of this process, increasingly demanding. This experience shows that success begins with the involvement in the process of higher leadership levels, such as governor, minister, and other leaders of central financial and education institutions. Because along the way it needs human and financial resources and, therefore, the support of decision-makers is doubly necessary. The personal involvement of the Governor and Minister of Education in the first week and more broadly testifies to a clear embezzlement of this experience.  izuar_nga_Shoqata_Shqiptare_e_Bankave_dhe_Banka_e_Shqiperise.html Page 2 of 5 Deputy Governor Ahmetaj's word at the empowering fina forum... rganised by the Albanian Banking Association and the Bank of Albania 29/07/22, 13:36 It is this experience, which has shown us that communication to be efficient must address an audience as wide as possible. So, the more activities that speak Albanian and with simple language to the public and, the more media that follow this communication. Meetings with financial agents, press conferences, interviews for the public and open lectures are instruments widely used in this context by the Bank of Albania, but which, of course, need to intensify and come more simply to the public. Co-operation with as many partners as possible is another need of this process. And here, reputable institutions, such as the Bank of Albania, take on a central role, because they have more ability to gather organisations and individual contributors in halls as open to all. The Bank of Albania has made strong use of this. It, with the active involvement of the Albanian Association of Banks and International Partners, brings together in conference halls, sometimes a year, experts, various interest groups and representatives of all the media, in order to help cultivate economic thought, explain its policies and bring to the Albanian public the latest developments in the arena of world economic debate. Financial education, like any sustainable education, needs as much literature and didactic materials as possible, but to be first easily understandable to teachers. Teachers at every educational level are the best conductors of this information, not only because of time-span contact, but especially because they are addressed to the younger generation. Over more than a decade, thanks to uncompulsive co-operation on the part of the Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth, for which I find the opportunity, on behalf of the Bank of Albania, to thank Zj. Minister, we have held seminars for secondary and 9-year-old teachers and drafted the text for the high school "Personal finances in your hands"- text for teacher and students. Also, the Bank of Albania has drafted a series of brochures that are available to the public, such as: What is price stability for you?; Build the future - plan your income; Short lessons on money; etc.), as well as organizing numerous competitions for students and lectures open to students. Experience has directed us that the methods used to decipher knowledge should be as fun as possible, in order to be accessed without strain by the public, as well as to tear the tis of the shadowy picture of the world of finances. The publication of the Bank of Albania "1.2.3 piggy Chufo learns to save" dedicated to children of the primary cycle, is a success in this respect, but which must be associated with others of this kind. The inclusion of as many contributors as possible and the formation of this mission in all our daily activities, and not just by campaign, serves everyone. But, specifically, the public education process is very important to the Central Bank itself. This: Not only because a more educated public makes more efficient decisions for financial stability,  izuar_nga_Shoqata_Shqiptare_e_Bankave_dhe_Banka_e_Shqiperise.html Page 3 of 5 Deputy Governor Ahmetaj's word at the empowering fina forum... rganised by the Albanian Banking Association and the Bank of Albania 29/07/22, 13:36 Not only because it becomes more involved in the financial market, making it more efficient for monetary policy to use the basic interest rate as its instrument, not only because the rational use of deposit and credit financial products makes long-term consumer planning more harmonious and so, more stable prices, but because through this education, It can explain to the public what central bank independence means and why it is an essential element of its ability to meet the mission as monetary policy authority. Through the financial education of the public, the Bank of Albania makes it easier to understandably communicate monetary policy decisions, actions and inactions, purpose and strategy for its achievement. Only through this education does the public build confidence in the central bank and understand why price stability, which constitutes its primary objective, is ultimately a public good. We must be clear in our mission: we do not intend to tell the public what to think about or decide on different issues, but simply to offer him a set of knowledge on the basis of which he makes assessments and makes his decisions. Because an individual with more knowledge of the economy and finances: Not only is he able to better orient himself in the labour market, not only is he able to make more rational decisions to create his wealth and, consequently, of the country, but he will be more responsible even in his role as a voter, as a consumer, as a taxpayer, these tasks very important to every citizen. But is there an indicator by which to measure the effectiveness of the public's financial education process? There may be some, but the most blind and touching is one: financial involvement. This indicator for Albania speaks of a low level of this education. So we're here today to discuss it and improve. The Bank of Albania cares that the system ensures financial services and access to loans as fairly as possible. For this, it on the one hand regulates and oversees the system and, on the other hand, engages many of its capacities in the field of economic and financial education. The regulation also has parts of itself to ensure fair treatment of customers on the part of banks, enabling them to serve the entire community, including low-income groups. If financial involvement comes in improving, it means that the public is becoming more and more part of the financial system, is using its products, thus making its contribution to expanding financial mediation. If this mediation expands, the economy is feeding on funds, new projects are being alive, the potential of the economy is expanding. Isn't the ultimate goal boosting well-being for all?  izuar_nga_Shoqata_Shqiptare_e_Bankave_dhe_Banka_e_Shqiperise.html Page 4 of 5 Deputy Governor Ahmetaj's word at the empowering fina forum... rganised by the Albanian Banking Association and the Bank of Albania 29/07/22, 13:36 Well, let's understand that financial education means increasing well-being for all. This will make us all more actively involved in this process.  izuar_nga_Shoqata_Shqiptare_e_Bankave_dhe_Banka_e_Shqiperise.html Page 5 of 5

Muz dhe Eduk " Kreu / Shtypi / Fjalime, intervista, artikuj / Fjalime Njoftimet pr shtyp Njoftime t # mbledhjeve t Kshillit Mbikqyrs Konferenca pr shtyp Fjalime, $ intervista, artikuj Fjalime Intervista e artikuj Kalendar # Kalendari i festave zyrtare pr vitin 2022 COVID-19 Evropa # BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Zvendsguvernatores Ahmetaj n forumin Empowering financial inclusion through financial education, organizuar nga Shoqata Shqiptare e Bankave dhe Banka e Shqipris Data e publikimit: 29.06.2018 Si prfaqsuese e Banks s Shqipris, ndihem mir t jem pjes e ksaj konference, sepse Banka e Shqipris sht ndr bankat qendrore pioniere n rajon pr prfshirjen konkrete n edukimin financiar t publikut. Ka nj arsye detyruese pr kt angazhim: pr cilindo q jeton n nj ekonomi tregu, marrja e vendimeve t duhura financiare sht nj aftsi thelbsore pr mirqenien jo vetm individuale, por dhe shoqrore. Sepse, t njjtat aftsi, orientojn njkohsisht vendimet q individt marrin si qytetar, duke ndihmuar kshtu n formsimin e nj ekonomie t mir. Vitet e fundit ka nj zhvendosje t theksit, nga nj edukim tradicional mbi ekonomin, n njohurit mbi financat. Kjo sepse sofistikimi i produkteve dhe shrbimeve financiare, si dhe prfshirja gjithnj e m shum e fintech n kt industri, e bn m urgjente kt nevoj. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjizuar_nga_Shoqata_Shqiptare_e_Bankave_dhe_Banka_e_Shqiperise.html Pagina 1 di 5 Fjala e Zvendsguvernatores Ahmetaj n forumin Empowering finarganizuar nga Shoqata Shqiptare e Bankave dhe Banka e Shqipris 29/07/22, 13:36 Dhe, nga nevoja pr m shum njohuri, nuk prjashtohet askush, as vet ne q punojm n kt industri. Pr shembull, edhe pr ne mund t ket nevoj pr sqarime mbi nj kontrat hipotekare. Po kshtu, zgjerimi i tregut financiar me produkte t reja, si jan fondet e pensioneve, sigurimet shndetsore dhe t aseteve, po e zhvendosin gjithnj e m shum nevojn pr mbrojtje financiare afatgjat, nga bizneset tek individt, duke i br njohurit financiare m t nevojshme pr ta. Mbetet mjaft me vend koncepti i thjesht i Alfred Marshall pr ekonomiksin, si nj studim i njerzimit n biznesin e jets. Kjo do t thot se nse duam t kemi nj ekonomi t fort, duhet t ndihmojm njerzit t prdorin njohurit e ekonomis n funksion t jets s tyre t prditshme, t asaj q ai e quan biznes i jets. Aktiviteti i Banks s Shqipris pr edukimin financiar t publikut fillon me synimin pr ta zhveshur bankn nga tisi i misterit q e ka rrethuar historikisht aktivitetin real t nj banke qendrore. N kt mnyr, ajo synon t ndrtoj dhe forcoj besimin q publiku ka tek vendimet dhe veprimet e saj. Kjo ka nisur me hapjen e dyerve t banks pr publikun n aktivitete t ndryshme si dhe, veanrisht, n krijimin e nj muzeu me fakte dhe artefakte, mbi rrnjt e krijimit dhe t sotmen e sistemit monetar shqiptar. Ai muze sht br pjes e krenaris son n syt e vizitorve. Nga vendet e prfshira m hert dhe aktivisht n prgjegjsin pr edukimin financiar t publikut vijn disa prvoja t vlefshme pr ne, q jemi ende n hapat e par t ktij procesi, gjithnj e m krkues. Kjo prvoj tregon se suksesi fillon me prfshirjen n proces t niveleve m t larta drejtuese, si sht guvernatori, ministri, e t tjer drejtues t institucioneve qendrore financiare dhe t edukimit. Sepse gjat rrugs ka nevoj pr burime njerzore dhe financiare dhe ndaj, mbshtetja e personave vendimmarrs sht dyfish e domosdoshme. Prfshirja personalisht e Guvernatorit dhe Ministres s Arsimit n javn e paras dhe m gjer, dshmon nj prvetsim t qart t ksaj prvoje. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjizuar_nga_Shoqata_Shqiptare_e_Bankave_dhe_Banka_e_Shqiperise.html Pagina 2 di 5 Fjala e Zvendsguvernatores Ahmetaj n forumin Empowering finarganizuar nga Shoqata Shqiptare e Bankave dhe Banka e Shqipris 29/07/22, 13:36 sht po kjo prvoj, q na ka treguar se, komunikimi pr t qen eficient, duhet ti drejtohet nj audience sa m t gjer. Pra, sa m shum aktivitete q flasin shqip dhe me gjuh t thjesht pr publikun dhe, sa m shum media q e prcjellin kt komunikim. Takimet me agjentt financiar, konferencat pr shtyp, intervistat pr publikun dhe leksionet e hapura, jan instrumente t prdorura gjersisht n kt kontekst nga Banka e Shqipris, por q, natyrisht, kan nevoj t intensifikohen e t vijn m thjesht n publik. Bashkpunimi me sa m shum partner sht nj tjetr nevoj e ktij procesi. Dhe ktu, institucione me reputacion, si Banka e Shqipris, marrin rol qendror, pr shkak se ato kan m shum aftsi t mbledhin organizata e individ kontribues n salla sa m t hapura pr t gjith. Banka e Shqipris e ka prdorur fort kt aset. Ajo, me prfshirjen aktive t Shoqats Shqiptare t Bankave dhe partnerve ndrkombtar, mbledh s bashku n salla konferencash, disa her n vit, ekspert, grupe t ndryshme interesi dhe prfaqsues t gjith mediave, n mnyr q t ndihmoj n kultivimin e mendimit ekonomik, t shpjegoj politikat e saj dhe t sjell pr publikun shqiptar zhvillimet m t fundit n arenn e debatit ekonomik botror. Edukimi financiar, si do edukim i qndrueshm, ka nevoj pr sa m shum literatur e materiale didaktike, por q t jen s pari lehtsisht t kuptueshme pr msuesit. Msuesit, n cilindo nivel arsimor jan pruesit m t mir t ktij informacioni, jo vetm pr shkak t kontaktit n shtrirje kohore, por, sidomos, pr shkak se i adresohen brezit t ri. Prgjat m shum se nj dekade, fal edhe bashkpunimit t pakursyer nga ana e Ministris s Arsimit, Sportit dhe Rinis, pr t cilin gjej rastin, n emr t Banks s Shqipris, t falnderoj zj. Ministre, ne kemi zhvilluar seminare pr msuesit e shkollave t mesme dhe 9-vjeare dhe kemi hartuar tekstin msimor pr gjimnazin Financat personale n duart tuaja- teksti pr msuesin dhe nxnsit. Gjithashtu, Banka e Shqipris ka hartuar dhe nj sr broshurash t cilat jan n dispozicion t publikut, si: sht pr ju stabiliteti i mimeve?; Ndrtoni t ardhmen - planifikoni t ardhurat tuaja; Msime t shkurtra mbi paran; etj.), si dhe ka organizuar konkurse t shumta pr nxns e leksione t hapura pr student. Eksperienca na ka orientuar q metodat e prdorura pr primin e njohurive duhet t jen sa m argtuese, n mnyr q t aksesohen pa sforcim nga publiku, si dhe t griset tisi i prfytyrimit hijernd t bots s financave. Botimi i Banks s Shqipris 1,2,3 derrkuci ufo mson t kursej dedikuar fmijve t ciklit fillor, sht nj sukses n kt aspekt, por q duhet shoqruar me t tjera t ktij lloji. Prfshirja e sa m shum kontribuuesve dhe trupzimi i ktij misioni n t gjitha aktivitetet tona t prditshme, dhe jo vetm me fushat, i shrben t gjithve. Por, n mnyr t veant, procesi i edukimit t publikut sht shum i rndsishm pr vet Bankn Qendrore. Kjo: jo vetm sepse nj publik m i edukuar merr vendime m eficiente pr stabilitetin financiar, https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjizuar_nga_Shoqata_Shqiptare_e_Bankave_dhe_Banka_e_Shqiperise.html Pagina 3 di 5 Fjala e Zvendsguvernatores Ahmetaj n forumin Empowering finarganizuar nga Shoqata Shqiptare e Bankave dhe Banka e Shqipris 29/07/22, 13:36 jo vetm sepse bhet m i prfshir n tregun financiar, duke e br m efikas pr politikn monetare prdorimin e norms baz t interesit si instrument t saj, jo vetm se prdorimi racional i produkteve financiare t depozitave dhe kredis e bn m harmonik planifikimin afatgjat t konsumit e ndaj, m stabl mimet, por, sepse prmes ktij edukimi, ajo ka mundsi t shpjegoj pr publikun do t thot pavarsi e banks qendrore dhe pse ajo sht element esencial i aftsis s saj pr prmbushjen e misionit si autoritet i politiks monetare. Prmes edukimit financiar t publikut, Banka e Shqipris e ka m t leht t komunikoj n mnyr t kuptueshme vendimet e politikes monetare, veprimet e mosveprimet, qllimin dhe strategjin pr arritjen e tij. Vetm prmes ktij edukimi, publiku ndrton besimin tek banka qendrore dhe kupton pse stabiliteti i mimeve, q prbn objektivin parsor t saj, sht n fund t fundit nj e mir publike. Duhet t jemi t qart n misionin ton: ne nuk synojm ti tregojm publikut se far duhet t mendoj apo t vendos pr shtjet e ndryshme, por thjesht, ti ofrojm atij nj set njohurish mbi bazn e t cilave ai t bj vlersime e t marr vendimet e tij. Sepse nj individ me m shum njohuri mbi ekonomin dhe financat: jo vetm sht n gjendje t orientohet m mir n tregun e puns, jo vetm sht n gjendje t marr vendime m racionale pr t krijuar pasurin e tij e, rrjedhimisht, t vendit, por ai do t jet m i prgjegjshm edhe n rolin e tij si votues, si konsumator, si taksapagues, detyra kto mjaft t rndsishme pr do qytetar. Po a ka nj tregues me t cilin t matim efektivitetin e procesit t edukimit financiar t publikut? Mund t ket disa, por m i qarti dhe m i prekshmi sht nj: prfshirja financiare. Ky tregues pr Shqiprin flet pr nj nivel t ult t ktij edukimi. Ndaj, jemi edhe sot ktu: pr ta diskutuar e prmirsuar. Banka e Shqipris kujdeset q sistemi t siguroj shrbimet financiare dhe akses n kredi n mnyr sa m t drejt. Pr kt, ajo nga njra an rregullon dhe mbikqyr sistemin dhe, nga ana tjetr, angazhon mjaft kapacitete t vetat n fushn e edukimit ekonomik dhe financiar. Rregullimi ka pjes t vetn edhe sigurimin e trajtimit t drejt t klientve nga ana e bankave, duke mundsuar q ato ti shrbejn gjith komunitetit, prfshir ktu grupet me t ardhura t ulta. Nse prfshirja financiare vjen duke u prmirsuar, do t thot se publiku po bhet gjithnj e m shum pjes e sistemit financiar, po prdor produktet e tij, po jep kshtu kontributin e tij pr zgjerimin e ndrmjetsimit financiar. Nse ky ndrmjetsim zgjerohet, ekonomia po ushqehet me fonde, projekte t reja po jetsohen, potenciali i ekonomis po zgjerohet. A nuk sht qllimi final rritja e mirqenies pr t gjith? https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fizuar_nga_Shoqata_Shqiptare_e_Bankave_dhe_Banka_e_Shqiperise.html Pagina 4 di 5 Fjala e Zvendsguvernatores Ahmetaj n forumin Empowering finarganizuar nga Shoqata Shqiptare e Bankave dhe Banka e Shqipris 29/07/22, 13:36 E pra, le t kuptojm se edukim financiar do t thot rritje e mirqenies pr t gjith. Title: Questions and answers to the press conference
text: Questions answers of the press conference July 4, 2018 29/07/22, 13:36 Questions answers of the press conference July 4, 2018 Publication date: 04.07.2018 Q: You said market interference would continue? How much euro will be bought on the market? Governor: We don't know and we can't know how many euros we're going to buy on the market. The aim of the intervention is to achieve our main objective, to maintain price stability, i.e. the level of inflation. According to the analyses we have done, we have determined the impact that the exchange rate overlap has on achieving the inflation level target. When we estimated that that level of course would negatively affect the short and medium term of expected inflation  it could also lead us to inflation at level 0, the Supervisory Council made the decision to start a programme of interventions in the internal currency market, to withdraw the currency surplus for inflation effect. We can't predict the exchange rate and we can't determine it. Since we cannot determine the course, we cannot even determine the extent of our interventions. The Bank of Albania has begun applying the intervention programme by buying currencies on the market. This programme has had a positive effect; through it we have curbed the overprice of the local currency, which was rated negative for the reasons I mentioned above. On a regular basis we analyze the situation at the Meetings of the Supervisory Council to judge how much this programme will continue and the impact it will have, which will appear in the future. We cannot absolutely predict how much we will spend and how much the intervention programme will continue because it depends on the performance of the exchange rate in the future. Q: Mr. Governor in continuation of the colleague's question, how many euros did you buy during the month of June? And on your last exit, you were told that we have more euros than money in the market, whether from those formals, but even after the decision that 40 foreign exchange points have been closed, how much has this measure affected yours? Page 1 of 2 Questions answers of the press conference July 4, 2018 29/07/22, 13:36 Governor: I'm starting at the end of the question the answer. I can give answers and I can give a figure regarding euros that are in the banking system which is licensed and regulated by the Bank of Albania. The absolute figure I don't remember, but it's over 4 billion euros, it could be 4.3 billion euros. But, the market includes the formal and informal market and we have no data on informal market euros. We have data on the amount of money in circulation in money. Leku is the money we produce as a central bank and therefore we monitor the circulation of national money. But we don't know how many euros are in circulation on the market. For the banking system we can say the amount of the euro and I said a figure. In accordance with the Bank of Albania's regulation we report on the intervention programme and their amount three months after the end of each quarter. Now we reported the currency purchase figure during the first quarter of this year. Currently we are implementing a programme of interventions for the effect of the impact of the exchange rate overprice on inflation, but of course and before that we have bought currencies on the market for the effect of the Bank of Albania's currency reserve. These transactions can have the same impact as we buy the euro with money, but the goals have been different. At the end of the respective quarter, we will report the amount of purchases in accordance with the regulation. At the moment, I do not have an accurate figure, but it is important that the intervention programme has given effect to curbing the overpriceof the exchange rate. Page 2 of 2

text: Question answers of the press conference August 1, 2018 29/07/22, 13:36 itika ! netare Markets! Stability! Financial Surveillance! Intervention of ! Extraordinary Statistics! Right ! Payments! Muz and Eduk " Head / Press / Speeches, interviews, articles / Speeches Page 1 of 2 Question answers of the press conference August 1, 2018 29/07/22, 13:36 Press releases Notices of # meetings of Council Supervisor Press conference Speeches, interview articles Speeches Interview of articles Calendars # Official holiday calendar for 2022 COVID-19 Europe # BANK OF ALBANIA PRESS NEWS Question answers of the press conference August 1, 2018 Publication date: 01.08.2018 Q: Two days ago, the 2018 budget normative act came into force. The government's decision envisions freezing the salary fund to the value of 10 million. This decision is expected to pass the Assembly for approval in September. How will this freeze affect inflation and consumption? Governor: In accordance with the law, the Council of Ministers and the Ministry of Finance have the right to make changes in terms of realisation of income and expenditure. Some movements are dictated depending on performance. The oversupply of the exchange rate has certainly had an effect on income. Perhaps the wage fund freeze has come as a result of this factor. We as the Bank of Albania have reacted with regard to the overprice of the exchange rate, to curb further overprice, according to the plan of interventions in the internal currency market that we are continuing to pursue. Even at today's meeting of the Supervisory Council we decided to continue this program as we are in season and are under seasonal influence. We're monitoring the market and we'll see how it comes down. Some moves in relation to the budget are imposed. To keep the budget under control, the government has been forced to make changes at this time of year. It's not the first year that changes are made to the budget. Macroeconomic factors are impossible to predict. We did not anticipate that we would have such a strong oversupply of the exchange rate and therefore we were forced to make interventions. The overprice of the exchange rate has been going on for several years, but as we have stated, the overprice of recent months has been faster as a result of some expectations in the internal currency market such as: BERZH's loan to an Albanian public company, the capital conversion of some banks, the impact of the tourist season and other factors. This has led the Bank of Albania to undertake the programming of interventions in the internal currency market and further easing of our monetary policy, and the government from its arm will change the budget by reflecting the consequences of overpriced exchange rates. That's what I could say at the moment. Page 2 of 2

Nuk sht viti i par q bhen ndryshime n buxhet. Faktort makroekonomik jan t pamundur t parashikohen.
