text: 05/08/22, 17:17 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making Publication date: 01.08.2018 The Albanian economy came to follow a positive development trend in the first six months of 2018. Economic activity has come to an increase, enabling employment expansion, wage growth, improving the financial situation of businesses and gradually strengthening inflationary pressures.  1/4 05/08/22, 17:17 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making These developments are supported by improved foreign environment, improved confidence in the economy, favourable financial conditions, dictated by our easing monetary policy, as well as positive supply shocks. Our expectations for the future remain positive. However, their materialization requires the preservation of monetary policy easing kah, while the balance of risks remains shifting to the lower direction. Average second-quarter inflation recorded 2.2% value, coming in growth from the average rate of 1.9% of the first quarter. In particular, inflation scored 2.4% in the month of June. The balance of inflationary pressures continues to be formed by a gradual trend strengthening internal pressures and short-term price fluctuations of specific consumer basket items. The rise in inflation in the second quarter reflected the resulting effect of two reverse kah shocks. On the one hand, rising oil prices in international markets brought rising production costs and exerted a growing impact on inflation. On the other hand, strengthening the exchange rate curbed the conveyance of foreign inflationary pressures in the domestic market. The first factor had a stronger intensity of action in the second quarter, but its effect is estimated to be shorter in time. Our projections suggest that inflation will return to target within 2020. This forecast factors positive economic growth dynamics and our expectations for the economy to return to balance in the first six months of next year. It also relies on the assessment that disinflationary pressures from the exchange rate overprice will remain fleeting. These judgments find support from the economic and monetary data of the first six months. httpsE:/k/  2/4 05/08/22, 17:17 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making Albanian economy marked a 4.45% increase in the first quarter, and indirect data They are talking about positive growth rhythms in the second quarter. In more long-term terms, activity expansion economic growth was based on rising consumption and private investment, while the deficit trade exchanges with abroad increased and fiscal policy remained in the consolidating direction. Indirect data suggest that these developmenttrends were carried out even in the quarter Second. The expansion of economic activity has been associated with increased employment and a 12.5% drop in the unemployment rate. This rate represents the lowest historical level of unemployment recorded in Albania and suggests an increasingly full use of production capacities in the country. In response, Instat reports that average real wages increased by 2.3% in the first quarter, which represents a positive premise for gradually strengthening domestic inflationary pressures. The internal financial market continues to appear calm and secular, but the derogatory pressures of the lek continue to be present in its currency segment. Recent monetary policy measures  lowering the basic interest rate to 1.0% level and intervening in the internal currency market, with the aim of curbing the rapid overprice of the exchange rate  have resulted in effective. Wool interest rates have come down in the second quarter. Interest rates on loans, deposits and letters of value in money appear at minimum levels. Credit for the private sector recorded an average increase of 5% in the second quarter of the year, with a more balanced contribution increasing between credit in money and currency credit. In general, credit growth is in line with the moderate improvement in demand for it. However, the monitoring of lending activity suggests that the lending standards and conditions applied by the banking sector remain conservative. The Bank of Albania states that falling credit risk and continued balance sheet improvement, as illustrated by the fall in the ratio of troubled loans to a 13.27% level, should find a better reflection on the lending policies of the banking sector. After the rapid overprice recorded in April-May, the Bank of Albania's intervention managed to calm the functioning of the internal currency market and curb the overprice of the exchange rate. However, our analyses suggest that the ratio of demand and supply to the currency market remains unbalanced, partly and as a result of high seasonal flows, and that the rapid and further oversupply of the exchange rate would damage the return of inflation to the target in the medium term. Judging on the above, the Bank of Albania estimates that the current monetary policy position remains appropriate. text_original: 05/08/22, 17:17 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare  Kreu / Shtypi / Fjalime, intervista, artikuj / Fjalime Njoftimet pr shtyp Njoftime t mbledhjeve t Kshillit Mbikqyrs Konferenca pr shtyp Fjalime, intervista, artikuj Fjalime Intervista e artikuj Kalendar Kalendari i festave zyrtare pr vitin 2022 COVID-19 Evropa      BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare Data e publikimit: 01.08.2018 Ekonomia shqiptare vijoi t ndjek nj trend pozitiv zhvillimi n gjashtmujorin e par t vitit 2018. Aktiviteti ekonomik ka ardhur n rritje, duke mundsuar zgjerimin e punsimit, rritjen e pagave, prmirsimin e gjendjes financiare t bizneseve dhe forcimin gradual t presioneve inflacioniste. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_Sejko_ne_konferencen_per_shtyp_per_vendimmarr 1/4 05/08/22, 17:17 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare Kto zhvillime jan mbshtetur nga prmirsimi i ambientit t huaj, nga prmirsimi i besimit n ekonomi, nga kushtet e favorshme financiare, t diktuara nga politika jon monetare lehtsuese, si dhe nga goditje pozitive t oferts. Pritjet tona pr t ardhmen mbeten pozitive. Megjithat, materializimi i tyre krkon ruajtjen e kahut lehtsues t politiks monetare, ndrsa balanca e rreziqeve mbetet e zhvendosur n kahun e poshtm. Inflacioni mesatar i tremujorit t dyt regjistroi vlern 2.2%, duke ardhur n rritje nga norma mesatare prej 1.9% e tremujorit t par. N veanti, inflacioni shnoi vlern 2.4% n muajin qershor. Balanca e presioneve inflacioniste vazhdon t formohet nga nj trend gradual forcimi t presioneve t brendshme dhe nga luhatje afatshkurtra t mimeve t artikujve specifik t shports s konsumit. Rritja e inflacionit n tremujorin e dyt pasqyroi efektin rezultant t dy goditjeve t kahut t kundrt. Nga njra an, rritja e mimit t nafts n tregjet ndrkombtare solli rritjen e kostove t prodhimit dhe ushtroi nj ndikim rrits n inflacion. Nga ana tjetr, forcimi i kursit t kmbimit frenoi prcjelljen e presioneve t huaja inflacioniste n tregun vendas. Faktori i par ka pasur nj intensitet m t fort veprimi n tremujorin e dyt, por efekti i tij vlersohet t jet m i shkurtr n koh. Projeksionet tona sugjerojn se inflacioni do t kthehet n objektiv brenda vitit 2020. Ky parashikim faktorizon dinamikn pozitive t rritjes ekonomike dhe pritjet tona pr kthimin e ekonomis n ekuilibr n gjashtmujorin e par t vitit t ardhshm. Gjithashtu, ai mbshtetet n vlersimin se presionet dezinflacioniste t ardhura nga mbimimi i kursit t kmbimit do t mbeten kalimtare. Kto gjykime gjejn mbshtetje nga t dhnat ekonomike e monetare t gjashtmujorit t par. httpsE:/k/www.bankiofalbhaniia.org/Shtyphi/Fjalimie_injtervisitaj_artikuj/Fjja4lim4e5/F%jala_e_Guvernatjorit_iSejko_ne_kondfehrencen_pdehr_shtyp_per_vendhimmarr 2/4 05/08/22, 17:17 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare Ekonomia shqiptare shnoi nj rritje prej 4.45% n tremujorin e par, dhe t dhnat e trthorta flasin pr ritme pozitive rritjeje edhe n tremujorin e dyt. Prshpejtimi i ritmit t rritjes ekonomike n tremujorin e par t vitit pasqyroi rritjen e shpejt t prodhimit t energjis elektrike, n prgjigje t kushteve t mira hidrike. N terma m afatgjat, zgjerimi i aktivitetit ekonomik u bazua te rritja e konsumit dhe e investimeve private, ndrkoh q deficiti i shkmbimeve tregtare me jasht u rrit dhe politika fiskale vijoi t mbetet n kahun konsolidues. T dhnat e trthorta sugjerojn se kto tendenca zhvillimi jan mbartur edhe n tremujorin e dyt. Zgjerimi i aktivitetit ekonomik sht shoqruar me rritjen e punsimit dhe rnien n 12.5% t norms s papunsis. Kjo norm prbn nivelin m t ult historik t papunsis t regjistruar n Shqipri dhe sugjeron nj prdorim gjithnj e m t plot t kapaciteteve prodhuese n vend. N prgjigje t saj, Instat-i raporton se paga mesatare reale u rrit me 2.3% n tremujorin e par, ka prbn nj premis pozitive pr forcimin gradual t presioneve t brendshme inflacioniste. Tregu i brendshm financiar vazhdon t shfaqet i qet dhe likuid, por presionet mbimuese t lekut vijojn t jen t pranishme n segmentin e tij valutor. Masat e fundit t politiks monetare  ulja n nivelin 1.0% e norms baz t interesit dhe ndrhyrja n tregun e brendshm valutor, me objektiv frenimin e mbimimit t shpejt t kursit t kmbimit  kan rezultuar efektive. Normat e interesit t lekut kan ardhur n rnie n tremujorin e dyt. Normat e interesit t kredive, depozitave dhe letrave me vler n lek shfaqen n nivele minimale. Kredia pr sektorin privat regjistroi nj rritje mesatare me 5% n tremujorin e dyt t vitit, me nj kontribut m t balancuar n rritje midis kredis n lek dhe kredis n valut. N prgjithsi, rritja e kredis sht n linj me prmirsimin e moderuar t krkess pr t. Megjithat, vrojtimi i aktivitetit kreditues sugjeron se standardet dhe kushtet e kreditimit t aplikuara nga sektori bankar vijojn t mbeten konservatore. Banka e Shqipris konstaton se rnia e rrezikut t kredis dhe prmirsimi i vazhdueshm i bilanceve, sikundr ilustrohet nga rnia n nivelin 13.27% e raportit t kredive me probleme, duhet t gjejn nj pasqyrim m t mir n politikat e kreditimit t sektorit bankar. Pas mbimimit t shpejt t regjistruar n muajt prill-maj, ndrhyrja e Banks s Shqipris arriti t qetsoj funksionimin e tregut t brendshm valutor dhe t frenoj mbimimin e kursit t kmbimit. Megjithat, analizat tona sugjerojn se raporti i krkess dhe oferts n tregun valutor mbetet i zhbalancuar, pjesrisht dhe si pasoj e prurjeve t larta sezonale, dhe se mbimimi i shpejt dhe i mtejshm i kursit t kmbimit do t dmtonte kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv n afatin e mesm. Duke gjykuar mbi sa m sipr, Banka e Shqipris vlerson se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare mbetet i prshtatshm. N kto rrethana, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi: t mbaj t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 1.0%; https://www.bankofablbajnia.org/Shtypdi/Fjalimhe_intervista_artikuj/Fjailime/Fjala_i e_Guvdernatoriti_Sejkod_hne_konfekrencdeni _per_jshtdypi_per_vendimmarr 3/4 05/08/22, 17:17 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare t mbaj t pandryshuara normat e interesit t depozits dhe t kredis njditore, respektivisht n nivelin 0.1% dhe 1.9%; t vijoj programin e blerjeve n tregun valutor, me synim frenimin e mbimimit t shpejt t kursit t kmbimit. Title: Questions and answers to the press conference
text: Questions answers of the press conference October 3, 2018 29/07/22, 13:36 Questions answers of the press conference October 3, 2018 Publication date: 03.10.2018 Q: We are already familiar with eurobond, but we care to know the real implications of it. How will its issue affect the business climate in conditions when we do not have new foreign direct investment? What is the central bank's opinion? Governor: We were informed of the eurobond emission for the Albanian government. Its issue is a success both by value  over 1 billion euros were offered despite the government's need being 500m euros- and the interest rate of 3.5% and the deadline. All of these are indicators for the successful emission of eurobond. The eurobond issue is an indicator of the assessment of the Albanian economy by foreign international markets. In addition to the assessments we have had from international institutions, such as the International Monetary Fund, the World Bank, the European Commission, etc., we already have accurate indicators of the assessment of the Albanian economy, the assessment of the international market which valued the Eurobond at a good interest rate for current markets. We need to understand that the interest rate varies from day to day in markets, but this price is the result of two factors. The first factor is the low interest rate in international markets. The second factor is the positive assessment of the economy's performance, in conditions when double the amount offered for eurobond was required. The eurobond issue has some positive elements. In the first place, it frees up liquidity in the market, giving the banking system the opportunity to lean towards lending. So it orients the liquidity of banks towards lending, since they do not need to invest in eurobond. It is also a positive signal for foreign investors as it is an indicator of the appreciation of the Albanian economy. Page 1 of 3 Questions answers of the press conference October 3, 2018 29/07/22, 13:36 We appreciate a successful transaction. It is important to point out that, from the contacts we have with the Ministry of Finance and from looking at the financial mirrors of the state budget, the Eurobond will not affect Albania's debt growth. Part of it is calculated for the write-off of the old debt and the rest will always be managed and used in the context of fiscal consolidation. Therefore, the Eurobond will not affect the growth of the economy's debt, in the medium and long term. We have an organic law that forces us to move towards fiscal consolidation and continue to lower debt levels; We'll continue to keep the debt level down. In conclusion, the Eurobond is a positive assessment and indicator of the assessment of international markets for the Albanian economy. Q: Regarding the sale of commercial banks, the departure of banks originating from European Union countries and the introduction of banks that have no origin from the European Union is indicative of a good business climate in the country? Governor: This is a phenomenon that is happening throughout the region, it is not just happening in Albania. After the crisis, many of the European banks, mainly those operating in the Eurozone and which have their subsidiaries in the countries of birth, as a result of the austerity conditions of the European Central Bank, have been forced to either inject capital, i.e. increase capital, or continue with the process of reduction, i.e. the closure of some branches or subsidiaries in some states. Of course, injecting capital has been harder. In the absence of injecting or finding capital to add the capital sufficiency rate, these banks have been forced to withdraw from the region. We've been analyzing this situation for years, so it's not unexpected, that's what we knew. As regulators of the financial system, we have intended this process to be coupled with the consolidation of the banking system and has somehow yielded positive results, as today we have two banks absorbed by the existing bank. So in total we have 14 banks today, versus the 16 banks we had before. This is a positive indicator for our banking and financial system. On the other hand, we have been careful and are monitoring developments and those banks that are in the process of withdrawing. But I want to stress that we, as regulators and the central bank, do not interfere with the process of selling banks' shares. It is a free process where banks themselves choose their tender process to find the best buyer. What I guarantee on behalf of the Bank of Albania is that at the moment of applying and submitting the request to the Bank of Albania for shareholder change, we will strictly respect the legal requirements of our regulations, as we have always done in the direction of maintaining security and financial stability. I stress once again that, in this context, everything is monitored and controlled; We have no surprises. The banking system remains well capitalised, the capital sufficiency rate has increased even further as a result of the high level of bank profitability. The capital sufficiency rate has reached a level of 18% and banks are in excess of liquidity, which we aim to translate into healthy loans for the economy, as I mentioned and the very issue of eurobond has created the government Page 2 of 3 Questions answers of the press conference October 3, 2018 29/07/22, 13:36 Excess liquidity for its needs. The liquidity of the banking system must be oriented towards healthy lending to the economy, whether for individuals or businesses. In conclusion, I stress that we are monitoring the process and I guarantee you once again that we will strictly respect the requirements of our law and regulations in approving any new shareholders who will enter the Albanian banking system. Muz dhe Eduk " Kreu / Shtypi / Fjalime, intervista, artikuj / Fjalime Njoftimet pr shtyp Njoftime t # mbledhjeve t Kshillit Mbikqyrs Konferenca pr shtyp Fjalime, $ intervista, artikuj Fjalime Intervista e artikuj Kalendar # Kalendari i festave zyrtare pr vitin 2022 COVID-19 Evropa # BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Pyetje prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp 3 tetor 2018 Data e publikimit: 03.10.2018 Pyetje: Tashm jemi t njohur me eurobondin, por na intereson t dim implikimet reale t tij. Si do t ndikoj emetimi i tij n klimn e biznesit n kushtet kur nuk kemi investime t reja t huaja direkte? Cili sht mendimi i banks qendrore? Guvernatori: U informuam mbi emetimin e eurobondit pr qeverin shqiptare. Emetimi i tij sht nj sukses si nga vlera  u ofruan mbi 1 miliard euro pavarsisht se nevoja e qeveris ishte 500 milion euro-, ashtu edhe nga norma e interesit prej 3.5% dhe afati. T gjitha kto jan tregues pr emetimin me sukses t eurobondit. Emetimi i eurobondit sht nj tregues i vlersimit t ekonomis shqiptare nga tregjet e huaja ndrkombtare. Prve vlersimeve q kemi patur nga institucionet ndrkombtare, si Fondi Monetar Ndrkombtar, Banka Botrore, Komisioni Evropian, etj., tashm kemi dhe tregues t sakt t vlersimit t ekonomis shqiptare, vlersimin e tregut ndrkombtar i cili e moi eurobondin me nj norm t mir interesi pr tregjet aktuale. Duhet t kuptojm q norma e interesit ndryshon nga dit n dit n tregje, por ky mim sht pasoj e dy faktorve. Faktori i par sht norma e ult e interesit n tregjet ndrkombtare. Faktori i dyt sht vlersimi pozitiv i ecuris s ekonomis, n kushtet kur pr eurobondin u krkua dyfishi i shums s ofruar. Emetimi i eurobondit ka disa elemente pozitiv. N radh t par, liron likuiditetin n treg, duke i dhn mundsin sistemit bankar t priret drejt kreditimit. Pra orienton likuiditetin e bankave drejt kreditimit, duke qen se ato nuk kan nevoj t investojn n eurobond. Gjithashtu sht nj sinjal pozitiv pr investitort e huaj pasi sht nj tregues i vlersimit t ekonomis shqiptare. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Pyetje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_3_tetor_2018.html Pagina 1 di 3 Pyetje prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp 3 tetor 2018 29/07/22, 13:36 Ne e vlersojm nj transaksion t suksesshm. E rndsishme sht t theksohet se, nga kontaktet q ne kemi me Ministrin e Financave dhe nga shikimi i pasqyrave financiare t buxhetit t shtetit, eurobondi nuk do t ndikoj n rritjen e borxhit t Shqipris. Nj pjes e tij sht llogaritur pr shlyerjen e borxhit t vjetr dhe pjesa tjetr do t menaxhohet e prdoret gjithmon n kontekstin e nj konsolidimi fiskal. Pra, eurobondi nuk do t ndikoj n rritjen e borxhit t ekonomis, n afatmesm dhe afatgjat. Ne kemi nj ligj organik i cili na detyron t ecim drejt konsolidimit fiskal dhe t vazhdojm uljen e nivelit t borxhit; ne do ta vazhdojm ta mbajm t ulur nivelin e borxhit. N prfundim, eurobondi sht nj vlersim dhe tregues pozitiv i vlersimit t tregjeve ndrkombtare pr ekonomin shqiptare. Pyetje: Lidhur me shitblerjen e bankave tregtare, largimi i bankave me origjin nga vendet e Bashkimit Evropian dhe futja e bankave q nuk kan origjin nga Bashkimi Evropian a sht tregues pr nj klim t mir biznesi n vend? Guvernatori: Ky sht nj fenomen q po ndodh n gjith rajonin, nuk po ndodh vetm n Shqipri. Pas krizs, shum nga bankat evropiane, kryesisht ato q operojn n Eurozon dhe q kan filialet e tyre n vendet e lindjes, si pasoj e kushteve shtrnguese t Banks Qendrore Evropiane, kan qen t detyruara ose t injektojn kapital, pra t rrisin kapitalin, ose t vazhdojn me procesin e zvoglimit, pra t mbylljes t disa degve ose filialeve t tyre n disa shtete. Natyrisht q, injektimi i kapitalit ka qen m i vshtir. N munges t injektimit ose t gjetjes t kapitalit pr t shtuar normn e mjaftueshmris s kapitalit, kto banka jan detyruar t trhiqen nga rajoni. Ne e kemi analizuar kt situat prej vitesh, prandaj nuk sht e papritur, kt ne e dinim. Si rregullator t sistemit financiar, ne kemi synuar q ky proces t shoqrohej me konsolidimin e sistemit bankar dhe n njfar mnyre ka dhn rezultat pozitiv, pasi sot kemi dy banka t prthithura nga banka ekzistuese. Pra, n total ne sot kemi 14 banka, kundrejt 16 bankave q kishim m par. Ky sht nj tregues pozitiv pr sistemin ton bankar e financiar. Nga ana tjetr, jemi treguar t kujdesshm dhe po monitorojm zhvillimet dhe pr ato banka q jan n procesin e trheqjes. Por dua t theksoj q ne, si rregullator dhe bank qendrore, nuk ndrhyjm n procesin e shitblerjes s aksioneve t bankave. Ai sht nj proces i lir ku vet bankat zgjedhin procesin e tyre t tenderimit pr t gjetur blersin m t mir. Ajo q un garantoj n emr t Banks s Shqipris sht q n momentin e aplikimit dhe t paraqitjes s krkess n Bankn e Shqipris pr ndryshimin e aksionerve, ne do t respektojm strikt krkesat ligjore t rregulloreve tona, sikurse kemi br gjithmon n drejtim t ruajtjes s siguris dhe stabilitetit financiar. E theksoj edhe nj her q, n kt kontekst, do gj sht e monitoruar dhe e kontrolluar; nuk kemi asnj surpriz. Sistemi bankar mbetet i mirkapitalizuar, norma e mjaftueshmris s kapitalit sht rritur edhe m tej si pasoj e nivelit t lart t prfitueshmris s bankave. This is also the reason for my appeal not to be separated for any moment from knowledge and education. Rest assured that wherever you are, in Albania or elsewhere, education will always reward your struggle and time spent. Live with courage and self-confidence! Time rewards those who dream and dare to see beyond tomorrow. This is the right way to build a better society than this today, capable of creating more prosperity for generations to come. Give up ambitions for a fast and undeserved career! In the end, let me close my word by wishing you successes and luck again in the next stages of life! Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, December 24, 2018 29/07/22, 13:35 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, December 24, 2018 Publication date: 24.12.2018 Honored media representatives, Welcome to the last press conference for this year! Today, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania met to be recognised and discussed on recent economic and financial developments in the country, expectations for the future, the appropriateness of monetary policy stance, as well as other issues of organisation and direction of the Bank of Albania. Following my address, I will present the Supervisory Council's announcement on the monetary policy decision. Page 1 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, December 24, 2018 29/07/22, 13:35 Although the information available remains partial and indirect, data taken in the analysis suggest that economic activity in the country has come to an increase during the second half of 2018. Economic growth has been reflected in better exploitation of production capacities, as is the rise in employment, the reduction of the unemployment rate, as well as strengthening domestic inflationary pressures. This performance has generally been in line with our previous expectations and does not bring significant changes in our forecasts for the future. Among other things, it highlights the positive impact the Bank of Albania's monetary stimulus policy has had, and suggests that the current position of this policy remains appropriate, both to ensure economic growth in line with the country's productive potential and to guarantee the return of inflation to the target within 2020. In the sectoral perspective, the expansion of economic activity seems to mainly reflect the increase in production in industries and services. However, available data show that the pace of growth in electricity generation has come to a slowdown during the third quarter, suggesting a slight slowdown in economic growth in the second half of the year. In terms of aggregate demand, economic growth seems to have been supported by the expansion of consumption and private investment, as well as by the increase in Albanian exports. On the other hand, the fiscal policy consolidator, during the third quarter and most of the fourth quarter, has been stronger than expected, bringing a lower-than-forecast contribution of public spending to economic growth. In the balance, the overall context of economic and financial developments in the country remains positive. The Albanian economy follows on from the positive performance of our main trading partner, Eurozone, from improved financial balances for families and businesses, as well as fiscal consolidation, which has reduced risk premiums in internal financial markets. In parallel with these factors, the expansion of economic activity has been supported by the monetary stimulus policy of the Bank of Albania. This policy is transmitted through the low level of basic interest rate, continuous injection of liquidity into the internal financial market, market orientation on the direction of monetary policy in the future, as well as selective interventions in the currency market during the summer period. Our monetary stimulus has created a financial lyrical and low interest rate environment, as well as softened the effect of strengthening pressures on the exchange rate. Low interest rates have supported the expansion of lending: cleared of the course effect and the extraction of off-balance sheet loans, credit for the private sector increased by 4.9% and 4.5%, respectively during the third quarter and the first two months of the fourth quarter. Also, low interest rates have helped restructure loans, easing debt service costs and improving the stability of loans. Page 2 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, December 24, 2018 29/07/22, 13:35 financial system. The ratio of troubled loans decreased to 12.7% in the month of November, illustrating the continued improvement in the health of the banking sector. Finally, temporary intervention in currency markets has reduced currency supply and demand imbalances, calming the functioning of the currency market and reducing course deviations from levels suggested by fundamental factors. Increased lending, easing the financial burden of creditors and reducing exchange rate fluctuations have encouraged consumption, investment, economic growth and employment growth, creating premise for returning inflation to target, on the medium-term time horizon. Inflation scored 1.8% in the month of November, reducing against the level recorded in the third quarter and october. In line with our previous expectations, this reduction reflects the fallen effect that strengthens the exchange rate on imported inflation. Our analyses suggest that this effect is expected to be fleeting and will not affect meeting the inflation target in the medium term. The update of forecasts under the base line scenario confirmed our previous expectations on the return of the economy to balance in the second half of next year, and the return of inflation to the target in 2020. This performance is expected to be supported by the positive performance of Eurozone and our other trading and financial partners, the monetary and financial stimulus environment in the country, as well as by calming the strengthening pressures on the exchange rate. In parallel, the Supervisory Council estimated that the balance of risks would remain shifted to the lower direction. These risks are related to both possible shocks that could come from the foreign environment and the speed of improving the business climate and lending in the country. *** Judging on the above, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current monetary policy position remains appropriate. Under these circumstances, the Supervisory Council decided: Keep the basic interest rate unchanged at 1.0%; Keep deposit and one-day loan interest rates unchanged, at 0.1% and 1.9%, respectively. Maintaining the kah and intensity of monetary stimulus drives the increase in aggregate demand, helping increase employment, wages, and domestic inflationary pressures. In line with basic scenario forecasts, as well as on the basis of available information, the Supervisory Council estimated that the basic interest rate increase would not begin before the second quarter of 2019. Nga ana tjetr, kahu konsolidues i politiks fiskale, gjat tremujorit t tret dhe pjess m t madhe t tremujorit t katrt, ka qen m i fort se ai i parashikuar, duke sjell nj kontribut m t ult se parashikimi t shpenzimeve publike n rritjen ekonomike. N balanc, konteksti i prgjithshm i zhvillimeve ekonomike dhe financiare n vend mbetet pozitiv. Paralelisht me kta faktor, zgjerimi i aktivitetit ekonomik ka vijuar t mbshtetet nga politika monetare stimuluese e Banks s Shqipris. S fundi, ndrhyrja e prkohshme n tregjet valutore ka reduktuar zhbalancimet e oferts dhe krkess pr valut, duke qetsuar funksionimin e tregut valutor dhe duke reduktuar shmangiet e kursit nga nivelet e sugjeruara nga faktort fondamental. Rritja e kreditimit, lehtsimi i barrs financiare t kredimarrsve dhe reduktimi i luhatjeve t kursit t kmbimit, kan inkurajuar konsumin, investimet, rritjen ekonomike dhe rritjen e punsimit, duke krijuar premisa pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv, n horizontin kohor afatmesm. Inflacioni shnoi vlern 1.8% n muajin nntor, duke u reduktuar kundrejt nivelit t regjistruar n tremujorin e tret dhe muajin tetor. N prputhje dhe me pritjet tona t mparshme, ky reduktim pasqyron efektin rns q sjell forcimi i kursit t kmbimit mbi inflacionin e importuar. Analizat tona sugjerojn se ky efekt pritet t jet kalimtar dhe nuk do t cnoj prmbushjen e objektivit t inflacionit n afatin e mesm. Prditsimi i parashikimeve sipas skenarit baz konfirmoi pritjet tona t mparshme mbi kthimin e ekonomis n ekuilibr n gjysmn e dyt t vitit t ardhshm, dhe kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv n vitin 2020. Title: Questions and answers at the press conference
text: Question answers of the press conference dated December 24, 2018 29/07/22, 13:35 Question answers of the press conference dated December 24, 2018 Publication date: 24.12.2018 Q: In your latest reporting before the Economy Commission you stated that the Bank of Albania was monitoring whether there would be a new balance of the Euro-lek exchange rate. Since then, the euro has fallen by almost two dollars per unit. Now in the reporting of the Supervisory Council you have said that you are willing to consider market interventions again. Faced with this two-money drop and falling inflation and away from the target, firstly when it is a level at which the bank would be considered obliged to intervene and secondly if in the summer we considered the influxes from tourism as the influencer on the decline of the course what are the factors that affect today's decline of this course. Governor: In terms of the exchange rate it is a fact that we have overpriced national currency savings against the euro. For this reason, we are monitoring the performance of this course and analyzing it as we have done in recent years. The overprice of the money currency started years ago constantly, but at certain times this overpricehas been more pronounced, because seasonal factors have mainly influenced, as now that we are at the peak of a seasonal factor. The summer period and December have always brought about the overprice of the local currency as a result of strong currency inflows. In addition, there are a number of other factors that affect the exchange rate, which we have reported and have constantly informed about them. These factors relate to foreign direct investment, exports, remittances especially during the summer period which have sufficiently justified the overprice of the exchange rate.  e_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_24_dhjetor_2018.html Page 1 of 3 Question answers of the press conference dated December 24, 2018 29/07/22, 13:35 There have been other specific factors that have forced the Bank of Albania to undertake the intervention programme, especially during the summer period. These factors have been the conversion of capital by some banks and a large loan of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, which amounted to a sum close to 300m euros to be converted at a given moment. This amount of currency put pressure on the exchange rate and increased the expectation of the financial system at that time. According to our analyses, estimating that the decline in the exchange rate would affect the achievement of the inflation target we were forced to intervene. The Bank of Albania intervenes when the inflation target is at risk, as well as when there are market disturbances. In June, we had both of these elements and that's why we made that decision. Currently, the exchange rate does not show disorders, so the market operates normally. We have an exchange rate, which comes as a result of demand-supply in the currency market, i.e. normal behavior. I would not like to mention this figure (when inflation is at risk) as a level, as it can create psychological impact and become a cause for speculation in the currency market, but we are certainly at a lower level than the previous level in terms of its impact on inflation. Of course, if we see disturbances under the bank of Albania's law and regulations and see that the exchange rate will affect the level of inflation, then the intervention programme will continue. We have a free exchange rate regime in Albania, and we do not want to influence this free regime of its own. The Bank of Albania does not intervene to protect the interests of particular groups that lose or win, as it makes no sense. We look at macroeconomic parameters and we would never enter this game. During the year we have made significant purchases which are reported every quarter. We have bought over 400m euros in total, not only for course effect but also for currency reserve reasons. Of course this is a considerable figure to attract the euro surplus to the market, and to maintain balances at the exchange rate level to achieve those elements I told you above, i.e. targeting inflation or avoiding disorders. The Bank of Albania does not control the entire amount of the euro in circulation, as it enters formal and informal channels, and this is impossible for any central bank. Of course we try through all our analyses, but also other, if not empirical, ways to judge and assess what the impact of this amount is on circulation to make our predictions for the future for economic growth and to design monetary policy, to consider how we will use monetary policy instruments. If we have an impact on the course, the figures will tell us whether or not to intervene. I can't say the course will be at this or that level, as of course it's in a new balance and in we can't predict how much the course will be. We prefer that there be stability in financial markets, including the currency market. The course will certainly have fluctuations, because it is an indicator of the market economy and in a free regime the course fluctuates. The less fluctuation, the better, as the agents  e_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_24_dhjetor_2018.html Page 2 of 3 Question answers of the press conference dated December 24, 2018 29/07/22, 13:35 economics would be more protected. Economic agents can take measures to protect themselves from the risk of the exchange rate, defining it in their contracts. Swap or forward contracts are methods also known to international institutions, used by economic agents mainly those operating in the field of exports. This is the only way to avoid the risk of the exchange rate. We as the central bank of course are concerned to take all measures so that we have economic growth, increased Albanian exports, the wealth of Albanian citizens, and the exchange rate must positively affect all these factors and not negatively. But we must understand that the economy is highly euroised at the business level and the individual and any fluctuation in the exchange rate, whether on the lower side or in the upper direction, would affect a part of the population. As long as euro exposure is at the 50% level, if we are overpriced, businesses or individuals who have income in euros or in the opposite case are affected by those with income in money. What I have highlighted in previous conferences regarding the exchange rate has been that the exchange rate in Albania over the past few decades has shown a sustainability and this has been a good element. The Bank of Albania has over the past decades managed the risk of the exchange rate well, but in the current situation there are many currency inflows from many directions. Our analysis continues because it is done in accordance with the course's time performance and we will intervene when we see these parameters that I mentioned above are affected.  e_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_24_dhjetor_2018.html Page 3 of 3

Muz dhe Eduk " Kreu / Shtypi / Fjalime, intervista, artikuj / Fjalime Njoftimet pr shtyp Njoftime t # mbledhjeve t Kshillit Mbikqyrs Konferenca pr shtyp Fjalime, $ intervista, artikuj Fjalime Intervista e artikuj Kalendar # Kalendari i festave zyrtare pr vitin 2022 COVID-19 Evropa # BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Pyetje prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp t dats 24 dhjetor 2018 Data e publikimit: 24.12.2018 Pyetje: N raportimin tuaj t fundit prpara Komisionit t Ekonomis ju deklaruat se Banka e Shqipris po monitoronte nse do t kishte nj ekuilibr t ri t kursit t kmbimit euro-lek. Q prej asaj kohe, euro ka rn me pothuajse dy lek pr njsi. Tani n raportimin e Kshillit Mbikqyrs ju that se jeni t gatshm t konsideroni srish ndrhyrjet n treg. Prball ksaj rnieje me dy lek dhe inflacionit n rnie dhe larg objektivit, s pari kur sht nj nivel n t cilin banka do t konsiderohej e detyruar pr t ndrhyr dhe s dyti n qoft se n ver konsideronim flukset nga turizmi si ndikuesi n rnien e kursit cilat jan faktort q ndikojn sot n rnien e ktij kursi. Guvernatori: Lidhur me kursin e kmbimit sht fakt q kemi kurs t mbimuar t monedhs kombtare kundrejt euros. Pr kt arsye, ne po monitorojm ecurin e ktij kursi dhe po e analizojm sikurse kemi br edhe gjat viteve t shkuara. Mbimimi i monedhs lek ka filluar vite m par n mnyr konstante, por n periudha t caktuara ky mbimim ka qen m i theksuar, sepse kan ndikuar kryesisht faktort sezonal, njsoj si tani q jemi n pikun e nj faktori sezonal. Periudha e vers dhe muaji dhjetor gjithmon kan sjell mbimimin e monedhs vendase si pasoj e hyrjeve t forta valutore. Prve ksaj, ka dhe nj sr faktorsh t tjer q ndikojn n kursin e kmbimit, t cilt ne i kemi raportuar dhe ju kemi informuar vazhdimisht lidhur me ta. Kta faktor lidhen me investimet e huaja direkte, eksportet, remitancat sidomos gjat periudhs s vers t cilat kan justifikuar mjaftueshmrisht mbimimin e kursit t kmbimit. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjae_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_24_dhjetor_2018.html Pagina 1 di 3 Pyetje prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp t dats 24 dhjetor 2018 29/07/22, 13:35 Ka pasur dhe faktor t tjer specifik q kan detyruar Bankn e Shqipris t ndrmarr programin e ndrhyrjeve, veanrisht gjat periudhs s vers. Kta faktor kan qen konvertimi i kapitalit nga disa banka dhe nj kredi e madhe e Banks Evropiane pr Rindrtim dhe Zhvillim, t cilat prbnin nj shum afr 300 milion euro pr tu konvertuar n nj moment t caktuar. Kjo sasi valute bnte presion mbi kursin e kmbimit dhe rriste pritshmrin e sistemit financiar n at moment. Sipas analizave tona, duke vlersuar q rnia e kursit t kmbimit do t ndikonte arritjen e objektivit t inflacionit ne u detyruam t ndrhynim. Banka e Shqipris ndrhyn kur rrezikohet objektivi i inflacionit si dhe kur ka rregullime n treg. N qershor, ne i kishim t dy kto element dhe prandaj morm at vendim. Aktualisht, kursi i kmbimit nuk shfaq rregullime, pra tregu funksionon normalisht. Kemi nj kurs kmbimi, i cili vjen si pasoj e krkes-oferts n treg valutor, pra nj sjellje normale. Un nuk do doja ta prmendja kt shifr (kur rrezikohet inflacioni) si nivel, pasi mund t krijoj ndikim psikologjik dhe t bhet shkak pr spekulime n tregun valutor, por sigurisht q jemi n nj nivel m t ult se sa niveli i mparshm pr sa i prket ndikimit t tij n raport me inflacionin. Natyrisht n rast se ne do t shikojm rregullime sipas prcaktimeve t ligjit dhe rregulloreve t Banks s Shqipris dhe do t shohim q kursi i kmbimit do t ndikoj nivelin e inflacionit, ather do t vazhdoj programi i ndrhyrjeve. Ne kemi nj regjim t lir t kursit t kmbimit n Shqipri, dhe nuk duam t ndikojm kt regjim t lir t tij. Banka e Shqipris nuk ndrhyn pr t mbrojtur interesat e grupeve t veanta q humbasin ose fitojn, pasi nuk ka kuptim. Ne shikojm parametrat makroekonomik dhe nuk do ti hynim kurr ksaj loje. Gjat vitit ne kemi br blerje t konsiderueshme t cilat raportohen do tremujor. Ne kemi bler mbi 400 milion euro n total, jo vetm pr efekt t kursit por dhe pr arsye t rezervs valutore. Sigurisht q kjo sht nj shifr e konsiderueshme pr t trhequr tepricn e euros n treg, dhe pr t ruajtur ekuilibrat n nivelin e kursit t kmbimit pr t arritur ato element q ju thash m lart, pra objektivin e inflacionit apo shmangien e rregullimeve. Banka e Shqipris nuk kontrollon gjith sasin e euros n qarkullim, pasi ajo hyn n kanale formale dhe informale, dhe kjo sht e pamundur pr do bank qendrore. Sigurisht q ne prpiqemi nprmjet t gjitha analizave tona por dhe mnyra t tjera, qoft edhe empirike, t gjykojm dhe t vlersojm se sa sht ndikimi i ksaj sasie n qarkullim pr t br parashikimet tona pr t ardhmen pr rritjen ekonomike dhe pr t dizenjuar politikn monetare, pr t pasur parasysh se si do ti prdorim instrumentet e politiks monetare. N rast se do t kemi ndikim n kurs, shifrat do t na tregojn nse duhet ndrhyjm ose jo. Nuk mund t them q kursi do t jet n kt apo at nivel, pasi natyrisht q sht n nj ekuilibr t ri dhe n nuk mund ta parashikojm se sa do t jet kursi. Ne preferojm q t ket stabilitet n tregjet financiare, prfshi dhe tregun valutor. Kursi sigurisht q do t ket luhatje, sepse sht nj tregues i ekonomis s tregut dhe n nj regjim t lir kursi luhatet. Agjentt ekonomik mund t marrin masa pr tu mbrojtur nga rreziku i kursit t kmbimit, duke e prcaktuar n kontratat e tyre. Title: Speech at the press conference on the activity of the Bank of Albania during 2018
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference on the Bank of Albania event during 2018 29/07/22, 13:35 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference on the Bank of Albania event during 2018 Publication date: 24.12.2018 Continuing the tradition we have started, in the interest of transparency and accountability of the institution, I want to share with you a short mirror of the work of the Bank of Albania during the year we are leaving behind. The activity of the Supervisory Council In accordance with legal provisions and regulations, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania held 15 meetings during 2018, during which a series of issues related to monetary policy, financial stability, bank supervision, and other operational nature were examined and adopted.  htyp_mbi_veprimtarine_e_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_gjate_vitit_2018.html Page 1 of 6 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference on the Bank of Albania event during 2018 29/07/22, 13:35 In accordance with its duties and competences, as well as in pursuit of work plans and in the function of development priorities, the Council adopted 69 decisions during 2018, 48 of which were new acts and 21 changes to existing acts. Some of the main events at the Council's 2018 event are: (i) the adoption of the Policy for the Expansion of the Use of the National Currency in the Activity of Banks and Nonbank Financial Institutions; (ii) adoption of the Payment Systems Supervision and Atonement Policy; as well as, (iii) the adoption of The Contabel Policies according to International Financial Reporting Standards (SNRF). Also, the Council has received regular information on the institution's management policies, on the ways and procedures of using financial tools for the realization of operational activity, as well as on the findings and recommendations of the Internal Audit. Financial markets and monetary operations 2018 has marked important developments in the direction of expanding and deepening financial markets. A prominent development this year was the implementation of the Primary Dealers system, through the pilot project to issue 5-year reference titles with commercial banks which already perform the role of Market Creators. The Bank of Albania has supported the Ministry of Finance and Economy in this project, both operationally and in the drafting of the regulatory framework. Banking supervision and financial stability The Bank of Albania estimates that the financial sector is stable. In particular, the banking sector follows to expand activity, remaining simultaneously secular and well-capitalised. This sector's exposures to market risks remain controlled, while liquidity risk is estimated low. The quality of the loan portfolio suffered an improvement during 2018: the troubled loan ratio index marked the 12.43% level at the end of the third quarter, versus 13.23% at the end of 2017. The improvement in credit quality has come mainly from their write-offs, while additional contributions in this direction have also  htyp_mbi_veprimtarine_e_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_gjate_vitit_2018.html Page 2 of 6 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference on the Bank of Albania event during 2018 29/07/22, 13:35 The recovery. In this direction, the Bank of Albania targeted the systematic and formalized treatment of troubled loans, especially in the case of large creditors, through the drafting of a special regulation for this purpose, according to international best practices and country specifics. Strengthening banking supervision and supporting financial stability remain fundamental objectives of the Bank of Albania. These objectives are exercised through our licensing, regulatory and supervisory role. Let me give you some more details. In the direction of licensing, significant ownership changes for some banks materialized during 2018. By decision of the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania, legal reorganization was adopted through the merger with absorption of some banks, as well as the change or expansion of the activity object of several other financial institutions. The above structural changes are expected to affect the improvement of the efficiency of banking activity and financial mediation. In the direction of bank supervision, in accordance with established objectives, the Bank of Albania carried out full and partial examinations throughout the year on bank and nonbank subjects, as well as currency exchange offices. In this direction, coordination also came with the Directorate General of Money Laundering Prevention (DPPPP), with which joint inspections were carried out in the context of preventing money laundering and preventing terrorism financing (PPP/PFT). Also, in November 2018, the Memorandum of Co-operation in the field of banking supervision between the Bank of Albania and the European Central Bank (ECB) was signed. The signing of this Memorandum formalizes the mechanisms of co-operation and information sharing between the ECB and the Bank of Albania and is fundamental to ensure effective and comprehensive supervision of subjects under the jurisdiction of each of the regulatory authorities. At the same time, at the invitation of the ECB, participation in supervisory colleges for two of the banks belonging to European banking groups has been ensured. Exchange of experiences and information on plans at group level make a valuable contribution to the orientation of the supervisory process for the banks in question. In the direction of banking regulation, the Bank of Albania has been working to meet the central bank's macroprudence policy framework. During 2018, early warning systems related to systemic risks have been improved, determining the list of indicators used for their evidence. Depending on the approximation of the regulatory framework with European directives and regulations for credit institution activity, as well as with basel Committee standards for effective supervision, the Bank of Albania has undertaken a series of changes to some of the existing regulations related to regulatory capital and banking transparency, as well as has successfully completed the drafting of the new draft regulation "For the liquidity coverage report". Even during 2018, particular attention came to monitoring credit risk at system level and for particular banks, with the focus indicating the quality of the loan portfolio.  htyp_mbi_veprimtarine_e_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_gjate_vitit_2018.html Page 3 of 6 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference on the Bank of Albania event during 2018 29/07/22, 13:35 Finally, the Bank of Albania actively participated in filling out Moneyval's comments on Albania's fifth round of assessment for PPP/PFT, regarding the technical questionnaire and that of effectiveness. At the end of this process, it was concluded in a final document for Albania, where a number of recommendations were clarified, for a part of which the BSH has a role and for which it drafted its short-term action plan, with the aim of meeting them. In parallel with the above directions of work, the Bank of Albania has dedicated its importance and strategic aspect to the supervisory and regulatory architecture of the financial system. In this function. The Bank of Albania has engaged in the following directions: To promote the increase in the use of the national currency, in early 2018, a series of regulatory changes were adopted affecting the active and passive banking sector and setting requirements for better awareness of borrowers, regarding unprotected lending in currencies; In fulfilling its legal role as the Extraordinary Intervention Authority in the country, the Bank of Albania created the "Fund for Extraordinary Intervention", through the contribution of banks. This fund will support the implementation of the Bank of Albania's instruments in the direction of extraordinary intervention. In October, the Co-operation Agreement between the Bank of Albania and the Joint Board of Extraordinary Intervention (EU Intervention Authority), which supports the exchange of information for drafting plans, coordination of actions by the two authorities in the event of activation of these plans, was signed in October. As well as organizing joint activities for the establishment of expertise in the field of extraordinary intervention. In addition to the main course of work of the Bank of Albania described above, I would like to stop in some other aspects of our work. These activities meet our legal obligations and simultaneously serve the development of the financial system and market economy in Albania. Let me just stop at some of them. In the role of developer and supervisor of payment systems, the National Strategy for Reforming Small Value Payment Systems was adopted. This strategy aims to expand the financial inclusion of the population and expand the use of electronic payment instruments. In its implementation, the drafting of the "For Payment Services" bill, which aims to promote competition in the market, promote innovative services, create a well-regulated consumer protection regime, and respond to the requirements of the European Union Directive for payment services. In the context of improving the institution's financial and material management, the Bank of Albania has completed work on the implementation of the new accounting standard, named as SNRF-9. With the drafting and auditing of financial mirrors for 2018, a process that is expected to be carried out by March 2019, the implementation of this standard takes final form even through publication. Within the framework of increasing the quality of the Albanian currency show, there are  htyp_mbi_veprimtarine_e_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_gjate_vitit_2018.html Page 4 of 6 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference on the Bank of Albania event during 2018 29/07/22, 13:35 implemented a series of measures aimed at minimizing operational risk, improving the currency processing process, and protecting it from counterfeiting. Also, this year, work has been done on the realization of the 10,000-dollar denomination bill, which is added to the series of banknotes in circulation and reflects the symbols of the national flag. In the field of statistics, work has been done to meet quantitative standards of international methodologies and European Union legislation, regarding the development, compiling and reporting of statistics near European and international bodies. For the first time, a new statistical block was published, that of Financial Accounts, developed according to the latest financial account compilation standard, ESA 2010, as well as compiled interest rate statistics under ECB regulations. In the field of information technology, the Bank of Albania has completed a series of important projects in the function of strategic objectives for further process automation, as well as for improving the security and sustainability of information systems. Activity and research work has been and remains an important direction for the Bank of Albania. During 2018, studies have focused on interpreting the economic and monetary phenomena that have dominated the internal and external environment, paying particular attention to the developments of the exchange rate and prices, the mechanism of transmission of monetary policy, consumer and financial behaviour of families, as well as the financial stability of the banking system. The results of these studies are based on decision-making within the Bank of Albania, but also wider. To this end, the Bank of Albania, in co-operation with the Institute of Global Studies of the London School of Economics (LSE), organised its annual conference on monetary policy, economic integration and "New Normality". Also, studies prepared by the Bank of Albania were presented and discussed at the 12th Economic Research Workshop for Southeast Europe where 37 scientific works were presented by researchers from the Bank of Albania and academic and financial institutions from Europe, the US and the region. In the field of communication, during 2018 the Bank of Albania introduced the new website, which constitutes the main means of its communication with the public. The improvement in image, design and content of this page enables the Bank to convey information to the public more easily and quickly. Full transparency of speeches, announcements and interviews, reports, analysis of bulletins, a high variety of statistics and data, summaries of international conference works and a range of other activities of particular character are reflected in it. As part of the interaction with the public to include all interest groups, communication has also been regularly communicated through the visual and written media, as well as digital media through social networks. The Bank of Albania has played a particular role in the education and financial involvement of the public. Publications, numerous visits to the Bank of Albania Museum, temporary exhibitions and other activities of informative, historical and numismatic character, have served this function of  htyp_mbi_veprimtarine_e_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_gjate_vitit_2018.html Page 5 of 6 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference on the Bank of Albania event during 2018 29/07/22, 13:35 Important. Among the most prominent activities of the year can be mentioned the organization of The Week of Money 2018, the Conference II of the Museum of the BSH, as well as the lectures of the cycle "Museum Nights". Also, within the framework of the "Nationwide Year of Gjergj Skanderbeg" two temporary exhibitions were opened in Tirana and Prizren, themed "Gjergj Skanderbeg in albanian currency and banknote". *** Honored media representatives, Since this is the last media outing this year, I take the opportunity to congratulate you, and through you and the general public, happy holiday of the year, as well as i would like to invite you to follow carefully the work and activity of the Bank of Albania and during 2019. I am convinced that in our institution you will find a serious, reliable partner, and up to the challenges of time. Thank you for the attention! Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, December 24, 2018  htyp_mbi_veprimtarine_e_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_gjate_vitit_2018.html Page 6 of 6

Disa nga ngjarjet kryesore n veprimtarin e Kshillit pr vitin 2018 jan: (i) miratimi i Politiks pr Zgjerimin e Prdorimit t Monedhs Kombtare n Veprimtarin e Bankave dhe t Institucioneve Financiare Jobankare; (ii) miratimi i Politiks s Mbikqyrjes s Sistemeve t Pagesave dhe t Shlyerjes; si dhe, (iii) miratimi i Politikave Kontabl sipas Standardeve Ndrkombtare t Raportimit Financiar (SNRF). Gjithashtu, Kshilli ka marr informacion t rregullt mbi politikat e administrimit t institucionit, mbi mnyrat dhe procedurat e prdorimit t mjeteve financiare pr realizimin e veprimtaris operative, si dhe mbi gjetjet dhe rekomandimet e Auditimit t Brendshm. Tregjet financiare dhe operacionet monetare Viti 2018 ka shnuar zhvillime t rndsishme n drejtim t zgjerimit dhe thellimit t tregjeve financiare. Nj zhvillim i spikatur i ktij viti ishte zbatimi i sistemit Primary Dealers, nprmjet projektit pilot t emetimit t titujve referenc 5-vjear me banka tregtare t cilat kryejn tashm rolin e Krijuesve t Tregut. Banka e Shqipris ka mbshtetur Ministrin e Financave dhe Ekonomis n kt projekt, si n aspektin operacional ashtu dhe n at t hartimit t kuadrit rregullator. Mbikqyrja bankare dhe stabiliteti financiar Banka e Shqipris vlerson se sektori financiar sht i qndrueshm. N veanti, sektori bankar vijon t zgjeroj veprimtarin, duke mbetur njherazi likuid dhe i mirkapitalizuar. Ekspozimet e ktij sektori ndaj rreziqeve t tregut mbeten t kontrolluara, ndrkoh q rreziku i likuiditetit vlersohet i ult. Cilsia e portofolit t kredis psoi nj prmirsim gjat vitit 2018: treguesi i raportit t kredive me probleme shnoi nivelin 12.43% n fund t tremujorit t tret, kundrejt 13.23% n fund t vitit 2017. Po n kt drejtim, Banka e Shqipris synoi trajtimin sistematik dhe t formalizuar t kredive me probleme, veanrisht n rastin e kredimarrsve t mdhenj, nprmjet hartimit t nj rregulloreje t veant pr kt qllim, sipas praktikave m t mira ndrkombtare dhe specifikave t vendit. Forcimi i mbikqyrjes bankare dhe mbshtetja e stabilitetit financiar mbeten objektiva themelore t Banks s Shqipris. Kto objektiva ushtrohen nprmjet rolit ton licencues, rregullator dhe mbikqyrs. M lejoni t jap disa detaje m tepr. N drejtim t licencimit, gjat vitit 2018 u materializuan ndryshime t rndsishme t pronsis pr disa banka. Me vendim t Kshillit Mbikqyrs t Banks s Shqipris, u miratuan riorganizimi juridik nprmjet bashkimit me prthithje i disa bankave, si dhe ndryshimi apo zgjerimi i objektit t veprimtaris t disa institucioneve t tjera financiare. Ndryshimet e msiprme strukturore pritet t ndikojn n prmirsimin e eficiencs s veprimtaris bankare dhe t ndrmjetsimit financiar. N drejtim t mbikqyrjes bankare, n prputhje me objektivat e vendosur, Banka e Shqipris realizoi prgjat gjith vitit ekzaminime t plota e t pjesshme n subjekte banka dhe jobanka, si dhe zyra t kmbimit valutor. Po n kt drejtim, vijoi koordinimi edhe me Drejtorin e Prgjithshme t Parandalimit t Pastrimit t Parave (DPPPP), me t ciln u kryen inspektime t prbashkta n kuadrin e parandalimit t pastrimit t parave dhe parandalimit t financimit t terrorizmit (PPP/PFT). Po ashtu, n muajin nntor 2018, u nnshkrua Memorandumi i Bashkpunimit n fushn e mbikqyrjes bankare mes Banks se Shqipris dhe Banks Qendrore Evropiane (BQE). Nnshkrimi i ktij Memorandumi formalizon mekanizmat e bashkpunimit dhe ndarjes s informacionit ndrmjet BQE-s dhe Banks s Shqipris dhe sht themelor pr t siguruar nj mbikqyrje efektive dhe gjithprfshirse t subjekteve nn juridiksionin e secilit prej autoriteteve rregullatore. Njkohsisht, me ftes t BQE-s, sht siguruar pjesmarrja n kolegjet e mbikqyrsve pr dy nga bankat q i prkasin grupeve bankare evropiane. Shkmbimi i eksperiencave dhe informimi mbi planet n nivel grupi japin nj kontribut t vlefshm n orientimin e procesit mbikqyrs pr bankat n fjal. N drejtim t rregullimit bankar, Banka e Shqipris ka vijuar punn pr plotsimin e kuadrit t politiks makroprudenciale t banks qendrore. Gjat vitit 2018 jan prmirsuar sistemet e paralajmrimit t hershm lidhur me rreziqet sistemike, duke prcaktuar listn e treguesve t prdorur pr evidentimin e tyre. N funksion t prafrimit t kuadrit rregullator me direktivat dhe rregulloret evropiane pr veprimtarin e institucioneve t kreditit, si dhe me standardet e Komitetit t Bazelit pr mbikqyrjen efektive, Banka e Shqipris ka ndrmarr nj sr ndryshimesh n disa prej rregulloreve ekzistuese q lidhen me kapitalin rregullator dhe transparencn bankare, si dhe ka prfunduar me sukses hartimin e projektrregullores s re Pr raportin e mbulimit me likuiditet. Edhe gjat vitit 2018, nj vmendje t veant vijoi t marr monitorimi i rrezikut t kredis n nivel sistemi dhe pr banka t veanta, me fokus treguesin e cilsis s portofolit t kredis. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjahtyp_mbi_veprimtarine_e_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_gjate_vitit_2018.html Pagina 3 di 6 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp mbi veprimtarin e Banks s Shqipris gjat vitit 2018 29/07/22, 13:35 S fundi, Banka e Shqipris mori pjes aktive n plotsimin e komenteve t Moneyval mbi raundin e pest t vlersimit t Shqipris pr PPP/PFT, n lidhje me pyetsorin teknik dhe at t efektivitetit. N prfundim t ktij procesi u konkludua n nj dokument prfundimtar pr Shqiprin, ku u qartsuan edhe nj numr rekomandimesh, pr nj pjes t t cilave BSH-ja ka rol dhe pr t cilat hartoi planin e saj t veprimit afat shkurtr, me qllim prmbushjen e tyre. Paralelisht me drejtimet e msiprme t puns, Banka e Shqipris i ka kushtuar rndsi dhe aspektit strategjik t arkitekturs mbikqyrse dhe rregullatore t sistemit financiar. N kt funksion. Banka e Shqipris sht angazhuar n drejtimet e mposhtme: Pr t nxitur rritjen e prdorimit t monedhs kombtare, n fillim t vitit 2018, u miratuan nj sr ndryshimesh rregullative q prekin aktivet dhe pasivet e sektorit bankar dhe vendosjen e krkesave pr nj ndrgjegjsim m t mir t huamarrsve, lidhur me kreditimin e pambrojtur n valut; N prmbushje t rolit t saj ligjor si Autoritet i Ndrhyrjes s Jashtzakonshme n vend, Banka e Shqipris krijoi "Fondin pr ndrhyrjen e jashtzakonshme", prmes kontributit t bankave. Ky fond do t mbshtes zbatimin e instrumenteve t Banks s Shqipris n drejtim t ndrhyrjes s jashtzakonshme. Po n kuadrin e administrimit t krizave financiare, n tetor u nnshkrua Marrveshja e Bashkpunimit ndrmjet Banks s Shqipris dhe Bordit t Prbashkt t Ndrhyrjes s Jashtzakonshme (Autoriteti i Ndrhyrjes pr BE-n), e cila mbshtet shkmbimin e informacionit pr hartimin e planeve, koordinimin e veprimeve nga t dy autoritetet n rast t aktivizimit t ktyre planeve, si dhe organizimin e aktiviteteve t prbashkta pr ngritjen e ekspertizs n fushn e ndrhyrjes s jashtzakonshme. Krahas drejtimeve kryesore t puns s Banks s Shqipris t prshkruara m lart, n vijim do t doja t ndalesha edhe n disa aspekte t tjera t puns son. Kto aktivitete, prmbushin detyrimet tona ligjore dhe i shrbejn njkohsisht zhvillimit t sistemit financiar dhe t ekonomis s tregut n Shqipri. M lejoni t ndalem vetm n disa prej tyre. N rolin e zhvilluesit dhe mbikqyrsit t sistemeve t pagesave, u miratua Strategjia Kombtare pr Reformimin e Sistemeve t Pagesave me Vler t Vogl. Kjo strategji synon zgjerimin e prfshirjes financiare t popullsis dhe zgjerimin e prdorimit t instrumenteve elektronike t pagesave. N zbatim t saj, ka prfunduar hartimi i projektligjit Pr shrbimet e pagesave, i cili synon nxitjen e konkurrencs n treg, promovimin e shrbimeve inovative, krijimin e nj regjimi t mirrregulluar pr mbrojtjen e konsumatorit, e q u prgjigjet krkesave t Direktivs s Bashkimit Evropian pr shrbimet e pagesave. N kuadr t prmirsimit t administrimit financiar dhe material t institucionit, Banka e Shqipris ka prfunduar punn pr zbatimin e standardit t ri t kontabilitetit, i emrtuar si SNRF-9. Me hartimin dhe auditimin e pasqyrave financiare pr vitin 2018, proces i cili pritet t kryhet deri n mars 2019, zbatimi i ktij standardi merr form prfundimtare edhe nprmjet publikimit. N kuadr t rritjes s cilsis s emisionit t monedhs shqiptare, jan https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjahtyp_mbi_veprimtarine_e_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_gjate_vitit_2018.html Pagina 4 di 6 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp mbi veprimtarin e Banks s Shqipris gjat vitit 2018 29/07/22, 13:35 zbatuar nj sr masash q synojn minimizimin e rrezikut operacional, prmirsimin e procesit t prpunimit t monedhs, dhe mbrojtjen e saj nga falsifikimi. Gjithashtu, kt vit ka vijuar puna pr realizimin e kartmonedhs me prerje 10,000 lek, e cila i shtohet seris s kartmonedhave n qarkullim dhe pasqyroj simbolet e flamurit kombtar. N fushn e statistikave, ka vijuar puna pr plotsimin e standardeve sasiore t metodologjive ndrkombtare dhe legjislacionit t Bashkimit Evropian, lidhur me zhvillimin, prpilimin dhe raportimin e statistikave pran organizmave evropiane dhe ndrkombtare. Pr her t par u publikua nj bllok i ri statistikor, ai i Llogarive Financiare, i zhvilluar sipas standardit m t fundit t kompilimit t llogarive financiare, ESA 2010, si dhe u prpiluan statistikat e normave t interesit sipas rregullores s BQE-s. N fushn e teknologjis s informacionit, Banka e Shqipris ka prfunduar nj sr projektesh t rndsishme n funksion t objektivave strategjike pr automatizimin e mtejshm t proceseve, si dhe pr prmirsimin e rritjen e siguris dhe qndrueshmris s sistemeve informatike. Aktiviteti dhe puna krkimore ka qen dhe mbetet nj drejtim i rndsishm pr Bankn e Shqipris. Gjat vitit 2018, studimet jan fokusuar n interpretimin e fenomeneve ekonomike dhe monetare q kan dominuar ambientin e brendshm dhe t jashtm, duke i kushtuar nj vmendje t veant zhvillimeve t kursit t kmbimit dhe mimeve, mekanizmit t transmetimit t politikes monetare, sjelljes konsumatore e financiare t familjeve, si dhe stabilitetit financiar t sistemit bankar. Rezultatet e ktyre studimeve jan vn n funksion t vendimmarrjes brenda Banks s Shqipris, por dhe m gjer. Pr kt qllim, Banka e Shqipris, n bashkpunim me Institutin e Studimeve Globale t Shkolls Ekonomike t Londrs (LSE) organizoi konferencn e saj vjetore me tem "Politika Monetare, Integrimi Ekonomik dhe Normaliteti i Ri". Gjithashtu, studimet e prgatitura nga Banka e Shqipris u prezantuan dhe diskutuan n Workshop-in e 12t t Krkimeve Ekonomike pr Evropn Juglindore ku u paraqitn 37 punime shkencore nga studiues t Banks s Shqipris dhe t institucioneve akademike dhe financiare nga Evropa, SHBA e rajoni. N fushn e komunikimit, gjat vitit 2018 Banka e Shqipris prezantoi faqen e re t internetit, e cila prbn mjetin kryesor t komunikimit t saj me publikun. Prmirsimi n imazh, dizajn dhe prmbajtje, i ksaj faqeje, i mundson Banks prcjelljen e informacionit n publik n mnyr m t leht dhe m t shpejt. N t jan pasqyruar me transparenc t plot fjalime, njoftime dhe intervista, raporte, analiza e buletine, nj shumllojshmri e lart statistikash e t dhnash, prmbledhje t punimeve t konferencave ndrkombtare dhe nj sr aktivitetesh t tjera me karakter t veant. Si pjes e ndrveprimit me publikun pr t prfshir t gjitha grupet e interesit, ka vijuar rregullisht edhe komunikimi nprmjet mediave vizive e atyre t shkruara, si dhe ai dixhital nprmjet rrjeteve sociale. Banka e Shqipris ka luajtur nj rol t veant n edukimin dhe prfshirjen financiare t publikut. Botimet, vizitat e shumta n Muzeun e Banks s Shqipris, ekspozitat e prkohshme dhe aktivitetet e tjera me karakter informues, historik dhe numizmatik, i kan shrbyer ktij funksioni t https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjahtyp_mbi_veprimtarine_e_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_gjate_vitit_2018.html Pagina 5 di 6 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp mbi veprimtarin e Banks s Shqipris gjat vitit 2018 29/07/22, 13:35 rndsishm. Ndr aktivitetet m t spikatura t vitit mund t prmendim organizimin e Javs s Paras 2018, Konferencn II t Muzeut t BSH-s, si dhe leksionet e ciklit Nett e Muzeut. Gjithashtu, n kuadr t Vitit Mbarkombtar t Gjergj Kastrioti Sknderbeut u eln dy ekspozita t prkohshme n Tiran dhe Prizren, me tem Gjergj Kastrioti Sknderbeu n monedhn dhe kartmonedhn shqiptare. *** T nderuar prfaqsues t medias, Meqense kjo sht dalja e fundit mediatike pr kt vit, prfitoj nga rasti q tju uroj ju, dhe nprmjet jush dhe publikut t gjer, festa t gzuara t fundvitit, si dhe dshiroj tju ftoj t ndiqni me vmendje punn dhe aktivitetin e Banks s Shqipris dhe gjat vitit 2019.
