Title: Speech of the Second Deputy Governor Ahmetaj at the conference "Balancing the opportunities and risks FinTech - implementation of the" Bali Agenda "
text: Second Deputy Governor Ahmetaj's word at the "Balan... FinTech opportunities and risks - implementation of the "Bali Agenda" 29/07/22, 13:35 Second Deputy Governor Ahmetaj's word at the "Balancing Opportunities and Risks FinTech - Implementation of the Bali Agenda" conference Publication date: 29.01.2019 Honored participants, Bali's agenda forms a matrix of objectives to meet and a guide to increasing the potential of our countries' economy. As such, it constitutes an international standard that must be implemented nationally. But of course, for implementation to be effective, every standard must be adapted by reflecting each country's priorities. In the Albanian case, this means that the work turn should reflect a small country, with per capita income of USD 4870, high cash presence in the economy, high emigration and lower financial involvement in the region, where over 60% of adults do not have a bank account and 65% do not have a card. Such a profile immediately signals two boxes of matrix in red, - before you talk about blockchain or digital currenty - formalization of remittances and financial inclusion. It is in these two directions that I want to focus on this discussion. Both issues have three common allies: technology, financial education and nonbanks. I'm stopping short at each one. ... i_mundesive_dhe_rreziqeve_FinTech_zbatimi_i_Axhendes_se_Balit.html Page 1 of 6 Second Deputy Governor Ahmetaj's word at the "Balan... FinTech opportunities and risks - implementation of the "Bali Agenda" 29/07/22, 13:35 The higher presence of technology in citizens' lives and especially in financial infrastructure, simultaneously and interspersedly promotes the formalization of shipments through banking channels and motivation to be a consumer in the financial industry. Generally, technology is embraced for the various advantages it brings to users. It brings people together in groups and platforms where information is distributed, expands the concept of the market in time and space, increases security but also produces new risks and ultimately increases the productivity of the "work" factor. For all this there is an uncompetitive advantage: speed and range of action. Technology providers can explain all this and much else with a sophisticated and perhaps confusing technical language. But we, as users and mediators between financial technology manufacturers (FinTech) and the wide mass of users of products and services generated by it, need to adopt and convey it to the market in a simple and understandable way. Otherwise, technology cannot be embraced by the financial industry, no matter how useful, simply because it cannot be sold. And it can't be sold unless it becomes obviously useful. This is where financial education comes in, where we have to lead. And the base exists, because in Albania there are 112% mobile phone reconciliations and 66% internet access. More FinTech for us means: 1. Reduction of cash in the economy, as a result of infrastructure for electronic payments and home banking. In addition to contributing to the transmission of monetary policy and increasing financial stability, this brings about reducing social costs in the economy. A significant benefit comes from limiting opportunities for the informal economy and tax evasion. Today cash is used for 90% of small payments, which is estimated to impose a cost to the economy of 1.5% of GDP. 2. Expansion of channels for formal remittance entry in Albania. Today, 250 million people, or 3.4% of the world's population, live in a different country ... i_mundesive_dhe_rreziqeve_FinTech_zbatimi_i_Axhendes_se_Balit.html Page 2 of 6 Second Deputy Governor Ahmetaj's word at the "Balan... FinTech opportunities and risks - implementation of the "Bali Agenda" 29/07/22, 13:35 From that of birth, and this trend has come to an increase. About 500 million more people depend on the influx of their remittances. About 1.2 million Albanians are immigrants, or as many as 40% of those living in the country, while the influx of remittances is estimated at about USD 1.15 billion a year, or as much as 12% of GDP. This important source of income makes a multidimensional contribution: for the balance of payments, as it covers about 37% of the trade deficit in goods; GDP growth, as it is estimated that during the period 2010-2017 they contributed to about 5.6% of GDP. for families, as they are estimated to provide 13% of the Albanian family's budget, reducing poverty through rising levels of consumption, education, health. The volume of remittances in the world has doubled compared to a decade ago. This is due to increased immigration and due to progress in money transfer infrastructure. Generally, it is difficult to accurately measure the volumes of remittances due to numerous formal and informal channels, through which they flow. But the preference to use a channel against others depends heavily on financial systems and the overall institutional environment of sending and hosting countries. Today in Albania, 4% of shipments enter through bank channels, 57% through nonbanks and 39% in cash. This way of entry, which translates into disbursement of 96% of them in cash, weakens the multiplicity effect of financial mediation. To judge what is the most effective intervention for the formalization of remittances, we must understand the reasons why informal channels are resolved. Of the observations, there are three: 1. Difficulties in accessing the banking sector for immigrants in countries of origin. 2. Costs, which in formal channels are estimated to be around 8-18%, significantly more high than the region, and far from the global target of 3% targeted by 2030. 3. Perception of banking procedures as complicated, due to the culture of low financial. This explains why 57% of individuals choose nonbank institutions, which have even higher costs, but are simpler in access. Avoiding these barriers contributes to comprehensive growth and helps greatly in the financial inclusion of beneficiary families. The formalization of the influx of remittances creates opportunities for rural householdaccess to basic financial products and, subsequently, to more sophisticated ones, such as loans. The possibility of an expanded and lower-cost formal infrastructure could shift flows from informal channels towards formal ones. This requires finding a balance between a regulatory regime, which generally minimizes financial abuse, and facilitating the flow of funds between migrants and their families. A central bank could be a catalyst for FinTech's advance, while remaining a strict regulator at the same time. It's just a matter of balance between promoting FinTech's innovative ideas and regulatory prudence. ... i_mundesive_dhe_rreziqeve_FinTech_zbatimi_i_Axhendes_se_Balit.html Page 3 of 6 Second Deputy Governor Ahmetaj's word at the "Balan... FinTech opportunities and risks - implementation of the "Bali Agenda" 29/07/22, 13:35 For this reason, the formalization of the incoming flow of remittances through bank channels, together with the accompanying effect on reducing cash in the economy, is placed in the focus of a joint project with the World Bank. In this context, in 2017 a study focused on the market for small-value payments was carried out, part of which are also remittances. The findings of this study were used as the basis for drafting the National Strategy for Reforming the Market for Small Value Payment Systems in Albania. The implementation of this strategy is in the focus of the National Payments Committee, an interinstitutional structure. In this context, the Bank of Albania has drafted the new bill for payment services, which also has parts of the small-value payment market. Since this law has approached in the Albanian context the EU PSD2 directive, considered a revolution for supporting the innovation of the payment field, its impact is expected to be important even in the payment market in Albania. It also envisaged the creation of appropriate conditions for enhancing competition, transparency and security. One of the projects under consideration is also providing a basic account for the low-income segment, which allows basic payment services, at no cost. Some of the measurable objectives of the success of this strategy include achieving over 130% of cashless payments (cashless) and having an account at the 70% level by people of older age, by 2022. Atonement services at the cross-border level are accommodated by corresponding banks, which impose monetary and time costs. For this reason, it is considered very important to create the necessary legal and infrastructural preconditions for integrating the local market with the common euro payment market, SEPA, which will reduce costs. In addition, innovative technology services such as block chain and instant payment can serve the same purpose. In line with the World Bank, the Bank of Albania has built the database with payment commissions on the Albanian market, which is also expanding for nonbank institutions, thus creating the possibility for monitoring their gradual reduction towards international targets. For all this project, public financial education is essential. Another project, called Greenback, aimed at formalizing remittances and lowering costs, through awareness and financial education, has already been introduced with partner support. The financial market in Albania consists of 90% of banks, but their penetration rate per 100,000 inhabitants over the age of 18 results in lower than the region. They, together with the 9 financial institutions licensed for the payment and transfer service, make up the small-value payment market. The banking market has invested seriously in this area, providing home banking services, which allow remote access to funds and electronic payment instruments. Two banks also offer e-commerce services, which could affect the partial channelling of goods-shaped remittances. Card use is increasing. Today, 1/3 of the population owns a card ... i_mundesive_dhe_rreziqeve_FinTech_zbatimi_i_Axhendes_se_Balit.html Page 4 of 6 Second Deputy Governor Ahmetaj's word at the "Balan... FinTech opportunities and risks - implementation of the "Bali Agenda" 29/07/22, 13:35 debit and only 8% a credit card. However, the infrastructure of their use remains concentrated in urban areas and for the most part they are used for basic services. But, unlike the positive trend in the volume of remittances and technology that favours their formal entry into the country, a negative trend has been observed in the attention banks have shown towards products dedicated to immigrants, at a time that banks in Albania make up 90% of the financial market. If we compare the activity of banks for offering products for this segment of the market, it turns out that today there are fewer banks that are active than 10 years ago, before the crisis. The main product they offer to immigrants remains transfers and deposits, while a withdrawal of credit products for immigrants offered on the market 10 years ago is noticed. Positive development in this segment has only had to offer electronic cards. By shifting attention from this market, banks have placed themselves in an unfavourable position compared to nonbank operators. Nonbank financial institutions have different access from banks. They are more active to this segment not only with microcredit products, but also with immigrant shipment services, and recent developments show that they embrace innovation faster. The Bank of Albania is among the pioneering central banks in the region for concrete involvement in the financial education of the public. It has already had a full annual agenda in this position for years, being aware that in recent years there is a shift in emphasis, from a traditional education on the economy, to knowledge of finances. This is because the sophistication of financial products and services, as well as the increasing involvement of FinTech in this industry, makes this need more urgent. Likewise, expanding the financial market with new products, such as pension funds, health insurance and assets, are increasingly shifting the need for long-term financial protection, from businesses to individuals, making financial knowledge more necessary for them. The Bank of Albania is also aware that there is an indication that measures the effectiveness of this process, which is the level of financial involvement. This indicator for Albania, with all the progress, proves that there is still much to do. In its position as a regulator, the Bank of Albania aims to ensure financial services and access to loans as fairly as possible. The regulation also has parts of itself to ensure fair treatment of customers on the part of banks, enabling them to serve the entire community, including low-income groups. Because sustainable economic growth requires comprehensive growth. Access to financial services and resources, as well as an impartial regulatory environment, is an essential contributor to the successful growth of the economy. If financial involvement comes in improving, it means that the public is becoming more and more part of the financial system, is using its products, thus making its contribution to expanding financial mediation. Financial education means increased well-being for all. This will make us all more actively involved in this process. Muz dhe Eduk " Kreu / Shtypi / Fjalime, intervista, artikuj / Fjalime Njoftimet pr shtyp Njoftime t # mbledhjeve t Kshillit Mbikqyrs Konferenca pr shtyp Fjalime, $ intervista, artikuj Fjalime Intervista e artikuj Kalendar # Kalendari i festave zyrtare pr vitin 2022 COVID-19 Evropa # BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Zvendsguvernatores s Dyt Ahmetaj n konferencn Balancimi i mundsive dhe rreziqeve FinTech  zbatimi i Axhends s Balit Data e publikimit: 29.01.2019 T nderuar pjesmarrs, Axhenda e Balit formon nj matric objektivash pr tu prmbushur dhe nj udhzues pr rritjen e potencialit t ekonomis s vendeve tona. Po ndalem shkurt tek secili. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjai_mundesive_dhe_rreziqeve_FinTech_zbatimi_i_Axhendes_se_Balit.html Pagina 1 di 6 Fjala e Zvendsguvernatores s Dyt Ahmetaj n konferencn Balani mundsive dhe rreziqeve FinTech  zbatimi i Axhends s Balit 29/07/22, 13:35 Prania m e lart e teknologjis n jetn e qytetarve dhe veanrisht n infrastrukturn financiare, promovon njkohsisht dhe n mnyr t ndrsjell formalizimin e drgesave prmes kanaleve bankare dhe motivimin pr t qen konsumator n industrin financiare. Prgjithsisht, teknologjia prqafohet pr avantazhet e ndryshme q u sjell prdoruesve. Ajo bashkon njerzit n grupe dhe platforma ku shprndahet informacioni, zgjeron n koh dhe hapsir konceptin e tregut, rrit sigurin por edhe prodhon rreziqe t reja e, n fund t fundit rrit produktivitetin e faktorit pun. Pr t gjitha kto ka nj avantazh t pakonkurrueshm: shpejtsin dhe rrezen e veprimit. Ofruesit e teknologjis mund ti shpjegojn t gjitha kto e shum t tjera me nj gjuh t sofistikuar e ndoshta hutuese teknike. Por ne, si prdorues dhe ndrmjets midis prodhuesve t teknologjis financiare (FinTech) dhe mass s gjer t prdoruesve t produkteve dhe shrbimeve t gjeneruara prej saj, na duhet ta prvetsojm dhe ta prcjellim n treg n mnyr t thjesht dhe t kuptueshme. Prndryshe, teknologjia nuk do mund t prqafohet nga industria financiare, sado e dobishme t jet, thjesht sepse nuk mund t shitet. Dhe nuk mund t shitet, nse nuk bhet dukshm e dobishme. Ktu hyn n rol edukimi financiar, ku ne duhet t udhheqim. Dhe baza ekziston, sepse n Shqipri rezulton t ket 112% pajtimtar t telefonis celulare dhe 66% akses n internet. M shum FinTech pr ne do t thot: 1. Reduktim i cash-it n ekonomi, si rrjedhoj e infrastrukturs pr pagesa elektronike dhe home banking. Prve kontributit n transmetimin e politiks monetare dhe rritjes s stabilitetit financiar, kjo sjell reduktimin e kostove sociale n ekonomi. Nj prfitim i rndsishm vjen nga kufizimi i mundsive pr ekonomin informale dhe evazionin fiskal. Sot cash-i prdoret pr 90% t pagesave t vogla, gj q vlersohet t vendos nj kosto pr ekonomin prej 1.5% t PBB-s. 2. Zgjerim t kanaleve pr hyrje formale t remitancave n Shqipri. Sot, 250 milion njerz, ose 3.4% e popullsis botrore, jetojn n nj vend t ndryshm https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fji_mundesive_dhe_rreziqeve_FinTech_zbatimi_i_Axhendes_se_Balit.html Pagina 2 di 6 Fjala e Zvendsguvernatores s Dyt Ahmetaj n konferencn Balani mundsive dhe rreziqeve FinTech  zbatimi i Axhends s Balit 29/07/22, 13:35 nga ai i lindjes, dhe kjo prirje ka ardhur n rritje. Nga fluksi i remitancave t tyre varen rreth 500 milion njerz t tjer. Rreth 1.2 milion shqiptar jan emigrant, ose sa 40% e atyre q jetojn n vend, ndrsa fluksi i remitancave vlersohet n rreth USD 1.15 miliard n vit, ose sa 12% e PBB-s. Ky burim i rndsishm t ardhurash jep kontribut shumdimensional: pr bilancin e pagesave, pasi mbulon rreth 37% t deficitit tregtar t mallrave; pr rritjen e PBB-s, pasi vlersohet se gjat periudhs 2010-2017 kan kontribuar n rreth 5.6% t PBB-s. pr familjet, pasi vlersohet se sigurojn 13% t buxhetit t familjes shqiptare, duke zbutur varfrin prmes rritjes s nivelit t konsumit, arsimit, shndetit. Volumi i remitancave n bot sht dyfishuar krahasuar me nj dekad m par. Kjo pr dy arsye: pr shkak t rritjes s emigracionit dhe pr shkak t progresit n infrastrukturn e transferimit t parave. Prgjithsisht, sht e vshtir t maten sakt volumet e remitancave pr shkak t kanaleve t shumta formale dhe joformale, prmes t cilave ato rrjedhin. Por, preferenca pr t prdorur nj kanal kundrejt t tjerve varet shum nga sistemet financiare dhe ambienti i prgjithshm institucional i vendeve drguese dhe pritse. Sot n Shqipri, 4% e drgesave hyjn prmes kanaleve bankare, 57% prmes jobankave dhe 39% n cash. Kjo mnyr hyrjeje, q prkthehet n disbursim t 96% t tyre n cash, dobson efektin multiplikator t ndrmjetsimit financiar. Pr t gjykuar se cila sht ndrhyrja m efektive pr formalizimin e remitancave, duhet t kuptojm arsyet pse zgjidhen kanalet joformale. Nga vrojtimet rezulton t jen tre: 1. Vshtirsi n akses n sektorin bankar pr emigrantt n vendet e origjins. 2. Kostot, t cilat n kanalet formale vlersohen t jen rreth 8-18%, dukshm m t larta se rajoni, dhe larg objektivit global prej 3% q synohet deri n vitin 2030. 3. Perceptimi pr procedurat bankare si t komplikuara, pr shkak t kulturs s ult financiare. Kjo shpjegon pse 57% e individve zgjedh institucionet jobanka, q kan kosto akoma m t larta, por jan m t thjeshta n aksesim. Shmangia e ktyre pengesave kontribuon pr rritjen gjithprfshirse dhe ndihmon shum n prfshirjen financiare t familjeve prfituese. Formalizimi i fluksit t remitancave krijon mundsi pr aksesim t familjeve rurale n produktet financiare bazike dhe, m pas, n ato m t sofistikuara, si kredia. Mundsimi i nj infrastrukture formale m t zgjeruar dhe me kosto m t ult mund t'i zhvendos flukset nga kanalet informale drejt atyre formale. Pr kt nevojitet gjetja e nj balance midis nj regjimi rregullativ, q minimizon prgjithsisht abuzimin financiar, dhe lehtsimit t fluksit t fondeve midis emigrantve dhe familjeve t tyre. Nj bank qendrore mund t jet nj katalizator pr avancimin e FinTech, duke mbetur njkohsisht nj rregullator i rrept. sht vetm shtje balancash midis promovimit t ideve novatore t FinTech dhe prudencs rregullatore. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fji_mundesive_dhe_rreziqeve_FinTech_zbatimi_i_Axhendes_se_Balit.html Pagina 3 di 6 Fjala e Zvendsguvernatores s Dyt Ahmetaj n konferencn Balani mundsive dhe rreziqeve FinTech  zbatimi i Axhends s Balit 29/07/22, 13:35 Pr kt arsye, formalizimi i fluksit hyrs t remitancave prmes kanaleve bankare, s bashku me efektin shoqrues n reduktimin e cash-it n ekonomi, sht vendosur n fokus t nj projekti t prbashkt me Bankn Botrore. N kt kuadr, n vitin 2017 u realizua nj studim i prqendruar pr tregun e pagesave me vler t vogl, pjes e t cilit jan edhe remitancat. Gjetjet e ktij studimi u prdorn si baz pr hartimin e Strategjis kombtare pr reformimin e tregut t sistemeve t pagesave me vler t vogl n Shqipri. Zbatimi i ksaj strategjie sht n fokus t Komitetit Kombtar t Pagesave, nj struktur ndrinstitucionale. N kt kuadr, Banka e Shqipris ka hartuar projektligjin e ri pr shrbimet e pagesave, i cili ka pjes t vetn edhe tregun e pagesave me vler t vogl. Meqense ky ligj ka prafruar n kontekstin shqiptar direktivn e BE PSD2, q konsiderohet revolucion pr mbshtetjen e inovacionit t fushn e pagesave, pritet q ndikimi i tij t jet i rndsishm edhe n tregun e pagesave n Shqipri. Brenda tij parashikohet edhe krijimi i kushteve t prshtatshme pr zgjerimin e konkurrencs, transparencs dhe siguris. Nj nga projektet n shqyrtim sht edhe ofrimi i nj llogari bazike pr segmentin me t ardhura t ulta, e cila lejon shrbimet baz t pagesave, pa kosto. Disa nga objektivat e matshm t suksesit t ksaj strategjie prfshijn arritjen e mbi 130% t pagesave pa para n dor (cashless) dhe pasjen e nj llogarie n nivelin 70% nga personat n mosh madhore, deri n vitin 2022. Shrbimet e shlyerjes n nivel ndrkufitar akomodohen nga bankat korrespondente, t cilat imponojn kosto monetare dhe kohore. Pr kt arsye, sht vlersuar si shum i rndsishm krijimi i parakushteve t nevojshme ligjore dhe infrastrukturore pr integrimin e tregut vendas me tregun e prbashkt t pagesave n euro, SEPA, ka do t reduktoj kostot. Prve ksaj, shrbimet inovative t teknologjis, si block chain dhe instant payment mund t shrbejn pr t njjtin qellim. N linj me Bankn Botrore, Banka e Shqipris ka ndrtuar bazn e t dhnave me komisionet e pagesave n tregun shqiptar, e cila po zgjerohet edhe pr institucionet jobanka, duke krijuar kshtu mundsin pr monitorim t reduktimit gradual t tyre drejt objektivave ndrkombtar. Pr gjith kt projekt, edukimi financiar i publikut sht thelbsor. Nj tjetr projekt, i quajtur Greenback, q ka pr qllim t oj n formalizim t remitancave dhe ulje t kostove, prmes ndrgjegjsimit dhe edukimit financiar, sht prezantuar tashm me mbshtetjen e partnerve. Tregu financiar n Shqipri prbhet n 90% nga bankat, por niveli i deprtimit t tyre pr 100,000 banor mbi 18 vje rezulton m i ult se rajoni. Ato, s bashku me 9 institucionet financiare t licencuara pr shrbimin e pagesave dhe transfertave, prbjn tregun e pagesave me vler t vogl. Tregu bankar ka investuar seriozisht n kt fush, duke ofruar shrbime home banking, q lejojn aksesim n distanc t fondeve dhe instrumente elektronike t pagesave. Dy banka ofrojn edhe shrbime t tregtis elektronike, gj q mund t ndikoj n kanalizimin pjesor t remitancave n form mallrash. Prdorimi i kartave po rritet. Sot, 1/3 e popullsis zotron nj kart https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fji_mundesive_dhe_rreziqeve_FinTech_zbatimi_i_Axhendes_se_Balit.html Pagina 4 di 6 Fjala e Zvendsguvernatores s Dyt Ahmetaj n konferencn Balani mundsive dhe rreziqeve FinTech  zbatimi i Axhends s Balit 29/07/22, 13:35 debiti dhe vetm 8% nj kart krediti. Megjithat, infrastruktura e prdorimit t tyre mbetet e prqendruar n zonat urbane dhe n pjesn m t madhe ato prdoren pr shrbime bazike. Por, ndryshe nga trendi pozitiv i volumit t remitancave dhe teknologjis q favorizon hyrjen formale t tyre n vend, sht vn re nj trend negativ n vmendjen q bankat kan treguar ndaj produkteve t dedikuara pr emigrantt, n nj koh q bankat n Shqipri prbjn 90% t tregut financiar. Nse krahasojm aktivitetin e bankave pr ofrimin e produkteve pr kt segment t tregut, rezulton se sot ka m pak banka q jan aktive sesa 10 vjet m par, para krizs. Produkti kryesor q ato ofrojn pr emigrantt mbetet transferta dhe depozita, ndrsa vihet re nj trheqje e tyre prej produkteve t kredis pr emigrantt t ofruara n treg 10 vjet m par. Zhvillim pozitiv n kt segment ka pasur vetm n ofrimin e kartave elektronike. Duke zhvendosur vmendjen nga ky treg, bankat e kan vendosur veten n pozicion t pafavorshm krahasuar me operatort jobanka. Institucionet financiare jobanka kan qasje tjetr nga bankat. Ato jan m aktive ndaj ktij segmenti jo vetm me produkte t mikrokredis, por dhe me shrbime t drgesave t emigranteve dhe zhvillimet e fundit tregojn q e prqafojn inovacionin m shpejt. Banka e Shqipris sht ndr bankat qendrore pioniere n rajon pr prfshirjen konkrete n edukimin financiar t publikut. Ajo ka tashm prej vitesh nj axhend t plot vjetore n kt funksion, duke qen e ndrgjegjshme se vitet e fundit ka nj zhvendosje t theksit, nga nj edukim tradicional mbi ekonomin, n njohuri mbi financat. Kjo sepse sofistikimi i produkteve dhe shrbimeve financiare, si dhe prfshirja gjithnj e m shum e FinTech n kt industri, e bn m emergjente kt nevoj. Po kshtu, zgjerimi i tregut financiar me produkte t reja, si jan fondet e pensioneve, sigurimet shndetsore dhe ato t aseteve, po e zhvendosin gjithnj e m shum nevojn pr mbrojtje financiare afatgjat, nga bizneset tek individt, duke i br njohurit financiare m t nevojshme pr ta. Banka e Shqipris sht gjithashtu e ndrgjegjshme se ka nj tregues q mat efektivitetin e ktij procesi, q sht niveli i prfshirjes financiare. Ky tregues pr Shqiprin, me gjith progresin, dshmon se ka ende shum pr t br. N funksionin e saj si rregullator, Banka e Shqipris synon q sistemi t siguroj shrbimet financiare dhe akses n kredi n mnyr sa m t drejt. Rregullimi ka pjes t vetn edhe sigurimin e trajtimit t drejt t klientve nga ana e bankave, duke mundsuar q ato ti shrbejn gjith komunitetit, prfshir ktu grupet me t ardhura t ulta. Sepse, rritja e qndrueshme ekonomike krkon rritje gjithprfshirse. Aksesi n shrbimet dhe burimet financiare, si dhe nj mjedis rregullator i paanshm sht nj kontribuues thelbsor pr rritjen e suksesshme t ekonomis. Nse prfshirja financiare vjen duke u prmirsuar, do t thot se publiku po bhet gjithnj e m shum pjes e sistemit financiar, po prdor produktet e tij, po jep kshtu kontributin e tij pr zgjerimin e ndrmjetsimit financiar. Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, February 6, 2019 29/07/22, 13:35 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, February 6, 2019 Publication date: 06.02.2019 Honored media representatives, Today, at its meeting dated 6 February 2019, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Quarterly Monetary Policy Report. *** The new economic and monetary information received in the analysis suggests that the Albanian economy follows a positive development trend. Aggregate demand has been rising in the second half of last year, bringing increased production, expanding employment and improving the country's key economic and financial balances. Our monetary policy has been able to make a positive contribution, through generating a financial environment with low interest rates, as well as through curbing derogatory pressures on the exchange rate. The Bank of Albania estimates that the new information has generally been in line with our expectations.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_6_shkurt_2019.html Page 1 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, February 6, 2019 29/07/22, 13:35 Inflation marked a slight decline in the last quarter of 2018. Its average rate decreased to 1.8% during the fourth quarter, versus the 2.2% value scored in the previous quarter. This decline reflected temporary supply shocks and fuller inflation transmission of the restraining effect arising from the overpriced exchange rate. This effect will continue to be present during the first six months of 2019, but it is expected to be extinguished in the following period. The Bank of Albania estimates that internal inflationary, medium and long-term pressures are towards strengthening, as illustrated by the basic inflation indicator. Despite the fluctuations, this indicator shows a gradual tendency to converge towards balance. This performance is dictated by further improvement in the country's cyclical position, reflected both in the falling tendency of the unemployment rate and in improving the scale of capacity exploitation. According to INSTAT data, the Albanian economy grew by 4.45%, during the third quarter of last year. This increase has been fuelled by further expansion of private consumption, investments and exports, as well as by the annual increase in electricity generation. It has been reflected in the expansion of activity in the industry, services and construction sectors. Available data suggest that the economy grew even in the fourth quarter, albeit at a slower rate than in previous quarters. Our analyses suggest that this slowdown reflects a lower contribution of electricity generation and is expected to be temporary. Our medium-term projections have not undergone significant changes. Current economic development trends and their supporting economic and financial factors suggest how the economy and inflationary pressures will come to an increase over the following period. Although ambiguities and risks remain present, the foreign environment generally appears favourable to economic growth in the country. The growing demand of the world economy follows to favour the growth of Albanian exports and financing costs remain relatively low. In parallel with it, the mix of internal policies remains stimulating.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_6_shkurt_2019.html Page 2 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, February 6, 2019 29/07/22, 13:35 As a result of the monetary policy stimulus course, interest rates on government-valued deposits, loans and letters remain at historically low levels. Likewise, the liquidity situation in financial markets has improved and risk premiums have come down. The exchange rate appeared stable during January, thanks to a better balance of demand and currency supply, as well as the Bank of Albania's response. Recently, the banking sector is characterized by good levels of liquidity, capital and profitability, while its balance sheets continue to improve. In particular, the troubled loan ratio decreased to 11.1% at the end of 2018, illustrating the steady trend of progress made in this direction. In response, the loan to the private sector has shown signs of revival, although its reported declining stock follows reflecting the effect of clearing balances from troubled loans and that of the exchange rate. Excluding these two effects, the loan to the private sector marked an annual increase of 5.9%, at the end of 2018. Credit growth continues to be faster in the money and consumer credit segment. Meanwhile, credit for businesses showed a rapid increase in the month of December, despite more conservative lending policies applied by banks in this segment. Fiscal policy has been pursuing a consolidating course. Fiscal data suggest that the budget deficit decreased to 1.6% of GDP at the end of 2018, being 0.4 percentage points lower than the planned level. In line with it, even direct fiscal stimulus in the economy has been lower than expected. On the other hand, lowering total public sector borrowing, as well as reliance on the foreign market for financing a large part of it over the past year, have increased spaces for private sector lending. In line with these trends, the Bank of Albania estimates that the Albanian economy will come to grow over the next three years. Expanding aggregate demand will bring further employment growth, creating premise for wage growth and domestic-generated inflation. In parallel with it, curbing the overprice of the exchange rate will reduce disinflationary pressures from it. In line with this development scenario, inflation is expected to return to target in the second half of 2020. In parallel with the expected positive developments under the basic scenario, the Supervisory Council states that the balance of risks follows to remain avoided on the bottom. In particular, the external environment, exchange rate performance and pace of lending growth can avoid inflation at the lower end of our expectations. *** Judging on these factors, the Supervisory Council states that the current monetary policy stimulus course remains appropriate. Under these circumstances, he decided: keep the basic interest rate unchanged at 1.0%; keep deposit and one-day loan interest rates unchanged, at levels 0.1% and 1.9%, respectively. Monetary policy will remain stimulating even during the medium-term horizon,  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_6_shkurt_2019.html Page 3 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, February 6, 2019 29/07/22, 13:35 Although the intensity of the stimulus will be adapted to the speed and sustainability of improving economic activity. Finally, the Supervisory Council finds it appropriate to repeat the call for the continuation of structural reforms, as the best instrument for promoting the country's sustainable and long-term growth.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_6_shkurt_2019.html Page 4 of 4

Muz dhe Eduk " Kreu / Shtypi / Fjalime, intervista, artikuj / Fjalime Njoftimet pr shtyp Njoftime t # mbledhjeve t Kshillit Mbikqyrs Konferenca pr shtyp Fjalime, $ intervista, artikuj Fjalime Intervista e artikuj Kalendar # Kalendari i festave zyrtare pr vitin 2022 COVID-19 Evropa # BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 6 shkurt 2019 Data e publikimit: 06.02.2019 T nderuar prfaqsues t medias, Sot, n mbledhjen e tij t dats 6 shkurt 2019, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris mori n shqyrtim dhe miratoi Raportin Tremujor t Politiks Monetare. *** Informacioni i ri ekonomik dhe monetar i marr n analiz, sugjeron se ekonomia shqiptare vijon t ndjek nj trend pozitiv zhvillimi. Krkesa agregate ka vijuar t rritet n gjysmn e dyt t vitit t shkuar, duke sjell rritjen e prodhimit, zgjerimin e punsimit dhe prmirsimin e ekuilibrave kryesor ekonomik dhe financiar t vendit. Politika jon monetare ka vijuar t jap nj kontribut pozitiv, nprmjet gjenerimit t nj ambienti financiar me norma t ulta interesi, si dhe nprmjet frenimit t presioneve mbimuese mbi kursin e kmbimit. Banka e Shqipris vlerson se informacioni i ri ka qen prgjithsisht n prputhje me pritjet tona. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjer_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_6_shkurt_2019.html Pagina 1 di 4 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 6 shkurt 2019 29/07/22, 13:35 Inflacioni shnoi nj rnie t leht n tremujorin e fundit t vitit 2018. Norma mesatare e tij zbriti n 1.8% gjat tremujorit t katrt, kundrejt vlers 2.2% t shnuar n tremujorin paraardhs. Kjo rnie pasqyroi goditje t prkohshme t oferts dhe prcjellje m t plot n inflacion t efektit frenues q vjen nga mbimimi i kursit t kmbimit. Ky efekt do t vijoj t jet i pranishm edhe gjat gjashtmujorit t par t vitit 2019, por ai pritet t shuhet n periudhn pasuese. Banka e Shqipris vlerson se presionet e brendshme inflacioniste, afatmesme dhe afatgjata, jan drejt forcimit, sikundr ilustrohet nga treguesi i inflacionit baz. Me gjith luhatjet, ky tregues shfaq nj tendenc graduale konvergimi drejt ekuilibrit. Kjo ecuri diktohet nga prmirsimi i mtejshm i pozicionit ciklik t vendit, i pasqyruar si n tendencn rnse t norms s papunsis, ashtu dhe n prmirsimin e shkalls s shfrytzimit t kapaciteteve. Sipas t dhnave t INSTAT-it, ekonomia shqiptare u rrit me prej 4.45%, gjat tremujorit t tret t vitit t shkuar. Kjo rritje sht ushqyer nga zgjerimi i mtejshm i konsumit privat, investimeve dhe eksporteve, si dhe nga rritja vjetore e prodhimit t energjis elektrike. Ajo sht pasqyruar n zgjerimin e aktivitetit n sektort e industris, shrbimeve dhe ndrtimit. T dhnat e disponuara sugjerojn se ekonomia ka vijuar t rritet edhe n tremujorin e katrt, ndonse me nj ritm m t ngadalt se ai i tremujorve paraardhs. Analizat tona sugjerojn se ky ngadalsim pasqyron nj kontribut m t ult t prodhimit t energjis elektrike dhe pritet t jet i prkohshm. Projeksionet tona afatmesme nuk kan psuar ndryshime t ndjeshme. Trendet aktuale t zhvillimit ekonomik dhe faktort ekonomik e financiar mbshtets t tyre, sugjerojn se si ekonomia dhe presionet inflacioniste do t vijn n rritje gjat periudhs n vijim. Ndonse paqartsit dhe rreziqet mbeten t pranishme, ambienti i huaj shfaqet prgjithsisht i favorshm pr rritjen ekonomike n vend. Krkesa n rritje e ekonomis botrore vijon t favorizoj rritjen e eksporteve shqiptare dhe kostot e financimit mbeten relativisht t ulta. Paralelisht me t, miksi i politikave t brendshme mbetet stimulues. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjer_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_6_shkurt_2019.html Pagina 2 di 4 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 6 shkurt 2019 29/07/22, 13:35 Si pasoj e kursit stimulues t politiks monetare, normat e interesit t depozitave, kredive dhe letrave me vler t qeveris, mbeten n nivele t ulta historike. Po ashtu, situata e likuiditetit n tregjet financiare ka ardhur n prmirsim dhe primet e rrezikut kan ardhur n rnie. Kursi i kmbimit u shfaq i qndrueshm gjat muajit janar, n saj t nj balancimi m t mir t krkess dhe oferts pr valut, si dhe t reagimit t Banks s Shqipris. S fundmi, sektori bankar vijon t karakterizohet nga nivele t mira likuiditeti, kapitali dhe prfitueshmrie, ndrkoh q bilancet e tij vijojn t prmirsohen. N veanti, raporti i kredis me probleme zbriti n 11.1% n fund t vitit 2018, duke ilustruar trendin e qndrueshm t progresit t br n kt drejtim. N prgjigje t tyre, kredia pr sektorin privat ka shfaqur shenja rigjallrimi, ndonse stoku i raportuar n rnie i saj vijon t pasqyroj efektin e pastrimit t bilanceve nga kredit me probleme dhe at t kursit t kmbimit. Duke prjashtuar kto dy efekte, kredia pr sektorin privat shnoi nj rritje vjetore prej 5.9%, n fund t vitit 2018. Rritja e kredis vijon t jet m e shpejt n segmentin e kredis n lek dhe n at t kredis pr konsum. Ndrkoh, kredia pr biznese shfaqi nj rritje t shpejt n muajin dhjetor, pavarsisht politikave m konservatore t kreditimit t aplikuara nga bankat n kt segment. Politika fiskale ka vijuar t ndjek nj kurs konsolidues. T dhnat fiskale sugjerojn se deficiti buxhetor zbriti n 1.6% t PBB-s n fund t vitit 2018, duke qen 0.4 pik prqindjeje m i ult se niveli i planifikuar. N prputhje me t, edhe stimuli direkt fiskal n ekonomi ka qen m i ult se niveli i pritur. Nga ana tjetr, ulja e huamarrjes totale t sektorit publik, si dhe mbshtetja n tregun e huaj pr financimin e nj pjese t madhe t saj gjat vitit t shkuar, kan rritur hapsirat pr kreditimin e sektorit privat. N prputhje me kto trende, Banka e Shqipris vlerson se ekonomia shqiptare do t vijoj t rritet gjat tre viteve t ardhshme. Zgjerimi i krkess agregate do t sjell rritje t mtejshme t punsimit, duke krijuar premisa pr rritje t pagave dhe t inflacionit t gjeneruar n vend. Paralelisht me t, frenimi i mbimimit t kursit t kmbimit do t reduktoj presionet dezinflacioniste t ardhura prej tij. N prputhje me kt skenar zhvillimesh, inflacioni pritet t kthehet n objektiv n gjysmn e dyt t vitit 2020. Paralelisht me zhvillimet pozitive t pritura sipas skenarit baz, Kshilli Mbikqyrs konstaton se balanca e rreziqeve vijon t mbetet e shmangur n kahun e posht. N veanti, ambienti i jashtm, ecuria e kursit t kmbimit dhe ritmi i rritjes s kreditimit, mund t shmangin inflacionin n kahun e poshtm t pritjeve tona. *** Duke gjykuar mbi kta faktor, Kshilli Mbikqyrs konstaton se kursi aktual stimulues i politiks monetare mbetet i prshtatshm. N kto rrethana, ai vendosi: t mbaj t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 1.0%; t mbaj t pandryshuara normat e interesit t depozits dhe kredis njditore, respektivisht n nivelet 0.1% dhe 1.9%. Title: Speech at the book promotion ceremony Money, banks and society. Historical journey from the beginnings to modern times "
text: 05/08/22, 17:17 Governor Seyko's word at the book promotion ceremony "Money, banks and society. Historical collaboration from the beginning... Governor Seyko's word at the book promotion ceremony "Money, banks and society. Historical collaboration since the girls until modern times" Publication date: 22.02.2019 Honored professors, Honorable participants, ... 1/6 05/08/22, 17:17 Governor Seyko's word at the book promotion ceremony "Money, banks and society. Historical collaboration from the beginning... Honored ladies and gentlemen, It is a pleasure and I feel honoured to open this completely special activity, extremely different from those most commonly organized in this historic hall of the Bank of Albania, as it goes outside the frames of our daily life. Title: Questions and answers at the press conference
text: Question answers of the press conference dated March 28, 2019 29/07/22, 13:35 Question answers of the press conference dated March 28, 2019 Publication date: 28.03.2019 Q: Looking at the political developments that are happening, leaving mandates on the part of opposition MPs, how much is this affecting the country's economy, do you see this factor integrated into your future reports on the country's economy? Governor: We've stressed it other times when we've had tense political situations. It is outside any discussion that any political tension or any other tension has its effects on the economy and cannot be overlooked, if it is prolonged and escalated. Currently with the data available, which was presented and today at the meeting of the Supervisory Council, we have not yet reflected the effects of a deteriorating political situation in the economy. The data refers to an earlier period and does not yet reflect this effect. The Bank of Albania will continue to monitor developments and will certainly reflect on its analyses if there is a deterioration in macroeconomic indicators from the political situation. At the moment, we have not yet negatively reflected the effect of the political situation on the data we have. The data, as you saw from the statement, generally show a positive growing situation - certainly in some particular segments we have and certain complications because the economy is complex. Q: What are the factors that have influenced the decline in lending and the slight increase in the index of troubled loans?  etje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_28_mars_2019.html Page 1 of 3 Question answers of the press conference dated March 28, 2019 29/07/22, 13:35 Governor: In terms of lending and troubled loans, I would like to clarify that lending as an indication whether absolute or in percentage terms has suffered a decline. But in fact we have to take into account some factors, and strip credit of their effect. These factors are: the effect of overcutting the exchange rate (the contravention effect of the exchange rate, on reflecting the loan surplus) of the deletion of loans lost from banks' balance sheets the effect of a large loan, granted by the BERZH to the Albanian Energy Corporation. As the volume of loans has not changed, but the figure taken out of the banking system has decreased, so credit has not decreased in the economy, but the loan figure from the banking system has decreased. All three of these important factors have influenced the lending figure for 2018. Avoiding the impact of these factors, credit has increased by 5%. As far as the indicator of troubled loans is concerned, it has been influenced by the emergence as a separate entity of the BKT branch, Kosovo. This branch has a significant value, about 3% of the weight in our banking system and 11% of the National Commercial Bank itself. The division of this branch has had an impact either on the percentage figure or on the absolute value of troubled loans. Troubled loans reached 11.1% at the end of 2018 and currently this indicator has a slight increase to 11.5 as the effect of the breakaway branch of the National Commercial Bank. To go back to the credit issue once again. In fact, lending has had a year-on-year increase. To understand the figures we refer to the new loan. We often mess with figures and reports and don't understand whether there is an increase or a drop in lending. Lending can be seen as trending, referring to the new loan figure in the economy. The new loan figure is on the rise year-on-year, including the renewal of loans at the border or overdrafts. For 2018, this loan was over 2 billion euros. Only the new loan without overdrafts can be over 1 billion euros. The figure in total included and overdrafts have come in increasing. So this actually shows the increase in lending by the banking sector in the country. Our easing monetary policy has had a positive impact on lending growth. This is also the aim of easing monetary policy, to boost investment in the country. If we see, the overwhelming share of lending growth comes from credit growth in the lek, as a result of lowering the basic interest rate and our monetary stimulus policy. Of course, euro credit interest rates have also been lowered, as a result of monetary stimulus policy pursued by the European Central Bank. We need to understand the effect of monetary stimulus policy even within the high level of euroisation, as we still have a high level of euroisation in the financial system, nearly 50-50 is the percentage in loans and deposits. Therefore, our monetary policy has this limitation, as it applies only to lec interest rates, whether loans or deposits. So without prolonging we have had a moderate but increasing lending trend in the country.  etje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_28_mars_2019.html Page 2 of 3 Question answers of the press conference dated March 28, 2019 29/07/22, 13:35  etje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_28_mars_2019.html Page 3 of 3

Por, n fakt ne duhet t marrim parasysh disa faktor, dhe ta zhveshim kredin nga efekti i tyre. Kta faktor jan: efekti i mbimimit t kursit t kmbimit (efekti kontabl i kursit t kmbimit, n pasqyrimin e teprics s kredis) fshirja e kredive t humbura nga bilancet e bankave efekti i nj kredie t madhe, dhn nga BERZH pr Korporatn Energjetike Shqiptare. Si volum kredie nuk ka ndryshuar, por shifra e marr nga sistemi bankar sht ulur, pra nuk sht ulur kredia n ekonomi, por sht ulur shifra e kredis nga sistemi bankar. T tre kta faktor t rndsishm kan ndikuar n shifrn e kreditimit pr vitin 2018. Duke shmangur ndikimin e ktyre faktorve, kredia sht rritur me 5%. Prsa i prket treguesit t kredive me probleme, ai sht ndikuar nga dalja si entitet m vete i degs s BKT, Kosov. Kjo deg ka nj vler t konsiderueshme, rreth 3% t peshs n sistemin ton bankar dhe 11% t vet Banks Kombtare Tregtare. Ndarja e ksaj dege ka pasur nj ndikim qoft n shifr prqindjeje, qoft n vler absolute t kredive me probleme. Kredit me probleme arritn n 11.1% n fund t vitit 2018 dhe aktualisht ky tregues ka nj rritje t leht n 11.5 si efekt i shkputjes s degs s Banks Kombtare Tregtare. Pr tiu kthyer dhe nj her shtjes s kreditimit. N fakt, kreditimi ka pasur nj rritje nga viti n vit. Pr t kuptuar shifrat ne i referohemi kredis s re. Shpeshher ne ngatrrohemi me shifrat e raportet dhe nuk kuptojm nse ka rritje apo ka rnie t kreditimit. Kreditimi mund t shihet si trend, duke iu referuar shifrs s kredis s re n ekonomi. Shifra e kredis t re sht n rritje nga viti n vit, duke prfshir edhe rinovimin e kredive n kufi ose overdraft-eve. Pr vitin 2018, kjo kredi ishte mbi 2 miliard euro. Vetm kredia e re pa overdraftet mund t jet mbi 1 miliard euro. Shifra n total prfshir dhe overdraftet ka ardhur n rritje. Pra, kjo tregon realisht rritjen e kreditimit nga sektori bankar n vend. Politika jon monetare lehtsuese ka patur nj ndikim pozitiv n rritjen e kreditimit. Ky sht dhe qllimi i politiks monetare lehtsuese, t nxis investimet n vend. Po t shohim, pjesa drrmuese e rritjes s kreditimit vjen nga rritja e kredis n lek, si pasoj e uljes s norms baz s interesit dhe politiks ton monetare stimuluese. Sigurisht edhe normat e interesit t kredis n euro jan ulur, si pasoj e politiks monetare stimuluese t ndjekur nga Banka Qendrore Evropiane. Ne duhet t kuptojm efektin e politiks monetare stimuluese edhe n kuadr t nivelit t lart t euroizimit, pasi ne kemi akoma nj nivel t lart euroizimi n sistemin financiar, gati 50-50 sht prqindja tek kredit dhe depozitat. Prandaj, politika jon monetare e ka kt kufizim, pasi aplikohet vetm mbi normat e interesit t lekut, qoft t kredive qoft t depozitave. Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, March 28, 2019 29/07/22, 13:35 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, March 28, 2019 Publication date: 28.03.2019 Honored media representatives, Today, at the meeting dated 28 March 2019, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Intermediate Monetary Policy Report. The new data obtained over the past two months has generally been in line with our forecasts. Likewise, our expectations for the future have not undergone significant changes, although risks to the internal and foreign environment have increased. Under these circumstances, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current monetary policy position is appropriate for meeting the bank of Albania's objectives. Monetary stimulus, transmitted through low interest rates and communication of future monetary policy kah, remains necessary for boosting economic growth and turning inflation into targets. *** The foreign environment presents a slowdown in growth rhythms and a reduction in the current and expected level of inflation, both in the European and global contexts. In their response, the main central banks have reconsidered the stance of monetary policy, towards further easing or towards delaying its normalization in time. On the other hand, foreign financial markets appear relatively quiet.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_28_mars_2019.html Page 1 of 3 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, March 28, 2019 29/07/22, 13:35 In line with our expectations, inflation in the country suffered declines during the first two months of 2019. Average inflation of this period marked the value of 1.8%, reflecting the fullest reflection of the restraining effect of strengthening the exchange rate. According to our estimates, this effect will peak during the first half of 2019 and will gradually wear off during the following quarters. In parallel with this effect, domestic inflationary pressures still appear insufficient to return inflation to the target. Although the continued expansion of aggregate demand has brought employment and wage growth, production costs and profit rates are still not enough to meet our inflation target. According to indirect data available, the pace of economic growth appears to have slowed somewhat over the past two quarters. To a large extent, this slowdown reflects the performance of electricity generation and, as such, it is not estimated that it will affect medium-term growth trends. On the other hand, the long-term and long-term determinant factors of aggregate demand and economic growth appear more stable. But according to the indirect data available, consumption and private investmenthave been seen to mark increases in this period, reflecting improved disposable income and financial balances, increased capacity exploitation, and favourable financing conditions. Albanian exports of goods marked growth in the fourth quarter of last year and slowdown in the first two months of 2019. This slowdown reflected the basic effect of high electricity exports during the same period last year, as well as the unfavourable international conjuncture for some categories of our exports. Finally, fiscal policy has maintained its consolidating stance, even during the first two months of 2019. Monetary stimulus and fiscal consolidation have created a favourable financial environment for boosting demand. In their response, interest rates and public and private sector financing costs appear near their historical minimums. Also, the exchange rate appears relatively stable, reflecting the better balance of demand and currency supply. The expansion of economic activity is supported by  and reflected in  the gradual increasing trend of credit for the private sector. Excluding the contaminant effect of the exchange rate as well as that of extracting lost loans off balance sheets, the loan to the private sector marked an annual increase of about 6% during the first two months of 2019. This increase, while still moderate, represents a positive signal for the revitalization of demand and improved credit supply. The ongoing consolidation of the banking sector, as well as the continued improvement of its balance sheets, create preconditions for a faster improvement in supply and lending pace in the country. The continued decline in the ratio of troubled loans shows that the risk of credit in the country has been significantly reduced. The Bank of Albania considers that these positive premises should be more consistently reflected in the banking sector's lending policies and standards.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_28_mars_2019.html Page 2 of 3 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, March 28, 2019 29/07/22, 13:35 Judging on current development trends, as well as their defining factors, the Bank of Albania estimates that aggregate demand will come in increasing over the medium-term horizon. Increasing consumption, investment and exports will enable further employment expansion, rising wages and profit rates, as well as gradually strengthening domestic inflationary pressures. In parallel with the complete suppression of the brake effect of the exchange rate, these developments will enable inflation to be returned to target within 2020. *** The Supervisory Council estimated that preserving monetary policy stimulus kah is an important prerequisite for meeting this forecast. Under these circumstances, he decided: Keep the basic interest rate unchanged at 1.0%; Keep deposit and one-day loan interest rates unchanged, at levels 0.1% and 1.9%, respectively. In parallel with the reconfirmation of the basic expectations scenario, the Supervisory Council estimates that the risks of the lower kah have been strengthened during 2019. Deteriorating foreign environment, tense political situation in the country, as well as timely compliance with the pace of improvement in supply with demand for loans, are factors that can shift economic developments below expectations of the basic scenario. Monetary policy will continue to remain stimulating even during the medium-term horizon, but the intensity of the stimulus will adapt to the speed and sustainability of improving economic activity. In particular, the Supervisory Council estimates that materializing risk factors may require delaying monetary policy normalization in time.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_28_mars_2019.html Page 3 of 3

Muz dhe Eduk " Kreu / Shtypi / Fjalime, intervista, artikuj / Fjalime Njoftimet pr shtyp Njoftime t # mbledhjeve t Kshillit Mbikqyrs Konferenca pr shtyp Fjalime, $ intervista, artikuj Fjalime Intervista e artikuj Kalendar # Kalendari i festave zyrtare pr vitin 2022 COVID-19 Evropa # BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 28 mars 2019 Data e publikimit: 28.03.2019 T nderuar prfaqsues t medias, Sot, n mbledhjen e dats 28 mars 2019, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris mori n shqyrtim dhe miratoi Raportin e ndrmjetm t Politiks Monetare. T dhnat e reja t prftuara gjat dy muajve t fundit kan qen prgjithsisht n linj me parashikimet tona. Po ashtu, pritjet tona pr t ardhmen nuk kan psuar ndryshime t ndjeshme, ndonse rreziqet n mjedisin e brendshm dhe t huaj jan shtuar. N kto rrethana, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare sht i prshtatshm pr prmbushjen e objektivave t Banks s Shqipris. Stimuli monetar, i transmetuar nprmjet normave t ulta t interesit dhe komunikimit t kahut t ardhshm t politiks monetare, mbetet i nevojshm pr nxitjen e rritjes ekonomike dhe pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv. *** Ambienti i huaj paraqet nj ngadalsim t ritmeve t rritjes dhe reduktim t nivelit aktual e t pritur t inflacionit, si n kontekstin evropian dhe n at global. N prgjigje t tyre, bankat qendrore kryesore kan ripar qndrimin e politiks monetare, drejt lehtsimit t mtejshm ose drejt shtyrjes n koh t normalizimit t saj. Nga ana tjetr, tregjet e huaja financiare shfaqen relativisht t qeta. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjer_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_28_mars_2019.html Pagina 1 di 3 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 28 mars 2019 29/07/22, 13:35 N prputhje me pritjet tona, inflacioni n vend psoi rnie gjat dy muajve t par t vitit 2019. Inflacioni mesatar i ksaj periudhe shnoi vlern 1.8%, duke pasqyruar prcjelljen m t plot t efektit frenues t forcimit t kursit t kmbimit. Sipas vlersimeve tona, ky efekt do t kulmoj gjat gjysms s par t vitit 2019 dhe do t shuhet gradualisht gjat tremujorve n vazhdim. Paralelisht me kt efekt, presionet e brendshme inflacioniste paraqiten ende t pamjaftueshme pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv. Ndonse zgjerimi i vazhduar i krkess agregate ka sjell rritje t punsimit dhe t pagave, kostot e prodhimit dhe normat e fitimit nuk jan ende t mjaftueshme pr t prmbushur objektivin ton t inflacionit. Sipas t dhnave t trthorta t disponuara, ritmi i rritjes ekonomike duket t jet ngadalsuar disi gjat dy tremujorve t fundit. N nj mas t madhe, ky ngadalsim pasqyron ecurin e prodhimit t energjis elektrike dhe, si i till, nuk vlersohet se do t ndikoj trendet afatmesme t rritjes. Nga ana tjetr, faktort prcaktues afatmesm e afatgjat t krkess agregate dhe t rritjes ekonomike, duken m t qndrueshm. Po sipas t dhnave t trthorta t disponuara, konsumi dhe investimet private kan vijuar t shnojn rritje n kt periudh, duke pasqyruar prmirsimin e t ardhurave t disponueshme dhe t bilanceve financiare, rritjen e shkalls s shfrytzimit t kapaciteteve, dhe kushtet e favorshme t financimit. Eksportet shqiptare t mallrave kan shnuar rritje n tremujorin e katrt t vitit t shkuar dhe ngadalsim n dy muajt e par t vitit 2019. Ky ngadalsim pasqyroi efektin baz t eksportit t lart t energjis elektrike gjat s njjts periudh t vitit t shkuar, si dhe koniunkturn jo t favorshme ndrkombtare pr disa kategori t eksporteve tona. S fundi, politika fiskale ka ruajtur qndrimin e saj konsoliduese, edhe gjat dy muajve t par t vitit 2019. Stimuli monetar dhe konsolidimi fiskal kan krijuar nj ambient t favorshm financiar pr nxitjen e krkess. N prgjigje t tyre, normat e interesit dhe kostot e financimit t sektorit publik e privat shfaqen pran minimumeve t tyre historike. Po ashtu, kursi i kmbimit shfaqet relativisht i qndrueshm, duke pasqyruar balancimin m t mir t krkess dhe oferts pr valut. Zgjerimi i aktivitetit ekonomik sht mbshtetur nga  dhe pasqyruar n  trendin gradual rrits t kredis pr sektorin privat. Duke prjashtuar efektin kontabl t kursit t kmbimit si dhe at t nxjerrjes s kredive t humbura jasht bilanceve, kredia pr sektorin privat shnoi nj rritje vjetore prej rreth 6% gjat dy muajve t par t vitit 2019. Kjo rritje, ndonse ende e moderuar, prbn nj sinjal pozitiv pr gjallrimin e krkess dhe prmirsimin e oferts pr kredi. Konsolidimi n proces i sektorit bankar, si dhe prmirsimi i vazhdueshm i bilanceve t tij, krijojn parakushte pr nj prmirsim m t shpejt t oferts dhe t ritmit t kreditimit n vend. Trendi i vazhdueshm rns i raportit t kredive me probleme tregon se rreziku i kreditit n vend sht reduktuar ndjeshm. Banka e Shqipris gjykon se kto premisa pozitive duhet t pasqyrohen m me konsekuenc n politikat dhe standardet e kreditimit t sektorit bankar. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjer_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_28_mars_2019.html Pagina 2 di 3 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 28 mars 2019 29/07/22, 13:35 Duke gjykuar mbi trendet aktuale t zhvillimit, si dhe faktort prcaktues t tyre, Banka e Shqipris vlerson se krkesa agregate do t vij n rritje gjat horizontit afatmesm. Rritja e konsumit, investimeve dhe eksporteve, do t mundsoj zgjerimin e mtejshm t punsimit, rritjen e pagave dhe t normave t fitimit, si dhe forcimin gradual t presioneve t brendshme inflacioniste. Paralelisht edhe me shuarjen e plot t efektit frenues t kursit t kmbimit, kto zhvillime do t mundsojn kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv brenda vitit 2020. *** Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se ruajtja e kahut stimulues t politiks monetare sht nj parakusht i rndsishm i plotsimit t ktij parashikimi. N kto rrethana, ai vendosi: T mbaj t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 1.0%; T mbaj t pandryshuara normat e interesit t depozits dhe kredis njditore, respektivisht n nivelet 0.1% dhe 1.9%. Paralelisht me rikonfirmimin e skenarit baz t pritjeve, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlerson se rreziqet e kahut t poshtm jan forcuar gjat vitit 2019. Prkeqsimi i ambientit t huaj, situata e tensionuar politike n vend, si dhe prputhshmria n koh e ritmit t prmirsimit t oferts me at t krkess pr kredi, jan faktor t cilt mund ti zhvendosin zhvillimet ekonomike posht pritjeve t skenarit baz. Politika monetare do t vijoj t mbetet stimuluese edhe gjat horizontit afatmesm, por intensiteti i stimulit do t prshtatet me shpejtsin dhe qndrueshmrin e prmirsimit t aktivitetit ekonomik. N veanti, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlerson se materializimi i faktorve t rrezikut, mund t krkoj shtyrjen n koh t normalizimit t politiks monetare. Copyright  2018 Banka e Shqipris. Title: Speech, at the joint press conference with the Head of the IMF Mission and the Minister of Finance and Economy
text: , Mr. Gent Seyko, in the cone... IMF Mission Hef and Minister of Finance and Economy 29/07/22, 13:35 , Mr Gent Seyko, at the joint press conference with the Chief of mission of IMF and Minister of Finance and Economy Publication date: 06.05.2019 On discussions with the IMF Mission within the Framework of Post-Programmer Monitoring Honored media representatives, Let me, in the first place, thank the IMF Mission for the fruitful discussions we have had over the last two weeks. As you may be aware, these discussions take place under the Post-Programmer Monitoring that the IMF makes to our country. Let me also stress that with the Mission we have shared similar views on the country's development stage, the challenges we have ahead, and the policies and measures needed to address them. Next, I want to share with you the opinion of the Bank of Albania on these three topics. *** In our assessment, the cyclical position and overall balances of the Albanian economy have been improved. The expansion of aggregate demand, mainly resulting from increased consumption and private investment, has enabled the preservation of the positive economic growth rate and the increasing lyrical exploitation of production capacities. In parallel, the economy's external balances have come to an improvement, domestic debt has been reduced and private sector financial balances have strengthened.  e_Misionit_te_FMN-se_dhe_Ministren_e_Financave_dhe_Ekonomise.html Page 1 of 3 , Mr. Gent Seyko, in the cone... IMF Mission Hef and Minister of Finance and Economy 29/07/22, 13:35 Rising employment and wages have brought strengthening domestic inflationary pressures. However, the inflation rate still remains below target, as a result of strengthening the exchange rate and the fact that aggregate demand is still insufficient to ensure inflation returns to target. Internal financial markets appear calm and suitable for supporting economic growth. Liquidity in the banking sector is plentiful, loan interest rates are at low levels and the exchange rate presents relatively stable. Also, bank credit has marked improvement in growth rates and gradual diversification of the portfolio structure. The main indicators of the health of the banking sector  liquidity, capitalisation, profitability  remain at high levels, while the index of troubled credit has a clear downward trend. Together with the ongoing consolidation of the banking sector, they give way to a more active position in lending. These development trends have reflected: (i) the improvement of the external environment; (ii) harmonisation of fiscal consolidation with monetary stimulus and financial sector stabilisation and development policies; as well as (iii) structural reforms undertaken during this period. As far as the Bank of Albania is concerned, during 2018, we have been following and even strengthening monetary stimulus, further lowering financing costs and softening currency market fluctuations. Also, during 2018, the Bank of Albania: has worked to implement the plan of measures to reduce troubled loans; has taken concrete action to implement the national programme for increasing the use of lek in the country's economic and financial life; has worked to improve the regulatory framework, supervisory practices of the banking sector and strengthen the security networks of the financial system; As well as, it has further exercised its powers for the development of the financial market and payment systems. The country's development prospects remain positive. In the absence of blows, the Albanian economy will continue to grow in the medium term, boosting employment and wage growth, returning inflation to targets and further improving overall macroeconomic balances. Materializing these forecasts and meeting our objectives requires preserving the current kah of economic policies: monetary stimulus, fiscal consolidation and care for financial stability. In particular, monetary policy normalization will be careful and the intensity of monetary stimulus will adapt to the balance of inflationary pressures. On the other hand, as we have said before, the balance of dangers presents itself visibly shifted to the lower direction. In particular, significant worsening of the foreign environment and increased political tension in the country can bring negative consequences to the economy. The Bank of Albania is closely monitoring foreign developments, aiming to identify the appropriate response and undertake it in time. We also judge that any effort to calm the political situation would contribute to maintaining the positive economic development sourcing.  e_Misionit_te_FMN-se_dhe_Ministren_e_Financave_dhe_Ekonomise.html Page 2 of 3 , Mr. Gent Seyko, in the cone... IMF Mission Hef and Minister of Finance and Economy 29/07/22, 13:35 In any case, the Bank of Albania's response through its main instruments: monetary policy and regulation of banking supervision, will be coherent with the challenges we have ahead and consistent with meeting our objectives. In the long term, the Bank of Albania continues to state that the country needs further structural reforms. These reforms should aim at increasing productivity and competitiveness, accelerating the pace of growth and pace of convergence with the European Union, as well as increasing the sustainability of the Albanian economy and financial system. Structural reforms must be forward-paced, ambitious and comprehensive. They need to be increasingly anchored in the Process of European Integration and aim for as broad a political and social consensus as possible. Within its area of expertise, the Bank of Albania has been and will remain a committed and serious partner in advancing the country's development agenda. Thank you!  e_Misionit_te_FMN-se_dhe_Ministren_e_Financave_dhe_Ekonomise.html Page 3 of 3

Gent Sejko, n konferencn e prbashkt pr shtyp me Shefin e Misionit t FMN-s dhe Ministren e Financave dhe Ekonomis Data e publikimit: 06.05.2019 Mbi diskutimet me Misionin e FMN-s n kuadr t Monitorimit Post-Programor T nderuar prfaqsues t medias, M lejoni, n radh t par, t falnderoj Misionin e FMN-s pr diskutimet e frytshme q kemi pasur gjat dy javve t fundit. Si mund t jeni n dijeni, kto diskutime zhvillohen n kuadrin e Monitorimit Post-Programor q FMN i bn vendit ton. M lejoni, po ashtu, t theksoj se me Misionin kemi ndar pikpamje t ngjashme mbi stadin e zhvillimit t vendit, sfidat q kemi prpara, dhe politikat e masat e nevojshme pr adresimin e tyre. N vijim, dshiroj t ndaj me ju opinionin e Banks s Shqipris mbi kto tre tema. *** N vlersimin ton, pozicioni ciklik dhe ekuilibrat e prgjithshm t ekonomis shqiptare kan vijuar t prmirsohen. Zgjerimi i krkess agregate, i ardhur kryesisht si pasoj e rritjes s konsumit dhe investimeve private, ka mundsuar ruajtjen e trendit pozitiv t rritjes ekonomike dhe shfrytzimin gjithnj e m t plot t kapaciteteve prodhuese. Paralelisht me to, balancat e jashtme t ekonomis kan ardhur n prmirsim, borxhi i brendshm sht reduktuar dhe bilancet financiare t sektorit privat jan forcuar. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fje_Misionit_te_FMN-se_dhe_Ministren_e_Financave_dhe_Ekonomise.html Pagina 1 di 3 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko, n konhefin e Misionit t FMN-s dhe Ministren e Financave dhe Ekonomis 29/07/22, 13:35 Rritja e punsimit dhe e pagave ka sjell forcimin e presioneve t brendshme inflacioniste. Megjithat, norma e inflacionit mbetet ende nn objektiv, si pasoj e forcimit t kursit t kmbimit dhe e faktit se krkesa agregate sht ende e pamjaftueshme pr t siguruar kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv. Tregjet e brendshme financiare shfaqen t qeta dhe t prshtatshme pr mbshtetjen e rritjes ekonomike. Likuiditeti n sektorin bankar sht i bollshm, normat e interesit t kredive jan n nivele t ulta dhe kursi i kmbimit paraqitet relativisht i qndrueshm. Po ashtu, kredia bankare ka shnuar prmirsim t ritmeve t rritjes dhe diversifikim gradual t strukturs t portofolit. Treguesit kryesor t shndetit t sektorit bankar  likuiditeti, kapitalizimi, prfitueshmria  mbeten n nivele t larta, ndrsa treguesi i kredis me probleme ka nj trend t qart rns. S bashku me konsolidimin n proces t sektorit bankar, ato i hapin rrug nj qndrimi m aktiv t tij n kreditim. Kto trende zhvillimi kan pasqyruar: (i) prmirsimin e ambientit t jashtm; (ii) harmonizimin e konsolidimit fiskal me stimulin monetar dhe politikat e stabilizimit dhe zhvillimit t sektorit financiar; si dhe (iii) reformat strukturore t ndrmarra gjat ksaj periudhe. Sa i takon Banks s Shqipris, gjat vitit 2018, ne kemi vijuar e madje forcuar stimulin monetar, duke ulur m tej kostot e financimit dhe duke zbutur luhatjet e tregut valutor. Po ashtu, gjat vitit 2018, Banka e Shqipris: ka punuar pr zbatimin e planit t masave pr reduktimin e kredive me probleme; ka ndrmarr veprime konkrete pr zbatimin e programit kombtar pr rritjen e prdorimit t lekut n jetn ekonomike dhe financiare t vendit; ka punuar pr prmirsimin e kuadrit rregullator, t praktikave mbikqyrse t sektorit bankar dhe pr forcimin e rrjeteve t siguris s sistemit financiar; si dhe, ka ushtruar m tej kompetencat e veta pr zhvillimin e tregut financiar dhe t sistemeve t pagesave. Perspektivat e zhvillimit t vendit mbeten pozitive. N munges t goditjeve, ekonomia shqiptare do t vijoj t rritet n afatin e mesm, duke nxitur rritjen e punsimit e t pagave, kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv dhe prmirsimin e mtejshm t ekuilibrave t prgjithshm makroekonomik. Materializimi i ktyre parashikimeve dhe prmbushja e objektivave tona krkon ruajtjen e kahut aktual t politikave ekonomike: stimulit monetar, konsolidimit fiskal dhe kujdesit ndaj stabilitetit financiar. N veanti, normalizimi i politiks monetare do t jet i kujdesshm dhe intensiteti i stimulit monetar do t prshtatet me balancn e presioneve inflacioniste. Nga ana tjetr, sikundr e kemi thn dhe m par, balanca e rreziqeve paraqitet e zhvendosur dukshm n kahun e poshtm. N veanti, prkeqsimi i ndjeshm i ambientit t huaj dhe tensioni i rritur politik n vend, mund t sjellin pasoja negative n ekonomi. Banka e Shqipris po monitoron me vmendje zhvillimet e huaja, duke synuar t identifikoj reagimin e duhur dhe ta ndrmarr n koh at. Po ashtu, ne gjykojm se do prpjekje n funksion t qetsimit t situats politike do t kontribuonte n ruajtjen e trendit pozitiv t zhvillimeve ekonomike. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fje_Misionit_te_FMN-se_dhe_Ministren_e_Financave_dhe_Ekonomise.html Pagina 2 di 3 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. N afatin e gjat, Banka e Shqipris vijon t konstatoj se vendi ka nevoj pr vazhdimin e reformave strukturore. Kto reforma duhet t synojn rritjen e produktivitetit dhe t konkurrueshmris, prshpejtimin e ritmit t rritjes dhe t ritmit t konvergjencs me Bashkimin Evropian, si dhe rritjen e qndrueshmris s ekonomis dhe sistemit financiar shqiptar. Reformat strukturore duhet t vijojn t jen largpamse, ambicioze dhe gjithprfshirse. Ato duhet t ankorohen gjithnj e m tepr n procesin e integrimit evropian dhe t synojn nj konsensus sa m t gjer politik e social. Brenda fushs s saj t ekspertizs, Banka e Shqipris ka qen dhe do t mbetet nj partner i angazhuar dhe serioz n uarjen prpara t axhends s zhvillimit t vendit. Ju faleminderit!
