Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, May 8, 2019 29/07/22, 13:34 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, May 8, 2019 Publication date: 08.05.2019 Honored media representatives, Today, at the meeting dated 8 May 2019, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania considered and approved the Quarterly Monetary Policy Report. The new information received in the analysis in this Report has generally been in line with our expectations. This information suggests that the Albanian economy follows a positive growth trajectory, which has enabled the fullest exploitation of production capacities and has supported increasing domestic inflationary pressures. Similarly, this information confirmed our expectations for reducing economic growth rates in the fourth quarter of 2018 and inflation in the first months of 2019. Page 1 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, May 8, 2019 29/07/22, 13:34 Slowing inflation owes mainly to the action of supply factors, but it resulted somewhat stronger than expectations. Our predictions for the future remain positive. They project further increases in economic activity and strengthen domestic inflationary pressures. However, the deteriorating external environment has in time pushed our assessment of the economy's return to balance and inflation on target. These developments confirm the appropriateness of the current monetary policy position, as well as highlight the need for continued accommodative monetary policy on the medium-term horizon. The report's conclusions and reasons for this decision will be presented in more detail. *** Inflation recorded an average annual rate of 1.6% in the first quarter of the year, reducing from the value scored in the previous quarter. The increase in rent and water prices a year ago was extinguished earlier this year, bringing down the contribution of these groups to inflation. In addition to this effect, service price growth slowed and agricultural price inflation marked a strong reduction in the month of March. In the macroeconomic perspective, the slowdown in inflation reflected the fuller reflection of exchange rate overprice, slowing inflation in partner countries, as well as the effect of supply shocks on agricultural prices. On the other hand, economic growth has brought strengthening domestic inflationary pressures, while pressures from the foreign environment appear to be declining. According to INSTAT data, economic activity expanded by 3.1% in the fourth quarter of 2018, marking a slowdown compared to previous quarters. The economic growth of 2018 marked the value 4.1%. It has found support in private sector demand, which benefited from rising employment, improved confidence and conditions Page 2 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, May 8, 2019 29/07/22, 13:34 favorable funding. On the other hand, fiscal policy has been able to follow a consolidating course, expressed in positive values of the budgetbalance, making a low contribution to the growth of the economy. The expansion of aggregate demand has brought about the reduction of untapped capacities in the economy. But according to INSTAT, employment has come up and the unemployment rate stands at historically low levels. Likewise, data taken from business surveys suggest a higher intensity of use of production capacities. In response to these developments, average wages in the economy have come to an increase, although the pace of growth continues to be low. In parallel with it, the performance of basic inflation proves that the gradual convergence of the economy towards potential has not yet been coupled with sufficient inflationary pressures for turning inflation to target. Our monetary policy has enabled the creation of favourable financing conditions. Internal financial markets operate quietly, with low interest rates, low risk premiums and a tendency to stabilize the exchange rate. In response, the pace of credit growth has improved. Adjusted for exchange rate and balance sheet loans, the private sector loan portfolio marked an annual increase of 6% in the first quarter of the year. This performance continues to be supported by the expansion of the loan into money, which occupies about 48% of the loan in total. In parallel with it, the developments of recent months show a more balanced performance of the loan portfolio, with increased contribution from both individuals and businesses. In our assessment, the ongoing consolidation of the banking sector, the continued reduction of credit risk and the expected increase in demand for it create premise for sustainable credit growth in the future. However, materializing this projection requires a more active approach of banks to lending. Judging on current development trends and the balance of supporting factors, the Bank of Albania estimates that the medium-term economic outlook is positive. Expanding economic activity will enable further employment growth, fuller exploitation of production capacities and faster growth in wages and production costs. These developments will enable inflation to return to target in early 2021. In relation to past forecasts, the return of the economy to balance and inflation on target have been pushed slightly on time. This revision is mostly influenced by the most pessimistic forecasts for the foreign economy. It also reflects the need for full absorption of supply shocks into inflation and the complete suppression effects that come from the exchange rate. The dangers of the lower kah dominate the forecast horizon. They are mostly related to uncertainties in the external environment, the duration and impact of strengthening the exchange rate in inflation, the sustainability of bank loan recovery and, finally, the tense political situation in the country. *** Starting from these considerations, the Supervisory Council estimates that monetary policy will Page 3 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, May 8, 2019 29/07/22, 13:34 It remains stimulating even during the medium-term horizon. At this meeting, he decided: Keep the basic interest rate unchanged at the current level of 1.00%; and, keep deposit and one-day loan interest rates unchanged, respectively at levels 0.1% and 1.9%. Also, judging on the basic scenario and balance of risks, the Supervisory Council estimates that the normalization of monetary policy will be very careful. In any case, the intensity of the stimulus will adapt to the speed and sustainability of improving economic activity, while the Bank of Albania remains ready to react to possible shocks. Page 4 of 4

Title: Meeting discussion with the banking sector on "Banking sector as an important contributor to the economic development of the country"
text: Governor Seyko's discussion meeting with the banking sector themed "That... kar as an important contributor to the country's economic development" 29/07/22, 13:34 Governor Sejko's discussion meeting with the banking sector themed "Banking sector as important contributor to the economic development of the country" Publication date: 29.05.2019 On 29 May 2019, the meeting was held at the Bank of Albania's premises with the theme: "Banking sector as an important contributor to the economic development of the country". Already back in a tradition, this meeting aims to further strengthen the relationship of co-operation with the banking system. At this meeting, organised at the initiative and under the direction of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr Gent Sejko participated as directors of the Bank of Albania, the highest executive representatives of commercial banks (directors general and their deputy), as well as representatives from the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank. Page 1 of 4 Governor Seyko's discussion meeting with the banking sector themed "That... kar as an important contributor to the country's economic development" 29/07/22, 13:34 At the beginning of his speech, Governor Seyko stated that through this meeting it is intended to achieve the drafting of a concrete plan of measures to improve the amount and quality of lending, as well as to expand the range of financial products. Stopping at the performance of the banking sector, the Governor praised the important contribution the banking sector makes to the country's economic development, where the volume of financial savings managed by the banking sector occupies about 70% of GDP, while the volume of credit provided by it is about 35% of GDP. In the judgment of the Bank of Albania, the banking sector is the main pillar of the financial system and at the same time among the most developed and professional segments of the economy. The consolidation of the banking sector as well as the continued reduction in credit risk are expected to bring an increase in the lending process to the country. For materializing this objective, Governor Seyko asked representatives of the banking sector to reflect a more active approach to fulfilling their main mission, that of healthy lending to the economy. To this end, Governor Sejko designated as necessary for the banking sector to take the appropriate steps to expand the range of lending products as well as to finance new sectors of the Albanian economy, such as agriculture and other innovative businesses in the field of information technology. This process should be accompanied in parallel with increased attention on the part of the banking sector to show maximum care in the selection and financing of sectors that offer a high return potential. It is also the duty of the banking sector to complement the range of financial products with derivatives of exchange rate protection for that category of creditors who are exposed to it. At the end of his speech, Governor Seyko said that another important role of the banking sector is to provide payment services in the economy. In this respect, to improve the low-value payment market, the Bank of Albania has drafted the bill "For payment services", with whose approval the conditions for promoting technological innovations will be created, promoting the presentation of more efficient, faster and lower-cost instruments, which will increase competition in the market, As well as provide transparency and above all protection for the consumer. ... si_kontribuues_i_rendesishem_ne_zhvillimin_ekonomik_te_vendit.html Page 2 of 4 Governor Seyko's discussion meeting with the banking sector themed "That... kar as an important contributor to the country's economic development" 29/07/22, 13:34 Governor Seyko's word In his address, Albanian Banking Association Chairman Silvio Pedrazzi said that the banking sector presents itself as stable and cash, a complete prerequisite for quality lending of the economy. Mr. Pedrazzi called on businesses to present new financing projects, projects that generate employment growth in the economy. In conclusion, he expressed the commitment of the banking sector to contribute to the further economic development of the country. Word of albanian Bank Association Chairman Pedrazzi Furthermore, the meeting came with two specific presentations "Can more be done for increased lending and how?" and "Modernization of payment systems", which were followed by active discussions of attendees on the topics presented and issues raised during presentations. Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, July 3, 2019 29/07/22, 13:34 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, July 3, 2019 Publication date: 03.07.2019 Honored media representatives, Today, at the meeting dated 3 July 2019, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Intermediate Monetary Policy Report. The new information received in the analysis has been at the lower end of our expectations. The Albanian economy has been growing during the first two quarters, but at slower rates compared to last year. Inflation continues to remain below target, mainly as a result of the restraining effect that continues to give the rapid strengthening of the exchange rate over the past year. On the other hand, monetary conditions present stimulus and lending activity has shown signs of recovery. Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, August 7, 2019 29/07/22, 13:34 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, August 7, 2019 Publication date: 07.08.2019 Honored media representatives, Today, at the meeting dated 7 August 2019, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania considered and approved the Quarterly Monetary Policy Report. New information obtained in the analysis shows a slowdown in economic growth in the first half of the year and a drop in the average inflation rate in the second quarter. The kahu of these developments was expected by the Bank of Albania, but slowing growth rates resulted in higher than our expectations. Analysis of available information suggests that this dynamic reflects, to the greatest extent, the offer shock, the effect of which is expected to be short-term. The Bank of Albania expects an improvement in the pace of growth in the medium term, an improvement that will help return the economy to balance and inflation on target within this time horizon. The Supervisory Council considers that the current monetary policy position is appropriate to ensure that our objective is fulfilled. However, increasing uncertainties in the internal and external economic environment and increasing and strengthening the risks of lower kah may necessitate further easing of monetary policy stance in the future. The report's conclusions and reasons for this decision will be presented in more detail. ***  per_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_7_gusht_2019.html Page 1 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, August 7, 2019 29/07/22, 13:34 Inflation showed slight decline trends in the second quarter. Its average rate resulted in 1.4%, versus the 1.6% level recorded in the previous quarter. In the perspective of basket composition, the fall in inflation reflected the decline in food inflation, a phenomenon that is present and in foreign trading partners. In terms of macroeconomic factors, the fall in inflation reflected the fall in inflation of import items. On a more long-term time horizon, low and under-target inflation values reflect the still insufficient level of domestic inflationary pressures dictated by the still incomplete exploitation of production capacities - and the low pressures arising from imported inflation, dictated to a large extent by the still overpriced exchange rate. The Bank of Albania considers that the restraining effect of these factors will gradually come towards wear-down over the next two years. According to INSTAT data, the Albanian economy grew by 2.2% during the first quarter. This performance reflects a significant slowdown in the pace of growth, both compared to the previous quarter and compared to the same quarter a year ago. Analysis of available data suggests that slowing growth pace has come mainly as a result of declining electricity generation, in response to unfavourable climatic conditions. This slowing factor had a negative effect of 1.6 percentage points on first-quarter economic growth. Although not in this intensity, the impact of this factor is expected to be present for the remainder of the year. On the other hand, the main components of aggregate demand  consumption and private investment  have been rising, the balance of trade exchanges with abroad has deteriorated, as has the consequence of the decline in electricity production, while fiscal policy had a consolidating nature in the first quarter and easing in the second quarter.  per_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_7_gusht_2019.html Page 2 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, August 7, 2019 29/07/22, 13:34 The expansion of aggregate demand has been seen to enable employment growth, falling unemployment rates and continued wage growth over recent years. This trend was present in the first quarter of the current year. Although not favoured by the tense political climate, consumption and private investment have expanded in response to increased disposable income, the need to expand production capacities, as well as favourable financing conditions. Monetary stimulus policy has created a financial environment characterized by low interest rates and reduced risk premiums, driving increased lending, consumption and investment. Credit interest rates remained near historic lows and in the second quarter, enabling further improvement in lending activity. This improvement is noted both in accelerating to 6.8% of the pace of credit growth, as well as in expanding the basis of this growth. The continued reduction of troubled loans, the process of consolidating the banking sector, as well as the increasing trend in demand, have created premise for ever higher lending in the future. The exchange rate has shown mild derogatory tendencies during the summer months, in our judgment, as a result of the seasonal increase in currency flows. However, its annual overprice rate has come towards decline and the restraining effect it produces on the economy and inflation is coming towards reduction. *** The Bank of Albania estimates that economic growth will remain in positive territory in the medium term. The decline in electricity generation will bring a temporary slowdown in growth during 2019. Furthermore, favourable financing conditions and improved balancesheets of private agents are expected to bring the expansion of domestic demand and the fullest exploitation of production capacities. Designing these trends in the future, the Bank of Albania expects the Albanian economy to return to balance over the next year, creating premise for faster wage growth and domestic production costs. Together with the expected stabilization of the nominal exchange rate, they will help return inflation to the target in the second half of 2021. In particular, the Bank of Albania states that fluctuations in energy production have created added fluctuations in the pace of economic growth over the past three years. However, they have had no effects on its medium and long-term trend or production costs. Consequently, they do not affect our assessment of the country's cyclical position and should not be subject to monetary policy response. *** Judging on these forecasts and considerations, the Supervisory Council estimated that the current monetary policy position remains appropriate. Under these circumstances, he decided: Keep the basic interest rate unchanged at the current level of 1.00%;  per_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_7_gusht_2019.html Page 3 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, August 7, 2019 29/07/22, 13:34 and, keep deposit and one-day loan interest rates unchanged, respectively at levels 0.1% and 1.9%. The Supervisory Council estimated that meeting the basic scenario forecasts would require the preservation of monetary policy stimulus kah even in the medium term. This scenario predicts that monetary policy normalization will be quite gradual and  in any case  its beginning will not be earlier than the second quarter of 2020. On the other hand, the Supervisory Council confirmed that the uncertainties added to the economy have delayed the timeframe of the expected return of inflation to target. Also, the Supervisory Council confirmed that the risks of lower kah have been increased in numbers and increased in probability. These risks stem from both the external environment, where the Eurozone economy is appearing in constant and internal slowdowns, where political tension continues to induce uncertainty and where unexpected blows to the exchange rate can further avoid it from balance. The worsening of our basic scenario, or the materialization of risk shocks, may require a review into the easing direction of monetary policy stance. Finally, the Supervisory Council finds it appropriate to reiterate its call for the continuation of structural reforms, which have been and remain the main instrument of accelerating the pace of growth and integration into the European Union.  per_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_7_gusht_2019.html Page 4 of 4

Normat e interesit t kredis vijuan t mbeten pran niveleve m t ulta historike dhe n tremujorin e dyt, duke mundsuar prmirsimin e mtejshm t aktivitetit kreditues. Ky prmirsim vihet re si n prshpejtimin n 6.8% t ritmit t rritjes s kredis, ashtu dhe n zgjerimin e bazs s ksaj rritjeje. Reduktimi i vazhduar i kredive me probleme, procesi i konsolidimit t sektorit bankar, si dhe trendi rrits i krkess, kan krijuar premisa pr nj kreditim gjithnj e m t lart n t ardhmen. Kursi i kmbimit ka shfaqur tendenca t lehta mbimuese gjat muajve t vers, n gjykimin ton, si pasoj e rritjes sezonale t prurjeve t valuts. Megjithat, norma e mbimimit vjetor t tij ka ardhur drejt rnies dhe efekti frenues q ai prodhon n ekonomi dhe inflacion po vjen drejt reduktimit. *** Banka e Shqipris vlerson se rritja ekonomike do t vijoj t mbetet n territor pozitiv n afatin e mesm. Rnia e prodhimit t energjis elektrike do t sjell nj ngadalsim t prkohshm t rritjes gjat vitit 2019. M tej, kushtet e favorshme t financimit dhe bilancet e prmirsuara t agjentve privat, pritet t sjellin zgjerimin e krkess s brendshme dhe shfrytzimin m t plot t kapaciteteve prodhuese. Duke i projektuar kto trende n t ardhmen, Banka e Shqipris pret q ekonomia shqiptare t kthehet n ekuilibr gjat vitit t ardhshm, duke krijuar premisa pr rritje m t shpejt t pagave dhe t kostove t brendshme t prodhimit. S bashku me stabilizimin e pritur t kursit nominal t kmbimit, ato do t ndihmojn kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv n gjysmn e dyt t vitit 2021. N veanti, Banka e Shqipris konstaton se luhatjet e prodhimit t energjis kan krijuar luhatje t shtuara n ritmin e rritjes ekonomike gjat tre viteve t fundit. Megjithat, ato nuk kan pasur efekte n trendin afatmesm e afatgjat t saj apo n kostot e prodhimit. Pr rrjedhoj, ato nuk ndikojn vlersimin ton mbi pozicionin ciklik t vendit dhe nuk duhet t jen subjekt i reagimit t politiks monetare. *** Duke gjykuar mbi kto parashikime dhe konsiderata, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare mbetet i prshtatshm. N kto rrethana, ai vendosi: T mbaj t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit n nivelin aktual prej 1.00%; https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjper_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_7_gusht_2019.html Pagina 3 di 4 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 7 gusht 2019 29/07/22, 13:34 dhe, T mbaj t pandryshuara normat e interesit t depozits dhe t kredis njditore, prkatsisht n nivelet 0.1% dhe 1.9%. Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se prmbushja e parashikimeve t skenarit baz do t krkoj ruajtjen e kahut stimulues t politiks monetare edhe n afatin e mesm. Ky skenar parashikon se normalizimi i politiks monetare do t jet mjaft gradual dhe  n do rast  fillimi i tij nuk do t jet m i hershm se tremujori i dyt i vitit 2020. Nga ana tjetr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs konstatoi se pasigurit e shtuara n ekonomi kan shtyr momentin kohor t kthimit t pritur t inflacionit n objektiv. Po ashtu, Kshilli Mbikqyrs konstatoi se rreziqet e kahut t poshtm jan shtuar n numr dhe jan rritur n probabilitet. Kto rreziqe burojn si nga ambienti i jashtm, ku ekonomia e Eurozons po shfaqet n ngadalsim t vazhdueshm, ashtu dhe nga ai i brendshm, ku tensioni politik vazhdon t induktoj pasiguri dhe ku goditje t papritura n kursin e kmbimit mund ta shmangin at m tej nga ekuilibri. Prkeqsimi i skenarit ton baz apo materializimi i goditjeve t rrezikut, mund t krkoj nj rishikim n kahun lehtsues t qndrimit t politiks monetare. S fundi, Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjen me vend t prsris thirrjen e tij pr vijimin e reformave strukturore, t cilat kan qen dhe mbeten instrumenti kryesor i prshpejtimit t ritmit t rritjes dhe integrimit n Bashkimin Evropian. Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, October 2, 2019 29/07/22, 13:34 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, October 2, 2019 Publication date: 02.10.2019 Honored media representatives, At today's meeting, dated 2 October 2019, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Intermediate Monetary Policy Report. The Supervisory Council confirmed that new economic and financial information has generally been in line with expectations. Inflation marked a slight increase in the months of July and August, the rate of economic growth came to reflect the effect of short-term shocks, while financial conditions remain stimulating.  per_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_2_tetor_2019.html Page 1 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, October 2, 2019 29/07/22, 13:34 The Supervisory Council estimated that, despite the supply shocks, the trend of development of the Albanian economy remains positive. This performance is illustrated by the fullest exploitation of production capacities, rising employment and wages, as well as by accelerating lending. Based on the above, the Supervisory Council reconfirmed expectations on the positive performance of the economy in the future, but confirmed that the risks of the lower kah have been added. Under these circumstances, the Council assessed that the current monetary policy position is appropriate. *** Inflation marked an average value of 1.5% in the months of July August, compared to the average value of 1.4% of the second quarter. Inflation swings over the past few months have reflected food price fluctuations, while inflation of other basket items has generally been stabilized or with a slight increasing tendency. In macroeconomic terms, inflation performance has reflected strengthening domestic inflationary pressures, while imported inflation has come down. The latter has been influenced by the falling tendency of inflation and the prices of raw materials in world markets. According to INSTAT data, gross domestic product increased by 2.3% during the second quarter. (In parallel, INSTAT revised the growth rate upwards for the first quarter, reassessing it at 2.4%). From a production perspective, economic growth in the second quarter has been dictated by the expansion of activity in the services and agriculture sectors, while the industry and construction sectors have shown declines. From an aggregate demand perspective, the increase in economic activity has reflected the expansion of consumption, while investments and the balance of trade exchanges with abroad have had a negative effect. Preliminary data available for the third quarter suggest a similar performance to the previous quarter.  per_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_2_tetor_2019.html Page 2 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, October 2, 2019 29/07/22, 13:34 The slowing pace of growth in the first half of the year mainly reflects the reduction of electricity production and in part the effect of the completion of major energy projects. As above, the Bank of Albania expects these bid shocks to remain fleeting. Their effect will be evident in the growth rate of 2019, but it does not affect our assessment of the cyclic state of the economy and our expectations on the country's medium-term development trends. In this context, the increase in employment in the second quarter, in parallel with the fall in the unemployment rate to 11.5% and the increase by 4.5% of the average wage, suggest that the expansion of aggregate demand is sufficient to ensure increased exploitation of production capacities. This positive trend of developments also reflects the effect of our monetary stimulus policy. In response to our monetary stimulus, financial markets and monetary conditions remain accommodating to boosting aggregate demand and returning inflation to target. Financial markets are characterized by low interest rates, good liquidity situation, increased exchange rate sustainability, and a growing lending trend. In particular, credit for the private sector has been slowing the pace of growth, marking an average growth rate of 7.4% in the first two months of the third quarter. The increase in credit follows a broad basis, reflecting both the acceleration of lending in the businesses and individuals segment, and the expansion of credit in the lec and currency segment. The positive lending trend has benefited from rising demand and credit supply. The improvement in supply attests to the declining risk of lending in the country, as illustrated by the drop in the level of troubled loans in August to 11%, as well as the positive effect of restructuring the banking sector, through the entry of new actors into the market. ***  per_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_2_tetor_2019.html Page 3 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, October 2, 2019 29/07/22, 13:34 In reflection of the above information, updating our forecasts of economic growth and inflation did not bring about significant changes from the previous round. In our basic scenario, the Bank of Albania expects a continued growth of the economy over the medium-term horizon. Exceeding the effect of supply shocks is expected to be accompanied by an acceleration of growth rates over the following two years. The expansion of economic activity will be fuelled by favourable financial conditions and further expansion of lending, as well as will be supported by healthy private sector financial balances and improved confidence. Based on our projections, the Bank of Albania expects inflation to return to target in the second half of 2021. Judging on these forecasts, the Supervisory Council estimated that the current monetary policy position remains appropriate. Under these circumstances, he decided: Keep the basic interest rate unchanged at the current level of 1.00%; and, keep deposit and one-day loan interest rates unchanged, respectively at levels 0.1% and 1.9%. The Supervisory Council estimated that meeting the basic scenario forecasts will require the preservation of monetary policy stimulus kah across the entire medium-term horizon. This scenario predicts that monetary policy normalization will be quite gradual and  in any case  its beginning will not be earlier than the second quarter of 2020. On the other hand, the Supervisory Council follows to state that the risks of the lower kah have been further strengthened. These risks stem from both the external environment, where the Eurozone economy appears to be slowing, as well as from the internal one, where political tension continues to induce uncertainty. Starting from above, the Supervisory Council stresses that the materialization of risk shocks may require a review into the easing direction of monetary policy stance. The Bank of Albania calls for the continuation and acceleration of structural reforms, as the main instrument of increasing productivity, expanding economic potential, increasing resistance to shocks, and converging with European Union standards.  per_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_2_tetor_2019.html Page 4 of 4

Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, November 6, 2019 29/07/22, 13:34 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, November 6, 2019 Publication date: 06.11.2019 Honored media representatives, Today, at the meeting dated 6 November 2019, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania considered and approved the Quarterly Monetary Policy Report. The new information received in the analysis has generally been in line with our expectations. Economic growth was slow in the second quarter, in line with performance noted during the previous quarter, while inflation remained at low levels and below target in the third quarter. ... er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_6_nentor_2019.html Page 1 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, November 6, 2019 29/07/22, 13:34 In the Council's opinion, this performance is mostly dictated by temporary supply shocks. As such, it does not significantly change our expectations for the economy's performance in the medium term. Our forecasts, in their basic scenario, suggest that the pace of economic growth will improve over the next two years, enabling inflation to return to target within this time horizon. Under these circumstances, the current stimulus position of our monetary policy is estimated to be appropriate. However, the Supervisory Council notes that the risks of the lower kah have been strengthened and that their materialization could dictate a further easing of monetary policy. The following will present in more detail the report's conclusions and the reasons for the decision-making. *** Average third-quarter inflation resulted in 1.4% value, the same level as recorded in the previous quarter. The falling contribution of inflation of non-food consumer goods and housing services was offset by higher inflation of services category items and long-term consumer goods. In the macroeconomic plan, price performance has reflected strengthening domestic inflationary pressures and falling inflation in partner countries. Looking to the future, the Bank of Albania believes that rising wages and production costs, as well as stabilising the exchange rate, will create premise for the gradual return of inflation to the target. According to INSTAT data, the Albanian economy grew by 2.3% in the second quarter of the year. Economic growth is supported by expanding public and private consumption, while net exports and investments have marked declines. As well as in the first quarter, the slowing pace of growth reflects the decline in electricity production and export, the transitional effects of closing fortune games, and entering the final phase of work on a major project. ... er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_6_nentor_2019.html Page 2 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, November 6, 2019 29/07/22, 13:34 energy. These effects will also be present in the second half of the year. Consequently, the pace of economic growth in this period is expected to be comparable to that of the first half, but come to acceleration the next two years. The expansion of the volume of economic activity has reflected low consumer and investment financing costs, improved balances of economic agents, as well as increased revenues from tourism activity. The combination of monetary stimulus, fiscal consolidation and strengthening the health of the banking sector has produced a macroeconomic environment conducive to growth. In particular, the internal financial environment presents stimulus, in response to monetary policy pursued by the Bank of Albania. The performance of the exchange rate appears relatively stabilized: the ratio of the exchange of the lek to the euro is closer to balance, while its fluctuations appear to have been dictated by seasonal factors. Risk premiums in financial markets are low, while the liquidity situation is satisfactory. Interest rates on loans, deposits and letters of government value are close to minimum levels, driving credit growth and encouraging growth in consumption and investment. Credit to the private sector marked an average increase of 7.5% in the third quarter. Accelerating the pace of growth is dedicated to both expanding demand and improving the supply of bank credit. The latter reflects not only the continued improvement of the credit environment and the balance sheet of the banking sector, as shown by the decline in the ratio of troubled loans to 10.6% level - but also the increase in competition in the system, with the completion of the banking sector consolidation process. From a composition point of view, accelerating the pace of credit growth has had a broad basis, in terms of currency structure, beneficiaries, as well as its destination. This is another encouraging signal for the expansion of credit in the future. Fiscal policy continues to maintain its consolidating direction, but the intensity of fiscal consolidation has decreased. This development reflects the fastest increase in spending compared to public income, although the budget deficit continues to remain at low levels. The Bank of Albania follows to stress the importance of strengthening the health of public finances, through maintaining the focus on controlling the budget deficit and through further reforms to improve the management of public finances. Further expansion of aggregate demand has enabled continued employment growth and falling unemployment rate. The latter scored 11.5% in the second quarter, recording the historical minimum levels of this indicator. Rising demand for jobs has created premise for increasing wages and production costs. According to INSTAT data, the average wage level in the economy increased by 4.5% in the second quarter, reflecting the positive trend started in 2017. *** The Bank of Albania considers that the Albanian economy will continue to remain in a positive growth trend over the medium-term horizon, ensuring an increasingly full exploitation of production capacities. ... er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_6_nentor_2019.html Page 3 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, November 6, 2019 29/07/22, 13:34 Projections of our basic scenario suggest that the Albanian economy will return to balance over the next year, creating premise for faster wage growth and production costs. Together with the expected stabilization of the nominal exchange rate, they will help return inflation to the target in the second half of 2021. *** Judging on these forecasts, the Supervisory Council estimated that the current monetary policy position remains appropriate. Under these circumstances, he decided: Keep the basic interest rate unchanged at the current level of 1.00%; and, keep deposit and one-day loan interest rates unchanged, respectively at levels 0.1% and 1.9%. The Supervisory Council estimated that meeting the basic scenario forecasts would require the preservation of monetary policy stimulus kah even in the medium term. This scenario predicts that monetary policy normalization will be quite gradual and - in any case - its beginning will not be earlier than the second quarter of 2020. On the other hand, the Supervisory Council states that the risks of the lower kah remain present. Zgjerimi i vllimit t aktivitetit ekonomik ka pasqyruar kostot e ulta t financimit t konsumit dhe investimeve, bilancet e prmirsuara t agjentve ekonomik, si dhe rritjen e t ardhurave nga aktiviteti i turizmit. Kombinimi i stimulit monetar, konsolidimit fiskal dhe forcimit t shndetit t sektorit bankar, ka prodhuar nj ambient makroekonomik t favorshm pr rritje. N veanti, ambienti i brendshm financiar paraqitet stimulues, n prgjigje t politiks monetare t ndjekur nga Banka e Shqipris. Ecuria e kursit t kmbimit shfaqet relativisht e stabilizuar: raporti i kmbimit t lekut me euron sht m afr ekuilibrit, ndrsa luhatjet e tij duket se jan diktuar nga faktor sezonal. Primet e rrezikut n tregjet financiare jan t ulta, ndrsa gjendja e likuiditetit sht e knaqshme. Kredia pr sektorin privat shnoi nj rritje mesatare prej 7.5% n tremujorin e tret. Prshpejtimi i ritmit t rritjes i dedikohet si zgjerimit t krkess, ashtu dhe prmirsimit t oferts s kredis bankare. Kjo e fundit, pasqyron jo vetm prmirsimin e vazhdueshm t ambientit t kreditit dhe t bilancit t sektorit bankar sikundr tregohet nga rnia n nivelin 10.6% e raportit t kredive me probleme  por edhe rritjen e konkurrencs n sistem, me prfundimin e procesit t konsolidimit t sektorit bankar. Ky sht nj sinjal tjetr inkurajues pr zgjerimin e kredis n t ardhmen. Politika fiskale vijon t ruaj kahun e saj konsolidues, por intensiteti i konsolidimit fiskal sht ulur. Ky zhvillim pasqyron rritjen m t shpejt t shpenzimeve n raport me t ardhurat publike, ndonse deficiti buxhetor vijon t mbetet n nivele t ulta. Banka e Shqipris vijon t theksoj rndsin e forcimit t shndetit t financave publike, nprmjet ruajtjes s fokusit n kontrollin e deficitit buxhetor dhe nprmjet reformave t mtejshme pr prmirsimin e administrimit t financave publike. Nga ana tjetr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs konstaton se rreziqet e kahut t poshtm mbeten t pranishme. Kto rreziqe burojn si nga ambienti i jashtm, ku ekonomia e Eurozons po shfaqet n ngadalsim t vazhdueshm, ashtu dhe nga ai i brendshm, ku tensioni politik vazhdon t induktoj pasiguri dhe ku goditje t papritura n kursin e kmbimit mund ta shmangin at m tej nga ekuilibri. Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, December 18, 2019 29/07/22, 13:34 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, December 18, 2019 Publication date: 18.12.2019 Honored media representatives, [ Let me start this communication somewhat differently, expressing, in the first place and on behalf of the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania, the deepest regret for all those who lost relatives and those who suffered physical and material damage from the earthquake dated November 26th. National disasters of these sizes require courage, solidarity and joint work, for addressing the consequences and for the full recovery of affected businesses, families and communities. Honored media representatives, Page 1 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, December 18, 2019 29/07/22, 13:34 Today, at its meeting dated 18 December 2019, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania considered and approved the Intermediate Monetary Policy Report. The information available does not dictate the need for a change in monetary policy stance. The Supervisory Council estimated that meeting the price stability target and supporting economic growth make it necessary to pursue a monetary stimulus policy. However, the Supervisory Council notes that the full assessment of the economic consequences of the earthquake still takes time. This assessment will pave the way for the revision of our medium-term forecasts and the judgment on monetary policy that we will follow in the future. Available data shows that fourth-quarter inflation has stayed at levels almost the same as in the previous quarter. Inflation fluctuations have been dictated to the greatest extent by the fluctuations in food prices, which continue to make and the main contribution to inflation. In the macroeconomic plan, price performance follows to reflect low inflationary pressures coming from the foreign and domestic economy. Price growth in international markets is slow, while its follow-up to the domestic market has been curbed and further curbed by strengthening the exchange rate during 2018. Likewise, rising aggregate demand, employment and wages in Albania has not yet translated into sufficient inflationary pressures for turning inflation into targets. The indirect data available suggests that third-quarter economic growth has been at levels approximate to that of the previous quarter. The expansion of economic activity appears to have been supported by increased consumption and private investment and, in particular, by expanding tourism revenues. The performance of the economy is also reflected in the labour market data for the third quarter, which show the 3.3% increase in employment in annual terms, the drop to 11.4% of the unemployment rate and the 3.5% increase in the average wage in the economy. Page 2 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, December 18, 2019 29/07/22, 13:34 The improving trend of aggregate demand indicators and the scale of capacity exploitation has also reflected the effect of our monetary stimulus policy. This policy has provided a financial environment characterized by low interest rates, controlled risk premiums and low volatility, helping and sustainability of the exchange rate. The favourable financial environment and improved demand and loan supply have dictated a further improvement in lending. In particular, the consolidation of the banking sector and the reduction of credit risk, as illustrated by the fall in the 9.5% ratio of troubled loans in November, have dictated a more active approach of banks towards lending. Cleaned up by the exchange rate effect and the effect of extracting lost loans off the balance sheet, the loan to the private sector recorded an annual increase of 8% in the month of October. This increase has shown a broad basis. It has been fuelled by the expansion of lending both in the individual segment and in that of businesses. In this context, it is worth pointing out that increasing loans for investment purposes to business gives encouraging signals for increased support for the needs for economy funds from the banking sector. Similarly, encouraging signals towards increasing monetary policy effectiveness come from the progressive expansion of the loan weight to the total. This indicator marked the value 48% in the month of October. *** Our previous forecasts have suggested that inflation will follow an increasing trajectory on the medium-term horizon, to return to target in the second half of 2021. This forecast was based on an expected improvement in the pace of economic growth, which would increase wages and production costs, and higher exchange rate sustainability, which would facilitate the follow-up of foreign inflationary pressures. In consistency with these forecasts, the Supervisory Council has stressed that the current monetary policy position has been appropriate, that monetary policy will remain accommodative in the medium term, and that the intensity of monetary stimulus will be adjusted in line with the speed of returning inflation to the target. In general terms, the Supervisory Council considers that  even in the presence of earthquake consequences dated 26 November  this projection framework remains valid for the medium term. However, these consequences are  in most of them  negative and can dictate a time delay in returning the economy to balance and inflation on target. As above, the Supervisory Council notes: - First, in the absence of full official estimates on the scale and size of the damage, it is almost impossible to make accurate assessments on the expected impact on the economy. In particular, it is important to highlight damage to business production capacities, whether these operators of the tourism sector or other sectors of the economy, to assess the costs of reconstruction and the possible lack of income in the economy. Page 3 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, December 18, 2019 29/07/22, 13:34 -Second, the consequences of the earthquake are expected to be  on the whole  negative, although they will be concentrated in a geographically limited area and not the same in the sectors of the economy. The main broadcasting channels will be the possible shrinking of consumption and private investment in the affected areas, as well as the possible decline in production in them  especially in the tourism sector. On the other hand, the re-construction programme is expected to give a positive stimulus to this sector. The intensity of the strikes and the scale of their compensation from the re-construction programme will also determine the overall effect of the earthquake on the economy. - Third, the effect of the earthquake will also depend on the shape and intensity of the response. The Supervisory Council notes that rapid damage management would ease their impact on the economy. Also, the financing structure of this reconstruction programme and the relative weight of grants and donations, increased borrowing, and relocation of expenses will also have an impact. - Fourth, the Bank of Albania is in the process of assessing the consequences of the earthquake in the indicators of the banking sector. For this reason, we have requested the necessary information close to the banks and are awaiting preliminary assessments. - Finally, the Supervisory Council points out that even testing extreme scenarios suggests that: -The rate of economic growth is expected to remain in positive territory for 2020 and beyond; - The country's monetary and financial stability remains intact. *** Considering the above, the Supervisory Council decided: -Keep the basic interest rate unchanged at the current level of 1.00%; And, -Keep deposit and one-day loan interest rates unchanged, respectively at levels 0.1% and 1.9%. The Supervisory Council estimated that meeting our price stability target will require maintaining monetary policy stimulus kah even in the medium term. Clarifying the consequences of the earthquake will enable a more accurate picture of expected developments in the future and the position of monetary policy. In particular, materializing strong negative shocks may require further easing of it. Page 4 of 4

Megjithat, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vren se vlersimi i plot i pasojave ekonomike t trmetit krkon ende koh. Ky vlersim do ti hap rrug rishikimit t parashikimeve tona afatmesme dhe gjykimit mbi politikn monetare q do t ndjekim n t ardhmen. T dhnat e disponuara tregojn se inflacioni i tremujorit t katrt ka qndruar n nivele pothuajse t njjta me ato t tremujorit paraardhs. Luhatjet e inflacionit jan diktuar n masn m t madhe nga luhatjet e mimeve t ushqimeve, t cilat vijojn t japin dhe kontributin kryesor n inflacion. N planin makroekonomik, ecuria e mimeve vijon t reflektoj presionet e ulta inflacioniste q vijn nga ekonomia e huaj edhe ajo vendase. Rritja e mimeve n tregjet ndrkombtare sht e ngadalt, ndrsa prcjellja e saj n tregun vendas sht frenuar dhe m tej nga forcimi i kursit t kmbimit gjat vitit 2018. T dhnat e trthorta t disponuara sugjerojn se rritja ekonomike e tremujorit t tret ka qen n nivele t prafrta m at t tremujorit paraardhs. Kjo politik ka siguruar nj ambient financiar t karakterizuar nga norma t ulta interesi, nga prime t kontrolluara rreziku dhe volatilitet i ult, duke ndihmuar dhe qndrueshmrin e kursit t kmbimit. Ambienti i favorshm financiar dhe prmirsimi i krkess dhe oferts pr kredi kan diktuar nj prmirsim t mtejshm t kreditimit. N veanti, konsolidimi i sektorit bankar dhe reduktimi i rrezikut t kreditit, sikundr ilustrohet nga rnia n nivelin 9.5% e raportit t kredive me probleme n muajin nntor, kan diktuar nj prqasje m aktive t bankave drejt kreditimit. E pastruar nga efekti i kursit t kmbimit dhe ai i nxjerrjes s kredive t humbura jasht bilancit, kredia pr sektorin privat regjistroi nj rritje vjetore prej 8% n muajin tetor. Kjo rritje ka shfaqur nj baz t gjer. Ajo sht ushqyer nga zgjerimi i kreditimit si n segmentin e individve dhe n at t bizneseve. N kt kontekst, vlen t theksohet se rritja e kredive pr qllime investimi ndaj biznesit jep sinjale inkurajuese pr nj mbshtetje n rritje t nevojave pr fonde t ekonomis nga sektori bankar. Po ashtu, sinjale inkurajuese n drejtim t rritjes s efektivitetit t politiks monetare vijn nga zgjerimi progresiv i peshs s kredis n lek ndaj totalit. Ky tregues shnoi vlern 48% n muajin tetor. *** Parashikimet tona t mparshme kan sugjeruar se inflacioni do t ndjek nj trajektore rritse n horizontin afatmesm, pr tu kthyer n objektiv n gjysmn e dyt t vitit 2021. Ky parashikim mbshtetej n prmirsimin e pritur t ritmit t rritjes ekonomike, ka do t rriste pagat dhe kostot e prodhimit, dhe n nj qndrueshmri m t lart t kursit t kmbimit, ka do t lehtsonte prcjelljen e presioneve t huaja inflacioniste. N konsistenc me kto parashikime, Kshilli Mbikqyrs ka theksuar se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare ka qen i prshtatshm, se politika monetare do t vijoj t mbetet akomoduese n afatin e mesm, dhe se intensiteti i stimulit monetar do t rregullohet n prputhje me shpejtsin e kthimit t inflacionit n objektiv. N terma t prgjithshme, Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjykon se  edhe n prani t pasojave t trmetit t dats 26 nntor  ky kuadr projeksionesh mbetet i vlefshm pr afatin e mesm. Megjithat, kto pasoja jan  n shumicn e tyre  negative dhe mund t diktojn nj vones kohore n kthimin e ekonomis n ekuilibr dhe t inflacionit n objektiv. Sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vren: - S pari, n munges t vlersimeve t plota zyrtare mbi shkalln dhe madhsin e dmit, sht pothuaj e pamundur t bhen vlersime t sakta mbi ndikimin e pritur n ekonomi. N veanti, rndsi ka evidentimi i dmeve n kapacitetet prodhuese t biznesit, qofshin kta operator t sektorit t turizmit apo t sektorve t tjer t ekonomis, pr t vlersuar kostot e rindrtimit dhe t ardhurat e mundshme t munguara n ekonomi. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fj_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_18_dhjetor_2019.html Pagina 3 di 4 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 18 dhjetor 2019 29/07/22, 13:34 -S dyti, pasojat e trmetit pritet t jet  n trsi  negative, ndonse ato do t jen t prqendruara n nj zon t kufizuar gjeografike dhe jo t njjta n sektort e ekonomis. Kanalet kryesore t transmetimit do t jen tkurrja e mundshme e konsumit dhe investimeve private n zonat e prekura, si dhe rnia e mundshme e prodhimit n to  sidomos n sektorin e turizmit. Nga ana tjetr, programi i ri-ndrtimit pritet ti jap nj stimul pozitiv ktij sektori. Intensiteti i goditjeve dhe shkalla e kompensimit t tyre nga programi i ri-ndrtimit do prcaktojn dhe efektin trsor t trmetit n ekonomi. -S treti, efekti i trmetit do t varet dhe nga forma dhe intensiteti i prgjigjes. Kshilli Mbikqyrs vren se adresimi me shpejtsi i dmeve do t lehtsonte ndikimin e tyre n ekonomi. Po ashtu, ndikim do t ket dhe struktura e financimit t ktij programi rindrtimi dhe pesha relative e granteve dhe donacioneve, rritjes s huamarrjes, dhe ri-alokimit t shpenzimeve. -S katrti, Banka e Shqipris sht n proces t vlersimit t pasojave t trmetit n treguesit e sektorit bankar. Pr kt arsye, ne kemi krkuar informacionin e nevojshm pran bankave dhe jemi n pritje t vlersimeve paraprake. -S fundi, Kshilli Mbikqyrs thekson se dhe testimi i skenarve ekstrem sugjeron se: -norma e rritjes ekonomike pritet t mbetet n territor pozitiv pr vitin 2020 e m tej; -stabiliteti monetar dhe financiar i vendit mbetet i paprekur. *** Duke marr n konsiderat sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi: -T mbaj t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit n nivelin aktual prej 1.00%; dhe, -T mbaj t pandryshuara normat e interesit t depozits dhe t kredis njditore, prkatsisht n nivelet 0.1% dhe 1.9%. Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se prmbushja e objektivit ton t stabilitetit t mimeve do t krkoj ruajtjen e kahut stimulues t politiks monetare edhe n afatin e mesm. Qartsimi i pasojave t trmetit do t mundsoj nj tablo m t sakt mbi zhvillimet e pritura n t ardhmen dhe qndrimin e politiks monetare. Title: Speech of the Governor at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, February 5, 2020 29/07/22, 13:34 Governor's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, February 5, 2020 Publication date: 05.02.2020 Honored media representatives, Today, at the meeting dated 5 February 2020, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and adopted the Quarterly Monetary Policy Report. New information taken in the analysis suggests that economic activity in the country was hit by the earthquake dated November 26, but this impact has not damaged the medium and long-term development trend. The aftermath of the earthquake is expected to have a slowing resulting effect on growth and inflation, but this slowdown is expected to be temporary and concentrated during 2020. Updating the basic scenario of our forecasts suggests that the pace of growth will accelerate in the medium term. This acceleration is expected to bring the economy back to balance and inflation on target within 2021. Under these circumstances, the Supervisory Council estimated that the current level of monetary stimulus would remain appropriate. In parallel with the basic scenario, the Supervisory Council confirmed that the risks of the lower kah have been added. Materializing them would require a revision to the easing of monetary policy stance. The following will present in more detail the report's conclusions and the reasons for the decision-making.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_5_shkurt_2020.html Page 1 of 5 Governor's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, February 5, 2020 29/07/22, 13:34 Fourth quarter average inflation recorded 1.3% value, marking declines compared to the previous quarter and remaining below our 3% target. The fall in the inflation rate reflected the slowest rise in food prices, a phenomenon that was particularly present in the month of December. Meanwhile, prices of other basket items marked scant fluctuations. In macroeconomic terms, low and below-target inflation rates reflect still insufficient growth in wages and domestic production costs, low inflation in our trading partners, as well as the back-to-back effects of rapidly strengthening the exchange rate during 2018. The deterrent effect of these factors will gradually ease in the medium term. According to INSTAT data, the Albanian economy marked an annual growth of 3.8% in the third quarter, accelerating against the first half of the year and being at the upper end of our expectations. In sectoral terms, this acceleration was dictated by the good tourist season and the reduction of the negative effect coming from the decline in electricity production. In terms of aggregate demand, it reflected faster growth in consumption and exports, while private investment marked declines. The expansion of aggregate demand has been coupled with the gradual improvement of the country's cyclical position over the past four years. In response to these trends, the unemployment rate scored 11.4% in the third quarter, which also constitutes the lowest historical rate recorded in Albania, while the average wage recorded an annual increase of 3.7%. However, rising wages and production costs still remain insufficient to return inflation to the target, which proves that the Albanian economy is still far from fully employing its production capacities.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_5_shkurt_2020.html Page 2 of 5 Governor's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, February 5, 2020 29/07/22, 13:34 The information available on fourth-quarter economic developments is still not complete. Analysis of preliminary data suggests that the earthquake dated November 26th had a negative impact on the pace of economic growth. This impact is expected to be carried even during 2020. Damage to business environments, increased uncertainty and reorientation of spending towards damage repair are expected to materialise in slowing production in some sectors, including tourism. On the other hand, the reconstruction process is expected to give an increased positive effect, but this effect will be later in time compared to that of negative shocks, nor sufficiently strong to compensate for their effects. Judging on available information and world experience, the Bank of Albania estimates that the earthquake has not damaged the country's medium-term and long-term growth and development bases. Damage repair and normalisation of the situation will help to regenerate production capacities and faster expansion of aggregate demand in 2021, and onwards. Increasing employment and wages will support the expansion of family consumption, increasing the scale of capacity exploitation will increase the demand for investment, while Albanian exports will continue to benefit from the expansion of the tourism sector. In parallel with them, the overall financial environment is favourable. Financial markets are relatively calm, financing costs are low, while the exchange rate presents itself more stable. Our monetary stimulus policy, the restructuring of the banking sector and the improvement of its balance sheets have driven a faster increase in lending. The loan portfolio marked an average increase of 7.8% during the fourth quarter, supported by the expansion of business credit and credit in money. The credit growth structure gives encouraging signals, both in terms of its impact on economic growth and for the quality of the loan portfolio in the long term. At the same time, the ratio of troubled loans dropped to 8.4% in December, reflecting concrete measures undertaken by the Bank of Albania to reduce them, as well as improving the economic environment and financial situation of creditors.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_5_shkurt_2020.html Page 3 of 5 Governor's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, February 5, 2020 29/07/22, 13:34 Looking to the future, the Bank of Albania considers that the impact of the earthquake on the economy is expected to be concentrated in 2020. This year's economic growth and average inflation are expected to be at levels comparable to rates scored during 2019. On the other hand, exceeding the consequences of the earthquake is expected to give way to a faster growth of the economy and inflation in the following period. Compared to the previous round, our basic projection shows a noticeable movement in the lower direction for 2020, but preserves the same trajectories for 2021 and beyond. These forecasts have an added dose of uncertainty, which is largely linked to the impossibility of accurately predicting the impact of the earthquake on economic growth. Likewise, the balance of risks around our central forecast is shifting to the lower direction. Judging on these forecasts, the Supervisory Council estimated that the current monetary policy position remains appropriate. Under these circumstances, he decided: Keep the basic interest rate unchanged at the current level of 1.00%; and, keep deposit and one-day loan interest rates unchanged, respectively at levels 0.1% and 1.9%. The Supervisory Council estimated that meeting our price stability target will require preserving monetary policy stimulus throughout the medium-term horizon. On the other hand, the Supervisory Council states that the risks of the lower kah remain present. These risks stem from both the external environment, where the improvement of the Eurozone economy still remains fragile and from the internal environment. In particular, the Supervisory Council estimates that the potential risks with potential negative impact are: A stronger intensity of the negative effects of the earthquake on the performance of the economy throughout 2020 and on. This scenario could materialize if the psychological effects of the earthquake outweigh its material impact on the economy. Time delay in the reconstruction programme, or a greater reliance on internal funding sources. Addressing these risks remains the attribute of central and local governance structures, but materializing them would require a review of monetary policy stance. Finally, the Supervisory Council stresses the need to further accelerate structural reforms, as the main instrument for generating rapid, sustainable and long-term economic growth, as well as the need to preserve the focus of economic policies towards maintaining the country's long-term sustainability.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_5_shkurt_2020.html Page 4 of 5 Governor's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, February 5, 2020 29/07/22, 13:34  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_5_shkurt_2020.html Page 5 of 5

N vijim do t paraqes m n detaje konkluzionet e raportit dhe arsyet e vendimmarrjes. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjer_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_5_shkurt_2020.html Pagina 1 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 5 shkurt 2020 29/07/22, 13:34 *** Inflacioni mesatar i tremujorit t katrt regjistroi vlern 1.3%, duke shnuar rnie krahasuar me tremujorin paraardhs dhe duke mbetur posht objektivit ton prej 3%. Rnia e norms s inflacionit pasqyroi rritjen m t ngadalt t mimeve t ushqimeve, nj fenomen ky i pranishm veanrisht n muajin dhjetor. Ndrkoh, mimet e artikujve t tjer t shports shnuan luhatje t pakta. N aspektin makroekonomik, normat e ulta dhe nn objektiv t inflacionit pasqyrojn rritjen ende t pamjaftueshme t pagave dhe t kostove t brendshme t prodhimit, inflacionin e ult n partnert tan tregtar, si dhe efektet prapavepruese t forcimit t shpejt t kursit t kmbimit gjat vitit 2018. Efekti frenues i ktyre faktorve do t zbutet gradualisht n afatin e mesm. Sipas t dhnave t INSTAT-it, ekonomia shqiptare shnoi nj rritje vjetore prej 3.8% n tremujorin e tret, duke u prshpejtuar kundrejt gjysms s par t vitit dhe duke qen n kahun e siprm t pritjeve tona. N terma sektorial, ky prshpejtim u diktua nga sezoni i mir turistik dhe reduktimi i efektit negativ t ardhur nga rnia e prodhimit t energjis elektrike. N terma t krkess agregate, ai pasqyroi rritjen m t shpejt t konsumit dhe eksporteve, ndrkoh q investimet private shnuan rnie. Zgjerimi i krkess agregate sht shoqruar me prmirsimin gradual t pozicionit ciklik t vendit gjat katr viteve t fundit. Megjithat, rritja e pagave dhe e kostove t prodhimit mbetet ende e pamjaftueshme pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv, ka dshmon se ekonomia shqiptare sht ende larg punsimit t plot t kapaciteteve t saj prodhuese. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjer_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_5_shkurt_2020.html Pagina 2 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 5 shkurt 2020 29/07/22, 13:34 Informacioni i disponuar mbi zhvillimet ekonomike t tremujorit t katrt sht ende jo i plot. Analiza e t dhnave paraprake sugjeron se trmeti i dats 26 nntor pati nj ndikim negativ n ritmin e rritjes ekonomike. Ky ndikim pritet t mbartet edhe gjat vitit 2020. Dmtimi i ambienteve t biznesit, rritja e pasiguris dhe riorientimi i shpenzimeve drejt riparimit t dmeve, pritet t materializohen n ngadalsim t prodhimit n disa sektor, prfshi dhe turizmin. Nga ana tjetr, procesi i rindrtimit pritet t jap nj efekt pozitiv n rritje, por ky efekt do t jet m i von n koh krahasuar me at t goditjeve negative dhe as mjaftueshmrisht i fort sa t kompensoj efektet e tyre. Duke gjykuar mbi informacionin e disponuar dhe prvojn botrore, Banka e Shqipris vlerson se trmeti nuk ka dmtuar bazat afatmesme dhe afatgjata t rritjes e zhvillimit t vendit. Riparimi i dmeve dhe normalizimi i situats do t ndihmoj n rigjenerimin e kapaciteteve prodhuese dhe zgjerimin m t shpejt t krkess agregate n vitin 2021, e n vazhdim. Rritja e punsimit dhe e pagave do t mbshtes zgjerimin e konsumit familjar, rritja e shkalls s shfrytzimit t kapaciteteve do t rris krkesn pr investime, ndrsa eksportet shqiptare do t vijojn t prfitojn nga zgjerimi i sektorit t turizmit. Paralelisht me to, ambienti i prgjithshm financiar paraqitet i favorshm. Tregjet financiare jan relativisht t qeta, kostot e financimit jan t ulta, ndrsa kursi i kmbimit paraqitet m i qndrueshm. Politika jon monetare stimuluese, ristrukturimi i sektorit bankar dhe prmirsimi i bilanceve t tij, kan nxitur nj rritje m t shpejt t kreditimit. Portofoli i kredis shnoi nj rritje mesatare prej 7.8% gjat tremujorit t katrt, i mbshtetur nga zgjerimi i kredis pr biznese dhe i kredis n lek. Struktura e rritjes s kredis jep sinjale inkurajuese, si pr sa i takon ndikimit t saj n rritjen ekonomike ashtu dhe pr cilsin e portofolit t kredis n afatin e gjat. N t njjtn koh, raporti i kredive me probleme zbriti n nivelin 8.4% n muajin dhjetor, duke pasqyruar masat konkrete t ndrmarra t nga Banka e Shqipris pr reduktimin e tyre, si dhe prmirsimin e ambientit ekonomik dhe t gjendjes financiare t kredimarrsve. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjer_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_5_shkurt_2020.html Pagina 3 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 5 shkurt 2020 29/07/22, 13:34 Duke par nga e ardhmja, Banka e Shqipris gjykon se ndikimi i trmetit n ekonomi pritet t jet i prqendruar n vitin 2020. Rritja ekonomike dhe inflacioni mesatar i ktij viti pritet t jen n nivele t krahasueshme me normat e shnuara gjat vitit 2019. Nga ana tjetr, tejkalimi i pasojave t trmetit pritet ti hap rrug nj rritjeje m t shpejt t ekonomis dhe t inflacionit n periudhn pasuese. Krahasuar me raundin paraardhs, projeksioni yn baz shfaq nj lvizje t dukshme n kahun e poshtm pr vitin 2020, por ruan t njjtat trajektore pr vitet 2021 e n vazhdim. Kto parashikime kan nj doz t shtuar pasigurie, e cila lidhet n masn m t madhe me pamundsin e parashikimit t sakt t ndikimit t trmetit n rritjen ekonomike. Po ashtu, balanca e rreziqeve rreth parashikimit ton qendror sht e zhvendosur n kahun e poshtm. *** Duke gjykuar mbi kto parashikime, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare mbetet i prshtatshm. N kto rrethana, ai vendosi: T mbaj t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit n nivelin aktual prej 1.00%; dhe, T mbaj t pandryshuara normat e interesit t depozits dhe t kredis njditore, prkatsisht n nivelet 0.1% dhe 1.9%. Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se prmbushja e objektivit ton t stabilitetit t mimeve do t krkoj ruajtjen e kahut stimulues t politiks monetare prgjat gjith horizontit afatmesm. Nga ana tjetr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs konstaton se rreziqet e kahut t poshtm mbeten t pranishme. Kto rreziqe burojn si nga ambienti i jashtm, ku prmirsimi i ekonomis s Eurozons mbetet ende i brisht, ashtu dhe nga ai i brendshm. N veanti, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlerson se rreziqet potenciale me ndikim t mundshm negativ jan: Nj intensitet m i fort i efekteve negative t trmetit n ecurin e ekonomis prgjat vitit 2020 e n vazhdim. Ky skenar mund t materializohet nse efektet psikologjike t trmetit tejkalojn ndikimin e tij material n ekonomi. Vonesa kohore n programin e rindrtimit, apo nj mbshtetje m e madhe e tij n burimet e brendshme t financimit. Adresimi i ktyre rreziqeve mbetet atribut i strukturave t qeverisjes qendrore dhe vendore, por materializimi i tyre do t krkonte nj rishikim n kahun lehtsues t qndrimit t politiks monetare. S fundi, Kshilli Mbikqyrs thekson nevojn e prshpejtimit t mtejshm t reformave strukturore, si instrumenti kryesor pr gjenerimin e nj rritjeje ekonomike t shpejt, t qndrueshme dhe afatgjat, si dhe nevojn e ruajtjes s fokusit t politikave ekonomike drejt ruajtjes s qndrueshmris afatgjat t vendit. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjer_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_5_shkurt_2020.html Pagina 4 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 5 shkurt 2020 Copyright  2018 Banka e Shqipris. Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, March 25, 2020 29/07/22, 13:34 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, March 25, 2020 Publication date: 25.03.2020 Honorable public, I am in front of you today, in this unusual form of communication, to let you know the bank of Albania's latest monetary policy decision. This decision is taken in progress by the Bank of Albania's previous measures to mitigate the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the country's economic and financial health. Today, at the meeting dated 25 March 2020, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania decided to further ease the position of monetary policy and monetary and financial conditions in the country. More specifically, the Supervisory Council decided:  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_25_mars_2020.html Page 1 of 3 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, March 25, 2020 29/07/22, 13:34 Lower the basic interest rate, from 1.0% to 0.5%; Lower the one-day loan interest rate from 1.9% to 0.9%; Keep the one-day deposit interest rate unchanged at 0.1%. The spread of the COVID-19 pandemic in Albania poses a challenge to our economy and financial sector. The necessary care measures, taken by public and private authorities to limit the spread of the COVID-19 virus in the population, will also have a dual impact on economic activity. On the one hand, the temporary reduction in production and employment brings down the supply of goods and services to the market and the reduction of household incomes. On the other hand, social distancing brings down demand, as well as shrinking sales, revenues and liquidity of businesses. In the Supervisory Council's judgment, lowering the basic interest rate is a necessary measure for reducing the cost of new borrowing, reducing the cost of serving existing debt and facilitating liquidity circulation in Albanian businesses and households. It helps the functioning of the monetary policy transmission mechanism as normal as possible, as well as relieves pressure on the financial balances of economic operators, giving them more time, space and breathing to cope with the blow. This decision today complements the other measures we have taken to minimize the effects of pandemics. Over the last few days: The Bank of Albania has increased operational capacities to guarantee the supply of the economy with currency and banknotes, as well as to guarantee the normal functioning of the electronic payment system. Within the time limit of movement imposed by public authorities, all economic operators should be aware that the payment system will operate normally. The Bank of Albania has adopted the operational strategy of unlimited liquidity injection into the banking sector. This sector, and through it businesses, families and the public sector, will have the opportunity to attract to the Bank of Albania all the liquidity needed and required of them. The Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania decided to facilitate delay procedures by a quarter of the payment of loan installments to businesses and families affected by the crisis, providing the banking sector with the necessary regulatory spaces to do so. These measures we have taken, within our field of competence, enable and complement the fiscal package proclaimed by the Albanian government, which aims to shift part of the financial bill of coping with the crisis from the private sector to the public sector. The Supervisory Council remains in constant monitoring of the situation. In line with measures taken by other central banks and depending on the evolution of the situation, the Bank of Albania remains ready to use all the operational instruments and regulatory space available to minimize the consequences of the pandemic in the Albanian economy and financial system.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_25_mars_2020.html Page 2 of 3 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, March 25, 2020 29/07/22, 13:34 In any case, the objective of our action will be to preserve the country's monetary and financial stability, ease crisis costs for Albanian businesses and families, and create premise for a faster recovery of the economy in the following period. Meeting these preconditions gives way to respecting our price stability target in the medium and long term. Our monetary, regulatory and institutional measures will stay in place as long as necessary. In a more long-term perspective, the Supervisory Council finds it appropriate to stress that the messages we have delivered continuously on the health of the Albanian economy and banking system remain valid. Let me reemphasize them: Albania enjoys good economic and financial health; the operating parameters of the economy and the banking sector are healthy; Liquidity and capital reserves of the Albanian banking sector are high. In this context, the Supervisory Council notes that minimizing the long-term consequences of the pandemic requires serious, coordinated and harmonized efforts by all public and private authorities in the country.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_25_mars_2020.html Page 3 of 3
