Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, May 6, 2020 29/07/22, 13:34 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, May 6, 2020 Publication date: 06.05.2020 Honored media representatives, Today, on 6 May 2020, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the 2020/II Quarterly Monetary Policy Report. Analysis of the country's economic and financial situation, discussion of scenarios of possible developments in the future, as well as the identification of the monetary policy response strategy, were dominated by the current and expected effects of the Covid19 pandemic in Albania. Page 1 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, May 6, 2020 29/07/22, 13:34 At the end of the discussion, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current monetary policy position remains appropriate for coping with the emergency, but further escalating the blow or creating difficulties in the monetary policy transmission mechanism would require increasing monetary stimulus and, potentially, adopting its unconventional instruments. *** The health emergency caused by the spread of Covid-19 and public authorities' measures for its control, in Albania and the world, pose a challenge to the country's economic and financial stability, to the health of the finances of businesses and families, as well as to the sustainability of the country's economic growth, in the medium and long term. Available information indicates that Covid-19 will have a strong impact on all of the country's economic and financial indicators. Measures of social distancing and increasing uncertainty have brought about a general slowdown in almost all components of aggregate demand: the export of goods and services, family consumption and investments. In parallel with them, the temporary closure of some production and service activities has brought a further decline in production. This double shock, demand and supply, will be reflected in declining economic activity during 2020. Furthermore, declining production is expected to be accompanied by falling employment, rising unemployment, falling family incomes and financial difficulties for businesses. The medium and long-term dynamics of economic development, in Albania as well as in the world, will depend on the duration of the pandemic. In the positive scenario, that of a gradual reduction in social distance measures during the second quarter, economic activity in the country is expected to mark the point of slowdown in the second quarter, continue to remain in negative territory over the following two quarters, and return to growth in 2021. This scenario envisions a relatively stable inflation rate during 2020 and a gradual increase towards the target in the following two years. In this scenario, the pandemic will leave visible, but fleeting, traces of the country's economy and finances. Above all, it will not affect economic and financial balances and long-term and long-term development trends. On the other hand, a potential extension of the pandemic beyond the second quarter also implies a proportionally higher negative impact on the country's economic and financial indicators. The Supervisory Council considers that the primary objective of public policies, as well as the response of the private sector, should be to take measures to cope with the emergency and create premise for the fastest recovery of economic growth in the future. This will require, first, maintaining the country's monetary and financial stability and, secondly, limiting damage to the country's production capacities. In this context, the Supervisory Council considers that fiscal policy has a primary role in dealing with the situation. Allocation of funds needed to cope with the health emergency, social assistance for families affected and in need, as well as measures Page 2 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, May 6, 2020 29/07/22, 13:34 fiscal measures to improve the liquidity situation of businesses are necessary measures to address the situation. Increasing public debt is an acceptable cost for maintaining the country's economic and financial balances. Also, the Supervisory Council notes that private business must be flexible in adopting new business models, careful in managing the liquidity situation, as well as forward-looking in a fair division of costs, in the interests of preserving the production and service chains. For its part, the Bank of Albania has taken a full package of measures to address the situation. Easing monetary policy stance by the Bank of Albania, through a 0.5% reduction in the basic interest rate and through the unlimited supply of liquidity to the banking system, promoting the most normal functioning of financial markets and enabling volume growth and lowering the cost of credit for the private sector. The presentation of easing measures in the area of banking regulation has encouraged the temporary delay, by a quarter, of the payment of loan installments, improving the liquidity situation of businesses and individuals in temporary difficulty and their chances of survival. In parallel with them, we have eased the cost of operating the electronic payment system, responding to the growing needs for this type of service, as well as taking care of the normal supply of the economy with physical money. The Supervisory Council assesses that the Bank of Albania has taken appropriate measures in due course. In their response, financial markets continue to exercise activity within the limits of normality, despite increased public sector demand for funds and added uncertainty over the country's economic and financial future. *** At the close of discussions, judging and on projections of the scenario of the rapid completion of the pandemic, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current monetary policy position is appropriate. For this reason, he decided: Leave the basic interest rate unchanged at 0.5%; Leave deposit and one-day interest rates unchanged, at 0.1% and 0.9%, respectively. Also, confirming the positive scenario means that monetary policy will remain easing throughout the forecast horizon. On the other hand, the Supervisory Council notes that the uncertainty in the forecast, this time, is extremely high. Likewise, this uncertainty has the form of a relatively high probability that future developments will result in the lower direction of our expectations. The dangers of the lower kah stem especially from: possible extension of the pandemic beyond the second quarter; creating problems in the monetary policy transmission mechanism, in the form of rising interest rates and sector financing costs Page 3 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, May 6, 2020 29/07/22, 13:34 private, in the form of deteriorating bank loan supply, or in the form of strong fluctuations in other financial market indicators. The Supervisory Council notes that materializing these risks may require further easing of monetary policy stance. In accordance with our contingent plans, this relief can also take the form of unconventional instruments, instruments that will always be in line with the reality and needs of the Albanian financial market and with the legal framework that regulates the activity of the Bank of Albania. Informacioni i disponueshm tregon se Covid-19 do t ket nj ndikim t fort n t gjith treguesit ekonomik dhe financiar t vendit. Masat e distancimit social dhe rritja e pasiguris kan sjell nj ngadalsim t prgjithshm t thuajse gjith komponentve t krkess agregate: eksportit t mallrave e shrbimeve, konsumit familjar dhe investimeve. Paralelisht me to, mbyllja e prkohshme e disa aktiviteteve t prodhimit e shrbimit, ka sjell nj rnie t mtejshme t prodhimit. Kjo goditje e dyfisht, krkese dhe oferte, do t pasqyrohet n rnie t aktivitetit ekonomik gjat vitit 2020. M tej, rnia e prodhimit pritet t shoqrohet me rnie t punsimit, rritje t papunsis, rnie t t ardhurave familjare dhe vshtirsi financiare pr bizneset. Dinamika afatmesme dhe afatgjat e zhvillimit ekonomik, n Shqipri sikundr dhe n bot, do t varet nga kohzgjatja e pandemis. N skenarin pozitiv, at t nj reduktimi gradual t masave t distancimit social gjat tremujorit t dyt, aktiviteti ekonomik n vend pritet t shnoj pikun e ngadalsimit n tremujorin e dyt, t vijoj t mbetet n territor negativ gjat dy tremujorve n vijim, dhe ti kthehet rritjes n vitin 2021. Ky skenar parashikon nj norm inflacioni relativisht t qndrueshme gjat vitit 2020 dhe nj rritje graduale t saj drejt objektivit n dy vitet pasuese. N kt skenar, pandemia do t lr gjurm t dukshme, por kalimtare, n ekonomin dhe financat e vendit. Mbi t gjitha, ajo nuk do t cnoj ekuilibrat ekonomik e financiar dhe trendet afatmesme dhe afatgjata t zhvillimit. Nga ana tjetr, nj zgjatje potenciale e pandemis prtej tremujorit t dyt nnkupton dhe nj ndikim proporcionalisht m t lart negativ n treguesit ekonomik dhe financiar t vendit. Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjykon se objektivi primar i politikave publike, si dhe i reagimit t sektorit privat, duhet t jet marrja e masave pr prballimin e emergjencs dhe krijimi i premisave pr rikuperimin sa m t shpejt t rritjes ekonomike n t ardhmen. Kjo do t krkoj, s pari, ruajtjen e stabilitetit monetar dhe financiar t vendit dhe, s dyti, kufizimin e dmeve mbi kapacitetet prodhuese t vendit. N kt kontekst, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlerson se politika fiskale ka nj rol primar n prballimin e situats. Title: Speech at the 43rd meeting of the Club of Governors of Central Asia, the Black Sea Region and the Balkans
text: 05/08/22, 17:18 Governor Seyko's word at the 43rd meeting of the Governors' Club of Central Asian countries, Black Sea Region dh... Governor Seyko's word at the 43rd meeting of the Governors Club of Central Asian countries, Black Sea Region and the Balkans Publication date: 02.06.2020 Honourable Governors, we are living in a time deeply influenced by the Covid-19 pandemic.  1/4 05/08/22d, 17:1d8 Governor Seyko's sentence at the 43rd meeting of the Governors of central Asian countries, Black Sea Region dh... Apart from being one of the worst health crises we have gone through, it has also turned into one of the most serious economic challenges in contemporary history. The spread of the pandemic, combined with strong measures taken to prevent further infection, unprecipitously reduced the movement of people, goods and services. The simultaneous decline in demand and supply has caused a rapid decline in production, an immediate increase in unemployment, great difficulties for families and businesses, and has posed complex challenges to public policymaking. Albania is no exception to this picture of international developments. We are facing an economic contraction, among the strongest in the last two decades. The comprehensive package of economic stimulus policies to minimize negative effects is implemented at optimal times and has comprehensive impact. Its objective has been triple: (i) providing the funding needed to cope with the health emergency; (ii) the protection of families and businesses affected by the crisis, with the aim of minimizing losses in production capacities; and (iii) preserve monetary and financial stability. Due to the rapid dynamics and size of the emergency, fiscal policy plays a leading role in coping with the situation, partially offsetting income losses for families and providing liquidity support to businesses affected by the situation. The size of the fiscal stimulus package in Albania is estimated at about 3% of GDP and includes incentives in  2/4 05/08/22, 17:18 Governor Seyko's word at the 43rd meeting of the Governors' Club of Central Asian countries, Black Sea Region dh... the fiscal stimulus package in Albania is estimated at about 3% of GDP, and includes incentives in form of tax transfers for individuals, deferral of tax and tax payments, and sovereign guarantees to facilitate the receipt of bank credit. In our view, the growth of public debt is an acceptable cost when compared to its impact in facilitating the social impact of the crisis, the avoidance of large-scale bankruptcy of businesses and in the removal of the deep negative pact that these bankruptcies would have on the financial stability of country. The Intervention of the Bank of Albania was swift. Our actions were aimed at achieving three objectives: (i) ensuring the normal provision of financial services during the time of the closure of economic activity; (ii) reducing the costs of serving the debt of economic agents; and (iii) maintaining monetary and financial stability, as a necessary prerequisite for a rapid recovery of the economy. About this: The Bank of Albania added monetary stimulus by lowering the basic interest rate to a new historic minimum of 0.5%, as well as by increasing liquidity injections in the market. For more, we instructed banks to offer liquidity ease to various businesses facing temporary difficulties, such as delaying payments for a short-term period. as well as in the form of restructuring loans where necessary. We facilitated this process through specific but temporary changes to the regulatory framework that guides these activities. We decided to temporarily remove commissions on the use of electronic payment platforms, as well as issued detailed guidelines for banks in order to facilitate the continuation of their activity. Looking to the future, the uncertainties around the economic damage caused by the pandemic are extremely great. Although any score projection on the performance of the economy is yet to be assessed, our basic scenario - and at the same time the best case of the economy's performance in the future - predicts a V-shaped recovery, starting in the third quarter of 2020. To date, the Albanian banking system remains solid, with stable and secular paying skills. For more, our internal financial markets are calm and financial conditions remain supportive of credit growth. Title: Questions and answers to the press conference
text: Question answers of the press conference July 1, 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 Question answers of the press conference July 1, 2020 Publication date: 01.07.2020 Q: In April, a record money was marked in circulation outside the banking system. Since the economy has been closed and most transactions are oriented towards those of online banking services, what has happened to explain this phenomenon? Governor: The main factor of increasing money in circulation has been measures of social distance during the pandemic period. Because of these measures, mainly citizens, but also businesses, have preferred to keep a quantity of cash outside the banking system, have preferred to withdraw and maintain necessary amounts of cash. This is as a consequence of the psychological impact of the crisis, to operate more simply but also to avoid contacts in bank branches or ATMs. Another factor that has influenced have been fiscal measures taken both in the form of disbursement of payments to families in need and in the form of reducing the tax burden. However, it is worth noting that despite the increase in cash money in circulation during this period, deposits have increased in parallel. So the situation in the banking system has been stable and with a high level of liquidity, despite the impact and consequences of the pandemic. In April alone, deposits increased by 8 billion dollars in the banking system and the cash situation increased by 6 billion dollars. Of course, the Bank of Albania has taken steps to reduce the cash situation in circulation, but it is impossible as we are known to be a cash economy. There are many measures That I will not now publish in the function of this question, which are aimed at the medium term and in the long term reducing cash in the economy and formalizing the economy. Page 1 of 5 Question answers of the press conference July 1, 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 At the moment we have taken some measures, removing commissions for online transactions in the banking system. So we as the Bank of Albania have removed our commission and indirectly banks must lower commissions to increase the level of online transactions. Q: After the eurobond issue is there still in the Bank of Albania's emergency programme intervening in a scenario weighed down through the quantitative easing policy? Governor: Even in the statement of the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania we stressed that the contingent plans for a monetary policy easing, and in this context even those to be met with quantitative easing, with unconventional measures, remain in force, but these are still contingent plans. After taking the Eurobond from the Albanian government to the value of 650m euros these contingent plans fade, so they are less likely. Measures of quantitative easing or unconventional monetary policy mean the purchase of Albanian government treasury bonds through the secondary market. So in a way, financing the budget deficit through quantitative easing becomes less likely because the Eurobond has provided the Albanian government with the liquidity needed to cope with the consequences of the pandemic, and of course this is a positive element since the liquidity of the Bank of Albania and the banking system is not affected. Anyway, we're on situational monitoring. The Bank of Albania will continue to monitor the situation and in an economic situation that is under the influence of the pandemic consequences of course that the contingent plans always remain in our attention and active. The Supervisory Council has consistently stressed in its statements that the quantitative easing policy will be used if necessary, but always the central bank will be the last borrower in line. Q: After postponing the moratorium on the payment of loans, what is the number of customers who have currently postponed the installments after the opening of the economy and how much is currently the value of the deferred loan? Governor: According to data that the Bank of Albania has received from the Albanian Banking Association, i.e. from the banking system, the value of the deferred credit insands for the second quarter is in the value of 1.9 billion euros or in number, 23 thousand cases. This is a lower value compared to the first quarter by both the number of cases and the value. In the first quarter the value was 2 billion euros and the number of cases of creditors who applied and benefited from the postponement was 25,000. This means that with the easing of measures, a number of customers have preferred not to apply for a second quarterly delay. What I would like to stress in this question is that the banking system has reacted proactively and results in us that 95% of cases that have applied for deferral to the banking system have been approved. It remains to be seen how he will react Page 2 of 5 Question answers of the press conference July 1, 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 the system, the economy and the performance of financial indicators in the banking sector, but at the moment there are these figures. Q: Will there be a change in inflation? Governor: I also highlighted it in the monetary policy statement of the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania. Inflation levels have recently been at the 2% level. The Bank of Albania forecasts to reach its inflation target of 3%, at the end of 2021, in its third or fourth quarter. Inflation has been stable. Of course, the sustainability of inflation reflects the combined effect of rising product costs on the circulation of goods and in turn the severity of demand in the market, resulting from the pandemic. But a positive element that has influenced the maintenance of stable inflation has been the exchange rate. We hope, especially by looking at eurobond, that we will continue to have a stable level of exchange rate. If we had a strong depreciation of the exchange rate, of course the level of inflation would increase more, but that would not be the preferred way for us as the central bank. In normal terms, i.e. considering a stabilized exchange rate and other factors affecting the level of inflation, we anticipate that inflation will reach the Bank of Albania's target at the end of 2021. Q: Have you had any consultation with the government about a possible plan for the use of the Eurobond (money that remains after the debt payment)? So where are they going to be invested? If not, what does the Bank of Albania suggest? Governor: As the Eurobond is known in the 650m-euro value that was recently received, it will be used at 250m euros in October for the final isation of the remainder of the Eurobond ejection in 2015, while the rest of the 400m euros will be for financing budget needs, to meet all the needs that the state budget may have in this situation. Normally the Ministry of Finance and Economy, the Albanian government, is revising the budget and we are waiting for the revised version of the budget. So it will be done and clearer how the remainder of the Eurobond will be spent. However, I would like to stress, as we have stressed before, that we will have an increase in public debt, so the Eurobond will increase public debt. Increasing public debt is a necessary evil in this situation, to avoid the bankruptcy of businesses and to guarantee the monetary and financial stability of the country. First, taking the Eurobond enables the Albanian government to provide the funds needed to cope with the pandemic. Second, the Eurobond facilitates the work of second-rate banks and provides the liquidity needed for them to credit the economy, i.e. not to credit the government, but to the private sector. Therefore, we consider eurobond as a necessary tool and a positive emissions, a very positive element for the Albanian economy in this difficult situation that it is as a result of the effects of the blow from the Covid-19 pandemic. There's no need to do Page 3 of 5 Question answers of the press conference July 1, 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 Comments, the interest rate has been commented on that it is at a very good level as financial markets have been in a pretty good situation. The exit moment for the eurobond was a positive moment at a rate of 3.625% called a successful/positive interest rate for debt-taking at the moment. Also, part of the question was did he consult with the Bank of Albania. Bank of Albania experts are in a joint team with experts from the Ministry of Finance and Economy, in exits to take on debt either in national markets or in the internal market. Q: So far how many have applied and how much have they benefited from sovereign guarantee 2? Why are businesses dissatisfied? Will there be any possible Bank of Albania intervention with Commercial Banks? Governor: The first guarantee was for wages, second for business activity. The first guarantee for wages has about 530 approved cases with a value of 51m euros benefited, while there are another 220 cases underway, but the deadline has been 20 June. This deadline has expired and we are still unaware whether the Ministry of Finance and Eonomia will declare a second deadline for this guarantee. While the second sovereign guarantee has a lower level of benefit as even the risk criteria have been higher. Risk-taking for this guarantee has been 60% on the part of the government and 40% by banks, unlike the first guarantee. For this reason, a total value of 9m euros has so far been disbursed for about 50 creditors who have benefited, while 65 creditors are in the process of applying. Certainly business has its stress in this difficult financial and economic situation. Business has its displeasures in the first place from the difficult situation and being in a stress situation has high expectations of both the government and the banks. But in this difficult situation, and the government and central banks themselves, all other market actors face difficulties and of course that a crisis situation brings and discontent. The situation is being managed, actors need to better coordinate efforts. We have called and constantly coordinated the efforts, but in such a situation it must be given that the cost of the crisis must be distributed and distributed fairly and proportionately among all actors. So neither the Albanian government nor the banking system nor the private sector can take the cost of the crisis alone. This cost should be distributed proportionally among all actors and economic and financial market factors, and hope that we will have an economic growth according to forecast. So this year is going to be a tough year. We hope to get through this year without bankruptcy in the business sector and expect a re-establishment as quickly as possible during both the summer and 2021 period, which according to the Bank of Albania's forecasts will be the year of economic recovery. Duke qen se ekonomia ka qen e mbyllur dhe shumica e transaksioneve jan orientuar drejt atyre t shrbimeve bankare online, far ka ndodhur q t shpjegohet kjo dukuri? Guvernatori: Faktori kryesor i rritjes s paras n qarkullim ka qen masat e distancimit social gjat periudhs s pandemis. Pr shkak t ktyre masave, kryesisht qytetart, por edhe bizneset, kan preferuar t mbajn nj sasi cash-i jasht sistemit bankar, kan preferuar t trheqin dhe t mbajn sasi t nevojshme cash-i. Kjo si pasoj e ndikimit psikologjik t krizs, pr t operuar m thjesht por dhe pr t shmangur kontaktet n degt e bankave apo ATM-t. Nj faktor tjetr q ka ndikuar kan qen masat fiskale t ndrmarra si n formn e disbursimit t pagesave pr familjet n nevoj, ashtu edhe n formn e reduktimit t barrs tatimore. Gjithsesi, sht pr tu theksuar q pavarsisht se sht rritur paraja cash n qarkullim gjat ksaj periudhe jan rritur paralelisht dhe depozitat. Pra, gjendja n sistemin bankar ka qen stabl dhe me nj nivel t lart likuiditeti, pavarsisht ndikimit dhe pasojave t pandemis. Vetm n muajin prill, depozitat jan rritur me 8 miliard lek n sistemin bankar dhe gjendja e cash-it sht rritur me 6 miliard lek. Natyrisht q Banka e Shqipris ka marr masa pr t zvogluar gjendjen e cash-it n qarkullim, por sht e pamundur pasi dihet q jemi nj ekonomi cash-i. Ka shum masa q nuk do ti listoj tani n funksion t ksaj pyetjeje, t cilat synojn n afatin e mesm dhe n afatin e gjat reduktimin e cash-it n ekonomi dhe formalizimin e ekonomis. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Pyetje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_1_korrik_2020.html Pagina 1 di 5 Pyetje prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp 1 korrik 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 Pr momentin ne kemi marr disa masa, duke hequr komisionet pr transaksionet online n sistemin bankar. Pra ne si Bank e Shqipris kemi hequr komisionin ton dhe n mnyr indirekte bankat duhet t ulin komisionet pr t rritur nivelin e transaksioneve online. Pyetje: Pas emetimit t eurobondit a ekziston ende n programin e emergjencs t Banks s Shqipris ndrhyrja n nj skenar t rnduar prmes politiks s lehtsimit sasior? Guvernatori: Edhe n deklaratn e Kshillit Mbikqyrs t Banks s Shqipris theksuam se planet e kontigjencs pr nj politik monetare lehtsuese, dhe n kt kontekst edhe ato pr t vijuar me nj lehtsim sasior, me masa jokonvencionale, mbeten n fuqi, por kto jan gjithsesi plane kontigjence. Pas marrjes s eurobondit nga qeveria shqiptare n vlern e 650 milion eurove kto plane kontigjence zbehen, pra jan m pak t mundshme. Masat e lehtsimit sasior ose politika monetare jokonvencionale do t thot blerja e bonove t thesarit t qeveris shqiptare nprmjet tregut sekondar. Pra n njfar mnyr, financimi i deficitit buxhetor nprmjet lehtsimit sasior bhet m pak i mundshm sepse eurobondi i ka siguruar qeveris shqiptare likuiditetin e nevojshm pr t prballuar pasojat e pandemis, dhe natyrisht q ky sht nj element pozitiv pasi nuk cnohet likuiditeti i Banks s Shqipris dhe i sistemit bankar. Gjithsesi, ne jemi n monitorim t situats. Banka e Shqipris do t vazhdoj t monitoroj situatn dhe n nj situat ekonomike q sht nn goditjen e pasojave t pandemis natyrisht q planet e kontigjencs mbeten gjithmon n vmendjen ton dhe aktive. Kshilli Mbikqyrs e ka theksuar n deklaratat e tij n mnyr t vazhdueshme q politika e lehtsimit sasior do t prdoret nse do t jet e nevojshme, por gjithmon banka qendrore do t jet huamarrsi i fundit n radh. Pyetje: Pas shtyrjes s moratoriumit t pagess s kredive, sa sht numri i klientve q aktualisht kan shtyr kstet pas hapjes s ekonomis dhe sa sht aktualisht vlera e kredis s shtyr? Guvernatori: Sipas t dhnave q Banka e Shqipris ka marr nga Shoqata Shqiptare e Bankave, pra nga sistemi bankar, vlera e ksteve t kredis t shtyra pr tremujorin e dyt sht n vlern e 1.9 miliard eurove ose n numr, 23 mij raste. Kjo sht nj vler m e ult n krahasim me tremujorin e par si nga numri i rasteve ashtu edhe nga vlera. N tremujorin e par vlera ishte n 2 miliard euro dhe numri i rasteve t kredimarrsve t cilt aplikuan dhe prfituan shtyrje ishte 25 mij. Kjo do t thot se me zbutjen e masave, nj numr klientsh kan preferuar t mos aplikojn pr nj shtyrje t dyt tremujore. Ajo q do t doja t theksoja n kt pyetje sht q sistemi bankar ka reaguar n mnyr proaktive dhe na rezulton q 95% e rasteve q kan aplikuar pr shtyrje n sistemin bankar jan aprovuar. Pyetje: A do t ket ndryshim t inflacionit? Guvernatori: E theksova dhe n deklaratn e politiks monetare t Kshillit Mbikqyrs t Banks s Shqipris. Niveli i inflacionit s fundmi ka qen n nivelin 2%. Banka e Shqipris parashikon t arrij objektivin e saj t inflacionit prej 3%, n fundin e vitit 2021, n tremujorin e tret ose t katrt t tij. Inflacioni ka qen i qndrueshm. Natyrisht q qndrueshmria e inflacionit pasqyron efektin e kombinuar t rritjes s kostove t prodhimeve n qarkullimin e mallrave dhe nga ana tjetr ndrojtjes s krkess n treg, q vjen si pasoj e pandemis. Por, nj element pozitiv q ka ndikuar n mbajtjen e inflacionit stabl ka qen niveli i kursit t kmbimit. Ne shpresojm, sidomos duke par eurobondin, q do t vazhdojm t kemi nj nivel stabl t kursit t kmbimit. N rast se ne do t kishim nj zhvlersim t fort t kursit t kmbimit, sigurisht q niveli i inflacionit do t rritej m shum, por nuk do t ishte kjo mnyra e paraplqyer pr ne si bank qendrore. N terma normal, pra duke konsideruar nj kurs t stabilizuar t kmbimit dhe faktor t tjer q ndikojn n nivelin e inflacionit, ne parashikojm q inflacioni do t arrij objektivin e Banks s Shqipris n fund t vitit 2021. Pyetje: A keni patur ndonj konsult me qeverin n lidhje me nj plan t mundshm pr prdorimin e eurobondit (t parave q mbeten paspagess s borxhit)? Pra ku do investohen? Nse jo, far sugjeron Banka e Shqipris? Guvernatori: Si dihet eurobondi n vlern prej 650 milion eurosh q u mor s fundmi, do t prdoret n vlern 250 milion euro n tetor pr likuidimin e pjess s mbetur t eurobondit t emetuar n vitin 2015, ndrsa pjesa tjetr prej 400 milion eurosh do t jet pr financimin e nevojave t buxhetit, pr t plotsuar gjith nevojat q mund t ket buxheti i shtetit n kt situat. Normalisht Ministria e Financave dhe Ekonomis, qeveria shqiptare, sht duke rishikuar buxhetin dhe ne jemi duke pritur variantin e rishikuar t buxhetit. Kshtu do t bhet dhe m e qart sesi do t shpenzohet pjesa e mbetur e eurobondit. Gjithsesi do t doja t theksoja, sikurse e kemi theksuar dhe m par, q do t kemi nj rritje t borxhit publik, pra eurobondi do t rris borxhin publik. Rritja e borxhit publik sht nj e keqe e domosdoshme n kt situat, pr t shmangur falimentin e bizneseve dhe pr t garantuar stabilitetin monetar dhe financiar t vendit. S pari, marrja e eurobondit i mundson qeveris shqiptare sigurimin e fondeve t nevojshme pr prballimin e pandemis. S dyti, eurobondi i lehtson punn bankave t nivelit t dyt dhe i siguron likuiditetin e nevojshm atyre pr t kredituar ekonomin, pra pr t mos kredituar qeverin, por sektorin privat. Prandaj, ne e konsiderojm eurobondin si nj mjet t domosdoshm dhe nj emetim pozitiv, nj element shum pozitiv pr ekonomin shqiptare n kt situat t vshtir q ajo ndodhet si pasoj e efekteve t goditjes nga pandemia Covid-19. Nuk ka nevoj t bj https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Pyetje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_1_korrik_2020.html Pagina 3 di 5 Pyetje prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp 1 korrik 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 komente, norma e interesit sht komentuar q sht n nj nivel mjaft t mir pasi dhe tregjet financiare kan qen n nj situat mjaft t mir. Momenti i daljes pr eurobondin ishte nj moment pozitiv me nj norm prej 3.625% q quhet nj norm e suksesshme/pozitive interesi pr marrjen e borxhit n kt moment. Gjithashtu, nj pjes e pyetjes ishte a sht konsultuar me Bankn e Shqipris. Ekspertt e Banks s Shqipris jan n nj ekip t prbashkt me ekspertt e Ministris s Financave dhe Ekonomis, n daljet pr t marr borxh qoft n tregjet kombtare qoft n tregun e brendshm. Pyetje: Deri m tani sa kan aplikuar dhe sa kan prfituar nga garancia sovrane 2? Pse jan t paknaqura bizneset? A do t ket ndonj ndrhyrje t mundshme t Banks s Shqipris tek Bankat Tregtare? Guvernatori: Garancia e par ka qen pr pagat, e dyta pr aktivitetin e biznesit. Garancia e par pr pagat ka rreth 530 raste t aprovuara me nj vler prej 51 milion euro t prfituara, ndrkoh q jan edhe 220 raste t tjera n proces por afati ka qen 20 qershor. Ky afat ka skaduar dhe akoma nuk jemi n dijeni nse Ministria e Financave dhe Eonomis do t shpall nj afat t dyt pr kt garanci. Ndrsa garancia e dyt sovrane ka nj nivel m t ult prfitimi pasi edhe kriteret e rrezikut kan qen m t larta. Marrja e rrezikut pr kt garanci ka qen 60% nga ana e qeveris dhe 40% nga bankat, ndryshe nga garancia e par. Pr kt arsye, deri tani sht disbursuar nj vler totale prej 9 milion euro pr rreth 50 kredimarrs q kan prfituar, ndrkoh q 65 kredimarrs jan n proces aplikimi. Patjetr q biznesi ka stresin e tij n kt situat t vshtir financiare dhe ekonomike. Biznesi ka paknaqsit e tij n radh t par nga situata e vshtir dhe duke qen n nj situat stresi ka pritshmri t larta si ndaj qeveris ashtu dhe ndaj bankave. Por, n kt situat t vshtir, dhe vet qeveria dhe bankat qendrore, t gjith aktort e tjer t tregut prballen me vshtirsi dhe natyrisht q nj situat krize sjell dhe paknaqsi. Situata sht duke u menaxhuar, aktort duhet t koordinojn m mir prpjekjet. Ne kemi br thirrje dhe vazhdimisht i kemi koordinuar prpjekjet, por n nj situat t till duhet pasur parasysh q kostoja e krizs duhet t shprndahet dhe do t shprndahet n mnyr t drejt dhe proporcionale midis gjith aktorve. Pra nuk mund ta marr e vetme as qeveria shqiptare, as sistemi bankar dhe as sektori privat koston e krizs. Kjo kosto duhet shprndar n mnyr proporcionale midis t gjith aktorve dhe faktorve t tregut ekonomik dhe financiar, dhe t shpresojm q do t kemi nj rritje ekonomike sipas parashikimit. Pra, ky vit do t jet nj vit i vshtir. Shpresojm q ta kalojm kt vit pa pasur falimente n sektorin e biznesit dhe t presim nj ringritje sa m t shpejt si gjat periudhs s vers ashtu edhe n vitin 2021, i cili sipas parashikimeve t Banks s Shqipris do t jet viti i ringritjes ekonomike. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Pyetje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_1_korrik_2020.html Pagina 4 di 5 Pyetje prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp 1 korrik 2020 Copyright  2018 Banka e Shqipris. Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, July 1, 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, July 1, 2020 Publication date: 01.07.2020 Honored media representatives, Today, on 1 July 2020, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Intermediate Monetary Policy Report. Analysis of available information shows that the Albanian economy was under the strong effect of pandemics during the second quarter. These consequences are still present. Reducing domestic and foreign demand and limiting production and service activities in the country have brought declining production, rising unemployment, and financial difficulties for Albanian businesses and families. However, the country's banking sector remains healthy and financial markets appear relatively calm.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_1_korrik_2020.html Page 1 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, July 1, 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 The Supervisory Council estimates that the progressive opening of the economy, the easing of social distancing measures, as well as the country's stable monetary and financial environment, create premise for gradual recovery of economic activity in the following quarters. However, the balance of dangers remains shifted to the lower direction. At the conclusion of the discussions, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current mix of fiscal, monetary and financial policies provides the necessary stimulus for supporting economic growth and for turning inflation into targets. *** The Covid-19 pandemic has exerted an all-out blow on the Albanian economy. Its consequences have already begun to be reflected in available statistical information. According to Instat data, the Albanian economy shrunk by 2.5% in the first quarter of this year, reflecting the decline in export and investment. Similarly, labour market data show that the Albanian economy lost about 17,000,000 jobs in this period, while the unemployment rate rose to 11.4%.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_1_korrik_2020.html Page 2 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, July 1, 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 Indirect second-quarter data suggest the hit has strengthened further. Exports of goods shrunk by 33% during the first two months of this quarter, in response to falling foreign demand and barriers to circulation. Also, imports were reduced by about 30%, signaling rapid slowdowns in consumption and investment in the country, while budgetary revenues shrunk by about 30% in the first two months of the quarter, reflecting the overall decline in economic activity. In contrast to this picture, inflation marked a slight increase in the months of April and May. Its average rate jumped to 2%, mainly as a result of temporary supply shocks in this period. The Bank of Albania estimates that the future performance of the economy will depend on the duration of the pandemic consequences and the response of internal and foreign economic agents to them. Our basic scenario of expected developments is built on the assumption of avoiding a second wave of pandemics and gradually reducing to complete extinction of its consequences. In this scenario, the Albanian economy is expected to mark a significant decline for 2020 and relatively rapid and stable growth rates in the future. Economic activity in the country is expected to mark the point of slowdown in the second quarter, continue to remain in negative territory in the following two quarters, and return to growth in 2021. In line with this scenario, inflation is expected to stay close to current levels in the second half of the year. Furthermore, this indicator is expected to mark a gradual increase over the next year and return to target in its final quarter. This economic performance will be supported by an accommodative mix of economic policies. Fiscal packages undertaken so far have helped mitigate the consequences of the crisis. The Bank of Albania expects a revision of the Budget for the second part of the year, which is expected to result in a higher fiscal deficit. If we have said so, fiscal policy must have a primary role in addressing the challenge we are facing. The careful and temporary increase in public debt is an acceptable compromise to soften the impact on the economy and support the country's monetary and financial stability. In parallel, the Bank of Albania has adopted monetary and financial easing policies. Lowering the basic interest rate to its historic minimum, as well as increasing liquidity injections, have enabled risk premium control and kept interest rates at low levels. In parallel, the regulatory measures we have undertaken have encouraged the temporary postponement of credit insands for struggling customers, as well as the restructuring of loans for customers who exhibit solid business prospects, but short-term and medium-term financial difficulties. Also, these measures have targeted increasing the use of electronic payments and have enabled the normal supply of the economy with physical money.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_1_korrik_2020.html Page 3 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, July 1, 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 In response, financial markets appear relatively quiet. The cost of financing the private sector is close to its historic minimum, the exchange rate is stable, while the banking sector follows to show good indicators of liquidity and capitalisation. In particular, the ratio of troubled loans dropped to 8.1% in the month of May, marking a further decline compared to the previous quarter. The Supervisory Council estimates that the banking sector is exercising its function of shock absorber in the economy. This sector has been able to credit the private sector of the economy, and in particular that of businesses. The loan to the private sector came to mark increases in the months of April and May, which has been present mainly in the business sector, supporting them with the liquidity needed to cope with the crisis. Likewise, the banking sector has taken on part of the financial cost of the hit, further easing the burden on the public and private sector. Encouraging the continuation of this role, the Supervisory Council notes that the banking sector cannot and should not face the financial burden of the blow alone. In this context, a primary role has and should play in the public sector, through increased fiscal stimulus, as well as the private sector, through increased financial care and operational efficiency. *** At the close of discussions, judging and on the projections of the basic scenario and the balance of risks around it, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current monetary policy position is appropriate. For this reason, he decided: Leave the basic interest rate unchanged at 0.5%; Leave deposit and one-day interest rates unchanged, at 0.1% and 0.9%, respectively. Monetary policy will remain easing throughout the forecast horizon. However, the Supervisory Council considers that the balance of risks follows to remain in the lower direction. In particular, the dangers of the lower kah stem from: Return to the form of a second wave of pandemics; Creating problems in the monetary policy transmission mechanism, in the form of rising interest rates and private sector financing costs, in the form of deteriorating bank loan supply, or in the form of strong fluctuations in other financial market indicators. The Supervisory Council notes that the possibility of materializing these risks has been softened, reducing the need for increased monetary stimulus and the use of non-conventional monetary policy instruments. However, materialising these risks would require further easing of monetary policy stance and, potentially, even the use of unconventional instruments, always in line with the legal framework that contoures the activity of the Bank of Albania.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_1_korrik_2020.html Page 4 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, July 1, 2020 29/07/22, 13:33  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_1_korrik_2020.html Page 5 of 5

Megjithat, balanca e rreziqeve vijon t mbetet e zhvendosur n kahun e poshtm. N prfundim t diskutimeve, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se miksi aktual i politikave fiskale, monetare dhe financiare, ofron stimulin e nevojshm pr mbshtetjen e rritjes ekonomike dhe pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv. *** Pandemia Covid-19 ka ushtruar goditje t gjithanshme mbi ekonomin shqiptare. Pasojat e saj kan filluar t pasqyrohen tashm dhe n informacionin e disponueshm statistikor. Sipas t dhnave t Instat-it, ekonomia shqiptare u tkurr me 2.5% n tremujorin e par t ktij viti, duke pasqyruar rnien e eksportit dhe t investimeve. Po kshtu, t dhnat e tregut t puns tregojn se ekonomia shqiptare humbi rreth 17000 mij vende pune n kt periudh, ndrsa norma e papunsis u rrit n 11.4%. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjaer_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_1_korrik_2020.html Pagina 2 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 1 korrik 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 T dhnat indirekte t tremujorit t dyt sugjerojn se goditja sht forcuar m tej. Eksportet e mallrave u tkurrn me 33% gjat dy muajve t par ktij tremujori, n prgjigje t rnies s krkess s huaj dhe t pengesave n qarkullim. Po ashtu, importet u reduktuan me rreth 30%, duke sinjalizuar ngadalsimin e shpejt t konsumit dhe t investimeve n vend, ndrsa t ardhurat buxhetore u tkurrn me rreth 30% n dy muajt e par t tremujorit, duke pasqyruar rnien e prgjithshme t aktivitetit ekonomik. Prkundrejt ksaj tabloje, inflacioni shnoi nj rritje t leht n muajt prill dhe maj. Norma mesatare e tij krceu n nivelin 2%, kryesisht si pasoj e goditjeve t prkohshme t oferts n kt periudh. Banka e Shqipris vlerson se ecuria e ardhshme e ekonomis do t varet nga kohzgjatja e pasojave t pandemis dhe reagimi i agjentve t brendshm e t huaj ekonomik ndaj tyre. Skenari yn baz i zhvillimeve t pritura sht ndrtuar mbi supozimin e shmangies s nj vale t dyt t pandemis dhe reduktimin gradual deri n zhdukje t plot t pasojave t saj. N kt skenar, ekonomia shqiptare pritet t shnoj nj rnie t ndjeshme pr vitin 2020 dhe norma relativisht t shpejta dhe t qndrueshme rritjeje n vijim. Aktiviteti ekonomik n vend pritet t shnoj pikun e ngadalsimit n tremujorin e dyt, t vijoj t mbetet n territor negativ n dy tremujort n vijim, dhe ti kthehet rritjes n vitin 2021. N prputhje me kt skenar, inflacioni pritet t qndroj pran niveleve aktuale n gjysmn e dyt t vitit. M tej, ky tregues pritet t shnoj nj rritje graduale gjat vitit t ardhshm dhe t kthehet n objektiv n tremujorin e fundit t tij. Kjo ecuri ekonomike do t mbshtetet nga nj miks akomodues i politikave ekonomike. Paketat fiskale t ndrmarra deri tani kan ndihmuar n zbutjen e pasojave t krizs. Banka e Shqipris pret nj rishikim t Buxhetit pr pjesn e dyt t vitit, rishikim i cili pritet t rezultoj n nj deficit m t lart fiskal. Sikundr e kemi thn, politika fiskale duhet t ket nj rol primar n adresimin e sfids q po prballemi. Rritja e kujdesshme dhe e prkohshme e borxhit publik sht nj kompromis i pranueshm pr t zbutur efektin e goditjes n ekonomi dhe pr t mbshtetur stabilitetin monetar dhe financiar t vendit. Paralelisht me t, Banka e Shqipris ka adoptuar politika lehtsuese monetare dhe financiare. Ulja e norms baz t interesit n minimumin e saj historik si dhe rritja e injektimeve t likuiditetit, kan mundsuar kontrollin e primeve t rrezikut dhe kan mbajtur n nivele t ulta normat e interesit. Paralelisht me to, masat rregullatore q kemi ndrmarr kan inkurajuar shtyrjen e prkohshme t ksteve t kredis pr klientt n vshtirsi si dhe ristrukturimin e kredive pr klientt t cilt shfaqin perspektiva solide biznesi, por vshtirsi afatshkurtra dhe afatmesme financiare. Gjithashtu, kto masa kan synuar rritjen e prdorimit t pagesave elektronike dhe kan mundsuar furnizimin normal t ekonomis me para fizike. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjer_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_1_korrik_2020.html Pagina 3 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 1 korrik 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 N prgjigje t tyre, tregjet financiare shfaqen relativisht t qeta. Kostoja e financimit t sektorit privat sht pran minimumit t saj historik, kursi i kmbimit sht i qndrueshm, ndrsa sektori bankar vijon t shfaq tregues t mir likuiditeti dhe kapitalizimi. N veanti, raporti i kredive me probleme zbriti n nivelin 8.1% n muajin maj, duke shnuar nj rnie t mtejshme krahasuar me tremujorin paraardhs. Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlerson se sektori bankar sht duke ushtruar funksionin e tij t amortizuesit t goditjeve n ekonomi. Ky sektor ka vijuar t kreditoj sektorin privat t ekonomis, e n veanti at t bizneseve. Kredia pr sektorin privat vijoi t shnoj rritje n muajt prill e maj, rritje e cila ka qen e pranishme kryesisht n sektorin e bizneseve, duke i mbshtetur kta t fundit me likuiditetin e nevojshm pr prballimin e krizs. Po ashtu, sektori bankar ka marr mbi vete nj pjes t kostos financiare t goditjes, duke lehtsuar m tej barrn pr sektorin publik dhe privat. Duke inkurajuar vazhdimin e ktij roli, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vren sektori bankar nuk mund dhe nuk duhet t prballoj i vetm barrn financiare t goditjes. N kt kontekst, nj rol primar ka dhe duhet t luaj sektori publik, nprmjet rritjes s stimulit fiskal, si dhe sektori privat, nprmjet rritjes s kujdesit financiar dhe eficiencs operacionale. *** N mbyllje t diskutimeve, duke gjykuar dhe mbi projeksionet e skenarit baz dhe balancn e rreziqeve rreth tij, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare sht i prshtatshm. Pr kt arsye, ai vendosi: T ler t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 0.5%; T ler t pandryshuar normat e interesit t depozitave dhe kredive njditore, respektivisht n 0.1% dhe 0.9%. Politika monetare do t vijoj t mbetet lehtsuese gjat gjith horizontit t parashikimit. Gjithsesi, Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjykon se balanca e rreziqeve vijon t mbetet n kahun e poshtm. N veanti, rreziqe t kahut t poshtm burojn nga: Rikthimi n formn e nj vale t dyt t pandemis; Krijimi i problemeve n mekanizmin e transmetimit t politiks monetare, n formn e rritjes s normave t interesit dhe kostove t financimit t sektorit privat, n formn e prkeqsimit t oferts s kredis bankare, apo n formn e luhatjeve t forta t treguesve t tjer t tregut financiar. Kshilli Mbikqyrs vren se mundsia e materializimit t ktyre rreziqeve sht zbutur, ka redukton nevojn pr rritjen e stimulit monetar dhe prdorimin e instrumenteve jo-konvencionale t politiks monetare. Megjithat, materializimi i ktyre rreziqeve do t krkonte lehtsimin e mtejshm t qndrimit t politiks monetare dhe, potencialisht, edhe prdorimin e instrumenteve jo-konvencional, gjithnj n prputhje me kuadrin ligjor cili konturon aktivitetin e Banks s Shqipris. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjer_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_1_korrik_2020.html Pagina 4 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 1 korrik 2020 Copyright  2018 Banka e Shqipris. Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, August 5, 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, August 5, 2020 Publication date: 05.08.2020 Honored media representatives, On 5 August 2020, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Quarterly Monetary Policy Report. The information taken in the analysis suggests that economic activity has shown a strong slowdown in the first half of the year, as a result of measures taken to control the spread of the pandemic. The relaxation of social distancing measures during the end of the second quarter, as well as the country's monetary and financial stability, have created premise for a gradual recovery of economic activity in the following period.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_5_gusht_2020.html Page 1 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, August 5, 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 At the end of the discussion, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current monetary policy position remains appropriate. Current monetary conditions provide the necessary stimulus for boosting economic growth and returning inflation to the target within 2022. However, further escalation of the blow or the creation of difficulties in the monetary policy transmission mechanism would require increased monetary stimulus. *** Pandemia has dealt a severe blow to the Albanian economy, both at macro level and at the business and individual family level. According to Instat data, the Albanian economy contracted by 2.5% in the first quarter of the year. This contraction reflected shrinking investments, reducing the export of goods and services, as well as slowing private consumption. The indirect data available suggests that economic activity will suffer a markedly stronger decline in the second quarter. In macro terms, falling demand for goods and services and temporary closure or rising costs for certain categories of activities has been reflected in a range of economic indicators. Inflation marked slight growth in the second quarter, recording an average level of 1.9%. This performance was dictated by rising production and transport costs, effects that dominated the fall in inflation that shrinking aggregate demand brings. Also, the decline in economic activity is expected to be accompanied by lower employment and rising unemployment, with expansion of the current account deficit and rising public debt during 2020. In microeconomic terms, falling demand and sales have brought financial difficulties for many Albanian businesses and families, as a result of shrinking incomes and job losses. These difficulties, as well as perceived uncertainty by economic operators, try to prolong the effects of the crackdown on time, through slowing consumption and private investment.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_5_gusht_2020.html Page 2 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, August 5, 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 The Supervisory Council considers that the effect of the pandemic on the economy will come progressively towards reduction over the following quarters, although recovery is expected to be slow and the balance of risks remains in the lower direction. In the basic scenario, economic activity in the country is expected to mark the point of slowdown in the second quarter, continue to remain in negative territory for the following two quarters, and return to growth in 2021. The increase in aggregate demand is expected to be accompanied by employment growth and rising wages and production costs, creating premise for returning inflation to the target within 2022. This scenario is conditional on the further performance of the pandemic, the speed of improving economic activity in our trading partners, the impact of the pandemic on future business and consumer behaviour, as well as the timely effectiveness of fiscal, monetary and financial measures, undertaken so far. The Supervisory Council considers that coordinated fiscal, monetary and financial stimulus has been a crucial element in mitigating the negative consequences of the crisis. Fiscal policy has adopted a stimulus, enabling: increased current spending, in the interest of allocated funds for the coping of pandemics and for the protection of social layers in need; creation of sovereign guarantee schemes, in the interest of increasing business access to loans; as well as increasing public investment, in the interest of recovering the consequences of the earthquake and increasing aggregate demand. In parallel, the Bank of Albania has increased monetary stimulus, through lowering the basic interest rate and increasing liquidity injections, aimed at lowering financing costs and increasing monetary measures in the economy. Also, in collaboration with the banking industry. The Bank of Albania has undertaken changes to the regulatory framework, which have facilitated the temporary postponement of the payment of inslaught and the restructuring of bank loans for struggling customers. In response, financial markets appear relatively quiet. Private sector financing costs remain low, the exchange rate is stable, while the banking sector follows to show good liquidity and capitalisation indicators. The Supervisory Council estimates that the banking sector has made a strong contribution towards shock depreciation. The loan to the private sector marked growth in the second quarter, peaking at 7% in June and supporting Albanian businesses and families with the liquidity needed to cope with the crisis. Also, this sector has taken on a portion of the financial cost of the hit, further easing the burden on the private sector. The Supervisory Council notes that following this positive approach of the banking sector to credit, which is favoured and by sovereign guarantee instruments, will be a necessary prerequisite for recovering the economy in the future. ***  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_5_gusht_2020.html Page 3 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, August 5, 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 At the close of discussions, judging and on the projections of the basic scenario and the balance of risks around it, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current monetary policy position is appropriate. For this reason, he decided: Leave the basic interest rate unchanged at 0.5%; Leave deposit and one-day interest rates unchanged, at 0.1% and 0.9%, respectively. Monetary policy will remain easing throughout the forecast horizon. However, the Supervisory Council considers that the balance of risks follows to remain in the lower direction. In particular, the dangers of the lower kah stem from: The extension highlighted in the pandemic and the re-presentation of social distancing measures for its control; The birth of problems in the monetary policy transmission mechanism, in the form of rising interest rates and private sector financing costs, in the form of deteriorating bank loan supply, or in the form of strong fluctuations in other financial market indicators. The Supervisory Council notes that materializing these risks would require further easing of monetary policy stance.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_5_gusht_2020.html Page 4 of 4

Kushtet aktuale monetare ofrojn stimulin e nevojshm pr nxitjen e rritjes ekonomike dhe pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv brenda vitit 2022. Megjithat, prshkallzimi i mtejshm i goditjes apo krijimi i vshtirsive n mekanizmin e transmetimit t politiks monetare, do t krkonin rritjen e stimulit monetar. *** Pandemia ka sjell nj goditje t rnd pr ekonomin shqiptare, si n nivel makro ashtu dhe n nivel biznesesh e familjes individuale. Sipas t dhnave t Instat-it, ekonomia shqiptare u kontraktua me 2.5% n tremujorin e par t vitit. Ky kontraktim pasqyroi tkurrjen e investimeve, reduktimin e eksportit t mallrave dhe shrbimeve, si dhe ngadalsimin e konsumit privat. T dhnat indirekte t disponuara sugjerojn se aktiviteti ekonomik do t psoj nj rnie dukshm m t fort n tremujorin e dyt. N terma makro, rnia e krkess pr mallra e shrbime dhe mbyllja e prkohshme apo rritja e kostove pr disa kategori aktivitetesh, sht pasqyruar n nj sr treguesish ekonomik. Inflacioni shnoi rritje t leht n tremujorin e dyt, duke regjistruar nj nivel mesatar prej 1.9%. Kjo ecuri u diktua nga rritja e kostove t prodhimit e t transportit, efekte kto t cilat dominuan mbi ndikimin rns n inflacion q sjell tkurrja e krkess agregate. Po ashtu, rnia e aktivitetit ekonomik pritet t shoqrohet me ulje t punsimit dhe rritje t papunsis, me zgjerim t deficitit t llogaris korrente dhe rritje t borxhi publik gjat vitit 2020. N terma mikroekonomik, rnia e krkess dhe e shitjeve, ka sjell vshtirsi financiare pr shum biznese e familje shqiptare, si pasoj e tkurrjes s t ardhurave dhe e humbjes s vendeve t puns. Kto vshtirsi, si dhe pasiguria e perceptuar nga operatort ekonomik, tentojn t zgjasin n koh efektet e goditjes, nprmjet ngadalsimit t konsumit dhe investimeve private. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjer_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_5_gusht_2020.html Pagina 2 di 4 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 5 gusht 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjykon se efekti i pandemis n ekonomi do t vij progresivisht drejt reduktimit gjat tremujorve n vijim, ndonse rikuperimi pritet t jet i ngadalt dhe balanca e rreziqeve mbetet n kahun e poshtm. N skenarin baz, aktiviteti ekonomik n vend pritet t shnoj pikun e ngadalsimit n tremujorin e dyt, t vijoj t mbetet n territor negativ gjat dy tremujorve n vijim, dhe ti kthehet rritjes n vitin 2021. Rritja e krkess agregate pritet t shoqrohet me rritje t punsimit dhe rritje t pagave e t kostove t prodhimit, duke krijuar premisa pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv brenda vitit 2022. Ky skenar sht i kushtzuar nga ecuria e mtejshme e pandemis, nga shpejtsia e prmirsimit t aktivitetit ekonomik n partnert tan tregtar, nga ndikimi i pandemis n sjelljen e ardhshme t biznesit dhe konsumatorit, si dhe nga efektiviteti n koh i masave fiskale, monetare dhe financiare, t ndrmarra deri tani. Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjykon se stimuli i koordinuar fiskal, monetar dhe financiar, ka qen nj element vendimtar n zbutjen e pasojave negative t krizs. Politika fiskale ka adoptuar nj kah stimulues, duke mundsuar: rritjen e shpenzimeve korrente, n interes t alokimit t fondeve pr prballimin e pandemis dhe pr mbrojtjen e shtresave sociale n nevoj; krijimin e skemave t garancis sovrane, n interes t rritjes s aksesit t biznesit n kredi; si dhe, rritjen e investimeve publike, n interes t rikuperimit t pasojave t trmetit dhe t rritjes s krkess agregate. Paralelisht me t, Banka e Shqipris ka rritur stimulin monetar, nprmjet uljes s norms baz t interesit dhe rritjes s injektimeve t likuiditetit, duke synuar uljen e kostove t financimit dhe rritjen e mass monetare n ekonomi. Po ashtu, n bashkpunim me industrin bankare. Banka e Shqipris ka ndrmarr ndryshime t kuadrit rregullator, t cilat kan lehtsuar shtyrjen e prkohshme t pagess s ksteve dhe ristrukturimin e kredive bankare pr klientt n vshtirsi. N prgjigje t tyre, tregjet financiare shfaqen relativisht t qeta. Kostot e financimit t sektorit privat mbeten t ulta, kursi i kmbimit sht i qndrueshm, ndrsa sektori bankar vijon t shfaq tregues t mir likuiditeti dhe kapitalizimi. Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlerson se sektori bankar ka dhn nj kontributin t qensishm n drejtim t amortizimit t goditjeve. Kredia pr sektorin privat vijoi t shnoj rritje n tremujorin e dyt, duke kulmuar n nivelin 7% n muajin qershor dhe duke i mbshtetur bizneset dhe familjet shqiptare me likuiditetin e nevojshm pr prballimin e krizs. Gjithashtu, ky sektor ka marr mbi vete nj pjes t kostos financiare t goditjes, duke lehtsuar m tej barrn pr sektorin privat. Kshilli Mbikqyrs vren se vijimi i ksaj prqasje pozitive t sektorit bankar ndaj kredis, e cila sht favorizuar dhe nga instrumentet e garancis sovrane, do t jet nj parakusht i nevojshm pr rikuperimin e ekonomis n t ardhmen. *** https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjer_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_5_gusht_2020.html Pagina 3 di 4 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 5 gusht 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 N mbyllje t diskutimeve, duke gjykuar dhe mbi projeksionet e skenarit baz dhe balancn e rreziqeve rreth tij, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare sht i prshtatshm. Politika monetare do t vijoj t mbetet lehtsuese gjat gjith horizontit t parashikimit. Gjithsesi, Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjykon se balanca e rreziqeve vijon t mbetet n kahun e poshtm. Title: Questions and answers to the press conference
text: Question answers of the press conference October 7, 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 Question answers of the press conference October 7, 2020 Publication date: 07.10.2020 Q: How much economic shrinkage is forecast to be for this year, as scenarios are negative either from the World Bank or the BERZH. The World Bank declared -8.4%. What is the Bank of Albania's forecast for this? At these rates of economic growth or more accurately even with the data we have when the curve will start to rise in the economy despite optimism for 2021 but on what data will this economic growth come? Governor: The Bank of Albania, like all other national and international institutions, but mainly international institutions such as the International Monetary Fund, the World Bank, the BERK and others, has forecast economic declines for this year. A decline, which in a way, has been in line with our expectations for the second quarter, as our forecast has been slightly and deeper than the 10.2% level. However, we are on the same line with international institutions for predicting economic decline. The Bank of Albania's current forecast is at the level of -7.6%, but the exact figure does not matter, because forecasts change frequentweek after week, as the economy is dynamic and this is an unprecedented crisis. It is important to stress that we anticipate that the economy will return to recovery next year, if we do not have a worsening pandemic scenario or have materialization of the extreme risks scenario I mentioned in the monetary policy statement. So we anticipate that we will have a return to economic growth in 2021, but also in the following years. Also important is harmonisation and coordination of fiscal and monetary policies between the Government and the Bank of Albania, in line with recommendations agreed with international institutions, mainly with the Monetary Fund Page 1 of 3 Question answers of the press conference October 7, 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 International but also the World Bank. So we expect the economy to return to recovery and switch to positive territory in 2021. We also expect that during these two quarters we will have an improvement in the economic situation. Of course we have indices on this, not only from indirect data figures, but also from the survey conducted by the Bank of Albania on the indicator of consumer confidence that has shown that we have positive elements that prove the return. Q: How will public debt be predicted under these conditions because the situation we are in or even the measures taken so far. What will the performance of public debt be like? Governor: I have stressed in several other appearances, but also in the reporting we have done in parliament as the Bank of Albania, that debt is a necessary evil. Not only Albania, but the countries of the region and wider, throughout the world, all countries have been affected by the crisis and as a result of the pandemic have increased their debt, foreign but also domestic debt. Debt parameters have been tolerated to overcome the crisis, as one of the basic instruments for overcoming it. However, the assessment of international assessment institutions, such as Standards & Poors, Moody's, has not changed for Albania, despite rising debt levels. This means that rising debt levels are accepted in an extraordinary crisis situation. Of course, it is an element of risk that must be addressed seriously in the future with the overcoming of risk. After overcoming the risk we will have to return to fiscal consolidation. At the moment, to overcome the crisis we must continue with fiscal easing as well as easing monetary policy, but in the future we will have to change and have a reduction in the level of debt. We will try to reduce debt to the level of the budget deficit. Now we are in this situation where we need to manage overcoming the crisis and then, certainly in the middle and long-term future the goal will be to lower the debt level to preserve macroeconomic balances. Q: Since the Bank of Albania for this year and from the report you published a few days earlier, no purchase of the euro has been made. This has happened because of saying that the lack of euros introduced into the economy by tourism was extremely small this year or are there other reasons? Governor: We have changed our operations as the Central Bank, as the exchange rate behaviour has changed. The Bank of Albania has bought euros for two reasons during previous periods, before the crisis: the first to increase the reserve as an operational target of the Central Bank and the second that the overprice of the exchange rate negatively affected the level of inflation. The situation has changed, with the beginning of the pandemic we had a understatement of the lec. So from the overpriceof the lec, we went under, so we carried out the opposite operation. At first, with the underprice of the lek we were forced to sell euros, an amount which has been declared and has been at the level of about twenty-twenty-one million euros. Now the exchange rate has stabilized and presents itself quite stable. Under these conditions, it is unnecessary that the Bank of Albania sees it unnecessary Page 2 of 3 Question answers of the press conference October 7, 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 pull the euro out of the market, having a high reserve level, not having the negative impact of the exchange rate on inflation and not having an overprice on the exchange rate. Banka Botrore deklaroi -8.4%. Sa sht parashikimi i Banks s Shqipris pr kt? Me kto ritme t rritjes ekonomike ose m sakt edhe me t dhnat q kemi kur do t filloj kurba t ngrihet n ekonomi pavarsisht optimizmit pr 2021 por mbi far t dhnash do t vij kjo rritje ekonomike? Guvernatori: Banka e Shqipris njlloj si gjith institucionet e tjera kombtare dhe ndrkombtare, por kryesisht institucione ndrkombtare si Fondi Monetar Ndrkombtar, Banka Botrore, BERZH dhe t tjera, ka parashikuar rnie ekonomike pr kt vit. Nj rnie, e cila n nj fare mnyre, ka qen n linj me pritjet tona pr tremujorin e dyt, pasi parashikimi yn ka qen pak dhe m i thell se niveli 10.2%. Gjithsesi, ne jemi n t njjtn linj me institucionet ndrkombtare pr parashikimin e rnies ekonomike. Parashikimi i deritanishm i Banks s Shqipris sht n nivelin e -7.6 %, por nuk ka rndsi shifra e sakt, sepse parashikimet ndryshojn n mnyr frekuente, jav pas jave, pasi dhe ekonomia sht dinamike dhe kjo sht nj kriz e paprecedent. E rndsishme sht t theksojm q ne parashikojm q ekonomia do ti kthehet ringritjes vitin e ardhshm, n rast se ne nuk do t kemi nj skenar t prkeqsuar t pandemis ose nuk do t kemi materializim t skenarit t rreziqeve ekstreme q prmenda n deklaratn e politiks monetare. Pra, ne parashikojm q t kemi nj rikthim t rritjes ekonomike n vitin 2021, por dhe n vitet n vazhdim. Gjithashtu sht i rndsishm harmonizimi dhe koordinimi i politikave fiskale dhe monetare midis Qeveris dhe Banks s Shqipris, n linj me rekomandimet e dakordsuara me institucionet ndrkombtare, kryesisht me Fondin Monetar https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Pyetje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_7_tetor_2020.html Pagina 1 di 3 Pyetje prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp 7 tetor 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 Ndrkombtar por dhe Bankn Botrore. Pra ne presim q ekonomia ti kthehet ringritjes dhe t kaloj n territor pozitiv n vitin 2021. Gjithashtu, presim q gjat ktyre dy tremujorve t kemi nj prmirsim t situats ekonomike. Sigurisht q kemi indikacione pr kt, jo vetm nga shifrat e t dhnave t trthorta, por edhe nga anketa e zhvilluar nga Banka e Shqipris mbi treguesin e besimit t konsumatorit q ka treguar se kemi element pozitiv q vrtetojn kthimin. Pyetje: Si do t parashikohet borxhi publik n kto kushte duke qen se situata n t ciln ndodhemi apo edhe masat e marra deri m tani. Si do t jet ecuria e borxhit publik? Guvernatori: E kam theksuar edhe n disa dalje t tjera, por dhe n raportimin q ne kemi br n parlament si Bank e Shqipris, q borxhi sht nj e keqe e domosdoshme. Jo vetm Shqipria, por vendet e rajonit dhe m gjer, n t gjith botn, t gjitha vendet jan prekur nga kriza dhe si pasoj e pandemis kan rritur borxhin e tyre, borxhin e jashtm por edhe t brendshm. Parametrat e borxhit jan toleruar pr t kaprcyer krizn, si nj nga instrumentet baz pr kaprcimin e saj. Megjithat, vlersimi i institucioneve t vlersimit ndrkombtar, si jan Standards & Poors, Moodys, nuk ka ndryshuar pr Shqiprin, megjith rritjen e nivelit t borxhit. Kjo do t thot q rritja e nivelit t borxhit sht e pranuar n situat t jashtzakonshme krize. Sigurisht q sht nj element rreziku i cili duhet adresuar seriozisht n t ardhmen me kaprcimin e rrezikut. Pas kaprcimit t rrezikut ne do t duhet ti rikthehemi konsolidimit fiskal. Pr momentin, pr t kaprcyer krizn ne duhet t vazhdojm me lehtsimin fiskal sikurse me politikn monetare lehtsuese, por n t ardhmen do t duhet t ndryshojm dhe t kemi nj ulje t nivelit t borxhit. Do t mundohemi t ulim borxhin deri n nivelin e deficitit buxhetor. Tani ne jemi n kt situat ku duhet t menaxhojm kaprcimin e krizs dhe m pas, sigurisht n nj t ardhme t mesme dhe afatgjat synimi do t jet ulja e nivelit t borxhit pr t ruajtur balancat makroekonomike. Pyetje: Duke qen se Banka e Shqipris pr kt vit dhe nga raporti q ju keni publikuar pak dit m hert nuk sht br blerje e euros. Kjo ka ndodhur pr shkak t themi se mungesa e eurove t futura n ekonomi nga turizmi ishte tejet e vogl kt vit apo ka arsye t tjera? Guvernatori: Ne kemi ndryshuar operacionet tona si Bank Qendrore, pasi dhe sjellja e kursit t kmbimit ka ndryshuar. Banka e Shqipris ka bler euro pr dy arsye gjat periudhave t mparshme, para krizs: e para pr t rritur rezervn si nj objektiv operacional i Banks Qendrore dhe e dyta se mbimimi i kursit t kmbimit ndikonte negativisht n nivelin e inflacionit. Situata ka ndryshuar, me fillimin e pandemis patm nj nnmim t lekut. Pra nga mbimimi i lekut kaluam n nnmim, kshtu q dhe ne kryem operacionin e kundrt. N fillim, me nnmimin e lekut u detyruam t shesim euro, nj sasi e cila sht deklaruar dhe ka qen n nivelin rreth njzet -njzet e nj milion euro. Tani kursi i kmbimit sht stabilizuar dhe paraqitet mjaft i qndrueshm.
