Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, October 7, 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, October 7, 2020 Publication date: 07.10.2020 Honored media representatives, On 7 October 2020, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Intermediate Monetary Policy Report. In line with our expectations, the information available suggests that the impact of the pandemic on the economy has been complete and serious in the second quarter, but has come towards reduction in the following months. Simultaneous fiscal, monetary and financial stimulus has effectively resulted in avoiding the more negative consequences of the blow. The easing of social distancing measures, the stability of financial markets, as well as the health of the banking sector balance sheet, constitute premise for a gradual recovery of economic activity in the future. At the end of the discussion, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current monetary policy position remains appropriate. Current monetary conditions provide the necessary stimulus for boosting economic growth and returning inflation to the target within 2022. However, further escalation of the blow or the creation of difficulties in the monetary policy transmission mechanism would require increased monetary stimulus.  per_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_7_tetor_2020.html Page 1 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, October 7, 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 The Covid-19 pandemic is the most serious challenge facing the global economy in recent decades. Economic activity in most economies has shown double-digit decline rates, unemployment has increased, while the financial situation of the private sector has deteriorated. Unprecedented fiscal and monetary measures have eased the pandemic's impact, but the prospect of recovery still remains surrounded by uncertainty. Inflation in the country marked an average value of 1.3% during the months of July and August, marking declines compared to the second quarter. This decline has reflected lower inflation rates of food items and certain categories of services. In macro terms, the slowdown in inflation reflected the gradual suppression of supply shocks and showed the fullest effect of declining aggregate demand, at home and globally. According to Instat data, economic activity in the country marked an annual decline of 10.2% in the second quarter. This decline reflected the negative contribution of almost all sectors of the economy and aggregate demand components. In parallel, employment marked an annual decline of 3.6% while the unemployment rate rose to 11.9%. Third-quarter data still remains preliminary. However, the better performance of tax revenues and exports, as well as improved business and consumer confidence, suggest that the economic decline has been falling, but at slower rates than in the second quarter. The Supervisory Council considers that the effect of the pandemic on the economy will come towards reduction over the following quarters. In the basic scenario, economic activity in the country is expected to improve, but still remain in negative territory, during the second half of the current year and return to growth in the coming year. The increase in aggregate demand is expected to be accompanied by employment growth and rising wages and production costs, helping to return inflation to the target within 2022. The life of the basic scenario is conditional on the further performance of the pandemic, its impact on future business and consumer behaviour, the speed of improving economic activity in our trading partners, as well as by the timely response of public authorities and the private sector.  per_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_7_tetor_2020.html Page 2 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, October 7, 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 The current fiscal, monetary and financial easing policies have had an important role in coping with the blow. More specifically: fiscal stimulus has softened the impact of the blow on business and household finances; monetary stimulus has lowered financing costs in the economy, guaranteed the supply of the banking sector with the required liquidity, as well as creating the necessary premise for increased lending; While, the temporary easing of the banking sector's regulatory framework, has helped postpone credit card payments in time and encouraged the restructuring of loans, in line with the common will and interest of banks and creditors. In reflection of these measures, Albanian financial markets have operated quietly. Interest rates remain near historic minimums, while the exchange rate appears stable. In particular, the banking sector has been able to supply businesses and households in need with liquidity. Credit for the private sector recognised an average annual increase of 6.4% in the months of July  August, reflecting a good transmission of economic policy stimulus, balance sheet health and the willingness of the banking sector to contribute to coping with the blow. Looking to the future, the Supervisory Council notes that ensuring economic growth requires maintaining a stimulating kahu of macroeconomic policies. Likewise, the Supervisory Council notes that monetary and financial stability in the country constitutes a positive premise for the recovery of the economy and an essential prerequisite for sustainability in its time. In this context, while the expected reduction of fiscal stimulus in the future and macroprudential normalization will help preserve the country's financial balances, monetary policy must follow to preserve its accommodative position. *** At the close of discussions, judging and on the projections of the basic scenario and the balance of risks around them, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current monetary policy position remains appropriate. For this reason, he decided: leave the basic interest rate unchanged at 0.5%; left deposit and one-day interest rates unchanged at 0.1% and 0.9%, respectively. Monetary policy will remain easing throughout the forecast horizon. The Bank of Albania will continue to preserve the current form of liquidity injection operations, a form that guarantees unlimited injection in its quantity, until the end of the first quarter of next year. However, the Supervisory Council considers that the balance of risks follows to remain in the lower direction. In particular, the dangers of the lower kah stem from: the time-pronounced extension of the pandemic and the possible re-presentation of measures  per_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_7_tetor_2020.html Page 3 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, October 7, 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 social distancing for its control; the birth of problems in the monetary policy transmission mechanism, in the form of rising interest rates and private sector financing costs, in the form of deteriorating bank loan supply, or in the form of unforeseen fluctuations in other financial market indicators. The Supervisory Council notes that materializing these risks would require further easing of monetary policy stance.  per_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_7_tetor_2020.html Page 4 of 4

Masat e paprecedenta fiskale dhe monetare kan lehtsuar impaktin e pandemis, por perspektiva e rikuperimit mbetet ende e rrethuar nga pasiguri. Title: Speech of the First Deputy Governor Minxhozi, at the hearing session of the Parliamentary Committee on Economy and Finance on the draft budget 2021
text: First Deputy Governor Minxhozi's word at the hearing... Parliamentary Economy and Finance on Draft Budget 2021 29/07/22, 13:33 Word of First Deputy Governor Minxhozi, at the hearing of the Parliamentary Commission on Economics and Finance on the 2021 draft Publication date: 02.11.2020 Honorable, Mrs. Speaker, Honored ladies and gentlemen, deputies, I thank you for the invitation and opportunity you have given me to present the Bank of Albania's opinion on the 2021 draft budget. The Bank of Albania devotes particular importance to continued institutional dialogue with the Ministry of Finance and Economy, as well as with the Assembly of the Republic of Albania, in the interest of harmonizing and coordinating policies as best as possible.  rlamentar_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_mbi_projektbuxhetin_2021.html Page 1 of 7 First Deputy Governor Minxhozi's word at the hearing... Parliamentary Economy and Finance on Draft Budget 2021 29/07/22, 13:33 This dialogue becomes even more useful in moments like this one today, when the country faces the health, economic and social consequences of the Covid-19 pandemic. In this context, the 2021 Budget must play a triple role. He must: (i) provide the necessary financial support for mitigating the consequences of the crisis in the short term; (ii) provide the necessary funds for supporting the country's long-term development priorities; as well as (iii) ensure the long-term sustainability of the health of the country's public finances. In terms of how much above, the Bank of Albania states that: The 2021 draft budget envisions preserving a fiscal policy stimulus kahu over the next year. Also, the 2021 Draft Budget maintains a high level of public investment, investments that are essential for recovering physical capital damaged by the November 2019 earthquake and improving the country's development infrastructure. Finally, the 2021 Draft Budget is in line with the 'fiscal accountability' clauses of the Organic Budget Law, but the understandable increase in public debt during the period 2019-2021 must be addressed carefully in the medium and long-term fiscal plans.  lamentar_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_mbi_projektbuxhetin_2021.html Page 2 of 7 First Deputy Governor Minxhozi's word at the hearing... Parliamentary Economy and Finance on Draft Budget 2021 29/07/22, 13:33 In accordance with our legal mandate, the Bank of Albania's ongoing opinion will be oriented in the following directions: macroeconomic stability and the intertwining of fiscal policy with monetary policy; fiscal projections and sustainability of public debt; as well as, the impact of projected public borrowing on internal financial markets. Also, at the close of this opinion you will find some suggestions from the Bank of Albania on issues, which we think should be had at attention, in the function of increasing the effectiveness and sustainability of public finances. The following issues will be addressed in more detail. 1. Expected economic performance and its intertwining with monetary and fiscal policies The Albanian economy is facing its biggest challenge of the past two decades. The earthquake dated November 26, 2019 brought great losses to human life and damaged a large number of dwellings and infrastructure facilities. The Covid-19 pandemic forced public authorities to take restrictive measures to move individuals and increased the uncertainty of manufacturers and consumers. These shocks had a strong negative impact on 2020 economic growth, bringing the Albanian economy into recession. Available data suggest that economic declines peaked in the second quarter of the year and the economy is gradually moving towards recovering the positive pace of growth and previous levels of economic activity. However, this recovery remains fragile and the risks are expected to remain in the lower direction. The economic stimulus policies pursued so far have had a crucial role in coping with the blow and creating premise for growth. The Bank of Albania has taken a full package of measures, measures which have aimed to help function  lamentar_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_mbi_projektbuxhetin_2021.html Page 3 of 7 First Deputy Governor Minxhozi's word at the hearing... Parliamentary Economy and Finance on Draft Budget 2021 29/07/22, 13:33 normal financial markets, support the supply of the economy with funds and lower the cost of debt service, as well as increase the sustainability of the banking sector. Here I find a way to distinguish: increasing monetary stimulus, through lowering the basic interest rate, to a historic minimum of 0.5%, and unlimited liquidity provision for the banking sector; encouragement through regulatory measures of delaying the provisional payment of credit instalments for customers in dire financial difficulties and restructuring loans for customers in more stable difficulty; promoting online payments, through the elimination of the costs of using the infrastructure of the national currency payment system operated by the Bank of Albania; empowering the capital base of the banking sector and monitoring its financial indicators, through the cancellation of the 2020 grant payments and the continuation of on-and-off-site supervision programmes. At the same time, fiscal stimulus has partially cushioned the negative impact of pandemics on Albanian household incomes, helped ease the negative impact on the financial flows of businesses, as well as generate additional funds for coping with the health emergency. Given the prospect of economic developments, as well as the added uncertainties and the prevailing risks of the lower kah, the Bank of Albania considers that the combination of economic policies should remain stimulating for the near future. We also judge how monetary and fiscal policy should make their contribution in this direction. The countercyclical nature of fiscal policy is necessary to increase the effectiveness of monetary stimulus, promote the expansion of aggregate demand and cushion losses in production, as a result of the pandemic and earthquake. In this context, the 2021 Draft Budget seems to address this objective. According to the accompanying claim and its projections, this Project Budget is based on the premise of a gradual recovery of the economy over the next year and projects a deficit around the 6.5% level of GDP. To a large extent, this deficit reflects the design of a relatively high level of public investment, projected to reach the 7.2% GDP level. As far as possible, the Bank of Albania considers that: The preservation of fiscal policy easing kah even during 2021 is  under current circumstances  consistent with the optimal combination of economic policies; fiscal policy, tax measures and the ratio of current public spending to those capital are in line with the country's short-term and long-term development needs. Public investment is the potentially most effective element of fiscal incentives. In addition to the positive effect in the short term,  through the creation of new jobs  the addition of public investment has positive impacts and on increasing the country's productive potential. Finally, the Bank of Albania states that the expected effect of fiscal measures on inflation will be relatively low and fleeting.  lamentar_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_mbi_projektbuxhetin_2021.html Page 4 of 7 First Deputy Governor Minxhozi's word at the hearing... Parliamentary Economy and Finance on Draft Budget 2021 29/07/22, 13:33 2. Fiscal projections and sustainability of public debt The 2021 draft budget is based on the projection of a level of public income around 480 billion dollars or 11% higher than the level expected during the current year. This projection partly factors the tendency to recover economic activity and partly increase the efficiency of the tax and customs administration in tax collection. On the other hand, fiscal package changes are designed to have a negative marginal aggregate impact on income performance. The Bank of Albania considers this to be a reasonable projection for budget construction and spending programming. However, our revenue projections are easily lower than budget projections. Also, uncertainty over the future as well as the many risks of lower kah can produce negative surprises in revenue collection. For this reason, although the Budget has contingencies for their amortization, the Bank of Albania considers that the realization of programmed expenses should be careful and track the level of income realisation in a timely and timely way. In this direction, we suggest that a positive step would be to increase beyond the current levels of contingency funds in the budget or preliminary identification of non-priority expenditure, the realisation of which should be conditional on the realisation of the projected level of income. In parallel with the care of respecting next year's Budget indicators, the Bank of Albania devotes great importance to the long-term sustainability of public debt. In this prism I want to share with you two counties. First, the 2021 Draft Budget meets the requirements arise from the Organic Budget Law (LOB). More specifically, these provisions require: reinstatement of debt on a falling trajectory, after the hit taken in 2020; determining investments at a higher level than the overall budget deficit; non-inclusion of privatisation revenues as a conventional instrument in deficit financing; As well as, the creation of a contingencies fund to meet potential risks from fluctuations in exchange courses or interest rates that affect the level of debt. In our judgment, these provisions find reflection in the 2021 Draft Budget. Second, the 2021 Draft Budget envisions a reduction of about two percentage points in the ratio of public debt to GDP, to drop it around 78.6% at the end of 2021. In a more long-term respect, the Bank of Albania draws attention to the fact that this level of debt continues to remain high. Facing the latest crisis fully illustrated the importance of having a low or controlled level of public debt. For this reason, reducing public debt should be a primary objective of our fiscal policy,  lamentar_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_mbi_projektbuxhetin_2021.html Page 5 of 7 First Deputy Governor Minxhozi's word at the hearing... Parliamentary Economy and Finance on Draft Budget 2021 29/07/22, 13:33 as an instrument for lowering public and private sector financing costs, as well as as as a guarantee instrument on preserving the necessary fiscal spaces for coping with future shocks. In this context, the Bank of Albania: welcomes the inclusion in the LOB of the obligation to create primary sufficiency starting in 2023. This is a necessary measure for increasing the sustainability of public finances in the long term; Considers that fiscal policy consolidation should begin at the first appropriate moment that enables the crystallization of economic growth sustainability and the performance of risk premiums in financial markets. 3. Public sector borrowing and internal financial market The total budget deficit of 2021 is programmed to almost 108.7 billion dollars. Its financing is designed to be realized mainly in the internal financial market, and less through the use of excess liquidity created from 2020; and increased borrowing from abroad. The Bank of Albania considers that internal financial markets are relatively accommodative to an increased government borrowing. However, the financial market remains sensitive to non-simultaneous distributions of government borrowing during the year. Also, separate banks are said to have restrictive policies in terms of exposure to sovereign debt, which could bring a lower interest of market actors to invest in government titles. Under these circumstances, the Bank of Albania suggests continued monitoring of financial markets, as well as continued dialogue and co-operation between our institutions. In a more long-term perspective, care must be done for the structural improvement of the financial system as well as for increasing the efficiency of the secondary market of valuable letters. 4. Suggestions for the future Depending on the optimal harmonization of fiscal policy with the monetary one in the future, which would guarantee the achievement of macroeconomic balances in the future, we consider that addressing some issues is necessary in the medium and long term, as follows. Public - private partnership projects The 2021 draft budget takes into account the risks stemming from the expansion of public-private partnership projects (PPP), setting limits on the total value of these projects and detailing related expenses within the year. However, the Bank of Albania suggests assessing the possibility of including a general upper limit on the total value of PPPs in relation to THE GDP in the Organic Budget Law.  lamentar_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_mbi_projektbuxhetin_2021.html Page 6 of 7 First Deputy Governor Minxhozi's word at the hearing... Parliamentary Economy and Finance on Draft Budget 2021 29/07/22, 13:33 We also find it appropriate to stress that new PPP projects must be adopted within a framework, which enables the prioritization of public investments. Currency structure of public debt Analysis of public debt and the matrix of its risks in the future shows that debt composition must be improved, especially in currency terms, towards increasing the weight of debt denominated in national currency and controlling exposure to denominated foreign currency debt. On the effectiveness of public finances The Bank of Albania has consistently supported legal sanction, which requires the level of public investment to be no lower than the level of borrowing. Underlining and once again the major role these investments have in the country's development, the Bank of Albania suggests maintaining attention to the current structural deficit, in the interest storing spaces for capital investment in the future. *** Honorable, Mrs. Speaker, Honored ladies and gentlemen, deputies, Let me express, at the end of my word, the will and readiness of the Bank of Albania to respect its legal duties and for the continued continuation of dialogue with the Albanian Assembly and Government. Gjithashtu, n mbyllje t ktij opinioni do t gjeni disa sugjerime t Banks s Shqipris mbi shtje, t cilat mendojm se duhen pasur n vmendje, n funksion t rritjes s efektivitetit dhe t qndrueshmris s financave publike. shtjet e msiprme do t adresohen m n detaje n vijim. 1. Ecuria e pritur ekonomike dhe ndrthurja e saj me politikat monetare e fiskale Ekonomia shqiptare po prballet me sfidn e saj m t madhe t dy dekadave t fundit. Trmeti i dats 26 nntor 2019 solli humbje t mdha n jet njerzore dhe dmtoi nj numr t madh banesash dhe asetesh infrastrukturore. Pandemia Covid-19 detyroi autoritetet publike t marrin masa kufizuese pr lvizjen e individve dhe rriti pasigurin e prodhuesve dhe konsumatorve. Kto goditje patn nj ndikim t fort negativ n rritjen ekonomike t vitit 2020, duke e sjell ekonomin shqiptare n recesion. T dhnat e disponuara sugjerojn se rnia ekonomike kulmoi n tremujorin e dyt t vitit dhe ekonomia po lviz gradualisht drejt rikuperimit t ritmit pozitiv t rritjes dhe nivelit t mparshm t aktivitetit ekonomik. Megjithat, ky rikuperim mbetet i brisht dhe rreziqet jan e priten t mbeten n kahun e poshtm. Politikat ekonomike stimuluese t ndjekura deri tani kan pasur nj rol vendimtar n prballimin e goditjes dhe krijimin e premisave pr rritje. Banka e Shqipris ka marr nj paket t plot masash, masa t cilat kan synuar t ndihmojn funksionimin https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjlamentar_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_mbi_projektbuxhetin_2021.html Pagina 3 di 7 Fjala e Zvendsguvernatores s Par Minxhozi, n seancn dgjim Parlamentar t Ekonomis dhe Financave mbi projektbuxhetin 2021 29/07/22, 13:33 normal t tregjeve financiare, t mbshtesin furnizimin e ekonomis me fonde dhe t ulin koston e shrbimit t borxhit, si dhe t rritin qndrueshmrin e sektorit bankar. Ktu gjej me vend t veoj: rritjen e stimulit monetar, nprmjet uljes s norms baz t interesit, n minimumin historik prej 0.5%, dhe ofrimit t pakufizuar t likuiditetit pr sektorin bankar; inkurajimin nprmjet masave rregullatore t shtyrjes s pagess t prkohshme t ksteve t kredive pr klientt n vshtirsi financiare t ngutshme dhe ristrukturimin e kredive pr klientt n vshtirsi m t qndrueshme; nxitjen e pagesave online, nprmjet eliminimit t kostove t prdorimit t infrastrukturs s sistemit t pagesave n monedh kombtare t operuar nga Banka e Shqipris; fuqizimin e bazs s kapitalit t sektorit bankar dhe monitorimin e treguesve t tij financiar, nprmjet anulimit t pagesave t dividendit gjat vitit 2020 dhe vazhdimit t programeve t mbikqyrjes on- dhe off-site. N t njjtn koh, stimuli fiskal ka amortizuar pjesrisht ndikimin negativ t pandemis n t ardhurat e familjeve shqiptare, ka ndihmuar n lehtsimin e ndikimit negativ mbi flukset financiare t bizneseve, si dhe ka gjeneruar fonde shtes pr prballimin e emergjencs shndetsore. Bazuar n perspektivn e zhvillimeve ekonomike, si dhe n pasigurit e shtuara dhe rreziqet mbizotruese t kahut t poshtm, Banka e Shqipris gjykon se kombinimi i politikave ekonomike duhet t mbetet stimulues pr t ardhmen e afrt. Po ashtu, ne gjykojm se si politika monetare dhe ajo fiskale duhet t japin kontributin e tyre n kt drejtim. Natyra kundrciklike e politiks fiskale sht e nevojshme pr t rritur efektivitetin e stimulit monetar, pr t nxitur zgjerimin e krkess agregate dhe pr t amortizuar humbjet n prodhim, si pasoj e pandemis dhe e trmetit. N kt kontekst, Projektbuxheti i vitit 2021 duket se e adreson kt objektiv. Sipas relacionit shoqrues dhe projeksioneve t tij, ky Projektbuxhet bazohet n premisn e nj rikuperimi gradual t ekonomis gjat vitit t ardhshm dhe projekton nj deficit rreth nivelit 6.5% t PBB-s. N nj mas t madhe, ky deficit pasqyron projektimin e nj niveli relativisht t lart investimesh publike, t parashikuara t arrijn n nivelin 7.2% t PBB-s. Pr sa m sipr, Banka e Shqipris gjykon se: ruajtja e kahut lehtsues t politiks fiskale edhe gjat vitit 2021 sht  n rrethanat aktuale konsistente me kombinimin optimal t politikave ekonomike; politika fiskale, masat tatimore dhe raporti i shpenzimeve publike korrente ndaj atyre kapitale, jan n prputhje me nevojat afatshkurtra dhe afatgjata t zhvillimit t vendit. Investimet publike jan elementi potencialisht m efektiv i stimujve fiskal. Krahas efektit pozitiv n afatin e shkurtr,  nprmjet krijimit t vendeve t reja t puns  shtimi i investimeve publike ka ndikime pozitive dhe n rritjen e potencialit prodhues t vendit. S fundi, Banka e Shqipris konstaton se efekti i pritur i masave fiskale mbi inflacion do t jet relativisht i ult dhe kalimtar. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjlamentar_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_mbi_projektbuxhetin_2021.html Pagina 4 di 7 Fjala e Zvendsguvernatores s Par Minxhozi, n seancn dgjim Parlamentar t Ekonomis dhe Financave mbi projektbuxhetin 2021 29/07/22, 13:33 2. Projeksionet fiskale dhe qndrueshmria e borxhit publik Projektbuxheti i vitit 2021 bazohet n projeksionin e nj niveli t ardhurash publike rreth vlers 480 miliard lek ose 11% m t larta se niveli i pritur gjat vitit aktual. Ky projeksion faktorizon pjesrisht tendencn e rikuperimit t aktivitetit ekonomik dhe pjesrisht rritjen e eficiencs s administrats tatimore e doganore n mbledhjen e taksave. N t kundrt, ndryshimet e pakets fiskale projektohen t ken nj ndikim agregat marxhinal negativ n ecurin e t ardhurave. Banka e Shqipris gjykon se ky sht nj projeksion i arsyeshm pr ndrtimin e Buxhetit dhe programimin e shpenzimeve. Megjithat, projeksionet tona t t ardhurave jan lehtsisht m t ulta se projeksionet e Buxhetit. Po ashtu, pasiguria pr t ardhmen si dhe rreziqet e shumta t kahut t poshtm mund t prodhojn surpriza negative n grumbullimin e t ardhurave. Pr kt arsye, ndonse Projektbuxheti ka kontingjenca pr amortizimin e tyre, Banka e Shqipris gjykon se realizimi i shpenzimeve t programuara duhet t jet i kujdesshm dhe t ndjek n ritm e n koh nivelin e realizimit t t ardhurave. N kt drejtim, ne sugjerojm se nj hap pozitiv do t ishte rritja prtej niveleve aktuale e fondeve kontingjente n buxhet apo identifikimi paraprak i shpenzimeve joprioritare, realizimi i t cilave duhet t kushtzohet me realizimin e nivelit t parashikuar t t ardhurave. Paralelisht me kujdesin ndaj respektimit t treguesve t Buxhetit t vitit t ardhshm, Banka e Shqipris i kushton rndsi t madhe qndrueshmris afatgjat t borxhit publik. N kt prizm dshiroj t ndaj me ju dy konstatime. S pari, Projektbuxheti i vitit 2021 plotson krkesat q burojn nga Ligji Organik i Buxhetit (LOB). M konkretisht, kto dispozita krkojn: rivendosjen e borxhit n nj trajektore rnse, pas goditjes s marr n vitin 2020; prcaktimin e investimeve n nivel m t lart sesa deficiti i prgjithshm buxhetor; mosprfshirjen e t ardhurave nga privatizimi si nj instrument konvencional n financimin e deficitit; si dhe, krijimin e nj fondi kontingjence pr prballimin e rreziqeve potenciale nga luhatjet n kurset e kmbimit ose normat e interesit q ndikojn nivelin e borxhit. N gjykimin ton, kto dispozita gjejn pasqyrim n Projektbuxhetin e vitit 2021. S dyti, Projektbuxheti i vitit 2021 parashikon nj reduktim prej rreth dy piksh prqindje t raportit t borxhit publik ndaj PBB-s, pr ta zbritur at rreth nivelit 78.6% n fund t vitit 2021. N nj aspekt kohor m afatgjat, Banka e Shqipris trheq vmendjen se ky nivel borxhi vijon t mbetet i lart. Prballja me krizn e fundit ilustroi plotsisht rndsin q ka nj nivel i ult apo nn kontroll i borxhit publik. Pr kt arsye, reduktimi i borxhit publik duhet t jet nj objektiv primar i politiks ton fiskale, https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjlamentar_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_mbi_projektbuxhetin_2021.html Pagina 5 di 7 Fjala e Zvendsguvernatores s Par Minxhozi, n seancn dgjim Parlamentar t Ekonomis dhe Financave mbi projektbuxhetin 2021 29/07/22, 13:33 si nj instrument pr uljen e kostove t financimit t sektorit publik dhe privat si dhe si nj instrument garancie mbi ruajtjen e hapsirave t nevojshme fiskale pr prballimin e goditjeve t ardhshme. N kt kontekst, Banka e Shqipris: prshndet prfshirjen n LOB t detyrimit pr t krijuar suficite primare duke filluar nga viti 2023. Kjo sht nj mas e nevojshme pr rritjen e qndrueshmris s financave publike n afatin e gjat; gjykon se konsolidimi i politiks fiskale duhet t filloj n momentin m t par t prshtatshm q mundson kristalizimi i qndrueshmris s rritjes ekonomike dhe ecuria e primeve t rrezikut n tregjet financiare. 3. Huamarrja e sektorit publik dhe tregu i brendshm financiar Deficiti i prgjithshm buxhetor i vitit 2021 programohet thuajse n nivelin 108.7 miliard lek. Financimi i tij projektohet t realizohet kryesisht n tregun e brendshm financiar, dhe m pak nprmjet prdorimit t likuiditetit t teprt t krijuar nga viti 2020; dhe rritjes s huamarrjes nga jasht. Banka e Shqipris gjykon se tregjet e brendshme financiare paraqiten relativisht akomoduese ndaj nj huamarrjeje t rritur t qeveris. Megjithat, tregu financiar mbetet i ndjeshm ndaj shprndarjeve jo t njtrajtshme t huamarrjes s qeveris gjat vitit. Gjithashtu, banka t veanta vijojn t ken politika kufizuese pr sa i prket ekspozimit ndaj borxhit sovran, gj q mund t sjell nj interes m t ult t aktorve t tregut pr t investuar n titujt e qeveris. N kto rrethana, Banka e Shqipris sugjeron monitorimin e vazhdueshm t tregjeve financiare, si edhe vazhdimin e dialogut dhe bashkpunimit midis institucioneve tona. N nj perpsektiv m afatgjat, kujdes duhet br pr prmirsimin strukturor t sistemit financiar si dhe pr rritjen e efikasitetit t tregut sekondar t letrave me vler. 4. Sugjerime pr t ardhmen N funksion t harmonizimit optimal t politiks fiskale me at monetare n t ardhmen, ka do t garantonte arritjen e ekuilibrave makroekonomik n t ardhmen, gjykojm se sht i nevojshm adresimi n afatin e mesm dhe t gjat i disa shtjeve, si n vijim. Projektet e partneritetit publik  privat Projektbuxheti i vitit 2021 merr parasysh rreziqet q burojn nga zgjerimi i projekteve t partneritetit publik-privat (PPP), duke vendosur kufi mbi vlern totale t ktyre projekteve dhe duke detajuar shpenzimet e lidhura me to brenda vitit. Megjithat, Banka e Shqipris sugjeron vlersimin e mundsis s prfshirjes s nj kufiri t siprm t prgjithshm mbi vlern totale t PPP-ve n raport me PBB-n n Ligjin Organik t Buxhetit. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjlamentar_te_Ekonomise_dhe_Financave_mbi_projektbuxhetin_2021.html Pagina 6 di 7 Fjala e Zvendsguvernatores s Par Minxhozi, n seancn dgjim Parlamentar t Ekonomis dhe Financave mbi projektbuxhetin 2021 29/07/22, 13:33 Po ashtu, gjejm me vend t theksojm q projektet e reja t PPP-ve duhet t miratohen brenda nj kornize, e cila mundson prioritizimin e investimeve publike. Struktura valutore e borxhit publik Analiza e borxhit publik dhe matrica e rreziqeve t tij n t ardhmen tregon se kompozimi i borxhit duhet prmirsuar, sidomos n termat e monedhs, drejt rritjes s peshs s borxhit t denominuar n monedh kombtare dhe kontrollin e ekspozimit ndaj borxhit t denominuar n monedh t huaj. Mbi efektivitetin e financave publike Banka e Shqipris ka mbshtetur n vazhdimsi sanksionimin ligjor, i cili krkon q niveli i investimeve publike t jet jo m i vogl se niveli i huamarrjes. Duke nnvizuar dhe nj her rolin e madh q kto investime kan n zhvillimin e vendit, Banka e Shqipris sugjeron ruajtjen e vmendjes ndaj deficitit strukturor korrent, n interes t ruajtjes s hapsirave pr investime kapitale n t ardhmen. *** E nderuar zonja Kryetare, T nderuar zonja dhe zotrinj deputet, M lejoni tju shpreh, n fund t fjals sime, vullnetin e gatishmrin e Banks s Shqipris pr respektimin e detyrave t saj ligjore dhe pr vijimin e vazhdueshm t dialogut me Kuvendin dhe Qeverin Shqiptare. Title: Speech of the First Deputy Governor Minxhozi at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: First Deputy Governor Minxhozi's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making 29/07/22, 13:33 First Deputy Governor Minxhozi's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making Publication date: 04.11.2020 Honored media representatives, Today, on 4 November 2020, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Quarterly Monetary Policy Report. The information received in the analysis shows that economic activity has come to an improvement during the summer months, following the sharp decline marked in the second quarter. This recovery reflected the easing of social distance measures and the support provided by the all-fiscal, monetary and macroprudence stimulus. However, despite positive tendencies, the prospect of the economy recovering in the future still remains fragile. The new wave of infections and the presentation of restrictive measures in many countries, potentially and in Albania, present serious challenges to public health and the performance of the economy during the following period. Page 1 of 4 First Deputy Governor Minxhozi's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making 29/07/22, 13:33 In this context, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current monetary policy position remains appropriate. Monetary conditions and low interest rates provide the right support for economic growth and for returning inflation to the target within 2022. *** Pandemia has given a strong negative impact on the Albanian economy. Its consequences have clearly materialized in the main indicators; social distancing measures and rising uncertainty have brought about a sharp contraction in economic activity, reduced employment and falling inflation. Consumer price inflation marked an average value of 1.4% in the third quarter, coming in slowing from a quarter earlier. Its reduction is mainly attributed to the fall in prices of certain food items and the prices of certain categories of services. In macroeconomic terms, the fall in inflation reflected the suppression of supply shocks, low pressures from weak aggregate demand and disinflationary tendencies in our partner economies. According to Instat data, gross domestic product fell by 10.2% in the second quarter of the year, marking the strongest contraction in Albanian history in the last two decades. This contraction resulted in broad based on sectoral distribution and aggregate demand structure, but it mostly reflected the contraction of private consumption and activity in the services sector. In the same quarter, the Albanian economy lost about 50,000 jobs and the unemployment rate rose to 11.9%. However, fiscal aid packages have somewhat cushioned the difficult situation in the labour market. Consequently, both falling employment and rising unemployment have been more softened than the performance of indicators of economic activity. Page 2 of 4 First Deputy Governor Minxhozi's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making 29/07/22, 13:33 The indicators available for economic activity and the labour market signal a gradual recovery during the third quarter. Reducing restrictions on the circulation of people and goods, at home and in the world, preserving the country's monetary and financial stability, as well as the slight improvement of confidence indicators, have created the necessary premise for the growth of the economy in the future. However, economic recovery remains fragile and the risks are expected to remain at the bottom. Our basic scenario of expected developments is built on the assumption of avoiding extreme measures for controlling the spread of a second wave of pandemics and gradually reducing its consequences. In this scenario, the Albanian economy is expected to mark a significant decline for 2020 and relatively rapid and stable growth rates in the future. In line with this scenario, inflation is expected to stay close to current levels in the following year. Furthermore, the return of economic activity to the potential will create conditions for returning inflation to the target within 2022. Coordinated fiscal, monetary and financial stimulus has been a crucial element for mitigating the consequences of the crisis. Monetary and financial measures taken by the Bank of Albania have targeted the full supply of liquidity to financial markets, reducing lending and debt service costs, as well as a more adequate division of the financial burden of the crisis between the banking sector and Albanian businesses and families. On the other hand, fiscal measures have aimed at coping with the health emergency, increasing financial support for families in need, as well as easing fiscal pressure on businesses and improving their access to loans. Financial markets have reacted positively to the measures taken and the transmission of monetary stimulus to the economy has been complete. Borrowing interest rates are at low levels, liquidity pressures are controlled and the exchange rate is stable. The banking sector has accommodated the needs of creditors, offering temporary delays of credit inslaughter to customers and its comprehensive restructurings, and taking on part of the financial burden of the crisis. Likewise, banks have been able to credit the economy by responding to the needs of the private sector for Page 3 of 4 First Deputy Governor Minxhozi's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making 29/07/22, 13:33 funding. Credit for the private sector increased by about 6.3% in the third quarter, supported mainly by loans for businesses and that in money. Beyond monetary stimulus, the performance of these portfolios has been positively influenced by regulatory measures taken by the Bank of Albania and sovereign guarantee schemes. Preserving the banking sector's positive approach to lending will be a necessary prerequisite for recovering the economy. At the same time, the normalization of the economic situation must come to be supported by a stimulus of economic policies. *** At the close of discussions, judging and on the projections of the basic scenario and the balance of risks around it, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current monetary policy position is appropriate. For this reason, he decided: leave the basic interest rate unchanged at 0.5%; left deposit and one-day interest rates unchanged at 0.1% and 0.9%, respectively. Monetary policy will remain easing throughout the forecast horizon to ensure favourable financing conditions for the growth of the economy and for returning inflation to the target. However, the Supervisory Council considers that expected macroeconomic developments are surrounded by numerous uncertainties and exposed to the risks of the lower kah. In particular, the dangers of the lower kah stem from: worsening epidemiological situation and deepening its impact on the economy; the extent of damage to production capacities, and the possibility of a slower recovery of domestic and foreign demand; the birth of difficulties in the monetary policy transmission mechanism, in the form of rising interest rates and private sector financing costs, in the form of slow growth in bank credit, or in the form of strong fluctuations in other financial market indicators. The Supervisory Council notes that materializing these risks would require further easing of monetary policy stance. Page 4 of 4

Vala e re e infektimeve dhe prezantimi i masave kufizuese n shum vende, e potencialisht dhe n Shqipri, paraqesin sfida serioze pr shndetin publik dhe pr ecurin e ekonomis gjat periudhs n vijim. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fj_konferencen_per_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare.html Pagina 1 di 4 Fjala e Zvendsguvernatores s Par Minxhozi n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare 29/07/22, 13:33 N kt kontekst, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare mbetet i prshtatshm. Kushtet monetare dhe normat e ulta t interesit ofrojn mbshtetjen e duhur pr rritjen ekonomike dhe pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv brenda vitit 2022. *** Pandemia ka dhn nj ndikim t fort negativ n ekonomin shqiptare. Pasojat e saj jan materializuar qart n treguesit kryesor; masat e distancimit social dhe rritja e pasiguris kan sjell tkurrjen e fort t aktivitetit ekonomik, reduktimin e punsimit dhe rnien e inflacionit. Inflacioni i mimeve t konsumit shnoi nj vler mesatare prej 1.4% n tremujorin e tret, duke ardhur n ngadalsim nga nj tremujor m par. Reduktimi i tij i atribuohet kryesisht rnies s mimeve t disa artikujve ushqimor dhe t mimeve t disa kategorive t shrbimeve. N aspektin makroekonomik, rnia e inflacionit pasqyroi shuarjen e goditjeve t oferts, presionet e ulta t ardhura nga krkesa e dobt agregate dhe tendencat dezinflacioniste n ekonomit tona partnere. Sipas t dhnave t Instat-it, prodhimi i brendshm bruto ra me 10.2% n tremujorin e dyt t vitit, duke shnuar tkurrjen m t fort n historin shqiptare t dy dekadave t fundit. Ky kontraktim rezultoi me baz t gjer n shprndarjen sektoriale dhe strukturn e krkess agregate, por ai pasqyroi m s shumti tkurrjen e konsumit privat dhe t aktivitetit n sektorin e shrbimeve. N t njjtin tremujor, ekonomia shqiptare humbi rreth 50 mij vende pune dhe shkalla e papunsis u rrit n nivelin 11.9%. Megjithat, paketat ndihmse fiskale kan amortizuar disi situatn e vshtir n tregun e puns. Pr rrjedhoj, si rnia e punsimit dhe rritja e papunsis kan qen m t zbutura se ecuria e treguesve t aktivitetit ekonomik. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fj_konferencen_per_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare.html Pagina 2 di 4 Fjala e Zvendsguvernatores s Par Minxhozi n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare 29/07/22, 13:33 Treguesit e disponuar pr aktivitetin ekonomik dhe tregun e puns sinjalizojn nj rikuperim gradual gjat tremujorit t tret. Reduktimi i kufizimeve n qarkullimin e njerzve dhe mallrave, n vend dhe n bot, ruajtja e stabilitetit monetar dhe financiar t vendit, si dhe prmirsimi i leht i treguesve t besimit, kan krijuar premisat e nevojshme pr rritjen e ekonomis n t ardhmen. Megjithat, rikuperimi ekonomik mbetet i brisht dhe rreziqet jan e pritet t mbeten n kahun e poshtm. Skenari yn baz i zhvillimeve t pritura sht ndrtuar mbi supozimin e shmangies s masave ekstreme pr kontrollin e prhapjes s nj vale t dyt t pandemis dhe reduktimin gradual t pasojave t saj. N kt skenar, ekonomia shqiptare pritet t shnoj nj rnie t ndjeshme pr vitin 2020 dhe norma relativisht t shpejta dhe t qndrueshme rritjeje n vijim. N prputhje me kt skenar, inflacioni pritet t qndroj pran niveleve aktuale n vitin n vazhdim. M tej, rikthimi i aktivitetit ekonomik pran potencialit do t krijoj kushtet pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv brenda vitit 2022. Stimuli i koordinuar fiskal, monetar dhe financiar, ka qen nj element vendimtar pr zbutjen e pasojave t krizs. Masat monetare dhe financiare t marra nga Banka e Shqipris kan synuar furnizimin e plot me likuiditet t tregjeve financiare, reduktimin e kostove t kreditimit dhe t shrbimit t borxhit, si dhe nj ndarje sa m t prshtatshme t barrs financiare t krizs midis sektorit bankar dhe bizneseve e familjeve shqiptare. Nga ana tjetr, masat fiskale kan synuar prballimin e emergjencs shndetsore, rritjen e mbshtetjes financiare pr familjet n nevoj, si dhe lehtsimin e presionit fiskal mbi bizneset dhe prmirsimin e aksesit t tyre n kredi. Tregjet financiare kan reaguar pozitivisht ndaj masave t marra dhe transmetimi i stimulit monetar n ekonomi ka qen i plot. Normat e interesit t huamarrjes jan n nivele t ulta, presionet pr likuiditet jan t kontrolluara dhe kursi i kmbimit sht i qndrueshm. Sektori bankar ka akomoduar nevojat e kredimarrsve, duke ofruar shtyrje t prkohshme t ksteve t kredis pr klientt dhe ristrukturime trsore t saj, dhe duke marr mbi vete nj pjes t barrs financiare t krizs. Po ashtu, bankat kan vijuar t kreditojn ekonomin duke iu prgjigjur nevojave t sektorit privat pr https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fj_konferencen_per_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare.html Pagina 3 di 4 Fjala e Zvendsguvernatores s Par Minxhozi n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare 29/07/22, 13:33 financim. Kredia pr sektorin privat sht rritur me rreth 6.3% n tremujorin e tret, e mbshtetur kryesisht nga kredia pr biznese dhe ajo n lek. Prtej stimulit monetar, ecuria e ktyre portofoleve sht ndikuar pozitivisht nga masat rregullatore t marra nga Banka e Shqipris dhe skemat e garancis sovrane. Ruajtja e qasjes pozitive t sektorit bankar ndaj kreditimit, do t jet nj parakusht i nevojshm pr rikuperimin e ekonomis. N t njjtn koh, normalizimi i situats ekonomike duhet t vijoj t mbshtetet nga nj kah stimulues i politikave ekonomike. *** N mbyllje t diskutimeve, duke gjykuar dhe mbi projeksionet e skenarit baz dhe balancn e rreziqeve rreth tij, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare sht i prshtatshm. Pr kt arsye, ai vendosi: t ler t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 0.5%; t ler t pandryshuara normat e interesit t depozitave dhe kredive njditore, respektivisht n 0.1% dhe 0.9%. Politika monetare do t vijoj t mbetet lehtsuese gjat gjith horizontit t parashikimit pr t siguruar kushte financimi t favorshme pr rritjen e ekonomis dhe pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv. Gjithsesi, Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjykon se zhvillimet e pritura makroekonomike jan t rrethuara nga pasiguri t shumta dhe t ekspozuara ndaj rreziqeve t kahut t poshtm. N veanti, rreziqe t kahut t poshtm burojn nga: prkeqsimi i situats epidemiologjike dhe thellimi i ndikimit t saj n ekonomi; shkalla e dmtimit t kapaciteteve prodhuese, dhe mundsia e nj rikuperimi m t ngadalt t krkess s brendshme dhe asaj t huaj; lindja e vshtirsive n mekanizmin e transmetimit t politiks monetare, n formn e rritjes s normave t interesit dhe kostove t financimit t sektorit privat, n formn e rritjes s ngadalt t kredis bankare, apo n formn e luhatjeve t forta t treguesve t tjer t tregut financiar. Title: Questions and answers to the press conference
text: Question answers of the press conference December 16, 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 Question answers of the press conference December 16, 2020 Publication date: 16.12.2020 Q: How is the troubled loan expected to change and is the Bank of Albania thinking of additional measures? Governor: Despite the difficult situation, the index of troubled loans remained unchanged. Currently, this index is at 8.29% level. The level of troubled loans would be at a lower level if we hadnot been hit by earthquake and pandemic, but the fact that this level has not increased is a very positive indicator for the financial system and mainly the banking system in the country. From these strokes, this level could be even higher, considered the difficult situation created. We have highlighted in reports to albania's parliament or commented in our previous statements that the level of troubled loans may have an increase in 2021, a phenomenon expected to occur in the banking system of many other countries. A positive element that has influenced the failure of this indicator, but which has also helped the banking sector, the financial system, families and businesses, has been the measures taken on our part, such as delaying credit payment installments for 2 quarters and regulatory changes to enable banks to restructure loans. I want to stress that based on our analyses, even in the worst case scenario, the banking sector remains stable and increasing the level of troubled loans would not censor the capital sufficiency ratio, liquidity, their performance in 2021 and in the future. However, the basic scenario predicts sustainability and we do not anticipate problems from increasing the level of troubled loans. We have one. Page 1 of 3 Question answers of the press conference December 16, 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 Good experience from the past, we have a plan of measures for their treatment, which has been undertaken, has worked and is consolidated. Of course we're analyzing the situation continuously. There is also a demand on the part of the Banks Association, if we can postpone for another period, not the credit payment installments, but the regulatory changes that enable banks to proactively restructure loans. This will be judged and decided very soon. Q: How has lending performed this difficult year and how is it expected in the following year? Governor: I also highlighted it in the monetary policy statement since 2020, despite it being a difficult year, we have had annual lending growth at the 6.7% level. Lending has increased in both segments, both in the business segment and in that of individuals. The business segment has had more significant growth of late 6.9%, while that of individuals 6.4%. Importantly, lending has continued even with a difficult economic situation influenced by pandemics. This is where albanian government packages have been influenced and, i.e. state guarantees through which second-rate banks have disbursed funds and these are included in the level of lending, but beyond them we have had a higher lending from even second-rate banks. That's a positive indicator, it's beyond our predictions. As we pointed out in the statement, everything is related to the performance of the pandemic. If we had an improvement in the situation and a decrease in the level of sick numbers, of course the economy would recover in 2021 and lending would breathe even more, we would have a more positive credit. In the basic scenario, again we have predicted that we will have an increase in lending. One very positive element that we also highlighted is the increase in lending in the lek. The increase in lending in the lek shows the transmission of our monetary policy and further increases the transmission of the central bank's monetary policy. It also avoids the currency exchange risk in returning credit, thus positively affecting the country's financial stability. Everything is to be seen, everything is depending on the pandemic situation, how the pandemic will evolve and what its impact on the economy will be in 2021. However, the actual figures are what I just said. As it is also the last time at this conference, I wish to congratulate all partners, colleagues, viewers, Happy Weekend Holidays and New Year. Thank you, I wish you health and all the best! Page 2 of 3 Question answers of the press conference December 16, 2020 29/07/22, 13:33 Page 3 of 3

N rast se do t kemi nj prmirsim t situats dhe nj ulje t nivelit t shifrave t t smurve, natyrisht q ekonomia do t ringrihej n vitin 2021 dhe kreditimi do t merrte frym m shum akoma, do t kishim nj kreditim m pozitiv. N skenarin baz, prsri ne kemi parashikuar q do t kemi nj rritje kreditimi. Nj element shum pozitiv q e theksuam gjithashtu sht rritja e kreditimit n lek. Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, December 16, 2020 29/07/22, 13:32 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, December 16, 2020 Publication date: 16.12.2020 Honored media representatives, Welcome to our last press conference for this year! 2020 has been a difficult year, both in health and economic and social terms. The Covid-19 pandemic has caused strong contractions in economic activity, rising unemployment, financial difficulties for the public and private sector, as well as weak inflationary pressures. Under these circumstances, the main objective of economic policies has been to ease the financial burden on Albanian businesses and families, preserve monetary and financial stability in the country, as well as create premise for the recovery of the economy. Page 1 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, December 16, 2020 29/07/22, 13:32 The Bank of Albania undertook a full package of measures to address the situation. We facilitated our monetary policy and increased liquidity injections, targeting the normal functioning of the financial market, easing the cost of debt, increasing lending and promoting consumption and investment. Likewise, we provisionally facilitated the operating regulations of the banking sector, prompting the delay in time of the payment of loan inslaught and its restructuring. From this move, over 40% of the bank loan portfolio was placed in the moratorium, easing the financial burden on businesses and families in temporary difficulty. Also, credit restructuring has benefited over 25,000 banking customers, increasing the sustainability of their long-term plans. In parallel with them, we suspended the distribution of the banking sector's division during 2020, in the interest of capital growth and sustainability of this sector. Finally, we eliminated the costs of using the infrastructure of electronic payment systems, aiming at expanding the use of these instruments. The Supervisory Council estimates that these measures have resulted in success. The country's monetary and financial stability have resulted in intact, while businesses and families have been able to find support with loans from the banking sector, avoiding mass bankruptcies and softening unemployment growth. Let me now present the main messages of the Intermediate Monetary Policy Report and the decision taken by the Supervisory Council at today's meeting. The new information received in the analysis has been close to our expectations. The latest news on vaccine progress gives hope for the completion of the pandemic and the return of the situation to normal during 2021. These developments increase the likelihood of gradual but continuous recovery of economic activity on the medium-term horizon, but the epidemiological situation follows to present serious challenges to the economy's performance in the short term. Page 2 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, December 16, 2020 29/07/22, 13:32 Under these circumstances, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current monetary policy stimulus position remains appropriate, to support both the growth of the economy and the return of inflation to target. The following will present in more detail the conclusions of the analysis, the monetary policy decision and its reasons. *** Consumer price inflation marked an average value of 1.8% in the months of October and November, coming in growth versus the average level of 1.4% scored in the third quarter. Inflation performance over recent months has been mostly influenced by supply factors, which have also dictated the fluctuation in food prices. On the other hand, inflationary pressures, which stem from aggregate demand and foreign environment, remain low. The Albanian economy marked a turn towards recovery in the third quarter. However, economic activity in the country continues to remain below the potential level, while its recovery is expected to be a gradual and risk-riddled process. Available indicators came to an improvement during the summer months, reflecting curbs on the spread of the epidemic, relaxation of social distancing, as well as the positive effect of fiscal, monetary and financial easing measures. In response, the performance of budgetary revenues and that of foreign trade improved. Also, the improvement marked the labour market, as illustrated by quarterly employment growth and a 11.6% reduction in the unemployment rate. The data available for the fourth quarter is still preliminary. However, the worsening epidemiological situation and the partial restoration of restrictions during the fourth quarter suggest a slower recovery of economic activity in this period. This assessment is supported by the decline in business confidence and illustrates the fragility of economic developments in the short term. The easing measures taken by the Bank of Albania have created calm financial markets and monetary stimulus conditions for boosting economic activity. In particular, interest rates for households and businesses have stayed at low levels, the exchange rate has resulted in stable, while the banking sector has been able to credit the economy. The loan to the private sector marked an average annual increase of 6.7% during 2020, supported mainly by the expansion of business credit and increased credit in money. In parallel with the growth of the loan portfolio, the positive performance has also had the structure of this portfolio. The 50.2% increase in the weight of credit in money to the total gives encouraging signals for increasing monetary policy effectiveness and increasing the country's financial sustainability. The banking sector has made a positive contribution to coping with the crisis. The increase in lending has helped businesses and families in temporary difficulty with liquidity, as well as supporting the continuation of investments. Likewise, delaying the payment of loan instakes for certain categories of borrowers and restructuring loans for other categories has shifted some of the financial burden of the crisis to the balance sheets of this sector. Page 3 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, December 16, 2020 29/07/22, 13:32 In the basic scenario, the Bank of Albania expects a gradual rise in inflation towards the target on the medium-term horizon. This forecast factores expectations for progressive increases in economic activity, at home and in the world. The increase in aggregate demand will be associated with increased employment, wages and production costs. In parallel with rising inflationary pressures from abroad, inflation is forecast to come up and return to target within 2022. Meeting this scenario of developments remains conditional on the rapid completion of the pandemic, the speed of consumer and investment recovery, at home and in the world, as well as the preservation of a calm and suitable financial environment. Also, meeting this scenario requires support from macroeconomic stimulus policy. The Bank of Albania notes that the current combination of economic policies remains appropriate. Preserving monetary policy stimulus kah is necessary to promote low-cost lending to the economy. At the same time, the gradual reduction in fiscal stimulus  envisaged in the 2021 Budget and medium-term draft budgets  balances the need to boost aggregate demand with that of strengthening the sustainability of public debt in the medium and long term. *** Judging on these forecasts and considerations, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current monetary policy position is appropriate. For this reason, he decided: leave the basic interest rate unchanged at 0.5%; leave deposit and one-day interest rates unchanged, at 0.1% and 0.9% respectively. Monetary policy will remain easing throughout the forecast horizon to ensure favourable financing conditions for the growth of the economy and for returning inflation to the target. Likewise, the Bank of Albania will continue to preserve the current form of liquidity injection operations, a form that guarantees unlimited injection into its quantity, at least until the end of the first quarter of next year. Finally, the Supervisory Council notes that expected macroeconomic developments are surrounded by uncertainty and exposed to the risks of the lower kah. In particular, the dangers of the lower kah stem from: worsening epidemiological situation and deepening its impact on the economy; the extent of damage to production capacities and the possibility of slower recovery of domestic and foreign demand; the birth of difficulties in the monetary policy transmission mechanism, in the form of rising interest rates and private sector financing costs, in the form of slow growth in bank credit, or in the form of strong fluctuations in other financial market indicators. The Supervisory Council notes that materializing these risks would require further easing of monetary policy stance. Viti 2020 ka qen nj vit i vshtir, si n aspektin shndetsor dhe n at ekonomik e social. Pandemia Covid-19 ka shkaktuar tkurrje t fort t aktivitetit ekonomik, rritje t papunsis, vshtirsi financiare pr sektorin publik dhe privat, si dhe presione t dobta inflacioniste. N kto rrethana, objektivi kryesor i politikave ekonomike ka qen lehtsimi i barrs financiare pr bizneset dhe familjet shqiptare, ruajtja e stabilitetit monetar dhe financiar n vend, si dhe krijimi i premisave pr rimkmbjen e ekonomis. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fj_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_16_dhjetor_2020.html Pagina 1 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 16 dhjetor 2020 29/07/22, 13:32 Banka e Shqipris ndrmori nj paket t plot masash pr adresimin e situats. Ne lehtsuam politikn ton monetare dhe rritm injektimet e likuiditetit, duke synuar funksionimin normal t tregut financiar, lehtsimin e kostos s borxhit, rritjen e kreditimit dhe nxitjen e konsumit dhe investimeve. Po ashtu, ne lehtsuam n mnyr t prkohshme rregulloret e funksionimit t sektorit bankar, duke nxitur shtyrjen n koh t pagess s ksteve t kredis dhe ristrukturimin e saj. Nga kjo lvizje u vendos n moratorium mbi 40% e portofolit t kredis bankare, duke lehtsuar barrn financiare mbi bizneset dhe familjet n vshtirsi t prkohshme. Gjithashtu, nga ristrukturimi i kredis kan prfituar mbi 25 mij klient bankar, duke rritur qndrueshmrin e planbizneseve t tyre afatgjata. Paralelisht me to, ne pezulluam shprndarjen e dividendit t sektorit bankar gjat vitit 2020, n interes t rritjes s kapitalit dhe qndrueshmris s ktij sektori. S fundi, ne eliminuam kostot e prdorimit t infrastrukturs s sistemeve elektronike t pagesave, duke synuar zgjerimin e prdorimit t ktyre instrumenteve. Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlerson se kto masa kan rezultuar t suksesshme. Stabiliteti monetar dhe financiar i vendit kan rezultuar t paprekur, ndrsa bizneset dhe familjet kan vijuar t gjejn mbshtetje me kredi nga sektori bankar, duke shmangur falimentimet n mas dhe duke zbutur rritjen e papunsis. M lejoni tani t paraqes mesazhet kryesore t Raportit t Ndrmjetm t Politiks Monetare dhe vendimin e marr nga Kshilli Mbikqyrs n mbledhjen e sotme. Informacioni i ri i marr n analiz ka qen pran pritjeve tona. Lajmet e fundit mbi progresin e vaksinave japin shpres pr prfundimin e pandemis dhe rikthimin e situats n normalitet gjat vitit 2021. Kto zhvillime rritin gjasat e rikuperimit gradual por t vazhdueshm t aktivitetit ekonomik n horizontin afatmesm, por situata epidemiologjike vijon t paraqes sfida serioze pr ecurin e ekonomis n afatin e shkurtr. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fj_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_16_dhjetor_2020.html Pagina 2 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 16 dhjetor 2020 29/07/22, 13:32 N kto rrethana, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual stimulues i politiks monetare mbetet i prshtatshm, pr t mbshtetur si rritjen e ekonomis, ashtu edhe kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv. N vijim do t paraqes m n detaje konkluzionet e analizs, vendimin e politiks monetare dhe arsyet e tij. *** Inflacioni i mimeve t konsumit shnoi nj vler mesatare prej 1.8% n muajt tetor e nntor, duke ardhur n rritje kundrejt nivelit mesatar prej 1.4% t shnuar n tremujorin e tret. Ecuria e inflacionit gjat muajve t fundit sht ndikuar m s shumti nga faktor t oferts, t cilt kan diktuar dhe luhatjen e mimeve t ushqimeve. Nga ana tjetr, presionet inflacioniste, t cilat burojn nga krkesa agregate dhe nga ambienti i huaj, vijojn t mbeten t ulta. Ekonomia shqiptare ka shnuar nj kthes drejt rikuperimit n tremujorin e tret. Megjithat, aktiviteti ekonomik n vend vijon t mbetet posht nivelit potencial, ndrsa rikuperimi i tij pritet t jet nj proces gradual dhe i rrethuar me rreziqe. Treguesit e disponuar erdhn n prmirsim gjat muajve t vers, duke pasqyruar frenimin e prhapjes s epidemis, relaksimin e distancimit social, si dhe efektin pozitiv t masave lehtsuese fiskale, monetare dhe financiare. N prgjigje t tyre, ecuria e t ardhurave buxhetore dhe ajo e tregtis me jasht u prmirsua. Po ashtu, prmirsim shnoi dhe tregu i puns, sikurse ilustrohet nga rritja tremujore e punsimit dhe reduktimi n 11.6% i shkalls s papunsis. T dhnat e disponuara pr tremujorin e katrt jan ende paraprake. Megjithat, prkeqsimi i situats epidemiologjike dhe rivendosja e pjesshme e kufizimeve gjat tremujorit t katrt sugjerojn nj rikuperim m t ngadalt t aktivitetit ekonomik n kt periudh. Ky vlersim mbshtetet nga rnia e besimit t bizneseve dhe ilustron brishtsin e zhvillimeve ekonomike n afatin e shkurtr. Masat lehtsuese t marra nga Banka e Shqipris kan krijuar tregje financiare t qeta dhe kushte monetare stimuluese pr nxitjen e aktivitetit ekonomik. N veanti, normat e interesit pr familjet dhe bizneset kan qndruar n nivele t ulta, kursi i kmbimit ka rezultuar i qndrueshm, ndrsa sektori bankar ka vijuar t kreditoj ekonomin. Kredia pr sektorin privat shnoi nj rritje mesatare vjetore prej 6.7% gjat vitit 2020, e mbshtetur kryesisht nga zgjerimi i kredis pr biznese dhe rritja e kredis n lek. Paralelisht me rritjen e portofolit t kredis, ecuri pozitive ka pasur dhe struktura e ktij portofoli. Rritja n 50.2% e peshs s kredis n lek ndaj totalit, jep sinjale inkurajuese pr rritjen e efektivitetit t politiks monetare dhe rritjen e qndrueshmris financiare t vendit. Sektori bankar ka dhn nj kontribut pozitiv n prballimin e krizs. Rritja e kreditimit ka ndihmuar me likuiditet bizneset dhe familjet n vshtirsi t prkohshme, si dhe ka mbshtetur vijimin e investimeve. Po ashtu, shtyrja e pagimit t ksteve t kredis pr kategori t caktuara huamarrsish dhe ristrukturimi i kredive pr kategori t tjera, ka zhvendosur nj pjes t barrs financiare t krizs n bilancet e ktij sektori. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fj_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_16_dhjetor_2020.html Pagina 3 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 16 dhjetor 2020 29/07/22, 13:32 N skenarin baz, Banka e Shqipris pret nj rritje graduale t inflacionit drejt objektivit n horizontin afatmesm. Ky parashikim faktorizon pritjet pr rritje progresive t aktivitetit ekonomik, n vend dhe bot. Rritja e krkess agregate do t shoqrohet me rritjen e punsimit, t pagave e t kostove t prodhimit. Paralelisht me rritjen e presioneve inflacioniste nga jasht, inflacioni parashikohet t vij n rritje dhe t kthehet n objektiv brenda vitit 2022. Prmbushja e ktij skenari zhvillimesh mbetet e kushtzuar nga prfundimi i shpejt i pandemis, nga shpejtsia e rikuperimit t konsumit dhe investimeve, n vend dhe n bot, si dhe nga ruajtja e nj ambienti t qet e t prshtatshm financiar. Gjithashtu, prmbushja e ktij skenari krkon mbshtetje nga politika makroekonomike stimuluese. Banka e Shqipris vren se kombinimi aktual i politikave ekonomike mbetet i prshtatshm. Ruajtja e kahut stimulues t politiks monetare sht i domosdoshm pr t nxitur kreditimin me kosto t ult t ekonomis. N t njjtn koh, reduktimi gradual i stimulit fiskal  i parashikuar n Buxhetin e vitit 2021 dhe projektbuxhetet afatmesme  balancon nevojn e nxitjes s krkess agregate me at t forcimit s qndrueshmris s borxhit publik n afatin e mesm dhe t gjat. *** Duke gjykuar mbi kto parashikime dhe konsiderata, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare sht i prshtatshm. Pr kt arsye, ai vendosi: t ler t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 0.5%; t ler t pandryshuara normat e interesit t depozitave dhe kredive njditore, respektivisht n nivelin 0.1% dhe 0.9%. Politika monetare do t vijoj t mbetet lehtsuese gjat gjith horizontit t parashikimit pr t siguruar kushte financimi t favorshme pr rritjen e ekonomis dhe pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv. Po ashtu, Banka e Shqipris do t vijoj t ruaj formn aktuale t operacioneve t injektimit t likuiditetit, form e cila garanton injektimin e pakufizuar n sasi t tij, t paktn deri n fund t tremujorit t par t vitit t ardhshm. S fundi, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vren se zhvillimet e pritura makroekonomike jan t rrethuara nga pasiguri dhe t ekspozuara ndaj rreziqeve t kahut t poshtm. N veanti, rreziqe t kahut t poshtm burojn nga: prkeqsimi i situats epidemiologjike dhe thellimi i ndikimit t saj n ekonomi; shkalla e dmtimit t kapaciteteve prodhuese dhe mundsia e nj rikuperimi m t ngadalt t krkess s brendshme dhe asaj t huaj; lindja e vshtirsive n mekanizmin e transmetimit t politiks monetare, n formn e rritjes s normave t interesit dhe kostove t financimit t sektorit privat, n formn e rritjes s ngadalt t kredis bankare, apo n formn e luhatjeve t forta t treguesve t tjer t tregut financiar. Kshilli Mbikqyrs vren se materializimi i ktyre rreziqeve do t krkonte lehtsimin e mtejshm t qndrimit t politiks monetare. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fj_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_16_dhjetor_2020.html Pagina 4 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 16 dhjetor 2020 29/07/22, 13:32 Copyright  2018 Banka e Shqipris.
