Title: Questions and answers to the press conference
text: Questions answers of press conference February 3, 2021 29/07/22, 13:32 Questions answers of press conference February 3, 2021 Publication date: 03.02.2021 Q: Started by the fact that the banking sector bore a good part of the burden and is very important for economic development, citing some of your words, there is a bank of Albania launch that has also been embraced by the Association of Banks, which is linked to the reduction of cash money in the economy, related to the growth of e-commerce, What and the pandemic showed us are essential. My question, since we're in a new reality, from the moment this campaign started, is there room for other measures? Is Albania and Albanians ready for other measures? Governor: Of course, the fight against cash money, efforts against cash money in the economy have been early efforts by the central bank and other law enforcement authorities. Especially during the pandemic situation, efforts to combat cash money have taken particular focus. The Bank of Albania passed a payment service law last year, which has a range of measures related to financial inclusion and financial education. These relate as to the fight against the use of cash money, i.e. the introduction of cash money into the banking system, but in parallel also go to the function of modernizing the payment system. So on the one hand, it takes a good financial education and an increase in the financial involvement of the population so that money can be deposited in banks, because not only is it safer, but it serves better and there are also better banking products and offers, which also go in the direction of easing inequality and many other advantages. But on the other hand, this is achieved through a modernization of the payment system. In this context, we have taken many measures, made some moves and plan to take other measures as well. During the pandemic period, the removal of commissions or regulatory changes by removing commissions of second-rate banks for electronic transfers have indirectly taken their toll. Page 1 of 5 Questions answers of press conference February 3, 2021 29/07/22, 13:32 During this year, we are working to make foreign currency payments, in euros, domestically, to carry them out with bank of Albania systems and avoid corresponding banks. This would bring an increase in speed at the time of payments in foreign currency, as in lek, but would also bring a reduction in commissions for the population. Also, in accordance with the new law we have for payment services, we plan to make some developments for mobilizing the payment system, such as a national unifying platform for the entire banking system, for carrying out all electronic payments and chartered ones. This is a serious development that will take its time, but we have begun to think and are working on this development. Meanwhile, even the new law adopted and prepared in co-operation with the World Bank has created spaces to develop the market towards modernising the payment system. Without question that the introduction of cash money into the banking system is a challenge that goes even in the direction of formalizing the economy, it is one of our main challenges that we are working on. Q: Let me have a second question. I start again from one of your campaigns and policies: Deeuroisation. It's been going on, it's been a few years. It's affected. Credit's up in the money. The effect has. But there are still some sectors in the Albanian economy, here I am quoting, that real estate, for example, that prefers foreign currency, and more respectively, cash, euro. Can we continue more but, in order to transmit monetary policy, the lek is the first in our transactions? Thank you! Governor: Deeuroisation is a project launched by us. We have discussed it together, but also with all other colleagues in the media. This policy has two main goals that I am repeating, as I think it is better to repeat: 1. Deeurosation increases the transmission of monetary policy, as our monetary policy is exercised only on the local currency, i.e. on the lec. Monetary policy is aimed at stimulating investment, consumption and lending. All three of these elements affect the increase in the well-being of the population. So we demand that the transmission of monetary policy grow, to grow the economy. That's the point. This is an instrument. The central bank's basic instrument. The fight against euroisation, i.e. deeuroisation helps us in this direction, so it helps the central bank in this direction. 2. In parallel, with it, deeuroisation also affects the preservation of financial stability, i.e. in maintaining the sustainability of the banking system, protecting depositors' deposits, bank customers. This is because a good part of businesses and individuals have exposures, have loans in euros, while their income is in the local currency, so they have them in money. About 1/2 of the total portfolio of bank loans, individuals and businesses, is in foreign currency, mainly in euros. Because these clients generate the income in money, they are exposed to the exchange rate, given that we have a free exchange rate regime in the Republic of Albania. In the event of a depreciation of the national currency, of course all these customers would be exposed to the risk of default Page 2 of 5 Questions answers of press conference February 3, 2021 29/07/22, 13:32 credit. Not only would they have bankruptcy or serious problems in their businesses, but also the banking system would face a serious risk, which is the risk of the exchange rate. Precisely, for these reasons we have promoted or worked on increasing transparency and financial education of customers, whether in the case of creditors and depositors, but in the concrete case of creditors, since the income is in a certain currency, or when the income is in the local currency, the loan is taken in the local currency, Because they avoid this kind of risk, and furthermore that our monetary easing policy is at historical minimum levels, so there is no difference in interest rates. As long as you don't lose interest rates, instead they may be at levels the same as the euro, then why should this foreign currency loan be taken?!. In this context we have positive results, since the process for deeuroisation has begun (if we can call it so), we have a slight decline, especially in the direction of credit we have a very positive effect. So, the market is educated. Also in the direction of deposits. This year alone we have more than 1% decrease in the level of loans and deposits in euros, but especially loans. Of course work needs to continue. It is right that you said: there is no need to unnecessarily price some products, especially products of great value, of the automotive industry, of real estate in euros. These products can be quoted very well in the local currency. But we also have products in lesser value. We see shops that quota in euros. There's no reason. As long as our national currency is the lek, of course product prices must be priced in the lek. This is defined by law. So it doesn't have to be tolerated, or it doesn't have to use the euro as a means of payment unnecessarily. The euro can be converted. We have enough banks and exchange offices where they can convert. If we see you in all states, whether in the region, but even wider, when they have their own currency, of course they use their currency. So they don't accept the purchase or sale in foreign currency. So the same thing has to happen here. The goals I explained and the reasons why. Of course there is room and space to work further, but that will be discussed at the next meeting of the Financial Stability Advisory Group, together with the Ministry of Finance and Economy, and with other institutions on how this process will continue. It's a gradual process. Of course, I stress, we do not intend to remove the euro, to "eliminate" the euro from the market. But let's keep in those parameters that we have as our target for the reasons mentioned above. Q: How much is the number of bad loans expected to increase? Governor: We have stressed that bad loans as a result of the pandemic are projected to come up. Fortunately this indicator did not increase in 2020. As I mentioned and in the statement their level was 8.1%. This is a positive indicator, as was credit growth. Troubled loans are a percentage that is expressed in relation to the total loan and the loan increased to the 7.7% level. So generally the financial sector despite the crisis had positive results, good indicators of capitalisation, profitability and lending. Page 3 of 5 Questions answers of press conference February 3, 2021 29/07/22, 13:32 But of course 2021 could be a deterioration. We took various measures during 2020 as they were: the two-quarter postponement of loan installment payments, regulatory changes to restructure loans for 6 months to give banks proactive opportunities to make loan structure. This regulatory change was recently postponed and for a quarter, until the end of the first quarter of 2021, precisely to help banks and businesses cope with the pandemic situation, to create ease for businesses to make restructurings, to extend deadlines in all possible forms that banks judge for those customers who have been affected. This affects that at the moment troubled credit does not increase, but certainly with the end of these deadlines we anticipate that we will have a troubled loan increase. I can't say exactly how much this troubled loan increase will be because we don't have a figure. We have some predictions, but the forecasts change. Any forecast in fact not only for troubled credit but also for economic growth, increased lending and for all other macro indicators is depending on the pandemic situation, how long the pandemic will last, how much austerity measures will be, and how the economy will then react according to the duration of the pandemic. In this context, I can't give an exact figure for troubled loans, but of course we expect an increase. However, our analyses, the stress-tests we have done, the various scenarios we have taken in analysis for the banking system, even in the worst case scenario of the growth of troubled credit tell us that the banking system is healthy, there is sufficient capitalization and liquidity to cope with the situation from the growth of troubled credit, so we do not anticipate that we need capital increaseors or certain turbulence in the banking system from the growth and growth of the bank. troubled credit. Fortunately we are at a low level, it has not increased and we hope to have as little growth in troubled credit as possible, but it remains to be seen how the situation will go from the pandemic. Question: In fact despite what has been stated so far, Mr. Governor on the issue of stability and sustainability comes a reality from big business as complaint-demand more. Because liquidity insurance is being done in ways, or more precisely on non-bank roads where I am saying debt with interest percentages off the bank roads. Does this bother you as a phenomenon and do you have perhaps preliminary analysis to cope with this situation. Governor: The informal lending market has existed and exists. It's not a big problem as far as the tests have resulted from us, and the tests are always updated. Referring to the past years, we have taken the informal market in analysis as there has always been this concern. And it has resulted in an informal market, which has not competed in the banking market, but has created certain deformities in the market. Of course, we as a regulatory institution have taken measures, we have made maximum efforts with both regulatory acts and financial education to avoid this informal market. The most serious partner for any individual and business should be the bank, as the informal market is accompanied by higher interest rates. Of course there may be lower demand in procedures, there may be a faster processing, but it is more "slaughtering" in terms of price, there are much higher interest rates than the formal market that banks are. Page 4 of 5 Questions answers of press conference February 3, 2021 29/07/22, 13:32 Serious customers who consider returning the loan, i.e. to take out a debt for a certain need and purpose with the intention of decommissioning it, have good financial care. Since taking on that debt, they have made accounts of how they will pay it off, to close the history of the debt, and not to be held hostage to the courts, the exterminations, the executions. For these customers, the bank is the best partner because it is the most serious partner in respecting the terms of the contract and at the best price. While the informal market prefers those customers who have good non-formation, need immediate and will then face difficulties. Of course we have made not only calls, but we have also taken measures to avoid this informal market. However, this market is not at those levels. We always talk on general lines to individuals that we can also have business-to-business deals, which may have certain historical problems with banks and, having a business opportunity lend to each other. Lending and borrowing is allowed by law. So if businesses judge that they can credit each other, or individuals can credit or lend to each other with a notary statement under the law they can do so. The problem is the phenomenon, the concern, if there are unlicensed, unregulated institutions, operating in this area abusing, coming up with interest rates outside the market. This does not result in a very expanded phenomenon, however we have it under surveillance. It's a phenomenon that exists, but it's not yet a phenomenon that competes with the banking market. However, it's very complex. On the one hand, we want to preserve banks that they are the main holders of population deposits. Financial stability is right there. So we want to secure savings in the first place but we want to secure the role of banks for the development of the economy, so that they are creditors. And financial mediation is done only by having some healthy banks with good indicators. Of course we would not want banks to sacrifice risk criteria, to credit without limit, to ease the criteria and tomorrow to have a worse higher loan, as we mentioned a little earlier. That would then be to the detriment of the economy again because they would no longer credit. So the factors are intertwined, they're chain. We want to have serious lending, to have formalization, to have a stable banking system, to avoid the informal market. All of these are separate challenges that we work on. Page 5 of 5

Pyetja ime, meq jemi n nj realitet t ri, nga momenti q ka nisur kjo fushat, a ka vend pr masa t tjera? A sht gati Shqipria dhe shqiptart pr masa t tjera? Guvernatori: Patjetr, lufta kundr paras cash, prpjekjet kundr paras cash n ekonomi kan qen prpjekje t hershme nga banka qendrore dhe nga autoritetet t tjera ligjzbatuese. Veanrisht gjat situats s pandemis, prpjekjet pr t luftuar paran cash kan marr fokus t veant. Banka e Shqipris ka miratuar vitin e kaluar nj ligj pr shrbimin e pagesave i cili ka nj sr masash q lidhen edhe me prfshirjen financiare dhe edukimin financiar. Kto lidhen si me luftn kundr prdorimit t paras cash, pra futjes s paras cash n sistemin bankar, por paralelisht shkojn edhe n funksion t modernizimit t sistemit t pagesave. Pra, nga njra an duhet nj edukim i mir financiar dhe nj rritje e prfshirjes financiare t popullats n mnyr q paraja t depozitohet n banka, sepse jo vetm q sht m e sigurt, por shrben m mir dhe ka edhe produkte dhe oferta m t mira bankare, q shkojn edhe n drejtim t zbutjes s pabarazis dhe shum avantazhe t tjera. Por nga ana tjetr, kjo arrihet nprmjet nj modernizimi t sistemit t pagesave. N kt kontekst, ne kemi marr shum masa, kemi br disa lvizje dhe kemi n plan pr t marr edhe masa t tjera. Gjat periudhs s pandemis, heqja e komisioneve ose ndryshimet rregullative duke hequr komisionet e bankave t nivelit t dyt pr transfertat elektronike, n mnyr indirekte kan patur ndikimin e tyre. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Pyetje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_3_shkurt_2021.html Pagina 1 di 5 Pyetje prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp 3 shkurt 2021 29/07/22, 13:32 Gjat ktij viti, po punojm pr t br klerimin e pagesave n monedh t huaj, n euro, brenda vendit, pr ti kryer ato me sistemet e Banks s Shqipris dhe shmangur bankat korrespondente. Kjo do t sillte nj rritje t shpejtsis n kohn e kryerjes s pagesave n valut t huaj, njlloj si n lek, por do t sillte edhe nj ulje t komisioneve pr popullatn. Gjithashtu, n zbatim t ligjit t ri q kemi pr shrbimet e pagesave, ne kemi n plan pr t br disa zhvillime pr mobilizimin e sistemit t pagesave, si do t jet nj platform unifikuese kombtare pr t gjith sistemin bankar, pr kryerjen e t gjitha pagesave elektronike dhe atyre me kart. Ky sht nj zhvillim serioz i cili do t krkoj kohn e tij, por ne kemi filluar t mendojm dhe po punojm pr kt zhvillim. Ndrkoh, edhe ligji i ri i miratuar dhe i prgatitur n bashkpunim me Bankn Botrore ka krijuar hapsira pr t zhvilluar tregun drejt modernizimit t sistemit t pagesave. Pa diskutim q futja e paras cash n sistemin bankar sht nj sfid q shkon edhe n drejtim t formalizimit t ekonomis, sht nj nga sfidat tona kryesore pr t cilat ne po punojm. Pyetje: M lejoni nj pyetje t dyt. Nisem prsri nga nj prej fushatave dhe politikave tuaja: Deeurozimin. Ka nisur, ka disa vite. Ka ndikuar. sht rritur kredia n lek. Efektin e ka br. Por, ka ende disa sektor n ekonomin shqiptare, ktu po citoj, at imobiliar, pr shembull, q preferon monedhn e huaj, dhe m respektivisht, cash, euro. A mund t vazhdojm m shum por, n mnyr q t transmetohet politika monetare edhe leku t jet i pari n transaksionet tona? Faleminderit! Guvernatori: Deeuroizimi sht nj projekt i nisur nga ne. E kemi diskutuar dhe bashk, por dhe me t gjith kolegt e tjer n media. Kjo politik ka dy qllime kryesore q po i prsris, pasi mendoj q sht m mir t riprsriten: 1. Deeurozimi rrit transmetimin e politiks monetare, pasi politika jon monetare ushtrohet vetm mbi monedhn vendase, pra mbi lekun. Politika monetare ka pr qllim stimulimin e investimeve, konsumit dhe t kreditimit. T tri kta element ndikojn n rritjen e mirqenies s popullats. Pra ne krkojm q t rritet transmetimi i politiks monetare, pr tu rritur ekonomia. Ky sht qllimi. Ky sht nj instrument. Instrumenti baz i banks qendrore. Lufta kundr euroizimit, pra deeuroizimi na ndihmon n kt drejtim, pra ndihmon bankn qendrore n kt drejtim. 2. Paralelisht, me t, deeuroizimi ndikon dhe n ruajtjen e stabilitetit financiar, pra n ruajtjen e qndrueshmris s sistemit bankar, mbrojtjes s depozitave t depozituesve, t klientve t bankave. Kjo sepse nj pjes e mir e bizneseve dhe individve kan ekspozime, kan kredi n euro, ndrsa t ardhurat e tyre i kan n monedhn vendase, pra i kan n lek. Rreth 1/2 e portofolit total t kredive bankare, individ dhe biznese, sht n monedh t huaj, kryesisht n euro. Duke qen se kta klient i gjenerojn t ardhurat n lek, ata jan t ekspozuar ndaj kursit t kmbimit, duke pasur parasysh q ne kemi nj regjim t lir t kursit t kmbimit n Republikn e Shqipris. N rast t zhvlersimit t monedhs kombtare, natyrisht q t gjith kta klient do t ishin t ekspozuar ndaj rrezikut t mospagimit https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Pyetje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_3_shkurt_2021.html Pagina 2 di 5 Pyetje prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp 3 shkurt 2021 29/07/22, 13:32 t kredis. Jo vetm q ata do t kishin falimentim apo probleme serioze n bizneset e tyre, por dhe sistemi bankar do t prballej me nj rrezik serioz, q sht rreziku i kursit t kmbimit. Pikrisht, pr kto arsye ne e kemi promovuar ose kemi punuar pr rritjen e transparencs dhe edukimit financiar t klientve, qoft n rastin e kredimarrsve ashtu dhe t depozituesve, por n rastin konkret t kredimarrsve, q kur t ardhurat i kan n nj monedh t caktuar, ose kur t ardhurat i kan n monedhn vendase, kredin ta marrin n monedhn vendase, sepse shmangin kt lloj rreziku, dhe pr m tepr q politika jon monetare lehtsuese sht n nivelet minimale historike, pra nuk ka diferenca n normat e interesit. Pr sa koh q nuk humbet nga normat e interesit, prkundrazi mund t jen n nivele t njjta me euron, ather prse duhet marr kjo kredi n monedh t huaj?!. N kt kontekst ne kemi rezultate pozitive, q kur ka filluar procesi pr deeuroizimin (nse mund ta quajm kshtu), kemi nj rnie t leht, sidomos n drejtim t kredis kemi nj efekt shum pozitiv. Pra, sht edukuar tregu. Po ashtu n drejtim t depozitave. Vetm kt vit ne kemi m shum se 1% rnie n nivelin e kredive dhe depozitave n euro, por sidomos t kredive. Sigurisht q duhet vazhduar puna. sht e drejt ajo q ju that: nuk ka pse t kuotohen n mnyr t panevojshme mimet e disa produkteve, sidomos produkteve me vler t madhe, t industris s automobilave, t pasurive t paluajtshme n euro. Kto produkte mund t kuotohen shum mir n monedhn vendase. Por kemi dhe produkte n vler m t vogl. Shohim dyqane q kuotojn n euro. Nuk ka arsye. Pr sa koh q monedha jon kombtare sht leku, natyrisht q mimet e produkteve duhet t kuotohen n lek. Kjo sht e prcaktuar dhe me ligj. Pra, nuk ka pse t tolerohet, ose nuk ka pse t prdoret euro si mjet pagese n mnyr t panevojshme. Euro mund t konvertohet. Ne kemi mjaftueshm banka dhe zyra kmbimi ku mund t konvertohen. Po t shohim n t gjith shtetet, qoft n rajon, por dhe m gjer, kur kan monedhn e tyre, natyrisht q prdorin monedhn e tyre. Pra nuk ta pranojn blerjen apo shitjen n monedh t huaj. Pra e njjta gj duhet t ndodh dhe ktu. Qllimet un i shpjegova dhe arsyet pse. Natyrisht q ka vend dhe hapsir pr t punuar m tej, por q do t diskutohet n mbledhjen e radhs s Grupit Kshillimor t Stabilitetit Financiar, s bashku me Ministrin e Financave dhe t Ekonomis, dhe me institucionet e tjera se si do t vazhdoj ky proces. sht nj proces gradual. Sigurisht, e theksoj, nuk synojm t heqim euron, t zhdukim euron nga tregu. Por, t mbajm n ato parametra t cilat ne i kemi si objektiv pr arsyet e prmendura m lart. Pyetje: Sa parashikohet q t rritet numri i kredive t kqija ? Guvernatori: E kemi theksuar q kredit e kqija si pasoj e pandemis jan parashikuar t vijn n rritje. Pr fat t mir ky tregues nuk u rrit n vitin 2020. Si e prmenda dhe n deklarat niveli i tyre ishte 8.1 %. Ky sht nj tregues pozitiv, ashtu si ishte edhe rritja e kredis. Kredit me probleme jan nj prqindje q shprehet n raport me kredin n total dhe kredia u rrit n nivelin 7.7%. Pra, prgjithsisht sektori financiar pavarsisht nga kriza pati rezultate pozitive, tregues t mir kapitalizimi, rentabiliteti edhe kreditimi. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Pyetje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_3_shkurt_2021.html Pagina 3 di 5 Pyetje prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp 3 shkurt 2021 29/07/22, 13:32 Por natyrisht q viti 2021 mund t ket nj prkeqsim. Kemi marr masa t ndryshme gjat vitit 2020 si ishin: shtyrja me dy-tremujor e pagesave t ksteve t kredive, ndryshime rregullative pr ristrukturimin e kredive pr 6 muaj pr ti dhn bankave mundsi proaktive pr t br strukturime t kredive. Ky ndryshim rregullativ u shty s fundmi dhe pr nj tremujor, deri n fund t tremujorit t par t vitit 2021, pikrisht pr t ndihmuar bankat dhe bizneset pr t prballuar situatn e pandemis, pr ti krijuar lehtsi bizneseve pr t br ristrukturime, pr t zgjatur afatet n t gjith format e mundshme q bankat gjykojn pr ata klient q jan prekur. Kjo ndikon q pr momentin kredia me probleme t mos rritet, por sigurisht q me mbarimin e ktyre afateve ne parashikojm q do t kemi nj rritje t kredis me probleme. Nuk mund ta them sakt se sa do t jet kjo rritje e kredis me probleme sepse nuk kemi nj shifr. Kemi disa parashikime por parashikimet ndryshojn. do parashikim n fakt jo vetm pr kredin me probleme por dhe pr rritjen ekonomike, pr rritjen e kreditimit dhe pr t gjith treguesit e tjer makro sht n varsi t situats s pandemis, sa do t zgjas pandemia, sa do t jen masat shtrnguese dhe si do t reagoj pastaj ekonomia n funksion t zgjatjes s pandemis. N kt kontekst, nuk mund t jap nj shifr t sakt pr kredit me probleme por sigurisht q ne presim nj rritje. Megjithat analizat tona, stres-testet q kemi br, skenart e ndryshm q kemi marr n analiz pr sistemin bankar, edhe n rastin m t keq t rritjes s kredis me probleme na tregojn q sistemi bankar sht i shndetshm, ka kapitalizim dhe likuiditet t mjaftueshm pr t prballuar situatn nga rritja e kredis me probleme, pra ne nuk parashikojm q t kemi nevoj pr shtim kapitali apo turbulenca t caktuara n sistemin bankar nga rritja e kredis me probleme. Pr fat jemi n nj nivel t ult, nuk sht rritur dhe shpresojm t kemi nj rritje sa m t pakt t kredis me probleme, por mbetet t shohim si do shkoj situata nga pandemia. Pyetja: N fakt pavarsisht asaj far sht deklaruar deri tani, z. Guvernator pr shtjen e stabilitetit dhe qndrueshmris vjen nj realitet nga biznesi i madh si ankes-krkes m shum. Duke qen se sigurimi i likuiditetit po bhet n mnyra, ose m sakt n rrug jo bankare ku merren po them borxh me prqindje interesi jasht rrugve bankare. A ju shqetson ky si fenomen dhe a keni ndoshta analiza paraprake pr ti br ball ksaj situate. Guvernatori: Tregu joformal i kreditimit ka ekzistuar dhe ekziston. Nuk sht nj problem madhor pr sa na ka rezultuar nga analizat, dhe analizat jan gjithmon t rifreskuara. Referuar viteve t kaluara, kemi marr n analiz tregun informal pasi gjithmon ka qen ky shqetsim. Dhe ka rezultuar q ka nj treg joformal, i cili nuk ka konkurruar tregun bankar, por ka krijuar deformime t caktuara n treg. Natyrisht q ne si institucion rregullator kemi marr masa, kemi br prpjekje maksimale qoft me akte rregullative ashtu dhe nprmjet edukimit financiar pr ta shmangur kt treg joformal. Partneri m serioz pr do individ dhe biznes duhet t jet banka, pasi tregu joformal shoqrohet dhe me norma m t larta interesi. Natyrisht q mund t ket krkes m t ult n procedura, mund t ket nj procesim m t shpejt, por ama sht m thers n aspektin e mimit, ka norma shum m t larta interesi se sa tregu formal q jan bankat. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Pyetje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_3_shkurt_2021.html Pagina 4 di 5 Pyetje prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp 3 shkurt 2021 29/07/22, 13:32 Klientt serioz t cilt mendojn ta kthejn kredin, pra t marrin nj borxh pr nj nevoj dhe qllim t caktuar me synimin pr ta likuiduar, kan kujdes financiar t mir. Q kur e marrin at borxh kan br llogarit se si do ta shlyejn, q ta mbyllin historin e borxhit dhe t mos ngelen peng ndaj gjykatave, prmbarimeve, ekzekutimeve. Pr kta klient, banka sht partneri m i mir sepse sht partneri m serioz n respektimin e kushteve t kontrats dhe me mimin m t mir. Ndrkoh q tregu joformal preferon ata klient t cilt kan joformim t mir, kan nevoj t menjhershme dhe do t prballen pastaj dhe me vshtirsi. Sigurisht q ne kemi br jo vetm thirrje, por kemi marr dhe masa pr ta shmangur kt treg joformal. Sidoqoft, ky treg nuk sht n ato nivele. Gjithmon flasim n vija t prgjithshme pr individt se ne mund t kemi dhe raste marrveshjeje biznes me biznes, q mund t ken problem t caktuara historiku me bankat dhe, duke pasur nj oportunitet biznesi i japin hua njeri-tjetrit. Huadhnia dhe huamarrja sht e lejuar me ligj. Pra n qoft se bizneset gjykojn q mund t kreditojn njri-tjetrin, ose individt mund t kreditojn ose ti japin hua njri tjetrit me nj deklarat noteriale sipas ligjit mund ta bjn kt. Problem sht fenomeni, shqetsimi, nse ka institucione t palicensuara, t parregulluara, q operojn n kt fush duke abuzuar, duke dal me norma interesi jasht tregut. Kjo nuk na rezulton q t jet nj fenomen shum i zgjeruar megjithat ne e kemi n mbikqyrje. sht nj fenomen q ekziston, por nuk sht akoma nj fenomen i cili konkurron tregun bankar. Megjithat sht shum komplekse. Nga njra an, ne duam t ruajme bankat se ato jan mbajtset kryesore t depozitave t popullats. Stabiliteti financiar pikrisht aty synon. Pra ne duam t sigurojm kursimet n radh t par por duam t sigurojm dhe rolin e bankave pr zhvillimin e ekonomis, pra q ato t jen kredituese. Dhe ndrmjetsimi financiar bhet vetm duke pasur disa banka t shndetshme me tregues t mir. Sigurisht q ne nuk do t donim q bankat t sakrifikonin kriteret e rrezikut, t kreditonin pa limit, t lehtsonin kriteret dhe nesr t kishin nj kredi t keqe m t lart, si e prmendm pak m par. Kjo do t ishte pastaj n dm prsri t ekonomis sepse nuk do t kreditonin m. Pra faktort jan t ndrthurur, jan zinxhir. Ne duam t kemi kreditim serioz, t kemi formalizim, t kemi sistem t qndrueshm bankar, t shmangim tregun joformal. T gjitha kto jan sfida m vete pr t cilat ne punojm. Copyright  2018 Banka e Shqipris. Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, February 3, 2021 29/07/22, 13:32 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, February 3, 2021 Publication date: 03.02.2021 Honored media representatives, Today, on 3 February 2021, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and adopted the Quarterly Monetary Policy Report. New information obtained in the analysis shows that economic activity has improved over the second half of last year. The Supervisory Council estimated that this improvement has been faster than the Bank of Albania's expectations. However, he notes that inflation continues to remain below target, while economic activity and employment continue to remain below levels recorded before the pandemic.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_3_shkurt_2021.html Page 1 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, February 3, 2021 29/07/22, 13:32 The update of our forecasts suggests that aggregate demand will come up and that economic activity will gradually come towards normalization over the next two years. This normalization will be accompanied by increased employment, employee wages and business profit margins, which will create premise for returning inflation to our target of 3% within 2022. The Supervisory Council estimated that meeting these projections requires preserving favourable financial conditions throughout the medium-term horizon. In this context, he judged that the current monetary policy position remains appropriate. *** Economic activity in the country showed recovery trends in the second half of 2020, following the deep recession marked in the second quarter. However, the negative impact of the pandemic continues to be present, both in macroeconomic indicators and in indicators of the financial health of businesses and families. Inflation scored an average value of 1.6% in the fourth quarter, coming in slightly higher from the previous quarter. His fluctuations reflected, to the greatest extent, the price fluctuations of food items. On the other hand, basic inflation, an indicator that more clearly reflects the medium-term trends of price growth, came to be stable, but below the levels targeted by the Bank of Albania. This performance reflects the suppression of supply shocks during the second half of the year and weak pressures generated by aggregate demand. According to Instat data, economic activity marked an annual decline of 3.5% during the third quarter, marking a significant relative improvement compared to the depth of the second quarter recession. This improvement reflected the opening up of the economy, increased investment and a slower decline in private consumption and exports. The expansion of aggregate demand was reflected in increased activity in the construction sector and in a lower contracting of the industry and services sectors.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_3_shkurt_2021.html Page 2 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, February 3, 2021 29/07/22, 13:32 The improvement in economic activity was also reflected in employment indicators. Employment increased by about 34 thousand people during the third quarter, recovering about 2/3 of the losses recorded in the previous quarter, while the unemployment rate decreased to 11.6%. The data available for fourth-quarter economic activity are only indirect and still not complete. However, the Bank of Albania estimates that economic activity in the country has been further recovered, despite difficulties caused by pandemics and the adverse foreign environment. Beyond easing the restrictive measures taken for control of the pandemic, this recovery has also been helped by fiscal stimulus transmitted during 2020 and by monetary and financial stimulus policies pursued by the Bank of Albania. The budget deficit reached around the 5.1% LEVEL of GDP during the first eleven months of the year. This deficit reflected both the decline in revenues during the calendar year and the increase in current and capital spending during the year. According to our estimates, our monetary stimulus policy and the temporary easing of banking sector operating regulations enabled the normal functioning of financial markets and created an appropriate environment for credit growth over the past year. Financial markets were able to function normally even during the fourth quarter. The exchange rate presented steady, interest rates remained near their historical minimums, while lending came to rise further. In particular, the loan to the private sector recorded an annual increase of 7.7% during 2020, helping Albanian businesses and families cope with liquidity needs and providing the necessary financial means for increasing consumption and investment. The Bank of Albania considers that the banking sector has helped mitigate the consequences of the pandemic crackdown. This sector has taken on some of the financial burden of the hit, while maintaining at the same time healthy indicators of liquidity, profitability and capitalization. In particular, the ratio of troubled loans decreased to 8.1% in  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_3_shkurt_2021.html Page 3 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, February 3, 2021 29/07/22, 13:32 at the end of December, a level close to the historical minimums of the last decade. The continuation of this active role of the banking sector even over the next period will be a key element in the sustainability of economic recovery. Our basic scenario of expected developments is built on the assumption of gradual easing of measures taken for pandemic control and progressive reduction of its consequences. In this scenario, the Albanian economy is expected to score relatively fast and stable growth rates over the following two years. Inflation is expected to stay close to current levels in the following year. Furthermore, the return of economic activity to the potential will create conditions for returning inflation to the target within 2022. *** The Supervisory Council estimated that the normalization of the economic situation should be supported through the preservation of a stimulating profile of economic policies. He also confirmed that the balance of dangers follows to remain at the bottom. In particular, these risks stem from: a possible deterioration of the epidemiological situation, at home and in the world; possible difficulties in the monetary policy transmission mechanism, in the form of rising interest rates and private sector financing costs, in the form of slow bank loan growth; As well as from, a slower business and household response to improved financial conditions. At the close of discussions, the Supervisory Council estimated that the current monetary policy position is appropriate for boosting economic growth and for the steady return of inflation to our 3% target. For this reason, he decided: leave the basic interest rate unchanged at 0.5%; leave deposit and one-day loan interest rates unchanged, at 0.1% and 0.9% respectively. Likewise, the Supervisory Council stresses that monetary policy will remain easing throughout the mid-term time horizon, aiming to provide favourable financing conditions for the growth of the economy and for returning inflation to the target. Among other things, monetary stimulus will benefit from preserving the current form of fixed-price liquidity injection and unlimited amounts in the banking sector, at least and during the second quarter of this year. Finally, the Supervisory Council notes that materializing these risks would require further easing of monetary policy stance.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_3_shkurt_2021.html Page 4 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, February 3, 2021 29/07/22, 13:32  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_3_shkurt_2021.html Page 5 of 5

Ky normalizim do t shoqrohet me rritje t punsimit, t pagave t punonjsve dhe t marzheve t fitimit t biznesit, ka do t krijoj premisa pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektivin ton prej 3% brenda vitit 2022. Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se prmbushja e ktyre projeksioneve krkon ruajtjen e kushteve t favorshme financiare gjat gjith horizontit afatmesm. N kt kontekst, ai gjykoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare mbetet i prshtatshm. *** Aktiviteti ekonomik n vend shfaqi tendenca rikuperimi n gjysmn e dyt t vitit 2020, pas recesionit t thell t shnuar n tremujorin e dyt. Megjithat, ndikimi negativ i pandemis vazhdon t jet i pranishm, si n treguesit makroekonomik ashtu edhe n treguesit e shndetit financiar t bizneseve dhe familjeve. Inflacioni shnoi nj vler mesatare prej 1.6% n tremujorin e katrt, duke ardhur n rritje t leht nga tremujori i mparshm. Luhatjet e tij pasqyruan, n masn m t madhe, luhatjet e mimeve t artikujve ushqimor. Nga ana tjetr, inflacioni baz, nj tregues ky i cili pasqyron m qart trendet afatmesme t rritjes s mimeve, vijoi t jet i qndrueshm, por nn nivelet e synuara nga Banka e Shqipris. Kjo ecuri pasqyron shuarjen e goditjeve t oferts gjat gjysms s dyt t vitit dhe presionet e dobta t gjeneruara nga krkesa agregate. Sipas t dhnave t Instat-it, aktiviteti ekonomik shnoi nj rnie vjetore prej 3.5% gjat tremujorit t tret, duke shnuar nj prmirsim relativ t ndjeshm krahasuar me thellsin e recesionit t tremujorit t dyt. Ky prmirsim pasqyroi hapjen e ekonomis, rritjen e investimeve dhe nj rnie m t ngadalt t konsumit privat dhe t eksporteve. Zgjerimi i krkess agregate u pasqyrua n rritje t aktivitetit n sektorin e ndrtimit dhe n nj kontraktim m t ult t sektorve t industris dhe t shrbimeve. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjer_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_3_shkurt_2021.html Pagina 2 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 3 shkurt 2021 29/07/22, 13:32 Prmirsimi i aktivitetit ekonomik u pasqyrua dhe n treguesit e punsimit. Punsimi u rrit me rreth 34 mij persona gjat tremujorit t tret, duke rikuperuar rreth 2/3 e humbjeve t regjistruara n tremujorin paraardhs, ndrsa norma e papunsis zbriti n 11.6%. T dhnat e disponuara pr aktivitetin ekonomik t tremujorit t katrt jan vetm indirekte dhe ende jo t plota. Megjithat, Banka e Shqipris vlerson se aktiviteti ekonomik n vend ka vijuar t rikuperohet m tej, pavarsisht vshtirsive t shkaktuara nga pandemia dhe nga ambienti i pafavorshm i huaj. Prtej lehtsimit t masave kufizuese t marra pr kontrollin e pandemis, ky rikuperim sht ndihmuar dhe nga stimuli fiskal i transmetuar gjat vitit 2020 dhe nga politikat stimuluese monetare dhe financiare t ndjekura nga Banka e Shqipris. Deficiti buxhetor arriti rreth nivelit 5.1% t PBB-s gjat njmbdhjet muajve t par t vitit. Ky deficit pasqyroi si rnien e t ardhurave gjat vitit kalendarik, ashtu dhe rritjen e shpenzimeve korrente dhe kapitale gjat vitit. Sipas vlersimeve tona, politika jon stimuluese monetare dhe lehtsimi i prkohshm i rregulloreve t funksionimit t sektorit bankar, mundsuan funksionimin normal t tregjeve financiare dhe krijuan nj ambient t prshtatshm pr rritjen e kredis gjat vitit t shkuar. Tregjet financiare vijuan t funksionojn normalisht edhe gjat tremujorit t katrt. Kursi i kmbimit u paraqit i qndrueshm, normat e interesit mbetn pran minimumeve t tyre historike, ndrsa kreditimi vijoi t rritet m tej. N veanti, kredia pr sektorin privat regjistroi nj rritje vjetore prej 7.7% gjat vitit 2020, duke ndihmuar bizneset dhe familjet shqiptare n prballimin e nevojave pr likuiditet dhe duke ofruar mjetet e nevojshme financiare pr rritjen e konsumit dhe t investimeve. Banka e Shqipris gjykon se sektori bankar ka ndihmuar n zbutjen e pasojave t goditjes s pandemis. Ky sektor ka marr prsipr nj pjes t barrs financiare t goditjes, duke ruajtur n t njjtn koh tregues t shndetshm likuiditeti, rentabiliteti dhe kapitalizimi. N veanti, raporti i kredive me probleme zbriti n nivelin 8.1% n https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjer_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_3_shkurt_2021.html Pagina 3 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 3 shkurt 2021 29/07/22, 13:32 fund t muajit dhjetor, nj nivel ky pran minimumeve historike t dekads s fundit. Vijimi i ktij roli aktiv t sektorit bankar edhe gjat periudhs s ardhshme do t jet nj element ky n qndrueshmrin e rimkmbjes ekonomike. Skenari yn baz i zhvillimeve t pritura sht ndrtuar mbi supozimin e zbutjes graduale t masave t marra pr kontrollin e pandemis dhe reduktimin progresiv t pasojave t saj. N kt skenar, ekonomia shqiptare pritet t shnoj norma relativisht t shpejta dhe t qndrueshme rritjeje gjat dy viteve n vijim. Inflacioni pritet t qndroj pran niveleve aktuale n vitin n vazhdim. M tej, rikthimi i aktivitetit ekonomik pran potencialit do t krijoj kushtet pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv brenda vitit 2022. *** Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se normalizimi i situats ekonomike duhet t vijoj t mbshtetet nprmjet ruajtjes s nj profili stimulues t politikave ekonomike. Po ashtu, ai konstatoi se balanca e rreziqeve vijon t mbetet n kahun e poshtm. N veanti, kto rreziqe burojn nga: nj prkeqsim i mundshm i situats epidemiologjike, n vend dhe n bot; vshtirsi t mundshme n mekanizmin e transmetimit t politiks monetare, n formn e rritjes s normave t interesit dhe kostove t financimit t sektorit privat, n formn e rritjes s ngadalt t kredis bankare; si dhe nga, nj reagim m i ngadalt i biznesit dhe i familjeve ndaj kushteve t prmirsuara financiare. N mbyllje t diskutimeve, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare sht i prshtatshm pr nxitjen e rritjes ekonomike dhe pr kthimin e qndrueshm t inflacionit n objektivin ton prej 3%. Pr kt arsye, ai vendosi: t ler t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 0.5%; t ler t pandryshuara normat e interesit t depozitave dhe t kredive njditore, respektivisht n nivelin 0.1% dhe 0.9%. Po ashtu, Kshilli Mbikqyrs thekson se politika monetare do t vijoj t mbetet lehtsuese gjat gjith horizontit kohor afatmesm, duke synuar t siguroj kushte financimi t favorshme pr rritjen e ekonomis dhe pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv. Ndr t tjera, stimuli monetar do t prfitoj nga ruajtja e forms aktuale t injektimit t likuiditetit me mim fiks dhe sasi t pakufizuara n sektorin bankar, t paktn dhe gjat tremujorit t dyt t ktij viti. S fundi, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vren se materializimi i ktyre rreziqeve do t krkonte lehtsimin e mtejshm t qndrimit t politiks monetare. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjer_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_3_shkurt_2021.html Pagina 4 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 3 shkurt 2021 Copyright  2018 Banka e Shqipris. Title: Questions and answers at the press conference
text: Question answers of the press conference dated March 24, 2021 29/07/22, 13:32 Question answers of the press conference dated March 24, 2021 Publication date: 24.03.2021 Q: You have expressed earlier in discussions with the IMF that vaccination will be indicative of economic growth or how the process of re-establishment from this situation will go. Already that vaccination has begun and looks like we are going towards herd immunity, what forecast is the Bank of Albania that will have vaccination in its projection of economic growth? Governor: Last year closed with a recession, economic downturn, the final figure of which is expected to come out around the level - 4%. Of course, and based on the monetary policy statement and analyses we have done with the departments of the Bank of Albania, on the line and with our international partners such as the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank, we anticipate economic growth over the following 2 years. The forecast in the figures at the moment, as forecasts change steadily, for this year is an increase of 4.9% and next year of 4.1%. However, predictions vary and are depending on the pandemic situation. You mentioned vaccines. Of course, vaccines are the main element that will accelerate the improvement of the pandemic situation and in parallel with it will also come economic recovery. This is clear not only for Albania and the region, but also for the whole world. The sooner the population is vaccinated and the herd immunity is achieved, the sooner security will be created and normal life will return. And of course economic indicators will improve. One of the elements we expect, in parallel with vaccination and improving the pandemic situation, is also the summer season, which is always a test because tourism is one of the main pillars of the Albanian economy. It's a test showing how  etje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_24_mars_2021.html Page 1 of 3 Question answers of the press conference dated March 24, 2021 29/07/22, 13:32 Economic recovery will come. There's uncertainty, of course. I pointed out that the balance of dangers is on the lower side, for these very reasons. Since we don't know the duration of the pandemic. Of course we try to make as realistic predictions as possible and based on these predictions come the above conclusions. So we anticipate a re-rise for the following two years, in case the pandemic situation comes gradually to ahalt. That's what we can say at the moment. Q: Since the year we left behind but even currently we have not had a change in the exchange rate, how is the deeuroisation process affected? Thinking we're going to have a reopening, what news are we going to have and what developments are there expected to be? Governor: Regarding the second question about deeuroization, this is a story we have discussed and continue to pursue. The Bank of Albania has a policy for promoting the national currency. This policy for promoting the national currency is done for two main reasons, theoretical and practical, but mainly for increasing the transmission of monetary policy with the aim of stimulating consumption, investment and lending. So with the aim of promoting economic growth and boosting the well-being of Albanian citizens and from the other side and for maintaining financial stability. We aim to maintain financial stability as we have a very high level of foreign currency loan exposure, without accounting for customers who have national currency income, while credit is in foreign currency. If we had an inflationary situation in the long term, a situation of depreciation of the national currency, surely this large part that is 1/4 of the loan portfolio would create serious problems in the performance of banks, would shake up financial stability. For these reasons, for better transmission of monetary policy and the preservation of financial stability the Bank of Albania, but also central banks in general, promote the national currency and want to have an increase in its use. The euroisation situation in the country - once a dollarisation situation - is at high levels and for these reasons we try to lower its level. The measures are introduced and have a positive performance; we have a decline in euroisation, but we do not intend to avoid the euro. Of course foreign trade, imports and exports will work in euros, but the sale and purchase of some elements must be done in the national currency that is the lectern. There's no need to circulate euros where it shouldn't. Import-export activity will be carried out in euros, while internal activity must naturally be carried out in the national currency. These are our deeuroisation policy goals. We repeat them because there's nothing wrong with repetition. In fact achieving these goals would make not only the Bank of Albania achieve its objectives, but we would be safer from either the banking system or financial stability and better transmission of monetary policy.  etje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_24_mars_2021.html Page 2 of 3 Question answers of the press conference dated March 24, 2021 29/07/22, 13:32  etje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_24_mars_2021.html Page 3 of 3

Tashm q vaksinimi ka filluar dhe duket se do shkojm drejt imunitetit t tufs, far parashikimi ka Banka e Shqipris q do t ket vaksinimi n projeksionin e saj t rritjes ekonomike? Guvernatori: Viti i kaluar u mbyll me nj recesion, rnie ekonomike, shifra prfundimtare e t cilit pritet t dal rreth nivelit - 4%. Natyrisht, dhe n baz t deklarats s politiks monetare dhe t analizave q ne kemi br me departamentet e Banks s Shqipris, n linj dhe me partnert tan ndrkombtar si Fondi Monetar Ndrkombtar dhe Banka Botrore, parashikojm t kemi rritje ekonomike gjat 2 viteve n vijim. Ka pasiguri sigurisht. E theksova q balanca e rreziqeve sht n kahun e poshtm, pikrisht pr kto arsye. Pasi nuk e dim kohzgjatjen e pandemis. Sigurisht q ne prpiqemi t bjm parashikime sa m realiste dhe bazuar n kto parashikime vijn dhe konkluzionet e msiprme. Pra ne parashikojm nj ringritje pr dy vitet n vijim, n rast se situata e pandemis do t vij gradualisht duke u shuar. Kjo sht ajo q mund t themi pr momentin. Pyetje: Duke qen se vitin q lam pas por edhe aktualisht nuk kemi patur ndryshim t kursit t kmbimit, si po shkohet me procesin e deeuroizimit? Duke menduar se do t kemi nj rihapje, far t rejash do t kemi dhe far zhvillimesh pritet t ket? Guvernatori: N lidhje me pyetjen e dyt pr deeuroizimin, kjo sht nj histori q ne e kemi diskutuar dhe vazhdojm ta ndjekim. Banka e Shqipris ka nj politik pr promovimin e monedhs kombtare. Kjo politik pr promovimin e monedhs kombtare bhet pr dy arsye kryesore, teorike dhe praktike, por kryesisht pr rritjen e transmetimit t politiks monetare me qllim stimulimin e konsumit, investimeve dhe kreditimit. Pra me qllim nxitjen e rritjes ekonomike dhe rritjen e mirqenies t qytetarve shqiptar dhe nga kahu tjetr dhe pr ruajtjen e stabilitetit financiar. Qllim kemi ruajtjen e stabilitetit financiar pasi kemi nj nivel shum t lart t ekspozimit t kredive n valut t huaj, pa llogaritur klientt q i kan t ardhurat n monedh kombtare, ndrkoh q kredin e kan n valut t huaj. N rast se do t kishim n afatgjat nj situat inflacioniste, situat t zhvlersimit t monedhs kombtare, sigurisht q kjo pjes e madhe q sht 1/4 e portofolit t kredis do t krijonte problem serioze n performancn e bankave, do t trondiste stabilitetin financiar. Pikrisht pr kto arsye, pr transmetimin m t mir t politiks monetare dhe ruajtjes s stabiliteti financiar Banka e Shqipris, por dhe bankat qendrore n prgjithsi, promovojn monedhn kombtare dhe duan t ken nj rritje t prdorimit t saj. Situata e euroizimit n vend - dikur ka qen e dollarizimit - sht n nivele t larta dhe pr kto arsye ne prpiqemi pr uljen e nivelit t tij. Masat jan prezantuar dhe kan nj ecuri pozitive; kemi nj rnie t euroizimit, por ne nuk synojm t shmangim euron. Sigurisht q tregtia e jashtme, importet dhe eksportet, do t funksionojn n euro, por shitja dhe blerja e disave elementeve duhen br n monedhn kombtare q sht leku. Nuk ka nevoj t qarkulloj euro aty ku sduhet. Aktiviteti i import-eksportit do t kryhet n euro, ndrsa aktiviteti i brendshm natyrisht q duhet kryer n monedhn kombtare. Kto jan synimet tona t politiks s deeuroizimit. Ne i prsrisim sepse nuk ka asgj t keqe nga prsritja. N fakt arritja e ktyre synimeve do t bnte q jo vetm Banka e Shqipris do t arrinte objektivat e veta por do t ishim m t sigurt qoft nga sistemi bankar, qoft nga stabiliteti financiar ashtu edhe nga transmetimi m i mir i politiks monetare. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjetje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_24_mars_2021.html Pagina 2 di 3 Pyetje prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp t dats 24 mars 2021 Copyright  2018 Banka e Shqipris. Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, March 24, 2021 29/07/22, 13:32 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, March 24, 2021 Publication date: 24.03.2021 Honourable media representatives, Today, on 24 March 2021, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Intermediate Monetary Policy Report. In the balance, new information taken in the analysis shows that economic activity has marked a gradual improvement over recent months. The fall in inflation during the first two months of this year appears to reflect the temporary effect of supply fluctuations.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_24_mars_2021.html Page 1 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, March 24, 2021 29/07/22, 13:32 However, the Supervisory Council notes that inflation continues to remain below target, while economic activity and employment continue to remain below levels recorded before the pandemic. Updating our forecasts suggests that economic activity will gradually come towards normalization over the next two years. This normalization will be accompanied by increases in employment, wages and business profit margins, which will create premise for returning inflation to our target of 3% within 2022. Under these circumstances, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current monetary policy stimulus position remains appropriate. The Bank of Albania will aim to maintain favourable financial conditions throughout the medium-term horizon, to guarantee the recovery of the economy and return inflation to the target. [Next I will know you in more detail with the reasons for the decision-making and conclusions of the Council's discussions.] *** Inflation recorded lower values than our expectations during the first two months of the year. The annual inflation rate fell to 0.4% in January, and rose to 1.1% in February. This performance was dictated by food price fluctuations, which, as well as over the past year, remain subject to sudden fluctuations in supply, in the context of pandemics. On the other hand, factors with medium-term impact on inflation, aggregate demand and employment and wage performance have been in line with our expectations. Although still insufficient to return inflation to the target, internal pressures on wages and prices appear stable and continue to contribute to inflation formation, as illustrated by the performance of basic inflation. Consequently, the effect of supply shocks is expected to be fleeting and not censor the return of inflation to the target within 2022.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_24_mars_2021.html Page 2 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, March 24, 2021 29/07/22, 13:32 New information on economic activity is generally in line with our expectations. Direct data on gross domestic product performance and aggregate demand are lacking, but indirect indicators suggest the continuation of recovery over the past two quarters. Increasing sales volumes, increasing electricity consumption, better performance of fiscal revenues, as well as expanding exports and imports, signal a better performance of the economy. On the other hand, the labour market showed employment declines in the fourth quarter of 2020, and an increase in the unemployment rate to 11.8%. The dampening of the positive impact of the summer season on service branches, and the tightening of pandemic prevention measures have negatively affected employment dynamics late last year. The performance of economic activity in the country is supported by accommodative monetary policy and fiscal stimulus. Fiscal policy has been able to preserve stimulus traits, mainly thanks to increased capital expenditure. Budget revenues have marked a slight decline, while public spending has increased. In line with the budget adopted, fiscal policy will remain stimulating even during 2021, boosting aggregate demand growth and expanding economic activity. Monetary stimulus policy has enabled the creation of favourable financing conditions. Financial markets operate quietly and are characterized by abundant liquidity and controlled risk premiums. Their good situation has enabled the effective monitoring of monetary stimulus, which has kept credit interest rates for the private sector at low levels. Likewise, the exchange rate has appeared stable, reflecting the balance of demand and currency supply. Monetary stimulus conditions have supported the growth of bank credit, which has been a stable source of financing for Albanian families and companies. The volume of bank credit for the private sector recorded an annual increase of 7.1% in the month of February. The expansion of the loan has been relatively balanced, in the direction of the structure of currencies, towards beneficiaries businesses or individuals, as well as in the direction of the destination for financing investments or covering circulating capital. Similarly, encouraging signals towards increasing monetary policy effectiveness come from the progressive expansion of the loan weight to the total. This index marked 50% value at the beginning of 2021. The increased lending performance is giving a substantial impact on boosting aggregate demand and recovering the economy. It reflects the effect of monetary, financial and fiscal stimulus measures on lending promotion, the good financial situation of the banking sector, as well as the proactive position adopted by banks in the situation we are going through. Looking to the future, the Supervisory Council expects economic activity to return to positive growth rates in 2021 and next. Economic growth is expected to be supported by considerable monetary and fiscal stimulus, reducing uncertainty, as well as recovering global economic activity. These factors are expected to drive growth in consumption, exports and investment, as well as gradually increase  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_24_mars_2021.html Page 3 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, March 24, 2021 29/07/22, 13:32 revenues in all sectors of the economy. Rising demand will help increase employment, further translating into wage growth and a gradual reversal of inflation towards the target within 2022. In any case, these projections rely on the assumption of progressive reduction of the pandemic during 2021, and are visibly conditioned by it. The pandemic's performance and its impact on the economy have been and still remain a source of uncertainty in economic forecasts. The Supervisory Council considers that the balance of risks continues to remain in the lower direction. In particular, the dangers of the lower kah stem from: a timely extension of the pandemic and the limitations it brings to economic activity; a slower recovery in consumption and investment, as a result of more careful behaviour of Albanian families and business; a slower transmission of monetary stimulus, as a result of a more careful behaviour of banks in lending. *** In consistency with these forecasts, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current monetary policy position is appropriate. Consequently, he decided: leave the basic interest rate unchanged at 0.5%; left deposit and one-day interest rates unchanged at 0.1% and 0.9%, respectively. Also, the Supervisory Council considers that monetary policy will continue to remain accommodative throughout the medium-term time horizon, in the function of sustainable recovery of economic activity and the return of inflation to target. Finally, the Supervisory Council notes that materializing the risks of the lower kah would require further easing of monetary policy stance.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_24_mars_2021.html Page 4 of 4

Prditsimi i parashikimeve tona sugjeron se aktiviteti ekonomik do t vij gradualisht drejt normalizimit gjat dy viteve n vazhdim. Ky normalizim do t shoqrohet me rritje t punsimit, t pagave dhe t marxheve t fitimit t biznesit, ka do t krijoj premisa pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektivin ton prej 3% brenda vitit 2022. N kto rrethana, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual stimulues i politiks monetare mbetet i prshtatshm. Banka e Shqipris do t synoj t ruaj kushte t favorshme financiare gjat gjith horizontit afatmesm, pr t garantuar rimkmbjen e ekonomis dhe kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv. [N vijim do t'ju njoh m n detaje me arsyet e vendimmarrjes dhe konkluzionet e diskutimeve t Kshillit.] *** Inflacioni regjistroi vlera m t ulta se pritjet tona gjat dy muajve t par t vitit. Norma vjetore e inflacionit ra n nivelin 0.4% n muajin janar, dhe u rrit n 1.1% n muajin shkurt. Kjo ecuri u diktua nga luhatjet e mimeve t ushqimeve, t cilat, ashtu si dhe gjat vitit t shkuar, mbeten subjekt i luhatjeve t papritura t oferts, n kontekstin e pandemis. Nga ana tjetr, faktort me ndikim afatmesm n inflacion, krkesa agregate dhe ecuria e punsimit dhe e pagave, kan qen n linj me pritjet tona. Ndonse ende t pamjaftueshme pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv, presionet e brendshme mbi pagat dhe mimet shfaqen t qndrueshme dhe vazhdojn t kontribuojn n mnyr t qensishme n formimin e inflacionit, sikurse ilustrohet dhe nga ecuria e inflacionit baz. Pr rrjedhoj, efekti i goditjeve t oferts pritet t jet kalimtar dhe t mos cenojn kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv brenda vitit 2022. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjer_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_24_mars_2021.html Pagina 2 di 4 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 24 mars 2021 29/07/22, 13:32 Informacioni i ri mbi aktivitetin ekonomik sht prgjithsisht n linj me pritjet tona. T dhnat direkte mbi ecurin e prodhimit t brendshm bruto dhe krkesn agregate mungojn, por treguesit e trthort sugjerojn vijimin e rimkmbjes gjat dy tremujorve t fundit. Rritja e vllimit t shitjeve, rritja e konsumit t energjis elektrike, ecuria m e mir e t ardhurave fiskale, si dhe zgjerimi i eksportit dhe importeve, sinjalizojn nj ecuri m t mir t ekonomis. Nga ana tjetr, tregu i puns shfaqi rnie t punsimit n tremujorin e katrt t vitit 2020, dhe rritje t shkalls s papunsis n nivelin 11.8%. Shuarja e ndikimit pozitiv t sezonit veror n degt e shrbimeve, dhe shtrngimi i masave pr parandalimin e pandemis kan ndikuar negativisht dinamikn e punsimit n fund t vitit t shkuar. Ecuria e aktiviteti ekonomik n vend sht mbshtetur nga politika monetare akomoduese dhe nga stimuli fiskal. Politika fiskale ka vijuar t ruaj tipare stimuluese, kryesisht n saj t rritjes s shpenzimeve kapitale. T ardhurat buxhetore kan shnuar nj rnie t leht, ndrkoh q shpenzimet publike jan rritur. N prputhje me buxhetin e miratuar, politika fiskale do t mbetet stimuluese edhe gjat vitit 2021, duke nxitur rritjen e krkess agregate dhe zgjerimin e aktivitetit ekonomik. Politika monetare stimuluese ka mundsuar krijimin e kushteve t favorshme t financimit. Tregjet e financiare operojn t qeta dhe karakterizohen nga likuiditet i bollshm dhe nga prime t kontrolluara rreziku. Gjendja e mir e tyre ka mundsuar prcjelljen efektive t stimulit monetar, i cili ka mbajtur n nivele t ulta normat e interesit t kredis pr sektorin privat. Po ashtu, kursi i kmbimit sht shfaqur i qndrueshm, n pasqyrim t balancs s krkess dhe oferts pr valut. Kushtet monetare stimuluese kan mbshtetur rritjen e kredis bankare, e cila ka vijuar t jet nj burim i qndrueshm financimi pr familjet dhe kompanit shqiptare. Vllimi i kredis bankare pr sektorin privat regjistroi nj rritje vjetore prej 7.1% n muajin shkurt. Zgjerimi i kredis ka qen relativisht i balancuar, n drejtim t strukturs s monedhave, n drejtim t prfituesve biznese apo individ, si dhe n drejtim t destinacionit pr financimin e investimeve apo mbulimin e kapitalit qarkullues. Po ashtu, sinjale inkurajuese n drejtim t rritjes s efektivitetit t politiks monetare vijn nga zgjerimi progresiv i peshs s kredis n lek ndaj totalit. Ky tregues shnoi vlern 50% n fillim t vitit 2021. Ecuria n rritje e kreditimit po jep nj ndikim t qensishm n nxitjen e krkess agregate dhe rikuperimin e ekonomis. Ajo pasqyron efektin e masave stimuluese monetare, financiare e fiskale, pr nxitjen e kreditimit, gjendjen e mir financiare t sektorit bankar, si dhe qndrimin proaktiv t adoptuar nga bankat n situatn q po kalojm. Duke e par nga e ardhmja, Kshilli Mbikqyrs pret q aktiviteti ekonomik ti rikthehet normave pozitive t rritjes n vitin 2021 dhe n vijim. Rritja ekonomike pritet t mbshtetet nga nj stimul i konsiderueshm monetar dhe fiskal, nga reduktimi i pasiguris, si dhe nga rimkmbja e aktivitetit ekonomik botror. Rritja e krkess do t ndihmoj rritjen e punsimit, duke u prkthyer m tej n rritje t pagave dhe n nj kthim gradual t inflacionit drejt objektivit brenda vitit 2022. N do rast, kto projeksione mbshteten n supozimin e reduktimit progresiv t pandemis gjat vitit 2021, dhe jan t kushtzuara dukshm prej saj. Ecuria e pandemis dhe ndikimi i saj n ekonomi kan qen dhe vijojn t mbeten burim pasigurie n parashikimet ekonomike. Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjykon se balanca e rreziqeve vijon t mbetet n kahun e poshtm. N veanti, rreziqe t kahut t poshtm burojn nga: nj zgjatje n koh e pandemis dhe e kufizimeve q ajo sjell n aktivitetin ekonomik; nj rimkmbje m e ngadalt e konsumit dhe investimeve, si pasoj e nj sjelljeje m t kujdesshme t familjeve dhe t biznesit shqiptar; nj transmetim m i ngadalt i stimulit monetar, si pasoj e nj sjelljeje m t kujdesshme t bankave n kredidhnie. *** N konsistenc me kto parashikime, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare sht i prshtatshm. Rrjedhimisht, ai vendosi: t ler t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 0.5%; t ler t pandryshuara normat e interesit t depozitave dhe kredive njditore, respektivisht n 0.1% dhe 0.9%. Gjithashtu, Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjykon se politika monetare do t vijoj t mbetet akomoduese gjat gjith horizontit kohor afatmesm, n funksionin t rikuperimit t qndrueshm t aktivitetit ekonomik dhe t kthimit t inflacionit n objektiv. Governor: Part of the statement answered this question, however summarily I can say that the Bank of Albania anticipates a more optimistic year than we had predicted in our previous analyses for 2021. Economic growth will be above the 5% level, i.e. from 4.9% which was forecast in the previous analysis, we now predict a 5.3% increase. This will come as a result of several factors: the good tourist season we expect, increased investment, increased consumption and increased lending of the banking sector, which has shown a very good consistency in relation to the crisis shock. Of course, all this expectation is based on the prediction that the level of cases and infection figures will come down, as is coming, otherwise the analysis will have different results. Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, May 5, 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, May 5, 2021 Publication date: 05.05.2021 Honored media representatives, Today, on 5 May 2021, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and adopted the Quarterly Monetary Policy Report. New information analyzed shows that the pace of recovery in economic activity has accelerated and the development outlook has come towards improvement over the past two quarters. The Supervisory Council estimates that this performance reflects: (i) the flexibility of the Albanian economy and the sustainability of its financial system; (ii) the support provided by monetary, financial and fiscal stimulus; as well as, recently, (iii) reducing restrictions and increasing confidence in response to the vaccination process. Page 1 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, May 5, 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 However, the Supervisory Council notes that  at the current stage  economic recovery is not complete and its supporting factors are not yet consolidated. The consequences of the pandemic in the economy remain evident, at still low levels of aggregate demand, falling employment and rising unemployment. Inflation also remains below our 3% target. In this context, the Council considers that monetary policy should remain in the easing direction. The monetary stimulus will serve to boost consumption and investment, which will further translate into increased employment, wages and profit margins, in line with our inflation target. *** The new information has generally been in line with our expectations, although the increase in economic activity has been somewhat higher than them and the inflation rate has been somewhat lower. Inflation marked a rapid and unexpected decline in January, as a result of the reduction in food prices. The recovery of these prices in the subsequent period also brought inflation up in the months of February and March, but the average rate of this indicator for the first quarter resulted in low, at 0.9%. On the other hand, basic inflation resulted in steady, around the 1.5% level, suggesting that food price fluctuations would have only transient effects on inflation. Page 2 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, May 5, 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 According to INSTAT data, the volume of economic activity in the country increased by 3% in the last quarter of last year, after three consecutive quarters of decline. Economic growth was supported by the expansion of consumption, investment and exports, and was reflected in improving manufacturing activities and services. The data available for the first quarter of the current year are only indirect, but they signal the continuation of the growth of the economy, as illustrated by improved confidence of economic agents, fiscal accounts and trade flows. However, although increasing, aggregate demand still remains below levels recorded in the period before the pandemic and insufficient to put production factors into full use. Consequently, economic activity in the country shrunk by 3.3% during 2020, the Albanian economy lost about 43,000 jobs, while the unemployment rate increased to 11.8%. Likewise, the pace of wage growth and other production costs came to a slowdown. The weakness of aggregate demand and the cyclical position of the economy have required a strong and coordinated response from macroeconomic policies. The fiscal stimulus of 2020 took the form of temporary tax relief, the provision of sovereign guarantees, as well as increased current and capital expenditure. For 2021, fiscal stimulus has the form of increased capital expenditure, in support of the reconstruction and infrastructure development programme. Fiscal first-quarter data are in line with this performance, witnessing a simultaneous expansion of both fiscal and budget deficit revenues and spending. For its part, the Bank of Albania offered the necessary monetary stimulus, to ensure the normal functioning of financial markets and to further boost economic lending. Likewise, the temporary and targeted easing of oversight of banking sector operating regulations offered further ease for Albanian businesses and families, in the form of the six-month loan moratorium and in the form of promoting its restructuring. Monetary and financial incentives have had a good transmission. Consequently, monetary conditions in the economy have been and still remain accommodative. Financial markets operate quietly and interest rates are expected to be close to historic minimums, Page 3 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, May 5, 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 Despite short-term fluctuations. Likewise, the exchange rate appears stable. In particular, the banking sector has been moving to finance businesses and families, reflecting both the health of the banking sector's balance sheets and its proper response to the crackdown. In March 2021, the index of troubled loans dropped below the 8% level, recording the lowest recorded value of 2009. The loan to the private sector recognised an average annual increase of 7.5% in the first quarter. This increase showed a broad basis, driven by the expansion of lending both in the individual segment and in that of businesses. In this context, it is worth pointing out that increasing loans for investment purposes is an encouraging development for economic growth in the future. Likewise, the progressive expansion of the credit weight in money, an indicator that marked 52% value against the total in March, gives positive signals in the direction of increasing monetary policy effectiveness and financial sustainability. Our projections for the future remain positive. Following the vaccination process at home and around the world, monetary and fiscal stimulus, as well as restoring confidence in historical levels, will pave the way for progressive expansion of economic activity over the following years. The basic forecast scenario projects a recovery at stable pace of the economy during 2021 and 2022, following the contraction experienced in 2020. The expansion of activity is expected to be led by accelerating family consumption, export of goods and services, as well as increased private investment. In response, employment and wages are expected to come in as well, enabling inflation to return to target within 2022. *** In the Council's judgment, the full recovery of the economy and steady growth in inflation towards the target should be supported by a stimulating profile of economic policies. As far as possible, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current monetary policy position is appropriate, for promoting economic growth and for the stable return of inflation to the target. For this reason, he decided: leave the basic interest rate unchanged at 0.5%; leave deposit and one-day loan interest rates unchanged, respectively at levels 0.1% and 0.9%. Among other things, monetary stimulus will benefit from preserving the current form of fixed-price liquidity injection and unlimited amounts in the banking sector, at least and during the third quarter of this year. Finally, the Supervisory Council states that the balance of risks follows to remain at the lower end in the short term, but it appears more balanced in the medium term. In particular, the risks in the short term stem from: a slower improvement than expectations of the epidemiological situation, at home and in the world; possible difficulties in the monetary policy transmission mechanism, in Page 4 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, May 5, 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 form of slow growth in bank credit; As well as from, a slower business and household response to improved financial conditions. For these reasons, the Supervisory Council stresses that monetary policy will remain easing throughout the mid-term time horizon. Any timely normalization of monetary policy will be careful, not censoring the sustainability of economic recovery and not undermining the premise of returning inflation to the target. Finally. The Supervisory Council finds it appropriate to stress that the gradual normalization of the economic situation and strengthening the sustainability of recovery should bring into focus decision-makers the need to accelerate the agenda of structural reforms. These reforms should aim at increasing competitiveness, further improving the investment and business climate, as well as strengthening the long-term sustainability of public finances. They are the only instruments that will enable a faster and more sustainable long-term growth of the Albanian economy. Page 5 of 5
