Pr rrjedhoj, aktiviteti ekonomik n vend u tkurr me 3.3% gjat vitit 2020, ekonomia shqiptare humbi rreth 43,000 vende pune, ndrsa shkalla e papunsis u rrit n 11.8%. Po ashtu, ritmi i rritjes s pagave dhe t kostove t tjera t prodhimit erdhi n ngadalsim. Dobsia e krkess agregate dhe e pozicionit ciklik t ekonomis kan krkuar nj prgjigje t fort dhe t koordinuar nga politikat makroekonomike. Stimuli fiskal i vitit 2020 mori formn e lehtsive t prkohshme tatimore, t ofrimit t garancive sovrane, si dhe t rritjes s shpenzimeve korrente e kapitale. Pr vitin 2021, stimuli fiskal ka formn e rritjes s shpenzimeve kapitale, n mbshtetje t programit t rindrtimit dhe t zhvillimit t infrastrukturs. T dhnat fiskale t tremujorit t par jan n linj me kt ecuri, duke dshmuar nj zgjerim t njkohshm si t t ardhurave e shpenzimeve fiskale, ashtu dhe t deficitit buxhetor. Nga ana e saj, Banka e Shqipris ofroi stimulin e nevojshm monetar, pr t garantuar funksionimin normal t tregjeve financiare dhe pr t nxitur m tej kreditimin e ekonomis. Po ashtu, lehtsimi i prkohshm dhe i targetuar i mbikqyrjes s rregulloreve t funksionimit t sektorit bankar ofroi lehtsi t mtejshme pr bizneset dhe familjet shqiptare, n formn e moratoriumit gjashtmujor t ksteve t kredis dhe n formn e nxitjes s ristrukturimit t saj. Stimujt monetar e financiar kan pasur nj transmetim t mir. Pr rrjedhoj, kushtet monetare n ekonomi kan qen dhe vijojn t mbeten akomoduese. Tregjet financiare operojn t qeta dhe normat e interesit vijojn t jen pran minimumeve historike, https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fj_per_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_5_maj_2021.html Pagina 3 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 5 maj 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 pavarsisht luhatjeve afatshkurtra. Po ashtu, kursi i kmbimit shfaqet i qndrueshm. N veanti, sektori bankar ka vijuar t financoj bizneset dhe familjet, duke pasqyruar si shndetin e bilanceve t sektorit bankar ashtu dhe reagimin e duhur t tij ndaj goditjes. N muajin mars 2021, treguesi i kredive me probleme zbriti nn nivelin 8%, duke regjistruar vlern m t ult t regjistruar prej vitit 2009. Kredia pr sektorin privat njohu nj rritje mesatare vjetore prej 7.5% n tremujorin e par. Kjo rritje shfaqi nj baz t gjer, e nxitur nga zgjerimi i kreditimit si n segmentin e individve dhe n at t bizneseve. N kt kontekst, vlen t theksohet se rritja e kredive pr qllime investimi sht nj zhvillim inkurajues pr rritjen ekonomike n t ardhmen. Po ashtu, zgjerimi progresiv i peshs s kredis n lek, tregues ky i cili shnoi vlern 52% ndaj totalit n muajin mars, jep sinjale pozitive n drejtim t rritjes s efektivitetit t politiks monetare dhe t qndrueshmris financiare. Projeksionet tona pr t ardhmen mbeten pozitive. Vijimi i procesit t vaksinimit n vend dhe n bot, stimuli monetar dhe fiskal, si dhe rikthimi i besimit n nivelet historike, do ti hapin rrug zgjerimit progresiv t aktivitetit ekonomik gjat viteve n vazhdim. Skenari baz i parashikimeve projekton nj rimkmbje me ritme t qndrueshme t ekonomis gjat viteve 2021 dhe 2022, pas kontraktimit t prjetuar n vitin 2020. Zgjerimi i aktivitetit pritet t udhhiqet nga prshpejtimi i konsumit familjar, i eksportit t mallrave e t shrbimeve, si dhe nga investimet private n rritje. N prgjigje t tyre, punsimi dhe pagat pritet t vijn po ashtu n rritje, duke mundsuar kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv brenda vitit 2022. *** N gjykimin e Kshillit, rimkmbja e plot e ekonomis dhe rritja e qndrueshme e inflacionit drejt objektivit duhet t vijoj t mbshtetet nga nj profil stimulues i politikave ekonomike. Pr sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare sht i prshtatshm, pr nxitjen e rritjes ekonomike dhe pr kthimin e qndrueshm t inflacionit n objektiv. Pr kt arsye, ai vendosi: t ler t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 0.5%; t ler t pandryshuar normat e interesit t depozitave dhe t kredive njditore, prkatsisht n nivelet 0.1% dhe 0.9%. Ndr t tjera, stimuli monetar do t prfitoj nga ruajtja e forms aktuale t injektimit t likuiditetit me mim fiks dhe sasi t pakufizuara n sektorin bankar, t paktn dhe gjat tremujorit t tret t ktij viti. S fundi, Kshilli Mbikqyrs konstaton se balanca e rreziqeve vijon t mbetet n kahun e poshtm n afatin e shkurtr, por ajo shfaqet m e balancuar n afatin e mesm. N veanti, rreziqet n afatin e shkurtr burojn nga: nj prmirsim m i ngadalt se pritjet i situats epidemiologjike, n vend dhe n bot; vshtirsi t mundshme n mekanizmin e transmetimit t politiks monetare, n https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fj_per_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_5_maj_2021.html Pagina 4 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 5 maj 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 formn e rritjes s ngadalt t kredis bankare; si dhe nga, nj reagim m i ngadalt i biznesit dhe i familjeve ndaj kushteve t prmirsuara financiare. Pr kto arsye, Kshilli Mbikqyrs thekson se politika monetare do t vijoj t mbetet lehtsuese gjat gjith horizontit kohor afatmesm. do normalizim n koh i politiks monetare do t jet i kujdesshm, duke mos cenuar qndrueshmrin e rimkmbjes ekonomike dhe duke mos dmtuar premisat e kthimit t inflacionit n objektiv. S fundi. Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjen me vend t theksoj se normalizimi gradual i situats ekonomike dhe forcimi i qndrueshmris s rimkmbjes duhet t risjellin n fokus t vendimmarrsve nevojn e prshpejtimit t axhends s reformave strukturore. Kto reforma duhet t synojn rritjen e konkurrueshmris, prmirsimin e mtejshm t klims s investimeve dhe t biznesit, si dhe forcimin afatgjat t qndrueshmris s financave publike. Title: Speech during the presentation of the Annual Report of the Bank of Albania for 2020 in the Albanian Parliament
text: Governor Sejko's word during the presentation of the Bank of Albania's 2020 Annual Report to the Assembly of Albania 29/07/22, 13:31 Governor Sejko's word during the presentation of the Bank of Albania's 2020 Annual Report to the Assembly of Albania Publication date: 27.05.2021 Honorable, Mr. Speaker of the Assembly, Honourable ladies and gentlemen, Deputies, Let me thank you for the opportunity you give me to present to you the work and results of the Bank of Albania over the past year, through this direct communication. The COVID-19 pandemic put the Bank of Albania  as well as the entire Albanian economy, society and institutions  in the face of unforeseen and extraordinary challenges. Aware of the magnitude and complexity of the problem, in coordination and with fiscal policy, the Bank of Albania intervened quickly and fully. The objectives of our intervention were: (i) easing the short-term crisis pact in the economy; (ii) reducing the possible negative consequences on the country's manufacturing potential; as well as (iii) preserving the country's monetary and financial stability. Overall, I think our measures to deal with the crisis resulted in success: the impact of the crisis on the economy resulted in less of our initial expectations, illustrating both the resistance and flexibility of the private sector and the positive impact of responding to public policies; Likewise, the impact of the blow on long-term growth factors seems contained. Despite the natural problems, we have avoided the mass bankruptcies of businesses and the strong increase in unemployment;  s_se_Shqiperise_per_vitin_2020_ne_Kuvendin_e_Shqiperise_29116.html Page 1 of 5 Governor Sejko's word during the presentation of the Bank of Albania's 2020 Annual Report to the Assembly of Albania 29/07/22, 13:31 Finally, despite the strong test we underwent, the country's economic and financial balances remained solid. In our judgment, the Albanian economy enjoys the premise for a rapid recovery in the future. Honorable, Mr. Speaker of the Assembly, Let me stress that, during 2020, the Bank of Albania has fulfilled its other legal duties, has marked progress in implementing the Medium-Term Development Strategy, as well as implementing recommendations left by the Assembly of Albania. The following will present a more complete discussion of our work and results over the past year. 1. Economic performance and response of the Bank of Albania Rising uncertainty and necessary social distancing measures, taken to limit the spread of the COVID-19 pandemic, brought the Albanian economy into recession, brought rising unemployment and created financial difficulties for many businesses and families during 2020. Economic balance indexes deteriorated. The volume of economic activity shrunk by 3.3%, the Albanian economy lost about 43,000 jobs and the unemployment rate rose to 11.8%. Falling revenues brought about increased private and public debt. In reflection of slowing economic activity, at home and globally, average inflation for 2020 resulted in 1.6%, resulting in remaining below our target. The crisis particularly hit trade flows and private consumption. Consequently, the consequences of the crisis were present in all sectors of the economy, but in particular they were felt in the industry sector and in particular branches of the services sector. The size and complexity of the blow made it necessary to address it with coordinated fiscal, monetary and financial stimulus policies. Within its field of competence, the Bank of Albania received a full package of measures. More specifically, we:  s_se_Shqiperise_per_vitin_2020_ne_Kuvendin_e_Shqiperise_29116.html Page 2 of 5 Governor Sejko's word during the presentation of the Bank of Albania's 2020 Annual Report to the Assembly of Albania 29/07/22, 13:31 we lowered the basic interest rate to its historic minimum of 0.5%, facilitated the banking sector's access to liquidity funds and increased liquidity injections into the interbank market; we adopted regulatory changes that encouraged the 6-month delay of credit inslaught for customers in immediate difficulty, as well as the restructuring of loans for customers in longer-term difficulties; we suspended the distribution of the divide for the banking sector, aiming to increase the sector's financial absorption capacities against the shock; we eliminated the costs of using electronic interbank payment platforms operated by the Bank of Albania, targeting the use of electronic payments. In our assessment, the measures taken have been effective for reducing the impact of pandemics on our sector. First, our intervention helped maintain the country's monetary and financial stability. The financial market resulted in calm, characterized by normal activity and low volatileity. This development is a qualitative change from previous episodes of blows and evidence of the increased maturity of our financial system. Second, monetary and macroprudence stimulus created the necessary conditions for the continuation of lending. Credit to the private sector marked an average increase of 6.7% during 2020. Also, over 23,000 businesses and families benefited from the moratorium on insands and credit restructuring, for a loan portfolio that captures the value of about 200 billion dollars. Overall, our estimates show that the monetary policy stimulus course pursued over the past four years has generated a volume about 3.7% higher in economic activity, making a considerable contribution to improving social welfare. Third, the supervision of careful monitoring of the performance of the banking sector, continued communication with it and the temporary suspension of the distribution of the division, served the preservation of a liquid, well-capitalized banking system and sound risk management practices. Finally, ensuring the uninterrupted operation of payment systems and lowering costs for online payments in the lek supported the normal functioning of the financial market. 2. Financial stability and banking supervision Our banking sector shouldered a significant portion of the financial burden of the crisis, properly exercising the function of shock absorber. This development, which is different from previous episodes of crises, reflects the continued work the Bank of Albania has carried out in the direction of improving supervision and regulation, improving security nets, as well as consolidating the banking sector. Despite the challenges, banking sector activity appeared stable. During 2020, the active sector grew by about 7%, the financial result remained in positive territory, its capitalization remains satisfactory, while the ratio of troubled loans decreased to 8.1% at the end of the year.  s_se_Shqiperise_per_vitin_2020_ne_Kuvendin_e_Shqiperise_29116.html Page 3 of 5 Governor Sejko's word during the presentation of the Bank of Albania's 2020 Annual Report to the Assembly of Albania 29/07/22, 13:31 Direct exposure of banking sector activity to market risks remains controlled. Bank industry estimates and resistance test exercises suggest that the banking sector's capacities are sufficient to cope with their potential growth. In addition to the measures taken within the pandemic, the Bank of Albania has been working on long-term strengthening of the banking system's supervisory framework. The main directions of work consist of: implementation of the recommendations of the KiE Committee of Experts for the Assessment of Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing Measures (MONEYVAL), where necessary supplements have been made under the regulatory framework and the number of inspections focusing on terrorism financing issues has been added; further improvement of the regulatory framework, reflecting the approximation with the EU acquis, the principles of the Basel Committee and international best practices; conducting on-site inspections, setting priorities and conducting targeted inspections under the conditions of the restrictions; empowerment of the capacity for extraordinary intervention, where in the quality of the Extraordinary Intervention Authority, extraordinary intervention plans for systemic banks have been drawn up. 3. Other activities Honoured ladies and gentlemen, the Bank of Albania has maintained constant attention and to other areas of its activity, which have a direct contribution to the development of the financial market and the economic life of the country. In this direction, I find it appropriate to point out: further development of the payment system, through legal and infrastructure improvements; the continued supply of the economy with physical money and the increase in its quality; currency reserve management; support ing European integration; improving financial statistics; intesification of efforts towards increasing education and financial inclusion; As well as research work and improved communication with the public. Also, the internal control systems established have been used to contribute to the management of normal work processes and the viability of all bank functions. *** Honourable ladies and gentlemen, Deputies, 2021 is expected to mark a positive turn towards the revitalization of the country's economy.  s_se_Shqiperise_per_vitin_2020_ne_Kuvendin_e_Shqiperise_29116.html Page 4 of 5 Governor Sejko's word during the presentation of the Bank of Albania's 2020 Annual Report to the Assembly of Albania 29/07/22, 13:31 The opening of partner economies, population vaccination, and monetary and fiscal stimulus in the country will support the expansion of economic activity during 2021 and 2022. However, uncertainties over these expectations remain present and the probability of other negative shocks in the future is not negligible. The full recovery of the economy and the steady return of inflation to the target should be supported by macroeconomic incentives in the short term. In the medium and long term, economic policies must shift towards a more stable balance between the need to provide stimulus and the need to maintain monetary and financial stability. At the end of my word, let me stress that the end of the crisis must be accompanied by the complete return of attention to the need to accelerate the agenda of structural reforms. These reforms are the only instrument for steadily accelerating the pace of economic growth and turning its fruits into as broad an improvement in social welfare as possible. They should aim at increasing competitiveness, further improving the investment and business climate, as well as strengthening the long-term sustainability of public finances. Thank you!  s_se_Shqiperise_per_vitin_2020_ne_Kuvendin_e_Shqiperise_29116.html Page 5 of 5

N trsi, mendoj se masat tona pr prballimin e krizs rezultuan t suksesshme: ndikimi i krizs n ekonomi rezultoi m i vogl s pritjet tona fillestare, duke ilustruar si rezistencn dhe fleksibilitetin e sektorit privat, ashtu dhe ndikimin pozitiv t prgjigjes s politikave publike; po ashtu, ndikimi i goditjes mbi faktort afatgjat t rritjes duket i prmbajtur. N gjykimin ton, ekonomia shqiptare i gzon premisat pr nj rimkmbje t shpejt n t ardhmen. N vijim do t paraqes nj shtjellim m t plot t puns dhe rezultateve tona gjat vitit t shkuar. 1. Treguesit e balancave ekonomike u prkeqsuan. Vllimi i aktivitetit ekonomik u tkurr me 3.3%, ekonomia shqiptare humbi rreth 43,000 vende pune dhe shkalla e papunsis u rrit n 11.8%. Rnia e t ardhurave solli rritjen e borxhit privat e publik. N pasqyrim t ngadalsimit t aktivitetit ekonomik, n vend dhe n bot, inflacioni mesatar pr vitin 2020 rezultoi 1.6%, duke vijuar t mbetet posht objektivit ton. Madhsia dhe kompleksiteti i goditjes e bri t domosdoshm adresimin e saj me politika t koordinuara stimuluese fiskale, monetare e financiare. Tregu financiar rezultoi i qet, i karakterizuar nga nj aktivitet normal dhe volatilitet i ult. Ky zhvillim sht nj ndryshim cilsor nga episode t mparshme goditjesh dhe dshmi e maturitetit t rritur t sistemit ton financiar. S dyti, stimuli monetar dhe makroprudencial krijoi kushtet e nevojshme pr vijimin e kreditimit. Kredia pr sektorin privat shnoi rritje mesatare prej 6.7% gjat vitit 2020. Gjithashtu, mbi 23,000 biznese e familje prfituan nga moratoriumi i ksteve dhe ristrukturimi i kredis, pr nj portofol kredie q kap vlern e rreth 200 miliard lekve. N trsi, vlersimet tona tregojn se kursi stimulues i politiks monetare t ndjekur gjat katr viteve t fundit ka gjeneruar nj vllim rreth 3.7% m t lart t aktivitetit ekonomik, duke dhn nj kontribut t konsiderueshm n prmirsimin e mirqenies sociale. S treti, mbikqyrja e monitorimi i kujdesshm i ecuris s sektorit bankar, komunikimi i vazhduar me t dhe pezullimi i prkohshm i shprndarjes s dividendit, i shrbyen ruajtjes s nj sistemi bankar likuid, t mirkapitalizuar dhe me praktika t shndosha pr administrimin e rreziqeve. S fundi, garantimi i funksionimit t pandrprer t sistemeve t pagesave dhe ulja e kostove pr pagesat online n lek mbshteti funksionimin normal t tregut financiar. 2. Stabiliteti financiar dhe mbikqyrja bankare Sektori yn bankar mbajti mbi shpatulla nj pjes t konsiderueshme t barrs financiare t krizs, duke ushtruar n mnyr t denj funksionin e amortizuesit t goditjeve. Ky zhvillim cilsisht i ndryshm nga episodet e mparshme t krizave, pasqyron punn e vazhdueshme q Banka e Shqipris ka kryer n drejtim t prmirsimit t mbikqyrjes dhe rregullimit, t prmirsimit t rrjetave t siguris, si dhe t konsolidimit t sektorit bankar. Gjat vitit 2020, aktivet e ktij sektori u rritn me rreth 7%, rezultati financiar mbeti n territor pozitiv, kapitalizimi i tij mbetet i knaqshm, ndrsa raporti i kredive me probleme zbriti n 8.1% n fund t vitit. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjs_se_Shqiperise_per_vitin_2020_ne_Kuvendin_e_Shqiperise_29116.html Pagina 3 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko gjat prezantimit t Raportit Vjetor t Banks s Shqipris pr vitin 2020 n Kuvendin e Shqipris 29/07/22, 13:31 Ekspozimi i drejtprdrejt i aktivitetit t sektorit bankar ndaj rreziqeve t tregut mbetet i kontrolluar. Vlersimet e industris bankare dhe ushtrimet e provs s rezistencs, sugjerojn se kapacitetet e sektorit bankar jan t mjaftueshme pr t prballuar rritje potenciale t tyre. Krahas masave t marra n kuadr t pandemis, Banka e Shqipris ka vijuar punn pr forcimin afatgjat t kuadrit mbikqyrs t sistemit bankar. Drejtimet kryesore t puns konsistojn n: zbatimin e rekomandimeve t Komitetit t Ekspertve t KiE-s pr Vlersimin e Masave kundr Pastrimit t Parave dhe Financimit t Terrorizmit (MONEYVAL), ku jan br plotsimet e nevojshme n kuadrin rregullator dhe sht shtuar numri i inspektimeve me fokus n shtjet e financimit t terrorizmit; prmirsimin e mtejshm t kuadrit rregullator, duke vijuar prafrimin me acquis t BE-s, parimet e Komitetit t Bazelit dhe praktikat m t mira t ndrkombtare; kryerjen e inspektimeve n vend, duke vendosur prioritete dhe duke kryer inspektime t targetuara n kushtet e kufizimeve; fuqizimin e aftsis pr ndrhyrje t jashtzakonshme, ku n cilsin e Autoritetit t Ndrhyrjes s Jashtzakonshme, jan hartuar planet e ndrhyrjes s jashtzakonshme pr bankat sistemike. 3. Title: Questions and answers at the press conference
text: Question answers of the press conference dated July 7, 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 Question answers of the press conference dated July 7, 2021 Publication date: 07.07.2021 Q: Did you say a little early on that economic growth is expected but did not say how much the economy is expected to grow by the end of the year, based on the data you have and the expectations that the Bank of Albania has? Governor: Based on analyses conducted by the Bank of Albania, we have communicated that the latest figure for forecasting economic growth has been at 5.3%. We've been in a line of communication with the International Monetary Fund. You heard in the statement of the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania, following today's analysis, that data available from the Intermediate Monetary Policy Report suggest higher growth in economic growth in the following quarters. Even the first quarter of the year resulted in economic growth at the 5.5% level. I cannot say how much it will be after no analysis has been completed on how accurate the Bank of Albania's forecast is. Predictions are always predictions. This is worth seeing how much will materialize, but we anticipate good economic growth, above 5%, anyway. Whether it will be over 5.3% or not, this will be analyzed and communicated at the next meeting of the Supervisory Council, which will be in August. So the full Monetary Policy report with the consolidated data will be in a month's time, and we will communicate it. However, I want to stress that the level of economic growth is conditional on the risks I mentioned in the statement. The main risk is the economic situation influenced by the pandemic. If we are going to worsen the situation from the pandemic, especially in the fall, given the information we hear from the new variants of the virus, then the forecast for economic growth may not materialize. In contrast, as well as all indicators and data confirm, of course we will have good economic growth this year, but also in the next two years. So, fortunately  etje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_7_korrik_2021.html Page 1 of 4 Question answers of the press conference dated July 7, 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 We have better expectations for economic growth than forecasts. All indicators, whether economic growth or trade balances, imports-exports, and the financial system, give positive signals. The financial system, too, has very good credit indicators. So we generally have positive signals that promise good economic growth, but the exact figure we will confirm at the next meeting. Q: What is the Bank of Albania doing to reverse the inflation target? You already expressed, we had 1.9% inflation in the second quarter, but what's going to happen? How long can the target be achieved? Governor: Following comments I just made, inflation has also been on the rise. So the index went towards the target, compared to the previous quarter. Inflation in the previous quarter was at 0.9%. While in April and May, as we pointed out and in the statement it was at a level of 1.9%. We anticipate that we will reach the level of inflation within 2022. That's the prediction. There are international signals, analysis in more developed countries and in larger countries, which may have a faster inflationary situation than predicted. Our inflation target is at 3%, so we are below target and aim to slightly raise the level of inflation to stimulate or turn on the economy a little bit. But from different states, especially from the pandemic crisis, the signals are that it can approach an inflationary situation faster compared to previous periods. However, regardless, monetary stimulus or accommodative policy will continue. All states have confirmed their position: that economies need monetary and fiscal incentives. In this respect, we will continue with monetary stimulus policy. Therefore, the main instrument for achieving the inflation target by the Bank of Albania is the interest rate, so it is the monetary policy pursued. We will continue with this accommodative policy, for the medium term, until the negative production gap closes and the economy will reach its required level. So it's going to be in the potential. I want to stress that we didn't use contingent plans. We have always had contingent plans for quantitative amenities and have not used them, as the Albanian economy has been sufficiently flexible towards crisis shocks. And, fortunately, we're in a positive direction, so we expect growth. Under these conditions, we will continue with monetary stimulus policy and aim to achieve our inflation target within 2022  I can say in the second half of 2022. But the important thing is what we said and on the first question, so that we can achieve growth rhythms, to achieve a steady increase this year and in the years after. Q: Troubled credit in 2020 has been down 0.26% reaching the 7.8% level, meanwhile in nonbank financial institutions bad credit has increased. How do you argue or comment on this fluctuation between the total level and level in the nonbank sector?  etje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_7_korrik_2021.html Page 2 of 4 Question answers of the press conference dated July 7, 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 Governor: In terms of problem credit, it is to be stressed that this indicator has fallen. So we currently said in the statement it's at the 7.8% level. We expected to have a troubled credit increase, as opposed to all states as a result of the pandemic crackdown. Businesses and individuals were hit and this would be reflected in their behaviour with the financial system. As a result of measures taken by the Bank of Albania to restructure loans, delay inslaughter or communicated measures that you already know, but also as a result of the reaction of Albanian businesses themselves in relation to the crisis, fortunately we have not yet had a rise in troubled loans. Second-rate banks give positive signals that do not expect a significant increase in troubled credit. It's to be seen, but we're prepared. And in the worst case scenario, as a result of bank of Albania's analyses, banks would have no problems or need for additional capital as a result of deteriorating credit portfolios. We are not in this situation, so we practically do not expect a loan increase with significant problems. Non-bank financial institutions, including microcredit and other institutions, have a difference from second-rate banks. First of all, these institutions do not work with funds, citizens' deposits, but work with donations or various sources of funding. From this point of view we certainly exercise great attention, as they contribute to economic development through lending, but from a risk point of view of financial stability carry a lesser risk comparatively with banks, as they do not directly affect citizens' deposits. There are many factors here because bad credit in these institutions can be higher. In the first place. First, we should thank these institutions for the work they do by lending, financing more difficult areas, which are mainly rural areas, or population segments less formal than other segments, and being that these institutions work with these regions and these business segments and credit in relation to credit write-offs is a little more difficult. However, these institutions have performed well and shown quite good resistance during the period of pandemic, but I think about it anyway and once these are institutions that do not work with population deposits, but with their funds and donations. Q: You have thrown for public consultation with interest groups a draft regulation on consumer credit and that mortgage. How is it expected of nonbank societies and when is it expected to come into force? Governor: The Bank of Albania as regulator of the financial system has analysed and observed and as a result of many complaints that have come from subjects, whether citizens or different businesses, for high interest rates, we must be clear that these financial institutions have just said that working with donations or other sources of financing have a higher cost and based on these costs they also have interest rates more The high and typology of loans these institutions provide carries the highest interest rate everywhere, not only in Albania but throughout the region, and around the world. Of course these interest rates have a limit and to regulate the market, so that there are no limits on interest rates, the Bank of Albania is preparing a regulation to make a market adjustment.  etje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_7_korrik_2021.html Page 3 of 4 Question answers of the press conference dated July 7, 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 Of course the market is free and price reports are free, but of course we want to avoid abuses if there is and are in the phase of verification and market research in this respect. It has not yet been concluded, it is said that the analytical work in relation to this regulation will be closed within this year and the regulation will come into force in the coming year. We are in constant consultation with the relevant industry and institutions. Of course they are alerts to see what changes the Bank of Albania is making, but we also need to be very serious in co-operation with industry before we make any regulatory changes. Of course we wouldn't want to allow abuse in this market.  etje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_7_korrik_2021.html Page 4 of 4

Pra raporti i plot i Politiks Monetare me t dhnat e konkluduara do t jet pas nj muaji, dhe ne do ta komunikojm. Gjithsesi, dua t theksoj q niveli i rritjes ekonomike sht i kushtzuar nga rreziqet q prmenda n deklarat. Rreziku kryesor sht situata ekonomike e ndikuar nga pandemia. Nse do t kemi prkeqsim t situats nga pandemia, sidomos n vjesht, duke pasur parasysh edhe informacionet q dgjojm nga variantet e reja t virusit, ather mund t mos materializohet parashikimi pr rritjen ekonomike. N t kundrt, sikundr dhe t gjith treguesit dhe t dhnat konfirmojn, natyrisht q ne do t kemi nj rritje t mir ekonomike kt vit, por edhe n dy vitet n vazhdim. Sistemi financiar, gjithashtu, ka tregues shum t mir kreditimi. Pra, n prgjithsi kemi sinjale pozitive q premtojn pr nj rritje t mir ekonomike, por shifrn e sakt do ta konfirmojm n mbledhjen e radhs. Pyetje: far po bn Banka e Shqipris pr t kthyer objektivin e inflacionit? Ju tashm e shpreht, patm nj inflacion 1.9% n tremujorin e dyt, por far do t ndodh? Pr sa koh mund t arrihet objektivi? Guvernatori: N vijim t komenteve q sapo bra, inflacioni gjithashtu ka qen n rritje. Pra, treguesi ka vajtur drejt objektivit, krahasuar me tremujorin e mparshm. Inflacioni n tremujorin e mparshm ka qen n nivelin 0.9%. Ndrkoh q n muajt prill dhe maj, sikurse e theksuam dhe n deklarat ishte n nivelin 1.9%. Ne parashikojm q do t arrijm nivelin e inflacionit brenda vitit 2022. Ky sht parashikimi. Ka sinjale ndrkombtare, analiza n vende m t zhvilluara dhe n vende m t mdha, q mund t ket nj situat inflacioniste m t shpejt se sa e parashikuara. Objektivi yn i inflacionit sht n nivelin 3%, pra ne jemi nn objektiv dhe synojm t rrisim pak nivelin e inflacionit pr t stimuluar ose pr t ndezur pak ekonomin. Por, nga shtete t ndryshme, sidomos nga kriza e shkaktuar nga pandemia, sinjalet jan q t mund t afroj m shpejt nj situat inflacioniste krahasuar me periudhat e mparshme. Megjithat, pavarsisht nga kjo, politika monetare stimuluese apo akomoduese do t vazhdoj. T gjith shtetet kan konfirmuar qndrimin e tyre: q ekonomit kan nevoj pr stimuj monetar dhe fiskal. Sikundr n kt aspekt dhe ne do t vazhdojm me politikn monetare stimuluese. Pra, instrumenti kryesor pr arritjen e objektivit t inflacionit nga Banka e Shqipris sht norma e interesit, pra sht politika monetare e ndjekur. Ne do t vazhdojm me kt politik akomoduese, pr nj periudh afatmesme, deri n momentin q do t mbyllet hendeku negativ i prodhimit dhe ekonomia do t arrij n nivelin e saj t krkuar. Pra, do t jet n potencial. Dua t theksoj q ne nuk kemi prdorur plane kontigjence. Gjithmon kemi pasur plane kontigjence pr lehtsira sasiore dhe nuk i kemi prdorur, pasi ekonomia shqiptare ka qen mjaftueshmrisht fleksibl kundrejt goditjeve t krizs. Dhe, fatmirsisht ne jemi n kahun pozitiv, pra presim rritje. N kto kushte, ne do t vazhdojm me politikn monetare stimuluese dhe synojm t arrijm objektivin ton t inflacionit brenda vitit 2022  mund t them n gjysmn e dyt t vitit 2022. Por e rndsishme sht ajo q tham dhe n pyetjen e par, pra q t arrijm ritmet e rritjes, q t arrijm nj rritje t qndrueshme kt vit dhe n vitet m pas. Bizneset dhe individt u goditn dhe kjo do t reflektohej n sjelljen e tyre me sistemin financiar. Si pasoj e masave t marra nga Banka e Shqipris pr ristrukturimin e kredive, pr shtyrjen e ksteve apo masat e komunikuar q tashm ju i dini, por edhe si pasoj e vet reagimit t bizneseve shqiptare n raport me krizn, pr fat t mir nuk kemi pasur akoma rritje t kredis me probleme. Bankat e nivelit t dyt japin sinjale pozitive q nuk presin nj rritje t konsiderueshme t kredis me probleme. sht pr tu par, por ne jemi t prgatitur. Dhe n skenarin m t keq, si pasoj e analizave t Banks s Shqipris, bankat nuk do t kishin probleme ose nevoj pr kapital shtes si pasoj e prkeqsimit t portofoleve t kredis. Nuk jemi n kt situat, pra praktikisht ne nuk presim nj rritje t kredis me probleme t rndsishme. Institucionet financiare jobanka ku prfshihen ato t mikrokredis dhe institucione t tjera, kan nj dallim nga bankat e nivelit t dyt. N radh t par kto institucione nuk punojn me fonde, me depozita t qytetarve, por punojn me donacione ose burime t ndryshme financimi. Ktu ka shum faktor sepse kredia e keqe n kto institucione mund t jet m e lart. n rradh t par. N radh t par, duhet ti falenderojm kto institucione pr punn q ato kryejn duke kredituar, duke financuar zona m t vshtira, q jan kryesisht zona rurale, ose segmente popullate m pak formale se segmentet e tjera dhe duke qen q kto institucione punojn me kto rajone dhe kto segmente t biznesit dhe kredia n raport me shlyerjet e kredis sht pak m e vshtir. Megjithat dhe kto institucione kan ecur mir dhe kan treguar nj rezistenc mjaft t mir gjat periudh s pandemis, por gjithsesi e thkesoj dhe njher q kto jan institucione q nuk punojn me depozita t popullats, por me fonde dhe donacionet e tyre. Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, July 7, 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, July 7, 2021 Publication date: 07.07.2021 Honored media representatives, Today, on 7 July 2021, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Intermediate Monetary Policy Report. New information analysed suggests that the Albanian economy has shown clear recovery tendencies in the first half of the year. Inflation also came in higher during April and May, correcting the first quarter decline.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_7_korrik_2021.html Page 1 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, July 7, 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 The forecast update confirms the scenarios we presented in continuity during 2021. The Albanian economy is expected to mark a rapid and steady growth over the current year and the next two years. This increase will be accompanied by employment expansion and wage growth, creating premise for returning inflation to the target during 2022. The Supervisory Council considers that the factors that support the recovery of the Albanian economy have come by expanding and strengthening. Likewise, the dangers of the lower kah, though still present, have come towards fading. However, the Supervisory Council notes that inflation continues to remain below target, that employment continues to remain below the potential level, and that the sustainability of economic growth follows to require the preservation of monetary stimulus conditions. Under these circumstances, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current monetary policy position remains appropriate. I will thefollowing know you in more detail on the reasons for the decision-making and conclusions of the Council's discussions. *** Inflation came in higher during April and May. The average inflation rate marked the 1.9% value for these two months, being significantly higher than the first quarter average. Rising inflation mainly reflected rising food and oil prices, while prices of other basket items did not undergo significant changes. This dynamic confirmed our previous estimates that falling inflation in the first quarter would be temporary. At the same time, it suggests that the current speed of its growth is not stable. Factors conditioning the steady return of inflation to the target are coming towards improvement, but its return to target is expected to be a medium-term prospect. The increase in aggregate demand has not yet translated into steady employment and wage growth. Likewise, the rapid rise in consumer prices in partner countries seems, at the moment, to be a passing phenomenon. Finally, economic agents' expectations for inflation continue to remain below target.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_7_korrik_2021.html Page 2 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, July 7, 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 The Bank of Albania estimates that all three of these factors will come towards improvement on the medium-term horizon. In line with our expectations, economic activity in the country has come towards recovery during the first two quarters of the year. According to INSTAT data, the Albanian economy grew by 5.5% during the first quarter of the year, while analysis of indirect data suggests even faster growth rates during the second quarter. Recovery of economic activity appears broadly based. In terms of aggregate demand, it reflects expanding consumption and private investment, increasing budgetary spending, as well as expanding the export of goods and services. In sectoral terms, this recovery reflected the simultaneous expansion of the manufacturing and service sectors. Improved economic activity has not yet been fully reflected in the labour market. According to INSTAT data, employment marked an annual decline of 2.6% in the first quarter of the year, while the unemployment rate scored 11.9%. These indicators suggest that the Albanian economy is still far from fully normalizing its activity and that this process should be supported by stimulus policies. The supporting factors for economic growth have come towards consolidation. Reducing restrictions as a result of the vaccination process, improving business and consumer confidence, expanding foreign demand, as well as fiscal and monetary stimulus, have generated the necessary premise for a gradual normalization of economic activity. Fiscal policy has been used to preserve a stimulating nature during the first half of the year. Fiscal stimulus has taken the form of expanding current and capital expenditure, respectively by 10% and 29% by May, while budgetary revenues have marked increases of about 19%. Compliance with budget projections means that fiscal stimulus will remain present during 2021, to come towards contraction in the following years. The Bank of Albania estimates that maintaining this fiscal policy kahu serves both support for economic recovery in the short term and strengthening fiscal sustainability in the long term. In parallel with fiscal stimulus, monetary stimulus policy has enabled the creation of favourable financing conditions. Financial markets operate quietly and are characterized by abundant liquidity and controlled risk premiums. Their good situation has enabled the effective monitoring of monetary stimulus, which has kept credit interest rates for the private sector at low levels. Likewise, the exchange rate remains relatively stable, reflecting the balance of demand and currency supply. Improved loan demand and favourable supply conditions have brought about a relatively rapid increase in lending. The private sector loan portfolio marked an annual increase of 7.8% in May, versus an average growth rate of 6.8% during 2020. Beyond overall portfolio growth, lending dynamics carry other positive signals. First, the growth of the loan portfolio has gone extensively for financing business investments and mortgage loans,  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_7_korrik_2021.html Page 3 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, July 7, 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 signalled increased private sector investment and an improving liquidity situation. Second, credit in the local currency follows to preserve higher growth rates, reflecting on the progressive increase in the weight of credit in money against the total. This encouraging development creates premise for a better conveyance of monetary stimulus and a higher resistance of the banking system to the risks of financial stability. Third, the troubled credit index fell to 7.8% in May, suggesting a satisfactory quality of this portfolio. Judging on the fact-based trends of economic and monetary developments, as well as on their defining factors, the Supervisory Council estimates that the Albanian economy will mark rapid and stable rates of economic growth on the medium-term horizon. Economic growth will be supported by improving foreign environments, reducing uncertainty, a stimulus mix of monetary and fiscal policies, as well as improving private sector balance sheets. These factors are expected to drive growth in consumption, exports and investment, as well as gradually increase revenues in all sectors of the economy. Expanding demand will help increase employment, further translating into wage growth and a gradual return of inflation towards the target within 2022. In any case, these projections are based on the assumption of avoiding serious restrictions on economic activity, as a result of further pandemic shocks. However, the pandemic's performance and its impact on the economy have been and still remain a source of uncertainty in economic forecasts. The Supervisory Council estimates that the risks of the lower kah appear somewhat paler in this round of analysis, and the overall balance of risks is more neutral. In particular, the risks of lower kah stem from a worsening epidemiological situation and its negative effect on the economy, as well as a slower recovery in consumption and investment, as a result of more careful behaviour of Albanian families and business. Conversely, the risks of upper kah come from a more expansionary domestic fiscal policy than current forecasts, as well as a rapidrise than inflation expectations in partner countries. *** In consistency with these forecasts, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current monetary policy position is appropriate. Consequently, he decided: leave the basic interest rate unchanged at 0.5%; left deposit and one-day interest rates unchanged at 0.1% and 0.9%, respectively. Also, the Supervisory Council considers that monetary policy will continue to remain accommodative throughout the medium-term time horizon, in the function of sustainable recovery of economic activity and the return of inflation to target.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_7_korrik_2021.html Page 4 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, July 7, 2021 29/07/22, 13:31  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_7_korrik_2021.html Page 5 of 5

Kjo rritje do t shoqrohet me zgjerim t punsimit dhe rritje t pagave, duke krijuar premisa pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv gjat vitit 2022. Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjykon se faktort t cilt mbshtesin rimkmbjen e ekonomis shqiptare kan ardhur duke u zgjeruar dhe forcuar. Po ashtu, rreziqet e kahut t poshtm, ndonse ende t pranishm, kan ardhur drejt zbehjes. Megjithat, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vren se inflacioni vijon t mbetet nn objektiv, se punsimi vijon t mbetet posht nivelit potencial, dhe se qndrueshmria e rritjes ekonomike vijon t krkoj ruajtjen e kushteve monetare stimuluese. N kto rrethana, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare mbetet i prshtatshm. N vijim do t'ju njoh m n detaje mbi arsyet e vendimmarrjes dhe konkluzionet e diskutimeve t Kshillit. *** Inflacioni erdhi n rritje gjat muajve prill e maj. Norma mesatare e inflacionit shnoi vlern 1.9% pr kta dy muaj, duke qen dukshm m e lart se mesatarja e tremujorit t par. Rritja e inflacionit pasqyroi kryesisht rritjen e mimeve t ushqimeve dhe t nafts, ndrkoh q mimet e artikujve t tjera t shports nuk psuan ndryshime t ndjeshme. Kjo dinamik konfirmoi vlersimet tona t mparshme se rnia e inflacionit n tremujorin e par do t ishte e prkohshme. N t njjtn koh, ajo sugjeron se shpejtsia aktuale e rritjes s tij nuk sht e qndrueshme. Faktort q kushtzojn kthimin e qndrueshm t inflacionit n objektiv po vijn drejt prmirsimit, por kthimi i tij n objektiv pritet t jet nj prospekt afatmesm. Rritja e krkess agregate nuk sht prkthyer ende n rritje t qndrueshme t punsimit e t pagave. Po ashtu, rritja e shpejt e mimeve t konsumit n vendet partnere duket, pr momentin, se do t jet nj fenomen kalimtar. S fundi, pritjet e agjentve ekonomik pr inflacionin vijojn t mbeten nn objektiv. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjaer_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_7_korrik_2021.html Pagina 2 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 7 korrik 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 Banka e Shqipris vlerson se t tre kta faktor do t vijn drejt prmirsimit n horizontin afatmesm. N linj me pritjet tona, aktiviteti ekonomik n vend ka ardhur drejt rikuperimit gjat dy tremujorve t par t vitit. Sipas t dhnave t INSTAT-it, ekonomia shqiptare u rrit me 5.5% gjat tremujorit t par t vitit, ndrkoh q analiza e t dhnave indirekte sugjeron pr norma edhe m t shpejta rritjeje gjat tremujorit t dyt. Rikuperimi i aktivitetit ekonomik shfaqet me baz t gjer. N terma t krkess agregate, ai pasqyron zgjerimin e konsumit dhe t investimeve private, rritjen e shpenzimeve buxhetore, si dhe zgjerimin e eksportit t mallrave e shrbimeve. N terma sektorial, ky rikuperim pasqyroi zgjerimin e njkohshm t sektorve prodhues dhe t shrbimeve. Prmirsimi i aktivitetit ekonomik nuk sht pasqyruar ende plotsisht n tregun e puns. Sipas t dhnave t INSTAT-it, punsimi shnoi nj rnie vjetore prej 2.6% n tremujorin e par t vitit, ndrkoh q norma e papunsis shnoi vlern 11.9%. Kto tregues sugjerojn se ekonomia shqiptare sht ende larg normalizimit t plot t aktivitetit t saj dhe se ky proces duhet t vijoj t mbshtet nga politika stimuluese. Faktort mbshtets t rritjes ekonomike kan ardhur drejt konsolidimit. Reduktimi i kufizimeve si pasoj e procesit t vaksinimit, prmirsimi i besimit t biznesit dhe konsumatorit, zgjerimi i krkess s huaj, si dhe stimuli fiskal dhe monetar, kan gjeneruar premisat e nevojshme pr nj normalizim gradual t aktivitetit ekonomik. Politika fiskale ka vijuar t ruaj nj natyr stimuluese gjat gjysms s par t vitit. Stimuli fiskal ka marr formn e zgjerimit t shpenzimeve korrente dhe kapitale, prkatsisht me 10% dhe 29% deri n muajin maj, ndrkoh q t ardhurat buxhetore kan shnuar rritje me rreth 19%. Respektimi i projeksioneve t buxhetit nnkupton q stimuli fiskal do t mbetet i pranishm gjat vitit 2021, pr t ardhur drejt tkurrjes n vitet n vazhdim. Banka e Shqipris vlerson se ruajtja e ktij kahu t politiks fiskale i shrben si mbshtetjes s rikuperimit ekonomik n afatin e shkurtr ashtu dhe forcimit t qndrueshmris fiskale n afatin e gjat. Paralelisht me stimulin fiskal, politika monetare stimuluese ka mundsuar krijimin e kushteve t favorshme t financimit. Tregjet e financiare operojn t qeta dhe karakterizohen nga likuiditet i bollshm dhe nga prime t kontrolluara rreziku. Gjendja e mir e tyre ka mundsuar prcjelljen efektive t stimulit monetar, i cili ka mbajtur n nivele t ulta normat e interesit t kredis pr sektorin privat. Po ashtu, kursi i kmbimit mbetet relativisht i qndrueshm, n pasqyrim t balancs s krkess dhe oferts pr valut. Prmirsimi i krkess pr kredi dhe kushtet e favorshme t oferts, kan sjell nj rritje relativisht t shpejt t kreditimit. Portofoli i kredis pr sektorin privat shnoi nj rritje vjetore prej 7.8% n muajin maj, kundrejt nj norme mesatare rritjeje prej 6.8% gjat vitit 2020. Prtej rritjes s prgjithshme t portofolit, dinamikat e kreditimit mbartin sinjale t tjera pozitive. S pari, rritja e portofolit t kredis ka shkuar gjersisht pr financimin e investimeve t bizneseve dhe pr kredi hipotekare, duke https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjaer_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_7_korrik_2021.html Pagina 3 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 7 korrik 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 sinjalizuar rritjen e investimeve t sektorit privat dhe nj situat n prmirsim t likuiditetit t tij. S dyti, kredia n monedhn vendase vijon t ruaj norma m t larta rritjeje, duke u reflektuar n rritjen progresive t peshs s kredis n lek ndaj totalit. Ky zhvillim inkurajues krijon premisa pr nj prcjellje m t mir t stimulit monetar dhe nj rezistenc m t lart t sistemit bankar ndaj rreziqeve t stabilitetit financiar. S treti, treguesi i kredis me probleme ra n nivelin 7.8% n muajin maj, duke sugjeruar nj cilsi t knaqshme t ktij portofoli. Duke gjykuar mbi trendet e faktuara t zhvillimeve ekonomike dhe monetare, si dhe mbi faktort prcaktues t tyre, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlerson se ekonomia shqiptare do t shnoj norma t shpejta dhe t qndrueshme rritjeje ekonomike n horizontin afatmesm. Rritja ekonomike do t mbshtetet nga prmirsimi i ambientit t huaj, nga reduktimi i pasiguris, nga nj miks stimulues politikash monetare dhe fiskale, si dhe nga prmirsimi i bilanceve t sektorit privat. Kta faktor pritet t nxitin rritjen e konsumit, t eksporteve dhe t investimeve, si dhe t rritin gradualisht t ardhurat n t gjith sektort e ekonomis. Zgjerimi i krkess do t ndihmoj rritjen e punsimit, duke u prkthyer m tej n rritje t pagave dhe n nj kthim gradual t inflacionit drejt objektivit, brenda vitit 2022. N do rast, kto projeksione bazohen n supozimin e shmangies s kufizimeve serioze mbi aktivitetin ekonomik, si pasoj e goditjeve t mtejshme t pandemis. Megjithat, ecuria e pandemis dhe ndikimi i saj n ekonomi kan qen dhe vijojn t mbeten burim pasigurie n parashikimet ekonomike. Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlerson se rreziqet e kahut t poshtm shfaqen disi m t zbeht n kt raund analize, dhe balanca e prgjithshme e rreziqeve paraqitet m neutrale. N veanti, rreziqet e kahut t poshtm burojn nga nj prkeqsim i situats epidemiologjike dhe i efektit negativ t saj n ekonomi, si dhe nj rimkmbje m e ngadalt e konsumit dhe investimeve, si pasoj e nj sjelljeje m t kujdesshme t familjeve dhe t biznesit shqiptar. N t kundrt, rreziqe t kahut t siprm vijn nga nj politik e brendshme fiskale m ekspansioniste se parashikimet aktuale, si dhe nga nj rritje e me e shpejt se pritjet e inflacionit n vendet partnere. *** N konsistenc me kto parashikime, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare sht i prshtatshm. Governor Seyko's word at the book promotion ceremony: "In the face of crisis, challenges of theory and economic policies", by the authors Akkad. Prof. Dr. Anastas Angjeli and Prof. Dr. Adrian Civici Publication date: 22.07.2021 The COVID-19 pandemic put global society in the face of unforeseen and extraordinary challenges. The public health emergency and the economic and financial difficulties caused by this crackdown and the measures taken to limit pandemics  1/5 05/08/22, 17:18 The word of the Government of Sejkjo rejoices in the devotion of the book: "In the face of crisis, spfidas of theory and economic politics", ng... dominated and continue to receive the attention of society and policymakers, as well as to Influence their decision-making. The complexity of the problems we face requires rapid, robust and coordinated intervention between health, fiscal and monetary ones. Measures taken by authorities could minimize the negative effects of pandemics and have created premises for a rapid recovery, hoping vaccination and other health measures will end the pandemic. This discussion comes with much professionalism and realism in the book "Faced with Crisis, Challenges of Theory and Economic Policies", by authors Anastas Angjeli and Adrian Civici. Following health problems, economic developments, and describing the decision-making of the authorities, they have clearly analysed the mechanism of this crisis and the economic and financial policies undertaken in response to it. The COVID-19 pandemic has confronted the authorities in the face of difficult and complex elections and has further deepened the problems facing our societies and humanity at the global level. Authorities carry out rapid decision-making to respond to unexpected developments. Adapted policies have imposed the change of traditional ones with unconventional ones that  2/5 05/08/22, 17:18 Governor Seyko's word at the book promotion ceremony: "In the face of crisis, challenges of theory and economic policies", ng... Adapted policies have imposed the change of traditional ones with unconventional ones that have brought about significant changes, not only in the way institutions operate, but even in changing the mandates of their goals. After a relatively long and vigorous period of policymaking, authorities are evaluating these policies. The assessment is carried out not only to measure their success but also to understand the potential secondary effects they can transmit to the economy and society in general. The genesis of the book is precisely this discussion. Through a combination of events, history and doctrines of economic theories the authors present a clear situation of the sharper problems of the time, as well as the need to revise economic thought. Professors Angjeli and Civici lower the analysis from theoretical level to practical, giving concrete recommendations on policymaking and stopping in the case of the Albanian economy. This discussion paves the way for a deepened analysis of the crisis on the Albanian economy, which they say has mainly hit small businesses. The analysis presents the response of the authorities and assesses the impacts of policies undertaken on the economy and its particular sectors. The authors summarize and compare assessments conducted by Albanian and international institutions, as well as present a deepened assessment of the effects of pandemics in the overall macroeconomic and financial framework. They identify vulnerabilities and economic and financial issues that deserve to be treated with special care. Special attention is paid to structural changes in the financial system and in labour and education markets. The above turns the focus of the discussion on the fundamental directions that will also determine the growth and development potentials in the medium and long-term future.  3/5 05/08/22, 17:18 Governor Seyko's word at the book promotion ceremony: "In the face of crisis, challenges of theory and economic policies", ng... Without wanting to repeat, I stress that professors correctly state that this transformation will not only stop at the banking system but will extend to the entire Albanian economy. Transformation must respond to sectoral developments, structural changes and digitalization tendencies that will affect the economy. The orientation of educational programmes must take into account economic and trade developments on the global plain. These are especially important for a small and open economy like ours. After a detailed description of the aid packages and the financial and economic situation of businesses, the book presents an accurate explanation of the success and effects that the decision-making of the authorities had on business and the economy. In this sense the book offers readers an opportunity to assess the impacts of policies from an independent and critical point of view. It also offers an opportunity to optimize and coordinate policymaking in the future. The authors rightly state that digital revolution is a great opportunity for the development of the banking system and the rapid and secure financial involvement of companies. This is also a convenient case for the creation of flexible instruments that enable rapid responses to negative shocks and ensure the financial stability of businesses and the economy. Digitization will also enrich banking and financial systems with new actors and services. During the crisis humanity but also Albanian society faced very strong elections and dilemmas. The difficult choice between economics and health is evident by authors as a fundamental and most difficult dilemma faced by authorities. However, in further analysis it is said that the choice between the economy and health, which dominated short-term decision-making, is not separate from other decisions facing our societies, such as: rule of law, equality before it, as well as reducing economic and financial inequalities. If we were to add to these environmental problems, such as global warming, we would understand that together they have an important role for a society's capacity to cope with negative shocks from the pandemic. As I said above, these challenges have fundamental weight for revising the mandate and objectives of institutions including central banks.  4/5 05/08/22, 17:18 Governor Seyko's word at the book promotion ceremony: "In the face of crisis, challenges of theory and economic policies", ng... objectives of institutions, including central banks. The attitude we hold towards they have a fair effect on the economic and financial sustainability of families, businesses and the entire economy. Finally, I mean that professors more intelligently have paid special attention to policies and strategies adapted by the US and the EU for coping with the crisis. I stress, cleverly, as the philosophy of developed policies and strategies and instruments adapted to the two largest economies of the market are not only an important object of study from an academic point of view, but also serve as a guide for all other economies. Furthermore, developed economies are the main partners of small and open economies. They emit the two dominant currencies for the world economy and finances. For all these reasons developments in the US and eu have a great value and fair impact on our economy. Consequently, consideration should be taken into account in the context of economic and financial decision-making. In closing, I would like to congratulate Prof. Civicin's Prof. Angel for his work and dedication during the excellent analysis of the economic, financial and social effects that COVID-19 brought to the albanian world economy. I am convinced that the authors' analyses, comments and recommendations will be very valuable to institutions and policymakers.  5/5

Profesort Angjeli e Civici e zbresin analizn nga niveli teorik n at praktik, duke dhn rekomandime konkrete mbi politikbrjen dhe duke u ndalur n rastin e ekonomis shqiptare. Ky diskutim i hap rrugn nj analize t thelluar t krizs mbi ekonomin shqiptare, e cila sipas tyre ka goditur kryesisht bizneset e vogla. Analiza paraqet prgjigjen e autoriteteve dhe vlerson ndikimet e politikave t ndrmarra n ekonomi dhe n sektort e veant t saj. Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, August 4, 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, August 4, 2021 Publication date: 04.08.2021 Honored media representatives, Today, on 4 August 2021, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Quarterly Monetary Policy Report. New information taken in the analysis suggests that the pace of economic recovery is coming to an acceleration. The Supervisory Council estimates that supporting factors for economic growth have strengthened over the past quarters. Likewise, the prospect of economic developments has come towards improvement, and the risks of the lower kah  though present  have  yp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_4_gusht_2021_29647.html Page 1 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, August 4, 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 They're coming towards fading. However, the Supervisory Council notes that inflation continues to remain under target, that the consequences of pandemics in the economy continue to be present, and that economic growth follows to seek support from a stimulus mix of monetary and fiscal policies. In this context, the Council considers that monetary policy should remain in the easing direction along the entire medium-term horizon. The monetary stimulus will help maintain abundant liquidity and low financing costs, promoting expansion of private sector consumption and investment. In this way, this stimulus will serve to strengthen the sustainability of economic growth, employment and wage growth, as well as the steady return of inflation to the target. As above, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current monetary policy position is appropriate. Next, let me clarify in more detail the main conclusions of the Quarterly Report, our expectations for the future, as well as the reasons that motivated today's monetary policy decision. *** The new information obtained over the last quarter has been at the top of our expectations. Average second-quarter inflation rose to 1.8% value, correcting the decline recorded in the first quarter. This increase mainly reflected higher inflation of fuels and food items, especially crude ones, while inflation of other basket items was stable. In particular, basic inflation  which better represents the balance of factors affecting the performance of consumer item prices in the medium term  was stable. Overall, inflation performance over the past quarters has been subject to frequent and unexpected fluctuations in supply factors, which have shown and are expected to have a passing impact. On the other hand, factors with medium-term impact on inflation: rising wages and production costs, price performance in partner countries and expectations for inflation appear stable, but are still insufficient for inflation to return to target. Updating our analysis and forecasts suggests that these factors will be powered over the following quarters, supporting the return of inflation to the target within 2022. According to INSTAT data, the Albanian economy grew by 5.5% during the first quarter, exceeding our expectations. This increase reflected the simultaneous expansion of private and public sector consumption and investment, as well as the increase in goods exports. At the same time, it benefited from a higher base effect  as a result of INSTAT's downward revision of 2020 economic growth  as well as transitional factors, such as the rapid increase in electricity production. The information available suggests a strong acceleration of economic activity in the second quarter, albeit at a rate that will not be indicative of the pace of further growth of the Albanian economy.  yp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_4_gusht_2021_29647.html Page 2 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, August 4, 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 Despite this improvement, the labour market showed a sluggish performance in the first quarter. Employment levels continue to remain below that recorded before the pandemic, the unemployment rate rose to 11.9%, while market pressures for wage growth are still pale. Based on historical performance, the Bank of Albania considers that sustainable employment and wage growth will be delayed following the expansion of demand for goods and services. In the macroeconomic plan, the acceleration of economic growth has reflected the reduction of restrictions, as a result of improved epidemiological situation and expansion of vaccination, increased business and consumer confidence, improved foreign environment, as well as fiscal and monetary stimulus policies. Fiscal policy has been used to preserve an expansionist character during the first half of the year. The budget deficit of this period remained around the 3.4% LEVEL of GDP, generating a positive fiscal impulse. This performance reflected the rapid increase in spending compared to revenues, although the latter recorded an annual increase of about 37% in the second quarter. The Bank of Albania has considered the stimulating nature of fiscal policy necessary during the peak of the pandemic. On the other hand, with the end of the health and economic emergency, we expect a return of the government's attention towards consolidating public finances. Our projections for the future factor in a progressive reduction in fiscal stimulus during the second half of the year and the following period. For its part, the Monetary Stimulus Policy of the Bank of Albania has been able to generate a quiet financial environment, characterized by: the normal circulation of funds in markets; low lending costs; And stable exchange rate. The loan to the private sector marked an average increase of 7.7% during the second quarter, reflecting a relatively rapid and steady increase in credit in Lek, credit for investment purposes and that for housing purchases. The reported increase in credit demand in the third quarter and easing lending conditions promise continued support with consumer and investment needs funds. In this context, an important role has also played in improving balances of Albanian businesses, which have been reflected in the 7.1% drop in the ratio of troubled loans in June. The update to forecasts in this quarterly report suggests a positive performance of the economy on the medium-term horizon, revising upwards the projection of the pace of economic growth during the current year. Economic growth will be supported by expanding consumption and private investment, as well as increasing the export of goods and services. This performance will reflect improved business and consumer confidence, gradual normalization of economic activity in partner countries, as well as the favourable financial environment in the country. Furthermore, increasing aggregate demand will help boost employment and wages, creating premise for returning inflation to the target within 2022.  yp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_4_gusht_2021_29647.html Page 3 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, August 4, 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 These predictions are built on the assumption of: avoiding strong restrictions on economic activity as a result of the pandemic; as well as the slow but progressive reduction of fiscal stimulus on the medium-term horizon. *** Judging on the above, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania estimated that monetary stimulus had an effective transmission in financial markets. He also estimated that this stimulus should be present in the economy even during the medium term, targeting the support of the economy with abundant and low-cost loans, as well as offsetting the expected reduction in fiscal stimulus. For this reason, the Supervisory Council decided: leave the basic interest rate unchanged at 0.5%; leave deposit and one-day loan interest rates unchanged, at 0.1% and 0.9%, respectively. The Supervisory Council considers that economic recovery and the return of inflation to the target require the preservation of monetary policy stimulus kah along the forecast horizon. However, the materialisation of the basic scenario will also require a gradual normalization of monetary policy, towards more stable interest rate levels. In any case, this normalization will be transparent and careful, not censoring the sustainability of economic recovery and not undermining the premise of returning inflation to target. On the other hand, the Supervisory Council confirmed that the risks of the lower kah have been reduced, although the epidemiological situation continues to remain a source of potential shocks and the long-term impact of the pandemic on the economy - although at the moment seems minimal - remains to be assessed. Finally, the Supervisory Council stresses that gradual normalization of the economic situation and strengthening the sustainability of recovery should bring to focus decision-makers the need to accelerate the structural reform agenda. These reforms should aim at increasing competitiveness, further improving the investment and business climate, as well as strengthening the long-term sustainability of public finances.  yp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_4_gusht_2021_29647.html Page 4 of 4

Po ashtu, perspektiva e zhvillimeve ekonomike ka ardhur drejt prmirsimit dhe rreziqet e kahut t poshtm  ndonse t pranishme  kan https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_4_gusht_2021_29647.html Pagina 1 di 4 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 4 gusht 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 ardhur drejt zbehjes. Megjithat, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vren se inflacioni vijon t mbetet nn objektiv, se pasojat e pandemis n ekonomi vijojn t jen prezente, dhe se rritja ekonomike vijon t krkoj mbshtetje nga nj miks stimulues politikash monetare e fiskale. N kt kontekst, Kshilli gjykon se politika monetare duhet t vijoj t mbetet n kahun lehtsues prgjat gjith horizontit afatmesm. Stimuli monetar do t ndihmoj n ruajtjen e likuiditetit t bollshm dhe kostove t ulta t financimit, duke nxitur zgjerimin e konsumit dhe t investimeve t sektorit privat. N kt mnyr, ky stimul do ti shrbej forcimit t qndrueshmris s rritjes ekonomike, rritjes s punsimit dhe t pagave, si dhe kthimit t qndrueshm t inflacionit n objektiv. Sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare sht i prshtatshm. N vijim, m lejoni t sqaroj m n detaje konkluzionet kryesore t Raportit Tremujor, pritjet tona pr t ardhmen, si dhe arsyet q motivuan vendimin e sotm t politiks monetare. *** Informacioni i ri i prftuar gjat tremujorit t fundit ka qen n kahun e siprm t pritjeve tona. Inflacioni mesatar i tremujorit t dyt u rrit n vlern 1.8%, duke korrektuar rnien e regjistruar n tremujorin e par. Kjo rritje pasqyroi kryesisht nj inflacion m t lart t karburanteve dhe t artikujve ushqimor, e sidomos atyre t paprpunuar, ndrkoh q inflacioni i artikujve t tjer t shports ishte i qndrueshm. N veanti, inflacioni baz  i cili prfaqson m mir balancn e faktorve q ndikojn ecurin e mimeve t artikujve t konsumit n afatin e mesm  ishte i qndrueshm. N trsi, ecuria e inflacionit gjat tremujorve t fundit ka qen subjekt i luhatjeve t shpeshta e t papritura t faktorve t oferts, t cilat kan shfaqur dhe pritet t ken nj ndikim kalimtar. Nga ana tjetr, faktort me ndikim afatmesm n inflacion: rritja e pagave dhe e kostove t prodhimit, ecuria e mimeve n vendet partnere dhe pritjet pr inflacionin, shfaqen t qndrueshme, por jan ende t pamjaftueshme pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv. Prditsimi i analizs dhe parashikimeve tona sugjeron se kta faktor do t fuqizohen gjat tremujorve n vijim, duke mbshtetur kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv brenda vitit 2022. Sipas t dhnave t INSTAT-it, ekonomia shqiptare u rrit me 5.5% gjat tremujorit t par, duke tejkaluar pritjet tona. Kjo rritje pasqyroi zgjerimin e njkohshm t konsumit dhe investimeve t sektorit privat e publik, si dhe rritjen e eksporteve t mallrave. Njkohsisht, ajo prfitoi nga nj efekt baz m i lart  si pasoj e rishikimit pr posht nga INSTAT-i t rritjes ekonomike t vitit 2020  si dhe nga faktor tranzitor, si rritja e shpejt e prodhimit t energjis elektrike. Informacioni i disponuar sugjeron nj prshpejtim t fort t aktivitetit ekonomik n tremujorin e dyt, ndonse me nj norm e cila nuk do t jet indikative pr ritmin e rritjes s mtejshme t ekonomis shqiptare. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_4_gusht_2021_29647.html Pagina 2 di 4 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 4 gusht 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 Pavarsisht ktij prmirsimi, tregu i puns ka shfaqur nj ecuri t plogsht n tremujorin e par. Niveli i punsimit vijon t mbetet posht atij t regjistruar prpara pandemis, norma e papunsis u rrit n 11.9%, ndrsa presionet e tregut pr rritjen e pagave jan ende t zbehta. Bazuar n ecurin historike, Banka e Shqipris gjykon se rritja e qndrueshme e punsimit dhe e pagave do t ndjek me vones kohore zgjerimin e krkess pr mallra e shrbime. N planin makroekonomik, prshpejtimi i rritjes ekonomike ka pasqyruar reduktimin e kufizimeve, si pasoj e prmirsimit t situats epidemiologjike dhe zgjerimit t vaksinimit, rritjen e besimit t biznesit dhe konsumatorit, prmirsimin e ambientit t huaj, si dhe politikat stimuluese fiskale dhe monetare. Politika fiskale ka vijuar t ruaj nj karakter ekspansionist gjat gjysms s par t vitit. Deficiti buxhetor i ksaj periudhe qndroi rreth nivelit 3.4% t PBB-s, duke gjeneruar nj impuls pozitiv fiskal. Kjo ecuri pasqyroi rritjen me t shpejt t shpenzimeve n raport me t ardhurat, ndonse kto t fundit regjistruan nj rritje vjetore prej rreth 37% n tremujorin e dyt. Banka e Shqipris e ka konsideruar t domosdoshme natyrn stimuluese t politiks fiskale gjat pikut t pandemis. Nga ana tjetr, me prfundimin e emergjencs shndetsore dhe ekonomike, ne presim nj rikthim t vmendjes s qeveris drejt konsolidimit t financave publike. Projeksionet tona pr t ardhmen faktorizojn nj reduktim progresiv t stimulit fiskal gjat gjysms s dyt t vitit dhe periudhs n vijim. Nga ana e saj, politika monetare stimuluese e Banks s Shqipris ka vijuar t gjeneroj nj ambient financiar t qet, t karakterizuar nga: qarkullimi normal i fondeve n tregje; kosto t ulta kreditimi; dhe kurs i qndrueshm kmbimi. Kredia pr sektorin privat shnoi nj rritje mesatare prej 7.7% gjat tremujorit t dyt, duke vijuar t pasqyroj nj rritje relativisht t shpejt e t qndrueshme t kredis n Lek, t kredis pr qllime investimi dhe t asaj pr blerje banese. Rritja e raportuar e krkess pr kredi n tremujorin e tret dhe lehtsimi i kushteve t kreditimit premtojn nj mbshtetje t vazhduar me fonde t nevojave pr konsum dhe investime. N kt kontekst, nj rol t rndsishm kan luajtur dhe bilancet n prmirsim t bizneseve shqiptare, t cilat jan pasqyruar n rnien n nivelin 7.1% t raportit t kredive me probleme n muajin qershor. Prditsimi i parashikimeve n kt raport tremujor sugjeron nj ecuri pozitive t ekonomis n horizontin afatmesm, duke ripar pr lart projeksionin e ritmit t rritjes ekonomike gjat vitit aktual. Rritja ekonomike do t mbshtetet nga zgjerimi i konsumit dhe investimeve private, si dhe rritja e eksportit t mallrave dhe shrbimeve. Kjo ecuri do t pasqyroj prmirsimin e besimit t biznesit dhe konsumatorit, normalizimin gradual t aktivitetit ekonomik n vendet partnere, si dhe ambientin e favorshm financiar n vend. M tej, rritja e krkess agregate do t ndihmoj rritjen e punsimit dhe t pagave, duke krijuar premisa pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv brenda vitit 2022. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_4_gusht_2021_29647.html Pagina 3 di 4 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 4 gusht 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 Kto parashikime jan ndrtuar mbi supozimin e: shmangies s kufizimeve t forta mbi aktivitetin ekonomik si pasoj e pandemis; si dhe t reduktimit t ngadalt, por progresiv, t stimulit fiskal n horizontin afatmesm. *** Duke gjykuar mbi sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris vlersoi se stimuli monetar ka pasur nj transmetim efektiv n tregjet financiare. Gjithashtu, ai vlersoi se ky stimul duhet t vijoj t jet i pranishm n ekonomi edhe gjat afatit t mesm, duke synuar mbshtetjen e ekonomis me kredi t bollshme e me kosto t ult, si dhe duke kompensuar reduktimin e pritur t stimulit fiskal. Pr kt arsye, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi: t ler t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 0.5%; t ler t pandryshuar normat e interesit t depozitave dhe t kredive njditore, respektivisht n nivelin 0.1% dhe 0.9%. Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjykon se rikuperimi ekonomik dhe kthimi i inflacionit n objektiv krkojn ruajtjen e kahut stimulues t politiks monetare prgjat horizontit t parashikimit. Megjithat, materializimi i skenarit baz do t krkoj dhe nj normalizim gradual t politiks monetare, drejt niveleve m t qndrueshme t normave t interesit. N do rast, ky normalizim do t jet transparent dhe i kujdesshm, duke mos cenuar qndrueshmrin e rimkmbjes ekonomike dhe duke mos dmtuar premisat e kthimit t inflacionit n objektiv. Nga ana tjetr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs konstatoi se rreziqet e kahut t poshtm jan reduktuar, ndonse situata epidemiologjike vazhdon t mbetet burim goditjesh potenciale dhe ndikimi afatgjat i pandemis n ekonomi - ndonse pr momentin duket minimal - mbetet ende pr tu vlersuar. S fundi, Kshilli Mbikqyrs thekson se normalizimi gradual i situats ekonomike dhe forcimi i qndrueshmris s rimkmbjes duhet t risjellin n fokus t vendimmarrsve nevojn e prshpejtimit t agjends s reformave strukturore. Kto reforma duhet t synojn rritjen e konkurrueshmris, prmirsimin e mtejshm t klims s investimeve dhe t biznesit, si dhe forcimin afatgjat t qndrueshmris s financave publike.
