Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, October 6, 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, October 6, 2021 Publication date: 04.10.2021 Honored media representatives, Today, on 6 October 2021, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Intermediate Monetary Policy Report. New information obtained in the analysis shows a rapid recovery in economic activity in the country, but also pressures for rising inflation in Albania and the world. On the one hand, reducing restrictions, improving household and business confidence and the positive effects of economic stimulus have brought broad-based growth in demand for goods and services. On the other hand, temporary demand and supply imbalances in international markets have brought additional blows on inflation, beyond those naturally dictated by economic recovery.  typ_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_6_tetor_2021_29986.html Page 1 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, October 6, 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 Updating our forecasts confirms projections for a further increase in the Albanian economy in the medium term, which will create premise for the sustainable return of inflation to the target during 2022. However, the materialization of these projections remains conditional on the performance of the pandemic, the sustainability of the recovery of the world economy, as well as by the impact of the current supply shocks. Rising prices in world markets will have its impact on inflation performance, at home and globally. This impact is expected to be fleeting, but it poses a risk factor for the level of inflation and  potentially  for the speed of economic recovery. Judging on the expected economic and monetary developments, as well as the balance of risks around them, the Supervisory Council appreciated the need to preserve monetary policy stimulus. Monetary stimulus has been achieved and will continue to serve the steady return of inflation to the target, as well as supporting economic growth. Next I'll meet you in more detail with the reasons for the decision-making. *** New information in recent months has confirmed trends expected by the Bank of Albania, although economic growth resulted faster and inflation levels resulted somewhat higher than them. Inflation marked values of 2.2% and 2.4% in july and August, coming in growth versus the first six months of the year. Rising inflation mostly reflected rising food and oil prices, while inflation of other basket items did not undergo significant changes. In the macroeconomic perspective, the rise in inflation reflected the blows coming from the foreign environment, as a result of rising prices in international markets. Prices of raw materials, food and energy products have seen a rapid increase in recent months. This increase has reflected both the recovery in global demand and the difficulties in restoring supply to the levels of  yp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_6_tetor_2021_29986.html Page 2 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, October 6, 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 pre-crisis. Current projections speak of a normalisation of the situation over the next year, suggesting that its impact on final consumer prices will be significant, but fleeting. However, the performance of energy and basic product prices remains at the attention of central banks worldwide. On the other hand, inflationary pressures generated by the internal economy are presented in growth, but still contained. This performance is dictated by an increase in employment and wages, which is still insufficient for returning inflation to the target. According to INSTAT data, economic growth marked the 17.9% level in the second quarter of the year. This performance suggests that the Albanian economy has almost entirely recovered losses in economic activity caused by earthquake and pandemic. Analysis of available data shows that second-quarter growth reflects not only the strong underlying effect of the strong economic downturn during the second quarter of last year, but also the breadth and strength of factors that fuelled growth in the first half of the year. Likewise, analysis of indirect data suggests rapid growth rates even during the third quarter. The increase in economic activity appears broadly based. In terms of aggregate demand, it reflected the expansion of consumption and private investment, increased budgetary spending, as well as the expansion of the export of goods and services. In sectoral terms, it reflected the simultaneous expansion of building activity, industrial activity and services. Improved economic activity has begun to be reflected in the labour market, although its recovery remains partial. Employment rose 1.1% during the second quarter, while the unemployment rate dropped to 11.6%. Despite improving tendencies, employment continues to be lower and the unemployment rate higher than prepandemia levels. The return of the economy to full employment seems to require more time and continued support with macroeconomic incentives. Fiscal and monetary policies have provided adequate support for economic recovery. Fiscal stimulus remains in positive territory, but its intensity has come to a pale in recent months. This performance is conditioned by slowing the pace of public spending versus high income collection rates. For the following years, the Bank of Albania expects a return to the consolidating direction of fiscal policy orientation. This would serve both to increase the response spaces to potential future shocks and to properly sequence policy normalization. Monetary stimulus has provided a financial environment conducive to the growth of the economy and the return of inflation to the target. Financial markets operate normally, public and private sector financing costs are low, and bank sector balances are presented healthy. Likewise, Leku's exchange rate has shown a slight oversupply during the summer months, in line with its seasonal behaviour. The Bank of Albania estimates that financing conditions remain appropriate for boosting aggregate demand, and reflect a good transmission of our monetary stimulus.  yp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_6_tetor_2021_29986.html Page 3 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, October 6, 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 Bank lending has been a stable source of financing for the economy, reflecting favourable financing conditions, rising demand and banks' positive approach to lending. The volume of credit for the private sector increased by an average of 8.4% in the months of July and August. The increase in credit has financed the expansion of investments of Albanian businesses and families, as well as covering their needs with liquidity. Furthermore, lending follows to preserve two positive traits. First, credit in Lek follows high growth rates, illustrating a good reflection of monetary stimulus and increasing the banking system's resistance to risks. Second, the troubled credit index fell below the 7.0% level in August, suggesting a satisfactory quality of this portfolio. The economic outlook remains generally positive. The Albanian economy is expected to mark a rapid growth over the current year and expand at stable pace over the following years. This performance is expected to be supported by the favourable foreign environment, by reducing uncertainty in the country, by a stimulus mix of monetary and fiscal policies, as well as by improving private sector balance sheets. These factors are expected to drive increased consumption, exports and investment. Expanding demand will help boost employment and wages and gradually return inflation towards the target within 2022. Risks around this forecast are balanced, although the economy's performance remains subject to possible negative shocks from pandemic performance, while inflation performance is at risk in the rising direction from price performance in world markets. The potential risks of the lower kah are: (i) the restoration of restrictions, as a result of the deterioration of the epidemiological situation; (ii) slower recovery of investment and consumption, as a result of a more careful approach of businesses and households; as well as, (iii) a faster tightening of monetary conditions in the Eurozone, as a result of the recent rise in inflation. The potential risks of upper kah are: (i) a faster increase in economic activity, as a result of a more softened fiscal consolidation; and (ii) faster or more stable price growth in global markets. In particular, the latest scenario is receiving increasing attention over recent weeks, illustrating strong oil, gas and energy price increases in world markets, as well as the impact they may have on tightening monetary policies. *** Judging on the above, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current monetary policy position remains appropriate. Consequently, he decided: leave the basic interest rate unchanged at 0.5%; left deposit and one-day interest rates unchanged, at levels 0.1% and 0.9%, respectively. Also, the Supervisory Council assessed the need to preserve the current form, at a fixed price and unlimited amounts, of liquidity injection scans in the banking sector even during the last quarter of 2021.  yp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_6_tetor_2021_29986.html Page 4 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, October 6, 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 The Supervisory Council estimated that materializing expectations of the basic scenario  which envisions the adoption of a consolidating fiscal policy kahu, the continuation of economic recovery and transitional impacts on inflation from supply shocks  would require the beginning of gradual normalization of monetary policy over the following quarters. This normalization would serve to respect our goal of price stability and sustainability of economic growth in the medium and long term. On the other hand, the Supervisory Council remains in monitoring the consequences that price growth will have on world markets. If this increase proves to be stronger or more stable in time, as well as in the event that its impact on domestic inflation is higher than current expectations, the Supervisory Council remains willing to review the monetary policy position, taking care that it is always in line with our inflation target.  yp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_6_tetor_2021_29986.html Page 5 of 5

Projeksionet aktuale flasin pr nj normalizim t situats gjat vitit t ardhshm, duke sugjeruar se ndikimi i saj n mimet finale t konsumit do t jet i ndjeshm, por kalimtar. Megjithat, ecuria e mimeve t produkteve energjetike dhe t lndve baz vijon t mbetet n vmendjen e bankave qendrore n t gjith botn. Nga ana tjetr, presionet inflacioniste t gjeneruara nga ekonomia e brendshme paraqiten n rritje, por ende t prmbajtura. Kjo ecuri diktohet nga nj rritje e punsimit dhe e pagave, e cila sht ende e pamjaftueshme pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv. Sipas t dhnave t INSTAT-it, rritja ekonomike shnoi nivelin 17.9% n tremujorin e dyt t vitit. Kjo ecuri sugjeron se ekonomia shqiptare ka rikuperuar thuajse trsisht humbjet n aktivitetin ekonomik t shkaktuara nga trmeti dhe pandemia. Analiza e t dhnave t disponuara tregon se rritja e tremujorit t dyt pasqyron jo vetm efektin e fort baz t rnies s fort ekonomike gjat tremujorit t dyt t vitit t shkuar, por edhe gjersin dhe forcn e faktorve q kan ushqyer rritjen n gjysmn e par t vitit. Po ashtu, analiza e t dhnave indirekte sugjeron pr norma t shpejta rritjeje edhe gjat tremujorit t tret. Rritja e aktivitetit ekonomik shfaqet me baz t gjer. N terma t krkess agregate, ajo pasqyroi zgjerimin e konsumit dhe t investimeve private, rritjen e shpenzimeve buxhetore, si dhe zgjerimin e eksportit t mallrave e shrbimeve. N terma sektorial, ajo pasqyroi zgjerimin e njkohshm t aktivitetit ndrtues, t aktivitetit industrial dhe t atij t shrbimeve. Prmirsimi i aktivitetit ekonomik ka filluar t pasqyrohet n tregun e puns, ndonse rikuperimi i tij mbetet i pjesshm. Punsimi u rrit me 1.1% gjat tremujorit t dyt, ndrsa shkalla e papunsis zbriti n nivelin 11.6%. Pavarsisht tendencave prmirsuese, punsimi vijon t jet m i ult dhe shkalla e papunsis m e lart se nivelet e parapandemis. Kthimi i ekonomis n punsim t plot duket se krkon m shum koh dhe mbshtetje t vazhduar me stimuj makroekonomik. Politikat fiskale dhe monetare kan siguruar mbshtetjen e duhur pr rimkmbjen ekonomike. Stimuli fiskal mbetet n territor pozitiv, por intensiteti i tij ka ardhur n zbehje gjat muajve t fundit. Kjo ecuri sht kushtzuar nga ngadalsimi i ritmit t kryerjes s shpenzimeve publike kundrejt normave t larta t mbledhjes s t ardhurave. Pr vitet n vijim, Banka e Shqipris pret nj kthim n kahun konsolidues t orientimit t politiks fiskale. Kjo do ti shrbente si rritjes s hapsirave t reagimit ndaj goditjeve potenciale n t ardhme, ashtu dhe sekuencimit t duhur t normalizimit t politikave. Stimuli monetar ka siguruar nj mjedis financiar t favorshm pr rritjen e ekonomis dhe kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv. Tregjet financiare funksionojn normalisht, kostot e financimit t sektorit publik dhe privat jan t ulta, dhe bilancet e sektorit bankar paraqiten t shndetshme. Po ashtu, kursi i kmbimit t Lekut ka shfaqur nj mbimim t leht gjat muajve t vers, n prputhje me sjelljen e vet sezonale. Banka e Shqipris vlerson se kushtet e financimit mbeten t prshtatshme pr nxitjen e krkess agregate, dhe pasqyrojn nj transmetim t mir t stimulit ton monetar. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_6_tetor_2021_29986.html Pagina 3 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 6 tetor 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 Kredia bankare ka vijuar t jet nj burim i qndrueshm financimi pr ekonomin, duke pasqyruar kushtet e favorshme t financimit, rritjen e krkess dhe prqasjen pozitive t bankave ndaj kreditimit. Vllimi i kredis pr sektorin privat u rrit mesatarisht me 8.4% n muajt korrik e gusht. Rritja e kredis ka financuar zgjerimin e investimeve t bizneseve dhe t familjeve shqiptare, si dhe mbulimin e nevojave t tyre me likuiditet. Pr m tepr, kreditimi vijon t ruaj dy tipare pozitive. S pari, kredia n Lek vijon t shfaq ritme t larta rritjeje, duke ilustruar nj prcjellje t mir t stimulit monetar dhe duke rritur rezistencn e sistemit bankar ndaj rreziqeve. S dyti, treguesi i kredis me probleme ra posht nivelit 7.0% n muajin gusht, duke sugjeruar nj cilsi t knaqshme t ktij portofoli. Perspektiva ekonomike mbetet prgjithsisht pozitive. Ekonomia shqiptare pritet t shnoj nj rritje t shpejt gjat vitit aktual dhe t zgjerohet me ritme t qndrueshme gjat viteve n vijim. Kjo ecuri pritet t mbshtetet nga ambienti i favorshm i huaj, nga reduktimi i pasiguris n vend, nga nj miks stimulues politikash monetare dhe fiskale, si dhe nga prmirsimi i bilanceve t sektorit privat. Kta faktor pritet t nxitin rritjen e konsumit, t eksporteve dhe t investimeve. Zgjerimi i krkess do t ndihmoj rritjen e punsimit dhe t pagave dhe n nj kthim gradual t inflacionit drejt objektivit, brenda vitit 2022. Rreziqet rreth ktij parashikimi jan t balancuara, ndonse ecuria e ekonomis mbetet subjekt i goditjeve t mundshme negative nga ecuria e pandemis, ndrsa ecuria e inflacionit rrezikohet n kahun rrits nga ecuria e mimeve n tregjet botrore. Rreziqe potenciale t kahut t poshtm jan: (i) rivendosja e kufizimeve, si pasoj e prkeqsimit t situats epidemiologjike; (ii) rimkmbja m e ngadalt e investimeve dhe konsumit, si pasoj e nj prqasjeje m t kujdesshme t bizneseve dhe familjeve; si dhe, (iii) nj shtrngim m i shpejt i kushteve monetare n Eurozon, si pasoj e rritjes s fundit t inflacionit. Rreziqe potenciale t kahut t siprm jan: (i) nj rritje m e shpejt e aktivitetit ekonomik, si pasoj e nj konsolidimi m t zbutur fiskal; dhe (ii) nj rritje m e shpejt apo m e qndrueshme n koh e mimeve n tregjet botrore. N veanti, skenari i fundit po merr nj vmendje n rritje gjat javve t fundit, n ilustrim t rritjeve t forta t mimeve t nafts, t gazit dhe t energjis n tregjet botrore, si dhe ndikimit q ato mund t ken n shtrngimin e politikave monetare. *** Duke gjykuar mbi sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare mbetet i prshtatshm. Rrjedhimisht, ai vendosi: t ler t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 0.5%; t ler t pandryshuar normat e interesit t depozitave dhe kredive njditore, respektivisht n nivelet 0.1% dhe 0.9%. Gjithashtu, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi t nevojshme ruajtjen e forms aktuale, me mim fiks dhe sasi t pakufizuar, t ankandeve t injektimit t likuiditetit n sektorin bankar edhe gjat tremujorit t fundit t vitit 2021. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_6_tetor_2021_29986.html Pagina 4 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 6 tetor 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se materializimi i pritjeve t skenarit baz  i cili parashikon adoptimin e nj kahu konsolidues t politiks fiskale, vijimin e rimkmbjes ekonomike dhe ndikime kalimtare n inflacion nga goditjet e oferts  do t krkonte fillimin e normalizimit gradual t politiks monetare gjat tremujorve n vijim. Ky normalizim do ti shrbente respektimit t objektivit ton t stabilitetit t mimeve dhe qndrueshmris s rritjes ekonomike n afatin e mesm dhe t gjat. Nga ana tjetr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs mbetet n monitorim t pasojave q do t ket rritja e mimeve n tregjet botrore. N rast se kjo rritje provohet t jet m e fort apo m e qndrueshme n koh, si dhe n rast se ndikimi i saj n inflacionin vendas sht m i lart se pritjet aktuale, Kshilli Mbikqyrs mbetet i gatshm t rishikoj qndrimin e politiks monetare, duke u kujdesur q ajo t jet gjithnj n prputhje me objektivin ton t inflacionit. Muz and Eduk " Head / Press / Speeches, interviews, articles / Speeches Press releases Notices of # meetings of Council Supervisor Press conference Speeches, interview articles Speeches Interview of articles Calendars # Official holiday calendar for 2022 COVID-19 Europe # BANK OF ALBANIA Question answers of the press conference dated October 6, 2021 Publication date: 06.10.2021 Q: Mr Governor you saw concerns coming from international markets about rising prices and so on, but today we also had a publication by BB of an increase in the economy for Albania to 7.2%. What are the expectations of the Bank of Albania and do we have changes to the forecasts from the last conference you have made and why is this all BB optimism for such a big increase in the economy when we are already forecasting an energy crisis that has its consequences if it is going to be a crisis? Governor: In fact, this also coincides with the Bank of Albania's forecast for this year's economic growth. I am once again repeating that we had a strong increase in the second quarter of the year, which resulted in a 17.9% level as a result of two factors. First, a strong impact according to last year's second-quarter comparative basis, which was closed quarterly for all sectors of the economy, where the decline was at 11.3%. But despite avoiding the impact of this factor on second-quarter economic growth, again monetary policy analysis and all indicators indicate economic growth at the 4.5%-6% level. Second, we have a broad-based economic growth in the second quarter, which has been influenced by the growth of the industry, construction and service sectors. Only the agriculture sector has been the sector which has had a slight decline and this is understandable as this sector continued to be effective last year as a result of meeting the needs of the population for food. The Bank of Albania has forecast economic growth and in the following 2 quarters. This year's economic growth will follow according to our forecast at levels 7%-8%. So the World Bank's forecast at the 7.2% level coincides or is in line with forecasts made by the Bank of Albania. This year we will have a good economic growth, despite the forecasts we have of the impact that rising energy prices can have.  yetje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_6_tetor_2021.html Page 1 of 3 Question answers of the press conference dated October 6, 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 The economy is continuing to grow, consumption has increased and all factors and indicators show and promote expectations for economic growth as highlighted in our monetary policy statement. Economic growth years later will be lower as the comparative base will not be the same as with 2020, but the economy is expected to return to potential. Even the energy price increase crisis will be temporary, so it is expected to have a passing impact. Q: When can we have a deadline for stabilization between market supply and consumer demand to have and price stabilization? Governor: We also pointed out in the monetary policy statement that rising prices result from inflation imported from international markets, especially energy product prices. The price of oil, gas and energy has increased, especially in the Eurozone by nearly 480% compared to last year, while in America it has been lower as resources are higher than demand. So supply in the United States is higher than demand, while in Europe there is a higher demand for energy products and this has brought price increases. However, at the moment we have not seen rising prices, this is simply expectation and the expectation is for the last 3 months of this year and the first 3 months of next year, since we have the winter ahead and the need for energy will be higher. However, this is to see how the markets will react. On the other hand, there is a discrepancy between demand and supply after the pandemic because demand rose immediately and production capacities failed to respond and of course the price is coming up. Q: What would be the instruments that the Bank of Albania would undertake for the inflation part, we have no worrying levels but rising prices make us have something like this? When is supply compliance expected to occur in the market with consumer demand, which would also bring price stabilisation, as well as if inflation exceeds normal levels, what would be the instruments with which it would be interfered with? Governor: The Bank of Albania will monitor the situation and see how this will be reflected in inflation. If domestic inflation and not imported inflation will start to rise faster than forecast then of course we will react with our monetary policy instrument. So we're going to move on to austerity monetary policy which means raising the interest rate. Anyway, it's early to say that. The Bank of Albania even without this price increase predicted that the economy would return to balance and close the negative production gap during 2022, so in any case we had predicted the normalization of monetary policy during 2022, by the middle perhaps of 2022, always depending on the level of inflation. If the numbers change, if we have a very high and stable inflation the first thing we do will change the direction of monetary policy, then we will look at the other elements we can use within the legal framework that we have as the central bank. All actions are intertwined, monetary policy is intertwined with the fiscal policy of the Albanian government. The Bank of Albania has been in close coordination with the Ministry of Finance and Economy for harmonisation of monetary policies and fiscal policies and yes  yetje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_6_tetor_2021.html Page 2 of 3 Question answers of the press conference dated October 6, 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 We continue during this period. We are working and with the IMF mission intensively, all policies are being coordinated to cope with all the effects that may have the blows from rising prices, and more broadly, on the economy. Today there was also a conference of Deputy Prime Minister Ahmetaj, who stressed that the Albanian government is preparing and will announce its packages to compensate if there will be price increases because we are still not seeing strong transmission of price increases. So the Bank of Albania will react on the monetary policy side, while the Albanian government will react with its fiscal policies which will be announced. However, it is good to see that we are transparent with the public, to sensitize public opinion and to know if we will face a danger. But the danger hasn't come yet. If it comes, we will harmonize policies to meet this risk. Right now we're here.  yetje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_6_tetor_2021.html Page 3 of 3

Guvernator ju i pat shqetsimet q vinin nga tregjet ndrkombtare pr rritjen e mimeve e kshtu me radh, por sot kemi patur dhe nj publikim nga BB pr nj rritje t ekonomis pr Shqiprin n 7.2%. Cilat jan pritshmrit e Banks s Shqipris dhe a kemi ndryshime t parashikimeve nga konferenca e fundit q ju keni br dhe pse ky gjith optimizm i BB pr nj rritje kaq t madhe t ekonomis kur tashm jemi parashikuar pr nj kriz energjie e cila ka pasojat e veta nse do t jet nj kriz e mirfillt? Guvernatori: N fakt kjo prkon edhe me parashikimin e Banks s Shqipris pr rritjen ekonomike t ktij viti. Edhe njher po e prsris q ne patm nj rritje t fort n tremujorin e dyt t vitit, e cila rezultoi n nivelin 17.9% si pasoj e dy faktorve. S pari, nj ndikim i fort sipas bazs krahasuese t tremujorit t dyt t vitit t kaluar, q ishte tremujor i mbyllur pr t gjith sektort e ekonomis, ku rnia ishte n nivelin 11.3%. Por pavarsisht, duke shmangur ndikimin e ktij faktori n rritjen ekonomike t tremujorit t dyt, prsri analiza e politiks monetare dhe e gjith treguesve tregon pr nj rritje ekonomike n nivelin 4.5%- 6%. S dyti, kemi nj rritje ekonomike me baz t gjer n tremujorin e dyt, e cila sht ndikuar nga rritja e sektorve t industris, t ndrtimit dhe t shrbimeve. Vetm sektori i bujqsis ka qen sektori i cili ka pasur nj rnie t leht dhe kjo sht e kuptueshme pasi ky sektor ka vazhduar t jet eficient vitin e kaluar si pasoj e plotsimit t nevojave t popullats pr ushqim. Banka e Shqipris ka parashikuar q t ket nj rritje ekonomike dhe n 2 tremujort n vijim. Rritja ekonomike e ktij viti do t vijoj sipas parashikimit ton n nivelet 7%-8%. Pra, parashikimi i Banks Botrore n nivelin 7.2% prkon ose sht n prputhje me parashikimet q ka br dhe Banka e Shqipris. Kt vit do t kemi nj rritje t mir ekonomike, pavarsisht parashikimeve q kemi pr ndikimin q mund t ket rritja e mimit t energjis. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalyetje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_6_tetor_2021.html Pagina 1 di 3 Pyetje prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp t dats 6 tetor 2021 29/07/22, 13:31 Ekonomia po vazhdon t rritet, konsumi sht rritur dhe t gjith faktort dhe indikatort tregojn dhe nxisin pritshmrit pr rritje ekonomike sikurse u theksua dhe n deklaratn ton t politiks monetare. Rritja ekonomike e viteve m pas do t jet m e ult pasi baza krahasuese nuk do t jet njlloj si me vitin 2020, por ekonomia pritet t kthehet n potencial. Edhe kriza e rritjes s mimit t energjis do t jet e prkohshme, pra pritet t ket nj ndikim kalimtar. Pyetje: Kur mund t kemi nj afat pr stabilizimin mes oferts n treg dhe krkess nga konsumatori q t kemi dhe stabilizim t mimeve? Guvernatori: E theksuam edhe n deklaratn e politiks monetare q rritja e mimeve vjen si pasoj e inflacionit t importuar nga tregjet ndrkombtare, veanrisht mimet e produkteve energjitike. sht rritur mimi i nafts, gazit dhe energjis, veanrisht n Eurozon me gati 480% krahasuar me vitin e kaluar, kurse n Amerik ka qen m e ult pasi burimet jan m t larta sesa krkesa. Pra oferta n Shtetet e Bashkuara sht m e lart sesa krkesa, ndrkoh q n Evrop ka nj krkes m t lart pr produktet energjitike dhe kjo ka sjell rritje t mimit. Gjithsesi, pr momentin ne nuk kemi par t kemi rritje t mimeve, kjo sht thjesht pritshmri dhe pritshmria sht pr 3-mujorin e fundit t ktij viti dhe 3-mujorin e par t vitit t ardhshm, duke qen se kemi dimrin prpara dhe nevoja pr energji do t jet m e lart. Gjithsesi kjo sht pr tu par sesi do t reagojn tregjet. Nga ana tjetr, ka nj mosprputhje midis krkess dhe oferts pas pandemis sepse krkesa u rrit menjher dhe kapacitetet prodhuese nuk arritn ti prgjigjeshin dhe natyrisht q mimi vjen duke u rritur. Pyetje: Cilat do t ishin instrumentet q Banka e Shqipris do t ndrmerrte pr pjesn e inflacionit, nuk kemi nivele shqetsuese por rritja e mimeve bn t kemi dika t till? Kur pritet t ndodh prputhja e oferts n treg me krkesn e konsumatorit e cila do t sillte edhe stabilizim t mimeve si dhe n rast se inflacioni kaprcen nivelet normale, cilat do ishin instrumentet me t cilat do t ndrhyhej? Guvernatori: Banka e Shqipris do t monitoroj situatn dhe do t shoh sesi do t reflektohet kjo n inflacion. Nse inflacioni i brendshm dhe jo inflacioni importuar do t filloj t rritet m shpejt sesa parashikimi ather natyrisht q ne do t reagojm me instrumentin ton t politiks monetare. Pra do t kalojm n politikn monetare shtrnguese q do t thot rritje e norms s interesit. Gjithsesi sht hert pr ta thn kt. Banka e Shqipris edhe pa kt rritje mimesh parashikonte q ekonomia do t kthehej n ekuilibr dhe do t mbyllej hendeku negative i prodhimit gjat vitit 2022, pra n do rast ne kishim parashikuar normalizimin e politiks monetare gjat vitit 2022, nga mesi ndoshta i vitit 2022, gjithmon n varsi t nivelit t inflacionit. Nse shifrat do t ndryshojn, nse do t kemi nj inflacion shum t lart dhe t qndrueshm gjja e par q do t bjm do t ndryshojm kahun e politiks monetare, pastaj do t shikojm dhe elementt e tjer q mund t prdorim brenda kuadrit ligjor q ne kemi si bank qendrore. T gjitha veprimet jan t ndrthurura, politika monetare sht e ndrthurur me politikn fiskale t qeveris shqiptare. Ne jemi duke punuar dhe me misionin e FMN n mnyr intensive, po koordinohen t gjith politikat pr t prballuar t gjith efektet q mund t ken goditjet nga rritja e mimeve, dhe m gjer, n ekonomi. Sot pati dhe nj konferenc t Zvendskryeministrit Ahmetaj, i cili theksoi q qeveria shqiptare po prgatitet dhe do t anonoj paketat e saj pr t kompensuar nse do t ket rritje mimesh sepse akoma ne nuk po shikojm transmetim t fort t rritjes s mimeve. Pra Banka e Shqipris nga ana e saj do t reagoj n kahun e politiks monetare, ndrkoh q qeveria shqiptare do t reagoj me politikat e saj fiskale t cilat do t anonohen. Gjithsesi sht pr tu par, sht mir q ne t jemi transparent me publikun, t sensibilizojm opinionin publik dhe ta dim nse do t prballemi me nj rrezik. Por rreziku akoma nuk ka ardhur. In the lecture, Governor Seyko focused the presentation on three main issues. Initially he stopped at the experience of the countries of the Southeast European region in facing the three most recent crises, such as: the global financial crisis, 2008-2009; European sovereign debt crisis, 20102012; and the current crisis of the COVID-19 pandemic. Stopping longer in the COVID-19 crisis, the Governor said that in March 2020, just like the whole world, Albania faced an unusual situation, a health crisis caused by COVID-19, which forced governments to take extreme measures and suspend a range of activities.  2/5 05/08/22, 17:18 The Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Seyko, holds an online public lecture organised by the School of Economics and ... In this difficult situation, in parallel with the health crisis, institutions had to manage the economic situation, which was directly affected by this crisis. In this framework, an importance special measures were taken by the main institutions in the country, in co-ordinate with each other. All institutions coordinated joint efforts to help economic agents cope with difficult conditions and create opportunities for recovery as quickly as possible. As one of the main institutions in the country, the Bank of Albania took the necessary measures in time to support the Pandemic-hit Albanian economy. These measures helped mitigate the negative effects on the well-being of businesses and individuals, as well as the creation of premise for a faster recovery of the post-pandemic economy. The governor stressed that the Bank of Albania, constantly monitoring the situation, used a range of operational instruments and available regulatory space to minimize the consequences of pandemics in the Albanian economy and financial system in particular.  3/5 05/08/22, 17:18 The Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Seyko, holds an online public lecture organised by the School of Economics and ... The measures taken have yielded their result, guaranteeing the preservation of the country's monetary and financial stability, and easing crisis costs for Albanian businesses and families. Furthermore, Governor Sejko stressed that an important role in successfully coping with this situation played a series of reforms undertaken by Albanian authorities with direct impact in maintaining financial stability, but also continuous timely coordination with international institutions. Finally, the Governor said that with the crisis created by the pandemic, the attention of institutions has focused towards new challenges presented in the economic panorama such as facing the recent global price shock, normalizing various policies and assessing possible structural impacts on the economy. Furthermore, the Governor's presentation was followed by discussions by professors of the London School of Economics and Political Sciences (LSE), Mr Ricardo Reis, Zj. Piroska Nagy-Mohacsi, and Mr. Vassilis Monastiriotis, who took the word by assessing very positively the management of this crisis from our country. Title: Speech at the joint press conference with the Head of the IMF Mission and the Minister of Finance and Economy
text: , Mr. Gent Seyko, in the cone... IMF Mission Hefen and Minister of Finance and Economy 29/07/22, 13:30 , Mr Gent Seyko, at the joint press conference with the Chief of Mission of IMF and Minister of Finance and Economy Publication date: 12.10.2021 Honored media representatives, If you are aware, over the past two weeks, the Bank of Albania and albanian authorities have been engaged in intensive discussions with the IMF mission, carried out within the framework of Article IV. These discussions have focused on them both the current challenges facing the Albanian economy on its path to recovery and structural reforms, which would enable a faster and more sustainable development of the country in the long-term. I gladly state that the Bank of Albania and the Mission share similar views on current economic and financial developments, on the expected direction of these developments in the future, as well as on the position that fiscal policies should maintain,  e_Misionit_te_FMN-se_dhe_Ministren_e_Financave_dhe_Ekonomise.html Page 1 of 4 , Mr. Gent Seyko, in the cone... IMF Mission Hefen and Minister of Finance and Economy 29/07/22, 13:30 monetary and macroprudential, to the challenges we have ahead. Next, let me briefly present the Bank of Albania's vision on the topics I touched on above. The available data, obtained during the first nine months of the year, suggest that the Albanian economy is in a recovery phase. This recovery has resulted in faster than our projections and is supported by a wide range of factors. Reducing restrictions as a result of the vaccination process, improving business and Albanian household confidence, increasing foreign demand, as well as monetary and fiscal stimulus, have supported rapid recovery of consumption, investment and exports. In this performance, an essential role had coordinated fiscal and monetary stimulus, as well as temporary and targeted easing of banking sector operating regulations. These measures reduced the financial burden of hitting Albanian businesses and families. In this way, they breathed into businesses in their fight for survival, curbed the significant rise in unemployment, as well as created premise for a rapid and stable recovery of the economy with the end of the pandemic. On the same line, the structural reforms we have undertaken over the past few years for increasing the sustainability and efficiency of the financial system have yielded their fruits. Among other things, these reforms targeted and achieved greater use of the national currency in financial transactions, reduction of troubled loans, consolidation of the banking sector, as well as further improvements in regulation and supervision of the financial system in general, and the banking sector in particular. Their timely implementation enabled the banking sector to cope with a significant part of the financial crisis bill, as well as continue to feed the Albanian economy with low-cost loans. Expanding demand has helped recover domestic production, bringing it close to precipitation levels. However, this recovery is not yet complete in the labour market, where the level of employment is below the values recorded before the pandemic and where wage growth is still insufficient to turn inflation into a target.  e_Misionit_te_FMN-se_dhe_Ministren_e_Financave_dhe_Ekonomise.html Page 2 of 4 , Mr. Gent Seyko, in the cone... IMF Mission Hefen and Minister of Finance and Economy 29/07/22, 13:30 For this reason, inflation continues to remain below target, with all the volatiles showing over the last year. Recently, its performance has become subject to supply shocks, which have come from the increase in the price of food, energy products and other raw materials in the world market. According to information coming from our markets and analyses, the effect of these shocks is expected to be fleeting, but it represents an additional element of uncertainty. Looking to the future, our projections for the performance of the Albanian economy remain positive. In the absence of shocks, economic activity in the country is expected to increase over the following years. Although the pace of economic growth is expected to slow, it will be stable and sufficient to generate better exploitation of production capacities, increased employment and wages, as well as returning inflation to the target within 2022. This development scenario is surrounded by lower-kah risks in the short term. In particular, the possible worsening of the epidemiological situation or rising prices in world markets could bring negative effects on the performance of the world and Albanian economy. On the other hand, the balance of risks appears more symmetrical in the medium and long term. The Bank of Albania considers that materializing developments in the basic scenario will require a gradual normalization of economic stimulus. This normalization will enable a better balance between economic growth and the country's monetary and financial stability, as well as recreate the spaces needed to cope with other potential shocks in the future. At the same time, the Bank of Albania believes that the normalization process should be careful, conditional on the speed of recovery and sustainability of economic growth sources, as well as coordinated between the policies and instruments used. The Bank of Albania supports a progressive  but clear and stable  reduction in fiscal stimulus. Shifting the focus of fiscal policy towards consolidating and reducing public debt will help reduce risk premiums in financial markets. Also, fiscal consolidation will increase the spaces for dealing with shocks in the future. On the other hand, our estimates suggest that monetary policy should remain accommodative. The monetary stimulus will continue to provide the necessary support for economic recovery and facilitate the fiscal consolidation process. Current supply shocks are not expected to jeopardise price stability in the medium term and, as such, do not require monetary policy intervention. However, the Bank of Albania will remain attentive to assess the impact, duration and transmission of these blows to our economy. This will help us to continuously adapt our monetary policy stance to respecting our price stability target. Finally, I find it appropriate to stress that the Bank of Albania has completely normalized temporary macroprudence relief measures. Our attention in the future will be to carefully monitor the consequences of the pandemic on the balance sheets of the banking sector,  e_Misionit_te_FMN-se_dhe_Ministren_e_Financave_dhe_Ekonomise.html Page 3 of 4 , Mr. Gent Seyko, in the cone... IMF Mission Hefen and Minister of Finance and Economy 29/07/22, 13:30 identify potential problems and take timely correctional measures. Also, the Bank of Albania will continue to work towards approximating its supervisory and regulatory framework with European Union standards, as well as  in co-operation with other institutional actors  for further development of the financial system and for further improvement of the payment system. In closing, I would like to thank the IMF Mission for the fruitful talks, held in a constructive and transparent spirit, as well as to wish the new Minister of Finance and Economy success in her work. Thank you!  e_Misionit_te_FMN-se_dhe_Ministren_e_Financave_dhe_Ekonomise.html Page 4 of 4

Gent Sejko, n konferencn e prbashkt pr shtyp me Shefen e Misionit t FMN-s dhe Ministren e Financave dhe Ekonomis Data e publikimit: 12.10.2021 T nderuar prfaqsues t medias, Sikundr jeni n dijeni, gjat dy javve t fundit, Banka e Shqipris dhe autoritetet shqiptare kan qen t angazhuara n diskutime intensive me misionin e FMN-s, t kryera n kuadr t Artikullit IV. Kto diskutime kan pasur n fokus t tyre si sfidat aktuale me t cilat prballet ekonomia shqiptare n rrugn e saj drejt rimkmbjes, ashtu edhe reformat strukturore, t cilat do t mundsonin nj zhvillim m t shpejt dhe m t qndrueshm t vendit n planin afatgjat. Me knaqsi konstatoj se Banka e Shqipris dhe Misioni ndajn pikpamje t ngjashme mbi zhvillimet aktuale ekonomike dhe financiare, mbi kahun e pritur t ktyre zhvillimeve n t ardhmen, si dhe mbi qndrimin q duhet t mbajn politikat fiskale, https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fje_Misionit_te_FMN-se_dhe_Ministren_e_Financave_dhe_Ekonomise.html Pagina 1 di 4 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko, n konhefen e Misionit t FMN-s dhe Ministren e Financave dhe Ekonomis 29/07/22, 13:30 monetare dhe makroprudenciale, ndaj sfidave q kemi prpara. N vijim, m lejoni tju prezantoj shkurtimisht vizionin e Banks s Shqipris mbi temat q preka m sipr. T dhnat e disponuara, t prftuara gjat nnt muajve t par t vitit, sugjerojn se ekonomia shqiptare sht n nj faz rimkmbjeje. Kjo rimkmbje ka rezultuar m e shpejt se projeksionet tona dhe sht mbshtetur nga nj gam e gjer faktorsh. Reduktimi i kufizimeve si pasoj e procesit t vaksinimit, prmirsimi i besimit t biznesit dhe t familjeve shqiptare, rritja e krkess s huaj, si dhe stimuli monetar dhe fiskal, kan mbshtetur rikuperimin e shpejt t konsumit, t investimeve dhe t eksporteve. N kt ecuri, nj rol esencial pati stimuli i koordinuar fiskal dhe monetar, si dhe lehtsimi i prkohshm dhe i targetuar i rregulloreve t funksionimit t sektorit bankar. Kto masa reduktuan barrn financiare t goditjes mbi bizneset dhe familjet shqiptare. N kt mnyr, ato i dhan frymmarrje bizneseve n luftn e tyre pr mbijetes, frenuan rritjen e ndjeshme t papunsis, si dhe krijuan premisa pr nj rimkmbje t shpejt e t qndrueshme t ekonomis me prfundimin e pandemis. N t njjtn linj, reformat strukturore q kemi ndrmarr gjat viteve t fundit pr rritjen e qndrueshmris dhe t eficiencs s sistemit financiar, dhan frytet e tyre. Ndr t tjera, kto reforma synuan dhe arritn nj prdorim m t madh t monedhs kombtare n transaksionet financiare, reduktimin e kredive me probleme, konsolidimin e sektorit bankar, si dhe prmirsimin e mtejshm t rregullimit dhe mbikqyrjes s sistemit financiar n prgjithsi, dhe t sektorit bankar n veanti. Implementimi n koh i tyre, i mundsoi sektorit bankar t prballoj nj pjes t konsiderueshme t faturs financiare t krizs, si dhe t vazhdoj t ushqej me kredi me kosto t ult ekonomin shqiptare. Zgjerimi i krkess ka ndihmuar rikuperimin e prodhimit vendas, duke e sjell at pran niveleve t parakriss. Megjithat, ky rikuperim nuk sht ende i plot n tregun e puns, ku niveli i punsimit sht posht vlerave t regjistruara prpara pandemis dhe ku rritja e pagave sht ende e pamjaftueshme pr t kthyer inflacionin n objektiv. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fje_Misionit_te_FMN-se_dhe_Ministren_e_Financave_dhe_Ekonomise.html Pagina 2 di 4 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko, n konhefen e Misionit t FMN-s dhe Ministren e Financave dhe Ekonomis 29/07/22, 13:30 Pr kt arsye, inflacioni vijon t mbetet nn objektiv, me gjith volatilitetin e shfaqur gjat vitit t fundit. S fundmi, ecuria e tij sht br subjekt i goditjeve t oferts, t cilat kan ardhur nga rritja e mimit t ushqimeve, t produkteve energjetike dhe t lndve t tjera t para n tregun botror. Sipas informacionit q vjen nga tregjet dhe analizave tona, efekti i ktyre goditjeve pritet t jet kalimtar, por ai prbn nj element shtes pasigurie. Duke par nga e ardhmja, projeksionet tona pr ecurin e ekonomis shqiptare mbeten pozitive. N munges t goditjeve, aktiviteti ekonomik n vend pritet t vijoj t rritet gjat viteve n vijim. Ndonse ritmi i rritjes ekonomike pritet t vij n ngadalsim, ai do t jen i qndrueshm dhe i mjaftueshm pr t gjeneruar nj shfrytzim m t mir t kapaciteteve prodhuese, rritje t punsimit e t pagave, si dhe kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv brenda vitit 2022. Ky skenar zhvillimesh rrethohet nga rreziqe t kahut t poshtm n afatin e shkurtr. N veanti, prkeqsimi i mundshm i situats epidemiologjike apo rritja e mimeve n tregjet botrore mund t sjellin efekte negative n ecurin e ekonomis botrore dhe t asaj shqiptare. Nga ana tjetr, balanca e rreziqeve shfaqet m simetrike n afatin e mesm dhe t gjat. Banka e Shqipris gjykon se materializimi i zhvillimeve t skenarit baz do t krkoj nj normalizim gradual t stimulit ekonomik. Ky normalizim do t mundsoj nj balanc m t mir midis rritjes ekonomike dhe stabilitetit monetar e financiar t vendit, si dhe do t rikrijoj hapsirat e nevojshme pr prballimin e goditjeve t tjera potenciale n t ardhmen. N t njjtn koh, Banka e Shqipris vlerson se procesi i normalizimit duhet t jet i kujdesshm, i kushtzuar nga shpejtsia e rimkmbjes dhe qndrueshmria e burimeve t rritjes ekonomike, si dhe i koordinuar midis politikave dhe instrumenteve t prdorura. Banka e Shqipris mbshtet nj reduktim progresiv  por t qart dhe t qndrueshm  t stimulit fiskal. Zhvendosja e fokusit t politiks fiskale drejt konsolidimit dhe reduktimit t borxhit publik, do t ndihmoj n reduktimin e primeve t rrezikut n tregjet financiare. Gjithashtu, konsolidimi fiskal do t rris hapsirat pr prballimin e goditjeve n t ardhmen. Nga ana tjetr, vlersimet tona sugjerojn se politika monetare duhet t vijoj t mbetet akomoduese. Stimuli monetar do t vijoj t ofroj mbshtetjen e nevojshme pr rikuperimin e ekonomik dhe do t lehtsoj procesin e konsolidimit fiskal. Goditjet aktuale t oferts nuk pritet t rrezikojn stabilitetin e mimeve n afatin e mesm dhe, si t tilla, nuk krkojn ndrhyrje t politiks monetare. Megjithat, Banka e Shqipris do t mbetet e vmendshme pr t vlersuar ndikimin, kohzgjatjen dhe transmetimin e ktyre goditjeve n ekonomin ton. Kjo do t na ndihmoj t prshtatim n vazhdimsi qndrimin e politiks son monetare me respektimin e objektivit ton t stabilitetit t mimeve. S fundi, gjej me vend t theksoj se Banka e Shqipris ka normalizuar trsisht masat e prkohshme lehtsuese makroprudenciale. Vmendja jon n t ardhmen do t jet te monitorimi i kujdesshm i pasojave t pandemis n bilancet e sektorit bankar, https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fe_Misionit_te_FMN-se_dhe_Ministren_e_Financave_dhe_Ekonomise.html Pagina 3 di 4 Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko, n konhefen e Misionit t FMN-s dhe Ministren e Financave dhe Ekonomis 29/07/22, 13:30 identifikimi n avanc i problemeve potenciale dhe marrja n koh e masave korrektuese. Po ashtu, Banka e Shqipris do t vijoj t punoj pr prafrimin e kuadrit t saj mbikqyrs e rregullator me standardet e Bashkimit Evropian, si dhe  n bashkpunim me aktort e tjer institucional  pr zhvillimin e mtejshm t sistemit financiar dhe pr prmirsimin e mtejshm t sistemit t pagesave. N mbyllje, dshiroj t falnderoj Misionin e FMN-s pr bisedimet e frytshme, t zhvilluara n nj frym konstruktive dhe transparente, si dhe ti uroj Ministres s re t Financave dhe Ekonomis suksese n punn e saj. Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, November 3, 2021 29/07/22, 13:30 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, November 3, 2021 Publication date: 03.11.2021 Honourable media representatives, Today, on 3 November 2021, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Quarterly Monetary Policy Report. New information obtained in the analysis shows that the Albanian economy is recovering from earthquake and pandemic strikes. This performance is noted in increasing the volume of economic activity, expanding employment and increasing wages, improving private sector financial balances, as well as in steady growth in bank credit. ... er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_3_nentor_2021.html Page 1 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, November 3, 2021 29/07/22, 13:30 Also, new information shows rising inflation, both in the foreign and domestic environments. Rising inflation was mainly dictated by income shocks as a result of the disbalances between demand and supply in international markets. These imbalances are expected to be temporary and their effect on inflation is expected to be fleeting. On the other hand, although increasing, domestic pressures for rising employment, wages and inflation are still moderate. Predictions for the future remain positive. Our projections suggest that the Albanian economy will come to grow on the medium-term horizon, supported and by monetary stimulus, creating premise for the sustainable return of inflation to the target over the next year. As above, the Supervisory Council estimated that the current monetary policy position remains appropriate. [ Next, let me clarify in more detail the main conclusions of the Quarterly Report, our expectations for the future, as well as the reasons that motivated today's decision. ] The new information received in the analysis has been at the top of our expectations. Inflation came in higher during the third quarter, marking the average level of 2.4%. This performance reflected - to the greatest extent - supply shocks from rising food, energy, oil and transport costs prices in world markets. The effect of supply shocks on inflation is expected to be present and during the current quarter and first half of next year, and come to a halt during the ongoing period. This judgment is based on the consensus of analyses of international institutions and the expectations of markets. According to this consensus, oil, energy and food products prices are initially expected to stabilize and then reduce during 2022, which will reduce pressure on domestic production costs and consumer prices. ... er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_3_nentor_2021.html Page 2 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, November 3, 2021 29/07/22, 13:30 In contrast, internal inflationary pressures have shown a growing but gradual and still contained dynamic. This dynamic reflects the still insufficient expansion of employment, wages and production costs, as well as expectations for moderate inflation from businesses and financial markets. Economic activity in the country is recovering. According to INSTAT data, the Albanian economy grew by 17.9% in the second quarter of the year. The indirect information available signals a further expansion of it during the third quarter. The recovery of economic activity is supported by reducing restrictive measures, increasing confidence, improving foreign environment, as well as economic stimulus policies. This recovery has had a broad basis. In terms of aggregate demand, it reflected the increase in consumption and private investment, the expansion of exports of goods and services, as well as the positive - albeit declining - contribution of fiscal stimulus. In sectoral terms, it reflected the growth of almost all sectors of production and service branches, with the exception of agricultural ones. The expansion of demand for goods and services has enabled the return of economic activity to pre-earthquake and pandemic levels. This recovery, present at both the economy and sectoral level, suggests that the country's productive potential has remained relatively unaffected by the shocks and that their medium and long-term consequences in the economy will be relatively low. However, the economic recovery has had a partial reflection on the labour market so far. Although the unemployment rate dropped to a level of 11.6% in the second quarter, it still remains far from the levels recorded before the pandemic. Slower employment and wage recovery is a well-known phenomenon in the recovery process. However, it dictates contained pressures for rising inflation and requires the continuation of the monetary policy accommodative course. Monetary stimulus policy has been transmitted to low financing costs and adequate lending conditions. Financial markets appear calm and are characterized by normal trading volumes, controlled risk premiums and ... er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_3_nentor_2021.html Page 3 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, November 3, 2021 29/07/22, 13:30 from low interest rates. Likewise, the lek exchange rate appears stable, recording contained fluctuations, in line with the performance of seasonal factors. This financial environment has enabled a rapid and sustainable increase in credit for the private sector. The bank loan portfolio increased by 8.9% at the end of the third quarter, dictated by the expansion of credit into money, investment credit and housing purchases. Positive lending performance has reflected both the expansion of demand and improved supply. The latter has been influenced by the healthy balance sheets of the banking sector, where there is a reduction in the 6.5% level of the troubled loan ratio in September, as well as by the proactive approach to lending adopted by the banking sector. Fiscal policy has been able to preserve its expansionist nature during 2021, although the intensity of fiscal stimulus has come to a pale in recent months. The budget deficit was reduced to 2.7% of GDP during the third quarter, reflecting a faster revenue growth compared to spending, but it is expected to come into expansion during the fourth quarter. Fiscal stimulus is expected to come towards reduction over the following years. The Bank of Albania considers that strengthening recovery sustainability necessitates an increase in attention to fiscal consolidation. This consolidation increases the space for dealing with potential future shocks, reduces risk premiums in financial markets and empowers the country's macroeconomic stability. *** Our projections of the basic scenario remain positive. Under this scenario, the economy is projected to mark a rapid growth during 2021 and to grow at slower but stable rates in the following years. This increase will reflect improving private sector confidence and financial balances, increasing foreign demand, as well as the appropriate financial environment. Expanding demand for goods and services will bring increased employment, wages and profit margins in line with our inflation target. In this scenario, the effect of supply shocks is expected to be fleeting and inflation is expected to return to our target of 3% during 2022. Similarly, under this scenario, the mix of economic policies will remain balanced: the pace of fiscal consolidation is expected to come towards acceleration over the coming years, while monetary stimulus will continue to remain present, although its intensity will gradually come towards reduction. The balance of risks appears shifted upwards in the short term and balanced in the medium term. On the one hand, faster or longer price growth in international markets, as well as a slower pace of fiscal consolidation, pose upper-cap risks to inflation. On the other hand, a slower recovery of the world economy poses a risk of a lower cap on inflation. *** Judging on the above, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania estimated that ... er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_3_nentor_2021.html Page 4 of 5 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, November 3, 2021 29/07/22, 13:30 The current monetary policy position is appropriate for supporting the economy and returning inflation to the target within 2022. For this reason, the Supervisory Council decided: Leave the basic interest rate unchanged at 0.5%; Leave deposit and one-day loan interest rates unchanged, at levels 0.1% and 0.9%, respectively. The Supervisory Council estimated that materializing the basic scenario - that of further consolidating recovery and strengthening domestic inflationary pressures - would require gradual normalization of monetary policy over the following quarters. Likewise, improving the liquidity situation in the banking sector will enable the adoption of the traditional form of liquidity injection polling in the banking sector, starting in the first quarter of next year. The gradual reduction of monetary stimulus will ensure compliance with our inflation target and create premise for more stable economic growth in the medium and long term. Also, the Supervisory Council estimated that materializing risk scenarios would require a review of monetary policy stance, approaching monetary policy on time and speeding up the process of normalizing monetary policy, or pushing it on time and slowing it down. In any case, the Supervisory Council notes that this position will be entirely in line with respecting our inflation target in the medium term. ... er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_3_nentor_2021.html Page 5 of 5

Rritja e inflacionit u diktua kryesisht nga goditjet e ardhura si pasoj e disbalancave midis krkess dhe oferts n tregjet ndrkombtare. Kto disbalanca priten t jen t prkohshme dhe efekti i tyre n inflacion pritet t jet kalimtar. Nga ana tjetr, ndonse n rritje, presionet e brendshme pr rritjen e punsimit, t pagave dhe t inflacionit, jan ende t moderuara. Parashikimet pr t ardhmen mbeten pozitive. Projeksionet tona sugjerojn se ekonomia shqiptare do t vijoj t rritet n horizontin afatmesm, e mbshtetur dhe nga stimuli monetar, duke krijuar premisa pr kthimin e qndrueshm t inflacionit n objektiv gjat vitit t ardhshm. Sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare mbetet i prshtatshm. [ N vijim, m lejoni t sqaroj m n detaje konkluzionet kryesore t Raportit Tremujor, pritjet tona pr t ardhmen, si dhe arsyet q motivuan vendimin e sotm. ] Informacioni i ri i marr n analiz ka qen n kahun e siprm t pritjeve tona. Inflacioni erdhi n rritje gjat tremujorit t tret, duke shnuar nivelin mesatar prej 2.4%. Kjo ecuri pasqyroi  n masn m t madhe  goditjet e oferts t ardhura nga rritja e mimeve t ushqimeve, t energjis, t nafts dhe t kostove t transportit, n tregjet botrore. Efekti i goditjeve t oferts n inflacion pritet t jet i pranishm dhe gjat tremujorit aktual dhe gjysms s par t vitit t ardhshm, e t vij n shuarje gjat periudhs n vazhdim. Ky gjykim bazohet n konsensusin e analizave t institucioneve ndrkombtare dhe pritjet e tregjeve. Sipas ktij konsensusi, mimet e nafts, t energjis dhe t produkteve ushqimore, pritet fillimisht t stabilizohen e m pas t reduktohen gjat vitit 2022, ka do t zvogloj presionin mbi kostot e prodhimit n vend dhe mimet e konsumit. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjer_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_3_nentor_2021.html Pagina 2 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 3 nntor 2021 29/07/22, 13:30 Prkundrejt tyre, presionet e brendshme inflacioniste kan shfaqur nj dinamik rritse, por graduale dhe ende t prmbajtur. Kjo dinamik pasqyron zgjerimin ende t pamjaftueshm t punsimit, t pagave dhe t kostove t prodhimit, si dhe pritjet pr inflacion t moderuar nga bizneset dhe tregjet financiare. Aktiviteti ekonomik n vend po vijon t rimkmbet. Sipas t dhnave t INSTATit, ekonomia shqiptare u rrit me 17.9% n tremujorin e dyt t vitit. Informacioni indirekt i disponuar sinjalizon nj zgjerim t mtejshm t saj gjat tremujorit t tret. Rimkmbja e aktivitetit ekonomik sht mbshtetur nga reduktimi i masave kufizuese, rritja e besimit, prmirsimi i ambientit t huaj, si dhe politikat stimuluese ekonomike. Kjo rimkmbje ka pasur nj baz t gjer. N terma t krkess agregate, ajo pasqyroi rritjen e konsumit dhe t investimeve private, zgjerimin e eksporteve t mallrave e t shrbimeve, si dhe kontributin pozitiv  ndonse n rnie  t stimulit fiskal. N terma sektorial, ajo pasqyroi rritjen e thuajse t gjith sektorve e degve t prodhimit e t shrbimit, me prjashtim t atij bujqsor. Zgjerimi i krkess pr mallra e shrbime ka mundsuar rikthimin e aktivitetit ekonomik n nivelet e shnuara para trmetit dhe pandemis. Ky rikuperim, prezent si n nivel ekonomie ashtu dhe n nivel sektorial, sugjeron se potenciali prodhues i vendit ka mbetur relativisht i paprekur nga goditjet dhe se pasojat afatmesme dhe afatgjata t tyre n ekonomi do t jen relativisht t ulta. Megjithat, rimkmbja ekonomike ka pasur  deri m tani  nj pasqyrim t pjesshm n tregun e puns. Ndonse norma e papunsis zbriti n nivelin 11.6% n tremujorin e dyt, ajo mbetet ende larg niveleve t regjistruara prpara pandemis. Rikuperimi m i ngadalt i punsimit dhe pagave sht nj fenomen i njohur n procesin e rimkmbjes. Gjithsesi, ai dikton presione t prmbajtura pr rritjen e inflacionit dhe krkon vijimin e kursit akomodues t politiks monetare. Politika monetare stimuluese ka vijuar t transmetohet n kosto t ulta financimi dhe kushte t prshtatshme kreditimi. Tregjet financiare shfaqen t qeta dhe karakterizohen nga vllime normale tregtimi, nga prime t kontrolluara rreziku dhe https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjer_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_3_nentor_2021.html Pagina 3 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 3 nntor 2021 29/07/22, 13:30 nga norma t ulta interesi. Po ashtu, kursi i kmbimit t lekut shfaqet i qndrueshm, duke regjistruar luhatje t prmbajtura, n linj me ecurin e faktorve sezonal. Ky ambient financiar ka mundsuar nj rritje t shpejt dhe t qndrueshme t kredis pr sektorin privat. Portofoli i kredis bankare u rrit me 8.9% n fund t tremujorit t tret, i diktuar nga zgjerimi i kredis n lek, i kredis pr qllime investimi dhe i asaj pr blerje banese. Ecuria pozitive e kreditimit ka pasqyruar si zgjerimin e krkess ashtu dhe prmirsimin e oferts. Kjo e fundit sht ndikuar nga bilancet e shndetshme t sektorit bankar, ku spikat reduktimi n nivelin 6.5% i raportit t kredis me probleme n muajin shtator, si dhe nga qasja proaktive ndaj kreditimit e adoptuar nga sektori bankar. Politika fiskale ka vijuar t ruaj natyrn e saj ekspansioniste gjat vitit 2021, ndonse intensiteti i stimulit fiskal ka ardhur n zbehje gjat muajve t fundit. Deficiti buxhetor u reduktua n 2.7% t PBB-s gjat tremujorit t tret, duke pasqyruar nj rritje m t shpejt t t ardhurave n raport me shpenzimet, por ai pritet t vij n zgjerim gjat tremujorit t katrt. Stimuli fiskal pritet t vij drejt reduktimit gjat viteve n vijim. Banka e Shqipris gjykon se forcimi i qndrueshmris s rimkmbjes e bn t nevojshme nj rritje t vmendjes ndaj konsolidimit fiskal. Ky konsolidim rrit hapsirn pr prballimin e goditjeve potenciale n t ardhmen, redukton primet e rrezikut n tregjet financiare dhe fuqizon stabilitetin makroekonomik t vendit. *** Projeksionet tona t skenarit baz mbeten pozitive. Sipas ktij skenari, ekonomia parashikohet t shnoj nj rritje t shpejt gjat vitit 2021 dhe t vijoj t rritet me ritme m t ngadalta, por t qndrueshme, n vitet n vijim. Kjo rritje do t pasqyroj prmirsimin e besimit dhe t bilanceve financiare t sektorit privat, rritjen e krkess s huaj, si dhe ambientin e prshtatshm financiar. Zgjerimi i krkess pr mallra e shrbime do t sjell rritjen e punsimit, t pagave dhe t marzheve t fitimit, n linj me objektivin ton t inflacionit. N kt skenar, efekti i goditjeve t oferts pritet t jet kalimtar dhe inflacioni pritet t kthehet n objektivin ton prej 3% gjat vitit 2022. Po ashtu, sipas ktij skenari, miksi i politikave ekonomike do t mbetet i balancuar: ritmi i konsolidimit fiskal pritet t vij drejt prshpejtimit gjat viteve t ardhshme, ndrsa stimuli monetar do t vijoj t mbetet i pranishm, ndonse intensiteti i tij do t vij gradualisht drejt reduktimit. Balanca e rreziqeve shfaqet e zhvendosur pr lart n afatin e shkurtr dhe e balancuar n afatin e mesm. Nga njra an, nj rritje m e shpejt apo m e gjat n koh e mimeve n tregjet ndrkombtare, si dhe nj ritm m i ngadalt i konsolidimit fiskal, prbjn rreziqe t kahut t siprm mbi inflacionin. Nga ana tjetr, nj rimkmbje m e ngadalt e ekonomis botrore prbn rrezik t kahut t poshtm mbi inflacionin. *** Duke gjykuar mbi sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris vlersoi se https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjer_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_3_nentor_2021.html Pagina 4 di 5 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 3 nntor 2021 29/07/22, 13:30 qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare sht i prshtatshm pr mbshtetjen e ekonomis dhe kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv brenda vitit 2022. Pr kt arsye, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi: T ler t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 0.5%; T ler t pandryshuara normat e interesit t depozitave dhe t kredive njditore, respektivisht n nivelet 0.1% dhe 0.9%. Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se materializimi i skenarit baz  ai i konsolidimit t mtejshm t rimkmbjes dhe forcimit t presioneve t brendshme inflacioniste  do t krkoj normalizimin gradual t politiks monetare gjat tremujorve n vijim. Po ashtu, prmirsimi i gjendjes s likuiditetit n sektorin bankar do t mundsoj adoptimin e forms tradicionale t ankandeve t injektimit t likuiditetit n sektorin bankar, duke filluar nga tremujori i par i vitit t ardhshm. Reduktimi gradual i stimulit monetar do t garantoj respektimin e objektivit ton t inflacionit dhe do t krijoj premisa pr nj rritje m t qndrueshme ekonomike n afatin e mesm e t gjat. Gjithashtu, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se materializimi i skenarve t rrezikut do t krkoj nj rishikim t qndrimit t politiks monetare, duke e afruar n koh dhe prshpejtuar procesin e normalizimit t politiks monetare, apo duke e shtyr n koh dhe ngadalsuar at. Title: Governor of the Bank of Albania in the presentation to the Committee on Economy and Finance. Opinion of the Bank of Albania on the Draft Budget for 2022
