Bank of Albania opinion on 2022 Draft Budget 29/07/22, 13:30 Governor of the Bank of Albania at the presentation to the Commission on Economy and Finance. Bank of Albania's opinion on 2022 draft budget Publication date: 05.11.2021 Honourable, Mr. Chairman of the Commission, Honourable ladies and gentlemen, Deputies, First, let me thank you for the invitation to appear in this Commission and present to you the Bank of Albania's opinion on the 2022 Draft Budget. This Draft Budget sets out the fiscal policy position for 2022, alokes the funds needed to finance development programmes, as well as introduces tax legislation for next year. For this reason, the Bank of Albania has continuously assessed and appreciates the open discussion on projections where this project is based, the objectives included in it, as well as the instruments envisaged for their achievement. I hope that our contribution to this process also gives added value.  inioni_i_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_mbi_Projektbuxhetin_e_vitit_2022.html Page 1 of 7 Governor of the Bank of Albania at the presentation to the Commission for ... t. Bank of Albania opinion on 2022 Draft Budget 29/07/22, 13:30 As always, in respect of the legal mandate, the Bank of Albania's opinion on the Draft Budget will focus on those issues, which are within our scope of competence and expertise. More specifically, my comments will address the following issues: 1. Kahu and the effect of fiscal policy on the economy; 2. Public borrowing and its impact on internal financial markets; And, End, 3. Increasing the effectiveness and sustainability of public finances. Let me, at first, summarize our vision on the prospect of the development of the country and the contribution we as policymakers must make to it. 1. Macroeconomic context, fiscal policy and budgetary projections The 2022 draft budget comes to life in the context of a recovery process for the Albanian economy, following the double earthquake and pandemic strike, but also against the backdrop of the continuing medium and long-term development challenges we have  inioni_i_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_mbi_Projektbuxhetin_e_vitit_2022.html Page 2 of 7 Governor of the Bank of Albania at the presentation to the Commission for ... t. Bank of Albania opinion on 2022 Draft Budget 29/07/22, 13:30 Forward. The blows we faced over the past two years tested the country's economic, monetary and financial balances hard, as well as the sustainability of growth sources. In the Bank of Albania's judgment, the economic developments of 2021, and in particular: high growth rates during the first half of the year; partial recovery of labour market indicators; gradual improvement of private sector financial balances; the stability of inflation and the exchange rate; as well as increased private sector lending; shows that the Albanian economy is successfully facing this challenge. Likewise, the fact that the volume of production in the country, both at the aggregate level and in most sectors, has passed the level it had before the earthquake and pandemic, shows that the long-term and long-term impact of these two shocks on sources of economic growth is very likely to be low. The economic recovery has been fuelled by reduced restrictions on pandemic control, improving the confidence of businesses and families, improving foreign demand, but also by monetary and fiscal stimulus policies. Among other things, these policies guaranteed the country's monetary and financial stability, promoted low-cost lending of economic activity, as well as eased the financial burden of the private sector. The Bank of Albania considers that the prospect of the country's development remains positive and that the economic recovery is coming towards consolidation. For this reason, our economic policies  monetary and fiscal policies  must begin to gradually move towards normalisation. This normalization will serve to improve macroeconomic balances, increase space for dealing with potential future shocks, as well as strengthening the country's financial sustainability. In our judgment, the optimal sequence of this normalization process would be fiscal consolidation, followed and supported by the gradual withdrawal of monetary stimulus. This approach provides adequate support for the recovery process and mitigates fiscal risks arising from rising public debt.  inioni_i_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_mbi_Projektbuxhetin_e_vitit_2022.html Page 3 of 7 Governor of the Bank of Albania at the presentation to the Commission for ... t. Bank of Albania opinion on 2022 Draft Budget 29/07/22, 13:30 Based on the above, the Bank of Albania wants to share with you the following counts. This Draft Budget is based on the assumption of a positive and sustainable growth of the economy, both during 2022 and on the medium-term horizon. In particular, the Draft Budget predicts that 2022 budget revenues will increase by about 8% against the expected level of 2021, reaching 28.7% of GDP. In the Bank of Albania's judgment, macroeconomic projections, which contour the budget, are realistic in their basic scenario, even though they remain at the upper end of our expectations. Likewise, projections of budgetary income for 2022 seem acceptable, but they also factor in a positive effect expected by the increase in the formalization of the economy. In this prism, the Bank of Albania: suggests the need for continued attention from fiscal authorities towards income performance, to identify in time possible negative differences between the fact and the plan, as well as to take the necessary measures for controlling the budget deficit and public debt; encourages timely and decisive implementation of measures supporting the formalisation of the economy. Our experience has shown that  despite their short-term costs  structural reforms produce long-term benefits for the country; It appreciates the need to finalize and implement the Medium-Term Public Revenue Strategy as quickly as possible. Among other things, this strategy should aim at simplifying the tax system, increasing its sustainability in time and avoiding ineffective tax exemptions. Together with increasing formalisation, this will enable the increase in the scale of revenue collection and improved competition, within and between sectors. Second, the 2022 Draft Budget envisions the start of the fiscal consolidation process. According to draft budget projections, the budget deficit is scheduled to decrease to 5.4% of GDP for 2022, compared to the 6.8% level expected for the current year. Also, the primary deficit is scheduled to record a consolidation of 1.9 percentage points of GDP during 2022, while gross public debt is projected to reduce by 1.1 percentage points. The Bank of Albania welcomes the start of the fiscal consolidation process during 2022. The speed of consolidation seems conditional on rising prices in international markets and the need to complete the reconstruction process. In their absence, the Bank of Albania considers that this consolidation would have to be more ambitious. We also welcome the adoption of a numerical target for the pace of fiscal consolidation, materialized through the establishment in the Organic Budget Law of a target on a positive primary balance starting in 2024. In this prism, the Bank of Albania: encourages the adoption of relevant provisions in the Draft Budget, which enable the acceleration of the pace of fiscal consolidation during 2022  i.e. further reduction of deficit and debt  in the event of income  inioni_i_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_mbi_Projektbuxhetin_e_vitit_2022.html Page 4 of 7 Governor of the Bank of Albania at the presentation to the Commission for ... t. Bank of Albania opinion on 2022 Draft Budget 29/07/22, 13:30 budgetary results higher than expectations or if the need for subsidising energy imports results in lower than the current estimate; suggests revising the provisions of Section 7 of the 2022 Budget Bill, enabling grant-shaped revenues to fund earthquake injury reconstruction to be used to reduce the budget deficit; encourages a faster pace of fiscal consolidation on the medium and long-term horizon; believes that this consolidation, in line and with the adoption of the medium-term public revenue strategy, should be based more on revenue growth than on cutting public spending. Third, the 2022 Draft Budget envisions public investment at the 6.4% GDP level. This level comes in slight decline compared to the previous year, but it remains sufficiently high anyway. The Bank of Albania encourages the preservation of capital investment spaces in the country's budget structure. These investments are necessary for the total improvement of the country's infrastructure, in the interest of accelerating the pace of economic growth in the medium and long term, as well as in the interest swelling of society's well-being. In this prism, the Bank of Albania: estimates that disciplining current spending and steadily increasing the public revenue base will create premise for preserving spaces for public investment, even in the presence of fiscal consolidation; considers that the process of selecting investment projects can be further improved, through the adoption of a formal structure to assess their profitability on time. 2. Financial markets, budget deficit and public debt The 2022 draft budget forecasts a budget deficit of about 101 billion dollars or 5.4% of GDP. This deficit is projected to be financed to the tune of 50 billion dollars (or 2.7% of GDP) from internal borrowing and 51 billion dollars (again 2.7% of GDP) from foreign financing. Financing in the internal market is provided through the issue of valuable letters. Meanwhile, foreign financing is expected to be provided as follows: 25 billion dollars (or 1.4% of GDP) from projects covered by foreign financing, about 17.5 billion dollars (or 1% of GDP) from the budgetary support of international partners and the remaining 8.5 billion dollars (or 0.3% of GDP) from funds provided by the expected issue of a Eurobond in international markets during 2021. This Eurobond (expected at the level of 700m euros, or about 85 billion dollars) will be used as follows: 34.1 billion dollars for the coverage of foreign debt payments during 2021, 42.5 billion dollars for the coverage of foreign debt payments in 2022 and 8.5 billion dollars for financing the budget deficit during 2022. In  inioni_i_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_mbi_Projektbuxhetin_e_vitit_2022.html Page 5 of 7 Governor of the Bank of Albania at the presentation to the Commission for ... t. Bank of Albania opinion on 2022 Draft Budget 29/07/22, 13:30 lack of Eurobond, the government would have to lower to a corresponding measure the planned spending during the period 2021-2022, or increase borrowing on the internal market. The Bank of Albania estimates that this financing plan is reasonable, under the conditions of high levels of deficit and government-targeted borrowing on the 20212022 horizon. Comprehensive financing of these deficits in the internal financial market would bring interest rate increases and reduction of funds available to private sector lending. Also, the Bank of Albania supports the objectives and work of the Ministry of Finance and Economy for further extension of the public debt maturity structure. However, the Bank of Albania finds it appropriate to stress that the increasing trend of foreign and currency-denominated borrowing exposes public debt not only to the risk of interest rates but also to the risk of unfavourable exchange rate fluctuations. For this reason, the Bank of Albania considers that the deficit and debt financing structure should aim for greater reliance on local markets and currency in the medium and long term. This approach would reduce the probability and intensity of possible strikes in the future. In this direction, the Bank of Albania suggests: First, the revision of the provisions envisaged in Article 10 of the 2022 Budget Bill, which limit borrowing in internal financial markets  destined for budget deficit financing  to the maximum level of 50 billion dollars, and reduce this borrowing for maximum half of the amount of possible privatisation income obtained during the year; second, the continuation of work to further expand and diversify the investor base in the internal market. This objective must be met  among other things  through the continuation of the programme to improve the functioning of the secondary market, which increases the interest of local investors; Third, adopting a more ambitious approach to reducing foreign debt on the medium and long-term horizon. This target goes in line with  and is made possible by  the primary objective of reducing the level of public debt. Next, let me briefly summarize some suggestions from the Bank of Albania, which, in our vision, would help increase the long-term sustainability and effectiveness of public finances. 3. On increasing efficiency and sustainability of public finances By assessing the 2022 Draft Budget as a balancing act between  on the one hand  the needs of supporting the recovery of the economy and the final reduction of earthquake and pandemic consequences, and  on the other hand  preserving and consolidating the sustainability of public finances, the Bank of Albania finds the following suggestions and recommendations. On the deficits created by the Social Security and Health Insurance scheme 2022 draft budget predicts deficit created by insurance scheme  inioni_i_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_mbi_Projektbuxhetin_e_vitit_2022.html Page 6 of 7 Governor of the Bank of Albania at the presentation to the Commission for ... t. Bank of Albania opinion on 2022 Draft Budget 29/07/22, 13:30 social and health will be at the level of 101 billion dollars or 5.4% of GDP. This level is equal to the 2022 budget deficit and about twice as high as the budget deficit level targeted for 20242025. Social and health insurance schemes are likely to pose a significant burden on the state's finances. In this context, given and adverse demographic trends, the Bank of Albania suggests periodic revision of the pension scheme, that of health insurance and other social security schemes, with the aim of preserving these schemes in sustainable and affordable trajectories for the state budget. On the management of Public -Private Partnership Programs The 2022 draft budget predicts that payments from the state budget for obligations arising from concessionary contracts and PPPs will be within legal restrictions, most specifically at the 3% tax revenue level of the previous year. However, in line with our previous positions, the Bank of Albania suggests: inclusion of long-term legal ceilings on the total contracted value of PpPs. This adjustment would be a complementary element of the control of the level of potential risk that PpPs may have on the health of the public finances; integration of the contracting process and selection of PpPs with the strategic investment programme, as identified in the country's long-term development programmes; the continued improvement of the professional capacities of the entities that manage the evaluation, contracting and monitoring of these projects, especially in the legal and financial obligations they charge the Budget. On the pace of budgetary spending Finally, the Bank of Albania continues to reiterate the call for a better distribution of spending time during the year. The pace of budgetary spending during the year continues to show a marked concentration in the fourth quarter. This phenomenon, repeated and dictated to the greatest extent by the inconsistent pace of investment realisation, creates unnecessary fluctuations during the year in liquidity and interest rate indicators in the internal financial market. Thank you for the attention!  inioni_i_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_mbi_Projektbuxhetin_e_vitit_2022.html Page 7 of 7

Konteksti makroekonomik, politika fiskale dhe projeksionet buxhetore Projektbuxheti i vitit 2022 merr jet n kontekstin e nj procesi rimkmbjeje t ekonomis shqiptare, pas goditjes s dyfisht t trmetit dhe pandemis, por edhe n sfondin e sfidave t vazhdueshme afatmesme dhe afatgjata t zhvillimit q kemi https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalinioni_i_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_mbi_Projektbuxhetin_e_vitit_2022.html Pagina 2 di 7 Guvernatori i Banks s Shqipris n prezantimin n Komisionin pr t. Goditjet me t cilat u prballm gjat dy viteve t fundit testuan fort ekuilibrat ekonomik, monetar dhe financiar t vendit, si dhe qndrueshmrin e burimeve t rritjes. N gjykimin e Banks s Shqipris, zhvillimet ekonomike t vitit 2021, dhe n veanti: normat e larta t rritjes gjat gjysms s par t vitit; rikuperimi i pjesshm i treguesve t tregut t puns; prmirsimi gradual i bilanceve financiare t sektorit privat; stabiliteti i inflacionit dhe i kursit t kmbimit; si dhe kreditimi n rritje i sektorit privat; tregon se ekonomia shqiptare po e prballon me sukses kt sfid. Po ashtu, fakti se vllimi i prodhimit n vend, si n nivel agregat dhe n pjesn m t madhe t sektorve, ka kaluar nivelin q kishte para trmetit dhe pandemis, tregon se ndikimi afatmesm e afatgjat i ktyre dy goditjeve n burimet e rritjes ekonomike, ka shum gjasa t jet i ult. Rimkmbja ekonomike sht ushqyer nga reduktimi i kufizimeve t marra pr kontrollin e pandemis, nga prmirsimi i besimit t bizneseve dhe familjeve, nga prmirsimi i krkess s huaj, por edhe nga politika stimuluese monetare dhe fiskale. Ndr t tjera, kto politika garantuan stabilitetin monetar edhe financiar t vendit, nxitn kreditimin me kosto t ult t aktivitetit ekonomik, si dhe lehtsuan barrn financiare t sektorit privat. Banka e Shqipris gjykon se perspektiva e zhvillimit t vendit mbetet pozitive dhe se rimkmbja ekonomike po vjen drejt konsolidimit. Pr kt arsye, politikat tona ekonomike  ajo monetare dhe ajo fiskale  duhet t fillojn t orientohen gradualisht drejt normalizimit. Ky normalizim do ti shrbej prmirsimit t ekuilibrave makroekonomik, rritjes s hapsirs pr prballimin e goditjeve potenciale n t ardhmen, si dhe forcimit t qndrueshmris financiare t vendit. N gjykimin ton, sekuencimi optimal i ktij procesi normalizimi do t ishte konsolidimi fiskal, i pasuar dhe i mbshtetur nga trheqja graduale e stimulit monetar. Kjo prqasje ofron mbshtetjen e duhur pr procesin e rimkmbjes dhe zbut rreziqet fiskale q burojn prej rritjes s borxhit publik. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalinioni_i_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_mbi_Projektbuxhetin_e_vitit_2022.html Pagina 3 di 7 Guvernatori i Banks s Shqipris n prezantimin n Komisionin pr t. Opinioni i Banks s Shqipris mbi Projektbuxhetin e vitit 2022 29/07/22, 13:30 Bazuar n sa m sipr, Banka e Shqipris dshiron t ndaj me ju konstatimet e mposhtme. Ky Projektbuxhet bazohet n supozimin e nj rritjeje pozitive dhe t qndrueshme t ekonomis, si gjat vitit 2022 ashtu edhe n horizontin afatmesm. N veanti, Projektbuxheti parashikon se t ardhurat buxhetore t vitit 2022 do t rriten me rreth 8% ndaj nivelit t pritur t vitit 2021, duke arritur n 28.7% t PBB-s. N gjykimin e Banks s Shqipris, projeksionet makroekonomike, t cilat konturojn buxhetin, jan realiste n skenarin e tyre baz, edhe pse ato mbeten n kahun e siprm t pritjeve tona. Po ashtu, projeksionet e t ardhurave buxhetore pr vitin 2022 duken t pranueshme, por ato faktorizojn dhe nj efekt pozitiv t pritur nga rritja e formalizimit t ekonomis. N kt prizm, Banka e Shqipris: sugjeron nevojn pr vmendje t vazhduar nga autoritetet fiskale ndaj ecuris s t ardhurave, pr t identifikuar n koh diferencat e mundshme negative midis faktit dhe planit, si dhe pr t marr masat e nevojshme pr kontrollin e deficitit buxhetor dhe t borxhit publik; inkurajon zbatimin n koh dhe me vendosmri t masave q mbshtesin formalizimin e ekonomis. Prvoja jon ka treguar se  pavarsisht kostove t tyre afatshkurtra  reformat strukturore prodhojn prfitime afatgjata pr vendin; vlerson t domosdoshm finalizimin dhe zbatimin n nj koh sa m t shpejt t Strategjis Afatmesme t t Ardhurave publike. Ndr t tjera, kjo strategji duhet t synoj thjeshtimin e sistemit tatimor, rritjen e qndrueshmris n koh t tij dhe shmangien e prjashtimeve tatimore joefektive. S bashku me rritjen e formalizimit, kjo do t mundsoj rritjen e shkalls s grumbullimit t t ardhurave dhe prmirsimin e konkurrencs, brenda dhe midis sektorve. S dyti, Projektbuxheti i vitit 2022 parashikon fillimin e procesit t konsolidimit fiskal. Sipas projeksioneve t Projektbuxhetit, deficiti buxhetor programohet t ulet n 5.4% t PBB-s pr vitin 2022, kundrejt nivelit 6.8% t pritur pr vitin aktual. Po ashtu, deficiti primar programohet t regjistroj nj konsolidim prej 1.9 pik prqindjeje t PBB-s gjat vitit 2022, ndrsa borxhi publik bruto parashikohet t reduktohet me 1.1 pik prqindjeje. Banka e Shqipris mirpret fillimin e procesit t konsolidimit fiskal gjat vitit 2022. Shpejtsia e konsolidimit duket e kushtzuar nga rritja e mimeve n tregjet ndrkombtare dhe nevoja e prfundimit t procesit t rindrtimit. N munges t tyre, Banka e Shqipris gjykon se ky konsolidim do t duhej t ishte m ambicioz. Po ashtu, ne mirpresim adoptimin e nj objektivi numerik pr ritmin e konsolidimit fiskal, t materializuar prmes vendosjes n Ligjin Organik t Buxhetit t nj objektivi mbi nj balanc primare pozitive duke filluar nga viti 2024. N kt prizm, Banka e Shqipris: inkurajon adoptimin e dispozitave relevante n Projektbuxhet, t cilat mundsojn prshpejtimin e ritmit t konsolidimit fiskal gjat vitit 2022  pra reduktimin e mtejshm t deficitit dhe t borxhit  n rast se t ardhurat https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalinioni_i_Bankes_se_Shqiperise_mbi_Projektbuxhetin_e_vitit_2022.html Pagina 4 di 7 Guvernatori i Banks s Shqipris n prezantimin n Komisionin pr t. S treti, Projektbuxheti i vitit 2022 parashikon investime publike n nivelin 6.4% t PBB-s. Ky nivel vjen n rnie t leht krahasuar me vitin paraardhs, por ai mbetet gjithsesi mjaftueshmrisht i lart. Banka e Shqipris inkurajon ruajtjen e hapsirave pr investime kapitale n strukturn e buxhetit t vendit. Kto investime jan t nevojshme pr prmirsimin e gjithanshm t infrastrukturs s vendit, n interes t prshpejtimit t ritmit t rritjes ekonomike n afatin e mesm dhe t gjat, si dhe n interes t rritjes s mirqenies s shoqris. N kt prizm, Banka e Shqipris: vlerson se disiplinimi i shpenzimeve korrente dhe rritja e qndrueshme e bazs s t ardhurave publike do t krijojn premisa pr ruajtjen e hapsirave pr investime publike, edhe n prani t konsolidimit fiskal; gjykon se procesi i przgjedhjes s projekteve t investimeve mund t prmirsohet m tej, nprmjet adoptimit t nj strukture formale t vlersimit t rentabilitetit t tyre n koh. 2. Tregjet financiare, deficiti buxhetor dhe borxhi publik Projektbuxheti i vitit 2022 parashikon nj deficit buxhetor prej rreth 101 miliard leksh ose 5.4% t PBB-s. Ky deficit parashikohet t financohet n masn 50 miliard lek (ose 2.7% t PBB-s) nga huamarrja e brendshme dhe 51 miliard lek (prsri 2.7% t PBB-s) nga financimi i huaj. Financimi n tregun e brendshm parashikohet t sigurohet nprmjet emetimit t letrave me vler. Ndrkoh, financimi i huaj pritet t sigurohet si m posht: 25 miliard lek (ose 1.4% e PBB-s) nga projektet e mbuluara nga financimi i huaj, rreth 17.5 miliard lek (ose 1% e PBB-s) nga mbshtetja buxhetore e partnerve ndrkombtar dhe pjesa e mbetur prej 8.5 miliard leksh (ose 0.3% e PBB-s) nga fondet e siguruara nga emetimi pritur i nj Eurobondi n tregjet ndrkombtare gjat vitit 2021. Ky Eurobond (i pritur n nivelin e 700 milion eurove, ose rreth 85 miliard lek) do t prdoret si m posht: 34.1 miliard lek pr mbulimin e pagesave t borxhit t huaj gjat vitit 2021, 42.5 miliard lek pr mbulimin e pagesave t borxhit t huaj n vitin 2022 dhe 8.5 miliard lek pr financimin e deficitit buxhetor gjat vitit 2022. Banka e Shqipris vlerson se ky plan financimi sht i arsyeshm, n kushtet e niveleve t larta t deficitit dhe huamarrjes s synuar nga qeveria n horizontin 20212022. Financimi trsor i ktyre deficiteve n tregun e brendshm financiar do t sillte rritje t normave t interesit dhe reduktim t fondeve n dispozicion t kreditimit t sektorit privat. Gjithashtu, Banka e Shqipris mbshtet objektivat dhe punn e Ministris s Financave dhe Ekonomis pr zgjatjen e mtejshme t strukturs s maturimit t borxhit publik. Megjithat, Banka e Shqipris gjen me vend t theksoj se trendi rrits i huamarrjes s huaj dhe asaj t denominuar n valut, ekspozon borxhin publik jo vetm ndaj rrezikut t normave t interesit por dhe ndaj rrezikut t luhatjeve t pafavorshme t kursit t kmbimit. Pr kt arsye, Banka e Shqipris gjykon se struktura e financimit t deficitit dhe t borxhit duhet t synoj nj mbshtetje m t madhe n tregjet dhe monedhn vendase n afatin e mesm dhe t gjat. Kjo prqasje do t reduktonte probabilitetin dhe intensitetin e goditjeve t mundshme n t ardhmen. N kt drejtim, Banka e Shqipris sugjeron: s pari, rishikimin e dispozitave t parashikuara n nenin 10 t Projektligjit pr Buxhetin e vitit 2022, t cilat kufizojn huamarrjen n tregjet e brendshme financiare  t destinuar pr financimin e deficitit buxhetor  n nivelin maksimal prej 50 miliard leksh, dhe e reduktojn kt huamarrje pr maksimalisht gjysmn e sasis s t ardhurave t mundshme t privatizimit t prftuara gjat vitit; s dyti, vijimin e puns pr zgjerimin dhe diversifikimin e mtejshm t bazs s investitorve n tregun e brendshm. Ky objektiv duhet prmbushur  ndr t tjera  nprmjet vijimit t programit t prmirsimit t funksionimit t tregut dytsor, ka rrit interesin e investitorve vendas; s treti, adoptimin e nj prqasjeje m ambicioze pr reduktimin e borxhit t huaj n horizontin afatmesm dhe afatgjat. Ky objektiv shkon n linj me  dhe bhet i mundur nga  objektivi primar i reduktimit t nivelit t borxhit publik. N vijim, m lejoni t prmbledh shkurtimisht disa sugjerime t Banks s Shqipris, t cilat, n vizionin ton, do t ndihmonin n rritjen e qndrueshmris afatgjat dhe efektivitetit t financave publike. 3. Mbi rritjen e efektivitetit dhe qndrueshmrin e financave publike Duke vlersuar Projektbuxhetin e vitit 2022 si nj akt balancues midis  nga njra an  nevojave t mbshtetjes s rikuperimit t ekonomis dhe reduktimit prfundimtar t pasojave t trmetit dhe pandemis, dhe  nga ana tjetr  ruajtjes dhe konsolidimit t qndrueshmris s financave publike, Banka e Shqipris gjen me vend t bj dhe sugjerimet e rekomandimet e mposhtme. Ky nivel sht i barabart me deficitin buxhetor t vitit 2022 dhe rreth dy her m i lart se niveli i deficitit buxhetor t targetuar pr vitet 2024  2025. Skemat e sigurimeve shoqrore dhe shndetsore vijojn t prbjn nj barr t ndjeshme pr financat e shtetit. N kt kontekst, duke pasur parasysh dhe trendet e pafavorshme demografike, Banka e Shqipris sugjeron rishikimin periodik t skems s pensioneve, at t sigurimeve shndetsore dhe skemat e tjera t sigurimeve sociale, me synim ruajtjen e ktyre skemave n trajektore t qndrueshme dhe t prballueshme pr buxhetin e shtetit. Megjithat, n linj dhe me qndrimet tona t mparshme, Banka e Shqipris sugjeron: prfshirjen e tavaneve ligjore afatgjata mbi vlern e prgjithshme t kontraktuar t PPP-ve. Title: Speech at the closing meeting of the year, organized by the Albanian Banking Association
text: 05/08/22, 17:18 Governor Seyko's word at the closing meeting of the year, organised by the Albanian Banking Association Governor Seyko's word at the closing meeting of the year, organised by the Albanian Banking Association Publication date: 16.12.2021 Honoured Mr. Chairman of the Albanian Banking Association, Honored leaders and colleagues of the banking system in Albania, Honored ladies and gentlemen!  1/6 05/08/22, 17:18 Governor Seyko's word at the closing meeting of the year, organised by the Albanian Banking Association It is a pleasure to return with you to the traditional end-of-year meeting, organised by the Albanian Banking Association, especially after two years of secession, because of the measures taken within the pandemic. Returning and participating in this activity takes special importance to share together experiences, key moments, challenges, and why not, even our achievements over the last two years, years that put us before an unprecedented situation. Let me initially stop at the country's overall economic performance in 2021. The Albanian economy has shown a marked recovery during 2021, exceeding our initial expectations. The continued positive pace of economic growth is strong, broad-based and vulnerable. Gross domestic product has already reached pre-crisis level; employment is recovering; financial balances have increased; while major indicators of the health of the banking sector have improved. In this direction, let me stress that the sources of economic growth have restored to their growing tendency and that of proper diversification. On the part of aggregate demand, revitalization of growth  2/6 05/08y/22, 5:18 PM j Governor Sejko's word at the closing meeting of the year, organized ngga Husband, atagSjhqiptare of the Banks economic performance was supported by the increasing performance of exports of goods and services, as well as by increased consumption and internal investments. In the sectoral perspective, the expansion of economic activity significantly reflected the recovery of the industry and services sector. From the perspective of the policies pursued, thanks to strong fiscal and monetary incentives, the continuation of economic recovery was defeated. For more, this reflects growing foreign demand, stable private sector balances and higher optimism of businesses and individuals. The Albanian economy possesses all the prerequisites for a stable and future-based economy, while the expected opening of negotiations for Membership of the European Union would strengthen economic growth and boost foreign and domestic investment. The Albanian banking sector, even this year, changed its positive performance tendency and appeared stable to external shocks (the two-year effects of pandemics). The sector's activity came to expand (over 9%), supported mainly by local deposits (over 80% of active ones), but without affecting the overall capitalization of the banking system (18.4%), thanks to increased capital supplements and careful dividend policies, followed by banks, in full co-operation with the Bank of Albania. Profit has improved while liquidity remains high.  3/6 05/08/22, 17:18 Governor Seyko's word at the closing meeting of the year, organised by the Albanian Banking Association The portfolio of loans shows a well-diversified increase (10 in total), both in money and in foreign currency, for businesses, for loans for retail trade and that mortgage. The ratio of troubled loans has decreased (from 8.13% to 6.3%), benefiting from the increase in the total loan portfolio and the reduction of troubled loans (-17%). In addition to declining troubled loan figures, the ratio of total coverage improved (from 65% to 70%). However, there is still ample room for credit growth, given abundant liquid reserves, low-level credit/deposit ratios and positive profitability, which can fully support capital. *** Honourable representatives of the banking sector, In the context of these two difficult years, the prospect of economic growth in Albania is positive and optimistic, while offering the banking system a solid support base to expand its activity, through the commitment, efforts and devotion of all actors. Let me share with you some of the common challenges we will face in the following years. First, the banking sector will continue to consolidate further in the coming year, following the acquisition of 100% of Alpha Bank's shares. by OTP NYRT. This development is expected to bring increased competition, especially among the largest market actors. The portfolio of loans remains the main contributor to balance sheet income, and to maintain competitive position, banks must preserve and increase it continuously. While the market offers opportunities for increased lending and banks have liquidity and capital sufficiency, it is necessary to create a long-term vision and define strategic objectives, carefully designed to exploit this long-term potential, with the aim of building the necessary infrastructure in the bank and strengthening customer relations. Second, the Bank of Albania, as the authority responsible for overseeing 90% of the financial market, plays an important role in the process of approximating the legal framework with that of the European Union. Part of this process are the additional capital requirements, which were introduced over the past year. Our goal is to carefully present these requirements, without harming the competitiveness of individual banks and limiting their potential for growth. This process extends to a long-term time frame and during this deadline, we will closely monitor the progress of creating  4/6 05/08/22, 17:18 Governor Seyko's word at the closing meeting of the year, organised by the Albanian Banking Association necessary capital and the fulfilment of the Minimum Requirement for Capital and Accepted Obligations (MREL), as well as carefully and flexibly calibrate aggregate capital requirements, in order not to hinder the organic and healthy growth of banking activity. Meanwhile, positive profit offers safe support for capital growth. Third, while we have been determined to introduce the Effective Interest Rate (NEI) ceiling for the first time, we have realized that these new regulations will have operational and financial effects on our market. In 2021, the Bank of Albania launched a comprehensive consultation process regarding regulatory changes in terms of the presentation of the ceiling for nei. These changes became necessary, after the expansion of the consumer loans market, with the aim of reducing asymmetries within this market and fulfilling the role of the Bank of Albania in terms of consumer protection and financial inclusion. We have received different opinions from market actors (mainly positive) and for the most part, their comments and suggestions have reflected them. In this context, we will be prepared and flexible to ensure a smooth and calibrated transition in this direction. Next year, we will continue dialogue with the industry, as we have the results of the implementation of the ceiling for NEI and especially that of penalties for consumer loans, which is also the most debated part. Fourth, the financial infrastructure of the banking sector has further consolidated over the past two years. The Bank of Albania and the National Payment Systems Committee have implemented a national strategy for empowering the low-value payment market and increasing the financial involvement of citizens. The first results are promising and will be followed by other steps that the Bank of Albania and the banking sector will take, which are aimed at doubling the number of citizens who have a bank account in 2023. Soon, we will also introduce the new payment system for paying payments in the Euro currency in Albania. This system aims to increase the effectiveness of this segment of the market, lowering the costs carried by banks through current solutions, which are channelled to the last customer and beyond. This will also serve to strengthen the formalisation of the Albanian economy. At the close, let me reconfirm and reemphasize the dedication and steadfast attitude of the Bank of Albania to be always transparent, open and supportive of the banking sector throughout its activity. Wishing you the holidays, thank you for the attention! Be it next year, a prosperous year for all of you and your families!  5/6 05/08/22, 17:18 Governor Seyko's word at the closing meeting of the year, organised by the Albanian Banking Association  6/6

Rikthimi dhe pjesmarrja n kt aktivitet merr rendsi t veant pr t ndar s bashku prvojat, momentet kye, sfidat, dhe pse jo, edhe arritjet tona gjat dy viteve t fundit, vite t cilat na vun para nj situate t paprecedent. N kt drejtim, m lejoni t theksoj se burimet e rritjes ekonomike i jan rikthyer tendencs s tyre rritse dhe asaj t diversifikimit t duhur. Nga ana e krkess agregate, rigjallrimi i rritjes https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_Sejko_ne_takimin_permbylles_te_vitit_te_organizua 2/6 05/08y/22, 17:18 j Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n takimin pgrmbylls t vitit, t organizugar ngga Shoq,atagSjhqiptare e Bankavej ekonomike u mbshtet nga ecuria n rritje e eksporteve t mallrave e shrbimeve, si dhe nga rritja e konsumit dhe investimeve t brendshme. N kndvshtrimin sektorial, zgjerimi i aktivitetit ekonomik reflektoi n mas t konsiderueshme rimkmbjen e sektorit t industris dhe t atij t shrbimeve. Nga kndvshtrimi i politikave t ndjekura, fal stimujve t fuqishm fiskal dhe monetar, u mundsua vazhdimsia e rimkmbjes ekonomike. Pr m shum, kjo reflekton nj krkes t huaj n rritje, bilance t qndrueshme t sektorit privat dhe optimizm m t lart t bizneseve dhe individve. Ekonomia shqiptare zotron t gjitha parakushtet pr nj rrije ekonomie t qndrueshme dhe t mbshtetur n t ardhmen, ndrsa elja e pritur e negociatave pr antarsim n Bashkimin Evropian do t forconte rritjen ekonomike dhe do t nxiste investimet e huaja dhe ato vendase. Sektori bankar shqiptar, edhe kt vit, vijoi tendencn e tij t ecuris pozitive dhe u shfaq i qndrueshm ndaj goditjeve nga jasht (efekteve prej dy vjetsh t pandemis). Veprimtaria e sektorit vijoi t zgjerohej (mbi 9%), mbshtetur kryesisht nga depozitat vendase (mbi 80% e aktiveve), por pa ndikuar kapitalizimin e prgjithshm t sistemit bankar (18.4%), fal shtesave t rritura t kapitalit dhe politikave t kujdesshme t dividentit, t ndjekura nga bankat, n bashkpunim t plot me Bankn e Shqipris. Fitimi sht prmirsuar ndrsa likuiditeti mbetet i lart. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_Sejko_ne_takimin_permbylles_te_vitit_te_organizua 3/6 05/08/22, 17:18 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n takimin prmbylls t vitit, t organizuar nga Shoqata Shqiptare e Bankave Portofoli i kredive tregon nj rritje t mirdiversifikuar (+10 n total), si n lek dhe n monedh t huaj, pr biznese, pr kredi pr tregti me pakic dhe at hipotekare. Raporti i kredive me probleme sht ulur (nga 8.13% n 6.3%), duke prfituar nga rritja e portofolit total t kredive dhe nga reduktimi i kredive me probleme (-17%). Prve rnies s shifrave t kredive me probleme, raporti i mbulimit total u prmirsua (nga 65% n 70%). Megjithat, ende ka hapsir t bollshme pr rritjen e kredis, duke pasur parasysh rezervat e bollshme likuide, raportet kredi/depozit n nivele t ulta dhe fitimin pozitiv, t cilt mund t mbshtesin plotsisht kapitalin. *** T nderuar prfaqsues t sektorit bankar, N kontekstin e ktyre dy viteve t vshtira, perspektiva e rritjes ekonomike n Shqipri sht pozitive dhe optimiste, ndrsa i ofron sistemit bankar nj baz mbshtetse solide pr t zgjeruar veprimtarin e tij, nprmjet angazhimit, prpjekjeve dhe devotshmris s t gjith aktorve. M lejoni t ndaj me ju disa nga sfidat e prbashkta me t cilat do t prballemi n vitet n vijim. S pari, sektori bankar do t vijoj t konsolidohet m tej vitin q vjen, pas blerjes 100% t aksioneve t Alpha Bank sh.a. nga OTP NYRT. Ky zhvillim pritet t sjell rritje t konkurrencs, veanrisht ndrmjet aktorve m t mdhenj t tregut. Portofoli i kredive mbetet kontribuuesi kryesor n t ardhurat e bilanceve, dhe pr t mbajtur pozicion konkurrues, bankat duhet ta ruajn dhe ta rrisin at n vazhdimsi. Ndrkoh q tregu ofron mundsi pr rritje t kreditimit dhe bankat kan likuiditet dhe mjaftueshmri t kapitalit, sht e domosdoshme t krijohet nj vizion afatgjat dhe t prcaktohen objektiva strategjik, t hartuar me kujdes pr t shfrytzuar kt potencial n afatgjat, me qllim ndrtimin e infrastrukturs s nevojshme n bank dhe forcimin e marrdhnieve me klientt. S dyti, Banka e Shqipris, si autoriteti prgjegjs pr mbikqyrjen e 90% t tregut financiar, luan nj rol t rndsishm n procesin e prafrimit t kuadrit ligjor me at t Bashkimit Evropian. Pjes e ktij procesi jan dhe krkesat shtes t kapitalit, t cilat u prezantuan gjat vitit t kaluar. Qllimi yn sht prezantimi i kujdesshm i ktyre krkesave, pa dmtuar konkurrencn e bankave individuale dhe kufizuar potencialin e tyre pr rritje. Ky proces shtrihet n nj kuadr kohor afatgjat dhe gjat ktij afati, ne do t monitorojm nga afr progresin e krijimit t https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Fjala_e_Guvernatorit_Sejko_ne_takimin_permbylles_te_vitit_te_organizua 4/6 05/08/22, 17:18 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n takimin prmbylls t vitit, t organizuar nga Shoqata Shqiptare e Bankave kapitalit t nevojshm dhe plotsimin e Krkess Minimale pr Kapital dhe Detyrime t pranuara (MREL), si dhe do t kalibrojm me kujdes dhe fleksibilitet krkesat agregate pr kapital, me qllim q t mos pengohet rritja organike dhe e shndetshme e veprimtaris bankare. Ndrkoh, fitimi pozitiv ofron nj mbshtetje t sigurt pr rritjen e kapitalit. S treti, ndrsa kemi qen t vendosur pr t prezantuar pr her t par tavanin e Norms Efektive t Interesit (NEI), kemi kuptuar se kto rregullore t reja do t ken efekte operacionale dhe financiare n tregun ton. N vitin 2021, Banka e Shqipris nisi nj proces gjithprfshirs konsultimi n lidhje me ndryshimet rregullative sa i prket prezantimit t tavanit pr NEI. Kto ndryshime u bn t nevojshme, pas zgjerimit t tregut t kredive konsumatore, me qllim reduktimin e asimetrive brenda ktij tregu dhe n prmbushje t rolit t Banks s Shqipris n lidhje me mbrojtjen e konsumatorit dhe prfshirjen financiare. Kemi marr opinione t ndryshme nga aktort e tregut (kryesisht pozitive) dhe n pjesn m t madhe, komentet e sugjerimet e tyre i kemi reflektuar. N kt kontekst, ne do t jemi t prgatitur dhe fleksibl pr t siguruar nj kalim t kalibruar e t but n kt drejtim. Vitin tjetr, do t vazhdojm dialogun me industrin, pasi t kemi rezultatet e zbatimit t tavanit p NEI dhe veanrisht atij t penaliteteve pr huat konsumatore, e cila sht dhe pjesa m e debatuar. S katrti, infrastruktura financiare e sektorit bankar sht konsoliduar m tej gjat dy viteve t fundit. Banka e Shqipris dhe Komiteti Kombtar i Sistemeve t Pagesave kan zbatuar nj strategji kombtare pr fuqizimin e tregut t pagesave me vler t vogl dhe rritjen e prfshirjes financiare t qytetareve. Rezultatet e para jan premtuese dhe do t ndiqen nga hapa t tjer q do t ndrmarr Banka e Shqipris dhe sektori bankar, t cilat kan si objektiv, dyfishimin e numrit t qytetarve q kan nj llogari bankare n vitin 2023. S shpejti, ne do t prezantojm edhe sistemin e ri t pagesave pr shlyerjen e pagesave n monedhn Euro n Shqipri. Ky sistem ka pr qllim t rris efektivitetin e ktij segmenti t tregut, duke ulur kostot e mbartura nga bankat nprmjet zgjidhjeve aktuale, t cilat kanalizohen tek klienti i fundit dhe m tej. Kjo do t shrbej gjithashtu pr t forcuar formalizimin e ekonomis shqiptare. N mbyllje, m lejoni t rikonfirmoj dhe t ritheksoj prkushtimin dhe qndrimin e palkundur t Banks s Shqipris pr t qen gjithnj transparente, e hapur dhe mbshtetse ndaj sektorit bankar, gjat gjith veprimtaris s saj. Title: Questions and answers at the press conference
text: Questions from the press conference dated December 22, 2021 29/07/22, 13:30 Questions from the press conference dated December 22, 2021 Publication date: 22.12.2021 Question: Mr. Governor you said that in 2022 you would put pressure on the wage increase. How are you going to put that pressure on? How's that going to happen? Governor: Regarding pressure for wage growth, the Bank of Albania does not directly pressure. The Bank of Albania through its monetary policy tries and aims to stimulate investment, lending and consumption. This is done through creating conditions for raising lending at low interest rates, while also orienting investments towards sources with more stable and better economic incomes. Of course, in relation to the bank of Albania's monetary policy, stimulus or austerity depending on different economic situations, this is reflected in the growth of the country's economic activity. Consequently, there will be an increase in economic activity. Mainly, wage growth is a more direct consequence of fiscal policy than monetary policy. Generally, policies and reforms undertaken on the part of the government reflect on wage growth, while monetary policy helps in this direction. With our monetary policy, a certain level of inflation is targeted to maintain price stability, to have control over prices. At the same time, good exchange rate management and regime is also targeted, as we have a free regime of its own and can be kept under control but not by intervention, so that the exchange rate does not hit the different layers of either the population or business. Q: Having fallen and the number of bad loans, was there an amnesty?  e_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_22_dhjetor_2021.html Page 1 of 5 Questions from the press conference dated December 22, 2021 29/07/22, 13:30 Governor: These two years that we have been hit by pandemics, we have taken some measures which I mentioned and as achievements and realizations. We've had two main directions in terms of lending activity. The first was the 3-month moratorium for delaying the payment of loan installments, for those customers who have been hit by pandemics. This has not affected all customers 100%, but still a large number over 50% have been. Second, were regulatory changes to stimulate banks to have a more practical restructuring in the creditor assessment process. Both of these elements significantly influenced the performance of the banking sector, not only of this sector but also of business. Banks helped businesses in the first place, the population, individuals and themselves to manage the pandemic situation. These were not measures that were taken only by us, were not invented, these were measures that were applied in one form or another in the countries of the region, and in developed states. But there was no amnesty at this point. About 7 years ago we had a level of bad loans at 25%, while today we are at the 6.2% level. As a result of the plan of measures undertaken by the Bank of Albania and the Albanian government troubled loans have gradually declined, and of course the decline has been made in several main directions, such as proactive restructuring, the deletion from the balance of lost loans and other measures undertaken by second-rate banks under the orientation and direction of the Bank of Albania's plan of measures. Troubled loans have declined fortunately, but the appetite for credit has also increased from the other side. We have been in difficult economic periods, we have been under constant crisis strikes since the Greek crisis, floods, earthquakes, pandemics, and in turn, the economy has been constantly under shock and we have been constantly attentive to manage troubled loans, in order to ensure good performance of the financial sector and banking sector, And fortunately, despite the blows, the financial sector and banks have performed in managing troubled loans. No loans have been amnestyd. Loans wiped from balancesheets have been managed and they have been pursued, but have not been forgiven as loans. Banks have negotiated, restructured, managed the portfolio of troubled loans, in the function of their performance and profitability, often even in aid of businesses and individuals in financial difficulty. In relation to loans, since you asked me the question, it is very important the performance of the financial system as it affects economic growth. The performance of banks affects financial stability, guaranteeing deposits of Albanian citizens and businesses, but mainly albanian citizens as individuals have the bulk of deposits. On the other hand, businesses and individuals themselves must be clear that lending is done with these funds. So correctness in relation to respecting contracts to banks should be primary. If we don't have the correctness in respecting contracts, then we certainly can't claim the same from the banks. We often notice that there is a lack of correctness in the implementation of contracts and an expectation that is unjustified  e_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_22_dhjetor_2021.html Page 2 of 5 Questions from the press conference dated December 22, 2021 29/07/22, 13:30 legally and from business principles. Practically, banks restructure and negotiate in cases of business difficulties, but in other cases the loan contract must be respected and this is a fundamental principle. Q: Inflation in the third quarter has been higher even than the Bank of Albania's expectations and the rate you have as a target. How will this inflation be managed, albeit temporary? Governor: The inflation situation is changing after many years. Economies have been on easing monetary policies, low interest rates and inflation below the target level. The situation of recent years has been deflationary and all of a sudden after the pandemic as a result of the supply shocks we have increased inflation. Energy, transport, oil prices, which are then reflected in food prices and all other products, have consequently increased. In the largest economies of Eurozone, the U.S., and consequently even those in our region, these prices will certainly be reflected. Central banks have generally thought that this inflation is transient and we continue to think that supply shocks will gradually balance in the following months, but that does not mean that inflation will return to levels before this period, so certainly inflation will continue to remain higher than it was. In the monetary policy statement, the Supervisory Council stressed that our target of 3% could be exceedable, so we have inflation at the 3.2% level, it can go up to 3.6% forecast. This is to be seen, as there are forecasts that vary and at the end of 2022 we anticipate that we will be on our inflation target of 3%. The factual performance of inflation is what will impose on us the change of monetary policy. Of course, at a certain moment we will start normalising monetary policy, try if inflation does not have strong shocks and is within our forecast, continue with a monetary policy easing as long as we think the Albanian economy continues to need monetary stimulus. The low interest rate will continue to affect lending activity, help Albanian businesses, borrowers and citizens, as well as affect investment and consumption growth. If we do not have unforeseen strong inflation shocks in the following months we will try to continue with this monetary policy, but certainly in a near time the normalization of monetary policy will come. Many banks in Eastern and Central European countries have already begun to gradually change the course of monetary policy, initiated and by the fact that the level of inflation in these states has been much higher than the level of inflation in Albania. We see that in more developed states as in the UNITED Kingdom inflation is approaching 5% level, in the US inflation has risen above the 6% level. We stressed that we will monitor the situation and react with monetary policy in respect of the inflation target.  e_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_22_dhjetor_2021.html Page 3 of 5 Questions from the press conference dated December 22, 2021 29/07/22, 13:30 Q: Since you have also been dealt with this year with the regulation that must be given to microcredit institutions for the floor and ceiling level. What stage are you at and when will this be defined for these institutions? When are you going to introduce it as a regulation? Governor: The Bank of Albania has set a limit ceiling on the interest rates of nonbank financial institutions. This has come to limit both interest rates and penalties (interest-delays) so as not to indefinitely burden banks' customers. So to do a softening of the price of credit from these institutions. The regulation will come into force in the coming year. We are consulting with microcredit institutions. They are working and evaluating the regulation. Of course there are some technical elements that are being discussed with the Supervision Department of the Bank of Albania and certainly at the moment that all the vaguenesses of the technical elements pertaining to calculating the effective interest rate, etc., will then be determined correctly and the month of the beginning of the application of these restrictions. But it's all in collaboration with microcredit institutions. The Bank of Albania is cooperative, partnered, not only supervisory and regulatory, but also partners of these institutions  institutions that we license, and we will certainly impose a tight measure, when the conditions for applying this measure are complete. Q: The deeuroization process, how has this process been processed and what impact has there been in the results of the banking system? Governor: The deeuroisation process is one of the strategic plans of the Bank of Albania undertaken several years ago. In this regard, the Bank of Albania has undertaken a series of measures dealing with currency reserve lending, liquidity, but also transparency to the public regarding the currency with which the loan is taken. Our measures have targeted customer awareness to receive bank loans in that currency they have and their income. Since often in the past a tendency has been noticed to take the loan into the euro, when the income is generated in the money. To avoid the risk of exchange rate, in these cases we have cooperated closely with second-rate banks and financial institutions not banks so that customers are clear. We have a high level of euroisation in both the financial system and the real economy. The deeuroisation process aims to have as good a management as possible, but not avoiding the euro currency. We are clear that the euro will continue to be used. As a consequence of the plan of measures for deeuroisation there have been results, especially in the bank loan direction we have a marked increase in credit in the local currency. But I can't say that on the deposit side as deposits in euros have continued to rise. So the deeuroisation process has resulted in the increase in loans in money, and of course, and this has come as a result of the public's awareness of taking the loan in the local currency as it costs cheaper and avoids the risk of exchange rate.  e_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_22_dhjetor_2021.html Page 4 of 5 Questions from the press conference dated December 22, 2021 29/07/22, 13:30 From the other side, in co-operation with the Ministry of Finance we will continue to take measures to implement laws in the Republic of Albania and impose payments on money in internal trade, as the national currency in Albania is leash and there is no need to use euros in the sale of products within albania's territory. Wherever we go to border countries but also in developed countries, selling on the retail and wholesale trade network is done in local currency, while foreign currency is exchanged in foreign exchange offices or in the bank, so it is not used for purchases. However, the results from deeuroisation have been positive, have had effects and in the next meeting we have with the Ministry of Finance and the Financial Stability Advisory Group we will make a summary of the results of the deeuroisation process and continue to determine the milestones and strategy to continue and pursue this process further.  e_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_22_dhjetor_2021.html Page 5 of 5

Muz dhe Eduk " Kreu / Shtypi / Fjalime, intervista, artikuj / Fjalime Njoftimet pr shtyp Njoftime t # mbledhjeve t Kshillit Mbikqyrs Konferenca pr shtyp Fjalime, $ intervista, artikuj Fjalime Intervista e artikuj Kalendar # Kalendari i festave zyrtare pr vitin 2022 COVID-19 Evropa # BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Pyetje prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp t dats 22 dhjetor 2021 Data e publikimit: 22.12.2021 Pyetja: Z. Guvernator ju that q n vitin 2022 do t bni presion pr rritjen e pags. Si do ta bni kt presion? Si do t ndodh kjo? Guvernatori: Lidhur me presionin pr rritjen e pagave, Banka e Shqipris nuk bn presion direkt. Banka e Shqipris nprmjet politiks s saj monetare prpiqet dhe synon stimulimin e investimeve, kreditimit dhe konsumit. Kjo bhet nprmjet krijimit t kushteve pr rritjen e kreditimit me norma t ulta interesi, njkohsisht edhe me orientimin e investimeve drejt burimeve me t ardhura m t qndrueshme dhe m t mira ekonomike. Sigurisht q n raport me impaktin q ka politika monetare e Banks s Shqipris, stimuluese ose shtrnguese n varsi t situatave t ndryshme ekonomike, kjo reflektohet n rritjen e aktivitetit ekonomik t vendit. Rrjedhimisht me rritjen e aktivitetit ekonomik do t ket dhe rritje t pagave. Kryesisht, rritja e pagave sht pasoj m e drejtprdrejt e politiks fiskale sesa e politiks monetare. Prgjithsisht, politikat dhe reformat e ndrmarra nga ana e qeveris reflektohen n rritjen e pagave, ndrkoh q politika monetare ndihmon pikrisht n kt drejtim. Me politikn ton monetare, synohet nj nivel i caktuar inflacioni pr t ruajtur stabilitetin e mimeve, pr t pasur nj kontroll mbi mimet. Njkohsisht synohet edhe nj menaxhim dhe regjim i mir i kursit t kmbimit, pasi ne kemi nj regjim t lir t tij dhe mund t mbahet nn kontroll por jo me ndrhyrje, n mnyr q kursi i kmbimit t mos godas shtresat e ndryshme qoft t popullsis, qoft t biznesit. Pyetje: Duke qene se ka rn dhe numri i kredive t kqija, a pati amnisti? https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjae_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_22_dhjetor_2021.html Pagina 1 di 5 Pyetje prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp t dats 22 dhjetor 2021 29/07/22, 13:30 Guvernatori: Kto dy vite q ne jemi goditur nga pandemia, ne kemi marr disa masa t cilat un i prmenda dhe si arritje dhe realizime. Kemi patur dy drejtime kryesore lidhur me aktivitetin kreditues. E para, ka qen moratoriumi 3-mujor pr shtyrjen e pagess s ksteve t kredive, pr ata klient q kan qen t goditur nga pandemia. Kjo nuk ka prekur gjith klientt 100%, por gjithsesi nj numr i madh mbi 50% kan qen. E dyta, ishin ndryshimet rregullative pr t stimuluar bankat pr t pasur nj ristrukturim m praktik n procesin e vlersimit t kredimarrsve. T dy kto element ndikuan ndjeshm n performancn e sektorit bankar, jo vetm t ktij sektori por edhe t biznesit. Bankat ndihmuan bizneset n radh t par, popullsin, individt dhe veten e tyre pr t menaxhuar situatn e pandemis. Kto nuk ishin masa q u morn vetm nga ne, nuk ishin t shpikura, kto ishin masa q ishin aplikuar n nj form apo tjetr n vendet e rajonit, dhe n shtete t zhvilluara. Por nuk ka pasur amnisti n kt pik. Para rreth 7 vitesh ne kishim nj nivel t kredive t kqija n shifrn 25%, ndrsa sot jemi n nivelin 6.2%. Si pasoj e planit t masave t ndrmarra nga Banka e Shqipris dhe qeveria shqiptare kredit me probleme kan rn gradualisht, dhe sigurisht rnia sht br n disa drejtime kryesore, si ka qen ristrukturimi proaktiv, fshirja nga bilanci i kredive t humbura dhe masa t tjera t ndrmarra nga bankat e nivelit t dyt nn orientimin dhe drejtimin e planit t masave t Banks s Shqipris. Kredit me probleme kan rn fatmirsisht, por nga krahu tjetr sht rritur edhe oreksi pr kredi. Ne kemi qen n periudha t vshtira ekonomike, kemi qen nn goditje t vazhdueshme krizash q nga kriza greke, prmbytjet, trmeti, pandemia, e me radh, ekonomia ka qen vazhdimisht nn goditje dhe ne kemi qen vazhdimisht t vmendshm pr t menaxhuar kredit me probleme, n mnyr q t sigurojm performanc t mir t sektorit financiar dhe sektorit bankar, dhe fatmirsisht, me gjith goditjet, sektori financiar dhe bankat kan performuar n menaxhimin e kredive me probleme. Nuk jan amnistuar kredit. Kredit e fshira nga bilancet jan menaxhuar dhe ato, jan ndjekur, por nuk jan falur si kredi. Bankat kan negociuar, kan ristrukturuar, kan menaxhuar portofolin e kredive me probleme, n funksion t performancs dhe t prfitueshmris s tyre, shpeshher edhe n ndihm t bizneseve dhe individve n vshtirsi financiare. N raport me kredit, meq ju ma bt pyetjen, sht shum e rndsishme performanca e sistemit financiar pasi ndikon n rritjen ekonomike. Performanca e bankave ndikon n stabilitetin financiar, n garantimin e depozitave t qytetarve shqiptare dhe t bizneseve, por kryesisht t qytetarve shqiptar pasi individt kan pjesn m t madhe t depozitave. Nga ana tjetr dhe vet bizneset dhe individt duhet t jen t qart q kreditimi bhet me kto fonde. Pra, korrektesa n raport me respektimin e kontratave ndaj bankave duhet t jet primare. Nse ne nuk kemi korrektes n respektimin e kontratave, ather q sigurisht q nuk mund t pretendojm dhe nga bankat t njjtn gj. Praktikisht, bankat ristrukturojn dhe negociojn n raste t vshtirsive t biznesit, por n raste t tjera kontrata e kredis duhet respektuar dhe ky sht parim themelor. Pyetje: Inflacioni n tremujorin e tret ka qen m i lart edhe se pritshmrit e Banks s Shqipris edhe t norms q ju keni si target. Si do t menaxhohet ky inflacion edhe pse i prkohshm? Guvernatori: Situata e inflacionit po ndryshon pas shum vitesh. Ekonomit kan qen me politika monetare lehtsuese, me norma t ulta interesi dhe me nj inflacion posht nivelit t targetuar. Situata e viteve t fundit ka qen deflacioniste dhe krejt papritur pas pandemis si pasoj e goditjeve t oferts kemi nj inflacion t rritur. mimet e energjis, t transportit, t nafts t cilat jan reflektuar pastaj n mimet e ushqimeve dhe t gjith produkteve t tjera, rrjedhimisht jan rritur. N ekonomit m t mdha, t Eurozons, t SHBA-s dhe rrjedhimisht edhe n ato t rajonit ton do t reflektohen kto mime sigurisht. Bankat qendrore prgjithsisht kan menduar q ky inflacion sht kalimtar dhe ne vazhdojm t mendojm q goditjet e oferts do t balancohen gradualisht n muajt n vijim, por kjo nuk do t thot q inflacioni do t kthehet n nivelet e para ksaj periudhe, pra sigurisht q inflacioni do t vazhdoj t mbetet m i lart se ishte. N deklaratn e politiks monetare, Kshilli Mbikqyrs e theksoi q objektivi yn prej 3% mund t jet i tejkalueshm, pra ne kemi nj inflacion n nivelin e 3.2%, mund t shkoj deri n 3.6% parashikimi. Kjo sht pr tu par, pasi jan parashikime t cilat variojn dhe n fund t vitit 2022 ne parashikojm q t jemi n objektivin ton t inflacionit prej 3%. Ecuria faktike e inflacionit sht ajo q do t na imponoj ndryshimin e kahut t politiks monetare. Natyrisht q n nj moment t caktuar ne do t fillojm normalizimin e politiks monetare, do t prpiqemi n rast se inflacioni nuk do t ket goditje t forta dhe do t jet brenda parashikimit ton, t vazhdojm me nj politik monetare lehtsuese sa m gjat pasi ne mendojm q ekonomia shqiptare vazhdon t ket nevoj pr stimul monetar. Norma e ult e interesit do t vazhdoj t ndikoj n aktivitetin kreditues, t ndihmoj bizneset, huamarrsit dhe qytetart shqiptar, po ashtu do t ndikoj n rritjen e investimeve dhe t konsumit. Nse nuk do t kemi goditje t forta t paparashikuara t inflacionit n muajt n vijim do t prpiqemi t vazhdojm me kt politik monetare, por sigurisht n nj koh t afrt normalizimi i politiks monetare do t vij. Shum banka t vendeve t Evrops Lindore dhe Qendrore kan filluar tashm t ndryshojn gradualisht kursin e politiks monetare, nisur dhe nga fakti q niveli i inflacionit n kto shtete ka qen shum m i lart se niveli i inflacionit n Shqipri. Ne shohim q n shtete m t zhvilluara si n Mbretrin e Bashkuar inflacioni po i afrohet nivelit 5%, n SHBA inflacioni ka dal mbi nivelin 6%. Ne e theksuam q do t monitorojm situatn dhe do t reagojm me politikn monetare n respektim t objektivit t inflacionit. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjae_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_22_dhjetor_2021.html Pagina 3 di 5 Pyetje prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp t dats 22 dhjetor 2021 29/07/22, 13:30 Pyetje: Duke qen se ju edhe kt vit jeni marr me rregulloren q duhet t jepet pr institucionet e mikrokredis pr nivelin dysheme dhe tavan. N far faze jeni dhe kur do t jet kjo e prcaktuar pr kto institucione? Kur do tjua prezantoni si rregullore? Guvernatori: Banka e Shqipris ka vn nj tavan limit mbi normat e interesit t institucioneve financiare jobanka. Kjo ka ardhur pr t kufizuar si normat e interesit ashtu edhe penalitetet (interes-vonesat) pr t mos rnduar pafundsisht klientt e bankave. Pra, pr t br nj zbutje t mimit t kredis nga kto institucione. Rregullorja do t hyj n fuqi vitin q vjen. Ne jemi duke u konsultuar me institucionet e mikrokredis. Ato jan duke punuar dhe vlersuar rregulloren. Sigurisht q ka disa elemente teknik t cilt po diskutohen me Departamentin e Mbikqyrjes s Banks s Shqipris dhe sigurisht n momentin q do t ezaurohen dhe do t sheshohen t gjitha paqartsit e elementeve teknik q kan t bjn me llogaritjen e norms efektive t interesit, etj., ather do t prcaktohet sakt dhe muaji i fillimit t aplikimit t ktyre kufizimeve. Por, gjithka sht n bashkpunim me institucionet e mikrokredis. Banka e Shqipris sht bashkpunuese, sht partnere, jo vetm mbikqyrse dhe rregullatore, por edhe partnere e ktyre institucioneve  institucione q ne licencojm, dhe sigurisht q do t imponojm nj mas t shtrnguar, ather kur t jen t plota kushtet pr aplikimin e ksaj mase. Pyetje: Procesi i deuroizimit, si ka vijuar ky proces dhe far impakti ka pasur ne rezultatet e sistemit bankar? Guvernatori: Procesi i deuroizimit sht nj nga planet strategjike t Banks s Shqipris t ndrmarr para disa vitesh. Lidhur me kt, Banka e Shqipris ka ndrmarr nj sr masash q kan t bjn me ponderimin e rezervs valutore, me likuiditetin, por edhe me transparencn ndaj publikut lidhur me monedhn me t ciln merret kredia. Masat tona kan synuar ndrgjegjsimin e klientve pr t marr kredi bankare n at monedh q kan dhe t ardhurat e tyre. Pasi shpeshher n t kaluarn sht vn re nj tendenc pr ta marr kredin n euro, kur t ardhurat jan t gjeneruara n lek. Pr t shmangur rrezikun e kursit t kmbimit, n kto raste ne kemi bashkpunuar ngusht me bankat e nivelit t dyt dhe institucionet financiare jo banka n mnyr q klientt t jen t qart. Ne kemi nj nivel t lart euroizimi si n sistemin financiar ashtu dhe n ekonomin reale. Procesi i deuroizimit synon t ket nj menaxhim sa m t mir, por jo shmangien e monedhs euro. Ne jemi t qart q euro do t vazhdoj t prdoret. Si pasoj e planit t masave pr deuroizimin ka patur rezultate, veanrisht n kahun e kredis bankare ne kemi nj rritje t theksuar t kredis n monedhn vendase. Por kt nuk mund ta them n kahun e depozitave pasi depozitat n euro kan vazhduar t rriten. Pra procesi i deuroizimit ka dhn rezultat n aspektin e rritjes s kredive n lek dhe sigurisht dhe kjo ka ardhur si pasoj e ndrgjegjsimit t publikut pr ta marr kredin n monedhn vendase pasi kushton m lir dhe shmang rrezikun e kursit t kmbimit. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjae_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_te_dates_22_dhjetor_2021.html Pagina 4 di 5 Pyetje prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp t dats 22 dhjetor 2021 29/07/22, 13:30 Nga krahu tjetr, n bashkpunim me Ministrin e Financave ne do t vazhdojm t marrim masa pr t zbatuar ligjet n Republikn e Shqipris dhe pr t imponuar kryerjen e pagesave n lek n tregtin e brendshme, pasi monedha kombtare n Shqipri sht leku dhe nuk ka nevoj t prdoret euro n shitblerjen e produkteve brenda territorit t Shqipris. Kudo q shkojm n vendet kufitare por dhe n vendet e zhvilluara, shitblerja n rrjetin e tregtis me pakic dhe shumic bhet n monedhn vendase, ndrsa monedhn e huaj e kmben n zyrat e kmbimit valutor ose n bank, pra nuk prdoret pr shitblerjet. Gjithsesi, rezultatet nga deeuroizimi kan qen pozitive, kan pasur efekte dhe n mbledhjen e radhs q ne kemi me Ministrin e Financave dhe Grupin Kshillimor t Stabilitetit Financiar do t bjm nj rezyme t rezultateve t procesit t deeuroizimi dhe do t vazhdojm t prcaktojm piketat dhe strategjin pr t vazhduar dhe pr ta ndjekur m tej kt proces.
