Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, December 22, 2021 29/07/22, 13:30 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, December 22, 2021 Publication date: 22.12.2021 Honourable media representatives, Today, at the meeting dated 22 December 2021, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Intermediate Monetary Policy Report. Analysis of available information shows the continuation of recovery of economic activity in the country, improved labour market indicators, but also a rapid rise in inflation over the past two months. Rising oil, energy and food prices on the world market have begun to reflect - directly and indirectly - on the prices of consumer items in the country. These strikes are created by a Page 1 of 7 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, December 22, 2021 29/07/22, 13:30 temporary imbalance of demand and supply. Under these circumstances, their effect will be present and during the first half of the following year, but - further - it will come towards reduction. In the basic scenario, converging the economy into balance and reducing the effect of supply shocks will enable inflation to return to target during the second half of 2022. Based on the above, the Supervisory Council estimated that the current monetary policy position remains appropriate. Next, let me clarify the report's conclusions in more detail. The new information received in the analysis has generally been in line with our expectations. Inflation in the country marked a rapid rise, capturing 3.1% value in the month of November. The rising inflation trend during 2021 has been dictated by rising demand, employment and wages. However, the rise in inflation during the fourth quarter mainly reflects the effect of significant increases in food, oil and energy prices on world markets. This blow is expected to keep inflation above our target over the following months. Furthermore, we look forward to rebalancing the demand-to-supply ratio in global markets, solving logistical problems and stabilizing the price of energy. This performance will ease inflationary pressures and reduce the effect of foreign prices on inflation in the country. Economic activity has increased at rapid pace during 2021, and growth sources have had a broad basis. Gross domestic product expanded by 11.7% in the first six months, driven by increased consumption and investment, private and public, as well as increased exports of goods and services. Although the new information remains partial and indirect, it suggests further growth in the economy in the second six months. However, while the strong effect of the comparison base with 2020 will come towards reduction, economic growth rates are expected to be lower and fluctuate around the potential level. Page 2 of 7 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, December 22, 2021 29/07/22, 13:30 The expansion of economic activity has been associated with the improvement of the labour market. During the third quarter, employment increased by 0.7%, the unemployment rate decreased to 11.3%, while the average salary marked an annual increase of 6.9%. Improving labour market indicators and increasing job demand reported by businesses suggest that pressures for wage growth will be strengthened in the future. Economic growth is supported by increased confidence in the economy, improved foreign environment, as well as domestic economic stimulus policies. This wide range of factors promises a sustainability of economic growth in the future. Monetary stimulus policy has lowered financing costs, boosted credit growth and helped ease the financial situation of borrowers. In this way, it has supported the expansion of economic activity and has created the preconditions for turning inflation to target. Credit interest rates for businesses and individuals have remained at low levels, reflecting the good liquidity situation, contained risk premiums and banks' supportive approach to their customers. Likewise, the exchange rate has been characterized by two-fold fluctuations over the past two months. Page 3 of 7 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, December 22, 2021 29/07/22, 13:30 Bank credit has recorded high growth rates, increasingly supporting growth in consumption and investment. The volume of credit for the private sector recorded an 11% annual increase in the month of November. Credit growth is observed both in businesses and individuals, both for investment purposes and for covering short-term needs, both in money and in currencies. Rising demand for loans, reported in monitoring lending activity, easing lending conditions, and the good health of the banking industry suggests a good ongoing credit performance. In particular, the 6.2% drop in the ratio of troubled loans in November illustrates both the increase in the paying capacity of businesses and households and the improved health of the bank sector's balance sheets. Rapid revenue growth and softening the pace of primary spending growth have brought a slowdown in fiscal momentum in recent months. However, the accumulated high level of spending and budget deficit in December implies a possible increase in fiscal stimulus in the economy. The Bank of Albania considers that consolidating fiscal policy in the future is not only reasonable, in the conditions of strengthening recovery sustainability, as well as necessary, to increase the space for coping with potential future shocks and empowering the country's macroeconomic stability. Fiscal stimulus policy has supported the growth of the economy, albeit to a lower extent from a year ago. Rapid revenue growth and softening rates of primary spending growth have brought a slowdown in fiscal momentum in recent months. However, the accumulated high level of spending and budget deficit in December implies a possible increase in fiscal stimulus in the economy. *** Our projections for the future remain positive. In the medium term, the growth of the economy is expected to be supported by favourable financing conditions, improved private sector confidence and balance sheets, and gradual normalization of economic activity in partner countries. These factors are expected to drive growth in consumption, investment and exports. Expanding economic activity will be associated with more dynamic employment, wage and other production costs growth, strengthening domestic inflationary pressures. Supported by them, inflation is forecast to return steadily to the 3% target at the end of 2022, and stay close to it in the medium term. On the other hand, foreign supply shocks will dictate above-target inflation values in the short term, but their effect is expected to be fleeting anyway. The balance of risks around inflation appears shifted upwards in the short term and balanced in the medium term. On the one hand, faster or longer price growth in international markets, as well as a slower pace of fiscal consolidation, pose upper-cap risks to inflation. On the other hand, a slower recovery of the world and Albanian economy, as a result of the timely extension of the pandemic or the rapid tightening of monetary conditions in international markets, poses a risk of lower growth above inflation. Page 4 of 7 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, December 22, 2021 29/07/22, 13:30 *** Judging on the above, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania assessed that the current monetary policy position remains appropriate. Monetary stimulus helps increase demand for goods and services, offsets the expected reduction in fiscal stimulus, and creates premise for rising employment, wages and inflation in line with our target. For this reason, the Supervisory Council decided: leave the basic interest rate unchanged at 0.5%; leave deposit and one-day loan interest rates unchanged, at 0.1% and 0.9%, respectively. At the same time, the Supervisory Council estimates that meeting the inflation target in the medium term will require gradual normalization of monetary policy during the following period. This normalization is expected to begin over the following quarters. Reducing monetary stimulus guarantees compliance with our inflation target and creates premise for more stable economic growth in the medium and long term. However, the Supervisory Council notes that the balance of risks around inflation continues to remain in the upper direction, dictated by the duration and intensity of the supply shock in world markets. As above, the Supervisory Council stresses that it will carefully monitor the performance of inflation and its defining factors, to ensure - under any circumstances - the appropriateness of monetary policy stance with the achievement of the inflation target. *** Honored media representatives, At the end of this communication, taking advantage of the fact that this meeting is the last for this year, let me share with you a short mirror of the work of the Bank of Albania during the year we are leaving behind. The last two years have been unprecedented and challenging for the economy and the Bank of Albania. However, I gladly state that the diti institution rises to the height of the challenges and successfully fulfilled its legal duties. As I mentioned in the first part of my word, the monetary stimulus policy pursued by the Bank of Albania has made an important contribution to the process of recovering the economy, following the pandemic blow. However, this policy has been coupled with an intensive decision by the Bank of Albania towards the supervision, licensing and regulation of banking activity. The core of our supervisory activity has been the revision of the regulatory framework, to minimize the consequences created by the pandemic, but also to follow the work for the convergence of our regulations and working practices with the best international standards. In the context of the pandemic, the Bank of Albania: Page 5 of 7 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, December 22, 2021 29/07/22, 13:30 approved the suspension until the end of December 2021, the distribution of 2020 profit and profit to be realized during 2021 in the banking industry; implemented some temporary regulatory changes, which delayed payments or facilitated the process of restructuring loans, for those businesses and individuals put in financial difficulties by the pandemic. In parallel with them, over the last year, the Bank of Albania has been working to implement its duties in the context of licensing, supervision and regulation of the banking sector. Find it appropriate to highlight the further progress we marked in the area of consolidation of the banking industry with: the proposed absorption of alpha bank by the OTP Bank; continued co-operation with counterpart authorities, within the framework of supervisory colleges and the fight against money laundering; as well as following work on the drafting and revision of the supervisory regulatory framework, aiming at its continued approximation of the EU acquis and the standards of the Basel Committee. The last two years have marked developments in the field of extraordinary intervention in banks, complementing the regulatory and methodological framework of extraordinary intervention with other sublegal acts and methodological documents, in harmony with the European regulatory framework, as well as fully preparing extraordinary intervention plans for all banking sector banks. In the field of special attention payment systems is dedicated to meeting the strategic goal of promoting the financial involvement of the population and the use of electronic payment instruments. Legal and regulatory interventions, infrastructural developments undertaken from 2018 to date, within the framework of the National Small Value Payment Strategy, as well as the operationalisation of the Euro payment atonement system domestically, have resulted in success, while their impact is expected to become and more vulnerable in the following years. The Bank of Albania has been working on the management of the currency reserve, in line with the basic objectives of its investment: liquidity and security. In this direction, I find it appropriate to stress that during 2021 the signing of the new agreement with the European Central Bank, represented by the Bank of France, was finalized for the approval of a collateralized credit line for the sum of 400m euros. Despite the difficulties created, throughout the period, the Bank of Albania has continued to contribute responsibly to the country's European integration process, in all its dimensions. More specifically, a high degree of fulfillment of commitments stemming from the National Country Integration Plan has been enabled, as well as an active participation in all meetings with the relevant EU subcommittees. Communication with the public has been a constant priority of the Bank of Albania. At the heart of our work has also been the implementation of a responsible and transparent communication policy, in order to ensure that the duties and activities of the institution are fairly understood by the general public. For this reason, the National Bank of Austria, in its report entitled "Focus on European Economic Integration" for the second quarter of 2021, where it analysed the transparency and communication of central banks of Central, Eastern and Southeast Europe with the public, ranked the Bank of Albania in first place. Page 6 of 7 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, December 22, 2021 29/07/22, 13:30 The issue of the note, its physical security and the management of physical money, constitutes another important direction of our activity. The Bank of Albania successfully faced the emergency situation created due to the pandemic. In June 2021, an agreement was signed with the ECB to protect the Euro banknote from counterfeiting, making the Bank of Albania an integral part of the European process in the fight against banknote counterfeiting. Also, we've done the job of filling out the new series of banknotes. In June 2021, another 2 cuts, that 1,000 and 10,000 money, were thrown into circulation. The addition of the latter, i.e. the banknote with the largest cut in the value of 10,000 money, also represents a novelty in the process of producing our money. At the same time, it is worth noting that in 2021, we produced the last 2 banknotes of the series, those with cuts of 500 and 2000 Money, which are expected to be released in the following days, eventually completing our new series of banknotes, consisting of 6 cuts. Starting on January 17, 2022, the new banknotes will be in the hands of the public and circulate in parallel with the current series banknotes. They are designed and produced with the latest field technology and are equipped with contemporary and sophisticated security elements. Meeting the objectives and results of the Bank of Albania would not be possible without the vision, leadership and dedication of the Supervisory Council. This Council has guaranteed the institution's work, as well as has directed and led the drafting of the Bank of Albania's Medium-Term Development Strategy. In his work, the Council was also assisted by the Internal Audit. This important function was certified in accordance with international internal auditing standards, as well as fulfilling planned audit commitments. In conclusion, I take the opportunity to stress that the Bank of Albania will continue to be a careful supervisor of the country's economic and financial reality. Many challenges still remain before us, but what I gladly state is that our institution is capable of facing them. Hoping that 2022 will bring the end of the pandemic and return to normality of social and economic life, let me stress that the Bank of Albania will be fully committed to taking the measures agreed in fulfilling its legal mission! Informacioni i ri i marr n analiz ka qen n prgjithsi n prputhje me pritjet tona. Inflacioni n vend shnoi nj rritje t shpejt, duke kapur vlern 3.1% n muajin nntor. Trendi rrits i inflacionit gjat vitit 2021 sht diktuar nga rritja e krkess, e punsimit dhe e pagave. Megjithat, rritja e inflacionit gjat tremujorit t katrt pasqyron kryesisht efektin e rritjes s ndjeshme t mimeve t ushqimeve, t nafts dhe t energjis n tregjet botrore. Kjo goditje pritet ta mbaj inflacionin mbi objektivin ton gjat muajve n vijim. M tej, ne presim riekuilibrimin e raportit krkes-ofert n tregjet botrore, zgjidhjen e problemeve logjistike dhe stabilizimin e mimit t energjis. Kjo ecuri do t lehtsoj presionet inflacioniste dhe do t reduktoj efektin e mimeve t huaja n inflacionin n vend. Aktiviteti ekonomik sht rritur me ritme t shpejta gjat vitit 2021, dhe burimet e rritjes kan pasur nj baz t gjer. Prodhimi i brendshm bruto u zgjerua me 11.7% n gjashtmujorin e par, i nxitur nga rritja e konsumit dhe e investimeve, private e publike, si dhe nga rritja e eksporteve t mallrave dhe shrbimeve. Ndonse informacioni i ri mbetet i pjesshm dhe i trthort, ai sugjeron rritje t mtejshme t ekonomis n gjashtmujorin e dyt. Megjithat, ndrsa efekti i fort i bazs krahasuese me vitin 2020 do t vij drejt reduktimit, normat e rritjes ekonomike priten t jen m t ulta dhe t luhaten rreth nivelit potencial. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fj_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_22_dhjetor_2021.html Pagina 2 di 7 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 22 dhjetor 2021 29/07/22, 13:30 Zgjerimi i aktivitetit ekonomik sht shoqruar me prmirsimin e tregut t puns. Gjat tremujorit t tret, punsimi u rrit me 0.7%, shkalla e papunsis zbriti n 11.3%, ndrsa paga mesatare shnoi nj rritje vjetore prej 6.9%. Prmirsimi i treguesve t tregut t puns dhe rritja e krkess pr pun e raportuar nga bizneset sugjerojn se presionet pr rritjen e pagave do t vijojn t forcohen n t ardhmen. Rritja ekonomike sht mbshtetur nga rritja e besimit n ekonomi, nga prmirsimi i ambientit t huaj, si dhe nga politikat e brendshme stimuluese ekonomike. Kjo gam e gjer faktorsh premton nj qndrueshmri t rritjes ekonomike n t ardhmen. Politika monetare stimuluese ka ulur kostot e financimit, ka nxitur rritjen e kredis dhe ka ndihmuar n lehtsimin e gjendjes financiare t huamarrsve. N kt mnyr, ajo ka mbshtetur zgjerimin e aktivitetit ekonomik dhe ka krijuar parakushtet pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv. Normat e interesit t kredis pr bizneset dhe individt kan mbetur n nivele t ulta, n reflektim t gjendjes s mir t likuiditetit, primeve t prmbajtura t rrezikut dhe prqasjes mbshtetse t bankave pr klientt e tyre. Po ashtu, kursi i kmbimit sht karakterizuar nga luhatje t dykahshme gjat dy muajve t fundit. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fj_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_22_dhjetor_2021.html Pagina 3 di 7 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 22 dhjetor 2021 29/07/22, 13:30 Kredia bankare ka regjistruar norma t larta rritjeje, duke mbshtetur gjithmon e m shum rritjen e konsumit dhe t investimeve. Vllimi i kredis pr sektorin privat regjistroi nj rritje vjetore me 11% n muajin nntor. Rritja e kredis vrehet si tek bizneset dhe individt, si pr qllime investimi ashtu edhe pr mbulimin e nevojave afatshkurtra, si n lek edhe n valut. Rritja e krkess pr kredi, e raportuar tek vrojtimi i aktivitetit kreditues, lehtsimi i kushteve t kreditimit, dhe shndeti i mir i industris bankare sugjeron pr nj ecuri t mir t kredis n vazhdim. N veanti, rnia n nivelin 6.2% e raportit t kredive me probleme n muajin nntor, ilustron si rritjen e aftsis paguese t bizneseve dhe familjeve ashtu dhe shndetin e prmirsuar t bilanceve t sektorit bankar. Rritja e shpejt e t ardhurave dhe zbutja e ritmit t rritjes s shpenzimeve primare, kan sjell nj ngadalsim t impulsit fiskal gjat muajve t fundit. Megjithat, niveli i lart i akumuluar i shpenzimeve dhe i deficitit buxhetor n muajin dhjetor, nnkupton nj rritje t mundshme t stimulit fiskal n ekonomi. Banka e Shqipris gjykon se konsolidimi i politiks fiskale n t ardhmen sht jo vetm i arsyeshm, n kushtet e forcimit t qndrueshmris s rimkmbjes, po edhe i nevojshm, pr t rritur hapsirn pr prballimin e goditjeve potenciale n t ardhmen dhe fuqizimin e stabilitetit makroekonomik t vendit. Politika fiskale stimuluese ka mbshtetur rritjen e ekonomis, ndonse n nj mas m t ult nga nj vit m par. Rritja e shpejt e t ardhurave dhe zbutja e ritmeve t rritjes s shpenzimeve primare, kan sjell nj ngadalsim t impulsit fiskal gjat muajve t fundit. N afatin e mesm, rritja e ekonomis pritet t mbshtetet nga kushtet e favorshme t financimit, prmirsimi i besimit dhe i bilanceve t sektorit privat, dhe nga normalizimi gradual i aktivitetit ekonomik n vendet partnere. Kta faktor pritet t nxitin rritjen e konsumit, t investimeve dhe t eksporteve. Zgjerimi i aktivitetit ekonomik do t shoqrohet me rritjen m dinamike t punsimit, pagave dhe t kostove t tjera t prodhimit, duke forcuar presionet e brendshme inflacioniste. I mbshtetur prej tyre, inflacioni parashikohet t kthehet n mnyr t qndrueshme tek objektivi 3% n fund t vitit 2022, dhe t qndroj pran tij n afatin e mesm. N t njjtn koh, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlerson se prmbushja e objektivit t inflacionit n afatin e mesm do t krkoj normalizimin gradual t politiks monetare gjat periudhs n vijim. Ky normalizim pritet t filloj gjat tremujorve n vijim. Reduktimi i stimulit monetar garanton respektimin e objektivit ton t inflacionit dhe krijon premisa pr nj rritje m t qndrueshme ekonomike n afatin e mesm e t gjat. Megjithat, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vren se balanca e rreziqeve rreth inflacionit vazhdon t qndroj n kahun e siprm, e diktuar nga kohzgjatja dhe intensiteti i goditjes s oferts n tregjet botrore. Dy vitet e fundit kan qen t paprecedenta dhe sfiduese pr ekonomin dhe Bankn e Shqipris. Megjithat, me knaqsi konstatoj se institucioni diti t ngrihet n lartsin e sfidave dhe prmbushi me sukses detyrat e tij ligjore. Si e prmenda edhe n pjesn e par t fjals sime, politika monetare stimuluese e ndjekur nga Banka e Shqipris ka dhn nj kontribut t rndsishm n procesin e rikuperimit t ekonomis, pas goditjes s pandemis. Paralelisht me to, gjat vitit t fundit, Banka e Shqipris ka vijuar punn pr zbatimin e detyrave t saj n kuadrin e licencimit, mbikqyrjes dhe rregullimit t sektorit bankar. Gjej me vend t theksoj progresin e mtejshm q shnuam n fushn e konsolidimit t industris bankare me: prthithjen e propozuar t Banks Alfa nga Banka OTP; vazhdimin e bashkpunimit me autoritetet homologe, n kuadr t kolegjeve mbikqyrse dhe lufts ndaj pastrimit t parave; si dhe vijimin e puns pr hartimin dhe rishikimin e kuadrit rregullator mbikqyrs, duke synuar prafrimin e tij t vazhdueshm me acquis t BE-s dhe standardet e Komitetit t Bazelit. Dy vitet e fundit kan shnuar zhvillime edhe n fushn e ndrhyrjes s jashtzakonshme n banka, duke plotsuar kuadrin rregullator dhe metodologjik t ndrhyrjes s jashtzakonshme me akte t tjera nnligjore dhe dokumente metodologjike, n harmoni me kuadrin rregullator evropian, si dhe duke prgatitur t plota planet e ndrhyrjes s jashtzakonshme pr t gjitha bankat e sektorit bankar. N fushn e sistemeve t pagesave vmendje e veant i sht kushtuar prmbushjes s objektivit strategjik pr nxitjen e prfshirjes financiare t popullsis dhe prdorimit t instrumenteve elektronike t pagesave. Ndrhyrjet ligjore e rregullatore, zhvillimet infrastrukturore t ndrmarra nga viti 2018 deri tani, n kuadr t Strategjis Kombtare t Pagesave me Vler t Vogl, si dhe operacionalizimi i sistemit t shlyerjes s pagesave n Euro brenda vendit, kan rezultuar t suksesshm, ndrkoh q impakti i tyre pritet t bhet dhe m i prekshm n vitet n vijim. Banka e Shqipris ka vijuar punn pr administrimin e rezervs valutore, n prputhje me objektivat baz t investimit t saj: likuiditetit dhe siguris. N kt drejtim, gjej me vend t theksoj se gjat vitit 2021 u finalizua nnshkrimi i marrveshjes s re me Bankn Qendrore Evropiane, e prfaqsuar nga Banka e Francs, pr aprovimin e nj linje krediti t kolateralizuar pr shumn 400 milion euro. Me gjith vshtirsit e krijuara, prgjat gjith periudhs, Banka e Shqipris ka vazhduar t kontribuoj me prgjegjshmri n procesin e integrimit evropian t vendit, n t gjitha dimensionet e tij. M konkretisht, sht mundsuar nj shkall e lart plotsimi angazhimesh q rrjedhin nga Plani Kombtar i Integrimit t Vendit, si dhe nj pjesmarrje aktive n t gjitha takimet me nnkomitetet prkatse t BE-s. Komunikimi me publikun ka qen nj prioritet konstant i Banks s Shqipris. N qendr t puns son ka qen edhe mbetet zbatimi i nj politike komunikimi t prgjegjshme dhe transparente, n mnyr q t sigurohet q detyrat dhe aktivitetet e institucionit t kuptohen n mnyr t drejt nga publiku i gjer. Banka e Shqipris prballoi me sukses situatn e emergjencs t krijuar pr shkak t pandemis. N muajin qershor 2021, u nnshkrua me BQE-n nj marrveshje pr mbrojtjen e kartmonedhs Euro nga falsifikimi, duke e br kshtu Bankn e Shqipris pjes integrale t procesit evropian n luftn kundr falsifikimit t kartmonedhave. Po ashtu, ne kemi vijuar punn pr plotsimin e seris se re t kartmonedhave. N muajin qershor t vitit 2021 u hodhn ne qarkullim edhe 2 prerje t tjera, ato 1,000 dhe 10,000 Lek. Shtimi i ksaj t fundit, pra i kartmonedhs me prerjen m t madhe n vlern 10,000 Lek, prbn edhe nj risi n procesin e prodhimit t paras son. Njkohsisht, vlen t theksohet se n vitin 2021, kemi prodhuar edhe 2 kartmonedhat e fundit t seris, ato me prerje 500 dhe 2000 Lek, t cilat pritet t hidhen n qarkullim n ditt n vijim, duke realizuar prfundimisht kompletimin e seris son t re t kartmonedhave, t prbr nga 6 prerje. Duke filluar nga data 17 janar 2022, kartmonedhat e reja do t jen n duart e publikut dhe do t qarkullojn paralelisht me kartmonedhat e seris aktuale. Ato jan dizajnuar dhe prodhuar me teknologjin m t fundit t fushs dhe jan t pajisura me elemente bashkkohore dhe t sofistikuara sigurie. Prmbushja e objektivave dhe rezultatet e Banks s Shqipris nuk do t ishin t mundura pa vizionin, lidershipin dhe prkushtimin e Kshillit Mbikqyrs. Ky Kshill ka garantuar mbarvajtjen e puns s institucionit, si dhe ka orientuar e udhhequr hartimin e Strategjis Afatmesme t Zhvillimit t Banks s Shqipris. N punn e tij, Kshilli sht asistuar dhe nga Auditimi i Brendshm. Ky funksion i rndsishm u certifikua n prputhje me standardet ndrkombtare t auditimit t brendshm, si dhe prmbushi angazhimet e planifikuara t auditimit. N prfundim, prfitoj nga rasti t theksoj se Banka e Shqipris do t vazhdoj t jet nj mbikqyrse e kujdesshme e realitetit ekonomik dhe financiar t vendit. Shum sfida mbeten ende para nesh, por ajo q konstatoj me knaqsi sht se institucioni yn sht i aft t prballet me to. Duke shpresuar se viti 2022 do t sjell prfundimin e pandemis dhe kthimin n normalitet t jets sociale dhe ekonomike, m lejoni t theksoj se Banka e Shqipris do t jet plotsisht e angazhuar pr marrjen e masave adekuate n prmbushjen e misionit t saj ligjor! Title: Questions - Answers to the press conference
text: Question  answers of the press conference, March 23, 2022 29/07/22, 13:30 Question  answers of the press conference, March 23, 2022 Publication date: 23.03.2022 Q: If the price situation continues to be problematic again as a result of the conflict that we do not know how long it will last, does the Bank of Albania have other options to intervene or to take measures to have price stability in the country in addition to raising the interest rate? Governor: The main objective that the Bank of Albania has by law is to preserve price stability and the main instrument that the Bank of Albania uses in this direction is the basic interest rate. The basic interest rate applies to the national currency and the transmission of monetary policy should be stressed that it is gradual, therefore not immediate, requires 2 to 3 quarters and more to reflect at the price level. Of course, the Bank of Albania also has instruments other than this main instrument that are all other elements that concern both micro and macro precautionary measures that apply to financial stability, i.e. on the financial system and on the banking system. Also measures related to the liquidity situation, i.e. the supply of the market with liquidity according to certain financial situations. These are crisis situations that are specific and have their own traits. Of course we went through a difficult crisis situation that was the period of pandemic and that crisis situation required a monetary policy easing, i.e. an interest rate cut to the historical minimum level. Now the situation has changed, we are in a crisis situation that comes from the military conflict in Ukraine and we face the opposite, with price increases and a different monetary policy position is needed. This is a monetary policy position they are taking Page 1 of 3 Question  answers of the press conference, March 23, 2022 29/07/22, 13:30 most central banks today in the Eurozone, but also in the world, both the Federal Reserve and other central banks. The Bank of Albania will continue to work on the objective of price stability. I want to stress that with all the limits and restrictions we have had from the high level of euroisation in the Albanian economy, the transmission of monetary policy of the Bank of Albania has been good, it has been very good with this level of restriction as we have had increases in consumption, investment, growth of the economy and increased lending in the national currency. Q: Was there interference by the Bank of Albania in the market when there were fluctuations at the beginning of this month on the exchange rate, when the euro at some points was exchanged up to 128 dollars? Governor: The exchange rate behaviour at this moment displayed the same behavior as in the beginning of the pandemic crisis. If you remember, two years ago, as soon as the hit from the pandemic crisis began, we had a devaluation of the national currency and the Bank of Albania made its intervention at that moment. The same thing happened this time. For a few days we noticed that the exchange rate had devaluation. I must stress that we respect the free exchange rate regime and have no defined objective of it. By having a free exchange rate regime, we intervene only in specific cases, clearly defined by regulations. And these cases are: when the course has strange behavior, therefore when there is speculative behavior, when spreads open; And more specifically we were in this situation when the exchange rate had a strange behavior with very broad spreads resulting from the shock of the psychological factor and the high expectations of economic agents for rising energy and oil import prices and all other import products, but this did not represent a real situation of demand and supply for currency in the market. Then the Bank of Albania intervened for 23 days and the course stabilised. The fact that the course stabilised after the Bank's intervention proved that the course's behaviour was as a result of psychological effects, not the demand-offer factor. However, I must stress that we intervene only for specific cases on the exchange rate. If the exchange rate were underestimated or overstated as a result of a new economic reality, the Bank of Albania would not intervene, because as I said exchange rate interventions are specified, they are done in very special cases when the target of inflation, financial stability, for the increase in the currency reserve is hit, or when we have strange behavior from psychological factors. In the current days, we see the following course remain stabilised. We will monitor how the economy behaves, what the markets will be like, how long the conflict will be and the level of conflict hit by international markets in the Albanian economy. Even today's decision of the Bank of Albania or central banks in general, for raising the interest rate has a correlative link to the level of the exchange rate. The failure of central banks to react through the basic interest rate would affect the devaluation of the exchange rate. Muz dhe Eduk " Kreu / Shtypi / Fjalime, intervista, artikuj / Fjalime Njoftimet pr shtyp Njoftime t # mbledhjeve t Kshillit Mbikqyrs Konferenca pr shtyp Fjalime, $ intervista, artikuj Fjalime Intervista e artikuj Kalendar # Kalendari i festave zyrtare pr vitin 2022 COVID-19 Evropa # BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Pyetje  prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp, 23 mars 2022 Data e publikimit: 23.03.2022 Pyetje: N rast se situata me mimet vijon t jet prsri problematike si pasoj e konfliktit q ne nuk e dim se sa do t zgjas, a ka Banka e Shqipris alternativa t tjera pr t ndrhyr apo pr t marr masa pr t pasur stabilitet mimesh n vend prve rritjes s norms s interesit? Guvernatori: Objektivi kryesor q ka Banka e Shqipris me ligj sht ruajtja e stabilitetit t mimeve dhe instrumenti kryesor q Banka e Shqipris prdor n kt drejtim sht norma baz e interesit. Norma baz e interesit aplikohet mbi monedhn kombtare dhe transmetimi i politiks monetare duhet theksuar q sht gradual, pra nuk sht i menjhershm, krkon 2 deri n 3 tremujor dhe m shum q t reflektohet n nivelin e mimeve. Natyrisht q Banka e Shqipris ka dhe instrumente t tjer prve ktij instrumenti kryesor q jan t gjith elementt e tjer q kan t bjn si me masat mikro dhe makro prudenciale q aplikohen pr stabilitetin financiar, pra mbi sistemin financiar dhe mbi sistemin bankar. Po ashtu dhe masa q lidhen me situatn e likuiditetit, pra me furnizimin e tregut me likuiditet sipas situatave t caktuara financiare. Kto jan situata krize q jan specifike dhe kan tiparet e tyre. Natyrisht q ne kaluam nj situate krize t vshtir q ishte periudha e pandemis dhe ajo situat krize krkonte nj politik monetare lehtsuese, pra nj ulje t norms s interesit deri n nivelin minimal historik. Tani situata ndryshoi, jemi n nj situat krize q vjen nga konflikti ushtarak n Ukrain dhe prballemi me t kundrtn, me rritje t mimeve dhe nevojitet nj qndrim i ndryshm i politiks monetare. Ky sht nj qndrim i politiks monetare q po mbajn https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjalime/Pyetje_pergjigjet_e_konferences_per_shtyp_23_mars_2022.html Pagina 1 di 3 Pyetje  prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp, 23 mars 2022 29/07/22, 13:30 shumica e bankave qendrore sot n Eurozon, por edhe n bot, edhe Rezerva Federale, edhe bankat e tjera qendrore. Banka e Shqipris do t vazhdoj t punoj pr objektivin e stabilitetit t mimeve. Dua t theksoj q me gjith limitet dhe kufizimet q ne kemi pasur nga niveli i lart i euroizimit n ekonomin shqiptare, transmetimi i politiks monetare t Banks s Shqipris ka qen i mir, ka qen shum i mir me kt nivel kufizimi pasi ne kemi pasur rritje t konsumit, t investimeve, rritje t ekonomis dhe rritje t kreditimit n monedhn kombtare. Pyetje: A ka pasur ndrhyrje nga Banka e Shqipris n treg kur ka patur luhatjet n fillim t ktij muaji n kursin e kmbimit, kur euro n disa pika kmbehej deri n 128 lek? Guvernatori: Sjellja e kursit t kmbimit n kt moment shfaqi t njjtn sjellje si n fillimin e krizs s pandemis. Nqs ju kujtohet, para dy vjetve, sapo filloi goditja nga kriza e pandemis, ne patm nj zhvlersim t monedhs kombtare dhe Banka e Shqipris bri ndrhyrjen e saj n at moment. E njjta gj ka ndodhur edhe ksaj radhe. Pr disa dit ne vum re q kursi i kmbimit pati zhvlersim. Duhet t theksoj se ne respektojm regjimin e lir t kursit t kmbimit dhe nuk kemi objektiv t prcaktuar t tij. Duke pasur nj regjim t lir t kursit t kmbimit, ne ndrhyjm vetm n raste specifike, t prcaktuara qartsisht me rregullore. Dhe kto raste jan: kur kursi ka sjellje t uditshme, pra kur ka sjellje spekulative, kur hapen spread-et; dhe m konkretisht ne ishim n kt situat kur kursi i kmbimit kishte nj sjellje t uditshme me spread-e shum t gjera q vinin si pasoj e goditjes s faktorit psikologjik dhe pritshmrive t larta t agjentve ekonomik pr rritje t mimeve t importit t energjis dhe nafts dhe gjith produkteve t tjera t importit, por kjo nuk prfaqsonte nj situat reale t krkess dhe oferts pr valut n treg. Ather, Banka e Shqipris ndrhyri pr 2-3 dit dhe kursi u stabilizua. Fakti q kursi u stabilizua pas ndrhyrjes s Banks vrtetoi q sjellja e kursit ishte si pasoj e efekteve psikologjike, dhe jo e faktorit krkes-ofert. Gjithsesi, duhet t theksoj, se ne ndrhyjm vetm pr raste specifike n kursin e kmbimit. Nqs kursi i kmbimit do t nnmohej ose mbimohej si pasoj e nj realiteti t ri ekonomik, Banka e Shqipris nuk do t ndrhynte, sepse si e thash ndrhyrjet n kursin e kmbimit jan t specifikuara, bhen n raste shum t veanta kur goditet objektivi i inflacionit, stabilitetit financiar, pr rritjen e rezervs valutore, ose kur kemi sjellje t uditshme nga faktort psikologjik. N ditt aktuale, ne shohim q kursi vijon t mbetet i stabilizuar. Do t monitorojm si do t sillet ekonomia, si do t jen tregjet, sa do jet kohzgjatja e konfliktit dhe niveli i goditjes s konfliktit nga tregjet ndrkombtare n ekonomin shqiptare. Edhe vendimmarrja e sotme e Banks s Shqipris ose bankave qendrore n prgjithsi, pr rritjen e norms s interesit ka nj lidhje korrelative me nivelin e kursit t kmbimit. Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, March 23, 2022 29/07/22, 13:30 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, March 23, 2022 Publication date: 23.03.2022 Honored media representatives, Today, on 23 March 2022, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Intermediate Monetary Policy Report. The Council's discussions focused on the impact Russia's military attack on Ukraine will have on the Albanian economy. Sanctions imposed on Russia and increased volatileand uncertainty in international markets have generated a new and challenging economic reality. This reality dictates the revision of our previous projections and reassessing the suitability of monetary policy stance.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_23_mars_2022.html Page 1 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, March 23, 2022 29/07/22, 13:30 Geopolitical tension will deliver a double blow - directly from the kahu of the offer and indirect from the kahu of demand  on the Albanian economy. However, based on current analyses and projections, the Supervisory Council estimates that the Albanian economy will continue to grow during 2022 and beyond. This judgment relies on the breadth and strength of growth sources, the assumption of further non-escalation of conflict, as well as that of following a stimulus mix of monetary and fiscal policies. On the other hand, the Supervisory Council estimates that inflation will stay above the Bank of Albania's target for most of the following two years. Under these circumstances, the Supervisory Council decided to adjust the level of monetary stimulus to the economy. This adaptation aims to create necessary monetary conditions for respecting our inflation target, for maintaining financial stability, as well as for the sustainable and long-term growth of the economy and employment in Albania. Next, let me clarify in more detail the main conclusions of the Report, our expectations for the future, as well as the reasons that motivated today's decision. *** The new information available suggests that the global economy is facing and will face high prices of food, raw materials and basic products. These strikes will also be broadcast in Albania. Consumer price inflation marked growth in the first quarter. According to Instat data, this inflation recorded levels of 3.7% and 3.9%, respectively in January and February. Although full official data is missing, the information available shows a further price increase in the month of March. Inflation performance in Albania has been influenced by rising prices of food, oil, and production and transport costs. In macroeconomic terms, the rising inflation trend reflects rapid and steady demand growth, rising wages and employment, as well as rapid price growth in international markets over the past two quarters. The latter have been high over the second half of last year and have come under added pressure from the geopolitical tension accompanying the conflict in Ukraine.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_23_mars_2022.html Page 2 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, March 23, 2022 29/07/22, 13:30 Further price performance will be determined by the intensity and duration of this conflict, by the impact it will have on international prices and trade, as well as by the sustainability of economic growth in the country. Data coming from foreign markets signal that prices in international markets will remain high during 2022 and 2023. These high prices will erode household purchasing power and be accompanied by slowing growth rates in the global range. Consequently, global inflation projections for the following two years have been revised upwards, while projections of economic growth have been revised downwards. Likewise, most central banks have accelerated their plans to normalise monetary policy stance. In contrast to this situation, the Albanian economy has shown clear signs of recovery. Available information indicates that economic activity exceeded the level recorded before the pandemic earthquake in the first quarter of last year. Likewise, this information suggests that the positive moment of growth has been carried and in the first two months of the current year. Economic growth has had a broad base. It reflects the expansion of almost all sectors of the economy and components of aggregate demand. In macroeconomic terms, it has been fuelled by improved confidence, rising foreign demand, the favourable monetary and financial environment, as well as by the fiscal stimulus of the past two years. The Bank of Albania's monetary stimulus policy has generated stabilized financial markets, low interest rates and favourable financing conditions. Credit for the private sector increased by 11.8% in February, illustrating growing support with funds, consumer and investment. The increasing lending trend has been influenced by both increased business and household demand and favourable lending policies applied by the banking sector. This sector is characterized by healthy and balance sheets and declining troubled loans. Our estimates suggest that aggregate demand is generating an almost complete exploitation of capital and labour. Economic growth has been reflected in gradual employment growth and accelerating the pace of wage growth. In particular, Instat data show that employment increased by 2.1% in annual terms during the fourth quarter of 2021, while pay in the private sector increased by 10.2%. The high rate of wage growth suggests that the labour market is characterized by few untapped spaces. *** The update of the medium-term forecasts indicates that the Albanian economy will suffer the consequences of the blow. Rising prices in world markets and reducing foreign demand will be associated with higher inflation rates and slower economic growth compared to our previous estimates.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_23_mars_2022.html Page 3 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the press conference for monetary policy decision-making, March 23, 2022 29/07/22, 13:30 However, assessments of the basic scenario suggest that the Albanian economy will come to grow during 2022 and in the medium term. Likewise, our projections show that economic growth will remain in positive territory even if the hit results in stronger than current estimates. On the other hand, supply shocks and sustainability of domestic demand are expected to be reflected in higher inflation rates. Under the basic forecast scenario, inflation will fluctuate around the 5-6% level for the remainder of 2022. Furthermore, with the expected calm of international markets, inflation is expected to come down during 2023 and return to target in its last quarter. *** Consistent with the above forecasts and its previous communications, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania appreciated the necessary adaptation of monetary policy stance to new economic conditions. Our monetary policy has been in extremely stimulating positions over the past two years. It has targeted the promotion of aggregate demand during the pandemic, as a prerequisite for respecting our inflation target. This policy has resulted in success in its mission. However, the current supply hit, and the strength of aggregate demand, risk censoring our price stability target in the medium term. Judging on the above, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania decided: increase by 0.5 percentage points of basic interest rate, from 0.5% to 1.0% level. keeping the interest rate of the one-day deposit at the current level of 0.1%; increase in the one-day loan interest rate, from 0.9% to the 1.9% level. The Supervisory Council notes that  even after this movement  the position of monetary policy follows to be stimulating the growth of the economy, employment and wages. In the new reality, this position offers a better balance between the risk of accelerating inflation and the risk of damage to economic recovery. Judging on current information, normalising the position of monetary policy will be a gradual and based process on new information. However, the Supervisory Council notes that the balance of risks to inflation remains in the upper direction. For this reason, it will continuously monitor the reaction of the Albanian economy to this shock and take all necessary measures to respect the objective of price stability in the medium term.  er_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_23_mars_2022.html Page 4 of 4

Megjithat, bazuar n analizat dhe projeksionet aktuale, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlerson se ekonomia shqiptare do t vijoj t rritet gjat vitit 2022 e n vazhdim. Ky gjykim mbshtetet n gjersin dhe fortsin e burimeve t rritjes, n supozimin e mos-prshkallzimit t mtejshm t konfliktit, si dhe at t vijimit t nj miksi stimulues politikash monetare e fiskale. Nga ana tjetr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlerson se inflacioni do t qndroj mbi objektivin e Banks s Shqipris gjat pjess m t madhe t dy viteve n vijim. N kto rrethana, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi t prshtat nivelin e stimulit monetar n ekonomi. Kjo prshtatje synon t krijoj kushte e nevojshme monetare pr respektimin e objektivit ton t inflacionit, pr ruajtjen e stabilitetit financiar, si dhe pr rritjen e qndrueshme dhe afatgjat t ekonomis dhe t punsimit n Shqipri. N vijim, m lejoni t sqaroj m n detaje konkluzionet kryesore t Raportit, pritjet tona pr t ardhmen, si dhe arsyet q motivuan vendimin e sotm. *** Informacioni i ri i disponuar sugjeron se ekonomia botrore po prballet dhe do t vijoj t prballet me mime t larta t ushqimeve, t lndve t para dhe t produkteve baz. Kto goditje do t transmetohen edhe n Shqipri. Inflacioni i mimeve t konsumit shnoi rritje n tremujorin e par. Sipas t dhnave t Instat-it, ky inflacion regjistroi nivelet 3.7% dhe 3.9%, respektivisht n muajt janar dhe shkurt. Ndonse t dhnat e plota zyrtare mungojn, informacioni i disponuar tregon nj rritje t mtejshme t mimeve n muajin mars. Ecuria e inflacionit n Shqipri sht ndikuar nga rritja e mimeve t artikujve ushqimor, t nafts, dhe t kostove t prodhimit e t transportit. N terma makroekonomik, trendi rrits i inflacionit pasqyron rritjen e shpejt dhe t qndrueshme t krkess, rritjen e pagave dhe t punsimit, si dhe rritjen e shpejt t mimeve n tregjet ndrkombtare gjat dy tremujorve t fundit. Kto t fundit kan qen t larta gjat gjysms s dyt t vitit t shkuar dhe jan vn nn presion t shtuar nga tensioni gjeopolitik q shoqron konfliktin n Ukrain. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjer_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_23_mars_2022.html Pagina 2 di 4 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 23 mars 2022 29/07/22, 13:30 Ecuria e mtejshme e mimeve do t prcaktohet nga intensiteti dhe kohzgjatja e ktij konflikti, nga ndikimi q ai do t ket mbi mimet dhe tregtin ndrkombtare, si dhe nga qndrueshmria e rritjes ekonomike n vend. T dhnat q vijn nga tregjet e huaja sinjalizojn se mimet n tregjet ndrkombtare do t vijojn t mbeten t larta gjat viteve 2022 dhe 2023. Kto mime t larta do t grryejn fuqin blerse t familjeve dhe do t shoqrohen me ngadalsim t ritmit t rritjes n rang botror. Pr rrjedhoj, projeksionet globale t inflacionit pr dy vitet n vijim jan ripar pr lart, ndrsa projeksionet e rritjes ekonomike jan ripar pr posht. Po ashtu, pjesa m e madhe e bankave qendrore kan prshpejtuar planet e tyre t normalizimit t qndrimit t politiks monetare. Prkundrejt ksaj situate, ekonomia shqiptare ka shfaqur shenja t qarta rimkmbjeje. Informacioni i disponuar tregon se aktiviteti ekonomik ka tejkaluar nivelin e regjistruar prpara trmetit e pandemis n tremujorin e par t vitit t shkuar. Po ashtu, ky informacion sugjeron se momenti pozitiv i rritjes sht mbartur dhe n dy muajt e par t vitit aktual. Rritja ekonomike ka pasur nj baz t gjer. Ajo pasqyron zgjerimin e thuajse t gjith sektorve t ekonomis dhe prbrsve t krkess agregate. N terma makroekonomik, ajo sht ushqyer nga prmirsimi i besimit, nga rritja e krkess s huaj, nga ambienti i favorshm monetar dhe financiar, si dhe nga stimuli fiskal i dy viteve t fundit. Politika monetare stimuluese e Banks s Shqipris ka gjeneruar tregje financiare t stabilizuara, norma t ulta interesi dhe kushte t favorshme financimi. Kredia pr sektorin privat u rrit me 11.8% n muajin shkurt, duke ilustruar nj mbshtetje n rritje me fonde, t konsumit dhe investimeve. Trendi rrits i kreditimit sht ndikuar si nga rritja e krkess s biznesit dhe t familjeve, ashtu dhe nga politikat e favorshme t kreditimit t aplikuara nga sektori bankar. Ky sektor vijon t karakterizohet nga bilance likuide e t shndetshme dhe rnie e kredive me probleme. Vlersimet tona sugjerojn se krkesa agregate po gjeneron nj shfrytzim thuajse t plot t kapitalit dhe t puns. Rritja ekonomike sht pasqyruar n rritje graduale t punsimit dhe prshpejtim t ritmit t rritjes s pagave. N veanti, t dhnat e Instat-it tregojn se punsimi u rrit me 2.1% n terma vjetor gjat tremujorit t katrt t vitit 2021, ndrsa paga n sektorin privat u rrit me 10.2%. Norma e lart e rritjes s pagave sugjeron se tregu i puns karakterizohet nga hapsira t pakta t pashfrytzuara. *** Prditsimi i parashikimeve afatmesme tregon se ekonomia shqiptare do t vuaj pasojat e goditjes. Rritja e mimeve n tregjet botrore dhe reduktimi i krkess s huaj, do t shoqrohen me norma m t larta inflacioni dhe rritje m t ngadalt ekonomike krahasuar me vlersimet tona t mparshme. https://www.bankofalbania.org/Shtypi/Fjalime_intervista_artikuj/Fjer_shtyp_per_vendimmarrjen_e_politikes_monetare_23_mars_2022.html Pagina 3 di 4 Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 23 mars 2022 29/07/22, 13:30 Megjithat, vlersimet e skenarit baz sugjerojn se ekonomia shqiptare do t vijoj t rritet gjat vitit 2022 dhe n afatin e mesm. Po ashtu, projeksionet tona tregojn se rritja ekonomike do t mbetet n territor pozitiv edhe n rast se goditja rezulton m e fort se vlersimet aktuale. Nga ana tjetr, goditjet e oferts dhe qndrueshmria e krkess s brendshme pritet t pasqyrohen n norma m t larta inflacioni. Sipas skenarit baz t parashikimeve, inflacioni do t luhatet rreth nivelit 5-6% pr pjesn e mbetur t vitit 2022. M tej, me qetsimin e pritur t tregjeve ndrkombtare, inflacioni pritet t vij n rnie gjat vitit 2023 dhe t kthehet n objektiv n tremujorin e fundit t tij. *** N konsistenc me parashikimet e msiprme dhe komunikimet e tij t mparshme, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris e vlersoi t nevojshm prshtatjen e qndrimit t politiks monetare me kushtet e reja ekonomike. Politika jon monetare ka qen n pozita tejet stimuluese gjat dy viteve t fundit. Ajo ka synuar nxitjen e krkess agregate gjat pandemis, si nj parakusht pr respektimin e objektivit ton t inflacionit. Kjo politik ka rezultuar e suksesshme n misionin e saj. Megjithat, goditja aktuale e oferts dhe fortsia e krkess agregate, rrezikojn t cenojn objektivin ton t stabilitetit t mimeve n afatin e mesm. Duke gjykuar mbi sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris vendosi: rritjen me 0.5 pik prqindje t norms baz s interesit, nga niveli 0.5% n nivelin 1.0%. mbajtjen e norms s interesit t depozits njditore, n nivelin aktual prej 0.1%; rritjen e norms s interesit t kredis njditore, nga niveli 0.9% n nivelin 1.9%. Kshilli Mbikqyrs vren se  edhe pas ksaj lvizjeje  qndrimi i politiks monetare vijon t jet stimulues pr rritjen e ekonomis, t punsimit dhe t pagave. N realitetin e ri, ky qndrim ofron nj balanc m t mir midis rrezikut t prshpejtimit t inflacionit dhe rrezikut t dmtimit t rimkmbjes ekonomike. Duke gjykuar mbi informacionin aktual, normalizimi i qndrimit t politiks monetare do t jet nj proces gradual dhe i mbshtetur n informacionin e ri. Megjithat, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vren se balanca e rreziqeve mbi inflacionin mbetet n kahun e siprm. Pr kt arsye, ai do t monitoroj n vazhdimsi reagimin e ekonomis shqiptare ndaj ksaj goditjeje dhe do t marr t gjitha masat e nevojshme pr respektimin e objektivit t stabilitetit t mimeve n afatin e mesm. Title: Speech at the Signing Ceremony of the EBRD Agribusiness and Tourism Support Program (AATSF) Loan Agreement between the EBRD and ProCredit Bank Albania
text: Governor Seyko's word at the recipient signing ceremony... urism in the country (AATSF) between BERZH and ProCredit Bank Albania 29/07/22, 13:29 Governor Seyko's word at the signing ceremony of the loan agreement for the BERK programme for support of Agribusiness and Tourism in the country (AATSF) between BERZH and ProCredit Bank Albania Publication date: 11.04.2022 Honorable Mrs. President of the BERZh, Honourable, Minister, Honored representative of the European Union Delegation, Honourable representatives of the ProCredit Bank, Dear friends and colleagues, The Bank of Albania has the pleasure of opening its doors today for the signing ceremony of the agreement between the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (BERZh) and the ProCredit Bank, for the use of the risk-sharing instrument within the framework of the Programme for The Support of Agribusiness and Tourism in Albania.  zmit_ne_vend_AATSF_midis_BERZH-it_dhe_ProCredit_Bank_Albania.html Page 1 of 4 Governor Seyko's word at the recipient signing ceremony... urism in the country (AATSF) between BERZH and ProCredit Bank Albania 29/07/22, 13:29 Under the umbrella of this programme, BERZh, the European Union and the Government of Albania, in partnership with the financial sector, are increasing access to financing for operating companies in these sectors, thus addressing one of the main challenges for their development. We are all aware of the difficulties in financing companies in the field of agribusiness and tourism, which, in the vast majority, are organized as small and medium-sized enterprises. But also, we are all aware of the great potential of these companies, as value creators, as employment promoters and as a source of innovation. All of these are important ingredients for a successful recipe for the sustainable development of our economy. For this reason, I consider it extremely important and fruitful to undertake such programmes, which enable not only the availability of funds, but also increase the analytical, evaluating and further financing capacity of the banking sector. Guarantee and risk-sharing instruments ease the burden on banks in terms of risk and further help pave the way towards sustainable financing of these sectors. Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: PRESS RELEASE Governor Sejko's remarks at the press conference on monetary policy decision making, 2 February 2022 Gent_Sejko_44594_Albanian Date of publication: 02.02.2022 Dear representatives of the media, Today, on 2 February 2022, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Quarterly Monetary Policy Report. The new information obtained in the analysis showed the rapid and sustained expansion of domestic economic activity during the second half of last year and the acceleration of inflation in the fourth quarter. The rise in inflation is caused both by stable factors, linked to progressive growth in demand, employment and wages, and by transitory factors, linked to rapid price growth in international markets. Our projections suggest further growth in the economy in the coming years. The inflation rate is expected to remain above our target of 3% over the current year, as a consequence of high prices in international markets. These impacts have resulted stronger and sustained than our initial estimates. However, their impact on inflation is expected to come down to gradually receding during 2022. Further, inflation is expected to return steadily to target in 2023, reflecting the balance of demand with supply and employment and wage growth in line with productivity. In this context, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current stance of monetary policy remains appropriate. In the Council's judgment, the current level of monetary stimulus serves to respect our inflation target, helps further recovery of the Albanian economy, as well as [Let me explain in more detail the main conclusions of the Quarterly Report, our expectations for the future, and the reasons that motivated today's decision.] *** The new information of recent months has been broadly in line with our expectations, although the bid headwinds are proving to be stronger and more stable than initial estimates. Globally, the recovery of economies from the pandemic hit is strong but uneven between countries. It is also characterized by problems in supply chains and shortages in the workforce. Strong demand for goods and services, supply restrictions and high electricity prices have pushed global inflation upwards. In this context, the outlook for global monetary policy is towards normalization, which is reflected in the behavior of international financial markets. Inflation in the country marked a rapid increase during the fourth quarter, reaching 3.7% in December. Inflation is present in the prices of almost all items in the consumer basket, whose prices are freely determined in the market. However, its acceleration in the fourth quarter was dictated by rising prices of processed foods and petroleum. In macroeconomic terms, the rapid rise in inflation in the fourth quarter reflected both the gradual and steady action of demand factors and the strong  but transitory  impact of supply shocks. On the one hand, continued growth in demand for goods and services has been accompanied by increases in employment and wages, as well as the strengthening of domestic inflationary pressures. This performance is reflected in the upstary trend of underlying inflation during 2021. On the other hand, strong growth in food prices, energy supplies, transportation costs and basic goods on world markets has had a significant impact on the rise of inflation in the fourth quarter. Domestic economic activity is expanding at relatively solid levels. According to INSTAT data, the Albanian economy grew by 10.4% during the first three quarters of the year. The available information signals a further expansion of it in the fourth quarter. Our analysis shows that the volume of economic activity in the country has already passed its pre-earthquake and pre-hispanic level, both at aggregate and sectoral level, illustrating the rapid recovery of demand and the few structural impacts that these shocks have left on the manufacturing structure of the economy. Overall, private sector balance sheets remain healthy, as illustrated by the growth of deposits and the decline of performing performing business confidence consistent with a further expansion of output. The recovery of aggregate demand reflected reduction of restraints, improved confidence, improved partner economies and continued support with stimulus economic policies. The growth profile highlights the expansion of consumption and private investment, public spending and net exports. In particular, the rapid growth of exports in the third quarter of 2021 was dictated by improved tourism activity. The economy has improved the job market. Both employment and the rate of participation in the skilled labor force have been rising, while the rate of Monetary and fiscal stimulus has provided an important support in the recovery process, both in terms of economic growth and in maintaining monetary and financial stability. Stimulus monetary policy has contributed through lowering the cost of borrowing and increasing lending to the economy. Interest rates for businesses and individuals have remained low and the exchange rate of lek against major cages has been stable. Favorable financial conditions, increased demand and improved nonfinancing supply conditions have driven the expansion of the loan portfolio for the private sector. This portfolio marked an average growth of around 9.9% during the fourth quarter, which is the highest value of this indicator since 2011. The bank loan has served consumer and investment financing and cover liquidity needs, both businesses and households. Lending has maintained relatively high growth rates, reflecting the effectiveness of monetary policy and mitigating exchange rate risks on financial stability. Current trends and supporting credit factors suggest a good performance in the future. These expectations are supported by high demand, sound balance sheets of the banking sector, eased lending conditions and, in particular, decreased credit risk, as illustrated by the further decline  to 5.65%  of the NPD ratio at the end of December 2021. Fiscal policy has made a positive contribution to the growth of aggregate demand during 2021, through increased investment and public consumption. However, fiscal stimulus has come to a dimming during the fourth quarter, reflecting slowing spending and rapid growth in budget revenues. Fiscal stimulus is expected to be reduced over the coming years. The 2022 budget suggests that fiscal policy has taken a turn towards normalisation in 2022, while the pace of public finance consolidation is expected to accelerate in the coming years. The Bank of Albania judges that increasing the sustainability of economic recovery makes it necessary to turn attention to reducing public debt. This course helps to properly sequence the process of normalization of economic policies and increases fiscal sustainability in the long term. *** Our projections for the future remain positive. The Albanian economy is expected to follow an upward trajectory over the coming years. The growth in activity is expected to be supported both by domestic and foreign demand, reflecting favorable financing conditions, improved confidence and balance sheets of the private sector, as well as increased demand in partner economies. Against the high levels of 2021, economic growth rates are expected to come to a reduction in 2022 and the following. However, the expansion in demand is expected to be sufficient to ensure employment growth aligned with market supply and wage growth in line with our inflation target. The Bank of Albania also estimates that expanding demand for goods and services will enable the growth of almost all sectors of the economy, although some of them will face increased costs for basic and energy products. Inflation is expected to stay above our target through 2022, in reflective of the headwind coming from increased prices in international markets. However, this stroke is expected to have temporary effects. Our analysis and international institutions suggest that the markets will Inflation is forecast to return steadily to the 3% target, starting in 2023. The return and stabilisation of inflation around the target will be supported by reducing supply shocks and by a good balance of demand and supply in the Albanian economy. However, the balance of risks around inflation remains shifted upwards. The risks stem mainly from the possibility of a faster or longer-term rise in prices in international markets, a body of them in inflationary expectations, as well as a slower pace of fiscal consolidation. The downside risks are associated with a possible negative impact of the pandemic on economic activity. *** Judging on the above, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania assessed that the current monetary policy stance is appropriate for supporting the economy and returning inflation to target by 2023. For this reason, the Supervisory Board decided: the Leave unchanged the base interest rate at 0.5%; the Leave unchanged the interest rates of one-day deposits and loans, at the 0.1% and 0.9% levels respectively. The Supervisory Council assessed that the materialization of the base scenario  that of further consolidation of the recovery, of the continued gradual increase of domestic inflationary pressures and of curbing supply shocks  will require the gradual normalization of monetary policy during 2022. This normalization is expected to begin in the coming months and continue gradually over the medium-term horizon. Through it, the Bank of Albania will aim to respect our inflation target and create the premises for more sustainable economic growth in the medium to long term. The Supervisory Council also assessed that the materialization of risk scenarios will require a review of the monetary policy stance, in the form of accelerating the process of normalization of monetary policy or delaying it in time. In any case, the Supervisory Council notes that the monetary policy stance will be entirely aligned with our inflation target in the medium term and will provide adequate support for consolidating economic recovery.
text_original: NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 2 shkurt 2022 Data e publikimit: 02.02.2022 T nderuar prfaqsues t medias, Sot, n datn 2 shkurt 2022, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris mori n shqyrtim dhe miratoi Raportin Tremujor t Politiks Monetare. Informacioni i ri i marr n analiz tregoi zgjerimin e shpejt e t qndrueshm t aktivitetit t brendshm ekonomik gjat gjysms s dyt t vitit t kaluar dhe prshpejtimin e inflacionit n tremujorin e katrt. Rritja e inflacionit sht shkaktuar si nga faktor t qndrueshm, t lidhur me rritjen progresive t krkess, t punsimit dhe t pagave, ashtu edhe nga faktor tranzitor, t lidhur me rritjen e shpejt t mimeve n tregjet ndrkombtare. Projeksionet tona sugjerojn rritje t mtejshme t ekonomis n vitet n vazhdim. Norma e inflacionit pritet t mbetet mbi objektivin ton prej 3% gjat vitit aktual, si pasoj e mimeve t larta n tregjet ndrkombtare. Kto goditje kan rezultuar m t forta dhe t qndrueshme se vlersimet tona fillestare. Megjithat, ndikimi i tyre n inflacion pritet t vij drejt shuarjes graduale gjat vitit 2022. M tej, inflacioni pritet t kthehet n mnyr t qndrueshme n objektiv gjat vitit 2023, n pasqyrim t balancimit t krkess me ofertn dhe t rritjes s punsimit dhe pagave n linj me produktivitetin. N kt kontekst, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare mbetet i prshtatshm. N gjykimin e Kshillit, niveli aktual i stimulit monetar i shrben respektimit t objektivit ton t inflacionit, ndihmon rimkmbjen e mtejshme t ekonomis shqiptare, si dhe [ N vijim, m lejoni t sqaroj m n detaje konkluzionet kryesore t Raportit Tremujor, pritjet tona pr t ardhmen, si dhe arsyet q motivuan vendimin e sotm. ] *** Informacioni i ri i muajve t fundit ka qen prgjithsisht n prputhje me pritjet tona, ndonse goditjet e oferts po provohen t jen m t forta dhe m t qndrueshme se vlersimet fillestare. N nivel global, rimkmbja e ekonomive nga goditja e pandemis sht e fort, por e pabarabart midis vendeve. Po ashtu, ajo vazhdon t karakterizohet nga probleme n zinxhirt e furnizimit dhe mungesa n fuqin puntore. Krkesa e fort pr mallra e shrbime, kufizimet n ofert dhe mimet e larta t energjis elektrike kan shtyr lart inflacionin global. N kt kontekst, perspektiva e politiks monetare globale sht drejt normalizimit, ka sht reflektuar edhe n sjelljen e tregjeve financiare ndrkombtare. Inflacioni n vend shnoi nj rritje t shpejt gjat tremujorit t katrt, duke arritur vlern 3.7% n muajin dhjetor. Inflacioni sht i pranishm n mimet e thuajse t gjith artikujve t shports s konsumit, mimet e t cilve prcaktohen lirisht n treg. Megjithat, prshpejtimi i tij n tremujorin e katrt u diktua nga rritja e mimeve t ushqimeve t prpunuara dhe t nafts. N terma makroekonomik, rritja e shpejt e inflacionit n tremujorin e katrt pasqyroi si veprimin gradual e t qndrueshm t faktorve t krkess, ashtu dhe ndikimin e fort  por tranzitor  t goditjeve t oferts. Nga njra an, rritja e vazhduar e krkess pr mallra e shrbime, sht shoqruar me rritje t punsimit dhe t pagave, si dhe forcimin e presioneve t brendshme inflacioniste. Kjo ecuri sht pasqyruar n trendin rrits t inflacionit baz gjat vitit 2021. Nga ana tjetr, rritja e fort e mimeve t ushqimeve, t lndve energjetike, t kostove t transportit dhe t mallrave baz n tregjet botrore, ka pasur nj ndikim t konsiderueshm n rritjen e inflacionit n tremujorin e katrt. Aktiviteti i brendshm ekonomik po zgjerohet me ritme relativisht solide. Sipas t dhnave t INSTAT-it, ekonomia shqiptare u rrit me 10.4% gjat tre tremujorve t par t vitit. Informacioni i disponuar sinjalizon nj zgjerim t mtejshm t saj n tremujorin e katrt. Analizat tona tregojn se vllimi i aktivitetit ekonomik n vend ka kaluar tashm nivelin e tij t para-trmetit e parapandemis, si n nivel agregat dhe n nivel sektorial, duke ilustruar rimkmbjen e shpejt t krkess dhe ndikimin e pakt strukturor q kto goditje kan ln n strukturn prodhuese t ekonomis. N trsi, bilancet e sektorit privat mbeten t shndetshme, sikundr ilustrohet nga rritja e depozitave dhe rnia e kredive me probleme, ndrsa ecuria e besimit t biznesit sht konsistente me nj zgjerim t mtejshm t prodhimit. Rimkmbja e krkess agregate pasqyroi reduktimin e kufizimeve, prmirsimin e besimit, prmirsimin e ekonomive partnere dhe mbshtetjen e vazhduar me politika ekonomike stimuluese. Profili i rritjes evidenton zgjerimin e konsumit dhe investimeve private, t shpenzimeve publike dhe t eksporteve neto. N veanti, rritja e shpejt e eksporteve n tremujorin e tret t vitit 2021 u diktua nga prmirsimi i aktivitetit t turizmit. Rritja e ekonomis ka sjell prmirsimin e treguesve t tregut t puns. Si punsimi dhe shkalla e pjesmarrjes n forcn e aft pr pun kan ardhur n rritje, ndrkoh q norma e Stimuli monetar e fiskal ka dhn nj mbshtetje t rndsishme n procesin e rimkmbjes, si n terma t rritjes ekonomike ashtu dhe n ruajtjen e stabilitetit monetar e financiar. Politika monetare stimuluese ka kontribuar nprmjet uljes s kostos s huamarrjes dhe rritjes s kreditimit n ekonomi. Normat e interesit t kredis pr bizneset dhe individt kan mbetur n nivele t ulta dhe kursi i kmbimit t lekut ndaj valutave kryesore ka qen i qndrueshm. Kushtet e favorshme financiare, rritja e krkess dhe prmirsimi i kushteve jofinanciare t oferts, kan nxitur zgjerimin e portofolit t kredis pr sektorin privat. Ky portofol shnoi nj rritje mesatare rreth nivelit 9.9% gjat tremujorit t katrt, ka prbn dhe vlern m t lart t ktij treguesi prej vitit 2011. Kredia bankare i ka shrbyer financimit t konsumit e t investimeve dhe mbulimit t nevojave pr likuiditet, si t bizneseve dhe t familjeve. Kredia n lek ka mbajtur ritme relativisht t larta rritjeje, duke pasqyruar efektivitetin e politiks monetare dhe duke zbutur rreziqet e kursit t kmbimit n stabilitetin financiar. Trendet aktuale dhe faktort mbshtets t kredis sugjerojn nj ecuri t mir t saj edhe n t ardhmen. Kto pritje mbshteten nga krkesa e lart, bilancet e shndosha t sektorit bankar, kushtet e lehtsuara t kreditimit dhe, n veanti, ulja e rrezikut t kreditit, sikundr ilustrohet nga rnia e mtejshme  n nivelin 5.65%  e raportit t kredive me probleme n fund t dhjetorit 2021. Politika fiskale ka dhn nj kontribut pozitiv n rritjen e krkess agregate gjat vitit 2021, nprmjet rritjes s investimeve dhe konsumit publik. Megjithat, stimuli fiskal ka ardhur n zbehje gjat tremujorit t katrt, n pasqyrim t ngadalsimit t shpenzimeve dhe t rritjes s shpejt t t ardhurave buxhetore. Stimuli fiskal pritet t reduktohet gjat viteve n vijim. Buxheti i vitit 2022 sugjeron se politika fiskale ka marr nj kthes drejt normalizimit n vitin 2022, ndrkoh q ritmi i konsolidimit t financave publike pritet t prshpejtohet n vitet n vijim. Banka e Shqipris gjykon se rritja e qndrueshmris s rimkmbjes ekonomike e bn t domosdoshme kthimin e vmendjes drejt reduktimit t borxhit publik. Ky kurs ndihmon sekuencimin e duhur t procesit t normalizimit t politikave ekonomike dhe rrit qndrueshmrin fiskale n afatin e gjat. *** Projeksionet tona pr t ardhmen mbeten pozitive. Ekonomia shqiptare parashikohet t ndjek nj trajektore rritse gjat viteve n vijim. Rritja e aktivitetit pritet t mbshtetet si nga krkesa e brendshme dhe nga ajo e huaj, duke pasqyruar kushtet e favorshme t financimit, prmirsimin e besimit dhe t bilanceve t sektorit privat, si dhe rritjen e krkess n ekonomit partnere. Prkundrejt niveleve t larta t vitit 2021, normat e rritjes ekonomike pritet t vijn n reduktim gjat vitit 2022 e n vazhdim. Megjithat, zgjerimi i krkess pritet t jet i mjaftueshm pr t siguruar rritje t punsimit n linj me ofertn e tregut dhe rritje t pagave n linj me objektivin ton t inflacionit. Po ashtu, Banka e Shqipris vlerson se zgjerimi i krkess pr mallra e shrbime do t mundsoj rritjen e pothuajse t gjith sektorve t ekonomis, ndonse disa prej tyre do t prballen me kosto t rritura pr produktet baz dhe ato energjetike. Inflacioni pritet t qndroj mbi objektivin ton gjat vitit 2022, n pasqyrim t goditjes q vjen nga mimet e rritura n tregjet ndrkombtare. Megjithat, kjo goditje pritet t ket efekte t prkohshme. Analizat tona dhe t institucioneve ndrkombtare sugjerojn se tregjet do t Inflacioni parashikohet t kthehet n mnyr t qndrueshme n objektivin 3%, duke filluar nga viti 2023. Kthimi dhe stabilizimi i inflacionit rreth objektivit do t mbshtetet nga reduktimi i goditjeve t oferts dhe nga balancimi i mir i krkess dhe oferts n ekonomin shqiptare. Megjithat, balanca e rreziqeve rreth inflacionit mbetet e zhvendosur pr lart. Rreziqet e kahut t siprm burojn kryesisht nga mundsia e nj rritjeje m t shpejt apo m t gjat n koh t mimeve n tregjet ndrkombtare, nj trupzim i tyre tek pritjet inflacioniste, si dhe nj ritm m i ngadalt i konsolidimit fiskal. Rreziqet e kahut t poshtm lidhen me nj ndikim t mundshm negativ t pandemis n aktivitetin ekonomik. *** Duke gjykuar mbi sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare sht i prshtatshm pr mbshtetjen e ekonomis dhe kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv brenda vitit 2023. Pr kt arsye, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi: t lr t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 0.5%; t lr t pandryshuara normat e interesit t depozitave dhe t kredive njditore, respektivisht n nivelet 0.1% dhe 0.9%. Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se materializimi i skenarit baz  ai i konsolidimit t mtejshm t rimkmbjes, i vijimit t rritjes graduale t presioneve t brendshme inflacioniste dhe i frenimit t goditjeve t oferts  do t krkoj normalizimin gradual t politiks monetare gjat vitit 2022. Ky normalizim pritet t filloj n muajt n vijim dhe t vijoj n mnyr graduale gjat horizontit afatmesm. Nprmjet tij, Banka e Shqipris do t synoj respektimin e objektivit ton t inflacionit dhe do t krijoj premisa pr nj rritje m t qndrueshme ekonomike n afatin e mesm e t gjat. Gjithashtu, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se materializimi i skenarve t rrezikut do t krkoj nj rishikim t qndrimit t politiks monetare, n formn e prshpejtimit t procesit t normalizimit t politiks monetare apo t shtyrjes n koh t tij. N do rast, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vren se qndrimi i politiks monetare do t jet trsisht n linj me respektimin e objektivit ton t inflacionit n afatin e mesm dhe do t ofroj mbshtetjen e duhur pr konsolidimin e rimkmbjes ekonomike.

Title: Questions  Answers to press conference, 23 March 2022
text: Questions  Answers to press conference, 23 March 2022 Date of publication: 23.03.2022 Question: If the price situation continues to be problematic again as a result of the conflict that we do not know how long it will last, does the Bank of Albania have other options to intervene or to take measures to have price stability in the country besides the interest rate increase? Governor: The main objective of the Bank of Albania by law is to maintain price stability and the main instrument that the Bank of Albania uses in this regard is the basic interest rate. The basic interest rate applies to the national currency and the transmission of monetary policy should be emphasized that it is gradual, therefore not immediate, requires 2 to 3 quarters and more to be reflected at the price level. Of course, the Bank of Albania has other instruments besides this main instrument, which are all other elements related to both micro and macro prudential measures that apply to financial stability, i.e. the financial system and the banking system. Also, measures related to the liquidity situation, i.e. supply of the market with liquidity according to certain financial situations. These are crisis situations that are specific and have their own traits. Of course we went through a difficult crisis situation that was the pandemic period and that crisis situation required an easing monetary policy, i.e. a cut of the interest rate to the historical minimum level. Now the situation has changed, we are in a situation of crisis stemming from the military conflict in Ukraine and we face the opposite, with rising prices and a different monetary policy stance is needed. This is a monetary policy stance that most central banks in the eurozone are holding today, but also in the world, the Federal Reserve, and other central banks. The Bank of Albania will continue to work towards the goal of price stability. I want to emphasize that despite the limits and limitations we have had from the high level of Euroization in the Albanian economy, the monetary policy transmission of the Bank of Albania has been good, it has been very good with this level of constraint as we have had increased consumption, investment, growth of the economy and increased credit in the national currency. Question: Was there interference by the Bank of Albania in the market when there were fluctuations earlier this month in the exchange rate, when the euro in some points was exchanged up to 128 ALL? Governor: The exchange rate behavior at the moment displayed the same behavior as at the beginning of the pandemic crisis. Two years ago, the pandemic crisis hit, we had a devaluation of the national currency and the Bank of Albania made its intervention at that moment. The same thing happened this time. For a few days we noticed that the exchange rate was devalued. I must stress that we respect the free exchange rate regime and have no definite objective of it. Having a free exchange rate regime, we only intervene in specific cases, clearly defined by regulations.
