And these are: when the course has strange behavior, i.e. speculative behavior, when spreads are opened; And more specifically we were in this situation when the exchange rate had a strange behavior with very wide spreads resulting from the psychological shock and high expectations of economic agents for increased prices of energy and oil imports and all other import products, but this did not represent a real situation of demand and supply for currency in the market. The Bank of Albania intervened for 2-3 days and the course stabilized. The fact that the course was stabilized after the Bank's intervention proved that the course behaviour was due to psychological effects, not to the demand-supply factor. However, I must emphasize that we only intervene for specific cases in the exchange rate. If the exchange rate were to be underestimated or overvalued as a result of a new economic reality, the Bank of Albania would not intervene, because as I said, the exchange rate interventions are specified, are done in very special cases when the target of inflation, financial stability, the growth of the foreign reserve, or when we have behavior strangely from psychological factors. In the current days, we see the course continue to be stabilized. We will monitor how the economy will behave, how markets will be, how long the conflict will be and the level of conflict shock from international markets to the Albanian economy. Even today's decision of the Bank of Albania or central banks in general, on raising the interest rate has a correlative relation to the level of exchange rates. Not responding to central banks through the base interest rate would affect the depreciation of the exchange rate.
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Pyetje  prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp, 23 mars 2022 Data e publikimit: 23.03.2022 Pyetje: N rast se situata me mimet vijon t jet prsri problematike si pasoj e konfliktit q ne nuk e dim se sa do t zgjas, a ka Banka e Shqipris alternativa t tjera pr t ndrhyr apo pr t marr masa pr t pasur stabilitet mimesh n vend prve rritjes s norms s interesit? Guvernatori: Objektivi kryesor q ka Banka e Shqipris me ligj sht ruajtja e stabilitetit t mimeve dhe instrumenti kryesor q Banka e Shqipris prdor n kt drejtim sht norma baz e interesit. Norma baz e interesit aplikohet mbi monedhn kombtare dhe transmetimi i politiks monetare duhet theksuar q sht gradual, pra nuk sht i menjhershm, krkon 2 deri n 3 tremujor dhe m shum q t reflektohet n nivelin e mimeve. Natyrisht q Banka e Shqipris ka dhe instrumente t tjer prve ktij instrumenti kryesor q jan t gjith elementt e tjer q kan t bjn si me masat mikro dhe makro prudenciale q aplikohen pr stabilitetin financiar, pra mbi sistemin financiar dhe mbi sistemin bankar. Po ashtu dhe masa q lidhen me situatn e likuiditetit, pra me furnizimin e tregut me likuiditet sipas situatave t caktuara financiare. Kto jan situata krize q jan specifike dhe kan tiparet e tyre. Natyrisht q ne kaluam nj situate krize t vshtir q ishte periudha e pandemis dhe ajo situat krize krkonte nj politik monetare lehtsuese, pra nj ulje t norms s interesit deri n nivelin minimal historik. Tani situata ndryshoi, jemi n nj situat krize q vjen nga konflikti ushtarak n Ukrain dhe prballemi me t kundrtn, me rritje t mimeve dhe nevojitet nj qndrim i ndryshm i politiks monetare. Ky sht nj qndrim i politiks monetare q po mbajn shumica e bankave qendrore sot n Eurozon, por edhe n bot, edhe Rezerva Federale, edhe bankat e tjera qendrore. Banka e Shqipris do t vazhdoj t punoj pr objektivin e stabilitetit t mimeve. Dua t theksoj q me gjith limitet dhe kufizimet q ne kemi pasur nga niveli i lart i euroizimit n ekonomin shqiptare, transmetimi i politiks monetare t Banks s Shqipris ka qen i mir, ka qen shum i mir me kt nivel kufizimi pasi ne kemi pasur rritje t konsumit, t investimeve, rritje t ekonomis dhe rritje t kreditimit n monedhn kombtare. Pyetje: A ka pasur ndrhyrje nga Banka e Shqipris n treg kur ka patur luhatjet n fillim t ktij muaji n kursin e kmbimit, kur euro n disa pika kmbehej deri n 128 lek? Guvernatori: Sjellja e kursit t kmbimit n kt moment shfaqi t njjtn sjellje si n fillimin e krizs s pandemis. Nqs ju kujtohet, para dy vjetve, sapo filloi goditja nga kriza e pandemis, ne patm nj zhvlersim t monedhs kombtare dhe Banka e Shqipris bri ndrhyrjen e saj n at moment. E njjta gj ka ndodhur edhe ksaj radhe. Pr disa dit ne vum re q kursi i kmbimit pati zhvlersim. Duhet t theksoj se ne respektojm regjimin e lir t kursit t kmbimit dhe nuk kemi objektiv t prcaktuar t tij. Duke pasur nj regjim t lir t kursit t kmbimit, ne ndrhyjm vetm n raste specifike, t prcaktuara qartsisht me rregullore. Dhe kto raste jan: kur kursi ka sjellje t uditshme, pra kur ka sjellje spekulative, kur hapen spread-et; dhe m konkretisht ne ishim n kt situat kur kursi i kmbimit kishte nj sjellje t uditshme me spread-e shum t gjera q vinin si pasoj e goditjes s faktorit psikologjik dhe pritshmrive t larta t agjentve ekonomik pr rritje t mimeve t importit t energjis dhe nafts dhe gjith produkteve t tjera t importit, por kjo nuk prfaqsonte nj situat reale t krkess dhe oferts pr valut n treg. Ather, Banka e Shqipris ndrhyri pr 2-3 dit dhe kursi u stabilizua. Fakti q kursi u stabilizua pas ndrhyrjes s Banks vrtetoi q sjellja e kursit ishte si pasoj e efekteve psikologjike, dhe jo e faktorit krkes-ofert. Gjithsesi, duhet t theksoj, se ne ndrhyjm vetm pr raste specifike n kursin e kmbimit. Nqs kursi i kmbimit do t nnmohej ose mbimohej si pasoj e nj realiteti t ri ekonomik, Banka e Shqipris nuk do t ndrhynte, sepse si e thash ndrhyrjet n kursin e kmbimit jan t specifikuara, bhen n raste shum t veanta kur goditet objektivi i inflacionit, stabilitetit financiar, pr rritjen e rezervs valutore, ose kur kemi sjellje t uditshme nga faktort psikologjik. N ditt aktuale, ne shohim q kursi vijon t mbetet i stabilizuar. Do t monitorojm si do t sillet ekonomia, si do t jen tregjet, sa do jet kohzgjatja e konfliktit dhe niveli i goditjes s konfliktit nga tregjet ndrkombtare n ekonomin shqiptare. Edhe vendimmarrja e sotme e Banks s Shqipris ose bankave qendrore n prgjithsi, pr rritjen e norms s interesit ka nj lidhje korrelative me nivelin e kursit t kmbimit. Mosreagimi i bankave qendrore nprmjet norms baz t interesit do t ndikonte n zhvlersimin e kursit t kmbimit.

Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: PRESS RELEASE Governor Sejko's remarks at the press conference on monetary policy decision making, 23 March 2022 Date of publication: 23.03.2022 Dear representatives of the media, Today, on 23 March 2022, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Intermediate Monetary Policy Report. The Council's discussions focused on the impact that russia's military assault on Ukraine will have on the Albanian economy. Sanctions imposed on Russia and increasing volatility and uncertainty in international markets have generated a new and challenging economic reality. This reality dictates the revision of our previous projections and reassessment of the adequacy of the monetary policy stance. Geopolitical tension will deal a double blow  directly from the supply and indirectly from the demand  on the Albanian economy. However, based on current analyses and projections, the Supervisory Council estimates that the Albanian economy will continue to grow during 2022 and beyond. This judgment is based on the breadth and strength of growth sources, the assumption of further non-escalation of conflict, as well as that of a continuation of a stimulus of monetary and fiscal policies. On the other hand, the Supervisory Council estimates that inflation will stay above the Bank of Albania's target for most of the next two years. In these circumstances, the Supervisory Council decided to adjust the level of monetary stimulus in the economy. This adaptation aims to create necessary monetary conditions for the respect of our inflation objective, for maintaining financial stability, as well as for the sustainable and long-term growth of the economy and employment in Albania. *** The new information available suggests that the world economy is facing and will continue to face high prices of food, raw materials and basic products. These strikes will also be broadcast in Albania. Consumer price inflation marked a rise in the first quarter. According to Instat data, this inflation recorded levels of 3.7% and 3.9%, respectively in January and February. Although full official data is missing, available information indicates a further increase in prices in the month of March. Inflation in Albania has been affected by the increase in prices of food, oil, and production and transport costs. In macroeconomic terms, the uptight inflation trend reflects rapid and steady demand growth, wage and employment growth, as well as the rapid growth in prices in international markets over the last two quarters. The latter have been high for the second half of last year and have come under increased pressure from the geopolitical tension accompanying the conflict in Ukraine. Further price performance will be determined by the intensity and duration of this conflict, the impact it will have on prices and international trade, as well as the sustainability of economic growth in the country. Data from foreign markets signal that prices in international markets will remain high during 2022 and 2023. These high prices will erode household purchasing power and be accompanied by slowing the pace of global growth. Consequently, global inflation projections for the next two years have been revised upwards, while economic growth projections have been revised downward. Likewise, most central banks have accelerated their plans to normalize the stance of monetary policy. In this case, the Albanian economy has shown clear signs of recovery. Available information indicates that economic activity exceeded the level recorded before the earthquake and pandemic in the first quarter of last year. This growth also has a broad base. It reflects the expansion of almost all sectors of the economy and components of aggregate demand. In macroeconomic terms, it has been fueled by improved confidence, rising foreign demand, favorable monetary and financial environment, and fiscal stimulus of the past two years. The Bank of Albania's stimulative monetary policy has generated stabilized financial markets, low interest rates and favorable financing conditions. Credit to the private sector grew by 11.8% in February, illustrating a growing support with funds, consumer and investment. The upstating lending trend is influenced by both the growth of business and household demand, as well as the favorable lending policies applied by the banking sector. This sector continues to be characterized by healthy liquid balance sheets and falling non-performing loans. Our estimates suggest that aggregate demand is generating an almost complete exploitation of capital and labor. Economic growth has been reflected in gradual increases in employment and accelerating pace of wage growth. In particular, Instat data shows that employment grew by 2.1% in annual terms during the fourth quarter of 2021, while pay in the private sector increased by 10.2%. The high rate of wage growth suggests that the labor market is characterized by scarce untapped spaces. *** The update of medium-term forecasts indicates that the Albanian economy will suffer the consequences of the blow. Rising prices in world markets, and reducing foreign demand, will be coupled with higher inflation rates and slower economic growth compared to our previous estimates. However, the baseline scenario estimates suggest that the Albanian economy will continue to grow during 2022 and in the medium term. Our projections also indicate that economic growth will remain in positive territory even if the impact results stronger than current estimates. On the other hand, supply shocks and domestic demand sustainability are expected to be reflected in higher inflation rates. Under the baseline scenario of the forecasts, inflation will fluctuate around the 5-6% level for the remainder of 2022. Further, with the expected calming of international markets, inflation is expected to come downwards during 2023 and return to target in its last quarter. *** In line with the above forecasts and its previous communications, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania deemed necessary to adjust the monetary policy stance to new economic conditions. Our monetary policy has been in a highly stimulating position over the past two years. It has targeted the promotion of aggregate demand during the pandemic, as a prerequisite for adherence to our inflation target. This policy has proved successful in its mission. However, the current supply hit and the robustness of aggregate demand, risk under-affecting our price stability target in the medium term. growth by 0.5 percentage points of the base interest rate, from the 0.5% level to the 1.0% level. Keeping the interest rate of the one-day deposit, at the current level of 0.1%; growth The interest rate of the one-day loan, from the level 0.9% to the level of 1.9%. The Supervisory Council notes that  even after this move  the monetary policy stance continues to be stimulating the growth of the economy, employment and wages. In the new reality, this position offers a better balance between the risk of accelerating inflation and the risk of damage to economic recovery. Judging on current information, the normalisation of the monetary policy stance will be a gradual and based-on new information process. However, the Supervisory Council notes that the balance of risks on inflation remains on the upper hand. For this reason, it will continuously monitor the reaction of the Albanian economy to this shock and will take all necessary measures to respect the price stability objective in the medium term.
text_original: NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 23 mars 2022 Data e publikimit: 23.03.2022 T nderuar prfaqsues t medias, Sot, n datn 23 mars 2022, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris mori n shqyrtim dhe miratoi Raportin e Ndrmjetm t Politiks Monetare. Diskutimet e Kshillit u prqendruan n ndikimin q do t ket n ekonomin shqiptare sulmi ushtarak i Rusis ndaj Ukrains. Sanksionet e vna ndaj Rusis dhe rritja e volatilitetit dhe e pasiguris n tregjet ndrkombtare kan gjeneruar nj realitet ekonomik t ri dhe sfidues. Ky realitet dikton rishikimin e projeksioneve tona t mparshme dhe rivlersimin e prshtatshmris s qndrimit t politiks monetare. Tensioni gjeopolitik do t jap nj goditje t dyfisht - direkte nga kahu i oferts dhe indirekte nga kahu i krkess  mbi ekonomin shqiptare. Megjithat, bazuar n analizat dhe projeksionet aktuale, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlerson se ekonomia shqiptare do t vijoj t rritet gjat vitit 2022 e n vazhdim. Ky gjykim mbshtetet n gjersin dhe fortsin e burimeve t rritjes, n supozimin e mos-prshkallzimit t mtejshm t konfliktit, si dhe at t vijimit t nj miksi stimulues politikash monetare e fiskale. Nga ana tjetr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlerson se inflacioni do t qndroj mbi objektivin e Banks s Shqipris gjat pjess m t madhe t dy viteve n vijim. N kto rrethana, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi t prshtat nivelin e stimulit monetar n ekonomi. Kjo prshtatje synon t krijoj kushte e nevojshme monetare pr respektimin e objektivit ton t inflacionit, pr ruajtjen e stabilitetit financiar, si dhe pr rritjen e qndrueshme dhe afatgjat t ekonomis dhe t punsimit n Shqipri. *** Informacioni i ri i disponuar sugjeron se ekonomia botrore po prballet dhe do t vijoj t prballet me mime t larta t ushqimeve, t lndve t para dhe t produkteve baz. Kto goditje do t transmetohen edhe n Shqipri. Inflacioni i mimeve t konsumit shnoi rritje n tremujorin e par. Sipas t dhnave t Instatit, ky inflacion regjistroi nivelet 3.7% dhe 3.9%, respektivisht n muajt janar dhe shkurt. Ndonse t dhnat e plota zyrtare mungojn, informacioni i disponuar tregon nj rritje t mtejshme t mimeve n muajin mars. Ecuria e inflacionit n Shqipri sht ndikuar nga rritja e mimeve t artikujve ushqimor, t nafts, dhe t kostove t prodhimit e t transportit. N terma makroekonomik, trendi rrits i inflacionit pasqyron rritjen e shpejt dhe t qndrueshme t krkess, rritjen e pagave dhe t punsimit, si dhe rritjen e shpejt t mimeve n tregjet ndrkombtare gjat dy tremujorve t fundit. Kto t fundit kan qen t larta gjat gjysms s dyt t vitit t shkuar dhe jan vn nn presion t shtuar nga tensioni gjeopolitik q shoqron konfliktin n Ukrain. Ecuria e mtejshme e mimeve do t prcaktohet nga intensiteti dhe kohzgjatja e ktij konflikti, nga ndikimi q ai do t ket mbi mimet dhe tregtin ndrkombtare, si dhe nga qndrueshmria e rritjes ekonomike n vend. T dhnat q vijn nga tregjet e huaja sinjalizojn se mimet n tregjet ndrkombtare do t vijojn t mbeten t larta gjat viteve 2022 dhe 2023. Kto mime t larta do t grryejn fuqin blerse t familjeve dhe do t shoqrohen me ngadalsim t ritmit t rritjes n rang botror. Pr rrjedhoj, projeksionet globale t inflacionit pr dy vitet n vijim jan ripar pr lart, ndrsa projeksionet e rritjes ekonomike jan ripar pr posht. Po ashtu, pjesa m e madhe e bankave qendrore kan prshpejtuar planet e tyre t normalizimit t qndrimit t politiks monetare. Prkundrejt ksaj situate, ekonomia shqiptare ka shfaqur shenja t qarta rimkmbjeje. Informacioni i disponuar tregon se aktiviteti ekonomik ka tejkaluar nivelin e regjistruar prpara trmetit e pandemis n tremujorin e par t vitit t shkuar. Po ashtu, ky Rritja ekonomike ka pasur nj baz t gjer. Ajo pasqyron zgjerimin e thuajse t gjith sektorve t ekonomis dhe prbrsve t krkess agregate. N terma makroekonomik, ajo sht ushqyer nga prmirsimi i besimit, nga rritja e krkess s huaj, nga ambienti i favorshm monetar dhe financiar, si dhe nga stimuli fiskal i dy viteve t fundit. Politika monetare stimuluese e Banks s Shqipris ka gjeneruar tregje financiare t stabilizuara, norma t ulta interesi dhe kushte t favorshme financimi. Kredia pr sektorin privat u rrit me 11.8% n muajin shkurt, duke ilustruar nj mbshtetje n rritje me fonde, t konsumit dhe investimeve. Trendi rrits i kreditimit sht ndikuar si nga rritja e krkess s biznesit dhe t familjeve, ashtu dhe nga politikat e favorshme t kreditimit t aplikuara nga sektori bankar. Ky sektor vijon t karakterizohet nga bilance likuide e t shndetshme dhe rnie e kredive me probleme. Vlersimet tona sugjerojn se krkesa agregate po gjeneron nj shfrytzim thuajse t plot t kapitalit dhe t puns. Rritja ekonomike sht pasqyruar n rritje graduale t punsimit dhe prshpejtim t ritmit t rritjes s pagave. N veanti, t dhnat e Instat-it tregojn se punsimi u rrit me 2.1% n terma vjetor gjat tremujorit t katrt t vitit 2021, ndrsa paga n sektorin privat u rrit me 10.2%. Norma e lart e rritjes s pagave sugjeron se tregu i puns karakterizohet nga hapsira t pakta t pashfrytzuara. *** Prditsimi i parashikimeve afatmesme tregon se ekonomia shqiptare do t vuaj pasojat e goditjes. Rritja e mimeve n tregjet botrore dhe reduktimi i krkess s huaj, do t shoqrohen me norma m t larta inflacioni dhe rritje m t ngadalt ekonomike krahasuar me vlersimet tona t mparshme. Megjithat, vlersimet e skenarit baz sugjerojn se ekonomia shqiptare do t vijoj t rritet gjat vitit 2022 dhe n afatin e mesm. Po ashtu, projeksionet tona tregojn se rritja ekonomike do t mbetet n territor pozitiv edhe n rast se goditja rezulton m e fort se vlersimet aktuale. Nga ana tjetr, goditjet e oferts dhe qndrueshmria e krkess s brendshme pritet t pasqyrohen n norma m t larta inflacioni. Sipas skenarit baz t parashikimeve, inflacioni do t luhatet rreth nivelit 5-6% pr pjesn e mbetur t vitit 2022. M tej, me qetsimin e pritur t tregjeve ndrkombtare, inflacioni pritet t vij n rnie gjat vitit 2023 dhe t kthehet n objektiv n tremujorin e fundit t tij. *** N konsistenc me parashikimet e msiprme dhe komunikimet e tij t mparshme, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris e vlersoi t nevojshm prshtatjen e qndrimit t politiks monetare me kushtet e reja ekonomike. Politika jon monetare ka qen n pozita tejet stimuluese gjat dy viteve t fundit. Ajo ka synuar nxitjen e krkess agregate gjat pandemis, si nj parakusht pr respektimin e objektivit ton t inflacionit. Kjo politik ka rezultuar e suksesshme n misionin e saj. Megjithat, goditja aktuale e oferts dhe fortsia e krkess agregate, rrezikojn t cenojn objektivin ton t stabilitetit t mimeve n afatin e mesm. rritjen me 0.5 pik prqindje t norms baz s interesit, nga niveli 0.5% n nivelin 1.0%. mbajtjen e norms s interesit t depozits njditore, n nivelin aktual prej 0.1%; rritjen e norms s interesit t kredis njditore, nga niveli 0.9% n nivelin 1.9%. Kshilli Mbikqyrs vren se  edhe pas ksaj lvizjeje  qndrimi i politiks monetare vijon t jet stimulues pr rritjen e ekonomis, t punsimit dhe t pagave. N realitetin e ri, ky qndrim ofron nj balanc m t mir midis rrezikut t prshpejtimit t inflacionit dhe rrezikut t dmtimit t rimkmbjes ekonomike. Duke gjykuar mbi informacionin aktual, normalizimi i qndrimit t politiks monetare do t jet nj proces gradual dhe i mbshtetur n informacionin e ri. Megjithat, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vren se balanca e rreziqeve mbi inflacionin mbetet n kahun e siprm. Pr kt arsye, ai do t monitoroj n vazhdimsi reagimin e ekonomis shqiptare ndaj ksaj goditjeje dhe do t marr t gjitha masat e nevojshme pr respektimin e objektivit t stabilitetit t mimeve n afatin e mesm.

Title: Speech at the Presentation of the EBRD 2021-2022 Transition Report
text: Governor Sejko's remarks at the Presentation of the EBRD Transition Report 2021-2022 Publication date: 05.04.2022 In nderuar Zonja Solovova, In zoti Plekhanov's case, Dear friends and guests, As every year, it is a special pleasure to welcome the presentation in Albania of the "Transition Report 2021-2022", prepared by the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development. This report remains an important moment of discussion and reflection on the challenges facing the economies of the region, in terms of convergence with European Union standards and sustainable and long-term growth of their well-being. Holding this meeting with physical presence conveys an important message. The world economy is leaving behind the worst days and worst consequences of the pandemic it has faced over the past two years. However, on our horizon as policymakers  but also in the daily life of the economic life of every business and family  a new challenge has emerged. Russia's military assault on Ukraine and the sanctions imposed have brought a rapid rise in food, oil, energy and raw materials prices to international markets. While the uncertainty is considerable, available information suggests that these prices will remain high, at least and through the remainder of 2022. Taking advantage of this public communication, and before I stop at the main messages of the Transition Report, allow me to briefly excavate the Bank of Albania's view of the expected impact of this crackdown and the measures that public authorities and the private sector should take to cope with it. As I pointed out, Albania and the region are facing a new reality of price and uncertainty in world markets. As small and open economies, we cannot escape the consequences of this reality. Overall, the Albanian economy will face additional costs for households, businesses and public sector balance sheets for a non-short time horizon. What does this mean for the Albanian economy? First, the negative aspect. Based on current information, our projections suggest inflation is expected to stay above target for much of the next two years. At the same time, business profit margins will be put on pressure and debt servicing costs will rise. Second, the positive aspect. Even in the presence of this shock, our projections suggest that the volume of economic activity in the country will increase during 2022. This prediction factors  on the one hand  the assumption of non-escalation of conflict and  on the other hand  the positive momentum with which the Albanian economy entered 2022, the breadth and strength of the sources of growth, as well as the continuation of a stimulus of monetary and fiscal policies. In this context, the focus of public authorities should be twofold. First, economic policies must protect from the consequences of hitting the most needy layers of society and the most fragile segments of the economy. This objective must be met through a temporary and prudential fiscal policy intervention which, in any case, should aim at the maximum possible, not translate into strong public debt growth. Second, the risk that the initial supply hit will be transmitted to costs and translated into expectations for high inflation in the future dictates the need to adjust the stance of economic policies. For this reason, public authorities should rebalance the objective of supporting economic recovery with the risk of underlying the country's monetary and financial stability. In our vision, economic and financial balance is a necessary prerequisite for sustainable growth. In this context, the increase in the base interest rate last month signals the bank of Albania's willingness to maintain price stability in the country. Recalibration of the monetary policy stance aims to minimise the consequences that the price crackdown will have on the cost of living, on the exchange rate and on the health of the banking sector in the medium and long term. At the same time, it is important to note that, even after this move, the stance of our monetary policy continues to remain stimulating for the growth of consumption and investment in the country. In parallel with public authorities, private sector operators should also take measures to minimise the impact of the crackdown. Albanian business should increase attention to operational costs in general and energy efficiency in particular. At the same time, I find it fitting to point out that the direct exposure of the Albanian economy to the conflicting countries has been and continues to remain limited. This means that  in the presence of a stable economic and financial environment  economic growth prospects over the medium and long term remain solid. Honourable guest, Our experience with the crises of the past two years has illustrated that success in coping with strokes is not the product of chance. Rather, it reflects the progress made with structural reforms, the degree of development and sophistication of the private sector, as well as the proactive response of economic policies. I am pleased to note that the Transition Report to be presented today echoes all three of these moments. The report highlights further, though gradual, structural reforms in Albania and the countries of the region. This is an encouraging development, for the very fact that progress has occurred during two years in which the main attention and energies have been focused on overcoming the consequences of the pandemic. At the same time, the report highlights that the countries of the region have made substantial progress in financial market development, with specific reforms that have improved market infrastructure, legal and regulatory framework, diversification of financial instruments, and market depth. Advancing financial market reforms, as well as those that enable the creation of a functional capital market, is necessary to increase the diversification of financing instruments and represents an untapped potential for our economies. The most important thing for this year's transition is digitalization. The pandemic confronted the trend of digitalization of many aspects of life and work. The benefits of digitalization, in terms of increased efficiency and productivity, but also increased access to finance, are well documented. The report notes that this process was even faster in our region, contributing to increased competitiveness, to the retention of jobs during the pandemic and to the growth of them after the opening of economies. The Bank of Albania has evaluated and encouraged the application of information technology and digitalization in the financial system early on. In this regard, it has been worked to promote greater use of technology in the payment system, to improve and strengthen the regulatory framework for electronic payment institutions, as well as for consumer and borrower protection. To further foster the growth of technological capabilities and to benefit from the technological dividend associated with it, I think regional and Albanian authorities should continue implementing specific structural reforms, which aim to: Support digitalization and technological innovation as an instrument for increasing productivity and competitiveness, through strengthening digital education and skills, increasing digital infrastructure and online services, and incentivizing companies to invest in new technologies and increase workforce training; development further financial market and the promotion of the capital market as an instrument for supporting new and innovative businesses, diversifying sources of financing and sharing the financial risk of entrepreneurs; Home structural reforms aimed at increasing competitiveness, improving governance, adopting green public policies, increasing all inclusion in economic processes, strengthening the sustainability of the economy and accelerating integration in regional and wider markets. In all, these reforms should aim at creating favorable institutional and legal conditions in support of the adoption of technological developments and the creation of new technologies. *** Honorable participant, Transition Report has consolidated its credentials as a professional and forward-looking document. This year's report is no exception. It helps all of us, decision makers, academics, researchers or private sector operators, to make a thorough diagnosis of the progress and path of the challenges ahead in economic development and enhanced well-being. Thank you all for your participation and invite you to contribute with your discussions to further expletion of his messages. Ju faleminderit!
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n Prezantimin e Raportit t Tranzicionit t BERZH 2021-2022 Data e publikimit: 05.04.2022 E nderuar zonja Solovova, I nderuar zoti Plekhanov, T nderuar miq e t ftuar, Si do vit, sht knaqsi e veant t mikpres prezantimin n Shqipri t Raportit t Tranzicionit 2021-2022, t prgatitur nga Banka Evropiane pr Rindrtim dhe Zhvillim. Ky Raport mbetet nj moment i rndsishm diskutimi dhe reflektimi mbi sfidat q kan prpara ekonomit e rajonit, n drejtim t konvergjencs me standardet e Bashkimit Evropian dhe t rritjes s qndrueshme e afatgjat t mirqenies s tyre. Mbajtja e ktij takimi me prani fizike prcjell nj mesazh t rndsishm. Ekonomia botrore po le pas ditt m t kqija dhe pasojat m t rnda t pandemis me t ciln ajo sht prballur gjat dy viteve t fundit. Megjithat, n horizontin ton si politikbrs  por edhe n prditshmrin e jets ekonomike t do biznesi dhe familjeje  sht shfaqur nj sfid e re. Sulmi ushtarak i Rusis ndaj Ukrains dhe sanksionet e vendosura, kan sjell nj rritje t shpejt t mimeve t ushqimeve, t nafts, t produkteve energjitike dhe t lndve t para, n tregjet ndrkombtare. Ndonse pasiguria sht e konsiderueshme, informacioni i disponuar sugjeron se kto mime do t vijojn t mbeten t larta, t paktn dhe gjat pjess s mbetur t vitit 2022. Duke prfituar nga ky komunikim publik, dhe prpara se t ndalem n mesazhet kryesore t Raportit t Tranzicionit, m lejoni t shtjelloj shkurtimisht kndvshtrimin e Banks s Shqipris mbi ndikimin e pritur t ksaj goditjeje dhe masat q autoritetet publike e sektori privat duhet t marrin pr prballimin e saj. Sikundr e theksova, Shqipria dhe rajoni po prballen me nj realitet t ri mimesh dhe pasigurie n tregjet botrore. Si ekonomi t vogla dhe t hapura, ne nuk mund tu shptojm pasojave t ktij realiteti. N vija t prgjithshme, ekonomia shqiptare do t prballet me kosto shtes pr familjet, bizneset dhe bilancet e sektorit publik, pr nj horizont jo t shkurtr kohor. far do t thot kjo pr ekonomin shqiptare? S pari, aspekti negativ. Bazuar n informacionin aktual, projeksionet tona sugjerojn se inflacioni pritet t qndroj mbi objektiv pr pjesn m t madhe t dy viteve t ardhshme. N t njjtn koh, marzhet e fitimit t biznesit do t vihen n presion dhe kostot e shrbimit t borxhit do t rriten. S dyti, aspekti pozitiv. Edhe n prani t ksaj goditjeje, projeksionet tona sugjerojn se vllimi i aktivitetit ekonomik n vend do t shnoj rritje gjat vitit 2022. Ky parashikim faktorizon  nga njra an  supozimin e mosprshkallzimit t konfliktit dhe  nga ana tjetr  momentin pozitiv me t cilin ekonomia shqiptare hyri n vitin 2022, gjersin dhe fortsin e burimeve t rritjes, si dhe vazhdimin e nj miksi stimulues politikash monetare dhe fiskale. N kt kontekst, fokusi i autoriteteve publike duhet t jet i dyfisht. S pari, politikat ekonomike duhet t mbrojn nga pasojat e goditjes shtresat m n nevoj t shoqris dhe segmentet m t brishta t ekonomis. Ky objektiv duhet t prmbushet nprmjet nj ndrhyrjeje t prkohshme dhe t kujdesshme t politiks fiskale, e cila, n do rast, duhet t synoj n maksimumin e mundshm, t mos prkthehet n rritje t fort t borxhit publik. S dyti, rreziku q goditja fillestare e oferts t transmetohet n kosto dhe t prkthehet n pritje pr inflacion t lart n t ardhmen, dikton nevojn e prshtatjes s qndrimit t politikave ekonomike. Pr kt arsye, autoritetet publike duhet t ribalancojn objektivin e mbshtetjes s rimkmbjes ekonomike me rrezikun e dmtimit t stabilitetit monetar dhe financiar t vendit. N vizionin ton, ekuilibri ekonomik dhe financiar sht nj parakusht i domosdoshm pr rritje t qndrueshme. N kt kontekst, rritja gjat muajit t kaluar e norms baz t interesit sinjalizon vullnetin e Banks s Shqipris pr t ruajtur stabilitetin e mimeve n vend. Rikalibrimi i qndrimit t politiks monetare synon t minimizoj pasojat q goditja e mimeve do t ket mbi koston e jetess, mbi kursin e kmbimit dhe mbi shndetin e sektorit bankar n afatin e mesm dhe t gjat. N t njjtn kohe, sht e rndsishme t theksohet se, edhe pas ksaj lvizjeje, qndrimi i politiks son monetare vijon t mbetet stimulues pr rritjen e konsumit dhe t investimeve n vend. Paralelisht me autoritetet publike, edhe operatort e sektorit privat duhet t marrin masa pr minimizimin e pasojave t goditjes. Biznesi shqiptar duhet t rris vmendjen ndaj kostove operacionale n prgjithsi dhe eficiencs energjitike n veanti. N t njjtn koh, gjej me vend t theksoj se ekspozimi direkt i ekonomis shqiptare ndaj vendeve n konflikt ka qen dhe vijon t mbetet i kufizuar. Kjo do t thot se  n prani t nj ambienti t qndrueshm ekonomik dhe financiar  perspektivat e rritjes ekonomike n afatin e mesm dhe t gjat mbeten solide. T nderuar t ftuar, Eksperienca jon me krizat e dy viteve t fundit ka ilustruar se suksesi n prballimin e goditjeve nuk sht produkt i rastsis. Prkundrazi, ai pasqyron progresin e br me reformat strukturore, shkalln e zhvillimit dhe sofistikimit t sektorit privat, si dhe reagimin proaktiv t politikave ekonomike. Me knaqsi konstatoj se Raporti i Tranzicionit q do t prezantohet sot i bn jehon t tre ktyre momenteve. Raporti evidenton progres t mtejshm, ndonse gradual, t reformave strukturore n Shqipri dhe n vendet e rajonit. Ky sht nj zhvillim inkurajues, pr vet faktin se progresi ka ndodhur gjat dy viteve n t cilat vmendja dhe energjit kryesore kan qen t prqendruara n tejkalimin e pasojave t pandemis. N t njjtn koh, raporti thekson se vendet e rajonit kan br progres t qensishm n zhvillimin e tregut financiar, me reforma specifike q kan prmirsuar infrastrukturn e tregut, kornizn ligjore e rregullatore, diversifikimin e instrumenteve financiare, si dhe thellsin e tregut. Avancimi i reformave t tregut financiar, si dhe i atyre q mundsojn krijimin e nj tregu funksional kapitalesh, sht i domosdoshm pr t rritur diversifikimin e instrumenteve t financimit dhe prbn nj potencial ende t pashfrytzuar pr ekonomit tona. Lajtmotivi i Raportit t Tranzicionit pr kt vit sht digjitalizimi. Prballja me pandemin prshpejtoi trendin e nisur t digjitalizimit t shum aspekteve t jets dhe t puns. Prfitimet nga digjitalizimi, n terma t rritjes s eficiencs e t produktivitetit, por edhe t rritjes s aksesit n financ, jan t mirdokumentuara. Raporti v n dukje se ky proces ishte edhe m i shpejt n rajonin ton, duke kontribuar n rritjen e konkurrueshmris, n ruajtjen e vendeve t puns prgjat pandemis dhe n shtimin e tyre pas hapjes s ekonomive. Banka e Shqipris ka vlersuar dhe inkurajuar q hert aplikimin e teknologjis s informacionit dhe digjitalizimit n sistemin financiar. N kt drejtim, sht punuar pr nxitjen e prdorimit m t madh t teknologjis n sistemin e pagesave, pr prmirsimin dhe forcimin e kuadrit rregullator pr institucionet e pagesave elektronike, si dhe pr mbrojtjen e konsumatorit dhe huamarrsit. Pr t nxitur m tej rritjen e aftsive teknologjike e pr t prfituar nga dividendi teknologjik i lidhur me t, mendoj se autoritetet rajonale dhe shqiptare duhet t vazhdojn zbatimin e reformave specifike strukturore, t cilat synojn: mbshtetjen e digjitalizimit dhe t inovacionit teknologjik, si nj instrument pr rritjen e produktivitetit dhe t konkurrueshmris, me an t forcimit t edukimit dhe aftsive digjitale, rritjes s infrastrukturs digjitale dhe t shrbimeve online, si dhe incentivizimin e kompanive pr t investuar n teknologji t reja e pr t shtuar trajnimin e forcs s puns; zhvillimin e mtejshm t tregut financiar dhe promovimin e tregut t kapitaleve, si nj instrument pr mbshtetjen e bizneseve t reja e inovative, pr diversifikimin e burimeve t financimit dhe pr ndarjen e rrezikut financiar t siprmarrsve; vijimin e reformave strukturore me synim rritjen e konkurrueshmris, prmirsimin e qeverisjes, adoptimin e politikave publike t gjelbra, rritjen e gjtihprfshirjes n proceset ekonomike, forcimin e qndrueshmris s ekonomis dhe prshpejtimin e integrimit n tregjet rajonale e m gjer. N trsi, kto reforma duhet t synojn krijimin e kushteve t favorshme institucionale e ligjore n mbshtetje t adoptimit t zhvillimeve teknologjike dhe t krijimit t teknologjive t reja. *** T nderuar pjesmarrs, Raporti i Tranzicionit i ka konsoliduar kredencialet e veta si nj dokument profesional dhe largpams. Edhe Raporti i ktij viti nuk bn prjashtim. Ai na ndihmon t gjithve, vendimmarrs, akademik, studiues apo operator t sektorit privat, t bjm nj diagnoz t plot t progresit dhe rrugs e sfidave q kemi prpara n zhvillimin ekonomik dhe rritjen e mirqenies. Ju falenderoj t gjithve pr pjesmarrjen dhe ju ftoj t kontribuoni me diskutimet tuaja n shtjelllimin e mtejshm t mesazheve t tij. Ju faleminderit!

Title: Speech at the Signing Ceremony of the EBRD Agribusiness and Tourism Support Program (AATSF) Loan Agreement between the EBRD and ProCredit Bank Albania
text: Governor Sejko's remarks at the Signing Ceremony of the Loan Agreement for the EBRD Programme for The Support of Agribusiness and Tourism in the Country (AATSF) between the EBRD and ProCredit Bank Albania Date of publication: 11.04.2022 E nderuara zonja President and BERZh-it, Dear Mrs. Minister, Dear Representative of the Delegation of the European Union, Honourable representatives of ProCredit Bank, Dear friends and colleagues, The Bank of Albania is pleased to open its doors today for the signing ceremony of the agreement between the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) and proCredit Bank, on the use of the risk sharing instrument within the Agribusiness and Tourism Support Programme in Albania. Under the umbrella of this program, the EBRD, the European Union and the Government of Albania, in partnership with the financial sector, are increasing access to financing for operating companies in these sectors, thus addressing one of the main challenges for their development. We are all aware of the difficulties of financing companies in the field of agribusiness and tourism, which are largely organized as small and medium-sized enterprises. But we are all aware of the enormous potential of these companies, as value makers, as hiring promoters and as a source of innovation. All of these are important ingredients for a successful recipe for the sustainable development of our economy. For this reason, I consider it extremely important and fruitful to undertaking such programs, which enable not only availability of funds, but also increase the capacity of analysis, evaluation and further financing of the banking sector. The risk sharing and guarantee instruments ease the burden on banks in terms of risk and further help pave the way towards sustainable financing of these sectors. I have said before that any effort to increase access to finance must be seen as a shared opportunity for growth, both by the real sector and the banking industry. I will therefore continue to encourage the banking industry to engage more, but prudently, in potential sectors of the country. The signing of the agreement today is a step forward in that direction. The EBRD has made available a fund of up to 100 million euros for financing and risk sharing facilities, which will enable an additional investment of 80 million euros from participating financial institutions. For its part, the Albanian government has made available up to 36 million euros to support this program through risk coverage for the first losses in the timeframe of 3 years. Since the start of the program in 2016, more than 6,100 small and medium-sized enterprises in the field of agribusiness have received loans of 70 million euros. I take the opportunity to thank in particular our international partners, the EBRD and the EU, for their concrete support with financial investment in key areas of the economy. Thanks to this support we are able to achieve sustainable development outcomes and make a real difference in people's lives.
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n Ceremonin e nnshkrimit t marrveshjes s huas pr programin e BERZH-it pr mbshtetjen e Agrobiznesit dhe Turizmit n vend (AATSF) midis BERZH-it dhe ProCredit Bank Albania Data e publikimit: 11.04.2022 E nderuara zonja Presidente e BERZh-it, T nderuara Zonja Ministre, I nderuar prfaqsues i Delegacionit t Bashkimit Evropian, T nderuar prfaqsues t Banks ProCredit, T dashur miq e koleg, Banka e Shqipris ka knaqsin t hap dyert e saj sot pr ceremonin e nnshkrimit t marrveshjes midis Banks Evropiane pr Rindrtim dhe Zhvillim (BERZh) dhe Banks ProCredit, pr prdorimin e instrumentit t ndarjes t rrezikut n kuadr t Programit pr Mbshtetjen e Agrobiznesit dhe Turizmit n Shqipri. Nn ombrelln e ktij programi, BERZh, Bashkimi Evropian dhe Qeveria e Shqipris, n partneritet me sektorin financiar, po rritin aksesin n financim pr kompanit operuese n kta sektor, duke adresuar kshtu nj nga sfidat kryesore pr zhvillimin e tyre. T gjith jemi t ndrgjegjshm pr vshtirsit q ka financimi i kompanive n fushn e agrobiznesit dhe t turizmit, t cilat, n pjesn drrmuese jan t organizuara si siprmarrje t vogla dhe t mesme. Por, gjithashtu, t gjith jemi t ndrgjegjshm pr potencialin e madh t ktyre kompanive, si krijues vlere, si promotor punsimi dhe si burim inovacioni. T gjith kta jan ingredient t rndsishm pr nj recet t suksesshme pr zhvillimin e qndrueshm t ekonomis son. Pr kt arsye, e konsideroj tejet t rndsishme dhe frytdhnse ndrmarrjen e programeve t tilla, t cilat mundsojn jo vetm disponibilitet fondesh, por edhe rrisin kapacitetin analizues, vlersues dhe m tej financues t sektorit bankar. Instrumentet e garancis dhe t ndarjes s rrezikut lehtsojn barrn e bankave n terma t rrezikut dhe m tej ndihmojn n shtrimin e rrugs drejt financimit t qndrueshm t ktyre sektorve. Un e kam thn edhe m par se do prpjekje pr t rritur aksesin n financim duhet par si nj mundsi e prbashkt pr rritje, si nga sektori real, ashtu edhe nga industria bankare. Prandaj, do t vazhdoj t inkurajoj industrin bankare pr nj angazhim m t madh, por t kujdesshm, tek sektort potencial t vendit. Nnshkrimi i marrveshjes sot sht nj hap prpara n kt drejtim. BERZH ka vn n dispozicion nj fond deri m 100 milion euro pr financim dhe pr lehtsira pr ndarjen e rrezikut, t cilat do t mundsojn nj investim shtes prej 80 milion eurosh nga institucionet financiare pjesmarrse. Nga ana e saj, qeveria shqiptare ka vendosur n dispozicion deri n 36 milion euro pr t mbshtetur kt program nprmjet mbulimit t riskut pr humbjet e para n harkun kohor t 3 viteve. Prej fillimi t programit n vitin 2016, m shum se 6,100 ndrmarrje t vogla e t mesme n fushn e agrobiznesit kan prfituar kredi n vlern 70 milion euro. Un gjej rastin t falnderoj n veanti partnert tan ndrkombtar, BERZH-in dhe BE, pr mbshtetjen konkrete me investime financiare n fusha kye t ekonomis. Fal ksaj mbshtetje ne jemi n gjendje t arrijm rezultate t zhvillimit t qndrueshm e t bjm nj ndryshim t vrtet n jetn e njerzve.

Title: Speech at the press conference on monetary policy decision-making
text: Governor Sejko's speech at the press conference on decision making politikes monetare, 04 maj 2022 Date of publication: 04.05.2022 Dear representatives of the media, Today, on 4 May 2022, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Quarterly Monetary Policy Report. The world and Albanian economies continue to be subject to the blow caused by the conflict in Ukraine. This crackdown has increased food, raw material and energy prices, added uncertainty to economic agents, and begun to be reflected in tighter financing conditions. As a result of this complex of factors, inflation has seen a significant increase, while economic growth has shown signs of slowing. The new information received in the analysis suggests that the bid headwinds will be stronger and more consistent in time than our previous estimates. Consequently, inflation is expected to stay longer above the Bank of Albania's target, while the pace of economic growth  although positive  will be lower than our expectations at the beginning of the year. However, the Supervisory Council notes that the Albanian economy will maintain its monetary and financial stability. This forecast factors in our expectations for non-escalation of conflict, for reducing global market pressures over the coming year, and for continued economic growth in our trading partners. It also calls for the gradual normalization of monetary policy over the medium-term horizon. Judging on the above, at today's meeting, the Supervisory Council decided not to change the monetary policy stance. [In the following, let me explain in more detail the main conclusions of the Quarterly Report, our expectations for the future, and the reasons that motivated today's decision.] The new information obtained in the analysis showed that inflationary pressures in world markets resulted stronger and more stable than our expectations at the beginning of the year. The conflict in Ukraine and sanctions imposed on Russia brought new disruptions to global production and distribution chains and added uncertainties for the future. They were followed by a strong price rise in world markets and aggressive central banks' moves in the direction of tightening monetary policy stance. Inflation in the country increased during the first quarter of the year, marking the average level of 4.4%. Its growth was particularly rapid in March, when inflation jumped to 5.7%. For the most part, the rise in inflation was caused by supply shocks, coming from rising food and oil prices. However, in parallel, the rising inflation trend has also reflected the rapid economic recovery over the past year, employment and wage growth, as well as the increasing trend of inflation expectations. The expansion of aggregate demand and the improved labor market have generated added inflationary pressures from the domestic economy. According to the Institute of Statistics, gross domestic product grew by 8.5% during 2021, surpassing levels recorded before the earthquake and pandemic. Economic growth was supported by expansion of consumption, investment and exports. Rising demand for goods and services has driven employment, wages and production costs to rise. Employment growth brought the unemployment rate down to 11.4% at the end of 2021 and was reflected in a rapid increase in wages in the last two quarters of last year. The improving labor market will help cushion some of the hit coming from high prices, but translate into more consistent pressures in time on inflation. In macroeconomic terms, the expansion of aggregate demand has been supported by the easing of restrictive measures for pandemic control, improved confidence, increased foreign demand, as well as monetary and fiscal stimulus policies. In particular, the strong monetary stimulus of the past two years has supported the economy's recovery from earthquake and pandemic shocks. Stimulus monetary policy has generated a calm financial environment characterized by abundant liquidity, low credit costs and stable exchange rates. In addition to these factors, the good health of the banking sector and high demand for funds have supported the steady growth of credit. In March, the loan portfolio for the private sector increased by 12.8%, meeting the needs of households and businesses for consumption, investments and circulating capital. The increase in the base interest rate during March has had a rapid transmission to short-term segments of the monetary market. It has favoured a better anchoring of expectations for inflation, as well as helping stabilise pressures on the exchange rate. However, its effect on deposit and bank loans prices has not yet appeared complete. Our direct exposure to countries involved in conflict is relatively low. However, the war in Ukraine has dimmed the outlook for global growth and particularly that of European economies, as well as added to inflationary pressures. The update of our baseline scenario forecasts suggests that inflation in the country will remain at relatively high levels over the coming period. High prices in world markets, increased aggregate demand, and labor market dynamics are expected to keep inflation near current levels during 2022. Further, it is expected to come in gradual decline during 2023 and return to target in the first half of 2024. In the event of this, the Albanian economy is expected to continue to grow over the medium-term horizon. Economic growth will continue to be supported by still favourable financing conditions, the sound financial balances of the real and financial sector, as well as the lingering growth of exports. However, the pace of growth is expected to be slower than the forecasts of the year. The balance of risks around these forecasts remains shifted upwards in the case of inflation and downwards in the case of economic growth. It reflects the heightened uncertainties that the conflict in Ukraine has caused in the markets of products, factors of production and financial factors. *** Judging on the above, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania assessed that the current monetary policy stance is appropriate for meeting the price stability objective in the medium term and for supporting economic recovery. For this reason, the Supervisory Board decided: the Keep the basic interest rate unchanged, at level 1.0%; the The interest rates of deposits and one-day loans are kept unchanged, respectively, at 0.1% and 1.9%. In the Council's judgment, the current level of monetary stimulus provides the right balance between the risk of accelerating inflation and the risk of slowing economic growth. However, the Supervisory Council will carefully monitor inflation dynamics and remains ready to intervene on time and with the necessary force to ensure compliance with its price stability objective. In the Judgment of the Council, respecting this objective will require the normalization of the monetary policy stance in the medium term. In line with the baseline scenario projections, this normalization will take the form of a gradual process over the next two years. However, given the country's very low interest rate levels, monetary policy will remain in a stimulus position throughout this period. Conversely, materializing risk scenarios may cause deviations from this scenario. In any case, the stance of monetary policy will be guided by new information and the need for respecting our price stability objective.
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 04 maj 2022 Data e publikimit: 04.05.2022 T nderuar prfaqsues t medias, Sot, n datn 4 maj 2022, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris mori n shqyrtim dhe miratoi Raportin Tremujor t Politiks Monetare. Ekonomia botrore dhe ajo shqiptare vijojn t jen subjekt i goditjes s shkaktuar nga konflikti n Ukrain. Kjo goditje ka rritur mimet e ushqimeve, t lndve t para dhe t atyre energjetike, ka shtuar pasigurit n agjentt ekonomik, dhe ka filluar t pasqyrohet n kushte m t shtrnguara financimi. Si pasoj e ktij kompleksi faktorsh, inflacioni ka psuar nj rritje t ndjeshme, ndrsa rritja ekonomike ka shfaqur shenja ngadalsimi. Informacioni i ri i marr n analiz sugjeron se goditjet e oferts do t jen m t forta dhe m t qndrueshme n koh se vlersimet tona t mparshme. Pr rrjedhoj, inflacioni pritet t qndroj m gjat mbi objektivin e Banks s Shqipris, ndrsa ritmi i rritjes ekonomike  ndonse pozitiv  do t jet m i ult se pritjet tona t fillimvitit. Megjithat, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vren se ekonomia shqiptare do t ruaj stabilitetin e saj monetar dhe financiar. Ky parashikim faktorizon pritjet tona pr mosprshkallzimin e konfliktit, pr reduktimin e presioneve n tregjet botrore gjat vitit t ardhshm dhe pr vijimin e rritjes ekonomike n partnert tan tregtar. Gjithashtu, ai krkon normalizimin gradual t politiks monetare n horizontin afatmesm. Duke gjykuar mbi sa m sipr, n mbledhjen e sotme, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi t mos ndryshoj qndrimin e politiks monetare. [ N vijim, m lejoni t sqaroj m n detaje konkluzionet kryesore t Raportit Tremujor, pritjet tona pr t ardhmen, si dhe arsyet q motivuan vendimin e sotm. ] Informacioni i ri i marr n analiz tregoi se presionet inflacioniste n tregjet botrore rezultuan m t forta dhe m t qndrueshme sesa pritjet tona n fillim t vitit. Konflikti n Ukrain dhe sanksionet e vendosura ndaj Rusis solln ndrprerje t reja n zinxhirt global t prodhimit e t shprndarjes dhe shtuan pasigurit pr t ardhmen. Ato u pasuan nga nj rritje e fort e mimeve n tregjet botrore dhe lvizje agresive t bankave qendrore n drejtim t shtrngimit t qndrimit t politiks monetare. Inflacioni n vend u rrit gjat tremujorit t par t vitit, duke shnuar nivelin mesatar prej 4.4%. Rritja e tij ishte veanrisht e shpejt n muajin mars, kur inflacioni krceu n 5.7%. N pjesn m t madhe, rritja e inflacionit u shkaktua nga goditjet e oferts, t ardhura nga rritja e mimeve t ushqimeve dhe t nafts. Megjithat, paralelisht me to, trendi rrits i inflacionit ka pasqyruar edhe rimkmbjen e shpejt ekonomike gjat vitit t shkuar, rritjen e punsimit dhe t pagave, si dhe tendencn n rritje t pritjeve pr inflacionin. Zgjerimi i krkess agregate dhe prmirsimi i tregut t puns kan gjeneruar presione t shtuara inflacioniste nga ekonomia vendase. Sipas Institutit t Statistikave, prodhimi i brendshm bruto u rrit me 8.5% gjat vitit 2021, duke tejkaluar nivelet e regjistruara para trmetit dhe pandemis. Rritja ekonomike u mbshtet nga zgjerimi i konsumit, i investimeve dhe i eksporteve. Rritja e krkess pr mallra e shrbime ka nxitur rritjen e punsimit, t pagave dhe t kostove t prodhimit. Rritja e punsimit solli rnien n 11.4% t norms s papunsis n fund t vitit 2021 dhe u pasqyrua n nj rritje t shpejt t pagave n dy tremujort e fundit t vitit t shkuar. Prmirsimi i tregut t puns do t ndihmoj n amortizimin e nj pjese t goditjes q vjen nga mimet e larta, por prkthehet dhe n presione m t qndrueshme n koh mbi inflacionin. N terma makroekonomik, zgjerimi i krkess agregate sht mbshtetur nga lehtsimi i masave kufizuese pr kontrollin e pandemis, prmirsimi i besimit, rritja e krkess s huaj, si dhe nga politikat stimuluese monetare e fiskale. N veanti, stimuli i fort monetar i dy viteve t fundit ka mbshtetur rimkmbjen e ekonomis nga goditjet e trmetit dhe pandemis. Politika monetare stimuluese ka gjeneruar nj ambient financiar t qet, t karakterizuar nga likuiditet i bollshm, kosto t ulta kreditimi dhe kurs i qndrueshm kmbimi. Krahas ktyre faktorve, shndeti i mir i sektorit bankar dhe krkesa e lart pr fonde, kan mbshtetur rritjen e qndrueshme t kredis. N muajin mars, portofoli i kredis pr sektorin privat u rrit me 12.8%, duke plotsuar nevojat e familjeve dhe t bizneseve pr konsum, investime dhe kapital qarkullues. Rritja e norms baz t interesit gjat muajit mars ka pasur nj transmetim t shpejt n segmentet afatshkurtra t tregut monetar. Ajo ka favorizuar nj ankorim m t mir t pritjeve pr inflacionin, si dhe ka ndihmuar stabilizimin e presioneve mbi kursin e kmbimit. Megjithat, efekti i saj n mimet e depozitave e t kredive bankare nuk sht shfaqur ende i plot. Ekspozimi yn direkt ndaj vendeve t prfshira n konflikt sht relativisht i ult. Megjithat, lufta n Ukrain ka zbehur perspektivn e rritjes globale dhe veanrisht at t ekonomive evropiane, si dhe ka shtuar presionet inflacioniste. Prditsimi i parashikimeve tona t skenarit baz sugjeron se inflacioni n vend do t mbetet n nivele relativisht t larta gjat periudhs n vijim. mimet e larta n tregjet botrore, krkesa e rritur agregate, si dhe dinamikat e tregjeve t puns, pritet ta mbajn inflacionin pran niveleve aktuale gjat vitit 2022. M tej, ai pritet t vij n rnie graduale gjat vitit 2023 dhe t kthehet n objektiv n gjysmn e par t vitit 2024. Prkundrejt ksaj ecurie, ekonomia shqiptare pritet t vijoj rritjen gjat horizontit afatmesm. Rritja ekonomike do t vijoj t mbshtetet nga kushtet ende t favorshme t financimit, nga bilancet e shndosha financiare t sektorit real dhe financiar, si dhe nga vijimi i rritjes s eksporteve. Megjithat, ritmi i rritjes pritet t jet m i ngadalt krahasuar me parashikimet e fillimvitit. Balanca e rreziqeve rreth ktyre parashikimeve mbetet e zhvendosur pr lart n rastin e inflacionit dhe pr posht n rastin e rritjes ekonomike. Ajo pasqyron pasigurit e rritura q ka shkaktuar konflikti n Ukrain n tregjet e produkteve, t faktorve t prodhimit dhe ato financiare. *** Duke gjykuar mbi sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare sht i prshtatshm pr prmbushjen e objektivit t stabilitetit t mimeve n afatin e mesm dhe pr mbshtetjen e rimkmbjes ekonomike. Pr kt arsye, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi: t mbaj t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 1.0%; t mbaj t pandryshuara normat e interesit t depozitave dhe t kredive njditore, respektivisht n nivelin 0.1% dhe 1.9%. N gjykimin e Kshillit, niveli aktual i stimulit monetar ofron balancn e duhur midis rrezikut t prshpejtimit t inflacionit dhe rrezikut t ngadalsimit t rritjes ekonomike. Megjithat, Kshilli Mbikqyrs do t monitoroj me kujdes dinamikn e inflacionit dhe mbetet i gatshm t ndrhyj n kohn dhe me forcn e duhur pr t garantuar respektimin e objektivit t tij t stabilitetit t mimeve. N gjykimin e Kshillit, respektimi i ktij objektivi do t krkoj normalizimin e qndrimit t politiks monetare n afatin e mesm. N prputhje me parashikimet e skenarit baz, ky normalizim do t marr formn e nj procesi gradual gjat dy viteve t ardhshme. Megjithat, nisur nga nivelet tejet t ulta t normave t interesit n vend, politika monetare do t vijoj t mbetet n pozita stimuluese gjat gjith ksaj periudhe. N t kundrt, materializimi i skenarve t rrezikut mund t shkaktoj devijime nga ky skenar. N do rast, qndrimi i politiks monetare do t udhhiqet nga informacioni i ri dhe nevoja pr respektimin e objektivit ton t stabilitetit t mimeve.

Title: Governor Sejko's remarks during the presentation of the Annual Report of the Bank of Albania for 2021 to the Economy and Finance Commission
text: Governor Sejko's remarks during the presentation of the Annual Report of the Bank of Albania for 2021 to the Economy and Finance Commission Date of publication: 11.05.2022 Mr. Chairman, Dear Ladies and Gentlemen, First, let me thank you for the assessment you gave me, entrusting me with a second term as Governor of the Bank of Albania. I assure you that the accountability and constructive dialogue between our institutions will continue in the future. In my speech today, I will present to you the work and results of the Bank of Albania over the past year, both in terms of fulfilling its legal obligations, as well as in terms of respecting the Assembly resolution on the activity of the Bank of Albania for 2020 and implementing its institutional commitments. However, taking advantage of this opportunity, I would like to share with you our view of the challenges we are facing in the new economic reality, caused by Russia's military assault on Ukraine. This development has brought a massive increase in prices of basic products to world markets, costing households' living costs and increasing the production costs of businesses. Moreover, armed conflict has added to uncertainties and created new bottlenecks in supply chains, which are also being affected by newly imposed restrictions on new waves of pandemics in Asia. This double-impact hit  rising prices and falling economic activity  will also be transmitted to the Albanian economy. It is expected to bring higher inflation rates and slower economic growth to Albania compared to our estimates before the war began. However, the positive trend of economic development of the country is expected to remain pristine in the medium and long term. Based on current information, we expect the economy to continue to grow during 2022 and upcoming. This judgment is based on the breadth and strength of growth sources, consolidated economic and financial balances, and the continuation of a stimulus of monetary and fiscal policies. On the other hand, we anticipate inflation to remain at relatively high levels during 2022. Further, it is expected to come downwards during 2023, in line with expected reduction of pressures in world markets, and return to target in the first half of 2024. These projections rely on three important considerations. First, they assume non-escalation of conflict and continous growth in our trading partners. Second, they factor in the solid foundations of the Albanian economy after the overall recovery of 2021. In summary, let me emphasize that the Albanian economy ended 2021 with improved economic and financial parameters. The volume of economic activity increased, employment expanded and wage growth accelerated. Overall, private sector balances improved, the country's monetary and financial stability consolidated, and financial markets functioned normally. In particular, the banking sector maintained good indicators of liquidity, capitalization and profitability. Third, they require constant revision of the mix of economic policies. In the judgment of the Bank of Albania, these policies should continue to provide support for the recovery process, but without prejudice for any moment the monetary and financial stability of the country. This stability has been and remains a prerequisite for the sustainable development of the economy and the growth of the well-being of society. Meeting this target today, unlike before, requires addressing the risks to rising inflation. Starting from the above, the Bank of Albania's monetary policy will continue to be guided by respect for its primary objective: maintaining price stability. In this spirit, we decided to raise the base interest rate in March, returning it to the pre-emptive level of 1%. On the other hand, fiscal policy should continue to provide financial support to the lower-income strata of society and to sectors most vulnerable to shock. However, this support should be funded by the additional revenue provided by rising prices and by the revision of non-surpriation expenditure. In this way, the effectiveness of intervention will not harm public debt indicators. Dear Ladies and Gentlemen, The conflict has added uncertainty about the future. The scale of its impact will depend on the duration of the conflict and the potential tightening of sanctions on Russia. We are aware that the risks to inflation are concentrated upwards and those to economic growth downwards. In this complex economic environment, the role of monetary and fiscal policies remains critical. The Bank of Albania will continue to monitor the performance of inflation and will not hesitate to react, in time and with the necessary force, to guarantee the country's monetary and financial stability. The course of monetary policy is expected to begin the path of gradual normalization during 2022. This position provides an appropriate balance between the risk of accelerating inflation and the risk of slowing economic growth. Following my speech, I will briefly focus on the main directions of our work during 2021 and its results. *** 1. Economic performance and monetary policy of the Bank of Albania The Albanian economy recovered in rapid steps in 2021. According to Statistics Institute data, gross domestic product grew by 8.5%, after contracting by 3.5% during 2020. The rapid economic growth reflected reductions in restrictive measures, increased confidence, improved foreign environment, as well as monetary and fiscal incentives. These factors gave way to rapid expansion of demand for goods and services. The rapid economic recovery had several characteristics, which illustrated the flexibility of our economy and are encouraging premises for the sustainable growth of the following economy. Let me stop at some of them: Recovery It was broad-based. In terms of aggregate demand, it reflected the growth of consumption and private investment, the expansion of exports of goods and services, as well as the positive contribution of fiscal stimulus. In sectoral terms, it reflected the expansion of all sectors of the economy. Recovery It was accompanied by increased employment and wages, improving the financial balance of families. Employment growth enabled the unemployment rate to drop to 11.4% at the end of the year, staying close to pre-crisis levels. In their reflection, wages recognized high growth rates in almost all sectors of the economy. Recovery It was full. Both the economy as a whole and its individual sectors in particular have outperformed the levels of production and income they provided in the run-up to the pandemic and earthquake of 2019. This development illustrates the rapid demand recovery and the small structural impact these shocks had on the manufacturing structure of the economy. Recovery It reflects the positive contribution of all economic actors. First, the response of businesses and households showed that they enjoyed both relatively solid balance sheets and flexibility and willingness to return to their normal economic behavior. Second, the response of the public authorities was swift, appropriate and efficient, which eased the financial burden of the blow on Albanian businesses and families, paving the way for recovery. Third, the banking sector continued to finance the expansion of consumption and investments, while at the same time improving its profitability and liquidity indicators. From Last but not least, the recovery was accompanied by an improvement in the country's economic and financial balances. The country's foreign and fiscal position improved and the main indicators of financial health consolidated. The current account deficit decreased to an average level of 7.7% of GDP during 2021, versus the 8.7% level registered a year earlier. In the fiscal sphere, the combination of economic growth with the decrease in budget deficit helped the public debt-to-GDP ratio drop to 73.2%, from 74.5% recorded in the year 2020. The progressive increase in demand for goods and services enabled employment, wages and profit margins to increase, reflecting an inflation-raising trend in line with our target. Average inflation resulted at 2.0% in 2021, versus 1.6% the previous year. On the other hand, the rapid rise in prices in the international market pushed inflation to 3.7% in December 2021 and 5.7% to March 2022. Dear Ladies and Gentlemen, Without taking too long, let me stop at the role played by the Bank of Albania in the recovery process, both in terms of economic growth and in maintaining monetary and financial stability. Monetary policy remains in the stimulus even through 2021. The base interest rate remained at its historic lows, of 0.5%, while the volume of liquidity injected into the system increased. In parallel, the Bank of Albania continued to orient the market on the direction of monetary policy in the future, reducing uncertainty in financial markets. The stimulus course of monetary policy ensured an environment with low financing costs and appropriate credit conditions. Financial markets operated normally and were characterized by abundant liquidity and controlled risk premiums. The effective transmission of monetary stimulus has kept interest rates on the loan at low levels for both the private and public sectors. The exchange rate was also relatively stable, reflecting the balance of demand and supply for currency. This environment enabled a steady increase in credit. The volume of credit to the private sector increased by an average of 8.4% during 2021 - the highest growth rate since 2012. Beyond the overall portfolio growth, lending dynamics carried other positive signals. First, the growth of the loan portfolio went mostly to financing business investment and mortgage loans, signaling the growth of private sector investments and an improving liquidity situation. Second, the loan in the local currency continues to maintain high growth rates, reflecting in the progressive increase in the loan weight in ALL over the total. This development creates the premises for a better monetary stimulus and a higher resistance of the banking system to risks. Third, the quality of the loan portfolio for the private sector has improved, as illustrated by the progressive decline of the non-rated credit indicator. Our empirical estimates show that the stimulus course of monetary policy has contributed to the 1.3 percentage points on 2021 economic growth. This contribution comes as a result of low interest rates, low risk premiums, continuous lending to the economy and increased competitiveness of Albanian exports. Through stimulating aggregate demand and better exploitation of productive potential, monetary stimulus has contributed positively to price stability. Let me now stop at the issues of financial stability and banking supervision and regulation. 2. Banking supervision and financial stability The banking system was characterized by a positive performance during 2021. During the pandemic period, the banking system showed that it was a serious partner in supporting the country's economic development, shouldering some of the burden of costs. The year 2021 confirmed that this sector has high resistance capabilities, thanks to the macroprudential policies of the Bank of Albania, the implementation of a sound oversight framework and the continuous improvement of the bank's control systems. The financial activity of the banking system was stable, their investments have expanded, the quality of the portfolio of assets has improved and profit rates have seen increases. The financial result was positive and about 29% higher from a year earlier; The level of capital fulcity remained at 18% and significantly above the regulatory limit; The non-performing loans index fell to 5.6% at the end of the year, from 8.1% a year ago, marking the lowest rate of the last decade. The exposure of banking sector activity to risks remains controlled. The resistance test exercises show that the ability of the banking sector to cope with losses emanating from materialising adverse shocks in the real and financial sector remains strong. These positive results have not decreased our attention to strengthening bank supervision and improving the macroprudential framework. Below, I will briefly list some of the priorities of the Bank of Albania's work in this regard. Opening the process of enorming our supervisory and regulatory framework with that of the EU. This process aims to certify the degree of convergence of our regulatory framework and our supervisory practices with those of the European Union. With the technical assistance of international experts, during 2021 an independent assessment of the monitoring framework in the country was conducted, which concluded that Albania enjoys a high level of equivalence with European Union standards. The Bank of Albania has already requested the European Commission to launch the formal equivalence process. Implement the recommendations of the MONEYVAL Committee, in the framework of anti-money laundering and terrorist financing measures. The Bank of Albania is involved in the national plan of measures for preventing money laundering and financing of terrorism, having responsibility for improving the regulatory framework and strengthening the effectiveness of the supervision process. In this context, it has been following on-site inspections on issues related to the prevention of money laundering, with a particular focus on issues of terrorism financing and international sanctions enforcement. The inspections have targeted banks, nonbank financial entities (FSB) and foreign exchange offices (NCBS). Improving the regulatory framework for increasing transparency and consumer protection. Looking at the acceleration of consumer lending, especially by non-bank financial entities, the Bank of Albania undertook an initiative to strengthen the regulatory framework for consumer loans, with the aim of protecting consumers from setting high and unjustified interest rates for these loans. The changes introduce for the first time the concept of a maximum permanence of effective interest rates and penalties applicable to customers of consumer loans. To implement these changes, best practices from the European Union countries were followed. Changes have also been made in the framework of transparency of banking products, whereby the gradual process of substituting the reference for interest rates of banking products such as LIBOR, EURIBOR etc., banks should increase the rate of information to borrowers. The amendments adopted in the relevant regulations, entourage this information with legal basis in contracting relations. Regulatory and methodological alignment with international standards. The Bank of Albania has been working on improving the regulatory supervisory framework, with the aim of aligning it with the EU acquis, the principles of the Basel Committee and best practices on banking supervision. The review of regulations has focused on adapting to the most current EU regulations, which aim to assess the liquidity management capabilities of banks; Creating capital add-ons to protect banks from exposure to various risks etc. Also, an important part of the bylaws have been drafted and approved to supplement the regulatory framework for the implementation of the law "On payment services" and the law "On recovery and extraordinary intervention in banks in the Republic of Albania". Rigorous monitoring of the financial system through on-site inspections. On-site inspections have been regularly followed, where examinations of non-bank financial entities and foreign exchange offices have been increased. The focus of the examinations at the banks has been the assessment of the management of the pandemic situation and the impact on the loan portfolio. Banks have taken a cautious approach to lending, based on certain criteria for providing facilities to customers with problems. In addition to the main focus on credit risk, the examinations also assessed the profile of other risks related to banking activity, such as operational and information technology risk, financial risks, etc., for which the relevant recommendations were given. Empowering the capacity for extraordinary intervention. During 2021, the drafting of extraordinary intervention plans of all banks operating in the Albanian market has been completed, and potential obstacles to the capacity for exceptional intervention have been identified. In accordance with the legal and regulatory frameworks of extraordinary intervention, the minimum requirements of instruments that must be maintained by banks at all times, in order to enable the implementation of extraordinary interventions, are also defined. Development and implementation of macroprudential policy in order to maintain financial stability. During 2021, measures aimed at reducing the use of ccurrency in banking sector activity and implementation of macroprudential capital additions were followed. Developments during the year have not required interventions with additional measures of macroprudential nature. However, the use of cage still remains at high levels and requires greater attention from other authorities. *** In addition to its primary role in maintaining monetary and financial stability, the Bank of Albania is responsible for a series of tasks and activities, which, for the sake of time, I will have to mention in a short way. 3. Other activities Ensure safe and efficient payment systems. The Bank of Albania operates two payment systems in Lek: the one for small value payments (AECH) and the one for large value payments (AIPS). Both systems have shown maximum availability and have operated safely, guaranteeing the flow of funds to the economy. With the aim of complementing and modernizing the payment infrastructure in the country, the Bank of Albania has completed the project for offering a new payment system of payments in euro currency to bank customers  AIPS-Euro. This system started operating in January 2022, enabling Albanian citizens to make euro payments within the country at much lower costs and in a much shorter time frame compared to the previous process through correspondent banks. Also, in order to increase financial inclusion and use of electronic payments, during 2021, it was possible to implement the "Direct Debit" scheme, which gives consumers flexibility in making payments for utilitarian services through the banking system. Promoting electronic payments and financial inclusion of the population. The number of electronic payments carried out in the country increased by 29.5% during 2021. Their growth has been helped by regulatory changes through the "On Payment Services" law, as well as improvements in infrastructure. The use of electronic payments per year for adults reached the level of 12.5 at the end of 2021, versus 4.3 in 2017. Positive developments have also been noted in the expansion of the percentage of the population, which owns a payment account. In 2021, it turns out that about 69% of the population in the majority of adults owns a payment account, versus only 40% in 2017. Improving the regulatory framework of payment systems in line with European Union standards. In 2021, the draft law "On the account of payments with basic services" has been drafted, in accordance with the EU Directives. Its approval provides basic financial services for individuals covered with banking services, regardless of income level, employment status, and insolvency history. Issue of banknotes. Its physical security and the management of physical money constitutes another important direction of our activity.
