In this regard, in June 2021, an agreement was signed with the ECB to protect the Euro banknote from counterfeiting, thus making the Bank of Albania an integral part of the European process in the fight against banknote counterfeiting. We have also finally completed our new series of banknotes, consisting of 6 denominations. In December 2021, the last two denominations of this series were released, those 500 and 2,000 ALL, while in June 2021, the market was added banknotes with the largest denomination in the value of ALL 10,000, which is also a novelty in the process of producing our money. The banknotes of the new series are designed and produced with the latest field technology and are equipped with contemporary and sophisticated security elements. Fulfilling institutional obligations within the framework of European integration. The Bank of Albania has an essential role in achieving the national goal of joining the European Union. She is a leader in a legislation compliance chapter, while she is a member of working groups for other chapters. The Bank of Albania has implemented the adoption of the bylaws provided for in the National Plan for European Integration and has included in its work the recommendations of the European Commission. Increase communication, transparency and accountability. The Bank of Albania remains an open institution, ready to communicate with transparency its decisions and to respond with seriousness to its activity. Physical and virtual communication with media, academics, general public and stakeholders has been followed through in 2021. In recent years, the Bank of Albania has taken public responsibility for undertaking campaigns for financial education. In cooperation with the Association of Banks, several activities were carried out, with the aim of increasing the financial knowledge of the public and raising awareness of personal finance. In parallel with these, the Bank of Albania has made further progress in the field of foreign reserve management, in the field of scientific research, in the processes of collecting, compiling and reporting statistics, as well as in terms of strengthening the governance of the institution. The Bank of Albania has also fulfilled the recommendations made by the Albanian Parliament for its activity during 2020. You will find extensive information on these issues detailed in the pages of the 2021 Annual Report. *** Dear Ladies and Gentlemen, Thanking you for the attention, let me emphasize that the Bank of Albania has been and remains committed to respecting its legal duties, addressing the challenges of growth, and building a constructive dialogue with all stakeholders and factors of economic and social life. The Albanian Parliament and the Albanian public will find us a serious partner in the path of development of the country. Ju faleminderit!
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko gjat prezantimit t Raportit Vjetor t Banks s Shqipris pr vitin 2021 n Komisionin e Ekonomis dhe Financave Data e publikimit: 11.05.2022 I nderuar zoti Kryetar, T nderuar zonja dhe zotrinj Deputet, N fillim, m lejoni tju falnderoj pr vlersimin q m dhat, duke m besuar nj mandat t dyt si Guvernator i Banks s Shqipris. Ju siguroj se llogaridhnia dhe dialogu konstruktiv midis institucioneve tona do t vazhdoj edhe n t ardhmen. N fjaln time sot, do tju paraqes punn dhe rezultatet e Banks s Shqipris gjat vitit t shkuar, si n drejtim t prmbushjes s detyrave t saj ligjore, ashtu dhe n drejtim t respektimit t rezoluts s Kuvendit pr veprimtarin e Banks s Shqipris pr vitin 2020 dhe t jetsimit t angazhimeve t saj institucionale. Megjithat, duke prfituar nga kjo mundsi, dshiroj t ndaj me ju edhe kndvshtrimin ton mbi sfidat me t cilat po prballemi n realitetin e ri ekonomik, t shkaktuar nga sulmi ushtarak i Rusis ndaj Ukrains. Ky zhvillim ka sjell nj rritje galopante t mimeve t produkteve baz n tregjet botrore, duke shtrenjtuar kostot e jetess s familjeve dhe duke rritur kostot e prodhimit t bizneseve. Pr m tepr, konflikti i armatosur ka shtuar pasigurit dhe ka krijuar pengesa t reja n zinxhirt e furnizimit, t cilt po ndikohen edhe nga kufizimet e vendosura rishtas ndaj valve t reja t pandemis n Azi. Kjo goditje me ndikim t dyfisht  n rritje pr mimet dhe n rnie pr aktivitetin ekonomik  do t transmetohet edhe n ekonomin shqiptare. Ajo pritet t sjell norma m t larta inflacioni dhe rritje m t ngadalt ekonomike n Shqipri krahasuar me vlersimet tona prpara fillimit t lufts. Megjithat, trendi pozitiv i zhvillimit ekonomik t vendit pritet t mbetet i pacenuar n afatin e mesm dhe t gjat. Bazuar n informacionin aktual, ne presim q ekonomia t vijoj t rritet gjat vitit 2022 dhe n vijim. Ky gjykim mbshtetet n gjersin dhe fortsin e burimeve t rritjes, n ekuilibrat e konsoliduar ekonomik dhe financiar, si dhe n vijimin e nj miksi stimulues politikash monetare e fiskale. Nga ana tjetr, ne parashikojm q inflacioni t mbetet n nivele relativisht t larta gjat vitit 2022. M tej, ai pritet t vij n rnie gjat vitit 2023, n linj me reduktimin e pritur t presioneve n tregjet botrore, dhe t kthehet n objektiv n gjysmn e par t vitit 2024. Kto projeksione mbshteten n tre konsiderata t rndsishme. S pari, ato supozojn mosprshkallzimin e konfliktit dhe vijimin e rritjes n partnert tan tregtar. S dyti, ato faktorizojn bazat solide n t cilat ndodhet ekonomia shqiptare pas rimkmbjes s gjithanshme t vitit 2021. N mnyr t prmbledhur, m lejoni t theksoj se ekonomia shqiptare e mbylli vitin 2021 me parametra t prmirsuar ekonomik e financiar. Vllimi i aktivitetit ekonomik u rrit, punsimi u zgjerua dhe rritja e pagave u prshpejtua. N trsi, bilancet e sektorit privat u prmirsuan, stabiliteti monetar dhe financiar i vendit u konsolidua, dhe tregjet financiare funksionuan normalisht. N veanti, sektori bankar ruajti tregues t mir likuiditeti, kapitalizimi dhe rentabiliteti. S treti, ato krkojn rishikimin e vazhdueshm t miksit t politikave ekonomike. N gjykimin e Banks s Shqipris, kto politika duhet t vijojn t ofrojn mbshtetje pr procesin e rimkmbjes, por pa paragjykuar pr asnj moment stabilitetin monetar e financiar t vendit. Ky stabilitet ka qen dhe mbetet nj parakusht pr zhvillimin e qndrueshm t ekonomis dhe rritjen e mirqenies s shoqris. Prmbushja e ktij objektivi sot, ndryshe nga m par, krkon adresimin e rreziqeve pr rritjen e inflacionit. Nisur nga sa m sipr, politika monetare e Banks s Shqipris do t vijoj t udhhiqet nga respektimi i objektivit parsor t saj: ruajtjen e stabilitetit t mimeve. N kt frym, ne vendosm t rrisim normn baz t interesit n muajin mars, duke e kthyer at n nivelin e parapandemis prej 1%. Nga ana tjetr, politika fiskale duhet t vijoj t ofroj mbshtetje financiare pr shtresat me t ardhura t ulta t shoqris dhe pr sektort m t ekspozuar ndaj goditjes. Megjithat, kjo mbshtetje duhet t financohet nga t ardhurat shtes t siguruara nga rritja e mimeve dhe nga rishikimi i shpenzimeve joprioritare. N kt mnyr, efektiviteti i ndrhyrjes nuk do t dmtoj treguesit e borxhit publik. T nderuar zonja dhe zotrinj, Konflikti ka shtuar pasigurit pr t ardhmen. Shkalla e ndikimit t tij do t varet nga kohzgjatja e konfliktit dhe shtrngimi potencial i sanksioneve ndaj Rusis. Ne jemi t ndrgjegjshm se rreziqet ndaj inflacionit jan t prqendruara pr lart dhe ato ndaj rritjes ekonomike pr posht. N kt mjedis ekonomik kompleks, roli i politikave monetare dhe fiskale mbetet kritik. Banka e Shqipris do t vijoj t monitoroj ecurin e inflacionit dhe nuk do t hezitoj t reagoj, n kohn dhe me forcn e duhur, pr t garantuar stabilitetin monetar dhe financiar t vendit. Kursi i politiks monetare pritet t filloj rrugn e normalizimit gradual gjat vitit 2022. Ky qndrim ofron nj balanc t prshtatshme midis rrezikut t prshpejtimit t inflacionit dhe rrezikut t ngadalsimit t rritjes ekonomike. N vijim t fjals sime do t ndalem shkurtimisht n drejtimet kryesore t puns son gjat vitit 2021 dhe rezultatet e saj. *** 1. Ecuria ekonomike dhe politika monetare e Banks s Shqipris Ekonomia shqiptare u rimkmb me hapa t shpejt gjat vitit 2021. Sipas t dhnave t Institutit t Statistikave, prodhimi i brendshm bruto u rrit me 8.5%, pas tkurrjes me 3.5% gjat vitit 2020. Rritja e shpejt ekonomike pasqyroi reduktimin e masave kufizuese, rritjen e besimit, prmirsimin e ambientit t huaj, si dhe stimujt monetar dhe fiskal. Kta faktor i hapn rrug zgjerimit t shpejt t krkess pr mallra e shrbime. Rimkmbja e shpejt ekonomike pati disa karakteristika, t cilat ilustruan fleksibilitetin e ekonomis son dhe jan premisa inkurajuese pr rritjen e qndrueshme t ekonomis n vijim. M lejoni t ndalem n disa prej tyre: Rimkmbja ishte me baz t gjer. N terma t krkess agregate, ajo pasqyroi rritjen e konsumit dhe t investimeve private, zgjerimin e eksporteve t mallrave e t shrbimeve, si dhe kontributin pozitiv t stimulit fiskal. N terma sektorial, ajo pasqyroi zgjerimin e t gjith sektorve t ekonomis. Rimkmbja u shoqrua me rritje t punsimit dhe t pagave, duke prmirsuar bilancet financiare t familjeve. Rritja e punsimit mundsoi rnien e shkalls s papunsis n 11.4% n fund t vitit, duke qndruar pran niveleve t parakrizs. N reflektim t tyre, pagat njohn ritme t larta rritjeje, n thuajse t gjith sektort e ekonomis. Rimkmbja ishte e plot. Si ekonomia n trsi ashtu dhe sektort e saj individual n veanti, kan tejkaluar nivelet e prodhimit dhe t t ardhurave q siguronin n periudhn para pandemis dhe trmetit t vitit 2019. Ky zhvillim ilustron rikuperimin e shpejt t krkess dhe ndikimin e pakt strukturor q kto goditje patn n strukturn prodhuese t ekonomis. Rimkmbja pasqyroi kontributin pozitiv t t gjith aktorve ekonomik. S pari, prgjigjja e bizneseve dhe familjeve tregoi se ata gzonin si bilance relativisht solide, ashtu edhe fleksibilitet e gatishmri pr tiu rikthyer sjelljes s tyre normale ekonomike. S dyti, prgjigjja e autoriteteve publike ishte e shpejt, e prshtatshme dhe efikase, ka lehtsoi barrn financiare t goditjes mbi bizneset dhe familjet shqiptare, duke i hapur rrug rimkmbjes. S treti, sektori bankar vijoi t financoj zgjerimin e konsumit dhe t investimeve, duke prmirsuar n t njjtn koh treguesit e tij t fitimit dhe t likuiditetit. S fundi, por jo m pak e rndsishme, rimkmbja u shoqrua me prmirsim t ekuilibrave ekonomik e financiar t vendit. Pozicioni i huaj dhe ai fiskal i vendit u prmirsan dhe treguesit kryesor t shndetit financiar u konsoliduan. Deficiti i llogaris korrente zbriti n nj nivel mesatar prej 7.7% t PBB-s gjat vitit 2021, kundrejt nivelit 8.7% t regjistruar nj vit m par. N sfern fiskale, kombinimi i rritjes ekonomike me rnien e deficitit buxhetor ndihmoi rnien e raportit t borxhit publik ndaj PBB-s n 73.2%, nga 74.5% t regjistruar n vitin 2020. Rritja progresive e krkess pr mallra e shrbime mundsoi rritjen e punsimit, t pagave dhe t marzheve t fitimit, duke u pasqyruar n nj trend rrits t inflacionit n linj me objektivin ton. Inflacioni mesatar rezultoi n nivelin 2.0% n vitin 2021, kundrejt vlers 1.6% t nj viti m par. Nga ana tjetr, rritja e shpejt e mimeve n tregun ndrkombtar e shtyu inflacionin n nivelin 3.7% n muajin dhjetor 2021 dhe 5.7% n muajin mars 2022. T nderuar zonja dhe zotrinj, Pa ju marr shum koh, m lejoni t ndalem tek roli q ka luajtur Banka e Shqipris n procesin e rimkmbjes, si n drejtim t rritjes ekonomike, ashtu dhe n at t ruajtjes s stabilitetit monetar e financiar. Politika monetare vijoi t mbetet n kahun stimulues edhe gjat vitit 2021. Norma baz e interesit mbeti n nivelet e veta m t ulta historike, prej 0.5%, ndrsa vllimi i likuiditetit t injektuar n sistem u rrit. Paralelisht me to, Banka e Shqipris vijoi t orientoj tregun mbi kahun e politiks monetare n t ardhmen, duke reduktuar pasigurin n tregjet financiare. Kursi stimulues i politiks monetare siguroi nj ambient me kosto t ulta financimi dhe kushte t prshtatshme kreditimi. Tregjet financiare funksionuan normalisht dhe u karakterizuan nga likuiditet i bollshm dhe prime t kontrolluara rreziku. Transmetimi efektiv i stimulit monetar ka mbajtur n nivele t ulta normat e interesit t kredis pr sektorin privat dhe at publik. Po ashtu, kursi i kmbimit ishte relativisht i qndrueshm, n pasqyrim t balancs s krkess dhe oferts pr valut. Ky ambient mundsoi nj rritje t qndrueshme t kredis. Vllimi i kredis pr sektorin privat u rrit mesatarisht me 8.4% gjat vitit 2021 - norma m e lart e rritjes prej vitit 2012. Prtej rritjes s prgjithshme t portofolit, dinamikat e kreditimit mbartn sinjale t tjera pozitive. S pari, rritja e portofolit t kredis shkoi m s shumti pr financimin e investimeve t bizneseve dhe pr kredi hipotekare, duke sinjalizuar rritjen e investimeve t sektorit privat dhe nj situat n prmirsim t likuiditetit t tij. S dyti, kredia n monedhn vendase vijoi t ruaj norma t larta rritjeje, duke u reflektuar n rritjen progresive t peshs s kredis n lek ndaj totalit. Ky zhvillim krijon premisa pr nj prcjellje m t mir t stimulit monetar dhe nj rezistenc m t lart t sistemit bankar ndaj rreziqeve. S treti, cilsia e portofolit t kredis pr sektorin privat erdhi drejt prmirsimit, sikundr ilustrohet nga rnia progresive e treguesit t kredis me probleme. Vlersimet tona empirike tregojn se kursi stimulues i politiks monetare ka kontribuuar me rreth 1.3 pik prqindje n rritjen ekonomike t vitit 2021. Ky kontribut vjen si rezultat i normave t ulta t interesit, i primeve t ulta t rrezikut, i kreditimit t vazhdueshm t ekonomis dhe i rritjes s konkurrencs s eksporteve shqiptare. Nprmjet nxitjes s krkess agregate dhe shfrytzimit m t mir t potencialeve prodhuese, stimuli monetar ka kontribuuar pozitivisht n stabilitetin e mimeve. M lejoni tani t ndalem n shtjet e stabilitetit financiar dhe t mbikqyrjes e rregullimit bankar. 2. Mbikqyrja bankare dhe stabiliteti financiar Sistemi bankar u karakterizua nga nj ecuri pozitive gjat vitit 2021. Gjat periudhs s pandemis, sistemi bankar tregoi se ishte nj partner serioz n mbshtetjen e zhvillimit ekonomik t vendit, duke mbajtur prsipr nj pjes t barrs s kostove. Viti 2021 konfirmoi se ky sektor ka aftsi t larta rezistence, fal politikave makroprudenciale t Banks s Shqipris, zbatimit t nj kuadri t shndosh mbikqyrjeje dhe prmirsimit t vazhdueshm s sistemeve t kontrollit t bankave. Veprimtaria financiare e sistemit bankar ishte e qndrueshme, investimet e tyre jan zgjeruar, cilsia e portofolit t aktiveve sht prmirsuar dhe normat e fitimit kan njohur rritje. Rezultati financiar ishte pozitiv dhe rreth 29% m i lart nga nj vit m par; niveli i mjaftueshmris s kapitalit mbeti n nivelin 18% dhe ndjeshm mbi limitin rregullator; dhe treguesi i kredive me probleme zbriti n 5.6% n fund t vitit, nga 8.1% nj vit m par, duke shnuar dhe normn m t ult t dekads s fundit. Ekspozimi i aktivitetit t sektorit bankar ndaj rreziqeve mbetet i kontrolluar. Ushtrimet e provs s rezistencs tregojn se aftsia e sektorit bankar pr t prballuar humbjet q burojn nga materializimi i goditjeve t pafavorshme n sektorin real dhe financiar mbetet e fort. Kto rezultate pozitive nuk kan ulur vmendjen ton ndaj forcimit t mbikqyrjes s bankave dhe prmirsimit t kuadrit makroprudencial. M posht, do t rendis shkurtimisht disa nga prioritetet e puns s Banks s Shqipris n kt drejtim. elja e procesit t ekuivalentimit t kuadrit ton mbikqyrs e rregullator me at t BE-s. Ky proces synon t certifikoj shkalln e konvergjencs s kuadrit ton rregullator dhe t praktikave tona mbikqyrse me ato t Bashkimit Evropian. Me asistencn teknike t ekspertve ndrkombtare, gjat vitit 2021 u krye nj vlersim i pavarur i kuadrit mbikqyrs n vend, i cili konkludoi se Shqipria gzon nj nivel t lart ekuivalence me standardet e Bashkimit Evropian. Tashm, Banka e Shqipris ka krkuar pran Komisionit Evropian nisjen e procesit formal t ekuivalencs. Zbatimi i rekomandimeve t Komitetit t MONEYVAL, n kuadr t masave kundr pastrimit t parave dhe financimit t terrorizmit. Banka e Shqipris sht e prfshir n planin kombtar t masave pr parandalimin e pastrimit t paras dhe t financimit t terrorizmit, duke pasur prgjegjsi pr prmirsimin e kuadrit rregullator dhe forcimin e efektivitetit t procesit mbikqyrs. N kt kuadr, ajo ka vijuar inspektimet n vend pr shtje q lidhen me parandalimin e pastrimit t parave, me nj fokus t veant n shtjet e financimit t terrorizmit dhe t zbatimit t sanksioneve ndrkombtare. Inspektimet kan targetuar bankat, subjektet financiare jobanka (SFJB) dhe zyrat e kmbimit valutor (ZKV). Prmirsimi i kuadrit rregullator pr rritjen e transparencs dhe mbrojtjen e konsumatorit. Duke par prshpejtimin e kreditimit t konsumatorve, veanrisht nga subjektet financiare jobanka, Banka e Shqipris ndrmori nj iniciativ pr forcimin e kuadrit rregullator pr kredit konsumatore, me qllim mbrojtjen e konsumatorit nga vendosja e normave t larta dhe t pajustifikuara t interesit pr kto kredi. Ndryshimet prezantojn pr her t par konceptin e nj kufiri maksimal t lejuar t norms efektive t interesit dhe t penaliteteve q zbatohen pr klientt e kredive konsumatore. Pr realizimin e ktyre ndryshimeve, u ndoqn praktikat m t mira nga vendet e Bashkimit Evropian. Ndryshime jan br edhe n kuadr t transparencs s produkteve bankare, ku me procesin gradual t zvendsimit t referencs pr normat e interesit t produkteve bankare, si jan LIBOR, EURIBOR etj., bankat duhet t rrisin shkalln e informimit pr huamarrsit. Ndryshimet e miratuara n rregulloren prkatse, e konturojn kt informim me baza ligjore n marrdhniet kontraktore. Prafrimi rregullator e metodologjik me standardet ndrkombtare. Banka e Shqipris ka vijuar punn pr prmirsimin e kuadrit rregullator mbikqyrs, me synim prafrimin e tij me acquis t BE-s, parimet e Komitetit t Bazelit dhe me praktikat m t mira t mbikqyrjes bankare. Rishikimi i rregulloreve ka pasur n fokus prshtatjen me rregulloret m aktuale t BE-s, t cilat synojn t vlersojn aftsit pr administrimin e likuiditetit t bankave; krijimin e shtesave n kapital pr t mbrojtur bankat nga ekspozimet pr rreziqe t ndryshme etj. Gjithashtu, nj pjes e rndsishme e akteve nnligjore jan hartuar dhe miratuar pr t plotsuar kuadrin rregullator pr zbatimin e ligjit Pr shrbimet e pagesave dhe at pr ligjin Pr rimkmbjen dhe ndrhyrjen e jashtzakonshme n banka, n Republikn e Shqipris. Monitorimi rigoroz i sistemit financiar nprmjet inspektimeve n vend. Inspektimet n vend kan vijuar rregullisht, ku jan shtuar ekzaminimet e subjekteve financiare jobanka dhe t zyrave t kmbimit valutor. Fokusi i ekzaminimeve n banka ka qen vlersimi i administrimit t situats s pandemis dhe ndikimit n portofolin e kredis. Bankat kan ndjekur nj qasje t kujdesshme n kreditim, t mbshtetur n kriteret e caktuara pr ofrimin e lehtsirave pr klient me probleme. Krahas fokusit kryesor tek rreziku i kredis, ekzaminimet kan vlersuar dhe profilin e rreziqeve t tjera q lidhen me veprimtarin bankare, si rreziku operacional dhe i teknologjis s informacionit, rreziqe financiare etj., pr t cilat jan dhn rekomandimet prkatse. Fuqizimi i aftsis pr ndrhyrje t jashtzakonshme. Gjat vitit 2021 ka prfunduar hartimi i planeve t ndrhyrjes s jashtzakonshme t t gjitha bankave q operojn n tregun shqiptar, si dhe jan identifikuar pengesat potenciale ndaj aftsis pr ndrhyrje t jashtzakonshme. N prputhje me kuadrin ligjor dhe rregullator t ndrhyrjes s jashtzakonshme, jan prcaktuar dhe krkesat minimale t instrumenteve q duhet t mbajn bankat n do koh, me qllim mundsimin e zbatimit t ndrhyrjes s jashtzakonshme. Zhvillimi dhe zbatimi i politiks makroprudenciale n funksion t ruajtjes s stabilitetit financiar. Gjat vitit 2021, vijoi zbatimi i masave q synojn uljen e prdorimit t valutave n veprimtarin e sektorit bankar dhe zbatimi i shtesave makroprudenciale t kapitalit. Zhvillimet gjat vitit nuk kan krkuar ndrhyrje me masa shtes t natyrs makroprudenciale. Megjithat, prdorimi i valutave mbetet ende n nivele t larta dhe krkon vmendje m t madhe nga autoritetet e tjera. *** Krahas rolit t saj primar n ruajtjen e stabilitetit monetar e financiar, Banka e Shqipris sht prgjegjse pr nj sr detyrash e veprimtarish, t cilat, pr hir t kohs, do t m duhet ti prmend fare shkurt. 3. Aktivitete t tjera Garantimi i sistemeve t pagesave t sigurta dhe eficiente. Banka e Shqipris operon dy sisteme pagesash n Lek: at pr pagesat me vler t vogl (AECH) dhe at pr pagesat me vler t madhe (AIPS). T dy sistemet kan treguar disponueshmri maksimale dhe kan funksionuar n mnyr t sigurt, duke garantuar rrjedhjen e fondeve pr ekonomin. Me synimin pr t plotsuar dhe modernizuar infrastrukturn e pagesave n vend, Banka e Shqipris ka prfunduar projektin pr ofrimin e nj sistemi t ri t shlyerjes s pagesave kombtare n monedhn Euro pr klientt e bankave  AIPS-Euro. Ky sistem ka filluar operimin n janar t vitit 2022, duke u mundsuar qytetarve shqiptar kryerjen e pagesave n Euro brenda vendit, me kosto shum m t ulta dhe n nj afat kohor shum m t shkurtr krahasuar me procesin e mparshm nprmjet bankave korrespondente. Gjithashtu, me qllim rritjen e prfshirjes financiare dhe t prdorimit t pagesave elektronike, gjat vitit 2021, u b i mundur zbatimi i skems s Debitimit direkt, e cila i krijon konsumatorve fleksibilitet n kryerjen e pagesave pr shrbimet utilitare nprmjet sistemit bankar. Nxitja e pagesave elektronike dhe e prfshirjes financiare t popullsis. Numri i pagesave elektronike t kryera n vend u rrit me 29.5% gjat vitit 2021. Rritja e tyre sht ndihmuar nga ndryshimet rregullatore nprmjet ligjit Pr shrbimet e pagesave, si dhe prmirsimet n infrastruktur. Prdorimi i pagesave elektronike n vit pr individ n mosh madhore arriti n nivelin 12.5 n fund t vitit 2021, kundrejt 4.3 n vitin 2017. Zhvillime pozitive jan shnuar dhe n zgjerimin e prqindjes s popullsis, e cila zotron nj llogari pagesash. N vitin 2021, rezulton se rreth 69% e popullsis n mosh madhore zotron nj llogari pagese, kundrejt vetm 40% n vitin 2017. Prmirsimi i kuadrit rregullator t sistemeve t pagesave n prputhje me standardet e Bashkimit Evropian. Gjat vitit 2021 sht hartuar projektligji Pr llogarin e pagesave me shrbime bazike, n prputhje me Direktivat e BE-s. Miratimi i tij ofron shrbime financiare bazike pr individt e pambuluar me shrbime bankare, pavarsisht nivelit t t ardhurave, statusit t punsimit, historikut t aftsis paguese. Emetimi i kartmonedhs. Siguria fizike e saj dhe miradministrimi i paras fizike prbn nj drejtim tjetr t rndsishm t veprimtaris son. N kt drejtim, n muajin qershor 2021, u nnshkrua me BQE-n nj marrveshje pr mbrojtjen e kartmonedhs Euro nga falsifikimi, duke e br kshtu Bankn e Shqipris pjes integrale t procesit evropian n luftn kundr falsifikimit t kartmonedhave. Po ashtu, ne kemi realizuar prfundimisht kompletimin e seris son t re t kartmonedhave, t prbr nga 6 prerje. N muajin dhjetor t vitit 2021 u hodhn n qarkullim edhe dy prerjet e fundit t ksaj serie, ato 500 dhe 2,000 Lek, ndrkoh q n qershor 2021, tregut i ishte shtuar edhe kartmonedha me prerjen m t madhe n vlern 10,000 Lek, e cila prbn edhe nj risi n procesin e prodhimit t paras son. Kartmonedhat e seris s re jan dizajnuar dhe prodhuar me teknologjin m t fundit t fushs dhe jan t pajisura me elemente bashkkohore dhe t sofistikuara sigurie. Prmbushja e detyrimeve institucionale n kuadr t integrimit evropian. Banka e Shqipris ka nj rol esencial n arritjen e qllimit kombtar pr aderimin n Bashkimin Evropian. Ajo sht udhheqse n nj kapitull t prputhshmris s legjislacionit, ndrsa sht antare e grupeve t puns pr kapituj t tjer. Banka e Shqipris ka realizuar miratimin e akteve nnligjore t parashikuara n Planin Kombtar t Integrimit Evropian dhe ka prfshir n prioritetet e puns s saj rekomandimet e Komisionit Evropian. Rritja e komunikimit, transparencs dhe llogaridhnies. Banka e Shqipris mbetet nj institucion i hapur, i gatshm t komunikoj me transparenc vendimet e saj dhe t prgjigjet me seriozitet pr veprimtarin e vet. Gjat vitit 2021 ka vijuar komunikimi fizik dhe virtual me median, akademik, publikun e gjer dhe pal t interesuara. Vitet e fundit, Banka e Shqipris ka marr prgjegjsi publike pr ndrmarrjen e fushatave pr edukimin financiar. N bashkpunim edhe me Shoqatn e Bankave, jan kryer disa aktivitete, me qllim rritjen e njohurive financiare t publikut dhe rritjen e ndrgjegjsimit pr financat personale. Paralelisht me to, Banka e Shqipris ka shnuar progres t mtejshm n fushn e administrimit t rezervs valutore, n fushn e krkimit shkencor, n proceset e mbledhjes, hartimit dhe raportimit t statistikave, si dhe n drejtim t forcimit t qeverisjes s institucionit. Gjithashtu, Banka e Shqipris ka prmbushur rekomandimet e lna nga Kuvendi i Shqipris pr aktivitetin e saj gjat vitit 2020. Nj informacion t gjer mbi kto shtje do ta gjeni t detajuar n faqet e Raportit Vjetor 2021. *** T nderuar zonja dhe zotrinj Deputet, Duke ju falnderuar pr vmendjen, m lejoni t theksoj se Banka e Shqipris ka qen dhe mbetet e angazhuar pr respektimin e detyrave t saj ligjore, pr adresimin e sfidave t rritjes, si dhe pr ndrtimin e nj dialogu konstruktiv me t gjith aktort dhe faktort e jets ekonomike dhe sociale. Kuvendi i Shqipris dhe publiku shqiptar do t gjej t ne nj partner serioz n rrugn e zhvillimit t vendit. Ju faleminderit!

Title: Governor Sejko's speech at the International Scientific Conference organized by the Faculty of Economics, University of Tirana
text: Governor Sejko's speech at the International Scientific Conference organized by the Faculty of Economics, University of Tirana Date of publication: 11.06.2022 Honorable participant, It is a special pleasure to be with you today to welcome the conference and to jointly discuss the latest developments in global markets, as well as the effects they have on the economy and monetary policy of the Bank of Albania. Before I keep my word, let me first express my gratitude to the organizers for the opportunity of this conference. In this important 65th anniversary of the Faculty of Economics, the Bank of Albania and every other institution of the country, whose mission is intertwined with that of the faculty, should be proud to share with it an important part of its history. This faculty is the oldest institution of economic education in Albania, having a significant impact on the well-being and identity of Albanians. During its history, the best economists of the country have been able to contribute significantly to the development of Albania's economic and financial policies. For this reason, I say with conviction that the history of academic development of this faculty is also the history of the economic development of the country. Honorable participant, The topic chosen is as current as far-sighted and forward-looking. The economic and financial developments of the last decade, but especially the shocks we have faced over the past two years, have brought about major changes for central banking and, in particular, monetary policy and banking supervision and regulation. Taking advantage of this invitation, today I want to share with you the Vision of the Bank of Albania on the challenges of the future and the impact they will have on the objectives, strategies and instruments that central banks will pursue and use in the future. To be as comprehensive and conciential as possible in my discussion, I want to guide it in three main directions: (i) first, I want to share with you the current stage of monetary policy development in the Bank of Albania, and its intertwining with the supervision and banking regulation; (ii) second, I will focus on our experience with the two financial crises of the previous decade, to highlight how they have designed the development in time the bank's thinking and method of action; (iii) third, I will briefly underline the role of the Bank of Albania and its contribution to macroeconomic stability in recent years. At closing I will briefly pause on lessons learned and challenges for the future. Let me start from the first point. 1. Bank of Albania as a promoter of stability and development The Bank of Albania is the monetary authority of the Republic of Albania. In accordance with global best practices, its primary legal mandate is to achieve and maintain price stability. This mandate is based on a broad academic and practical consensus, according to which the most inseable contribution a central bank can make to sustainable growth in standard of living is to maintain price stability. Price stability is a prerequisite for fulfilling three classical functions of money: that of exchange, of value preserver and unit of comparison, or of accounting. In this way, a stable monetary environment helps the economy, businesses and households to plan reliably on income, consumption, investment and savings, increasing the transparency of the economic system and the efficiency of resource allocation. In practice, price stability in Albania is defined as a numerical inflation target of the 3% level. However, achieving this goal is not possible without having a stable, stable and efficient banking and financial system. Also, the world experience shows that a stable monetary environment is a necessary but not sufficient condition for a stable financial system and capable of performing its duties of financial intermediary and payment instrument provider effectively. For this reason, the Bank of Albania has adopted a number of secondary objectives, which aim at the normal functioning of the banking sector and the money markets. The achievement of these objectives contributes to the promotion of the country's financial stability and provides the second instrument by which central banks help to increase the long-term well-being of society. The monetary policy regime adopted by the Bank of Albania is that of targeting inflation. This regime, widely applied by central banks, has three essential elements. From First, it means that the central bank uses all relevant information available to assess the balance of inflationary pressures. A Typical Phillips curve for a small and open economy such as Albania sees this balance as a function of three components: the cyclical position of the economy; pressure on prices coming from the foreign market; And, partially rational expectations of economic agents for inflation. In practice, this information translates into projections on price performance over the medium-term horizon, which enables the central bank to identify possible inflation deviations from the target and take appropriate measures in time. From Second, targeting inflation means that the central bank interferes with the financial system with indirect instruments, which operate in accordance with market logic. In practice, central banks define the level of the base interest rate, which further orients the entire spectrum of interest rates across the range of financial market instruments. From Third, it means that the exchange rate is free and fluctuate in accordance with the reports of demand and supply for currency. This enables monetary policy to focus entirely on meeting the objective of price stability, while simultaneously providing the economy with an instrument for deprecation of shocks that can come from the external environment. Beyond these classical elements, the Bank of Albania applies a flexible regime of targeted inflation. This means that, in assessing the appropriateness of the monetary policy stance, the Bank of Albania also takes into account the cyclical position of the economy and that the function of the monetary policy response gives a certain weight to the smoothing of business cycles, of course without prejudice to respecting price stability for any moment. In line with these traits, the Bank of Albania has made a public commitment to pursue a consistent and sustainable monetary policy. The commitment to consistency requires that the stance of our monetary policy is, at all times, the right one for meeting our inflation target within a medium-term time horizon. The commitment to sustainability requires that our monetary policy factors and elements of risk and uncertainty, which are inseparable in the process of economic forecasting and always present in the functioning of financial markets. Focusing on the last element, I would like to emphasize that the Strategy of the Bank of Albania for meeting the inflation target is based not only on the best practices of central banking, but also on the reality that the growth rate of the Albanian economy and financial markets offers. For this reason, we attach special importance both to the assessment of the monetary policy transmission mechanism and to the stability of the banking and financial system. As the supervisor and regulator of banking activity, the dominance of the banking system in the Albanian economy gives the Bank of Albania a unique perspective on the mechanism of monetary policy transmission and its interplay with banking regulation or  in other words  macroprudential policy. While the efficient combination of monetary policy and macroprudential policy remains an area that does not yet have a clear academic and practical consensus, our experience of the last decade has offered some important lessons. The global financial crisis and the eurozone debt crisis were the wake-up call for the need for a fuller assessment of the interconnection of monetary stability with financial stability. These crises highlighted the importance of a stable banking and financial system for the overall stability and development of the country. Until before these two crises, the philosophy of economic management was guided by a tacit assumption that monetary stability was, in itself, a sufficient condition for the country's overall economic and financial stability. Financial markets were assumed to be efficient and self-regulated, which meant the absence of systemic financial crises. The 2008 financial crisis caused a major financial shock and overturned that consensus. The burdened balance sheets of the banking sector, increasing uncertainty and interruption of the circulation of financial flows, hindered the normal transmission of monetary policy. In developed countries, central banks reacted strongly to support the economy and stability of the financial system. Rates quickly went to zero, and even into negative territory. However, the transmission mechanism's problems forced them to adopt and apply unconventional monetary policy instruments. Quantitative and credit easing restored, to some extent, liquidity turnover in the economy, bypassing financial intermediaries  banks and the capital market. However, it resulted in a rapid expansion of central banks' balance sheets and pushed them into an uncharted area of monetary policy. On the other hand, the low rate of development of financial markets made it inappropriate to use this instrument, in Albania and in the countries of the region. In these circumstances, our attention focused on identifying the consequences of the blow to the banking sector and devising strategies for their rapid resolution. The experience of the Bank of Albania with the financial crises of the last decade and the lessons learned from it will be addressed in the second section of my speech. 2. Lessons learned from the two financial crises of the end of '00 and '10 years Albania and the Western Balkan countries experienced a decade of rapid and steady growth on the eve of the global financial crisis. Economic liberalization of the early 1990s, the growing integration with the developed economies and markets of the European Union, the rapid growth of productivity, as a result of the inflow of foreign capital and expertise, and the sweeping structural and institutional reforms, put the region on a rapid development trajectory. Overall, the economies of the region left behind the status of economies in need and gained the status of emerging economies, with solid growth prospects and convergence in the European Union. The global financial crisis has changed almost everything. Although Albania and the countries of the region had relatively low economic and financial exposure to the UNITED STATES - the country of origin of the crisis its effects were felt strong in the region. The tightening of global financial conditions and the reduction of foreign demand were combined with a range of weaknesses that our economic and financial development model had. Soon, this initial blow was followed by the sovereign debt crisis in the eurozone. This blow was as serious and lasting as the global financial crisis. In particular, it brought a rapid flow of bank capital and financial funds out of the region, which made it difficult for policymakers to manage the consequences of the crisis. In summary, the consequence of these shocks were burdens of financial balances for the public and private sectors, as well as a decade where the pace of economic growth almost halved compared to the pre-crisis period, while inflation stayed below central bank targets. Let me pause on the developmental features in Albania and the region, which intensified the consequences of the crackdown and the challenges we faced. First, the economic growth model was significantly oriented towards consumption and inward investment, especially investments in the residential construction sector. This model encouraged an uncompensating economic structure. It resulted in over-allocation of economic and financial resources in the construction sector and unjustified increases in asset prices. Confronting the reality behind the past two financial crises brought recognition of the role of structural reforms as the main promoter of the country's sustainable and long-term development, but also took time to bear fruit. Also, from the central bank's perspective, he brought to attention the large role asset prices have as indicators of economic imbalances, their implications for financial stability, and the length of time required by addressing them. Second, rapid economic growth was fed by foreign financial flows, generally mediated by the banking sector. This process was facilitated by the large weight of banking capital originating from the European Union countries in the region, as well as the structure of their incentives and business model. Within the banking sector, the most serious consequences of the crisis manifested i i.e. in the form of the growth of NPP loans, especially in the foreign currency lending segment, and in the form of lowering the attention of European banks towards the region. In particular, the high level of non-currency loans in the segment of borrowers in currency vulnerable to exchange rate risk, limited the degree of freedom of monetary policy action and curbed the use of exchange rate as shock absorbers. These problems led to the non-economic functioning of the monetary policy transmission mechanism. In order to address them, the Bank of Albania engaged in comprehensive programmes of measures to: 1000 NSA credit and improving the credit environment. Among other things, particular attention has been paid to improving risk management systems within commercial banks themselves; Consolidation of the banking sector, replacing a part of the foreign banking groups, which revised  whether compulsively or not  their expansion strategies in the region, with new and motivated investors; reducing The use of euro currency in the financial sector. This action aims at reducing the unnecessary use of the euro, both in saving and in credit, especially in the segment of borrowers vulnerable to exchange rate risk. Third, the imbalances in the financial sector were encouraged by the inability of local regulators to fully discipline the amount and destination of inflows, as well as by the lack of attention of foreign regulators to these developments. Consequently, in the post-crisis period, the Bank of Albania has undertaken a full convergence programme of its supervisory and regulatory framework with the requirements of the Basel Committee and European Union standards. As evidence of our work, an independent assessment conducted over the past year found a high degree of convergence between the regulatory framework and our supervisory practices with those of the European Union. In parallel, we have intensified dialogue with foreign supervisors to timely identify problems and to build  where possible  joint intervention strategies. Fourth, Albania entered the global financial crisis with one of the highest levels of public debt in the region. This feature, as well as the extreme increase in financing costs in foreign markets over the following period, reduced the space for a countercyclical fiscal stimulus. This obstacle brought to attention the importance of a low and controlled level of public debt in terms of both preserving fiscal space for reaction and the overall sustainability of the financial system. In this context, of the three possible instruments of state intervention in economics - monetary policy, macroprudential policy and fiscal policy - the burden of coping with the costs of the two financial crises of the preceding decade fell solely on monetary policy. Furthermore, this policy had limited action space, due to the negative consequences that a strong monetary stimulus could have on financial stability, and faced an incompletely functional transmission mechanism. While these problems lasted in time the consequences of the crackdown, I find it pertininating that Albania and the Bank of Albania did not waste time in terms of identifying them and institutional response. Timely and energetic implementation of these reforms has brought about increasing the stability of the banking sector against shocks and improving the monetary policy transmission mechanism, helping our response to the two subsequent crises. 3. Bank of Albania facing pandemic and supply shocks The pandemic and The Russian invasion of Ukraine are among the most serious blows of recent decades. Although these two events constitute diametrically opposite shocks  the first was a demand shock, while the second a pure bid strike  their intensity tested and continues to test the economic and financial balance of the country. Thankfully, in relation to the previous two strokes, we were prepared. The response in the economic sphere of public authorities during the pandemic period is an example of success. The situation required a rapid, calibrated and coordinated response, aiming both to amortize the impact of the impact in the short term and minimize the damage on the country's production potential in the long term. The latter means minimizing the massive bankruptcies of businesses, reducing long-term layoffs, and, above all, preserving the country's overall economic and financial stability. The Bank of Albania undertook a package of monetary, macroprudential, supervisory and operational measures, which aimed at maintaining liquidity in financial markets, reducing borrowing costs and maintaining an uninterrupted flow of lending and financial services. Our immediate and multi-dimensional response enabled: (i) the reduction of the cost of borrowing and continued support of Albanian families and businesses with bank loans; (ii) maintaining a liquid, well-capitalised, and sound risk management banking system; (iii) reducing uncertainty and increasing confidence in the future. The recovery of the economy during 2021 was solid, the sources of growth were broad-based, as were its supporting factors, where we distinguish the stable monetary and financial environment. In my judgment, success is attributable to several factors: from First, we were prepared. Lessons learned after the global financial crisis and the European sovereign debt crisis served us to reduce the structural weaknesses of the economy, strengthen the financial sector and increase its resilience to shocks; from Second, the response to the policies was proportionate to the complexity of the situation, quick in time and coordinated. We activated a wide range of instruments, in unprecedented size. The monetary stimulus was implemented simultaneously with fiscal incentives  sovereign guarantee funds  and targeted regulatory and macroprudential easings; from Third, global policy response and coordination helped limit the extent of the economic downturn. International financial institutions and EU organisations and institutions took an active role in promoting global policy coordination. For us the region's policymakers, this provided international support for expansionist policies in the country and helped increase the action space. However, the challenges remain current. The war in Ukraine has brought a rapid rise in inflation everywhere in the world. In response, the Bank of Albania took a first step towards normalization of monetary policy in March, raising the benchmark interest rate by 0.5 percentage points. At the same time, we have signalled our willingness and willingness to undertake any monetary measures necessary to avoid transmission of this shock in anticipation for high inflation in the future. Our transparent communication has served to clarify the public's monetary policy course and helped control inflation expectations in financial markets. 4. Instead of conclusions Honorable participant! At the close of my speech, let me share with you some lessons learned from the experience of the Bank of Albania in the face of the challenges we have faced over the years. Price stability is a necessary prerequisite for sustainable and long-term growth of the country and the well-being of society. On a general level, this stability should be the only legitimate objective of monetary policy. However, the focus on price stability should not divert the central bank's attention from other sources of weakness and risks. In particular, financial stability should be another complementary objective of central banks, as long as it enables price stability and enables efficient allocation of funds in the economy. Adopting a modern monetary policy framework is essential to its success. Among other things, this framework should be transparent in its objectives, comprehensive in the range of information used, consistent in decision making and flexible in the operational framework used. In particular, recent experience has shown that central banks should also pay attention to unconventional monetary policy instruments, such as quantitative or credit easing. However, these instruments should be treated as last-resort options in line, and their use should be conditional on the degree of development and sophistication of financial markets. As for financial stability, this sphere of central banking activity must adopt  as well as monetary policy  a future-oriented approach and a proactive attitude. In particular, although our role as supervisor and regulator cannot and should not be to ensure the health of any financial intermediary, systemic weaknesses that constitute the premises for financial and economic crises must be identified and addressed in time. In parallel, recent experiences have shown that fiscal policy has an irreplaceable role in coping with strong economic and financial shocks. Despite the power and complexity of the instruments at the disposal of the central bank, it cannot cope alone and with full efficiency the shocks that small and open economies face. For this reason, the health of public finances should be seen as an important indicator of the country's capacity to cope with crises. In general terms, these considerations will determine the philosophy of thought and action of the Bank of Albania in the future. However, I find it appropriate to point out that a responsible central bank should not be sufficient to study the past to use as a guide to the future. New challenges that are on the horizon, such as financial innovation, global warming, population ageing or business model changes as a result of geopolitical tensions, should have due attention. I am confident that the work of this conference will shed more light on the issues and challenges I touched on. Ju faleminderit!
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n Konferencn Shkencore Ndrkombtare t organizuar nga Fakulteti i Ekonomis, Universiteti i Tirans Data e publikimit: 11.06.2022 T nderuar pjesmarrs, sht knaqsi e veant t jem sot me ju, pr t prshndetur konferencn dhe pr t diskutuar s bashku zhvillimet m t fundit n tregjet globale, si dhe efektet q ato kan mbi ekonomin dhe politikn monetare t Banks s Shqipris. Prpara se t mbaj fjaln time, m lejoni fillimisht tu shpreh organizatorve mirnjohjen time pr mundsimin e ksaj konference. N kt 65-vjetor t rndsishm t Fakultetit t Ekonomis, Banka e Shqipris dhe do institucion tjetr i vendit, misioni i t cilit ndrthuret me at t fakultetit, duhet t jet krenar q ndan me t nj pjes t rndsishme t historis s tij. Ky fakultet sht institucioni m i vjetr i edukimit ekonomik n Shqipri, duke pasur nj ndikim t rndsishm n mirqenien dhe identitetin e shqiptarve. Gjat historis s tij, nga kta auditor kan dal ekonomistt m t mir t vendit, t cilt kan kontribuuar n mnyr domethnse n zhvillimin e politikave ekonomike e financiare t Shqipris. Pr kt arsye, them me bindje se historia e zhvillimit akademik t ktij fakulteti sht edhe historia e zhvillimit ekonomik t vendit. T nderuar pjesmarrs, Tema e zgjedhur sht sa aktuale aq dhe largpamse. Zhvillimet ekonomike e financiare t dekads s fundit, por veanrisht goditjet me t cilat jemi prballur gjat dy viteve t fundit, kan sjell ndryshime t mdha pr bankingun qendror dhe, n veanti, pr politikn monetare dhe mbikqyrjen e rregullimin bankar. Duke prfituar nga kjo ftes, sot dshiroj t ndaj me ju vizionin e Banks s Shqipris mbi sfidat e t ardhmes dhe ndikimin q ato do t ken n objektivat, strategjit dhe instrumentet q bankat qendrore do t ndjekin e prdorin n t ardhmen. Pr t qen sa m i plot dhe konciz n diskutimin tim, dshiroj ta orientoj at n tre drejtime kryesore: (i) s pari, dua t ndaj me ju stadin aktual t zhvillimit t politiks monetare n Bankn e Shqipris, dhe ndrthurjen e saj me mbikqyrjen e rregullimin bankar; (ii) s dyti, do t ndalem n eksperiencn ton me dy krizat financiare t dekads paraardhse, pr t evidentuar si ato kan konturuar zhvillimin n koh t mendimit dhe metods s veprimit t Banks s Shqipris; dhe (iii) s treti, do t nnvizoj shkurtimisht rolin e Banks s Shqipris dhe kontributin e saj n stabilitetin makroekonomik n vitet e fundit. N mbyllje do t ndalem shkurtimisht n msimet e nxjerra dhe sfidat pr t ardhmen. M lejoni t filloj nga pika e par. 1. Banka e Shqipris si promotor stabiliteti dhe zhvillimi Banka e Shqipris sht autoriteti monetar i Republiks s Shqipris. N prputhje me praktikat m t mira botrore, mandati ligjor parsor i saj sht arritja dhe ruajtja e stabilitetit t mimeve. Ky mandat bazohet n nj konsensus t gjer akademik e praktik, sipas t cilit kontributi m i qensishm q mund t jap nj bank qendrore pr rritjen e qndrueshme t standardit t jetess sht ruajtja e stabilitetit t mimeve. Qndrueshmria e mimeve sht nj parakusht pr prmbushjen e tre funksioneve klasike t paras: atij t mjetit t kmbimit, t ruajtsit t vlers dhe t njsis s krahasimit, apo t kontabilizimit. N kt mnyr, nj ambient monetar i qndrueshm ndihmon ekonomin, bizneset dhe familjet, t planifikojn me besueshmri t ardhurat, konsumin, investimet dhe kursimet, duke rritur transparencn e sistemit ekonomik dhe eficiencn e shprndarjes s burimeve. N praktik, stabiliteti i mimeve n Shqipri prkufizohet si nj objektiv numerik i inflacionit n nivelin 3%. Megjithat, arritja e ktij objektivi nuk sht e mundur pa pasur njkohsisht nj sistem bankar e financiar t stabilizuar, t qndrueshm dhe eficient. Po ashtu, eksperienca botrore tregon se nj ambient monetar i qndrueshm sht nj kusht i nevojshm, por jo i mjaftueshm pr t pasur nj sistem financiar t qndrueshm dhe t aft t kryej me eficienc detyrat e tij t ndrmjetsuesit financiar dhe t ofruesit t instrumenteve t pagess. Pr kt arsye, Banka e Shqipris ka adoptuar edhe nj sr objektivash dytsor, t cilt synojn funksionimin normal t sektorit bankar dhe t tregjeve t paras. Prmbushja e ktyre objektivave kontribuon n promovimin e stabilitetit financiar t vendit dhe ofron instrumentin e dyt me t cilin bankat qendrore ndihmojn rritjen e mirqenies afatgjat t shoqris. Regjimi i politiks monetare t adoptuar nga Banka e Shqipris sht ai i shnjestrimit t inflacionit. Ky regjim, i aplikuar gjersisht nga bankat qendrore, ka tre elemente esenciale. S pari, ai nnkupton q banka qendrore prdor t gjith informacionin relevant t disponuar pr vlersimin e balancs s presioneve inflacioniste. Nj kurb Filipsi tipike pr nj ekonomi t vogl e t hapur si Shqipria, e shikon kt balanc si funksion i tre prbrsve: pozicionit ciklik t ekonomis; presioneve mbi mimet q vijn nga tregu i huaj; dhe, pritjeve pjesrisht racionale t agjentve ekonomik pr inflacionin. N praktik, ky informacion prkthehet n projeksione mbi ecurin e mimeve n horizontin afatmesm, ka i mundson banks qendrore t evidentoj shmangiet e mundshme t inflacionit nga objektivi dhe t marr n koh masat prkatse. S dyti, shnjestrimi i inflacionit nnkupton q banka qendrore ndrhyn n sistemin financiar me instrumente indirekte, t cilat operojn n prputhje me logjikn e tregut. N praktik, bankat qendrore prcaktojn nivelin e norms baz t interesit, i cili orienton m tej t gjith spektrin e normave t interesit n t gjith gamn e instrumenteve t tregut financiar. S treti, ai nnkupton q kursi i kmbimit sht i lir dhe luhatet n prputhje me raportet e krkess dhe oferts pr valut. Kjo i mundson politiks monetare t fokusohet trsisht n prmbushjen e objektivit t stabilitetit t mimeve, duke i ofruar njkohsisht ekonomis nj instrument pr amortizimin e goditjeve q mund t vijn nga ambienti i jashtm. Prtej ktyre elementeve klasike, Banka e Shqipris aplikon nj regjim fleksibl t inflacionit t shnjestruar. Kjo do t thot se, n vlersimin e prshtatshmris s qndrimit t politiks monetare, Banka e Shqipris mban parasysh edhe pozicionin ciklik t ekonomis dhe se funksioni i reagimit t politiks monetare i jep nj pesh t caktuar edhe zbutjes s cikleve t biznesit, natyrisht pa paragjykuar pr asnj moment respektimin e stabilitetit t mimeve. N prputhje me kto tipare, Banka e Shqipris ka marr nj angazhim publik pr t ndjekur nj politik monetare konsistente dhe t qndrueshme. Angazhimi pr konsistenc krkon q qndrimi i politiks son monetare t jet, n do koh, ai i duhuri pr prmbushjen e objektivit ton t inflacionit brenda nj horizonti kohor afatmesm. Angazhimi pr qndrueshmri krkon q politika jon monetare t faktorizoj dhe elementet e rrezikut e t pasiguris, t cilat jan t pandashme n procesin e parashikimit ekonomik dhe gjithnj prezente n funksionimin e tregjeve financiare. Duke u ndalur te elementi i fundit, dshiroj t theksoj se strategjia e Banks s Shqipris pr prmbushjen e objektivit t inflacionit bazohet jo vetm n praktikat m t mira t bankingut qendror, por edhe n realitetin q ofron shkalla e zhvillimit t ekonomis dhe t tregjeve financiare shqiptare. Pr kt arsye, ne i kushtojm nj rndsi t veant si vlersimit t mekanizmit t transmetimit t politiks monetare, ashtu edhe stabilitetit t sistemit bankar e atij financiar. Si mbikqyrs e rregullator i aktivitetit bankar, dominimi i sistemit bankar n ekonomin shqiptare i jep Banks s Shqipris nj perspektiv unike mbi mekanizmin e transmetimit t politiks monetare dhe ndrthurjen e saj me rregullimin bankar apo  me fjal t tjera  politikn makroprudenciale. Ndonse ndrthurja eficiente e politiks monetare me at makroprudenciale mbetet nj fush e cila nuk ka ende nj konsensus t qart akademik e praktik, eksperienca jon e dekads s fundit na ka ofruar disa msime t rndsishme. Kriza globale financiare dhe kriza e borxhit n Eurozon ishin kamban zgjimi pr nevojn e nj vlersimi m t plot t ndrlidhjes s stabilitetit monetar me at financiar. Kto kriza nxorn n pah rndsin q ka nj sistem bankar e financiar i qndrueshm pr stabilitetin dhe zhvillimin e prgjithshm t vendit. Deri prpara ktyre dy krizave, filozofia e menaxhimit ekonomik u udhhoq nga nj supozim i heshtur se stabiliteti monetar ishte, n vetvete, nj kusht i mjaftueshm pr stabilitetin e prgjithshm ekonomik e financiar t vendit. Tregjet financiare u supozuan t ishin efikase dhe t vetrregulluara, ka nnkuptonte mungesn e krizave financiare sistemike. Kriza financiare e vitit 2008 shkaktoi nj tronditje t madhe financiare dhe e prmbysi kt konsensus. Bilancet e rnduara t sektorit bankar, rritja e pasiguris dhe ndrprerja e qarkullimit t flukseve financiare, penguan transmetimin normal t politiks monetare. N vendet e zhvilluara, bankat qendrore reaguan fuqishm pr t mbshtetur ekonomin dhe stabilitetin e sistemit financiar. Normat shkuan shpejt n zero, e madje n territor negativ. Megjithat, problemet e mekanizmit t transmetimit i detyruan ato t adoptonin e aplikonin instrumente jokonvencionale t politiks monetare. Lehtsimi sasior dhe ai i kreditit rivendosn, deri n nj far mase, qarkullimin e likuiditetit n ekonomi, duke anashkaluar ndrmjetsit financiar  bankat dhe tregun e kapitaleve. Megjithat, ai rezultoi n nj zgjerim t shpejt t bilancit t bankave qendrore dhe i shtyu ato n nj fush t paeksploruar t politiks monetare. Nga ana tjetr, shkalla e ult e zhvillimit t tregjeve financiare e bri t paprshtatshm prdorimin e ktij instrumenti, n Shqipri dhe n vendet e rajonit. N kto rrethana, vmendja jon u prqendrua n identifikimin e pasojave t goditjes n sektorin bankar dhe hartimin e strategjive t masave pr adresimin sa m t shpejt t tyre. Eksperiencn e Banks s Shqipris me krizat financiare t dekads s fundit dhe msimet e nxjerra prej saj do ti adresoj n seksionin e dyt t fjals sime. 2. Msimet e nxjerra nga dy krizat financiare t fundviteve 00 dhe fillimviteve 10 Shqipria dhe vendet e Ballkanit Perndimor prjetuan nj dekad rritjeje t shpejt e t qndrueshme n vigjilje t krizs financiare globale. Liberalizimi ekonomik i fillim-viteve 90, integrimi n rritje me ekonomit dhe tregjet e zhvilluara t Bashkimit Evropian, rritja e shpejt e produktivitetit, si pasoj e futjes s kapitalit dhe ekspertizs s huaj, si dhe reformat e gjithanshme strukturore e institucionale, e vun rajonin n nj trajektore t shpejt zhvillimi. N trsi, ekonomit e rajonit e lan pas statusin e ekonomive n nevoj dhe fituan statusin e ekonomive n zhvillim, me perspektiva solide rritjeje dhe konvergjence n Bashkimin Evropian. Kriza financiare globale ndryshoi thuajse gjithka. Ndonse Shqipria dhe vendet e rajonit kishin nj ekspozim relativisht t ult ekonomik dhe financiar ndaj SHBA-ve - vendit t origjins s krizs pasojat e saj u ndjen t forta n rajon. Shtrngimi i kushteve financiare globale dhe reduktimi i krkess s huaj, u kombinuan me nj sr dobsish q kishte modeli yn i zhvillimit ekonomik dhe financiar. Shum shpejt, kjo goditje fillestare u pasua nga kriza e borxhit sovran n Eurozon. Kjo goditje ishte po aq serioze dhe e qndrueshme sa kriza financiare globale. N veanti, ajo solli nj rrjedhje t shpejt kapitali bankar e fondesh financiare jasht rajonit, ka vshtirsoi reagimin e politikbrsve pr administrimin e pasojave t krizs. N mnyr t prmbledhur, pasoja e ktyre goditjeve ishin bilancet e rnduara financiare pr sektorin publik dhe privat, si dhe nj dekad ku ritmi i rritjes ekonomike thuajse u prgjysmua n krahasim me periudhn prpara krizs, ndrsa inflacioni qndroi posht objektivave t bankave qendrore. M lejoni t ndalem n tiparet e zhvillimit n Shqipri e rajon, q intensifikuan pasojat e goditjes dhe sfidat me t cilat u prballm. S pari, modeli i rritjes ekonomike u orientua dukshm drejt konsumit e investimeve t brendshme, e n veanti investimeve n sektorin e ndrtimit rezidencial. Ky model inkurajoi nj struktur ekonomike jokonkurruese. Ai rezultoi n mbialokim t resurseve ekonomike dhe financiare n sektorin e ndrtimit dhe n rritje t pajustifikuar t mimeve t aseteve. Prballja me realitetin pas dy krizave t shkuara financiare solli njohjen e rolit t reformave strukturore, si promotori kryesor i zhvillimit t qndrueshm e afatgjat t vendit, por krkoi dhe koh pr marrjen e fryteve t tyre. Gjithashtu, nga kndvshtrimi i banks qendrore, ai solli n vmendje rolin e madh q kan mimet e aseteve si tregues t zhbalancimeve ekonomike, implikimet e tyre pr stabilitetin financiar, si dhe kohn e gjat q krkon adresimi i tyre. S dyti, rritja e shpejt ekonomike u ushqye nga flukset e huaja financiare, t ndrmjetsuara prgjithsisht nga sektori bankar. Ky proces u lehtsua nga pesha e madhe e kapitalit bankar me origjin nga vendet e Bashkimit Evropian n rajon, si dhe nga struktura e incentivave dhe e modelit t biznesit t tyre. Brenda sektorit bankar, pasojat m serioze t krizs u manifestuan n formn e rritjes s kredive me probleme, sidomos n segmentin e kredive n valut, dhe n formn e uljes s vmendjes s bankave evropiane ndaj rajonit. N veanti, niveli i lart i kredive me probleme n segmentin e huamarrsve n valut t pambrojtur nga rreziku i kursit t kmbimit, kufizoi shkalln e liris s veprimit t politiks monetare dhe frenoi prdorimin e kursit t kmbimit si absorbues goditjeje. Kto problematika solln funksionimin jooptimal t mekanizmit t transmetimit t politiks monetare. Pr adresimin e tyre, Banka e Shqipris u angazhua n programe gjithprfshirse masash pr: uljen e kredive me probleme dhe prmirsimin e mjedisit t kreditit. Ndr t tjera, nj vmendje e veant i sht dedikuar prmirsimit t sistemeve t administrimit t rrezikut brenda vet bankave tregtare; konsolidimin e sektorit bankar, duke zvendsuar nj pjes t grupeve bankare t huaja, t cilat rishikuan  n mnyr t detyruar ose jo  strategjit e tyre t ekspansionit n rajon, me investitor t rinj e t motivuar; reduktimin e prdorimit t monedhs euro n sektorin financiar. Ky aksion synon uljen e prdorimit t panevojshm t euros, si n kursim dhe n kreditim, e sidomos n segmentin e kredimarrsve t pambrojtur nga rreziku i kursit t kmbimit. S treti, zhbalancimet n sektorin financiar u inkurajuan nga pamundsia e rregullatorve lokal pr t disiplinuar plotsisht sasin dhe destinacionin e flukseve hyrse financiare, si dhe nga mungesa e vmendjes s rregullatorve t huaj ndaj ktyre zhvillimeve. Pr rrjedhoj, n periudhn pas krizave, Banka e Shqipris ka ndrmarr nj program t plot konvergjence t kuadrit t saj mbikqyrs e rregullator me krkesat e Komitetit t Bazelit dhe standardet e Bashkimit Evropian. Si dshmi e puns son, nj vlersim i pavarur i kryer gjat vitit t shkuar konstatoi nj shkall t lart konvergjence midis kuadrit rregullator e praktikave tona mbikqyrse me ato t Bashkimit Evropian. Paralelisht me to, ne kemi intensifikuar dialogun me mbikqyrsit e huaj, pr t evidentuar n koh problemet dhe pr t ndrtuar  aty ku sht e mundur  strategji t prbashkta ndrhyrjeje. S katrti, Shqipria hyri n krizn financiare globale me nj nga nivelet m t larta t borxhit publik n rajon. Ky tipar, si dhe rritja e skajshme e kostove t financimit n tregjet e huaja gjat periudhs n vijim, zvogluan hapsirat pr nj stimul fiskal kundrciklik. Kjo penges solli n vmendje rndsin q ka nj nivel i ult dhe i kontrolluar i borxhit publik n drejtim si t ruajtjes s hapsirs fiskale pr reagim, ashtu dhe t qndrueshmris s prgjithshme t sistemit financiar. N kt kontekst, nga tre instrumentet e mundshme t ndrhyrjes s shtetit n ekonomi - politiks monetare, politiks makroprudenciale dhe politiks fiskale - barra e prballimit t kostove t dy krizave financiare t dekads paraardhse ra vetm mbi politikn monetare. Pr m tepr, kjo politik pati hapsir t kufizuar veprimi, pr shkak t pasojave negative q nj stimul i fort monetar mund t kishte n stabilitetin financiar, si dhe u prball me nj mekanizm joplotsisht funksional transmetimi. Ndrsa kto probleme zgjatn n koh pasojat e goditjes, gjej me vend t theksoj se Shqipria dhe Banka e Shqipris nuk humbn koh n drejtim t identifikimit t tyre dhe t reagimit institucional. Zbatimi n koh dhe me energji i ktyre reformave ka sjell rritjen e qndrueshmris s sektorit bankar ndaj goditjeve dhe prmirsimin e mekanizmit t transmetimit t politiks monetare, duke ndihmuar dukshm reagimin ton n dy krizat pasuese. 3. Banka e Shqipris prball pandemis dhe goditjeve t oferts Pandemia dhe pushtimi rus i Ukrains jan ndr goditjet m serioze t dekadave t fundit. Ndonse kto dy ngjarje prbjn goditje diametralisht t kundrta  e para ishte n rezultante nj goditje krkese, ndrsa e dyta nj goditje e pastr oferte - intensiteti i tyre testoi dhe vijon t testoj fort ekuilibrat ekonomik dhe financiar t vendit. Fatmirsisht, n raport me dy goditjet paraardhse, ne ishim t prgatitur. Prgjigjja n sfern ekonomike e autoriteteve publike gjat periudhs s pandemis sht nj shembull suksesi. Situata krkonte nj reagim t shpejt, t kalibruar dhe t koordinuar, duke synuar si amortizimin e pasojat t goditjes n afat t shkurtr ashtu dhe minimizimin e dmit mbi potencialin prodhues t vendit n afatin e gjat. Kjo e fundit nnkupton minimizimin e falimentimeve masive t bizneseve, reduktimin e largimeve afatgjata nga puna, dhe, mbi t gjitha, ruajtjen e stabilitetit t prgjithshm ekonomik dhe financiar t vendit. Banka e Shqipris ndrmori nj paket masash monetare, makroprudenciale, mbikqyrse dhe operacionale, t cilat synuan ruajtjen e likuiditetit n tregjet financiare, uljen e kostove t huamarrjes dhe ruajtjen e nj fluksi t pandrprer t kreditimit dhe t shrbimeve financiare. Reagimi yn i menjhershm dhe shumdimensional mundsoi: (i) uljen e kostos s huadhnies dhe mbshtetjen e vazhduar t familjeve dhe bizneseve shqiptare me kredi bankare; (ii) ruajtjen e nj sistemi bankar likuid, t mirkapitalizuar, dhe me praktika t shndosha pr administrimin e rreziqeve; dhe (iii) reduktimin e pasiguris dhe rritjen e besimit n t ardhmen. Rimkmbja e ekonomis gjat vitit 2021 ishte solide, burimet e rritjes ishin me baz t gjer, ashtu si edhe faktort mbshtets s saj, ku veojm mjedisin e qndrueshm monetar dhe financiar. N gjykimin tim, suksesi i dedikohet disa faktorve: s pari, ne ishim t prgatitur. Msimet e nxjerra pas krizs globale financiare dhe krizs s borxheve sovrane evropiane na shrbyen pr t reduktuar dobsit strukturore t ekonomis, pr t forcuar sektorin financiar dhe pr t rritur qndrueshmrin e tij ndaj goditjeve; s dyti, prgjigjja e politikave ishte proporcionale me kompleksitetin e situats, e shpejt n koh dhe e koordinuar. Ne aktivizuam nj gam t gjer instrumentesh, n prmasa t paprecedenta. Stimuli monetar u zbatua njkohsisht me stimuj fiskal  fondet e garancis sovrane  dhe me lehtsime t targetuara rregullatore e makroprudenciale; s treti, prgjigjja dhe koordinimi i politikave globale ndihmuan n kufizimin e shtrirjes s rnies ekonomike. Institucionet financiare ndrkombtare dhe organizatat e institucionet e BE-s morn nj rol aktiv n nxitjen e koordinimit t politikave globale. Pr ne politikbrsit e rajonit, kjo siguroi mbshtetjen ndrkombtare pr politikat ekspansioniste n vend dhe ndihmoi n rritjen e hapsirs s veprimit. Megjithat, sfidat mbeten aktuale. Lufta n Ukrain ka sjell nj rritje t shpejt t inflacionit kudo n bot. N prgjigje t tij, Banka e Shqipris ndrmori nj hap t par drejt normalizimit t politiks monetare n muajin mars, duke rritur me 0.5 pik prqindjeje normn baz t interesit. N t njjtn koh, ne kemi sinjalizuar vullnetin dhe gatishmrin ton pr t ndrmarr do mas monetare t nevojshme pr t shmangur transmetimin e ksaj goditjeje n pritje pr inflacion t lart n t ardhmen. Komunikimi yn transparent i ka shrbyer qartsimit t publikut mbi kahun e veprimit t politiks monetare dhe ka ndihmuar n kontrollin e pritjeve pr inflacionin n tregjet financiare. 4. N vend t konkluzioneve T nderuar pjesmarrs! N mbyllje t fjals sime, m lejoni t ndaj me ju disa msime t dala nga eksperienca e Banks s Shqipris prball sfidave me t cilat jemi prballur n vite. Stabiliteti i mimeve sht nj parakusht i domosdoshm pr rritje t qndrueshme e afatgjat t vendit dhe t mirqenies s shoqris. N vija t prgjithshme, ky stabilitet duhet t jet objektivi i vetm legjitim i politiks monetare. Megjithat, fokusi te stabiliteti mimeve nuk duhet ta shmang vmendjen e banks qendrore nga burime t tjera dobsish e rreziqesh. N veanti, stabiliteti financiar duhet t jet nj objektiv tjetr komplementar i bankave qendrore, pr sa koh ai bn t mundur stabilitetin e mimeve dhe mundson shprndarjen eficiente t fondeve n ekonomi. Adoptimi i nj kuadri modern t politiks monetare sht esencial pr suksesin e saj. Ndr t tjera, ky kuadr duhet t jet transparent n objektivat e tij, gjithprfshirs n gamn e informacionit t prdorur, konsistent n vendimmarrje dhe fleksibl n kuadrin operacional t prdorur. N veanti, eksperienca e fundit ka treguar se bankat qendrore duhet ti kushtojn vmendje edhe instrumenteve jokonvencionale t politiks monetare, si lehtsimi sasior apo ai i kreditit. Megjithat, kto instrumente duhet t trajtohen si opsione t fundit n radh, dhe prdorimi i tyre duhet t jet i kushtzuar nga shkalla e zhvillimit dhe e sofistikimit t tregjeve financiare. Sa i takon stabilitetit financiar, kjo sfer e aktivitetit t bankave qendrore duhet t adoptoj  ashtu si politika monetare  nj prqasje t orientuar nga e ardhmja dhe nj qndrim proaktiv. N veanti, megjithse roli yn si mbikqyrs e rregullator nuk mund e nuk duhet t jet garantimi i shndetit t do ndrmjetsi financiar, dobsit sistemike q prbjn premisa pr kriza financiare e ekonomike, duhen evidentuar dhe trajtuar n koh. Paralelisht me to, eksperiencat e fundit kan treguar se politika fiskale ka nj rol t pazvendsueshm n prballimin e goditjeve t forta ekonomike e financiare. Pavarsisht fuqis dhe kompleksitetit t instrumenteve q disponon banka qendrore, ajo nuk mund t prballoj e vetme dhe me efikasitet t plot, goditjet me t cilat prballen ekonomit e vogla dhe t hapura. Pr kt arsye, shndeti i financave publike duhet par si nj tregues i rndsishm i aftsis s vendit pr prballimin e krizave. N vija t prgjithshme, kto konsiderata do t prcaktojn filozofin e mendimit e t veprimit t Banks s Shqipris n t ardhmen. Megjithat, gjej me vend t theksoj se nj bank qendrore e prgjegjshme nuk duhet t mjaftohet me studimin e s shkuars pr ta prdorur si udhrrfyes pr t ardhmen. Sfidat e reja q prvijohen n horizont, si inovacioni financiar, ngrohja globale, plakja e popullsis apo dhe ndryshimi i modelit t biznesit, si pasoj e tensioneve gjeopolitike, duhet t ken vmendjen e duhur. Jam i bindur se punimet e ksaj konference do t hedhin m shum drit mbi shtjet dhe sfidat q un preka. Ju faleminderit!

Title: Speech during the presentation of the Annual Report of the Bank of Albania for 2021 in the Albanian Parliament
text: Governor Sejko's remarks during the presentation of the Annual Report of the Bank of Albania for 2021 in the Albanian Parliament Date of publication: 16.06.2022 Dear Mrs. Speaker of the Assembly, Dear Ladies and Gentlemen, I would like to start the presentation of the Annual Report by expressing my highest regard for the Albanian Parliament. In the bank of Albania's view, reporting to this institution is a legal obligation not only legal but also moral. As a key element of transparency and accountability, this report serves to increase the accountability and credibility of the Bank of Albania in the public eye. Also, this report enables the presentation of the Bank of Albania's perspective on the economic and financial situation in the country and the challenges of the future, helping to constructive dialogue between our institutions. Dear Ladies and Gentlemen, Let me give you an exponence of our work and results over the past year. The key to the economic developments of 2021 was recovery and consolidation. Economic activity in the country marked a rapid and all-around recovery, while the main indicators of economic and financial health consolidated. According to official data, the volume of economic activity increased by 8.5% against the previous year, exceeding the level recorded before the earthquake and pandemic. Economic growth was broad-based. It reflected the rapid recovery of household consumption, private investment, as well as exports of goods and services. Furthermore, the fruits of this recovery were present in almost all sectors and main branches of the economy. The overall demand recovery generated more revenue for Albanian businesses and households, improving their financial balance sheets and increasing the sustainability of growth sources. The economic recovery brought increases in employment, wages and profit margins, which materialized in rising domestic inflationary pressures. Inflation has been a gradual increase over the past year, although it remains below target. The recovery was accompanied by consolidation of economic and financial balances. The country's external economic and financial position has improved. The current account deficit decreased to 7.7% of GDP during 2021, against the 8.7% level registered a year earlier. The country's foreign debt also declined. In fiscal plan, economic growth and falling budget deficit brought a reduction to 73.2% of the ratio of public debt to GDP, from the 74.5% level registered in 2020. In parallel with these developments, the country's monetary and financial stability came into consolidation. Financial markets operated calmly, exchange rates appeared stable, and credit conditions improved. The banking system also had a positive performance during 2021. Financial intermediation came in on the rise, while the indicators of capitalization, liquidity and profitability improved and were significantly above our regulatory requirements. The banking sector's activity exposure to risks is controlled, while resistance-test exercises suggest its ability to withstand shock appears high. This positive picture of developments has reflected not only the relatively solid foundations of the Albanian economy and the flexibility of the private sector of the economy, but also the coordinated response, at the time and with the appropriate instruments, of fiscal, monetary and financial policy. Looking at the work of the Bank of Albania, I must emphasize that our monetary policy has remained in the stimulus during 2021. This position served both to meet our primary objective, that of price stability, and to promote economic recovery. In more concrete terms, we maintained the basic interest rate at historical minimum levels, met the market's liquidity needs, and continued to orient the market towards monetary policy in the future. Our monetary policy ensured an environment with low financing costs, appropriate credit conditions and stable exchange rates. It kept the financial costs of the private sector in check and enabled a rapid and steady growth of lending, helping to expand consumption and investment in the economy. Our estimates show that monetary stimulus contributed about 1.3 percentage points to 2021 economic growth and helped strengthen price stability, in line with our inflation target. In coordination with the monetary stimulus, the Bank of Albania continues to maintain macroprudential stimulus measures, measures that supported the restructuring of loans for customers in need, even during the first quarter of 2021. Furthermore, with credit consolidation and economic recovery, our supervisory and regulatory focus was directed towards strengthening financial stability. In this context, the Bank of Albania intensified the work on further regulatory and methodological alignment with the EU acquis, the principles of the Basel Committee and best practices on banking supervision. Also, during 2021, the Bank of Albania further developed the framework, objectives and instruments of macroprudential intervention, as well as strengthened its capacities for exceptional interventions, finalizing individual intervention plans and setting the minimum requirements on the instruments banks should maintain to enable the implementation of the intervention. These actions add safety nets to the financial system and strengthen our institutional capacities for ensuring financial stability. In parallel, we have paid particular attention to improving the regulatory framework for increasing transparency and consumer protection. In this context, we have strengthened the regulatory framework for consumer loans granted by non-bank financial institutions, with the aim of quantitatively limiting interest rates and commissions applied to these loans. These changes are based entirely on best practices followed by the European Union countries. We also have been monitoring the financial system. On-site inspections have been regularly followed, adding examinations of non-bank financial entities and foreign exchange offices. Their focus has been to assess the management of the pandemic situation and the impact on the loan portfolio, as well as other risks related to banking activity. Finally, the Bank of Albania has paid special attention to the implementation of the recommendations of the MONEYVAL Committee, in the framework of anti-money laundering and terrorist financing measures. We have continued to work on improving the regulatory framework and strengthening the effectiveness of the oversight process through continuous inspections on issues related to the prevention of money laundering, with a particular focus on issues of terrorism financing and international sanctions enforcement. The inspections target banks, and non-bank financial entities and foreign exchange offices. As a result of the work done in all these directions, moneyval's latest 2021 report finds the progress made by the Bank of Albania in the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing, assessing as "widely addressed" the recommendations left on the rules and supervision of financial institutions. On the other hand, the Bank of Albania has already initiated the process of equipping our supervisory and regulatory framework with that of the European Union, paving the way for further reduction of mediation costs and a more appropriate lending environment in the country. Following the very encouraging results of an independent assessment, made by a specialised foreign agency, we have requested to the European Commission to launch the formal equivalence process. In parallel with the supervision and regulation of the banking sector, the Bank of Albania has also worked to promote the development and sophistication of the Albanian financial markets. In this regard, find it a place to highlight the work done for: Guarantee secure and efficient payment systems, as well as expanding existing infrastructure with a new system of payment of national payments in euro currency for bank customers. This system enables the making of payments in euros within the country, at much lower costs and in a much shorter time frame compared to the previous process. Promotion electronic payments and increased financial inclusion of the population. The number of electronic payments carried out in the country increased significantly during 2021, driven by regulatory changes to the law "On Payment Services" and improvements in infrastructure. Improvement regulatory framework of payment systems in accordance with European Union standards. In 2021, the draft law "On accounting for payments with basic services" has been drafted, in accordance with the EU Directives. Its approval provides basic financial services to individuals without cover for banking services, regardless of income level, employment status, or insepensiveness history. In an illustration of the results of our work, but also of the progress that the banking sector itself has made towards digitalization, the use of electronic payment instruments increased by about 30%, the volume of home banking increased by about 25%, while the number of remotely accessible accounts increased by 31% during 2021. Electronic payment developments have contributed to the fulfillment of the quantitative objectives of the National Small Value Payment Strategy. The use of electronic payments per capita reached the 12.5 out of 10 payments that is the objective of this strategy. Also, in 2021, about 69% of the population in the majority of the population owns a payment account, significantly approaching the 70% target set in the strategy.
