In addition to fulfilling its primary role, the Bank of Albania has worked to carry out a series of other institutional tasks and commitments, as well as to respect the recommendations left in the Resolution of the Assembly. In summary, let me emphasize that in fulfilling its function as issuer of money, the Bank of Albania has continuously improved the quality of the Albanian currency. During 2021, we completed printing all the cuts of the new series of banknotes, and for the first time we put the 10,000 leke in circulation. This process was accompanied by a wide-ranging educational campaign on Albanian banknotes. The Bank of Albania has also continued work to improve the management of the foreign reserve, which is already based on a consolidated regulatory and professional process, where the main objective is to ensure its liquidity and security. The Bank of Albania has also made further progress in: Fulfillment of institutional obligations within the Framework of European Integration, where the Bank of Albania has a key role in aligning the legislation and institutional infrastructure of the financial system with EU standards; growth communication, transparency and accountability, serving our commitment to turn the Bank of Albania into an open and trustworthy institution to the public; spur financial education as an essential element for the long-term well-being of society; Field scientific research as a prerequisite of the drafting of the most effective policies of growth and development; how and in the processes of collecting, compiling and reporting statistics, in support of a more efficient decision-making, both in the public and private sectors. All these changes have been driven and supported by strengthening the governance of the institution and continuous investment in professional staff building, so that we are always able to face the challenges of the time. You will find extensive information on these issues detailed in the pages of the Report. *** Dear Ladies and Gentlemen, Taking advantage of this public communication, I cannot fail to highlight the current challenge facing the Albanian economy, as a result of the increase in prices in world markets. This has not saved any economy, not only at european level but also at the global level. The rapid rise in energy, food and basic commodity prices on world markets has cost households living and increased the costs of manufacturing businesses. Further, uncertainty over the duration and consequences of armed conflict has added to uncertainty in financial markets and created new bottlenecks in supply chains. This shock has begun to be broadcast in the Albanian economy. Domestic and global inflation is recording the highest levels of the past two decades, and current projections suggest that the impact of this shock will be significant in the coming year. The Bank of Albania is constantly monitoring the situation. Based on our current information and analysis, the Bank of Albania judges that the Albanian economy has sufficient premises to resist shock and avoid recession. In these circumstances, the focus of economic policies should be directed towards maintaining price stability, as a prerequisite for the country's financial stability and sustainable and long-term growth, and on helping the most vulnerable strata. This focus will require a continuous review of the adequacy of the monetary policy stance, as well as maintaining budgetary flexibility to address possible contingents in terms of social cost relief, without undermining the long-term sustainability of public debt. With this shock overcome, our focus must once again be directed towards undertaking necessary structural reforms that will unleash the country's productive potential and help to increase the society's prosperity faster. *** Thanking you for your attention, let me emphasize that the Bank of Albania has been and remains committed to respecting its legal duties and addressing the challenges of the country's development. Ju faleminderit!
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko gjat prezantimit t Raportit Vjetor t Banks s Shqipris pr vitin 2021 n Kuvendin e Shqipris Data e publikimit: 16.06.2022 E nderuar zonja Kryetare e Kuvendit, T nderuar zonja dhe zotrinj Deputet, Dshiroj ta filloj prezantimin e Raportit Vjetor duke shprehur konsideratn time m t lart pr Kuvendin e Shqipris. N kndvshtrimin e Banks s Shqipris, raportimi prpara ktij institucioni sht nj detyrim jo vetm ligjor por edhe moral. Si nj element ky i transparencs dhe llogaridhnies, ky raportim i shrben rritjes s prgjegjshmris dhe besueshmris s Banks s Shqipris n syt e publikut. Gjithashtu, ky raportim mundson prezantimin e kndvshtrimit t Banks s Shqipris mbi situatn ekonomike dhe financiare n vend dhe sfidat e s ardhmes, duke ndihmuar dialogun konstruktiv midis institucioneve tona. T nderuar zonja e zotrinj deputet, M lejoni t tju paraqes n vazhdim nj ekspoze t puns dhe rezultateve tona gjat vitit t shkuar. Kryefjala e zhvillimeve ekonomike t vitit 2021 ishte rimkmbja dhe konsolidimi. Aktiviteti ekonomik n vend shnoi nj rikuperim t shpejt e t gjithanshm, ndrsa treguesit kryesor t shndetit ekonomik e financiar u konsoliduan. Sipas t dhnave zyrtare, vllimi i aktivitetit ekonomik u rrit me 8.5% kundrejt vitit paraardhs, duke tejkaluar nivelin e regjistruar prpara trmetit e pandemis. Rritja ekonomike ishte me baz t gjer. Ajo pasqyroi rimkmbjen e shpejt t konsumit familjar, t investimeve private, si dhe t eksporteve t mallrave e shrbimeve. Pr m tepr, frytet e ksaj rimkmbjeje ishin t pranishme n thuajse t gjith sektort dhe degt kryesore t ekonomis. Rikuperimi i gjithanshm i krkess gjeneroi m shum t ardhura pr bizneset dhe familjet shqiptare, duke prmirsuar bilancet e tyre financiare dhe duke rritur qndrueshmrin e burimeve t rritjes. Rimkmbja ekonomike solli rritje t punsimit, t pagave dhe t marzheve t fitimit, ka u materializua n rritje t presioneve t brendshme inflacioniste. Pr rrjedhoj, inflacioni shnoi nj rritje graduale gjat vitit t shkuar, ndonse ai vijoi t mbetet nn objektiv. Rimkmbja u shoqrua me konsolidim t ekuilibrave ekonomik e financiar. Pozicioni i jashtm ekonomik dhe financiar i vendit erdhi n prmirsim. Deficiti i llogaris korrente zbriti n 7.7% t PBB-s gjat vitit 2021, kundrejt nivelit 8.7% t regjistruar nj vit m par. Po ashtu, borxhi i huaj i vendit shnoi rnie. N planin fiskal, rritja ekonomike dhe rnia e deficitit buxhetor solln reduktimin n 73.2% t raportit t borxhit publik ndaj PBB-s, nga niveli 74.5% i regjistruar n vitin 2020. Paralelisht me kto zhvillime, stabiliteti monetar dhe financiar i vendit erdhi n konsolidim. Tregjet financiare operuan t qeta, kursi i kmbimit u shfaq i qndrueshm, dhe kushtet e kreditimit u prmirsuan. Gjithashtu, sistemi bankar pati nj ecuri pozitive gjat vitit 2021. Ndrmjetsimi financiar erdhi n rritje, ndrsa treguesit e kapitalizimit, t likuiditetit dhe t prfitueshmris, u prmirsuan dhe ishin ndjeshm mbi krkesat tona rregullatore. Ekspozimi i aktivitetit t sektorit bankar ndaj rreziqeve sht i kontrolluar, ndrsa ushtrimet e provs s rezistencs sugjerojn se aftsia e tij pr t prballuar goditje shfaqet e lart. Kjo tablo pozitive zhvillimesh ka pasqyruar jo vetm fondamentet relativisht solide t ekonomis shqiptare dhe fleksibilitetin e sektorit privat t ekonomis, por edhe reagimin e koordinuar, n kohn dhe me instrumentet e duhura, t politiks fiskale, monetare e financiare. Duke u ndalur te puna e Banks s Shqipris, m duhet t theksoj se politika jon monetare vijoi t mbetet n kahun stimulues gjat vitit 2021. Ky qndrim i shrbeu si prmbushjes s objektivit ton t primar, atij t stabilitetit t mimeve, ashtu dhe nxitjes s rimkmbjes ekonomike. N terma m konkret, ne ruajtm normn baz t interesit n nivelet minimale historike, plotsuam nevojat e tregut me likuiditet, si dhe vijuam t orientojm tregun mbi kahun e politiks monetare n t ardhmen. Politika jon monetare siguroi nj ambient me kosto t ulta financimi, kushte t prshtatshme kreditimi dhe kurs t qndrueshm kmbimi. Ajo mbajti n kontroll kostot financiare t sektorit privat dhe mundsoi nj rritje t shpejt e t qndrueshme t kreditimit, duke ndihmuar zgjerimin e konsumit dhe t investimeve n ekonomi. Vlersimet tona tregojn se stimuli monetar kontribuoi me rreth 1.3 pik prqindje n rritjen ekonomike t vitit 2021 dhe ndihmoi forcimin e stabilitetit t mimeve, n linj me objektivin ton t inflacionit. N koordinim me stimulin monetar, Banka e Shqipris vijoi t ruaj masat stimuluese makroprudenciale, masa t cilat mbshtetn ristrukturimin e kredive pr klientt n nevoj, edhe gjat tremujorit t par t vitit 2021. M tej, me konsolidimin e kreditit dhe t rimkmbjes ekonomike, fokusi yn mbikqyrs e rregullator u orientua drejt fuqizimit t stabilitetit financiar. N kt kontekst, Banka e Shqipris intensifikoi punn pr prafrimin e mtejshm rregullator e metodologjik me acquis t BE-s, parimet e Komitetit t Bazelit dhe me praktikat m t mira t mbikqyrjes bankare. Po ashtu, gjat vitit 2021, Banka e Shqipris zhvilloi m tej kuadrin, objektivat dhe instrumentet e ndrhyrjes makroprudenciale, si dhe fuqizoi kapacitetet e saj pr ndrhyrje t jashtzakonshme, duke prfunduar planet individuale t ndrhyrjes dhe duke prcaktuar krkesat minimale mbi instrumentet q duhet t mbajn bankat pr t mundsuar zbatimin e ndrhyrjes. Kto aksione shtojn rrjetat e siguris n sistemin financiar dhe fuqizojn kapacitetet tona institucionale pr garantimin e stabilitetit financiar. Paralelisht me to, ne i kemi kushtuar nj vmendje t veant prmirsimit t kuadrit rregullator pr rritjen e transparencs dhe mbrojtjen e konsumatorit. N kt kontekst, ne kemi forcuar kuadrin rregullator pr kredit konsumatore t dhna nga institucione financiare jo-banka, me qllim kufizimin sasior t normave t interesit dhe t komisioneve t aplikuara pr kto kredi. Kto ndryshime jan bazuar trsisht n praktikat m t mira t ndjekura nga vendet e Bashkimit Evropian. Po ashtu, ne kemi vijuar monitorimin rigoroz t sistemit financiar. Inspektimet n vend kan vijuar rregullisht, duke shtuar ekzaminimet e subjekteve financiare jo-banka dhe t zyrave t kmbimit valutor. Fokusi i tyre ka qen vlersimi i administrimit t situats s pandemis dhe ndikimit n portofolin e kredis, si dhe rreziqeve t tjera q lidhen me veprimtarin bankare. S fundi, Banka e Shqipris i ka kushtuar nj kujdes t posam zbatimit t rekomandimeve t Komitetit t MONEYVAL, n kuadr t masave kundr pastrimit t parave dhe financimit t terrorizmit. Ne kemi vijuar punn pr prmirsimin e kuadrit rregullator dhe forcimin e efektivitetit t procesit mbikqyrs, nprmjet inspektimeve t vazhdueshme pr shtje q lidhen me parandalimin e pastrimit t parave, me nj fokus t veant shtjet e financimit t terrorizmit dhe t zbatimit t sanksioneve ndrkombtare. Inspektimet kan targetuar si bankat, dhe subjektet financiare jo-banka dhe zyrat e kmbimit valutor. Si rezultat i puns s br n t gjitha kto drejtime, raporti i fundit i MONEYVAL pr vitin 2021 konstaton progresin e br nga Banka e Shqipris n drejtim t lufts ndaj pastrimit t parave dhe financimit t terrorizimit, duke vlersuar si gjersisht t adresuara rekomandimet e lna mbi rregullat dhe mbikqyrjen e institucioneve financiare. Nga ana tjetr, Banka e Shqipris ka iniciuar tashm procesin e ekuivalentimit t kuadrit ton mbikqyrs e rregullator me at t Bashkimit Evropian, duke i hapur rrugn uljes s mtejshme t kostove t ndrmjetsimit dhe nj ambienti m t prshtatshm pr kreditimin n vend. Pas rezultateve mjaft inkurajuese t nj vlersimi t pavarur, t br nga nj agjenci e specializuar e huaj, ne kemi krkuar pran Komisionit Evropian nisjen e procesit formal t ekuivalencs. Paralelisht me mbikqyrjen dhe rregullimin e sektorit bankar, Banka e Shqipris ka punuar edhe pr nxitjen e zhvillimit dhe sofistikimit t tregjeve financiare shqiptare. N kt drejtim, gjej me vend t evidentoj punn e br pr: Garantimin e sistemeve t pagesave t sigurta dhe eficiente, si dhe zgjerimin e infrastrukturs ekzistuese me nj sistem t ri t shlyerjes t pagesave kombtare n monedhn euro pr klientt e bankave. Ky sistem mundson kryerjen e pagesave n euro brenda vendit, me kosto shum m t ulta dhe n nj afat kohor shum m t shkurtr krahasuar me procesin e mparshm. Nxitjen e pagesave elektronike dhe rritjen e prfshirjes financiare t popullsis. Numri i pagesave elektronike t kryera n vend u rrit ndjeshm gjat vitit 2021, i nxitur nga ndryshimet rregullatore n ligjin Pr shrbimet e Pagesave dhe prmirsimet n infrastruktur. Prmirsimin e kuadrit rregullator t sistemeve t pagesave n prputhje me standardet e Bashkimit Evropian. Gjat vitit 2021 sht hartuar projekt-ligji Pr llogarin e pagesave me shrbime bazike, n prputhje me Direktivat e BE. Miratimi i tij ofron shrbime financiare bazike pr individt e pa mbuluar me shrbime bankare, pavarsisht nivelit t t ardhurave, statusit t punsimit, apo historikut t aftsis paguese. N ilustrim t rezultateve t puns son, por dhe t progresit q vet sektori bankar ka br n drejtim te dixhitalizimit, prdorimi i instrumenteve elektronike t pagesave u rrit me rreth 30%, vllimi i pagesave home banking u rrit me rreth 25%, ndrsa numri i llogarive t aksesueshme n distanc u rrit me 31% gjat vitit 2021. Zhvillimet e pagesave elektronike kan kontribuar n prmbushjen e objektivave sasior t Strategjis Kombtare t Pagesave me Vler t Vogl. Prdorimi i pagesave elektronike pr frym arriti n nivelin 12.5 nga 10 pagesa q sht objektivi i ksaj strategjie. Gjithashtu, n vitin 2021 rezulton se rreth 69% e popullsis n mosh madhore zotron nj llogari pagese, duke iu afruar ndjeshm objektivit prej 70% t vendosur n strategji. Krahas prmbushjes s rolit t saj primar, Banka e Shqipris ka vijuar punn pr jetsimin e nj sr detyrash dhe angazhimesh t tjera institucionale, si dhe pr respektimin e rekomandimeve t lna n rezolutn e Kuvendit. N mnyr t prmbledhur, m lejoni t theksoj se n prmbushje t funksionit t saj si emetuese e paras, Banka e Shqipris ka prmirsuar vazhdimisht cilsin e monedhs shqiptare. Gjat vitit 2021, ne prfunduam shtypjen e t gjitha prerjeve t seris s re t kartmonedhave, si dhe pr her t par hodhm n qarkullim prerjen me vler 10000 lek. Ky proces u shoqrua me nj fushat t gjer edukuese mbi kartmonedhat shqiptare. Po ashtu, Banka e Shqipris ka vijuar punn pr prmirsimin e administrimit t rezervs valutore, e cila tashm mbshtetet n nj proces t konsoliduar rregullator dhe profesional, ku objektivi kryesor sht garantimi i likuiditetit dhe i siguris s saj. Gjithashtu, Banka e Shqipris ka br progres t mtejshm n: prmbushjen e detyrimeve institucionale n kuadr t integrimit evropian, ku Banka e Shqipris ka nj rol ky n prafrimin e legjislacionit dhe infrastrukturs institucionale t sistemit financiar me standardet e BE-s; rritjen e komunikimit, transparencs dhe llogaridhnies, duke i shrbyer angazhimit ton pr ta kthyer Bankn e Shqipris n nj institucion t hapur dhe t besueshm pr publikun; nxitjen e edukimit financiar, si nj element esencial pr rritjen e mirqenies afatgjat t shoqris; fushn e krkimit shkencor, si nj parakusht i hartimit t politikave sa m efektive t rritjes e zhvillimit; si dhe n proceset e mbledhjes, hartimit dhe raportimit t statistikave, n mbshtetje t nj vendimmarrjeje sa m efikase, si n sektorin publik dhe n at privat. T gjitha kto ndryshime jan nxitur e mbshtetur nga forcimi i qeverisjes s institucionit dhe investimi i vazhdueshm n ngritjen profesionale t stafit, n mnyr q t jemi gjithnj t aft t prballemi me sfidat e kohs. Nj informacion t gjer mbi kto shtje do ta gjeni t detajuar n faqet e Raportit. *** T nderuar zonja dhe zotrinj Deputet, Duke prfituar nga ky komunikim publik, nuk mund t le pa evidentuar edhe sfidn aktuale me t ciln po prballet ekonomia shqiptare, si pasoj e rritjes s mimeve n tregjet botrore. Kjo goditje nuk ka kursyer asnj ekonomi, jo vetm n nivel evropian por dhe n nivel botror. Rritja e shpejt e mimeve t energjis, t ushqimeve dhe t produkteve baz n tregjet botrore, ka shtrenjtuar kostot e jetess s familjeve dhe ka rritur kostot e prodhimit t bizneseve. Po ashtu, paqartsia mbi kohzgjatjen dhe pasojat e konfliktit t armatosur, ka shtuar pasigurit n tregjet financiare dhe ka krijuar pengesa t reja n zinxhirt e furnizimit. Kjo goditje ka filluar t transmetohet edhe n ekonomin shqiptare. Inflacioni n vend dhe n bot po regjistron nivelet m t larta t dy dekadave t fundit dhe projeksionet aktuale sugjerojn se pasojat e ksaj goditjeje do t jen t ndjeshme edhe gjat vitit n vazhdim. Banka e Shqipris sht n monitorim t vazhdueshm t situats. Bazuar n informacionin aktual dhe analizat tona, Banka e Shqipris gjykon se ekonomia shqiptare ka premisa t mjaftueshme pr ti rezistuar goditjes dhe pr t shmangur recesionin. N kto rrethana, fokusi i politikave ekonomike duhet t orientohet drejt ruajtjes s stabilitetit t mimeve, si nj parakusht pr stabilitetin financiar t vendit dhe pr rritje t qndrueshme e afatgjat, dhe n ndihmn ndaj shtresave m n nevoj. Ky fokus do t krkoj rishikimin n vazhdimsi t prshtatshmris s qndrimit t politiks monetare, si dhe ruajtjen e fleksibilitetit buxhetor pr t adresuar kontigjencat e mundshme n drejtim t lehtsimit t kostove sociale, pa dmtuar qndrueshmrin afatgjat t borxhit publik. Me tejkalimin e ksaj goditjeje, fokusi yn duhet t orientohet dhe njher drejt ndrmarrjes s reformave t nevojshme strukturore t cilat do t lirojn potencialet prodhuese t vendit dhe do t ndihmojn n rritjen m t shpejt t mirqenies s shoqris. *** Duke ju falnderuar pr vmendjen, m lejoni t theksoj se Banka e Shqipris ka qen dhe mbetet e angazhuar pr respektimin e detyrave t saj ligjore dhe pr adresimin e sfidave t zhvillimit t vendit. Ju faleminderit!

Title: Governor Sejko's speech at the book promotion ceremony: "Towards a new crisis"
text: Governor Sejko's speech at the book promotion ceremony: "Straight A new crisis." Date of publication: 05.07.2022 I am very pleased to hold in my hands this valuable book - the third in the series of volumes of collaborations of the authors - written by two distinguished professors, my friends, Professor Angeli and Professor Civici, through which they share with us all thoughts, assessments, reflections, questions and suggestions on the successive and multiplant crises we are facing. I also value this book as an early publication on a global level, in reaction to this "third crisis," as the authors call it. The book discusses a long list of issues and challenges facing the global and Albanian economy. Through their treatment, the authors bring to the reader the truthfulness of the situation we are experiencing, following the chronology of the successive crises from the November 26, 2019 earthquake to the pandemic, the post-covidian period, and finally the crisis driven by the war in Ukraine. The combined discussion of these developments and their effects on the factors of global production and economic and financial activity constitutes the main axis of the book. In this way, they manage to present a complete and real analysis of geopolitical and geoeconomic events and developments. The book gives this full view, cross-examining data and analysis of events, with the history and challenges of the future. Above all, the analysis and conclusions of this book are complemented by a comprehensive and comparative picture of the economic, financial and monetary policies needed to meet these challenges. The crisis of war, the food security crisis (where prices were rising progressively, even before the Russian attack on Ukraine), the energy and raw materials crisis, the general slowdown in economic growth, inflation, and finally the prospect of higher interest rates are affecting a landscape already severely damaged by two years of pandemic. This book is dedicated precisely to following this situation day by day and week after week, trying to answer the questions: "What will happen? Where are we going? What will change?" The period we are going through has been accompanied by doubts, uncertainty and consequences of the war, uncertainty, different approaches, questions, paradoxes and dilemmas, all exposed and analyzed with such professionalism by the authors in this book. The authors put the situation in Albania in the face of the global situation, noting that no economy at European level, but also global level, was spared and cannot be spared from this war and the geopolitical challenges that define it. The analysis is designed in the Albanian economy to assess the potential negative effects on prices and economic activity. The current challenge facing the Albanian economy, as a result of the rapid increase in energy prices, food and basic products in the world markets, has cost families living and increased the costs of production of businesses. The uncertainty over the duration and consequences of the war in Ukraine has added to uncertainty in financial markets and created new bottlenecks in supply chains. Therefore, this blow that has begun to be transmitted in the Albanian economy requires a rapid, efficient and all-enstema response of public authorities, in a situation of many unknowns and with profound economic, political and social changes. I am pleased to note that the suggestions given on economic and financial policies, in the case of Albania, are in line with the current orientation of the Albanian authorities. I take the opportunity to thank the authors for their assessment of our monetary policy when they say: "A valuable help in this regard comes also from the prudent monetary policy of the Bank of Albania, which is implementing a prudent policy of raising interest rates ... and has taken care of stability in the exchange rates of international currencies. This prevents the impact of stagflation (of the eurozone) on the Albanian economy." As the authors noted, the Bank of Albania is constantly monitoring the situation. The focus of our economic and financial policies is oriented towards maintaining price stability, as a prerequisite for the country's financial stability and sustainable and long-term growth, as well as on helping the most vulnerable strata. Faced with a rapid inflation rate, not only in Albania but everywhere in the world, the Bank of Albania, in response, took a first step towards the normalization of monetary policy in March, raising the base interest rate by 0.5 percentage points. At the same time, we have signalled our willingness and willingness to undertake any monetary measures necessary to avoid transmission of this shock in anticipation for high inflation in the future. Our transparent communication has served to clarify the public's monetary policy course and helped control inflation expectations in financial markets. In response to these measures, the appropriate measures at the right time, as well as the continuation of the monitoring and appropriateness of the monetary policy stance, our analysis judge that the Albanian economy There are enough premises to resist shock and avoid recession. However, we continue to face unforeseen circumstances where it is difficult to determine when this situation will end. Uncertainty is reflected in our forecasts, however, that doesn't mean we don't do anything. On the contrary, the Bank of Albania is doing the best possible, continuously monitoring  as the authors have done during the "journey" of this book, day after day, week after week  the implications of the spread of the crisis in the economy, the performance of financial markets, and the effectiveness of the measures taken. The Bank of Albania is ready to use all available instruments to mitigate the effects of this crisis not only on price stability, but also on financial stability and economic activity. As the authors Angjeli and Civici point out, the challenges that await us are very serious and they need to be given proper attention. I am not talking about the current challenges, but also the new ones that are on the horizon, such as digitalization and financial innovation. These two factors the authors, rightly, have dedicated an entire section of the book. Other challenges unfolding before us are global warming, population ageing, or changing business models as a result of geopolitical tensions. I guarantee that the Bank of Albania has incorporated these challenges into the focus of medium and long-term institutional policies, conducting studies to better understand them and their implications in the economy and financial system. Confronting them requires a comprehensive approach where all public actors, private sector operators, international organizations, non-governmental organizations and academics, cooperate, making the right decisions, in a timely and coordinated manner. Not wanting to extend further, I want to close my word by expressing the full confidence that if each of us will do our best, then the withstanding of this blow will be within our means, and from it we will emerge stronger and better prepared for similar blows in the future. Thank you once for giving me the opportunity to express my thoughts on a book that is a necessary read for intellectuals, economists, but also students. It opens a window of knowledge to understand where we are going, what will happen to the economy of Albania and the whole world in the coming years. Ju faleminderit!
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n ceremonin e promovimit t librit: Drejt nj krize t re Data e publikimit: 05.07.2022 Jam shum i knaqur q mbaj n duar kt libr me vler - t tretin n serin e vllimeve bashkpunime t autorve  t shkruar nga dy profesor t nderuar, miq t mi, Profesor Angjeli dhe Profesor Civici, prmes t cilit ata ndajn me t gjith ne mendime, vlersime, reflektime, pyetje dhe sugjerime mbi krizat e njpasnjshme dhe shumplanshe me t cilat po prballemi. E vlersoj kt libr gjithashtu si nj botim t hershm n nivel global, n reagim t ksaj krize t tret, si e quajn autort. Libri diskuton nj list t gjat shtjesh dhe sfidash me t cilat prballet ekonomia globale dhe ajo shqiptare. Prmes trajtimit t tyre, autort sjellin para lexuesit vrtetsin e situats q po prjetojm, duke ndjekur kronologjin e krizave t njpasnjshme nga trmeti i 26 nntorit 2019 te pandemia, periudha post-covidiane, dhe s fundi kriza e nxitur nga lufta n Ukrain. Diskutimi i kombinuar i ktyre zhvillimeve dhe efektet e tyre mbi faktort e prodhimit dhe aktivitetit ekonomik e financiar global prbn boshtin kryesor t librit. N kt mnyr, ata arrijn t paraqesin nj analiz t plot dhe reale pr ngjarjet dhe zhvillimet gjeopolitike e gjeoekonomike. Libri e jep kt pamje t plot, duke kryqzuar t dhnat dhe analizn e ngjarjeve, me historin dhe sfidat e t ardhmes. Mbi t gjitha, analiza dhe konkluzionet e ktij libri plotsohen nga nj tablo e plot dhe krahasuese e politikave ekonomike, financiare dhe monetare t nevojshme pr t prballuar kto sfida. Kriza e lufts, kriza e siguris ushqimore (ku mimet po rriteshin n mnyr progresive, madje edhe para sulmit rus mbi Ukrain), kriza energjetike dhe e lndve t para, ngadalsimi i prgjithshm i rritjes ekonomike, inflacioni, si dhe s fundmi perspektiva e normave m t larta t interesit, po ndikojn mbi nj peizazh tashm t dmtuar rnd nga dy vite pandemi. Ky libr i dedikohet pikrisht ndjekjes t ksaj situate dit pas dite dhe jav pas jave, duke u munduar ti jap prgjigje pyetjeve: far do t ndodh? Ku po shkojm? far do t ndryshoj?. Periudha q po kalojm sht shoqruar me dyshime, paqartsia mbi kohzgjatjen dhe pasojat e lufts, pasiguri, qasje t ndryshme, pyetje, paradokse dhe dilema, t gjitha kto t ekspozuara dhe t analizuara me aq profesionalizm nga autort n kt libr. Situats globale, autort i vn prball situatn n Shqipri, duke vn n dukje q asnj ekonomi n nivel evropian, por dhe botror, nuk u kursye dhe nuk mund t kursehet nga kjo luft dhe sfidat gjeopolitike q e prcaktojn at. Analiza projektohet n ekonomin shqiptare pr t vlersuar efektet e mundshme negative mbi mimet dhe aktivitetin ekonomik. Sfida aktuale me t ciln po prballet ekonomia shqiptare, si pasoj e rritjes s shpejt t mimeve t energjis, t ushqimeve dhe t produkteve baz n tregjet botrore, ka shtrenjtuar kostot e jetess s familjeve dhe ka rritur kostot e prodhimit t bizneseve. Po ashtu, paqartsia mbi kohzgjatjen dhe pasojat e lufts n Ukrain, ka shtuar pasigurit n tregjet financiare dhe ka krijuar pengesa t reja n zinxhirt e furnizimit. Prandaj, kjo goditje q ka filluar t transmetohet n ekonomin shqiptare krkon nj reagim t shpejt, t efektshm dhe t gjithanshm t autoriteteve publike, n nj situat me shum t panjohura dhe me ndryshime t thella ekonomike, politike dhe sociale. Vrej me knaqsi se sugjerimet e dhna pr politikat ekonomike e financiare, n rastin e Shqipris, jan n prputhje me orientimin aktual t autoriteteve shqiptare. Gjej rastin ti falnderoj autort pr vlersimin q i kan br politiks ton monetare kur shprehen se: Nj ndihm e vyer n kt drejtim vjen edhe nga politika monetare e kujdesshme e Banks s Shqipris, q po zbaton nj politik t matur t rritjes s (norms) s interesave ..., dhe sht kujdesur pr nj stabilitet n kurset e kmbimit t monedhave ndrkombtare. Kjo pengon ndikimin e stagflacionit (t Eurozons) n ekonomin shqiptare. Si konstatohet nga autort, Banka e Shqipris sht n monitorim t vazhdueshm t situats. Fokusi i politikave tona ekonomike e financiare sht i orientuar drejt ruajtjes s stabilitetit t mimeve, si nj parakusht pr stabilitetin financiar t vendit dhe pr rritje t qndrueshme e afatgjat, si dhe n ndihmn ndaj shtresave m n nevoj. Ndodhur prball nj situate me nj rritje t shpejt t inflacionit, jo vetm n Shqipri, por kudo n bot, Banka e Shqipris, n prgjigje t saj, ndrmori nj hap t par drejt normalizimit t politiks monetare n muajin mars, duke rritur me 0.5 pik prqindjeje normn baz t interesit. N t njjtn koh, kemi sinjalizuar vullnetin dhe gatishmrin ton pr t ndrmarr do mas monetare t nevojshme pr t shmangur transmetimin e ksaj goditjeje n pritje pr inflacion t lart n t ardhmen. Komunikimi yn transparent i ka shrbyer qartsimit t publikut mbi kahun e veprimit t politiks monetare dhe ka ndihmuar n kontrollin e pritjeve pr inflacionin n tregjet financiare. N prgjigje t ktyre masave, t duhurat n kohn e duhur, si dhe vazhdimit t monitorimit dhe prshtatshmris s qndrimit t politiks monetare, analizat tona gjykojn se ekonomia shqiptare ka premisa t mjaftueshme pr ti rezistuar goditjes dhe pr t shmangur recesionin. Megjithat, vazhdojm t ndodhemi prball rrethanave t paparashikuara, ku sht e vshtir t prcaktosh kohn kur kjo situat do t marr fund. Pasiguria pasqyrohet dhe n parashikimet tona, megjithat kjo nuk do t thot q t mos bjm asgj. Prkundrazi, Banka e Shqipris po bn m t mirn e mundshme, duke monitoruar n vazhdimsi  ashtu si kan br edhe autort gjat rrugtimit t ktij libri, dit pas dite, jav pas jave - implikimet e prhapjes s krizs n ekonomi, ecurin e tregjeve financiare, si dhe efektivitetin e masave t marra. Banka e Shqipris sht e gatshme t prdor t gjitha instrumentet q ka n dispozicion, pr ti zbutur efektet e ksaj krize jo vetm mbi stabilitetin e mimeve, por edhe mbi stabilitetin financiar dhe aktivitetin ekonomik. Ashtu sikurse theksojn dhe autort Angjeli e Civici, sfidat q na presin jan tepr serioze dhe atyre u duhet kushtuar vmendja e duhur. Ktu nuk e kam fjaln ve pr sfidat aktualet, por dhe pr ato t reja q prvijohen n horizont, si digjitalizimi dhe inovacioni financiar. Ktyre dy faktorve autort, me t drejt, i kan dedikuar nj seksion t tr t librit. Sfida t tjera q shpalosen para nesh jan edhe ngrohja globale, plakja e popullsis apo ndryshimi i modelit t biznesit, si pasoj e tensioneve gjeopolitike. Ju garantoj se Banka e Shqipris i ka prfshir kto sfida n fokusin e politikave afatmesme e afatgjata institucionale, duke kryer studime pr ti kuptuar m mir ato dhe implikimet e tyre n ekonomi e sistemin financiar. Prballimi i tyre krkon nj qasje gjithprfshirse, ku t gjith aktort publik, operatort e sektorit privat, organizatat ndrkombtare, organizatat joqeveritare dhe akademikt, t bashkpunojn, duke marr vendimet e duhura, n kohn e duhur dhe n mnyr sa m t koordinuar. Duke mos dashur t zgjatem m tej, dua ta mbyll fjaln time duke shprehur besimin e plot q, nse secili nga ne do t bj m t mirn, prballimi i ksaj goditjeje do t jet brenda mundsive tona, dhe prej saj do t dalim m t fort dhe m t prgatitur pr goditje t ngjashme n t ardhmen. Ju falnderoj dhe nj her q m dhat mundsin t shpreh mendimet mbi nj libr q prbn nj lexim t domosdoshm pr intelektualt, ekonomistt, por edhe studentt. Ai hap nj dritare njohurie pr t kuptuar se ku po shkojm, far do t ndodh me ekonomin e Shqipris dhe t mbar bots n vitet e ardhshme. Ju faleminderit!

Title: Governor Sejko's remarks at the press conference on monetary policy decision making, 06 July 2022
text: Governor Sejko's remarks at the press conference on monetary policy decision making, 06 July 2022 Publication Date: 06.07.2022 Dear representatives of the media, Today, on 6 July 2022, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Intermediate Monetary Policy Report. The new information obtained in the analysis continues to illustrate the impact that the military conflict in Ukraine has on the world and Albanian economies. Rising prices of products, tightening financial conditions and rising uncertainty have brought a strong rise in inflation and are beginning to curb economic growth rates. The updated analysis and update of our projections suggests that inflation in the country will remain high through 2022. This inflation reflects  to the greatest extent  the direct effects of the supply shock coming from international markets. However, the consequences of this crackdown risk strengthening and prolonging in time, as a result of relatively solid demand for goods and services in the country. In these circumstances, the Supervisory Council deemed that rising inflation is the main risk that threatens the country's sustainable and long-term growth. The Supervisory Council decided to continue the process of normalization of monetary policy. This normalization aims to create monetary conditions suitable for controlling inflation over the medium-term and signals our willingness to respect the price stability objective. I will present today's decision and explain in more detail the reasons that motivated it. *** Inflation increased in April and May, recording 6.2% and 6.7% respectively. These levels were at the top of our expectations. The basis of inflationary pressures has come in widening. Although the inflation dynamics in these two months mainly reflected the rise in food and energy prices, this increase is present in most basket items. In the macroeconomic view, inflationary pressures continue to be fuelled by high inflation rates in world markets, which are at the highest levels of the past four decades, as well as the steady demand for goods and services in the country. According to Instat data, gross domestic product grew by almost 6% in the first quarter of the year. This rate of growth was also at the top of our expectations. Economic growth was dictated by the expansion of private consumption and investment, as well as by increased exports of goods and services. On the other hand, declining public investment and rising imports have been acting in reverse. The expansion in demand for goods and services was reflected in further employment and wage growth in the first quarter, providing an additional factor in the rise in inflation. According to official data, unemployment in the country dropped to 11.3% in the first quarter, while the pace of wage growth in the private sector marked 10.5%. Although wage growth was also influenced by measures taken to formalize the labour market, it suggests that the labour shortage is putting pressure on rising production costs in the country. Returning to the macroeconomic context, the first quarter growth reflected the sound financial balance sheets of the private sector, as well as favorable financing conditions. Financial developments in the country continue to be characterized by controlled risk premiums, abundant liquidity, stable exchange rates and increased credit. Our monetary stimulus has been conveyed to low interest rates for private sector financing. In parallel, the growth of demand for credit and the healthy balance sheets of the banking sector have translated into steady lending growth. Annual growth in credit for the private sector has further strengthened, marking 13.8% in May. This growth was present in both the business segment and individuals, serving both consumer and investment financing and the needs for circulating capital. The economy's performance in the following period remains subject to serious challenges. Rising prices in world markets, tightening financial conditions and the expected slowdown in the eurozone economy, as well as curbs on household purchasing power, will have a direct impact on inflation and economic growth in the country. However, the update of our forecasts according to the base scenario suggests that the Albanian economy will continue to see solid growth in the medium-term horizon. The pace of economic growth will slow down against the one recorded in the first quarter of the year, but it will be enough to preserve the health of the balance sheets of Albanian households and businesses. On the other hand, inflation will remain high in the coming quarters. Baseline scenario projections suggest that the inflation rate will peak not far from the current level in the third quarter of the current year and will come down gradually over the following quarters. This trajectory is expected to bring inflation to target in the first half of 2024. The baseline scenario projections foresee a gradual normalization of monetary policy in the coming period. The speed of normalization will aim to better align the intensity of monetary stimulus with the intensity of medium-term inflationary pressures. The balance of inflation risks remains at the top. In particular, additional strong supply shocks, or the appearance of second-round chain effects, would further strengthen inflationary pressures. Conversely, a more negative economic performance of our trading partners or a quick resolution to the conflict in Ukraine would reduce inflationary pressures. *** Judging on the above, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania assessed that high levels of inflationary pressures are the primary risk to the country's sustainable and long-term growth. For this reason, in respect of our objective of price stability, the Supervisory Council decided: the increase the base interest rate by 0.25 percentage points, from the level of 1.0% to the level of 1.25%; the increase by 0.35 percentage points the interest rate of the one-day loan, from the level of 1.9% to the level of 2.25%; as well as the increase by 0.15 percentage points the interest rate of the one-day deposit, from 0.1% to 0.25% level. In the Council's judgment, the normalization of monetary policy will create more suitable conditions for maintaining price stability and returning inflation to target within the medium-term horizon. At the same time, this normalisation will not undermine the premises of economic growth on this horizon. The Supervisory Council also stresses that materializing the base scenario projections will require the continuation of the normalization cycle of monetary policy in the following quarters. In this scenario, the speed of normalisation will be gradual, but in any case sufficient to respect our medium-term inflation target. The Supervisory Council will carefully monitor the dynamics of inflationary pressures in the coming period. He remains willing to intervene, in time and with the right force, to guarantee price stability in the country.
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 06 korrik 2022 Data e publikimit: 06.07.2022 T nderuar prfaqsues t medias, Sot, n datn 6 korrik 2022, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris mori n shqyrtim dhe miratoi Raportin e Ndrmjetm t Politiks Monetare. Informacioni i ri i marr n analiz vijon t ilustroj ndikimin q konflikti ushtarak n Ukrain ka mbi ekonomin botrore dhe at shqiptare. Rritja e mimeve t produkteve, shtrngimi i kushteve financiare dhe rritja e pasiguris, kan sjell nj rritje t fort t inflacionit dhe kan filluar t frenojn ritmet e rritjes ekonomike. Rifreskimi i analizs dhe prditsimi i projeksioneve tona sugjeron se inflacioni n vend do t vijoj t mbetet i lart gjat vitit 2022. Ky inflacion pasqyron  n masn m t madhe  efektet direkte t goditjes s oferts q vjen nga tregjet ndrkombtare. Megjithat, pasojat e ksaj goditjeje rrezikojn t forcohen dhe t zgjaten n koh, si pasoj e krkess relativisht solide pr mallra e shrbime n vend. N kto rrethana, Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjykoi se rritja e inflacionit sht rreziku kryesor q krcnon rritjen e qndrueshme dhe afatgjat t vendit. Sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi t vijoj procesin e normalizimit t politiks monetare. Ky normalizim synon t krijoj kushte monetare t prshtatshme pr kontrollin e inflacionit n horizontin afatmesm dhe sinjalizon vullnetin ton pr respektimin e objektivit t stabilitetit t mimeve. N vijim, do t prezantoj vendimin e sotm dhe t shpjegoj m n detaje arsyet q e motivuan at. *** Inflacioni shnoi rritje n muajt prill e maj, duke regjistruar respektivisht vlerat 6.2% dhe 6.7%. Kto nivele ishin n kahun e siprm t pritjeve tona. Baza e presioneve inflacioniste ka ardhur n zgjerim. Ndonse dinamika e inflacionit n kta dy muaj pasqyroi kryesisht rritjen e mimeve t ushqimeve dhe t lndve energjetike, kjo rritje sht e pranishme n pjesn m t madhe t artikujve t shports. N kndvshtrimin makroekonomik, presionet inflacioniste vijojn t ushqehen nga normat e larta t inflacionit n tregjet botrore, t cilat jan n nivelet m t larta t katr dekadave t fundit, si dhe nga krkesa e qndrueshme pr mallra e shrbime n vend. Sipas t dhnave t Instat-it, prodhimi i brendshm bruto u rrit me pothuaj 6% n tremujorin e par t vitit. Ky ritm rritjeje ishte  gjithashtu  n kahun e siprm t pritjeve tona. Rritja ekonomike u diktua nga zgjerimi i konsumit dhe investimeve private, si dhe nga rritja e eksporteve t mallrave e shrbimeve. Nga ana tjetr, rnia e investimeve publike dhe rritja e importeve kan vepruar n kahun e kundrt. Zgjerimi i krkess pr mallra e shrbime u pasqyrua n rritje t mtejshme t punsimit e t pagave n tremujorin e par, duke ofruar nj faktor shtes n rritjen e inflacionit. Sipas t dhnave zyrtare, papunsia n vend zbriti n nivelin 11.3% n tremujorin e par, ndrsa ritmi i rritjes s pagave n sektorin privat shnoi vlern 10.5%. Megjithse rritja e pagave u ndikua edhe nga masat e marra pr formalizimin e tregut t puns, ajo sugjeron se mungesa e fuqis puntore po ushtron presione pr rritjen e kostove t prodhimit n vend. Duke ju rikthyer kontekstit makroekonomik, rritja e tremujorit t par pasqyroi bilancet e shndosha financiare t sektorit privat, si dhe kushtet e favorshme t financimit. Zhvillimet financiare n vend vijojn t karakterizohen nga prime t kontrolluara rreziku, likuiditet i bollshm, kurs i qndrueshm kmbimi dhe kredi n rritje. Stimuli yn monetar sht prcjell n norma t ulta interesi pr financimin e sektorit privat. Paralelisht me t, rritja e krkess pr kredi dhe bilancet e shndetshme t sektorit bankar, jan prkthyer n rritje t qndrueshme t kreditimit. Rritja vjetore e kredis pr sektorin privat sht forcuar m tej, duke shnuar vlern 13.8% n muajin maj. Kjo rritje ishte e pranishme si n segmentin e bizneseve dhe n at t individve, duke i shrbyer si financimit t konsumit dhe investimeve ashtu dhe nevojave pr kapital qarkullues. Ecuria e ekonomis n periudhn vijuese mbetet subjekt i sfidave serioze. Rritja e mimeve n tregjet botrore, shtrngimi i kushteve financiare dhe ngadalsimi i pritur i ekonomis n Eurozon, si dhe frenimi i fuqis blerse t familjeve, do t ken nj ndikim me kah t kundrt mbi ecurin e inflacionit dhe t rritjes ekonomike n vend. Megjithat, prditsimi i parashikimeve tona sipas skenarit baz sugjeron se ekonomia shqiptare do t vijoj t shnoj rritje solide n horizontin afatmesm. Ritmi i rritjes ekonomike do t vij n ngadalsim kundrejt atij t shnuar n tremujorin e par t vitit, por ai do t jet i mjaftueshm pr t ruajtur shndetin e bilanceve t familjeve dhe bizneseve shqiptare. Nga ana tjetr, inflacioni do t vijoj t mbetet i lart n tremujort n vijim. Projeksionet e skenarit baz sugjerojn se norma e inflacionit do t kulmoj jo shum larg nivelit aktual n tremujorin e tret t vitit aktual dhe do t vij n rnie graduale gjat tremujorve n vijim. Kjo trajektore pritet ta sjell inflacionin n objektiv n gjysmn e par t vitit 2024. Projeksionet e skenarit baz parashikojn nj normalizim gradual t politiks monetare n periudhn n vijim. Shpejtsia e normalizimit do t synoj nj harmonizim sa m t mir t intensitetit t stimulit monetar me intensitetin e presioneve afatmesme inflacioniste. Balanca e rreziqeve mbi inflacionin vijon t mbetet n kahun e siprm. N veanti, goditjet e forta shtes t oferts apo shfaqja e efekteve zinxhir t raundit t dyt, do t forconin m tej presionet inflacioniste. N t kundrt, nj ecuri m negative ekonomike e partnerve tan tregtar apo nj zgjidhje e shpejt e konfliktit n Ukrain do t reduktonte presionet inflacioniste. *** Duke gjykuar mbi sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris vlersoi se nivelet e larta t e presioneve inflacioniste jan rreziku primar mbi rritjen e qndrueshme dhe afatgjat t vendit. Pr kt arsye, n respektim t objektivit ton t stabilitetit t mimeve, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi: t rris me 0.25 pik prqindjeje normn baz t interesit, nga niveli 1.0% n nivelin 1.25%; t rris me 0.35 pik prqindjeje normn e interesit t kredis njditore, nga niveli 1.9% n nivelin 2.25%; si dhe t rris me 0.15 pik prqindjeje normn e interesit t depozits njditore, nga niveli 0.1% n nivelin 0.25%. N gjykimin e Kshillit, normalizimi i politiks monetare do t krijoj kushte m t prshtatshme pr ruajtjen e stabilitetit t mimeve dhe kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv brenda horizontit afatmesm. N t njjtn koh, ky normalizim nuk do t cenoj premisat e rritjes ekonomike n kt horizont. Po ashtu, Kshilli Mbikqyrs thekson se materializimi i projeksioneve t skenarit baz do t krkoj vijimin e ciklit normalizues t politiks monetare edhe n tremujort n vazhdim. N kt skenar, shpejtsia e normalizimit do t jet graduale, por n do rast e mjaftueshme pr t respektuar objektivin ton afatmesm t inflacionit. Kshilli Mbikqyrs do t monitoroj me kujdes dinamikn e presioneve inflacioniste n periudhn n vijim. Ai mbetet i gatshm t ndrhyj, n kohn dhe me forcn e duhur, pr t garantuar stabilitetin e mimeve n vend.

Title: Questions  Answers to press conference, 6 July 2022
text: Questions  Answers to press conference, 6 July 2022 Publication Date: 06.07.2022 Question: Starting from the inflation increase, you said that it will increase, but how much are the expectations, how far it goes and how will it be translated later, if it will return to the indexation of salaries and pensions for Albanians? Governor: Inflation is the main concern of all the world economies. I also mentioned it in the monetary policy statement. We expect the maximum level of inflation will be reached in the third quarter. Now these are forecasts and I can't say an exact figure of what inflation will be, but what I can say at the moment is that the level of inflation during May was 6.7%. We expect the updated inflation figure for the month of June, which will be released these days by INSTAT. Of course, the numbers are surprising in this period as economies are facing successive crises and serious risks. Inflation will hit consumption, output, all production chains and normally economic growth. That's all I know, but how much and how much it's to be seen. We are being surprised for better and worse asymmetrically. First quarter economic growth was above our expectations. According to the analysis of our Monetary Policy Department, we had an expectation of 4.3% growth in the first quarter, while economic growth resulted in 6%. Of course, the economic growth of the third quarter period that includes the summer season is influenced by tourism and we expect to be positive, but how much we don't know. All of these factors and factors affect inflation. I can't say a precise figure for inflation expectations. It can be between 7 and 8%. This is to be seen, as it can remain at the level below 7%. The speed of monetary policy normalization, i.e. the decision-making of the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania regarding interest rate increases, will depend directly on the pace of inflation. You said you sound optimistic that inflation will come to target in 2024. This is the monetary policy model that gives us this data. Models change. The same thing happened with the previous monetary policy. We were dealing with a deflationary situation and the forecasts of achieving the inflation target have been pushed several times in time not only by us but by all central banks everywhere in the world. These are difficult targets and the economy is very complex. We make predictions and react to manage the macroeconomic situation, but we can't predict 100% accurate figures. Not us, but all central banks everywhere in the world. We are confident in the forecast that we will have economic growth this year, an economic growth rate of between 3 and 4%. It is to be seen, but this is a positive growth in the current situation facing the world and Albanian economies, in the face of strong inflationary pressures that affect consumption, production and so on. We hope that we will have positive effects from the season, which seems to have positive effects, and we will react as I said with our monetary policy as our primary legal objective is to maintain price stability. We analyzed the intermediate monetary policy report, wait for the quarterly report that we will analyze in early August and have a more complete view of the updated macroeconomic indicators. Q: The euro is marking its lowest historical level, at least in our memory. What are the predictions and why is the euro in this state? Governor: The exchange rate has a strengthening that is directly related to seasonal factors. It is therefore influenced by tourism and the increasing numbers of visitor arrivals in the Republic of Albania. There are unusually high numbers compared to last year, compared to a year closed in the period of restrictions from the pandemic. But, of course, the exchange rate during the summer period was also priced, so the leku was strong. This is determined by demand and supply in the market. The exchange rate is still strong. The main factor is tourism, but also the trade balance, while the trade deficit has narrowed by 15%. Exports have increased, both in goods and services. We have a 60% increase in exports of goods and services. And this is another source of euro inflows into the territory of the Republic of Albania. So these inflows of foreign currency, mainly in euros, have maintained the exchange rate of overvalued, in favor of all. What we notice is that exchange rate behaviour is normal. So we do not have a speculative behavior to impose the intervention of the Bank of Albania to adjust the parameters of the exchange rate. Spreads are normal. Commercial banks and economic agents in the market are trading and trading normally under calm conditions. This is the real market that the marketplace imposes. We have a free exchange rate regime and we have exactly defined by law and regulation when the central bank intervenes. We are not in those conditions. This shows that there is economic activity. Exchange currency for national currency. And it's also a positive factor from the perspective of inflationary pressures. It is positively impacted by the inflation rate. A strong exchange rate indicates that the Albanian economy reacts positively to inflation. However, I believe that the summer period will continue with an over-priced course, then after the season passes we can have a repositioning. No one can accurately predict the exchange rate. That's not a little, but safe. Question: What is being discussed and what is being commented on seems to be a lot of questions regarding fiscal amnesty, but my question is what are the expectations for the Bank of Albania and how much will this effect on the economy of the country? Governor: Regarding fiscal amnesty, the Bank of Albania has presented its comments to the Parliament during the annual reporting we have made. We see fiscal amnesty with costs and benefits. The main benefits of fiscal amnesty are of course the injection of liquidity into the economy, the improvement of revenues in the state budget, but the main benefit of fiscal amnesty is the formalism of the economy. As a central bank, we aim at financial education and financial inclusion, i.e. increasing the number of bank accounts and the maximum intred money that is outside the banking system. In this context, in terms of financial inclusion and financial formalization of the Albanian economy, fiscal amnesty can have a positive impact. But on the other hand there are also costs that are associated, in the first place, with avoiding the money penetration of crimes and corruption. This fiscal amnesty should avoid this money maximally, so we should not allow money to be laundered through fiscal amnesty, and in essence the concept of continuous fiscal amnesties should not be created. So, fiscal amnesty must be done once, it must be functional, it must be well thought out, it must be practical, avoid money from crime and corruption and create the premises of formalization of the economy. On the other hand, all public institutions dealing with revenue collection should increase/tighten fiscal rules, so that in parallel with amnesty, there is a minimum tax evasion after the amnesty. If the amnesty were carried out without these measures, to formalize the economy and strengthen fiscal rules, it would not be efficient. This is the principled opinion of the Bank of Albania as the draft law has just come in for consultation. We are studying and will give our opinion in writing regarding the draft law, referring to the concrete details it contains.
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Pyetje  prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp, 6 korrik 2022 Data e publikimit: 06.07.2022 Pyetje: Duke u nisur pikrisht nga rritja e inflacionit ju that q do t rritet, por sa jan pritshmrit, deri ku shkon dhe si do t mund t prkthehet m pas, nse do t rikthehet n indeksim t pagave dhe pensioneve pr shqiptart? Guvernatori: Inflacioni sht shqetsimi kryesor i t gjith ekonomive botrore. E prmenda dhe n deklaratn e Politiks Monetare. Ne presim q niveli maksimal i inflacionit do t arrihet n tremujorin e tret. Tani kto jan parashikime dhe un nuk mund t them nj shifr t sakt sesa do t jet inflacioni, por ajo q mund t them pr momentin sht q niveli i inflacionit gjat muajit maj ishte 6.7%. Ne presim shifrn e prditsuar t inflacionit pr muajin qershor, i cili do t dal kto dit nga INSTAT. Natyrisht q shifrat jan surprizuese n kt periudh pasi ekonomit jan duke u prballur me kriza t njpasnjshme dhe me rreziqe serioze. Inflacioni do t godas konsumin, prodhimin, gjith zinxhirt e prodhimit dhe normalisht m pas dhe rritjen ekonomike. Kjo sht e ditur, por sa dhe si kjo sht pr tu par. Ne po surprizohemi pr mir dhe pr keq n mnyr asimetrike. Rritja ekonomike e tremujorit t par ishte mbi pritjet tona. Sipas analizave t Departamentit ton t Politiks Monetare ne kishim nj pritshmri pr rritje 4.3% n tremujorin e par, ndrkoh q rezultoi nj rritje ekonomike prej 6%. Sigurisht q rritja ekonomike e periudhs s tremujorit t tret q prfshin dhe sezonin e vers ndikohet nga turizmi dhe presim t jet pozitive, por sa nuk e dim. T gjith kta element dhe faktor ndikojn n inflacion. Nuk mund t them nj shifr t sakt pr pritshmrin e inflacionit. Mund t luhatet midis 7 dhe 8%. Kjo sht pr tu par, pasi mund t mbetet dhe n nivelin posht 7%. Shpejtsia e normalizimit t politiks monetare, pra vendimmarrja e Kshillit Mbikqyrs t Banks s Shqipris n drejtim t rritjes s norms s interesit, do t varet n mnyr t drejtprdrejt nga ritmi i rritjes s inflacionit. Ju that q ju duket optimiste q inflacioni do t vij n objektiv n vitin 2024. Realisht ky sht parashikimi i modelit t politiks monetare q na jep kto t dhna. Modelet ndryshojn. E njjta gj ka ndodhur dhe me politikn monetare lehtsuese t mparshme. Kishim t bnim me nj situat deflacioniste dhe parashikimet e arritjes s objektivit t inflacionit jan shtyr disa her n koh jo vetm nga ne por nga t gjitha bankat qendrore kudo n bot. Kto jan objektiva t vshtir dhe ekonomia sht shum komplekse. Ne bjm parashikime dhe reagojm pr t menaxhuar situatn makroekonomike, por nuk mund t parashikojm dot shifra t sakta 100%. Jo ne, por t gjith bankat qendrore kudo n bot. Gjithsesi jemi t sigurt n parashikimin q do t kemi nj rritje ekonomike kt vit, nj rritjeekonomike midis 3 dhe 4%. sht pr tu par, por gjithsesi kjo sht nj rritje pozitive n situatn aktuale q po prballen ekonomit botrore dhe ajo shqiptare, prball presioneve t forta inflacioniste q ndikojn konsumin, prodhimin e kshtu me radh. Shpresojm q do t kemi efekte pozitive nga sezoni, q mesa duket ka efekte pozitive, dhe do t reagojm sikurse thash me politikn ton monetare pasi dhe objektivi jon primar ligjor sht ruajtja e stabilitetit t mimeve. Ne sot analizuam raportin e ndrmjetm t politiks monetare, t presim raportin tremujor t cilin do e analizojm n fillim t gushtit dhe do t kemi nj pamje m t plot t treguesve t prditsuar makroekonomik. Pyetje: Euro po shnon nivelin m t ult historik, t paktn n memorien ton. Cilat jan parashikimet dhe pse euro sht n kt gjendje aktualisht? Guvernatori: Kursi i kmbimit ka nj forcim q sht i lidhur drejtprdrejt me faktor sezonal. Pra ndikohet nga turizmi dhe shifrat n rritje t hyrjeve t vizitorve n Republikn e Shqipris. Ka shifra jashtzakonisht t larta krahasuar me vitin e kaluar, krahasuar me nj vit t mbyllur n periudhn e kufizimeve nga pandemia. Por, natyrisht, kursi i kmbimit gjat periudhs s vers ka qen i mbimuar, pra leku ka qen i fort. Kjo prcaktohet nga krkesa dhe oferta n treg. Prandaj dhe kursi i kmbimit mbetet i fort. Faktori kryesor sht turizmi, por edhe bilanci tregtar, ndrsa deficiti tregtar ka ardhur n ngushtim me 15%. Eksportet jan rritur, si ato t mallrave ashtu edhe t shrbimeve. Kemi nj rritje me 60% t eksporteve t mallrave dhe shrbimeve. Dhe ky sht nj burim tjetr i hyrjeve t eurove n territorin e Republiks s Shqipris. Pra, kto flukse hyrse t valuts s huaj, kryesisht n euro, kan mbajtur kursin e kmbimit t mbimuar, n favor t lekut. Ajo q ne vm re sht q sjellja e kursit t kmbimit sht normale. Pra nuk kemi nj sjellje spekulative q t imponoj ndrhyrjen e Banks s Shqipris pr t rregulluar parametrat e kursit t kmbimit. Spread-et jan normal. Bankat tregtare dhe agjentt ekonomik n treg po kmbejn dhe tregtojn normalisht n kushte t qeta. Ky sht kursi real q imponon tregu. Ne kemi nj regjim t lir t kursit t kmbimit dhe kemi t prcaktuar saktsisht me ligj dhe me rregullore se kur ndrhyn banka qendrore. Nuk jemi fare n kto kushte. Kjo tregon q ka aktivitet ekonomik. Kmbehet valut me monedhn kombtare. Dhe njkohsisht sht nj faktor pozitiv nga kndvshtrimi i presioneve inflacioniste. Pra ndikon pozitivisht n drejtim t norms s inflacionit. Nj kurs i fort kmbimi tregon q ekonomia shqiptare reagon pozitivisht ndaj inflacionit. Gjithsesi, besoj se periudha e vers do t vazhdoj me nj kurs t mbimuar, pastaj pas kalimit t sezonit mund t kemi nj ripozicionim. Por, askush nuk e parashikon dot sakt ecurin e kursit t kmbimit. Kjo sht jo pak, por e sigurt. Pyetje: Nga far po diskutohet dhe far po komentohet duket se ka shum pikpyetje lidhur me amnistin fiskale, por pyetja ime ka t bj se cilat jan pritshmrit pr Bankn e Shqipris dhe sa do t ket kjo efekt n ekonomin e vendit? Guvernatori: Lidhur me amnistin fiskale, Banka e Shqipris i ka paraqitur komentet e saj n Kuvend, gjat raportimit vjetor q kemi br. Ne e shohim amnistin fiskale me kosto dhe prfitime. Prfitimet kryesore t amnistis fiskale jan sigurisht injektimi i likuiditetit n ekonomi, prmirsimi i t ardhurave n buxhetin e shtetit, por prfitimi kryesor i amnistis fiskale sht formalizmi i ekonomis. Si bank qendrore, ne kemi objektiv edukimin financiar si dhe prfshirjen financiare, pra rritjen e numrit t llogarive bankare dhe futjen maksimalisht t paras q ndodhet jasht sistemit bankar, n sistemin bankar. N kt kuadr, n drejtim t prfshirjes financiare dhe formalizimit financiar t ekonomis shqiptare, natyrisht q amnistia fiskale mund t ket impakt pozitiv. Por, nga ana tjetr ka edhe kosto t cilat lidhen, n radh t par, me shmangien e deprtimit t parave t krimeve dhe korrupsionit. Kjo amnisti fiskale duhet t shmang maksimalisht kto para, pra nuk duhet t lejojm q t pastrohen parat nprmjet amnistis fiskale, dhe n esenc sduhet t krijohet koncepti i amnistive t vazhdueshme fiskale. Pra, amnistia fiskale duhet t bhet njher, duhet t jet funksionale, t jet e mirmenduar, t jet praktike, t shmang parat e krimit e korrupsionit dhe t krijoj premisat e formalizimit t ekonomis. Nga ana tjetr, t gjitha institucionet publike q merren me mbledhjen e t ardhurave duhet t rrisin/shtrngojn rregullat fiskale, q paralelisht me amnistin, ose pas kryerjes s amnistis t ket nj minimum evazioni fiskal. Nse amnistia do t kryhej pa ndrmarr kto masa, pr formalizimin e ekonomis dhe pr forcimin e rregullave fiskale, nuk do t ishte eficiente. Ky sht opinioni parimor q ka Banka e Shqipris pasi projektligji sapo ka ardhur pr konsultim. Ne jemi duke e studiuar dhe do t japim opinionin ton me shkrim, lidhur me projektligjin, duke iu referuar edhe detajeve konkrete q ai prmban.

Title: Governor Sejko's remarks at the press conference on monetary policy decision making, 03 August 2022
text: Governor Sejko's remarks at the press conference on monetary policy decision making, 03 August 2022 Date of publication: 03.08.2022 Dear representatives of the media, Today, on 3 August 2022, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Quarterly Monetary Policy Report. The new information taken into the analysis suggests that inflationary pressures are broader and stronger than our previous estimates. This judgment reflects the rapid price growth in world markets, as well as high and stable demand for goods and services in the country. In these circumstances, the Supervisory Council decided to continue the process of normalization of monetary policy. This normalisation is necessary for controlling inflationary pressures and returning inflation to target within a medium-term time horizon. In this way, monetary policy will help maintain internal monetary and financial stability and create suitable conditions for sustainable and long-term growth of the Albanian economy. [I will explain in more detail today's decision and the reasons that motivated it.] Consumer prices recorded further growth in the second quarter. Inflation has been rising in the past year, peaking at 7.4% in June. The basis of inflationary pressures has come in widening. The rise in inflation largely reflected higher prices of food, oil and transport items. However, price increases were present in a broad product category, illustrating the follow-up of supply shocks in the prices of other basket items. The inflation trend has, to the greatest extent, reflected the impact of foreign supply shocks. However, their follow-up in the Albanian economy has been favored by relatively high demand for goods and services, and by the upward revision of inflation expectations. Inflation performance in the future will depend on the dynamics and interplay of these factors. The external environment remains challenging. The conflict in Ukraine and sanctions imposed on Russia have brought a rapid rise in prices to world markets and are beginning to reflect slowing economic growth rates. In parallel, financial conditions have been tightening as central banks have raised interest rates and uncertainty among economic and financial agents remains high. Projections for the eurozone suggest inflation will peak in the second half of the current year, but the balance of risks lies in the upper hand. In addition to these developments, the Albanian economy has had a relatively solid performance in the first half of the year. The volume of economic activity increased by 6% in the first quarter of the year and indirect indicators suggest further growth in the second quarter. This performance reflects the sound financial balances of business and households, the operational flexibility of the private sector, and the resistance of the Albanian financial system to shocks. Economic growth is dictated by the expansion of household consumption, private sector investment, and exports of goods and services. On the other hand, rising prices in international markets have brought the import bill up, while fiscal policy has had a consolidating nature. The expansion of aggregate demand is supported by favorable financing conditions in place. The stimulus course of monetary policy has created a low-rate financial environment interest, abundant liquidity and controlled risk prime. Domestic demand for credit continues to remain high, while the banking sector continues to offer favorable lending terms and conditions. Consequently, the growth of credit for the private sector registered 13.8% in June, maintaining the positive trend shown over the past year. At the same time, the quality of the loan portfolio continues to remain healthy, as illustrated by the non-performing loans indicator which remains at the lowest levels of the last decade. Parallel to these developments, the exchange rate of lek against the euro has shown strengthening tendencies over the past two months. This strengthening reflects the high foreign currency inflows in response to the good tourist season and helps to soften some of the blow to the offer coming from the foreign market. The expansion of demand has brought about a better exploitation of the productive potential. In particular, the labor market continues to be characterized by increased employment, falling unemployment and rapid growth in wages in the private sector, while businesses report a higher use of productive capacities. These developments provide encouraging signals for the continued economic growth in the coming period. Baseline scenario projections suggest economic growth will remain in positive territory over the medium-term horizon. The expansion of economic activity will continue to be supported by rising domestic and foreign demand and to be fueled by healthy economic balance sheets, employment growth, wages and credit. Inflation is forecast to stay at high levels through 2022 and reduce further. Absent new shocks, stabilising prices abroad is expected to ease pressures on inflation in the country. At the same time, normalising our monetary policy will create more appropriate financial conditions for sustained growth of the economy and reducing inflation. Inflation is forecast to return to our 3% target in the first half of 2024. These projections remain subject to high uncertainty. In particular, the risks to inflation remain on the upper side, and those for economic growth in the lower side. *** Judging above, the Bank of Albania's Supervisory Council continues to assess that high levels of inflationary pressures are the primary risk to the country's sustainable and long-term growth. For this reason, in respect of the objective of price stability, the Supervisory Council decided: the Increase by 0. 5 percentage points at the base interest rate, from 1.25% to 1.75%; the increase the interest rate of the one-day loan by 0.5 percentage points, from the level of 2.25% to the level of 2.75%; the increase the interest rate of one day deposit by 0.5 percentage points, from the level of 0.25% to the level of 0.75%. In the Council's judgment, the normalization of monetary policy will create more suitable conditions for maintaining price stability and returning inflation to target within the medium-term horizon. At the same time, monetary policy will remain accommodative throughout the normalization process and will not undermine the premises of economic growth. The Supervisory Council stresses that materializing the base scenario projections will require the continuation of the normalization cycle of monetary policy in the following quarters. In this scenario, the speed of normalisation will be gradual, but in any case sufficient to respect our medium-term inflation target. The Supervisory Council will carefully monitor the dynamics of inflationary pressures in the coming period. He remains willing to intervene in the time and with the right force to guarantee price stability in the country.
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 03 gusht 2022 Data e publikimit: 03.08.2022 T nderuar prfaqsues t medias, Sot, n datn 3 gusht 2022, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris mori n shqyrtim dhe miratoi Raportin Tremujor t Politiks Monetare. Informacioni i ri i marr n analiz sugjeron se presionet inflacioniste jan m t gjera dhe m t forta se vlersimet tona t mparshme. Ky gjykim pasqyron rritjen e shpejt t mimeve n tregjet botrore, si dhe krkesn e lart e t qndrueshme pr mallra e shrbime n vend. N kto rrethana, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi t vijoj procesin e normalizimit t politiks monetare. Ky normalizim sht i nevojshm pr kontrollin e presioneve inflacioniste dhe kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv brenda nj horizonti kohor afatmesm. N kt mnyr, politika monetare do t ndihmoj ruajtjen e stabilitetit t brendshm monetar dhe financiar dhe do t krijoj kushte t prshtatshme pr rritjen e qndrueshme dhe afatgjat t ekonomis shqiptare. [ N vijim, do t sqaroj m n detaje vendimin e sotm dhe arsyet q e motivuan. ] mimet e konsumit shnuan rritje t mtejshme n tremujorin e dyt. Inflacioni shnoi rritje progresive gjat ksaj periudhe, duke kulmuar n nivelin 7.4% n muajin qershor. Baza e presioneve inflacioniste ka ardhur n zgjerim. Rritja e inflacionit pasqyroi kryesisht mimet m t larta t artikujve ushqimor, t nafts dhe t transportit. Megjithat, rritja e mimeve ishte e pranishme n nj kategori t gjer produktesh, duke ilustruar prcjelljen e goditjeve t oferts edhe n mimet e artikujve t tjer t shports. Trendi rrits i inflacionit ka pasqyruar, n masn m t madhe, ndikimin e goditjeve t oferts s huaj. Megjithat, prcjellja e tyre n ekonomin shqiptare sht favorizuar nga krkesa relativisht e lart pr mallra e shrbime, dhe nga rishikimi pr lart i pritjeve pr inflacionin. Ecuria e inflacionit n t ardhmen do t varet nga dinamikat dhe ndrveprimi i ktyre faktorve. Ambienti i jashtm vazhdon t mbetet sfidues. Konflikti n Ukrain dhe sanksionet e vendosura ndaj Rusis kan sjell nj rritje t shpejt t mimeve n tregjet botrore dhe kan filluar t pasqyrohen n ngadalsim t ritmeve t rritjes ekonomike. Paralelisht me t, kushtet financiare kan ardhur n shtrngim teksa bankat qendrore kan rritur normat baz t interesit dhe pasiguria e agjentve ekonomik dhe financiar mbetet e lart. Projeksionet pr Eurozonn sugjerojn se inflacioni do t kulmoj n gjysmn e dyt t vitit aktual, por balanca e rreziqeve qndron n kahun e siprm. Prkundrejt ktyre zhvillimeve, ekonomia shqiptare ka pasur nj ecuri relativisht solide n gjysmn e par t vitit. Vllimi i aktivitetit ekonomik u rrit me 6% n tremujorin e par t vitit dhe treguesit indirekt sugjerojn rritje t mtejshme n tremujorin e dyt. Kjo ecuri pasqyron bilancet e shndosha financiare t biznesit dhe familjeve, fleksibilitetin operacional t sektorit privat, si dhe rezistencn e sistemit financiar shqiptar ndaj goditjeve. Rritja ekonomike sht diktuar nga zgjerimi i konsumit familjar, i investimeve t sektorit privat, si dhe i eksportit t mallrave dhe shrbimeve. Nga ana tjetr, rritja e mimeve n tregjet ndrkombtare ka sjell rritjen e faturs s importeve, ndrsa politika fiskale ka pasur nj natyr konsoliduese. Zgjerimi i krkess agregate sht mbshtetur nga kushtet e favorshme t financimit n vend. Kursi stimulues i politiks monetare ka krijuar nj ambient financiar me norma t ulta interesi, likuiditet t bollshm dhe prime t kontrolluara rreziku. Krkesa e brendshme pr kredi vijon t mbetet e lart, ndrsa sektori bankar vijon t ofroj kushte e terma t favorshm kreditimi. Pr rrjedhoj, rritja e kredis pr sektorin privat regjistroi vlern 13.8% n muajin qershor, duke ruajtur trendin pozitiv t shfaqur gjat vitit t shkuar. N t njjtn koh, cilsia e portofolit t kredis vijon t mbetet e shndetshme, sikundr ilustrohet edhe nga treguesi i kredive me probleme i cili mbetet n nivelet m t ulta t dekads s fundit. Paralelisht me kto zhvillime, kursi i kmbimit t lekut ndaj euros ka shfaqur tendenca forcimi gjat dy muajve t fundit. Ky forcim pasqyron hyrjet e larta valutore n prgjigje t sezonit t mir turistik dhe ndihmon n zbutjen e nj pjese t goditjes s oferts q vjen nga tregu i huaj. Zgjerimi i krkess ka sjell nj shfrytzim m t mir t potencialit prodhues. N veanti, tregu i puns vijon t karakterizohet nga rritje e punsimit, rnie e papunsis dhe rritje e shpejt e pagave n sektorin privat, ndrsa bizneset raportojn nj prdorim m t lart t kapaciteteve prodhuese. Kto zhvillime japin sinjale inkurajuese pr vijimin e rritjes ekonomike n periudhn n vazhdim. Projeksionet e skenarit baz sugjerojn se rritja ekonomike do t mbetet n territor pozitiv gjat horizontit afatmesm. Zgjerimi i aktivitetit ekonomik do t vijoj t mbshtetet nga rritja e krkess s brendshme e t huaj dhe t ushqehet nga bilancet e shndetshme financiare t ekonomis, rritja e punsimit, e pagave dhe e kredis. Inflacioni parashikohet t qndroj n nivele t larta gjat vitit 2022 dhe t reduktohet m tej. N munges t goditjeve t reja, stabilizimi i mimeve jasht pritet t lehtsoj presionet mbi inflacionin n vend. N t njjtn koh, normalizimi i politiks son monetare do t krijoj kushte m t prshtatshme financiare pr rritjen e qndrueshme t ekonomis dhe reduktimin e inflacionit. Inflacioni parashikohet t kthehet n objektivin ton 3% n gjysmn e par t vitit 2024. Kto projeksione vijojn t mbeten subjekt i pasigurive t larta. N veanti, rreziqet mbi inflacionin qndrojn n kahun e siprm, kurse ato pr rritjen ekonomike n kahun e poshtm. *** Duke gjykuar mbi sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris vazhdon t vlersoj se nivelet e larta t presioneve inflacioniste jan rreziku primar mbi rritjen e qndrueshme dhe afatgjat t vendit. Pr kt arsye, n respektim t objektivit t stabilitetit t mimeve, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi: t rris me 0. 5 pik prqindjeje normn baz t interesit, nga niveli 1.25% n nivelin 1.75%; t rris me 0.5 pik prqindjeje normn e interesit t kredis njditore, nga niveli 2.25% n nivelin 2.75%; t rris me 0.5 pik prqindjeje normn e interesit t depozits njditore, nga niveli 0.25% n nivelin 0.75%. N gjykimin e Kshillit, normalizimi i politiks monetare do t krijoj kushte m t prshtatshme pr ruajtjen e stabilitetit t mimeve dhe kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv brenda horizontit afatmesm. N t njjtn koh, politika monetare do t vijoj t mbetet n kahun akomodues gjat gjith procesit t normalizimit dhe nuk do t cenoj premisat e rritjes ekonomike. Kshilli Mbikqyrs thekson se materializimi i projeksioneve t skenarit baz do t krkoj vijimin e ciklit normalizues t politiks monetare edhe n tremujort n vazhdim. N kt skenar, shpejtsia e normalizimit do t jet graduale, por n do rast e mjaftueshme pr t respektuar objektivin ton afatmesm t inflacionit. Kshilli Mbikqyrs do t monitoroj me kujdes dinamikn e presioneve inflacioniste n periudhn n vijim. Ai mbetet i gatshm t ndrhyj n kohn dhe me forcn e duhur pr t garantuar stabilitetin e mimeve n vend.

Title: Remarks of Governor Sejko at the press conference on monetary policy decision making, 05 October 2022
text: Remarks of Governor Sejko at the press conference on monetary policy decision making, 05 October 2022 Date of publication: 05.10.2022 Dear representatives of the media, Today, on 5 October 2022, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Intermediate Monetary Policy Report. The new information obtained in the analysis suggests that supply shocks and rising uncertainty in world markets are being transmitted to rising inflation and slowing pace of economic growth in the country. In particular, foreign inflationary pressures are estimated to be stronger and more stable than our previous estimates. Also, the growing demand for goods and services in the country, the dynamic labor market and expectations for high inflation rates are facilitating their spread in the Albanian economy. Based on the above, the Supervisory Council assessed that the rapid rise in prices remains the main risk to the country's monetary and financial stability and to its sustainable and long-term growth. In these circumstances, the Council decided to continue normalising the monetary policy stance. This normalisation aims to create the necessary conditions for the gradual return of inflation to the target, within a reasonable time horizon and at lower costs for domestic economic activity. I will explain the monetary policy decision and explain in more detail its reasons. Inflation rose further in the months of July and August, marking respective values of 7.5% and 8.0%. The main contribution to inflation continues to come from the rapid rise in food and oil prices. However, the trend of price increases is becoming present in an ever-wide range of goods and services. The strengthening and expansion of inflationary pressures reflects both accelerated price growth in the global market and intensifying domestic pressures. The war in Ukraine exacerbated existing global supply problems and caused new problems, mainly in the markets of basic foods, energy and basic materials. As a result, prices of these products rose quickly in global markets and our country. In parallel, the growth of aggregate demand in the country has supported the expansion of employment and wages and added to internal inflationary pressures. The Albanian economy continues to grow in the first half of 2022, although its pace slowed significantly in the second quarter. According to Instat data, economic growth fell to 2.2%, down from 6.5% in the first quarter. The reduction in growth reflected, to the greatest extent, the rapid slowdown in activity in the construction and industry sectors. However, signs of slowdown were present in other sectors of the economy as well. In the macroeconomics perspective, this slowdown reflected both the action of the base effect and the negative effect of high costs and increased uncertainty. These factors led to the slowing of the growth of exports and private sector investment, the shrinking of public sector spending, as well as the rapid growth of imports of goods and services. In the mean time, household consumption continues to record steady growth rates. In a longer-term view, the increasing trend of demand for goods and services has brought an increasingly complete exploitation of production capacities in the country. This trend is particularly present in the labour market, where the unemployment rate dropped to the historical minimum of 11.1% in the second quarter. Rising labor demand and a lack of labor are putting increasing pressures on wages in the private sector. This performance provides support for albanian household incomes in the coming period, but is also a premise for a longer stability in time of inflationary pressures. The domestic monetary environment continues to remain stimulating, while the Albanian financial markets continue to be calm. The rise in the base interest rate is being transmitted to the financial market, but interest rates are still stimulating and near historic lows. On the other hand, the lek exchange rate remains in strong positions against the European currency, helping to absorb some of the hit of the supply coming from the foreign market.
