Bank credit continues to finance consumption and investments, reflecting high demand, still favorable financing conditions, and the good health of the banking sector. Credit for the private sector increased by 13.7% in August, following the trend of recent years. Its growth has continues to be present in both businesses and individuals, for investment and spending purposes, both in the lek and in the currency. In addition to the upsizing trend of credit and diversification, the quality of the portfolio remains good as illustrated by the index of non-rated loans, which remains at low levels. The update to forecasts reconfirms our previous estimates that inflation will return to target in the first half of 2024. In terms of time dynamics, inflation is expected to remain high in the ongoing two quarters and start declining in the subsequent period. This forecast factors expectations for the progressive easement of inflationary pressures in the foreign environment. It also requires the normalization of the monetary policy stance, to ensure control of the effects of the second round on the domestic economy. On the other hand, the updated forecasts suggest that the Albanian economy will continue to grow in the medium-term, although the pace of growth will be somewhat lower. The deteriorating economic outlook in Europe, the negative impact that high prices have on household purchasing power, and the reduction in fiscal stimulus are expected to slow down household consumption and investment of the following businesses. On the other hand, high deposits, employment and wage growth, rising bank credit and social resistance packages are expected to provide support for private sector balance sheets. Available information suggests that the balance of risks on inflation lies at the top, while the balance of risks on economic growth lies in the lower downside. In particular, the war in Ukraine is the main source of uncertainty and the escalation of the conflict could lead to higher commodity prices, disruptions to supply chains and lower or even negative regional and European economic growth. *** Judging the above, the Supervisory Board decided: the increase the base interest rate by 0.5 percentage point, bringing it to the level of 2.25%; the increase the interest rate of the one-day deposit by 0.5 percentage point, bringing it to the level of 1.25%; the Increase the interest rate of the one-day loan by 0.5 percentage point, bringing it to the level of 3.25. In the Council's judgment, the gradual normalization of the monetary policy stance, from its highly stimulating position in the current to a more neutral position, is a necessary measure for respecting our price inflation target. In this view, this normalization serves the overall economic and financial stability of the country, sustainable and long-term growth and improvement of social welfare. Consistent with past communications and our medium-term forecasts, the Supervisory Council stresses that the normalization cycle of monetary policy will continue in the following quarters. In any case, the speed of normalization will be consistent with new data and sufficient to respect our medium-term inflation target. The Supervisory Council shall carefully monitor the situation to assess the implications for inflation performance in a timely way and to identify the measures necessary for its effective administration.
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 05 tetor 2022 Data e publikimit: 05.10.2022 T nderuar prfaqsues t medias, Sot, n datn 5 tetor 2022, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris mori n shqyrtim dhe miratoi Raportin e Ndrmjetm t Politiks Monetare. Informacioni i ri i marr n analiz sugjeron se goditjet e oferts dhe rritja e pasiguris n tregjet botrore, po transmetohen n rritje t inflacionit dhe ngadalsim t ritmit t rritjes ekonomike n vend. N veanti, presionet e huaja inflacioniste vlersohen t jen m t forta e m t qndrueshme se vlersimet tona t mparshme. Po ashtu, krkesa n rritje pr mallra e shrbime n vend, tregu dinamik i puns dhe pritjet pr norma t larta inflacioni, po lehtsojn prhapjen e tyre n ekonomin shqiptare. Bazuar n sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se rritja e shpejt e mimeve mbetet rreziku kryesor pr stabilitetin monetar e financiar t vendit dhe pr rritjen e qndrueshme e afatgjat t tij. N kto rrethana, Kshilli vendosi t vijoj normalizimin e qndrimit t politiks monetare. Ky normalizim synon t krijoj kushtet e nevojshme pr kthimin gradual t inflacionit n objektiv, brenda nj horizonti kohor t arsyeshm dhe me kosto sa m t ulta pr aktivitetin e brendshm ekonomik. N vijim, do t'ju njoh me vendimin e politiks monetare dhe do tju shpjegoj m n detaje arsyet e tij. Inflacioni u rrit m tej n muajt korrik e gusht, duke shnuar vlerat respektive prej 7.5% dhe 8.0%. Kontributi kryesor n inflacion vijon t vij nga rritja e shpejt e mimeve t ushqimeve dhe t nafts. Megjithat, tendenca e rritjes s mimeve po bhet prezente n nj gam gjithnj e m t gjer mallrash dhe shrbimesh. Forcimi dhe zgjerimi i presioneve inflacioniste pasqyron si rritjen e prshpejtuar t mimeve n tregun global ashtu edhe intensifikimin e presioneve t brendshme. Lufta n Ukrain prkeqsoi problemet ekzistuese t oferts globale dhe shkaktoi probleme t reja, kryesisht n tregjet e ushqimeve baz, t lndve energjetike dhe t lndve baz. Si rezultat, mimet e ktyre produkteve u rritn shpejt n tregjet globale dhe n vendin ton. Paralelisht me to, rritja e krkess agregate n vend ka mbshtetur zgjerimin e punsimit dhe t pagave dhe ka shtuar presionet e brendshme inflacioniste. Ekonomia shqiptare vijoi rritjen n gjashtmujorin e par t vitit 2022, ndonse ritmet e saj u ngadalsuan ndjeshm n tremujorin e dyt. Sipas t dhnave t Instat-it, rritja ekonomike zbriti n nivelin 2.2%, nga 6.5% n tremujorin e par. Reduktimi i rritjes pasqyroi, n masn m t madhe, ngadalsimin e shpejt t aktivitetit n sektorin e ndrtimit dhe t industris. Megjithat, shenja t ngadalsimit ishin t pranishme edhe n sektor t tjer t ekonomis. N kndvshtrimin makroekonomik, ky ngadalsim pasqyroi si veprimin e efektit baz, ashtu dhe efektin negativ t kostove t larta dhe t rritjes s pasiguris. Kta faktor solln frenimin e ritmit t rritjes s eksporteve dhe t investimeve t sektorit privat, tkurrjen e shpenzimeve t sektorit publik, si dhe rritjen e shpejt t importit t mallrave e shrbimeve. Prkundrejt tyre, konsumi familjar vijoi t shnoj norma t qndrueshme rritjeje. N nj kndvshtrim m afatgjat, trendi rrits i krkess pr mallra e shrbime ka sjell nj shfrytzim gjithnj e m t plot t kapaciteteve prodhuese n vend. Kjo tendenc sht veanrisht prezente n tregun e puns, ku shkalla e papunsis zbriti n minimumin historik prej 11.1% n tremujorin e dyt. Rritja e krkess pr pun dhe mungesa e fuqis puntore po ushtrojn presione rritse mbi pagat n sektorin privat. Kjo ecuri siguron mbshtetje pr t ardhurat e familjeve shqiptare n periudhn n vazhdim, por sht edhe premis pr nj qndrueshmri m t gjat n koh t presioneve inflacioniste. Ambienti i brendshm monetar vijon t mbetet stimulues, ndrsa tregjet financiare shqiptare vijojn t jen t qeta. Rritja e norms baz t interesit po transmetohet n tregun financiar, por normat e interesit jan ende stimuluese dhe pran niveleve t ulta historike. Nga ana tjetr, kursi i kmbimit t lekut mbetet n pozita t forta ndaj monedhs evropiane, duke ndihmuar absorbimin e nj pjese t goditjes s oferts q vjen nga tregu i huaj. Kredia bankare ka vijuar t financoj konsumin dhe investimet, n reflektim t krkess s lart, t kushteve ende t favorshme t financimit, si dhe t shndetit t mir t sektorit bankar. Kredia pr sektorin privat u rrit me 13.7% n muajin gusht, duke vijuar trendin e viteve t fundit. Rritja e saj ka vijuar t jet e pranishme si tek bizneset dhe tek individt, pr qllime investime dhe shpenzimi, si n monedhn lek ashtu edhe n valut. Krahas trendit rrits t kredis dhe diversifikimit t saj, cilsia e portofolit mbetet e mir sikurse ilustrohet nga treguesi i kredive me probleme, i cili mbetet n nivele t ulta. Prditsimi i parashikimeve rikonfirmon vlersimet tona t mparshme se inflacioni do t kthehet n objektiv n gjysmn e par t vitit 2024. N terma t dinamiks kohore, inflacioni pritet t mbetet i lart n dy tremujort n vazhdim dhe t nis rnien n periudhn pasuese. Ky parashikim faktorizon pritjet pr zbutjen progresive t presioneve inflacioniste n ambientin e huaj. Gjithashtu, ai krkon normalizimin e qndrimit t politiks monetare, pr t siguruar kontrollin e efekteve t raundit t dyt n ekonomin vendase. Nga ana tjetr, prditsimi i parashikimeve sugjeron se ekonomia shqiptare do t vijoj t rritet n horizontin afatmesm, ndonse ritmi i rritjes do t jet disi m i ult. Prkeqsimi i perspektivs ekonomike n Evrop, ndikimi negativ q mimet e larta kan n fuqin blerse t familjeve, si dhe reduktimi i stimulit fiskal, pritet t ngadalsojn konsumin familjar dhe investimet e bizneseve n vijim. Nga ana tjetr, niveli i lart i depozitave, rritja e punsimit dhe e pagave, rritja e kredis bankare dhe paketat e rezistencs sociale pritet t sigurojn mbshtetje pr bilancet e sektorit privat. Informacioni i disponuar sugjeron se balanca e rreziqeve mbi inflacionin qndron n kahun e siprm, ndrsa balanca e rreziqeve mbi rritjen ekonomike qndron n kahun e poshtm. N veanti, lufta n Ukrain sht burim kryesor i pasiguris dhe prshkallzimi i konfliktit mund t oj n mime m t larta t mallrave, ndrprerje t zinxhirve t furnizimit dhe rritje m t ult ose edhe negative ekonomike rajonale dhe evropiane. *** Duke gjykuar mbi sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi: t rris me 0.5 pik prqindje normn baz t interesit, duke e uar at n nivelin 2.25%; t rris me 0.5 pik prqindje normn e interesit t depozits njditore, duke e uar at n nivelin 1.25%; t rris me 0.5 pik prqindje normn e interesit t kredis njditore, duke e uar at n nivelin 3.25. N gjykimin e Kshillit, normalizimi gradual i qndrimit t politiks monetare, nga pozicioni tejet stimulues i saj n trajtat aktuale n nj pozicion m neutral, sht nj mas e domosdoshme pr respektimin e objektivit ton t inflacionit t mimeve. N kt kndvshtrim, ky normalizim i shrben stabilitetit t prgjithshm ekonomik dhe financiar t vendit, rritjes s qndrueshme dhe afatgjat dhe prmirsimit t mirqenies sociale. N konsistenc me komunikimet e kaluara dhe me parashikimet tona afatmesme, Kshilli Mbikqyrs thekson se cikli normalizues i politiks monetare do t vijoj edhe n tremujort n vazhdim. N do rast, shpejtsia e normalizimit do t jet n prputhje me t dhnat e reja dhe e mjaftueshme pr t respektuar objektivin ton afatmesm t inflacionit. Kshilli Mbikqyrs do t monitoroj me kujdes situatn pr t vlersuar n koh implikimet pr ecurin e inflacionit dhe pr t identifikuar n koh masat e nevojshme pr administrimin efektiv t saj.

Title: Questions  Answers to press conference, 5 October 2022
text: Questions  Answers to press conference, 5 October 2022 Date of publication: 05.10.2022 Question: Mr. Sejko, have you been familiar with the draft fiscal amnesty and have you had proposals for changing it? The fiscal amnesty, as I have information, is being reviewed. So, the draft amnesty is being worked on, as the Minister of Economy and Finance confirmed this if I am not mistaken in her interview. We have been asked and given our opinions on the drafts of fiscal amnesty. The opinion of the Bank of Albania was also highlighted before the Assembly of the Republic of Albania, as well as in the previous press conference. Despite the specific draft, which is still being seen in essence, I repeat again that the Bank of Albania sees fiscal amnesty with costs and benefits, but first of all, we see amnesty in function of formalizing the economy. The central bank aims to increase financial inclusion, to introduce money outside the banking system, formalize the economy and in this context financial education as a help to increase financial inclusion and formalization in terms of finance. The tax amnesty would certainly have a positive impact in this regard, that's a little but clear. At the same time, fiscal amnesty would bring further liquidation to the economy and would help the state budget to meet its needs. On the other hand, the costs of fiscal amnesty are the risk that money laundering could involve. The opinion of the Bank of Albania has been clear that the risk of laundering money in this fiscal amnesty should be avoided, at the same time, money that could come from criminality and corruption. We stressed that fiscal amnesty should be studied as a project, in order to be an instrument in order to improve fiscal administration. Practically speaking, it should be one of the elements to increase revenue and avoid tax evasion from this moment and into the future. It is not a concept that fiscal amnesties are made continuously. If it were to be done and worked, it would have to give the clear message that behind it there is no more hiding income and taxes and taxes should be paid regularly, so we should minimize tax evasion maximally. If these objectives were to be realized, of course, the Bank of Albania considers fiscal amnesty in order to formalize the economy and especially as our specific objective, increase financial inclusion, i.e. the introduction of money that circulates outside the banking system within it. This is the opinion repeated several times by the Bank of Albania in relation to fiscal amnesty. Q: If I'm not mistaken, so far it is the fourth time we have had interest rate increases. If we are to face inflation again, what will be the monetary policy that will be followed by the Bank of Albania? Governor: As we pointed out in the monetary policy statement, the Bank of Albania has made it clear that we will continue normalizing the monetary policy course in relation to inflation increase. Central banks, not only the Bank of Albania, but central banks whether of the region or beyond, have continued a course of monetary policy normalization. So you've noticed that interest rates have been rising in all central banks, in Europe, in the United States and elsewhere. And the Bank of England has continued to raise interest rates. Interest rate rises or the speed of monetary policy normalization are conditioned by inflation, i.e. on its rise. We will do the same as the Central Bank. The inflation figure will determine our response. So if inflation will rise at faster rates, and we will respond with our normalizing monetary policy. Otherwise, we will see that our main objective is to prevent or contain inflation and maintain price stability, but at the same time we are very carefully looking at the level of economic growth. So if you notice, the gradual normalization we have done is in the function of not being able to afford economic growth. But it depends, we cannot sacrifice price stability, because if we did not do this, the negative effect that would come from the price increase later on the economic growth would be very high, for individuals and businesses, as well as for the state budget. That's pretty clear since history has proven that. Central banks are reacting in the direction of interest rate increases. We cannot say exactly how the monetary policy performance will continue without having the figures that will come in the future periodically above the level of inflation and other macroeconomic indicators in the country. Question 3: What fiscal policies or measures does the Bank of Albania suggest to the Government to comply with monetary policy in the conditions of high inflation? Governor: We have consistently made them transparent and communicated our recommendations regarding fiscal policy. The Bank of Albania has given its opinion on the state budget every year before its adoption in the Assembly of the Republic of Albania. In the most specific case, we have again made clear our judgment. First, we recommend that we be careful with the level of debt, with the reduction of its level, so it should move towards a fiscal consolidation. But, in parallel with the difficult economic situation, one should also pay attention to the treatment of the strata in need. The social resistance packages or any other package that would go towards compensating the needs of these strata, influenced by rising prices, would certainly be a positive element that the Government is pursuing, and should be followed, but this measure must be balanced. First, you need to see the needy layers. Compensate, for example for the price of energy and for all other prices that may increase and affect these layers. But not by taking care of the public debt. It needs to be managed in both directions. These are the two main things I can mention right now. Of course, there was a list of recommendations and advice that we have given to the Ministry of Finance and Economy and the Albanian Government regarding the fiscus. But at the moment, these are the two main elements I would mention in terms of advice to the Government. Thank you! Question 4: The last few weeks in the online space has been talked about the purchase of a bank with foreign capital from a bank with local capital. Was there a demand with the Bank of Albania for such a transaction, and if so, what is the judgment now with the further consolidation of the banking system and the increasing presence of domestic capital? Governor: We don't have a formal request from any second-tier bank for stakeholder change, either foreign or local. Throughout the period, you have witnessed the fundamental changes in the structure of the Albanian banking system. Some foreign banks  some banks with capital from mainly European countries, but also others (as well as a bank with capital from Malaysia)  have withdrawn from our market. These banks have not only been withdrawn from Albania, but have been withdrawn from the entire region. The reason was not to leave the territory of the Republic of Albania for various issues. But the main reason was the impact of the 2008 global financial crisis on their balance sheets. The global financial crisis hit the balance sheets of these banks and the ECB placed conditions on them: either to raise capital or close their subsidiaries in several countries. Unable to raise capital, these banks were forced to close their subsidiaries, and Albania, as well as some countries in the region, was affected. This has been a difficult and stressful process, to be honest and transparent with you. Throughout the period of our first term, we have faced a series of crises, such as the debt crisis in Greece, the eurozone, other consequences that resulted from both the earthquake, the pandemic, but also with elements carried by the global financial crisis of 2008, which required a healthy banking system. We intended to have an economic growth, but also decrease in non-5 loans, which we inherited at a very high level, up to 25%, which came mainly from the operation of these European banks, as they had the greatest weight. Of course we tried to have other banks with banking histories of hundreds of years and european origin in the domestic market, but for the period there was no interest in the above-mentioned reasons. The change in the shareholder structure brought an increase in the percentage of domestic capital in the banking system and fortunately with the changes made, the financial system, the banking system has had more positive results that are visible and measurable. The introduction of local shareholders has surprised us for the better, as the central bank, but also the Albanian economic reality. Non-performing credit has continued to decline, and lending as an instrument for economic growth has continued to grow, going to 14% growth on an annual basis. Remember that five years ago we had an anemic credit growth. This is also because these European banks, precisely because of the restrictions imposed by European groups or authorities, were insintently active and almost did not perform their role in the Albanian economy. Replacing them with new shareholders with ambitions to operate, grow and generate profits for themselves and the market, led to the credit reaching 14% growth, always given that we are in a time of crisis. It made sure that the balance sheets of the financial system were not deteriorated, and the capital fulsibility rate (which is one of the main indicators by which we measure the health of the banking system) remained at very high levels. The average capital scoency rate for the banking system is 19%, compared to 12%, which is the minimum required by the Bank of Albania. So we have a short-term experience of about 5 years of structural change of the banking system and the increase of the specific weight of domestic shareholders in relation to foreign shareholders, which has resulted positive so far. We are in a difficult time and this is a new crisis. We passed the pandemic crisis that was a test and the Albanian economy resisted very well. Overall, the results across the macroeconomic indicators were more positive than what we expected, and we had accounted for not only us but also international institutions. Hopefully the same thing happens. We will use all instruments, both in the course of monetary policy and in the course of financial stability with macroprudential instruments, in order to maintain financial stability. Price stability and financial stability are closely linked to a final goal, economic growth and the welfare of the population and supporting business for growth. When asked questions, we don't have any specific information. Throughout this period, as there have been structural changes to bank departures or sale, there is a lot of information in the market that is rumours. This period has had many changes, and the Department of Supervision, but also other departments within the Bank of Albania related to this activity, have gained experience. Of course, in any case we may have now or in the future, we will strictly enforce all legal and regulatory requirements, in cooperation with international partners. There is no surprise if it were to happen, but we have no concrete official information. However, it is to be reiterated that the change of structure and the increase of capital of local shareholders has had positive effects on the financial system and the Albanian economy.
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Pyetje  prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp, 5 tetor 2022 Data e publikimit: 05.10.2022 Pyetje: Z. Sejko, a jeni njohur me draftin e amnistis fiskale dhe a keni pasur propozime pr ndryshimin e tij? Guvernatori: Amnistia fiskale, mesa kam informacion, po rishikohet. Pra, drafti i amnistis sht duke u punuar, pasi edhe Ministrja e Ekonomis dhe Financave kt konfirmoi n mos gaboj n intervistn e saj. Ne jemi pyetur dhe i kemi dhn opinionet tona pr draftet e amnistis fiskale. Opinioni i Banks s Shqipris sht theksuar dhe para Kuvendit t Republiks s Shqipris, sikurse edhe n konferencn e kaluar pr shtyp. Pavarsisht nga drafti specifik, i cili sht akoma duke u par n esenc, edhe njher e prsris se Banka e Shqipris e shikon amnistin fiskale me kosto dhe prfitime, por n radh t par, ne e shohim amnistin n funksion t formalizimit t ekonomis. Banka qendrore ka si objektiv rritjen e prfshirjes financiare, futjen e paras jasht sistemit bankar n sistem, formalizimin e ekonomis dhe n kt kontekst edukimin financiar pikrisht si ndihmes pr t rritur prfshirjen financiare dhe formalizimin n drejtim t financave. Amnistia fiskale sigurisht q do t kishte impakt pozitiv n kt drejtim, kjo sht pak por e qart. Njkohsisht amnistia fiskale do t sillte edhe likuiditete t mtejshme n ekonomi dhe do t ndihmonte buxhetin e shtetit pr t plotsuar nevojat e tij. Nga kahu tjetr, kostot e amnistis fiskale jan rreziku q mund t ket prfshirja e pastrimit t parave. Opinioni i Banks s Shqipris ka qen i qart, q duhet shmangur rreziku i pastrimit t paras n kt amnisti fiskale, njkohsisht dhe parat q mund t vijn nga kriminaliteti dhe korrupsioni. Ne e kemi theksuar q amnistia fiskale duhet br e studiuar si projekt, n mnyr q t jet nj instrument n funksion t prmirsimit t administrimit fiskal. Praktikisht, duhet t jet nj nga elementet pr t rritur t ardhurat dhe pr t shmangur evazionin fiskal nga ky moment e n t ardhmen. Pra, nuk duhet krijuar nj koncept q amnistit fiskale bhen n mnyr t vazhdueshme. Kjo amnisti nse do t bhej dhe do t funksiononte, do t duhej t jepte mesazhin e qart q pas saj nuk ka m fshehje t ardhurash dhe taksat dhe tatimet duhen paguar rregullisht, pra duhet t minimizojm maksimalisht evazionin fiskal. N rast se kto objektiva do t realizoheshin, sigurisht q Banka e Shqipris e shikon amnistin fiskale n funksion t formalizimit t ekonomis dhe veanrisht si objektivi yn specifik, rritjen e prfshirjes financiare, pra futjen e paras q qarkullon jasht sistemit bankar brenda tij. Ky sht opinioni i prsritur disa her nga Banka e Shqipris n raport me amnistin fiskale. Pyetje: N mos gaboj, deri tani sht e katrta her q kemi rritje t norms s interesit. Nse ne do t prballemi srish me rritje t inflacionit, cila do t jet politika monetare q do t ndiqet nga Banka e Shqipris? Guvernatori: Sikurse e theksuam n deklaratn e politiks monetare, Banka e Shqipris e ka br t qart se ne do t vazhdojm normalizimin e kursit t politiks monetare n raport me rritjen e inflacionit. Bankat qendrore, jo vetm Banka e Shqipris, por bankat qendrore qoft t rajonit apo dhe m gjer, kan vazhduar nj kurs normalizimi t politiks monetare. Pra ju keni vn re q normat e interesit kan vijuar t rriten nga t gjitha bankat qendrore, n Evrop, n Shtetet e Bashkuara dhe n vende t tjera. Dhe Banka e Anglis ka vazhduar ti rris normat e interesit. Rritja e norms s interesit apo shpejtsia e normalizimit t politiks monetare kushtzohet nga inflacioni, pra nga rritja e tij. T njjtn gj do t bjm dhe ne si bank qendrore. Shifra e inflacionit do t prcaktoj reagimin ton. Pra, nse inflacioni do t rritet me ritme m t shpejta, dhe ne do ti prgjigjemi me politikn ton monetare normalizuese. N rast t kundrt, do t shohim pasi sigurisht q objektivi yn kryesor sht parandalimi ose frenimi i inflacionit dhe ruajtja e stabilitetit t mimeve, por njkohsisht me shum kujdes shohim dhe nivelin e rritjes ekonomike. Pra po ta vini re, normalizimi gradual q ne kemi br sht n funksion t mospengimit t rritjes ekonomike. Por kjo varet, ne nuk mund t sakrifikojm stabilitetin e mimeve, pasi n rast se ne nuk do ta bnim kt, efekti negativ q do t vinte nga rritja e mimeve m pas n rritjen ekonomike, do t ishte shum i lart, si pr individt ashtu dhe pr bizneset, po edhe dhe pr buxhetin e shtetit. Kjo sht shum e qart pasi historia e ka provuar kt gj. Praktikisht, bankat qendrore po reagojn n drejtim t rritjes s norms s interesit. Nuk mund ta themi saktsisht se si do t vazhdoj ecuria e politiks monetare pa pasur shifrat q do t vijn n t ardhmen periodikisht mbi nivelin e inflacionit dhe treguesit e tjer makroekonomik n vend. Pyetje 3: far politikash fiskale apo masash i sugjeron Banka e Shqipris Qeveris pr tu prputhur me politikn monetare n kushtet e inflacionit t lart? Guvernatori: Ne vazhdimisht i kemi br transparente dhe i kemi komunikuar rekomandimet tona lidhur me politikn fiskale. Banka e Shqipris, do vit, ka dhn opinionin e saj lidhur me buxhetin e shtetit, para miratimit t tij n Kuvendin e Republiks s Shqipris. N rastin m specifik, ne prsri e kemi br t qart gjykimin ton. N radh t par, kemi rekomanduar q t kihet kujdes me nivelin e borxhit, me uljen e nivelit t tij, pra duhet t shkohet drejt nj konsolidimi fiskal. Por, paralelisht me situatn e vshtir ekonomike, duhet pasur n vmendje edhe trajtimi i shtresave n nevoj. Paketat e rezistencs sociale apo do lloj pakete tjetr q do t shkonte n drejtim t kompensimit t nevojave t ktyre shtresave, t ndikuara nga rritja e mimeve, sigurisht q do t ishte nj element pozitiv q Qeveria po e ndjek, dhe duhet t ndiqet, por kjo mas duhet t jet e balancuar. Pra, n radh t par duhet t shihen shtresat n nevoj. T kompensohen, pr shembull pr mimin e energjis dhe pr t gjitha mimet e tjera q mund t ken rritje dhe afektojn kto shtresa. Por duke mos cenuar, pra duke pasur kujdes nivelin e borxhit publik. Duhet menaxhuar n t dyja drejtimet. Kto jan dy elementet kryesore q un mund t prmend momentalisht. Sigurisht, q ka pasur nj list me rekomandime dhe kshillime q ne i kemi dhn Ministris s Financave dhe Ekonomis dhe Qeveris Shqiptare lidhur me fiskun. Por, pr momentin, kto jan dy elementet kryesore q un do t prmendja lidhur me kshillimin drejtuar Qeveris. Faleminderit! Pyetje 4: Javt e fundit n hapsirn online sht folur pr blerjen e nj banke me kapital t huaj nga nj bank me kapital vendas. A ka pasur nj krkes pran Banks s Shqipris pr nj transaksion t till, dhe nse po, cili sht gjykimi tani me konsolidimin e mtejshm t sistemit bankar dhe me prezencn gjithmon e m t madhe t kapitalit vendas? Guvernatori: Nuk kemi nj krkes zyrtare nga asnj bank e nivelit t dyt pr ndryshim aksionersh, qoft e huaj, qoft lokale. Gjat gjith periudhs, ju keni qen dshmitar t ndryshimeve esenciale n strukturn e sistemit bankar shqiptar. Disa banka t huaja - disa banka me kapital t kryesisht t vendeve evropiane, por edhe t tjera (sikundr ka qen edhe nj bank me kapital nga Malajzia) - jan trhequr nga tregu yn. Kto banka nuk jan trhequr vetm nga Shqipria, por jan trhequr nga i gjith rajoni. Pra, arsyeja nuk ka qen largimi nga territori i Republiks s Shqipris pr problematika t ndryshme. Por, arsyeja kryesore ka qen pasoja e krizs financiare globale t vitit 2008 n bilancet e tyre. Kriza financiare globale goditi bilancet e ktyre bankave dhe BQE-ja u vuri kushte: ose t rrisnin kapitalin ose t mbyllnin filialet e tyre n disa shtete. N pamundsi pr t rritur kapitalin, kto banka u detyruan t mbyllnin filialet e tyre, dhe Shqipria, sikundr edhe disa vende t rajonit, u afektua. Ky ka qen nj proces i vshtir dhe stresant, pr t qen t sinqert dhe transparent me ju. Gjat gjith periudhs s mandatit ton t par, ne jemi prballur me nj sr krizash si: krizn e borxheve n Greqi, n Eurozon, pasojat e tjera q erdhn si nga trmeti, nga pandemia, por edhe me elemente t mbartura nga kriza financiare globale e vitit 2008, t cilat krkonin nj sistem bankar t shndetshm. Ne synonim t kishim nj rritje ekonomike, por edhe ulje t kredive me probleme, t cilat i trashguam n nj nivel shum t lart, deri n 25%, q erdhn kryesisht nga operimi i ktyre bankave evropiane, pasi ato kishin peshn m t madhe. Natyrisht q u prpoqm t kishim n tregun vendas banka t tjera me histori bankare qindravjeare dhe me origjin evropiane, por pr periudhn nuk kishte interes pr arsyet e siprprmendura. Ndryshimi n strukturn aksionere solli nj rritje t prqindjes s kapitalit vendas n sistemin bankar dhe fatmirsisht me ndryshimet e bra, sistemi financiar, sistemi bankar ka pasur rezultate m pozitive q jan t dukshme e t matshme. Futja e aksionerve vendas na ka surprizuar pr mir, ne si bank qendrore, por edhe realitetin ekonomik shqiptar. Kredia me probleme ka vijuar t bjer, dhe kreditimi si nj instrument pr rritjen ekonomike ka vazhduar t rritet duke shkuar n nivelin 14% rritje me baz vjetore. Mos harroni q para 5 vitesh kemi pasur nj rritje anemike t kreditimit. Kjo edhe si pasoj se kto banka evropiane, pikrisht pr arsye t kufizimeve qe atyre u ishin vendosur nga grupet apo autoritetet evropiane, ishin jo sa duhej aktive dhe pothuajse nuk po kryenin rolin e tyre n ekonomin shqiptare. Zvendsimi i tyre me aksionert e rinj me ambicie pr t operuar, pr tu rritur e pr t gjeneruar fitime pr veten dhe tregun, bri q kredia t arrij n nivelin e rritjes 14%, gjithmon duke pasur parasysh q jemi n nj koh krize. Bri q mos prkeqsohen bilancet e sistemit financiar dhe gjithashtu norma e mjaftueshmris s kapitalit (q sht nj nga treguesit kryesor me t cilin masim shndetin e sistemit bankar) mbeti n nivele shum t larta. Mesatarja e norms s mjaftueshmris s kapitalit pr sistemin bankar sht 19%, krahasuar me 12%, q sht minimumi i krkuar nga Banka Shqipris. Pra, kemi nj prvoj afatshkurtr rreth 5-vjeare t ndryshimit strukturor t sistemit bankar dhe rritjes s peshs specifike t aksionerve vendas n raport me aksionert e huaj, e cila ka rezultuar pozitive deri tani. Natyrisht q jemi n periudha t vshtira dhe kjo sht nj kriz e re. Kaluam krizn e pandemis q ishte test dhe ekonomia shqiptare rezistoi shum mir. N prgjithsi, rezultatet n t gjith treguesit makroekonomik ishin m pozitive nga ato q prisnim dhe kishim llogaritur jo vetm ne, por edhe institucionet ndrkombtare. Shpresojm t ndodh e njjta gj. Do t prdorim t gjitha instrumentet, si n kahun e politiks monetare ashtu edhe n kahun e stabilitetit financiar me instrumentet makroprudenciale, n mnyr q t ruajm stabilitetin financiar. Stabiliteti i mimeve dhe stabiliteti financiar jan t lidhur ngusht pr nj qllim final, rritjen ekonomike dhe rritjen e mirqenies s popullsis dhe mbshtetjen e biznesit pr rritje. Duke ju rikthyer pyetjes, nuk kemi nj informacion konkret. Gjat gjith ksaj periudhe, duke qen se ka pasur ndryshime strukturore pr largime ose shitblerje bankash, ka shum informacione n treg q jan thashetheme. Kjo periudh ka pasur shum ndryshime, dhe Departamenti i Mbikqyrjes por dhe departamentet e tjera brenda Banks s Shqipris t lidhura me kt aktivitet, kan fituar eksperienc. Natyrisht q n do rast q mund t kemi tani ose n t ardhmen, ne do t zbatojm strikt t gjitha krkesat ligjore dhe rregullative, n bashkpunim me partnert ndrkombtar. Nuk ka ndonj surpriz nse do t ndodhte, por nuk kemi asnj informacion konkret zyrtar. Megjithat, sht pr tu ritheksuar se ndryshimi i strukturs dhe rritja e kapitalit t aksionerve vendas ka pasur efekte pozitive n sistemin financiar dhe n ekonomin shqiptare.

Title: Governor Sejko's remarks at the Annual Conference of the Bank of Albania
text: Governor Sejko's remarks at the Annual Conference of the Bank of Albania Date of publication: 27.10.2022 Mr. Mr. Minister, I nderuar z. Monastiriotis, Honorable participant, It is a pleasure for me to open the 16th annual conference of the Bank of Albania, organized in collaboration with the London School of Economic and Political Science (LSE). I am convinced that, as in previous years, this conference will help us better understand the origins and complexities of the challenges we are facing, as well as identify the right policies for addressing them. In this regard, let me conclude that the speakers' high level of expertise and wide range of guest experience, offer a solid guarantee of its success. The topic chosen this year is the rapid rise in inflation in the global environment and the problems that this inflation brings to policymakers, at macro and microeconomic levels. However, as professional and forward-looking institutions, the task of central banks is not to allow the agenda of the day to eclipse the handling of the problems of the future. For this reason, this conference will not leave out of our attention the growing challenges that impose on us the rapid structural changes in the economy, society and the physical environment around us. As governor of the Bank of Albania, in this opening speech, I would like to share with you our vision on the topics laid out, focusing on the performance of inflation and our measures to respect the price stability objective and briefly mentioning the long-term challenges of development. Honorable participant, The organization by a central bank of an inflation-focused conference may seem the most normal thing, and yet for an intern in the field, the synchronized turn of central banks' attention to identifying the necessary measures and finding the most effective instruments for reducing inflation is a landmark moment. For more than three decades, the global economy and financial markets have been characterized by relatively stable economic growth, low inflation and favorable financing conditions. While financial crises have not been lacking, whether local, regional or global, economic and monetary stability has been taken for granted in developed countries and has been an increasingly tangible reality for developing countries. This reality also named a period in the history of economics, called the Great Moderation. Consolidation of economic and monetary stability has had two powerful historical drivers: on the one hand, the globalization of product markets, integration into the production chains of developing countries of Asia and Eastern Europe, and the decrease in geopolitical tensions, resulted in an increase in global aggregate supply, driving economic growth and keeping production costs low; On the other hand, the crystallisation of an economic and political consensus on the role of central banks, the increase of institutional and operational independence, and the focus on price stability as the primary objective of monetary policy, provided an efficient and reliable mechanism for controlling inflation and smoothing business cycles. The increased monetary stability and credibility of central banks enabled the world economy to absorb unprecedented monetary stimulus in the period of the global financial crisis and pandemic period. Central banks lowered funding costs to historical minimum levels, leading in some cases into negative territory, and rapidly increased their balance sheets. The monetary stimulus proved decisive in amortizing the consequences of the crisis and creating preconditates for economic recovery. It was accompanied by increased public and private debt, but it did not translate into high inflation, once again illustrating the benefits of the Great Moderation. Unfortunately, Russia's military aggression against Ukraine has brought a new reality before us. The geopolitical tension that followed the conflict brought massive and unexpected problems in the world supply chains with sensitive products such as food, staples and energy, and rapidly increasing uncertainty in world markets. This hit coincided with the rapid recovery of aggregate demand in the post-pandemic period and was reflected in the rapid growth of global inflation during 2022. Now, most developed and developing countries are facing inflation levels unprecedented for decades. Nor is The Arab World no exception to this reality. Inflation recorded a rapid rise in 2022, reaching 8% in the third quarter  the highest level recorded since 1998. Although inflation in Albania is low, both in the regional and European contexts, reflecting the strong and stable exchange rate performance and regulated electricity prices for households, its base has come to grow and expand. Already, the bulk of basket items display an inflation rate above our target of 3%. Also, basket items with a high or rising inflation rate are no longer only goods and services of import origin, but also products, which generate most of the value added in the country. Identifying the right response to this crackdown poses a major challenge for governments, for central banks, for financial intermediaries markets, but also for businesses and families. For Governments, the economic and social strain that high inflation brings on the poorest strata of society and the most fragile segments of the economy, is articulated in increased demands for fiscal support. However, fulfilling these requirements becomes problematic, as long as public finances are under pressure from uncertainty about the future and increased costs of financing debt. For Central banks, dealing with foreign-origin supply shocks presents a small dilemma, because these shocks have an opposite effect on economic activity and price levels. In any case, monetary policy remains aware of the delicate balance that exists between respecting the primary objective of controlling inflation with respecting the secondary objective of mitigating economic fluctuations. For Markets and financial intermediaries, high levels of inflation tend to be accompanied by increased uncertainty, leading to the need for a reassessment of risk exposure and a review of their development strategies. From Finally, for businesses and families, high inflation presents a current challenge to living and business costs, but also a long-term challenge to their financial and business plans. In these circumstances, the Bank of Albania has identified the high level of inflation as the primary risk to the country's sustainable and long-term growth, to increased social well-being and social cohesion. For this reason, we have undertaken a gradual, but firm, normalisation of the monetary policy stance. The Bank of Albania has raised its base interest rate four times in 2022, bringing it from the historical minimum level of 0.5% to the current level of 2.25%. In our view, this normalization is a necessary measure for maintaining the economic and financial balances of the country. It aims to create more appropriate monetary conditions for respecting our legal mandate of price stability and for returning inflation to target within a two-year time horizon, while at the same time minimizing medium and long-term fluctuations in economic activity. This decision-making is motivated by three important considerations, which  in our judgment  provide a consistent analysis framework for determining the response of monetary policy. First, inflationary pressures in the country are strong and stable. Although these pressures stem  to the greatest extent  from foreign supply shocks, they have already begun to transmit to the structure of the costs of the Albanian economy and to the expectations for inflation of economic agents. This conclusion is in full sync with the evolution of the thinking of almost all central banks and carries the consensus of economic analysts. The sustainability of inflationary pressures is driven by the duration and intensity of the foreign supply shock, the relatively stable demand for goods and services in the country, but also by the reduction of untapped capacities in the labor and capital markets. The latter has been accompanied by rapid growth in employment and wages in the Albanian economy, facilitating transmission of further supply shocks. For this reason, the Albanian economy risks experiencing a long period of high inflation, in the absence of monetary policy response. Second, high and stable inflation brings  unconscionably  negative consequences for economic and social development, which tend to be greater for developing countries like Albania. One of the great ironies of the success of stabilization policies is that economic agents often forget the motivation and benefits of these policies. For this reason, let me spend some time in refreshing our shared memory on the negative effects of inflation. In economic terms, world theory and practice prove that high inflation reduces the level and increases the fluctuations of economic growth in the long run. The negative effect of inflation stems from increasing uncertainty and inefficient distribution of financial and human resources in the economy, as a result of the reduction of market price signalling ability. These consequences are further reinforced by increasing the attention of businesses and households to financial protection, on the back of long-term investments in physical assets, as well as by rising real funding costs, reflecting the reduction in financial savings. In social terms, world theory and practice prove that high inflation increases social inequality, affecting lower-income strata, and can undermine the political consensus and the democratic institutions of a state. In the context of developing countries, high inflation has an additional negative impact on financial stability, undermining public confidence in the national currency and hitting, potentially, even its confidence in financial institutions. From the above, the sustainability of inflationary pressures and long-term damage to inflation offer, in themselves, sufficient premis for a monetary policy response. However, our decision-making in this regard has also been motivated by a third consideration. The normalization of the monetary policy stance will not be accompanied by unnecessary negative consequences for the Albanian economy and its monetary and financial stability. Our projections suggest that the Albanian economy will continue to grow in the medium and long term. The results of our simulations also suggest that the banking system has a satisfactory degree of resistance, even to relatively extreme economic and financial shocks. Metaphorically, we enter this battle convinced that our cure will cure the disease, but  however bitter and unpleasant  it will not harm the patient. This belief is based on thorough, continuous and careful analysis, the main conclusions of which I am following. First, the Albanian economy comes into this confrontation with positive development inertia. Economic activity in the country marked a rapid recovery during the past year and the first half of this year. The sources of growth appear wide, based on both internal and external demand. The financial balances of businesses and households are relatively healthy, while the labor market remains dynamic, characterized by steady growth in employment and wages. In this context, although slowing in the near future is normal, economic growth is expected to remain in positive territory, while recessions appear as material risks only in extreme scenarios of developments in the foreign environment. Second, unlike previous experience of facing shocks, the country's financial stability appears consolidated. Financial markets are relatively calm, despite moderate swings in certain segments of it. The banking sector is liquid, well capitalised and profitable. Public confidence in it and in the national currency remains at extremely high levels. Finally and equally importantly, public debt remains under control and the government's concrete steps for fiscal consolidation provide more support to its sustainability. Standing in this line, I would like to point out that the ongoing reforms that the Bank of Albania and the Albanian authorities have undertaken in the financial field have borne fruits. More specifically, the consolidation of the sector has produced a healthier and competitive banking industry. The improvement of the credit environment has generated a more positive approach from banks to lending, turning them into a reliable supporter with funds for Albanian businesses and families. Financial security networks have also been further strengthened through: improving coordination of responsible institutions; strengthening the role of the Deposit Insurance Agency; as well as the adoption by the Bank of Albania of the extraordinary intervention function and the establishment of the relevant special fund. At the same time, prudential oversight and regulation of the banking sector have brought about better risk management, reducing its vulnerabilities to unexpected shocks. Finally, improving payment infrastructure and increasing financial education have broadened public attention and participation in the financial sector. Third, I find it fitting to emphasize that the stance of our monetary policy will remain stimulating throughout the normalization process. This normalization implies a reduction in the intensity of the monetary stimulus, but no change in the stimulus nature of this policy. In fact, our base scenario does not (yet) envisage adopting a tightening monetary policy stance, but revising the monetary policy stance aims to provide a better balance of risks in the economy. Honorable participant, The Analytical Framework of the Bank of Albania, which I outlined above - assessing the intensity and sustainability of inflationary pressures, identifying risks and assessing their balance, as well as assessing the cost and consequences of intervention - provides a consistent guide to decision-making. Looking back to the historical context, I think our duty as monetary authorities is to maintain pristine public confidence in central banks' will and ability to maintain price stability. Reaffirming this will and this ability will preserve intrude one of the two main premises of success that economic policies have had during the period of the Great Moderation. While its other premises  globalization, integration and geopolitical risk reduction  are not in our control, price stability and central banks' credibility is a relay, which we have taken from our predecessor generations and must take it further. In closing, I would like to emphasize that the Bank of Albania has paid and pays great attention to the long-term structural challenges that we have ahead. It is now clear that our analyses and projections, and therefore our policies, cannot be complete and accurate without a full assessment of the role of climate change, demographic trends such as population ageing and migration, and the impact of technological and financial innovation on the economy. All of these topics I am convinced will be addressed in breadth and depth at this conference. In welcoming you, I invite you to engage in a full and honest discussion! Ju faleminderit!
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n Konferencn Vjetore t Banks s Shqipris Data e publikimit: 27.10.2022 E nderuar zj. Ministre, I nderuar z. Monastiriotis, T nderuar pjesmarrs, sht knaqsi pr mua t hap punimet e konferencs s 16-t vjetore t Banks s Shqipris, t organizuar n bashkpunim me Shkolln e Londrs pr Shkenca Ekonomike dhe Politike (LSE). Jam i bindur se, ashtu si dhe n vitet e mparshme, kjo konferenc do t na ndihmoj t kuptojm m mir origjinn dhe kompleksitetin e sfidave me t cilat po prballemi, si dhe t identifikojm politikat e duhura pr adresimin e tyre. N kt drejtim, m lejoni t konstatoj se niveli i lart i ekspertizs s folsve dhe gama e gjer e eksperiencs s t ftuarve, ofrojn nj garanci solide pr suksesin e saj. Tema e przgjedhur kt vit sht rritja e shpejt e inflacionit n ambientin global dhe problematika q ky inflacion sjell pr politikbrsit, n nivel makro dhe mikroekonomik. Megjithat, si institucione profesionale dhe largpamse, detyra e bankave qendrore sht t mos lejojn q agjenda e dits t eklipsoj trajtimin e problemeve t s ardhmes. Pr kt arsye, kjo konferenc nuk do t ler jasht vmendjes as sfidat n rritje q imponojn mbi ne ndryshimet e vrullshme strukturore n ekonomi, n shoqri dhe n ambientin fizik q na rrethon. Si Guvernator i Banks s Shqipris, n kt fjal hapse, dshiroj t ndaj me ju vizionin ton mbi temat e parashtruara, duke u prqendruar te ecuria e inflacionit dhe masat tona pr respektimin e objektivit t stabilitetit t mimeve dhe duke prmendur shkurtimisht sfidat afatgjata t zhvillimit. T nderuar pjesmarrs, Organizimi nga nj bank qendrore i nj konference t fokusuar mbi inflacionin, mund t duket gjja m normale, e megjithat, pr nj praktikant t fushs, kthimi i sinkronizuar i vmendjes s bankave qendrore drejt identifikimit t masave t nevojshme dhe gjetjes s instrumenteve m efektive pr reduktimin e inflacionit, sht nj moment historik. Pr m shum se tre dekada, ekonomia dhe tregjet financiare botrore jan karakterizuar nga rritje relativisht e qndrueshme ekonomike, inflacion i ult dhe kushte t favorshme financimi. Ndonse krizat financiare nuk kan munguar, qofshin kto lokale, rajonale apo globale, stabiliteti ekonomik dhe monetar sht marr si i mirqen n vendet e zhvilluara dhe ka qen nj realitet gjithnj e m i prekshm pr vendet n zhvillim. Ky realitet emrtoi dhe nj periudh t historis s ekonomis, t quajtur Moderacioni i Madh. Konsolidimi i stabilitetit ekonomik dhe monetar ka pasur dy nxits t fuqishm historik: nga njra an, globalizimi i tregjeve t produkteve, integrimi n zinxhirt e prodhimit t vendeve n zhvillim t Azis dhe t Evrops Lindore, si dhe ulja e tensioneve gjeopolitike, solln nj rritje t oferts agregate botrore, duke nxitur rritjen ekonomike dhe duke mbajtur t ulta kostot e prodhimit; nga ana tjetr, kristalizimi i nj konsensusi ekonomik e politik mbi rolin e bankave qendrore, rritja e pavarsis institucionale e operacionale t tyre, si dhe fokusi mbi stabilitetin e mimeve si objektiv primar i politiks monetare, ofruan nj mekanizm eficient dhe t besueshm pr kontrollin e inflacionit dhe zbutjen e cikleve t biznesit. Rritja e stabilitetit monetar dhe e besueshmris s bankave qendrore, i mundsoi ekonomis botrore t absorboj nj stimul t paprecedent monetar n periudhn e krizs financiare globale dhe n periudhn e pandemis. Bankat qendrore uln n nivele minimale historike kostot e financimit, duke i uar n disa raste dhe n territor negativ, si dhe rritn me shpejtsi bilancet e tyre. Stimuli monetar rezultoi vendimtar n amortizimin e pasojave t krizs dhe n krijimin e parakushteve pr rimkmbje ekonomike. Ai u shoqrua me rritje t borxhit publik e privat, por nuk u prkthye n inflacion t lart, duke ilustruar edhe njher prfitimet e Moderacionit t Madh. Fatkeqsisht, agresioni ushtarak i Rusis ndaj Ukrains ka sjell para nesh nj realitet t ri. Tensioni gjeopolitik q pasoi konfliktin solli probleme masive dhe t papritura n zinxhirt botror t furnizimit me produkte sensitive, si ushqime, lnd baz e energji, dhe rritje t shpejt t pasiguris n tregjet botrore. Kjo goditje prkoi me rikuperimin e shpejt t krkess agregate n periudhn post-pandemike dhe u pasqyrua n rritjen e shpejt t inflacionit botror gjat vitit 2022. Tashm, pjesa m e madhe e vendeve t zhvilluara dhe n zhvillim po prballen me nivele inflacioni t paprecedenta prej disa dekadash. As Shqipria nuk bn prjashtim nga ky realitet. Inflacioni shnoi rritje t shpejt gjat vitit 2022, duke arritur nivelin 8% n tremujorin e tret  nivel ky m i larti i regjistruar q prej vitit 1998. Ndonse inflacioni n Shqipri paraqitet i ult, si n kontekstin rajonal dhe n at europian, duke pasqyruar ecurin e fort dhe t qndrueshme t kursit t kmbimit dhe mimet e rregulluara t energjis elektrike pr familjet, baza e tij ka ardhur n rritje e zgjerim. Tashm, pjesa m e madhe e artikujve t shports shfaqin nj norm inflacioni mbi objektivin ton prej 3%. Po ashtu, artikujt e shports me norm t lart apo n rritje inflacioni nuk jan m vetm mallra e shrbime me origjin importi, por edhe produkte, t cilat pjesn m t madhe t vlers s shtuar e gjenerojn n vend. Identifikimi i reagimit t duhur ndaj ksaj goditjeje prbn nj sfid madhore pr qeverit, pr bankat qendrore, pr tregjet e ndrmjetsit financiar, por edhe pr bizneset dhe familjet. Pr qeverit, tensioni ekonomik dhe social q inflacioni i lart sjell mbi shtresat m t varfra t shoqris dhe segmentet m t brishta t ekonomis, artikulohet n krkesa t shtuara pr mbshtetje fiskale. Megjithat, plotsimi i ktyre krkesave bhet problematik, pr sa koh financat publike jan n presionin e pasiguris pr t ardhmen dhe t kostove t rritura t financimit t borxhit. Pr bankat qendrore, trajtimi i goditjeve t oferts me origjin t huaj paraqet nj dilem jo t vogl, pr faktin se kto goditje kan ndikim t kahut t kundrt mbi aktivitetin ekonomik dhe nivelin e mimeve. N do rast, politika monetare mbetet e ndrgjegjshme pr balancn delikate q ekziston midis respektimit t objektivit primar t kontrollit t inflacionit me respektimin e objektivit dytsor t zbutjes s luhatjeve ekonomike. Pr tregjet dhe ndrmjetsit financiar, nivelet e larta t inflacionit tentojn t shoqrohen me rritje t pasiguris, duke sjell nevojn e nj rivlersimi t ekspozimit ndaj rrezikut dhe rishikimi t strategjive t tyre t zhvillimit. S fundi, pr bizneset dhe familjet, inflacioni i lart prbn nj sfid korrente pr kostot e jetess dhe t biznesit, por dhe nj sfid afatgjat mbi planet e tyre financiare dhe t biznesit. N kto rrethana, Banka e Shqipris e ka identifikuar nivelin e lart t inflacionit si rrezikun primar pr rritjen e qndrueshme dhe afatgjat t vendit, pr rritjen e mirqenies shoqrore dhe pr kohezionin social. Pr kt arsye, ne kemi ndrmarr nj normalizim gradual, por t vendosur, t qndrimit t politiks monetare. Banka e Shqipris ka rritur katr her normn baz t interesit gjat vitit 2022, duke e sjell at nga niveli minimal historik prej 0.5% n nivelin aktual prej 2.25%. N kndvshtrimin ton, ky normalizim sht nj mas e domosdoshme pr ruajtjen e ekuilibrave ekonomik dhe financiar t vendit. Ai synon t krijoj kushte m t prshtatshme monetare pr respektimin e mandatit ton ligjor t stabilitetit t mimeve dhe pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv brenda nj horizonti kohor dyvjear, duke minimizuar n t njjtn koh luhatjet afatmesme dhe afatgjata n aktivitetin ekonomik. Kjo vendimmarrje sht motivuar nga tre konsiderata t rndsishme, t cilat  n gjykimin ton  ofrojn nj kuadr konsistent analize pr prcaktimin e kahut t reagimit t politiks monetare. S pari, presionet inflacioniste n vend paraqiten t forta dhe t qndrueshme. Ndonse kto presione burojn  n masn m t madhe  nga goditje t huaja t oferts, ato kan filluar t transmetohen tashm n strukturn e kostove t ekonomis shqiptare dhe n pritjet pr inflacion t agjentve ekonomik. Ky konstatim sht n sinkron t plot me evoluimin e mendimit t thuajse gjith bankave qendrore dhe mbart konsensusin e analistve ekonomik. Qndrueshmria e presioneve inflacioniste sht nxitur nga kohzgjatja dhe intensiteti i goditjes s oferts s huaj, nga krkesa relativisht e qndrueshme pr mallra e shrbime n vend, por edhe nga reduktimi i kapaciteteve t pashfrytzuara n tregun e puns dhe t kapitalit. Kjo e fundit sht shoqruar me rritje t shpejt t punsimit dhe t pagave n ekonomin shqiptare, duke lehtsuar transmetimin e goditjeve t mtejshme t oferts. Pr kt arsye, ekonomia shqiptare rrezikon t prjetoj nj periudh t gjat me inflacion t lart, n munges t reagimit t politiks monetare. S dyti, inflacioni i lart dhe i qndrueshm sjell  n mnyr t pakontestueshme  pasoja negative pr zhvillimin ekonomik e social, pasoja t cilat tentojn t jen m t mdha pr vendet n zhvillim si Shqipria. Nj nga ironit e mdha t suksesit t politikave t stabilizimit, sht se shpesh agjentt ekonomik harrojn motivimin dhe prfitimet e ktyre politikave. Pr kt arsye, m lejoni t shpenzoj pak koh n rifreskimin e kujtess son t prbashkt mbi efektet negative t inflacionit. N kndvshtrimin ekonomik, teoria dhe praktika botrore dshmojn se inflacioni i lart redukton nivelin dhe rrit luhatjet e rritjes ekonomike n afatin e gjat. Efekti negativ i inflacionit buron nga rritja e pasiguris dhe shprndarja joeficiente e burimeve financiare dhe njerzore n ekonomi, si pasoj e reduktimit t aftsis sinjalizuese t mimeve t tregut. Kto pasoja prforcohen m tej nga rritja e vmendjes s bizneseve dhe familjeve ndaj mbrojtjes financiare, n kurriz t investimeve afatgjata n aktive fizike, si dhe nga rritja e kostove reale t financimit, n pasqyrim t reduktimit t kursimeve financiare. N kndvshtrimin social, teoria dhe praktika botrore dshmojn se inflacioni i lart rrit pabarazin sociale, duke prekur m shum shtresat me t ardhura t pakta, si dhe mund t dmtoj konsensusin politik dhe vet institucionet demokratike t nj shteti. N kontekstin e vendeve n zhvillim, inflacioni i lart ka nj ndikim shtes negativ n stabilitetin financiar, duke dmtuar besimin e publikut n monedhn kombtare dhe duke goditur, potencialisht, edhe besimin e tij n institucionet financiare. Nisur nga sa m sipr, qndrueshmria e presioneve inflacioniste dhe dmet afatgjata t inflacionit ofrojn, n vetvete, premisa t mjaftueshme pr nj reagim t politiks monetare. Megjithat, vendimmarrja jon n kt drejtim sht motivuar edhe nga nj konsiderat e tret. Normalizimi i qndrimit t politiks monetare nuk do t shoqrohet me pasoja t panevojshme negative pr ekonomin shqiptare dhe stabilitetin e saj monetar e financiar. Projeksionet tona sugjerojn se ekonomia shqiptare do t vijoj t rritet n afatin e mesm dhe t gjat. Po ashtu, rezultatet e simulimeve tona sugjerojn se sistemi bankar ka nj shkall t knaqshme rezistence, edhe ndaj goditjeve relativisht ekstreme ekonomike dhe financiare. N mnyr metaforike, ne hyjm n kt betej t bindur se kura jon do t shroj smundjen, por  sado e hidhur dhe e pakndshme  nuk do t dmtoj pacientin. Kjo bindje bazohet n analiza t plota, t vazhdueshme dhe t kujdesshme, konkluzionet kryesore t t cilave po i radhis n vijim. S pari, ekonomia shqiptare vjen n kt prballje me nj inerci pozitive zhvillimi. Aktiviteti ekonomik n vend shnoi nj rimkmbje t shpejt gjat vitit t shkuar dhe gjysms s par t ktij viti. Burimet e rritjes shfaqen t gjera, t bazuara si n krkesn e brendshme dhe n at t jashtme. Bilancet financiare t bizneseve dhe familjeve jan relativisht t shndetshme, ndrsa tregu i puns mbetet dinamik, i karakterizuar nga rritje e qndrueshme e punsimit dhe pagave. N kt kontekst, ndonse ngadalsimi i ritmit n t ardhmen e afrt sht dika normale, rritja ekonomike pritet t mbetet n territor pozitiv, ndrsa recesioni shfaqet si rrezik material vetm n skenar ekstrem t zhvillimeve n ambientin e huaj. S dyti, n ndryshim nga eksperiencat e mparshme t prballjes me goditje, stabiliteti financiar i vendit paraqitet i konsoliduar. Tregjet financiare jan relativisht t qeta, pavarsisht luhatjeve t moderuara n segmente t caktuara t tij. Sektori bankar sht likuid, i mirkapitalizuar dhe fitimprurs. Ndrkoh q besimi i publikut n t dhe n monedhn kombtare mbetet n nivele tejet t larta. S fundi dhe po aq e rndsishme, borxhi publik mbetet nn kontroll dhe hapat konkrete t qeveris pr konsolidim fiskal ofrojn nj mbshtetje m shum pr qndrueshmrin e tij. Duke qndruar n kt linj, dshiroj t evidentoj se reformat e vazhdueshme q Banka e Shqipris dhe autoritetet shqiptare kan ndrmarr n fushn financiare kan dhn frytet e tyre. M konkretisht, konsolidimi i sektorit ka prodhuar nj industri bankare m t shndetshme dhe konkurruese. Prmirsimi i ambientit t kreditit ka gjeneruar nj prqasje m pozitive nga bankat n kredidhnie, duke i shndrruar ato n nj mbshtets t besueshm me fonde pr bizneset dhe familjet shqiptare. Po ashtu, rrjetet e siguris financiare jan forcuar m tej, nprmjet: prmirsimit t koordinimit t institucioneve prgjegjse; fuqizimit t rolit t Agjencis s Sigurimit t Depozitave; si dhe adoptimit nga Banka e Shqipris t funksionit t Ndrhyrjes s Jashtzakonshme dhe krijimit t fondit special prkats. N t njjtn koh, mbikqyrja dhe rregullimi i kujdesshm i sektorit bankar kan sjell nj administrim m t mir t rrezikut, duke reduktuar vulnerabilitetet e tij ndaj goditjeve t papritura. S fundi, prmirsimi i infrastrukturs s pagesave dhe rritja e edukimit financiar kan zgjeruar vmendjen dhe pjesmarrjen e publikut n sektorin financiar. S treti, gjej me vend t theksoj se qndrimi i politiks son monetare do t vijoj t mbetet stimulues, gjat gjith procesit t normalizimit. Ky normalizim nnkupton nj reduktim t intensitetit t stimulit monetar, por jo ndryshim t natyrs stimuluese t ksaj politike. N fakt, skenari yn baz nuk parashikon (ende) adoptimin e nj qndrimi shtrngues t politiks monetare, por rishikimi i qndrimit t politiks monetare synon t ofroj nj balanc m t mir t rreziqeve n ekonomi. T nderuar pjesmarrs, Kuadri analitik i Banks s Shqipris, t cilin e parashtrova m lart - vlersimi i intensitetit dhe i qndrueshmris s presioneve inflacioniste, identifikimi i rreziqeve dhe vlersimi i balancs s tyre, si dhe vlersimi i kostos dhe pasojave t ndrhyrjes - ofron nj udhzues konsistent pr vendimmarrje. Duke iu kthyer edhe njher kontekstit historik, mendoj se detyra jon si autoritete monetare sht t ruajm t pacenuar besimin e publikut n vullnetin dhe aftsin e bankave qendrore pr t ruajtur stabilitetin e mimeve. Rikonfirmimi i ktij vullneti dhe ksaj aftsie do t ruaj t pacenuar nj nga dy premisat kryesore t suksesit q kan pasur politikat ekonomike gjat periudhs s Moderacionit t Madh. Ndonse premisat e tjera t tij - globalizimi, integrimi dhe ulja e rrezikut gjeopolitik - nuk jan n kontrollin ton, stabiliteti i mimeve dhe besueshmria e bankave qendrore sht nj stafet, t ciln e kemi marr nga brezat paraardhs dhe duhet ta ojm m tej. N mbyllje, dshiroj t theksoj se Banka e Shqipris i ka kushtuar dhe i kushton vmendje t madhe edhe sfidave afatgjata strukturore q kemi prpara. Tashm sht e qart se analizat dhe projeksionet tona, e pr rrjedhoj edhe politikat tona, nuk mund t jen t plota e t sakta pa nj vlersim t plot t rolit t ndryshimeve klimatike, t trendeve demografike, si plakja e popullsis dhe emigracioni, si dhe t ndikimit t inovacionit teknologjik e financiar n ekonomi. T gjitha kto tema jam i bindur se do t trajtohen n gjersi dhe thellsi n kt konferenc. Duke ju uruar mirseardhjen, ju ftoj t angazhohemi n nj diskutim sa m t plot e sa m t sinqert! Ju faleminderit!

Title: Governor Sejko's remarks at the press conference on monetary policy decision making, 2 November 2022
text: Governor Sejko's remarks at the press conference on monetary policy decision making, 2 November 2022 Publication date: 02.11.2022 Dear representatives of the media, Today, on 2 November 2022, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Quarterly Monetary Policy Report. The report finds that the consequences of the foreign supply shock on the Albanian economy are becoming increasingly apparent. In particular, analysis of available information suggests inflationary pressures are coming in and their base appears to expand. This judgment is based on the lingering presence of high prices in world markets, relatively stable demand for goods and services in the country, increased utilization of productive capacities, and the expected inflation rate of economic agents. In these circumstances, the Supervisory Council decided to continue the process of normalization of the monetary policy stance. This normalization is needed to control inflationary pressures and return inflation to target within 2024. In this way, the Bank of Albania will help maintain internal monetary and financial stability and create suitable conditions for sustainable and long-term growth of the Albanian economy. *** Consumer price inflation marked further growth in the third quarter. This inflation recorded an average value of 7.9% during the quarter, showing a progressive increase during it. In the view of the consumer basket, the rise in inflation reflected  to the greatest extent  the rise in the price of food, oil and transportation costs. These groups generated about 80% of total inflation in the third quarter. However, price growth has begun to be present in most of the basket, including those items whose most value added is created in the country. This performance suggests simultaneously increasing baseline and intensity of inflationary pressures. In the macroeconomic view, inflation growth reflects  to the greatest extent  the strong pressures coming from the foreign environment, but also an increased contribution from the domestic environment. The increase in domestic inflationary pressures reflects the action of three factors. First, the good cyclical position of the Albanian economy, which stems from the stable demand for goods and services and implies a high utilization of domestic productive capacities, has been accompanied by rapid wage growth. Second, high prices of raw materials, oil and energy bring a further increase in domestic production costs. Third, rising expected inflation impacts the price of futures contracts. Despite these shocks, the Albanian economy has been growing in 2022. According to INSTAT data, the Albanian economy grew by 2.2% in the second quarter. The data suggests that economic growth has remained in positive territory in the third quarter. It was supported by the expansion of private consumption and export of goods and services. This performance was reflected in the expansion of the services, agriculture and certain branches of the industry sector, as well as in further increases in employment and wages in the private sector. The latter recorded an annual growth rate of 11.9% in the second quarter, illustrating both solid labour demand and the continued decline in the unemployment rate. The expansion of economic activity has continued to be supported by a stimulating financial environment, although the intensity of the monetary stimulus has come towards reduction. Financial markets in the country remain calm, liquidity in them is sufficient to meet the needs of the economy, interest rates are still accommodating, while the exchange rate continues to appear strong and stable. This financial environment has enabled the maintenance of credit growth rates for the private sector. In September, this portfolio registered an annual growth of 13.9%, covering the needs for funds  in lek and in currency  of Albanian businesses and families. However, the pace of growth of the economy has come to a slowdown after the first quarter. This slowdown reflects the negative effects emanating from high inflation levels, at home and globally. Among other things, these effects appear in the form of increased uncertainty of businesses, forced tightening of financing conditions, shrinking of purchasing power of households, and the expensive import bill of the Albanian economy. Our base scenario projections for the next two years suggest that the Albanian economy will continue to grow and inflationary pressures will come to a reduction. Inflation is expected to remain high in the fourth quarter of the current year, but to progressively reduce through 2023 and return to target in the second quarter of 2024. This projection remains conditional on the lingering process of normalization of the monetary policy stance. It also factors our expectations for stabilizing prices in foreign markets and for further expansion of economic activity in the country. The country's economic growth is expected to remain in positive territory, though the pace of growth will come to a slowdown in the short term and accelerate in the medium term. Economic growth will continue to be fuelled by sound balance sheets of businesses and households, further expansion of Albanian exports, and reduced uncertainty in response to expected reduction in inflation. The expansion of economic activity will continue to benefit from a stable monetary and financial environment. In particular, the sound and liquid financial balance sheets of the banking sector provide guarantees that this sector will continue to support Albanian businesses and households with funds, helping both to expand consumption and investments and to cover temporary liquidity needs. However, the Bank of Albania stresses that the overall environment remains challenging and projections for the future are surrounded by increased uncertainty. These uncertainties remain on the upper side for inflation and on the downside for economic growth. *** Based on the above, the Bank of Albania's Supervisory Council reaffirmed its judgment that high inflationary pressures remain the main risk to the country's sustainable and long-term growth. For this reason, in respect of the objective of price stability, the Supervisory Council decided: the increase the base interest rate by 0.5 percentage points, from 2.25% to 2.75%; the increase the interest rate of the one-day loan by 0.5 percentage point, from the level of 3.25% to the level of 3.75%; the increase the interest rate of one day deposit by 0.5 percentage point, from 1.25% to 1.75% level. In the Council's judgment, the gradual normalization of the monetary policy stance, from its still-stimulating position in current treatments to a more neutral position, is a necessary measure for respecting our price inflation target. In this view, this normalization serves the overall economic and financial stability of the country, sustainable and long-term growth, and improved social welfare. Consistent with past communications and our medium-term forecasts, the Supervisory Council stresses that the normalization cycle of monetary policy will continue in the near future. In any case, the speed of normalization will be consistent with new data and sufficient to respect our medium-term inflation target. The Supervisory Council shall carefully monitor the situation to assess the implications for inflation performance in a timely way and to identify the measures necessary for its effective administration.
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 2 nntor 2022 Data e publikimit: 02.11.2022 T nderuar prfaqsues t medias, Sot, n datn 2 nntor 2022, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris mori n shqyrtim dhe miratoi Raportin Tremujor t Politiks Monetare. Ky Raport konstaton se pasojat e goditjes s oferts t huaj n ekonomin shqiptare po bhen gjithnj e m t dukshme. N veanti, analiza e informacionit t disponuar sugjeron se presionet inflacioniste po vijn n rritje dhe baza e tyre shfaqet n zgjerim. Ky gjykim bazohet n vijimin e pranis s mimeve t larta n tregjet botrore, krkesn relativisht t qndrueshme pr mallra e shrbime n vend, shfrytzimin n rritje t kapaciteteve prodhuese, si dhe n rritjen e nivelit t pritur t inflacionit nga agjentt ekonomik. N kto rrethana, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi t vijoj procesin e normalizimit t qndrimit t politiks monetare. Ky normalizim sht i nevojshm pr kontrollin e presioneve inflacioniste dhe kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv brenda vitit 2024. N kt mnyr, Banka e Shqipris do t ndihmoj ruajtjen e stabilitetit t brendshm monetar dhe financiar dhe do t krijoj kushte t prshtatshme pr rritjen e qndrueshme dhe afatgjat t ekonomis shqiptare. *** Inflacioni i mimeve t konsumit shnoi rritje t mtejshme n tremujorin e tret. Ky inflacion regjistroi nj vler mesatare prej 7.9% gjat tremujorit, duke shfaqur dhe rritje progresive gjat tij. N kndvshtrimin e shports s konsumit, rritja e inflacionit pasqyroi  n masn m t madhe  rritjen e mimit t ushqimeve, t nafts dhe t kostove t transportit. Kta grupartikuj gjeneruan rreth 80% t inflacionit total n tremujorin e tret. Megjithat, rritja e mimeve ka filluar t jet e pranishme n pjesn m t madhe t shports, prfshi edhe ata artikuj pjesa m e madhe e vlers s shtuar t t cilve krijohet n vend. Kjo ecuri sugjeron rritjen e njkohshme t bazs dhe t intensitetit t presioneve inflacioniste. N kndvshtrimin makroekonomik, rritja e inflacionit pasqyron  n masn m t madhe  presionet e forta q vijn nga ambienti i huaj, por dhe nj kontribut n rritje nga ambienti i brendshm. Rritja e presioneve t brendshme inflacioniste pasqyron veprimin e tre faktorve. S pari, pozicioni i mir ciklik i ekonomis shqiptare, pozicion i cili buron nga krkesa e qndrueshme pr mallra e shrbime dhe nnkupton nj shfrytzim t lart t kapaciteteve t brendshme prodhuese, sht shoqruar me rritje t shpejt t pagave. S dyti, mimet e larta t lndve t para, t nafts dhe t energjis, sjellin nj rritje t mtejshme t kostove t brendshme t prodhimit. S treti, rritja e inflacionit t pritur ndikon n rritjen e mimeve t kontratave t s ardhmes. Edhe prball ktyre goditjeve, ekonomia shqiptare ka vijuar t rritet gjat vitit 2022. Sipas t dhnave t INSTAT-it, ekonomia shqiptare u rrit me 2.2% n tremujorin e dyt. T dhnat e trthorta sugjerojn se rritja ekonomike ka vijuar t mbetet n territor pozitiv edhe n tremujorin e tret. Ajo u mbshtet nga zgjerimi i konsumit privat dhe i eksportit t mallrave e t shrbimeve. Kjo ecuri u pasqyrua n zgjerimin e sektorit t shrbimeve, t bujqsis dhe t degve t caktuara t sektorit t industris, si dhe n rritjen e mtejshme t punsimit dhe t pagave n sektorin privat. Kto t fundit shnuan nj rritje vjetore prej 11.9% n tremujorin e dyt, duke ilustruar si krkesn solide pr pun ashtu edhe rnien e vazhdueshme t norms s papunsis. Zgjerimi i aktivitetit ekonomik ka vijuar t mbshtetet nga nj ambient financiar stimulues, ndonse intensiteti i stimulit monetar ka ardhur drejt reduktimit. Tregjet financiare n vend vijojn t jen t qeta, likuiditeti n to sht i mjaftueshm pr plotsimin e nevojave t ekonomis, normat e interesit jan ende akomoduese, ndrsa kursi i kmbimit vijon t shfaqet i fort dhe i qndrueshm. Ky ambient financiar ka mundsuar ruajtjen e ritmeve t rritjes s kredis pr sektorin privat. N muajin shtator, ky portofol regjistroi nj rritje vjetore prej 13.9%, duke mbuluar nevojat pr fonde  n lek e n valut  t bizneseve dhe familjeve shqiptare. Megjithat, ritmi i rritjes s ekonomis ka ardhur n ngadalsim pas tremujorit t par. Ky ngadalsim pasqyron efektet negative q burojn nga nivelet e larta t inflacionit, n vend dhe n bot. Ndr t tjera, kto efekte shfaqen n formn e rritjes s pasiguris s bizneseve, t shtrngimit t detyruar t kushteve t financimit, t tkurrjes s fuqis blerse t familjeve, si dhe t shtrenjtimit t faturs s importit t ekonomis shqiptare. Projeksionet tona t skenarit baz pr dy vitet e ardhshme, sugjerojn se ekonomia shqiptare do t vijoj t rritet dhe presionet inflacioniste do t vijn n reduktim. Inflacioni pritet t mbetet i lart n tremujorin e katrt t vitit aktual, por t reduktohet progresivisht gjat vitit 2023 dhe t kthehet n objektiv n tremujorin e dyt t vitit 2024. Ky projeksion mbetet i kushtzuar nga vijimi i procesit t normalizimit t qndrimit t politiks monetare. Gjithashtu, ai faktorizon pritjet tona pr stabilizimin e mimeve n tregjet e huaja dhe pr zgjerimin e mtejshm t aktivitetit ekonomik n vend. Rritja ekonomike e vendit pritet t mbetet n territor pozitiv, ndonse ritmi i rritjes do t vij n ngadalsim n afatin e shkurtr dhe do t prshpejtohet n afatin e mesm. Rritja ekonomike do t vijoj t ushqehet nga bilancet e shndosha t bizneseve dhe familjeve, nga zgjerimi i mtejshm i eksporteve shqiptare, si dhe nga ulja e pasiguris n prgjigje t reduktimit t pritur t inflacionit. Po ashtu, zgjerimi i aktivitetit ekonomik do t vijoj t prfitoj nga nj ambient i qndrueshm monetar dhe financiar. N veanti, bilancet financiare t shndosha dhe likuide t sektorit bankar japin garanci se ky sektor do t vijoj t mbshtes me fonde bizneset dhe familjet shqiptare, duke ndihmuar si zgjerimin e konsumit dhe t investimeve ashtu edhe mbulimin e nevojave t prkohshme pr likuiditet. Megjithat, Banka e Shqipris thekson se ambienti i prgjithshm mbetet sfidues dhe projeksionet pr t ardhmen rrethohen nga pasiguri t shtuara. Kto pasiguri qndrojn n kahun e siprm pr inflacionin dhe n kahun e poshtm pr rritjen ekonomike. *** Bazuar n sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris rikonfirmoi gjykimin e tij se presionet e larta inflacioniste mbeten rreziku kryesor mbi rritjen e qndrueshme dhe afatgjat t vendit. Pr kt arsye, n respektim t objektivit t stabilitetit t mimeve, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi: t rris me 0.5 pik prqindje normn baz t interesit, nga niveli 2.25% n nivelin 2.75%; t rris me 0.5 pik prqindje normn e interesit t kredis njditore, nga niveli 3.25% n nivelin 3.75%; t rris me 0.5 pik prqindje normn e interesit t depozits njditore, nga niveli 1.25% n nivelin 1.75%. N gjykimin e Kshillit, normalizimi gradual i qndrimit t politiks monetare, nga pozicioni ende stimulues i saj n trajtat aktuale n nj pozicion m neutral, sht nj mas e domosdoshme pr respektimin e objektivit ton t inflacionit t mimeve. N kt kndvshtrim, ky normalizim i shrben stabilitetit t prgjithshm ekonomik dhe financiar t vendit, rritjes s qndrueshme dhe afatgjat, dhe prmirsimit t mirqenies sociale. N konsistenc me komunikimet e kaluara dhe me parashikimet tona afatmesme, Kshilli Mbikqyrs thekson se cikli normalizues i politiks monetare do t vijoj edhe n t ardhmen e afrt. N do rast, shpejtsia e normalizimit do t jet n prputhje me t dhnat e reja dhe e mjaftueshme pr t respektuar objektivin ton afatmesm t inflacionit. Kshilli Mbikqyrs do t monitoroj me kujdes situatn pr t vlersuar n koh implikimet pr ecurin e inflacionit dhe pr t identifikuar n koh masat e nevojshme pr administrimin efektiv t saj.

Title: Governor Seyko's address at the VIII meeting of the National Payment Systems Committee
text: Governor Sejko's remarks at the 8th Meeting of the National Committee of Payment Systems Date of publication: 09.11.2022 Mr. Mr. Minister, Honorable participant, It is a special pleasure to open this 8th meeting of the National Committee of payment system, which fortunately takes place with physical participation, which shows that some challenges have already been overcome.
