At the same time, other challenges have been generated, putting an added direct and indirect pressure on the joint several years of work to promote financial inclusion and the use of electronic payments in the Albanian economy. However, despite the problems created by the pandemic, the Bank of Albania has intensified efforts in this regard. In the role of monetary authority, regulator and supervisor, the Bank considers financial inclusion and financial education as two strategic objectives important for monetary and financial stability, formalization of the economy and its sustainable development. In this context, it seems that the measures taken so far have reflected very positive developments in the market, enabling the fulfillment of the quantitative targets intended almost halfway through the Action Plan of the National Small Value Payment Strategy. Specifically, in 2021, an electronic payment usage level of 12.5 payments per capita has been reached, exceeding the strategy's target target of 10 payments by the end of 2023, while by 2022, it is estimated that this figure will reach 16 payments per capita. We can now say that card payments and homebanking are increasingly becoming part of the daily life of Albanians, while from the financial inclusion point of view developments seem quite encouraging. Specifically: the volumes of card payments have increased significantly, especially during the last five years (2018-2022), marking an average growth trend of about 40% per year; It also increased by 78% in the number of POS terminals during the same period. These indicators are evidence of the increasing use of electronic instruments by consumers, which positively affects the formalization of the economy. Also, from the available data regarding the volume of homebanking transactions for this 9-month period, it appears that an increase of 22% has been recorded compared to the same period of a year ago, following the growing trend over the years. Thanks to the data from the National Register of Accounts, the Bank of Albania has a more accurate and easily updated view of the financial inclusion of the population. This data dictates that Albanians have a relatively satisfactory level of financial inclusion, where almost 69% of the population owns an account. Our objective was initially to achieve a level of financial inclusion of the population to the extent of 70%, but we estimate that in the short term this level will be exceeded, marking a significant approximation with the Balkan countries and those of the European Union. This optimism is based on a range of factors and analyses. More specifically, despite our public communications we have mentioned achieving the objectives of most of the measures envisaged in the strategy, they are still materializing in the market and their expected effects will be reflected in measurable indicators in 2023 and beyond. Simply put, the achievements so far in terms of financial inclusion and the use of electronic payments are a reaction to our messages, while the real and meaningful effects of the strategy will be presented in full in the short and medium term. More specifically, we assess that the law "On payment services" is indeed the main pillar of promoting innovation and competition, which can be observed in the added interest of the entities seeking to enter this market segment, but its full materialization will occur with the operationalization of open-banking. In this regard, I appreciate it necessary to emphasize that the commitment of banks and non-banks should be maximal, so that these infrastructures and related services can be realized within the deadlines set by the Bank of Albania, always providing maximum security. Security in communication and interaction is not only necessary, but also necessary, in the conditions of open communication that openbanking imposes, as well as in the context of the increased risks in the cybersecurity sphere that we are facing recently. This was also the main reason for which the Bank of Albania was careful both in setting the well-defined and widely proven regulation standards of the European Union countries, as well as in creating necessary time zones that would enable a more efficient and safe implementation for all market actors. However, in addition to these legal and regulatory developments, the Bank has also undertaken a series of other measures, such as the creation and operation of the AIPS-EURO system for interbank payments in Euro within the country. Now, Albanians, in their daily life, are feeling the effects of this system, which has made it possible to avoid long queues at bank counters to make payments in euros from one bank to another, and reduce the high commissions applied by transferring through correspondent banks. The creation of this system, along with differentiating commissions for electronic payments processed in it, seems to have been quite effective. In more detail, from January to the end of October this year, through the AIPS EURO system, about 120 thousand payments have been processed and it turns out that, for this period, Albanian consumers and businesses have been saved approximately 10 million euros. In this regard, it can be said that the project has direct and indirect effects on the individual welfare of the client, the bank, as well as the economy as a whole. The Bank of Albania also considers that the regulation of direct interbank debit further encourages the creation of a more efficient market, offering a variety of services and payment instruments, which meet the daily needs of the citizens. In this regard, it is worth noting that since May, the Bank of Albania, the Ministry of Finance and Economy, THE AKSH and the banking system are cooperating closely, with the aim of creating all possible alternatives for carrying out remote payments through electronic means. We believe that achieving such a goal is very significant in fostering financial inclusion, education and public familiarity with the use of electronic payments. In this regard, we have the full confidence that, based on the experiences of other countries, the digitalization of government payments constitutes one of the most powerful levers for achieving the goals of the National Small Value Payment Strategy. Also, coordinating efforts in this direction can be considered as the first step towards a wide range of measures, which could be taken in the future. Another important measure being taken is the drafting and implementation of the draft law "On the account of basic services payments", which will transpose the relevant Directive of the European Union. This bill aims to create facilities from the point of view of the costs in carrying out the opening of bank accounts and its use for payments by that segment of the population that is not financially involved or has limited access. The draft law also provides for the provision of basic accounts, without commissions, for certain categories of the population such as pensioners, students and persons who benefit from economic aid. In order to support market developments, the Bank of Albania is also working towards improving payment systems for introducing new standards of communication and services, which help address the infrastructural needs for the implementation of the strategy. Also, together with the market stakeholders, we will intensify efforts to implement the Instant Payment project. Last but not least, in the framework of the more efficient materialization of the measures analyzed in this strategy and beyond, the creation and implementation of a National Strategy for Financial Education is being worked on. In our assessment, financial inclusion and education are two components entirely related to mutual achievements, and, as I mentioned before, they constitute strategic objectives for the Bank of Albania. I would like to conclude my speech by thanking the Ministry of Finance and Economy, the banking system, as well as all market actors for the continuous cooperation and coordination of efforts, which made possible the implementation of this reform so far. I also want to emphasize that it is necessary to continue with the same intensity and seriousness the fulfillment of the remaining measures of this strategy. I wish you the most productive and constructive activity!
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n mbledhjen VIII t Komitetit Kombtar t Sistemeve t Pagesave Data e publikimit: 09.11.2022 E nderuar zj. Ministre, T nderuar pjesmarrs, sht nj knaqsi e veant t hap kt mbledhje t 8-t t Komitetit Kombtar t Sistemit t Pagesave, q fatmirsisht zhvillohet me pjesmarrje fizike, ka tregon se tashm disa sfida jan tejkaluar. Njkohsisht t tjera sfida jan gjeneruar, duke ushtruar nj presion t shtuar t drejtprdrejt dhe t trthort n punn e prbashkt disavjeare pr nxitjen e prfshirjes financiare dhe prdorimin e pagesave elektronike n ekonomin shqiptare. Megjithat, pavarsisht problematikave t krijuara nga pandemia, Banka e Shqipris ka intensifikuar prpjekjet n kt drejtim. N rolin e autoritetit monetar, rregullator e mbikqyrs, Banka i vlerson prfshirjen financiare dhe edukimin financiar si dy objektiva strategjik mjaft t rndsishm pr stabilitetin monetar e financiar, formalizmin e ekonomis dhe zhvillimin e qndrueshm t saj. N kt kuadr, duket se masat e marra deri m tani kan reflektuar zhvillime mjaft pozitive n treg, duke br t mundur prmbushjen e objektivave sasior t synuar pothuajse n gjysmn e rrugtimit t Planit t Veprimit t Strategjis Kombtare t Pagesave me Vler t Vogl. Konkretisht, n vitin 2021 sht arritur nj nivel i prdorimit t pagesave elektronike prej 12.5 pagesash pr frym, duke tejkaluar edhe objektivin e synuar t Strategjis prej 10 pagesash deri n fund t vitit 2023, ndrkoh q, n vitin 2022, vlersohet se kjo shifr do t arrij nivelin 16 pagesa pr frym. Tashm mund t themi q pagesat me kart dhe ato homebanking gjithnj e m shum po bhen pjes e prditshmris s shqiptarve, ndrkoh q dhe nga pikpamja e prfshirjes financiare zhvillimet duken mjaft inkurajuese. Konkretisht: volumet e pagesave me kart jan rritur ndjeshm, sidomos gjat pesvjearit t fundit (2018-2022), duke shnuar nj trend mesatar rrits prej rreth 40% n vit; si dhe sht shnuar nj rritjen e konsiderueshme me 78% e numrit t terminaleve POS gjat s njjts periudhe. Kta tregues jan dshmi e rritjes s prdorimit t instrumenteve elektronike nga konsumatort, gj q ndikon pozitivisht edhe n formalizimin e ekonomis. Gjithashtu, nga t dhnat e disponuara sa i takon volumit t transaksioneve homebanking pr kt 9-mujor, rezulton se sht shnuar nj rritje prej 22%, krahasuar me t njjtn periudh t nj viti m par, duke vijuar trendin rrits t shfaqur ndr vite. Fal t dhnave nga Regjistri Kombtar i Llogarive, Banka e Shqipris disponon nj pamje m t sakt dhe lehtsisht t prditsueshme mbi prfshirjen financiare t popullsis. Kto t dhna diktojn se shqiptart kan nj nivel relativisht t knaqshm t prfshirjes financiare, ku pothuajse 69% e popullsis zotron nj llogari. Objektivi yn fillimisht ishte arritja e nj niveli t prfshirjes financiare t popullsis n masn 70%, por vlersojm se n periudhn afatshkurtr ky nivel do t tejkalohet, duke shnuar prafrim t ndjeshm me vendet e Ballkanit dhe ato t Bashkimit Evropian. Ky optimizm bazohet n nj sr faktorsh dhe analizash. M konkretisht, pavarsisht se n komunikimet tona publike ne kemi prmendur arritjen e objektivave t shumics s masave t parashikuara n strategji, ato jan ende duke u materializuar n treg dhe efektet e tyre t pritura do t reflektohen n tregues t matshm n vitin 2023 dhe n vijim. E thn m thjesht, arritjet e deritanishme n terma t prfshirjes financiare dhe t prdorimit t pagesave elektronike jan deri diku reagim ndaj mesazheve tona, ndrkoh q efektet reale dhe domethnse t strategjis do t paraqiten t plota n periudhn afatshkurtr e afatmesme. M konkretisht, ne vlersojm se ligji Pr shrbimet e pagesave vrtet prbn shtylln kryesore t nxitjes s inovacionit dhe t konkurrencs, gj q mund t vihet re edhe n interesin e shtuar t subjekteve q krkojn t hyn n kt segment t tregut, por materializimi i plot i tij do t ndodh me operacionalizimin e open-banking. N kt drejtim, e vlersoj t nevojshme t theksoj se angazhimi i bankave dhe jobankave duhet t jet maksimal, n mnyr q kto infrastruktura dhe shrbimet prkatse t realizohen brenda afateve t prcaktuara nga Banka e Shqipris, gjithmon duke ofruar siguri maksimale. Siguria n komunikim dhe n ndrveprim sht jo vetm e nevojshme, por edhe e domosdoshme, n kushtet e komunikimit t hapur q imponon openbanking, si dhe n kuadr t rreziqeve t shtuara n sfern e siguris kibernetike, me t cilat po prballemi s fundmi. Kjo ka qen edhe arsyeja kryesore pr t ciln Banka e Shqipris ka qen e kujdesshme si n vendosjen e standardeve t rregullimit t mirprcaktuara dhe gjersisht t provuara nga vendet e Bashkimit Evropian, ashtu edhe n krijimin e hapsirave t nevojshme kohore q do t mundsonin nj zbatim sa m efikas dhe t sigurt pr t gjith aktort e tregut. Megjithat, krahas ktyre zhvillimeve ligjore e rregullative, Banka ka ndrmarr edhe nj sr masash t tjera, si krijimi dhe operimi i sistemit AIPS-EURO pr pagesat ndrbankare n Euro brenda vendit. Tashm shqiptart, n prditshmrin e tyre, po ndjejn efektet e ktij sistemi, i cili i ka br t mundur shmangien e radhve t gjata npr sportelet e bankave pr kryerjen e pagesave n euro nga njra bank n tjetrn, dhe uljen e komisioneve t larta t aplikuara nga transferimi nprmjet bankave korrespondente. Krijimi i ktij sistemi, s bashku me diferencimin e komisioneve pr pagesat elektronike t procesuara n t, duket se ka qen mjaft efektiv. M n detaje, nga janari deri n fund t muajit tetor t ktij viti, nprmjet sistemit AIPS EURO, jan procesuar rreth 120 mij pagesa dhe rezulton se, pr kt periudh, konsumatorve dhe bizneseve shqiptare tu jen kursyer prafrsisht 10 milion euro. N kt kndvshtrim, mund t thuhet se projekti ka efekte t drejtprdrejta dhe t trthorta n mirqenien individuale t klientit, t banks, si dhe t ekonomis n trsi. Banka e Shqipris vlerson gjithashtu se rregullimi i debitimit direkt ndrbankar nxit m tej krijimin e nj tregu sa m efikas, duke ofruar nj larmishmri shrbimesh dhe instrumentesh pagese, t cilat plotsojn nevojat e prditshme t qytetarve. N kt drejtim, vlen t theksohet se q prej muajit maj, Banka e Shqipris, Ministria e Financave dhe Ekonomis, AKSH-i dhe sistemi bankar po bashkpunojn ngusht, me qllim krijimin e t gjitha alternativave t mundshme pr kryerjen e pagesave n distanc, nprmjet mjeteve elektronike. Ne vlersojm se arritja e nj qllimi t till sht shum domethnse n nxitjen e prfshirjes financiare, edukimit dhe familjarizimit t publikut me prdorimin e pagesave elektronike. N kt drejtim, ne kemi besimin e plot se, bazuar edhe n eksperiencat e vendeve t tjera, dixhitalizimi i pagesave t qeveris prbn nj nga levat m t fuqishme pr arritjen e synimeve t Strategjis Kombtare t Pagesave me Vler t Vogl. Po ashtu, edhe bashkrendimi i prpjekjeve n kt drejtim mund t konsiderohet si hapi i par drejt nj game t gjer masash, t cilat mund t merren n t ardhmen. Nj mas tjetr e rndsishme q po ndrmerret sht edhe hartimi dhe zbatimi i projektligjit Pr llogarin e pagesave me shrbime bazike, i cili do t transpozoj direktivn prkatse t Bashkimit Evropian. Ky projektligj synon t krijoj lehtsira nga pikpamja e kostove t mbartura n hapjen e llogarive bankare dhe prdorimit t saj pr pagesa nga ana e atij segmenti t popullsis q nuk sht i prfshir financiarisht ose ka akses t limituar. Projektligji parashikon njkohsisht edhe ofrimin e llogaris bazike, pa komisione, pr kategori t caktuara t popullsis si pensionistt, studentt dhe personat q prfitojn ndihma ekonomike. Me qllim mbshtetjen e zhvillimeve t tregut, Banka e Shqipris po punon gjithashtu edhe n drejtim t prmirsimit t sistemeve t pagesave pr prezantimin e standardeve t reja t komunikimit dhe shrbimeve, t cilat ndihmojn n adresimin e nevojave infrastrukturore pr zbatimin e strategjis. Gjithashtu, s bashku me aktort e tregut, ne do t intensifikojm prpjekjet pr realizimin e projektit Instant Payment. S fundi, por jo m pak e rndsishme, n kuadr t materializimit sa m efikas t masave t analizuara n kt strategji dhe m gjer, po punohet pr krijimin dhe zbatimin e nj Strategjie Kombtare pr Edukimin Financiar. N vlersimin ton, prfshirja dhe edukimi financiar jan dy komponent trsisht t ndrlidhur me arritje t ndrsjella, dhe, si e prmenda dhe m par, ata prbjn objektiva strategjik pr Bankn e Shqipris. Dshiroj t prfundoj fjaln time duke falnderuar veanrisht Ministrin e Financave dhe Ekonomis, sistemin bankar, si dhe t gjith aktort e tregut pr bashkpunimin e vazhdueshm dhe bashkrendimin e prpjekjeve, ka bri t mundur realizimin e deritanishm t ksaj reforme. Gjithashtu, dshiroj t theksoj se sht e nevojshme t vijojm me t njjtin intensitet dhe seriozitet prmbushjen e masave t mbetura t ksaj strategjie. Ju uroj nj aktivitet sa m t frytshm e konstruktiv!

Title: Remarks of Governor Sejko at the press conference on monetary policy decision making, 21 December 2022
text: Remarks of Governor Sejko at the press conference on monetary policy decision making, 21 December 2022 Date of publication: 21.12.2022 Dear representatives of the media, Today, on 21 December 2022, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Intermediate Monetary Policy Report for the fourth quarter. The Supervisory Council found that the effect of foreign shock continues to be present in the Albanian economy. However, the inflation trajectory appears to have marked a turn towards a reduction in the fourth quarter, while economic activity continues to be under pressure from increased prices and heightened uncertainty. The updated forecasts for the future suggests inflation will return to target in the first half of 2024. Also, the Albanian economy is expected to grow in the future, although the pace of growth is expected to slow down in the short term and grow towards potential in the medium term. The Supervisory Council assessed that the normalization of the monetary policy stance has contributed to the mitigation of inflationary pressures, through controlling inflation expectations, reducing uncertainty and maintaining stability in financial markets, as well as ensuring the sustainability of our national currency. Based on these considerations, at today's meeting, the Supervisory Council decided not to change the stance of monetary policy. This decision factors in the reduction of inflation at home and abroad in November, and enables us to reassess the normalization speed of the monetary policy stance, in order to respect the price stability objective and maintain positive growth rates. I will explain in more detail today's decision and the reasons that motivated it. Consumer price inflation marked a slight increase in October and a moderate reduction in november. The respective inflation rates in those two months were 8.3% and 7.9%. In the view of the consumer basket, the inflation performance in these two months was determined by the decline in the price of oil and transportation costs, as well as by the opposite fluctuations in food prices. Inflation of other basket items displayed lesser fluctuations. However, with the exception of electricity prices, the inflation rate of almost all basket items remains at historically high levels and shows clear signs of influence from foreign shock. In the macroeconomic view, inflation performance was determined by reducing the direct effect of imported inflation. This phenomenon was present and in the inflation performance of our main trading partners. However, beyond direct effect, the high level of inflation continues to be fuelled by their transmission to the cost of goods and services, as well as the relatively stable demand for goods and services in the country, which ensures a high degree of capacity exploitation, especially in the labour market. The analysis of available information suggests that economic activity continued to increase in the second half of the year. However, similar to the second quarter, the pace of economic growth has shown signs of slowing, as a result of uncertainties about the future, rising production costs and a reduction in foreign demand. These consequences have manifested in the form of expensive import bills, as well as slower performance of private and public investment. In the third quarter, the labor market showed a very positive performance. Employment in the economy grew by 4.2% in annual terms, the unemployment rate dropped to the new historical minimum of 10.6%, while average pay in the private sector marked an annual increase of 12.4%. This performance demonstrates that aggregate demand in the country remains solid enough to generate employment and wage growth. It illustrates, likewise, the fact that the fundamentals of the country's economic growth are relatively healthy. Financial markets are still quiet. The exchange rate of lek against the euro has been strengthening tendencies, while the transmission of normalization of monetary policy stance, both at home and in the eurozone, is increasingly full. However, even though the interest rates of the main financial products - deposits, loans and government securities - have been rising, they remain accommodative to growth. In response, the annual loan continues to show positive monthly flows, although the pace of growth was slowing during October. At the same time, the quality of the loan portfolio is satisfactory and there are improvement trends. Our baseline scenario projections suggest that the Albanian economy will continue to grow and inflationary pressures will decrease over the next two years. Inflation is expected to mark a turning point during the fourth quarter of 2022, reduce progressively during 2023 and return to target in the second quarter of 2024. This forecast is based on the expected reduction of inflation in the world environment, on the progressive reduction of the effects of the second round in the country, and on maintaining positive economic growth rates over the coming period. Economic growth is expected to remain moderate in the first half of next year and gradually converge towards its historical rates in the coming period, providing a more balanced ratio between demand and supply in the country. The projections update for the future have confirmed our previous expectations. However, this update has suggested the need for a more gradual normalisation of the monetary policy stance. *** Based on the above, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania decided: the Keep the basic interest rate unchanged, at 2.75%; the Keep unchanged the interest rate of the one-day loan at 3.75%; the Keep unchanged the interest rate of the one-day deposit at 1.75%. The Supervisory Council reaffirms its judgment that high inflationary pressures remain the main risk to the country's sustainable and long-term growth. Also, he stresses that, based on current information, further normalization of the monetary policy stance remains a necessary measure for respecting our price inflation target. This normalization becomes even more necessary, in the presence of a balance of risk to inflation, which still sits on the upper side. In line with previous communications, the Supervisory Council stresses that the speed and intensity of this normalization has been and will remain a process guided by new data. The monetary policy stance will aim to ensure the necessary conditions for respecting the price stability objective in the medium term, while at the same time taking care to minimize their impact on curbing economic activity. The Supervisory Council will monitor the situation carefully to assess the progress of inflationary pressures and to identify the measures necessary to achieve the target. ***** Dear representatives of the media, Taking advantage of this public communication, which is also the last for 2022, I want to  in respect of tradition  give a brief overview of the work of the Bank of Albania during the year that we left behind. As it has already become present, this was another challenging year for the Albanian economy, at macro and microeconomic level, for monetary and financial stability, as well as for public and private sector decision makers. As the country's monetary authority, as a key institution in maintaining financial stability, in the development of the financial market and in improving the payment system, as well as a constitutional institution charged with a range of functions that promote the sustainable economic and social development of the country, the Bank of Albania has made an important contribution to addressing these challenges. I will list some of the main directions of our work. First, we have initiated a normalization cycle of monetary policy stance during 2022, raising the base interest rate from the historical minimum of 0.5% at the beginning of the year to the 2.75% level at the end of it. This action of our monetary policy was similar to that of all other central banks, across the globe. He was motivated by a strong and unprecedented price crackdown on the foreign market, a blow stemming from Russia's sudden military aggression against Ukraine and which threatened price stability around the world. Normalising the stance of monetary policy was a necessary and prudent process. This normalization was a necessary process because it creates the necessary premises for respecting our inflation target, which is and remains not only our legal mandate but also the best contribution we can make to economic growth and social well-being in the medium and long term. The history of the economy teaches that periods of high inflation are associated with low and fluctuating economic growth, with fewer jobs created, and lower wages and incomes for a large part of society. At the same time, this normalization has been a careful process, guided by careful analysis of new information, aiming that the necessary monetary measures to control inflation have a lower cost on economic activity. This philosophy will guide our monetary policy decision-making over the next year. Second, we have contributed to the provision of a sound and efficient financial system, through strengthening the legal and regulatory framework, through careful supervision of banking activity and intensive cooperation with counterpart authorities, and through the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing. In parallel, during 2022, we updated the annual cycle of emergency intervention plans and carefully administered the Extraordinary Intervention Fund, which has been continuously growing and provides an additional guarantee for coping with financial shocks. In parallel with our work, I am pleased to find that Albanian banks enjoy good capital reserves, liquidity and low rates of non-performing loans; The latter fell to 5% in October, the lowest level in history. Our resistance tests also show that the banking system is, on the whole, resistant to even more extreme shocks, and capable of supporting the economy. Third, we have provided modern efficient payment-making systems and have met the economy's demands for physical money, strengthening confidence in our monetary and financial system. Thanks to a few years of work, the financial inclusion of the population and the use of electronic payment instruments has increased, as evidenced by the higher number of Albanians with bank accounts and electronic payments. Meanwhile, the operationalization of the Euro payment system within the country has significantly reduced costs and saved Albanians around 10 million euros. Also, during 2022, we completed the series of new banknotes with the last two denominations, respectively with 500 and 2000 LEke. Fourth, we have continued the work on managing the foreign exchange reserve of Albania, respecting the best criteria in the field of liquidity and security. In operational terms, I would also like to mention the measures we have taken for a wider participation of individuals in government securities auctions, reducing fluctuations in financial markets and enabling a better tracking of monetary policy in the markets. Fifth, we have actively contributed to the Process of European integration, as well as strengthened dialogue with domestic and foreign partners. The opening of the negotiations in July 2022 marked not only an important step in the country's progress towards membership, but it required a more intensive engagement in this regard, a commitment to which the Bank of Albania responded in time and in quality. According to the Latest European Commission Progress Report, the Bank of Albania is considered a financially independent institution, with sufficient instruments, competence and administrative capacity to design and implement an effective monetary policy. In the future, we will continue to contribute responsibly to the country's integration process as a life-time aspiration of ours. During the year, we have collaborated with the World Bank and other institutional partners to establish two important strategies at the national level: the Banking System Climate Change Strategy and the Financial Inclusion And Education Strategy. Finally, I would like to emphasize that the Bank of Albania has worked and made progress in all other areas of its activity: financial statistics, communication with the public and economic and social actors, financial education, scientific research, etc. The fulfillment of our objectives and results are guided and supported by a careful, coherent and professional decision-making by the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania. This decision has enshosed the bank's mission, vision and values, as they are revealed in the Medium Term Development Strategy of the Bank of Albania. In its activity, the Council is regularly informed by the internal and external controls on ensuring the correct observance of the law and other acts governing the daily operation of the institution. Finally, let me assure you that the Bank of Albania has been and will remain an institution invested in the overall improvement of the work and in the adoption of the best standards of central banking. The global and internal environment remains challenging, but we will be vigilant against new developments to ensure the fulfillment of our legal duties, in the interest of the welfare of Albanian citizens. Wishing you all a good year!
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 21 dhjetor 2022 Data e publikimit: 21.12.2022 T nderuar prfaqsues t medias, Sot, n datn 21 dhjetor 2022, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris mori n shqyrtim dhe miratoi Raportin e Ndrmjetm t Politiks Monetare pr tremujorin e katrt. Kshilli Mbikqyrs konstatoi se efekti i goditjes s huaj vijon t jet prezent n ekonomin shqiptare. Megjithat, trajektorja e inflacionit duket se ka shnuar nj kthes drejt reduktimit n tremujorin e katrt, ndrsa aktiviteti ekonomik vijon t jet nn presionin e mimeve t rritura dhe t pasiguris s shtuar. Prditsimi i parashikimeve pr t ardhmen sugjeron se inflacioni do t kthehet n objektiv n gjysmn e par t vitit 2024. Po ashtu, ekonomia shqiptare pritet t rritet n t ardhmen, ndonse ritmi i rritjes pritet t vij n ngadalsim n afatin e shkurtr dhe t rritet drejt potencialit n afatin e mesm. Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se normalizimi i deritanishm i qndrimit t politiks monetare ka kontribuuar n zbutjen e presioneve inflacioniste, nprmjet kontrollit t pritjeve pr inflacionin, reduktimit t pasiguris dhe ruajtjes s stabilitetit n tregjet financiare, si dhe garantimit t qndrueshmris s monedhs ton kombtare. Mbshtetur n kto konsiderata, n mbledhjen e sotme, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi t mos ndryshoj qndrimin e politiks monetare. Ky vendim faktorizon reduktimin e inflacionit brenda dhe jasht vendit n muajin nntor, si dhe na mundson nj rivlersim t shpejtsis s normalizimit t qndrimit t politiks monetare, n funksion t respektimit t objektivit t stabilitetit t mimeve dhe t ruajtjes s ritmeve pozitive t rritjes ekonomike. N vijim, do t sqaroj m n detaje vendimin e sotm dhe arsyet q e motivuan. Inflacioni i mimeve t konsumit shnoi nj rritje t leht n muajin tetor dhe nj reduktim t moderuar n muajin nntor. Normat respektive t inflacionit n kto dy muaj ishin 8.3% dhe 7.9%. N kndvshtrimin e shports s konsumit, ecuria e inflacionit n kto dy muaj u prcaktua nga rnia e mimit t nafts dhe t kostove t transportit, si dhe nga luhatje n kahe t kundrta t mimeve t artikujve ushqimor. Inflacioni i artikujve t tjer t shports shfaqi luhatje m t pakta. Gjithsesi, me prjashtim t mimit t energjis elektrike, norma e inflacionit t thuajse t gjith artikujve t shports mbetet n nivele t larta historike dhe shfaq shenja t qarta ndikimi nga goditja e huaj. N kndvshtrimin makroekonomik, ecuria e inflacionit u prcaktua nga reduktimi i efektit direkt t inflacionit t importuar. Ky fenomen ishte i pranishm dhe n ecurin e inflacionit t partnerve tan kryesor tregtar. Megjithat, prtej efektit direkt, niveli i lart i inflacionit vazhdon t ushqehet nga transmetimi i tyre n koston e mallrave dhe shrbimeve, si dhe nga krkesa relativisht e qndrueshme pr mallra e shrbime n vend, e cila siguron nj shkall t lart t shfrytzimit t kapaciteteve, veanrisht n tregu e puns. Analiza e informacionit t disponuar sugjeron se aktiviteti ekonomik ka vijuar t rritet n gjysmn e dyt t vitit. Megjithat, n ngjashmri me tremujorin e dyt, ritmi i rritjes ekonomike ka shfaqur shenja ngadalsimi, si pasoj e pasigurive pr t ardhmen, e rritjes s kostove t prodhimit dhe e reduktimit t krkess s huaj. Kto pasoja jan shfaqur n formn e shtrenjtimit t faturs s importeve, si dhe t nj ecurie m t ngadalt t investimeve private e publike. Prkundrejt tyre, tregu i puns n tremujorin e tret shfaqi nj ecuri mjaft pozitive. Punsimi n ekonomi u rrit me 4.2% n terma vjetor, norma e papunsis zbriti n minimumin e ri historik prej 10.6%, ndrkoh q paga mesatare n sektorin privat shnoi nj rritje vjetore prej 12.4%. Kjo ecuri dshmon se krkesa agregate n vend mbetet solide, e mjaftueshme pr t gjeneruar rritje punsimi dhe pagash. Ajo ilustron, po ashtu, faktin se bazat e rritjes ekonomike t vendit jan relativisht t shndetshme. Tregjet financiare vazhdojn t jen t qeta. Kursi i kmbimit t lekut ndaj euros ka pasur tendenca forcimi, ndrsa transmetimi i normalizimit t qndrimit t politiks monetare, si n vend ashtu edhe n Eurozon, po shfaqet gjithnj e m i plot. Megjithat, edhe pse normat e interesit t produkteve kryesore financiare, - depozitave, kredive dhe letrave me vler t qeveris - kan ardhur n rritje, ato vijojn t mbeten akomoduese pr rritjen. N prgjigje t tyre, kredia vjetore vijon t shfaq flukse mujore pozitive, ndonse ritmi i rritjes ishte n ngadalsim gjat muajit tetor. N t njjtn koh, cilsia e portofolit t kredis sht e knaqshme dhe shfaq tendenca prmirsimi. Projeksionet tona t skenarit baz, sugjerojn se ekonomia shqiptare do t vijoj t rritet dhe presionet inflacioniste do t vijn n reduktim gjat dy viteve t ardhshme. Inflacioni pritet t shnoj nj pik kthese gjat tremujorit t katrt t vitit 2022, t reduktohet progresivisht gjat vitit 2023 dhe t kthehet n objektiv n tremujorin e dyt t vitit 2024. Ky parashikim bazohet n reduktimin e pritur t inflacionit n ambientin botror, n reduktimin progresiv t efekteve t raundit t dyt n vend, si dhe n ruajtjen e normave pozitive t rritjes ekonomike gjat periudhs n vijim. Rritja ekonomike pritet t mbetet e moderuar edhe n gjysmn e par t vitit t ardhshm dhe t konvergoj gradualisht drejt normave t saj historike n periudhn n vijim, duke ofruar nj raport m t balancuar midis krkess dhe oferts n vend. Prditsimi i projeksioneve pr t ardhmen ka konfirmuar pritjet tona t mparshme. Megjithat, ky prditsim ka sugjeruar nevojn e nj normalizimi m gradual t qndrimit t politiks monetare. *** Bazuar n sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris vendosi: t mbaj t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 2.75%; t mbaj t pandryshuar normn e interesit t kredis njditore, n nivelin 3.75%; t mbaj t pandryshuar normn e interesit t depozits njditore, n nivelin 1.75%. Kshilli Mbikqyrs rikonfirmon gjykimin e tij se presionet e larta inflacioniste mbeten rreziku kryesor mbi rritjen e qndrueshme dhe afatgjat t vendit. Gjithashtu, ai thekson se, bazuar n informacionin aktual, normalizimi i mtejshm i qndrimit t politiks monetare mbetet nj mas e nevojshme pr respektimin e objektivit ton t inflacionit t mimeve. Ky normalizim bhet edhe m i nevojshm, n prani t nj balance rreziku pr inflacionin, e cila qndron ende n kahun e siprm. N linj me komunikimet e mparshme, Kshilli Mbikqyrs thekson se shpejtsia dhe intensiteti i ktij normalizimi ka qen dhe do t mbetet nj proces i udhhequr nga t dhnat e reja. Qndrimi i politiks monetare do t synoj t siguroj kushtet e nevojshme pr respektimin e objektivit t stabilitetit t mimeve n afatin e mesm, duke u kujdesur n t njjtn koh t minimizoj ndikimin e tyre n frenimin e aktivitetit ekonomik. Kshilli Mbikqyrs do t monitoroj me kujdes situatn pr t vlersuar n vazhdimsi ecurin e presioneve inflacioniste dhe pr t identifikuar n koh masat e nevojshme pr arritjen e objektivit. ***** T nderuar prfaqsues t medias, Duke prfituar nga ky komunikim publik, i cili sht dhe i fundit pr vitin 2022, dshiroj q  n respekt t tradits  t bj dhe nj pasqyr t shkurtr t puns s Banks s Shqipris gjat vitit q lam pas. Sikundr sht br tashm prezente, ky ishte nj tjetr vit sfidues pr ekonomin shqiptare, n nivel makro dhe mikroekonomik, pr stabilitetin monetar e financiar, si dhe pr vendimmarrsit e sektorit publik dhe privat. Si autoriteti monetar i vendit, si nj institucion ky n ruajtjen e stabilitetit financiar, n zhvillimin e tregut financiar dhe n prmirsimin e sistemit t pagesave, si dhe si nj institucion kushtetues i ngarkuar me nj sr funksionesh t cilat promovojn zhvillimin e qndrueshm ekonomik dhe shoqror t vendit, Banka e Shqipris ka dhn nj kontribut t rndsishm n prballimin e ktyre sfidave. N vijim, do t rendis disa prej drejtimeve kryesore t puns son. S pari, ne kemi iniciuar nj cikl normalizimi t qndrimit t politiks monetare gjat vitit 2022, duke e rritur normn baz t interesit nga minimumi historik prej 0.5% n fillim t vitit, n nivelin 2.75% n fund t tij. Ky aksion i politiks son monetare ishte i ngjashm me at t t gjith bankave t tjera qendrore, anemban globit. Ai u motivua nga goditja e fort dhe e paprecedent e mimeve n tregun e huaj, goditje e cila buroi nga agresioni i papritur ushtarak i Rusis ndaj Ukrains dhe e cila krcnoi stabilitetin e mimeve kudo n bot. Normalizimi i qndrimit t politiks monetare ishte nj proces i nevojshm dhe i kujdesshm. Ky normalizimi ishte nj proces i nevojshm sepse ai krijon premisat e domosdoshme pr respektimin e objektivit ton t inflacionit, ka sht e mbetet jo vetm mandati yn ligjor por edhe kontributi m i mir q ne mund t japim pr rritjen ekonomike dhe pr mirqenien shoqrore n afatin e mesm dhe t gjat. Historia e ekonomis na mson se periudhat me inflacion t lart shoqrohen me rritje t ult e t luhatshme ekonomike, me m pak vende pune t krijuara dhe me paga e t ardhura m t ulta pr nj pjes t madhe t shoqris. N t njjtn koh, ky normalizim ka qen nj proces i kujdesshm, i udhhequr gjithnj nga analiza e kujdesshme e informacionit t ri, duke synuar q masat e nevojshme monetare pr kontrollin e inflacionit t ken nj kosto sa m t ult mbi aktivitetin ekonomik. Kjo filozofi do t udhheq vendimmarrjen ton t politiks monetare edhe gjat vitit t ardhshm. S dyti, ne kemi kontribuuar n ofrimin e nj sistemi financiar t shndosh dhe efikas, nprmjet forcimit t kuadrit ligjor e rregullator, nprmjet mbikqyrjes s kujdesshme t veprimtaris bankare dhe bashkpunimit intensiv me autoritetet homologe, si dhe nprmjet lufts ndaj pastrimit t parave dhe financimit t terrorizmit. Paralelisht me to, gjat vitit 2022, ne prditsuam ciklin vjetor t planeve t ndrhyrjes s jashtzakonshme dhe administruam me kujdes Fondin e Ndrhyrjes s Jashtzakonshme, fond i cili ka ardhur n rritje t vazhdueshme dhe ofron nj garanci shtes pr prballimin e goditjeve financiare. Paralelisht me punn ton, konstatoj me knaqsi se bankat shqiptare gzojn rezerva t mira kapitali, likuiditeti dhe norma t ulta t kredive me probleme; kto t fundit zbritn n 5% n muajin tetor, niveli m i ult historik. Po ashtu, testet tona t rezistencs tregojn se sistemi bankar sht, n trsi, rezistent ndaj goditjeve edhe m ekstreme, dhe i aft t mbshtes ekonomin. S treti, ne kemi ofruar sisteme moderne eficiente pr kryerjen e pagesave dhe kemi plotsuar krkesat e ekonomis pr para fizike, duke forcuar besimin n sistemin ton monetar e financiar. Fal nj pune disa-vjeare, prfshirja financiare e popullsis dhe prdorimi i instrumenteve elektronike t pagesave ka ardhur n rritje, sikurse dshmohet nga numri m i lart i shqiptarve me llogari bankare dhe i pagesave elektronike. Ndrkoh, operacionalizimi i sistemit t shlyerjes s pagesave n Euro brenda vendit ka reduktuar ndjeshm kostot dhe i ka kursyer shqiptarve rreth 10 milion euro. Gjithashtu, gjat vitit 2022, ne plotsuam serin e kartmonedhave t reja me dy prerjet e fundit, respektivisht me ato 500 dhe 2000 Lek. S katrti, ne kemi vijuar punn pr administrimin e rezervs valutore t Shqipris, duke respektuar kriteret m t mira n fushn e likuiditetit dhe t siguris. N aspektin operacional, dshiroj t prmend gjithashtu masat q kemi marr pr nj pjesmarrje m t gjer t individve n ankandet e letrave me vler t qeveris, duke reduktuar luhatjet n tregjet financiare dhe duke mundsuar nj prcjellje m t mir t politiks monetare n tregje. S pesti, ne kemi kontribuuar aktivisht n procesin e integrimit evropian, si dhe kemi forcuar dialogun me partnert vendas dhe t huaj. Hapja e negociatave n korrik 2022 shnoi jo vetm nj hap t rndsishm n progresin e vendit drejt rrugs s antarsimit, por krkoi nj angazhim m intensiv n kt drejtim, angazhim t cilit Banka e Shqipris iu prgjigj n koh dhe me cilsi. Sipas Raport-Progresit t fundit t Komisionit Evropian, Banka e Shqipris vlersohet si nj institucion i pavarur financiarisht, me instrumente, kompetenc dhe kapacitete t mjaftueshme administrative pr t hartuar e zbatuar nj politik monetare efikase. Edhe n t ardhmen, ne do t vazhdojm t kontribuojm me prgjegjshmri n procesin e integrimit t vendit, si nj aspirat e kahershme e jona. Po ashtu, gjat vitit ne kemi bashkpunuar me Bankn Botrore dhe partner t tjer institucional pr ngritjen e dy strategjive t rndsishme n nivel kombtar: Strategjin pr Ndryshimet Klimatike n Sistemin Bankar dhe at pr Edukimin dhe Prfshirjen Financiare. S fundi, dshiroj t theksoj se Banka e Shqipris ka punuar dhe shnuar progres n t gjith sferat e tjera t aktivitetit t saj: statistikat financiare, komunikimin me publikun dhe aktort ekonomik e shoqror, edukimin financiar, krkimin shkencor, etj.. Prmbushja e objektivave dhe rezultatet e pun son jan orientuar dhe mbshtetur nga nj vendimmarrje e kujdesshme, koherente dhe profesionale nga Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris. Kjo vendimmarrje ka jetsuar misionin, vizionin dhe vlerat e Banks, sikurse shpalosen n Strategjin Afatmesme t Zhvillimit t Banks s Shqipris. N veprimtarin e tij, Kshilli sht informuar rregullisht nga hallkat e kontrollit t brendshm dhe t jashtm pr sigurimin e respektimit korrekt t ligjit dhe t akteve t tjera q rregullojn veprimtarin e prditshme t institucionit. N prfundim, m lejoni tju siguroj se Banka e Shqipris ka qen dhe do t mbetet nj institucion i investuar n prmirsimin e gjithanshm t puns dhe n prvetsimin e standardeve m t mira t bankingut qendror. Mjedisi global dhe ai i brendshm mbeten sfidues, por ne do t jemi vigjilent ndaj zhvillimeve t reja pr t garantuar prmbushjen e detyrave tona ligjore, n interes t mirqenies s shtetasve shqiptar. Ju uroj t gjithve nj vit t mbar!

Title: Questions  Answers press conference, 21 December 2022
text: Questions  Answers press conference, 21 December 2022 Date of publication: 22.12.2022 Question: We are in the condition that inflation may not have reached its peak, as we are at the end of the year and the history has shown that the inflation rate could be increased and further, the performance that could potentially be accompanied by an increase in the base interest rate for the lek. You said earlier that there were 5 increases that led to 2.75% of the base interest rate for the lek. Are the conditions ripe for, in addition to the monetary policy moves  of course the sole lever of the Bank of Albania  to have other moves in the fiscal policy? I don't know if there is any initiative between the Bank of Albania and institutions like the Ministry of Finance or other institutions of the line... Governor: Fiscal policy is an attribute of the government, while monetary policy is the legal attribute and obligation of the Bank of Albania. As I pointed out in the press release, we have been following a change in the course of monetary policy, as all central banks around the world have done, as a result of high inflation. Expectations for high inflation have been present since 2021, without a war between Russia and Ukraine. There were signals and we pointed out this fact at the Supervisory Council meeting at the time that we were preparing to react with a change in the stance of monetary policy. But the start of the war in Ukraine accelerated the rise of inflation and, as a result, accelerated decision-making, as well as the speed of interest rate hikes by central banks. It is emphasized everywhere that the speed of monetary policy normalisation is "data driven," d.m.th. Based on new inflation and economic growth data. Central banks have taken care wherever to contain the rise in inflation, as that is their main objective: maintaining price stability. This decision-making and this main instrument of the central bank has been used, looking very closely at the same time the impact it has on curbing economic activity. Since the last month, the inflation rate came down in the eurozone and Albania, this is also one of the main reasons that we made the decision today not to increase the basic interest rate, after several consecutive increases. As we pointed out, monetary policy decision-making will be based on new data and normalization will be aligned with inflation performance and economic growth performance. Regarding fiscal policy, the central bank has given its opinion on the need for fiscal consolidation before Parliament, which is the institution where we report. The Ministry of Finance itself has acknowledged that we need to have a consolidation of fiscal policy, i.e. a reduction in the level of debt, and it is certainly moving towards this reduction. The level of debt has come down and there is a concrete objective for it, which has been communicated by the Government and the Ministry of Finance. Of course, we have called for reducing the level of debt, but within this fiscal management, all elements must be taken into account to address the inflation shocks, not restraining economic growth on the one hand, and on the other hand to help the needy with packages or other measures such as wage growth, pensions or aid packages, which the government has communicated. So, the alignment of monetary policy with fiscal policy has always been, at all times, across all crises. We used to have an easing monetary policy, accommodative one was called, and on the other hand the government had a consolidating fiscal policy for reducing the debt level. Today, since we have changed the inflationary side, so we are no longer in a disinflationary situation but in an inflationary situation, we have changed the course of monetary policy, but still accommodative. This is called because in the Albanian reality, our politics have not yet reached austerity levels and interest rates have not come above 4 or 5% de facto. Meanwhile, policies should remain accommodating given these elements I mentioned above: helping the needy strata and continuing the country's economic growth. This is more or less the harmonization of fiscal-monetary policy and the strategies that we have as institutions, like the Bank of Albania and the Minister of Finance and Economy.
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Pyetje  prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp, 21 dhjetor 2022 Data e publikimit: 22.12.2022 Pyetje: Ndodhemi n kushtet q inflacioni mund t mos e ket arritur kulmin e tij, pasi jemi n fundvit dhe historiku ka treguar q norma e inflacionit mund t rritet dhe m tej, ecuri q mund t shoqrohej potencialisht dhe me rritje t norms baz t interesit pr lekun. Ju e that m hert q jan br 5 rritje q e kan uar n 2.75% normn baz t interesit pr lekun. A jan pjekur kushtet q prvese lvizjeve n kahun e politiks monetare - sigurisht e vetmja lev e Banks s Shqipris - t ket dhe lvizje t tjera n kahun e politiks fiskale? Nuk e di nse ka ndonj iniciativ mes Banks s Shqipris dhe institucioneve si Ministria e Financave apo institucione t tjera t linjs... Guvernatori: Politika fiskale sht atribut i qeveris, ndrsa politika monetare sht atribut dhe detyrim ligjor i Banks s Shqipris. Sikurse e theksova edhe n deklaratn pr shtyp, ne kemi ndjekur nj ndryshim t kursit t politiks monetare, si kan br t gjitha bankat qendrore n mbar botn, si pasoj e inflacionit t lart. Pritshmrit pr inflacionin e lart kan qen t pranishme q vitin e kaluar, pra q n vitin 2021, pa nisur lufta midis Rusis dhe Ukrains. Ka pasur sinjale dhe ne e kemi theksuar kt fakt n mbledhjen e Kshillit Mbikqyrjes n at koh q po prgatiteshim pr t reaguar me ndryshim t kahut t qndrimit t politiks monetare. Por, fillimi i lufts n Ukrain prshpejtoi rritjen e inflacionit dhe si rrjedhoj prshpejtoi vendimmarrjen, si dhe shpejtsin e rritjes s normave t interesit nga bankat qendrore. Theksohet kudo q shpejtsia e normalizimit t politiks monetare sht data driven, d.m.th. e bazuar n t dhnat e reja t inflacionit dhe t rritjes ekonomike. Bankat qendrore jan kujdesur kudo q t frenojn rritjen e inflacionit, pasi ky sht objektivi i tyre kryesor: ruajtja e stabilitetit t mimeve. Kjo vendimmarrje dhe ky instrument kryesor i banks qendrore sht prdorur duke par me shum vmendje paralelisht edhe ndikimin q ka n frenimin e aktivitetit ekonomik. Meqense muajin e fundit, norma e inflacionit erdhi n rnie n Eurozon dhe n Shqipri, kjo sht dhe nj nga arsyet kryesore q ne sot morm vendimin pr t mos rritur normn baz t interesit, pas disa rritjeve me radh. Si e theksuam, vendimmarrja e politiks monetare do t jet e bazuar n t dhnat e reja dhe normalizimi do t jet i rakorduar me ecurin e inflacionit dhe ecurin e rritjes ekonomike. Lidhur me politikn fiskale, banka qendrore ka dhn opinionin e saj lidhur me nevojn pr konsolidim fiskal para Parlamentit, i cili sht institucioni ku ne raportojm. Vet Ministria e Financave e ka pranuar se duhet t kemi nj konsolidim t politiks fiskale, pra nj ulje t nivelit t borxhit dhe sigurisht q po shkohet drejt ksaj uljeje. Niveli i borxhit ka ardhur n rnie dhe ka nj objektiv konkret pr t, i cili sht komunikuar nga Qeveria dhe Ministria e Financave. Sigurisht q dhe ne kemi br thirrje pr uljen e nivelit t borxhit, por brenda ktij menaxhimi fiskal duhen pasur parasysh gjith elementet pr t trajtuar goditjet e inflacionit, duke mos frenuar rritjen ekonomike nga njra an, dhe nga ana tjetr pr t ndihmuar shtresat n nevoj me paketa ose masa t tjera si jan rritja e pagave, pensioneve ose paketave ndihmse, t cilat qeveria i ka komunikuar. Pra, harmonizimi i politiks monetare me politikn fiskale ka qen gjithmon, n t gjith kohrat, n t gjith krizat. Dikur ne kishim nj politik monetare lehtsuese, akomoduese quhej, dhe nga ana tjetr qeveria kishte nj politik fiskale konsoliduese pr uljen e nivelit t borxhit. Sot q kemi ndryshimin e kahut t inflacionit, pra nuk jemi m n nj situat dezinflacioniste por n nj situat inflacioniste, kemi ndryshuar dhe kahun e politiks monetare, por akoma akomoduese. Kshtu quhet sepse n realitetin shqiptar, akoma politika jon nuk ka arritur n nivele shtrnguese dhe normat e interesit nuk kan dal mbi 4 ose 5% de facto. Ndrkoh, politikat do duhet t mbeten akomoduese duke pasur parasysh kto elemente q prmenda m lart: ndihmn e shtresave n nevoj dhe vazhdimin e rritjes ekonomike t vendit. Ky sht pak a shum harmonizimi i politiks fiskale-monetare dhe strategjit q ne kemi si institucione, si Bank e Shqipris dhe Ministri e Financave dhe Ekonomis.

Title: Governor Sejko's remarks at the press conference on monetary policy decision making, 1 February 2023
text: Governor Sejko's remarks at the press conference on monetary policy decision making, 1 February 2023 Publication date: 01.02.2023 Dear representatives of the media, Today, on 1 February 2023, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Quarterly Monetary Policy Report. The new information received in the analysis has generally been better than our expectations. Inflation declined in November and December, economic activity continued to increase in the second half of the year, while the effect of normalization of the monetary policy stance is appearing more complete in financial markets. These trends are expected to continue in the coming quarters. In particular, the update to forecasts reaffirms our expectations that inflation will return to target within the first half of 2024. As above, the Supervisory Council decided to keep the monetary policy stance unchanged. However, the Supervisory Council finds that inflationary pressures remain high and further normalization of the monetary policy stance in the future is necessary to guarantee the return of inflation to target. I will explain in more detail today's decision and the reasons that motivated it. *** Consumer price inflation came in downwards during the last two months of 2022. After peaking at 8.3% in October, the inflation rate dropped to 7.4% at the end of the year. In terms of basket, the fall in inflation reflected the decline in oil prices and certain food items, dictated by the similar performance of these prices on the international market. On the other hand, the inflation rates of services and other items remain at high levels, comparable to those of the previous months. In macroeconomic terms, the decline in inflation reflected the reduction of imported inflation, while domestic inflationary pressures remain high. They are fuelled by relatively high demand for goods and services, by the rapid growth of employment, wages and production costs, and by the still high inflation expectations of economic agents. Economic activity in the country continued to increase during the second half of 2022. Economic growth accelerated to 4% in the third quarter, following the temporary slowdown in the previous quarter. Sectorally, economic growth was supported by expansion of activity in the construction and service sectors, while industrial activity contracted and agricultural production was almost unchanged. In terms of demand, economic growth was fuelled by increased household consumption and private investment, while public sector and net-external trade exchanges had a deterrent effect. Economic growth has been accompanied by increased employment and wages. Employment rose 4.2%, the unemployment rate dropped to the new historical minimum of 10.6% and average pay in the private sector rose by 12.3% in the third quarter. The positive performance of the labor market creates the premise for the sustainability of future economic growth, but also signals rapid increases in production costs and pressures on consumer prices. Financial markets have been operating normally. The performance of government securities yields has shown signs of correction and normalization. Interest rates on deposits and bank loans have been rising as a result of the normalization of monetary policy in the country and the world, but their level remains stimulating for growth in consumption and investment. Consequently, although slowing, credit to the private sector has continues to show positive monthly flows and positive annual growth, covering the needs of businesses and households for financial means. In parallel, the exchange rate has shown tendencies of strengthening against the major international currencies, as a result of high foreign exchange income and controlled risk premiums. The update to forecasts suggests inflation will gradually decline during 2023 and return to target in the first half of 2024. In parallel, the Albanian economy is expected to continue to grow, while the main indicators of financial stability are expected to remain in control. The fall in inflation will reflect further reduction of inflation in international markets and the cumulative consequences of normalising the monetary policy stance in the country. These consequences arise in the form of controlling market agents' expectations of inflation, of supporting the exchange rate, as well as better balancing between demand and aggregate supply in the country. The country's economic growth is expected to remain in positive territory, fueled by healthy private sector balance sheets, positive labor market dynamics, reduced insecurity and a still accommodating financial environment. However, the pace of economic growth is expected to slow slightly in 2023 and return to historic growth rates in the medium to long term. This trend reflects, most notably, the expected foreign demand dynamics and the action of basic effects. *** Based on the above, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania decided: the Keep the basic interest rate unchanged, at 2.75%; the Keep unchanged the interest rate of the one-day loan at 3.75%; the Keep unchanged the interest rate of the one-day deposit at 1.75%. The Supervisory Council reaffirms its judgment that high inflationary pressures remain the main risk to the country's sustainable and long-term growth. Also, he stresses that, based on current information, further normalization of the monetary policy stance remains a necessary measure for respecting our price inflation target. This normalization becomes even more necessary, in the presence of a balance of risk to inflation, which still sits on the upper side. In line with previous communications, the Supervisory Council stresses that the speed and intensity of this normalization has been and will remain a process guided by new data. In any case, monetary policy will provide the necessary conditions for respecting the price stability objective in the medium term, while at the same time taking care to minimize its impact on curbing economic activity. The Supervisory Council will monitor the situation carefully to assess the progress of inflationary pressures and to identify the measures necessary to achieve the target.
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 1 shkurt 2023 Data e publikimit: 01.02.2023 T nderuar prfaqsues t medias, Sot, n datn 1 shkurt 2023, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris mori n shqyrtim dhe miratoi Raportin Tremujor t Politiks Monetare. Informacioni i ri i marr n analiz ka qen, prgjithsisht, m i mir se pritjet tona. Inflacioni shnoi rnie n muajt nntor e dhjetor, aktiviteti ekonomik vijoi t rritet n gjysmn e dyt t vitit, ndrsa efekti i normalizimit t qndrimit t politiks monetare po shfaqet m i plot n tregjet financiare. Kto tendenca pritet t vazhdojn edhe gjat tremujorve t ardhshm. N veanti, prditsimi i parashikimeve rikonfirmon pritjet tona se inflacioni do t kthehet n objektiv brenda gjysms s par t vitit 2024. Sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi t mbaj t pandryshuar qndrimin e politiks monetare. Megjithat, Kshilli Mbikqyrs konstaton se presionet inflacioniste vijojn t mbeten t larta dhe normalizimi i mtejshm i qndrimit t politiks monetare n t ardhmen sht i nevojshm pr t garantuar kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv. N vijim, do t sqaroj m n detaje vendimin e sotm dhe arsyet q e motivuan. *** Inflacioni i mimeve t konsumit erdhi n rnie gjat dy muajve t fundit t vitit 2022. Pasi kulmoi n nivelin 8.3% n muajin tetor, norma e inflacionit zbriti n 7.4% n fund t vitit. N aspektin e shports, rnia e inflacionit pasqyroi rnien e mimeve t nafts dhe t disa artikujve ushqimor, t diktuara nga ecuria e ngjashme e ktyre mimeve n tregun ndrkombtar. Nga ana tjetr, normat e inflacionit t shrbimeve dhe t artikujve t tjer mbeten n nivele t larta, t krahasueshme me ato t muajve paraardhs. N aspektin makroekonomik, rnia e inflacionit pasqyroi reduktimin e inflacionit t importuar, ndrkoh q presionet e brendshme inflacioniste mbeten t larta. Ato ushqehen nga krkesa relativisht e lart pr mallra dhe shrbime, nga rritja e shpejt e punsimit, e pagave dhe e kostove t prodhimit, si dhe nga pritjet ende t larta pr inflacionin t agjentve ekonomik. Aktiviteti ekonomik n vend vijoi t rritet edhe gjat gjysms s dyt t vitit 2022. Rritja ekonomike u prshpejtua n 4% n tremujorin e tret, pas ngadalsimit t prkohshm n tremujorin paraardhs. N kndvshtrim sektorial, rritja ekonomike u mbshtet nga zgjerimi i aktivitetit n sektort e ndrtimeve dhe t shrbimeve, ndrkoh q aktiviteti industrial u tkurr dhe prodhimi bujqsor ishte pothuajse i pandryshuar. N kndvshtrimin e krkess, rritja ekonomike u ushqye nga rritja e konsumit familjar dhe e investimeve private, ndrkoh q sektori publik dhe shkmbimet tregtare me jasht neto patn efekt frenues. Rritja ekonomike sht shoqruar me rritje t punsimit dhe t pagave. Punsimi u rrit me 4.2%, shkalla e papunsis zbriti n minimumin e ri historik prej 10.6% dhe paga mesatare n sektorin privat u rrit me 12.3% n tremujorin e tret. Ecuria pozitive e tregut t puns krijon premisa pr qndrueshmrin e rritjes ekonomike n t ardhmen, por sinjalizon edhe pr rritje t shpejt t kostove t prodhimit dhe presione mbi mimet e konsumit. Tregjet financiare kan funksionuar normalisht. Ecuria e yield-eve t letrave me vler t qeveris ka shfaqur shenja korrektimi dhe normalizimi. Normat e interesit t depozitave dhe kredive bankare kan ardhur n rritje, si pasoj e normalizimit t politiks monetare n vend dhe n bot, por niveli i tyre mbetet ende stimulues pr rritjen e konsumit dhe t investimeve. Pr rrjedhoj, ndonse n ngadalsim, kredia pr sektorin privat ka vijuar t shfaq flukse pozitive mujore dhe rritje pozitive vjetore, duke mbuluar nevojat e bizneseve dhe familjeve pr mjete financiare. Paralelisht me to, kursi i kmbimit ka shfaqur tendenca forcimi kundrejt monedhave kryesore ndrkombtare, si pasoj e t ardhurave t larta valutore dhe e primeve t kontrolluara t rrezikut. Prditsimi i parashikimeve sugjeron se inflacioni do t bjer gradualisht gjat vitit 2023 dhe do t kthehet n objektiv n gjysmn e par t vitit 2024. Paralelisht me t, ekonomia shqiptare pritet t vijoj t rritet, ndrsa treguesit kryesor t stabilitetit financiar pritet t mbeten n kontroll. Rnia e inflacionit do t pasqyroj reduktimin e mtejshm t inflacionit n tregjet ndrkombtare dhe pasojat kumulative t normalizimit t qndrimit t politiks monetare n vend. Kto pasoja shfaqen n formn e kontrollit t pritjeve t agjentve t tregut pr inflacionin, t mbshtetjes s kursit t kmbimit, si dhe t balancimit m t mir midis krkess dhe oferts agregate n vend. Rritja ekonomike e vendit pritet t mbetet n territor pozitiv, e ushqyer nga bilancet e shndetshme t sektorit privat, nga dinamikat pozitive t tregut t puns, nga reduktimi i pasiguris dhe nga nj ambient financiar ende akomodues. Megjithat, ritmi i rritjes ekonomike pritet t vij n ngadalsim t leht gjat vitit 2023 dhe ti kthehet ritmeve historike t rritjes n afatin e mesm e t gjat. Ky trend pasqyron, m s shumti, dinamikat e pritura t krkess s huaj dhe veprimin e efekteve baz. *** Bazuar n sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris vendosi: t mbaj t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 2.75%; t mbaj t pandryshuar normn e interesit t kredis njditore, n nivelin 3.75%; t mbaj t pandryshuar normn e interesit t depozits njditore, n nivelin 1.75%. Kshilli Mbikqyrs rikonfirmon gjykimin e tij se presionet e larta inflacioniste mbeten rreziku kryesor mbi rritjen e qndrueshme dhe afatgjat t vendit. Gjithashtu, ai thekson se, bazuar n informacionin aktual, normalizimi i mtejshm i qndrimit t politiks monetare mbetet nj mas e nevojshme pr respektimin e objektivit ton t inflacionit t mimeve. Ky normalizim bhet edhe m i nevojshm, n prani t nj balance rreziku pr inflacionin, e cila qndron ende n kahun e siprm. N linj me komunikimet e mparshme, Kshilli Mbikqyrs thekson se shpejtsia dhe intensiteti i ktij normalizimi ka qen dhe do t mbetet nj proces i udhhequr nga t dhnat e reja. N do rast, politika monetare do t siguroj kushtet e nevojshme pr respektimin e objektivit t stabilitetit t mimeve n afatin e mesm, duke u kujdesur n t njjtn koh t minimizoj ndikimin e saj n frenimin e aktivitetit ekonomik. Kshilli Mbikqyrs do t monitoroj me kujdes situatn pr t vlersuar n vazhdimsi ecurin e presioneve inflacioniste dhe pr t identifikuar n koh masat e nevojshme pr arritjen e objektivit.

Title: Greetings of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Sejko, at the 4th Conference of the Bank of Albania Museum
text: Greetings of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Sejko, at the 4th Conference of the Bank of Albania Museum Date of publication: 08.02.2023 E. nderuar zonja Ministre, Honorable Mr. Chairman of the Academy of Sciences, Distinguished academics, distinguished professors, present, It is a great pleasure and honor for me to welcome you to the opening of the 4th Conference of the Bank of Albania Museum, an activity that is returning after a two-year hiatus, as a result of the global "paralysis" caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. The organization of this Conference is one of the most important activities for this Museum, as it not only helps us to enrich and continue the study of the collections exhibited in it, but also serves local scholars as a platform of discussion and argument for their research work. The Bank of Albania Museum gathers today for the fourth time representatives from the most important research institutions such as the Academy of Sciences of Albania, the Institutes of Archaeology and History, and professors of the University of Tirana. It also receives added value from the participation of counterparts of central banks, who will present their statements on the role and importance of medieval monetary systems. As reflected in its theme "The Middle Ages, precursor of a well-organized monetary system", during the discussion of the participants' works we will be able to hear about the creation and functioning of monetary systems in different ways of state organization, their currencies and the nature of financial systems. The characteristics of these systems emerge as determining factors for economic prosperity, trade relations, the value and international function of the currency for the domination of world markets, and the prosperity and longevity of a state or empire. Looking at history is important as we can find answers to the problems that concern us today, like p.sh. Price stability and financial stability, expressed most prominently in the stability of the currency and its role in the credibility of the financial system. The prominent examples of some currencies such as the Solidus of the Byzantine Empire or the Golden Duchy of Venice, which dominated monetary systems and global trade for several centuries, show us that the credibility of the issuing authorities is the basis of the currency's credibility and, consequently, the stability of the financial system. This is a lesson that still applies, and to this day, concretely spelled out in central banks' intervention through interest rate hikes to keep inflation in check over the last year. The Middle Ages is also known for its innovations in financial markets and the significant role they had in the development of economies. The invention and use of calibration and letters of credit created new opportunities for expanding trade and making payments without the need to move physical money, significantly reducing the risk and costs of commercial and financial transactions. These, and many new financial instruments for the time, became the initial basis for the development of banking activity and the birth of financial markets. These innovations, which have been enriched by new financial and monetary instruments over the centuries, They do not differ in their purpose and their effects on important processes that have dominated or are dominating today's money and financial markets. Here for example, we can mention inventions that date back to the last century such as debit and credit cards, such as digital currencies, instant payment systems and instruments, as well as other innovative financial intermediation instruments. As centuries ago, these technological developments have essentially financial inclusion of the population, creating new opportunities and reducing costs. In this way, they not only complement and increase the efficiency of the financial market, but also the economic prosperity of the population and the family. For all these reasons, the Bank of Albania has attached special importance to creating opportunities for the development of innovative payment instruments through the new payment law and other legal and regulatory initiatives that serve to increase the financial inclusion of the population. Discussions on the two above topics, dealing with the sustainability of monetary systems and the emergence of financial instruments, shed light on the significant moments that have defined their success or failure and present valuable lessons for the formulation of today's development policies. I am glad that these important topics also touch on the history of our country and region systems. The Bank of Albania Museum will continue to work in both these directions, as a supporter of the scientific research of monetary history in the Albanian and economical lands of the country, developing historical research, as well as supporting and providing cooperation for scholars and institutions of cultural heritage. Our museum is not only an exhibition of rare collections, but also a platform where researchers find the necessary space to develop and reference their research, providing the public with an institution of knowledge where they can be informed about economic and monetary history, through collections, various exhibitions, study activities and publications. Being the most important financial institution in the country, the Bank of Albania seeks and fosters cooperation with all cultural and academic heritage institutions regarding its field of activity. I find the opportunity to thank the Ministry of Culture for the cooperation and support for the Museum and all other activities related to numismatics and cultural heritage. All this heritage presented in the Bank of Albania Museum also represents a medium for implementing programs and carrying out financial education activities. Our museum, through the history of its exhibition, provides concrete and understandable examples to illustrate the main concepts of money, financial systems and monetary policy, which lie at the core of the objective of financial education. Without further ado, I invite you to follow the conference's work throughout its three sessions and I thank all the participants, academics, scholars, speakers, listeners and collaborators who have responded positively to our invitation. I wish you a successful conference!
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala prshndetse e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko, n Konferencn e IV-t t Muzeut t Banks s Shqipris Data e publikimit: 08.02.2023 E nderuar zonja Ministre, I nderuar zoti Kryetar i Akademis s Shkencave, T nderuar akademik, profesor t nderuar, t pranishm, sht knaqsi dhe nder i madh pr mua tju uroj mirseardhjen n eljen e punimeve t Konferencs s IV-t t Muzeut t Banks s Shqipris, nj aktivitet i cili po rikthehet srish pas nj ndrprerjeje dyvjeare, si rrjedhoj e paralizimit global t shkaktuar nga pandemia COVID- 19. Organizimi i ksaj Konference sht nj nga aktivitetet m t rndsishme pr kt Muze, pasi jo vetm na ndihmon t pasurojm dhe t vijojm studimin e koleksioneve t ekspozuara n t, por njherazi i shrben edhe studiuesve vendas si nj platform diskutimi dhe argumentimi pr punn e tyre krkimore. Muzeu i Banks s Shqipris mbledh sot pr t katrtn her prfaqsues nga institucionet m t rndsishme krkimore si Akademia e Shkencave t Shqipris, Institutet e Arkeologjis dhe Historis, si dhe profesor t Universitetit t Tirans. Gjithashtu merr vler t shtuar edhe nga pjesmarrja n t e kolegve homolog t bankave qendrore, t cilt do t prezantojn kumtesat e tyre mbi rolin dhe rndsin e sistemeve monetare mesjetare. Sikurse pasqyrohet dhe n temn e saj Mesjeta, pararendse e nj sistemi monetar t mirorganizuar, gjat diskutimit t punimeve t pjesmarrsve do t mund t dgjojm mbi krijimin dhe funksionim e sistemeve monetare n mnyra t ndryshme t organizimit shtetror, monedhave t tyre dhe natyrn e sistemeve financiare. Karakteristikat e ktyre sistemeve dalin si faktor prcaktues pr lulzimin ekonomik, raportet tregtare, vlern dhe funksionin ndrkombtar t monedhs pr dominimin e tregjeve botrore, si dhe prosperitetin e jetgjatsin e nj shteti apo perandorie. Vshtrimi n histori sht i rndsishm pasi mund t gjejm prgjigje mbi problematika q na shqetsojn dhe sot, si p.sh. stabiliteti i mimeve dhe ai financiar, shprehur n mnyr m t dukshme n qndrueshmrin e monedhs dhe rolin e saj n besueshmrin e sistemit financiar. Shembujt e spikatur t disa monedhave si Solidus e Perandoris Bizantine apo Dukati i art venedikas, t cilat dominuan sistemet monetare financiare dhe tregtin globale pr disa shekuj, na tregojn se besueshmria e autoriteteve emetuese sht baza e besueshmris s vet monedhs dhe, si pasoj, edhe e qndrueshmris s sistemit financiar. Ky sht nj msim q vlen ende dhe sot e ksaj dite, i shprehur konkretisht n ndrhyrjen e bankave qendrore nprmjet rritjes s norms s interesit pr t mbajtur nn kontroll inflacionin gjat vitit t fundit. Mesjeta njihet edhe pr inovacionet n tregjet financiare dhe rolin domethns q ato patn n zhvillimin e ekonomive. Shpikja dhe prdorimi i kambialeve dhe Letr-Kreditit, krijuan mundsi t reja pr zgjerimin e tregtis dhe kryerjen e pagesave pa nevojn e lvizjes s paras fizike, duke ulur dukshm riskun dhe kostot e transaksioneve tregtare dhe financiare. Kto, dhe shum instrumente financiare t reja pr kohn, u bn baza fillestare pr zhvillimin e veprimtaris bankare dhe lindjen e tregjeve financiare. Kto inovacione, t cilat ndr shekuj jan pasuruar me instrumente t reja financiare dhe monetare, nuk dallojn pr nga qllimi dhe efektet q japin n procese t rndsishme q kan dominuar apo po dominojn sot paran dhe tregjet financiare. Ktu pr shembull mund t prmendim shpikje q i takojn shekullit t kaluar si kartat e debitit dhe kreditit apo dhe ato aktuale si monedhat digjitale, sistemet dhe instrumentet e pagesave t menjhershme (instant payments), por dhe instrumente t tjera inovative t ndrmjetsimit financiar. Ashtu sikurse shekuj m par, kto zhvillime teknologjike kan n thelb prfshirjen financiare t popullats, duke krijuar mundsi t reja dhe duke ulur kostot. N kt mnyr, ato jo vetm plotsojn dhe rrisin eficiencn e tregut financiar, por dhe prosperitetin ekonomik t popullats dhe familjes. Pr t gjitha kto arsye, Banka e Shqipris i ka kushtuar rndsi t veant krijimit t mundsive pr zhvillimin e instrumenteve inovative t pagesave prmes ligjit t ri t pagesave dhe iniciativave t tjera ligjore dhe rregullative q i shrbejn rritjes s prfshirjes financiare t popullats. Diskutimet mbi dy temat e msiprme, q trajtojn qndrueshmrin e sistemeve monetare dhe lindjen e instrumenteve financiare hedhin drit mbi momentet domethnse q kan prcaktuar suksesin apo dshtimin e tyre dhe paraqesin msime t vlefshme pr formulimin e politikave t sotme zhvillimore. M vjen mir q kto tema t rndsishme prekin edhe historikun e sistemeve t vendit dhe rajonit ton. Muzeu i Banks s Shqipris do t vijoj punn n t dy kto drejtime, si mbshtets i krkimit shkencor t historis monetare n trojet shqiptare dhe at ekonomikomonetare t vendit, duke zhvilluar krkimin historik, si dhe duke mbshtetur dhe ofruar bashkpunim pr studiuesit dhe institucionet e trashgimis kulturore. Muzeu yn sht jo vetm nj ekspozit koleksionesh t rralla, por edhe nj platform ku studiuesit t gjejn hapsirn e nevojshme pr t zhvilluar dhe referuar krkimet e tyre, duke i ofruar publikut nj institucion i dijes ku mund t informohet mbi historin ekonomike dhe monetare, nprmjet koleksionit, ekspozitave t ndryshme, aktiviteteve studimore dhe publikimeve tona. Duke qen institucioni m i rndsishm financiar n vend, Banka e Shqipris krkon dhe nxit bashkpunimin me t gjitha institucionet e trashgimis kulturore dhe ato akademike, lidhur me fushn e veprimtaris s saj. Gjej mundsin t falnderoj dhe Ministrin e Kulturs pr bashkpunimin dhe mbshtetjen pr Muzeun dhe gjith aktivitetet e tjera t lidhura me numizmatikn dhe trashgimin kulturore. E gjitha kjo trashgimi e paraqitur n Muzeun e Banks s Shqipris prfaqson dhe nj medium pr zbatimin e programeve dhe kryerjen e aktiviteteve t edukimit financiar. Muzeu yn, prmes historis q mbart ekspozita e tij, jep shembuj konkret dhe t kuptueshm pr t ilustruar konceptet kryesore t paras, sistemeve financiare dhe politikave monetare, t cilat qndrojn dhe n thelb t objektivit t edukimit financiar. Pa u zgjatur m tej, ju ftoj t ndiqni punimet e Konferencs prgjat tri sesioneve t saj dhe falnderoj t gjith pjesmarrsit, akademikt, studiuesit, folsit, dgjuesit dhe bashkpuntort q i jan prgjigjur pozitivisht ftess ton. Ju uroj nj konferenc t suksesshme!

Title: Remarks by Governor Sejko at the press conference on monetary policy decision making, 23 March 2023
text: Remarks by Governor Sejko at the press conference on monetary policy decision making, 23 March 2023 Date of publication: 23.03.2023 Dear representatives of the media, Today, on 23 March 2023, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Intermediate Monetary Policy Report. The new information obtained in the analysis has resulted in the upper end of our expectations. This information suggests that economic growth in the country has been relatively fast and steady during the second half of last year. At the same time, although inflation has been coming down, domestic pressures on prices, and especially those emanating from the labour market, are estimated to be strong and growing. Based on the above, at today's meeting, the Supervisory Council decided to continue the process of normalization of the monetary policy stance. In line with our previous communications, the Supervisory Council considers that this decision is a necessary step to ensure a sustainable return of inflation to the target, within a reasonable time horizon and with lower long-term costs on the Albanian economy. Factoring in domestic economic and financial trends, expected developments in world markets, and today's monetary policy move, the Supervisory Council estimates that economic growth will continue to remain in positive territory and inflation will gradually drop towards its target over the next year. *** Inflation declined during the first two months of the year, marking respective values of 7.2% and 7.1% in January and February. The downside inflation trend, started in November last year, was in line with our expectations. However, the level of inflation in the first two months of the year was at the upper end of expectations. In the basket's view, the fall in inflation was dictated by a slower annual rise in oil and food prices, in line and with the trends observed in the international market. On the other hand, the inflation of other basket items appeared relatively high and stable. In the macroeconomic view, this performance was dictated by the reduction of imported inflation, while domestic inflationary pressures remain high.
