These pressures are fuelled by high demand for goods and services, rapidly rising wages and production costs, and economic agents' expectations for further price increases. Available information suggests that the Albanian economy has been growing in the fourth quarter of last year and the first quarter of the current year. The increase in aggregate demand is based on the expansion of household consumption, private and public investments, as well as exports of goods of services. This dynamic is supported by increased disposable income, improved business and household confidence, sound private sector balance sheets, and still-stimulating financial conditions. The rapid and steady expansion of aggregate demand has brought an increasing exploitation of the production capacities of the Albanian economy. Our estimates suggest that aggregate demand for goods and services has increased faster than the production potential of the Albanian economy. This conclusion is reflected in historically high rates of capacity utilization in the private sector, by continued employment growth, the decline in historical minimum unemployment rates, and the rapid growth of wages in the private sector. In particular, average pay in the private sector expanded by about 14% in annual terms during the final quarter of last year. This growth has supported the expansion of disposable income of Albanian households, fueled the expansion of household consumption and helped sustain economic growth. However, on the other hand, it has increased the costs of business production and facilitated the tracking of price increases from foreign markets to the domestic economy. Against them, domestic financial markets continue to remain calm and to transmit the normalization so far of the monetary policy stance, both at home and in the world. Interest rates have increased across the entire arc of financial products, while the yields of government securities have fallen, better reflecting the bank's so far monetary policy moves. Also, the exchange rate of lek against the main currencies continued to show over-price trends, in response to the improvement of the balance of foreign trade exchanges and to preserve the relative attractiveness of the financial instruments in ALL. Finally, although slowing, credit to the private sector has continued to expand, supporting the expansion of consumption and investment in the economy. The update to the forecasts confirms our previous expectations and suggests that the main economic trends observed in recent months will continue in the future. More specifically, inflation is expected to slowly decline over the following quarters and return to target by the middle of next year. Economic growth is also expected to stay in positive territory, although the pace of growth is forecast to mark a slight slowdown during the current year. These projections are conditioned by: Materialisms of international markets' expectations for a progressive reduction in inflation and a temporary restraint on the pace of growth in our trading partners; Materialisms our expectations for maintaining a stable and still stimulating financial environment in the country; Materialisms budget projections for slowing the pace of fiscal consolidation during the year; As well as from, one Further move towards normalization of monetary policy stance at today's meeting. In particular, consistent with previous judgments, the Bank of Albania notes that further normalization of the monetary policy stance is a necessary step to ensure the economic and financial stability of the country. *** Based on the above, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania decided: the increase the base interest rate from 2.75% to 3.00%; the increase the interest rate of the one-day loan from 3.75% to 4.00%; the Increase the interest rate of the one-day deposit, from the level of 1.75% to the level of 2.00%. The Supervisory Council judged that high inflationary pressures emanating from the domestic environment to be an important risk factor, first, for respecting the price stability objective and, further, for the country's sustainable and long-term growth. In these circumstances, he deemed it necessary to reduce monetary stimulus through increases in the base interest rate. The Supervisory Council notes that this measure is consistent with our previous communications and consistent with recent movements of the major central banks. Based on current information, the Supervisory Council deems that most of the necessary monetary normalisation has already been carried out. In line with previous communications, the Supervisory Council stresses that the future stance of monetary policy will be guided by new data, and in particular the balance of inflationary pressures, the sustainability of economic growth and other indicators of the country's economic and financial health.
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 23 mars 2023 Data e publikimit: 23.03.2023 T nderuar prfaqsues t medias, Sot, n datn 23 mars 2023, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris mori n shqyrtim dhe miratoi Raportin e Ndrmjetm t Politiks Monetare. Informacioni i ri i marr n analiz ka rezultuar n kahun e siprm t pritjeve tona. Ky informacion sugjeron se rritja ekonomike n vend ka qen relativisht e shpejt dhe e qndrueshme gjat gjysms s dyt t vitit t shkuar. N t njjtn koh, megjithse inflacioni ka ardhur n rnie, presionet e brendshme mbi mimet, dhe veanrisht ato q burojn nga tregu i puns, vlersohet t jen t forta dhe n rritje. Bazuar n sa m sipr, n mbledhjen e sotme, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi t vijoj procesin e normalizimit t qndrimit t politiks monetare. N linj me komunikimet tona t mparshme, Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjykon se ky vendim sht nj hap i nevojshm pr t garantuar kthimin e qndrueshm t inflacionit n objektiv, brenda nj horizonti kohor t arsyeshm dhe me kosto afatgjata sa m t ulta mbi ekonomin shqiptare. Duke faktorizuar trendet e brendshme ekonomike dhe financiare, zhvillimet e pritura n tregjet botrore, si dhe lvizjen e sotme t politiks monetare, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlerson se rritja ekonomike do t vijoj t mbetet n territor pozitiv ndrsa inflacioni do t zbres gradualisht drejt objektivit gjat vitit t ardhshm.. *** Inflacioni shnoi rnie gjat dy muajve t par t vitit, duke shnuar vlerat respektive prej 7.2% dhe 7.1% n muajt janar dhe shkurt. Trendi rns i inflacionit, i nisur q prej muajit nntor t vitit t kaluar, ishte n prputhje me pritjet tona. Megjithat, niveli i inflacionit n dy muajt e par t vitit ishte n kahun e siprm t pritjeve. N kndvshtrimin e shports, rnia e inflacionit u diktua nga nj rritje m e ngadalt vjetore e mimeve t nafts dhe t ushqimeve, n linj dhe me tendencat e vna re n tregun ndrkombtar. Nga ana tjetr, inflacioni i artikujve t tjer t shports u shfaq relativisht i lart dhe i qndrueshm. N kndvshtrimin makroekonomik, kjo ecuri u diktua nga reduktimi i inflacionit t importuar, ndrkoh q presionet e brendshme inflacioniste vijojn t mbeten t larta. Kto presione ushqehen nga krkesa e lart pr mallra e shrbime, nga rritja e shpejt e pagave dhe e kostove t prodhimit, si dhe nga pritjet e agjentve ekonomik pr rritje t mtejshme t mimeve. Informacioni i disponuar sugjeron se ekonomia shqiptare ka vijuar t rritet n tremujorin e katrt t vitit t shkuar dhe tremujorin e par t vitit aktual. Rritja e krkess agregate sht bazuar n zgjerimin e konsumit familjar, t investimeve private e publike, si dhe t eksporteve t mallrave t shrbimeve. Kjo dinamik sht mbshtetur nga rritja e t ardhurave t disponueshme, nga prmirsimi i besimit t biznesit e t familjeve, nga bilancet e shndosha t sektorit privat, si dhe nga kushtet ende stimuluese financiare. Zgjerimi i shpejt dhe i qndrueshm i krkess agregate ka sjell nj shfrytzim gjithnj e m t lart t kapaciteteve prodhuese t ekonomis shqiptare. Vlersimet tona sugjerojn se krkesa agregate pr mallra e shrbime ka shnuar nj rritje m t shpejt se potenciali prodhues i ekonomis shqiptare. Ky konkluzion pasqyrohet n normat historikisht t larta t shfrytzimit t kapaciteteve n sektorin privat, nga rritja e vazhdueshme e punsimit, nga rnia n nivele minimale historike e norms s papunsis, si dhe nga rritja e shpejt e pagave n sektorin privat. N veanti, paga mesatare n sektorin privat u zgjerua me rreth 14% n terma vjetor gjat tremujorit t fundit t vitit t shkuar. Kjo rritje ka mbshtetur zgjerimin e t ardhurave t disponueshme t familjeve shqiptare, ka ushqyer zgjerimin e konsumit familjar si dhe ka ndihmuar qndrueshmrin e rritjes ekonomike. Megjithat, nga ana tjetr, ajo ka rritur kostot e prodhimit t biznesit dhe ka lehtsuar prcjelljen e rritjes s mimeve nga tregjet e huaja n ekonomin vendase. Prkundrejt tyre, tregjet e brendshme financiare vijojn t mbeten t qeta dhe t transmetojn normalizimin e deritanishm t qndrimit t politiks monetare, si n vend dhe n bot. Normat e interesit kan shnuar rritje n t gjith harkun e produkteve financiare, ndrkoh q yield-et e letrave m vler t qeveris kan rn, duke pasqyruar m mir lvizjet e deritanishme t politiks monetare t Banks s Shqipris. Po ashtu, kursi i kmbimit t lekut ndaj monedhave kryesore ka vijuar t shfaq tendenca mbimimi, n prgjigje t prmirsimit t bilancit t shkmbimeve tregtare me jasht si dhe t ruajtjes s atraktivitetit relativ t instrumenteve financiare n lek. S fundi, ndonse n ngadalsim, kredia pr sektorin privat ka vijuar t zgjerohet, duke mbshtetur zgjerimin e konsumit dhe t investimeve n ekonomi. Prditsimi i parashikimeve konfirmon pritjet tona t mparshme dhe sugjeron se trendet kryesore ekonomike t vna re gjat muajve t fundit do t vijojn edhe n t ardhmen. M konkretisht, inflacioni pritet t shnoj rnie graduale gjat tremujorve n vijim dhe t kthehet n objektiv gjat mesit t vitit t ardhshm. Po ashtu, rritja ekonomike pritet t qndroj n territor pozitiv, ndonse ritmi i rritjes parashikohet t shnoj nj ngadalsim t leht gjat vitit aktual. Kto projeksione jan t kushtzuara nga: materializimi i pritjeve t tregjeve ndrkombtare pr nj reduktim progresiv t inflacionit dhe nj frenim t prkohshm t ritmit t rritjes n partnert tan tregtar; materializimi i pritjeve tona pr ruajtjen e nj ambienti t qndrueshm dhe ende stimulues financiar n vend; materializimi i projeksioneve t buxhetit pr ngadalsimin e ritmit t konsolidimit fiskal gjat vitit; si dhe nga, nj lvizje e mtejshme drejt normalizimit t qndrimit t politiks monetare n mbledhjen e sotme. N veanti, n konsistenc me gjykimet e mparshme, Banka e Shqipris vren se normalizimi i mtejshm i qndrimit t politiks monetare sht nj hap i nevojshm pr t siguruar stabilitetin ekonomik dhe financiar t vendit. *** Bazuar n sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris vendosi: t rris normn baz t interesit, nga niveli 2.75% n nivelin 3.00%; t rris normn e interesit t kredis njditore, nga niveli 3.75% n nivelin 4.00%; t rris normn e interesit t depozits njditore, nga niveli 1.75% n nivelin 2.00%. Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjykoi se presionet e larta inflacioniste q burojn nga ambienti i brendshm jan nj faktor i rndsishm rreziku, s pari, pr respektimin e objektivit t stabilitetit t mimeve dhe, m tej, pr rritjen e qndrueshme dhe afatgjat t vendit. N kto rrethana, ai e vlersoi t nevojshme reduktimin e stimulit monetar nprmjet rritjes s norms baz t interesit. Kshilli Mbikqyrs vren se kjo mas sht n prputhje me komunikimet tona t mparshme dhe n konsistenc me lvizjet e fundit t bankave kryesore qendrore. Bazuar n informacionin aktual, Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjykon se pjesa m e madhe e normalizimit t nevojshm monetar sht kryer tashm. N linj me komunikimet e mparshme, Kshilli Mbikqyrs thekson se qndrimi i ardhshm i politiks monetare do t udhhiqet nga t dhnat e reja, dhe n veanti balanca e presioneve inflacioniste, qndrueshmria e rritjes ekonomike dhe tregues t tjer t shndetit ekonomik dhe financiar t vendit.

Title: Questions  Answers to press conference, 23 March 2023
text: Questions  Answers to press conference, 23 March 2023 Date of publication: 23.03.2023 Q: Mr. Governor, as you stated and you now appear to have the necessary part of the base interest rate increase been carried out. This way you've always addressed it as a normalization of the basic interest rate. If in the future, in these following months, inflation will remain at these anemic lows let's say at 7.2 to 7.1 where it was not and the expected decrease you said also, do you think you will reach the tightening territory of monetary policy? Governor: First it's too early to talk about monetary policy easing, i.e. to think about interest rate cuts. Despite the decrease in the total value of inflation, we made a decision to increase the basic interest rate at today's meeting of the Supervisory Council based on the increase in basic inflation, on the increase of internal inflationary pressures, noting that prices in the country have increased. Regardless of the price of oil, other food prices and basket base prices have shown a persistent increase and this required a monetary policy response. Aggregate demand has increased, so the Bank of Albania judged that it should continue with the normalization of monetary policy. On the other hand, we have always considered maintaining a balance between the impact of the base interest rate on the reining in price growth, and the impact on economic growth, not to curb it. Also, another reason is related to the recent situation of banks that have problems in America and Europe, i.e. to be careful about the financial stability of the country and to affect the health of banks as little as possible. Today's decision-making is judged not to affect these factors, so we are practically still on a monetary policy easing ground. Interest rates have not risen to those levels that hinder economic growth, and certainly, even as I pointed out in the Statement of the Supervisory Council, in future moves we will remain cautious to see all these elements. The speed of monetary policy normalization will always be linked to indicators of economic growth, to the health of the financial system in the country and to all macroeconomic parameters. If inflation is to be lowered, the monetary policy response will probably be slower. So we'll wait and evaluate because of course the decision making is based on data. I can't communicate regardless of what the decision-making will be like, but one thing is for sure, that decision-making won't be as quick as last year.... The expectations for inflation growth in Albania in the region and the world were higher than what actually happened. Prices in the eurozone have come crashing and the normalization of central banks' monetary policy has slowed down, despite recent monetary policy moves of the Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank and the Bank of England. We may have continued to increase basic interest rates, but not at the speed predicted. So we're in a situation where interest rates will remain at these levels, may not rise at the speed predicted, and that depends on the numbers. But to talk about cutting interest rates is still early. If macroeconomic parameters are improved, we will react with monetary policy. If we reach our inflation target of 3 percent in the middle of next year, I think things are positive. We expect a successful summer tourist season, the economy is continuing to grow, the macroeconomic situation is running in positive territory and the financial system is stable and financial markets are calm. Question: Regarding the developments of the last few weeks where in America markets have been shaken by the bankruptcy of two banks in Europe, there is also much difficulty in the case of Credit Swisse. While panic in the markets investors have also caused the shares of many companies to fall on quoted stock exchanges. How much do you judge the banking system in Albania? Governor: The bankruptcy of Silicon Valley bank in America and the other Signature Bank is a signal of alarm to all international financial markets. The reaction in the European market through Credit Suisse and the developments you have been following, raised vigilance and we took into immediate analysis the situation of the financial system. These financial events are of course caused by the non-compliance of risk criteria in these banks, by the non-compliance of risk concentration levels and by non-analysis of liquidity risk and maturity gaps. So these banks did not analyze maturity imbalances and virtually changed interest rates affected by causing losses. This created panic and huge withdrawals of deposits in a short-term time frame, creating the situation we all know, but certainly the interference of regulators and relevant governments with large sums restrained and stabilized markets. However, our financial system is unindicted and has no exposure to these financial markets. Not only with U.S. banks, but also with Credit Suisse. Exposure is almost negligible, below 0.8%. On the other hand, the consequences of the 2008 crisis, the eurozone debt crisis and the Greek crisis have led us to take supervised, prudent and regulatory measures, so that banks are overcapitalized and with a high level of liquidity. These phenomena that I mentioned, and from the analysis we have done, result that banks are in a very healthy financial situation, have no problem of this nature. The liquidity index is not only at high levels, but also the regulatory requirements we have are a far away from this kind of crisis. The financial crisis has a chain effect. We are monitoring international markets very closely, but the truth is that the Albanian market is far away from these risks and moreover that the evidence of resistance and analysis that we conduct through our departments at the Bank of Albania shows that level banks are quite healthy. And in some hypothetical scenario, if there were too strong external blows, banks are still well capitalized and very healthy. At the moment, we have no real problem in our banking system. But of course this is a good time to be vigilant and to keep in mind that we must always be vigilant in respecting the risk criteria, because in these developed countries, look at what happens when we forget about the respect of risk criteria and supervisory regulatory norms.
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Pyetje  prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp, 23 mars 2023 Data e publikimit: 23.03.2023 Pyetje: Zoti Guvernator, si e deklaruat dhe ju tani duket se sht kryer pjesa e nevojshme e rritjes s norms baz t interesit. N kt mnyr i jeni drejtuar gjithmon si nj normalizim i norms baz t interesit. Nse n t ardhmen, n kto muajt q pasojn, inflacioni do t mbetet n kto ulje anemike le t themi n 7.2 n 7.1 ku nuk ishte dhe ulja e pritshme q that edhe ju, mendoni se do t arrini n territor shtrngues i politiks monetare? Guvernatori: S pari sht hert pr t folur pr lehtsim t politiks monetare, pra pr t menduar pr ulje t normave t interesit. Pavarsisht rnies s vlers totale t inflacionit, ne morm vendim pr rritjen e norms baz t interesit n mbledhjen e sotme t Kshillit Mbikqyrs bazuar n rritjen e inflacionit baz, n rritjen e presioneve t brendshme inflacioniste duke vne re q mimet n vend jan rritur. Pavarsisht nga mimi i nafts, mimet e tjera t ushqimeve dhe mimet baz t shports kan treguar nj rritje persistente dhe kjo krkoi nj reagim t politiks monetare. Krkesa agregate sht rritur, prandaj dhe Banka e Shqipris gjykoi se duhet t vazhdonte me normalizimin e politiks monetare. Nga kahu tjetr, ne gjithmon kemi pasur parasysh ruajtjen e nj ekuilibri midis ndikimit t norms baz t interesit mbi frenimin e rritjes s mimeve, dhe ndikimit mbi rritjen ekonomike, pr t mos ta frenuar at. Gjithashtu, nj arsye tjetr lidhet edhe me situatn e fundit t bankave q kan probleme n Amerik dhe Evrop, pra pr t qen t kujdesshm n raport me stabilitetin financiar t vendit dhe pr t ndikuar sa m pak n shndetin e bankave. Vendimmarrja e sotme gjykohet q nuk ndikon n kta faktor pra praktikisht ne jemi akoma n nj terren lehtsues t politiks monetare. Normat e interesit nuk jan rritur n ato nivele q t pengojn rritjen ekonomike dhe sigurisht, edhe si theksova n deklaratn e Kshillit Mbikqyrs, n lvizjet e ardhshme do t mbetemi t kujdesshm pr t par t gjith kta element. Shpejtsia e normalizimit t politiks monetare do t jet gjithmon e lidhur me treguesit e rritjes ekonomike, me shndetin e sistemit financiar n vend dhe me t gjith parametrat makroekonomik. Nse inflacioni do t ulet, reagimi i politiks monetare do t jet ndoshta m i ngadalt. Pra ne do t presim dhe do t vlersojm sepse sigurisht q vendimmarrja sht e bazuar n t dhnat. Nuk mund t komunikoj pavarsisht nga parashikimet si do t jet vendimmarrja, por nj gj sht e sigurt, q vendimmarrja nuk do t jet aq e shpejt sa ishte menduar vitin e kaluar. Pritshmrit pr rritjen e inflacionit n Shqipri n rajon dhe n bot ishin m t larta se far ndodhi realisht. mimet n eurozon kan ardhur n rnie dhe normalizimi i politiks monetare t bankave qendrore ka ulur shpejtsin, pavarsisht nga lvizjet e fundit t politiks monetare t Rezervs Federale, Banks Qendrore Evropiane dhe Banks s Anglis. Mund t kemi vazhdim t rritjes s normave baz t interesit, por jo me shpejtsin e parashikuar. Pra ne jemi n nj situat ku normat e interesit do t mbeten n kto nivele, mund t mos rriten me shpejtsin e parashikuar dhe kjo varet nga shifrat. Por pr t folur pr ulje t normave t interesit sht akoma hert. Sigurisht q nse do t prmirsohen parametrat makroekonomik, ne do t reagojm me politikn monetare. Nse ne arrijm objektivin ton t inflacionit prej 3 pr qind n mesin e vitit t ardhshm, mendoj q gjrat jan pozitive. Ne presim nj sezon turistik veror t suksesshm, ekonomia po vazhdon rritjen, situata makroekonomike sht duke ecur n territor pozitiv dhe sistemi financiar sht i qndrueshm dhe tregjet financiare jan t qeta. Pyetje: N lidhje me zhvillimet e javve t fundit ku n Amerik tregjet jan tronditur nga falimenti i dy bankave n Evrop po ashtu shum vshtirsi nga rasti i Credit Swisse. Ndrkoh q ka panik n tregje investitort kan br q dhe aksionet e shum kompanive shum bankave t bien n bursa t kuotuara. Sa t ekspozuar e gjykoni ju sistemin bankar n Shqipri? Guvernatori: Falimentimi i banks Silicon Valley n Amerik dhe banks tjetr Signature Bank sht nj sinjal alarmi pr t gjith tregjet financiare ndrkombtare. Reagimi n tregun evropian nprmjet Credit Suisse dhe zhvillimet q ju i keni ndjekur, ngriti vigjilencn dhe ne morm n analiz t menjhershme situatn e sistemit financiar. Kto ngjarje financiare ndodhen sigurisht nga mosrespektimi i kritereve t rrezikut n kto banka, nga mosrespektimi i niveleve t prqendrimit t rrezikut dhe nga mos analiza e rrezikut t likuiditetit dhe i hendeqeve t maturitetit. Pra kto banka nuk kan analizuar disbalancat e maturitetit dhe praktikisht ndryshimi i normave t interesit ndikoi duke shkaktuar humbje. Kjo krijoi panik dhe trheqje t mdha t depozitave n nj hark kohor afatshkurtr, duke krijuar situatn q t gjith e dim, por sigurisht ndrhyrja e rregullatorve dhe qeverive prkatse me shuma t mdha frenoi dhe stabilizoi tregjet. Gjithsesi sistemi yn financiar sht i pandikuar dhe nuk ka ekspozime n kto tregje financiare. Jo vetm me me bankat amerikane, por edhe me Credit Suisse. Ekspozimi sht pothuajse i paprfillshm, nn 0.8%. Nga ana tjetr pasojat e krizs s 2008-s, krizs s borxheve n Eurozon dhe krizs greke na kan br q ne t marrim masa mbikqyrse, t matura dhe rregullative, n mnyr q bankat t jen t mbikapitalizuara dhe me nj nivel t lart likuiditeti. Kto fenomene q prmenda, dhe nga analiza q kemi br, rezulton q bankat t jen n nj situat shum t shndetshme financiare, nuk kan asnj problematik t ksaj natyre. Treguesi i likuiditetit jo vetm q sht n nivele t larta, por dhe krkesat rregullative q ne kemi jan shum larg nga kjo lloj krize. Natyrisht q krizat e sistemit financiar kan efekt zinxhir. Po monitorojm tregjet ndrkombtare shum ngusht, por e vrteta sht q tregu shqiptar sht shum larg nga kto rreziqe dhe pr m tepr q provat e rezistencs dhe analizs q ne kryejm nprmjet departamenteve tona n Bankn e Shqipris tregojn q bankat e nivelit jan mjaft t shndetshme. Dhe n ndonj skenar hipotetik, sikur t ndodhte q t kishte goditje nga jasht shum t forta, bankat prap jan t mirkapitalizuara dhe shum t shndetshme. Pra pr momentin realisht nuk kemi asnj lloj problematike n sistemin ton bankar. Por sigurisht q ky sht nj moment i mir pr t qen vigjilent dhe pr t pasur parasysh q duhet t jemi gjithmon vigjilent n respektimin e kritereve t rrezikut, sepse dhe n kto shtetet kaq t zhvilluara shiko se far ndodh kur harrohet respektimi i kritereve t rrezikut dhe normave mbikqyrse rregullatore.

Title: The speech of Governor Sejko in the promotion of the book of Prof. Dr. Aristotle Pano
text: The speech of Governor Sejko in the promotion of the book of Prof. Dr. Aristotle Pano Date of publication: 04.04.2023 Dear Professor, Honorable participant, Dear Ladies and Gentlemen, It is a pleasure and I am honored to participate in this very special promotion for me, as the head of the Bank of Albania and as a friend and student of Professor Aristotle Panos, who has been one of the most elite associates and advisers of our central bank since its foundation. Unfortunately, last year the professor left life, but as we see today and will continue in the future, the work of this prolific author not only remains an entire institution of creativity, but still comes into the hands of the reader with new works. Having said this, I have the honor to present the book "Antiquity and Modernity of Economic Thought of Ancient Greece", written by Prof. Dr. Aristotle Pano and enriched with the reflections of Academic Prof. Dr. Anastas Angjeli. What makes this book important and almost unique to our country is its theme, almost undisputed in the local works on economic thought and philosophy. Ancient economic thought should be recognized, discussed. It continues to be very valuable even today, both for students of this relatively new science, as well as for us policymakers. As we understand from the information and reflections of this work, the period of Greek antiquity exhibits some of the earliest economic ideas and theories. By studying the economic thought of ancient societies, we can gain a better understanding of the evolution of economic thinking. Professor Angjeli opens his reflections on Professor Panos' work with the well-known phrase "history repeats itself", the further we turn to history, the further we predict the future. Studying ancient economic thought allows us to learn from the mistakes and successes of past economic systems. For example, the decline of ancient economies like those of Rome and Greece could provide important lessons on the dangers of unsustainable economic practices. Also, economic systems have always played a central role in shaping societies. By studying the economic thought of ancient societies, we can gain insight into how these systems have influenced the political, social and cultural structures of those societies. The study of ancient economic thought can also inform us about current economic policy. By analyzing the economic practices of past societies, we can identify successful strategies that can be implemented in modern economies. So, in general, studying ancient economic thought is important because it offers us a historical perspective on economic systems, helps us learn from the mistakes of the past and informs current economic policy. We central bankers can learn a lot too from the giants of antiquity discussed in this work. Thus, for example, the last chapter of the book tells us how the work of the legendary Greek antiquity thinker Aristotle is important for monetary policy. He was one of The earliest thinkers who analyzed the nature and function of money. His ideas on money and economics have influenced economic thought for centuries, and much of his knowledge is still relevant to our day. One of Aristotle's main contributions to monetary policy is his understanding of the role of money in the economy. He acknowledged that money serves as a means of exchange, making it easier to trade goods and services. Aristotle also understood that money has value because people accept it in exchange for goods and services, introduced us to the potential risks of excessive monetary expansion, and argued that if excessive currency is thrown into circulation, it can lead to inflation and decrease in the value of the currency. This notion is still valid after more than 2,300 years, as even today central banks and governments carefully monitor the supply of money to prevent inflation. In addition, the works of Aristotle reflected in this book, along with several other thinkers such as Plato, Homer, Socrates, etc., offer insights into the ethics of monetary policy. He argued that money should be used to facilitate trade rather than for personal gain, as well as believed that those responsible for monetary policy should act with integrity and fairness, and prioritize the common good over their own interests. Honorable participant, This book, written by one of the most important Albanian thinkers and economists of the 20th and 21st centuries, recognizes us with the centuries-old legacy of critical thought, the first works of greek antiquity authors and the analysis of these works. Professor Pano, together with his associate and historical student Professor Angjelin, continue to emphasize the importance of critical thinking and inspire and challenge today's scholars and thinkers. Their emphasis on reason, empirical evidence and rigorous debate remain a fundamental part of intellectual and academic life. Our professor Aristotle Pano enables us to understand how the reflections of past centuries still teach us lessons about monetary policy, because they offer insight into the nature and function of money, the potential risks of excessive monetary expansion and the ethics of monetary policy. By studying the philosophy discussed in this work, the young reader can educate themselves and gain a deeper understanding of the role of money in economics and policymakers make more informed decisions about monetary policy. Let me close my word by returning to the legacy that intellectuals like Aristotle Pano leave behind even when they leave life. I am very happy that Professor Pano trusted us with his manuscript on the Albanian monetary and banking history of the last two centuries. The bank of Albania will soon publish. I hope that such works inspire the faculties of economics, finance and business to address in their curricula more broadly the subject of the study of economic thought, as it provides a deeper understanding of economic theory, develops thinking skills and exposes students to different ideas and the study of intellectual history.
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n promovimin e librit t Prof. Dr. Aristotel Pano Data e publikimit: 04.04.2023 T nderuar profesor, T nderuar pjesmarrs, T nderuar zonja dhe zotrinj, sht knaqsi dhe ndihem i nderuar t marr pjes n kt promovim krejtsisht t veant pr mua, si drejtues i Banks s Shqipris dhe si mik e student i profesor Aristotel Panos, i cili ka qen nj nga bashkpuntort dhe kshilltart m elitar t banks ton qendrore q prej themelimit t saj. Fatkeqsisht, vitin e shkuar profesori u largua nga jeta, por si e shohim sot dhe do vijojm edhe n t ardhmen, vepra e ktij autori prolifik jo vetm q mbetet nj institucion i tr krijimtarie, por ende vjen n duart e lexuesit me pun t reja. Thn kt, kam nderin t prezantoj librin Antikiteti dhe moderniteti i mendimit ekonomik t Greqis s Lasht, shkruar nga Prof. Dr. Aristotel Pano dhe pasuruar me refleksionet e Akademik Prof. Dr. Anastas Angjeli. Ajo ka e bn kt libr t rndsishm dhe pothuajse unik pr vendin ton sht tema e tij, gati e padiskutuar n veprat vendase mbi mendimin dhe filozofin ekonomike. Mendimi ekonomik antik duhet njohur, e diskutuar. Ai vijon t jet shum i vlefshm edhe n ditt e sotme, si pr studentt e ksaj shkence relativisht t re, ashtu edhe pr ne politikbrsit. Si kuptojm nga informacioni dhe refleksionet e ksaj vepre, periudha e lashtsis greke shfaq disa prej ideve dhe teorive m t hershme ekonomike. Duke studiuar mendimin ekonomik t shoqrive t lashta, ne mund t prfittojm nj kuptim m t mir t evolucionit t t menduarit ekonomik. Profesor Angjeli el refleksionet e tij mbi veprn e profesor Panos me shprehjen e mirnjohur historia prsritet, sa m prapa i kthehemi historis aq m larg parashikojm t ardhmen. Studimi i mendimit t lasht ekonomik na lejon t msojm nga gabimet dhe sukseset e sistemeve t kaluara ekonomike. Pr shembull, rnia e ekonomive t lashta si ato t Roms dhe Greqis mund t jap msime t rndsishme mbi rreziqet e praktikave t paqndrueshme ekonomike. Gjithashtu, sistemet ekonomike kan luajtur gjithmon nj rol qendror n formsimin e shoqrive. Duke studiuar mendimin ekonomik t shoqrive t lashta, ne mund t fitojm njohuri se si kto sisteme kan ndikuar n strukturat politike, sociale dhe kulturore t atyre shoqrive. Studimi i mendimit t lasht ekonomik mund t na informoj gjithashtu mbi politikn aktuale ekonomike. Duke analizuar praktikat ekonomike t shoqrive t kaluara, ne mund t identifikojm strategji t suksesshme q mund t zbatohen n ekonomit moderne. Pra, n prgjithsi, studimi i mendimit t lasht ekonomik sht i rndsishm sepse na ofron nj perspektiv historike mbi sistemet ekonomike, na ndihmon t msojm nga gabimet e s kaluars dhe informon politikn aktuale ekonomike. Edhe ne bankiert qendror mund t msojm shum nga gjigantt e antikitetit t diskutuar n kt vepr. Kshtu, pr shembull kapitulli i fundit i librit na tregon se si vepra e mendimtarit legjendar t antikitetit grek, Aristotelit, sht e rndsishme pr politikn monetare. Ai ishte nj nga mendimtart m t hershm q analizoi natyrn dhe funksionin e paras. Idet e tij mbi paran dhe ekonomin kan ndikuar n mendimin ekonomik pr shekuj me radh, dhe shum nga njohurit e tij jan ende t rndsishme edhe n ditt tona. Nj nga kontributet kryesore t Aristotelit pr politikn monetare sht kuptimi i tij pr rolin e paras n ekonomi. Ai pranoi se paraja shrben si nj mjet kmbimi, duke e br m t leht tregtimin e mallrave dhe shrbimeve. Aristoteli gjithashtu kuptoi se paraja ka vler sepse njerzit e pranojn at n kmbim t mallrave dhe shrbimeve, na njohu me rreziqet e mundshme t zgjerimit t tepruar monetar, dhe argumentoi se nse n ekonomi hidhet n qarkullim monedh e tepruar, kjo mund t oj n inflacion dhe ulje t vlers s monedhs. Ky nocion sht ende i vlefshm pas m shum se 2300 vjetve, pasi edhe sot bankat qendrore dhe qeverit monitorojn me kujdes ofertn e paras pr t parandaluar inflacionin. Prve ksaj, veprat e Aristotelit t pasqyruara n kt libr, s bashku me disa mendimtar t tjer si Platoni, Homeri, Sokrati etj., na ofrojn njohuri mbi etikn e politiks monetare. Ai argumentoi se parat duhet t prdoren pr t lehtsuar tregtin dhe jo pr prfitime personale, si dhe besonte se ata q jan prgjegjs pr politikn monetare duhet t veprojn me integritet dhe drejtsi, dhe t ken prparsi t mirn e prbashkt mbi interesat e tyre. T nderuar pjesmarrs, Ky libr, i shkruar mjeshtrisht nga nj prej mendimtarve dhe ekonomistve m t rndsishm shqiptar t shekujve XX dhe XXI, na njeh me trashgimin shekullore t mendimit kritik, me veprat e para t autorve t Antikitetit Grek dhe me analizat e ktyre veprave. Profesor Pano, s bashku me bashkpuntorin dhe nxnsin e tij historik profesor Angjelin, vijojn t theksojn rndsin e t menduarit kritik dhe t frymzojn dhe sfidojn studiuesit dhe mendimtart e sotm. Theksi i tyre te arsyeja, provat empirike dhe debati rigoroz, mbeten nj pjes themelore e jets intelektuale dhe akademike. Profesori yn Aristotel Pano na mundson t kuptojm se si refleksionet e shekujve t shkuar, na japin ende msime pr politikn monetare, sepse ato ofrojn njohuri mbi natyrn dhe funksionin e paras, rreziqet e mundshme t zgjerimit t tepruar monetar dhe etikn e politiks monetare. Duke studiuar filozofin e diskutuar n kt vepr, lexuesi i ri mund t edukohet dhe t prftoj nj kuptim m t thell t rolit t paras n ekonomi dhe politikbrsit t marrin vendime m t informuara pr politikn monetare. M lejoni ta mbyll fjaln time duke u kthyer tek trashgimia q intelektual si Aristotel Pano ln pas edhe kur largohen nga jeta. Jam shum i lumtur q Profesor Pano na besoi dorshkrimin e tij mbi historin monetare dhe bankare shqiptare t dy shekujve t fundit. Vepr t ciln Banka e Shqipris do e botoj s shpejti. Shpresoj q vepra t tilla t frymzojn fakultetet e ekonomis, financave dhe biznesit pr t trajtuar n kurrikulat e tyre m gjersisht lndn e studimit t mendimit ekonomik, pasi ajo ofron nj kuptim m t thell t teoris ekonomike, zhvillon aftsit e t menduarit dhe ekspozon studentt ndaj ideve t ndryshme dhe studimit t historis intelektuale.

Title: Governor Sejko's remarks at the press conference on monetary policy decision making, 3 May 2023
text: Governor Sejko's remarks at the press conference on monetary policy decision making, 3 May 2023 Date of publication: 03.05.2023 Dear representatives of the media, Today, on 3 May 2023, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Quarterly Monetary Policy Report. The new information received in the analysis has been, overall, better than our expectations. Inflation continued the downturn during the first quarter, influenced by the overall fall in inflation in the world environment, the effect of the high comparative base of a year ago and the first effects of normalization of the monetary policy stance. At the same time, economic activity in the country has continued to grow at a steady pace and  along with it  employment and wages in the private sector. Our forecasts suggest that inflation will continue to decline gradually this year and return to target within the first half of 2024. Also, these forecasts suggest that the country's economic growth will remain in positive territory, supported by solid private sector balance sheets, positive labor market outlook, improved confidence of economic agents and still accommodative financing conditions. In these circumstances, the Supervisory Council decided to keep the monetary policy stance unchanged. However, the Council found that internal inflationary pressures remain high and meeting our price stability objective may require a further normalisation of the monetary policy stance in the future. *** Inflation descended to an average level of 6.5% in the first quarter of 2023, down from the 7.9% level recorded a quarter earlier. Its decline was particularly rapid in March, when that index hit a 5.3% level. The main contribution to this performance was the decline in food and oil commodity inflation, in line with their performance in global markets, as well as the effect of the high comparative basis of a year ago. Meanwhile, the increase in the prices of services and other basket items continues to be broad-based and at relatively unchanged rates from the previous months. In the macroeconomic view, the fall in inflation mostly reflected the decline in imported inflation, dictated by both the fall in inflation in our trading partners and the overvaluation of the exchange rate. On the other hand, domestic inflationary pressures continued to be high, reflecting relatively high demand for goods and services, tight labor market conditions and rapidly rising wages and labour costs. The Albanian economy continues to grow at relatively rapid speeds over the past year. Although under the shock effect, gross domestic product recorded an annual growth of 4.7% in the fourth quarter of 2022 and of 4.8% throughout the year. This growth reflected the continued expansion of activity in the construction, industry and service sectors, which benefited from the rapid and continuous growth of tourism revenues. In terms of demand, economic growth has continued to be fuelled by rising household consumption and private investment, while import growth and fiscal consolidation continue to have a restraining impact. Indirect data suggests the following trends continue during the first quarter of the current year. The continued expansion of demand for goods and services has brought improvements in almost all dimensions of the labor market. Thus, labor force participation rates and employment increased, the unemployment rate fell to historic minimum levels of 10.8%, and wages in the private sector increased by 14.2% during the fourth quarter of last year. Rising wages and employment have cushioned the impact of rising prices on household budgets. The labour market outlook remains positive, while business surveys suggest strong demand for manpower and the will to increase wages. Rapid employment and wage growth provide encouraging signals for the sustainability of future economic growth, but they also create a conducive environment for rising domestic inflationary pressures. High inflation and above the bank's target Central is harmful to households and businesses, as it erodes the purchasing power of their income and makes it difficult to plan for future consumption and investment. In response to high inflation, the Bank of Albania has gradually reduced the intensity of monetary stimulus by moving towards normalizing the monetary policy stance. Since the beginning of last year, the base interest rate has increased from the minimum level of 0.5% to the 3.00% level in March 2023. This normalisation is being conveyed to domestic financial markets. The latter have operated quietly and are characterized by good liquidity and risk-contained primes. Interest rates on deposits and bank loans have increased, while the exchange rate of lek against the euro has continued strengthening trends, in response to the continuous improvements in the balance of trade and financial exchanges with abroad, as well as the increase in interest to save and invest in our national currency. However, even as it is tightened, funding conditions remain stimulating for consumption and investment growth. In response, the credit continues to show positive monthly flows, although the pace of growth has slowed. At the same time, the quality of the loan portfolio has remained satisfactory, as illustrated by the low levels of the NLD ratio. The financial health of the banking sector suggests that this sector will be capable of continuing to respond to the economy's demands for funds. The update of our forecasts suggests that the Albanian economy will continue to grow, and that inflation will gradually decline and return to target in the first half of 2024. The fall in inflation will reflect its further reduction in global markets and the normalisation of monetary policy stance in the country. This normalisation will create a better balance between demand and supply, support the stability of financial markets, and help control economic agents' expectations for inflation. The country's economic growth is expected to continue to be in positive territory. The pace of growth is expected to come in slight slowdown during 2023 and return to historic levels in the medium to long term. This projection factors in the good financial health of the private and banking sector of the Albanian economy, the positive outlook of the labour market, the improvement of the confidence of families and businesses, and the presence of a still accommodating financial environment. *** Based on the above, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania decided: the Keep the basic interest rate unchanged, at 3.00%; the Keep unchanged the interest rate of the one-day loan at 4.00%; the Keep the interest rate of the one-day deposit at 2.00% unchanged. The Supervisory Council considers that high inflationary pressures from the domestic economy remain a risk factor for price stability in the country. The Council shall carefully monitor the situation to assess the performance of inflationary pressures and to identify in time the measures necessary to achieve the target, including further normalisation of the monetary policy stance. In any case, monetary policy will provide the necessary conditions for respecting the price stability objective in the medium term, while at the same time taking care to minimize its impact on curbing economic activity and possible undesirable consequences on financial stability.
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 3 maj 2023 Data e publikimit: 03.05.2023 T nderuar prfaqsues t medias, Sot, n datn 3 maj 2023, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris mori n shqyrtim dhe miratoi Raportin Tremujor t Politiks Monetare. Informacioni i ri i marr n analiz ka qen, n prgjithsi, m i mir se pritjet tona. Inflacioni vazhdoi trendin rns gjat tremujorit t par, i ndikuar nga rnia e prgjithshme e inflacionit n ambientin botror, efekti i bazs s lart krahasuese t nj viti m par dhe nga efektet e para t normalizimit t qndrimit t politiks monetare. N t njjtn koh, aktiviteti ekonomik n vend ka vijuar t rritet me ritme t qndrueshme dhe  bashk me t  edhe punsimi e pagat n sektorin privat. Parashikimet tona sugjerojn se inflacioni do t vijoj rnien graduale gjat ktij viti dhe do t kthehet n objektiv brenda gjysms s par t vitit 2024. Gjithashtu, kto parashikime sugjerojn se rritja ekonomike e vendit do t mbetet n territor pozitiv, e mbshtetur nga bilancet solide t sektorit privat, perspektiva pozitive e tregut t puns, prmirsimi i besimit t agjentve ekonomik dhe kushtet ende akomoduese t financimit. N kto rrethana, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vendosi t mbaj t pandryshuar qndrimin e politiks monetare. Megjithat, Kshilli konstatoi se presionet e brendshme inflacioniste mbeten t larta dhe prmbushja e objektivit ton t stabilitetit t mimeve mund t krkoj nj normalizim t mtejshm t qndrimit t politiks monetare n t ardhmen. *** Inflacioni zbriti n nj nivel mesatar prej 6.5% n tremujorin e par t vitit 2023, nga niveli 7.9% i regjistruar nj tremujor m par. Rnia e tij ishte veanrisht e shpejt n muajin mars, kur ky tregues shnoi nivelin 5.3%. Kontributin kryesor n kt ecuri e dha rnia e inflacionit t artikujve ushqimor dhe t nafts, n prputhje dhe me ecurin e tyre n tregjet globale, si dhe efekti i bazs s lart krahasuese t nj viti m par. Ndrkoh, rritja e mimeve t shrbimeve dhe artikujve t tjer t shports vijon t jet me baz t gjer dhe me norma relativisht t pandryshuara nga muajt e kaluar. N kndvshtrimin makroekonomik, rnia e inflacionit pasqyroi m s shumti rnien e inflacionit t importuar, e diktuar si nga rnia e inflacionit n partnert tan tregtar ashtu edhe nga mbimimi i kursit t kmbimit. Nga ana tjetr, presionet e brendshme inflacioniste vijuan t jen t larta, n pasqyrim t krkess relativisht t lart pr mallra e shrbime, t kushteve t shtrnguara n tregun e puns dhe t rritjes s shpejt t pagave e t kostove t puns. Ekonomia shqiptare vijoi t rritet me ritme relativisht t shpejta gjat vitit t shkuar. Edhe pse nn efektin e goditjes, prodhimi i brendshm bruto shnoi nj rritje vjetore prej 4.7% n tremujorin e katrt t vitit 2022 dhe prej 4.8% gjat gjith vitit. Kjo rritje pasqyroi zgjerimin e vazhdueshm t aktivitetit n sektort e ndrtimit, t industris dhe t shrbimeve, sektor t cilt prfituan nga rritja e shpejt dhe e vazhdueshme e t ardhurave nga turizmi. N aspektin e krkess, rritja ekonomike ka vazhduar t ushqehet nga rritja e konsumit familjar dhe e investimeve private, ndrkoh q rritja e importeve dhe konsolidimi fiskal vazhdojn t ken nj ndikim frenues. T dhnat indirekte sugjerojn vijimin e ktyre trendeve edhe gjat tremujorit t par t vitit aktual. Zgjerimi i vazhdueshm i krkess pr mallra e shrbime ka sjell prmirsime n thuajse t gjitha dimensionet e tregut t puns. Kshtu, shkalla e pjesmarrjes n forcn e puns dhe punsimi u rritn, norma e papunsis ra n nivele minimale historike prej 10.8%, dhe pagat n sektorin privat u rritn me 14.2% gjat tremujorit t katrt t vitit t shkuar. Rritja e pagave dhe e punsimit ka zbutur ndikimin e rritjes s mimeve n buxhetet e familjeve. Perspektiva e tregut t puns mbetet pozitive, ndrsa vrojtimet e bizneseve sugjerojn nj krkes t fort pr fuqi puntore dhe vullnet pr rritjen e pagave n vijim. Rritja e shpejt e punsimit dhe e pagave japin sinjale inkurajuese pr qndrueshmrin e rritjes ekonomike n t ardhmen, por ato krijojn gjithashtu nj mjedis t favorshm pr rritjen e presioneve t brendshme inflacioniste. Inflacioni i lart dhe mbi objektivin e banks qendrore sht i dmshm pr familjet dhe bizneset, pasi grryen fuqin blerse t t ardhurave t tyre dhe vshtirson planifikimin e konsumit dhe investimeve n t ardhmen. N prgjigje t inflacionit t lart, Banka e Shqipris ka reduktuar gradualisht intensitetin e stimulit monetar duke lvizur drejt normalizimit t qndrimit t politiks monetare. Prej fillimit t vitit t shkuar, norma baz e interesit sht rritur nga niveli minimal 0.5% n nivelin 3.00% n muajin mars 2023. Ky normalizim po prcillet n tregjet e brendshme financiare. Kto t fundit kan operuar t qeta dhe jan karakterizuar nga gjendje e mir likuiditeti dhe prime t prmbajtura rreziku. Normat e interesit t depozitave dhe kredive bankare kan ardhur n rritje, ndrsa kursi i kmbimit t lekut ndaj euros ka vijuar tendencat forcuese, n prgjigje t prmirsimeve t vazhdueshme t bilancit t shkmbimeve tregtare e financiare me jasht, si dhe t rritjes s interesit pr t kursyer e investuar n monedhn ton kombtare. Megjithat, edhe pse drejt shtrngimit, kushtet e financimit mbeten ende stimuluese pr rritjen e konsumit dhe t investimeve. N prgjigje t tyre, kredia vijon t shfaq flukse mujore pozitive, ndonse ritmi i rritjes ka ardhur n ngadalsim. N t njjtn koh, cilsia e portofolit t kredis ka mbetur e knaqshme, sikurse ilustrohet nga nivelet e ulta t raportit t kredive me probleme. Shndeti financiar i sektorit bankar sugjeron se ky sektor do t jet i aft t vazhdoj ti prgjigjet krkesave t ekonomis pr fonde. Prditsimi i parashikimeve tona sugjeron se ekonomia shqiptare do t vijoj t rritet, dhe se inflacioni do t shnoj rnie graduale dhe do t kthehet n objektiv n gjysmn e par t vitit 2024. Rnia e inflacionit do t pasqyroj reduktimin e mtejshm t tij n tregjet globale dhe normalizimin e qndrimit t politiks monetare n vend. Ky normalizim do t krijoj nj balanc m t mir midis krkess dhe oferts, do t mbshtes stabilitetin e tregjeve financiare, si dhe do t ndihmoj n kontrollin e pritjeve t agjentve ekonomik pr inflacionin. Rritja ekonomike e vendit pritet t vijoj t jet n territor pozitiv. Ritmi i rritjes pritet t vij n ngadalsim t leht gjat vitit 2023 dhe ti kthehet niveleve historike n afatin e mesm e t gjat. Ky parashikim faktorizon shndetin e mir financiar t sektorit privat dhe atij bankar t ekonomis shqiptare, perspektivn pozitive t tregut t puns, prmirsimin e besimit t familjeve dhe bizneseve, si dhe pranin e nj ambienti financiar ende akomodues. *** Bazuar n sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris vendosi: t mbaj t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 3.00%; t mbaj t pandryshuar normn e interesit t kredis njditore, n nivelin 4.00%; t mbaj t pandryshuar normn e interesit t depozits njditore, n nivelin 2.00%. Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjykon se presionet e larta inflacioniste nga ekonomia e brendshme mbeten nj faktor rreziku pr stabilitetin e mimeve n vend. Kshilli do t monitoroj me kujdes situatn pr t vlersuar n vazhdimsi ecurin e presioneve inflacioniste dhe pr t identifikuar n koh masat e nevojshme pr arritjen e objektivit, prfshi edhe normalizimin e mtejshm t qndrimit t politiks monetare. N do rast, politika monetare do t siguroj kushtet e nevojshme pr respektimin e objektivit t stabilitetit t mimeve n afatin e mesm, duke u kujdesur n t njjtn koh t minimizoj ndikimin e saj n frenimin e aktivitetit ekonomik dhe pasoja t mundshme t padshirueshme n stabilitetin financiar.

Title: Questions  Press conference answers, 3 May 2023
text: Questions  Press conference answers, 3 May 2023 Date of publication: 03.05.2023 Question: Today the Ministry of Finance and Economy has had a meeting with exporting businesses regarding the exchange rate performance. Will there be a decision and intervention by the Bank of Albania regarding the devaluation of the euro? Governor: Regarding the exchange rate, the Bank of Albania has clarified several times, but today we are giving our comment. The exchange rate of the lek is also priced and has been in strengthening for a long period of several years. This year, the sting is even stronger. This is due to several factors, the official and fundamental factors fully justify the strengthening of the exchange rate. Balance of Payments data show a significant increase in foreign direct investment compared to last year, a significant increase in tourism revenue compared to last year, increase in total exports as well as an increase in remittances. These channels of euro flow have made the euro offer in the market significant. We have monitored the market continuously and noticed that market behaviour has reflected the exchange rate in a normal way and we have not had any disruptions. We do not have speculative behavior or psychological factors that affect the exchange rate. The Bank of Albania is clearly defined by law and regulation when interfering in the exchange rate. We intervened in 2018 in the exchange rate market after all these criteria I mentioned were met that year. Spreads had expanded, the psychological factor was strong and the main one was that the rate in that period hit inflation, so we were in a deflationary situation and we wanted to raise inflation to 3%. Today we are in a completely different situation, we intervene for reserve, but it is not called an exchange rate intervention. The Bank of Albania publishes the calendar of interventions at the beginning of the year, precisely for this purpose, to be transparent and not to influence speculation in the foreign exchange market. We intervene to avoid speculation and simultaneously to protect inflation. All of these criteria are not met in this case. The calendar of interventions to increase the bank's foreign reserve is market-wise. We don't see any speculative behavior in the market. In this context we cannot set a precedent of intervention from the current strengthening of the exchange rate, as this really shows the foreign exchange market. This is real market, these are real estate. We don't have spread extensions, we have no reason to intervene. I understand and judge that we should cooperate with exporters or those industries that are affected by the effect of the exchange rate. Of course some sectors lose, some sectors win, some individuals lose, some individuals win. All those businesses or individuals that have income in euros and all expenses lose from strengthening exchange rates and, on the contrary, those businesses and individuals who have income in ALL and expenses in euros earn, importers say. We have a trade deficit, we are an importing economy. If we look at the economic level, we gain more than we lose. It is very true that exporters lose, some parts of exporting economies lose, and of course we aim to strengthen domestic production and we aim to strengthen the exporting economy. In this context, like the Ministry of Finance and Economy we will also get a quick contact with exporters. We will consult with them and are ready to offer training on exchange rate risk management. There are contracts that fix the course, there are financial instruments that are used by international companies that are well known. Since we are the leading financial institution, we have the necessary experience and expertise, we are ready to inform and train all those industries and businesses that suffer a blow from the exchange rate effect. We will also closely cooperate with the Ministry of Finance and Economy to see what measures we can take to help the exporters who lose out. However, I want to emphasize that the current exchange rate reflects the market, determined by the demand of the suppliers. I want to point out once that it is not the Bank of Albania that determines the exchange rate, it is the market that sets the exchange rate. The Bank of Albania, as a central financial institution, communicates the exchange rate, but intervenes only in those cases I mentioned. This clarification is more for public opinion because experts and specialists have that very clear.
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Pyetje  prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp, 3 maj 2023 Data e publikimit: 03.05.2023 Pyetje: Ditn e sotme Ministria e financave dhe Ekonomis ka pasur nj takim me bizneset eksportuese lidhur me ecurin e kursit t kmbimit. A do t ket nj vendim dhe ndrhyrje nga Banka e Shqipris lidhur me zhvlersimin e euros? Guvernatori: Lidhur me kursin e kmbimit, Banka e Shqipris ka sqaruar disa her, por dhe sot po japim komentin ton. Kursi i kmbimit t lekut sht i mbimuar dhe ka qen n forcim prej nj periudhe t gjat disavjeare. Kt vit ky mbimim sht dhe m i fort. Kjo vjen si pasoj e disa faktorve, faktort zyrtar dhe fondamental e justifikojn plotsisht forcimin e kursit t kmbimit. T dhnat e bilancit t pagesave tregojn nj rritje t konsiderueshme n investimet e huaja direkte n krahasim me vitin e kaluar, nj rritje t konsiderueshme t t ardhurave nga turizmi n krahasim me vitin e kaluar, rritje t eksporteve ne total si dhe nj rritje t remitancave. Kto kanale prurjesh n euro kan br q oferta e euros n treg t jet e konsiderueshme. Ne kemi monitoruar n mnyr t vazhdueshme tregun dhe kemi vn re q sjellja e tregut ka reflektuar kursin e kmbimit n mnyr normale dhe nuk kemi patur rregullime. Nuk kemi as sjellje spekulative ose faktor psikologjik t cilat t ndikojn n kursin e kmbimit. Banka e Shqipris e ka t prcaktuar qart me ligj dhe rregullore kur ndrhyn n kursin e kmbimit. Ne kemi ndrhyr n vitin 2018 n tregun e kursit t kmbimit pasi t gjith kto kritere q prmenda, n at vit plotsoheshin. Spread-et ishin zgjeruar, faktori psikologjik ishte i fort dhe m kryesorja ishte q kursi n at periudh godiste inflacionin, pra ne ishim n nj situat deflacioniste dhe krkonim t rrisnim inflacionin n nivelin 3%. Sot jemi n nj situat komplet t ndryshme, ne ndrhyjm pr rezerv, por nuk quhet ndrhyrje pr kursin e kmbimit. Banka e Shqipris publikon kalendarin e ndrhyrjeve n fillim t vitit, pikrisht pr kt qllim, q t jet transparent dhe mos t ndikoj n spekulime n tregun e kmbimeve valutore. Ne ndrhyjm pr t shmangur spekulimet dhe njkohsisht pr t mbrojtur inflacionin. T gjitha kto kritere nuk plotsohen n kt rast. Kalendari i ndrhyrjeve pr t rritur rezervn valutore t Banks s Shqipris sht i ditur nga tregu. Ndrkoh nuk shohim nj sjellje spekulative n treg. N kt kuadr nuk mund t krijojm nj precedent ndrhyrjeje nga forcimi aktual i kursit t kmbimit, pasi kjo tregon realisht tregun e kmbimeve valutore. Ky sht tregu real, kto jan prurje reale. Nuk kemi zgjerime spread-esh, nuk kemi asnj arsye pr t ndrhyr. Nga kahu tjetr e mirkuptoj dhe gjykoj q duhet bashkpunuar me eksportuesit ose me ato industri t cilat preken nga efekti i kursit t kmbimit. Natyrisht q disa sektor humbasin, disa sektor fitojn, disa individ humbasin, disa individ fitojn. T gjith ato biznese ose individ t cilt i kan t ardhurat n euro dhe shpenzimet n lek, humbasin nga forcimi i kursit t kmbimit dhe e kundrta, ato biznese dhe individ q i kan t ardhurat n lek dhe shpenzimet n euro fitojn, importuesit t themi. Natyrisht q ne kemi nj deficit tregtar, jemi ekonomi importuese. N total, po ta shohim n nivelekonomie, me shum fitojm sesa humbasim. sht shum e vrtet q eksportuesit humbasin, disa pjes t ekonomive eksportuese humbasin dhe natyrisht q ne synojm ta forcojm prodhimin vendas dhe synojm t forcojm ekonomin eksportuese. N kt kontekst, njsoj si Ministria e Financave dhe Ekonomis edhe ne do t marrim nj kontakt t shpejt me eksportuesit. Do t konsultohemi me ta dhe jemi t gatshm q t ofrojm trajnime mbi menaxhimin e rrezikut t kursit t kmbimit. Ka kontrata t cilat e fiksojn kursin, ka instrumente financiar t cilt prdoren nga kompanit ndrkombtaredhe q jan t njohura. Duke qen se ne jemi institucioni financiar kryesor, kemi dhe eksperiencen dhe ekspertizn e nevojshme, jemi t gatshm pr ti informuar dhe pr ti trajnuar t gjitha ato industri dhe ato biznese t cilat psojn nj goditje nga efekti i kursit t kmbimit. Gjithashtu do t bashkpunojm ngusht dhe me Ministrin e Financave dhe Ekonomis pr t par se far masash mund t marrim ne pr t ndihmuar eksportuesit q humbasin. Megjithat dua t theksoj q kursi kmbimit aktual reflekton tregun, prcaktohet nga krkesoferta. Dua t theksoj dhe njher q nuk sht Banka e Shqipris ajo q prcakton kursin e kmbimit sht tregu q e prcakton kursin e kmbimit. Banka e Shqipris, si institucion financiar qendror e shpall, e komunikon kursin e kmbimit, por ndrhyn vetm n ato raste q prmenda. Ky sqarim sht m shum pr opinionin publik sepse ekspertt dhe specialistt e kan shum t qart kt.

Title: Address to Governor Sejko at graduation ceremony of "Turgut Ozal" College
text: Address to Governor Sejko at graduation ceremony of "Turgut Ozal" College Publication Date: 29.05.2023 Ladies and gentlemen, dear members of the College, dear parents and, most importantly, dear seniors of The College "Turgut Ozal"! Today is a special day for all of us present in this room. Teachers, parents and you. Dear students, you have legitimate reasons to feel proud and accomplished today. Today is the day It crowns efforts initiated since childhood in relation to knowledge. As a parent, I feel proud and full of pride. With tremendous admiration for the incredible journey you've made during your high school years, I'm sure you've grown both academically and personally. This day marks the culmination of years of hard work, dedication and sacrifice. You have overcome countless challenges, you have shown that you have the courage and determination to face every difficulty. I appreciate that special credit is due to the invaluable support that your families, friends and the entire school community have given you. They have been a key factor in your journey, guiding you, encouraging and giving unconditional love. They have helped you navigate the unfamiliar paths of this transformative journey. Let's take a moment to express our hearty gratitude for their unwavering commitment to your success. Graduation is not just about getting a degree. It's about starting a new chapter in your life. It's about embracing the unknown and paving your way to the future. While you leave the familiar corridors of this institution, remember for a moment the lessons you have learned, the friendships you have created, and the many memories of school life. Amid the excitement of completing this and uncertainty about what lies ahead, try to preserve the ingrained values during the time you studied here. Strive for excellence in everything you do, pursue your passions with unwavering determination, and embrace an eternal love of knowledge. Appreciate the diversity around you and embrace sensitivity, kindness and understanding as you interact with people from all walks of life. Today's ceremony marks the closing of an important chapter. But this graduation also symbolizes the new challenges ahead. Whether you choose to pursue higher education, start a career path or explore different passions, embrace every opportunity with enthusiasm and the belief that you may one day be capable of bringing about change. Remember that success is not only measured by material achievements, but by the positive impact you have on others. Be visionary leaders, pioneers of thought in your areas of interest and promoters of change in your communities. Use your voice to advocate for justice and equality and strive to create a fairer, more inclusive and sustainable world. As you embark on a new journey, remember the great importance of endurance and perseverance. There will be times when the road ahead will seem challenging, when you will face obstacles and difficulties. It's just these moments in which your true character should shine. Rise above your adversity, learn from your failures, and let them push you forward to success. Finally, I want to bring something last to your attention. You are part of a select group that has had the privilege of receiving quality education in very good conditions. As you continue your journey, remember those who may not have had the same opportunities. Use your education to lift others up, create positive change, and be a modest ray of hope in a world that needs it. Finally, I would like to send a special thanks and congratulations to the College "Turgut Ozal" and its wonderful pedagogical staff, who with his dedication, passion, professionalism and dedication, like a second family, has accompanied and led you to this important stage of education, but especially of your life. Congratulations again, 2023! May your future be filled with infinite possibilities, boundless joy and fulfillment of all your dreams!
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala Guvernatorit Sejko n ceremonin e diplomimit t Kolegjit ''Turgut Ozal'' Data e publikimit: 29.05.2023 Zonja dhe zotrinj, t nderuar antar t Kolegjit, t dashur prindr dhe, m e rndsishmja, t dashur maturant t Kolegjit Turgut Ozal! Sot sht nj dit e veant pr t gjith ne t pranishm n kt sall. Msues, prindr dhe ju t dashur maturant keni arsye legjitime q sot t ndjeheni krenar dhe t realizuar. Sot sht dita q kurorzon prpjekje t nisura q nga fmijria n raport me dijen. Para jush, si prind n radh t par, ndjehem krenar dhe baba i plotsuar. Me admirim t jashtzakonshm pr udhtimin e pabesueshm q keni br gjat viteve t shkolls s mesme, jam i sigurt se ju jeni rritur si akademikisht ashtu edhe personalisht. Kjo dit shnon kulmin e viteve t puns s palodhur, prkushtimit dhe sakrifics. Ju keni kaprcyer sfida t panumrta, keni treguar se keni guximin dhe vendosmrin pr ti br ball do vshtirsie. Vlersoj se nj merit e veant i takon mbshtetjes s pamuar q ju kan dhn familjet tuaja, miqt dhe i gjith komuniteti i shkolls. Ata kan qen nj faktor ky n rrugtimin tuaj, duke ju udhzuar, inkurajuar dhe dhuruar dashuri t pakushtzuar. Ata ju kan ndihmuar t lundroni npr shtigjet e panjohura t ktij udhtimi transformues. Le t marrim nj moment pr t shprehur mirnjohjen ton t przemrt pr angazhimin e tyre t palkundur ndaj suksesit tuaj. Diplomimi nuk ka t bj vetm me marrjen e nj diplome; ka t bj me fillimin e nj kapitulli t ri n jetn tuaj. Bhet fjal pr t prqafuar t panjohurn dhe pr t shtruar rrugn tuaj t s ardhmes. Ndrkoh q lini korridoret e njohura t ktij institucioni, mos harroni pr asnj moment msimet q keni marr, miqsit q keni krijuar dhe kujtimet e shumta t jets shkollore. Mes entuziazmit t prfundimit t ksaj etape dhe pasiguris pr at q ju pret, prpiquni t ruani vlerat e rrnjosura gjat kohs q ju studiuat ktu. Prpiquni pr prsosmri n do gj q bni, ndiqni pasionet tuaja me vendosmri t palkundur dhe prqafoni nj dashuri t prjetshme pr dijen. Vlersoni diversitetin q ju rrethon dhe prqafoni ndjeshmrin, mirsin dhe mirkuptimin, ndrsa ndrveproni me njerz nga t gjitha sferat e jets. Ceremonia e sotme shnon mbylljen e nj kapitulli t rndsishm. Por nga ana tjetr ky diplomim simbolizon edhe sfidat e reja q ju presin. Pavarsisht nse zgjidhni t ndiqni arsimin e lart, t filloni nj rrug karriere ose t eksploroni pasione t ndryshme, prqafoni do mundsi me entuziazm dhe besimin se mund t jeni t aft nj dit t sillni ndryshim. Mos harroni se suksesi nuk matet vetm nga arritjet materiale, por nga ndikimi pozitiv q keni tek t tjert. Jini udhheqs vizionar, pionier t mendimit n fushat tuaja t interesit dhe promotor t ndryshimit n komunitetet tuaja. Prdorni zrin tuaj pr t mbrojtur drejtsin dhe barazin dhe prpiquni t krijoni nj bot m t drejt, m gjithprfshirse dhe t qndrueshme. Ndrkoh q do filloni nj udhtim t ri, mos harroni rndsin e madhe t qndrueshmris dhe t kmbnguljes. Do t ket momente kur rruga prpara do tju duket sfiduese, kur do t prballeni me pengesa dhe vshtirsi. Jan pikrisht kto momente n t cilat duhet t shklqej karakteri juaj i vrtet. Ngrihuni mbi fatkeqsit, msoni nga dshtimet dhe lrini ato t'ju shtyjn prpara drejt suksesit. S fundi, dua t sjell dhe dika t fundit n vmendjen tuaj. Ju jeni pjes e nj grupi t zgjedhur q keni pasur privilegjin t merrni arsim cilsor n kushte shum t mira. Ndrkoh q vazhdoni udhtimin tuaj, mbani mend ata q mund t mos ken pasur t njjtat mundsi. Prdoreni edukimin tuaj pr t ngritur lart t tjert, pr t krijuar ndryshime pozitive dhe pr t qen nj rreze sado modeste shprese n nj bot q ka nevoj pr t. N prfundim, do t doja q nj falnderim dhe urim t veant tia drejtoja Kolegjit Turgut Ozal dhe stafit t tij t mrekullueshm pedagogjik, i cili me prkushtimin, pasionin, profesionalizmin dhe dedikimin e tij, ashtu si nj familje e dyt, ju ka shoqruar e udhhequr n kt stad kaq t rndsishm t edukimit, por veanrisht t jets suaj. Edhe njher urime matura 2023! Qoft e ardhmja juaj e mbushur me mundsi t pafundme, gzim t pakufishm dhe prmbushje t t gjitha ndrrave tuaja!

Title: Governor Sejko's speech at the signing ceremony of the Memorandum of Understanding between the Swiss State Secretariat for Economic Affairs (SECO) and the Bank of Albania
text: Governor Sejko's speech at the signing ceremony Memorandum of Understanding between the Swiss State Secretariat Economic Affairs (SECO) and the Bank of Albania Publication Date: 19.06.2023 E. nderuar Ambasadore Huber, Honorable participant, We have gathered today to sign the new phase of an important cooperation between the Bank of Albania and the State Secretariat for Economic Affairs (SECO), which on behalf of the Swiss Government develops the technical assistance program in support of central banks. This agreement is another key step towards improving the monetary and financial policies in our country, to further strengthen Albania's economy and financial system. Before we focus on the details of this agreement, I would like to express our deep gratitude to the Swiss Government and SECO for their support and confidence in the Bank of Albania. This cooperation is a powerful example of how international partners can help develop our institutions and improve our capacities in the field of monetary, financial and statistical policies. The commitments to be undertaken for the next three years are based on a very large, elevated and enriched work continuously over the previous 10 years. Thanks to your assistance in these 10 years, the Bank of Albania has made significant progress, improving the analysis and models and extending them to new areas, which face and interact with price stability and financial ones. Together (with SECO) we have invested in human capacity development and improved our scientific research methodologies and practices. This has included organizing seminars, conferences and study visits for our employees. The State Secretariat for Economic Affairs (SECO) and its Bilateral Assistance and Capacity Building Programme (BCC) is a platform that extends cooperation with eight central banks in developing economies. As I have said before, the BCC also offers a valuable communication platform that includes discussion at international conferences, where representatives of the academy, international institutions and central banks discuss and bring the best experiences. This mechanism has been developed sufficiently to enable interaction and assistance between central banks involved in the programme. We note with satisfaction that in addition to the conferences and activities centered in Geneva, activities and discussions have been extended to the participating countries in the programme. A year ago, the Bank of Albania had the pleasure to welcome in Tirana all central banks that are part of the program, at a conference where we discussed and shared the experiences in the field of scientific research. I hope that the third phase of the agreement will further increase the bilateral and multilateral cooperation between the banks participating in the program. With today's signing, we show our continued commitment to achieving common goals and objectives. This new phase focuses on new macroeconomic and financial challenges that are determined by specific geopolitical conditions. At the same time, rapid developments in digitalization and financial innovation present significant challenges for both authorities and society that must recognize, understand and use these instruments, but at the same time protect against the risks that come with rapid and rapid development of technology. In this context, cooperation with SECO and the Bilateral Assistance and Capacity Building Programme is a guarantee that we will be able to successfully respond to the challenges that await us, contributing to the development of the financial sector and the economy of Albania in a sustainable way, without undercutting price stability and financial stability. Financial education, digitalization, and financial innovation are three important issues that have taken hold on the agendas of central banks. These determine the fundamental problems our societies will face, the nature and direction of monetary and financial stability policies, and at the same time the development of the financial and payment systems. The Bank of Albania has also started discussing and studying these phenomena, making them part of its development strategies. The next step is to implement them in the economy and the financial system. Of course, we want to do this by combining our efforts with the best world studies and experiences in these areas, so we are happy to continue our cooperation with the Swiss Government. On the other hand, today's agreement broadens its focus, enriching it with three issues: From First, by staying true to our main objective of achieving and maintaining the macroeconomic and financial stability of the country, the cooperation aims to strengthen our role in formulating and implementing monetary policy, as well as in promoting financial stability. The studies during this third phase will deepen the analysis of demographic developments, the impacts of climate change and environmental sustainability on the economy and financial system, and will also expand on phenomena and technological developments in financial markets. From Second, aiming to increase resistance to potential turbulence in the global economy, the internal market and the financial system, the cooperation will pay particular attention to de-euroization policies, increase the sustainability of the banking sector and expand the range of financial instruments and services in the service of business and households. From Third, we aim to provide a contemporary payment system that is capable of providing fast, efficient and minimal cost solutions for traditional and innovative financial services. Through him and financial education, the Bank of Albania aims to promote and increase the financial inclusion of the population. Our objective is to do this without undermining the stability of the system and increasing its resilience to climate change risks to ensure the sustainability of the banking and environmental system. Consequently, in this new phase of cooperation, we will continue to focus on improving the payment system infrastructure and developing human capacities. In the end, I want to emphasize the importance and utility of third-party engagement. SECO brings to this agreement the contribution of the academy, central banks of developed countries and international financial institutions. International cooperation is vital in the current time, when challenges and impacts are global. Only by working together and sharing our experiences and expertise can we achieve the objectives and bring progress to our country. In conclusion, I would like to again thank SECO, the Swiss Government, the Swiss Embassy in Tirana, and the entire working team for drafting the agreement, for their continued engagement and support. I am convinced that this new phase of cooperation will bring wonderful results and strengthen our role and contribution to the development of the country. Thank you all for your unwavering participation and support!
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n ceremonin e nnshkrimit t Memorandumit t Mirkuptimit midis Sekretariatit t Shtetit Zviceran pr shtjet Ekonomike (SECO) dhe Banks s Shqipris Data e publikimit: 19.06.2023 E nderuar Ambasadore Huber, T nderuar pjesmarrs, Jemi mbledhur sot pr t nnshkruar fazn e re t nj bashkpunimi t rndsishm mes Banks s Shqipris dhe Sekretariatit t Shtetit pr shtjet Ekonomike (SECO), i cili n emr t Qeveris Zvicerane zhvillon programin e asistencs teknike n mbshtetje t bankave qendrore. Kjo marrveshje sht nj tjetr hap ky drejt prmirsimit t politikave monetare dhe financiare n vendin ton, pr t forcuar m tej ekonomin dhe sistemin financiar t Shqipris. Prpara se t fokusohemi n detajet e ksaj marrveshjeje, dua t shpreh mirnjohjen ton t thell ndaj Qeveris Zvicerane dhe SECO-s pr mbshtetjen dhe besimin e tyre n Bankn e Shqipris. Ky bashkpunim sht nj shembull i fuqishm se si partnert ndrkombtar mund t ndihmojn n zhvillimin e institucioneve tona dhe t prmirsojn kapacitetet tona n fushn e politikave monetare, financiare dhe statistikore. Angazhimet q do t ndrmerren pr tri vitet e ardhshme bazohen n nj pun shum t madhe, t ngritur dhe t pasuruar vazhdimisht gjat 10 viteve t mparshme. N saj t asistencs suaj n kto 10 vjet, Banka e Shqipris ka br prparime t konsiderueshme, duke e prmirsuar analizn dhe modelet ekzistuese dhe duke i shtrir ato n fusha t reja, me t cilat prballet e ndrvepron stabiliteti i mimeve dhe ai financiar. S bashku (me SECO-n) kemi investuar n zhvillimin e kapaciteteve njerzore dhe kemi prmirsuar metodologjit dhe praktikat tona t krkimit shkencor. Kjo ka prfshir organizimin e seminareve, konferencave dhe vizitave studimore pr punonjsit tan. Sekretariati i Shtetit pr shtjet Ekonomike (SECO) dhe Programi i tij i Asistencs Bilaterale dhe Ngritjes s Kapaciteteve (BCC) sht nj platform q e shtrin bashkpunimin me tet banka qendrore n ekonomit n zhvillim. Si e kam thn edhe m par, BCC ofron gjithashtu nj platform t vlefshme komunikimi q prfshin edhe diskutimin n konferenca ndrkombtare, ku prfaqsuesit e akademis, institucioneve ndrkombtare dhe bankave qendrore diskutojn dhe sjellin eksperiencat m t mira. Ky mekanizm sht zhvilluar mjaftueshm pr t mundsuar ndrveprimin dhe dhnien e asistencs ndrmjet bankave qendrore t prfshira n program. Ne vrejm me knaqsi se prve konferencave dhe aktiviteteve t qendrzuara n Gjenev, aktivitetet dhe diskutimet jan shtrir edhe n vendet pjesmarrse n program. Nj vit m par, Banka e Shqipris ka pasur knaqsin t mirpres n Tiran t gjitha bankat qendrore q jan pjes e programit, n nj konferenc ku diskutuam dhe ndam eksperiencat n fushn e krkimit shkencor. Shpresoj q faza e tret e marrveshjes do ta rris edhe m shum bashkpunimin dy dhe shumpalsh ndrmjet bankave pjesmarrse n program. Me nnshkrimin e sotm, ne tregojm prkushtimin ton t vazhdueshm pr t arritur qllimet dhe objektivat e prbashkta. Kjo faz e re fokusohet drejt sfidave t reja makroekonomike e financiare q prcaktohen nga kushtet specifike gjeopolitike. Njkohsisht, zhvillimet e shpejta n digjitalizim dhe inovacionin financiar paraqesin sfida domethnse si pr autoritetet, ashtu edhe pr shoqrin q duhet ti njoh, ti kuptoj e ti prdor kto instrumente, por njkohsisht edhe t mbrohet nga rreziqet q vijn me zhvillimin e shpejt e t vrullshm t teknologjis. N kt kuadr, bashkpunimi me SECO-n dhe Programi i Asistencs Bilaterale dhe Ngritjes s Kapaciteteve, sht nj garanci se do t jemi n gjendje ti prgjigjemi me sukses sfidave q na presin, duke kontribuuar n zhvillimin e sektorit financiar dhe t ekonomis s Shqipris n mnyr t qndrueshme, pa cenuar stabilitetin e mimeve dhe at financiar. Edukimi financiar, digjitalizimi, si dhe inovacioni financiar jan tre shtje t rndsishme q kan zn vend n agjendat e bankave qendrore.
