Kto prcaktojn problemet fondamentale me t cilat do t prballen shoqrit tona, natyrn dhe drejtimin e politikave monetare e t stabilitetit financiar, dhe njkohsisht zhvillimin e sistemit financiar dhe atyre t pagesave. Edhe Banka e Shqipris ka nisur diskutimin dhe studimin e ktyre fenomeneve, duke i br ato pjes t strategjive t zhvillimit t saj. Lvizja e radhs sht implementimi i tyre n ekonomi dhe n sistemin financiar. Natyrisht, ne duam ta bjm kt duke ndrthurur prpjekjet tona me studimet dhe eksperiencat m t mira botrore n kto fusha, ndaj jemi t lumtur ta vazhdojm bashkpunimin ton me Qeverin Zvicerane. Nga ana tjetr, marrveshja e sotme e zgjeron fokusin e saj, duke e pasuruar at edhe me tre shtje: S pari, duke i qndruar besnik objektivit ton kryesor pr arritjen dhe ruajtjen e stabilitetit makroekonomik e financiar t vendit, bashkpunimi synon t forcoj m shum rolin ton n formulimin dhe zbatimin e politiks monetare, si dhe n promovimin e stabilitetit financiar. Studimet gjat ksaj faze t tret do t thellojn analizn pr zhvillimet demografike, ndikimet e ndryshimeve klimatike dhe t qndrueshmris s mjedisit n ekonomi dhe sistemin financiar, dhe njkohsisht do t zgjerohen n fenomenet dhe zhvillimet teknologjike n tregjet financiare. S dyti, duke synuar rritjen e rezistencs ndaj turbulencave t mundshme n ekonomin globale, tregun e brendshm dhe sistemin financiar, bashkpunimi do ti kushtoj vmendje t veant politikave t de-euroizimit, rritjes s qndrueshmris t sektorit bankar dhe zgjerimit t gams s instrumenteve dhe shrbimeve financiare n shrbim t biznesit dhe familjeve. S treti, ne synojm t sigurojm nj sistem avangard/bashkkohor t pagesave q sht i aft t ofroj zgjidhje t shpejta, eficiente dhe me kosto minimale pr shrbimet financiare tradicionale edhe ato novatore. Prmes tij dhe edukimit financiar, Banka e Shqipris synon t promovoj dhe t rris prfshirjen financiare t popullats. Objektivi yn sht q ta bjm kt pa cenuar stabilitetin e sistemit dhe duke rritur njkohsisht rezistencn e tij ndaj rreziqeve t lidhura me ndryshimet klimatike pr t garantuar qndrueshmrin e sistemit bankar dhe at mjedisore. Rrjedhimisht, n kt faz t re bashkpunimi, do t vazhdojm t fokusohemi n prmirsimin e infrastrukturs s sistemit t pagesave dhe n zhvillimin e kapaciteteve njerzore. N fund, dua t theksoj rndsin dhe dobin e angazhimit t palve t treta. SECO sjell n kt marrveshje, kontributin e akademis, bankave qendrore t vendeve t zhvilluara dhe institucioneve financiare ndrkombtare. Bashkpunimi ndrkombtar sht jetik n kohn aktuale, kur sfidat dhe ndikimet jan globale. Vetm duke punuar s bashku dhe duke ndar prvojat dhe ekspertizn ton, mund t arrijm objektivat dhe t sjellim prparim n vendin ton. N prfundim, dua t falnderoj srish SECO-n, Qeverin Zvicerane, Ambasadn e Zvicrs n Tiran, dhe t gjith ekipin e puns pr hartimin e marrveshjes, pr angazhimin dhe mbshtetjen e tyre t vazhdueshme. Jam i bindur se kjo faz e re bashkpunimi do t sjell rezultate t mrekullueshme dhe do t forcoj rolin dhe kontributin ton n zhvillimin e vendit. Faleminderit t gjithve pr pjesmarrjen dhe mbshtetjen tuaj t palkundur!

Title: Governor Sejko's speech at the High Level Conference "Green Finance in South East Europe: Capacity Development and a Taxonomy"
text: Governor Sejko's speech at the High Level Conference "Green Finance in South East Europe: Capacity Development and a Taxonomy" Date of publication: 22.06.2023 Dear Ladies and Gentlemen, The Minister of Foreign Affairs, Honorable colleagues, Welcome to the High Level Conference "Green Finance in South East Europe: Capacity Development and a Taxonomy". I would like to express my sincere gratitude to the CEF (Center of Excellence in Finance/ Centre of Excellence in Finance) for organizing this conference and creating the opportunity to beat our opinions on an issue of outstanding importance for the future of our planet. CEF has been a strong and reliable partner for us, with whom we will continue to cooperate to build policies that guarantee macroeconomic and financial stability. Through its activities, CEF contributes to achieving the goals of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, promoting effective, responsible and inclusive institutions at all levels. We are aware that climate change poses a serious threat to people's well-being and the health of our planet. These risks, be they physical - due to extreme weather events - or transitory, are complex to understand and assess. This complexity deepens in the absence of a common language or taxonomy, as well as sufficient data and empirical models and methods to assess these risks, the nature of which is certain, but their extent and impacts on the financial sector remain poorly defined and valued. Global awareness to withstand rising risks is growing. In 2015, the signatory states of the Paris Agreement pledged to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, while the European Union then set its ambitious goal of being the first continent to have a climate-neutral approach by 2050. The financial sector undoubtedly plays an important role in achieving this goal, not only through the selection and financing of green projects, but also by maintaining the balance of demand and supply in markets. At the same time, the financial sector is particularly exposed to the risks of climate change. Public institutions in the EU and the European System of Central Banks are pioneers in shaping the global regulatory environment and have adopted some of the best practices that continue to evolve. Their examples are inspiring to institutions and other central banks of developed and developing economies. Understanding climate change from the perspective of central banks and supervisors also includes structural changes that will affect the financial system and the economy at large. These changes will challenge us in carrying out our fundamental missions, whether it be in relation to price stability, financial stability or financial inclusion. In South East Europe, our financial institutions are in the initial stages of developing a strategic perspective and implementing the first steps for green finance. While capacities and taxonomy in green finance are developing quickly, there are still many gaps that require careful coordination, heritable adaptation and continuous learning. Ladies and gentlemen, Climate change is an undeniable reality, and despite Albania contributing limited to global greenhouse gas emissions, their consequences are beginning to take its toll on our country as well. From big businesses to simple families, climate change is challenging our economy at all levels, affecting all economic actors, across all sectors and across the country. This major challenge requires a joint and coordinated response from all stakeholders of the economy, including the Bank of Albania. The financial sector plays a key role in climate change, which are high in cost, and are multiplant. They are a source of risk for financial institutions, but on the other hand, there is no sustainable development without sustainable financing and here the banking sector can play a leading role for companies in Albania. This means not only "channeling funds" but also "educating customers" to develop more environmentally friendly and environmentally-sustainable and environmentally risk-resilient business and investment models. As a public institution, the Bank of Albania is committed to understanding and addressing the economic and financial consequences of climate change and the transition to a net zero emission economy. We are working to adapt our 2019 scoes and policies to these changes. Sharing knowledge, practices, discussions, staff training and public education are important in this process and the Bank of Albania will continue to dedicate sufficient resources to study and model the effects of climate on price stability and financial. In recent years, we have taken concrete steps to address climate change issues and promote green finance. Since 2018, we have started a wide process of modernization and digitalization of the payment market, aiming not only to promote financial inclusion and the use of electronic payments in the Albanian economy, but also to contribute to green finance. We have expanded our analytical capacities in the field of climate change. We have also contributed to the production of analysis and research on climate-related risks. In our Medium Term Strategy for 2022-2024, we have decided to monitor climate risks to the economic and financial environment, where the Bank of Albania operates. We also collaborated with the World Bank in drafting a multi-year green strategy, which was approved in May by the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania. As governor of the Bank of Albania, I appreciate the importance of discussion, cooperation and support at international level to address the challenges posed by climate change and the transition to a sustainable economy. For this reason, we have developed numerous national, regional and international partnerships to assess and manage the economic and financial impact of climate change. In this context, I appreciate our cooperation with CEF, our membership in the NGFS (Network for Greening the Financial System) since 2020, as well as our various collaborations with the Swiss Government's State Secretariat for Economic Affairs (SECO), the Vienna Initiative, the World Bank (FinSAC), and many others. Ladies and gentlemen, Recently, the challenges we have faced are many, complex and multidimensional, often interdependent. I'm aware that change won't happen in one night, but let's be optimistic. Today, launching this High-Level Conference, I want to emphasize the importance of green finance not only as a response to the global climate change challenge, but also as a means to guarantee macroeconomic and financial stability. One thing is certain: the costs or damage that inaction will cause will be far greater than the costs that will come from taking action to minimize future risks. We need strong policies, cooperation and innovation. By working together, we can exchange experiences and build a better and sustainable future for everyone. The financial system plays an important role in this process. With responsibility to future generations, let us commit today to having a positive impact on the future of our country and planet. Remember that the future will take the form of what we choose to finance today. Thank you for your attention!
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n Konferencn e Nivelit t Lart Financa e Gjelbr n Evropn Juglindore: Zhvillimi i Kapaciteteve dhe nj Taksonomi Data e publikimit: 22.06.2023 T nderuar zonja e zotrinj, Zonja Ministre, Koleg t nderuar, Mir se vini n Konferencn e Nivelit t Lart Financa e Gjelbr n Evropn Juglindore: Zhvillimi i Kapaciteteve dhe nj Taksonomi. Dshiroj t shpreh mirnjohjen time t sinqert ndaj CEF-it (Center of Excellence in Finance/Qendra e Ekselencs n Financ) pr organizimin e ksaj konference dhe krijimin e mundsis pr t rrahur mendimet tona mbi nj shtje t nj rndsie t jashtzakonshme pr t ardhmen e planetit ton. CEF-i ka qen nj partner i fort dhe i besueshm pr ne, me t cilin do t vazhdojm t bashkpunojm pr t ndrtuar politika q garantojn stabilitetin makroekonomik dhe financiar. Prmes aktiviteteve t tij, CEF-i kontribuon n arritjen e qllimeve t Agjends 2030 pr Zhvillimin e Qndrueshm, duke promovuar institucione efektive, t prgjegjshme dhe t prfshira n t gjitha nivelet. Jemi t vetdijshm se ndryshimet klimatike prbjn nj krcnim serioz pr mirqenien e njerzve dhe shndetin e planetit ton. Kto rreziqe, qofshin ato fizike - pr shkak t ngjarjeve ekstreme t motit - ose kalimtare, jan komplekse pr t'u kuptuar dhe vlersuar. Ky kompleksitet thellohet n munges t nj gjuhe ose taksonomie t prbashkt, si dhe t t dhnave t mjaftueshme dhe modeleve empirike e metodave pr t vlersuar kto rreziqe, natyra e t cilave sht e sigurt, por shtrirja dhe ndikimet e tyre n sektorin financiar mbeten t prcaktuara e t vlersuara n mnyr t dobt. Ndrgjegjsimi global pr ti br ball rritjes s rreziqeve po rritet. N vitin 2015, shtetet nnshkruese t Marrveshjes s Parisit premtuan q do t zvoglonin emetimet e gazrave t efektit ser, ndrsa m pas Bashkimi Evropian vendosi synimin ambicioz pr t qen kontinenti i par me nj qasje neutrale ndaj klims deri n vitin 2050. Sektori financiar luan padyshim nj rol t rndsishm n arritjen e ktij synimi, jo vetm prmes przgjedhjes e financimit t projekteve t gjelbra, por edhe duke ruajtur ekuilibrin e krkes-oferts n tregje. N t njjtn koh, sektori financiar sht veanrisht i ekspozuar ndaj rreziqeve t ndryshimit t klims. Institucionet publike n BE dhe Sistemi Evropian i Bankave Qendrore jan pionier n formimin e mjedisit rregullator global dhe kan adoptuar disa prej praktikave m t mira q vazhdojn t evoluojn. Shembujt e tyre jan frymzues pr institucionet dhe bankat e tjera qendrore t ekonomive t zhvilluara dhe n zhvillim. T kuptuarit e shtjes s ndryshimeve klimatike nga kndvshtrimi i bankave qendrore dhe mbikqyrsve prfshin edhe ndryshimet strukturore q do t ndikojn sistemin financiar dhe n ekonomin n prgjithsi. Kto ndryshime do t na sfidojn n kryerjen e misioneve tona themelore, qoft n lidhje me stabilitetin e mimeve, stabilitetin financiar apo prfshirjen financiare. N Evropn Juglindore, institucionet tona financiare jan n fazat fillestare t zhvillimit t nj perspektive strategjike dhe implementimit t hapave t par pr financn e gjelbr. Ndrsa kapacitetet dhe taksonomia n financn e gjelbr po zhvillohen shpejt, ende ka shum boshllqe q krkojn koordinim t kujdesshm, prshtatje t herpashershme dhe msim t vazhdueshm. Zonja dhe zotrinj, Ndryshimet klimatike jan nj realitet i pamohueshm, dhe pavarsisht se Shqipria kontribuon n mnyr t kufizuar n emetimet globale t gazrave t efektit ser, pasojat e tyre kan filluar t japin efektin e tyre edhe n vendin ton. Duke filluar nga bizneset e mdha, te familjet e thjeshta, ndryshimet klimatike po sfidojn ekonomin ton n t gjitha nivelet, duke prekur t gjith aktort ekonomik, n t gjith sektort dhe n t gjith territorin e vendit. Kjo sfid e madhe krkon nj prgjigje t prbashkt dhe t koordinuar nga t gjith aktort e ekonomis, duke prfshir edhe Bankn e Shqipris. Sektori financiar luan nj rol ky n lidhje me ndryshimet klimatike, t cilat kan nj kosto t lart, dhe jan shumplanshe. Ato jan nj burim rreziku pr institucionet financiare, por nga ana tjetr, nuk ka zhvillim t qndrueshm pa financim t qndrueshm dhe ktu sektori bankar mund t luaj nj rol udhheqs pr kompanit n Shqipri. Kjo do t thot jo vetm "kanalizim t fondeve", por edhe "edukim t klientve" pr t zhvilluar modele biznesi dhe investimi m miqsore ndaj mjedisit dhe m t qndrueshme ndaj rreziqeve mjedisore e klimatike. Si nj institucion publik, Banka e Shqipris sht e prkushtuar pr t kuptuar dhe trajtuar pasojat ekonomike dhe financiare t ndryshimeve klimatike dhe kalimin n nj ekonomi me emetim neto zero. Ne po punojm pr t prshtatur kuadrin regullativ dhe politikat tona me kto ndryshime. Ndarja e njohurive, praktikave, diskutimet, trajnimi i stafit dhe edukimi i publikut, jan t rndsishm n kt proces dhe Banka e Shqipris do t vazhdoj ti dedikoj burime t mjaftueshme studimit dhe modelimit t efekteve t klims n stabilitetin e mimeve dhe at financiar. Kto vitet e fundit kemi ndrmarr hapa konkret pr t adresuar shtjet e ndryshimeve klimatike dhe pr t promovuar financat e gjelbra. Q prej vitit 2018, kemi nisur nj proces t gjer modernizimi dhe digjitalizimi t tregut t pagesave, me qllim jo vetm nxitjen e prfshirjes financiare dhe prdorimit t pagesave elektronike n ekonomin shqiptare, por edhe kontributin n financn e gjelbr. Kemi zgjeruar kapacitetet tona analitike n fushn e ndryshimit t klims. Gjithashtu, kemi kontribuuar n prodhimin e analizave dhe hulumtimeve mbi rreziqet e lidhura me klimn. N Strategjin ton Afatmesme pr vitet 2022-2024, kemi vendosur t monitorojm rreziqet klimatike ndaj mjedisit ekonomik dhe financiar, ku operon Banka e Shqipris. Gjithashtu, kemi bashkpunuar me Bankn Botrore n hartimin e nj strategjie t gjelbr shumvjeare, e cila u miratua n muajin maj nga Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris. Si Guvernator i Banks s Shqipris, vlersoj rndsin e diskutimit, bashkpunimit dhe mbshtetjes n nivel ndrkombtar pr t adresuar sfidat q paraqesin ndryshimet klimatike dhe tranzicioni drejt nj ekonomie t qndrueshme. Pr kt arsye, ne kemi zhvilluar partneritete t shumta kombtare, rajonale dhe ndrkombtare, pr t vlersuar dhe menaxhuar ndikimin ekonomik dhe financiar t ndryshimeve klimatike. N kt kontekst, vlersoj bashkpunimin ton me CEF-in, antarsimin ton n NGFS (Network for Greening the Financial System) q nga viti 2020, si dhe bashkpunimet tona t ndryshme me Sekretariatin Shtetror pr shtjet Ekonomike t Qeveris Zvicerane (SECO), Iniciativn e Vjens, Bankn Botrore (FinSAC), dhe shum t tjer. Zonja dhe zotrinj, Koht e fundit, sfidat me t cilat jemi prballur jan t shumta, komplekse dhe shumdimensionale, shpesh t ndrvarura prej njra-tjetrs. Jam i vetdijshm q ndryshimi nuk do t ndodh brenda nj nate, por le t jemi optimist. Sot, duke e nisur kt Konferenc t Nivelit t Lart, dua t theksoj rndsin e financs s gjelbr jo vetm si nj prgjigje ndaj sfids globale t ndryshimit t klims, por edhe si nj mjet pr t garantuar stabilitetin makroekonomik dhe financiar. Nj gj sht e sigurt: kostot apo dmi q do t shkaktoj mosveprimi do t jen shum m t mdha se kostot q do t vijn nga marrja e masave pr t minimizuar rreziqet e ardhshme. Prandaj, ne kemi nevoj pr politika t fuqishme, pr bashkpunim dhe inovacion. Duke punuar s bashku, mund t shkmbejm eksperiencat dhe t ndrtojm nj t ardhme m t mir dhe t qndrueshme pr t gjith. Sistemi financiar luan nj rol t rndsishm n kt proces. Me prgjegjsi ndaj brezave t ardhshm, le t angazhohemi sot pr t pasur nj ndikim pozitiv n t ardhmen e vendit dhe planetit ton. Mos harroni se e ardhmja do t marr formn e asaj q zgjedhim t financojm sot. Faleminderit pr vmendjen tuaj!

Title: Governor Sejko's remarks at the press conference on monetary policy decision making, 5 July 2023
text: Governor Sejko's remarks at the press conference on monetary policy decision making, 5 July 2023 Publication Date: 05.07.2023 Dear representatives of the media, Today, on 5 July 2023, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Intermediate Monetary Policy Report. The new information obtained in the analysis suggests that the Albanian economy has been growing in the first half of the year, albeit at slower times compared to the previous period. At the same time, inflation has come in downwards, mostly reflecting the decline in imported inflation. Overall, these developments have been in line with current trends in the world economy and in line with our expectations. The update suggests that these trends will be present in the future: economic activity in the country is expected to continue to grow over the coming quarters, while inflation is expected to continue to gradually decline and return to target in the first half of 2024. In these circumstances, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current stance of monetary policy remains appropriate. However, the Council found that internal inflationary pressures remain high and meeting our price stability objective may require a further normalisation of the monetary policy stance in the future. Inflation declined during the second quarter, recording an average value of 4.7% in April-May. This dynamic has been dictated by the fall in inflation of the prices of processed food, petroleum and related products, while the inflation of other basket items has shown relatively stable. In macroeconomic terms, the downside inflation trend reflected the similar performance of this indicator in our trading partners, the strengthening of the lek exchange rate against the euro, as well as the effects of the comparative high base. On the other hand, domestic inflationary pressures remain high, reflecting high demand for goods and services, tight labor market conditions and rapidly rising wages and labor costs. According to Instat data, the volume of economic activity in the country increased by 2.7% in the first quarter of the year, coming in a slowdown compared to the previous quarter and being on the lower end of our expectations. Economic growth had a broad base, both in sectoral terms and in terms of aggregate demand components. At the same time, slowing growth had a relatively broad base, although it was most prominent in the construction and industry sectors and in the household consumption component. In macroeconomic terms, the increase in demand for goods and services has reflected the healthy position of the financial balance sheets of the private sector, still favorable financing conditions and the increase of exports of Albanian services, mainly tourism. On the other hand, fiscal policy has had a neutral impact, while the balance of foreign goods exchanges has had a negative impact. Although slowing, further expansion of aggregate demand has reflected to a high degree the exploitation of capacities in the economy. This phenomenon remains more prominent in the labor market. Available data for the first quarter suggests the lingering trend of employment and wage growth, supporting the expansion of household purchasing power but keeping domestic inflationary pressures high. The normalization of the monetary policy stance undertaken by the Bank of Albania has helped to smoothly function financial markets. However, during the second quarter, these markets were characterized by a reduction in interest rates of government securities and loans in ALL, as well as by a rapid strengthening of the exchange rate. On the one hand, the fall in lek interest rates has reflected the good liquidity situation in financial markets and the reduction of risk premiums perceived by its agents. On the other hand, the strengthening of the lek exchange rate has reflected the continuous improvement of the balance of trade and financial exchanges with abroad, as well as the increase in interest to save and invest in our national currency. Overall, the normalisation of the monetary policy stance has created financial conditions more suitable for controlling inflation. However, even as it is tightened, funding conditions remain stimulating for consumption and investment growth. In response, the private sector loan continues to grow while the quality of its portfolio has remained satisfactory, as illustrated by the low levels of the non-performing loans ratio. The financial health of the banking sector suggests that this sector will be able to continue to respond to the economy's demand for funds. The update of our forecasts suggests that the Albanian economy will continue to grow and that inflation will gradually decline and return to target in the first half of 2024. The fall in inflation will reflect further reduction of inflation in global markets and the normalization of monetary policy posture in the country. This normalisation will create a better balance between demand and supply, support the stability of financial markets, and help control economic agents' expectations for inflation. On the other hand, economic activity is expected to continue to grow over the next quarters. The pace of growth is expected to come in slightly slower over the next two years and return to historic levels in the medium to long term. This projection factors in the good financial health of the private and banking sector of the Albanian economy, the positive outlook of the labour market, the improvement of the confidence of families and businesses, and the presence of a still accommodating financial environment. *** Based on the above, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania decided: the Keep the basic interest rate unchanged, at 3.00%; the Keep unchanged the interest rate of the one-day loan at 4.00%; the Keep the interest rate of the one-day deposit at 2.00% unchanged. However, the Council judges that high inflationary pressures from the domestic economy remain a risk factor for price stability in the country. In these circumstances, it will monitor the situation carefully to assess the performance of inflationary pressures and to identify in time the measures necessary to achieve the target, including further normalisation of the monetary policy stance. In any case, monetary policy will provide the necessary conditions for the adherence to the price stability objective in the medium term, while taking care at the same time to minimize its impact on curbing economic activity and possible undesirable consequences on financial stability.
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 5 korrik 2023 Data e publikimit: 05.07.2023 T nderuar prfaqsues t medias, Sot, n datn 5 korrik 2023, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris mori n shqyrtim dhe miratoi Raportin e Ndrmjetm t Politiks Monetare. Informacioni i ri i marr n analiz sugjeron se ekonomia shqiptare ka vijuar t rritet n gjysmn e par t vitit, ndonse me ritme m t ngadalta n krahasim me periudhn paraardhse. N t njjtn koh, inflacioni ka ardhur n rnie, duke pasqyruar m s shumti rnien e inflacionit t importuar. N trsi, kto zhvillime kan qen n linj me trendet aktuale n ekonomin botrore dhe n prputhje me pritjet tona. Po ashtu, prditsimi i parashikimeve sugjeron se kto tendenca do t jen t pranishme edhe n t ardhmen: aktiviteti ekonomik n vend pritet t vazhdoj t rritet gjat tremujorve n vazhdim ndrsa inflacioni pritet t vijoj rnien graduale dhe t kthehet n objektiv n gjysmn e par t vitit 2024. N kto rrethana, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare mbetet i prshtatshm. Megjithat, Kshilli konstatoi se presionet e brendshme inflacioniste mbeten t larta dhe prmbushja e objektivit ton t stabilitetit t mimeve mund t krkoj nj normalizim t mtejshm t qndrimit t politiks monetare n t ardhmen. Inflacioni shnoi rnie gjat tremujorit t dyt, duke regjistruar nj vler mesatare prej 4.7% n muajt prill-maj. Kjo dinamik sht diktuar nga rnia e inflacionit t mimeve t ushqimeve t prpunuara, t nafts dhe t produkteve t lidhura me t, ndrkoh q inflacioni i artikujve t tjer t shports sht shfaqur relativisht i qndrueshm. N aspektin makroekonomik, trendi rns i inflacionit pasqyroi ecurin e ngjashme t ktij treguesi n partnert tan tregtar, forcimin e kursit t kmbimit t lekut ndaj euros, si dhe efektet e bazs s lart krahasuese. Nga ana tjetr, presionet e brendshme inflacioniste vijojn t mbeten t larta, n pasqyrim t krkess s lart pr mallra e shrbime, t kushteve t shtrnguara n tregun e puns dhe t rritjes s shpejt t pagave e t kostove t puns. Sipas t dhnave t Instat-it, vllimi i aktivitetit ekonomik n vend u rrit me 2.7% n tremujorin e par t vitit, duke ardhur n ngadalsim krahasuar me tremujorin paraardhs dhe duke qen n kahun e poshtm t pritjeve tona. Rritja ekonomike pati nj baz t gjer, si n terma sektorial ashtu dhe n terma t prbrsve t krkess agregate. N t njjtn koh, ngadalsimi i ritmit t rritjes kishte nj baz relativisht t gjer, ndonse ai ishte m i spikatur n sektort e ndrtimit e t industris dhe n prbrsin e konsumit familjar. N aspektin makroekonomik, rritja e krkess pr mallra e shrbime ka pasqyruar pozicionin e shndetshm t bilanceve financiare t sektorit privat, kushtet ende t favorshme t financimit dhe rritjen e eksportit t shrbimeve shqiptare, e kryesisht t atyre t turizmit. Nga ana tjetr, politika fiskale ka pasur nj ndikim neutral ndrkoh q bilanci i shkmbimeve t mallrave me jasht ka dhn nj ndikim negativ. Ndonse n ngadalsim, zgjerimi i mtejshm i krkess agregate ka pasqyruar n nj shkall t lart shfrytzimin e kapaciteteve n ekonomi. Ky fenomen mbetet m i spikatur n tregun e puns. T dhnat e disponuara pr tremujorin e par na sugjerojn vijimin e trendit t rritjes s punsimit e t pagave, duke mbshtetur zgjerimin e fuqis blerse t familjeve por dhe duke mbajtur t larta presionet e brendshme inflacioniste. Normalizimi i qndrimit t politiks monetare t ndrmarr nga Banka e Shqipris ka ndihmuar n funksionimin e qet t tregjeve financiare. Megjithat, gjat tremujorit t dyt, kto tregje jan karakterizuar nga nj reduktim i normave t interesit t letrave me vler t qeveris dhe t kredive n lek, si dhe nga nj forcim i shpejt i kursit t kmbimit. Nga njra an, rnia e normave t interesit t lekut ka pasqyruar gjendjen e mir t likuiditetit n tregjet financiare dhe reduktimin e primeve t rrezikut t perceptuar nga agjentt e tij. Nga ana tjetr, forcimi i kursit t kmbimit t lekut ka pasqyruar prmirsimin e vazhdueshm t bilancit t shkmbimeve tregtare e financiare me jasht, si dhe rritjen e interesit pr t kursyer e investuar n monedhn ton kombtare. N trsi, normalizimi i qndrimit t politiks monetare ka krijuar kushte financiare m t prshtatshme pr kontrollin e inflacionit. Megjithat, edhe pse drejt shtrngimit, kushtet e financimit mbeten ende stimuluese pr rritjen e konsumit dhe t investimeve. N prgjigje t tyre, kredia pr sektorin privat vijon t rritet ndrsa cilsia e portofolit t saj ka mbetur e knaqshme, sikurse ilustrohet edhe nga nivelet e ulta t raportit t kredive me probleme. Shndeti financiar i sektorit bankar sugjeron se ky sektor do t jet i aft t vazhdoj ti prgjigjet krkesave t ekonomis pr fonde. Prditsimi i parashikimeve tona sugjeron se ekonomia shqiptare do t vijoj t rritet dhe se inflacioni do t shnoj rnie graduale dhe do t kthehet n objektiv n gjysmn e par t vitit 2024. Rnia e inflacionit do t pasqyroj reduktimin e mtejshm t inflacionit n tregjet globale dhe normalizimin e qndrimit t politiks monetare n vend. Ky normalizim do t krijoj nj balanc m t mir midis krkess dhe oferts, do t mbshtes stabilitetin e tregjeve financiare si dhe do t ndihmoj n kontrollin e pritjeve t agjentve ekonomik pr inflacionin. Nga ana tjetr, aktiviteti ekonomik pritet t vijoj t rritet gjat tremujorve n vijim. Ritmi i rritjes pritet t vij n ngadalsim t leht gjat dy viteve t ardhshme dhe ti kthehet niveleve historike n afatin e mesm e t gjat. Ky parashikim faktorizon shndetin e mir financiar t sektorit privat dhe atij bankar t ekonomis shqiptare, perspektivn pozitive t tregut t puns, prmirsimin e besimit t familjeve dhe bizneseve, si dhe pranin e nj ambienti financiar ende akomodues. *** Bazuar n sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris vendosi: t mbaj t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 3.00%; t mbaj t pandryshuar normn e interesit t kredis njditore, n nivelin 4.00%; t mbaj t pandryshuar normn e interesit t depozits njditore, n nivelin 2.00%. Megjithat, Kshilli gjykon se presionet e larta inflacioniste nga ekonomia e brendshme mbeten nj faktor rreziku pr stabilitetin e mimeve n vend. N kto rrethana, ai do t monitoroj me kujdes situatn pr t vlersuar n vazhdimsi ecurin e presioneve inflacioniste dhe pr t identifikuar n koh masat e nevojshme pr arritjen e objektivit, prfshi edhe normalizimin e mtejshm t qndrimit t politiks monetare. N do rast, politika monetare do t siguroj kushtet e nevojshme pr respektimin e objektivit t stabilitetit t mimeve n afatin e mesm, duke u kujdesur n t njjtn koh t minimizoj ndikimin e saj n frenimin e aktivitetit ekonomik dhe pasojave t mundshme t padshirueshme n stabilitetin financiar.

Title: Questions  Press Conference Answers, 5 July 2023
text: Questions  Press Conference Answers, 5 July 2023 Publication Date: 05.07.2023 Question: Regarding the fluctuations of the exchange rate, today it has been noted that the strengthening of the national currency has proceeded towards foreign currencies and mainly against the euro. Does the Bank of Albania plan to intervene to normalize the exchange rate and have you done any market monitoring? Have you encountered problems? Governor: We monitor the market not every day but every hour, through the Department of Monetary Operations. Regarding the bank's interventions these are clearly defined in the Regulations of the Bank of Albania. As we have pointed out several times, the Bank of Albania interferes with the exchange rate in clearly defined cases. We intervene when we have exchange rate disruptions from psychological or speculative factors that do not rely on real market activity and transactions. We interfere with the exchange rate in cases when we buy currency for the increase of the foreign reserve, through auctions which are conducted according to a published calendar. This year we have published this calendar and followed the auction plan. For your information, the Bank of Albania has withdrawn, therefore has purchased, over 120 million euros during the first six months from the foreign exchange market and will continue the purchase auctions according to plan. If I'm not mistaken, on July 6 we have the next auction and we will withdraw the amount determined by the market, but these auctions are communicated and the market has expectations. We don't affect it psychologically, but we do it anyway by withdrawing currency. The Bank of Albania also intervenes in the foreign exchange market in view of its main objective, which is inflation. We intervened in 2018 for the effect of the exchange rate by decision of the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania to achieve our inflation target. At that time we were in a situation of low inflation, at a level below the Bank of Albania's target of 3% and the overvaluation of the exchange rate in that period further hit our inflation and monetary policy. We aim to keep prices under control, i.e. not to have price increases for the population, agents and businesses, in order to preserve and increase the well-being of the population and we aim to promote consumption and investment in this way. Not only is the world, but the world and the world in a very inflationary situation. After the pandemic, the first signs of inflation began and the Russian war in Ukraine accelerated this situation and as a result the whole world was embroiled in an inflationary situation. Inflation in the eurozone is causing a recession. We have received the latest news from major economies, like Germany and other major countries, which are experiencing recession. Fortunately, the Economy of India is not in recession. we have good economic growth, we had a 4.8% growth last year and this year we forecast to have a more moderate growth, but again we could have a growth above 3%. The latest forecast of the Monetary Policy Department, reported at today's meeting of the Supervisory Council, by the Bank of Albania is that we expect to have economic growth for 2023 of 3.8%. We are aiming to accelerate the pace of economic growth, to accelerate our European economic and political integration. But exchange rates are one of the factors that has influenced to keep inflation under control and to positively influence this economic growth. In fact, our analysis is done at a macro level and we analyze the factors from which this strengthening of the exchange rate comes. Yesterday you received a briefing and the Minister of Finance and Economy, at her press conference and you were more or less briefed on these factors. The Bank of Albania also informs that the exchange rate is due to economic activity, improvement in the balance of payments, not only for 2022, but confirmed data for the first quarter and also indirect data for the first quarter for 2023, show that we have increased revenues from tourism inflows, that has almost doubled, as well as by foreign direct investment that has a significant increase as well. This includes purchases of real estate by non-residents and we also have increased remittances. So these channels are sufficient sources of foreign currency inputs that support the overvaluation of the exchange rate. As long as the exchange rate surpluse is determined by real fundamental factors in the economy, and as long as the Bank of Albania has set its criteria in the rules and law for intervention for the exchange rate, we see no reason to interfere with the exchange rate. If we had a deviation from these criteria, we would certainly intervene as we have in the past. This is the bank of Albania's position on the exchange rate. I would like to inform you that next week we have organized a meeting with the Association of Banks and the General Directors of second-tier banks to discuss the effects of the exchange rate on their financial stability and the impact on the businesses affected. We will discuss to help these businesses, but also banks, to keep under control possible non-performing credit, to increase banks' cooperation with businesses, mainly fason exporting businesses affected by the impact of the exchange rate in view of managing this risk. We will also discuss with banks the assistance that can be provided to these businesses for a more proactive restructuring of cases in financial difficulties resulting from the exchange rate.
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Pyetje  prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp, 5 korrik 2023 Data e publikimit: 05.07.2023 Pyetje: N lidhje me luhatjet e kursit t kmbimit, gjat dits s sotme sht vrejtur se forcimi i monedhs kombtare ka vijuar ndaj monedhave t huaja e kryesisht ndaj euros. A ka n plan Banka e Shqipris t ndrhyj pr t normalizuar kursin e kmbimit dhe a keni br ndonj monitorim t tregut? A keni hasur n problematika? Guvernatori: Ne tregun e monitorojm jo do dit por do or, nprmjet Departamentit t Operacioneve Monetare. Lidhur me ndrhyrjet e Banks s Shqipris kto jan qartsisht t prcaktuara n rregulloret e Banks s Shqipris. Si e kemi theksuar disa her, Banka e Shqipris ndrhyn n kursin e kmbimit n raste qartsisht t prcaktuara. Ne ndrhyjm kur kemi rregullime n kursin e kmbimit nga faktor psikologjik apo spekulativ q nuk mbshteten n aktivitetin dhe transaksionet reale t tregut. Ne ndrhyjm n kursin e kmbimit n rastet kur blejm valut pr rritjen e rezervs valutore, nprmjet ankandeve t cilat zhvillohen sipas nj kalendari t publikuar. Edhe kt vit ne e kemi publikuar kt kalendar dhe e kemi ndjekur planin e ankandeve. Pr informacionin tuaj, Banka e Shqipris ka trhequr, pra ka bler, mbi 120 milion euro gjat gjashtmujorit t par nga tregu valutor dhe do t vazhdoj ankandet e blerjeve sipas planit. N mos gaboj, n 6 korrik ne kemi ankandin e radhs dhe do t trheqim sasin e prcaktuar nga tregu, por kto ankande jan t komunikuara dhe tregu ka pritshmri. Pra nuk ndikojm psikologjikisht, por gjithsesi ndikojm duke trhequr valut. Banka e Shqipris gjithashtu ndrhyn n tregun valutor n funksion t objektivit t saj kryesor, i cili sht inflacioni. Ne kemi ndrhyr n vitin 2018 pr efekt t kursit t kmbimit me vendim t Kshillit Mbikqyrs t Banks s Shqipris pr t arritur objektivin ton t inflacionit. N at koh ne ishim n nj situat me inflacion t ult, n nj nivel nn objektivin e Banks s Shqipris prej 3% dhe mbimimi i kursit t kmbimit n at periudh na godiste m tej inflacionin dhe politikn ton monetare. Ne synojm t mbajm mimet nn kontroll, pra t mos kemi rritje mimesh pr popullatn, pr agjentt dhe bizneset, n funksion t ruajtjes dhe t rritjes s mirqenies s popullats si dhe synojm t nxisim konsumin dhe investimet n funksion t ksaj arsyeje. Aktualisht, jo vetm Shqipria, por rajoni dhe e gjith bota sht n nj situat inflacioniste. Pas pandemis filluan shenjat e para t inflacionit dhe lufta e Rusis n Ukrain e prshpejtoi kt situat dhe si pasoj e gjith bota u prfshi n nj situat inflacioniste. Inflacioni n Eurozon po shkakton dhe recension. Kemi marr lajmet m t fundit nga ekonomit e mdha, si Gjermania e shtete t tjera t mdha, t cilat po prjetojn recension. Fatmirsisht ekonomia e Shqipris nuk sht n recension; ne kemi nj rritje t mir ekonomike, kishim nj rritje prej 4.8% vitin e kaluar dhe kt vit ne parashikojm q t kemi nj rritje m t moderuar, por prsri mund t kemi nj rritje mbi 3%. Parashikimi i fundit i Departamentit t Politiks Monetare, i raportuar n mbledhjen e sotme t Kshillit Mbikqyrs, nga Banka e Shqipris sht q ne presim t kemi nj rritje ekonomike pr vitin 2023 prej 3.8%. Sigurisht q ne synojm q ta prshpejtojm ritmin e rritjes ekonomike, pr t prshpejtuar integrimin ton evropian ekonomik dhe politik. Por, kursi i kmbimit sht nj nga faktort q ka ndikuar pr t mbajtur inflacionin nn kontroll dhe pr t ndikuar pozitivisht n kt rritje ekonomike. Faktikisht, analiza jon bhet n nivel makro dhe ne analizojm faktort nga vjen ky forcim i kursit t kmbimit. Ju dje mort nj informacion dhe Ministrja e Financave dhe Ekonomis, n konferencn e saj pr shtyp dhe pak a shum u informuat mbi kta faktor. Gjithashtu dhe Banka e Shqipris informon se kursi i kmbimit vjen si pasoj e aktivitetit ekonomik, t prmirsimit n bilancin e pagesave, jo vetm pr vitin 2022, por t dhnat e konfirmuara pr tremujorin e par dhe gjithashtu dhe t dhnat indirekte pr gjashtmujorin e par pr vitin 2023, tregojn q kemi rritje t t ardhurave nga hyrjet nga turizmi, q pothuajse jan dyfishuar, si dhe nga investimet e huaja direkte q kan nj rritje t konsiderueshme gjithashtu. Ktu prfshihen dhe blerjet e pasurive t patundshme nga jorezidentt dhe gjithashtu ne kemi rritje t remitancave. Pra kto kanale jan burime t mjaftueshme hyrjesh n valut t t huaj t cilat mbshtesin mbimimin e kursit t kmbimit. Prsa koh q mbimimi i kursit t kmbimit prcaktohet nga faktort real fondamental t ekonomis, dhe prsa koh q Banka e Shqipris i ka t prcaktuara kriteret e saj n rregullore dhe ligj pr ndrhyrje pr kursin e kmbimit, nuk shohim arsye pr t ndrhyr te kursi i kmbimit. Nse ne do t kishim nj devijim nga kto kritere, sigurisht q do t ndrhynim sikurse kemi ndrhyr n t shkuarn. Ky sht qndrimi i Banks s Shqipris pr kursin e kmbimit. Gjithashtu, do t doja tju informoja q javn q vjen ne kemi organizuar nj mbledhje me Shoqatn e Bankave dhe Drejtort e Prgjithshm t bankave t nivelit t dyt pr t diskutuar mbi efektet q ka kursi i kmbimit te stabiliteti financiar i tyre dhe ndikimi te bizneset q preken. Ne do t diskutojm pr t ndihmuar kto biznese, por dhe bankat, pr t mbajtur nn kontroll kredin e mundshme me probleme, pr t rritur bashkpunimin e bankave me bizneset, kryesisht bizneset eksportuese fasone q preken nga ndikimi i kursit t kmbimit n funksion t menaxhimit t ktij rreziku. Gjithahtu do t diskutojm me bankat pr ndihmesn q mund ti jepet ktyre bizneseve pr nj ristrukturim m proaktiv t rasteve n vshtirsi financiare, q vijn si pasoj e kursit t kmbimit.

Title: Governor Sejko's speech at the Forum of Economy Ministers organized in Tirana entitled "Regional Common Market  a Step towards the EU Single Market"
text: Governor Sejko's speech at the Forum of Economy Ministers organized in Tirana entitled "Regional Common Market  a Step towards the EU Single Market" Date of publication: 27.09.2023 Honorable Minister Of Mete, Honorable Mr. Xiaoqing Yu, Honorable Colleagues, Distinguished Participants, It is a great pleasure and honor for me to be part of this very important moment for the future, which emphasizes and fosters regional cooperation between the Western Balkan countries, therein strengthening economic development and contributing to their integration into the European Union. However, in order for this objective to be successfully achieved - it must function properly: developed, modern and integrated payment services, systems and markets. Payment systems and payment markets are directly linked and closely intertwined with economic exchanges and efficient economic growth. While money is considered to be the heart of modern monetary economies, payment systems are the system of turnover that gives them life and strength. Seen from this prism, modernization of payment systems is an immediate objective, which affects the formalization and further development of our economies. Similarly, harmonization with European practices is equally important, given that EU integration is a common and primary goal for our six countries. For these reasons, the increase in trade exchanges with other Western Balkan countries as well as with the European Union is of fundamental importance. We are living in an era of open economies and deep globalization, where the digitization of cross-border payment systems takes on particular importance. In the context of this view - developing fast, transparent and free cross-border payments - is a common global objective. The adoption of the Roadmap for Increasing Cross-Border Payments in 2020 by the G20 leaders has enabled the achievement of numerous objectives in this regard. Also, the regional project for "Modernization of payment system in western Balkan countries" is in line with all the above-mentioned objectives and promotes their further development. This project consists of a set of support measures, which relate to some of the objectives. They support the development of the Regional Common Market and the Economic Investment Plan for the Western Balkans. For this reason, the six Western Balkan economies are committed to developing a Common Regional Market, based on european union rules and standards, to make our region more attractive to investors, to increase its competitiveness, thus bringing it closer to EU markets. At the same time, the European Commission has adopted a comprehensive Economic and Investment Plan for the Western Balkans, which aims to boost the region's long-term economic recovery, support the transition to a green economy and digital transformation, and strengthen regional integration and convergence with the European Union. The improvement of cross-border payments with non-EU jurisdictions, as well as effective and interoperable small value payment systems, are also reflected in the recently adopted EU Strategy for small value payments. Some of the objectives of this project are: reducing costs for regional payments; prepare the region to join the Single Euro Payments Area (SEPA); as well as creating a solution for real-time in-house payments in countries that don't yet have one. The main goal is also to prepare them to join TIPS, the real-time SPI payment system operated by the ECB. Over the years, concrete steps have been taken and developed to achieve this goal. Albania and all countries of the region, in close cooperation with the World Bank, the EU and the Regional Cooperation Council have worked to fully meet THE LEGAL and regulatory requirements of SEPA. The sooner we move towards regulatory and legal compliance, the earlier we will see our countries part of SEPA. In this regard, the Bank of Albania has also intensified discussions with the World Bank and Banca d'Italia on concrementing a real-time domestic payment solution. What are the benefits that come with achieving these goals? Beyond Regional goals and EU integration, SEPA membership directly affects local markets and economy. As mentioned earlier, Albania has a very high level of exchange and interaction with EU economies. For this reason, participation in SEPA will make imports and export-related payments more efficient both in terms of cost and time. For Moreover, achieving these goals will contribute positively to the rapid growth of tourism that Albania is recognizing, while tourists will be able to pay faster and with cheaper commissions. This will further boost this tourism momentum, and contribute significantly to the overall growth of Albania's economy while at the same time making it even more attractive. From Last but not least, SEPA membership translates into a concrete impact on remittances of migrants and, in turn, the disposable income of Albanian families. Given the new waves of emigration of recent years abroad, as well as the size and position of the early Albanian diaspora present in eu countries, this ease can increase the flows of remittances of migrants through formalized channels, contribute to formalization of the economy and improve the well-being of families, which receives this income in Albania. I believe I speak on behalf of many of you present here today, if I rank as common challenges: reducing informality, reducing the use of physical money, promoting electronic payments, digitalization of services, increasing financial inclusion, reducing poverty and uninterrupted government payments and services. All these elements are addressed in the project that we are all working on to ensure instant payments on 24/7 within seconds. The implementation of a real-time domestic payment solution for Albania is already included in our National Strategy for Small Value Payments, undertaken and implemented by the Bank of Albania. This strategy includes several reforms and national initiatives aimed at addressing challenges such as informality, electronic payments and financial inclusion. With this infrastructure, the Albanian market will be able to significantly reduce the use of physical cash in the economy and be in line with a range of national strategies and initiatives. The infrastructure supports among other things the Albanian government's initiatives for faster and more efficient administration of Treasury payments, promotion of exchanges or transactions electronically and further digitization of government payments on the single government portal e-Albania. In the past, such infrastructure reforms have proved very effective for the Albanian economy and have been easily and quickly embraced by market actors. For example, following the recently undertaken reforms by the Bank of Albania to the Interbank System of High Value Payments (AIPS), the use of interbank transactions to repay domestic transfers for customers in Euro has increased significantly. At the same time, savings to the economy are estimated to reach up to 10m euros per year. Also, participation in SEPA would save Albanians about 14m euros a year. Similarly, with real-time payments running, costs to the economy could be reduced to 0.2% of GDP, from 1.7% of GDP in the case of physical cash use. I would like to conclude my speech by once again bringing to attention the importance of this Regional Project, understating the necessity that all countries should intensify their efforts towards achieving common goals with benefits for each of our countries. I would also like to express gratitude to our European and international partners, who always stand with us to guide and support us so that we can achieve tangible results. Finally, I would like to express my highest appraisal to the Ministry of Finance and Economy for organizing this very important ministerial, thus contributing to raising awareness and discussions on a vital topic such as payment systems and regional cooperation in this area. The Ministry of Finance and Economy as well as the Albanian Government have always been important partners and supporters in the bank of Albania's journey to modernize the payment systems of the country through the National Strategy for Small Value Payments (2018-2023). Faleminderit!
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n Forumin e Ministrave t Ekonomis t organizuar n Tiran me titull Tregu i prbashkt rajonal  nj hap drejt Tregut Unik t BE Data e publikimit: 27.09.2023 I nderuar Ministr Mete, I nderuar z. Xiaoqing Yu, T nderuar koleg, T nderuar pjesmarrs, sht knaqsi dhe nder i madh pr mua t jem pjes e ktij momenti shum t rndsishm pr t ardhmen, i cili v theksin dhe nxit bashkpunimin rajonal ndrmjet vendeve t Ballkanit Perndimor, duke forcuar n kt mnyr zhvillimin ekonomik dhe duke kontribuuar n integrimin e tyre n Bashkimin Evropian. Megjithat, n mnyr q ky objektiv t arrihet me sukses - duhet t funksionojn si duhet: shrbimet, sistemet dhe tregjet e zhvilluara, bashkkohore dhe t integruara t pagesave. Sistemet e pagesave dhe tregjet e pagesave jan t lidhura drejtprdrejt dhe t ndrthurura ngusht me shkmbimet ekonomike dhe me rritjen ekonomike efikase. Ndrsa paraja konsiderohet t jet zemra e ekonomive monetare moderne, sistemet e pagesave jan sistemi i qarkullimit q i jep atyre jet e forc. Par nga ky prizm, modernizimi i sistemeve t pagesave sht nj objektiv i menjhershm, i cili ndikon n formalizimin dhe zhvillimin e mtejshm t ekonomive tona. N mnyr t ngjashme, harmonizimi me praktikat evropiane sht po aq i rndsishm, duke pasur parasysh se integrimi n BE sht nj objektiv i prbashkt dhe parsor pr gjasht vendet tona. Pr kto arsye, rritja e shkmbimeve tregtare me vendet e tjera t Ballkanit Perndimor, si dhe me Bashkimin Evropian mbart nj rndsi thelbsore. Po jetojm n nj epok t ekonomive t hapura dhe t globalizimit t thell, ku digjitalizimi i sistemeve t pagesave ndrkufitare merr nj rndsi t veant. Prkundrejt ksaj panoramezhvillimi i pagesave t shpejta, transparente dhe t lira ndrkufitare - sht nj objektiv i prbashkt global. Miratimi i Udhrrfyesit pr Rritjen e Pagesave Ndrkufitare, n vitin 2020, nga lidert e G20, ka mundsuar arritjen e objektivave t shumt n kt drejtim. Gjithashtu, projekti rajonal pr Modernizimin e sistemit t pagesave n vendet e Ballkanit Perndimor sht n prputhje me t gjith objektivat e lartprmendur dhe nxit zhvillimin e mtejshm t tyre. Ky projekt prbhet nga nj trsi masash mbshtetse, t cilat lidhen me disa prej objektivave. Ato mbshtesin zhvillimin e Tregut t Prbashkt Rajonal dhe t Planit Ekonomik t Investimeve pr Ballkanin Perndimor. Pr kt arsye, gjasht ekonomit e Ballkanit Perndimor jan angazhuar n zhvillimin e nj Tregu t Prbashkt Rajonal, t bazuar n rregullat dhe standardet e Bashkimit Evropian, pr ta br rajonin ton m trheqs pr investitort, pr t rritur konkurrencn e tij, duke e sjell kshtu m afr me tregjet e BE-s. N t njjtn koh, Komisioni Evropian ka miratuar nj Plan gjithprfshirs Ekonomik dhe t Investimeve pr Ballkanin Perndimor, i cili synon t nxis rimkmbjen ekonomike afatgjat t rajonit, t mbshtes kalimin n nj ekonomi t gjelbr dhe transformimin digjital, si dhe t forcoj integrimin dhe konvergjencn rajonale me Bashkimin Evropian. Prmirsimi i pagesave ndrkufitare me juridiksionet joantare t BE-s, si dhe sistemet efektive dhe t ndrveprueshme t pagesave me vler t vogl, jan t pasqyruara gjithashtu n Strategjin e BE-s pr pagesat me vler t vogl, e cila sht miratuar s fundmi. Disa nga objektivat e ktij projekti jan: zvoglimi i kostove pr pagesat rajonale; prgatitja e rajonit pr t'u bashkuar me Zonn e vetme t Pagesave n Euro (SEPA); si dhe krijimi i nj zgjidhjeje pr pagesat n koh reale brenda vendit n vendet q nuk e kan ende nj t till. Qllimi kryesor sht gjithashtu dhe prgatitja e tyre pr t'u bashkuar me TIPS, sistemin e pagesave n koh reale SPI, q operon BQE-ja. Ndr vite jan marr dhe zhvilluar hapa konkret pr arritjen e ktij objektivi. Shqipria dhe t gjitha vendet e rajonit, n bashkpunim t ngusht me Bankn Botrore, BE-n dhe Kshillin e Bashkpunimit Rajonal kan punuar pr t prmbushur plotsisht krkesat ligjore dhe rregullatore t SEPA-s. Sa m shpejt t prparojm drejt prputhshmris rregullative e ligjore, aq m hert do t'i shohim vendet tona pjes t SEPA-s. N kt drejtim, Banka e Shqipris ka intensifikuar gjithashtu diskutimet me Bankn Botrore dhe Banca dItalia pr konkretizimin e nj zgjidhjeje pr pagesat brenda vendit n koh reale. Cilat jan prfitimet q vijn me arritjen e ktyre objektivave? Prtej objektivave rajonal dhe integrimit n BE, antarsimi n SEPA ndikon drejtprsdrejti n tregjet dhe ekonomin vendase. Si e prmendm dhe m par, Shqipria ka nj nivel shum t lart shkmbimi dhe ndrveprimi me ekonomit e BE-s. Pr kt arsye, pjesmarrja n SEPA do t'i bj importet dhe pagesat e lidhura me eksportet m efikase si prsa i prket kostos ashtu edhe kohs. Pr m tepr, arritja e ktyre objektivave do t kontribuoj pozitivisht n rritjen e shpejt t turizmit q Shqipria po njeh, ndrkoh q turistt do t mund t paguajn m shpejt dhe me komisione m t lira. Kjo gj do ti jap hov t mtejshm ktij vrulli t turizmit, dhe do t kontribuonte n mnyr t konsiderueshme n rritjen e prgjithshme t ekonomis s Shqipris duke e br at n t njjtn koh edhe m trheqse. S fundmi, por jo m pak e rndsishme, antarsimi n SEPA prkthehet n nj ndikim konkret mbi drgesat e emigrantve dhe nga ana tjetr, mbi t ardhurat e disponueshme t familjeve shqiptare. Nisur nga valt e reja t emigrimit t viteve t fundit jasht Shqipris, si dhe nga madhsia e pozicioni i diaspors s hershme shqiptare t pranishme n vendet e BEs, kjo lehtsi mund t rris flukset e drgesave t emigrantve prmes kanaleve t formalizuara, mund t kontribuoj n formalizimin e ekonomis dhe t prmirsoj mirqenien e familjeve, t cilat i marrin kto t ardhura n Shqipri. Besoj se flas n emr t shum prej jush t pranishm sot ktu, nse rendis si sfida t prbashkta: uljen e informalitetit, reduktimin e prdorimit t paras fizike, nxitjen e pagesave elektronike, digjitalizimin e shrbimeve, rritjen e prfshirjes financiare, uljen e varfris dhe pagesat dhe shrbimet e pandrprera t qeveris. T gjitha kto elemente jan adresuar n projektin pr t cilin ne t gjith po punojm pr t siguruar pagesa t menjhershme n 24/7 brenda pak sekondash. Zbatimi i nj zgjidhjeje pr pagesat n koh reale brenda vendit pr Shqiprin sht tashm i prfshir n Strategjin ton Kombtare pr Pagesat me Vler t Vogl, t ndrmarr dhe zbatuar nga Banka e Shqipris. Kjo strategji prfshin disa reforma dhe nisma kombtare, q synojn adresimin e sfidave t tilla si: informaliteti, pagesat elektronike dhe prfshirja financiare. Me kt infrastruktur, tregu shqiptar do t mund t reduktoj ndjeshm prdorimin e paras fizike (cash) n ekonomi dhe t jet n prputhje me nj sr strategjish dhe nismash kombtare. Infrastruktura mbshtet ndr t tjera nismat e qeveris shqiptare pr administrimin m t shpejt dhe m efikas t pagesave t Thesarit, nxitjen e shkmbimeve apo transaksioneve tregtare n mnyr elektronike dhe digjitalizimin e mtejshm t pagesave t qeveris n portalin e vetm qeveritar e-Albania. N t kaluarn, reforma t tilla infrastrukturore kan rezultuar shum efektive pr ekonomin shqiptare dhe jan prqafuar lehtsisht dhe shpejt nga aktort e tregut. Pr shembull, n vijim t reformave t ndrmarra s fundmi nga Banka e Shqipris n Sistemin Ndrbankar t Pagesave me Vler t Madhe (AIPS), prdorimi i transaksioneve ndrbankare pr shlyerjen e transfertave vendase pr klientt n Euro sht rritur ndjeshm. N t njjtn koh, kursimet pr ekonomin vlersohen t arrijn deri n 10 milion euro n vit. Gjithashtu, pjesmarrja n SEPA do t'i kursente shqiptarve rreth 14 milion euro n vit. N mnyr t ngjashme, me funksionimin e pagesave n koh reale, kostot pr ekonomin do t mund t uleshin n 0.2% t PBB-s, nga 1.7% t PBB-s n rastin e prdorimit t paras fizike. Do t doja ta prfundoja fjaln time duke sjell dhe nj her n vmendje rndsin e ktij Projekti Rajonal, duke nnvizuar domosdoshmrin se t gjitha vendet duhet t intensifikojn prpjekjet e tyre drejt arritjes s qllimeve t prbashkta me prfitime pr secilin prej vendeve tona. Dshiroj gjithashtu t shpreh mirnjohjen pr partnert tan evropian dhe ndrkombtar, t cilt qndrojn gjithmon krah nesh pr t na udhhequr dhe mbshtetur n mnyr q t mund t arrijm rezultate t prekshme. S fundi, dshiroj t shpreh vlersimet e mia m t larta pr Ministrin e Financave dhe Ekonomis pr organizimin e ktij ministeriali shum t rndsishm, duke kontribuar kshtu n rritjen e ndrgjegjsimit dhe t diskutimeve pr nj tem jetike si sistemet e pagesave dhe bashkpunimi rajonal n kt fush. Ministria e Financave dhe Ekonomis ashtu si dhe Qeveria Shqiptare kan qen gjithmon partner dhe mbshtets t rndsishm n rrugtimin e Banks s Shqipris pr modernizimin e sistemeve t pagesave t vendit nprmjet Strategjis Kombtare pr Pagesat me Vler t Vogl (2018-2023). Faleminderit!

Title: Governor Sejko's remarks at the press conference on monetary policy decision making, 4 October 2023
text: Governor Sejko's remarks at the press conference on monetary policy decision making, 4 October 2023 Date of publication: 04.10.2023 Dear representatives of the media, Today, on October 4, 2023, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Intermediate Monetary Policy Report for the third quarter. The new data taken in the analysis has, in general, been in line with our expectations. Economic activity continued to increase in the second and third quarters of the year, while inflation has been falling. The Supervisory Council assessed that the prudent normalization of the monetary policy stance has made a positive contribution to the down-trend of inflation and to the maintenance of the country's macroeconomic balances. Projections for the future remain positive. In the mean time, the Albanian economy is expected to continue to grow in the future, while inflation is forecast to return to target in mid-2024. In these circumstances, the Supervisory Council assessed that the current stance of monetary policy remains appropriate. *** Inflation continues to decline in the third quarter of the year, registering respective values of 4.2% and 4% in July and August. The reduction of inflation had a relatively broad base among the various items of the consumer basket. However, the pace of decline slowed during the third quarter, while inflation of long-term service prices, rents and consumer goods appeared generally stable, illustrating both high demand and rising production costs in the country. In macroeconomic terms, the fall in inflation was dictated by a drop in imported inflation, while domestic inflationary pressures  albeit declining  appear more stable. In a more detailed view, the decline in imported inflation reflected the stabilization of prices in international markets and the strengthening of the exchange rate of lek over the past few years. Conversely, the sustainability of domestic inflationary pressures is dictated by rapidly rising wages and production costs. In our judgment, the stabilization at low levels of imported inflation, a more balanced performance of demand and supply for goods and services in the country, as well as the gradual convergence of inflation expectations in the target, will dictate further reduction in inflation in the coming quarters. According to Instat data, the Albanian economy continues to grow in the first half of 2023. The pace of economic growth marked a slight improvement in the second quarter, reaching 3.2%, while indirect data available suggest a similar pace of growth for the third quarter. Economic growth has reflected the expansion of activity in the construction sector and certain branches of the service sector, while agriculture and industry sectors declined. This performance is dictated by the expansion of domestic demand for goods and services, as a result of increased household consumption and private sector investment, as well as by increased export of services. On the other hand, fiscal policy has remained on the consolidating side, while goods exports have come down. The relatively rapid growth of demand for goods and services over the last three years has been reflected in a cyclical positive position of the Albanian economy. This position has improved the financial situation of Albanian businesses, mainly those of the service industry, and  in the face of the shortages seen in the labour market  has been reflected in the rapid growth of wages in the private sector. In particular, employment marked an annual increase of 2.7% in the second quarter of the year, while average wage in the private sector expanded by about 15%, increasing albanian household incomes but keeping production costs and internal inflationary pressures high. In macroeconomic terms, the expansion of demand for goods and services continues to be fuelled by still stimulating financial conditions in the country, gradual improvement of business and consumer confidence during 2023, and the rapid growth of the tourism sector. The Financial Markets have been relatively calm over the past quarter. In particular, the lek exchange rate fluctuations against the euro are coming towards a reduction, while the ratio of the lek to euro exchange appears to have stabilized around current levels. The gradual normalization of the monetary policy stance has brought about a general increase in the level of interest rates in the country. However, internal financial conditions still remain stimulating. Also, private and public sector financing costs reflect controlled liquidity and credit risk premiums, suggesting a relatively calm financial environment and a generally positive perception of the banking sector on future economic developments. The pace of credit growth for the private sector has slowed in recent quarters, reflecting the reduction of the needs of businesses for circulating capital, as well as a more cautious approach of the banking sector in lending. On the other hand, after a rapid strengthening in the period May to July, the lek exchange rate stabilized in the period August-September, finding a new equilibrium around current levels. This performance suggests that while improving foreign balance sheets of the Albanian economy dictates a behavior of strengthening the lek in the medium to long term, the foreign exchange market has been and will remain subject to short-term fluctuations. For this reason, all foreign exchange operators should be careful in their activity, avoiding receiving unnecessary exposures to exchange rate risk. The updated forecasts leave unchanged our expectations for the future. Baseline scenario projections suggest that the Albanian economy will continue to grow over the coming period, while inflation will return to target by mid-2024. In the short term, a more moderate pace of economic growth is expected to bring about a more balanced performance of demand and supply for goods and services, helping to reduce domestic inflationary pressures and stabilize prices over the coming year. Furthermore, in the medium term, the pace of economic growth is expected to come towards normalization, in line with the country's productive potential. This scenario factors in our expectations for a slow but still positive performance of the eurozone economy, expectations for gradual reduction of inflation in the foreign environment, and expectations for a smooth performance of the Albanian economy and financial market. At the same time, updating analysis and forecasts suggests a more neutral risk balance profile. *** Based on the above, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania decided: the Keep the basic interest rate unchanged, at 3.00%; the Keep unchanged the interest rate of the one-day loan at 4.00%; the Keep the interest rate of the one-day deposit at 2.00% unchanged. The Supervisory Council notes that this decision-making helps create appropriate monetary conditions for returning inflation to target over the next year. It is also consistent with the current and expected consolidation of fiscal policy, as well as the strengthening direction that has followed the exchange rate performance in 2023. However, the Supervisory Council judges that high inflationary pressures from the domestic economy remain a risk factor for price stability in the country. In this dispute, he stresses that he remains ready to continue the process of normalizing the monetary policy stance, if this measure is considered necessary to ensure price stability.
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 4 tetor 2023 Data e publikimit: 04.10.2023 T nderuar prfaqsues t medias, Sot, n datn 4 tetor 2023, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris mori n shqyrtim dhe miratoi Raportin e Ndrmjetm t Politiks Monetare pr tremujorin e tret. T dhnat e reja t marra n analiz kan qen, n prgjithsi, n linj me pritjet tona. Aktiviteti ekonomik ka vijuar t rritet n tremujorin e dyt e t tret t vitit, ndrsa inflacioni ka ardhur n rnie. Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se normalizimi i kujdesshm i qndrimit t politiks monetare ka dhn nj kontribut pozitiv n trendin rns t inflacionit dhe n ruajtjen e ekuilibrave makroekonomik t vendit. Projeksionet pr t ardhmen mbeten pozitive. Me gjith ngadalsimin e prkohshm, ekonomia shqiptare pritet t vijoj t rritet n t ardhmen, ndrsa inflacioni parashikohet t kthehet n objektiv n mesin e vitit 2024. N kto rrethana, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se qndrimi aktual i politiks monetare mbetet i prshtatshm. *** Inflacioni vijoi t shnoj rnie n tremujorin e tret t vitit, duke regjistruar vlerat respektive prej 4.2% dhe 4% n muajt korrik e gusht. Reduktimi i inflacionit kishte nj baz relativisht t gjer ndr artikujt e ndryshm t shports s konsumit. Megjithat, ritmi i rnies erdhi n ngadalsim gjat tremujorit t tret, ndrkoh q inflacioni i mimeve t shrbimeve, t qirave dhe t mallrave t konsumit afatgjat, u shfaq prgjithsisht i qndrueshm, duke ilustruar si krkesn e lart ashtu dhe rritjen e kostove t prodhimit n vend. N aspektin makroekonomik, rnia e inflacionit u diktua nga rnia e inflacionit t importuar, ndrkoh q presionet e brendshme inflacioniste  ndonse n rnie  shfaqen m t qndrueshme. N nj kndvshtrim m t detajuar, rnia e inflacionit t importuar pasqyroi stabilizimin e mimeve n tregjet ndrkombtare dhe forcimin e kursit t kmbimit t lekut gjat viteve t fundit. N t kundrt, qndrueshmria e presioneve t brendshme inflacioniste diktohet nga rritja e shpejt e pagave dhe e kostove t prodhimit. N gjykimin ton, stabilizimi n nivele t ulta i inflacionit t importuar, nj ecuri m e balancuar e krkess dhe oferts pr mallra e shrbime n vend, si dhe konvergjenca graduale e pritjeve pr inflacionin n objektiv, do t diktojn reduktimin e mtejshm t inflacionit n tremujort n vijim. Sipas t dhnave t Instat-it, ekonomia shqiptare vijoi t rritet n gjysmn e par t vitit 2023. Ritmi i rritjes ekonomike shnoi nj prmirsim t leht n tremujorin e dyt, duke arritur nivelin 3.2%, ndrkoh q t dhnat e trthorta t disponuara sugjerojn nj ritm t ngjashm rritjeje edhe pr tremujorin e tret. Rritja ekonomike ka pasqyruar zgjerimin e aktivitetit n sektorin e ndrtimit dhe deg t caktuara t sektorit t shrbimeve, ndrkoh q sektori i bujqsis dhe ai i industris shnuan rnie. Kjo ecuri sht diktuar nga zgjerimi i krkess s brendshme pr mallra e shrbime, si pasoj e rritjes s konsumit familjar dhe t investimeve t sektorit privat, si dhe nga rritja e eksportit t shrbimeve. Nga ana tjetr, politika fiskale ka mbetur n kahun konsolidues, ndrsa eksporti i mallrave ka ardhur n rnie. Rritja relativisht e shpejt e krkess pr mallra e shrbime gjat tre viteve t fundit sht pasqyruar n nj pozicion ciklik pozitiv t ekonomis shqiptare. Ky pozicion ka sjell prmirsimin e gjendjes financiare t bizneseve shqiptare, e kryesisht t atyre t industris s shrbimeve, dhe  prball mungesave t vna re n tregun e puns,  sht pasqyruar n rritje t shpejt t pagave n sektorin privat. N veanti, punsimi shnoi nj rritje vjetore prej 2.7% n tremujorin e dyt t vitit ndrsa paga mesatare n sektorin privat u zgjerua me rreth 15%, duke rritur t ardhurat e familjeve shqiptare por duke mbajtur t larta edhe kostot e prodhimit dhe presionet e brendshme inflacioniste. N aspektin makroekonomik, zgjerimi i krkess pr mallra e shrbime vijon t ushqehet nga kushtet ende stimuluese financiare n vend, nga prmirsimi gradual i besimit t biznesit dhe t konsumatorit gjat vitit 2023, si dhe nga rritja e shpejt e sektorit t turizmit. Tregjet financiare shqiptare kan qen relativisht t qeta gjat tremujorit t shkuar. N veanti, luhatjet e kursit t kmbimit t lekut ndaj euros po vijn drejt reduktimit, ndrsa raporti i shkmbimit t lekut ndaj euros duket se sht stabilizuar rreth niveleve aktuale. Normalizimi gradual i qndrimit t politiks monetare ka sjell nj rritje t prgjithshme t nivelit t normave t interesit n vend. Megjithat, kushtet e brendshme financiare mbeten ende stimuluese. Po ashtu, kostot e financimit t sektorit privat dhe publik pasqyrojn prime t kontrolluara rreziku t likuiditetit dhe t kreditit, duke sugjeruar nj ambient relativisht t qet financiar dhe nj perceptim prgjithsisht pozitiv t sektorit bankar mbi zhvillimet e ardhshme ekonomike. Ritmi i rritjes s kredis pr sektorin privat ka ardhur n ngadalsim gjat tremujorve t fundit, n pasqyrim t reduktimit t nevojave t bizneseve pr kapital qarkullues, si dhe t nj prqasjeje m t kujdesshme t sektorit bankar n kredidhnie. Nga ana tjetr, pas nj forcimi t shpejt n periudhn maj  korrik, kursi i kmbimit t lekut sht stabilizuar n periudhn gusht-shtator, duke gjetur nj ekuilibr t ri rreth niveleve aktuale. Kjo ecuri sugjeron se ndrsa prmirsimi i bilanceve t huaja t ekonomis shqiptare dikton nj sjellje t kahut forcues t lekut n periudha afatmesme e afatgjata, tregu valutor ka qen dhe do t mbetet subjekt i luhatjeve afatshkurtra. Pr kt arsye, t gjith operatort e tregut valutor duhet t jen t kujdesshm n aktivitetin e tyre, duke shmangur marrjen e ekspozimeve t panevojshme ndaj rrezikut t kursit t kmbimit. Prditsimi i parashikimeve le t pandryshuara pritjet tona pr t ardhmen. Projeksionet e skenarit baz sugjerojn se ekonomia shqiptare do t vijoj t rritet gjat periudhs n vijim, ndrsa inflacioni do t kthehet n objektiv rreth mesit t vitit 2024. N periudhn afatshkurtr, nj ritm m i moderuar i rritjes ekonomike pritet t sjell nj ecuri m t balancuar t krkess dhe oferts pr mallra e shrbime, duke ndihmuar reduktimin e presioneve t brendshme inflacioniste dhe stabilizimin e mimeve gjat vitit t ardhshm. M tej, n periudhn afatmesme, ritmi i rritjes ekonomike pritet t vij drejt normalizimit, n linj me potencialet prodhuese t vendit. Ky skenar parashikimesh faktorizon pritjet tona pr nj ecuri t ngadalt, por gjithsesi pozitive, t ekonomis s Eurozons, pritjet pr reduktim gradual t inflacionit n ambientin e huaj, si dhe pritjet pr nj ecuri t qet t ekonomis dhe t tregut financiar shqiptar. N t njjtn koh, prditsimi i analizs dhe parashikimeve sugjeron nj profil m neutral t balancs s rrezikut. *** Bazuar n sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris vendosi: t mbaj t pandryshuar normn baz t interesit, n nivelin 3.00%; t mbaj t pandryshuar normn e interesit t kredis njditore, n nivelin 4.00%; t mbaj t pandryshuar normn e interesit t depozits njditore, n nivelin 2.00%. Kshilli Mbikqyrs vren se kjo vendimmarrje ndihmon n krijimin e kushteve t prshtatshme monetare pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv gjat vitit t ardhshm. Gjithashtu, ajo sht konsistente me kahun konsolidues, aktual e t pritur, t politiks fiskale, si dhe me kahun forcues q ka ndjekur ecuria e kursit t kmbimit gjat vitit 2023. Megjithat, Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjykon se presionet e larta inflacioniste nga ekonomia e brendshme mbeten nj faktor rreziku pr stabilitetin e mimeve n vend. N kt kontest, ai thekson se mbetet i gatshm t vazhdoj procesin e normalizimit t qndrimit t politiks monetare, nse kjo mas do t konsiderohet e nevojshme pr garantimin e stabilitetit t mimeve.

Title: Questions  Answers to press conference, 4 October 2023
text: Questions  Answers to press conference, 4 October 2023 Date of publication: 04.10.2023 Question: Mr. Governor, we currently have an exchange rate balance of the euro about 106 ALL. Does the Bank of Albania intend to intervene in the market to increase its foreign reserve? Or will it be a scheduled schedule? Governor: The calendar of interventions for the effect of the foreign reserve was published at the beginning of the steal was changed during August. We do not plan to make any further interventions beyond the calendar, unless the criteria legally set out in the Bank of Albania's regulation are met to maintain a stabilized exchange rate. Normally the exchange rate regime is free. So, as long as the exchange rate has a normal behavior, developing according to market criteria and not speculative conditions, we don't plan to intervene. Once again, I emphasize that a not only stabilized exchange rate but a strong exchange rate of lek versus foreign currencies, mainly the euro, helps keep prices in check, thus increasing the purchasing power of the population and keeping inflationary pressures in check. Inflation is the objection, but not only. Of course, if the exchange rate helps keep prices in check, the Central Bank has no reason to interfere with the exchange rate.
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Pyetje  prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp, 4 tetor 2023 Data e publikimit: 04.10.2023 Pyetje: Z. Guvernator, aktualisht kemi nj ekuilibr t kursit t kmbimit t euros rreth 106 lek. A ka ndrmend Banka e Shqipris t ndrhyj n treg pr t shtuar rezervn valutore t saj? Apo do t zbatoj kalendarin e publikuar? Guvernatori: Kalendari i ndrhyrjeve pr efekt t rezervs valutore sht publikuar n llim t vidhe sht ndryshuar gjat muajit gusht. Ne nuk kemi n plan t bjm ndrhyrje t tjera prtej kalendarit, n rast se nuk plotsohen kriteret q prcaktohen ligjrisht n rregulloren e Banks s Shqipris, pr t mbajtur nj kurs kmbimi t stabilizuar. Normalisht regjimi i kursit t kmbimit sht i lir. Pra, pr sa koh q kursi i kmbimit ka nj sjellje normale, q zhvillohet sipas kritereve t tregut dhe jo kushteve spekulae, ne nuk kemi n plan t ndrhyjm. Edhe nj her theksoj q nj kurs kmbimi jo vetm i stabilizuar por nj kurs kmbimi i fort i lekut kundrejt monedhave t huaja, kryesisht euros, ndihmon n mbajtjen e mimeve n kontroll pra n rritjen e fuqis blerse s popullats dhe n mbajtjen n kontroll t presioneve inacioniste. Objekyesor sht inacioni por jo vetm. Natyrisht q nse kursi i kmbimit ndihmon n mbajtjen e mimeve n kontroll, Banka Qendrore nuk ka arsye se pse t ndrhyj n kursin e kmbimit.

Title: Governor Sejko participates in the International Scientific Conference on "Challenges and Perspective of Kosovo-Albania and Region Economic Cooperation", in Pristina
text: Governor Sejko participates in the International Scientific Conference on "Challenges and Perspective of Kosovo-Albania and Region Economic Cooperation", in Pristina Date of publication: 06.10.2023 On October 5-6, 2023, the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Sejko, conducted an official visit to the Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo, within his participation in the International Scientific Conference on the topic "Challenges and perspective of economic cooperation Kosovo-Albania and the region", organized in Pristina, by the Academy of Sciences and Arts of Kosovo and the Academy of Sciences of Albania. On the first day of this visit, Governor Sejko held a meeting with the new Governor of the Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo, Mr. Ahmet Ismaili, at the premises of the CENTRAL BANK. He congratulated Governor Ismaili on his new assignment, reaffirming the cooperation and support of the Bank of Albania. The meeting discussed the experiences exchanged between the two institutions and the close and fruitful cooperation, mainly in the framework of the organization of joint visits between the staff of the BQK and the BSH. The Governors also underlined the importance of the Regional Memorandum of Cooperation in the field of corporate governance, signed in 2019 by the BSH and the CENTRAL BANK of The Republic of North Macedonia, the Central Bank of Montenegro, the Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina, with the aim of continuous cooperation of the parties in the field of supervision, research and decision-making, related to corporate governance indicators of the region's banks. Governor Sejko stressed that the Bank of Albania will make the utmost efforts to ensure that the cooperation within this Memorandum is as concrete and as directly impactful as possible. Governor Sejko and Governor Ismaili agreed that the ties between the two institutions will continue to be sustainable and fruitful and that cooperation will be further expanded in the financial sector, including joint activities in the framework of financial education. On the second day of this visit, the Governor attended the international scientific conference, organized by the academies of the two countries, to discuss the prospects and challenges of monetary and financial development of Albania and Kosovo. The activity was opened by the greeting words of Akad. Justina Shiroka-Pula, University of Pristina, Prof. Dr. Anastas Angjeli, Akad. Mehmet Kraja, President of the Academy of Sciences and Arts of Kosovo, Akad.
