Mr. Skender Gjinushi, chairman of the Academy of Sciences of Albania, Mr. Arberie Nagavci, Minister of Education, Science, Technology and Innovation of the Republic of Kosovo, Mr. Jeton Shaqiri, Minister of Education and Science in North Macedonia, etc. Invited as speaker at the first panel, Governor Sejko discussed on the topic "Prospects and challenges of monetary and financial development and economic integration for Kosovo-Albania economic cooperation in the context of regional integration". The governor said that the economies of the two countries have a relatively similar structure of private sector organization, as well as financial systems in terms of the nature and phase of their development, dominated mainly by banks, which have played an important role in the economic development of the countries. Meanwhile, the main challenges for both economies have been and remain productivity and competitiveness, as well as small size compared to the eurozone economy. The governor added that to further advance towards the European perspective, both regional and country-level cooperation plays an important role towards overcoming the challenges, alongside the continuation of structural reforms. In this regard, Albania and Kosovo have strengthened bilateral co-operation by signing a community of intergovernmental agreements. The challenges that the future holds are affected by demographic developments, education and financial inclusion, climate and environmental developments, green finance, and rapid digitization of finance and money, which are considered important elements of sustainable development. Financial inclusion and financial education are an important objective for the present and future. In the framework of progress towards the European Union, the Governor stressed the importance of having a full economic and financial integration between the two countries. In conclusion, Mr. Sejko said that cooperation in the fields of monetary policy, banking supervision, financial stability, payment systems, etc. Between Albania and Kosovo can bring significant benefits for strengthening financial stability in the region. Furthermore, cooperation between the two central banks should be extended not only in terms of research and analysis, but also in generating common products and strategies in the areas of central banking, especially in terms of future global challenges, as well as in the function of a faster convergence towards the EU. - Governor Sejko said.

Guvernatori shtoi se pr t prparuar m tej drejt perspektivs evropiane, si bashkpunimi rajonal, ashtu dhe ai midis shteteve, luajn nj rol t rndsishm drejt kaprcimit t sfidave, krahas vazhdimit t reformave strukturore. N kt drejtim, Shqipria dhe Kosova kan forcuar bashkpunimin dypalsh duke nnshkruar nj bashksi marrveshjesh ndrqeveritare. Title: Address of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Sejko, at the joint press conference with the IMF's Head of Mission and the Minister of Finance and Economy
text: Address of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Sejko, at the joint press conference with the IMF's Head of Mission and the Minister of Finance and Economy Date of publication: 27.10.2023 Dear representatives of the media, Let me first thank the IMF Mission for the fruitful discussions we have had over the past two weeks in the framework of periodic consultations on Article IV. At their closing, I am pleased to find that we share similar views on the development stage of the country, the challenges we have ahead, as well as the economic policies and structural reforms we must undertake to enable a faster and sustainable development of the country. I want to further address these three issues. The performance of the Albanian economy over the last year has been positive, especially in a challenging and not favorable global context. This is a step in several directions: from first, in the continuous growth of economic activity, employment and wages, which have improved the financial situation of Albanian families and businesses; from Second, to significantly reduce inflation from the high levels of a year ago. Inflation has fallen to 4.1% in September this year, from 8.3% in October 2022. This progress indicates significant progress towards achieving price stability, although there is still a way to reach that destination; from Third, in the sustainability of the banking sector, which represents stabilized or improved indicators of capital, liquidity and profitability. This sector has continues to provide the necessary funds for increasing consumption and investments, while taking care  at the same time  to preserve the savings of Albanian families. Our analysis and resistance exercises suggest that the banking sector appears resistant, even to possible stress situations; from Fourth, in improving the country's external position, reflected in the narrowing of current account deficit and the decline of foreign debt. This development reflected strong growth in tourist activity and high levels of foreign direct investment; from Finally, in the improvement of fiscal position, reflected in the decrease in budget deficit and public debt. The positive performance of the economy has reflected the flexibility of the private sector, its financial health, as well as the appropriate response of economic policies. In line with our objective, we have continued the path of a gradual and prudent normalisation of the stance of our monetary policy. The gradual increase of the interest rate to its equilibrium level has been intended to create a suitable financial environment for returning inflation to target, within a reasonable time horizon and at lower costs for the economy. The wording of our monetary policy stance has also taken into account the rapid strengthening of the lek exchange rate against the euro and the fiscal consolidation undertaken by the public authorities. As we have continuously communicated, the rapid strengthening of lek during this year has reflected a constant currency surplus in the domestic market, as a result of the rapid and strong growth of tourism, foreign direct investment and remittances. This factor has enabled us to maintain a lower level of the basic interest rate, providing the Albanian economy with lower financing costs and easing the financial burden on borrowers. The impact of our monetary policy is encouraging. Our response has helped control inflationary expectations and smoothly functioning financial markets, creating the necessary premises for returning inflation to target. Albania has had and continues to have one of the lowest rates of inflation and one of the highest rates of economic growth in the region. The country's development prospects remain positive. Our forecasts suggest that the Albanian economy will continue to grow over the coming years, while inflation will return to a target of 3% over the next year. This forecast factors in further lowering inflation in our trading partners and a more balanced performance of demand and supply in the economy. However, our analysis shows that domestic inflationary pressures remain high, while the rekindling of geopolitical tensions in the Middle East has the potential to increase risks to inflation. For this reason, we remain committed to reacting in the direction of further normalisation of the monetary policy stance in the future. Our primary objective has been and remains the return of inflation to target. We aim to meet this objective in a reasonable time and at lower costs to the Albanian economy. For this reason, our position will be guided by new data and the balance of factors affecting inflation, in particular price performance in foreign markets, exchange rate performance, wages and production costs, and fiscal policy. In a longer term view, the Bank of Albania judges that strengthening the pace of development of the country and its sustainability requires the continuation of structural reforms. These reforms should be prioritized to increase productivity and competitiveness of the economy and should be increasingly anchored in the Process of European integration. Within our area of expertise, the Bank of Albania remains engaged in: Storage sustainability and further development of the banking system, through ensuring prudent regulation and supervision of it, as well as through cooperation with relevant authorities for the development of other segments of the financial markets; spur formalization and increase the degree of education and financial inclusion. A starting point of this process is the drafting of the national strategy for financial education, as well as the modernization of the payment system and the increase in the use of electronic payments; Support european integration through the fulfillment of the criteria for approximating the Acquis of the European Union and following through with rigor the reforms imposed by this process. Thank you for your attention!
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko, n konferencn e prbashkt pr shtyp me Shefen e Misionit t FMN-s dhe Ministrin e Financave dhe Ekonomis Data e publikimit: 27.10.2023 T nderuar prfaqsues t medias, M lejoni, n radh t par, t falnderoj Misionin e FMN-s pr diskutimet e frytshme q kemi pasur gjat dy javve t fundit n kuadr t konsultimeve periodike pr Artikullin IV. N mbyllje t tyre, konstatoj me knaqsi se ndajm pikpamje t ngjashme mbi stadin e zhvillimit t vendit, sfidat q kemi prpara, si dhe politikat ekonomike e reformat strukturore q duhet t ndrmarrim pr t mundsuar nj zhvillim sa m t shpejt e t qndrueshm t vendit. N vijim, dshiroj ti shtjelloj m gjat kto tre shtje. Ecuria e ekonomis shqiptare gjat vitit t fundit ka qen pozitive, sidomos n nj kontekst global sfidues dhe aspak t favorshm. Kjo ecuri sht e prekshme n disa drejtime: s pari, n rritjen e pandrprer t aktivitetit ekonomik, t punsimit dhe t pagave, t cilat kan prmirsuar gjendjen financiare t familjeve dhe bizneseve shqiptare; s dyti, n reduktimin e ndjeshm t inflacionit nga nivelet e larta t nj viti m par. Inflacioni ka rn n 4.1% n muajin shtator t ktij viti, nga 8.3% n muajin tetor t vitit 2022. Kjo ecuri tregon pr nj progres t rndsishm n drejtim t arritjes s stabilitetit t mimeve, ndonse mbetet ende rrug pr t mbrritur n at destinacion; s treti, n qndrueshmrin e sektorit bankar, i cili paraqet tregues t stabilizuar apo n prmirsim t kapitalit, t likuiditetit dhe t prfitueshmris. Ky sektor ka vijuar t ofroj fondet e nevojshme pr rritjen e konsumit dhe t investimeve, duke u kujdesur  n t njjtn koh  t ruaj dhe kursimet e familjeve shqiptare. Analizat dhe ushtrimet tona t rezistencs sugjerojn se sektori bankar shfaqet rezistent, edhe ndaj situatave t mundshme t stresit; s katrti, n prmirsimin e pozicionit t jashtm t vendit, t pasqyruar n ngushtimin e deficitit t llogaris korrente dhe rnien e borxhit t huaj. Ky zhvillim pasqyroi rritjen e fort t aktivitetit turistik dhe nivelet e larta t investimeve t huaja direkte; s fundmi, n prmirsimin e pozicionit fiskal, t pasqyruar n rnien e deficitit buxhetor dhe t borxhit publik. Ecuria pozitive e ekonomis ka pasqyruar fleksibilitetin e sektorit privat, shndetin financiar t tij, si dhe reagimin e duhur t politikave ekonomike. N prputhje me objektivin ton, ne kemi vazhduar rrugn e nj normalizimi gradual dhe t kujdesshm t qndrimit t politiks son monetare. Rritja graduale e norms baz t interesit drejt nivelit t saj ekuilibr ka synuar t krijoj nj mjedis financiar t prshtatshm pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv, brenda nj horizonti kohor t arsyeshm dhe me kosto sa m t ulta pr ekonomin. Formulimi i qndrimit t politiks son monetare ka mbajtur parasysh edhe forcimin e shpejt t kursit t kmbimit t lekut ndaj euros dhe konsolidimin fiskal t ndrmarr nga autoritetet publike. Ashtu sikurse kemi komunikuar n vazhdimsi, forcimi i shpejt i lekut gjat ktij viti ka pasqyruar nj tepric konstante valute n tregun e brendshm, si pasoj e rritjes s shpejt dhe t fort t turizmit, investimeve t huaja direkte dhe remitancave. Ky faktor na kan mundsuar t mbajm nj nivel m t ult t norms baz t interesit, duke i ofruar ekonomis shqiptare kosto m t ulta financimi dhe duke lehtsuar barrn financiare mbi kredimarrsit. Efektet e deritanishme t politiks son monetare jan inkurajuese. Reagimi yn ka ndihmuar kontrollin e pritjeve inflacioniste dhe funksionimin e qet t tregjeve financiare, duke krijuar premisat e nevojshme pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv. Shqipria ka pasur dhe vijon t ket nj ndr normat m t ulta t inflacionit dhe nj ndr normat m t larta t rritjes ekonomike n rajon. Perspektivat e zhvillimit t vendit mbeten pozitive. Parashikimet tona sugjerojn se ekonomia shqiptare do t vijoj t rritet gjat viteve n vijim, ndrsa inflacioni do t kthehet n objektivin 3% gjat vitit t ardhshm. Ky parashikim faktorizon uljen e mtejshme t inflacionit n partnert tan tregtar dhe nj ecuri m t balancuar t krkess dhe oferts n ekonomi. Megjithat, analizat tona tregojn se presionet e brendshme inflacioniste vijojn t jen t larta, ndrsa rindezja e tensioneve gjeopolitike n Lindjen e Mesme ka potencialin t rris rreziqet ndaj inflacionit. Pr kt arsye, ne mbetemi t angazhuar t reagojm n drejtim t normalizimit t mtejshm t qndrimit t politiks monetare n t ardhmen. Objektivi yn primar ka qen dhe mbetet kthimi i inflacionit n objektiv. Ne synojm ta prmbushim kt objektiv n nj koh t arsyeshme dhe me kosto sa m t ulta pr ekonomin shqiptare. Pr kt arsye, qndrimi yn do t orientohet nga t dhnat e reja dhe balanca e faktorve q ndikojn n inflacion, e n veanti ecuria e mimeve n tregjet e huaja, ecuria e kursit t kmbimit, ecuria e pagave dhe e kostove t prodhimit, si dhe kahu i politiks fiskale. N nj kndvshtrim m afatgjat, Banka e Shqipris gjykon se forcimi i ritmit t zhvillimit t vendit dhe i qndrueshmris s tij krkon vazhdimin e reformave strukturore. Kto reforma duhet t synojn n mnyr prioritare rritjen e produktivitetit dhe t konkurrueshmris s ekonomis dhe duhet t ankorohen gjithnj e m tepr n procesin e integrimit evropian. Brenda fushs son t ekspertizs, Banka e Shqipris mbetet e angazhuar n: ruajtjen e qndrueshmris dhe zhvillimin e mtejshm t sistemit bankar, nprmjet garantimit t nj rregullimi dhe mbikqyrjeje t kujdesshme t tij, si edhe nprmjet bashkpunimit me autoritetet relevante pr zhvillimin e segmenteve t tjera t tregjeve financiare; nxitjen e formalizimit dhe rritjen e shkalls s edukimit dhe t prfshirjes financiare. Nj piknisje e ktij procesi sht hartimi i strategjis kombtare pr edukimin financiar, si dhe modernizimi i sistemit t pagesave dhe rritja e shkalls s prdorimit t pagesave elektronike; mbshtetjen e integrimit evropian nprmjet plotsimit t kritereve pr prafrimin e Acquis t Bashkimit Evropian dhe ndjekjen me rigorozitet t reformave q imponon ky proces. Ju faleminderit pr vmendjen!

Title: Questions and answers of Governor Sejko's joint press conference with the IMF Chief Mission and minister of Finance and Economy
text: Questions and answers of Governor Sejko's joint press conference with the IMF Chief Mission and minister of Finance and Economy Date of publication: 27.10.2023 Question: The Bank of Albania is a legal adviser to the Albanian government. What is the recommendation or advice you have made to the Albanian government that relates precisely to this policy on the pressures of the cost of living through fiscal policies, but especially for the poorer strata that are affected by these policies? Governor: Regarding the role that the Bank of Albania has as an advisor to the government, in the first place we have advised the Government of the Republic of Albania on the framework of macro policies, as macro indicators are what we as a central bank look at in our view. Fiscal policy is a direct attribute of the Albanian government, while monetary policy is the central bank's attribute. Regarding fiscal policy we have continuously communicated and agreed with the Ministry of Finance and have given before the Parliament of the Republic of Albania and the Commission of Economy and Finance recommendations related to the reduction of the level of public debt, without going into details of fiscal policy that is not our attribute. Meanwhile, the central bank itself has taken initiatives related to the layers in need which are mainly related to its objectives of financial inclusion and financial education. In this context, there has been a continuous focus, as mentioned in my speech, on the strategy of financial education and financial inclusion. These are not only theoretical, they are concrete actions where we demand that the population be as involved as possible in banks, because the higher the involvement in banking according to the world bank and other international institutions, the more social inequality decreases through the benefits of the population through financial products and services. More specifically, a year ago we implemented a euro payment system within the Republic of Albania using our capacities as we did for the money. This system that in the first year has brought over 10 million euros in savings and this year will show higher figures in direct savings not only of the layers in need but also of agents and businesses. At the same time, I would like to mention the last law on the basic account that the Albanian government just passed on our proposal and will be approved soon in parliament. This law is intended for vulnerable and vulnerable strata, for the lower-income population who will be able to access bank accounts and banking products at zero cost. This is another very important step in that direction. Regarding the consultation, the central bank opinion is given continuously each year before preparing the budget in the Ministry of Finance in writing and publicly to the Economy and Finance Commission. In more detail, fiscal policy is the absolute attribute of the Albanian government. Q: Is the current exchange rate a new normal? Governor: In a free exchange rate regime no one can say what the rate is, and what the rate will be. The course determines demand and supply in the market. What we can say and we have seen is that the strengthening of the exchange rate starting since 2015, but specifically more since 2018, has come into line with economic growth and the development of the Albanian economy. So it's been in line with the foundations. Even the strong exchange rate overvaluation this year has been a strong overvaluation, but this overvaluation has begun if we go back a little bit in time since 2018, which is also in line with the fundamentals. Looking at the balance of payments data, clearly shows the foreign exchange market inflows and foreign surpluses that come precisely from these channels that I have highlighted, without going into details. The Albanian economy will continue to grow and develop, and we hope that will happen. So we work for this, not only hope we are working, and we are tired of implementing all structural reforms in order to grow and sustain the Albanian economy. Then of course the exchange rate theoretically related to fundamentals can continue to be at these levels or stronger. But the exchange rate is so complex and influenced by many factors; It is not only affected by internal markets but also by external markets. And all these complex factors you can't predict and you can't say it's a new normal or not. On the basis of the fundamentals, the growth of the Albanian economy, both principledly and theoretically, is expected to bring about a strong exchange rate. But, in fact, other factors that affect the exchange rate that come from international markets can never be ruled out. We have a free exchange rate regime, this is a market indicator that is based on demand and supply and we cannot determine concretely that we would misorient the market and what. We would be wrong and theoretical if we said that.
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Pyetje-prgjigjet e konferencs s prbashkt pr shtyp t Guvernatorit Sejko me Shefen e Misionit t FMN-s dhe Ministrin e Financave dhe Ekonomis Data e publikimit: 27.10.2023 Pyetje: Banka e Shqipris sht kshilltar ligjor i qeveris shqiptare. Cili sht rekomandimi apo kshillimi q i keni br qeveris shqiptare q lidhet pikrisht me kt politik mbi presionet e kostos s jetess nprmjet politikave fiskale por sidomos pr shtresat e varfra q preken nga kto politika? Guvernatori: Lidhur me rolin q Banka e Shqipris ka si kshilltar i qeveris, n radh t par ne e kemi kshilluar n mnyr zyrtare dhe publike vazhdimisht Qeverin e Republiks s Shqipris n kuadrin e politikave makro, pasi treguesit makro jan ato q ne si bank qendrore shikojm n kndvshtrimin ton. Politika fiskale sht atribut direkt i qeveris shqiptare, ndrsa politika monetare sht atribut i banks qendrore. Lidhur me politikn fiskale vazhdimisht ne kemi komunikuar dhe rakorduar me Ministrin e Financave dhe kemi dhn para Parlamentit t Republiks s Shqipris dhe Komisionit t Ekonomis dhe Financave rekomandime q kan t bjn me uljen e nivelit t borxhit publik, pa hyr n detaje t politiks fiskale q nuk sht atributi yn. Ndrkoh, vet banka qendrore ka ndrmarr iniciativa lidhur me shtresat n nevoj t cilat lidhen kryesisht me objektivat e saj t prfshirjes financiare dhe edukimit financiar. N kt kuadr, ka pasur nj fokus t vazhdueshm sikurse prmenda dhe gjat fjals time n strategjin e edukimit financiar dhe prfshirjen financiare. Kto nuk jan vetm teorike, jan veprime konkrete ku ne krkojm q popullata t jet sa m e prfshir n banka, pasi sa m e lart t jet prfshirja n banking sipas studimeve t Banks Botrore dhe t institucioneve t tjera ndrkombtare, aq m shum ulet dhe pabarazia shoqrore nprmjet prfitimeve q merr popullata nprmjet produkteve dhe shrbimeve financiare. M konkretisht, para nj viti kemi implementuar nj sistem pagesash n euro brenda Republiks s Shqipris duke prdorur kapacitetet tona njlloj sikurse kemi br pr lekun. Ky sistem q n vitin e par ka sjell mbi 10 milion euro kursime dhe ky vit do t tregoj shifra dhe me t larta n kursim t drejtprdrejt jo vetm t shtresave n nevoj por dhe t agjentve dhe t bizneseve. Njkohsisht, dua t prmend dhe ligjin e fundit pr llogarin bazike q qeveria shqiptare sapo e kaloi me propozimin ton dhe do t miratohet s shpejti n parlament. Ky ligj sht i dedikuar pr shtresat n nevoj dhe vulnerabl, pr pjesn e popullsis me t ardhura m t ulta t cilat do t ken mundsi t ken llogari bankare dhe produkte bankare me kosto zero. Ky sht nj hap tjetr shum i rndsishm n kt drejtim. Lidhur me kshillimin, opinioni i banks qendrore jepet vazhdimisht do vit prpara prgatitjes s buxhetit n Ministrin e Financave me shkrim dhe publikisht n Komisionin e Ekonomis dhe Financave. Ndrkoh m n detaje, politika fiskale sht atribut absolut i qeveris shqiptare. Pyetje: A sht kursi aktual i kmbimit nj normalitet i ri? Guvernatori: N nj regjim t lir t kursit t kmbimit askush nuk mund t thot se cili sht kursi, dhe si do t jet kursi. Kursin e prcakton krkesa dhe oferta n treg. Ajo q mund t themi dhe q kemi par sht q forcimi i kursit t kmbimit duke filluar q nga viti 2015, por konkretisht m shum q nga viti 2018, ka ardhur n linj me rritjen ekonomike dhe me zhvillimin e ekonomis shqiptare. Pra ka qen n linj me fondamentet. Edhe mbimimi i fort i kursit t kmbimit n kt vit, ka qen nj mbimim i fort por ky mbimim ka filluar po t kthehemi pak n koh q nga viti 2018, i cili sht gjithashtu n linj me fondamentet. Po t shohim t dhnat e bilancit t pagesave, tregojn qartazi hyrjet n tregun valutor dhe tepricat valutore q vjen pikrisht nga kto kanale q un i kam theksuar, pa hyr n detaje. Natyrisht q ekonomia shqiptare do t vazhdoj t rritet dhe t zhvillohet, dhe ne shpresojm q kjo t ndodh. Pra ne pr kt punojm, jo vetm shpresojm po punojm, dhe lodhemi q t zbatojm gjith reformat strukturore n funksion t nj rritjeje dhe zhvillimi t qndrueshm t ekonomis shqiptare. Ather sigurisht q dhe kursi i kmbimit teorikisht lidhur me fondamentet mund t vijoj t jet n kto nivele ose m i fort. Por kursi i kmbimit sht kaq kompleks dhe i ndikuar nga shum faktor; nuk ndikohet vetm nga tregjet e brendshme por dhe nga tregjet e jashtme. Dhe t gjith kta faktor kaq kompleks nuk mund ti parashikosh dot dhe nuk mund t thuash q sht nj normalitet i ri ose jo. N baz t fondamenteve, rritja e ekonomis shqiptare si parimisht ashtu dhe teorikisht pritet t sjell nj kurs t fort kmbimi.Por konkretisht nuk mund t prjashtohen asnjher faktort e tjer q ndikojn n kursin e kmbimit, q vijn nga tregjet ndrkombtare. Ne kemi nj regjim t lir t kursit t kmbimit, ky sht nj tregues i tregut q bazohet n krkesn dhe ofertn dhe nuk mund ta prcaktojm dot konkretisht se do t keqorientonim tregun dhe sikur. Do bnim gabim teorik dhe praktik nse do t thonim konkretisht kt gj.

Title: Governor Sejko's remarks at the press conference on monetary policy decision making, 1 November 2023
text: Governor Sejko's remarks at the press conference on monetary policy decision making, 1 November 2023 Date of publication: 01.11.2023 Dear representatives of the media, Today, on 1 November 2023, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania reviewed and approved the Quarterly Monetary Policy Report. The new information received in the analysis has generally been in line with our expectations. Faced with a challenging foreign environment, economic activity in the country has increased during 2023, while inflation has come to a progressive decline. These positive trends are expected to continue in the future. However, the Supervisory Council assessed that internal inflationary pressures remain high. For this reason, at today's meeting, it decided to reduce the intensity of monetary stimulus, aiming to create the appropriate financial conditions for returning inflation to target, within the next year. [I will explain in more detail today's decision and the reasons that motivated it.] *** Consumer price inflation reached an average level of 4.1% in the third quarter, following the down-trend followed for the previous two quarters. The reduction in inflation during this quarter reflected  most notably  the decline in food inflation. On the other hand, the inflation of other basket items appeared relatively stable, while heightened geopolitical tensions have brought oil prices to a rise. In the macroeconomic view, the fall in inflation during 2023 is largely dictated by the decline in imported inflation. This trend has reflected the overall stabilisation of prices of basic products in international markets, the fall in inflation in our trading partners, as well as the strengthening of the exchange rate of lek over the last two years. In parallel, domestic inflationary pressures have also come down, but they remain relatively high and stable. In these circumstances, the pace of inflation decline slowed in the third quarter, while basic inflation remains above target. The Albanian economy continues to remain on a positive development trend. The volume of economic activity increased by 3.2% in the second quarter, marking an improvement compared to the previous period. The data available suggest that this growth trajectory continued in the third quarter. Economic growth has been dictated by the expansion of private consumption and investment, as well as by increased tourism revenues. It is reflected in the expansion of activity in the construction and services sector, while other sectors of the economy have had a weaker performance. Steady growth in demand for goods and services has pushed the economy into a positive phase of the business cycle. It is reflected in the improvement of the financial situation of the business and consumer, in the continued growth of employment, as well as in the rapid growth of wages and production costs. In this context, wages in the private sector rose 15% in the second quarter. The unemployment rate is near historic lows, while businesses report difficulties in securing labor. This dynamic suggests that  although downward  domestic inflationary pressures are not yet aligned with our price stability objective. In macroeconomic terms, economic growth is being supported by the increase in foreign demand in certain segments of Albanian exports, by sound balance sheets of the private sector, by improved business and consumer confidence, as well as by the still stimulating monetary and financial environment. The prudent normalization of the monetary policy stance has helped control inflation during 2022 and its return to a downward trajectory in 2023, as well as enabled the smooth functioning of financial markets. It has been accompanied by a general increase in interest rates in the interbank market, the government securities market, as well as deposits and loans in ALL. However, interest rate increases in Albania are among the lowest in the region and the costs and conditions of financing remain stimulating. In particular, interest rates on loans appear stabilized during the third quarter, or with declining tendencies in certain segments. In response, credit to the private sector has been keeping positive growth rates during this quarter, although the pace of growth has slowed. This slowdown reflects  to the greatest extent  the improvement of the financial situation of businesses and the reduction of their needs for circulating capital, while growth rates of investment credit and household credit appear relatively stable. At the same time, the structure of the loan portfolio is exhibiting an increasing orientation towards all, as a result of the reduction of interest rate difference and the strengthening of the exchange rate, while the quality of this portfolio remains high, as illustrated by the low levels of the ratio of non-rupted loans. These developments suggest that the banking sector remains ready and able to respond with financing to private sector demands for expanding investments, increasing consumption and buying housing. Parallel to these developments, the exchange rate of lek has shown an increasing stability over the last few months, while the foreign exchange market has been operating smoothly and with normal activity parameters. This performance suggests stabilizing demand and supply-to-currency ratios around current rates of the rate. The update to our forecasts suggests that these trends will continue in the coming period. Economic activity is expected to increase over the medium-term horizon, helping to boost employment and wages, as well as supporting the health of the financial balance sheets of businesses and households. The pace of growth is expected to mark a slight slowdown over the coming year, due to the global economic context and tighter financing conditions, but it is expected to return to its historic pace in the coming years. In parallel, inflation is expected to come in gradual decline over the next year and return to target in the second half of 2024. However, our analyses suggest that meeting this forecast requires a monetary policy response, to enable further reduction of domestic inflationary pressures. Finally, our projections suggest that the main indicators of domestic and external balances of the country-- the health of the banking sector, public debt and domestic foreign debt -- will remain stable or come to improve. *** Based on the above, the Supervisory Council of the Bank of Albania decided: the increase the base interest rate by 0.25 percentage point, bringing it to the level of 3.25%; the increase the interest rate of the one-day loan by 0.25 percentage point, bringing it to 4.25%; the increase the interest rate of the one-day deposit by 0.25 percentage point, bringing it to the level of 2.25%. The Supervisory Council deemed that reducing monetary stimulus, through further normalization of the monetary policy stance, is a necessary measure to guarantee the return of inflation to target within the next year. It factors in the need for a more active monetary policy role in terms of balancing demand and supply for goods and services, against expectations for a more stable exchange rate performance and a more neutral fiscal policy over the medium term horizon. In this context, it serves to preserve the purchasing power of Albanian families, to ensure the monetary and financial stability of the economy, as well as the sustainable and long-term development of the country. The Supervisory Council notes that this decision was consistent with our previous communications, and continues to maintain the overall stance of monetary policy in stimulus positions. Finally, the Supervisory Council stresses that high inflationary pressures from the domestic economy remain a risk factor for domestic price stability and that the balance of risks to inflation has shifted upwards. In this dispute, he remains ready to continue the process of normalizing the monetary policy stance, if this measure is considered necessary for the respect of our inflation target.
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n konferencn pr shtyp pr vendimmarrjen e politiks monetare, 1 nntor 2023 Data e publikimit: 01.11.2023 T nderuar prfaqsues t medias, Sot, n datn 1 nntor 2023, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris mori n shqyrtim dhe miratoi Raportin Tremujor t Politiks Monetare. Informacioni i ri i marr n analiz ka qen, prgjithsisht, n linj me pritjet tona. Prball nj ambienti t huaj sfidues, aktiviteti ekonomik n vend ka shnuar rritje gjat vitit 2023, ndrsa inflacioni ka ardhur n rnie progresive. Kto trende pozitive pritet t vijojn edhe n t ardhmen. Megjithat, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vlersoi se presionet e brendshme inflacioniste vijojn t mbeten t larta. Pr kt arsye, n mbledhjen e sotme, ai vendosi t reduktoj intensitetin e stimulit monetar, duke synuar t krijoj kushtet e prshtatshme financiare pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv, brenda vitit t ardhshm. [ N vijim, do t sqaroj m n detaje vendimin e sotm dhe arsyet q e motivuan at. ] *** Inflacioni i mimeve t konsumit shnoi nj nivel mesatar prej 4.1% n tremujorin e tret, duke vijuar trendin rns t ndjekur gjat dy tremujorve paraardhs. Reduktimi i inflacionit gjat ktij tremujori pasqyroi  m s shumti  rnien e inflacionit t ushqimeve. Nga ana tjetr, inflacioni i artikujve t tjer t shports u shfaq relativisht i qndrueshm, ndrkoh q tensionet e shtuara gjeopolitike kan sjell rritje t mimeve t nafts. N kndvshtrimin makroekonomik, rnia e inflacionit gjat vitit 2023 sht diktuar n masn m t madhe nga rnia e inflacionit t importuar. Ky trend ka pasqyruar stabilizimin e prgjithshm t mimeve t produkteve baz n tregjet ndrkombtare, rnien e inflacionit n partnert tan tregtar, si dhe forcimin e kursit t kmbimit t lekut gjat dy viteve t fundit. Paralelisht me t, edhe presionet e brendshme inflacioniste kan ardhur n rnie, por ato vijojn t mbeten relativisht t larta dhe t qndrueshme. N kto rrethana, ritmi i rnies s inflacionit erdhi n ngadalsim n tremujorin e tret, ndrsa inflacioni baz vijon t mbetet mbi objektiv. Ekonomia shqiptare vijon t qndroj n nj trend pozitiv zhvillimi. Vllimi i aktivitetit ekonomik u rrit me 3.2% n tremujorin e dyt, duke shnuar prmirsim krahasuar me periudhn paraardhse. T dhnat indirekte t disponuara sugjerojn se kjo trajektore rritjeje ka vijuar edhe n tremujorin e tret. Rritja ekonomike sht diktuar nga zgjerimi i konsumit dhe i investimeve private, si dhe nga rritja e t ardhurave nga turizmi. Ajo sht pasqyruar n zgjerimin e aktivitetit n sektorin e shrbimeve e t ndrtimit, ndrkoh q sektort e tjer t ekonomis kan pasur nj ecuri m t dobt. Rritja e qndrueshme e krkess pr mallra e shrbime e ka shtyr ekonomin n nj faz pozitive t ciklit t biznesit. Ajo sht pasqyruar n prmirsimin e gjendjes financiare t biznesit e t konsumatorit, n rritjen e vazhdueshme t punsimit, si dhe n rritjen e shpejt t pagave e t kostove t prodhimit. N kt kontekst, pagat n sektorin privat u rritn me 15% n tremujorin e dyt, norma e papunsis sht pran niveleve m t ulta historike, ndrsa bizneset raportojn vshtirsi n sigurimin e fuqis puntore. Kjo dinamik sugjeron se  edhe pse n rnie  presionet e brendshme inflacioniste nuk jan ende n linj me objektivin ton t stabilitetit t mimeve. N aspektin makroekonomik, rritja ekonomike po mbshtetet nga rritja e krkess s huaj n segmente t caktuara t eksportit shqiptar, nga bilancet e shndosha t sektorit privat, nga besimi i prmirsuar i biznesit dhe konsumatorit, si dhe nga ambienti ende stimulues monetar e financiar. Normalizimi i kujdesshm i qndrimit t politiks monetare ka ndihmuar n kontrollin e inflacionit gjat vitit 2022 dhe kthimin e tij n nj trajektore rnse gjat vitit 2023, si dhe ka mundsuar funksionimin normal t tregjeve financiare. Ai sht shoqruar me nj rritje t prgjithshme t normave t interesit n tregun ndrbankar, tregun e letrave me vler t qeveris, si dhe t depozitave e t kredive n lek. Megjithat, rritja e normave t interesit n Shqipri sht ndr m t ultat n rajon dhe kostot e kushtet e financimit mbeten ende stimuluese. N veanti, normat e interesit t kredive shfaqen t stabilizuara gjat tremujorit t tret, ose me tendenca rnse n segmente t caktuara. N prgjigje t tyre, kredia pr sektorin privat ka vijuar t shnoj norma pozitive rritjeje gjat ktij tremujori, ndonse ritmi i rritjes ka ardhur n ngadalsim. Ky ngadalsim pasqyron  n masn m t madhe  prmirsimin e gjendjes financiare t bizneseve dhe reduktimin e nevojave t tyre pr kapital qarkullues, ndrkoh q ritmet e rritjes s kredis pr investime dhe t kredis pr familje shfaqen relativisht t qndrueshme. N t njjtn koh, struktura e portofolit t kredis po shfaq nj orientim gjithnj e m t madh drejt lekut, si pasoj e reduktimit t diferencs s normave t interesit dhe forcimit t kursit t kmbimit, ndrsa cilsia e ktij portofoli mbetet e lart, sikundr ilustrohet nga nivelet e ulta t raportit t kredive me probleme. Kto zhvillime sugjerojn se sektori bankar mbetet i gatshm dhe i aft ti prgjigjet me financim krkesave t sektorit privat pr zgjerimin e investimeve, pr rritjen e konsumit dhe pr blerjen e banesave. Paralelisht me kto zhvillime, kursi i kmbimit t lekut ka shfaqur nj qndrueshmri n rritje gjat muajve t fundit, ndrsa tregu valutor ka funksionuar i qet dhe me parametra aktiviteti normale. Kjo ecuri sugjeron stabilizimin e raporteve t krkess dhe oferts pr valut rreth niveleve aktuale t kursit. Prditsimi i parashikimeve tona sugjeron se kto trende do t vijojn edhe n periudhn e ardhshme. Aktiviteti ekonomik pritet t vij n rritje gjat horizontit afatmesm, duke ndihmuar rritjen e punsimit e t pagave, si dhe duke mbshtetur shndetin e bilanceve financiare t bizneseve e familjeve. Ritmi i rritjes ekonomike pritet t shnoj nj ngadalsim t leht gjat vitit t ardhshm, si pasoj e kontekstit ekonomik botror dhe kushteve m t shtrnguara t financimit, por ai pritet ti rikthehet ritmeve t tija historike n vitet n vijim. Paralelisht me t, inflacioni pritet t vij n rnie graduale gjat vitit t ardhshm dhe t kthehet n objektiv n gjysmn e dyt t vitit 2024. Megjithat, analizat tona sugjerojn se prmbushja e ktij parashikimi krkon nj reagim t politiks monetare, pr t mundsuar reduktimin e mtejshm t presioneve t brendshme inflacioniste. S fundi, parashikimet tona sugjerojn se treguesit kryesor t ekuilibrave t brendshm e t jashtm t vendit: shndeti i sektorit bankar, borxhi publik dhe borxhi i huaj i vendit, do t mbeten t qndrueshm ose do t vijn n prmirsim. *** Bazuar n sa m sipr, Kshilli Mbikqyrs i Banks s Shqipris vendosi: t rris me 0.25 pik prqindjeje normn baz t interesit, duke e uar at n nivelin 3.25%; t rris me 0.25 pik prqindjeje normn e interesit t kredis njditore, duke e uar at n nivelin 4.25%; t rris me 0.25 pik prqindjeje normn e interesit t depozits njditore, duke e uar at n nivelin 2.25%. Kshilli Mbikqyrs gjykoi se reduktimi i stimulit monetar, prmes normalizimit t mtejshm t qndrimit t politiks monetare, sht nj mas e nevojshme pr t garantuar kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv brenda vitit t ardhshm. Ai faktorizon nevojn pr nj rol m aktiv t politiks monetare n drejtim t balancimit t krkess dhe oferts pr mallra e shrbime, prkundrejt pritjeve pr nj ecuri m t stabilizuar t kursit t kmbimit dhe nj politike fiskale m neutrale n horizontin afatmesm. N kt kontekst, ai i shrben ruajtjes s fuqis blerse t familjeve shqiptare, garantimit t stabilitetit monetar e financiar t ekonomis, si dhe zhvillimit t qndrueshm dhe afatgjat t vendit. Gjithashtu, Kshilli Mbikqyrs vren se ky vendim ishte konsistent me komunikimet tona t mparshme, si dhe vijon t mbaj qndrimin e prgjithshm t politiks monetare n pozita stimuluese. S fundi, Kshilli Mbikqyrs thekson se presionet e larta inflacioniste nga ekonomia e brendshme mbeten nj faktor rreziku pr stabilitetin e mimeve n vend dhe se balanca e rreziqeve ndaj inflacionit sht zhvendosur pr lart. N kt kontest, ai mbetet i gatshm t vazhdoj procesin e normalizimit t qndrimit t politiks monetare, nse kjo mas do t konsiderohet e nevojshme pr respektimin e objektivit ton t inflacionit.

Title: Governor Sejko's remarks at the hearing session of the Parliamentary Committee on Economy and Finance on draft budget 2024
text: Governor Sejko's remarks at the hearing session of the Parliamentary Committee on Economy and Finance on draft budget 2024 Date of publication: 10.11.2023 Dear Mr. Chairman of the Committee, Dear Ladies and Gentlemen, First of all, let me thank you for the invitation made to appear before this commission and to present the Opinion of the Bank of Albania on the draft budget of 2024. As always, the Bank of Albania has been and remains of the opinion that the drafting of a more optimal budget should be based on realistic analysis and forecasts, provide a fair balance between short-term priorities and medium and long-term objectives, and ensure a better coordination between fiscal policy, monetary policy and the financial situation in which the country is located. In this prism, we are convinced that discussing the draft budget with a wider category of institutional actors and interest groups serves to adopt a qualitative document. Standing within the legal frameworks of our mandate and institutional duties, the following opinion will focus on three main topics. From First, I will share with you the Bank of Albania's view on policy and fiscal measures, which contour this budget. From Second, I will focus on some structural aspects of the budget and tax policy, aspects that affect the effectiveness of fiscal policy and the flexibility of public finances in dealing with shocks. From Third, I will briefly present some constant suggestions of the Bank of Albania for increasing the long-term sustainability of public finances. Summarily, I find it fitting to point out that  in our judgment  the draft submitted for review is based on a realistic framework of macroeconomic forecasts. The draft budget also provides for a consolidating fiscal policy, which is in line with our monetary policy, as well as addresses some of the country's sustainable and long-term development priorities. In parallel with these findings, I would like to emphasize that this draft budget confirms the progress made over the years, in terms of respecting the principles of fiscal responsibility, increase of technical and analytical capacities, as well as priority addressing development needs. However, I also find it fitting to stress that the challenges we face remain serious and complex. For this reason, all institutional actors of the country's development should be attentive to economic developments, continuously assess the appropriateness of the policies they pursue, and ensure the flexibility necessary for timely response to potential shocks. Dear Ladies and Gentlemen, let me further detail our opinion, starting from the first point. 1. Konteksti makroekonomik dhe politika fiskale The 2024 draft budget takes place in a relatively favorable context of economic developments in the country. The Albanian economy has faced a continuous series of challenges over the past four years: the earthquake of 2019, the pandemic of 2020-2021, and the economic and financial consequences of the military conflict in Ukraine. These challenges have required a refocus of economic policies and have had a relatively high financial bill. However, the Albanian economy has shown an admirable degree of resistance, reflecting the flexibility of the private sector, the fruits of the continuous work we have done to strengthen economic and financial stability, as well as the success of the countercyclical policies we have pursued. Consequently, after the rapid recovery recorded during 2021 and 2022, economic activity in the country expanded further during 2023. According to our estimates, the Albanian economy is expected to grow around 3.5% during the current year and to see further growth over the next year. This economic growth has enabled a general increase in employment and wages, as well as an improvement of the country's economic and financial balances. More specifically, inflation has been a progressive decline in 2023, budget deficits and current account deficits have been reduced, the country's public and foreign debt has fallen, while the financial balance sheets of the banking sector and of businesses and households are healthy. In this context of developments, the Bank of Albania judges that the priority of fiscal policy should be twofold: on the one hand, this policy should aim to further consolidate the country's economic, monetary and financial stability and, on the other hand, should raise attention to long-term development challenges. In our judgment, the draft budget of 2024 maintains a good balance between these two objectives. Fiscal policy is designed to maintain its consolidation side during 2024, anchored in an overall budget deficit, about 2.5% of GDP level, and in a positive primary balance, around the 0.2% level of GDP. The Bank of Albania finds that this fiscal policy orientation serves to strengthen the economic and financial balances of the country and is consistent with the direction of our monetary policy. To further elaborate on this point, I want to emphasize the following. First, maintaining the fiscal policy consolidation policy enables a faster return and lower inflation costs to the target. In our judgment, high inflation rates have been and remain the priority challenge of our economic policies. High inflation erodes the purchasing power of households, undermines the well-being of low-income strata of society, and reduces the efficiency of resource allocation in the economy, while curbing the country's sustainable and long-term growth. This inflation was initially driven by the rapid rise in prices in world markets over the past year, but it is finding a growing support from the high demand for goods and services and the observed shortages in our domestic labour market, shortages that have been accompanied by rapid increases in wages and production costs. Therefore, in order to respect our legal objective of price stability, we have undertaken a gradual normalization of the monetary policy stance. However, as we have noted in our public communications, the intensity of this normalization has been lower than that applied by the European Central Bank and the central banks of the countries of the region, due to fiscal consolidation and exchange rate strengthening during 2023. In this prism, I find it fitting to emphasize that maintaining the fiscal policy consolidation in the next year enables this approach to preserve, i.e. a more gradual normalization of the monetary policy stance, creating the premise not only for a faster return of inflation to the target, but also for minimizing costs on the private sector. Second, maintaining the consolidating fiscal policy supports the long-term sustainability of public finances. Projections suggest that public sector gross debt is expected to drop below 60% of GDP in 2024, marking its lowest level for more than a decade. As we have repeatedly noted, the high level of public debt has been and remains one of the structural weaknesses of the Albanian economy, reducing our ability to cope with shocks and dictating higher financing costs for the private sector. For this reason, we have sought and supported any fiscal policy initiatives that enable sustainable reduction of public debt. Third, maintaining the consolidating fiscal policy supports the sustainability of domestic financial markets. Fiscal consolidation means lower financing needs during the year, helping to control the yield curve in the domestic financial market, as well as reducing the fluctuations in interest rates in it. In the revenue stream, the 2024 draft budget foresees an overall increase in public revenues at the level of 3.8%, dictated by an expected decrease in revenue from grants, to the tune of 45%, and an expected increase in tax revenues, to the tune of 6.3%. The expansion of tax revenues is based on projections for increasing the volume of economic activity, on little changes  but nevertheless with positive contribution to the budget  of tax policy, as well as on the expected effects of measures to reduce tax evasion. In our judgment, the revenue projection for 2024 is achievable. Also, the Bank of Albania welcomes the reduction of changes in tax and customs tariffs, as well as the increased focus towards increasing the formalization of the economy. These objectives serve to increase transparency and efficiency of tax policy, as well as strengthening fair competition in the private sector. However, the Bank of Albania draws attention to the fact that the rate of public revenue collection in the country  currently around the 28% level of GDP  remains relatively low compared to that of the countries in the region, whose average stands at around 36% of GDP. In this context, we judge: First, timely consolidation of the health of public finances should be based on progressively increasing the level of revenue collection. This approach helps sustain public debt and preserves the necessary spending spaces to support priorities strategic development, and more specifically for investments in education, health and infrastructure; Second, the steady growth of public revenues must be passed by a line of action, which First, to reduce the informality and to look at the space for simplification and balance of tax burden, among different economic categories and social strata. In the expenses, the draft budget of 2024 foresees an increase of their total to 4.3%, dictated by the current expenditure increase of 9.6% and the reduction of capital expenditures to the extent of 6%. Viewed in more detail, the current increase reflects the effect of wage reform on the public sector, as well as the rising cost of debt servicing, as a result of the increase in financing costs at home and globally. On the other hand, the reduction in the level of public investment appears to have been dictated by the decrease by 60% of funds allocated for the reconstruction process. Overall, the Bank of Albania judges that the structure of public expenditure addresses two long-term development priorities. It retains relatively substantial public investment at around 5.3% of GDP level, and provides the necessary funds for wage growth in the public sector, aiming  in particular  to increase efficiency and create the right incentives for employment in priority sectors such as health, education and public order. At the close of this section, I would like to emphasize that  in our judgment  the balance of risks to economic growth and budgetary income projections lies on the downwards. In this context, we continue to suggest drawing up contingency plans, to cope with the potential negative impact that unforeseen impacts can have on income realization. These contingency plans should aim  in any case  to respect the approved budget deficit limits and to maintain the downward trajectory of public debt. Dear ladies and gentlemen, let me now move on to the second point of our opinion. 2. On increasing the effectiveness and preserving the flexibility of public finances The effectiveness and flexibility of public finances are two very important criteria to judge on the extent of meeting two important fiscal policy objectives: supporting the country's long-term development and the ability of fiscal policy to react to unforeseen developments. In this context, it is encouraging that Albanian public finances have historically had a positive primary balance, which has fluctuated around 1.9% of GDP over the past five years. This positive balance means that the Albanian public sector allocates part of its current revenues to financing investments and increasing the stock of public capital, which helps accelerate long-term economic growth. In parallel, a positive primary balance provides the flexibility needed to address various shocks, as the necessary fiscal correction to cope with income shortfalls can be accommodated more easily through a temporary risk-taking of the investment plan rather than through a reduction in current expenditures. The 2024 draft budget preserves this positive feature of our fiscal policy. It predicts a positive current balance, at 2.8% of GDP, which enables the financing of the largest share of public investment for 2024. However, in terms of further increasing the effectiveness and flexibility of public finances in the future, the Bank of Albania suggests the following. First, adopting a work plan, which should aim at sustainable growth of the level of public income. As I pointed out above, the primary direction of work in this regard should be to reduce informality and increase the rate of revenue collection, within the existing tax framework. Meanwhile, in parallel with it, the Bank of Albania supports efforts to adopt  at a reasonable time  a medium-term strategy of public revenue. This strategy should serve as anchor and roadmap of our tax system, re-evaluating the priorities and instruments of this system, as well as increasing its sustainability and predictability. Standing at this point, the Bank of Albania suggests the need to periodically review the efficiency of tax exemptions. These facilities, which aim to support certain social categories or incentivize priority sectors, have a small cost on public finances. For this reason, their implementation should be based on more comprehensive analysis of the costs and benefits that these exemptions have on public finances and the overall development of the country. Second, in terms of the spending structure, the Bank of Albania suggests the possibility of adopting a long-term operational objective, which guarantees the maintenance of a positive current balance at a certain level. Third, the Bank of Albania wants to draw attention to the fact that the implementation of budget indicators  and in particular investment plan  should have a more uniform distribution during the year. Their chronic focus in the second half of the year causes unnecessary fluctuations in economic indicators and financial markets, reducing the efficiency of public spending. Dear ladies and gentlemen, let me now briefly pass through the third and last point. 3. On increasing the long-term sustainability of public finances The 2024 draft budget represents a positive step towards strengthening the long-term sustainability of public finances. This budget envisages reducing public debt, from the 61.5% level of expected GDP for 2023 to 59.8% of GDP for 2024. However, in line with our previous recommendations, we judge that addressing  in the medium and long term  of some issues as follows remains necessary. On the deficits created by the social security and health scheme The financial sustainability of social and health insurance schemes continues to be a serious challenge for the state's finances, especially in the context of unfaiver demographic trends and free movement of the labour force. In the draft budget of 2024, these schemes are projected to create a deficit of around 3.6% of GDP, or 1.1 percentage points higher than the overall budget deficit. For this reason, the Bank of Albania suggests periodic review of the legal framework regulating the pension scheme, that of health insurance and other social security schemes. We also encourage the intensification of efforts to develop the second and third pillars of the private pension system, that of mandatory and voluntary insurance. These important pillars of modern pension systems would contribute to increasing the eligibility of social and health insurance schemes with demographic changes and their placement on sustainable and affordable trajectories for the state budget. On managing Public - Private Partnership Programmes In the interest of increasing effectiveness and reducing potential risks from PPP, the Bank of Albania suggests: involvement long-term legal ceilings on the total contracted value of PPPs. This regulation would be a complementary element of controlling the level of potential risk that PPPs may have over the health of public finances; improvement continuous professional capacities of the units that administer the evaluation, contracting and monitoring of these projects, especially in terms of the legal and financial obligations they charge to the Budget.
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko, n seancn dgjimore t Komisionit Parlamentar t Ekonomis dhe Financave mbi projektbuxhetin 2024 Data e publikimit: 10.11.2023 I nderuar zoti Kryetar i Komisionit, T nderuar zonja dhe zotrinj Deputet, N radh t par, m lejoni tju falnderoj pr ftesn e br, pr tu paraqitur para ktij komisioni dhe pr t prezantuar opinionin e Banks s Shqipris mbi projektbuxhetin e vitit 2024. Si gjithnj, Banka e Shqipris ka qen dhe mbetet e mendimit se hartimi i nj buxheti sa m optimal duhet t bazohet n analiza e parashikime realiste, t ofroj nj balanc t drejt midis prioriteteve afatshkurtra dhe objektivave afatmesm e afatgjat, si dhe t siguroj nj koordinim sa m t mir midis politiks fiskale, politiks monetare dhe situats financiare n t ciln ndodhet vendi. N kt prizm, ne jemi t bindur se diskutimi i projektbuxhetit me nj kategori sa m t gjer aktorsh institucional dhe grupesh interesi i shrben miratimit t nj dokumenti sa m cilsor. Duke qndruar brenda kornizave ligjore t mandatit dhe detyrave tona institucionale, opinioni n vijim do t prqendrohet n tre tema kryesore. S pari, do t ndaj me ju kndvshtrimin e Banks s Shqipris mbi politikn dhe masat fiskale, t cilat konturojn kt projektbuxhet. S dyti, do t ndalem n disa aspekte strukturore t buxhetit dhe t politiks tatimore, aspekte t cilat ndikojn efektivitetin e politiks fiskale dhe fleksibilitetin e financave publike n prballimin e goditjeve. S treti, do t paraqes shkurtimisht disa sugjerime konstante t Banks t Shqipris pr rritjen e qndrueshmris afatgjat t financave publike. N mnyr t prmbledhur, gjej me vend t theksoj se  n gjykimin ton  drafti i paraqitur pr shqyrtim bazohet n nj kuadr realist parashikimesh makroekonomike. Po ashtu, ky projektbuxhet parashikon nj politik fiskale konsoliduese, e cila sht n linj me kahun e politiks son monetare, si dhe adreson disa nga prioritetet e zhvillimit t qndrueshm dhe afatgjat t vendit. Paralelisht me kto konstatime, dshiroj t theksoj se ky projektbuxhet konfirmon progresin e br gjat viteve, n drejtim t respektimit t parimeve t prgjegjshmris fiskale, t rritjes s kapaciteteve teknike dhe analitike, si dhe t adresimit prioritar t nevojave t zhvillimit. Megjithat, gjej po ashtu me vend t theksoj se sfidat me t cilat prballemi mbeten serioze dhe komplekse. Pr kt arsye, t gjith aktort institucional t zhvillimit t vendit duhet t jen t vmendshm ndaj zhvillimeve ekonomike, t vlersojn n vazhdimsi prshtatshmrin e politikave q ndjekin, si dhe t sigurojn fleksibilitetin e nevojshm pr reagimin n koh ndaj goditjeve t mundshme. T nderuar zonja dhe zotrinj deputet, m lejoni t detajoj m tej opinionin ton, duke nisur nga pika e par. 1. Konteksti makroekonomik dhe politika fiskale Projektbuxheti i vitit 2024 merr jet n nj kontekst relativisht t favorshm zhvillimesh ekonomike n vend. Ekonomia shqiptare sht prballur me nj seri t vazhdueshme sfidash gjat katr viteve t fundit: trmeti i vitit 2019, pandemia e viteve 2020  2021, si dhe pasojat ekonomike e financiare t konfliktit ushtarak n Ukrain. Kto sfida kan krkuar nj rifokusim t politikave ekonomike dhe kan pasur nj fatur relativisht t lart financiare. Megjithat, ekonomia shqiptare ka dshmuar nj shkall t admirueshme rezistence, duke pasqyruar fleksibilitetin e sektorit privat, frytet e puns s vazhdueshme q kemi br pr forcimin e stabilitetit ekonomik e financiar, si dhe suksesin e politikave kundrciklike q kemi ndjekur. Pr pasoj, pas rikuperimit t shpejt t shnuar gjat viteve 2021 e 2022, aktiviteti ekonomik n vend u zgjerua m tej gjat vitit 2023. Sipas vlersimeve tona, ekonomia shqiptare pritet t rritet rreth nivelit 3.5% gjat vitit aktual dhe t shnoj rritje t mtejshme gjat vitit t ardhshm. Kjo rritje ekonomike ka mundsuar nj rritje t prgjithshme t punsimit dhe t pagave, si dhe nj prmirsim t ekuilibrave ekonomik dhe financiar t vendit. M konkretisht, inflacioni ka shnuar rnie progresive gjat vitit 2023, deficiti buxhetor dhe ai i llogaris korrente kan ardhur n reduktim, borxhi publik dhe ai i jashtm i vendit ka rn, ndrsa bilancet financiare t sektorit bankar dhe t bizneseve e familjeve jan t shndetshme. N kt kontekst zhvillimesh, Banka e Shqipris gjykon se prioriteti i politiks fiskale duhet t jet i dyfisht: nga njra an, kjo politik duhet t synoj konsolidimin e mtejshm t stabilitetit ekonomik, monetar e financiar t vendit dhe, nga ana tjetr, duhet t rris vmendjen ndaj sfidave afatgjata t zhvillimit. Po n gjykimin ton, projektbuxheti i vitit 2024 ruan nj balanc t mir midis ktyre dy objektivave. Politika fiskale projektohet t ruaj kahun e vet konsolidues gjat vitit 2024, e ankoruar n nj deficit t prgjithshm buxhetor, rreth nivelit 2.5% t PBB-s, dhe n nj balanc primare pozitive, rreth nivelit 0.2% t PBB-s. Banka e Shqipris konstaton se ky orientim i politiks fiskale i shrben forcimit t ekuilibrave ekonomik e financiar t vendit dhe sht konsistent me kahun e politiks son monetare. Pr ta shtjelluar m tej kt pik, dshiroj t theksoj sa m posht. S pari, ruajtja e kahut konsolidues t politiks fiskale mundson nj kthim m t shpejt dhe me kosto m t ulta t inflacionit n objektiv. N gjykimin ton, nivelet e larta t inflacionit kan qen dhe mbeten sfida prioritare e politikave tona ekonomike. Inflacioni i lart grryen fuqin blerse t familjeve, dmton mirqenien e shtresave me t ardhura t pakta t shoqris, si dhe ul eficiencn e shprndarjes s burimeve n ekonomi, duke frenuar rritjen e qndrueshme dhe afatgjat t vendit. Ky inflacion u nxit fillimisht nga rritja e shpejt e mimeve n tregjet botrore gjat vitit t shkuar, por ai po gjen nj mbshtetje n rritje nga krkesa e lart pr mallra e shrbime dhe nga mungesat e vna re n tregun ton t brendshm t puns, mungesa t cilat jan shoqruar me rritje t shpejt t pagave dhe t kostove t prodhimit. Pr kt arsye, n funksion t respektimit t objektivit ton ligjor t stabilitetit t mimeve, ne kemi ndrmarr nj normalizim gradual t qndrimit t politiks monetare. Megjithat, sikundr e kemi theksuar n komunikimet tona publike, intensiteti i ktij normalizimi ka qen m i ult se ai i aplikuar nga Banka Qendrore Evropiane dhe nga bankat qendrore t vendeve t rajonit, pr arsye t konsolidimit fiskal dhe t forcimit t kursit t kmbimit gjat vitit 2023. N kt prizm, gjej me vend t theksoj se ruajtja e kahut konsolidues t politiks fiskale gjat vitit t ardhshm mundson ruajtjen e ksaj prqasjeje, pra nj normalizim m gradual t qndrimit t politiks monetare, duke krijuar premisa jo vetm pr nj kthim m t shpejt t inflacionit n objektiv, por edhe pr minimizimin e kostove mbi sektorin privat. S dyti, ruajtja e kahut konsolidues t politiks fiskale i shrben qndrueshmris afatgjat t financave publike. Projeksionet e projektbuxhetit sugjerojn se borxhi bruto i sektorit publik pritet t zbres posht nivelit 60% t PBB-s gjat vitit 2024, duke shnuar dhe nivelin m t ult t tij pr m shum se nj dekad. Sikundr e kemi theksuar n vazhdimsi, niveli i lart i borxhit publik ka qen dhe mbetet nj ndr dobsit strukturore t ekonomis shqiptare, duke reduktuar aftsin ton n prballimin e goditjeve dhe duke diktuar kosto m t larta financimi pr sektorin privat. Pr kt arsye, ne kemi krkuar dhe mbshtetur do nism e politik fiskale q mundson reduktimin e qndrueshm t borxhit publik. S treti, ruajtja e kahut konsolidues t politiks fiskale nxit qndrueshmrin e tregjeve t brendshme financiare. Konsolidimi fiskal nnkupton nevoja m t ulta pr financim gjat vitit, duke ndihmuar kontrollin e kurbs s yield-eve n tregun e brendshm financiar, si dhe duke reduktuar luhatjet e normave t interesit n t. N kahun e t ardhurave, projektbuxheti i vitit 2024 parashikon nj rritje t prgjithshme t t ardhurave publike n nivelin 3.8%, t diktuar nga nj rnie e pritur e t ardhurave nga grantet, n masn 45%, dhe nj rritje e pritur e t ardhurave tatimore, n masn 6.3%. Zgjerimi i t ardhurave tatimore bazohet n projeksionet pr rritjen e vllimit t aktivitetit ekonomik, n ndryshime t pakta  por gjithsesi me kontribut pozitiv n buxhet  t politiks tatimore, si dhe n efektet e pritura t masave pr uljen e evazionit fiskal. N gjykimin ton, projeksioni i t ardhurave pr vitin 2024 sht i arritshm. Gjithashtu, Banka e Shqipris mirpret reduktimin e ndryshimeve t tarifave tatimore e doganore, si dhe shtimin e fokusit n drejtim t rritjes s formalizimit t ekonomis. Kta objektiva i shrbejn rritjes s transparencs dhe eficiencs s politiks tatimore, si dhe forcimit t konkurrencs s ndershme n sektorin privat. Megjithat, Banka e Shqipris trheq vmendjen n faktin se shkalla e mbledhjes s t ardhurave publike n vend - aktualisht rreth nivelit 28% t PBB-s - mbetet relativisht e ult n krahasim me at t vendeve t rajonit, mesatarja e t cilave qndron rreth nivelit 36% t PBB-s. N kt kontekst, ne gjykojm se: s pari, konsolidimi n koh i shndetit t financave publike duhet t bazohet n rritjen progresive t nivelit t grumbullimit t t ardhurave. Kjo prqasje ndihmon qndrueshmrin e borxhit publik dhe ruan hapsirat e nevojshme pr shpenzime n mbshtetje t prioriteteve strategjike t zhvillimit, e m konkretisht pr investime n arsim, shndetsi dhe infrastruktur; s dyti, rritja e qndrueshme e t ardhurave publike duhet t kaloj nga nj linj aksioni, e cila duhet t synoj fillimisht reduktimin e informalitetit dhe m tej t shikoj hapsirat pr thjeshtimin dhe drejtpeshimin e barrs tatimore, midis kategorive t ndryshme ekonomike dhe shtresave sociale. N kahun e shpenzimeve, projektbuxheti i vitit 2024 parashikon nj rritje t totalit t tyre n masn 4.3%, t diktuar nga rritja e shpenzimeve korrente n masn 9.6% dhe reduktimi i shpenzimeve kapitale, n masn 6%. E par m n detaje, rritja e shpenzimeve korrente pasqyron efektin e reforms s pagave n sektorin publik, si dhe rritjen e kostos s shrbimit t borxhit, si pasoj e shtrenjtimit t kostove t financimit n vend dhe n bot. Nga ana tjetr, reduktimi i nivelit t investimeve publike duket se sht diktuar nga rnia me 60% e fondeve t alokuara pr procesin e rindrtimit. N trsi, Banka e Shqipris gjykon se struktura e shpenzimeve publike adreson dy prioritete afatgjata t zhvillimit. Ajo ruan hapsira relativisht t konsiderueshme pr investime publike, rreth nivelit 5.3% t PBB-s, si dhe siguron fondet e nevojshme pr rritjen e pagave n sektorin publik, duke synuar  n veanti  rritjen e eficiencs dhe krijimin e stimujve t duhur pr punsim, n sektor prioritar si shndetsia, arsimi dhe rendi publik. N mbyllje t ktij seksioni, dshiroj t theksoj se - n gjykimin ton  balanca e rreziqeve ndaj projeksioneve t rritjes ekonomike dhe t t ardhurave buxhetore qndron n kahun e poshtm. N kt kontekst, ne vazhdojm t sugjerojm hartimin e planeve t kontigjencs, pr t prballuar ndikimin e mundshm negativ, q goditje t paparashikuara mund t ken n realizimin e t ardhurave. Kto plane kontigjence duhet t synojn  n do rast  respektimin e kufijve t miratuar t deficitit buxhetor dhe ruajtjen e trajektores rnse t borxhit publik. T nderuar zonja dhe zotrinj deputet, m lejoni tani t kaloj n pikn e dyt t opinionit ton. 2. Mbi rritjen e efektivitetit dhe ruajtjen e fleksibilitetit t financave publike Efektiviteti dhe fleksibiliteti i financave publike jan dy kritere mjaft t rndsishme pr t gjykuar mbi shkalln e prmbushjes s dy objektivave t rndsishm t politiks fiskal: mbshtetjen e zhvillimit afatgjat t vendit dhe aftsin e politiks fiskale pr t reaguar ndaj zhvillimeve t paparashikuara. N kt kontekst, sht inkurajues fakti se financat publike shqiptare kan pasur historikisht nj balanc primare pozitive, e cila sht luhatur rreth nivelit 1.9% t PBB-s gjat pes viteve t fundit. Ky bilanc pozitiv nnkupton q sektori publik shqiptar alokon nj pjes t t ardhurave korrente t tij pr financimin e investimeve dhe rritjen e stokut t kapitalit publik, ka ndihmon n prshpejtimin e rritjes ekonomike afatgjat. Paralelisht me t, nj balanc primare pozitive siguron fleksibilitetin e nevojshm pr adresimin e goditjeve t ndryshme, pasi korrektimi i nevojshm fiskal pr prballimin e mungesave n t ardhura mund t akomodohet m leht nprmjet nj riskedulimi t prkohshm t planit t investimeve sesa nprmjet nj reduktimi t shpenzimeve korrente. Projektbuxheti i vitit 2024 ruan kt tipar pozitiv t politiks son fiskale. Ai parashikon nj balanc korrente pozitive, n nivelin 2.8% t PBB-s, e cila mundson financimin e pjess m t madhe t investimeve publike pr vitin 2024. Megjithat, n drejtim t rritjes s mtejshme t efektivitetit dhe fleksibilitetit t financave publike n t ardhmen, Banka e Shqipris sugjeron sa m posht. S pari, adoptimin e nj plani pune, i cili duhet t synoj rritjen e qndrueshme t nivelit t t ardhurave publike. Si e theksova dhe m lart, drejtimi primar i puns n kt drejtim duhet t jet reduktimi i informalitetit dhe rritja e shkalls s grumbullimit t t ardhurave, brenda kuadrit tatimor ekzistues. Ndrkoh, paralelisht me t, Banka e Shqipris mbshtet prpjekjet pr adoptimin  n nj koh sa m t arsyeshme  t nj strategjie afatmesme t t ardhurave publike. Kjo strategji duhet shrbej si ankor dhe udhrrfyes i sistemit ton tatimor, duke rivlersuar prioritetet dhe instrumentet e ktij sistemi, si dhe duke rritur qndrueshmrin dhe parashikueshmrin e tij. Duke qndruar n kt pik, Banka e Shqipris sugjeron nevojn e rishikimit periodik t eficiencs s prjashtimeve tatimore. Kto lehtsi, t cilat synojn mbshtetjen e kategorive t caktuara shoqrore apo incentivimin e sektorve prioritar, kan nj kosto jo t pakt mbi financat publike. Pr kt arsye, zbatimi i tyre duhet t bazohet n analiza m t plota t kostove e prfitimeve q kto prjashtime kan mbi financat publike dhe zhvillimin e prgjithshm t vendit. S dyti, n drejtim t strukturs s shpenzimeve, Banka e Shqipris sugjeron mundsin e adoptimit t nj objektivi operacional afatgjat, i cili t garantoj ruajtjen e nj balance korrente pozitive, n nj nivel t caktuar. S treti, Banka e Shqipris dshiron t trheq vmendjen n faktin se realizimi i treguesve t buxhetit  dhe n veanti i planit t investimeve  duhet t ket nj shprndarje m t njtrajtshme gjat vitit. Prqendrimi kronik i tyre n gjysmn e dyt t vitit shkakton luhatje t panevojshme n treguesit ekonomik dhe tregjet financiare, duke ulur dhe eficiencn e shpenzimeve publike. T nderuar zonja dhe zotrinj, m lejoni tani t kaloj shkurtimisht n pikn e tret e t fundit. 3. Mbi rritjen e qndrueshmris afatgjat t financave publike Projektbuxheti i vitit 2024 prbn nj hap pozitiv n drejtim t forcimit t qndrueshmris afatgjat t financave publike. Ky projektbuxhet parashikon reduktimin e borxhit publik, nga niveli 61.5% t PBB-s i pritur pr vitin 2023 n nivelin 59.8% t PBB-s pr vitin 2024. Megjithat, n linj me rekomandimet tona t mparshme, ne gjykojm se mbetet i nevojshm adresimi  n afatin e mesm dhe t gjat  i disa shtjeve, si n vijim. Mbi deficitet e krijuara nga skema e sigurimeve shoqrore dhe shndetsore Qndrueshmria financiare e skemave t sigurimeve shoqrore dhe shndetsore vijon t jet nj sfid serioze pr financat e shtetit, sidomos n kontekstin e trendeve jo t favorshme demografike dhe t lvizjes s lir t forcs puntore. N projektbuxhetin e vitit 2024, kto skema parashikohet t krijojn nj deficit rreth nivelit 3.6% t PBB-s, ose 1.1 pik prqindjeje m t lart se deficiti i prgjithshm buxhetor. Pr kt arsye, Banka e Shqipris sugjeron rishikimin periodik t kuadrit ligjor q rregullon skemn e pensioneve, at t sigurimeve shndetsore dhe skemat e tjera t sigurimeve sociale. Po ashtu, ne inkurajojm intensifikimin e prpjekjeve pr zhvillimin e shtylls s dyt e t tret t sistemit privat t pensioneve, at t sigurimit t detyrueshm dhe vullnetar. Kto shtylla t rndsishme t sistemeve moderne t pensioneve do t kontribuonin n rritjen e prshtatshmris s skemave t sigurimeve shoqrore dhe shndetsore me ndryshimet demografike dhe vendosjen e tyre n trajektore t qndrueshme dhe t prballueshme pr buxhetin e shtetit. Mbi administrimin e Programeve t Partneritetit Publik - Privat N interes t rritjes s efektivitetit dhe t reduktimit t rreziqeve potenciale q vijn nga PPP, Banka e Shqipris sugjeron: prfshirjen e tavaneve ligjore afatgjata mbi vlern e prgjithshme t kontraktuar t PPP-ve. Ky rregullim do t ishte nj element plotsues i kontrollit t nivelit t rrezikut potencial q PPP-t mund t ken mbi shndetin e financave publike; prmirsimin e vazhdueshm t kapaciteteve profesionale t njsive q administrojn vlersimin, kontraktimin dhe monitorimin e ktyre projekteve, sidomos sa i takon detyrimeve ligjore dhe financiare q ato i ngarkojn Buxhetit.

Title: Governor Sejko's speech on New Year's Eve of the Albanian Association of Banks
text: Governor Sejko's speech on New Year's Eve of the Albanian Association of Banks Date of publication: 15.12.2023 Dear Chairman of the Albanian Association of Banks, Distinguished Participants, As with every year, I look forward to this moment of meeting with the banking industry, where together we balance our achievements and efforts over the past year, share the best experiences, and restore priorities for the year ahead. Let me begin with the general economic situation of the country. 2023 was a positive year for the Albanian economy. Although the internal and external challenges we have faced have not been few, the Albanian economy continues to grow, generate new jobs and improve almost all internal and external balances. According to our forecasts, economic activity is expected to grow around 3.5%. In parallel, employment and wages have increased, inflation is on a clear downward trend, public and foreign debt have reduced, the balance of trade and financial exchanges with abroad has marked a significant progress and the balance sheets of the banking sector are showing healthy. As I have repeatedly pointed out, this positive performance - not only in the Albanian context, but also in the regional and European context - is not accidental. It has reflected the solid foundations of the economy, the flexibility of the private sector, the response in the direction and timely of public policy, and  to a small extent  the positive contribution of the banking industry. In response to the increased inflationary pressures, which were and remain a significant risk to the country's monetary and financial stability, the Bank of Albania has undertaken a gradual process of normalization of the monetary policy stance. This reaction is not a reflexive or dogmatic act. It stems from an in-depth analysis of the economic situation and an internal conviction that price destabilization endangers the economic and financial stability of the country as a whole, including the health of the balance sheets of the banking sector, and risks undermining all the progress achieved in recent years. The reaction of our monetary policy has been determined, aiming to create the right monetary premises for returning inflation to target, but also prudent, aiming to generate a lower impact on the Albanian economy. It has also relied on periodic updates of analysis and forecasts, as well as coordinated with the consolidating fiscal policy and strengthening trend of exchange rates. The first fruits of our response are obvious, making a material contribution to the down-trend of inflation. However, the battle with inflation is not yet won. Our commitment has been and remains to take all necessary measures, at the appropriate time and intensity, to provide the Albanian economy with a low and stable inflation, a reliable currency to maintain savings, and a safe and predictable monetary environment to undertake long-term business plans. Honorable participant, During 2023, the activity of the banking sector marked a modest increase, about 3%, in terms of total client assets and deposits, which constitute the primary source of growth. This growth has been massively supported by private sector businesses. Also, the loan portfolio showed growth dominated by the loan in the local currency and the loan for real estate. By September, the loan exceeded 720 billion ALL, while customer deposits in banks exceeded ALL 1,556 billion. It seems that the sector has sufficient resources, but needs to improve efficiency in the process of financial intermediation in the economy. The non-500 loan rate stood at 5.1%, but the positive is that the level of provisional coverage of this portfolio has increased to 71% (from 67% last year). The banking sector improved significantly in financial performance during 2023. The primary role in profit growth this year was the indexation of interest rates for banking products, which was faster for loans and titles, while it occurred slower for accounts and deposits of customers. In fact, this is a phenomenon that has happened with banking activity in the region and beyond. The capitalization level of the banking system continued to rise this year to 19.63%, reflecting the increase in regulatory requirements for macroprudential reserves and outstanding intervention reserves (MREL). Both of these elements have enhanced the stability and security of the banking system. We have had quite positive developments in the improvement of the payment infrastructure, helped by the improvement of the regulatory framework in the field of payment systems. For the second consecutive year, the AIPS Euro system is already continuing to bear its fruits in the banking system and in the Albanian economy. Based on available statistics, interbank transactions in euros for customers within the country have increased about 42% in the first 11 months of 2023. The benefits for economic actors have increased significantly, saving the Albanian economy at least 22 million euros. The use of the system, beyond reducing transaction costs, has contributed to the shortening of the necessary time and costs for managing physical money. Other positive developments also come from the expansion of the use of electronic payments, where with the completion of the National Strategy for Small Value Payments, the number of electronic payments per capita per year has nearly doubled to 18, against the target of 10 payments. These achievements reflect the coordination of joint efforts and proactive approach of the banking system through significant expansion of necessary infrastructure and services. But despite these developments, it is necessary to continue with the same intensity and commitment to the timely implementation of projects such as open-banking, instant payment and payment systems upgrade. The latter aims at the transition to ISO 20022 and SEPA communication standards, which will digitalise and modernize the market in its entirety and create potential for integration with the European Union markets.
