Finally, but not least, we need to intensify and further expand the cooperation within the implementation of the National Strategy for Education and Financial Inclusion, an essential mechanism for maximizing the expected effects of the measures taken so far in the framework of digitalization and financial inclusion. Dear Leaders of the Banking System, Despite the challenges and difficulties that have evoked the rise of inflation this year, the projections for the growth of the Albanian economy remain positive. However, addressing these challenges requires a carefully coordinated and parameterized response, not only by monetary policy instruments, but also by effective and forward-looking cooperation of all market actors. Let me mention some of the main challenges that are anticipated for the coming year. First, let me reiterate that the still high level of inflation may require further monetary policy reactions. If necessary, this reaction should be understood correctly by you and should not be a surprise in your activity. Second, non-NS loans should remain an important warning signal for all banks. The Bank of Albania warned last year that the rising cost of loans carries the risk of rising non-performing loans, as long as the borrowers' solvent ability has not increased proportionally as prices rise. Early-stage management of creditors' problems remains key to avoiding accumulation of problematic portfolios that paralyze the credit process. In this context, the risk that may arise from exposure to real estate, whether through direct financing or high accumulation of collateral from this category, should be considered. The Bank of Albania, in order to ensure the creation of adequate reserves for the coverage of this risk, has introduced regulatory changes that require the retention of a higher capital for speculative financing of real estate, which came into force at the beginning of this year. Also, in early October 2023, the regulation "On data reporting, identification and monitoring of indicators on lending and investments in real estate" was adopted, according to which banks will start reporting the standardized reporting of these residential real estate exposures in March 2024. We expect from banks a rigorous implementation and correct interpretation of the above provisions. Third, increasing the adoption of developments in information technology, in the most secure way, requires your maximum attention. Not only in theory but also in practice, it became clear during this year the critical importance it has for banking activity, the security of information systems and all associated processes related to identifying problems in this area, reporting, solving and testing them. Although the banking industry is generally evaluated positively for the quality of these systems, we assess that they need to be strengthened. This requires your continued engagement and investment in specialized human resources and special technologies, which are constantly evolving. It is important that engagement in this process is made in a conscious manner, not only highlighting the advantages that new technologies offer, but also by understanding the risks that can accompany their hasty adoption. In this regard, the Bank of Albania will strengthen cooperation with you and relevant public authorities over the next year, with a view to improving the effectiveness and applicability of legal and regulatory requirements. Fourth, the shocks we have faced in recent years have highlighted the still insufficient rate of development of the primary and secondary securities markets, as well as the low presence of derivative instruments that provide protection from exchange rate and interest rate risks. I am convinced that we as regulators and you as an industry need to do more in terms of further development of financial markets and products. I believe that I find your understanding, stressing that the development of these markets should be the focus of our agenda for the future. Fifth, even during 2024, in accordance with the regulatory provisions and the respective gradual application programme, capital requirements (macroprudential additions and requirements for regulatory capital instruments and accepted liabilities) will continue to increase. The implementation of these requirements, beyond aligning our regulatory framework with that of the EU, ensures not only a higher stability of the banking system against the above mentioned shocks, but also the continuity of the provision of financial services, already integrated into the daily lives of citizens and businesses. Consolidation of the banking system and the increase of the number of high-weight banks in the system makes it imperative to treat differentiated banks to mitigate systemic risks and effects on taxpayers' money in case of possible future crises. I think it is important that this year's higher revenues are harnessed by banks to increase the medium-term sustainability of capital indicators and support financial intermediation. In closing, taking advantage of this communication, I find it fitting to add that the banking sector has been an important factor of stability in facing the ongoing challenges of the past years. You have continued to support the albanian business with the necessary funds for expanding consumption and investments, as well as to meet the needs for circulating capital. This contribution is recognized and accepted by all analysts and actors of economic life. With a look to the future, let me emphasize that the country's development prospects remain solid and positive. Our forecasts suggest that economic activity will continue to increase, both in the medium and long-term horizons. Furthermore, the Process of European Integration offers material opportunity for a qualitative step in the economic development of the country. By inviting you to share this positive development vision, I ask you to continue to maintain a positive approach to credit, supporting the Albanian economy and especially its nevralgic sectors such as tourism, agriculture, etc., but also by ensuring a prudent and sustainable growth of your activity. Finally, let me assure you that the Bank of Albania, in the exercise of its function as supervisor and regulator, will continue to be your supporter and partner, both on good days and on difficult days, offering transparency, cooperation and objective assessment of your requests and proposals in every decision-making. Wishing you a good and successful year in every direction!
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n mbrmjen e Vitit t Ri t Shoqats Shqiptare t Bankave Data e publikimit: 15.12.2023 I nderuar Kryetar i Shoqats Shqiptare t Bankave, T nderuar pjesmarrs, Si do fundvit, e pres me shum knaqsi kt moment takimi me industrin bankare, ku s bashku bjm bilancin e arritjeve dhe prpjekjeve tona gjat vitit q kaloi, ndajm eksperiencat m t mira, si dhe rivendosim prioritetet pr vitin q na pret. M lejoni t ndalem fillimisht n situatn e prgjithshme ekonomike t vendit. Viti 2023 ishte nj vit pozitiv pr ekonomin shqiptare. Ndonse sfidat e brendshme e t jashtme me t cilat jemi prballur, nuk kan qen t pakta, ekonomia shqiptare vijoi t shnoj rritje, t gjeneroj vende t reja pune dhe t prmirsoj thuajse t gjith ekuilibrat e brendshm e t jashtm. Sipas parashikimeve tona, aktiviteti ekonomik pritet t rritet rreth nivelit 3.5%. Paralelisht me t, punsimi e pagat kan ardhur n rritje, inflacioni sht n nj trend t qart rns, borxhi publik dhe ai i huaj jan reduktuar, bilanci i shkmbimeve tregtare e financiare me jasht ka shnuar nj progres t dukshm dhe bilancet e sektorit bankar paraqiten t shndetshme. Sikundr e kam theksuar n vazhdimsi, kjo ecuri pozitive - jo vetm n kontekstin shqiptar, por edhe n at rajonal e evropian - nuk sht e rastsishme. Ajo ka pasqyruar fondamentet solide t ekonomis, fleksibilitetin e sektorit privat, reagimin n kahun dhe n kohn e duhur t politikave publike, si dhe  n nj mas jo t vogl - kontributin pozitiv t industris bankare. N prgjigje t presioneve t shtuara inflacioniste, t cilat ishin dhe mbeten nj rrezik i qensishm pr stabilitetin monetar dhe financiar t vendit, Banka e Shqipris ka ndrmarr nj proces gradual normalizimi t qndrimit t politiks monetare. Ky reagim i yni nuk sht nj veprim refleksiv apo dogmatik; ai buron nga nj analiz e thell e situats ekonomike dhe nj bindje e brendshme se destabilizimi i mimeve rrezikon stabilitetin ekonomik dhe financiar t vendit n trsi, prfshi dhe shndetin e bilanceve t sektorit bankar, si dhe rrezikon t dmtoj gjith progresin e arritur gjat viteve t fundit. Reagimi i politiks son monetare ka qen i vendosur, duke synuar t krijoj premisat e duhura monetare pr kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv, por edhe i matur, duke synuar t gjeneroj nj impakt sa m t ult mbi ekonomin shqiptare. Gjithashtu, ai sht mbshtetur n rifreskimin periodik t analizave dhe parashikimeve, si dhe ka qen i koordinuar me kahun konsolidues t politiks fiskale dhe trendin forcues t kursit t kmbimit. Frytet e para t reagimit ton jan t dukshme, duke dhn nj kontribut material n trendin rns t inflacionit. Megjithat, beteja me inflacionin nuk sht ende e fituar. Angazhimi yn ka qen dhe mbetet t marrim t gjitha masat e nevojshme, n kohn dhe n intensitetin e duhur, pr ti ofruar ekonomis shqiptare nj inflacion t ult e t qndrueshm, nj monedh t besueshme pr t ruajtur kursimet, si dhe nj ambient monetar t sigurt e t parashikueshm pr t ndrmarr plane afatgjata biznesi. T nderuar pjesmarrs, Gjat vitit 2023, veprimtaria e sektorit bankar shnoi nj rritje modeste, rreth 3%, n terma t totalit t aktiveve dhe depozitave t klientve, t cilat prbjn burimin parsor t rritjes. Kjo rritje sht mbshtetur masivisht nga fondet e bizneseve t sektorit privat. Po ashtu, portofoli i kredis shfaqi rritje t dominuar nga kredia n monedhn vendase dhe kredia pr prona t patundshme. Deri n shtator, kredia kaprceu vlern prej 720 mld leksh, ndrsa depozitat e klientve n banka kaprcyen vlern 1,556 mld lek. Si duket, sektori i ka burimet e mjaftueshme, por ka nevoj t prmirsoj eficiencn n procesin e ndrmjetsimit financiar n ekonomi. Niveli i kredive me probleme qndroi n 5.1%, por pozitiv sht fakti q niveli i mbulimit me provigjione t ktij portofoli sht rritur n 71% (nga 67% vitin e kaluar). Sektori bankar prmirsoi dukshm performancn financiare gjat vitit 2023. Rolin parsor n rritjen e fitimit kt vit e ka pasur indeksimi i normave t interesit pr produktet bankare, i cili ka qen m i shpejt pr kredit dhe titujt, ndrsa ka ndodhur m ngadal pr llogarit dhe depozitat e klientve. N fakt, ky sht nj fenomen q ka ndodhur me veprimtarin bankare edhe n rajon e m gjer. Niveli i kapitalizimit t sistemit bankar vijoi t rritet edhe kt vit, n 19.63%, duke reflektuar edhe rritjen e krkesave rregullatore pr rezervat makroprudenciale dhe rezervat pr ndrhyrje t jashtzakonshme (MREL). T dy kto elemente kan rritur qndrueshmrin dhe sigurin e sistemit bankar. Zhvillime mjaft pozitive kemi pasur edhe n prmirsimin e infrastrukturs s pagesave, ndihmuar edhe nga prmirsimi i kuadrit rregullator n fushn e sistemeve t pagesave. Pr t dytin vit radhazi, sistemi AIPS Euro tashm po vijon t jap frytet e tij n sistemin bankar dhe n ekonomin shqiptare. Bazuar n statistikat e disponueshme, transaksionet ndrbankare n euro pr klient brenda vendit jan rritur rreth 42% n 11 muajt e par t vitit 2023. Prfitimet pr aktort ekonomik jan rritur ndjeshm, duke i kursyer ekonomis shqiptare t paktn 22 milion euro. Prdorimi i sistemit, prtej reduktimit t kostove t transaksioneve, ka ndikuar n shkurtimin e kohs s nevojshme dhe kostove pr administrimin e paras fizike. T tjera zhvillime pozitive vijn edhe nga zgjerimi i prdorimit t pagesave elektronike, ku me prfundimin e Strategjis Kombtare pr Pagesat n Vler t Vogl, numri i pagesave elektronike pr frym n vit sht gati dyfishuar n 18, prkundrejt objektivit prej 10 pagesash. Kto arritje reflektojn bashkrendimin e prpjekjeve t prbashkta dhe prqasjen proaktive t sistemit bankar nprmjet zgjerimit t ndjeshm t infrastrukturs dhe shrbimeve t nevojshme. Por, pavarsisht ktyre zhvillimeve, sht e nevojshme t vijohet me t njjtin intensitet dhe angazhim edhe pr realizimin n koh t projekteve si open-banking, instant payment dhe upgrade t sistemeve t pagesave. Ky i fundit synon kalimin n standardet e komunikimit ISO 20022 dhe SEPA, t cilat do t digjitalizojn dhe modernizojn tregun n trsin e tij dhe do t krijojn potencial pr integrimin me tregjet e Bashkimit Evropian. S fundi, por jo m pak e rndsishme, duhet t intensifikojm dhe zgjerojm m tej bashkpunimin n kuadr t zbatimit t Strategjis Kombtare t Edukimit dhe Prfshirjes Financiare, nj mekanizm ky thelbsor pr maksimizimin e efekteve t pritshme nga masat e marra deri m tani n kuadr t digjitalizimit dhe prfshirjes financiare. T nderuar drejtues t sistemit bankar, Pavarsisht sfidave dhe vshtirsive q ka evokuar rritja e inflacionit gjat ktij viti, parashikimet pr rritjen e ekonomis shqiptare mbeten pozitive. Megjithat, prballimi i ktyre sfidave krkon nj prgjigje t koordinuar dhe t parametrizuar me kujdes, jo vetm nga instrumentet e politiks monetare, por edhe nga nj bashkpunim efektiv dhe largpams i t gjith aktorve t tregut. M lejoni t prmend disa nga sfidat kryesore q parashikohen pr vitin q vjen. S pari, m lejoni t ritheksoj se niveli ende i lart i inflacionit mund t krkoj reagime t mtejshme t politiks monetare. Nse do t jet i nevojshm, ky reagim duhet t kuptohet drejt nga ju dhe nuk duhet t prbj surpriz n aktivitetin tuaj. S dyti, kredit me probleme duhet t mbeten nj sinjal i rndsishm paralajmrues pr t gjitha bankat. Banka e Shqipris paralajmroi vitin e kaluar se rritja e kostos s kredive mbart rrezikun e rritjes s kredive me probleme, pr sa koh q aftsia paguese e kredimarrsve nuk sht rritur n mnyr proporcionale me rritjen e mimeve. Menaxhimi n faza t hershme i problemeve t kredimarrsve mbetet kyi pr shmangien e akumulimit t portofoleve problematike, q paralizojn procesin kreditues. N kt kuadr duhet konsideruar edhe rreziku q mund t vij nga ekspozimi ndaj pasurive t patundshme, qoft nprmjet financimit direkt apo akumulimit t lart t kolateraleve nga kjo kategori. Banka e Shqipris, pr t siguruar krijimin e rezervave t duhura pr mbulimin e ktij rreziku, ka prezantuar ndryshimet rregullative q krkojn mbajtjen e nj sasie kapitali m t lart pr financimin spekulativ t pasurive t paluajtshme, t cilat kan hyr n fuqi n fillim t ktij viti. Gjithashtu, n fillim t tetorit 2023, u miratua rregullorja Pr raportimin e t dhnave, identifikimin dhe monitorimin e treguesve mbi kredidhnien dhe investimet n pasurit e paluajtshme, sipas s cils bankat do t fillojn raportimin e standardizuar t ktyre ekspozimeve pr pasurit e paluajtshme rezidenciale n muajin mars 2024. Presim nga bankat nj zbatim rigoroz dhe interpretim sa m korrekt t dispozitave t msiprme. S treti, rritja e adoptimi i zhvillimeve n teknologjin e informacionit, n mnyr sa m t sigurt, krkon vmendjen tuaj maksimale. Jo vetm n teori por edhe n praktik, u b e qart gjat ktij viti rndsia kritike q ka pr veprimtarin bankare, siguria e sistemeve t informacionit dhe e t gjitha proceseve shoqruese q lidhen me identifikimin e problemeve n kt fush, raportimin, zgjidhjen dhe testimin e tyre. Pavarsisht se industria bankare vlersohet n trsi pozitivisht pr cilsin e ktyre sistemeve, vlersojm se ato kan nevoj t forcohen. Kjo krkon angazhimin tuaj t vazhdueshm dhe investime n burime njerzore t specializuara e teknologji t posame, tcilat evoluojn vazhdimisht. sht e rndsishme q angazhimi n kt proces t bhet n mnyr t vetdijshme, duke evidentuar jo vetm prparsit q ofrojn teknologjit e reja, por duke kuptuar edhe rreziqet q mund t shoqrojn adoptimin e nxituar t tyre. N kt drejtim, Banka e Shqipris do ta forcoj bashkpunimin me ju dhe autoritetet relevante publike gjat vitit t ardhshm, me synimin pr t prmirsuar efektivitetin dhe zbatueshmrin e krkesave ligjore dhe rregullative. S katrti, goditjet me t cilat jemi prballur gjat viteve t fundit kan evidentuar shkalln ende t pamjaftueshme t zhvillimit q kan tregjet primare e sekondare t letrave me vler, si dhe prezencn e ult t instrumenteve derivative q ofrojn mbrojtje nga rreziqet e kursit t kmbimit dhe t normave t interesit. Jam i bindur se ne si rregullator dhe ju si industri duhet t bjm m shum n drejtim t zhvillimit t mtejshm t tregjeve e produkteve financiare. Besoj se gjej mirkuptimin tuaj, duke theksuar se zhvillimi i ktyre tregjeve duhet t jet n fokus t agjends son pr t ardhmen. S pesti, edhe gjat vitit 2024, n prputhje me parashikimet rregullative dhe programin prkats t aplikimit gradual, do t vijojn t rriten krkesat pr kapital (shtesat makroprudenciale dhe krkesat pr instrumente t kapitalit rregullator dhe detyrimeve t pranuara). Zbatimi i ktyre krkesave, prtej prafrimit t kuadrit ton rregullator me at t BE-s, siguron jo vetm nj qndrueshmri m t lart t sistemit bankar ndaj goditjeve t prmendura m sipr, por edhe vazhdimsin e ofrimit t shrbimeve financiare, tashm t integruara n jetn e prditshme t qytetarve dhe bizneseve. Konsolidimi i sistemit bankar dhe rritja e numrit t bankave me pesh t lart n sistem e bn imperativ trajtimin e diferencuar t tyre pr t zbutur rreziqet sistemike dhe efektet mbi parat e taksapaguesve, n rast krizash t mundshme n t ardhmen. Vlersoj se sht e rndsishme q t ardhurat m t larta t ktij viti, t shfrytzohen nga bankat pr t rritur qndrueshmrin afatmesme t treguesve t kapitalit dhe mbshtetjen e ndrmjetsimit financiar. N mbyllje, duke prfituar nga ky komunikim, gjej me vend t shtoj se sektori bankar ka qen nj faktor i rndsishm stabiliteti n prballjen me sfidat e vazhdueshme t viteve t fundit. Ju keni vijuar t mbshtesni biznesin e familjet shqiptare me fondet e nevojshme pr zgjerimin e konsumit e t investimeve, si dhe pr prballimin e nevojave pr kapital qarkullues. Ky kontribut sht njohur e pranuar nga t gjith analistt e aktort e jets ekonomike. Me vshtrimin nga e ardhmja, m lejoni t theksoj se perspektivat e zhvillimit t vendit mbeten solide e pozitive. Parashikimet tona sugjerojn se aktiviteti ekonomik do t vijoj t shnoj rritje, si n horizontin afatmesm dhe n at afatgjat. Pr m tepr, procesi i integrimit evropian ofron oportunitete materiale pr nj hap cilsor n zhvillimin ekonomik t vendit. Duke ju ftuar t ndani kt vizion pozitiv zhvillimi, krkoj nga ju t vazhdoni t ruani prqasjen pozitive ndaj kreditimit, duke mbshtetur ekonomin shqiptare dhe veanrisht sektort nevralgjik t saj si turizmi, bujqsia etj., por edhe duke siguruar nj rritje prudente e t qndrueshme t aktivitetit tuaj. S fundi, m lejoni tju siguroj se Banka e Shqipris, n ushtrimin e funksionit t saj si mbikqyrs dhe rregullator, do t vijoj t jet mbshtetsi dhe partneri juaj, si n dit t mira dhe n dit t vshtira, duke ofruar transparenc, bashkpunim dhe vlersim objektiv t krkesave dhe propozimeve tuaja, n do vendimmarrje. Ju uroj nj vit t mbar dhe t suksesshm n do drejtim!

Title: Remarks by Governor Sejko at the International Conference of the Faculty of Economics of the University of Tirana
text: Address of Governor Sejko at the International Faculty Conference Economics of the University of Tirana Date of publication: 16.12.2023 Dear Mr. Rector/ Dean, Honorable Participant, First of all, let me thank you for your invitation and the opportunity you give me to Welcome to the conference. Let me also note that my pleasure today is twofold. First, because I am returning to the premises of the Faculty of Economics of the University of Tirana. This faculty has been and remains one of the most important educational institutions in the country. He has produced a constellation of scholars and has supplied the country with a series of practitioners, who have made an invaluable contribution to the process of its development and transformation. Second, because the topic chosen for this conference is as current as far-sighted. Albania has made an unquestionable progress on its path to development. However, this progress has often been painful and nonlinear, while the road ahead is still long and challenging. For this reason, building a common vision on development priorities and developing comprehensive and consistent strategies for their fulfillment is an essential process to shorten time and reduce the costs of progress. Based on the experience and diversity of the participants, I am convinced that the work of this conference will provide a major contribution to the push forward of the development agenda. Taking advantage of the opportunity of this greeting word, I would like to share with you some of my views on the topic of economic restructuring and sustainable development of the country. Honorable participant, In a historical perspective, Albania has shown an admirable development in the last three decades. Over this period, per capita income in the country has increased significantly, from an average of about 600 (U.S.) in 1990 to over 8,000 in 2023. In the course of three decades, Albania has gone from a low-income country to a middle-income country  high. This progress has not always been easy and often difficult. He has demanded a radical change of the economic system, from a centralized economy to a free market economy. He also called for a comprehensive restructuring of the economy, implying the shift of human and financial resources, from relatively unproductive activities and industries to sectors that offer greater growth and development potential. The reconfiguration of the Albanian economy has brought a significant increase in the relative weight of the services and construction sectors, as well as a corresponding decline in the weight of the agriculture and industry sectors. In general terms, these trends constitute a converging movement towards the economic structure of developed countries. In a more specific view, the development of the service sector has benefited from the competitive advantages that Albania offers, while the development of the construction sector is dictated by the need for a quantitative and quality improvement of the country's infrastructure. On the other hand, the progressive decline of the weight of the agricultural sector is in line with the sector-specific problems and the shift of the population towards urban areas, while the development of the industry sector has been restrained partly by the inefficient base inherited from the past and partly by the small success we have had in attracting strategic investors. To return to the topic of the conference, I want to emphasize that one of the success stories of the Albanian economy over the last few years has been the development of the tourism sector. Inflows of tourists have expanded, from 1.2 billion in 2010, to 2.8 billion in 2022 and are on track to reach 4 billion euros in 2023. This journey is reflected in a gradual and continuous improvement of the country's current exchange balance, which improved from double-digit deficit levels at the beginning of the previous decade to a surplus during the first quarters of 2023. Based on current trends, continued investments in infrastructure and further improvement of our tourism offer, I am convinced that this sector will continue to remain a supporting factor of the economic and social welfare growth in the future. However, looking to the future, I want to share with you some milestones  based on world and Albanian practice  which I think should guide the future development of the economy. First, the country's development and restructuring should be seen as a joint effort of the country's public, private and financial sector. In my judgment, no sector is capable of pushing forward the development agenda alone, just as no development strategy can be successful without the consensus and support of each of them. In this context, I find it fitting to emphasize that the primary actor of the country's development has been and will remain the private sector. This sector has been proven to be more attentive to developmental opportunities, faster in response and more efficient in using resources. However, I also find it appropriate to note that the private sector should aim for a constant refresh of the philosophy and management practices, to constantly adapt to the challenges of time and increasing competition, both nationally and regionally and europeanly. In the same way, the financial sector has an essential role to develop. It should provide the required financial funds and products, as well as provide the necessary consultancy in the field of business risk management and financial risk. So far, I am pleased to find that the banking sector  as the dominant segment of the financial industry  has successfully performed this task. Although we still fall short of the standards we aim for, this sector has continuously offered the Albanian economy the necessary funds - even in extreme shock situations, like those we have experienced over the last three years, and is continuously increasing the range of financial services. The sound financial balances of this sector, guaranteed by careful regulation and supervision by the Bank of Albania, lead me to believe that  even in the future  the banking sector will remain an important development promoter. On the other hand, the main task of the public sector has been and remains to provide a stable monetary and financial environment, as a non-negotiable prerequisite for long-term growth, the creation of a more stable, clear, consistent and reliable legal and fiscal environment, as well as the continuous investment in physical infrastructure and human resources. In parallel, the public sector should be attentive to development trends, provide short-term support for struggling sectors or medium-term incentives for priority sectors, but avoid the temptation to engage in long-term sector development policies, beyond the strategic national security sectors. Second, the development and restructuring of the Albanian economy must find a just balance between specialization and diversification. An extreme specialization in sectors or industries in which the country has competitive advantages, by nature or thanks to human investment, may offer a faster path of development, but  in turn  it makes an economy more susceptible to shocks. On the other hand, an extreme diversification makes an economy more resilient to specific shocks, but also more inefficient and less prosperous. Finding and maintaining a just balance between these extremes is no easy task. Large countries may have the luxury of having more diversified and complex economic structures, but for small and developing countries  such as Albania  this option is often impossible or unrealistic. However, I am convinced that between the two extremes set out above, we will know how to find an economic structure that enables us to develop not only rapidly but also sustainable. Third, sustainable development must be a just and balanced development between economic and social strata, as well as between geographical regions. Any restructuring, both natural and beneficial, is a premise of tension between different sectors of the economy or between different geographic regions, as rapid development often tends to deepen social differences. In my judgment, our joint task, as policymakers and as a society, is to ensure that these necessary processes do not leave behind any segment of the Albanian society. Thanks again for the invitation to greet the opening of the works, I wish the conference many successes!
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit Sejko n Konferencn Ndrkombtare t Fakultetit t Ekonomis t Universitetit t Tirans Data e publikimit: 16.12.2023 I nderuar zoti Rektor / Dekan, T nderuar pjesmarrs, N radh t par, m lejoni tju falnderoj pr ftesn tuaj dhe mundsin q m jepni pr t prshndetur punimet e ksaj konference. M lejoni, po ashtu, t theksoj se knaqsia ime sot sht e dyfisht. S pari, sepse po rikthehem n ambientet e Fakultetit t Ekonomis t Universitetit t Tirans. Ky fakultet ka qen e mbetet nj nga institucionet m t rndsishme t arsimit n vend. Ai ka prodhuar nj plejad studiuesish dhe ka furnizuar vendin me nj sr praktikantsh, t cilt kan dhn nj kontribut t pamuar n procesin e zhvillimit e transformimit t tij. S dyti, sepse tema e zgjedhur pr kt konferenc sht sa aktuale aq edhe largpamse. Shqipria ka shnuar nj progres t padiskutueshm n rrugn e saj t zhvillimit. Megjithat, ky progres ka qen shpesh i dhimbshm dhe jolinear, ndrsa rruga q kemi prpara sht ende e gjat dhe sfiduese. Pr kt arsye, ndrtimi i nj vizioni t prbashkt mbi prioritetet e zhvillimit dhe hartimi i strategjive gjithprfshirse e konsistente pr prmbushjen e tyre, sht nj proces i domosdoshm pr t shkurtuar kohn dhe pr t ulur kostot e progresit. Bazuar n eksperiencn dhe larmin e pjesmarrsve, jam i bindur se punimet e ksaj konference do t ofrojn nj kontribut t madh n shtyrjen prpara t agjends s zhvillimit. Duke prfituar nga mundsia e ksaj fjale prshndetse, dshiroj t ndaj me ju n vazhdim disa pikpamje t miat mbi temn e ristrukturimit ekonomik dhe zhvillimin e qndrueshm t vendit. T nderuar pjesmarrs, N nj kndvshtrim historik, Shqipria ka treguar nj zhvillim t admirueshm n tre dekadat e fundit. Gjat ksaj periudhe, e ardhura pr frym n vend sht rritur ndjeshm, nga nj mesatare prej rreth 600 dollarsh (amerikan) n vitin 1990 n mbi 8.000 dollar n vitin 2023. Pr rrjedhoj, n harkun e tre dekadave, Shqipria ka kaluar nga nj vend me t ardhura t ulta n nj vend me t ardhura mesatare  t larta. Ky progres ka qen jo gjithnj i leht dhe shpesh i mundimshm. Ai ka krkuar nj ndryshim radikal t sistemit ekonomik, nga nj ekonomi e centralizuar n nj ekonomi t tregut t lir. Gjithashtu, ai ka krkuar nj ristrukturim trsor t ekonomis, duke nnkuptuar zhvendosjen e burimeve njerzore e financiare, nga aktivitete dhe industri relativisht joproduktive, n sektor t cilt ofrojn oportunitete m t mdha rritjeje dhe zhvillimi. Rikonfigurimi i deritanishm i ekonomis shqiptare ka sjell nj rritje t ndjeshme t peshs relative t sektorit t shrbimeve dhe t ndrtimit, si dhe nj rnie korresponduese t peshs s sektorit t bujqsis dhe t industris. N nj kndvshtrim t prgjithshm, kto tendenca prbjn nj lvizje konverguese drejt strukturs ekonomike t vendeve t zhvilluara. N nj kndvshtrim m specifik, zhvillimi i sektorit t shrbimeve ka prfituar nga avantazhet konkurruese q ofron Shqipria, ndrsa zhvillimi i sektorit t ndrtimit sht diktuar nga nevoja pr nj prmirsim sasior e cilsor t infrastrukturs s vendit. Nga ana tjetr, rnia progresive e peshs s sektorit bujqsor sht n linj me problemet specifike t ktij sektori dhe zhvendosjen e popullsis drejt zonave urbane, ndrsa zhvillimi i sektorit t industris sht frenuar pjesrisht nga baza ineficiente e trashguar nga e kaluara dhe pjesrisht nga suksesi i pakt q kemi pasur n trheqjen e investitorve strategjik. Pr tu rikthyer te tema e konferencs, dshiroj t theksoj se nj nga historit e suksesit t ekonomis shqiptare gjat viteve t fundit ka qen zhvillimi i sektorit t turizmit. Flukset hyrse turistike jan zgjeruar, nga 1.2 miliard euro n vitin 2010, n 2.8 miliard euro n vitin 2022 dhe jan n rrug t mbar pr t arritur 4 miliard euro n vitin 2023. Ky rrugtim sht pasqyruar n nj prmirsim gradual dhe t vazhdueshm t bilancit t shkmbimeve korrente t vendit, bilanc i cili u prmirsua nga nivele dyshifrore deficiti n fillim t dekads paraardhse n nj suficit gjat tremujorve t par t vitit 2023. Duke u bazuar n trendet aktuale, investimet e vazhdueshme n infrastruktur dhe prmirsimin e mtejshm t oferts son turistike, jam i bindur se ky sektor do t vijoj t mbetet nj faktor mbshtets i rritjes s mirqenies ekonomike dhe shoqrore edhe n t ardhmen. Megjithat, duke par nga e ardhmja, dshiroj t ndaj me ju disa piketa  t mbshtetura n praktikn botrore dhe shqiptare  t cilat mendoj se duhet t orientojn zhvillimin e ardhshm t ekonomis. S pari, zhvillimi dhe ristrukturimi i vendit duhen par si nj prpjekje e prbashkt e sektorit publik, privat dhe financiar t vendit. N gjykimin tim, asnj sektor nuk sht i aft t shtyj prpara i vetm agjendn e zhvillimit, ashtu sikundr asnj strategji zhvillimi nuk mund t jet e suksesshme pa konsensusin e mbshtetjen e secilit prej tyre. N kt kontekst, gjej me vend t theksoj se aktori primar i zhvillimit t vendit ka qen dhe do t mbetet sektori privat. Ky sektor sht provuar n vazhdimsi t jet m i vmendshm ndaj oportuniteteve t zhvillimit, m i shpejt n reagim dhe m eficient n prdorimin e resurseve. Megjithat, gjej po ashtu me vend t theksoj se sektori privat duhet t synoj nj rifreskim konstant t filozofis e praktikave t menaxhimit, pr tiu prshtatur n vazhdimsi sfidave t kohs dhe konkurrencs n rritje, si n plan kombtar ashtu edhe rajonal e evropian. N t njjtn linj, sektori financiar ka nj rol esencial zhvillimi. Ai duhet t siguroj fondet e produktet e krkuara financiare, si dhe t ofroj konsulencn e nevojshme n fushn e administrimit t rrezikut t biznesit dhe t rrezikut financiar. Deri tani, konstatoj me knaqsi se sektori bankar  si segmenti dominues i industris financiare  e ka kryer me sukses kt detyr. Ndonse mbetemi ende larg standardeve q synojm, ky sektor i ka ofruar n vazhdimsi ekonomis shqiptare fondet e nevojshme, - edhe n situata ekstreme goditjesh, si ato q kemi prjetuar gjat tre viteve t fundit, dhe po rrit n vazhdimsi gamn e shrbimeve financiare. Bilancet e shndosha financiare t ktij sektori, t garantuara edhe nga nj rregullim e mbikqyrje e kujdesshme nga Banka e Shqipris, m shtyjn t besoj se  edhe n t ardhmen  sektori bankar do t mbetet nj promotor i rndsishm zhvillimi. Nga ana tjetr, detyra kryesore e sektorit publik ka qen dhe mbetet ofrimi i nj ambienti t qndrueshm monetar e financiar, si nj parakusht i panegociueshm i rritjes afatgjat, krijimi i nj ambienti ligjor e fiskal sa m t qndrueshm, t qart, konsistent dhe t besueshm, si dhe investimi i vazhdueshm n infrastruktur fizike dhe burime njerzore. Paralelisht me to, sektori publik duhet t jet i vmendshm ndaj trendeve t zhvillimit, t ofroj mbshtetje afatshkurtr pr sektor n vshtirsi apo stimuj afatmesm pr sektor prioritar, por t shmang tundimin e angazhimit n politika afatgjata t zhvillimit sektorial, prtej sektorve strategjik t siguris kombtare. S dyti, zhvillimi dhe ristrukturimi i ekonomis shqiptare duhet t gjejn nj ekuilibr t drejt midis specializimit dhe diversifikimit. Nj specializim ekstrem n sektor apo industri n t cilat vendi ka avantazhe konkurruese, nga natyra apo fal investimeve njerzore, mund ofroj nj rrug m t shpejt zhvillimi, por  nga ana tjetr  ajo e bn nj ekonomi m t ndjeshme ndaj goditjeve. Nga ana tjetr, nj diversifikim ekstrem e bn nj ekonomi m t qndrueshme ndaj goditjeve specifike, por edhe m ineficiente dhe m pak t begat. Gjetja dhe ruajtja e nj ekuilibri t drejt midis ktyre ekstremeve nuk sht detyr e leht. Vendet e mdha mund ta ken luksin e t pasurit t strukturave ekonomike m t diversifikuara e komplekse, por pr vende t vogla e n zhvillim  si Shqipria  kjo alternativ sht shpesh e pamundur ose jorealiste. Megjithat, jam i bindur se midis dy ekstremeve t parashtruara m sipr, ne do t dim t gjejm nj struktur ekonomike, e cila na mundson nj zhvillim jo vetm t shpejt por edhe t qndrueshm. S treti, nj zhvillim i qndrueshm duhet t jet dhe nj zhvillim i drejt e i balancuar midis shtresave ekonomike e shoqrore, si dhe midis rajoneve gjeografike. do ristrukturim, qoft ky dhe i natyrshm e i dobishm, sht premis tensioni midis sektorve t ndryshm t ekonomis apo midis rajoneve t ndryshme gjeografike, ashtu sikundr shpesh zhvillimi i shpejt tenton t thelloj diferencat sociale. N gjykimin tim, detyra jon e prbashkt, si politikbrs dhe si shoqri, sht t kujdesemi q kto procese t nevojshme t mos len pas asnj segment t shoqris shqiptare. Duke ju falenderuar srish pr ftesn pr t pershendetur eljen e punimeve, i uroj konferencs shum suksese!

Title: The speech of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Sejko, at the meeting with journalists, analysts and media executives
text: The speech of the Governor of the Bank of Albania, Mr. Gent Sejko, at the meeting with journalists, analysts and media executives Date of publication: 18.12.2023 Dear representatives of the media, Honorable students, Honorable participant, It's a special treat, to welcome you to our home on this end-of-year holiday eve. This meeting has become a tradition that has been consolidated, where opinion makers, influencers of public opinion, powerful voices of journalism honor us with their presence, not only to spend some moments with each other, but also to hold in parallel the other very special event, that of distributing the Governor's Award for best work. I want to start my speech by addressing a heartfell thank you to all of you who are present in this room today, but at the same time also not forget those media representatives who for the most diverse reasons could not be with us today. This gratitude is due to the realism and truthfulness you have made of the bank of Albania's entire activity during 2023, including its decision making in the field of monetary policy. We believe that your increased professionalism has helped to more efficiently transmit monetary policy in the economy and strengthen the stability of the Albanian banking sector. I take the opportunity to declare that the image of the Bank of Albania and its activity have generally been adequately conveyed to the public throughout 2023. Even in cases when we have had different interpretations we have tried and managed to fully clarify the position and consequences expected to eliminate any misinterpretation or misleading of the truth in public. Second, I want to take a very short pause on some of our most recent achievements and the challenges we are facing. Now that we are in the last month of 2023, we can say that the year we are leaving behind has marked a stable economic situation, which has managed to withstand the shocks caused by the global economy. Economic activity has increased, enabling increased employment and wages and improved financial situation of businesses. In parallel, the public debt and foreign debt of the Albanian economy have declined, while the exchange rate of lek against foreign currencies has strengthened and the index of non-currency loans remains at low levels. I want to emphasize that the overall financial situation of the banking sector is healthy, thus guaranteeing an important source for financing economic activity in the coming years. On the other hand, inflation has kept falling during the third quarter of the year, marking an average value of 4.1%. However, assessing domestic inflationary pressures as relatively strong, the Bank of Albania decided to continue the process of normalizing the monetary policy stance, raising the base interest rate to the level of 3.25%. As we have already noted, through this increase we aim to return inflation to target, at a reasonable time and at lower costs to the economy. On the other hand, the Bank of Albania has implemented measures under the National Strategy of Small Value Payments (2018-2023), which aims to promote financial inclusion of the population and use electronic payments as the most efficient means in the Albanian economy. I want to mention here the recent adoption of the Law on Accounting for Basic Services Payments. This highly important law aims to financially include all those categories of the population that don't own a bank account, or have it and don't use it because of costs. It offers these individuals not only access to accounts but electronic payment services with 50% lower commissions. On the other hand, for vulnerable categories such as pensioners, students, unemployed persons and for those who benefit economic aid, this product is at no cost. In this regard, it is estimated that the implementation of the law will not only contribute to further further overcoming the measures taken within the strategy, but at the same time supports the more efficient conduct of our policies for maintaining price stability and sustainable growth. Our predictions for the future remain in positive territory. Based on the favorable performance of economic developments in the country as well as the reaction of our monetary policy, we anticipate that the Albanian economy will continue to grow further over the coming years. In line with these expectations, the monetary policy response will aim to prevent this growth from translating into inflation, protecting the purchasing power of Albanian households and helping the overall financial health of the economy. As I have already pointed out, monetary policy will continue to maintain its essential role for increasing the overall well-being of the Albanian society, through ensuring price stability and strengthening the financial health of the economy. An important link that will be a more impetus is the health of the Albanian banking system, which enjoys all the attributes to support the economic development of the country with the steps that time dictates. Third, I would like to emphasize that the Bank of Albania will continuously be a playful partner of the media world by guaranteeing transparent and fast communication, stylized in a simple language, easily perceivable by the general public. I express my conviction that you, as to date, will be an important window for the public to follow our activity in public, professionally and quickly. I would like to confirm that our doors are open whenever you need to consult or request additional information about our actions and analysis of the economic and financial situation of the country. Thanking you again for your participation today, I would like to move my word to another plan related to another annual activity of the Bank of Albania, that of distribution of the governor's prize. This 17-year tradition of the Bank of Albania selects and evaluates the three best topics prepared by Albanian graduate students at home and abroad in the field of economics and finance. I am pleased to find that as in the past years, the topics focus on real problems of the economy and finance and use ever more sophisticated methods to evaluate hypotheses and analyse economic and financial data. In this year's competition are 26 students who have submitted their subjects of studies at master's level and university studies. The studies address contemporary topics and explore interesting phenomena in the field of economy and finance that are directly or indirectly related to the activity of the Bank of Albania and the financial market. We are pleased to note that the quality of the jobs presented is very high. Studies fulfill the characteristics of a scientific work based on the application of contemporary scientific research methodologies. The evaluation committee finds that students have applied accurately sophisticated methods to build and structure statistical information. The results and conclusions are based and of value to decision makers. The Commission, though difficult, managed to reach a unanimous decision on the winners of the first three seats of the "Governor's Award for Best Diploma" to be presented in the following. But before we do that, let me thank and congratulate all the participants in the competition for their commitment, the ideas, methods used and the conclusions drawn from your work. I congratulate the winners and invite all applicants to show the same dedication and intellectual ambition in their professional careers!
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Fjala e Guvernatorit t Banks s Shqipris, z. Gent Sejko, n takimin me gazetar, analist dhe drejtues t medias Data e publikimit: 18.12.2023 T nderuar prfaqsues t medias, t nderuar student, t nderuar pjesmarrs, sht nj knaqsi e veant, tju uroj mirseardhjen n shtpin ton n kt prag festash t fundit vitit. Ky takim sht shndrruar n nj tradit t konsoliduar tashm, ku opinion brs, influencues t mendimit publik, zra t fuqishm t gazetaris na nderojn me prezencn e tyre, jo vetm pr t kaluar disa momente me njri tjetrin, por edhe pr t zhvilluar paralelisht eventin tjetr shum t veant, at t shprndarjes s mimit t Guvernatorit pr punimin m t mir. Dshiroj ta filloj fjaln time duke ju drejtuar nj falnderim t przemrt t gjith juve q jeni t pranishm sot n kt sall, por njkohsisht pa harruar edhe ato prfaqsues t medias t cilt pr arsye nga m t ndryshmet nuk kan mundur t jen sot me ne. Ky falnderim merr shkas nga pasqyrimi me realizm dhe vrtetsi q ju i keni br t gjith aktivitetit t Banks s Shqipris gjat vitit 2023, prfshir dhe vendimmarrjen e saj n fushn e politiks monetare. Ne besojm se profesionalizmi i shtuar nga ana juaj, ka ndihmuar n nj transmetim m efikas t politiks monetare n ekonomi dhe n forcimin e stabilitetit t sektorit bankar shqiptar. Prfitoj nga rasti t deklaroj se imazhi i Banks s Shqipris dhe veprimtaria e saj, n prgjithsi jan prcjell n publik, n mnyr adekuate prgjat gjith vitit 2023. Edhe n rastet kur kemi patur interpretime t ndryshme jemi prpjekur dhe ja kemi arritur q n bashkpunim me juve t sqarojm n maksimum qndrimin dhe pasojat e pritshme pr t eliminuar do keqinterpretim apo devijim t t vrtets n publik. S dyti, dshiroj t ndalem shum shkurt n disa nga arritjet tona m t fundit dhe sfidat me t cilat po ballafaqohemi. Tashm q jemi n muajin e fundit t vitit 2023, mund t themi se viti q po lm pas, ka shnuar nj situat ekonomike t qndrueshme, e cila ka arritur ti bj ball goditjeve t shkaktuara nga ekonomia globale. Aktiviteti ekonomik ka ardhur n rritje, duke mundsuar rritje t punsimit e t pagave dhe prmirsim t gjendjes financiare t bizneseve. Paralelisht me t, borxhi publik dhe borxhi i huaj i ekonomis shqiptare kan psuar rnie, ndrkoh q kursi i kmbimit t lekut ndaj monedhave t huaja sht forcuar dhe treguesi i kredive me probleme mbetet n nivele t ulta. Dua t theksoj se gjendja e prgjithshme financiare e sektorit bankar paraqitet e shndetshme, duke garantuar kshtu nj burim t rndsishm pr financimin e aktivitetit ekonomik n vitet n vijim. Nga ana tjetr, inflacioni ka vijuar t shnoj rnie gjat tremujorit t tret t vitit, duke shnuar nj vler mesatare prej 4.1%. Megjithat, duke vlersuar presionet e brendshme inflacioniste si relativisht t forta, Banka e Shqipris vendosi t vijoj procesin e normalizimit t qndrimit t politiks monetare, duke rritur normn baz t interesit n nivelin 3.25%. Si e kemi theksuar edhe m hert, nprmjet ksaj rritjeje synojm kthimin e inflacionit n objektiv, n nj koh t arsyeshme dhe me kosto sa m t ulta pr ekonomin. Nga ana tjetr, Banka e Shqipris ka vijuar zbatimin e masave n kuadr t Strategjis Kombtare t Pagesave me Vler t Vogl (2018-2023), e cila synon nxitjen e prfshirjes financiare t popullsis dhe prdorimin e pagesave elektronike si mjet m efikas n ekonomin shqiptare. Dua t veoj ktu miratimin s fundmi t Ligjit pr llogarin e pagesave me shrbime bazike. Ky ligj mjaft i rndsishm synon t prfshij financiarisht t gjith ato kategori t popullsis q nuk zotrojn nj llogari bankare, ose e kan at dhe nuk e prdorin pr shkak t kostove. Ai u ofron ktyre individve jo vetm akses n llogari, por edhe shrbime pagesash elektronike me komisione 50% m t ulta. Nga ana tjetr pr kategorit vulnerabl si pensionistt, studentt, personat e papun dhe pr ata q prfitojn ndihm ekonomike ky produkt sht pa asnj kosto. N kt kndvshtrim, vlersohet se zbatimi i ligjit jo vetm do t kontribuoj n tejimin e mtejshm t masave t marra n kuadr t strategjis, por njkohsisht mbshtet dhe primin m efikas t politikave tona pr ruajtjen e stabilitetit t mimeve dhe rritjen e qndrueshme. Parashikimet tona pr t ardhmen mbeten n territor pozitiv. Mbshtetur n ecurin e favorshme t zhvillimeve ekonomike n vend si dhe n reagimin e politiks son monetare, ne parashikojm q ekonomia shqiptare do t vazhdoj t rritet m tej gjat viteve n vijim. N prputhje me kto pritshmri, reagimi i politiks monetare do t synoj q kjo rritje t mos prkthehet n inflacion, duke mbrojtur fuqin blerse t familjeve shqiptare dhe duke ndihmuar shndetin e prgjithshm financiar t ekonomis. Si e kam theksuar edhe m par, politika monetare do t vijoj t ruaj rolin e saj esencial pr rritjen e mirqenies s prgjithshme t shoqris shqiptare, nprmjet garantimit t stabilitetit t mimeve dhe fuqizimit t shndetit financiar t ekonomis. Nj hallk e rndsishme q do t jet nj shtys m shum sht dhe shndeti i sistemit bankar shqiptar i cili gzon t gjith atributet pr t mbshtetur zhvillimin ekonomik t vendit me hapat q dikton koha. S treti, do t doja t theksoja se Banka e Shqipris n vazhdimsi do t jet nj partner luajal i bots mediatike duke garantuar nj komunikim transparent dhe t shpejt, t stilizuar n nj gjuh t thjesht, lehtsisht t perceptueshme nga ana e publikut t gjer. Shpreh bindjen time, se ju t nderuar prfaqsues t medias, ashtu si deri m sot, do t jeni nj dritare e rndsishme pr prcjelljen e veprimtaris son n publik, n mnyr profesionale dhe t shpejt. Un dshiroj t konfirmoj se dyert tona jan t hapura sa her q juve do t keni nevoj pr t konsultuar apo krkuar informacion shtes n lidhje me aksionet dhe analizat tona mbi situatn ekonomiko financiare t vendit. Duke ju falnderuar prsri pr pjesmarrjen tuaj sot, dshiroj ta shprngul fjaln time n nj plan tjetr q lidhet me nj tjetr aktivitetit t prvitshm t Banks s Shqipris, at t shprndarjes s mimit t guvernatorit. Kjo tradite 17-vjeare e Banks s Shqipris przgjedh dhe vlerson tre temat m t mira t prgatitura nga student shqiptar t diplomuar brenda dhe jasht vendit n fushn e ekonomis dhe financs. Konstatoj me knaqsi se sikurse edhe gjate viteve t shkuara, temat fokusohen te problemet reale t ekonomis dhe financs dhe prdorin metoda bashkkohore gjithnj e me t sofistikuara pr t br vlersimin e hipotezave dhe analizn e t dhnave ekonomike e financiare. N konkursin e ktij viti jan 26 student q kan paraqitur temat e tyre t studimeve n nivel master dhe studime universitare. Studimet trajtojn tematika bashkkohore dhe hulumtojn fenomene interesante n fushn e ekonomis dhe financs qe lidhen drejtprsdrejti apo n mnyr indirekte me aktivitetin e banks s Shqipris dhe tregut financiar. Vrejm me knaqsi se cilsia e punve t paraqitura sht shum e lart. Studimet prmbushin karakteristikat e nj pun t mirfillt shkencore t bazuar n aplikimin e metodologjive bashkkohore t krkimit shkencor. Komiteti i vlersimit konstaton se studentet kan aplikuar n mnyr t sakt metoda t sofistikuara pr t ndrtuar e strukturuar informacionin statistikor. Rrjedhimisht edhe rezultatet e konkluzionet jan t bazuara dhe me vler pr vendimmarrsit. Komisioni, megjithse me vshtirsi, arriti t marr nj vendim unanim pr fituesit e tre vendeve t para t "mimit i Guvernatorit pr Diplomn m t Mir" q do t paraqiten n vijim. Por para se t bjm kt, m lejoni t falnderoj e t prgzoj t gjith pjesmarrsit n gar pr angazhimin e tyre, pr idet, metodat e prdorura dhe konkluzionet e nxjerra nga puna juaj. Uroj fituesit dhe ftoj t gjith aplikantt t tregojn t njjtin prkushtimin dhe ambicie intelektuale edhe n karriern e tyre profesionale!

Title: Questions  Answers press conference, 20 December 2023
text: Questions  Answers press conference, 20 December 2023 Date of publication: 20.12.2023 Q: You mentioned a few reasons for overestimating the lek, but I wanted to know if you have a plan for next year. If the Bank of Albania will continue to intervene or buy euros in the market for the effect of foreign reserves as happened this year? Governor: In connection with the plan of interventions, we have adopted the calendar of interventions in the market or rather the calendar of euro purchases in the market for the coming year and this calendar has been published. The Bank of Albania has revised the calendar always in function of creating the foreign reserve based on a methodology built with the International Monetary Fund, based on contemporary risks. We expect to have a foreign reserve in 2026, at approximately 7.4 billion. This has led us to increase the purchase forecasts for the next 3 years and in this context, to answer your question, in 2024 we have predicted the increase of purchases in the financial market in view of the addition of foreign reserve, do not mistake with an interval between 270 and 330 million euros, on average, but it could be 290-300 million euros per year. In the coming years we will withdraw from the domestic market more euros than we had previously anticipated and this in order to increase the foreign reserve. The auction calendar is published, the market has no surprises, the financial system, banks, agents operating in the foreign exchange market have no surprises as we publish the calendar. If we have calendar changes during the year, these are published and communicated. Factual purchases in the foreign exchange market are published with a three month delay in transparency, so as not to create speculative effects. This is how the Bank of India operates. Interventions in the foreign exchange market are made according to our regulatory requirements, interventions related to speculation, unnatural fluctuations in the foreign exchange market and which are defined in the regulations of the Bank of Albania. The Bank has exercised the interventions in strict accordance with its regulation, not only today but throughout its three-decade history. The recent overvaluation in the foreign exchange market is a consequence of supply demand, and not only does the balance of payments clearly show the figures of revenues from all sources, so as not to repeat them after I said my word, but at the same time the spreads in the foreign exchange market have been normal and have not requested intervention from the Bank of Albania outside its calendar. We will strictly monitor the foreign exchange market. The Bank of Albania does not have an exchange rate target, I repeat again despite having repeated it many times in the past, because it is good to be stuck in the minds of financial agents and the foreign exchange market that we do not have a target exchange rate. The exchange rate according to the free market regime is determined by the market, so supply demand and our interventions are made in those cases when we see that those criteria and parameters of our regulations are met and are not done in the function of certain interest groups but in the function of the main objectives of the Bank of Albania, which are price stability and financial stability. I have talked about the exchange rate for a long time. If you have specific questions we will always be ready to explain all the details except those we have limited under the regulation, i.e. we make public the interventions and purchases 3 months later after they have occurred. So nothing is secret about the activity of the Bank of Albania in relation to the exchange rate, everything is transparent. This is the principle of how the Bank of Albania operates in a free exchange rate regime. Question: Some banknotes that come out of circulation on December 31st, and will we have other denominations in the future? Governor: Thank you for the question because, despite the fact that we have communicated several times the collection timeframes for some banknotes that have been removed from circulation, there has been confusion regarding this issue especially in some layers of the population, the pensioners' share or perhaps even in rural areas. This may have come from some television images that did not match those of banknotes that come out of circulation. In fact, we talk about those banknotes, part of the 1992 to 1996 show, that have already gone out of circulation These banknotes are shown above the screen and invite the cameras to focus on them. Despite being communicated during these days, we take the opportunity of this press conference to make them public once again. These banknotes were released from circulation about 12-15 years ago, so they no longer have legal savings on the market. They cannot be used for many years for purchases and what the Bank of Albania has done recently is a reminder of the deadline of the final collection and the possibility for individuals to exchange banknotes for legal courses if they may have such. So it's not new information. We have said repeatedly, these banknotes are old and there is very little in circulation. And the fact is that this year very few cuts have been delivered to second-tier banks. But those citizens who may still have banknotes left over from 1992-1996, although they cannot use them in the market for purchase, can go to second-level banks and exchange them for banknotes that are legally available, i.e. they are in use. Conversely, after December 31, if one has banknotes of these series, they can keep them for memory as numismatic value, but will no longer be able to exchange them for real value banknotes for legal course. We have communicated it on many TV shows and again thank you for the question that we communicate and once what the audience is and see clearly on the screen and compare it to what may be left in the house.
text_original: BANKA E SHQIPRIS NJOFTIM PR SHTYP Pyetje  prgjigjet e konferencs pr shtyp, 20 dhjetor 2023 Data e publikimit: 20.12.2023 Pyetje: Ju i prmendt pak arsyet e mbivlersimit t lekut, por doja t dija nse keni nj plan pr vitin e ardhshm. Nse Banka e Shqipris do t vijoj me ndrhyrje apo blerje t eurove n treg pr efekt t rezervs valutore si ndodhi gjat ktij viti? Guvernatori: N lidhje me planin e ndrhyrjeve, ne kemi miratuar kalendarin e ndrhyrjeve n treg ose m mir kalendarin e blerjeve t eurove n treg pr vitin e ardhshm dhe ky kalendar sht publikuar. Banka e Shqipris ka rishikuar kalendarin gjithmon n funksion t krijimit t rezervs valutore bazuar n nj metodologji t ndrtuar me Fondin Monetar Ndrkombtar, bazuar n rreziqet bashkkohore. Parashikojm t kemi nj rezerv valutore n vitin 2026, prafrsisht n nivelin e 7.4 miliard euro. Kjo ka br q ne t rrisim parashikimet pr blerje pr 3 vitet e ardhshme dhe n kt kontekst, pr tiu prgjigjur pyetjes tuaj, n vitin 2024 kemi parashikuar rritjen e blerjeve n tregun financiar n funksion t shtimit t rezervs valutore mos gaboj me nj interval midis 270 dhe 330 milion euro, n mesatare por mund t jet edhe 290-300 milion euro n vit. N vitet e ardhshme ne do t trheqim nga tregu i brendshm m shum euro se far kishim parashikuar m par dhe kjo n funksion t shtimit t rezervs valutore. Kalendari i ankandeve sht i publikuar, tregu nuk ka surpriza, sistemi financiar, bankat, agjentt q operojn n tregun e kmbimit valutor nuk kan surpriza pasi ne e publikojm kalendarin. N rast se kemi ndryshime t kalendarit gjat vitit edhe kto publikohen dhe komunikohen. Blerjet faktike n tregun valutor publikohen me tre muaj vones pr transparenc, n mnyr q t mos krijojm efekte spekulative. Kjo sht mnyra se si operon Banka e Shqipris. Ndrhyrjet n tregun valutor bhen sipas krkesave tona rregullative, ndrhyrje q lidhen me spekulime, me luhatje t panatyrshme n tregun valutor dhe q jan t prcaktuara n rregulloret e Banks s Shqipris. Banka i ka ushtruar ndrhyrjet n prputhje strikt me rregulloren e saj, jo vetm sot por gjat gjith historis s tre dekadave. Mbimimi i fundit n tregun valutor sht pasoj e krkes oferts, dhe jo vetm bilanci i pagesave tregon qartsisht shifrat e t hyrave nga t gjitha burimet, q t mos i prsris pasi un i thash fjaln time, por njkohsisht dhe spread-et n tregun valutor kan qen normale dhe nuk kan krkuar ndrhyrje nga Banka e Shqipris jasht kalendarit t saj. Ne do ta monitorojm strikt tregun e kmbimit valutor. Banka e Shqipris nuk ka nj objektiv t kursit t kmbimit, po e prsris prap pavarsisht se e kemi prsritur shum her n t shkuarn, sepse sht mir q t ngulitet n mendjen e agjentve financiar dhe tregut valutor q ne nuk kemi nj kurs kmbimit t synuar. Kursin e kmbimit sipas regjimit t tregut t lir e prcakton tregu, pra krkes oferta dhe ndrhyrjet tona bhen n ato raste kur ne shikojm q plotsohen ato kritere dhe parametra t rregulloreve tona dhe nuk bhen n funksion t grupeve t caktuara t interesit por n funksion t objektivave kryesor t Banks s Shqipris, q jan stabiliteti i mimeve dhe stabiliteti financiar. Pr kursin e kmbimit un kam folur shum gjat. Nse ju keni pyetje specifike ne do t jemi gjithmon t gatshm tju sqarojm t gjitha detajet me prjashtim t atyre q e kemi t kufizuar sipas rregullores, pra ne i bjm publike ndrhyrjet dhe blerjet 3 muaj m von pasi kan ndodhur. Pra asgj nuk sht sekret n raport me aktivitetin e Banks s Shqipris n lidhje me kursin e kmbimit, gjithka sht transparente. Ky sht parimi sesi operon Banka e Shqipris n nj regjim t lir t kursit t kmbimit. Pyetje: Disa kartmonedha t cilat dalin nga qarkullimi n 31 dhjetor cilat jan ato dhe a do t kemi t tjera prerje n t ardhmen? Guvernatori: Ju falnderoj pr pyetjen sepse, pavarsisht se ne e kemi komunikuar disa her afatin e grumbullimit pr disa kartmonedha q jan hequr nga qarkullimi, ka pasur nj konfuzion lidhur me kt cshtje sidomos n disa shtresa t popullats, pjesa e pensionistve ose ndoshta dhe n zonat rurale. Kjo mund t ket ardhur ndoshta dhe nga disa pamje televizive q nuk kan prkuar me ato t kartmonedhave t cilat dalin nga qarkullimi. N fakt, ne flasim pr ato kartmonedha, pjes e emisionit t vitit 1992 deri n vitin 1996, q kan dal tashm nga qarkullimi Kto kartmonedha jan paraqitur dhe m lart n ekran dhe ftoj kamerat q ti fokusojn. Pavarsisht se jan komunikuar gjat ktyre ditve, shfrytzojm rastin e ksaj konference pr shtyp pr ti br dhe njher publike. Kto kartmonedha kan dal nga qarkullimi rreth 12-15 vjet m par, pra nuk kan m kurs ligjor n treg. Ato prej shum vitesh nuk mund t prdoren pr blerje dhe ajo q Banka e Shqipris ka br s fundi sht nj rikujtes e afatit t grumbullimit prfundimtar dhe dhnies mundsi individve q, nse mund t ken t tilla t mbartura, ti kmbejnr me kartmonedha me kurs ligjor. Pra nuk sht nj informacion i ri. E kemi thn n mnyr t vazhdueshme, kto kartmonedha jan t vjetra dhe shum pak ka n qarkullim. Dhe fakti sht q gjat ktij viti shum pak prerje jan dorzuar pran bankave t nivelit t dyt. Por ata qytetar q mund t ken akoma kartmonedha t mbetura t ktyre serive nga viti 1992-1996 ndonse q nuk mund ti prdorin n treg pr blerje, deri m dat 31 dhjetor mund t shkojn n bankat e nivelit t dyt dhe ti kmbejn me kartmonedhat q jan me kurs ligjor, pra q jan n prdorim. N t kundrt, pas dats 31 dhjetor, nse dikush do t ket kartmonedha t ktyre serive mund ti mbaj pr kujtim si vler numizmatike, por nuk do t jet m n gjendje ti kmbej me kartmonedha me vler reale me kurs ligjor. Ne e kemi komunikuar n shume emisione televizive dhe srish ju falnderoj pr pyetjen q ne ti komunikojm dhe njher se cilat jan dhe publiku ti shoh qartsisht n ekran dhe ti krahasoj me ato q mund ti ket t mbetura n shtpi.

Title: The monetary programme of 2004 - its cohabitation with the fiscal policy
Subtitle: Discussion by Mr Shklqim Cani, Governor of the Bank of Albania, in the Parliamentary Commission of Economy, Finance and Privatizations, Tirana, 15 December 2003.
text: Shkelqim Cani: The monetary programme of 2004 - its cohabitation with the fiscal policy Discussion by Mr Shkelqim Cani, Governor of the Bank of Albania, in the Parliamentary Commission of Economy, Finance and Privatizations, Tirana, 15 December 2003. * * * 1. 2003 in figures The Albanian economy during 2003 seems to have returned to its potential growth rates, leaving behind the deceleration of 2002. Various indicators generally point out that the economic growth forecast for 2003 - of about 6 percent - is a real opportunity. Developments such as: stability in the agricultural production, the positive performance in the branches of services, industry and transport, the increase of the trade transactions volume verified in the first 6 months of the year, the greater number of tourists, the stable and favourable energy situation, stability of remittances and other factors, are reliable arguments in achieving the economy growth objective. 2003 is believed to mark another year of the consumption price stability. As in the 3-4 previous months, the Bank of Albanias expectations speak about an annual inflation rate within the target interval of 2-4 percent. According to the latest data, the 12-month difference of consumption price index by the end of November 2003, marked the figure of 3.4 percent, while the annual inflation, calculated as the average of the last twelve months, reached the level of 2.24 percent, reinforcing thus its clear downward trend. The Bank of Albania - in its recent analyses - has been underlining the fact that its monetary policy has been a careful, financial, budgetary policy, where special emphasis has been given to the budget expenditures control versus the realized revenues ratio. Consequently, the governments liquidity needs, up to the present moment, have been completely covered by the banking system, and therefore, the Bank of Albania financing was unnecessary. Under these circumstances the fiscal pressures on the monetary policy are weak. Following this reasoning, it could be concluded that the move of both policies (monetary and fiscal) has been in harmony and in conformity with the general economic-financial development program of the country. Domestic budget deficit financing from the banking system during 2003 is estimated to be almost at the same level as the one of 2002, being about 2.2 percent of the GDP. The stable level of the internal government borrowing, facing the rapid increase of Lek deposits, was another factor, which influenced the immediate reduction of treasury bills interest rates. The monetary policy of 2003 has continued to be careful, characterized by smoothing tendencies. This is reflected in the reduction of interest rates three times throughout the year. Watching attentively the inflation performance and the liquidity indicators in the banking system, the Bank of Albania reduced, all in all, the Repos rate by 1.5 percentage points during 2003, bring it by the end of October at the pre-crisis liquidity level of the previous year. The real interest rates in positive terms have not changed the attitude of households and agencies in depositing their savings in the banking system. This helped keeping up the liquidity ratios in the system. Monetary developments show that the deposits hemorrhage of spring 2002 has been completely overcome, which is reflected in a liquidity surplus of the banking system, fluctuating round the level of Lek 5.3 billion during 2003. Worth underlining is the fact that, the surplus liquidity brought about the reduction of financial intermediation costs, expressed in the reduction of the difference between the treasury bills and Lek deposits interest rates. Also, considering the appreciating tendencies of Lek during 2003, the Bank of Albania has been present in the foreign exchange market. The foreign exchange activity of the Bank of Albania resulted in the injection of Lek 3.9 liquidity billion, in the market. However, considering the surplus liquidity performance in banks, the Bank of Albania sterilized the foreign exchange purchasing effect. It performed outright selling of treasury bills from its portfolio, at a value of Lek 4.07 billion. The rest of the surplus liquidity was withdrawn through the repurchase agreements. In support of the economy growth, this year seems to have marked a greater support towards the economy crediting. Banks credit portfolio for the private sector of the economy increased by Lek 10.1 billion during the first 10 months of the year. During this period, a new credit of Lek 8/2004 1 70.6 billion (USD 660 million) was extended to the economy, or 45 percent more than the same period in the previous year. Based on the developments noticed during the first ten months, on the current developments of the banking system liquidity, etc., it could be summarized that monetary developments of 2003 will be a greater contribution to the consolidation of the overall macroeconomic equilibrium of the country. In order to have a clearer view of the expected economic situation by end of 2003, following is given a table showing the general indicators of the countrys economic development, including here the monetary ones as well. Source: INSTAT, Ministry of Finances, Bank of Albania and IMF estimations. * * * As a conclusion, I would like to underline once again that the Bank of Albania does not make its policy decisions separately, but following carefully all the developments of the economy, and this is really important for the public to understand. As it is now a tradition, the monetary policy of the Bank of Albania is part of the general economic development program of the country. As such, it cant be but a range of decisions and measures, which in good harmony with the other policies, the fiscal one, etc., 2 8/2004 aim at economy growth and reduction of the poverty in the country. The coordination of monetary and fiscal policies could be achieved in the mid-term development program of the country, a program covering a three-year time span. The extensive logic of this program gives a crucial importance to keeping up macroeconomic stability. Keeping up macroeconomic stability serves as a bridging gap between the monetary policy and the fiscal one. Hence, the monetary policy is committed in keeping up price stability, whereas the fiscal one controls the budget deficit. These macroeconomic indicators are strongly related to one another: fulfilling each of them requires, as a basic condition, the observance of the other objectives. Following this idea and backing it up in figures, please allow me to shortly through a glance back in the past. The soundness of the Albanian state in these last years, the economic growth and amelioration of the tax and customs entities performance, enabled the reduction of the budget deficit. This deficit fell from 11.4 percent of the GDP in 1998 to 6.9 percent in 2002. In 2003, it is expected to fall at the level of 5.8 percent of the GDP, whereas the draft-budget for 2004 has an even more ambitious objective: the reduction of the general budget deficit at the level of 4.8 percent of the GDP. This fiscal discipline has given its own results. It influenced the reduction of treasury bills interest rates, bringing about an overall reduction of interest rates in economy. The reduction of interest rates and the governments demand for funds gave a greater respiration to economy crediting. It has extended more funds - at lower interest rates - to be used by the public sector. According to the data provided by the Bank of Albania, economy crediting increased at an average of 90 percent per year during 1999-2002. On the other side, the reduction of the Bank of Albanias financing to state budget, gave positive impacts on the liquidity indicators in the system. Now the long-term monetary assets gave a straightforward contribution on keeping inflation at low levels. Inflation fell from 8.7 percent in 1998 to 2.1 percent in 2002. In these last three years, it was within the interval of 2-4 percent, as targeted by the Bank of Albania. 2. Monetary program of 2004 Pursuant to drafting and implementing the monetary policy, the Bank of Albania designs each year the monetary program, which is a financial plan aiming at disciplining the funds circulation in economy, in conformity with the development objectives of the country. The main objective is meeting the needs of the economy for monetary assets, without influencing the balance of demand-supply for monetary assets, generating thus inflation or shrinking the economy. The monetary program of 2004 has also been set up on the same premises. Its not a secret the fact that in the coming year as well, as in the previous ones, the two main decision-making institutions of the country in the field of economics and finances, the Albanian Government and the Bank of Albania, have agreed upon the general objectives of the countrys development, including also the so called harmonized cohabitation between the fiscal and monetary policies. This process, albeit all, was part of a constructive consultation with institutions such as IFM and the WB, enabling thus a new financial agreement between these two institutions for 2004. 8/2004 3 Table 2. Main macroeconomic indicators1 2000 2001 Real economy indicators (in point percentage) GDP growth 7.8 6.5 Annual CPI (average) 0.0 3.1 Nominal GDP (Lek billion) 539.2 590.2 Fiscal indicators (in percentage versus the GDP) Fiscal deficit -8.9 -8.2 Monetary indicators (in percentage point) M 3 Growth 12 19.9 3m TB Interest rate 7.8 8.0 2002 4.5 - 5 5.2 678 -6.9 7.0 10.6 2003 6.0 2.3 745 -5.8 9.5 7.6 2004 6.0 3.0 823 -4.8 10.6 2.1 Inflation and monetary policy in 2004 The monetary policy of the Bank of Albania during 2003 was characterized by easing trends of the monetary conditions, in compliance with the lessening the inflationary pressures and improving the monetary indicators. The Bank of Albania took up the implementation of an easing monetary policy since April 2003 reducing the core interest rate by 0.5 percentage point. In July and October 2003, there were two other reductions by 0.5 percentage point each, bringing the core interest rate at the level it was at the beginning of the previous year. At the end of November 2003, the core interest rate was 7.0 percent; the annual inflation rate for that month was 3.4 percent, whereas the average annual inflation by the end of October was just 2.24 percent. The Bank of Albania has been present in the foreign exchange market throughout 2003 by buying foreign exchange. The foreign exchange activity of the Bank of Albania helped in injecting liquidity in the market and it has smoothed the Lek appreciating tendencies during the year. The forecasts for the main trends and inflation for 2004, suggest that the Bank of Albania should apply a similar policy in 2004, too. Developments in the consumption prices are characterized by low inflationary pressures. Our forecasts show that the inflation target of the Bank of Albania will be met during 2003. In case no shock phenomena emerge, inflation will be under control also for 2004. Besides, the expectations on the economy seem to speak about an inflation level sticking to the present one. Liquidity ratios and structures seem to be near their historic levels, whereas interests rates were characterized by downward trends during 2003. Therefore, the Bank of Albania might reconsider the possibility of a further reduction of interest rates, a possibility consisting in the future performance of the monetary and inflationary indicators. This will be in support of the economic activity or inflation target. Judging from the analysis of actual trends, we could say that interest rates during 2004 will be generally stable or in downward trend. The analysis of monetary indicators for 2004 shows that the Bank of Albania is going to be present in the foreign exchange market so as to impede the further appreciation of Lek. Judging from the monetary indicators of these recent years, we notice that Lek supply (M2 growth) in the internal market has been declining due to the lack of governments privatization incomes, which the Bank of Albania converted in Lek by injecting liquidity in the market. The reduced Lek supplies, together with its increased demand (due to the high interests rates of financial assets in Lek during 2003), have been exercising pressures on the Lek appreciation during 2003. 1 Foreign sector forecasts belong to June 2003. 4 8/2004 3. Main suppositions of the monetary program of the Bank of Albania for 2004 In designing the monetary program for 2004 particular attention was given to the Bank of Albanias target, that is keeping up the annual inflation rate within the limits of 2-4 percent. In hitting this target, the monetary program aims the control of money supply growth so that the level of real monetary assets responds to the real needs of the economy for a 6 percent economic growth. The economy demand forecast does still rely on the quasi-constant velocity forecast of money circulation. This forecast, judging from the nominal GDP level, is the bridging gap between inflation and money supply growth (intermediate objective). The monetary program guarantees the observance of quantitative objectives set by the Bank of Albania, the level of NDA and NIR of the Bank of Albania within the limits and the control of governments domestic borrowing at the level of 2.7 of the GDP. 3.1 Money supply and its constituents Money velocity is forecasted to be relatively stable during 2004. This assumption is based on keeping up the monetary developments trends of 2003 even for 2004. Thus:  Inflation is expected to be within the target of the Bank of Albania  Interests rates are expected to be stable or in downward trend  The government demand, which is also the main source of requiring funds, is expected to be at the same level, 2.7 percent of the GDP  The growth rate demand for the economy is expected to be almost the same as the 2003 one.
